Overview: The new CLS combines the elegance of a coupÃ© with the practicality of a saloon. It is a sedan, but Mercedes-Benz marketing folks like to incorrectly call it a coupe. Anyway, the CLS is a very expensive alternative to the car on which it is based, namely the E-Class. The CLS comes with an extensive list of standard features, including ABS with stability program, CD radio with telephone keypad and 8 loudspeakers, cruise control with variable speed limiter, infrared remote control and visual locking-verification signal, speed-sensitive power steering, automatic climate control and two-stage front airbags and side bags, plus window bags. First-year models included the 3.5-litre CLS 350, the 5.0-litre CLS 500 and the 5.4-litre supercharged CLS 55 AMG Kompressor. The second-year models included the carryover CLS 350, the the upgraded 5.5-litre CLS 500 and the all-new 6.2-litre CLS 63 AMG. The whole range was again changed in 2008, coinciding with a facelift. Options include bi-xenon headlamps with Active Light System and cornering light function, COMAND control and display system for radio and navigation, Distronic proximity control, upholstery options, headlamp cleaning system, keyless start, parking sensors, semi-active air suspension, four-zone automatic climate control and a tyre pressure warning system.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. The lengthened four-door wheelbase provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 3.0-litre diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Lamborghini HuracÃ¡n, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the HuracÃ¡n LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The 2015 Dodge Charger SRT received a significant facelift. From 2019, only the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 powered SRT Hellcat was available. It gets an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Charger SRT Hellcat receives a large, power-bulge aluminium hood, which features a dedicated air intake. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The 5th-generation 3-Series convertible was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Kyron is this Korean carmaker's entry into the hotly-contested traditional soft-roader category, only they do it with a real 4WD using truck underpinnings and low-range gearing. Two adults will have no trouble fitting in either front or second row. Behind them is plenty of room for their luggage too. The bench seat also folds down nearly flat to accommodate big, awkward loads like bicycles. The weak part is the 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. The drive system offers a choice of two-wheel drive, four-wheel high, or four-wheel low. The suspension utilizes double wishbones at the front and a multilink design at the rear. Available electronic aids include ABS, hill descent control, traction control, and brake assist. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. No changes were made for the 2018 model year. It has four models - the E200, E250, E300 which get the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and the all-wheel drive E400 which gets the 4.0-litre turbocharged V6 motor. All models get the 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad.  For the first time, air suspension is now offered. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The new Avalon is Toyota's rendition of the traditional big car. The Avalon was designed, engineered and built by the Toyota Technical Center in the United States. Its understated styling is more distinctive than any previous-generation Avalon, presenting a quiet look of grace. There was a very minor facelift in 2008, though no one noticed. Power produced by the powerful 3.5-litre V6 goes to the front wheels, originally via a smooth 5-speed automatic. A 6-speed automatic replaced the previous unit from 2008 onwards. Inside is a comfortable cabin lavished with tasteful materials and ergonomically-designed controls that makes this car a pleasant and cheap alternative to a Lexus. This newest Avalon is significantly larger than previous models. The front seats are roomy and comfortable and special attention was paid to back-seat comfort. The Avalon is smooth and comfortable, quiet and serene, as the suspension was tuned for ride comfort. Trim variations are limited to accessories. Standard features include a premium AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers, remote keyless entry, multi-function information display for audio, climate control, temperature and trip computer, among other things.

Mini released an all-new Cooper and Cooper S 5-door hatchback model in 2015 model. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The Audi S3 sedan made its debut in 2015 and is the performance version of the A3. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The 6-speed manual gearbox version is available in some GCC markets on special order. All-wheel drive is standard in the S3. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, sports seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and alloy wheels. Safety standards are high as in all Audi models with features which include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The S2000 is a small two-seat roadster that can easily chase the likes of the snobby Porsche Boxster. It is a technological innovation from Honda, whose aim with this car was to pump as much horsepower out of a small 2.0-litre engine as possible, without any turbo or supercharging trickery. The S2000 is said to drive like a superbike, because big horsepower from small displacement with a narrow powerband and extremely high rpm produces a very frantic experience. Driving it slowly, shifting the manual at low rpm apparently results in very weak performance in traffic. The latest model has refinements to the engine and suspension put in place back in 2005. Changes to the S2000 in 2006 include more shoulder and elbow room, and some tweaks, most notably 17-inch wheels, drive-by-wire throttle, stability control and new headlights with a triple-beam design. Early models had a plastic rear window, while 2002-plus models get a glass one. The last external facelift was in 2004. Interior features are basic, but include leather upholstery, electric power steering, starter button, power windows, power mirrors, remote central locking, air-conditioning and a pathetic radio cassette stereo with 2 speakers.

The Ford Explorer remains unchanged for 2013, with some slight trim changes and the addition of a new engine option. It is a crossover with a unibody structure and road-biased demeanour. The Explorer is now available with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 model, in addition to the 3.5-litre V6, both engines mated to a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with the base model getting front-wheel-drive and the rest getting full-time all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. There are four trim levels. The base model features include cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic Ford SYNC with 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, 18-inch wheels, three-row seating, keyless entry, cruise control, capless fuel filler, power driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, common power options and more. Available features higher up the trim levels include intelligent access with push button start, three-zone auto a/c, remote engine start, power liftgate, power-adjustable seats and pedals with memory, leather, heated and cooled front seats, MyFord Touch for the Ford SYNC touchscreen, 8-speaker stereo or 12-speaker Sony audio system, Bluetooth, 20-inch polished aluminium wheels, dual moonroof and power-folding third-row seats. The top Limited can be outfitted with further options such as HID headlights, rain-sensing wipers, adaptive cruise control with auto braking and the automatic parallel-parking system. The front-biased all-wheel-drive Explorer has an electronic center coupling that controls the torque split between the front and rear wheels, and acts as a center differential. Standard off-road electronics on AWD models include hill-descent control, hill-ascent assist, four-wheel electronic traction control and a standard "Terrain Management" system that varies drivetrain and ESP characteristics for different conditions. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, Roll Stability Control, stability control and Curve Control. Other optional safety features include inflatable rear-seatbelt airbags, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, and collision warning with pre-crash brake support.

Named after Mitsubishi's famed now-dead sports car, the Eclipse Cross is an economical crossover with no sporting pretensions beyond its sharply sloping rear roofline. Powered by a 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, the Eclipse Cross seats five and is based on the Outlander platform, just like the brand's ASX crossover. The rear seat reclines and slides front-back as needed, to increase legroom or boot space. It has the all modern amenities available, such as power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry and start, multimedia screen, and more. It rides on a choice of 16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor and dual front with optional side-curtain airbags.

A new generation of the Mazda 3 came out in 2020. Mechanically, the engines have carried over from the previous model. One engine is offered in the GCC, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT, or Mercedes-AMG GT as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Four variants of the AMG GT will be available as of 2017, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT C gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT C also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT R is the top performance model, with more power, modified suspension and more aerodynamic thanks to exterior mods. The GT R also gets all-wheel steering for better handling performance. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Ford Fusion receives a facelift, interior updates and more power for 2010. Essentially a modified version of the previous version, this Mexican-built midsize sedan is available in the GCC in a limited number of trim levels. The new look includes a sleeker chrome-grilled front end and a redesigned rear slapped onto the carryover three-box body. While introduced in the U.S. boasting four engines and various transmission options, it is sold here only in front-wheel-drive automatic form with one engine choice. The standard engine is a new 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a  6-speed automatic transmission. Features include the Ford SYNC voice-activated entertainment system, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, power windows, electric mirrors, manual A/C, power driver seat, 12-speaker Sony sound system, fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, capless fuel filler, dual chrome-tipped exhausts, four-wheel disc brakes, reverse sensors and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. Available safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, curtain side airbags, and front side airbags.

The new-for-2008 LX 570 now offers total comfort and luxury, while still offering outstanding off-road capability. Heavily based on the Toyota Land Cruiser, this new one at least gets a unique front end and a different interior. The Lexus version is powered by a new 5.7-litre V8 mated with a new 6-speed automatic transmission. The full-time all-wheel drive features a new 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a new crawl-control feature when in low range. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as multiple airbags. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. A minor facelift in 2010 offered up a new front bumper, an upgrade from 18-inch to 20-inch wheels, and an optional new body kit. For 2011, a new tan leather interior was optionally offered, besides the usual beige and black.

From 2014, the Infiniti G37 Coupe became the Q60 Coupe to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. This generation of the coupe was first offered in 2008. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted 7-speed automatic gearbox. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe and the convertible are proper 2+2 seater cars, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Some markets, such as UAE, now offer only one trim level. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The 206 is  Peugeot's most popular model, originally available with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. The 206 has technically been replaced by the 207, but the 206 continues to be in production due to its popularity. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, with derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet and a fast RC hatchback joining and leaving the line-up. Now available only in 5-door hatchback trim built in Slovakia and in new 4-door sedan trim built in Iran, it acts as a cheaper alternative to the 207. There are only two petrol engines offered since late 2007. The 206 can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic with tiptronic shifting. By mid-2010, only 1.6-litre sedan models remained on sale. All models come with at least front power windows, a cloth interior and other basics as standard. Add-ons such as sunroof, CD player, a single airbag and alloy wheels come in the higher models. Optional comprehensive safety equipment include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, along with dual front airbags.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. The S 65 AMG gets a twin turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. It also  includes a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels.

For 2014, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class gets a redesign. The four headlights have been removed after 17 years and replaced with one-piece LED headlamps. Like most of their new models, for the interior they have incorporated the "Direct Select" lever for the gear instead of the console-mounted shifter. A lot of new technology is borrowed from the 2014 S-Class which includes Stereo Multi-Purpose Camera, Active Parking Assist and a 360-degree camera for a bird's-eye view to aid parking.

The X-Trail is Nissan's entry for the small road-going 4WD market, though for a long time we thought it was really a midsize comparable to the old Pathfinder in size. Developed to attract young adventurous buyers, we find the X-Trail particularly unattractive, but it has proved to be a runaway success with older people just looking for a conservative vehicle that looks like a 4WD. The X-Trail has undergone only slight exterior redesigns and interior upgrades ever since it was launched years ago and is beginning to look dated. Powered by a 2.5-litre four-cylinder engine coupled with a 4-speed automatic or a 5-speed manual transmission, it isn't particularly fast, but a reasonable long-distance cruiser. Full-time four-wheel drive is available when the computer system senses the need for all wheels to be driven to suit demand, but it will get stuck if you take it beyond the beach. The interior is full of storage spaces, including cup-holders, centre console box and other nooks and crannies. ABS brakes and 2 airbags are standard.

An all-new model of the BMW X4 came out for the 2019 model. The X4 20i and X4 xDrive30i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, with two different tunes. Both are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic. The X4 M40i is available with a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder motor, mated to an 8-speed auto transmission as well. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The UK-built Honda Civic hatchback is finally being offered in the GCC as a limited-edition upscale model. Compared to the Japanese-built sedan, everything is different, including the exterior, interior and the suspension, which happens to be non-independent in the rear. The regular model is a loaded 5-door version, while the range-topper is the 3-door Type-R. The 5-door gets a standard 1.8-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed automatic, while the Type-R gets a highly-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual. Features in both models include a starter button, keyless entry, cruise control, 6-speaker CD stereo with AUX and USB ports, parking sensors, HID headlights, dual-zone automatic a/c and more. The 5-door has hidden rear-door handles, 17-inch alloys, leather upholstery and four-wheel disc brakes. The Type-R additionally gets sports seats, Alcantara cabin trim, 18-inch wheels, larger brakes, tuned exhaust system, Type-R badged cabin trim, special exterior trim and a rear spoiler. All models get front and side airbags, stability control, tyre-pressure monitor and ABS.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class sedan. Under the hood, they gets twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

An all-new model of the BMW X3 came out for the 2018 model. The X3 xDrive20i and xDrive30i gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit, while the X3 M40i gets the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Sportage is another of Kia's long-running nameplates, though the crossover itself has changed over time. Whereas the original Sportage was unreliable but could do basic off-roading, the new one is much more dependable but is allergic to sand dunes. It is even offered in a front-wheel-drive model alongside the four-wheel-drive, to dilute the nameplate further. Powered by either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, or a 2.7-litre V6 with a four-speed automatic, it is interesting to note that Kia and parent Hyundai are the first ones to officially offer a V6-powered small 4WD in the region. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, height-adjustable driver seat, power windows, front and rear power outlets, immobiliser, 60/40 split-folding rear seat, front and rear cup holders, 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette stereo with 4 speakers and a roof antenna. We could not verify what safety features are available on the Sportage, though ABS brakes and front airbags might possibly be options.

The Toyota Corolla Cross Hybrid debuted in the GCC in 2021. The Corolla Cross falls under the RAV-4 in the SUV line-up. Only the hybrid engine is offered here, which is a 1.8-litre unit combined with an electric motor. Power is delivered via CVT. Basic features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fabric seat, auto AC, rear AC vents, push engine start stop button, 8-inch audio display with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, 6-speakers, halogen headlamps, rear parking sensors and 17-inch steel wheels. The higher model gets a bigger info display, rearview camera,17-inch alloy wheels, LED headlamps, front fog lamps, sunroof and roof rails. Safety features include dual front airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, and emergency call system (ECALL). Higher models get side curtain airbags and driver knee airbags, and daytime running lamps.

The Ferrari 488 GTB replaced the 458 Italia in late 2015. Under the hood, the 488 GTB gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The exterior is still pretty similar to the 458, but gets a few visual updates, most of which have been added to improve aerodynamics and performance. The LED tailights have been slightly changed as well. The interior is quite familiar to the 458 with minor tweaks such as angled air vents and improved graphics on the infotainment and instrument panel. Keyless starts are also an added feature on the 488 GTB.

The Subaru Impreza WRX is available as a sedan or hatchback. It started off in its current iteration back in 2008, but criticism led to it gaining more power and sportier suspension in 2009 and a widebody kit from the STI in 2011. The turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine can be had with only a 5-speed manual, with all-wheel-drive. The front suspension uses a MacPherson strut setup, while the rear has a double wishbone suspension. Features include ABS-assisted disc brakes, LED tail lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, power windows, electric mirrors and a CD stereo. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in. While a new fully-redesigned version of the regular Impreza was launched in late 2011, the WRX continued in this older iteration for one more year.

The Eos is a resurrection of the Golf convertible, only with a different name. Sharing design cues, platforms and engines with the Golf, it is touted to be the first car in the world to feature a five-piece retractable hardtop. The car can somewhat seat four people, with good luggage room when the top is up. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Eos is available in the Middle East with three engine options, namely two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.2-litre V6, with choices of manual, automatic or DSG automanual, depending on model.  All models are well equipped, with a CD stereo, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front airbags, side airbags, lateral airbags, a roll-bar safety system, stability control, power mirrors and windows, among others.

An all-new model of the Audi Q3 Sportback came out in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The Dongfeng H30 Cross is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. It is available in Elegant and Nobel models. Both models get a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, but the Nobel models get the one with VVT-i tech and an all-aluminium body engine, and produces slightly more power. They all get front-wheel drive and equipped with a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the H30 Cross include power steering, power mirrors, automatic A/C, power windows and parking sensors. A power sunroof and multi-functional steering wheel with acoustic control and cruise control are available for the Nobel models. Standard safety features on the S30 and H30 include 4 airbags, ABS and EBD.

The 5-door Peugeot 208 is the French manufacturer's smallest car on offer as it replaces the 207. The base Active model comes with traction control, ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, key-less entry, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player as standard. The Allure model comes with: 16-inch 'Black Diamond' alloy wheels, tinted rear windows, a 6 speaker sound system, a USB/deported Jack plug, Bluetooth and remote controls on the steering wheel all as standard. Optional equipment is also on offer: the panoramic glass roof with manual curtain, speed limiter and cruise control, dynamic leather seats, LED lighting package with mood lighting, LED ceiling lights and halogen elliptical module headlights.

Mini released an all-new Cooper and Cooper S 5-door hatchback model in 2015 model. In 2018, it received a minor facelift and a new transmission. The Mini Cooper gets a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They both get a 7-speed, with the Cooper S getting the dual-clutch transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The last new Japanese Sunny, launched in 2001 and facelifted in 2004, was available with a choice of three engines, all of which are available in 2 different trim levels. The 1.3-litre model comes in basic FE and a better EX trim. The 1.6-litre comes in EX and value-packed SG trims. The 1.8-litre comes in EX and fully-loaded Super Saloon trims. By the end of its lifecycle in 2006, only the 1.6-litre was eventually available. All cars came with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Interior gadgets are limited in this budget sedan. Power windows and mirrors are limited to the EX and Super Saloon models, while the sunroof, keyless entry and automatic a/c are only available on the Super Saloon. The standard stereo is adequate, with decent sound quality, but nothing to rave about. A CD player is available in the top models. Options include a rear spoiler and front passenger airbags, among other add-on accessories.

The CX-9 crossover SUV received a facelift for the 2013 model year that incorporates their new 'Kodo' design theme. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it comes with a six-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in four trims, the GS, GT, GTX and GTX Limited are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The higher spec CX-9 gets  20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console. Safety-wise, the CX-9 comes with standard stability control and ABS, and is optionally equipped with Forward Obstruction Warning, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Control.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur made its debut as a 2014 model year, dropping the "Continental" from its name. The exterior shape continues into 2017, getting 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. It gets an 8-channel, 8-speaker audio system. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split. The suspension has been made softer for the new Flying Spur for a more comfortable ride. A Mulliner Driving Specification is available which adds diamond-quilted seats, drilled alloy foot pedals, a sports shift lever, jeweled filler cap and unique 21-inch two-piece alloy rims.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Coupe replaced 3-series coupe model. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 428i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The new BMW 4 Series Coupe is visibly larger in width and wheelbase than the outgoing BMW 3 Series Coupe. The BMW 4 Series Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

The Citroen C4 is the compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Only one engine option is available, which is the naturally aspirated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, heated power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, daytime running headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD player/AUX and MP3 capability, front fog lamps with cornering capability, hill-start assist and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features are good as it gets front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA) and Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) with traction control.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. Two engines have carried over to the new model, the 3.7-litre V6 and 5.0-litre V8, while there is a new turbocharged 2.3-litre 4-cylinder motor in the line-up. All engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The interior has been significantly improved as well with higher quality materials and upgraded MyFord infotainment system. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

A new-generation Kia Sorento made its debut in 2015. The Sorento is a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension. The available engines for the GCC are a 3.3-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive as well as a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available with cloth or leather upholstery. The Sorento can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, xenon headlamps, LED indicators on the mirrors, seat cooler and warmer in the front, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch or 19-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The B-Series is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines include a 2.2-litre and a 2.6-litre petrol engines, while the diesel offering is a 2.9-litre unit, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual, or even an automatic in some markets. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include overfender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

An all-new model of the BMW Z4 came out in 2019. The platform and drivetrain are shared with the revived Toyota Supra. It is available with two different engines. There is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine available in two different tunes, and there is the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder motor. All engines get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Like the older models, the Z4 will get separate convertible and coupe models. Standard features in the Z4 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, engine push start button, iDrive, cruise control, automatic A/C, leather seats and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control and tyre pressure monitor. Optional safety features include Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function, traffic sign recognition, distance information, Lane Change Warning system, Rear Collision Prevention and Cross-Traffic Alert, Active Park Distance Control and a rear-view camera.

The Subaru B9 Tribeca is the Japanese carmaker's attempt at a midsize 4x4. Built on the same all-wheel-drive platform as the Outback, the Tribeca is longer, wider and much inches taller than the Outback, and offers five or seven-passenger seating. The overall styling is controversial, while the interior attempts to be more modern and upscale than competitive makes, with an amazingly unique design. The oddly-named B9 Tribeca is powered by Subaru's 3.0-litre horizontally-opposed flat six-cylinder "boxer" engine, a rare type of engine design shared only with Porsche. Also standard is a five-speed automatic gearbox. The B9 Tribeca offers power windows, electric mirrors, standard roll sensing system, ABS brakes with Brake Assist, CD stereo, and standard two-position memory system for front driver's seat and more. Options include reverse-assist sensors, remote starter, and rear cargo cover with shade-type functionality. Safety features include dual front and side airbags.

The 2016 Mazda 2 is a new generation model. It is a hatchback and now uses its own "Skyactiv" chassis and engine. In 2020, it got a slight facelift. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a new 6-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. LED headlights, fog lamps, leather seats, heads-up display, rear spoiler and 16-inch alloys are some of the optional features. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The top-spec model gets 6 airbags.

The Cadillac SRX aims more for road-going luxury than any sort of off-roading ability. There's a standard power rear liftgate, reduced step-over for easy exiting, stylish 17-inch and 18-inch wheels and an enhanced optional wood package, all of which signify its intentions. Bigger than a wagon but not quite a 4WD, the SRX is one of the rare vehicles that truly deserves the "crossover" designation. It uses GM's Sigma platform serving the Cadillac CTS. Engine choices are a 3.6-litre V6 and a 4.6-litre Northstar V8, both of which use a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. Both engine sizes can be optioned up to all-wheel-drive. Standard features include fog lights, heated mirrors, roof rack side rails, rear wiper/washer, 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather-wrapped wheel with controls for audio and voice recognition systems, express up/down on all windows, leather interior, eight-way power driver's seat, 60/40 folding rear seat, CD player with seven speakers, automatic headlamps, and rear parking assist. The V8 model adds driver's side auto-dimming exterior mirror, 18-inch aluminum wheels, CD changer and more. The SRX handles like a car rather than a lumpy 4WD, and the optional Magnetic Ride Control, which automatically adjusts the shocks to compensate for any road imperfections, makes it even smoother on the roads, where it belongs.

The Volkswagen Beetle, which has been around since 2012 in other countries, made its debut in the GCC as a 2015 model. It will be powered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. It gets either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels. In 2016, the Beetle R-Line model was added to lineup.For the exterior, the Beetle R-Line front fascia features bigger air intakes in the bumper, while the rear gets a lower diffuser and large spoiler. It also gets 20-inch "Monterey" alloy wheels to complete the look.Inside, it gets two-tone cloth sport seats, a multi-function leather-wrapped steering wheel with R-Line badging and a set of sport gauges mounted on the top of the centre console, along with R-Line door entry sills. Other standard options on the Beetle R-Line include panoramic sunroof, xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights, touch screen, Bluetooth and USB connection.

The Mercury Milan is supposed to be a slightly upscale version of the Ford Fusion, on which it is based. However, aside from the unique exterior, the Milan is exactly the same as the Fusion underneath, right down to the interior styling. Engines include a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.0-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic and a front-wheel-drive platform. The interior design has metallic finishes on the instrument panel, centre console, doors and steering wheel, while a leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, shifter and padded armrests are standard. The seats received a makeover when compared to the previous model, with revised seat contours and more side support, with contrasting stitching and leather inserts. Drivers will be greeted by a new 'welcome' sequence, where gauge needles sweep back and forth as the lighting and new chimes come on. The ambient lighting system offers the option of illuminating the front and rear footwells and front cup holders. The two-tone look on the interior is complemented with satin-aluminium accents and a wood finish around the centre stack. Available features, standard or optional, include power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof, CD/MP3 player with iPod support and more. Safety features include stability control, front and side-curtain airbags, and ABS.

The Rodius is the only Ssangyong-badged vehicle in the line-up that is not a 4WD wagon. Considerably ugly before, it underwent a recent facelift to improve its looks, although it is still a nightmare to look at. The five-door Rodius can seat seven or eight people, depending on how many people you want to cram in, and comes with a good set of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through either a rear-wheel-drive or a four-wheel-drive system. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, aluminium-look trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, electric mirrors and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control and electronic stability control are also available.

The Lexus GS is all-new for the 2012 model year, gaining a new entry-level trim but losing the V8 at the top end. The new models include the GS 250 and the GS 350, with the GS 450h hybrid joining the range later. The GS 250 comes with a 2.5-litre direct-injection V6 and a 6-speed automatic with paddles. The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 6-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its new 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The GS 250 can be had in various trims. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 250, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The C-Class Coupe was introduced new in 2012. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. For the coupe is a 4-cylinder turbocharged 1.8-litre "BlueEfficiency" engine in the C 250. The 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standard range, on which the C 63 AMG version is based. All models come with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many premium features, such as 16-inch to 18-inch wheels, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. The "Sport" models offer stiffer suspension and quicker-shifting transmission. The optional AMG sports package offers stiffer suspension, 18-inch light-alloy wheels and cosmetic add-ons to most non-AMG models. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee, redesigned for 2011, firmly moves up one level in this iteration, with a new-found emphasis on quality. Offered with a choice of a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or an upgraded 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a 5-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and three trim levels. By 2012, the 5.7-litre models got a 6-speed automatic. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. An SRT8 version debuted for 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8, 5-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, new Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The all-new Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Maxus V80 is a large commercial vehicle offering from the Chinese brand. They are offered in three specifications - 15 seater passenger vehicle, 18 seater minibus and as a cargo vehicle. It is powered by a 2.5-litre turbo diesel engine, mated to a standard 5-speed manual transmission, and a 6-speed manual transmission in the minibus configuration. Standard features include electric front windows, front and rear A/C, central locking, remote key, audio system with radio and mp3 support, fog lamps and halogen headlamps. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and dual front airbags.

The new Commander is the first Jeep that offers three-row seating and the ability to carry seven passengers. Available with either a 4.7-litre V8 or a 5.7-litre Hemi V8, they are both mated to a five-speed automatic transmission, and both offer similar fuel economy. Standard is Jeep's Quadra-Trac I, which is an automatic full-time all-wheel-drive system enhanced by electronic traction control. Other standard features on the Commander include AM/FM stereo with CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power eight-way driver's seat, flipper glass on the liftgate with remote control, all-terrain tyres on 17-inch aluminium wheels, tyre-pressure monitoring, and cruise control. The higher-trim Commander comes with the Hemi V8 with fuel-saving Multi-Displacement System technology, a full-time active 4WD system known as Quadra-Trac II, that has a two-speed transfer case with front and rear electronic limited-slip differentials, dual-zone temperature control, leather-trimmed bucket seats with memory, power adjustable pedals, power sunroof,  power front seats and a six-disc in-dash CD player with MP3 capability. Options include rear DVD and 17-inch chrome wheels. Safety includes ABS, electronic stability control, Brake Assist, and numerous airbags.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's midsize sedan offering. Only sold in some GCC countries, the Insignia Grand Sport gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with front-wheel-drive. Some features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, ventilated leather seats with memory, infotainment system with an 8-inch screen and AUX/USB/Bluetooth connectivity, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, rearview camera, daytime running lights, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, forward collision alert, lane-departure warning, lane keeping assist, ESP and ABS.

Available in other parts of the world since 2017, the Chevrolet Bolt EV made its debut in the UAE and some GCC countries as 2019 model year. The first electric car offering from the American brand, the Bolt EV  is a 4-door sub-compact hatchback. It is available offered in one trim. According to Chevrolet, the Bolt EV has a range of 520 km. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors. keyless entry, central locking, push start stop engine, 10.2-inch screen in the centre console and 8.0-inch screen in the instrument cluster, fabric seats, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatible infotainment system and alloy wheels. Safety features include 10 airbags and tire pressure monitoring system.

A 2-door coupe joins the Cadillac CTS range in October 2010 as a 2011 model. Alongside the mainstay 3.6-litre direct-injection V6 base model is a supercharged 6.2-litre V8-powered CTS-V. The V6 engine only comes with a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the CTS-V can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. All the cars are rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterised by a large chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 17-inch to 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The smallest 4WD in BMW's lineup got a major facelift for 2007. The X3 slots in below the more expensive X5. The X3 seats five passengers, has a liftgate with a fixed glass window, and includes BMW's xDrive all-wheel drive. Engines for the new version include an upgraded 2.5-litre 6-cylinder for the 2.5si, and an upgraded 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the 3.0si. A 6-speed manual transmission is standard on all models, while a 6-speed automatic with manual shift gate is an option. The ground clearance is far from impressive, so the X3 is only good for light-duty off-roading. The all-wheel-drive system lacks low-range gearing, but includes a hill descent control that automatically limits speed down steep grades. ABS and traction/antiskid control are standard. Standard wheels are 17-inch, but 18-inch are available in a Sport Package that also includes firmer suspension and sport front seats. A sunroof and rear glass skylight are optional. Leather upholstery is available, while other options include a crude navigation system, steering-linked xenon headlamps, and front and rear parking sensors.

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. The Corolla can be equipped to be a luxurious compact, with the decent top-spec 1.8-litre four-cylinder, as well as optional leather interior and a DVD system, which are hard to find in any other compact besides the overpriced German cars. We even compared this version of the Corolla to an Audi, which no doubt made Audi angry. However, the base Corolla offers excellent value and comes standard with a 1.3-litre four-cylinder, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows and a cloth interior. Airbags are standard, but everything else is optional. Both engines can be had with either a five-speed manual or a smooth but outdated four-speed automatic. Everything is simple about this car. The air-conditioning controls and radio controls are straightforward, the cup holders work well, and storage holes are available all over. The sedan is surprisingly roomy and comfortable, while the wagon has a spacious luggage area.

The XC90 is Volvo's first proper 4WD vehicle, and a fairly good one at that. The seven-seater is powered by either a 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbo, a 3.2-litre V6 or a 4.4-litre V8, all with an automatic with tiptronic function. The V8 came only in 2005. Among the three rows of seats, the second row moves front and back offering adjustable legroom, while the foldable third row seats can be tucked away to increase luggage space. Standard features include keyless entry, 17-inch wheels, CD player, trip computer, rear air-conditioning, power windows, doors, locks and mirrors, and an eight-way power driver's seat with memory. Available features also include leather seats, a power front passenger seat, memory mirrors, a power moonroof, upgraded audio with a six CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels and self-leveling rear suspension. A sports package adds 19-inch rims, stiffer suspension and some trim pieces. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, and a rollover protection system.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This latest generation of midsize pickups feature roomier cabins, improved ride quality and increased stability. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with only a manual gearbox, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player.

The Kia Sportage was redesigned from the ground up in 2011, and continues largely unchanged for 2013. Based on Hyundai underpinnings, it is powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, or a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre AWD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, navigation and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. The Sportage received high ratings in European crash tests, but keep in mind that they apply to a model with six airbags.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. In 2017, the convertible joined the lineup. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. In 2019, the Mini Cooper got a facelift, and a new 7-speed automatic gearbox, along with new features inside such as a touchscreen with AppleCarPlay. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera. In 2021, a special Paddy Hopkirk edition was available, a model inspired by their 1964 Monte Carlo rally wins, and features the number 37 livery, a body finished in red, alongside a contrast white roof.

The Forester was Subaru's first attempt at a proper small 4WD, already being the first company to offer all-wheel drive across its entire model line. The Forester was introduced for the 1998 model year and has only survived on facelifts, being heavily revamped for 2003. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester features Subaru's symmetrical all-wheel-drive system. In the Middle East, only the 2.5X model is offered, powered by a 2.5-litre flat four-cylinder, mated to a four-speed automatic. The Forester includes a MP3/WMA CD stereo, 6-CD changer, automatic climate control system, power windows, electric mirrors, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, cruise control, cloth upholstery and an automatic air conditioner. The higher models include a sunroof, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather-wrapped surfaces such as the steering wheel, gear shift knob and handbrake. The Forester is different than most compact 4WDs since, in addition to being a soft-roader with no low-range gearing, it also has a lower car-like body.

The Mercedez-Benz GLS-Class is the new name for the GL-Class. In 2016, it received a facelift, along with mechanical updates. The GLS uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. The GLS 500 comes with a 4.7-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GLS-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too. The AMG body-kit is offered on the GLS 500 as an exterior package.

The S80 is the flagship of Volvo range, and though it looks big in size, it is actually more of a large midsize sedan than a true fullsize sedan. In 2014, it got minor exterior and interior changes, as well as new added safety features. The only model available in most GCC markets now is a front-wheel-drive S80 T5 model with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Features include the wafer-thin centre console that houses the digital climate controls and the Dolby Pro-Logic II surround sound system. The car is filled to the brim with the usual luxury features such as power windows, mirrors and seats, leather trim, 16-inch and 17-inch alloy rims, adaptive cruise control, Bluetooth, sunroof and more. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection, as well as Pedestrian Detection, Collision Warning with Full Auto Brake, Driver Alert Control, Lane Departure Warning and Active Bending Lights.

An all-new GMC Yukon was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. In 2018, the top Denali variant got a new front grille. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. The more luxurious Denali version, identified by its chrome grille and trimmings, gets a 6.2-litre V8. For 2018 the Denali got a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The Ferrari F8 Spider replaced the 488 Spider in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Opel Mokka is the German brand's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 4-cylinder 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The South Korean-made Mokka comes in two trims. The base-model comes in only front-wheel drive, while the higher model gets all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/AUX support and alloy wheels. Optional features include bigger alloy wheels, better sound system and chrome door handles. Safety-wise, the Trax gets traction control, stability control and 4-wheel ABS with panic brake assist.

The Logan has been around in Europe since 2004 under the Dacia brand name, with the distinction of being the cheapest car in Europe, but has recently spread its wings and is now built in at least five developing countries. For the GCC, there is only one trim level for now that comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Also standard are front power windows, rear wind-up windows, power steering, cloth seats, 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, a Blaupunkt CD stereo, a manual a/c and one airbag. The Logan aims for the lowest end of the new car market without actually being too small, offering a reasonably spacious 5-seater cabin and a hard-plastic interior that goes for durability and simplicity rather than outright cushiness and aesthetics. Being a front-wheel-drive European car, it also comes with a well-tuned suspension setup that favours handling while also retaining a fair degree of ride comfort. Models with more optional features are expected later.

Based on the latest E-Class platform, the CLS started off as just a prettier version of a midsize luxury sedan. Now from 2013, Mercedes-Benz is offering this 5-door CLS Shooting Brake wagon version. Models on offer include the CLS 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and the CLS 500 with a 4.6-litre twin-turbo V8. Both come with a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base.
