Standard features on all models include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps. Some models gets a standard sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry and start and a sports package for the non-AMG models. Options include metallic paint, nicer leather, wooden steering wheel, night vision, various 18-inch and 19-inch alloy-wheel designs, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more.

The Maserati Ghibli was revived by Fiat as a 2014 model and is intended to compete in the luxury midsize segment which is dominated by the Germans. The rear-wheel drive Ghibli gets two 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engines in different states of tune. Both versions get an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2015, the Ghibli S was also available with all-wheel-drive. Standard options include power windows, electric mirrors, power steering, cruise control, leather seats, infotainment screen with navigation, parking sensors, reverse camera and 19-inch alloy rims. The higher models get a better audio entertainment system, 20-inch alloys and all sorts of cabin trim choices. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Changan CS95 is a mid-size SUV available as both five and seven-seater variants, and is powered by a 2.0 turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. The only gearbox available is six-speed automatic. Front-wheel-drive is standard or you can have it with Changan’s NexTrac AWD system. In 2020, it got a facelift. Standard features include power windows, central locking, remote on key, cruise control, manual A/C, radio, 8 speakers, multifunctional steering wheel, USB+AUX ports, leather seats, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and LED headlamps. Safety features includes dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist. The top option gets addition side curtain airbags.

The Renault Laguna Coupe is a French-built 2-door that comes with a Nissan-developed 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. Featuring a unique design, one of the best features of the Laguna Coupe is its four-wheel steering, or 4-control as they like to call it, which turns the rear wheels slightly along with the front for better cornering ability. Basic features include leather seats, Bose stereo system, alloy wheels, hands-free key card, auto headlamps and auto wipers. Safety features include six airbags, ABS and electronic stability control.

The Lotus Emira is the all-new sports coupe which replaced the Exige, Elise and Evora. Under the hood, two engine options are on offer - the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder AMG engine and the Toyota-sourced 3.5-litre V6 supercharged motor. The AMG engine is mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission, while the 3.5-litre unit can be had with either a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. The interior accommodates a 12.3-inch fully digital driver's display joined by a 10.25-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay integration. Other standard features include power steering, power windows, power folding mirrors, cruise control, LED headlights, leather seats, front and rear parking sensors and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side curtain airbags, brake assist, ABS, stability control and traction control.

An all-new Bentley Continental GTC was released in 2018. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Continental GTC is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. A minor frontal facelift and other trim changes marked the changes for 2012. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard. From early 2012, a few hundred 30th Anniversary edition models were offered, signified by LED lights in the bumpers and a few other trim bits.

The Dzire is the supposedly-desirable sedan version of the Suzuki Swift hatchback. Built in India and available only in some GCC markets, it is powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Mechanically, it has independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension, with front disc and rear drum brakes. The DZire comes in three variants, all with cloth upholstery, power steering, dual airbags, ABS with EBD and a CD/MP3 player as standard. The first two trims come with 14-inch steel wheels, while the top model gets 15-inch alloys. Options include full power features, keyless entry system, trip computer, fog lamps, 4-speaker stereo, tweeters, stereo steering controls, USB port and automatic climate control. So far, the Dzire is only on sale in Saudi Arabia and Oman that we are aware of.

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new 2019 Mercedes-G Class was revealed. The first generation had run from 1990 till 2018. The G 500 comes with a twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 model, combined with a 9-speed automatic transmission. It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before.  Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

The BMW M5 is the performance version of the 5-series and a new model debuted in late 2011 with a highly-tuned 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard equipment include head-Up display, multi-channel audio system, four-zone automatic air conditioning and BMW iDrive control. The M5 gets a unique body kit, hydraulic steering, and simpler sports suspension. The redesigned BMW 5-Series comes with a parking assistant, as well as active cruise control, surround view and rear view camera, lane departure warning, lane change warning and night vision with pedestrian recognition.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. In 2018 it got a slight facelift and updated interior, and the M235i changed to M240i with more power. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i, 230i and the M240i. The 220i and 230i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M240i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M240i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Mini Coupe is the latest edition for 2012 to the ever-expanding Mini line-up. Based on the standard Mini, the only real difference is in the upper half. While the regular hatchback had tight back seats, the Coupe still features a rear hatch, albeit more sloping, and ditching the rear seats completely in the process. Models include the Cooper, the turbocharged Cooper S, and the upgraded turbocharged John Cooper Works. The Cooper uses a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with the S adding a turbocharger, and the JCW featuring an upgraded turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic for all except the JCW, which only comes with a manual. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. The John Cooper Works package bumps up the horsepower and handling. Further options on all Minis include bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The all-new Nissan Pathfinder ditches its body-on-frame chassis and gains some length to compete in the hotly-contested midsize crossover segment. The 7-seater Pathfinder is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT and a choice of either front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive in all trim levels. The all-wheel-drive model gets a selector for choosing 2WD, 4WD or Auto. The base Pathfinder S comes standard with a second-row 60/40-split fold-flat bench seat, a third-row 50/50-split fold-flat reclining bench seat, 18-inch alloys, tri-zone automatic a/c, keyless entry with push-button ignition, power windows, CD/MP3/DVD/HDD audio system with 6 speakers, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth phone, auto headlights, 6 airbags, stability control, tyre-pressure monitor and apparently a standard power liftgate in some markets. The Pathfinder SV adds power-adjustable front seats, 7-inch QVGA colour monitor, rear camera, 20-inch alloy wheels, remote starter, auxiliary audio/video input jack, power windows with front one-touch auto-up/down, front fog lamps, chrome body side trim, welcome lighting, stainless-steel kick plates, speed-sensitive intermittent wipers, illuminated sun-visor mirrors, sunroof, wood-tone trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, leather seats, and a tow hitch receiver with 7-pin trailer tow wiring harness on the rear bumper. The top-spec Pathfinder SL further adds a key-linked memory seat and other settings for individual drivers, side-curtain airbags front and rear, digital compass, 9GB hard drive, 8-inch VGA colour monitor with navigation, Bose audio system with 12 speakers, climate-controlled front seats, and a power-tilt/telescoping steering column. An around-view four-camera parking aid is optional, as is a rear DVD entertainment system with 2 screens. Available accessories include roof rail bars, rear-installing tent and more.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. They also introduced a SUV "coupe" version for the GLC. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. In 2020, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe got a slight facelift and bump in power. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

The GMC Acadia received a facelift for its 2013 model. The crossover offers three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. The Acadia gets a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19 or 20-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Jaguar F-Type Coupe hit showrooms in mid-2014, joining the range almost a year after the Roadster's launch. In 2020, it got a facelift, along with power and interior upgrades. It comes with a supercharged 3.0-litre engine V6 as well as with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8. A new detuned version of the V8 was introduced in 2020 but currenly not available in the GCC. In 2018, a 2.0-litre turbo joined the lineup as well. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive, then later on as only all-wheel drive. Components include adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. The F-Type R Coupe additionally gets a new electronic active differential and a torque vectoring system, as well as larger brakes with optional carbon-ceramic discs.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Receiving a major facelift for 2008, the car comes in various confusingly-named trims, including a new Turbo X model. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. The Turbo X model gets an upgraded version of the 2.8T, and gets a Haldex "XWD" all-wheel-drive system. Not all engines come in all body styles. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The Q50 is also longer, wider and sits lower than the previous generation, which was the G37. For 2017, it got new engines and for the 2018 model year it got a slight facelift. The interior gets Infiniti's InTouch system, a touch screen which displays information and navigation. Owners will also be able to download, update and synch personal apps through their smartphones and USB drives.  The standard motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit which made its debut in 2015. In 2017, a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine was introduced, available in two different tunes. There is also a 3.5-litre V6 engine coupled with an electric motor, which will be available in select markets. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

The 2014 VW Golf GTI is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine and having a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed "DSG" automanual gearboxes. It features a body kit with a built-in rear diffuser and wider side sills. Compared to the regular Golf, the GTI also rides on 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with lower suspension. Inside it gets sportier seats, steering wheel and pedals than the standard Golf. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, USB/auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, optional sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, common power accessories and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport.

The Traverse is a crossover wagon that combines car-like handling with the utility of a 4WD wagon, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The V5 Crossover is aptly named, although we'd say it is more of a minivan segment player. From what we can gather from vague press materials, it aims to include all the comforts of a luxury car with the space and versatility of a wagon. The interior is beautiful in design, though the build quality is far from perfect. The centrally-mounted gauges and the fake wood trim are expected downsides. Powered by the same 2.4-litre four-cylinder Mitsubishi engine that serves most other Chery models, it comes with a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power windows, remote central locking, CD player with optional 6-disc changer, 16-inch alloy wheels, manual cloth seats or optional electric leather seats, dual front airbags with optional front-side airbags, ABS-assisted four-wheel-disc brakes with EBD, power mirrors, parking sensors, power steering, optional DVD navigation, sunroof and of course an alarm system should someone try to steal your Chery.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. Only the Cross Country model was sold in the GCC. It is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Peugeot 508 midsize sedan was facelifted for the 2015 model year. It got a new front grille, bonnet, rear bumper and tail-lights. The only engine on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan is a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. The base model features 16-inch alloy wheels, LED running lights, auto a/c, power windows, electric folding mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, cruise control with speed limiter, fog lamps, and a cooled glove box. The mid-range model adds 17-inch alloys, power seats, dual-zone a/c, one-touch power windows, AUX port for the stereo, auto-dimming mirror and rear parking sensors. The top "Allure" model gets 18-inch alloys, four-zone a/c, turning HID headlights, navigation, 8-speaker JBL stereo, sunroof, smart keyless entry with starter button, electric parking brake with hill assist, side and rear sun-blinds, heads-up display, leather and front-rear parking sensors with distance display. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. All markets do not get all trim levels.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. For 2013, a Roadster version was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

A new generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class debuted as a 2015 model. It is 95 mm longer with 80 mm extra wheelbase, 40 mm wider and up to 100 kg lighter than the model it replaces.There are three variants on offer which is the C 180 which gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor, the C 200 and the C 250, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. More variants are expected to join later. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Ferrari 812 GTS made its debut in 2020, which is the convertible version of the 812 Superfast. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. The 812 GTS has the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

An all-new Chevrolet Suburban came as a 2015 model in mid-2014. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

Chrysler dropped the Dodge badge before the Viper name, spinning off their halo sports car as a separate line under the SRT brand for 2013, but that only lasted until 2014 before it became a Dodge again. So the SRT Viper, as it was known briefly, is powered by a front-midship naturally-aspirated 8.4-litre V10. It will be brought to the GCC only in GTS trim, with several carbon-fibre body panels and aluminium doors. The SRT Viper also boasts a weight-to-power ratio of 2.23 kg per horsepower, besting many other modern supercars. A big X-brace up front helps the new platform with a 50% increase in rigidity over the last Viper. It is fitted with stability control, which can be switched off completely if needed, along with Pirelli P-Zero Z-rated tyres that were designed specifically for the Viper, 295-width up front and a ridiculous 355-width in the back. Three different wheels will be available, with five or six spokes in polished, matte-black or gloss-black finishes. Inside, the Viper comes with seats from Sabelt, suppliers for Ferrari, and a customisable 7-inch LCD screen within the gauges. Chrysler's 8.4-inch Uconnect Media Center is also included, as is a Harmon Kardon sound system.

The Santa Fe is Hyundai's best 4WD to date, and is destined to become the brand's bread and butter model. Hyundai went all out on the redesign of this compact 4WD that borders on becoming a midsize. Standard features include a 2.7-litre V6 with automatic, dual mufflers, underbody skid plate, single airbag, power steering, two-tone exterior paint job, roof rack with crossbar, fake wood trim, power windows, central door locking, keyless entry with burglar alarm, electric outside mirrors, front fog lamps, radio cassette player with CD and MP3 capability and 4 speakers, ABS with EBD, 18-inch wheels and finally, front and rear manual a/c with vents in all seating rows. The top model gets Electronic Stability Program, dual airbags, leather steering wheel, leather seats, cruise control, power front seats, rear spoiler  with brake light, power sunroof, trip computer, centre console with cool box, auto-dimming centre rearview mirror with compass, in-dash 6-CD changer with amplifier and subwoofer, and steering wheel controls for the stereo.

The GMC Terrain made its debut in the GCC as a 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. Both engines get a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base SLE model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, HID headlamps with LED daytime running lamps, fog lamps, single-zone AC, rear AC vents, infotainment system with 7-inch screen, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The SLT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, infotainment system with 8-inch touchscreen display with navigation, 6-speaker audio system and leather seats. The Denali model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled front seats, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Bose premium 7-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

The ZNA Rich is a midsize pickup available in single and double-cab body styles, with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. In 2017 it got a facelift. Features include a 5-speed manual, 15-inch steel wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes, power steering, adjustable steering column, central locking, power windows, power mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and SD card, manual antenna, manual a/c and front seat belts.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT, or Mercedes-AMG GT as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Three variants of the AMG GT will be available as of 2017, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT S gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT S also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT R is the top performance model, with more power, modified suspension and more aerodynamic thanks to exterior mods. The GT R also gets all-wheel steering for better handling performance. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The Chrysler 300 got a facelift in 2015. The new 300 is rear-wheel-drive and gets a 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual capability. The base model gets cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. Higher trim levels additionally come with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with an 8-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. Standard features include cruise control, 18-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inch wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry with starter button. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more.

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, there is only one petrol engine on offer, which is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The other engines options are the diesel units which include a 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre, which will most likely not make it to the GCC just yet. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with AUX/USB/iPOD/MP3/CD player, and 4 speakers. Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, 5-inch touchscreen, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

An all-new 2019 Mercedes-Benz G 63 AMG was revealed. Under the hood, it gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission.  It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before. Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

The American-built Avalon now shares its front-wheel-drive platform as well as several mechanical bits with the Lexus ES, including the engine. It got a slight facelift in 2016 and remains the same for 2017. The 3.5-litre V6 is mated with a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic functionality. In the UAE, the base Avalon S model comes with 17-inch alloys, smart key, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, 6.1-inch touchscreen, auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror with compass, power front seats, cruise control, leatherette seats, halogen auto headlights with fog lamps, 10 airbags, ABS, stability control and dealer-installed front-rear parking sensors. The Avalon SE model adds a 7-inch touchscreen, HDD navigation, rear camera and an 11-speaker stereo with voice-control. The Avalon SE Plus model further adds further-adjustable power front seats with ventilation, premium leather, remote starter, paddle shifters, mirror puddle-lamps, HID headlights, and a power rear sun-shade.  The Avalon Grande additionally comes with adaptive cruise control and a pre-crash safety system. For KSA, the Avalon XLE base model is similar to the S trim above, lacking fog lamps and parking sensors, but gaining a WiFi feature. The Avalon Limited in KSA corresponds to the SE Plus trim above, but without nav or rear camera, which are optional.

The son of the Orient is the most impressive to look at. The design seems derivative, but is largely original and non-offensive, though what is under the hood is outsourced from Mitsubishi. Boasting the most advanced engine in this raggedy range, it comes with only an automatic transmission in this region. The underpowered 2.4-litre engine is of the same design as the one that did duty in various large Mitsubishi models in the past. There is also a 2.0-litre engine that has almost as much power as the 2.4-litre. With a Delphi ABS system and four airbags, it does not skimp on safety items, and with options such a visual reverse sensor, a 3-screen DVD stereo system, a CD changer, an automatic thermostatic air-conditioner and 8-way adjustable power leather seats, you'd be hard-pressed to find better value anywhere else, even among the Koreans. Other options on this front-wheel-drive compact include an electric sunroof, keyless entry and even GPS navigation. We just hope it is not loaded with a map of mainland China.

Creating a fixed-top version of the Azure convertible, the Brooklands coupe is limited to only 550 examples. The design of the four-seat shares its face as well as its 6.8-litre turbo V8 with the Arnage sedan. However, the rare Brooklands gets a higher-tuned version of the standard engine that beats in the Azure and the Arnage. The cabin and rear section of the car are a new design and the interior is crammed with every common luxury cue that defines a Bentley. The Brooklands is highlighted by a new laser-cut matrix grille that evokes the large sporting Bentleys that had won the 24 hours of Le Mans five times between 1924 and 1930. Bentley is now a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG. The spacious handcrafted interior features the highest level of leather and wood trim, individually tailored to the taste of each owner. The complex folding roof on the Azure convertible has been replaced by a traditional roof, shaped to look more sporting than the Arnage sedan, while still offering good space for rear passengers. Safety features in this classic include multiple airbags and the usual electronic nannies found in any modern car. though the platform remains a remnant from the last century.

The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG came in 2008. The high-performance eight cylinder engine is partnered by the AMG Speedshift Plus 7G-Tronic transmission. Equipped with AMG steering wheel shift paddles there are three driving modes with the 'M' mode changing gears 50 percent faster than the Comfort setting. Outstanding handling dynamics comes thanks to an all-new three-link front axle design with springs and gas shock absorbers ensuring optimal road contact and low body movement in cornering. The multi-link independent rear suspension has a 12 millimetre wider track and more camber than the standard C-Class giving improved cornering performance. Inside the AMG instrument cluster in a tubular design features newly styled dials, AMG-specific lettering and a new night-time design. The AMG main menu in a central display allows numerous settings including Warm Up, Set Up and Race modes activated via buttons on the steering wheel. Warm Up displays engine oil and coolant temperatures, Set Up the current ESP mode and transmission settings. Race mode makes the Racetimer available with which the driver can measure lap times on a race track.

The Toyota Hiace has been the market leader for years in the UAE and continues to be a popular choice in the commercial sector, whether for transporting the work-force or cargo. There is only one engine choice in the Hiace, a 2.7-litre four cylinder petrol engine mated to a standard 5-speed manual, while some markets such as UAE occasionally get a 4-speed automatic option. The Saudi market additionally gets a 2.5-litre diesel model with a 5-speed manual. It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

The long-running Nativa has been replaced with a new model for 2009, but Mitsubishi has chosen to rename it the Pajero Sport. Based on the latest L200 pickup-truck platform, the Pajero Sport also shares its entire front end with the L200, although the rest of the wagon body is completely new. Under the bonnet beats an easy-going 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic mode, and a four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The base model comes with side steps, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, multi-mode dash display, CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers, manual a/c with rear vents, dual airbags, power windows, keyless entry, chrome-plated power mirrors, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, immobilizer, under-engine cover, front skid plate, and three rows of cloth-upholstered seating. The mid-range model gets cruise control, fog lamps, upgraded stereo with 8 speakers, automatic a/c, parking sensors and roof rails. The top model gets faux leather upholstery, sunroof, chrome interior bits and a rear differential lock.

The Veloster is Hyundai's head-on dive into the sport-compact segment, with an entry that will be controversial forever. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side. The standard engine for the GCC is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, which puts a downer on its sporting intentions, especially since the standard gearbox is a 6-speed automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available in some GCC markets include a full set of airbags, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The Ford Focus ST got a facelift for its 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder EcoBoost engine, mated to a 6-speed manual. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, cruise control with speed limiter, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights and LED tail lamps. The Focus ST hatchback also gets a body kit, Recaro seats, sports suspension and an overboost feature for extra torque when needed. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. It gets the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive. In 2015, it received minor facial changes and tweeks have been done to the suspension to improve handling, as well as comfort. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Structural stiffness, suspension and aerodynamics had all been upgraded for 2011. The shocks were upgraded again for 2012. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Prices had gone up by 20% compared to the pre-facelift version, but then came down again for 2012, even while is was upgraded. A 'VVIP' edition debuted in 2011 that costs twice as much while offering a customisable leather interior and gold-plated exterior trimmings. A Black edition debuted in 2012 that added some red cabin trim and Recaro seats.

The five-door Leon is arguably the sportiest model in the Seat line-up, and the best interpretation of the new Seat design language yet. Named after a Spanish city, yet based on the VW Golf, the Leon offers an array of engines, including a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre and three turbocharged 2.0-litre units, all from Volkswagen. Depending on model, there are manual, automatic or DSG automanual gearboxes available. Standard features include power front windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, keyless entry, ABS brakes, traction control, electronic stability control and anti-slip regulation. Also available are front airbags, side and curtain airbags, a tyre pressure sensor, electric mirrors and a quality CD audio system. Basic models get 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, while climbing up the model range allows for 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include special upholstery, cruise control, onboard computer, rear power windows and side mirror with electric parking position. The sporty FR gets the first turbo engine, sports seats, lowered suspension and other trim bits. The Cupra carries the FR concept further with an upgraded turbo engine and a body kit, among other changes. The Cupra R replaced the Cupra later on with more power.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

New from the ground up for 2006 and much more better-looking, the M-Class, which actually uses the ML moniker, is a better on-road and off-road 4WD now. It received a few visual changes in 2008. The ML 63 AMG is the top performance variant and it uses a 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic. Features include AMG alloy wheels, leather upholstery, tyre pressure loss warning system, crash sensors, front and side airbags, CD radio with pre-installation for mobile phone and more.

The original B9 Tribeca, Subaru's attempt at a midsize 4WD, has received a facelift for 2008, getting a dull new look instead of the ugly old face. Built on the same all-wheel-drive platform as the Outback, the Tribeca is longer, wider and much inches taller than the Outback, and offers five or seven-passenger seating. The overall styling has been toned down after the previous design was deemed too controversial. The interior attempts to be more modern and upscale than competitive makes, with an amazingly unique design. The oddly-named B9 Tribeca has now dropped "B9" from its name, and is now powered by Subaru's 3.6-litre horizontally-opposed flat six-cylinder "boxer" engine, a rare type of engine design shared only with Porsche. Also standard is a five-speed automatic gearbox. The B9 Tribeca offers power windows, electric mirrors, standard roll sensing system, ABS brakes with Brake Assist, CD stereo, and standard two-position memory system for front driver's seat and more. Options include reverse-assist sensors, remote starter, and rear cargo cover with shade-type functionality. Safety features include dual front and side airbags.

The Audi Q3 is the German manufacturer's 'baby SUV' offering. It got a facelift for the 2015 and a second facelift in 2017. There are three engine options, namely the turbocharged 1.4-litre with a 6-speed automatic, and two tunes of the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged powerplant mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and "Quattro" all-wheel drive. The Q3 gets a lot of the standard features in the base model such as automatic xenon headlamps, LED rear lights, 17-inch alloy rims, automatic air-conditioning, 8-speaker audio system, AUX-IN port, front and side airbags, hill-start assist and ESC. The higher spec model gets hill-hold assist, parking sensors, driver information system, Bluetooth and cruise control.

The JAC S3 is a sub-compact crossover SUV, with styling derived from Hyundai no less. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine from 2017 onwards, mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Externally, the S3 SUV also has 16-inch alloy wheels and LED running lights as highlights. Under the skin, electric power steering, independent front suspension, semi-independent rear suspension and four-wheel-disc brakes are standard. Features include all the basics, such as power windows and mirrors, sunroof, keyless entry, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, faux leather upholstery, split-folding rear seat, cruise control and more. Safety features include 6 airbags, hill-start assist, ABS with EBD and hydraulic brake assist, ESP, rear camera and tyre-pressure monitor.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. In 2016, it received a facelift. It remains the same for 2017. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

The Mitsubishi Lancer EX, first introduced in 2008, got some minor trim changes for 2010. From 2013 onwards, it comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a new 1.6-litre and a carryover 2.0-litre. The smaller engine gets a 4-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Offering a choice of either engine, features in the most basic GLX model includes power steering, locally-installed CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, manual a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers, but only a driver's airbag. The mid-range GLS model can only be had with the larger engine, and includes a sporting body kit, rear spoiler, leather-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, smart key with starter button, sunroof, 6-speaker stereo with USB port, rear camera and faux-wood panelling. The top GT model adds adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, "sport-type" front seats, rear split seats with centre armrest, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels and just two front airbags.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 sportback is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Porsche 911 GT2 RS was released in 2017 and was a limited edition model. Only 1000 units were made, which got sold before its release. It was considered the most powerful Porsche 911 at the time. Under the hood, it got the 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to their 7-speed PDK automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start engine, Alcantara and leather upholstery, bucket seats made with carbon-fibre reinforced plastic, Porsche Communication Management infotainment system, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support, Apple CarPlay, and lightweight 20-inch alloy rims in the front and 21-inch for the rear axle. Rear-axle steering and ceramic brakes came standard in this 911 GT2 RS. There was an optional Weissach package available which reduces the overall weight of the car by almost 30 kg by using lightweight materials and adding material for the track, such as a roll-cage or six-point racing harness for driver and passenger. Optional equipment included different leather upholstery packages, carbon-fibre packages, and a high quality BOSE surround sound system. Standard safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Jaguar XF Sportbrake is the wagon version of the XF luxury-sports sedan that was all-new for 2016. Engines include a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder in the XF Prestige and XF R-Sport, and a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 in the XF S. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The 207 is the redesigned replacement for the popular 206 models, available in three body styles, various trim levels and four engine choices. Derivatives include the 207 CC Cabriolet and a fast 3-door RC hatchback, alongside the regular 3-door and 5-door hatchback range. The basic 3-door and 5-door hatchbacks can be had with a 1.4-litre and a manual gearbox, or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic. The 207 CC comes standard with this 1.6-litre and an automatic. A mid-range turbocharged 1.6-litre engine can also be had in the GT hatchback, but only with a manual gearbox. And there is yet another more powerful 1.6-litre turbocharged engine with a manual reserved for the sporty RC hatchback. Basic models come with front power windows, cloth interior, dual front airbags, keyless entry, ABS brakes and even a CD player as standard. Equipment in the higher models include stability and traction control, panoramic sunroof, 16-inch or 17-inch alloys, side airbags, electric mirrors, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors and more.

All-new in 2007, the Q7 is the first proper SUV to bear the Audi name. It is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 was first available with a fuel-guzzling 4.2-litre V8 in this region, so as not to compete directly with the Touareg. A 3.6-litre V6 version came later. Both come with a six-speed automatic with Tiptronic manual mode. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Standard features include self-levelling bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The SSangyong Tivoli is the Korean carmaker's first product under Indian Mahindra ownership. Basically a small car-like crossover, the Tivoli seats five with a lift-up tailgate in the back for cargo. The only engine available is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and comes in front-wheel-drive form only. Depending on trim, the features list includes two-tone upholstery, rear camera, front and rear parking sensors, 7-inch LCD multimedia screen, auto wipers, smart keyless entry and start, LED running lamps, super-vision gauges, fog lamps, cruise control, dual-zone auto a/c, steering firmness modes and more. Available safety features include seven airbags including driver's knee airbag, stability control, ABS, seat-belt pre-tensioners and a tyre-pressure monitor.

In what could possibly be the most hotly-anticipated sports car of the decade, the Toyota 86 finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. The 86 is a collaborative effort with Subaru, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates. Available in various trim levels, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a Subaru-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or automatic. For 2014, the base model was dropped in some GCC markets. In the UAE, there is the GTX trims for the manual now, while the automatic gets VT and VTX trims. Also from 2016 model year onwards, all trims get the TRD bodykit package. Some markets, such as Oman, apparently do not offer the manual. In UAE, the manual transmission model was dropped for 2017. Standard features include cloth sports seats, halogen headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, manual a/c, common power accessories and 16-inch alloy wheels with 205/55 tyres, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. Most versions get a limited-slip differential. Available features in higher trims include auto a/c, HID headlights, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and 17-inch alloys with 215/45 tyres, aside from dealer-installed leather upholstery. The Saudi market gets navigation with the mid-range model, while the top GT model gets a body kit. Specs may vary between different GCC countries.

The Lexus IS debuted in its current form back in 2014, and got a facelift in 2017. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, later renamed to IS300 in 2018, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2021, the IS got a major facelift. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

A new generation Kia Optima came out for the 2016 model year. In 2019, it got a facelift. Under the hood, two engines are available in the 2020 Kia Optima. One is the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the other a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 2020 Kia Optima include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, ventilated seats, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Kia is offering proper safety features only in the top model.

JAC M5 is the Chinese brand's large minivan offering. It features a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, trip computer, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 7-inch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system, rearview camera, folding mirrors. leather seats and xenon headlamps. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes, brake assist (BA) and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The redesigned 2014 Kia Carens is a seven-seater MPV, smaller than typical minivans. It remained the same for the 2018 model year. The Carens can be had with two 4-cylinder engines, one a direct-injection 1.6-litre "GDI" in LX and EX trim, and the other a fuel-injected 2.0-litre "MPI" in LX and two EX trims. All models get a 6-speed automatic, front-wheel-drive, fog lamps, cooled glovebox, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, roof rack and keyless entry. Base models get 16-inch steel wheels and a vinyl steering wheel. Higher trim levels get 17-inch alloy wheels, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, parking sensors, cruise control and more. Only the top model gets a panoramic glass roof. All models get ABS and only one airbag, except for the top model, which gets two front airbags to go with that glass roof.

The Dodge Durango was completely redesigned in 2011. Mildly facelifted for 2014 with a whole lot of LED lighting, the three-row crossover SUV is based on a stretched Jeep platform. There are now three trim levels, namely the base SXT V6 and SXT Plus V6, the Limited V6 and Limited V8, the R/T V8 and the Citadel V8. The carryover engines, a 3.6-litre V6 and a 5.7-litre V8, all now get a new 8-speed automatic with tiptronic as standard. The base model can be had in rear-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. All higher trim levels are all-wheel-drive, although only the V8 Hemi models get low-range gearing. The SXT model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, tri-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, built-in rechargeable torch, cargo cover, 6-speaker CD/DVD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with 30GB hard drive and audio jack, fog lamps, automatic headlights, hill-start assist and keyless entry. The Limited adds LED running lamps, leather steering wheel, remote start, front power seats with memory, Bluetooth, navigation, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, 9-speaker stereo with subwoofer, power liftgate, chrome roof rails, chrome mirrors with indicators, chrome exhaust tip, rear parking sensors, tyre pressure display, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, and rear-view camera. The R/T model adds leather seats, 20-inch wheels, power-adjustable steering wheel, heated first and second-row seats, HID headlights, body-colour exterior trim, sports suspension, rain-sensitive wipers and more. The top Citadel model adds 20-inch chrome alloys, bigger brakes, heated steering wheel, Nappa perforated leather, ventilated front seats, HID headlights, sunroof, blindspot monitor & cross-path detection, forward collision warning and adaptive cruise control. Some of the Citadel's features seem to be optionally available on the lower trim levels. Standard safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, rain brake support, anti-theft alarm, active headrests and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The painfully cute QQ symbolises China's history of producing bootlegged electronics and brand-name clothes. Except in this case, they've managed to pirate a complete car. As unbelievable as it might sound, the QQ was copied from a previous-generation Daewoo Matiz, now sold as the Chevrolet Spark. It is said that the cars are so alike that parts can be interchanged between the two cars. Needless to say, General Motors is pissed and they've been fighting in Chinese courts for ages now. Apparently, former Daewoo engineers got jobs at Chery, and they brought Daewoo blueprints with them. The car, however, is cheaper than dirt and you can have the same car for less money. The tiny 3-cylinder and 4-cylinder engines in the QQ produce almost as much power as the Spark, so it is still a painfully slow car. Keyless entry and power windows are standard, while dual airbags and CD player are optional. If anyone is interested in a brand new pint-sized car as small as this for fuel economy or whatever other reason, they might actually be happy with this thing. From what we hear, they are far from perfectly reliable, but we haven't exactly heard good things about GM-Daewoo either.

The new Elantra gets a sleeker yet bulbous new look. It's also taller and wider than the outgoing Elantra. There's also more interior space than before, and a higher seating position. Most people would probably consider the Elantra a compact sedan, but its new interior volume is now comparable to some midsize cars. Various trim levels are available on this front-wheel-drive sedan, including a top-of-the-line model which comes with leather seats. But all models are well-equipped with plenty of convenience features, including power windows, intermittent windshield wipers, multiple storage areas, a 60/40-split fold-down rear seatback, dual vanity mirrors, tinted windows, two 12-volt outlets and a tilt steering wheel. Engine choices include a carryover 1.6-litre four-cylinder and a revamped 2.0-litre four-cylinder. A five-speed manual comes standard with the smaller motor, while a four-speed automatic is available for both engines. Basic models get only a single airbag and steel 15-inch wheels. The top model gets dual airbags, ABS brakes, stability control, and 16-inch alloys.

The Pathfinder can be considered a proper off-roading 4WD. It is built on a fullsize pickup platform, thereby offering good off-road capability but marginal on-road handling. The current Pathfinder is significantly larger than previous models. It offers more interior space and more convenience features. It also offers third-row seating to carry up to seven people. The 4.0-litre V6 that powers the Pathfinder is a larger, retuned version of the engine that powers the 350Z. Its five-speed automatic transmission is geared to use the engine's torque characteristics. The 4WD features optional Hill Descent Control, which limits downhill speed without driver intervention, and Hill Start Assist, which briefly holds the Pathfinder on a slope while the driver releases the brake pedal and applies the accelerator. Standard features include fabric upholstery, cruise control, power mirrors, windows and door locks with keyless remote, CD stereo with six speakers, reclining backs on the middle row seats, front and side airbags, ABS and alloy wheels. Options include power seats, halogen foglights, running boards, roof rack cross bars and leather seating. For 2008, the Pathfinder received a very minor facelift, while gaining new available features such as Bluetooth, navigation, rear-seat DVD entertainment and intelligent keyless entry.

The Mitsubishi Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. A minor frontal facelift and other trim changes marked the changes for 2012. Both engines started getting the 5-speed automatic transmission from 2017.
