The standard package in the 2020 Mitsubishi Pajero includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features in the 2020 Mitsubishi Pajero include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard. From early 2012, a few hundred 30th Anniversary edition models were offered, signified by LED lights in the bumpers and a few other trim bits.

For 2018, the Infiniti QX80 got a major facelift which included new LED headlight clusters, new grille, reshaped bumpers, redone rear lights, new tailgate chrome trim, and redesigned 22-inch wheels. It still comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. A 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available. The QX80 also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. The cabin can be trimmed in either leather as standard or semi-aniline leather with optional contrast-colour piping. Standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 8-inch colour monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the QX80's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA colour touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

The Lexus LX 570, which was all-new for 2008, received a minor facelift for 2012. Heavily based on the Toyota Land Cruiser, new model gets a new front-end, bi-xenon headlights, new 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, new tail-lamp clusters and a couple of features such as "overturn" assist and new interior colours. The Lexus is powered by a 5.7-litre V8 mated with a 6-speed automatic transmission. In 2014, a limited-to-200 LX 570 Supercharged was offered exclusively for the Middle East market, with a 5.7-litre supercharged V8. The full-time all-wheel drive features a new 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a crawl-control feature when in low range. The "overturn" assist feature can lock one inside rear tyre to help make slow turns tighter in offroad conditions. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as multiple airbags. The leather interior can be had in tan, beige or black. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. A "Sport" kit with a unique front bumper was introduced for 2013 in the top models. The touchscreen computer gets a new interface for 2012.

The 2009 Mitsubishi Galant receives fresh styling with a new grille, hood and lower air intake at the front, and more changes at the rear including wider rear glass, a new trunk lid, taillights and rear bumper. The Galant is powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic transmission, and the 3.8-litre V6 engine with a 5-speed automatic. Bot gearboxes come with Sportronic manual shifting ability. The base model includes variable intermittent wipers, power mirrors, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, cloth seats, air conditioning, power windows, power locks with keyless entry and CD player with four speakers. The higher models get bright interior accents, cruise control, premium cloth seats, ABS brakes with EBD, and CD/MP3 player with six speakers, along with 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an eight-way power driver's seat. Options include reverse camera, fog lamps, special climate control console, steering wheel with audio controls, power sunroof, leather-trimmed seats, and a premium CD/MP3 player with changer and eight speakers. Safety features include only dual front airbags standard on all models, with ABS and traction control available on higher models only.

Volvo's new-for-2011 S60 sedan redefines the Swedish firm's styling trends yet again. New from the ground up, it again straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level S60 2.0T model comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, as well as three trim levels to choose from, including the top 'Prestige' trim. The top-spec model is the S60 T6 AWD, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, and available only in loaded 'Prestige' trim in certain GCC markets. Later, a T4 base model became available, with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, which is the only version available at some GCC dealerships. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The 'Prestige' model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. A simple silver body kit is optional. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. An R-Design package became available for 2013, which adds unique bumpers, 18-inch alloys, sports suspension and more. A software-based Polestar power upgrade is also offered from 2013 onwards, adding 20-30 hp, depending on the model.

After more than a decade with minimal changes, the Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, aiming to regain some of the market-share lost to its rivals. The Patrol can be optioned up with enough features to classify it as a full-fledged luxury vehicle, with some class-leading features and new technology. Engine options include a base 5.6-litre V8 with 5-speed automatic or 6-speed manual, known as the Patrol SE, as well as a brand-new 5.6-litre V8 with more power, direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top trims get a slightly-lower 'city' bumper. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The Passat CC, better known as just the CC in the GCC, received a facelift for the 2013 model. The CC utilises a common platform with the Passat, including the same engines, mechanicals and interior components. Standard engine choices include a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, with a 7-speed and 6-speed DSG automanual respectively. Both TSI engines are turbocharged 4-cylinder units. A naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine is offered as well with a 6-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel drive. Features include fabric or leather upholstery in various colours, sports seats, common power accessories, 17-inch alloy wheels, adaptive suspension, electrically-adjustable driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, 'Press & Drive' starter with keyless entry, front and curtain airbags for front and rear passengers including side airbags, electric parking brake with hill-hold control, stability control, ABS, rain-sensing wipers, tyre pressure monitor and more. Options include various wood and aluminium cabin trims, automatic a/c, cruise control, reverse camera, Xenon headlights with bending feature, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic sunroof, and various stereo options that include CD/MP3, Bluetooth phone, six-disc changer and AUX inputs. Park Assist, Automatic Distance Control and Lane Assist features are also optionally available.

The Honda Odyssey J is the Japanese version of the model, which is being sold side by side with the U.S. built Odyssey. This one was introduced to offer the minivan as more affordable option. This one gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlamps, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). The EX-V gets additional blind spot indicators on the side mirrors.

When the new Nissan Patrol was launched in 2010, the carmaker elected to keep producing the older-generation Patrol Safari alongside the new one. It remains the same for the 2018 model year. The long-running Safari continues to be Nissan's best four-wheel-drive model. It gets the 4.8-litre inline 6-cylinder engine as standard, with the choice of a 5-speed automatic with tiptronic or a proper 5-speed manual. It is available as a 3-door and a 5-door model. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol also has a decent interior featuring quality materials, wood trim, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, fog lamps, 16-inch wheels and other equipment. In 2017, the Patrol Super Safari trim was introduced which comes with new tan leather seats and door trim with 8-way power seats for the driver and 4-way for the front passenger. New features include a navigation system as well as front and rear parking sensors with rear view camera, Bluetooth, USB, CD, AUX input and FM/AM radio. The vehicle comes equipped with automatic climate control and a built-in refrigerated cool box. The Super Safari can be distinguished from other Patrol models by its unique machine-cut 17-inch black alloy wheels, dual-tone body colour, a rear spoiler and a Super Safari body stripe. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, the wagon model has room for seven. A sunroof and an electric front winch are optional. Stability control and a tyre-pressure monitor are standard now, as per current regulations. Dual front airbags, ABS, an immobiliser and cruise control are also included, as are the classic rear locking differential, as well as front and rear-pintle tow hooks.

Available from early 2013, the "Mark 7" VW Golf may look the same, but is really completely new, the big news being several weight-saving enhancements that form the car. The two "TSI" engine choices are a 1.2-litre and a 1.4-litre, both turbocharged 4-cylinder units mated to 7-speed "DSG" automanual transmissions. All Golf models now have touchscreen systems as standard, starting with a 5.8-inch colour display and rising to the range-topping satellite navigation system with 8-inch colour display that operates with finger gestures. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, power windows, keyless entry and such, with optional features such as sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, 5.8-inch touchscreen, fog lamps and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. Standard on all new Golf models is a multi-collision brake system which automatically brakes the vehicle after a collision, to reduce kinetic energy significantly and thus minimise the chance of a second impact. Other available electronic aids include adaptive cruise control and city emergency braking, both capable of applying full braking to a stop. Further options include a Driver Alert System that monitors the driver's inputs to detect any signs of tiredness, while a camera-operated Lane Assist system can help keep the car in a specific lane, providing countersteering assistance where necessary, while the Dynamic Light Assist system optionally masks the vehicle's high beam lighting to avoid dazzling oncoming traffic.

The Toyota Prado, debuted as an all-new model in 2010. The engines on offer from 2013 onwards are a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder and a 4.0-litre V6. The GCC-spec Prado 5-door will be available with both engines. All models are available with either a manual or an automatic gearbox, and while KSA gets both, the UAE only gets the automatic versions now. All models have four-wheel ventilated disc brakes as well as independent front and live-axle rear suspension. The basic 2.7L 5-door TX model gets 17-inch alloy wheels, common power accessories, keyless entry, single-CD stereo with 6 speakers, manual front and rear a/c, fog lamps, rear spoiler, side steps, fabric upholstery, chrome door handles, tilt-telescoping steering column, dual front airbags, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist. The UAE version additionally getting USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, while the KSA version instead gets side steps and rear parking sensors. The mid-range 2.7L 5-door TXL model further gets wider 17-inch alloys, leather steering wheel and shifter, side steps, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, USB/AUX port, Bluetooth, chrome grille and other trim, bumper guard and stability control. The UAE version also gets an aftermarket reverse camera and dual-zone auto a/c, while the KSA version instead gets a 9-speaker stereo, 6-CD changer and manual a/c. The UAE also gets a higher-spec 2.7L TXL version with an aftermarket DVD/navigation system, dealer-installed leather upholstery, floor lighting and rear lamp guards. Moving on to the basic 5-door 4.0L TX model, available only in the UAE, it has the same features as the 2.7L TX, while also getting a cool box, cruise control, hill-assist and stability control. The mid-range 4.0L TXL model, common for UAE and KSA, further gets side steps, fog lamps, roof rails, smart key with starter button, rear sensors, front bumper guard, chrome grille and door handles, and a leather steering wheel with switches. The UAE version also gets a reverse camera and dual-zone a/c, while an optional package includes aftermarket navigation and leather. The top 4.0L TXL model gets factory-fitted navigation, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, floor illumination and rear lamp guards. The KSA model additionally gets wi-fi and LED daytime running lamps, but not leather. The highest 4.0L VXL model is only offered in the UAE, and gets KDSS air suspension, powered 3rd-row seat, "optitron" gauges, rear-camera with guidance, wood trim, JBL 14-speaker stereo with navigation and DVD changer, 9 airbags, remote engine starter, headlamp cleaner, rear bumper guard, side-step lights, front and rear parking sensors, 18-inch alloys, floor-mounted spare tyre and HID headlights.

When the new Nissan Patrol was launched in 2010, the carmaker elected to keep producing the older-generation Patrol Safari alongside the new one. It remains the same for the 2019 model year. The long-running Safari continues to be Nissan's best four-wheel-drive model. It gets the 4.8-litre inline 6-cylinder engine as standard, with the choice of a 5-speed automatic with tiptronic or a proper 5-speed manual. It is available as a 3-door and a 5-door model. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol also has a decent interior featuring quality materials, wood trim, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, fog lamps, 16-inch wheels and other equipment. In 2017, the Patrol Super Safari trim was introduced which comes with new tan leather seats and door trim with 8-way power seats for the driver and 4-way for the front passenger. New features include a navigation system as well as front and rear parking sensors with rear view camera, Bluetooth, USB, CD, AUX input and FM/AM radio. The vehicle comes equipped with automatic climate control and a built-in refrigerated cool box. The Super Safari can be distinguished from other Patrol models by its unique machine-cut 17-inch black alloy wheels, dual-tone body colour, a rear spoiler and a Super Safari body stripe. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, the wagon model has room for seven. A sunroof and an electric front winch are optional. In late 2018, a trio of locally-modified versions were introduced -- the Falcon with chrome trim and leather; the Gazelle with a 2-inch lift kit, remote-reservoir shocks, fender flares and snorkel; and the Gazelle X with a 4-inch lift kit, off-road wheels, regeared diffs, metal bumpers, boot drawer set, louder exhaust and more. These versions will be built based on demand.Stability control and a tyre-pressure monitor are standard now, as per current regulations. Dual front airbags, ABS, an immobiliser and cruise control are also included, as are the classic rear locking differential, as well as front and rear-pintle tow hooks.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. The S 65 AMG gets a twin turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. It also  includes a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels.

The Audi A5 originally debuted for 2008 in the GCC as a four-seater coupe based on the latest stretched A4 platform, with the range later diluted by the addition of a 5-door model. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.2-litre V6 engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive version, and a 6-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive version. For 2009, an underwhelming Audi S5 Quattro coupe model debuted, with a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. The front-wheel-drive A5 Cabrio convertible also eventually joined the line-up with only a detuned 2.0T engine and a CVT, offering less power than the coupe. For 2010, the new A5 Sportback 5-door liftback model joined the range, with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, a 7-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel-drive. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The new platform moves the engine more rearward in relation to the front axle for better balance and handling, but ultimately the car loses out on the fun factor in any form, either due to its front-driven underpinnings or to its overly-safe Quattro system.

The new-for-2007 Aurion serves as a direct replacement to the previous V6-powered Camry Grande model. It uses the same front-wheel-drive platform as the all-new Camry. The Aurion features more aggressive front and rear styling, but is largely the same size as the Camry. The new Camry is thoroughly revamped, reworked and upgraded from the ground up, and the Aurion benefits directly. Inside is a huge airy interior that features some slight changes when compared to the Camry. The engine choice is the singular 3.5-litre V6 mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox. The Aurion can be had with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual array of power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a fancy keyless entry system, front and side airbags, and alloy wheels. Dynamic safety features also include electronic stability control and ABS brakes. Toyota has been smart in differentiating the common Camry from the fast V6 model, for the benefit of those who pay more for the extra power. A 'Touring' model appeared in 2011 with a body kit.

The new L200 offers versatility combined with a tough new look that makes it seem more like a lifestyle vehicle than a commercial pickup. It obviously is tough enough to be a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The spacious interior places the L200 firmly in the midsize class, unlike the previous compact model. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's new L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. The brakes, the rear axle, the steering gear and the chassis have all been substantially beefed up for the new L200, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Volkswagen Jetta received a facelift for 2015. There are two engines on offer, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder motor, both mated to a manually-shiftable 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel-drive. There are three trim levels, named S for the 2.0, and SE and SEL for the 2.5. The base S model comes with keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3/AUX stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. The SE additionally comes with 8-speakers, 6.5-inch colour touch screen, leather seats, 17-inch alloy wheels, automatic a/c, steering-wheel buttons, cruise control, fog lamps, sunroof, alarm system, rear camera and parking sensors. The top SEL comes with ESP, hill-hold control, xenon headlamps, rear LED lights, front fog lights with cornering lights. All VW Jetta models come with ABS, six airbags and auto hazard lights as standard.

The Toyota Land Cruiser continues to be a strong performer in the GCC market, even though it has remained mechanically unchanged for the past decade. Under the hood, engine choices in the 2020 Toyota Land Cruiser include a 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission, a 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with an 8-speed automatic. In 2017, Saudi Arabia started offering a 4.5-litre V8 turbo-diesel model as well. The 2020 Toyota Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. In the UAE, there are three trim levels, namely EXR, GXR and VXR. The KSA market has GX, GXR and VXR trims, with further variants within them. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 18-inch alloys on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional dealer-installed rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional dealer-installed leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items. Further available features include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, a front chin spoiler and extra chrome trim on some GXR and all VXR models, with 20-inch wheels and more on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, factory leather, adaptive cruise, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system.  In some GCC countries a special edition VXS model was available in 2017, which had a JBL audio system, wireless charging, rear entertainment system with wireless headphones, and diamond stitched leather seats. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on 2020 Toyota Land Cruider V8 models only.

In 2016, the Ford ditched the naturally aspirated engines in the Focus, leaving only the turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder Ecoboost engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Things remain the same for 2018 with standard features which include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a manual a/c. Other features, available on higher models, include 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, leather upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, "sports" front seats, cruise control with speed limiter, sunroof, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights, LED tail lamps, footwell courtesy lights, and an optional park-assist system with parking sensors and the ability to control the steering automatically during parallel-parking. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The 2015 Dodge Charger SRT received a significant facelift. From 2019, only the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 powered SRT Hellcat was available. It gets an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Charger SRT Hellcat receives a large, power-bulge aluminium hood, which features a dedicated air intake. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.A new widebody kit version was added to the lineup in 2020.

The Audi A8 is the German manufacturer's flagship full-size luxury sedan. Of course, that means the list of options will be long for this car. Only the long-wheel base makes its way to the UAE. There are three engine variants - the 3.0-litre supercharged V6, 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 and the 6.3-litre W12. They are all equipped with all-wheel drive systems. Some basic options include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon-head lamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, rear-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and sunroof. Customers can add different equipment packages which can add rear-entertainment systems, individual rear power seats, seat ventilation and massage function for both front and rear, alcantara trim, 20-inch alloy wheels, panoramic sunroof and electronically opening and closing bootlid. However, adding options to the A8 L creeps up the price further.

The Hyundai Grand i10 comes in both hatchback and sedan body styles. It has a longer wheelbase than the regular i10, therefore interior space is better. Features, either standard or optional, include smart key, engine start button, a rear parking assist system, AUX, IPOD, USB, Bluetooth and audio control buttons on the steering wheel. Only the hatchback model offers Electronic Stability Control and Vehicle Stability Management. A two-tone colour scheme has been applied to the instrument panel and seats. Two engine options will be available, a 3-cylinder 1.0-litre motor and 4-cylinder 1.25-litre unit. Consumers can choose between a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic.

Overhauled for 2018, the all-new Toyota Camry is offered in the GCC with a carryover 2.5-litre 4-cylinder motor mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. A 3.5-litre V6 engine with an 8-speed automatic has also been reintroduced, after the cancellation of the Toyota Aurion. In 2018, a hybrid Camry was launched, which uses the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, coupled to an electric motor and mated to a CVT. The 2019 Toyota Camry base model has 16-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 17-inch and 18-inch alloys. Base features, depending on the market, include a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags, as standard. The upper trims offer dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, stability control, side airbags, sunroof, DVD navigation, smart keyless start and navigation. In the UAE, the Sport variant gets a body kit, quad exhaust tips, paddle shifters and unique seats.

An all-new Ford Figo came out as a 2016 model year. It got a slight faceligt in 2019, as well as new tech upgrades. It is available as a 4-door sedan and a 5-door hatchback and features a new exterior design. Under the hood it gets a 1.5-litre motor mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trims. The base model gets cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include front power windows, rear manual windows, central locking, keyless entry, power mirrors, 4-speaker stereo with USB port, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, ABS, hill assist, soft-touch dashboard and a manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 15-inch alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat, and side-curtain airbags.

Introduced in late 2016, the Bentley Bentayga is the British luxury brand's first SUV model. In 2021 it got a facelift. Initially offered with a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 model with an 8-speed automatic, a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre W12 engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission was offered later. It gets a variable displacement system, which shuts down half of the engine under defined conditions. Intake and exhaust valves, fuel injection and ignition are all shut down on defined cylinders for improved efficiency. Other notable features include LED headlights, a front skid-plate, front fender vents, aluminium roof-rails, panoramic glass roof and 20 to 22-inch alloy wheels. The interior is, as expected, nothing short of luxury, with its premium leather upholstery, metallic accents, an infotainment system with an 8-inch display and 22-way adjustable front seats with heating, ventilation and massage functions. Bentley is also offering a 4-seat variant with each seat having its own set of power controls and massage functions. The seats are divided by a small centre-console which consists of cup holders, storage compartments and USB charging ports. Other optional equipment include a high-end premium audio system and entertainment Android tablets with 4G, WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity, and even a self-winding Breitling dash-clock option that costs as much as the base price. A Mulliner specification adds more customisability in terms of paint, leather and wood.

The 2018 Zotye T600 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. Looking a lot like a Volkswagen Tiguan due to the loose copyright laws in China, the 2018 Zotye T600 features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the T600 include, standard or optional, include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, touch screen, multi-functional steering wheel, leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C and alloy wheels. Safety features on the 2018 Zotye T600  include airbags, ABS, brake assist, stability control and traction control.

The VW Touareg is a luxurious and comfortable 4WD that is surprisingly capable both on the road and off it too. Facelifted and mildly upgraded for 2007, it is a practical vehicle, and on the highway, the Touareg offers a firm but smooth ride, and its handling is responsive for its mass, while in the desert, a full set of off-roading equipment comes in handy, including locking diffs and low-range gearing. The range includes a new 3.6-litre V6, an upgraded 4.2-litre V8 and a very limited 6.0-litre W12. All models come with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Also standard is Volkswagen's 4Motion permanent all-wheel-drive system. The Touareg seats five, and there is no third row of seats available. The 4WD comes standard with leatherette upholstery, dual-zone climate control with rear seat controls, wood trim, power windows, mirrors and sunroof, electrically adjustable front seating, alloy wheels of various sizes, ABS and many more items. Higher models get leather, auto-dimming outside mirrors with memory; and other luxuries. All models include front, side-impact and curtain airbags.

The 2015 Subaru WRX STi  is a new generation model. It is available only as a sedan. Under the hood, it gets a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler. It is coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission as standard. It is 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, traction control, stability control and ABS.

The CLS-Class "four-door coupe" was completely redesigned for the 2012 model year and facelifted for 2015. Based on the latest E-Class platform, the CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Models on offer include the CLS 400 with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 and the CLS 500 with a 4.6-litre twin-turbo V8. The V6 model gets a 7-speed automatic transmission, while the V8 model gets a new 9-speed automatic gearbox. Standard features on all models include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps. Some models gets a standard sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry and start and a sports package for the non-AMG models. Options include metallic paint, nicer leather, wooden steering wheel, night vision, various 18-inch and 19-inch alloy-wheel designs, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more.

The Hyundai Azera, newly-redesigned for 2012, fills the gap between the Sonata and the Genesis sedan. The front-wheel-drive full-size sedan comes with two engine choices, a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.0-litre V6, but some GCC markets get only the V6. Both engines get a standard 6-speed automatic. The 2.4-litre version gets smart keyless entry with starter button, mood lighting, available panoramic sunroof, fake wood trim, rear sunshade, CD/MP3 stereo, auto-dimming mirror, electric parking brake with auto hold, leather powered seats, fog lamps, parking sensors, and 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. The 3.0-litre version additionally gets xenon lights, memory and seat massage for driver, Infinity stereo, heating & cooling for front seats, electric tilt & telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth, tyre pressure monitoring system, electric folding mirrors, adaptive cruise control, rain sensor and dual-zone a/c. The top model gets a navigation and DVD entertainment system with rear camera. All models get 8 airbags and ABS with EBD, while only the V6 gets stability control.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. It received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. They all come with a 5-speed manual gearbox or the optional 4-speed automatic, the latter available only on the 3.0-litre. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, but the top model can be outfitted with two-tone cloth seats, CD stereo, power windows, fog lights and keyless entry. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

The A3 hatchback slips into Audi's line-up as the company's smallest and cheapest model. It was introduced in 2004, received a minor facelift in 2005, and has undergone a second facelift to keep it fresh. Sharing its platform with the MKV-generation VW Golf, the main A3 models now available here are a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, both turbocharged 4-cylinder engines mated to front-wheel-drive platforms and dual-clutch automanual gearboxes. Most dealers do not offer Quattro, manual or V6 models, as found in Europe, although Audi's clueless GCC-office people might argue otherwise. Since the three-door flopped here, the only bodystyle offered now is the five-door Sportback. Standard features include four-wheel disc brakes, 16-inch alloy wheels, automatic climate control, power windows, power locks with keyless remote, cloth seats and a CD player. The list of options vary, depending on who you ask. AS for the facelift, changes include new headlights, re-sculpted front bumper and possibly new tail-light lenses. The compact A3 tries to justify its high price with a well-built exterior and a pleasant interior, as well as a badge that no one respects yet.

The Ford Escort is the American brand's compact car offering. This Escort is however built in China and gets a 1.5-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Escort include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, auto headlamps, partial leather seats, infotainment system with 8-inch touchscreen, 2 USB ports, Bluetooth, auto headlamps, rear parking sensors, rear camera, auto start-stop, manual A/C and 15-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get 16-inch and 17-inch alloy wheels, full leather seats, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control and automatic A/C, Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, front and side airbags, ABS, stability control and hill-assist.

Toyota introduces an all-new Camry for 2007. The new one features aerodynamic new styling reminiscent of Lexus, which is no surprise since the expensive ES 350 is based on this car. The new Camry is thoroughly revamped, reworked and upgraded from the ground up. Inside is an airy new interior. The engine choice remains the same, with a carried-over 2.4-litre four-cylinder popular with most commuters and taxi companies, but the new 3.5-litre V6 available in other markets is not offered here, saved instead for the Aurion. The four-cylinder can have a five-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. The Camry can be had with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual array of power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a keyless entry system, front and optional side airbags, and either steel or alloy wheels. There is now a wannabe Sport version that adds a body kit and stiffer suspension. The Toyota Camry defines the dull midsize four-door sedan segment and now it has set the bar higher.

Mini released all-new Clubman model as a 2016 model. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. Unlike the old one, this one features proper 4 doors on the side. The Mini Cooper Clubman will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S Clubman gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The Cooper can be  had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the Cooper S Clubman is available with a 6-speed manual gear or an 8-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The McLaren 570GT Coupe is a more tamed road-trip-friendly variant of the 570S. It gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 motor mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570GT sports a side opening cargo hatch above the mid-mounted engine for additional cargo space, and has slightly softer suspension, whilst offering better sound insulation. As with the 570S, it benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. But unlike the 570S, carbon ceramic brakes are missing in the 570GT. Features include a 7-inch portrait touchscreen infotainment navigation system, smart keyless entry and push-start button, 3 USB ports, LED headlights with LED running lamps and tails, power windows and mirrors, a detailed LCD gauge cluster, non-opening panoramic glass roof and memory seats. Safety features include front, side and knee airbags, ABS, ESP, parking sensors and a rear camera awkwardly placed close to the ground.

The Mercedes-Benz E 55 AMG was the performance version of the E-Class and received a supercharged 5.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. It gets stiffer suspension for better handling. The E55 AMG was the fastest four door car in Mercedes-Benz's lineup at the time.

The Audi S8 is the sports version of the carmaker's flagship A8 model. It got slight power upgrades and reduced fuel economy for the 2014 model. It comes with a powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It also gets cylinder deactivation so it can run on only 4 cylinders for better fuel economy. Features include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon headlamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, rear-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and sunroof. Safety standards are high, with electronic stability control, various collision prevention systems and numerous airbags. Different equipment packages are available as well for further customisation.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 got a second lift in 2019, featuring a new front grille. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The smallest 4WD in BMW's lineup got a major facelift for 2007. The X3 slots in below the more expensive X5. The X3 seats five passengers, has a liftgate with a fixed glass window, and includes BMW's xDrive all-wheel drive. Engines for the new version include an upgraded 2.5-litre 6-cylinder for the 2.5si, and an upgraded 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the 3.0si. A 6-speed manual transmission is standard on all models, while a 6-speed automatic with manual shift gate is an option. The ground clearance is far from impressive, so the X3 is only good for light-duty off-roading. The all-wheel-drive system lacks low-range gearing, but includes a hill descent control that automatically limits speed down steep grades. ABS and traction/antiskid control are standard. Standard wheels are 17-inch, but 18-inch are available in a Sport Package that also includes firmer suspension and sport front seats. A sunroof and rear glass skylight are optional. Leather upholstery is available, while other options include a crude navigation system, steering-linked xenon headlamps, and front and rear parking sensors.

The Corsa is the smallest car among Opel models offered in the Middle East. Its extensive safety package and rigid galvanized body have been tested to excel in passenger protection. Body styles available in the Middle East are three-door and five-door hatchbacks, as well as a 4-door sedan. Opel went the extra step and added colour-keyed bumpers and high-level safety features, which is rare in this class of cars. Two engine options are available here, namely a 1.4-litre unit and a 1.8-litre unit, both four-cylinder. Both powerplants power the front wheels using the available standard manual transmission, but the smaller motor has an optional automatic five-speed transmission with manual shifting mode. All cars can seat five. A fold-down rear backrest can be fixed at two different angles and a rear bench can be fully folded down. Available features include power windows, cloth upholstery and CD stereo. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

Looking like an exotic sports car, but based on more conservative roots, the striking Mitsubishi Eclipse officially debuted for the 2009 model year in the GCC for the first time, after years of grey imports. This version of the Eclipse has actually been around in American markets for years now, and what the GCC gets is the facelifted version with a new grille. Under the hood, the new-for-2009 Eclipse comes with either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Both engines MIVEC variable valve timing, while all automatics feature a Sportronic mode to allow manual gearshifts. Safety includes standard advances dual-stage front airbags, seat-mounted side airbags and front seat curtain side airbags. Available cabin features, depending on trim, include a CD/MP3 stereo with changer and subwoofer, power windows, keyless entry, electric mirrors, split-folding rear seatbacks, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power-adjustable seats, sunroof, digital a/c and a two-tone interior. Mitsubishi has made the 650W Rockford Fosgate audio system with 9 speakers a standard fitment on all Eclipse trims. All models are equipped with front-wheel-drive, four-wheel disc brakes, ABS and electronic brake-force distribution. The V6-powered Eclipse GT features larger ventilated rear discs and standard 18-inch alloy wheels.

Released in 2003, and ever so slightly redesigned for 2006, the Mazda 6, also known as the grammatically-incorrect Mazda6, is the sportiest among the current crop of front-wheel-drive midsize family cars, but only in terms of handling. The Mazda 6 was originally designed for the driving enthusiast, with choices of V6 and turbocharged engines, but the Middle East market only gets a pathetic 2.0-litre and a reasonable 2.3-litre engine, both of which are four-cylinder and come with a choice of manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre comes in the four-door sedan and an attractive five-door station wagon body style, while the 2.3-litre comes in the four-door sedan shape as well as a sporty five-door liftback , as long in length as the sedan. Standard features include power windows, central locking, basic stereo system with 4 speakers, dual airbags for driver and front passenger, and available ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. Options include a full body kit, rear spoiler, fog lamps, 6 CD changer, cruise control, alloy wheels, sunroof and leather seats.

The Superb is an upper-medium segment car, with an extended wheelbase to increase interior room. The Superb name first appeared on a Skoda in 1934 and is the company's flagship model. The modern-day version Superb is available in various trim levels, with names like Classic, Comfort and Elegance. The Superb offers many of the benefits of a luxury car, with large rear doors and optional rear-seat DVD entertainment. The rear passenger space is exceptional for a vehicle in this segment and high quality trim materials are used throughout the model range. Customisation options include a sunroof and a host of alloy wheel designs and sizes. In the Middle East, the Superb is available with two petrol engines, namely the entry-level turbocharged 1.8-litre four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre V6. Both are coupled with a 5-speed automatic gearbox to drive the front wheels. Standard safety features include ABS brakes, front and side airbags, and even curtain airbags, while the V6 model gets electronic stability control as standard.

An all-new Ford Escape made its debut in 2017 in the GCC. This generation Escape is the first Ford vehicle in the world with available SYNC Connect, allowing users to unlock doors, check fuel level and even locate where a vehicle is parked. For the 2019 Ford Escape, two engines are available. The first is carried over from the previous generation, a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the other is a new 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base 2019 Ford Escape model is two-wheel drive, which optional 4-wheel drive is available. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering. The Sync 3 infotainment system gets Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as well. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. The 2019 Ford Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, blind spot monitor,  and adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support. Active Park Assist is also available to park the car itself, whether parallel or perpendicular. Higher models gets adaptive front lighting system which automatically adjust the bi-xenon headlamps according to the environment.

An all-new Mazda CX-5 was launched as a 2018 model year. The standard engine is a direct-injection 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There is one front-wheel-drive and two all-wheel-drive versions available. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

An all-new Subaru Impreza made its debut in 2017 in the GCC. The engines carry over from the previous model, which is either a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine, although only the 2.0-litre is offered in some markets for 2018. Both are mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. Standard features in the 1.6i model include 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, power windows and mirrors, multi-function display, automatic a/c, audio system with 6.5 inch screen, 4 speakers, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, 60/40 folding rear seats and cloth upholstery. The 2.0i model adds the larger engine, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, fog lamps, 6 speakers, faux paddle-shifters and a rear-seat centre armrest with cup-holders. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, knee airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, along with the all-weather traction of asymmetrical all-wheel-drive.

Available only as a sedan for now, the latest C-Class range is all-new for the 2008 model year, with some upgraded and some carryover engines. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional AMG sports package offers attractive suspension, a special grille and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the new line-up are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the C 180 Kompressor and the C 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune. The 2.5-litre C 230 four-cylinder comes next. The 3.0-litre V6-powered C 280 and the 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standard range. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. The diesel models are not promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many luxury features, such as 17-inch rims, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. Trim lines include Classic, Elegance and Avantgarde. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

The Sportage is another of Kia's long-running nameplates, though the crossover itself has changed over time. Whereas the original Sportage was unreliable but could do basic off-roading, the new one is much more dependable but is allergic to sand dunes. It is even offered in a front-wheel-drive model alongside the four-wheel-drive, to dilute the nameplate further. Powered by either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, or a 2.7-litre V6 with a four-speed automatic, it is interesting to note that Kia and parent Hyundai are the first ones to officially offer a V6-powered small 4WD in the region. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, height-adjustable driver seat, power windows, front and rear power outlets, immobiliser, 60/40 split-folding rear seat, front and rear cup holders, 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette stereo with 4 speakers and a roof antenna. We could not verify what safety features are available on the Sportage, though ABS brakes and front airbags might possibly be options.

The Geely Emgrand GS Sport is a Chinese-built high-riding hatchback that benefits from some Volvo input, considering Volvo is owned by Geely. The powertrain is conservative, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic. It rides on a basic independent front, torsion-beam rear suspension with four-wheel-disc brakes. Features include 18-inch alloy wheels, smart keyless entry and start, 8-inch touchscreen with Apply Carplay and Android Auto, AUX and USB ports, 6 speakers, Bluetooth, Eco/Normal/Sport drive mode selector, 3.5-inch dash display, one-touch up/down power windows, power-folding mirrors, auto a/c, rear camera with rear sensors, cruise control, panoramic sunroof, LED running lights and tail lights, halogen headlights and split-folding rear seats. Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, electric parking brake with auto-hold, seatbelt pretensioners, ISOFIX latches and 6 airbags.

An all-new model came out for the Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S Cabriolet in 2020. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the Porsche 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. A 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine comes standard while a 3.0-litre V6 is optional. The 2.3-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the 3.0-litre only gets an automatic. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 15-inch steel wheels and AM/FM/6CD stereo. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. Available safety features include front-and-side airbags along with ABS. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

Looking more like a minor facelift than a major update, the new-for-2011 Suzuki Swift is actually a fair bit longer, with a new engine on offer, and now is built in India. Powered by a new 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. A new Japanese-built Swift Sport model was offered in 2012 with a 1.6-litre engine and a CVT automatic. The base Swift model comes with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher trim levels are available with a leather steering wheel with audio controls, 6-speaker stereo, tachometer, 16-inch alloy wheels, adjustable steering wheel, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD. Only the top version gets rear disc brakes, while the lower ones get drums. The Swift Sport gets a unique front bumper, firmer suspension and some additional trimmings.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class Coupe made its debut as a 2018 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, and followed by the C-Class. Three models were introduced - the E200 and E300 which get the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and the all-wheel drive E400 which gets the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 motor. All models get the 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. For the first time, air suspension is now offered. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

Daihatsu aims to boost sales with its new Terios 4WD. With short front and rear overhangs, a long wheelbase and wide track, it looks like it can go off-road, but not with any real verve. It's apparently aimed at people looking for the traditional 4x4 qualities of high seating position, bad-weather traction and versatility combined with small car running costs and manoeuvrability. It is longer and wider than the previous model. The interior is about the same size as a mid-sized hatchback, with a split fold-and-tumble rear seat that frees up luggage space supposedly long enough to take a mountain bike. The front floor cross-member, tunnel, sills, B-pillars and roof-side rails are all strengthened to secure the cabin. With the rear seat in use the boot capacity is 380 litres. Its 1.5-litre engine is based on the Daihatsu 1.3-litre, with variable valve timing and its torque curve is virtually flat from 3200 to 4000 rpm. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic transmission. A centre differential transfers power with a fixed 50/50 torque split to the front and rear axles via separate propshafts. A fascia-mounted switch activates the electronically-controlled differential lock. ABS and airbags are available too.

The Suburban, alongside the shorter Tahoe, has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Suburban and Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Suburban, with better fuel economy to boot, but a bigger 6.0-litre V8 is available. The 5.3-litre's aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. The 6.0-litre V8 gets a 6-speed automatic. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Suburban is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The eight-seater Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, so it offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The Trajet is Hyundai's latest attempt at conquering the world of minivans, but it is a completely typical minivan, with nothing over the competition except a lower price and an underpowered 2.7-litre V6. Standard features include power steering, front and rear a/c, roof rack, front and rear power windows, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, central door locks, funky tail lights and an automatic transmission. Options include a sunroof, fog lamps, All models come with 15-inch wheels, though the lower model gets steel rims with plastic covers, while the top model gets alloys. Unique features include four forward-opening doors, which is a rarity in the large minivan set. The basic model actually comes with 8-seater capacity, thanks to a bunch of bench seats, but the top model is more of a 7-seater, with more comfortable accommodations. The cabin is of course versatile, with movable and foldable seats to increase or decrease luggage space as needed. Safety features are conspicuously absent in the Middle East model, though overseas versions get all sorts of airbags, traction control and ABS, some of which you could probably special-order.

The IS 300 C comes with a GCC-specific 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Along with the folding hard-top, the IS C features LED rear lights, parking sensors, revised instrument gauges, climate control designed for top-down motoring, 12-speaker Mark Levinson sound system and an in-dash CD changer. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

A new generation of the Kia Soul came out as a 2015 model year. Being touted as a crossover, it is really a tall compact hatchback, designed to be appealing for our misguided urban youth. Featuring tons of cabin space, the Kia Soul is powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Also the Soul gets more soft-touch material inside than the previous generation. Available in two trim levels, the basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, a single driver's airbag, roof rack, fog lamps, CD stereo with iPod input, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seat, black cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better CD stereo with a sub-woofer and illuminated speakers, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, underfloor tray and power outlet in the boot, luggage net, some extra trim. dual front airbags and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of black, beige and red two-tone interiors. Optional features are extensive, largely limited to appearance kits, such as funkier alloy wheels, stickers, chrome trim, front and rear skirts, and shiny fuel caps. In addition to front airbags, ABS is available on all except the base model, but stability control and side airbags are not available on GCC-spec models.

The BMW M5 is the performance version of the 5-series and a new model debuted in late 2011 with a highly-tuned 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard equipment include head-Up display, multi-channel audio system, four-zone automatic air conditioning and BMW iDrive control. The M5 gets a unique body kit, hydraulic steering, and simpler sports suspension. The redesigned BMW 5-Series comes with a parking assistant, as well as active cruise control, surround view and rear view camera, lane departure warning, lane change warning and night vision with pedestrian recognition.

The 2018 Ford Tourneo Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying passengers. It can seat up to 8 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2018 Ford Tourneo Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 4 speakers,  SYNC, 3.5-multifunctional display, Bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, manual A/C, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2018 Ford Tourneo Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets a major interior and exterior facelift for 2008. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models an upgraded 3.6-litre V6 engine. Engine choices also include the carryover 4.6-litre Northstar V8 and the 4.4-litre supercharged V8, the latter of which is reserved for the sporting STS-V. All engines hook up to a new six-speed automatic transmission, and all-wheel-drive is optional in the non-V models. The V8 models were cancelled after 2010. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, 17-inch or 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, automatic climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, rear parking assist, and a starter button. New technological features in the 2008 STS, available in some markets, include active steering technology in the StabiliTrak electronic stability control system, a Lane Department Warning System and Size Blind Zone Alert System. A Chinese-built long-wheelbase version of the rear-wheel-drive car, dubbed the SLS, is also available in Middle East markets.

The F6 was the second model to join the Chinese BYD range. The midsize sedan is slightly smaller than the class average, even if the derivative styling uses cues from Japanese stalwarts. Powered by a choice of Mitsubishi-designed 2.0-litre or 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engines, both can be had with a 5-speed manual, although the larger engine, which comes with Mitsubishi's MIVEC variable-valve timing technology, can also be mated with an outdated 4-speed automatic with tiptronic function. Available features include an 8-way adjustable driver's seat, tilt-and-telescoping multi-function steering wheel, power windows, electric mirrors and cruise control. Also available are cloth or leather upholstery with wood trim. Safety features include ABS with EBD, dual front airbags, seat-mounted side airbags and protective beams in the doors. BYD is only available in some GCC countries, including UAE, Kuwait and Oman.

The Mercedes-Benz A-Class changes focus completely from a half-sized runabout to a proper hatchback for 2013. Aiming to gain a larger share of the younger-driver market that the German carmaker has so far failed to impact in this region, the A-Class will only be offered in one version, the A 250, powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This generation of the pickup has been around since 2006, but has been facelifted for 2012. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with a manual gearbox as standard, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player. However, the 2.7-litre double-cab is available in automatic transmission.

An all-new Cadillac CT5 made its debut in 2020, replacing the CTS. In the GCC, the CT5 gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CT5 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE entertainment system with 10-inch screen and BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

An all-new Ford Escape made its debut in 2017 in the GCC. The new Escape is the first Ford vehicle in the world with available SYNC Connect, allowing users to unlock doors, check fuel level and even locate where a vehicle is parked. Under the hood, two new engines are available. The first is carried over from the previous generation, a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the other is a new 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base model is two-wheel drive, which optional 4-wheel drive is available. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering. The Sync 3 infotainment system gets Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as well. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, blind spot monitor,  and adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support. Active Park Assist is also available to park the car itself, whether parallel or perpendicular. Higher models gets adaptive front lighting system which automatically adjust the bi-xenon headlamps according to the environment.

This generation of the Genesis G80 sedan debuted in 2015 model year as the Hyundai Genesis, before the rebranding in 2017 as a separate marque. The Genesis can be had with a choice of either a 3.8-litre V6 or 5.0-litre V8. Both engines are mated to a Hyundai-designed 8-speed automatic transmission. Rear-wheel-drive is standard in both models. An "Intelligent Drive Mode" system offers Normal, Eco, Sport and Snow settings that alter transmission mapping, throttle responsiveness, stability control to suit driving conditions. The Genesis V8 can be optioned with an adaptive damping suspension that promises both sportier roadholding and a cushier ride. It, too, can be controlled by Intelligent Drive Mode.
