The Genesis 3.8 is fitted as standard with leather upholstery, 12-way power-adjustable front seats, a navigation system with an 8.0-inch screen, a seven-speaker AM/FM/CD radio stereo with AUX and USB input jacks, auto on/off headlight, LED headlight accents, LED taillights, rain-sensing windshield wipers, automatic climate control, Bluetooth connectivity, cruise control, hands-free trunk opening capability, a 4.3-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display and 18-inch alloy wheels. To those features, the Genesis 5.0 adds or substitutes a Lexicon Discrete Logic 7 surround sound system with 14 speakers, premium leather upholstery, genuine matte wood trim, 16-way power adjustable front seats, HID headlights with auto-leveling, high-beam assist, LED fog lights, a rear-view camera, front and rear parking sensors, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection with rear cross traffic alert and lane change assist, lane departure warning system with lane keep assist, a 7.0-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display, manual rear side window sunshades, a power rear sunshade, memory functionality for power driver's seat and outside mirrors and steering column, adaptive cruise control and 19-inch alloy wheels. Much of the 5.0's features can be added to the 3.8 in the form of optional extras. All Genesis models come with dual front, front side, rear side and full-length side curtain airbags in addition to a driver's knee airbag and traction and stability control systems. Optional equipment includes an automatic emergency braking system that applies the brakes if it detects an impending collision; a blind spot warning system with a rear cross traffic alert system that warns the driver of approaching traffic in backup situations; a lane departure warning system with lane keep assist setup that warns the driver if the Genesis begins to wander into an adjacent lane and provides slight steering corrections to bring the sedan back on course; and an emergency steering support mode that automatically changes the setting of suspension and electronic stability control in the direction suitable for emergency steering, to help avoid frontal crash situations.

The Nissan Altima received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year, including a restyled front end, new wheel designs, and new interior options. The Altima is available with a choice of a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6 in the coupe. All versions get the CVT automatic as standard, although the 2.5 coupe can actually be had with a 6-speed manual in some markets. All GCC-spec Altima models come with a beige interior, in cloth or optional leather, but red upholstery is optionally available for the coupe. The entertainment system has been upgraded with a optional new Bose premium stereo with nine speakers, optional 4.3-inch colour display, USB port with iPod connectivity, Bluetooth hands-free Phone System, MP3/WMA CD playback, and rear monitor. Also offered is an optional hard-drive navigation system with 6.5-inch VGA colour display, 9.3GB Music Box for music storage and playback, Bluetooth Streaming Audio, DVD player and an RCA input for auxiliary audio/video connectivity. The 2.5 models gets 16-inch alloy wheels, Bose stereo, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, manually-adjusted seatsfog lamps, rear camera and cloth upholstery with options such as sunroof and spoiler. And the 3.5 gets 17-inch alloys, power driver's seat, spoiler and optional leather. All Altima models now come with stability control, front and side airbags, and ABS, with options such as side-curtain airbags and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Pilot is Honda's midsize 4x4 offering, and their largest offering at this time. The facelifted-for-2012 SUV attempts to move slightly upscale with its available luxury options. The new look features a new standard grille, new front and rear bumpers, and optional new wheels, along with a few other cabin additions. The Pilot can seat eight people at a pinch. The standard 3.5-litre V6 engine features Variable Cylinder Management (VCM) which allows it to operate on half the cylinders when power is not needed, improving fuel economy. Also standard is a basic 5-speed automatic. Based on the same platform as the Odyssey minivan, the Pilot claims to be an off-roader, but only succeeds moderately, with an all-wheel-drive system that can lock itself in a 50:50 front/rear power split, but with no low-range gearing. Standard features include cloth upholstery, fog lights, roof rails, cruise control, tri-zone auto a/c, 7-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, auto headlights, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seats and 17-inch alloy wheels. The top Touring model can be had with leather upholstery, 10-speaker stereo with hard-drive navigation, rear DVD entertainment, rear camera, rear sun blinds, powered front seats, sunroof and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, front-side airbags and curtain airbags.

The FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The 2021 FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. In UAE, the manual gearbox is not offered anymore, with the 2021 Toyota FJ Cruiser GXR model coming with power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, infotainment system with a 12-inch screen, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, navigation, radio and Bluetooth, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear parking sensors, full-time 4x4, rear-diff lock and 17-inch alloy wheels, automatic gearbox, power mirrors, crawl control, dashboard display, navigation, rear-view camera, rear window wiper and part-time 4x4, 8 speakers, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, leather-stitched steering wheel, front skid plate protector, spare wheel hard cover, and lot of chrome pieces such as the exhaust tip, grille, door mirrors and door handles. In Saudi Arabia, the base FJ stopped getting a manual gearbox in 2020. Features include power steering, power windows, manual side mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear diff-lock and 17-inch alloy wheels, side-step, rear-window wiper, no traction control and no rear diff-lock; the FJ 1 gets power mirrors, Bluetooth, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, rear parking sensors, iPod support, driver arm rest, 10 JBL speakers & subwoofer, rear-view camera, spare wheel cover and no diff lock; the FJ 2 gets rear diff-lock, front skid plate, traction control, wi-fi and two-hitch. Safety features include standard front airbags as well as ABS and vehicle stability control. In Saudi Arabia, the top model gets side airbags as well. A new Adventure version was launched in the GCC in 2021, which gets smoked lights, blackened grille, bumpers, door handles and door mirrors, Bushwacker fender flares, Fox suspensions, 2-inch lift and Borla performance exhaust.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA-Class is a sub-compact 4-door sedan. The CLA-Class will only be offered in one version, the CLA 250, powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Not only does the 2014 Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG get a boost in power from the twin turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 engine, but also it has gone all-wheel drive. That's not it, as there is also an S-model which produces even more power. The engine is mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Like all AMG models, there is Comfort, Sport, Sport+ and Manual modes to tweak suspension and transmission settings. The S-model gets a limited-slip differential as well. AMG carbon ceramic brakes are optional.  The front fascia incorporates the new AMG design philosophy, which is the silver-chrome AMG "twin blade" radiator grille and the so-called "A-wing." The new three-dimensional air control element extends across the front fascia and sports the stylised "A" distinctive of AMG vehicles. The "A-wing" painted in body colour with silver-chrome trim strip frames the three generously dimensioned cooling-air inlets. Black flics on the side air inlets ensure optimal airflow to the cooling modules, and on the bottom a front splitter contributes to increasing downforce. It also gets widened fenders. There's both a sedan and a wagon version, although expect the sedan only to come to the Middle East, incidentally one of AMG's largest markets.  All the usual luxury and safety features are available, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. It also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

An all-new Mercedes-G Class was revealed in 2019. The first generation had run from 1990 till 2018. The G 500 comes with a twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 model, combined with a 9-speed automatic transmission. It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before.  Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

The Mitsubishi Outlander got a facelift in 2016. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

The new-for-2010 Jaguar XJ was redesigned from the ground up to continue the British brand's sharper new image, first introduced via the smaller XF model. The XJ is generally available in four trim levels in SWB and LWB versions. The UAE and some other GCC markets will only see the Premium Luxury, Portfolio and SuperSport versions, all in LWB form. The XJ Premium Luxury and the Portfolio will be available with a 5.0-litre naturally-aspirated V8. The XJ Portfolio can also be optioned up with a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The SuperSport comes exclusively with a higher-tuned 5.0-litre supercharged V8. In 2011, a GCC-specific 3.0-litre V6 base model was introduced. All models are rear-wheel-drive mated with 6-speed automatic gearboxes. Features include an aluminium body, air suspension, "Adaptive Dynamics" continuously-variable damping, adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, "Active Differential Control" and quick-ratio power steering. Customers can have their choice in colours, veneers and leathers. Inside the car, there is a 12.3-inch LCD with virtual Instruments, Dual-View 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, optional 1200W Bowers & Wilkins system, hard drive and connectivity for portable audio and video devices via a "Media Hub." Other available features include a panoramic glass roof, power accessories, automatic climate control, electric seats with ventilation, turning headlights and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS, pre-charged braking technology, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor and more. The V6 is available in regular or long-wheelbase form, while the V8 is only available in long-wheelbase form, with regular-wheelbase models available upon request.

From 2011, the Ford Mustang Convertible got two new aluminium engine choices, namely a 3.7-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, with a new 6-speed automatic transmission. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, 18-inch to 19-inch aluminium wheel choices, power mirrors, 8-speaker "Shaker 500" CD/MP3 stereo with a six-disc changer, standard SYNC multimedia system with Bluetooth, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, variable "MyColor" gauge illumination, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe.

The second generation Acura NSX made a comeback to the world after years of teasing in 2016. The NSX brings supercar looks and performance, with the advantage of being a daily driver. While the previous generation, which had ended back in 2007, had poor fuel economy, that department has massively improved thanks to its hybrid setup. Mechanically, the NSX gets a twin-turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to 3 electric motors, and mated to a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission with an all-wheel-drive system. Standard features in the 2-seater NSX include electric power steering, power windows, central locking, remote key access, engine start-stop button, cruise control with steering wheel buttons, leather and Alcantara upholstery, a mix of digital and analog instrument cluster, manual sports seats, dual-zone front A/C, adaptive suspension, backup camera, premium audio system which includes 8 speakers with subwoofer, 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, MP3/auxiliary input jack, USB audio interface, SMS text message function, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels in the front while gets 20-inch. Safety features include knee, side, curtain and front airbags, ABS, tyre pressure monitoring system, traction control, and vehicle stability control.

The Australian-built Caprice has been redesigned from the ground up, but still remains one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers a choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the V8 engine as an option. The V6 was dropped by 2011, leaving the V8 as standard. The big V8 is standard on the sport-tuned SS and the luxury-tuned Royale. The Caprice continues to use a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, a cloth or leather interior, and more. ABS brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ertiga is a seven-seater minivan offering from the Japanese brand. In 2019, an all-new model of the Ertiga came out, weighing 50 kg lighter than its predecessor.The front-wheel drive people carrier features a 1.5-litre engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ertiga include power steering, AM/FM radio, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C with rear vents, halogen headlamps and steel wheels. Higher options get alloy wheels, fog lamps, chrome grille and side body moulding. Depending on trim level, the Ertiga gets dual airbags and ABS.

The Lexus LX 570 got a makeover for the 2016 model year. It has pretty much remained the same for the 2018 model year. A limited edition model, known as LX 570 Signature in UAE and as Sport in other GCC countries, was introduced, featuring a new front spindle grille, new front bumper spoiler, black door mirror cover, darker door molding and a rear bumper diffuser. The Lexus is powered by a 5.7-litre V8 mated with an 8-speed automatic transmission. A 4.5-litre turbocharged diesel engine was introduced in Saudi Arabia in 2019. The full-time all-wheel drive features a 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a crawl-control feature when in low range. The "overturn" assist feature can lock one inside rear tyre to help make slow turns tighter in offroad conditions. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. The leather interior can be had in tan, beige or black. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes, and traction control, as well as multiple airbags, with available tech such as the Pre-Crash Safety System that can detect and prepare for a crash, Lane Departure Alert, Automatic High Beam System, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control with auto  braking, and Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert.

An all-new Volvo S60 came out as a 2020 model in the GCC. It is the first ever Volvo to be built in the United States. The S60 straddles the line between compact and midsize. In 2021, the petrol engine available was 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mild hybrid engine. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's tablet-style infotainment system in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher models gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians.

The redesigned-for-2008 Mondeo is an attractive midsize car built in Europe that shares a Mazda platform. It looks excellent inside and out, but loses out to the Japanese with a weak combination of carryover engines, along with the stigma of expensive dealer maintenance charges. It was facelifted a bit for 2011, with a new front bumper and grille. The Mondeo is largely avaliable as a family sedan, but it is also available in sporty liftback and practical wagon form in some markets. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for an affordable price. The interior is especially attractive and put together well. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available with a 5-speed manual. A 2.3-litre 4-cylinder engine is coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. Various trim levels are available, all with power windows, trip computer, ABS brakes, front airbags, CD stereo with MP3 connector and more. Options include stability control, CD changer, keyless starter button, Xenon adaptive headlights, tyre pressure monitor, sunroof, fog lights, variable suspension settings, hill launch assist and adaptive cruise control.

The Volvo V70 is a midsize station wagon available in a few GCC countries. Currently only the V70 Comfort is sold here with the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment in the car include power mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with CD player, foldable three-split rear seats and alloy wheels. Volvo, never to compromise on safety, has driver, passenger, side and curtain airbags as standard, along with WHIPS whiplash protection. Luggage space is quite big thanks to its upright shape. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The GAC GS4 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, the front-wheel GS4 gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, fabric seats, halogen lamps, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with USB/AUX/CD support and 6 speakers. The higher models get a sunroof, fog lamps, cruise control, leather seats, xenon headlamps and automatic A/C. Safety features include airbags for front driver and  passenger, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist, traction control, hill assist and hill descent control.

The Ferrari 812 Superfast replaced the F12 Berlinetta and is the fastest naturally aspirated model they have ever produced at the time. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Electric power steering was introduced in this model. The car also saw the introduction of the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Cadillac ATS is the smallest offering from the American luxury brand. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS will be offered with two engine choices. One will be a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine and other a 3.6-litre V6. External changes include three new colours. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, navigation, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Quietly put on the showroom floor by local Hyundai dealers, the unknown i30 is a new-for-2008 hatchback alternative to the Elantra. Powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the i30 is being positioned as a cheaper alternative to better-equipped compact Japanese and European rivals. It is available with only a 4-speed automatic gearbox. The i30 benefits from a spacious-enough interior and the flexibility of a hatchback cargo area, especially with the folding rear seatback. Standard features are limited, with height-adjustable front seats, 60/40 split rear seats, cloth or partial leatherette seats, power windows, electric mirrors, body-coloured exterior trim and LED cabin lighting. Other available features include keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with USB support, fog lights, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. The i30 was originally designed to compete in the European market, so it benefits from tighter suspension tuning and better cabin materials. Sadly, GCC-spec cars are underequipped, especially in terms safety, as there is only one standard airbag and no ABS brakes.

A new generation Nissan X-Trail debuted in the GCC in 2015. It got a facelfit for the 2018 model year. Featuring a completely revised exterior and interior, it gets a 2.5-litre 4 cylinder engine, mated to a CVT gearbox. The base model is front-wheel-drive, but all other trim levels are all-wheel-drive with an electronic 4x4 lock feature. There's also a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater layouts. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, keyless entry with central locking, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, and steel or 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include better entertainment system with screen and more speakers, bigger alloy wheels, parking sensors, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power front seats, navigation, 18-inch alloys and automatic a/c, among other things. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags with optional side airbags, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist (BA).

The Renault Symbol is a sub-compact offering from the French car manufacturer. The Romanian-built Symbol made its way back to the GCC market in 2015. It comes with only one engine, a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the basic Symbol PE model include power steering, front electric windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/USB, Bluetooth, steering wheel mounted controls, fabric seats, front fog lamps and steel wheels with 15-inch hubcaps. The SE model gets additional rear electric windows, electric mirrors, trip computer, temperature sensor, body colour door handles with chrome, automatic A/C, cruise control and leather steering wheel. The top SE model gets 15-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, 7-inch touchscreen with GPS and navigation, and optional leather seats. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS.

The LFA is the Lexus brand's "halo" model, serving more as a publicity stunt for their potential engineering prowess rather than an actual profitable product. Production of the LFA is limited to 500 units worldwide, with only a handful making it to the GCC, and purchase is by invitation only. The LFA, available only in coupe form for now, is powered by a 4.8-litre V10 with a 9000 rpm redline. It is mated to a 6-speed sequential automanual gearbox and a rear-wheel-drive platform with limited-slip differential. The LFA has a 48:52 front-to-rear weight distribution, and a 65% carbon-fibre body. It comes with 20-inch BBS alloy wheels, Brembo six-piston front and four-piston rear brakes, launch control, 3-mode stability control with sport mode and a speed-sensitive rear wing. The LFA interior incorporates carbon fibre, leather, alcantara, and metallic surfaces. Tech features include the Lexus Remote Touch controller interface, an LCD speedometer with customisable themes, alloy paddle-shifters, a 12-speaker Mark Levinson sound system with compact lightweight components, custom-made Tumi suitcases with a two-piece set made from carbon-fiber style materials and inscribed with the VIN and more. Safety features include several airbags for the two passengers, including seat-belt airbags. Customers invited to buy the car can personalise the Lexus LFA in undefined ways, in terms of colour schemes inside and out. There are apparently enough customisable options to ensure no two identical models will exist in the UAE. Only 20 cars per month, with cars built to order, and production is expected to end before 2013.

The ninth generation Chevrolet Malibu made its debut in the GCC as a 2017 model year. It got a slight facelift in 2019, along with a new base engine and improved tech. Under the hood the base model now gets a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed transmission. The other engine on offer is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. That one gets an 6-speed auto transmission. Standard features on the 2021 Chevrolet Malibu LS model include power steering, electric windows, central locking, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, single zone A/C, 6-speaker audio system, 7-inch touch screen with Bluetooth, phone projection and navigation, keyless entry, engine push start, fabric seats, cruise control and 16-inch steel wheels. The Malibu LT gets additional remote vehicle starter and 17-inch alloy wheels. The sunroof, 8-inch touch screen, and power seats are optional on the LT. On the Malibu Premier, additional features include dual exhausts, HID headlamps, LED tail lamps, auto headlight leveling function, dual-zone A/C, 9-speaker Bose audio system, 8-inch touch screen with navigation, USB charge port, leather seats, power seats and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the Premier include sunroof, rearview camera and adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS), and traction control. The Premier gets side airbags as well. Other optional safety equipment include lane-keeping assist, blind spot monitor, forward collision alert and rear cross traffic alert.

The Chevrolet Tahoe got a new 6-speed transmission from 2009 onward. A beefy  Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Tahoe. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Tahoe is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

An all new Porsche Cayenne came out for 2018. The variants initially available were the Cayenne, Cayenne S and Cayenne Turbo. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. The Cayenne S gets a new 2.9-litre turbo V6. The Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Later on, an E-Hybrid model joined the lineup which got a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine combined to an electric motor. In 2021, the Cayenne GTS was added, getting a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 motor. All engines get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Porsche updated the interior of the Cayenne by doing away with many buttons and by replacing them with a 12.3-inch touchscreen and a few touch-capacitive controls. The interior retains the analog tachometer which now comes with two 7-inch color displays on either sides that read out driver information. The new Cayenne comes with a list of goodies that are offered in other Porsche products. Rear wheel steering, a Porsche Active Suspension Management system for “finer degree of specific calibration” of the air suspension, a new Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control that uses a 48-volt electrical system and a new semi-autonomous driving tech called Innodrive are a few of them. Features available on the Cayenne optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch and higher quality audio systems. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

An all-new Jeep Wrangler Unlimited came out in 2018. It is slightly bigger, faster and lighter than the previous generation. The engine has been carried over from the older model, the 3.6-litre V6 “Pentastar” motor. Acceleration and fuel economy numbers have been improved, thanks to the new 8-speed automatic transmission replacing the ancient 5-speed. Manual gear lovers will be left disappointed though, as it is not offered anymore in this region. The electronically assisted steering has replaced the hydraulic steering. The interior has more quality materials than the older model, with the Sahara and Rubicon models getting more of the leather treatment. Even the standard equipment has improved, with the Wrangler Unlimited Sport getting a touchscreen for the infotainment system. Safety features include four airbags, ABS, stability control, and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monitor, and rear cross path detection.

In addition to a sedan version, the Impreza has now become a hatchback for 2008, with interior and exterior styling solidly in the mainstream of conservative design. It remains the only car in its class with standard full-time all-wheel drive. Subaru likes to tout their rally heritage, but none of the Middle East models are anywhere near rally cars. The models offered here are the new 1.5-litre, known as the 1.5i, and the 2.0-litre, known as the 2.0R. Both have flat 4-cylinder "boxer" engines, and both mated to either a 5-speed manual or an outdated 4-speed automatic. Base models have a standard AM/FM stereo system, cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking and steel wheels, along with dual front airbags. The full-spec 2.0R model features the same full power options, alloy wheels, rear spoiler, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, sunroof and not much else. Western and Eastern world markets receive turbocharged WRX sports models, but local dealers do not officially offer them in the GCC.

From the 2014 model year, the Infiniti QX56 became the QX80 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. The exterior gives away its Nissan origins, save for unique front and rear ends, as well as some trim bits. The QX80 comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. A 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available, which also includes optional 22-inch wheels and a number of other features. The QX80 also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. Inside, standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, available perforated semi-aniline leather seating, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 7-inch colour monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the QX80's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA colour touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

Based on the GranTurismo coupe, the GranCabrio convertible got a facelift and much-needed upgrade under the hood and tech for 2018. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.7-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of many colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This two-door 2+2 convertible is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium audio system, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The Hyundai i40 is a midsize station wagon. A basic, mid-range and top model are sold here. All the models get the same 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, steel wheels, AM/FM radio and CD player with MP3 playback capability and six speakers. Available features, standard on higher trim levels, include parking sensors and alloy wheels. The rear seat backrests feature a 60:40 split, so you can still carry the luggage plus a rear seat passenger or two. If more space is required, rear seat backrests fold flat into the floor while the floor rail system helps keep your luggage secured.

The Outback is the redesigned model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive crossover wagon. Like all previous Outback models for more than a decade, the new-for-2010 version continues to be based on the Legacy wagon, only with slightly better ground clearance. Compared to the previous version, it now features a larger body and carryover engines. The base Outback 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 3.6R, with a turbocharged 3.6-litre 6-cylinder boxer engine mated to a paddle-shifted 5-speed automatic. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

Launched in 2005 and facelifted for 2008, the compact S40 sedan is based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the S40 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The S40 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre, a higher-tuned 2.4-litre and a turbocharged 2.5-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The compact V50 wagon and its S40 sedan sibling are based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the V50 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The V50 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre and a higher-tuned 2.4-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The new 5-Series reared its rakish head back in 2004. Before the facelift in 2006, the extensive models available included the 523i, 525i, 520d, 530i, 530d, 530xi and the 545i. The 5-Series is available in both saloon and Touring wagon platforms, but the slow-selling wagons are not actively peddled in this region. The 530xi is the only all-wheel-drive model offered. The exterior design by Chris Bangle is controversial, especially the aptly-named "Bangle-butt" rear end. Its iDrive system has been simplified compared to the first-generation system that debuted in the 7-Series. It can be ordered with options such as Active Cruise Control, head-up display, active steering and a Harman Kardon Logic7 stereo system. The higher versions of the BMW 5-Series are high-performance sedans, and also among the most technically advanced. Available features include all the usual comfort and power accessories, along with options such as active steering, iDrive control system, and a sequential-manual gearbox offered alongside a manual and an automatic. Few cars can compare with the 5-Series, but rivals are forever trying to match the benchmark Bimmer, even before the debut of the M5 for 2006.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Coupe and M8 Competition Coupe was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

Launched back in 2001, redone mechanically in 2004, and facelifted in 2007, the S60 is tuned to be a sports sedan, but though it is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis in all but the R model, it looks like a sleek sports coupe from afar. The interior is fairly spacious even with the swooping roofline, and it offers more of a midsize package than a compact one, even though it is occassionally pitted against smaller German rivals in comparisons. For the Middle East market, there are five powerplants. These include a basic 2.0-litre turbo and a 2.5-litre turbo for the run-of-the-mill S60 sedan models, a 2.4-litre turbo for the sporty front-wheel-drive T5 and a highly-tuned 2.5-litre turbo for the all-wheel-drive S60 R. All engines are five-cylinder, and have an automatic with tiptronic, although some can be had with a manual too. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection.

The Peugeot 308 received a facelift in 2012. The same 1.6-litre 4-cylinder and turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape. However, the turbocharged version gets a power boost. They all get a new 6-speed automatic transmission. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. They also introduced a SUV "coupe" version for the GLC. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. In 2020, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe got a slight facelift and bump in power. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Kia Quoris is a new nameplate for the Korean brand, becoming the flagship of the range by a long shot, in terms of pricing. The full-size sedan comes with a 3.8-litre "MPI" V6 as standard. The rear-wheel-drive platform is fed power via an 8-speed automatic and held up by electronically-adjustable air suspension riding on 18-inch alloy wheels. Available features include a full LCD gauge cluster, electronic gear-shift knob, 17-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, haptic-feedback steering wheel controls, 9.2-inch dual rear screens, heads-up display, power ventilated front seats, surround-view cameras, power rear sunblinds and more. Safety features include nine airbags including a knee airbag, as well as stability control and ABS, while adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights and blind-spot monitoring are also available.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016. The wagon is available with a "SkyActiv" 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection engine. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. There is no top-spec model offered in the GCC. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

The Lexus ES, the luxury carmaker's bread-and-butter sedan, carries on with its comfort-biased approach and focus on convenience features. A new generation ES sedan came out in 2019. It comes with three engine options, a 4-cylinder 2.5-litre, a 3.5-litre V6, both mated to an 8-speed automatic, and a 2.5-litre coupled with an electric motor, connected to a CVT. All models are front wheel drive. The ES 250 model comes in one "Prlatinum" trim and features HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, front-rear parking sensors, 18-inch alloys, moonroof, headlamp cleaner, leather interior, powered front seats, 8-speaker navigation, 12.3-inch screen with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, power-adjustable steering, and dual-zone auto a/c. The ES 350 "Prestige" adds the V6 engine, nicer leather, navigation, power rear sunshade and a blind-spot monitor. The "Platinum" adds a front screen, rear camera and a remote-touch computer. The "Titanium" further adds adaptive headlights, different wheels, panoramic glass roof, even semi-aniline leather, front ventilated seats, 3-zone a/c, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist and a pre-crash safety system. All models come with front, knee, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The all-new Volvo C70 is touted as being two cars in one, namely a coupe and a convertible, although the concept has been around for years now. This one has room for four average-sized adults. The three-piece retractable steel roof folds up or down electrically in 30 seconds. Development of the trick top was apparently helped along by Pininfarina in Italy. The new car is slightly shorter and lower than the old model, though it offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers. Available in this region are two oddball five-cylinder engines, one a 2.4-litre and the other a turbocharged 2.5-litre, both with automatic gearboxes with tiptronic, and all models are invariably front-wheel-drive. Standard features include dual zone automatic climate control, power seats, trip computer, automatic dimming rear-view mirror and a CD audio system. Safety features typical of Volvo include emergency pop-up roll bars, ABS brakes, a front side-impact protection system also known as SIPS, and a whiplash protection they like to call WHIPS.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. Powered by either a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box and leather seats. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

Named after Ferrari coachbuilder Sergio Scaglietti, the all-aluminum 612 Scaglietti attempts to blend performance and comfort in the tradition of a true Ferrari berlinetta designed to accommodate four people. This Ferrari is a 12-cylinder model with both the space-frame chassis and body panels in aluminium. The overall layout, with the 5.7-litre engine mounted behind the front axle and the gearbox in line with the differential at the rear, ensures an ideally balanced weight distribution, as well as permitting a lower centre of gravity. The performance-orientated handling is enhanced by active damping and a new stability and traction control system, with components from General Motors subsidiaries no less. The 612 runs with a six-speed mechanical gearbox, in a choice of manual or F1-style paddle shifts. With a relatively long wheelbase, the 612 has been designed to offer ease of entry for rear-seat passengers to a luxurious cabin which will accommodate four adults in comfort, while the luggage trunk hold a five-piece Ferrari luggage set or two full sets of golf clubs. Features include a new radio-CD system, voice recognition system, MP3 player, Bluetooth and more.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. For 2018, the Huracan Performante was released with higher performance numbers. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Porsche 911 Cabriolet is all-new after spending more than a decade in its current form, with continuous updates of course. For 2012, the design incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than before. It is still a 2+2 seater convertible. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.4-litre direct-injection flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The 911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet, which was introduced in 2013, adds all-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S Cabriolet upgrades the motor to a 3.8-litre, while the, new for 2013, 911 Carrera 4S Cabriolet adds all-wheel-drive. The 911 Turbo Cabriolet and Turbo S Cabriolet was released in 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre turbocharged engine, and comes only with the PDK transmission. The 911 GTS was revealed in the GCC in late 2014 and is available as rear-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. It is powered by a 3.8-litre motor, coupled with either a 7-speed manual or PDK transmission. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

The attractive GranTurismo is derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. A Sport version ups the ante with a 4.7-litre V8, which can either mated to a Electro-Actuated MC Shift or an optional MC-Shift automanual transmission. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale is also available, which has some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is a contender to be the van of choice for families, assuming you are looking just for a whole lot of space and not much luxury features. Its tough looks are misleading, as it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning, some even with rear a/c. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps.

The Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is an all-new model, to compete against the BMW X6. Mercedes-AMG GLE Coupe 63 is the top performance model. In 2020, it got a facelift and power upgrades. Under the hood, it comes with the 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. A small electric motor has been added to the engine to provide better acceleration and response, as well as improve fuel economy. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and 21-inch cross-spoke AMG alloy wheels. The 5-seater interior offers leather upholstery, mood lighting, HDD navigation, panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking.

BMW's American-built 4WD comes in three models in this region, namely the 3.0i with a 6-cylinder engine, the 4.4i with a V8, and the 4.8is with a bigger V8. Debuting in 2000 and receiving a facelift in 2004, the X5 has all-wheel drive without low-range gearing, but does come with ABS and traction control. The 3.0i offers manual and automatic transmissions, but the V8 models only come with an automatic. The automatics do have a manual shift gate, but they are still essentially automatics. Standard on V8s and optional on the 3.0i are load-leveling suspension, leather upholstery, front and rear obstacle detection, and steering-linked xenon headlights. Other available features include adjustable ride-height suspension, heated rear seats, navigation system and sunroof. The X5 is far from an off-roader, but it has built up a reputation for excellent on-road driving dynamics for a 4WD, and has become popular with rich people who like to terrorise other road users with some deft moves. The V8 models drive more like sport wagons rather than any 4WD, though it seems a little pointless when BMW itself has much more capable V8-powered 5-Series wagons in its European stable.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 is immensely powerful, and features cylinder deactivation technology, seamlessly turning off the fuel consumption in four cylinders of the 5.7-liter HEMI engine when V8 power is not needed, improving fuel economy by up to 20 percent, though one would be hardpressed to notice a difference. The ride is smooth, but corners should be handled with care.

The Chery E8 is the Chinese brand's midsize sedan offering. The front-wheel drive E8 gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to CVT automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, fog lamps, manual fabric seats, radio with CD player, USB port, six speakers, parking sensors, chrome-plated front grille and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include electric sunroof and leather electric seats. Front driver and passenger airbags are standard, as is ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The latest Durango has been redesigned, mostly with a minor facelift, and it appears to be a well-built light duty 4WD capable of transporting seven people almost anywhere in very comfortable surroundings, even though it is ultimately one of the ugliest vehicles on the road. The only engine option available here is the 5.7-litre, Hemi V8, which helps the two-and-a-half ton Durango move off with reasonable verve. It's interior design conserves space, which permits a 3rd row of relatively accessible seating. It is obvious that parent company Mercedes-Benz has had an influence on the lowly Dodge. The seams are tight and the materials are of a high quality. The ergonomics work well too, with all the minor luxuries, including a good sound system and a rear seat DVD-entertainment system. Excellent sound insulation means passengers aren't too distracted by road or wind noise, while the third row folds flat into the floor and the 2nd row folds up and out of way very easily. Standard features include air conditioning, power mirrors, illuminated entry lighting, front and rear power outlets, bucket seats, 40/20/40 folding second-row seat, AM/FM stereo radio with in-dash single-disc CD player, cruise control, tilting steering column, and remote keyless entry. Also available are rear climate controls, a power sunroof, AM/FM/6CD/MP3 player and a two-speed transfer case for off-roading.

The MG RX5 is the Chinese-British brand’s offering of a compact crossover. There will be a choice of two well-equipped trims with two available powertrains, namely a 1.5-litre with a 7-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic, both turbocharged. The front-wheel-drive 2022 MG RX5 is available with LED headlamps, two-tone 18-inch rims, high-quality cabin finish including soft-touch surfaces, opening panoramic sunroof, adjustable fold-flat rear seats with split/fold function, power tailgate, keyless entry, a start button and an auto-hold brake function. A remote smart app allows the driver to operate vehicle functions such as remote start and stop air conditioning, vehicle tracking and aftersales appointments, even reminding owners of the services needed for the car. There is a 10.4-inch high-definition infotainment touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and navigation on the 2.0T version and an 8-inch colour navigation system for 1.5T models. The 2022 MG RX5 comes with standard ESP and traction control, a curving braking control system and more. Passive safety features include a strengthened body structure that uses thermal formed steel, multiple airbags, automatic unlocking in the event of a collision and a collapsible steering column, all of which has helped the MG RX5 earn a 5-star rating in the Chinese C-NCAP crash tests.

Soon after the launch of the all-new nearly-midsize Japanese-built Mazda 6, GCC dealers chose to launch the new American-built Mazda 6 as well. The American 6 is a good bit larger than the Japanese 6, with a longer wheelbase offering more legroom and cargo space. Dubbed the Mazda 6 Ultra, the larger car is offered in two versions, namely the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed automatic and the 3.7-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The Ultra only comes in the sedan body-style. Available features include intelligent keyless entry with starter button, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, power accessories, alloy wheels, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, Bose stereo with six-disc CD changer and ten speakers, manual-shifting functionality with all automatics, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, and automatic a/c with rear vents. Available safety features include dual front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control. Specifically for the GCC version, there are special chrome side-mirror housings, chrome on the upper grille, and a gold-plated ULTRA badge at the rear. With this larger model, Mazda can finally compete with the oversized Japanese midsize sedans that dominate the current market.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's 5-door hatchback offering. The only version offered in most GCC markets is the V40 T5 now, fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder for the Middle East. Variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels, as well as the V40 Cross Country model with faux skid-plates and a slightly-raised suspension. All versions are front-wheel-drive, although the Cross Country can be had with all-wheel-drive as well. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z Roadster includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The powered soft top model almost have the same rigidity as the coupe. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Forester was Subaru's first attempt at a proper small 4WD, already being the first company to offer all-wheel drive across its entire model line. The Forester was introduced for the 1998 model year and has only survived on facelifts, being heavily revamped for 2003. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester features Subaru's symmetrical all-wheel-drive system. In the Middle East, only the 2.5X model is offered, powered by a 2.5-litre flat four-cylinder, mated to a four-speed automatic. The Forester includes a MP3/WMA CD stereo, 6-CD changer, automatic climate control system, power windows, electric mirrors, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, cruise control, cloth upholstery and an automatic air conditioner. The higher models include a sunroof, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather-wrapped surfaces such as the steering wheel, gear shift knob and handbrake. The Forester is different than most compact 4WDs since, in addition to being a soft-roader with no low-range gearing, it also has a lower car-like body.

The American-built Avalon now shares its front-wheel-drive platform as well as several mechanical bits with the Lexus ES, including the engine. The 3.5-litre V6 is mated with a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic functionality. In the UAE, the base Avalon S model comes with 17-inch alloys, smart key, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, 6.1-inch touchscreen, auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror with compass, power front seats, cruise control, leatherette seats, halogen auto headlights with fog lamps, 10 airbags, ABS, stability control and dealer-installed front-rear parking sensors. The Avalon SE model adds a 7-inch touchscreen, HDD navigation, rear camera and an 11-speaker stereo with voice-control. The Avalon SE Plus model further adds further-adjustable power front seats with ventilation, premium leather, remote starter, paddle shifters, mirror puddle-lamps, HID headlights, and a power rear sun-shade.  The Avalon Limited additionally comes with adaptive cruise control and a pre-crash safety system. For KSA, the Avalon XLE base model is similar to the S trim above, lacking fog lamps and parking sensors, but gaining a WiFi feature. The Avalon Limited in KSA corresponds to the SE Plus trim above, but without nav or rear camera, which are optional.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

Luxgen S5 is the Taiwanese brand's compact SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features on the S5 include, standard or otherwise, power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, electric seats, central locking, fog lamps, cruise control, auto A/C, leather seats, HID headlamps, LED daytime running headlamps, front & rear parking sensors. Safety features on the car include front drive & passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist system (BAS), electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake override system (BOS), traction control and stability control.

The 2014 Toyota Zelas got a facelift and some minor improvements. The stylistic enhancements include new headlamp design, an extended hood, a new grille and LED accent lighting. A new black-out valance beneath the rear bumper features a lower-centre trim piece, lower perimeter reflectors and new LED tail lamps. The interior receives upgraded materials and lighter colour fabric on the seats and headliner. The power plant in the Zelas remains the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, coupled to an updated 6-speed automatic that can shifts ratios quicker. It also features a "Dynamic Rev Management" technology, which blips the throttle on downshifts to limit driveline shock. To improve dynamics, they have modified the stabiliser bar, optimised the shock absorbers, and have increased structural rigidity with additional spot welds. It also gets retuned electronic power steering. Available features include a CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more.

The Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV came to the GCC in 2020. It gets a 2.4-litre engine connected to two electric motors. Power is transmitted to the wheels via a 1-speed direct drive transmission. It comes only in all-wheel-drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

The Bugatti Chiron is a mid-engined two-seated sports car developed and manufactured in France. It is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron. It still carries from the Veyron is the 8-litre W16 quad-turbocharged engine, but it has been significantly upgraded. Like its predecessor, it has a carbon-fibre body structure, independent suspension and a Haldex AWD system.A 7-speed dual-clutch automatic routes power to all four wheels.
