This one is 82 mm longer, 40 mm wider and 53 mm higher than the Veyron, and is also 155 kg heavier.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This generation of the pickup has been around since 2006, but has been facelifted for 2012. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with a manual gearbox as standard, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player. However, the 2.7-litre double-cab is available in automatic transmission.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. The engines remain the same though, with minor updates, so the base Boxster is powered by a 2.7-litre flat-6 and the Boxster S gets a 3.4-litre flat-6, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The Cayman GTS debuted as a 2015 model year, featuring more power and also gets the Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM) as standard. The GTS also gets the 3.4-litre flat-6 engine. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

Based on the latest E-Class platform, the Mercedes-Benz CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. The CLS 63 AMG comes with a new 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 and a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base. Standard features include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps, sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more. The CLS 63 AMG can be had with a limited-slip rear diff, adjustable suspension, carbon-fibre trim inside and out, ceramic brakes and other optional items at extra cost, including an AMG performance package that adds additional horsepower.

The Prado has become a popular choice among people who want a true off-roader but never go off-road. The Prado also shares a bade with the legendary Land Cruiser which makes it more attractive. The latest Land Cruiser Prado is a refined animal, taking advantage of technical and engineering advances that offer reasonably smooth performance on the road and reasonably capable off-roading ability. One look at it reveals rock-solid build quality so obviously missing from competitors from American manufacturers. The Prado is offered with a 2.7-litre four-cylinder, a 4.0-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesel. The petrol engines get Toyota's more modern manual and automatic gearboxes, while the weak diesel gets only a manual. The cabin is spacious and roomy with abundant headroom and legroom. Features of the interior include dual-zone air-conditioning and a CD/cassette audio system with either 4 or 6 speakers, depending on model. The Prado comes with dual front airbags and ABS as standard, with seating for either five or eight people. Side-airbags and stability control are not offered in this aging SUV.

The new-for-2018 MG RX5 compact crossover is the latest entry in the Chinese-British brand’s march towards relevance in the mainstream GCC market. There will be a choice of two well-equipped trims with two available powertrains, namely a 1.5-litre with a 7-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic, both turbocharged. The front-wheel-drive MG RX5 is available with LED headlamps, two-tone 18-inch rims, high-quality cabin finish including soft-touch surfaces, opening panoramic sunroof, adjustable fold-flat rear seats with split/fold function, power tailgate, keyless entry, a start button and an auto-hold brake function. A remote smart app allows the driver to operate vehicle functions such as remote start and stop air conditioning, vehicle tracking and aftersales appointments, even reminding owners of the services needed for the car. There is a 10.4-inch high-definition infotainment touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and navigation on the 2.0T version and an 8-inch colour navigation system for 1.5T models. The MG RX5 comes with standard ESP and traction control, a curving braking control system and more. Passive safety features include a strengthened body structure that uses thermal formed steel, multiple airbags, automatic unlocking in the event of a collision and a collapsible steering column, all of which has helped the MG RX5 earn a 5-star rating in the Chinese C-NCAP crash tests.

The range-topping M6 arrived for 2006, in coupe and convertible form, using the same V10 engine as the M5. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a 7-speed SMG automanual in the M6. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee got a second facelift for the 2017 model year. Offered with a choice of the 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or the 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a new 8-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and four trim levels. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. Another trim level introduced for 2014 is the Summit which also comes in only V8 form. The SRT8 version gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. Another feature on all models is the new 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds chrome bumper trim, painted wheel arches, real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The Summit has similar options to the Limited, with the addition of a unique SRT-like front bumper, more premium leather and wood panels for the interior. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The long-running Town Car is Lincoln's full-size luxury sedan based on the Ford Crown Victoria rear-wheel-drive platform. Numerous trim series are available, including the Signature, the Signature Limited, and the long-wheelbase Signature L. Power comes from a 4.6-litre V8 mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. Town Car puts power to the ground through its rear wheels via a 3.27:1 rear-axle ratio, with traction control and ABS brakes as standard. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch wheels, rear parking assist, keyless entry, CD stereo, leather seats, auto-dimming rearview mirror, front and side airbags, automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals and power-adjustable front seats. Options in higher trims include HID headlights, CD changer, sunroof, two-tone paint and power-operated luggage trunk lid. The car is pretty dated now, but a mild redesign in 2003 involved upgrades both inside and out.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The Ibiza is based on the VW Polo and is the hatchback variant of the Cordoba. Though similar to the Cordoba, it somehow appears a lot more sporty than the dull Cordoba, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. In the Middle East, this front-wheel-drive is offered in three-door or five-door body styles, with numerous VW-derived powerplants, including a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre and two turbocharged 1.8-litre units, all 4-cylinder engines, with some manual and some automatic transmissions available, depending on model. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, power front windows, electric mirrors, remote central locking, 15-inch to 17-inch wheels, CD stereo, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, traction control and even an optional stability control system. These cars are quite well-packed with features for their size. Sport and FR models get larger alloy wheels, stiffer suspension, body-colour rear spoiler, sports seats and unique exhausts as standard. The limited-availability 3-door Cupra gets the top turbo engine and further sports tuning.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The Hyundai Veloster Turbo got its second-generation model in 2019. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side.The Veloster Turbo has a more aggressive look than the standard model, with a black hexagonal grille, fog lamps and a revised rear fascia which features two centre-mounted exhaust-tips. Under the hood is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a new 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available include a full set of airbags, LED front running lamps, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The MKT is Lincoln's full-size luxury crossover that is based on the Ford Flex, with three rows of seating and tons of space. According to Lincoln, the "T" in MKT, stands for Touring. Larger than the MKX midsize crossover and more efficient than the Navigator, the MKT is offered in the UAE with the turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Offered in either 6-seater or 7-seater configurations, a second-row 60/40 split folding bench seat, optional power "fold and tumble" second-row bucket seats include heating, cooling and power lumbar adjustment, and an available 5-quart refrigerator in the centre console, alongside all the usual features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, CD/MP3 stereo and Bluetooth phone. A fixed-glass panoramic roof with power-assisted front and rear sunshades is standard and an opening panoramic sunroof is optional. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as ABS and stability control.

The XC70 was Volvo's first attempt at a 4WD vehicle. Based on a jacked-up V70 wagon with all-wheel-drive, it has been heavily revamped for the 2008 model year, although it is still not really that good off-road, and gets by on gravel and flat sand, given its fairly impressive ground clearance. It is powered by a 3.2-litre 6-cylinder engine, with an automatic offering tiptronic manual shifting. The second-row has a three-section bench seat with removable centre position for various setups. Standard features include keyless entry, CD player, trip computer, air-conditioning, xenon headlights, power windows, doors, locks, sunroof and mirrors. Available features also include leather or vinyl seats, ventilated front seats with perforated leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an optional rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, collision Warning with brake support and emergency brake lamps, adaptive cruise control helps keeping a safe distance to vehicles ahead, hydraulic brake assist, optimised hydraulic brakes and fading brake support. .

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. It is a compact sedan with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S made its debut in 2014. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. There is no more manual transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The MG 360 is the Chinese-owned brand's offering in the compact sedan segment. Under the hood, it gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 350 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, an “InkaLink Vehicle System” that is Android Mobile compatible, an 8-inch touchscreen, a digital speedometer, Bluetooth hands-free telephone, sunroof, rear parking camera, parking sensors and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include front airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESP), brake assist and tyre pressure monitoring system.

The Volvo S60 Polestar is available only in certain GCC markets. From 2017 onwards, it comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine and all-wheel-drive. It also comes with a new 8-speed automatic transmission, retuned electric steering, redesigned wheels  and slightly revised suspension. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console. Features include leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians.

The Mazda CX-5 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Inside, the 5-seater cabin offers features such as a 4:2:4 three-way split-folding rear seat. As far as the upholstery goes, leather and two kinds of fabric are available for the seats and trim in two colours. The soft-touch material adopted for the majority of dash surfaces and door trim is offset by a central panel featuring glossy piano-black treatment. Engine specs include a direct-injection 2.0-litre "SKYACTIV-G" 4-cylinder that has a 13:1 compression for more torque, better fuel economy and lower emissions, although slightly detuned compared to the motors offered in Western countries. The engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There also a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine which offers more power. There is front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive available for the 2.0, but the 2.5 only comes with all-wheel-drive. Each engine variant has two trim levels. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top 2.5-litre version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

Available only as a sedan for now, the latest C-Class range is all-new for the 2008 model year, with some upgraded and some carryover engines. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional AMG sports package offers attractive suspension, a special grille and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the new line-up are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the C 180 Kompressor and the C 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune. The 2.5-litre C 230 four-cylinder comes next. The 3.0-litre V6-powered C 280 and the 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standard range. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. The diesel models are not promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many luxury features, such as 17-inch rims, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. Trim lines include Classic, Elegance and Avantgarde. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

An all-new Toyota RAV-4 was released for 2019. Under the hood, the 2.5-litre engine carried over into the 2019 Toyota RAV-4, but connected with a new 8-speed automatic transmission. In KSA, the base model gets a 2.0-litre engine, mated to a CVT. A new hybrid model has also been introduced in the GCC market for the first time, which comes an electric motor coupled with a 2.5-litre engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features on the RAV-4 include power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, 9-inch infotainment screen with 4 speakers, rear view camera and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher trims get 18-inch alloy wheels, moonroof and LED fog lamps. Safety features include front, side and knee airbags, vehicle stability control, traction control, and ABS.

The all-new Jaguar XK is the long-awaited successor to Jaguar's sports car franchise, and though its new face is decidedly controversial, it is still a very desirable car. The new-for-2007  XK comes as both a coupe and a convertible. Riding on a much longer wheelbase, the new aluminium-built XK offers substantially more interior space than the old model. The XK 4.2 model is powered by the corporate 4.2-litre V8, while the XKR gets a supercharged version of that engine. Both engines are mated to a six-speed manual gearbox with paddle shifters. Its rigid chassis and the latest CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a 520-watt Alpine sound system with eight speakers. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

The Peugeot 5008 is the French automaker's entry in the MPV market. The 7-seater 5008 comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include power steering, power windows, digital and bi-zone air conditioning, tilt and telescopic leather steering wheel, heater power mirrors, radio with CD/AUX support, front and rear fog lamps, rear parking sensors and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher model called 'Premium' gets additional options such as tinted windows, auto headlamps, automatic wipers, panoramic roof, bi-zone AC with rear ducts, power-foldable mirrors, sundshade curtains for the back row seats and rear parking sensors with distance measurement. Standard safety features include 6 airbags and seatbelt sensors, electric parking break with hill assist, ABS brakers, electronic stability control (ESP), electronic brake distribution (EBD), emergency brake assist (EBA) and anti-slip regulation (ASR).

The S60 is tuned to be a sports sedan, but though it is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis, it looks like a sleek sports coupe from afar. The interior is fairly spacious even with the swooping roofline, and it offers more of a midsize package than a compact one, even though it is occassionally pitted against smaller German rivals in comparisons. For the Middle East market, there were four powerplants from 2001 up to 2003. These include a basic 2.4-litre, a 2.0-litre turbo and a 2.4-litre turbo for the run-of-the-mill S60 sedan models, and a higher-tuned 2.3-litre turbo for the sporty front-wheel-drive T5. All engines are five-cylinder, and have an automatic with tiptronic, although some can be had with a manual too. Standard equipment includes CD stereo, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, cloth or leather cabin, alloy wheels of various sizes, power windows, electric mirrors, optional sunroof, wood trim, automatic a/c and power-adjustable front seats. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection. The all-wheel-drive models available in Europe were not marketed in the GCC during these years.

The Nissan X-Terra nameplate made a comeback to the region, with an all-new model coming out in 2021. Under the hood, it now gets 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The base SE is a two-wheel drive model with hydraulic power steering, power mirrors, power windows, push start engine, fabric seats, auto headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, roof rails, manual A/C, rear A/C, offroad monitor and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Titanium model can be had in two-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive. Additional features include LED fog lamps, headlamps leveler, automatic dual-zone A/C, wireless charging and rear USB ports. The top Platinum model gets leather seats, infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Navigation, power adjusted leather seats and 18-inch machine cut alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, hill assist, stability and traction control and brake assist. The top Xterra Platinum model gets added safety features such forward collision alert, auto emergency braking, lane departure warning, blind spot monitor and rear cross traffic alert.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is a contender to be the van of choice for families, assuming you are looking just for a whole lot of space and not much luxury features. Its tough looks are misleading, as it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning, some even with rear a/c. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps.

The second-generation Punto, codenamed Project 188, was launched in 1999 for the 2000 model year. The styling was all-new while retaining the original Punto's distinctive shape and design, while the chassis and interior were completely overhauled. The new Punto also became the first Fiat in decades to carry the original round Fiat badge, to celebrate Fiat's centenary. The entry-level engine had two forms of the 1.2-litre petrol unit, with either 8 valves or 16 valves, with various manual or CVT transmission choices. A sporty two-door 1.8-litre model with a manual gearbox, called the Punto HGT, was briefly offered before 2003. The Punto had adopted the Dualdrive electric power steering and came with two operation modes, using an electric motor, rather than a hydraulic pump driven by the engine, for reduced fuel consumption. Driver and passenger airbags are fitted to all models, while side and roof airbags came as extras. ABS is also fitted to all but the most basic models. The Punto was facelifted from the 2004 model year, with new headlights and a new grilled front end, but it is unclear if many of them came to the GCC, at a time when the brand was being phased out.

The VW Polo recently received a fresh redesign and upgraded equipment. The Polo, though simply a sub-compact hatchback, has a more upmarket feel, thanks to judicious use of materials. High quality interiors are synonymous with Volkswagen, and the high quality plastics and fabrics found in the Polo is no exception. Standard equipment includes a CD stereo system, along with power windows and other electricals. Sadly, the only available powerplant in the Polo is the 1.4-litre four-cylinder unit. Available with a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic gearbox, this engine kills the upscale illusion. The new Polo includes standard safety systems such as ABS brakes, Hydraulic Brake Assist, and dual front airbags. Side airbags, a curtain airbag system and Electronic Stabilisation Programme are optional. The Polo also has high levels of torsional rigidity, leading to improved crash performance, impressive refinement and driving dynamics.

Essentially a rebadged version of the Romanian-built Dacia Sandero that has been trundling around Europe since 2007, this hatchback is based on the same platform as the Renault Logan sedan. The Renault Sandero is more modern-looking than the Logan sedan, but still a very simple car aimed at the entry-level sub-compact segment. Originally designed in France for the Brazilian market, its claim to possible fame is that it is more spacious than its price competitors. However, compared to the Logan, it has a slightly shorter wheelbase. Storage options are decent, with the spare wheel underneath the car freeing up boot space, and a folding rear seat-back. The front-wheel-drive Sandero is equipped with a 1.6-litre engine, mated to a simple 4-speed automatic. The Sandero also seems better-equipped than the Logan, with ABS and better sound-deadening materials on offer, alongside an MP3 stereo, front power windows, central locking, cloth seats and one airbag.

The Eos is a hard-top convertible version of the Golf hatchback. Facelifted for 2012 with a new front-end, it features a five-piece retractable hardtop. The car can somewhat seat four people, with good luggage room when the top is up. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Eos is available in the GCC with only one engine now, namely a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, with a choice of manual or DSG automanual gearboxes, although most dealers are likely to stock the DSG version only. Depending on trim level, the Eos can be outfitted with a touchscreen CD/MP3 stereo, convertible-specific Climatronic a/c, electric windows, alloy wheels, multi-functturning, HID headlights, "ion" display, keyless entry and start, navigation, cruise control, Bluetooth phone and a second-generation Park Assist system with ParkPilot. Safety features include ABS, dual front airbags, side airbags, lateral airbags, a roll-bar safety system and stability control.

For 2012, the midsize Cadillac SRX received a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with paddle-shifting functions and all-wheel-drive. Even the base model is generously loaded, with a limited-slip differential, common power accessories, 18-inch wheels, LED tail lamps, chrome roof rails, 8-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, dual-zone a/c with rear vents and controls, cruise control, keyless entry, power-adjustable pedals, power-adjustable front seats and a leatherette interior. The top 'Luxury' version gets variable-effort power steering, continuously-variable real-time dampers, turning HID headlights, parking sensors with rear camera, navigation, 20-inch wheels, 10-speaker Bose stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, 40 GB hard drive, rear DVD screens, full keyless entry with push-button start, ventilated front seats, LED cabin lighting and a panoramic glass roof. For 2013, changes included an unnoticeable facelift and the introduction of the CUE multimedia entertainment system, along with some minor cabin alterations and an active noise-cancellation system. All models get front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Chinese Tiggo beautifully illustrates the Koreans' fight for dominance in the small-4WD segment over the Japanese. The Tiggo has a bit of the Kia Sorento front end slapped onto the body of a previous-generation Toyota RAV-4. It kind of reminds us of a fake Rolex watch that has a Swatch lookalike face--a bit of the best and a bit of the average, but still ultimately neither. The five-door five-seater Tiggo does benefit from a versatile interior though, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Powered by a 2.4-litre Mitsubishi-sourced 4-cylinder engine, it comes with either a four-speed auto with two-wheel-drive, or a five-speed manual gearbox with all-wheel-drive. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling. Don't put too much faith in the incredibly low manufacturer-quoted fuel consumption numbers though.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its second facelift for the 2012 model-year. The minivan attempts to resemble a 4WD in height, with a high waistline and four forward-opening doors, but it ends up looking like a van. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

The Aveo was formerly known as the Kalos, a subcompact automobile built by GM Daewoo, a South Korean subsidiary of General Motors. The Aveo is based on Daewoo's latest small car platform and was originally styled by Giorgetto Giugiaro. For 2006, the Aveo, the smallest Chevy-badged car, underwent a number of changes that also gave the sedan a new face. Features in this economy car include advanced dual-stage frontal airbags with passenger sensing system, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with bolt-on wheel covers on the base models or 14-inch alloy wheels on the top model, a retuned suspension with improved steering response and larger-diameter front stabilizer bar, tilting front seat headrests, revised interior fabrics, electronic throttle control and optional CD player. The Aveo comes in three trim lines, and available as a four-door sedan or a carryover five-door hatchback. All are powered by a 1.4-litre in-line four-cylinder, though the pre-facelift Aveo5 hatchback gets a weaker motor, and both come with a good five-speed manual that can be switched for an optional four-speed automatic. The hatchback was restyled for the 2008 model year after a brief hiatus, and remains different from the sedan. After the Sonic was introduced for 2012, the Aveo sedan continued to be offered as a fleet model.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo made its debut back in 2007 and has remain largely unchanged for the 2009 model year. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets a new all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 2007 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Further options include an powered steel sliding/lift sunroof and a roof-transport system. Another option in the Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. The GTC4Lusso is offered in a four-wheel-drive configuration, and powered by Ferrari’s 6.3-litre V12 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission. There is a rear-wheel-drive variant namely the GTC4Lusso T offered from 2017 model year. Both variants employ electronic rear differential and an all-wheel-steering system. Features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128gb in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays and more.

The Cadillac XT4 is the luxury brand's compact SUV offering. It comes equipped with a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, which is the only engine option, and a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the XT4 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, push start button, AM/FM stereo with 8-inch diagonal color information display, 7 speakers, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, parking sensors with rear camera, sunroof, LED headlamps and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment includes Bose Sound System, "Technology Package" which includes Air Ionizer, 8-inch diagonal color reconfigurable gauge cluster, head-up display, power rake, and telescoping steering column and wireless charging, 20-inch diamond cut alloy wheels, interior ambient lighting, navigation, AM/FM stereo with connected navigation providing real-time traffic, 8” diagonal color information display, one type A and one type C full function USBs, personalized profiles for each driver’s settings, Natural Voice Recognition (English only) and NFC (Near Field Communications) mobile device pairing. Safety features include airbags - dual-stage frontal, knee and seat-mounted side-impact for driver and front passenger; head-curtain for all outboard seating positions with rollover protection, stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor and ABS. Optional safety features include "Driver Awareness Package", which includes Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking, Front Pedestrian Braking, Following Distance Indicator, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and IntelliBeam. Also available is a "Driver Assist Package", which includes Adaptive Cruise Control, and Forward and Reverse Automatic Braking.

The Mercedes-Benz E 55 AMG was the performance version of the E-Class and received a supercharged 5.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. It gets stiffer suspension for better handling. The E55 AMG was the fastest four door car in Mercedes-Benz's lineup at the time.

As with the previous model, the new TT is built on the VW Golf platform. The new TT will be available with numerous engines, including a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo and a 3.2-litre V6. The TT RS model debuted in 2011 with a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo while the V6 was cancelled. The TT roadster will debut late into 2007. The new TT is a far more aggressive sports car than the model it replaces, which was more of a show car than a sports car. Like its predecessor, the curvy profile generates a lot of aerodynamic lift at the rear end, so the new TT adopts a rear spoiler which recesses smoothly into the tail at low speeds and raises automatically at over 120 kph. The new car is larger and heavier, so to compensate for the additional metal, the hood, front fenders, roof and doors are made of aluminium, while the panels of the rear body remain steel to help balance the car. "Quattro" all-wheel-drive is optional on the front-driven 2.0 turbo, while standard on the 3.2 V6 and the RS. Manual gearbox is standard, but a DSG automanual is optional. Features include cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry, alloy wheels and the usual power accessories. As was the case with the previous TT, the new car is built as part of a joint effort, with bodywork and paint done at the German plant in Ingolstadt, and vehicle assembly is completed at Audi's Hungarian plant in Gyor.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The coupe and powered soft top models almost have the same rigidity. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control. A proper 370Z NISMO did release in 2018 which features more power, bigger brakers and sportier suspension.

Introduced in 2012, the redesigned Nissan Sunny moves down to the sub-compact segment with a completely redesigned car, while offering more space than ever before. The Sunny sedan comes from India, and is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The basic 'S' model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, AUX jack, cloth upholstery, trip computer and a black grille surround. The 'SV' model, identified by a chrome grille surround and door handles, adds power mirrors, front power windows, keyless entry, upgraded cloth seats and hubcaps, with an optional comfort package that adds fog lights, rear power windows, rear fan vents, parking sensors, more speakers and a central rear armrest. The top 'SL' model comes only in automatic, with 15-inch alloys, Bluetooth, steering-wheel stereo controls, nicer gauges with more readings, cloth trim on the doors, rear spoiler and mud guards. All models get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, brake assist, and seatbelts for all five seating positions.

The BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo came out in 2018. Under the hood, it got a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine as standard, while the higher models got a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. Both engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The BMW M3 convertible debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The BAIC A5 is the Chinese brand's large sedan offering. Since BAIC bought off SAAB in 2009, the A5 uses the Swedish company's 9-5 chassis. Under the hood, there are two turbocharged 4-cylinder engine options - the 2.0-litre and 2.3-litre, both of which are mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission.  Standard features on the A5 include power steering, power windows, central locking, remote control entry, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 6 speakers, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, electric sunroof, push-start button, paddle shifters, Bluetooth, and 8 speakers. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, ABS, brake assist, electronic brake distribution and hill start assist.

The Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Roadster debuted in 2011, a year after the Coupe. Renamed the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT Roadster for 2013 with almost no changes, it is supposed to be an everyday-use supercar, a product of in-house development by AMG. The coupe's trademark 'gullwing' doors are lost here in favour of conventional doors, easing entry and exit. Underneath the long bonnet is the usual AMG-built 6.2-litre V8 engine, now upgraded by 20 hp in the GT, and mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox in this application. By the end of 2013, the GT was replaced by a GT Final Edition, identified by its big wing, carbon-fibre bonnet, lip spoiler and wheels. A lightweight structure molded largely from carbon-fibre and aluminium double-wishbone suspension form the basics of the SLS. Among other things, the centre console incorporates the AMG DRIVE UNIT, which enables SLS owners to customise their vehicle set-up, while the AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission is operated by means of the E-SELECT lever. Beyond the usual power accessories and comfort features such as automatic a/c, "airscarf" headrests and cruise control, the simplistic interior can be customised in various colours, and can be fitted with options such as sports seats, metal trim, various leather choices, nicer paint and carbon-fibre appliquÃ©s. Further options include different 19-inch and 20-inch alloy wheels, carbon-ceramic brakes, pricey Bang & Olufsen stereo and a sports steering wheel.

The Jaguar F-Type SVR Coupe is the top performance model trim. Under the hood, it gets the supercharged 5.0-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate, retractable rear wing spoiler, sports seats, dual-zone a/c, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. Performance upgrades include a high-performance braking system, an electronic rear-differential, and a sport-tuned suspension with adaptive dampers.

The Audi RS Q3 is the top performance trim for the sub-compact SUV. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features in the RS Q3 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start-stop button, multi-functional steering wheel, 6.5-inch display screen, MMI entertainment system, aluminium look pedals, black cloth headlining, dual-zone electric climate control, sports seats with leather upholstery and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, anti-slip regulation (ASR), electronic differential lock and electronic stability control (ESC).

The Audi RS 4 is made to combine high performance with practicality, so it comes only as a 5-door station wagon, which is rather unpopular in the GCC region. The all-wheel drive RS 4 gets a high-revving naturally aspirated 4.2-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets some aggressive styling for the bumpers and rims to differentiate from the standard Audi A4, while thei interior gets bits of carbon-fibre.

Launched here in 2005 and facelifted in 2007, the Scorpio is the first Indian consumer vehicle to grace Middle East roads since the disastrous Padmini. Unlike the Fiat-derived outdated Padmini, this 4WD wagon is mostly an original inhouse design and arguably more modern, though not quite up to current standards. Yet, it is good enough to win multiple Indian "Car of the Year" awards. This Mahindra & Mahindra product is available here only in top trim, complete with leather seats, possibly fake wood trim, power windows, central locking, power steering, keyless entry, CD stereo and rear a/c vents. It was restyled lightly for 2007. Interesting features include a low-range transfer case, seating for seven and a Renault-derived engine. However, this 2.0-litre four-cylinder is too weak to move a compact car, let alone this heavyweight 4WD. And even in top trim, there is an obvious lack of safety features other than its perceived bulk. Five of the seven passengers manage with seat belts only, with nothing for the last two inward-facing seats.

The Ferrari 488 GTB replaced the 458 Italia in late 2015. Under the hood, the 488 GTB gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The exterior is still pretty similar to the 458, but gets a few visual updates, most of which have been added to improve aerodynamics and performance. The LED tailights have been slightly changed as well. The interior is quite familiar to the 458 with minor tweaks such as angled air vents and improved graphics on the infotainment and instrument panel. Keyless starts are also an added feature on the 488 GTB.

An all-new 2019 Mercedes-Benz G 63 AMG was revealed. Under the hood, it gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission.  It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before. Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

VW-owned Czech carmaker Skoda diverged from simply building rebadged versions of dull VW products, and created something totally original. Dubbed the Roomster, it is billed as a "leisure activity vehicle" that pushes the boundaries of the non-SUV crossover genre. Sharing components with the last-generation Octavia and the current Fabia, the Roomster is supposed to be a combination of "room" and "roadster," although we are pretty sure it is more of a hostel bed-space than a sports car. Å koda conceived the Roomster's cabin to have different configurations. The rear seats, which are taller than the front seats, can be folded in a 40-20-40 split configuration, instead of the more usual 40-60, and can also be moved longitudinally and transversally by removing the middle seat. The rear seats also have variable inclination up to 7Â° to the back, or completely to the front. The luggage compartment can have a completely flat surface with the rear seats completely removed, and the surface's height can also be modified. The only available engine is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, shared with the Fabia. The main transmission choice is a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability, although a manual might be available on request. Available safety features include as many airbags as you'd like, as well as ABS brakes and optional stability control.

An all-new model came out in 2019 for the Hyundai Santa Fe. The new generation model is longer than the previous model. The 2020 Hyundai Santa Fe comes with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 3.5-litre V6 motor, with both units mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Two-wheel drive is standard in the 2.4-litre base model, while all the other trims are in four-wheel drive in the higher 2.4-litre and 3.5-litre models. Some of the optional features include panoramic sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, reverse camera, leather seats, memory seats with cooling & heating for front passengers, memory package for mirrors with auto folding, smart key with engine start, automatic lights and rain sensing wipers. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution(EBD) and traction control.

The Mercedes-Benz ML-Class, officially referred to as the M-Class for whatever reason, has been completely revamped for the 2012 model year, taking on a puffier styling theme while retaining all the characteristics of the previous model. This midsize SUV comes in three versions, namely the ML 350 with a 3.5-litre V6, the ML500 with a 4.7-litre V8, and the ML 63 AMG with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8, all with 7-speed automatics and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and a choice of 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers, depending on trim level, leather upholstery, wood trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, optional keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. An AMG package is optional, and it adds a body kit and sportier suspension. The ML 63 also option of AMG performance package which adds even more power.

The Lincoln debuted for the 2007 model year, and has been heavily revised for 2011, with a new face, higher-quality interior and better entertainment features, while still looking like a Ford Edge derivative, on which is based. The updated MKX features a new chrome grille, along with new headlights, tail lamps and wheel designs externally. The newly-designed interior still features seating for five with a fold-down rear seat to maximise cargo room, as well as soft-touch materials, mood lighting and wood trim. The MKX features a standard 3.7-litre V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, and available with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Available features include leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, adaptive HID turning headlights, MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC voice-controlled multimedia computer and Sony stereo, optional THX-certified audio system, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

Essentially a rebadged version of the Romanian-built Dacia Sandero that has been trundling around Europe since 2007, this hatchback is based on the same platform as the Renault Logan sedan. The Renault Sandero is more modern-looking than the Logan sedan, but still a very simple car aimed at the entry-level sub-compact segment. Originally designed in France for the Brazilian market, its claim to possible fame is that it is more spacious than its price competitors. However, compared to the Logan, it has a slightly shorter wheelbase. Storage options are decent, with the spare wheel underneath the car freeing up boot space, and a folding rear seat-back. The front-wheel-drive Sandero is equipped with a 1.6-litre engine, mated to a simple 4-speed automatic. The Sandero also seems better-equipped than the Logan, with ABS and better sound-deadening materials on offer, alongside an MP3 stereo, front power windows, central locking, cloth seats and one airbag.

The 308 is a completely new version of the outgoing 307, and is available in 3-door and 5-door versions, both in hatchback trim. The 308 SW wagon debuted in 2009, while a hard-top convertible 308 CC model came in 2010. Two 1.6-litre engines were initially available, one naturally-aspirated and one turbocharged. The CC came only with the turbo engine. All versions come with an automatic gearbox, with only the basic 5-door non-turbo model getting a manual. Later on, the 3-door 308 GT quietly became available, with an upgraded 1.6-litre turbo and a 6-speed manual. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, CD player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with GSM built-in telephone, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The Infiniti G35 is company's first serious rear-wheel-drive honest-to-goodness sports sedan. It uses a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. Its platform is the corporate front-midship, which it shares with the Nissan 350Z. Features include 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlamps, fog lamps, heated mirrors, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, cloth or leather seats with power adjustment, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo and wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a rear spoiler, power sunroof, rosewood interior trim, dual HVAC controls and a DVD-based navigation system. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Jaguar XF luxury-sports sedan got an all-new model for 2016. Engines include a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 unit with two different tunes. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The Jaguar XK received a face-lift for 2012. The XK Coupe and Convertible are powered by a 5.0-litre V8 direct-injection engine, while a supercharged version of the same V8 powers the high-performance XKR. That too can be had in either coupe or convertible format. Both engines are mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox with paddle shifters. An even more powerful XKR-S was released in 2012 with the same supercharged 5.0-litre engine but producing even more horsepower. Changes include a new wider front grille, enlarged vents in the lower grille with chrome accents, LED daytime running lights and slightly thinner headlamps. Its rigid chassis and CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a CD stereo system. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

The Toyota Prado got a minor facelift for 2014, and from 2016 all variants got a new 6-speed automatic transmission. The "VVT-i" engine offerings carry over, with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder and a 4.0-litre V6. All models offer standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing and available locking centre-differential. The Saudi market offers both manual and automatic variants on all except the top trim level, while the UAE market only gets automatic versions. The basic Prado 2.7L, known as TX in KSA and EXR in UAE, comes with 17-inch steel wheels, black front grille, black power mirrors and door handles, rear spoiler, mud guards, fabric seating for seven, keyless entry, front and rear manual a/c, CD/MP3 6-speaker stereo, ABS with EBD and brake-assist, dual front airbags and floor-mounted spare tyre. The TX additionally gets side-steps and rear parking sensors, while the EXR instead gets a cool box, steering audio controls, USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth. The mid-range Prado 2.7L, known as TXL in KSA and GXR in UAE, gets 17-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, chrome front grille, body-coloured trim, side steps, leather steering wheel and shift lever, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cool box and more. The TXL additionally gets front fog lamps, front bumper guard and stability control, while the EXR instead gets dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control and a dealer-installed auto-dimming mirror with rear camera. The UAE also gets a Prado 2.7L in VXR trim that adds powered front seats, side/curtain/knee airbags, stability control and dealer-installed features such as leather upholstery and navigation with rear camera while losing steering-wheel controls. The basic Prado 4.0L, known as EXR in UAE, comes with a 6-speaker stereo withBluetooth and USB/AUX ports, steering audio controls, rear parking sensors, manual a/c, fabric seats, dual airbags, stability control, ABS, smart key with engine start/stop button, cruise control and hill start/descent assist. All UAE-bound V6 Prado models have a door-mounted spare tyre. The mid-range Prado 4.0L, known as TXL in KSA and GXR in UAE, comes with roof rails, side steps, fog lamps, front bumper guard and uphill/downhill assist on all automatic models. The TXL additionally gets a tow hitch and side mouldings, while the GXR instead gets side/curtain/knee airbags, dual-zone a/c, extra chrome trim, power front seats, rear camera and dealer-installed navigation with no steering controls. A higher-spec Prado 4.0L trim, known as TXL2 in KSA and VXR in UAE, comes with sunroof, dual auto a/c, rear camera and aftermarket audio with navigation. The TXL2 version also gets auto-levelling LED headlights, sunshades and in-car WiFi, while the VXR gets remote start, leather and power front seats. The Prado 4.0L in top VXL trim gains 18-inch alloy wheels, LED-encrusted headlights, leather seats, ventilated front seats, power front seats with memory, front and rear parking sensors with rear camera, side/curtain/knee airbags, 14-speaker JBL stereo with voice control and steering-wheel buttons, multi-touch screen with navigation, remote engine starter and additional exterior trim. The Saudi VXL additionally gets self-leveling KDSS suspension, power-folding third row, Multi-Terrain Select with four cameras, rear DVD screen, blind-spot monitor and a tyre pressure warning system.

The Changan Eado is a compact sedan from China. An all-new model came out in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Eado include power windows, central locking, remote control on key, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 4 speakers, leather steering wheel with audio controls, USB+AUX ports, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and hologen headlamps. Safety features includes front dual airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist.

The Toyota Hiace has been the market leader for years in the UAE and continues to be a popular choice in the commercial sector, whether for transporting the work-force or cargo. There is only one engine choice in the Hiace, a 2.7-litre four cylinder petrol engine mated to a standard 5-speed manual, while some markets such as UAE occasionally get a 4-speed automatic option. The Saudi market additionally gets a 2.5-litre diesel model with a 5-speed manual. It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

The fully-redesigned Ford Explorer debuted technically for 2011, but launched as a 2012 model in the GCC. It is now a one-size-bigger crossover, with a unibody structure and road-biased demeanour. The Explorer is available with a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with the base model getting front-wheel-drive and the rest getting full-time all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. There are four trim levels. The base model features include cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic Ford SYNC with 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, 18-inch wheels, three-row seating, keyless entry, cruise control, capless fuel filler, power driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, common power options and more. Available features higher up the trim levels include intelligent access with push button start, three-zone auto a/c, remote engine start, power liftgate, power-adjustable seats and pedals with memory, leather, heated and cooled front seats, MyFord Touch for the Ford SYNC touchscreen, 8-speaker stereo or 12-speaker Sony audio system, Bluetooth, 20-inch polished aluminium wheels, dual moonroof and power-folding third-row seats. The top Limited can be outfitted with further options such as HID headlights, rain-sensing wipers, adaptive cruise control with auto braking and the automatic parallel-parking system. The front-biased all-wheel-drive Explorer has an electronic center coupling that controls the torque split between the front and rear wheels, and acts as a center differential. Standard off-road electronics on AWD models include hill-descent control, hill-ascent assist, four-wheel electronic traction control and a standard "Terrain Management" system that varies drivetrain and ESP characteristics for different conditions. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, Roll Stability Control, stability control and Curve Control. Other optional safety features include inflatable rear-seatbelt airbags, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, and collision warning with pre-crash brake support.

The Cordoba is designed to appeal to sedan customers who like the Ibiza hatchback. Though similar to the Ibiza, it somehow appears a lot more conservative than the Ibiza, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. It is keeping pace in the market with variations of the original car, by adding new Seat styling features to what is essentially the same car that was launched ages ago. In the Middle East, it is offered with only a VW-derived 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine, with an automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, front power windows, remote central locking, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, CD radio with six speakers, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, height and reach adjustable steering wheel, double headlamps, three-point rear seatbelts and three rear headrests, among others. Stability system with brake assistance is an option, as are rear power windows, alloy wheels and what not.

The French-built Saxo was launched in 1996 to replace the CitroÃ«n AX. The car's platform, engines and major components were a development of the AX and were shared with the Peugeot 106, CitroÃ«n's unofficial sister company. The different trim levels and engine options in the Saxo range changed many times during the model's lifetime. Engines amd trims included a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre VTR and a tuned 1.6-litre VTS. The sporting VTR and VTS came with 14-inch alloy wheels, firmer suspension, sports seats and a body kit. The 2000 model year saw the introduction of this heavily-facelifted version and upgraded engines, even though the basic platform was already dated. The Saxo came as 3-door and 5-door hatchback models, and only the basic 1.4i model had an optional automatic available. Basics included a stereo, cloth cabin, front airbags and not much else.

A new generation Renault Megane debuted in 2017, powered by a 1.6-litre with a CVT automatic. In 2018, they introduced a more powerful 2.0-litre version. Standard features in the 2019 Renault Megane include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4.2-inch display, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX port and Bluetooth and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, dual zone automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo, 8.7-inch screen, 8 speakers, navigation, parking sensors, rearview camera, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 16-inch,17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models. Higher models get blind spot warning as well.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. The GTC4Lusso is offered in a four-wheel-drive configuration, and powered by Ferrari’s 6.3-litre V12 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission. There is a rear-wheel-drive variant namely the GTC4Lusso T offered from 2017 model year. Both variants employ electronic rear differential and an all-wheel-steering system. Features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128gb in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays, and support for I-Pad installation.

The first ever GMC-badged compact 4WD isn't even a real GMC. The Terrain is a Korean product sold in Europe as an Opel and in America as a Saturn. However, it does complete the local range, giving GMC dealers their very own small soft-roader. The Terrain is available in SLE and SLT trims, while available engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.2-litre V6, both with a standard 5-speed automatic transmission offering rudimentary manual shifting capability. All-wheel-drive is standard, but there is no low-range gearing. Unlike its longer Chevy cousin, the Captiva-based Terrain seats five and does not offer third-row seating. However, the rear seat folds flat to extend the cargo area. Active and passive safety systems include stability control, hill descent control and active rollover protection, as well as dual-stage front and side-impact airbags, as well as head-curtain airbags. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD player, keyless entry, alloy wheels and more.

The V70, based on the S60, is tuned to be a sports wagon, but is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis and weak regional engine choices. The interior is fairly spacious and the luggage area is huge thanks to its upright boxy shape.
