The Audi Q8 is the German luxury brand's answer to the BMW X6 and Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe. Under the hood, it gets a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine, mated to a 8-speed transmission. Standard features in the all-wheel drive Q8 include tandard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. It comes standard in 18-inch alloy wheels, which can go up to 21-inch alloy wheels, while optional equipment panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. The optional "Audi pre sense basic" initiates preventive protective measures for the occupants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts.

The Accent is Hyundai's long-running sub-compact nameplate, though it could be more successful than it is. The new model is a decent upgrade over the old Accent, though still using lightly-modifed carryover engines. Now available in 5-door sedan and 3-door hatchback form in this region, the most basic Accent thankfully comes with power steering, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine with a manual or automatic gearbox at a dirt-cheap price. Step up to the higher models, and buyers are treated to a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with a manual or an automatic, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, fog lamps, better cloth seats, a 60/40 split-folding rear seat with centre armrest and cup holders, and not much else. An agreeably spacious interior and steel 14-inch wheels with plastic covers are standard on all trim levels, but there is no mention of airbags or ABS brakes in the spec sheet on cars bound for the Middle East market.

Ever so slightly redesigned in 2006, the 350Z is the halo model for the Nissan lineup. It is very fast, looks outrageous and easier on the pocket than a comparable German product. For 2007, the car received an upgraded 3.5-litre V6, with either a manual or an automatic transmission. A new hood design also marks 2007. Features that make the 350Z such a performance bargain are a carbon-fibre driveshaft, drive-by-wire throttle, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution and brake assist and convenience features such as automatic temperature control and a premium stereo. Other standard features on this rear-wheel-drive sports car includes power windows with auto up-down, power door locks, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, vehicle security system, heated outside mirrors, cloth seats with eight-way manual driver and four-way manual passenger adjustments and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shifter boot. A bunch of airbags and traction control are standard. Navigation and Bluetooth phone are available. The convertible is officially not sold here.

Dodge's new entry-level vehicle is a five-passenger hatchback that replaces the Neon sedan and attempts to be a replacement for the common 4WD wagon too. It has a liftgate and split-folding rear seats. All trim levels use a 4-cylinder engine. The base model is a 2.0-litre with CVT automatic. The larger 2.4-litre is available with either manual or CVT. For 2009, the Caliber SRT-4 model was quietly released, with a 2.4-litre turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual. Available features include a fold-flat front passenger seat, refrigerated glovebox, and removable cargo light/flashlight. Unique features include oddities such as flip-down speakers when the liftgate is open, illuminated cup-holders and a central armrest that moves front and back. Also available are leather upholstery, nine-speaker Boston Acoustics stereo and alloy wheels. ABS is optional on the base models, and standard on the top trim, where it comes with rear disc brakes instead of drums. A tyre pressure monitor is optional. All Calibers have available front airbags and side airbags.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2015. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution.

The Bentley Continental GTC received a facelift for the 2012 model. Also a new turbocharged V8 model was added to the line-up, to join the W12 engine. It now comes with an 8-speed automatic transmission which gives better fuel economy numbers and ever so slight increase in acceleration figures. The Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental GT convertible is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GTC Speed, which debuted in 2013 with the same W12 engine, adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. The engines remain the same though, with minor updates, so the base Boxster is powered by a 2.7-litre flat-6 and the Boxster S gets a 3.4-litre flat-6, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The 307 is available in three body styles, namely a 3-door or 5-door hatchback, a 5-door station wagon and a 2-door retractable-top coupe-cabriolet. Launched in 2002, the facelifted front end made its appearance in 2006, consistent with the latest Peugeot corporate look, though not necessarily better-looking. All models retain the traditional triangular headlights, while now receiving fancy LED tail-lights. The tall 307 can be had in a standard five-door hatchback body, a CC hardtop-convertible body, and an SW or Break station wagon body. Available engines are all four-cylinder units. The 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic on any hatchback or wagon model. The 307 CC coupe-convertible, available from 2004 to 2007, can be had with only the 2.0-litre, but only with an automatic gearbox. All models come with standard power windows, cloth interior, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, and at least driver and front passenger air bags. Available features include side airbags and a leather interior.

The Nissan Altima, released GCC-wide for 2005, is a roomy and practical midsize sedan, competing with the Honda Accord and Toyota Camry with slightly more sporty handling and a little more extrovert styling. The Altima however sits at the top of the class in terms of available horsepower and interior room. Though the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes, is enough for most people, it is the 3.5-litre V6, also with a choice of manual or automatic, that makes the Altima a cheap alternative to pricey and slow front-wheel-drive sports sedans from Volvo and Audi. The Altima delivers stunning acceleration when optioned with the V6, which is essentially the same engine used in the Nissan 350Z. The Altima also boasts a big interior. Standard features include power windows, tinted windshield, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, power steering, a 60/40 split folding rear seat and an in-glass antenna. Also available are power mirrors, remote keyless entry with remote trunk lock, optional electric seats, cruise control, a six-speaker audio system and optional leather. ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist are standard, as are front airbags and alloy wheels.

An all-new generation Volvo XC90 debuted in the middle of 2015. Under the hood, there are two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine options, the base engine being the turbocharged T5 unit, while the more powerful model gets a turbocharged and supercharged T6 motor. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base engine is called the T5 and and the more powerful motor is known as the T6. Available features, depending on trim, include integrated rear-door sunshades, illuminated front and rear treadplates, Bowers & Wilkins Premium 19-speaker audio system with USB/AUX inputs and CD player, Bluetooth, heads-up display, navigation, in-car wifi, 4-zone auto a/c with numerous rear vents, power-adjustable front seats, panoramic glass roof, power tailgate with foot-waving opening operation, front and rear parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, turning LED headlights and foglights, and auto-dimming mirrors. Safety features include City Safety which brakes automatically if a pedestrian runs across the road, driver-alertness detection, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, land-departure warning, road-sign detection that displays speed limits on the graphical LCD gauge cluster, whiplash protection, front and side/curtain airbags, and adaptive cruise control that can come to a complete stop and crawl in traffic automatically. Further safety features include a run-off road protection package, which detects what is happening and the front safety belts are tightened to keep the occupants in position, and auto brake at intersection capability.

BMW's American-built 4x4 has been completely updated for the 2011 model year, and comes in three models in this region, namely the xDrive35i with a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine, and the xDrive50i with a turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. The non-M models now have an 8-speed automatic. The X5 has all-wheel-drive without low-range gearing, but does come with ABS and traction control. The X5 offers optional 7-passenger seating. The list of optional equipment now includes features such as 18-inch to 20-inch alloy wheels, roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M Sport package includes 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, aluminium roof rails, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements.

At first glance, this Chinese-built car looks like nothing more than a cheap copy of the Toyota Corolla, with the rear end of a Honda City mixture, but wearing a fake BMW badge. And it is exactly that, but if you look past the lame attempts at plagiarism, you'll find a package that actually might be a decent deal for a new car. The F3 is powered by a 1.6-litre Mitsubishi-sourced engine, mated to a 5-speed manual Mitsubishi gearbox. It includes an interior that is exactly like that of a last-generation Toyota Corolla, but with softer touchable surfaces. Available features, standard or optional, include 15-inch wheels, leather upholstery, dual front airbags, sunroof, manual air-conditioning, CD player, remote keyless entry, fake wood trim, height-adjustable steering wheel, power windows, ABS brakes and the price tag of a car half its size. Build quality seems to be of passing-grade, although some plastic pieces have an unfinished feel to them. If only they'd try a bit harder and be a bit more original. The price may make up for it though, in the eyes of some cost-conscious buyers.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Trim levels include the confusing Linear, Arc, Vector and Aero trims. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The top Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. Not all engines come in all body styles, though all are available in Aero form. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a glass sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The Toyota Camry is a favourite among individuals and fleet buyers. The Camry sedan was completely redesigned and greatly improved for 2003, becoming a much larger car than its predecessor. For 2005, the Toyota Camry received a minor facelift, although most buyers will not be able to spot the changes. By the end of production, the Camry was being offered as four models, namely the XLi, GLi, Touring V6 and Grande V6. All 4-cylinder models come standard with a five-speed manual transmission, while a four-speed automatic transmission is standard on the V6 and optional on the 4-cylinder models. The base four-cylinder Camry XLi and GLi sedans come with air conditioning, power windows, central locking, AM/FM/cassette stereo, a 60/40 split rear seat and 15-inch steel wheels. The Touring and Grande Mid-Range grades add a V6 engine ABS with Electronic Brake force Distribution (EBD), an engine immobilizer, and aluminium wheels, front fog lamps and rear spoiler, while the top-of-the-range Grande adds cruise control, moonroof, keyless entry, leatherette and CD changer. Front airbags were standard on all models. These cars are very spacious, and used to sell when new midsize cars were actually affordable.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's 5-door hatchback offering. The only version offered in most GCC markets is the V40 T5 now, fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder for the Middle East. Variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels, as well as the V40 Cross Country model with faux skid-plates and a slightly-raised suspension. All versions are front-wheel-drive, although the Cross Country can be had with all-wheel-drive as well. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

Porsche introduced this generation of the 911 model series as a new model, even though it looks almost identical to the older one. The GT3 and GT3 RS get a further upgraded version of the 3.8-litre engine. It is available only with a 6-speed manual transmission. Additional new features include front and rear LED driving lights, bi-xenon headlights, dynamic cornering lights, and a mild overall facelift. Interior features include a CD stereo, leather upholstery, optional multimedia system, common power accessories and more. Safety includes multiple airbags, stability control, ABS and traction control.

For 2017, a new generation Audi S5 Quattro coupe debuted, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic.Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The attractive GranTurismo is a modern replacement for the 4200GT coupe, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. An S version ups the ante with a new 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale made its debut later on in 2011 and had little more power, as well as some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This new-for-2008 two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The all-new weirdly-named Qashqai is built on Nissan's new "C" platform, providing high body stiffness with reduced body weight. The Qashqai offers a choice of 2WDand full-time 4WD with a single underpowered 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine mated to an advanced CVT transmission. The fancy interior seats five, and includes features such as intelligent key, power windows and mirrors, rear 60/40 split-fold bench seat, cloth upholstery, automatic headlights and wipers, and xenon  headlights. Also available are steering wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, aCD audio system with six speakers and 6-disc CD changer, auto air-conditioning with dual zone temperature control and a Bluetooth hands-free phone system. While it looks like a 4WD, the poseur 2WD model should prove popular as a hatchback alternative, considering it does not offer much more cargo space than a standard hatchback anyway. Aside from the strong bodyshell, safety features include stability control and front airbags, while side and curtain airbags are optional.

The C3 is a curvaceous hatchback that competes in the hot compact segment dominated by Toyota. The standard C3 is available in five-door form only, while the funky C3 Pluriel is only available as a two-door. Designed to be roomy and versatile, it is utterly more futuristic than the usual offerings in this segment, and fairly well-equipped. The C3 cabin has plenty of cubbyholes and storage spaces, a big windshield and the 'Moduboard' foldable false floor for the luggage trunk. There are more unexpected features such as speed-sensitive windshield wipers, follow-me-home headlights and one-touch electric windows. Current engine choices are the 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre four-cylinder motors. An upgraded 1.4-litre option came later. A manual is standard, with an optional auto on the 1.4-litre. The SensoDrive auto gearbox is offered on the upgraded 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre with a fuel-saving feature called the Stop-Start system, which automatically turns the engine off when idling in traffic and turns it on again when you lift off the brake. The Pluriel comes with a different front end and a 1.6-litre auto only, and this unique car can be converted into a hatchback, a pick-up and a convertible by playing with roof configurations. The Pluriel was discontinued here by 2007. Standard front and side airbags, as are ABS brakes.

The Continental Flying Spur was launched in 2006 as the 4-door version of the Continental GT. It is also their first sedan model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the unloved VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets. Standard equipment on the Spur includes HID headlights, 19-inch alloy wheels, a tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, keyless entry and ignition, rain-sensing wipers, powered trunk lid and a choice of 16 colours. On the inside, one has a choice of 17 colours for the leather-appointed interior with matching carpets and seatbelts. The cabin features steering-column mounted shift paddles, sunroof with electronic sunshade, DVD navigation, six-CD changer and Bluetooth. Almost all seats feature lumbar massage, memory and heat settings. Options include a choice of three 19-inch wheel styles and a 20-inch wheel and tyre package, ceramic brakes, and the sunroof can be had with a solar panel to power ventilation fans to maintain interior temperature when parked, a full-length centre console and numerous trim choices. Convenience options include a cordless privacy handset with keypad in centre console, a rear telephone system, and a rear-view camera. The Continental Flying Spur is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. An unnoticeable facelift came in mid-2008, as well as a new Flying Spur Speed variant, adding more power, while improving performance and handling.

The Ford Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. It got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The engine range for the 2021 Ford Ranger includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features in the 2020 Ford Ranger include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ford Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts. In 2020, the WidTrak got new safety features such lane keeping assist, lane departure warning, blind spot warning and adaptive cruise control.

The MG ZS is a small 5-seater crossover. Powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 4-speed automatic, it has no sporting or offroad pretensions, but it does aim to appear the "premium" choice within its category. It rides on a front-wheel-drive platform with independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension. There are three trim choices, with the base one getting 16-inch wheels, fabric seats, manual a/c, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and a 4-speaker stereo with 1 USB port. The mid-range model adds LED running lights, front fog lamps, faux leather, roof rails, cruise control, additional USB port, 8-inch touchscreen with Apple Carplay and 6 speakers, steering wheel buttons, parking sensors and more. The top model only adds 17-inch alloys and a rear camera. All versions get ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor, ISOFIX latches and seat-belts with pretensioners. The base model gets front airbags, while the rest also get side airbags.

The Terracan is odd one out in the Hyundai range. It is a capable midsize off-road vehicle based on the old Mitsubishi Pajero, just the right size to not be too big on the roads. The problem is that it became outdated as soon as it was released. This 80s-style 4WD does have a fairly spacious  interior and loaded with features to compete in this class, with a low price to boot. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to an automatic, it comes with beefy tyres on 16-inch alloy wheels and a full-time 4WD system with active torque transfer. Standard features include power steering, single airbag, a nifty limited slip differential, central door locking system, side steps, roof rack, power windows and electric mirrors, front and rear a/c, front fog lamps, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and hidden antenna, and rear wiper with washer. Options include dual airbags, ABS brakes, keyless entry with anti-theft system, leather interior upholstery, useless rear spoiler, fake wood trim, cruise control, digital multi-metre, electric driver's seat, CD player with 6 speakers, and a few more storage areas.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD and has been completely overhauled for 2008. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. For the GCC, a 3.0-litre V6 is standard, and it only gets a 4-speed automatic. The 2008 version's carryover V6 was replaced by an upgraded V6 for 2009, with more power and a 6-speed automatic. The Escape also comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, electric power steering, 15-inch steel wheels and CD stereo with iPod jack. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. The Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

An all-new Hyundai Accent came out for 2019. The new-generation Accent is slightly longer and wider than the previous model, with increased interior space. Two four-cylinder petrol engine options are being offered for the 2020 Hyundai Accent in the region, including a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, with multi-point fuel injection, matched to a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic transmission. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features in the 2019 Hyundai Accent include stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Grand Marquis is the longest running Mercury-badged vehicle ever. The mechanical underpinnings date back to the 70s, but a revision in 2003 involved a new frame, a revised independent front suspension, a new steering rack and rear suspension tuning. More updates in 2005 included a facelifted exterior, interior trim changes and more convenience features.The Grand Marquis is powered by a heavily detuned version of the Mustang's 4.6-litre V8 powerplant, mated to a four-speed automatic. If not obvious yet, the Grand Marquis is just a rebadged version of the Ford Crown Victoria. Features include three-person bench seats front and back, optional leather trim, a new instrument panel, burl woodgrain, a two-tone colour package and standard power windows. It is available in the Middle East in GS, GS Convenience, GS-L, LS Premium, LSE and LS Ultimate trims, at last count. A handling package, optional on GS and LS series, aims to improve the boat-like drive with 16-inch  aluminium wheels, a 3.27 axle, heavy duty rear stabiliser bar and rear air suspension with unique springs. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

An all-new Nissan Sunny model came out in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to a continuously-variable transmission (CVT). Standard features in the 2021 Sunny S include power steering, power windows, manual AC, cloth seats, audio system with USB and AUX, 7-inch touch screen, Bluetooth, parking sensors and 15-inch steel wheels. In the Sunny SV, it gets 16-inch alloy wheels, rearview monitor, Apply CarPlay, Android Auto and wireless charger. In the Sunny SL, it gets additional navigation and 360 camera. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbags for front passengers, side curtain airbags for front and rear passengers, automatic emergency braking and tyre pressure monitoring system. The SL gets additional safety tech such as blind spot monitor and rear cross traffic alert systems.

Porsche is offering a "new" Cayman model from 2009, and while the facelift is barely noticeable, the real changes are under the bonnet. Still available in base and S versions, both models feature more horsepower, new gearbox choices and modern multimedia options. A lightweight Cayman R model debuted in early 2011 with slightly more power. The base Cayman now has a 2.9-litre flat-6, while the Cayman S and Cayman R have a 3.4-litre flat-6 with direct fuel injection technology. A Cayman S Black Edition model also gets the R engine. While a 6-speed manual is standard on all, the optional new 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK) dual-clutch automanual gearbox is also available, which actually improves acceleration and fuel economy. The Cayman is priced at a premium over the Boxster, for what amounts to a slight bump in power and a fixed top. Cosmetic changes from 2009 include new headlights and tail lamps, larger front intakes with integrated running lights, and an altered lower rear-end with twin diffusers. Both models can be fitted with a never-ending list of optional features, which can drive up the total price by 30% or more. While the basic models are very bare on features, the car can be optionally outfitted with a hardtop, various types of expensive cloth or leather sports seats, different 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheel designs, a new Porsche Communication Management System (PCM) with a touchscreen, Bluetooth, TV tuner, DVD changer, metallic paint, stickers, wind deflector, roll bars, headlamp cleaners, Xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, and a cabin that can be trimmed with carbon-fibre, aluminium, alcantara or wood.

The Audi Q3 is the German manufacturer's 'baby SUV' offering. It got a facelift for the 2015 and a second facelift in 2017. There are three engine options, namely the turbocharged 1.4-litre with a 6-speed automatic, and two tunes of the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged powerplant mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and "Quattro" all-wheel drive. The Q3 gets a lot of the standard features in the base model such as automatic xenon headlamps, LED rear lights, 17-inch alloy rims, automatic air-conditioning, 8-speaker audio system, AUX-IN port, front and side airbags, hill-start assist and ESC. The higher spec model gets hill-hold assist, parking sensors, driver information system, Bluetooth and cruise control.

The Acadia is GMC's first crossover wagon that combines car-like handling with the utility of a 4WD wagon, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. First introduced in 2007, the Acadia got an upgrade under the bonnet in 2009, with a slightly more powerful 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. An Acadia Denali version debuted for 2011, with identical drivetrains as the base model, but with 20-inch wheels, unique front and rear bumpers, chrome mesh grille and upgraded interior trim.

The Chevrolet Trax is the American brand's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 4-cylinder 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The South Korean-made Trax comes in two trims - LT and LTZ. The base-model LT comes in only front-wheel drive, while the LTZ gets all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/AUX support and alloy wheels. Optional features include bigger alloy wheels, better sound system and chrome door handles. Safety-wise, the Trax gets traction control, stability control and 4-wheel ABS with panic brake assist.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Trim levels include the confusing Linear, Arc, Vector and Aero trims. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The top Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. Not all engines come in all body styles, though all are available in Aero form. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a glass sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The new Toyota Yaris hatchback was released as a 2015 model year. The Thai-built Yaris has two 4-cylinder engines to choose from. The base SE gets a 1.3-litre, whereas higher SE+ model gets a 1.5-litre in the UAE, while only one 1.5-litre Sport S trim is available in KSA. They all get a 4-speed automatic transmission. New exterior colours have also been introduced. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris 1.3 SE hatchback include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 4 speakers, keyless entry, 14-inch steel wheels and halogen lamps. The 1.5 SE gets 15-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, red stitching and steering-mounted audio buttons. The Saudi Sport S additionally gets parking sensors. The SE+ get automatic air-conditioning, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers, split-folding rear seat, projector headlights and better-quality seat fabric. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake-Force Distribution (EBD). Some dealers offer additional accessories such as Bluetooth and parking sensors. In 2015, TRD-branded accessories such as lowering springs, body kits and wheels became available.

The Brilliance FSV, known as the BS2 elsewhere, is a Chinese-built compact sedan that's benefitted from technology partnerships from companies such as BMW and Toyota, with a Mitsubishi-design powertrain. Even the simplistic platform with independent-front torsion beam-rear suspension is said to be Lotus-tuned, while Italdesign Giugiaro had a hand in the styling. Available with a single 1.5-litre 4-cylinder "MIVEC" engine mated to a 4-speed automatic, the front-wheel-drive 5-seater is fairly class-competitive. Features in the base "Comfortable" trim level include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, front disc and rear drum brakes, power windows, tilt-adjustable power steering, speed-sensitive central locking, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, fabric upholstery, split-folding rear seats and a single rear foglamp. The "Deluxe" model adds 15-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, front and rear ventilated disc brakes, rear parking sensors, digital a/c, power mirrors, sunroof and front foglamps. All trim levels get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, alarm and collision beams in the doors.

The Escalade is all-new for 2007, but still based on the latest version of the Chevrolet Tahoe. The King of Bling is back, bigger, gaudier, more powerful and more fuel efficient than before. Available in either standard five-door 4WD body, ESV long-wheelbase 4WD body or a retarded EXT long-wheelbase 4WD pick-up body, the Escalade ups the ante when it comes to showing off on the streets. The Escalade boasts a massive grille, tighter panel gaps, and a more streamlined exterior, which enables it to get better fuel mileage despite having a more powerful, 6.2-litre V8 engine that makes 403 hp and a whopping 565 Nm of torque. The Escalade models come with standard 18-inch wheels and tyres, but buyers can opt for 22-inchers. Stability control is standard and now incorporates a program to help avoid rollovers, while front side air bags are standard and a full-length head curtain system is available. Other features include automatic dual-zone climate control, tyre pressure monitoring system, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power-adjustable pedals, leather and wood steering wheel with audio controls, leather interior, 14-way power seats, six-CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers and rear-seat audio controls, four ventilated brake discs, speed-sensitive steering, automatic rear level control system, and rear parking assist. All off-roading equipment from the Chevy version has been stripped out in this one.

The C4 Picasso is a modern replacement for the oddball Xsara Picasso. Based on the C4 compact platform, it is a tall stylish minivan-type vehicle that drives like a car and has the practicality of a big 4WD. It seats only five, and the larger seven-seater Grand Picasso is not offered here. When all five seats are up, has 500 litres of boot space underneath the luggage cover, extending to a maximum 1,734 litres once the rear seats are folded down. Only two 4-cylinder engines are offered, one a 1.8-litre and one a 2.0-litre, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes that vary by model. According to trim level, the metal suspension can be replaced with pneumatic suspension on the rear axle on 2.0-litre models. CitroÃ«n has paid close attention to achieving the best levels of acoustic comfort and vibration control, as well as a new air-conditioning system. Its cloth-lined cabin can be outfitted with a variety of options, such as a panoramic glass roof, high-quality stereo system and folding video screens in the back of the front seats. The C4 Picasso has four Isofix seat tethers, audible seatbelt warnings for all seats and seven airbags as standard. Automatic electronic parking brake and Hill Start Assist are also fitted as standard.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. Engine choices include SL 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and SL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8. Both are mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Passat attempted to reinvent itself back in 2006 with a list of weak base engines. It entered 2008 with a new list of engine choices, and some carrying over, although the latest model still looks the same as the all-new Passat that debuted in 2006. A wagon called the Passat Variant has also joined the lineup. The Passat boasts generous standard content and a high-quality interior mixed with high-tech hijinks. Volkswagen has rolled out a full line of four-door sedans, ranging from  1.8-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors, both turbocharged, to the 3.2-litre and 3.6 V6 models, the latter of which is for the body-kitted R36 model. All basic cars are front-wheel-drive, while V6 models get 4Motion all-wheel-drive. V6 models also get a dual-clutch DSG automanual gearbox, while the base cars get standard manuals and autos. All Passats come standard with the latest in safety features and electronics, including power features, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, ESP, tyre-pressure monitoring system and MP3-capable CD player. R-Line package is largely just an expensive bodykit.

The Hyundai i20 made a late debut into the GCC market. It replaces their previous subcompact, the Hyundai Getz. Three models are available in the UAE market. The basic model gets the 1.2 litre engine which is mated to a five-speed manual transmission. The GL and GLS models get a 1.4-litre engine connected to a four-speed automatic. Standard features on the 1.2-litre model include power steering, tilt/telescopic steering column, CD/MP3 Kenwood stereo with 6 speakers and AUX input, manual a/c, 60:40 split-folding rear seat and manual windows. The 1.4-litre model additionally gets body-coloured door handles, painted power mirrors with indicators, power windows, central locking, rear wiper, front fog lamps, rear shelf and a better-adjustable driver's seat. All the models get ABS and only one airbag as standard. Optional features include driver's armrest, USB port, steering audio controls, alloy wheels and parking sensors.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional 4-speed automatic. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are many other comfort and utility features. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

The Renault Megane came back to the GCC market in 2011 with an all-new design and, aside from the hatchback version, there's this hard-top convertible Megane CC model as well. A nearly-unnoticeable facelift came in 2013. Engine choices are limited to a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The CC comes with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include cloth upholstery, fog lamps, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and more. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Most markets got one loaded trim with two-tone cloth or leather upholstery. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

The Porsche Cayenne gets a minor facelift and engine upgrades for 2015. The variants available are the Cayenne, Cayenne S, Cayenne GTS, Cayenne Turbo, Cayenne Turbo S, Cayenne Diesel, Cayenne S Diesel and, for the first time, the Cayenne S E-Hybrid, the first plug-in hybrid in the premium SUV segment. All new models get a slight boost in performance and reduced fuel economy numbers. The new models get a new front fascia, similar to the design of the Porsche Macan, as well as new taillamps and exhaust pipes. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine. The Cayenne S and Cayenne GTS gets a new 3.6-litre turbo V6, while the Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.8-litre turbo V8. The hybrid and diesel models will be available only on special-order. The Cayenne S E-Hybrid has a lithium-ion traction battery with an all-electric driving range of 18 to 36 km. Inside, a new multifunction sport steering wheel featuring shift paddles is fitted as standard. Optional seat ventilation is now available for the first time. More variants of the Cayenne should be available later. As usual, everything on a Porsche is largely optional, with few exceptions. Features available on the Cayenne include a 7-inch TFT touchscreen, optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch, and a choice of an optional 14-speaker BOSE CD stereo or an optional 16-speaker Burmester CD stereo, both with USB and iPod support. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. Other features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Other features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

A new generation Nissan X-Trail debuted in the GCC in 2021. Featuring a completely revised exterior and interior, the 2.5-litre 4 cylinder engine is carried but slightly upgraded for more power, and mated to a CVT. The base model is front-wheel-drive, but all other trim levels are all-wheel-drive with an electronic 4x4 lock feature. There's also a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater layouts. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, keyless entry with central locking, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, and steel or 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include better entertainment system with screen and more speakers, bigger alloy wheels, parking sensors, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power front seats, navigation, 18-inch alloys and automatic a/c, among other things. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags with optional side airbags, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist (BA).

The Mercedes-Benz CLA-Class is a sub-compact 4-door sedan. A new generation model came out in 2020. The CLA-Class is offered in 2 versions. The CLA 200 is equipped with  4-cylinder 1.3-litre turbocharged engine and the CLA 250 gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine. Both models are mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist. An AMG Line version is available which includes a body kit and tuned sports suspension.

Dodge's new entry-level vehicle is a five-passenger hatchback that replaces the Neon sedan and attempts to be a replacement for the common 4WD wagon too. It has a liftgate and split-folding rear seats. All trim levels use a 4-cylinder engine. The base model is a 2.0-litre with CVT automatic. The larger 2.4-litre is available with either manual or CVT. For 2009, the Caliber SRT-4 model was quietly released, with a 2.4-litre turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual. Available features include a fold-flat front passenger seat, refrigerated glovebox, and removable cargo light/flashlight. Unique features include oddities such as flip-down speakers when the liftgate is open, illuminated cup-holders and a central armrest that moves front and back. Also available are leather upholstery, nine-speaker Boston Acoustics stereo and alloy wheels. ABS is optional on the base models, and standard on the top trim, where it comes with rear disc brakes instead of drums. A tyre pressure monitor is optional. All Calibers have available front airbags and side airbags.

The top-spec IS-F sports sedan model finally debuted in 2011 in the GCC with a 5.0-litre V8 and paddle-shifted 8-speed automatic. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof, ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats. The IS-F comes with lowered sports suspension, special wheels, sports seats, special cabin trim and a body kit along with the uniquely-tuned V8.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The eight-generation Hilux made its debut in the GCC as a 2016 model year. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Mechanically, the 2016 Hilux will offer a new 6-speed automatic transmission, which gives a 15-percent better fuel economy rating than the previous generation model. Engine choices include the 2.0-litre and 2.7-litre petrol engines, and a new more powerful 2.4-litre diesel engine. While the 2.0-litre is available only in rear-wheel-drive, the other two engines can be had in either four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive. Safety features for it includes front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbag for the driver, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) seat-belt equipped on all seats except the centre seat.

The all-new C-Class Coupe made its debut in 2016. The exterior and interior has been completely revamped from the previous generation. In 2018, two variants are on offer which is the C 200 and the C 300, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The 3008, a crossover in the truest sense of the word, first debuted in Europe back in 2009 before making its way to the GCC in 2010 as a 2011 model. It got a facelift in 2014. The 3008 is Peugeot's attempt to fill a vague niche, somewhere between a compact SUV and a midsize sedan. Only a 1.6-litre turbo 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic is offered here. Despite minivan looks, it seats just five, with a split tailgate, split-folding rear seat, rear-seat floor storage compartment, foldable front passenger seat and a two-level cargo hold. Features include tinted glass, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear wiper, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear ducts, panoramic roof with electric curtain, CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, automatic headlights and wipers, one-touch power windows, electric foldable mirrors with indicator lights, adjustable leather steering wheel, cruise control, cooled front storage compartment, cargo net, fog lamps, speed-sensitive power steering, parking sensors, keyless entry, rear-seat 12V plug-point, heads-up display and a detachable map-reading torch in the boot. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist.

The Opel Adam is the German brand's mini hatchback offering. Under the hood, the Adam gets a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. An automatic transmission will be available later. It is very fuel-efficient since it also comes with engine start/stop technology. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with USB/AUX support, manual A/C and fabric seats. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control (ESC).

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The 5-door wagon is sold here, with the 3-door and soft top versions available only on special order. The Mercedes-Benz G 500 is fitted with 4.0-litre V8 twin-turbocharged engine coupled with a 7-speed automatic transmission. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

Chevrolet Colorado is the American manufacturer's commercial midsize pickup offering, essentially a rebadged version of the Isuzu D-Max and built in Thailand. It comes in two engines - either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 5-speed manual or a 3.6-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, with no diesel options. Only the crew cab four-wheel drive models are available in the GCC. Entertainment is provided by the radio with a  single-disc CD drive and FM/AM/CD supporting MP3/WMA plus available four  speakers. Other standard features include power windows, power mirrors, painted front and rear bumpers and remote key entry. Safety-wise, the front driver and passenger get airbags and anti-lock braking (ABS) with electronic brake force distribution (EBD).

The Maxima was a hot car when it was first unveiled in this iteration. However, Nissan's GCC division chose to let this model stagnate to the point where it was easily overshadowed by the newer Altima, even when the Maxima was redesigned in other markets and transformed into a luxury cruiser. The GCC-spec Maxima also still uses Nissan's older version of the corporate V6, with a displacement of 3.0-litre, combined with front-wheel-drive, and with a choice of five-speed manual and four-speed auto gearboxes. Performance is very respectable even after all these years. It comes with automatic air-conditioning, CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, ABS-assisted disc brakes, cloth seats, front airbags and many wheel choices, depending on model. The basic model gets 15-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include an in-dash CD changer with subwoofer, cruise control, sunroof, rear electric sunshade and leather cabin trim. Changes from year to year largely involve a new grille style every few years.

The Infiniti Q70 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

The second generation Acura NSX made a comeback to the world after years of teasing in 2016. The NSX brings supercar looks and performance, with the advantage of being a daily driver. While the previous generation, which had ended back in 2007, had poor fuel economy, that department has massively improved thanks to its hybrid setup. Mechanically, the NSX gets a twin-turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to 3 electric motors, and mated to a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission with an all-wheel-drive system. Standard features in the 2-seater NSX include electric power steering, power windows, central locking, remote key access, engine start-stop button, cruise control with steering wheel buttons, leather and Alcantara upholstery, a mix of digital and analog instrument cluster, manual sports seats, dual-zone front A/C, adaptive suspension, backup camera, premium audio system which includes 8 speakers with subwoofer, 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, MP3/auxiliary input jack, USB audio interface, SMS text message function, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels in the front while gets 20-inch. Safety features include knee, side, curtain and front airbags, ABS, tyre pressure monitoring system, traction control, and vehicle stability control.

The SQ 5 is the top performance version of the Q5 compact SUV. An all-new model came out in 2018. Under the hood, it comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. The four-wheel-drive model gets standard features like power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, Nappa leather interior, cruise control, keyless entry and start, auto headlamps, auto headlight range adjustment, fog lamps, xenon headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, navigation, panoramic glass roof, 3-zone automatic A/C, Bluetooth, Bang & Olufsen sound system, front and rear parking sensors and 21-inch ally wheels. Optional equipment include electric front seats with memory function, electric folding mirrors with heated and memory, side steps, adaptive cruise control, adaptive lights, red brake callipers, dynamic steering, more leather padding and sports seats. Safety features include front, side and head airbags, traction control, brake assist and stability control.

The California is the first Ferrari ever with a front-mounted V8, as well as the first Ferrari with a direct-injection engine, a 7-speed transmission and a folding metal roof. The engine itself is a 4.3-litre V8, mated to the 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox and rear-wheel-drive. Focused slightly more on comfort than on track prowess, the F149-designated California comes with a customisable leather-clad cabin, CD stereo with LCD multimedia screen, and a multi-function steering wheel with starter button and driving-mode selection. It seats only two and has a shelf behind the seats along with a useable luggage trunk, as well as all the usual power accessories, airbags and electronic safety nannies. The comfort angle further enhanced by a new multilink rear suspension system instead of the usual sporting double-wishbones. The Ferrari California is also equipped with the exclusive F1-Trac traction control system which made its debut on the 599 GTB Fiorano. Brembo brakes featuring carbon-ceramic material discs are standard. Not much else to write home about though.

The Dodge Dart makes its debut in the region, but in limited numbers. With a standard 1.4-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed "DCCT" dual-clutch automatic, it certainly has a unique drivetrain for the segment. The base SXT model gets keyless entry with speed-sensitive power locks, power windows and mirrors, 17-inch alloys, manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Uconnect 8.4-inch touchscreen with voice command and Bluetooth, rear camera, USB port, remote start, active grille shutters for better aerodynamics, 60/40 split-folding rear seat with boot pass-through, auto-dimming mirror, fog lamps, auto halogen projector headlights and LED 'racetrack' taillamps, among other items. The Rallye version gets the black-out grille, sunroof and a unique alloy-wheel design, aside from an additional knee-airbag for the passenger. The top-spec Limited looks more conservative, but gets mirror-mounted indicators, dual-zone auto a/c, polished alloy wheels, one-touch up/down front power windows instead of for driver only, HID headlights, smart key with starter button and some electronic driving-safety aids. Safety features include standard front and side airbags, side-curtain airbags, driver's knee airbag with optional passenger knee-bag, standard traction and stability control, hill-start assist, rain brake support, active headrests, ready alert braking and tyre-pressure monitoring. The top model gets blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert. The Dart is only available in the UAE for now.

The Audi RS 4 is made to combine high performance with practicality, so it comes only as a 5-door station wagon, which is rather unpopular in the GCC region. The all-wheel drive RS 4 gets a high-revving naturally aspirated 4.2-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets some aggressive styling for the bumpers and rims to differentiate from the standard Audi A4, while thei interior gets bits of carbon-fibre.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, followed by the C-Class. Four models were introduced - the E200, E250, E300 which get the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and the all-wheel drive E400 which gets the 4.0-litre turbocharged V6 motor. All models get the 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad.  For the first time, air suspension is now offered. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The Mini Countryman got a minor facelift in 2015, with the Cooper S getting a minor horsepower increase. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and yet powered by the same Mini engines, namely the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder in turbo and non-turbo forms. The base model for the GCC will be the Mini Cooper Countryman in front-wheel-drive, while the Cooper S Countryman will come with the turbo engine as well as a choice of front-wheel-drive or "ALL4" all-wheel-drive. Both come with a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The American-built Sequoia is Toyota's largest ever passenger vehicle. Its claim to fame is space, with three rows of adult seating and impressive cargo volume. In the GCC, this big SUV will be promoted as a family hauler rather than an offroader, considering the initial availability of a rear-wheel-drive variant. The four-wheel-drive model with low-range gearing came in 2010. The second row can either seat two or three, depending on the setup chosen. It is powered by a 5.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. It may be based on the Tundra pickup-truck platform, but it comes standard with four-wheel independent suspension, stability control, CD/MP3 stereo, automatic three-zone a/c, stability control, front airbags, and side-curtain airbags. The three trim levels are named SR5, Limited and Platinum. Depending on trim level, this 'city SUV' comes with options such two rear-seat DVD screens, 20-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera and parking sensors, CD changer, powered tailgate, power-folding third-row seats, power tailgate, cloth or leather upholstery, navigation, rear air suspension and more.

The Cruze is Chevrolet's latest Korean-built compact model. Designed from the ground up, the Cruze first became available as a sedan, and later as a hatchback as well since 2011. The front-wheel-drive sedan features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a 5-speed manual or a class-leading 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

In 2015, the Volkswagen Scirocco R got a facelift. Engine for the Scirocco R is a higher tuned 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. It first became available in 2012, with more power, a body kit and firmer suspension. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

The Chevrolet Blazer made a comeback in 2019, slotting in between the Equinox and Traverse. Both engine options offered on the Blazer are naturally aspirated - with the base model getting the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the higher model gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine, both of which are mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The 2.5-litre is available in front-wheel drive and all-wheel-drive, while the 3.6-litre model only comes as all-wheel-drive. However, the rear axle can be completely cut-off in the AWD models to run only in FWD mode. Standard features in the Blazer include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, 4.2-inch driver information display screen, infotainment system with an 8-inch touch screen including Bluetooth, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay, 6 speakers and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control, traction control, and front, side and knee airbags. Higher models include options such as adaptive cruise control, leather seats, premium Bose audio system with sub-woofer, panoramic sunroof, surround vision camera, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy wheels, and wireless charging. The higher trims also get more safety features such as forward collision alert, automatic braking, pedestrian braking, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, blind spot monitor and park assist.

The Foton Tunland is the Chinese manufacturer's midsize pickup offering. Currently only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine is available in select GCC countries. Standard features on the Tunland include power steering, power windows, remote locking, central locking, fabric seats, rear fog lamp, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB support, 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. It gets ABS but no airbags. There is a higher model with leather seats, 16-inch alloy rims, and driver and passenger side front airbags.

The Scirocco is revival of Volkswagen's odd-shaped 1970s model that attempted to bridge the gap between a hatchback and a coupe. It last died out in 1992, until its revival as a concept car in 2006 and a production car by 2008. Debuting in the GCC as a 'sportier' alternative to the VW Golf, the Scirocco lifts platforms, engines and even interior panels from the Golf. However, the cabin itself has a lower roofline while retaining seating for four. Engine for the Scirocco R is a higher tuned 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. It first became available in 2012, with more power, a body kit and firmer suspension. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

The Colorado is a range of light pickup trucks. This midsize pickup can be had with two bed options, only one petrol engine, and comes standard with rear-wheel-drive. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, we beileve there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Available as a two-door single-cab or a four-door double-cab, four-wheel-drive is optional on the double cab only. Thankfully, amenities such as air-conditioning, dual front airbags, power steering, vinyl flooring, cloth bench seat and an ashtray are all standard. Upgrading to a higher trim level adds such luxuries as floor carpets, power windows, remote central locking, cloth bucket seats, chrome trimmings and body-colour door handles. Purely sold as a work truck here, the Colorado is actually marketed as a lifestyle truck in America, where it comes with cool colours, stylish trimmings, more luxuries and much bigger engines.

The unimaginatively-named Five Hundred full-size sedan is a capable new family performer that does what it's supposed to, and nothing extra. Based on a Volvo platform, this American model features the three-bar Ford grille, a massive well-appointed cabin and a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The standard model is front-wheel-drive, but all-wheel-drive is optional. Features include ABS brakes, traction control, keypad autolock, power mirrors, power windows, remote keyless entry, eight cupholders, CD stereo with MP3 audio jack, anti-theft system, and optional tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher models include dual-zone a/c, memory power seats, leather, fake wood trim and more. Available options include heated front seats, 18-inch chrome wheels, adjustable pedals, stability control, sunroof, reverse sensors, in-dash six-disc CD audiosystem and other items. Standard safety equipment includes dual-stage driver and passenger front air bags, seat-deployed side airbags for driver and front passenger, and side curtain airbags for both rows.

Available from early 2013, the "Mark 7" VW Golf may look the same, but is really completely new, the big news being several weight-saving enhancements that form the car. The two "TSI" engine choices are a 1.2-litre and a 1.4-litre, both turbocharged 4-cylinder units mated to 7-speed "DSG" automanual transmissions. All Golf models now have touchscreen systems as standard, starting with a 5.8-inch colour display and rising to the range-topping satellite navigation system with 8-inch colour display that operates with finger gestures. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, power windows, keyless entry and such, with optional features such as sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, 5.8-inch touchscreen, fog lamps and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport.
