Standard on all new Golf models is a multi-collision brake system which automatically brakes the vehicle after a collision, to reduce kinetic energy significantly and thus minimise the chance of a second impact. Other available electronic aids include adaptive cruise control and city emergency braking, both capable of applying full braking to a stop. Further options include a Driver Alert System that monitors the driver's inputs to detect any signs of tiredness, while a camera-operated Lane Assist system can help keep the car in a specific lane, providing countersteering assistance where necessary, while the Dynamic Light Assist system optionally masks the vehicle's high beam lighting to avoid dazzling oncoming traffic.

The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Fiat Fiorino is a compact commercial vehicle offering by the Italian brand. The Turkish-built Fiorino comes with a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual. Standard features include power steering, sliding side door, foldable passenger seat, adjustable driver's seat, heat reflecting windows, radio with CD/MP3 player, and ABS. It has 2.8 cubic-metre volume of cargo space with a 600 kg payload capacity.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2021 model year. Under the hood, is a highly-tuned 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The M3 comes standard with a carbon-fibre roof or an optional no-cost moonroof. The M3 also gets an optional M Drive Professional feature, which helps drivers analyse driving lines and times on race tracks. An M Drift Analyser records the duration of a drift, distance covered, and the line and angle, displaying a final rating on the Control Display after each drift. Users can also download an iPhone app that corresponds with the car to give them a bird’s-eye view of the track and access to a lap time comparison chart, as well as data like speed, accelerator position, and total G forces. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera. Other standard safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control and brake assist.

The new 5-Series reared its rakish head back in 2004. Facelifted for 2006, the extensive models available include the 523i, 525i, 530i, and, newly replacing the 545i are the 540i and the 550i. The 5-Series is available in both saloon and Touring wagon platforms, but the slow-selling wagons are not actively peddled in this region. The exterior design by Chris Bangle is controversial, especially the aptly-named "Bangle-butt" rear end. Its iDrive system has been simplified compared to the first-generation system that debuted in the 7-Series. It can be ordered with options such as Active Cruise Control, head-up display, active steering and a Harman Kardon Logic7 stereo system. Most of the 5-Series models are capable of high speeds but the electronic 250 kph limiter on all cars means that both the 530i and the M5 have the same top speed.

The Legacy is Subaru's midsize model, available in all-wheel-drive form as standard. For 2005, Subaru introduced the fourth-generation Legacy with fresh styling and better handling. The same model, available in sedan and wagon body styles, has been facelifted for the 2007 model year. The Legacy is available in the Middle East with either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder, known as the 2.0R, and the 3.0-litre six-cylinder, known as the 3,0R. Both are flat "boxer" engines, mated to automatic gearboxes. Standard equipment in the base 2.0R model includes MP3/WMA CD stereo, a 6-disc CD changer, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, alloy Wheels, fog lamps, climate control, cruise control and cloth upholstery. Leather and sunroof are optional. The top 3.0R trim level adds the advanced Vehicle Dynamics Control stability and traction control system, eight airbags, sunroof, leather upholstery with power-adjustable seats and more. The wagon is only available in 2.0R form.

The long-running Nativa has been replaced with a new model for 2009, but Mitsubishi has chosen to rename it the Pajero Sport. Based on the latest L200 pickup-truck platform, the Pajero Sport also shares its entire front end with the L200, although the rest of the wagon body is completely new. Under the bonnet beats an easy-going 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic mode, and a four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The base model comes with side steps, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, multi-mode dash display, CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers, manual a/c with rear vents, dual airbags, power windows, keyless entry, chrome-plated power mirrors, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, immobilizer, under-engine cover, front skid plate, and three rows of cloth-upholstered seating. The mid-range model gets cruise control, fog lamps, upgraded stereo with 8 speakers, automatic a/c, parking sensors and roof rails. The top model gets faux leather upholstery, sunroof, chrome interior bits and a rear differential lock.

The Golf intends to be a German-designed, German-engineered and German-built alternative to the Asian-nameplate vehicles that dominate the entry level of the automotive marketplace. Unlike many of its competitors, the Golf is a hatchback and therefore offers the advantage of cargo-carrying utility not provided by the typical four-door sedans. Hatchbacks were never popular, but the VW Golf always had some sort of following here. Though the base models, namely the 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, are no rockets, they are still responsive and fun to drive. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

With the Sharan, VW properly wets its feet in the minivan segment, though it is falling behind the modern competition nowadays, considering its 1995 origins. The Sharan is not a true VW, being based on a Ford minivan, and also sold as a rebadged Seat. Revamped in 2000, and facelifted for 2004, it provides ample room for the driver and six adult passengers to sit back, relax and enjoy their individually formed 'business class' seats. The Sharan offers the flexibility of removing the rear seats to open up a massive 2,610 cubic litres of storage space. Powered by two aging VW engines, namely the 1.8-litre turbo four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre VR6 units, they can be had with a manual or an automatic. Built in Portugal, the Sharan comes standard with five removable rear seats, ABS brakes with electronic brake-pressure distribution, electronic climate control both front and rear, alarm with interior protection and remote central locking, front side airbag system, driver's and front passenger's airbags, electric front windows, electrically adjustable door mirrors, radio/CD stereo with 10 speakers, and seat belts for all three rows of seating.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The coupe and powered soft top models almost have the same rigidity. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new Kia Picanto debuted as a 2018 model year in the GCC. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. It comes with a 4-speed automatic. Features on the 2019 Kia Picanto, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Standard safety features on the 2019 Kia Picanto include ABS, tire pressure monitor and driver airbag, with only the top model get dual airbags.

The Patriot is an all-new compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine with either a standard 5-speed manual transmission or an optional second-generation CVT automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. The optional off-road package has simulated low-range gearing using the CVT gearbox. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

An all-new Chevrolet Tahoe was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, a Tahoe RST was revealed with a 6.2-litre engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. The Tahoe RST gets magnetic ride control, optional Brembo performance brakes, Borla performance exhaust, illuminated black Chevrolet bowties, 22-inch gloss black aluminium wheels and RST badges. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

PGO proclaims itself to be a 'French automobile craftsman' to highlight their hand-crafted aspect and small-scale production. The CÃ©vennes got slight facelift and improvements in 2013. Both share the same technical foundation and differ only in style, with the CÃ©vennes looking more modern with restyled bumpers and trim. Indeed, the overall styling is still based on the 1950s Porsche 356. However, it is powered by a recent 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Peugeot engine, with no additional tuning. The rear-mounted motor is mated to a rear-wheel-drive platform and a choice of 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. While the car is very basic and very expensive, customisation options offer 15 paintjobs, 8 soft-top colours, 14 types of leather and 10 types of carpet. Standard features include a basic a/c, power windows, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with 2 speakers, keyless entry, electric mirrors, black manual soft top and a set of eight instrumentation gauges. Options include chrome wheels, two-tone leather, CD changer, alarm and more.

The Cadillac XTS debuted in late 2012 as a new flagship, replacing the STS as well as the DTS. By 2018, the XTS became a budget alternative to the CT6 that is selling well in some markets, so Cadillac has updated it with new front and rear designs, an updated infotainment system and more comfortable seats. Based on a front-wheel-drive Chevrolet platform, the XTS is powered by a 3.6-litre direct-injection V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. It comes with a electronically-controlled limited-slip differential, adjustable suspension and Brembo brakes, with standard 20-inch wheels. For 2014, a V-Sport model with a turbocharged 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive joined the range. Features include leather upholstery, configurable 12.3-inch LCD display, latest CUE multimedia system, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, HID headlights, smart keyless entry/start and all the usual power accessories, with further available features such as heads-up display, adaptive cruise control. Safety features include multiple airbags, lane departure warning, collision alert, safety alert seat, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert and available automatic emergency braking.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre C 160 sports coupe. Next are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the C 180 Kompressor and the C 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon. The 2.5-litre C 230 is also available in all body styles. The 3.0-litre C 280 is available as a sedan or wagon only, while the 3.7-litre C 350 is again available in all three body styles. The C 280 and C 350 can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The 5.4-litre C 55 AMG comes in sedan form only. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

The new Renault Safrane is a midsize sedan sedan that is based on the Japanese-market Nissan Teana platform, and is a rebadged version of the Korean-built Samsung SM5. This GCC-exclusive model is available in three trim levels and two different engine choices. Available with either a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or a 2.3-litre V6, both with automatics, other features include a Renault Smart Card key, a 6-speaker or a 7-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with optional 8-inch subwoofer, acoustic cabin damping, automatic a/c with front and rear vents, manual-adjusted  seats or driver memory seat, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, optional rear parking sensors, standard 16-inch aluminium wheels, optional rear spoiler, electronic stability control, electronic throttle control, standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, emergency brake assist, six airbags including side and curtain bags, and active protection headrests. Other available features include leather upholstery, wood-like trim and sunroof.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

An all-new BMW X6 launched as a 2020 model year. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Coupe is probably the only sports car in its price range among the hordes of boring sedans sold in the Middle East. It may be front-wheel-drive, not so powerful and hardly the best handler of them all, but darn does it look good from most angles. Powered by either a weak 2.0-litre four-cylinder or a decent 2.7-litre V6, only the smaller motor comes with a manual with optional available automatic, while the larger motor gets only an automatic. Standard basic features include a single airbag, power steering, central door locks, power windows, fog lamps, a rear spoiler with high-mounted brake lamp, outside electric mirrors, semi-cloth seats, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, rear wiper with washer, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The full options list includes dual airbags, ABS brakes, cruise control, keyless entry with burglar alarm, power sunroof, leather interior, CD player and 17-inch alloy wheels. Bumping up the horsepower would've made it a real contender in the sports car market.

Maserati Levante is the Italian premium car maker's first venture into the SUV market. Under the hood is a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, available in two different tunes. Power is delivered to the wheels via an 8-speed automatic. Standard features on the all-wheel drive Levante include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, 4-zone AC, electric seats and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include interior leather packages, sports kit, roof rails, adaptive bi-xenon headlights, skid plate, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy rims. Safety features include 6 airbags, lane departure warning system, forward collision alert, blind spot monitor, adaptive cruise control and traction control.

The MG 6 comes in two body shapes, either as a sedan or as a liftback version. There are two 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engines to choose from, one being naturally aspirated and the other a turbocharged unit. They can be had in either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission with optional paddle shifters. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with CD/MP3 support and 8 speakers, trip computer and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, power mirrors, cruise control, parking rear camera, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C, radio with DVD/MP3 support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

Expanding their midsize 5-Series line-up, the 5-Series Gran Turismo is supposed to be a coupe-like crossover vehicle that aims to appeal to markets where the 5-Series wagon is ignored. The 'F07' platform features a unique "bi-modal" trunk which may be opened in traditional sedan fashion, or the entire hatch may open like a hatchback. Various new BMW tech features debuted in the GT that appear in the next 5-Series range, such as four-wheel multilink suspension, standard 8-speed automatic gearboxes and turbo engines, namely the 3.0-litre inline-6 for the 535i GT and the 4.4-litre V8 for the 550i GT. Depending on trim level, the 4-seater GT can be outfitted with features such as leather upholstery, 4-zone automatic a/c, Bluetooth, navigation, USB/iPod port, CD/MP3 stereo with 80 GB hard disc, rear DVD entertainment system, heads-up display, panoramic glass roof, adaptive cruise control with stop-&-go feature, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning system, night vision, active steering, rear-wheel steering, rearview camera, side-view cameras, parking sensors, run-flat tyres and keyless button-start, among others. Also included are various selectable driving modes, adjustable air suspension, stability control and numerous airbags. The niche vehicle is almost as long as the 7-Series and has as much headroom as the X5.

The Tesla Model Y is an all-electric car in the crowded luxury compact SUV segment. It comes with a 75 kWh battery and all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, 15.4-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth, and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include, self-driving capability, enhanced autopilot, higher quality leather interior, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system and bigger alloy wheels. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features feature traffic-aware cruise control, autosteer and autopark.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The BLS offers all the looks of a Cadillac CTS, with all the driving dynamics of a Saab 9-3, on which is is based. Built on GM's corporate front-wheel-drive platform, the BLS is an entry-level model with three turbo engines taken straight from Saab. There are two 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engines that can be mated to  a five-speed automatic transmission. The top engine is a 2.8-litre V6 turbo. Built in Europe to somehow compete with German sports sedans, the usual power features are all there, as are six airbags and stability control features. The base model is fitted with 16-inch alloy wheels, climate control, cruise control, electric windows and door mirrors, a seven speaker CD system with MP3 inlet, and wheel-mounted controls for the cruise controls and stereo. Additional features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloys, fog lights and rain sensing wipers, leather trim, dual zone climate control, electric adjustment for driver and front passenger seats, a Bose stereo system with nine speakers and a six-CD changer, auto dimming rearview mirrors inside and out and rear parking sensors.

The Lamborghini HuracÃ¡n, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the HuracÃ¡n LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Chevrolet Trax is the American brand's compact SUV offering. For the 2017 model year, it got a facelift, some interior updates and upgraded safety features. The 2019 Chevrolet Trax comes with a 4-cylinder 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The South Korean-made Trax comes in two trims - LT and LTZ. The base-model LT comes in only front-wheel drive, while the LTZ gets all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/AUX support and alloy wheels. The infotainment system gets a 7-inch touch screen, which also supports Apple and Android phones. Optional features include bigger alloy wheels, better sound system and chrome door handles. Safety-wise, the 2019 Chevrolet Trax gets traction control, stability control and 4-wheel ABS with panic brake assist.

The Lotus Exige is a little sports coupe with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine. It gets go-kart handling, thanks to its light weight as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. In 2017, the Exige Sport 350 was introduced with better handling and slight visual upgrades. It is only available with a 6-speed manual gearbox, as a well as a 6-speed automatic. Standard features for the GCC include leather seats, plain black leather sun-visors, lightweight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand brake sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. There are two new interior package options available: Premium and Premium Sport. The Premium Pack provides added comfort and style where as the Premium Sport option focuses on creating an internal space optimised for ultimate driver involvement. Built for the adrenalin hungry sportscar aficionado, the Lotus Exige S features high performance bespoke tyre package with Pirelli P-Zero Corsa tyres as standard. A Lotus DPM (Dynamic Performance Management) switch allows the driver to switch between three driving modes: Touring, Sport and DPM off. And if three dynamic settings are not enough, an additional Race Pack option is available which adds a fourth driving mode setting: Race. This setting provides the maximum possible traction out of corners. The Race Pack also features Launch Control and an optimised suspension setting making the car perfect for letting rip on the track. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

Named after Ferrari coachbuilder Sergio Scaglietti, the all-aluminum 612 Scaglietti attempts to blend performance and comfort in the tradition of a true Ferrari berlinetta designed to accommodate four people. This Ferrari is a 12-cylinder model with both the space-frame chassis and body panels in aluminium. The overall layout, with the 5.7-litre engine mounted behind the front axle and the gearbox in line with the differential at the rear, ensures an ideally balanced weight distribution, as well as permitting a lower centre of gravity. The performance-orientated handling is enhanced by active damping and a new stability and traction control system, with components from General Motors subsidiaries no less. The 612 runs with a six-speed mechanical gearbox, in a choice of manual or F1-style paddle shifts. With a relatively long wheelbase, the 612 has been designed to offer ease of entry for rear-seat passengers to a luxurious cabin which will accommodate four adults in comfort, while the luggage trunk hold a five-piece Ferrari luggage set or two full sets of golf clubs. Features include a new radio-CD system, voice recognition system, MP3 player, Bluetooth and more.

Completely redesigned for the 2008 model year, the Cherokee is tougher than most compact 4WDs. Also known as the Liberty in some markets, it seats five people and can carry their gear too. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it is mated to a 4-speed automatic. Fold the rear seats and it can move two people and their cargo. The entry-level Sport has a body-coloured grille, while the upscale Limited has a chrome grille. Turn off the pavement, and it can negotiate most trails with confidence. All models come with stability control, ABS brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, front airbags, available side airbags, and all-speed traction control. Standard on all models is a full-time four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. Available features also include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, CD stereo, cruise control, parking sensors, rain-sensing wipers, 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, and a cloth or faux-leather interior, among other items. Options include a trick roof that can open the full length of the ceiling to the elements. By 2010, a minor update included the addition of the optional excellent voice-controlled UConnect multimedia-communications computer, with integrates navigation, Bluetooth, hard drive and USB-ready CD stereo in one touchscreen unit.

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The Renault Symbol is a sub-compact offering that's actually sourced from sister-brand Dacia. The Romanian-built Symbol made its way back to the GCC market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. It comes with only one engine, a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the basic Symbol PE model include power steering, front electric windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/USB, Bluetooth, steering wheel mounted controls, fabric seats, front fog lamps and steel wheels with 15-inch hubcaps. The SE model gets additional rear electric windows, electric mirrors, trip computer, temperature sensor, body colour door handles with chrome, automatic A/C, cruise control and leather steering wheel. The top SE model gets 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, 7-inch touchscreen with GPS and navigation, and optional leather seats. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS.

The MK6 Golf GTI debuted in the summer of 2009, with a mildly-upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and a choice of 6-speed manual or DSG automanual, though the manual version isn't imported by most GCC dealers. The interior is very similar to the previous Golf, but some new bits include the steering wheel, 'climatronic' a/c and better noise reduction. It comes with seven airbags including a knee airbag, stability control, adaptive cruise control, adaptive chassis control with adjustable suspension, Park Assist, alloy wheels, sunroof, and the usual power accessories. The Golf GTI has features such as sports seats, GTI alloy wheels, and a standard XDS electronic differential lock, and optional features such as adaptive suspension, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist and more.

The 2015 Honda CR-V got a minor facelift and a new powertrain, and remained the same for the 2016 model year. Built in the United States, it comes in LX, EX and EX-Leather flavours. It is now powered by a direct-injected 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT transmission. The base model is now offered in front-wheel-drive form. The CR-V's optional all-wheel-drive system still drives the front wheels most of the time but can send torque to the rear wheels anytime. The 5-seater cabin comes with a quick 60:40 fold-flat rear bench. The LX gets 17-inch alloys, a 4-speaker CD stereo with USB/AUX port, Bluetooth, rear parking sensors, basic keyless entry, starter button, mirror-mounted indicators, cruise control, ABS, stability control and front-side airbags. Only the EX and EX-L models get 18-inch wheels, a 6-speaker stereo with touchscreen, HID headlights, fog lamps, dual-zone auto a/c, smart keyless entry, sunroof, rear camera, "LaneWatch" blind-spot camera and an 'i-MID' LCD display. The EX-L itself further gets side-curtain airbags, leather and a power driver's seat.

Proton claimed that the Waja was their first in-house car designed by Malaysians. However, its petrol engine is bought directly from Mitsubishi, and the suspension work was done by their independent Lotus division. The Waja is sold as the Impian in some markets, or referred to as the Waja Campro sometimes to advertise its latest engine. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this four-door sedan can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, sunroof, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Waja is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras.

The Nissan Sentra carries on with no major changes since its introduction in 2013. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. The 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in only CVT. Both engines are not available in all GCC countries. The 1.6S and 1.8S gets power steering, power mirrors, power windows, halogen headlamps, rear LED lamps, keyless entry, manual seats, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/RDS support and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. The 1.6SV gets LED accent headlamps, intelligent key with engine push-start button, wood trim and 4 speakers. The 1.6 SV Sports gets fog lamps, leather steering, rear spoiler, 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors and indicators on side-view mirror.  Both 1.6 SV and 1.8 SV sports have the option of USB/iPod connectivity, bluetooth, navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. The 1.8 SV gets the same as S but with rear parking sensors and bluetooth. The 1.8 SL gets the same options as 1.6 SV Sports plus rear spoiler with brake lamp, 6 speakers and USB/iPod connectivity. The 1.8 SL Premium gets more features such as leather seats, sunroof, cruise control, dual-zone climate control A/C. The 1.8 SL and SL Premium have the option of adding navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. Safety features include electronic brake-force distribution (EBD), ABS and Brake Assist (BA), along with driver and passenger front airbags. Only the 1.8 SL Premium gets side and curtain airbags.

The ZNA Yumsun is a 7-seater minivan that turns out to be the unlikely flagship, with its 2.5-litre Nissan 4-cylinder engine. The single trim level includes soft-touch cabin trim, 4-speed automatic, 15-inch alloy wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, fake wood and leather trim, CD/MP3 stereo with steering controls and 6-CD changer, remote locking, power windows and mirrors, table on the backrest of front seats, 3.9-inch LCD screen with rear audio controls and 6 speakers, automatic antenna, rear parking sensors, auto front and rear a/c, and two airbags.

The Lincoln MKX got an all-new model for 2016. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, it gets a standard 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the higher models get a turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

The Cadillac ATS-V is the American luxury brand's compact sports sedan offering. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS-V gets a twin-turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. A 6-speed manual is available but will most likely not be offered in the GCC. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, automatic headlamps, automatic dual-zone A/C, Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Audi Q7 is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 has two 3.0-litre supercharged V6 "TFSI" engines at different states of tune, although the marketeers like to give only the more powerful one the "supercharged" label. There is a 4.2-litre turbodiesel V8 and a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V12 "TDI" engine available for order as well, for whatever reason. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. The new engines came in 2011, but visual changes to the Audi Q7 came in 2010, including new LED headlights and indicators, LED taillights, a chromed front grille, new bumpers, new instrument cluster, ambient lighting and new cabin trim choices, along with new paint colours. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering yet, and takes its name from a fighting bull or something. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini, available as coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. An Audi-derived 5.0-litre V10 engine, upgraded for 2006, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type limited-slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard. The track-ready Superleggera version, built in the final year, offers weight savings and a minor power increase.

The BMW X1 is the smallest crossover SUV in the German brand. It got a facelift in 2013. Based on the 1-Series platform, complete with four-wheel-independent suspension and disc brakes, the X1 is their first SUV to be available in rear-wheel-drive form with the sDrive18i base model, sporting a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The other two models in the range are the all-wheel-drive xDrive25i and the xDrive 28i, both fitted with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine in different states of tune, one with more power than the other. The interior features a new melted-look dashboard, with optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

The Ibiza is based on the VW Polo and is the hatchback variant of the Cordoba. Though similar to the Cordoba, it somehow appears a lot more sporty than the dull Cordoba, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. In the Middle East, this front-wheel-drive is offered in three-door or five-door body styles, with numerous VW-derived powerplants, including a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre and two turbocharged 1.8-litre units, all 4-cylinder engines, with some manual and some automatic transmissions available, depending on model. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, power front windows, electric mirrors, remote central locking, 15-inch to 17-inch wheels, CD stereo, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, traction control and even an optional stability control system. These cars are quite well-packed with features for their size. Sport and FR models get larger alloy wheels, stiffer suspension, body-colour rear spoiler, sports seats and unique exhausts as standard. The limited-availability 3-door Cupra gets the top turbo engine and further sports tuning.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. In 2018 it got a slight facelift and updated interior, and the M235i changed to M240i with more power. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i, 230i and the M240i. The 220i and 230i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M240i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M240i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

Ford has been overly careful not to mess with a winner, so when Ford redesigned the Explorer in 2006, America's favorite midsize sport utility for the last 15 years in a row, they barely changed anything. The latest Explorer is available with a big 4.0-litre V6, with a five-speed automatic. The wagon can seat seven, while the Sport Trac pickup can seat five. The wagon is a traditional midsize 4WD with a body-on-frame construction, and features new steering, new suspension and new brakes. Standard equipment include Roll Stability Control, independent rear suspension, keyless entry, cruise control, compass and thermometer, power windows, locks and mirrors, air conditioning, a floor console, rear vent windows and added 12-volt power point, AM/FM stereo with single CD or MP3 player, driver manual lumbar adjuster, a tyre-pressure monitoring system and alloy wheels. Options include running boards, roof rails, bigger wheels, more wood and leather, 10-way power seat and a six-disc changer. The Sport Trac has a composite cargo box with two-tier storage ability, available hard tonneau cover and three integrated tool bins.

The Lamborghini HuracÃ¡n, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the HuracÃ¡n LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Mercedes-Benz ML-Class, officially referred to as the M-Class for whatever reason, has been completely revamped for the 2012 model year, taking on a puffier styling theme while retaining all the characteristics of the previous model. This midsize SUV comes in three versions, namely the ML 350 with a 3.5-litre V6, the ML500 with a 4.7-litre V8, and the ML 63 AMG with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8, all with 7-speed automatics and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and a choice of 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers, depending on trim level, leather upholstery, wood trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, optional keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. An AMG package is optional, and it adds a body kit and sportier suspension. The ML 63 also option of AMG performance package which adds even more power.

The Jeep Compass, based on the feeble Dodge Caliber, gets heavily worked over for 2011, with a facelift that mimics the Jeep Grand Cherokee. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo made its debut back in 2007. In 2010 it received power upgrades and a new automatic gearbox. It has remained relatively unchanged in 2011 as well. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets an updated all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Further options include an powered steel sliding/lift sunroof and a roof-transport system. Another option in the Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

The S2000 is a small two-seat roadster that can easily chase the likes of the snobby Porsche Boxster. It is a technological innovation from Honda, whose aim with this car was to pump as much horsepower out of a small 2.0-litre engine as possible, without any turbo or supercharging trickery. The S2000 is said to drive like a superbike, because big horsepower from small displacement with a narrow powerband and extremely high rpm produces a very frantic experience. Driving it slowly, shifting the manual at low rpm apparently results in very weak performance in traffic. The latest model has refinements to the engine and suspension put in place back in 2005. Changes to the S2000 in 2006 include more shoulder and elbow room, and some tweaks, most notably 17-inch wheels, drive-by-wire throttle, stability control and new headlights with a triple-beam design. Early models had a plastic rear window, while 2002-plus models get a glass one. The last external facelift was in 2004. Interior features are basic, but include leather upholstery, electric power steering, starter button, power windows, power mirrors, remote central locking, air-conditioning and a pathetic radio cassette stereo with 2 speakers.

The 2014 Toyota Zelas got a facelift and some minor improvements. The stylistic enhancements include new headlamp design, an extended hood, a new grille and LED accent lighting. A new black-out valance beneath the rear bumper features a lower-centre trim piece, lower perimeter reflectors and new LED tail lamps. The interior receives upgraded materials and lighter colour fabric on the seats and headliner. The power plant in the Zelas remains the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, coupled to an updated 6-speed automatic that can shifts ratios quicker. It also features a "Dynamic Rev Management" technology, which blips the throttle on downshifts to limit driveline shock. To improve dynamics, they have modified the stabiliser bar, optimised the shock absorbers, and have increased structural rigidity with additional spot welds. It also gets retuned electronic power steering. Available features include a CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more.

The redesigned-for-2008 Mondeo is an attractive midsize car built in Europe that shares a Mazda platform. It looks excellent inside and out, but loses out to the Japanese with a weak combination of carryover engines, along with the stigma of expensive dealer maintenance charges. It was facelifted a bit for 2011, with a new front bumper and grille. The Mondeo is largely avaliable as a family sedan, but it is also available in sporty liftback and practical wagon form in some markets. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for an affordable price. The interior is especially attractive and put together well. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available with a 5-speed manual. A 2.3-litre 4-cylinder engine is coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. Various trim levels are available, all with power windows, trip computer, ABS brakes, front airbags, CD stereo with MP3 connector and more. Options include stability control, CD changer, keyless starter button, Xenon adaptive headlights, tyre pressure monitor, sunroof, fog lights, variable suspension settings, hill launch assist and adaptive cruise control.

The 407 is an oddity in the midsize car segment, with bold styling that puts form over function, and the 2-door coupe version goes even further. Standard is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with an all-new 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. Basic features include power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind, automatic climate control, and as many as nine airbags.

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The Rio is Kia's sub-compact nameplate that started life in 2000. It can always be depended on for the most unique exterior designs in this segment. This generation of the Rio debuted in 2006 and received a minor frontal facelift in 2010, before being replaced in 2012. The interior offers decent space for its size, although the cabin is a hard plastic tomb, like most others in its class. Powered by a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive runabout comes in either sedan or hatchback body styles. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, battery saver, wind-up windows and AM/FM radio cassette player. Higher models add a few items, such as body-coloured outer trimmings and power windows, along with electric mirrors, front fog lamps, driver's seat height adjustability, luggage undertray and central door locks. We could not verify what safety features are available besides seat belts, although we believe many markets get ABS brakes and front airbags, standard or otherwise.

The Matrix is an urban runabout, halfway between a minivan and a hatchback, while looking better than neither. First introduced way back in 2002, and facelifted for 2009, the Matrix is probably a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering good interior space inside a compact body, but it never caught on in the Middle East. Powered by either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or an automatic, while the larger engine gets only an automatic. Basic features include power steering, power windows, simple a/c, cloth seats, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, 14-inch steel wheels with plastic covers, and a roof rack. Safety is apparently optional, as the basic model only gets a single airbag and seatbelts. Only the higher models get dual airbags and ABS brakes, paired up with other options like fake metal-look trim, central door locking, rear wiper and washer, electrically-adjustable mirrors and 15-inch alloy wheels. Sometimes being named after an action movie just isn't enough.

The Changan Eado is a compact sedan from China. An all-new model came out in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Eado include power windows, central locking, remote control on key, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 4 speakers, leather steering wheel with audio controls, USB+AUX ports, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and hologen headlamps. Safety features includes front dual airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT Roadster, or Mercedes-AMG GT Roadster as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Two variants of the AMG GT Roadster are available as of 2018, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT Roadster gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT C gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT C also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Fluence is a budget model from Renault, built in Korea and designed for Eastern-European and Middle-Eastern markets. It received a face-lift for the 2013 model. Sized somewhere between a compact and a midsize, it is value-priced and can be loaded with up with respectable features. Powered by a weak 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, this front-wheel-drive sedan can be had with either a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic. A 2.0-litre model comes later with a CVT. Standard features include variable electric power steering, anti-theft alarm, adjustable steering wheel, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 player, manual a/c and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher models can be specced up with a Arkamys or Bose stereo, USB/iPod ports, Bluetooth, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, auto headlights, keyless start button, dual-zone automatic a/c, fog lamps, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof and more. Standard safety features include ABS-assisted front disc and rear drum brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution, two front airbags and seatbelt pre-tensioners, with optional features such as stability control and side-curtain airbags.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA 45 AMG is a sub-compact sports sedan of the German brand. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. In 2017, it got a power boost. It gets the AMG-specific bumpers and wheels. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. The CLA 45 AMG "Edition 1" model includes red highlights on certain trim bits, red brake calipers, 19-inch AMG light-alloy wheels in matte black, and special seat upholstery, AMG Performance steering wheel and other doodads. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, ABS brakes, ESP and traction control.

The Audi S6 got an all-new model in 2020. The all-wheel drive S6 has a 2.9-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Optional features for the S6 include heads-up display, sports differential, dynamic steering and ceramic brakes. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control. Optional safety features include rear side airbags, park assist, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, night vision and pre-sense assist.

An all-new Audi A4 came out in 2016. It is a more spacious car, while at the same time is lighter than its predecessor. Under the hood, there are 2 available engines. There is the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and is available only as front-wheel-drive. Then there is the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and comes with all-wheel drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Volkswagen Polo Sedan is powered by a 1.6-litre four cylinder engine mated to a six-speed automatic transmission. The front fascia of the Polo Sedan has the distinct look of all new Volkswagen models, with fog lamps and 15-inch alloys coming as standard. It got a minor facelift in 2016. The Polo sedan is slightly longer than the European hatchback model, thereby offering more rear legroom for passengers. Standard features include electrically adjustable side mirrors, electric remote unlocking for the boot lid and central locking. Parking sensors and automatic air-conditioning are optional extras. A radio with a CD/MP3 player is included in the base model. You get leather wrapped around the steering wheel and gear knob. Volkswagen offers ABS and dual airbags as standard on the Polo sedan.

The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Volvo XC60 was launched with high hopes for the Swedish company, capitalising on the small crossover vehicle market. The XC60 is a new 5-seater crossover SUV that is aimed at attracting luxury-brand buyers. The XC60 T6 is powered by a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shifting capability, and an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. For 2010, an XC60 T5 model was introduced, with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The smallest XC model includes new safety technology, debuting Volvo's new City Safety system, designed to help a driver avoid a collision at under 30 kph, or reduce the speed of impact at higher speeds by hitting the brakes if the vehicle in front suddenly stops and City Safety determines that a collision is likely. Another new safety featured being introduced on the XC60 is Pre-Prepared Restraints that uses a laser sensor that interacts with other technology to control the airbags and adaptive seatbelt load limiters. Other features, depending on trim level, include cloth or leather upholstery, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, reverse camera, keyless entry, sunroof, alloy wheels, common power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. An R-Design body kit is optional. Standard safety features include front and side-surtain airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, and whiplash-protection headrests.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The all-new 6-Series  was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, which has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic.

An all-new Ford F-150 Raptor was made available in the GCC in 2021. It comes with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. The Raptor is available as a SuperCab or as a SuperCrew. Standard features on the 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor include power steering, power windows, cruise control, keyless entry, manual single-zone A/C, bucket seats with manual lumbar support, fabric upholstery, SYNC voice recognition communications and entertainment system, AM/FM stereo with 7 speakers, leather wrapped steering-wheel with mounted audio controls, reverse parking sensors with camera, and 17-inch alloy wheels with all-terrain tyres. Optional features on the 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor include the SYNC 3 system with an 12-inch touch screen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, B & O audio system and sub-woofer, power seats, navigation, moonroof, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, ventilated seats, active park assist, adaptive cruise control and blind spot monitor. All models of the 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor get front driver and passenger airbags, side curtain airbags, rollover sensor and stability control.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

An all-new Hyundai Veloster came out in 2019. it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side. The standard engine for the GCC is a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder,  mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED headlamps, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available in some GCC markets include a full set of airbags, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 and received very small changes for the 2011 model year. Under the hood, it is still powered by the high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Cordoba is designed to appeal to sedan customers who like the Ibiza hatchback. Though similar to the Ibiza, it somehow appears a lot more conservative than the Ibiza, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. It is keeping pace in the market with variations of the original car, by adding new Seat styling features to what is essentially the same car that was launched ages ago. In the Middle East, it is offered with only a VW-derived 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine, with an automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, front power windows, remote central locking, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, CD radio with six speakers, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, height and reach adjustable steering wheel, double headlamps, three-point rear seatbelts and three rear headrests, among others. Stability system with brake assistance is an option, as are rear power windows, alloy wheels and what not.

The Lexus CT 200h is the first hybrid in the small-car segment to debut in the GCC. It got a facelift in 2014, getting the new front "spindle grille" design. This premium hatchback comes only in front-wheel-drive hybrid form, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a self-charging electric motor and a CVT automatic. The platform has its roots in Toyota models, but the suspension is fully independent, MacPherson-strut front and double-wishbone rear. Standard features include an info display to show battery usage, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with cloth upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, parking sensors, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, split-folding rear seat, sunroof, LED side and tail lamps, LED front driving lamps, fog lamps and alarm.
