The top trim additionally gets leather upholstery, wood trim, power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, front seat heaters, navigation system with flip-up 7-inch LCD screen, rear camera, Bluetooth, auto-levelling LED headlights, rain-sensing wipers, sport front bumper, and a 10-speaker audio system. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

An all-new model of the Kia Cadenza came out in 2017. The 2019 Kia Cadenza comes with two engine options, one the 3.3-litre "MPI" V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox, and the other more powerful 3.3-litre "GDI" V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Features, standard or otherwise, in the 2019 Kia Cadenza include cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 17-inch, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, 8-inch screen with navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. It gets Kia's UVO system featuring Android Auto and Apple CarPlay as standard, while a 12-speaker Harman/Kardon system is an option. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes. Higher models get Kia's "Drive Wise" semi-autonomous self-driving tech. The self-driving suite includes emergency braking, radar cruise control that can function in stop-and-go traffic, and lane keep assist tech.

The Opel Corsa OPC is the performance model of the standard version. The sporty Corsa OPC model comes with a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, and connected to a 6-speed manual transmission. There is more higher tuned Corsa OPC Nurburgring Edition which produces more power and an aggressive suspension setup.  The OPC is available only as a 3-door model. Standard options include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, automatic A/C, leather upholstery and alloy wheels, entertainment system with a touch screen, CD player and MP3/iPod/AUX support, fog lamps, automatic headlamps and alloy wheels. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, traction control, ABS brakes featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution.

The Sirion is Daihatsu's entry in the sub-compact segment, packed with features and space. It received a minor facelift for the 2008 model year, along with a bigger 1.5-litre engine. The little Sirion offers a generous amount of space for the front passengers, including a fair bit of room between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Rear passengers aren't so lucky, but they still get reasonable amounts of leg space between front and rear seats. The rear doors open wide to an angle of around 80 degrees, allowing easy entry and exit, and the tailgate eases handling of large luggage. There is a full 630 litres of luggage space with two people on board and the rear seats folded down. With five on board, it still has 225 litres. The top of the back door has decent head clearance and a pull handle also makes it easy to close the door. A luggage room lamp adds convenience, along with the CD/AM/FM Radio, power windows, central locking, front airbags, cup holders in the doors and the centre console, and split rear seats that are 60:40 foldable. It is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder motor, the Sirion shifts gears using a 4-speed automatic, as the manual is not offered here. 14-inch steel wheels are standard, while alloys are optional, among other things.

The Infiniti G35 is company's first serious rear-wheel-drive honest-to-goodness sports sedan. It uses a 3.5-litre V6 with a 5-speed automatic transmission. Its platform is the corporate front-midship, which it shares with the Nissan 350Z. Features include 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlamps, fog lamps, heated mirrors, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, cloth or leather seats with power adjustment, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo and wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a rear spoiler, power sunroof, rosewood interior trim, dual HVAC controls and a DVD-based navigation system. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

An all-new Nissan Navara Pickup was released as a 2017 model year. In the GCC, the engines are carried over from the previous generation but with new transmissions. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, both of which come with either a 6-speed manual or 7-speed automatic transmission. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloy wheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signal lamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensing wipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

More a tall wagon than a true off-roader, the Outlander is based on the Lancer platform and uses a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine that mates to a four-speed automatic transmission only. The all-wheel-drive system splits the torque evenly between the front and rear under normal driving conditions, and distributes it wherever necessary when the going gets slippery. It does not have he equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 6-CD changer with 6 speakers, and leather seats. The Outlander is gutsy for a four-cylinder, but far from quick. It is easy to climb into, with a fair amount of room up up front and good all-round visibility as it is taller than a car but shorter than a proper 4WD. Mitsubishi decided to ditch this ambiguous genre with the next-generation 2008 Outlander, which took on the appearance of a proper 4WD.

The Renault Symbol is a sub-compact offering that's actually sourced from sister-brand Dacia. The Romanian-built Symbol made its way back to the GCC market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. It comes with only one engine, a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the basic Symbol PE model include power steering, front electric windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/USB, Bluetooth, steering wheel mounted controls, fabric seats, front fog lamps and steel wheels with 15-inch hubcaps. The SE model gets additional rear electric windows, electric mirrors, trip computer, temperature sensor, body colour door handles with chrome, automatic A/C, cruise control and leather steering wheel. The top SE model gets 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, 7-inch touchscreen with GPS and navigation, and optional leather seats. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS.

JAC J5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, fabric seats, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support, 2 speakers and steel wheels. Optional equipment include a better stereo system with 4 speakers, fog lamps, alloy wheels, leather seats, parking sensors and sunroof. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Scirocco is revival of Volkswagen's odd-shaped 1970s model that attempted to bridge the gap between a hatchback and a coupe. It last died out in 1992, until its revival as a concept car in 2006 and a production car by 2008. Debuting in the GCC as a 'sportier' alternative to the VW Golf, the Scirocco lifts platforms, engines and even interior panels from the Golf. However, the cabin itself has a lower roofline while retaining seating for four. Engines include a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder with both a supercharger and a turbocharger, as well as a 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. The GCC dealers will be pushing the automatic version locally, with the 'DSG' automanual gearbox, but it can be special-ordered with a 6-speed manual. A higher-tuned Scirocco R model became available in 2012, with more power, a body kit and firmer suspension. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

Chery Arrizo 5 is the Chinese brand's compact car offering. Under the hood, it features a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features in the Arrizo 5 include power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, alloy wheels, LED daytime running lights and LED taillights and turn signals. Optional features include push button engine start-stop and an infotainment system with 7-inch touch screen and SD/USB/Bluetooth device support. Looking at the safety features, it includes ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor, hill hold control (HHC), speed-sensitive door-locking, emergency brake alarm and dual airbags in the front.

The F-150 delivers all the manly attributes of toughness, strength, and imposing size, although it is largely sold here as a fashion statement for tiny men. Redesigned for 2009, the fully-loaded F-150 crew-cab is sold here as more of a lifestyle vehicle, offering interior design and comfort that would rival some luxury cars. Properly equipped, it can haul more than a tonne in its bed. The F-150 is comfortable as well, with a quiet and refined ride. It comes with dual frontal airbags, cloth seats, a CD player, and air conditioning as standard. A host of power and luxury options are available too. For all these reasons, the F-150 has been America's best-selling full-size pickup for nearly 30 consecutive years. It is the most most profitable vehicle Ford makes. It is available in various trim levels, variations, and specialty models, including quad cab, single cab and dual cab model, with various bed sizes. At the bottom of the lineup is a V6 work truck, though the main options apparently offered here are the carryover 4.6-litre V8 and the 5.4-litre V8 engines, with automatic transmissions.

An all-new Bentley Continental GT was released in 2018. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Continental GT is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

An all-new GMC Acadia came in 2017. In 2020 it got a significant facelift and tech upgrades. The crossover offers three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. The Acadia gets a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry, tri-zone climate control and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19 or 20-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Veloster is Hyundai's head-on dive into the sport-compact segment, with an entry that will be controversial forever. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side. The standard engine for the GCC is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, which puts a downer on its sporting intentions, especially since the standard gearbox is a 6-speed automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available in some GCC markets include a full set of airbags, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The Opel Meriva is the German manufacturer's MPV offering. The Spanish-built Meriva has been around since 2010 but only made its Middle East debut in 2013. It got a slight facelift in 2015. It gets a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Standard features in the Meriva include power steering, power windows, AM/FM/CD player with MP3/AUX support. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags and ABS.

The Citroen C5 is a compact SUV offering by the French manufacturer. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base C5 Live nclude electric power steering, leather wrapped steering wheel, steering wheel audio controls, power windows, rear parking sensors, central 8-inch capacitive touch screen, 4.2 inch instrument display, AM/FM and MP3 compatible radio with two tweeters and four speakers, Bluetooth, 2 USB sockets, mirror screen (Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and MirrorLink), automatic dual-zone AC, automatic halogen headlights, LED rear lights, fog lamps, LED daytime running lamps, electric door mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The mid-range C5 Feel includes additionally wireless charging, LED indicator lamps, rear fog lamp, mood lighting, central 8-inch capacitive touch screen and 12.3 inch customisable TFT instrument display, front parking sensors, panoramic opening glass-roof and 18-inch alloy wheels. The top C5 Shine model gets more features such as rear camera, electric driver seat with massage function, LED headlamps, and keyless start. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, hill- start assist, ABS, stability and traction control, and tyre pressure monitor, while the higher models get additional side airbags and blind spot monitor.

The Ignis is categorized as a supermini by the Europeans, but we see it as something a little bigger and, as Suzuki claims, a little more of a 4WD wagon alternative for hauling purposes. The Ignis was facelifted for 2006, but the model had reached its last year in the GCC. Alloy wheels and foglamps are standard. Inside, all five seats provide decent space and comfort as well as firm support. The front seats slide and recline, and the driver's seat is fitted with a height adjuster. Interior amenities include door trim pockets, bottle holders on all doors, cup holders, a glove box, under-dash storage space, a front-seat back pocket, a 12-volt accessory socket, a centre console, a storage tray under the front passenger seat and more. The Ignis lives with a 1.3-litre engine with variable valve timing, and a five-speed manual gearbox is standard, while a four-speed automatic transmission is available as an option. Safety features include numerous airbags and active safety head restraints for the driver and front seat passenger.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The all-new M4 came out as a 2021 model year. Under the hood, is a highly-tuned 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The M4 comes standard with a carbon-fibre roof or an optional no-cost moonroof. The M4 also gets an optional M Drive Professional feature, which helps drivers analyse driving lines and times on race tracks. An M Drift Analyser records the duration of a drift, distance covered, and the line and angle, displaying a final rating on the Control Display after each drift. Users can also download an iPhone app that corresponds with the car to give them a bird’s-eye view of the track and access to a lap time comparison chart, as well as data like speed, accelerator position, and total G forces. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera. Other standard safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control and brake assist.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 and received very small changes for the 2011 model year. Under the hood, it is still powered by the high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The engine range includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 6.1-litre V8-powered SRT-8 models is available in many GCC markets, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. The SRT8 gets larger 20-inch alloy wheels, sports leather seats, a mild body kit and sports suspension. All models feature front and side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Kia Sorento has been completely redesigned from the ground up for 2010. Originally a proper 4x4 with low-range gearing, the Sorento is now a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension, and featuring the new Kia corporate grille. The available engine for the GCC is a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder joined later, with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available in four colours, with cloth or leather upholstery. The new Sorento CUV can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, LED indicators on the mirrors, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

The Passat has been a trendsetter for VW over the years, earning a distinction as the most copied design in automotive history. Many cars now look like a Passat, so the new one is now a larger car that attempts to reinvent itself. The all-new VW Passat boasts a few powerful new engines, a few weak engines, generous standard content and a high-quality interior mixed with high-tech hijinks. Volkswagen has rolled out a full line of four-door sedans, ranging from the poor 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre affordable models with nice leatherette upholstery to the more-powerful 2.0-litre turbocharged 2.0T model that just manages to be likeable, and a purely leather-clad V6-powered 3.2-litre V6 model that is destined to be extremely rare thanks to a bloated price tag. All cars are front-wheel-drive, with the exception of the all-wheel drive V6 model. All Passats come standard with the latest in safety features and electronics, including power features, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, ESP, tyre-pressure monitoring system and MP3-capable CD player.

The Lexus GS is all-new for the 2012 model year, gaining a new entry-level trim but losing the V8 at the top end. The new models include the GS 250 and the GS 350, with the GS 450h hybrid joining the range later. The GS 250 comes with a 2.5-litre direct-injection V6 and a 6-speed automatic with paddles. The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 6-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its new 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The GS 250 can be had in various trims. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 250, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

An all-new Mazda CX-9 crossover SUV made its debut in 2016. Powered by a new turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, it comes with a six-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in four trims, the GS, GT, GTX and GTX Limited are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The higher spec CX-9 gets  20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console. Safety-wise, the CX-9 comes with standard stability control and ABS, and is optionally equipped with Forward Obstruction Warning, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Control.

The Malibu nameplate returns to the GCC for 2010, after almost a decade, although it wasn't missed at all. Unlike its predecessor however, the new Malibu is a highly-competitive entry in the midsize sedan segment, with a clean-sheet design and good features. The new Malibu is a mainstream front-wheel-drive sedan, but aims slightly higher with its chrome trimmings and colourful interior options. Powered by either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.6-litre V6, both are available with a 6-speed automatic offering manual-shift capabilities. Unique features for this segment include standard 18-inch wheels, optional two-tone interior colour schemes, and lots of extra noise-reducing features that make the Malibu's cabin quieter than most. Other features include a CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or digital a/c, and options such as sunroof and cruise control, among others. The V6 is identified by its front foglights and dual exhaust tips. Safety is prioritised with six standard airbags, traction control, tyre pressure monitoring system, four-wheel-disc brakes, ABS and stability control.

The Ibiza is based on the VW Polo and is the hatchback variant of the Cordoba. Though similar to the Cordoba, it somehow appears a lot more sporty than the dull Cordoba, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. In the Middle East, this front-wheel-drive is offered in three-door or five-door body styles, with numerous VW-derived powerplants, including a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre and two turbocharged 1.8-litre units, all 4-cylinder engines, with some manual and some automatic transmissions available, depending on model. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, power front windows, electric mirrors, remote central locking, 15-inch to 17-inch wheels, CD stereo, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, traction control and even an optional stability control system. These cars are quite well-packed with features for their size. Sport and FR models get larger alloy wheels, stiffer suspension, body-colour rear spoiler, sports seats and unique exhausts as standard. The limited-availability 3-door Cupra gets the top turbo engine and further sports tuning.

JAC M5 is the Chinese brand's large minivan offering. It features a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, trip computer, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 7-inch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system, rearview camera, folding mirrors. leather seats and xenon headlamps. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes, brake assist (BA) and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Chevrolet Equinox made its debut in the GCC as a 2018 model year. Under the hood, the 2019 Chevrolet Equinox gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. The base engine gets a 6-speed automatic, while the 2.0-litre gets a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2019 Chevrolet Equinox LS model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, manual AC, rear AC vents, Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 2019 Chevrolet Equinox LT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, and  optional leather seats. The top Premier model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled driver and front passenger seats, leather interior, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Chevrolet MyLink with 8-inch touchscreen display, optional navigation, Bose premium 9-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features on the 2019 Chevrolet Equinox include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The new Renault Safrane is a midsize sedan sedan that is based on the Japanese-market Nissan Teana platform, and is a rebadged version of the Korean-built Samsung SM5. This GCC-exclusive model is available in three trim levels and two different engine choices. Available with either a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or a 2.3-litre V6, both with automatics, other features include a Renault Smart Card key, a 6-speaker or a 7-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with optional 8-inch subwoofer, acoustic cabin damping, automatic a/c with front and rear vents, manual-adjusted  seats or driver memory seat, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, optional rear parking sensors, standard 16-inch aluminium wheels, optional rear spoiler, electronic stability control, electronic throttle control, standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, emergency brake assist, six airbags including side and curtain bags, and active protection headrests. Other available features include leather upholstery, wood-like trim and sunroof.

The Tucson is a player in the rare breed of tiny 4WD vehicles that offer little off-road capability, but drive rather well on the road. It comes with either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or, surprisingly, a 2.7-litre V6, with a range of manual or automatic transmissions depending on model. It also comes in either a blasphemous front-wheel-drive version or a more realistic four-wheel-drive version with full-time 4WD. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power outside mirrors, central door locking, roof rack, cloth seats, front fog lamps, rear wiper with washer, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a range of storage spaces, while riding on 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include dual airbags, sunroof, probably faux leather upholstery, two-tone paint job, body-colour outside mirrors, AM/FM CD and cassette player with 4 speakers and tweeters, dual mufflers and a whole lot of cuteness for an affordable amount of cash.

The Peugeot 301 is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It got a facelift in 2018. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. While claiming class-leading cabin and boot space, the Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

Completely redesigned for the 2008 model year, the Cherokee is tougher than most compact 4WDs. Also known as the Liberty in some markets, it seats five people and can carry their gear too. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it is mated to a 4-speed automatic. Fold the rear seats and it can move two people and their cargo. The entry-level Sport has a body-coloured grille, while the upscale Limited has a chrome grille. Turn off the pavement, and it can negotiate most trails with confidence. All models come with stability control, ABS brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, front airbags, available side airbags, and all-speed traction control. Standard on all models is a full-time four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. Available features also include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, CD stereo, cruise control, parking sensors, rain-sensing wipers, 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, and a cloth or faux-leather interior, among other items. Options include a trick roof that can open the full length of the ceiling to the elements. By 2010, a minor update included the addition of the optional excellent voice-controlled UConnect multimedia-communications computer, with integrates navigation, Bluetooth, hard drive and USB-ready CD stereo in one touchscreen unit.

The Changan CS95 is a mid-size SUV available as both five and seven-seater variants, and is powered by a 2.0 turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. The only gearbox available is six-speed automatic and equipped with Changan’s NexTrac AWD system.

The BMW X1 is the smallest crossover SUV in the German brand. An all-new model came out in 2016. Based on the 1-Series platform, complete with four-wheel-independent suspension and disc brakes, the X1 is available in rear-wheel-drive form with the sDrive20i base model, sporting a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The other model in the range is the all-wheel-drive xDrive25i, also fitted with same engine but producing more power. The interior features an optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

The 5-door Peugeot 208 is the French manufacturer's smallest car on offer in the lineup.Under the hood, it gets a 1.2-litre turbocharged engine, mated to an 6-speed automatic transmission. The base Active plus model comes with traction control, ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth connectivity, cruise control with speed limiter, iCockpit layout, Mirrorscreen, rear parking sensors & rear view camera, leather steering wheel, 7-inch colour touchscreen, 16-inch alloy wheels, and electric parking brake as standard. The GT model comes with: 16-inch  alloy wheels, tinted rear windows, a 6 speaker sound system, a USB/deported Jack plug, Bluetooth and remote controls on the steering wheel all as standard.

The Toyota Prius was the world's first mass-produced hybrid vehicle when initially launched in 1997. The 2016 Prius retains the 2,700mm wheelbase of the previous Prius, but is 60mm longer overall at 4,540mm, 15mm wider at 1,760mm and 20mm lower. That's about the size of a Corolla. The Prius retains its 1.8-litre VVT-i Atkinson-cycle petrol engine. Features include a heads-up display, wireless charging, 7 airbags, blind-spot monitor and rear cross-traffic alert, ESP and regenerative braking.

All-new in 2007, the Q7 is the first proper SUV to bear the Audi name. It is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 was first available with a fuel-guzzling 4.2-litre V8 in this region, so as not to compete directly with the Touareg. A 3.6-litre V6 version came later. Both come with a six-speed automatic with Tiptronic manual mode. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Standard features include self-levelling bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. The Corolla can be equipped to be a luxurious compact, with the decent top-spec 1.8-litre four-cylinder, as well as optional leather interior and a DVD system, which are hard to find in any other compact besides the overpriced German cars. We even compared this version of the Corolla to an Audi, which no doubt made Audi angry. However, the base Corolla offers excellent value and comes standard with a 1.3-litre four-cylinder, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows and a cloth interior. Airbags are standard, but everything else is optional. Both engines can be had with either a five-speed manual or a smooth but outdated four-speed automatic. Everything is simple about this car. The air-conditioning controls and radio controls are straightforward, the cup holders work well, and storage holes are available all over. The sedan is surprisingly roomy and comfortable, while the wagon has a spacious luggage area.

The Mercedes-Benz ML-Class, officially referred to as the M-Class for whatever reason, has been completely revamped for the 2012 model year, taking on a puffier styling theme while retaining all the characteristics of the previous model. This ML 63 AMG, which is the performance version of the midsize SUV, comes with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8, all with a 7-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and AMG alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers alcantara and leather upholstery, carbon-fibre trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. The ML 63 also option of AMG performance package which adds even more power.

The Volvo V70 is a midsize station wagon available in a few GCC countries. It got a minor facelift and some interior upgrades in 2014. Currently only the V70 Comfort is sold here with the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment in the car include power mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with CD player, foldable three-split rear seats and alloy wheels. Volvo, never to compromise on safety, has driver, passenger, side and curtain airbags as standard, along with WHIPS whiplash protection. Luggage space is quite big thanks to its upright shape. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The Trooper was Isuzu's first well-known 4WD vehicle, and is a vehicle that was very competitive in terms of looks and features, but never caught on due to poor marketing and even poorer dealer support. It came in 3-door and 5-door body styles, both five-seaters, although both looked very similar to each other, except for the number of doors. While previous Trooper models were basic utilitarian offroaders, this version actually was well-endowed with basic luxury features of the time. This particular model line ended in 2002, at which point Isuzu discontinued its passenger-vehicle line and concentrated on work trucks. The Trooper came with an acceptable 3.5-litre V6, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. All trims had standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. Available features included cloth or leather interior, power windows, electric mirrors, monotone or two-tone paintjob, sunroof, cassette stereo with CD changer, cruise control and alloy wheels. Safety features included four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and front airbags.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Kia Rio is all-new for the 2012 model year. Attractively designed, it is available in 4-door sedan and 5-door hatchback form. The only engine for the GCC is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with variable-valve timing, mated to a 4-speed automatic. While mechanically basic, the Rio can be had with a host of features unseen in the sub-compact segment. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, adjustable steering wheel, central locking, power windows, electric mirrors and only one airbag. The mid-range model gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, centre-console armrest, fog lamps, keyless entry, USB port, Bluetooth, steering-wheel audio controls, sun-visor lights, folding mirrors with indicators and a split-folding rear seat. The top model gets rear parking sensors, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, padded leatherette door trim, LED front running lights and tail lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, more speakers for the stereo, cruise control, cooled glovebox, auto headlights, sunroof, and finally, ABS and a passenger-side airbag in addition to the driver's one. The Rio is offered in Europe and the States with full front-side-curtain airbags and stability control, and has a 5-star crash-test rating in Europe, but that model is not sold in the GCC.

The Fiat Fiorino is a compact commercial vehicle offering by the Italian brand. The Turkish-built Fiorino comes with a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual. Standard features include power steering, sliding side door, foldable passenger seat, adjustable driver's seat, heat reflecting windows, radio with CD/MP3 player, and ABS. It has 2.8 cubic-metre volume of cargo space with a 600 kg payload capacity.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This "compact" pickup has grown substantially for 2013, larger in every dimension, with more cabin and cargo room. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form now in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more. A D-Max GT model was launched in 2014, with the 3.0-litre engine, bumper-skirts, racing stripes, optional 17-inch grey alloys, red-black seats, bedliner and stereo choices.

The CX-9 crossover SUV has received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year that adds a new front end with a grinning corporate grille, new rear light clusters, and some small interior changes. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it comes with a six-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in two trims, both the base CX-9 and the CX-9 GT are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The CX-9 GT has 20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console.

Chery Arrizo 5 is the Chinese brand's compact car offering. Under the hood, it features a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features in the Arrizo 5 include power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, alloy wheels, LED daytime running lights and LED taillights and turn signals. Optional features include push button engine start-stop and an infotainment system with 7-inch touch screen and SD/USB/Bluetooth device support. Looking at the safety features, it includes ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor, hill hold control (HHC), speed-sensitive door-locking, emergency brake alarm and dual airbags in the front.

The American-built Honda Odyssey minivan received a facelift for the 2014 model year. The upmarket minivan is aimed at big families, and is longer, wider and lower than the previous version. It comes in LX, EXL and Touring trim levels. Mechanical specs include a 3.5-litre V6 with cylinder-shutoff technology, a 6-speed automatic, MacPherson strut front and double-wishbone rear suspension, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and an 80-litre fuel tank. Depending on trim, features include three rows of seating for up to eight people, adjustable 2nd-row seats that can space outwards to fit three baby seats, 3rd-row "magic" seats that can flip forwards or backwards, power-adjustable driver's seat with optional powered passenger seat, optional HID headlights, optional rear DVD screen that is ultra-wide to play a movie and a video game at the same time, ports for USB and even HDMI, optional navigation with Bluetooth phone, optional 15GB hard drive or 2GB flash drive to store CDs instead of needing a CD changer, front and side airbags with three-row side-curtain airbags, stability control, power windows front and rear, cruise control, sunroof, cooler box, remote-controllable power tailgate and rear sliding doors, variable power steering, ABS and 15 bottle and cup holders.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro was launched in 2016. In 2019, it got a facelift along with few software upgrades to the infotainment system for better usability. Under the hood, it gets two engine options - a 3.6-litre V6 and a 6.2-litre V8 engine. The Camaro also has a  4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, but it is not sold in the GCC. In 2019, the V6 and V8 models got a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 6-speed manual transmission is only available on the V8 model. Standard features on the 2021 Chevrolet Camaro include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof, leather seats and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Indica is an outdated hatchback launched in India back in 1998, spawning variants such as the Indigo sedan and the Indigo Marina station wagon. They went on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica and Indigo were considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger cars. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The original Continental by Bentley is a large, expensive, luxury coupÃƒÂ© made by Rolls-Royce for a 10-year run. It was the first Bentley in 25 years to not feature a body shared with a Rolls-Royce model. It was also the first Bentley to use a GM  4-speed automatic transmission to work Bentley's long-running twin-turbo 6.8-litre V8. Power output of the earliest models are unknown, as Rolls Royce was too snobby to reveal numbers. But back then, the Continental was still the quickest, most expensive, and most powerful Bentley ever. The convertible version was called the Bentley Azure, launched in 1995. The cabin featured usual Bentley traits such as acres of wood, leather and chrome. The standard model was known as the Continental R, but 1994 saw production of a severely-limited Continental S, and then the shortened Continental T was introduced in 1996 as a performance model. Mulliner editions, which started in 1999, added performance upgrades on both the R and the T. A handful of Continental SC models were built in 1999, with a huge lift-out glass sunroof.

The Kia Sportage was redesigned from the ground up in 2011, and continues largely unchanged for 2015 aside from a very minor facelift. Based on Hyundai underpinnings, it is powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, or a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre AWD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, navigation and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. The Sportage received high ratings in European crash tests, but keep in mind that they apply to a model with six airbags. Some markets have dropped the 2.0-litre model.

The new-for-2010 E-Class Cabriolet debuted in the summer of 2009, featuring much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door convertible format. But the engines are still carried over from the previous generation, with the 3.0-litre E 300, the 3.5-litre E 350 and the 5.5-litre E 500. The base E 200 CGI and E 250 CGI models appeared later, both with 1.8-litre engines, each with a different tune. An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard cabriolet models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Ferrari LaFerrari is a limited series special, where all 499 units will be built. It is also the first Ferrari to introduce hybrid technology into their cars. An electronic motor combines with a naturally aspirated 6.3-litre V12 engine to achieve the highest horsepower numbers, but with the lowest fuel economy among any Ferrari model at the time. Power is delivered via the 7-speed automanual dual-clutch gearbox. The interior is custom-made to the buyer's liking and will of-course include all the usual safety nannies.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is a contender to be the van of choice for families, assuming you are looking just for a whole lot of space and not much luxury features. Its tough looks are misleading, as it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning, some even with rear a/c. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps.

The Hyundai Kona is a sub-compact crossover with no offroad abilities whatsoever, although it sports black plastic cladding and half-baked roof rails to imitate it. In 2021, a facelift model debuted in the UAE & GCC. Powered by either a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic or a turbocharged 1.6-litre with a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic, both 4-cylinder and with either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, the Kona seems to rival the company's own Creta crossover. Available features include LED running lights and tail lights, alloy wheels, cruise control, and an LCD multimedia touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay and all that. Safety features include at least 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP and a tyre-pressure monitor. It has a 5-star EuroNCAP crash-test rating, but only when equipped with side airbags in full-option trim.

The Hyundai Kona is a sub-compact crossover with no offroad abilities whatsoever, although it sports black plastic cladding and half-baked roof rails to imitate it. Powered by either a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic or a turbocharged 1.6-litre with a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic, both 4-cylinder and with either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, the Kona seems to rival the company's own Creta crossover. Available features include LED running lights and tail lights, alloy wheels, cruise control, and an LCD multimedia touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB and all that. Safety features include at least 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP and a tyre-pressure monitor. It has a 5-star EuroNCAP crash-test rating, but only when equipped with side airbags in full-option trim.

The original B9 Tribeca, Subaru's attempt at a midsize 4WD, has received a facelift for 2008, getting a dull new look instead of the ugly old face. Built on the same all-wheel-drive platform as the Outback, the Tribeca is longer, wider and much inches taller than the Outback, and offers five or seven-passenger seating. The overall styling has been toned down after the previous design was deemed too controversial. The interior attempts to be more modern and upscale than competitive makes, with an amazingly unique design. The oddly-named B9 Tribeca has now dropped "B9" from its name, and is now powered by Subaru's 3.6-litre horizontally-opposed flat six-cylinder "boxer" engine, a rare type of engine design shared only with Porsche. Also standard is a five-speed automatic gearbox. The B9 Tribeca offers power windows, electric mirrors, standard roll sensing system, ABS brakes with Brake Assist, CD stereo, and standard two-position memory system for front driver's seat and more. Options include reverse-assist sensors, remote starter, and rear cargo cover with shade-type functionality. Safety features include dual front and side airbags.

The Dodge Challenger received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the all-new Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It can also be optioned with a forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection.Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger can be had with a 3.6-litre V6 or a 5.7-litre V8. Standard features in the V6 include sporty suspension, cloth upholstery, alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo, power accessories and not much else. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags.

The new-for-2010 Hyundai Tucson has been redesigned from the ground up, only slightly longer than the outgoing model, but 27 kg lighter than before. Now powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre 4WD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags.

An all-new generation of Honda Accord came for the 2018 model year. In 2021, it got a slight facelift and some interior updates. The naturally-aspirated engines has been replaced by two 4-cylinder turbocharged motors - a 1.5-litre, mated to CVT and a 2.0-litre connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features on the standard 2021 Honda Accord LX model include power windows, power mirrors, remote engine start, push button start, dual-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, 160-watt audio system with 4 speakers, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and 8-inch audio display, Bluetooth, USB, LED headlights, LED taillamps, dual exhausts and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 2021 Honda Accord Sport variant gets additional power seats with lumbar support, aluminium sports pedals, paddle shifts, 2-mode drive system (ECO/Sport), LED fog lamps, sunroof, dark chrome front grille, spoiler and 18-inch alloy wheels. The 2021 Honda Accord EX gets additional leather seats, 180-watt audio system with 8 speakers, The top 2021 Honda Accord 2.0T Sport gets additional 450-watt audio system with 10 speakers and subwoofer and head-up display. Available new features for 2021 include a wireless charger, rear USB ports and DAB radio for some markets. Standard safety features on the 2021 Honda Accord include front, side, curtain and knee airbags (total 8 airbags), ABS, EBD, brake assist, stability control, emergency stop signal, brake booster and tyre pressure monitoring system. The Honda Accord EX-L and 2.0T Sport additionally get Honda Lane Watch and updated Honda Sensing active safety features.

The Mitsubishi Lancer Fortis arrived to finally replace the 'regular' Lancer, a massive rental favourite in the GCC. However, this time the engine in the offered in the Lancer Fortis will actually move the car, a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features include fabric cloth seats, CD player with AM/FM radio and MP3 support, halogen lamps, power windows, power mirrors, disc brakes front and back, and steel wheels. Optional equipment include alloy wheels and fog lamps. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags.

The Caterham Seven is the lightweight sports car based on an ancient chassis simple enough to build it yourself if you wanted to. The Seven 270 comes in 1.6-litre Ford-engined ‘R’ pack form with 5-speed manual, as offered in the UAE. The ‘R’ pack is more track-focused and includes a limited-slip differential, sports suspension, a four-point race harness and many other race-orientated upgrades. The Seven 270 is available in the standard narrow-body S3 chassis, although a wide-body and a 6-speed gearbox can be ordered. The Seven 360 model adds a 2.0-litre Ford engine, and is offered in 'R' pack wide-body form in the UAE. The wide-body SV chassis benefits from a wider-track front suspension and a larger fuel tank, with only a 25 kg weight gain over the S3 chassis. Finally, the Seven 420 model adds a higher-tuned 2.0-litre Ford engine. There are no safety features to speak of, aside from a roll hoop and harness belts.

More a tall wagon than a true off-roader, the Outlander is based on the Lancer platform and uses a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine that mates to a four-speed automatic transmission only. The all-wheel-drive system splits the torque evenly between the front and rear under normal driving conditions, and distributes it wherever necessary when the going gets slippery. It does not have he equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 6-CD changer with 6 speakers, and leather seats. The Outlander is gutsy for a four-cylinder, but far from quick. It is easy to climb into, with a fair amount of room up up front and good all-round visibility as it is taller than a car but shorter than a proper 4WD. Mitsubishi decided to ditch this ambiguous genre with the next-generation 2008 Outlander, which took on the appearance of a proper 4WD.

The Navara is a stylish work truck, and essentially a pickup version of the Pathfinder. Like the Pathfinder, it offers good hauling capability and marginal on-road handling. It offers decent interior space and more convenience features than most competitors. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with a five-speed automatic and 2WD, or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine with a six-speed manual transmission and 4WD. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloywheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,4-speaker audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signallamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensingwipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment. It is apparently only available in double cab five-seater body style with a long rear load bay.

The Prado has become a popular choice among people who want a true off-roader but never go off-road. The Prado also shares a bade with the legendary Land Cruiser which makes it more attractive. The latest Land Cruiser Prado is a refined animal, taking advantage of technical and engineering advances that offer reasonably smooth performance on the road and reasonably capable off-roading ability. One look at it reveals rock-solid build quality so obviously missing from competitors from American manufacturers. The Prado is offered with a 2.7-litre four-cylinder, a 4.0-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesel. The petrol engines get Toyota's more modern manual and automatic gearboxes, while the weak diesel gets only a manual. The cabin is spacious and roomy with abundant headroom and legroom. Features of the interior include dual-zone air-conditioning and a CD/cassette audio system with either 4 or 6 speakers, depending on model. The Prado comes with dual front airbags and ABS as standard, with seating for either five or eight people. Side-airbags and stability control are not offered in this aging SUV.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. It's probably advisable to avoid highways as it comes with a tiny 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine under its hood, with the 4-speed automatic not doing any favours either. Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, enlarged spoiler, front sports bumper, chrome grill, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port.

In 2015, the Audi S7 Sportback got a facelift. It gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission, Horsepower also goes up in the new model. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected, as it gets front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, ESP and traction control.

A tribute to the discontinued Hummer H1 which was based on the military Humvee, the Hummer H2 is based on the Chevrolet Tahoe platform. Technically larger than the original H1, the H2 platform has actually been modified for proper off-road duty in keeping with the Hummer name. In 2005, the Hummer H2 wagon was joined by a second model called the SUT, or Sport Utility Truck. The SUT version, as its name implies, looks like a pickup, characterized by its unique tailgate, short pickup bed, and a standard tailgate-mounted full-size spare tyre. The new 6.2-litre V8 was introduced for 2008, mated to a new six-speed automatic and a mild facelift that includes a new interior. Features include air suspension, roof rack crossbars, an AM/FM 6-disc CD changer, leather seats, onboard air compressor, ESP, ABS brakes, numerous airbags, reverse camera and a first aid kit. Options include exterior chrome appearance package, 17-inch or 20-inch chrome wheels, chrome tubular assist steps, navigation and a third-row seat for the wagon. The Hummer H2 offers truly impressive off-road capabilities. However, its size makes us wish it was banned from on-road use.

The new Toyota Yaris hatchback was released as a 2015 model year. The Thai-built Yaris has two 4-cylinder engines to choose from. The base SE gets a 1.3-litre, whereas higher SE+ model gets a 1.5-litre in the UAE, while only one 1.5-litre Sport S trim is available in KSA. They all get a 4-speed automatic transmission. New exterior colours have also been introduced. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris 1.3 SE hatchback include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 4 speakers, keyless entry, 14-inch steel wheels and halogen lamps. The 1.5 SE gets 15-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, red stitching and steering-mounted audio buttons. The Saudi Sport S additionally gets parking sensors. The SE+ get automatic air-conditioning, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers, split-folding rear seat, projector headlights and better-quality seat fabric. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake-Force Distribution (EBD). Some dealers offer additional accessories such as Bluetooth and parking sensors. In 2015, TRD-branded accessories such as lowering springs, body kits and wheels became available.

The Chevrolet Equinox has been around since 2018, entering the highly competetive market of compact SUVs, dominated by the Japanese and Koreans. In 2021, the Equinox got a facelift and some interior upgrades. Under the hood, the 2021 Chevrolet Equinox gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. The base engine gets a 6-speed automatic, while the 2.0-litre gets a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2021 Chevrolet Equinox LS model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, manual AC, rear AC vents, Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 2020 Chevrolet Equinox LT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, and  optional leather seats. The top Premier model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled driver and front passenger seats, leather interior, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Chevrolet MyLink with 8-inch touchscreen display, optional navigation, Bose premium 9-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features on the 2021 Chevrolet Equinox include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Skoda Yeti got a facelift which came to the GCC in 2015. The Yeti is a sub-compact crossover SUV, and it comes standard with a 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine coupled to a 6-speed DSG automatic gearbox and an all-wheel-drive system that adapts for driving on rough terrain. Available in Comfort and Adventure trim levels, features are largely similar between the two. On the Comfort, these include 17-inch alloy wheels, fabric seating, black roof rails, auto a/c, cruise control, electric mirrors, folding table on rear-seat centre armrest and on the rear of front seats, cooled storage compartment, rear parking sensors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth and turning fog lamps. The Adventure gets different 17-inch wheels, silver roof rails, 6-CD changer with SD card reader, and a panoramic glass roof. Safety features include standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, hill-descent assist, and a whole host of electronics.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. Powered by either a 3.0-litre V6 or a 3.8-litre V6 engine, it can only be had with an automatic transmission nowadays. It can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box and leather seats.

The new Porsche Cayman, like the Boxter, has been completely redesigned for 2013. There are four models currently offered, the Cayman, Cayman S, Cayman GTS and Cayman GT4. The mid-engined coupe is now wider and has a longer wheelbase. Delivering more power and better fuel economy, the flat-six cylinder engines is mounted just in front of the rear axle, surrounded by its lightweight aluminium and steel body. The Cayman is powered by a new 2.7-liter engine and the 3.4-liter engine is in the Cayman S with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The Cayman GTS also gets a 3.4-litre flat-6 engine, but tuned for slightly more power and gets Porsche's adaptive chassis system as standard. The Cayman GT4 gets a 3.8-litre flat-6 engine and comes only with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard features include 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system.
