The Hyundai Centennial is a full-size high-end luxury sedan that serves as the flagship model for the Korean manufacturer. Also known as the Equus elsewhere, it is the most expensive sedan in the company's lineup ever. Introduced in 2010, this rear-wheel-drive cruiser underwent an unnoticeable external facelift for 2014, and is now offered with a choice of two engines, namely a 3.8-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, both direct-injection "GDI" units mated to an 8-speed automatic. The facelift also brought along with it a completely new interior. Standard features include 18-inch alloy wheels, dial-controlled multimedia screen, rear parking camera with guidelines, HID headlights, adaptive front lighting, fog lamps, electric parking brake, leather upholstery, ventilated power-adjustable front seats with reclining/massaging rear ones, power-adjustable headrests and steering column, CD/MP3 stereo with steering buttons, Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with push-button start, luggage net, auto-dimming mirror, power-folding side mirrors, leather upholstery, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, rear electric sunshade, and a 7-inch screen within the gauges. Optional features include 19-inch alloys, power-closing door latches, sunroof, rear armrest cool box, rear tray-tables, rear DVD entertainment screens, mud guards, easy-access sliding driver's seat with power lumbar adjustment, LED headlights, adaptive cruise control, heads-up display, around-view camera system, haptic steering-wheel controls, rear-side electric sunshades and a full 12.3-inch LCD gauge cluster. Standard safety features include stability control, nine airbags including knee airbags, tyre-pressure monitor, ABS with EBD and seatbelt pretensioners, with optional features such as lane departure warning, blind-spot monitor, and a pre-safety system which automatically applies full braking force and reels in the front seat belts when a collision is detected.

An all-new MG 6 came out as a 2019 model. The MG 6 comes as a liftback version. It gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay support and 6 speakers, trip computer. rear parking camera, push start button and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, cruise control, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The Grand Marquis is the longest running Mercury-badged vehicle ever. The mechanical underpinnings date back to the 70s, but a revision in 2003 involved a new frame, a revised independent front suspension, a new steering rack and rear suspension tuning. More updates in 2005 included a facelifted exterior, interior trim changes and more convenience features.The Grand Marquis is powered by a heavily detuned version of the Mustang's 4.6-litre V8 powerplant, mated to a four-speed automatic. If not obvious yet, the Grand Marquis is just a rebadged version of the Ford Crown Victoria. Features include three-person bench seats front and back, optional leather trim, a new instrument panel, burl woodgrain, a two-tone colour package and standard power windows. It is available in the Middle East in GS, GS Convenience, GS-L, LS Premium, LSE and LS Ultimate trims, at last count. A handling package, optional on GS and LS series, aims to improve the boat-like drive with 16-inch  aluminium wheels, a 3.27 axle, heavy duty rear stabiliser bar and rear air suspension with unique springs. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The Changan CS75 is a compact SUV offering from the Chinese brand. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the CS75 "Fashion" trim include power windows, central locking, remote on key, cruise control, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 8 speakers, multifunctional steering wheel, USB+AUX ports, leather seats, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and LED headlamps. Higher "Elite" trim gets additional 7-inch screen, keyless entry and start and auto climate control.Safety features includes dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist. The top option gets addition side curtain airbags.

Daihatsu aims to boost sales with its new Terios 4WD. With short front and rear overhangs, a long wheelbase and wide track, it looks like it can go off-road, but not with any real verve. It's apparently aimed at people looking for the traditional 4x4 qualities of high seating position, bad-weather traction and versatility combined with small car running costs and manoeuvrability. It is longer and wider than the previous model. The interior is about the same size as a mid-sized hatchback, with a split fold-and-tumble rear seat that frees up luggage space supposedly long enough to take a mountain bike. The front floor cross-member, tunnel, sills, B-pillars and roof-side rails are all strengthened to secure the cabin. With the rear seat in use the boot capacity is 380 litres. Its 1.5-litre engine is based on the Daihatsu 1.3-litre, with variable valve timing and its torque curve is virtually flat from 3200 to 4000 rpm. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic transmission. A centre differential transfers power with a fixed 50/50 torque split to the front and rear axles via separate propshafts. A fascia-mounted switch activates the electronically-controlled differential lock. ABS and airbags are available too.

It is trying to be Chevrolet's volume seller in the Middle East, but we have trouble spotting an Optra on the streets even though the car has been on the market for some time now. On paper at least, this car seems to have what it takes to go head-on with the opposition. Positioned in the lower compact segment, the Optra offers good value for money, selling in 4-door sedan, 5-door hatchback and 5-door station wagon trims. Styled by Italians but barely showing it, the styling can best be described as interesting without being ambitious. The cabin is basic, but there are lots of storage spaces and space for five adults. Engine options include a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder unit. These are combined with a five-speed manual or four-speed auto transmission transmitting juice to the front wheels. While both engines have enough grunt for the segment, they fall short of leaders like the top Civic and Corolla models. Ride and handling are quite good, and bodes well for the Optra. All we ask for are better engines.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 was launched in 2017. In 2020, it received a slight facelift and small increase in power. It came with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 engine. It comes with an 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry, heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system with touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 20-inch ones for the ZL1. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

JAC M5 is the Chinese brand's large minivan offering. It features a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, trip computer, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 7-inch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system, rearview camera, folding mirrors. leather seats and xenon headlamps. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes, brake assist (BA) and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. A 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine comes standard while a 3.0-litre V6 is optional. The 2.3-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the 3.0-litre only gets an automatic. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 15-inch steel wheels and AM/FM/6CD stereo. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. Available safety features include front-and-side airbags along with ABS. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The Jaguar XFR-S is the top performance model in the XF lineup. It gets a supercharged 5.0-litre V8 and is mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The most interesting feature of the car is its simplistic interior which consists of toys such as a rotary-dial gear selector and hideway a/c vents. It features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, in-dash 7-inch screen, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options. The audio unit comes with 30GB of storage and a standard 400-watt system, an optional 600-watt system, or a 1200-watt system which features 17-speakers with subwoofer from Bowers & Wilkins. The XFR-S gets unique bumpers, skirts, wheels and interior upholstery, as well as sports suspension and drivetrain components.

The Tiguan, small in size and conservative in design, was mildly facelifted for the 2012 model year to incorporate the latest VW design cues, mostly involving LEDs and a new grille. Three different trim levels include the Trend&Fun, the Sport&Style and the Track&Style, the latter of which is supposedly tuned for offroading, given its underbody plates and higher front bumper, though there is no low-range gearing for the 4Motion all-wheel-drive vehicle. There are two turbocharged engines, both 2.0-litre and in different states of tune. The engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. For additional cargo area, there is also an optional double-floor trunk-floor setup, including a cargo management system. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parallel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Coupe and M8 Competition Coupe was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The fourth-gen Audi A8 debuted as a 2018 model, lighter and filled with even more complicated technology than before. The initial powertrain offering for the GCC will be a 3.0-litre "TFSI" turbo V6, but a 4.0-litre TFSI turbo V8 follows later, and there will also be a 6.0-litre W12 for those who want one on special order. The new A8 has a suspension system that uses actuators to individually raise and lower each wheel to keep the car as flat as possibly over bumpy roads, and uses a camera that scans the road ahead to basically pre-set the suspension accordingly. Audi claims the new A8 is the first production car to offer Level 3 automated driving at speeds of up to 60 kph, but only on highways where a physical barrier separates you from cars travelling in the opposite direction. Other features include variations of adaptive cruise control, lane-departure assist and all that. Up front, Audi has more or less done away with buttons and switches via a 10.1-inch touchscreen display which, when off, blends almost invisibly into the high-gloss black surround. The user interface comes to life as soon as the car is opened. There’s also a secondary touchscreen display in the centre console to control air-con functions and make text inputs. Audi is also offering an optional ‘relaxation seat’ in the A8 L that adjusts four ways and has a footrest that incorporates both warming and massaging functions for aching soles. Other rear-seat features include matrix reading lights, in-seat massage function and a smartphone-mimicking remote control.

The Ford Fusion is midsize sedan offering from the American brand. It is powered by a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the front-wheel-drive sedan only comes with a 6-speed automatic. A 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder Ecoboost engine was available later on. Available in two trim levels, the Fusion S comes with independent front and rear suspension, torque-vectoring control, electric parking brake, trip computer, steering wheel with cruise and audio buttons, power windows with one-touch open/close, capless fuel filler, auto halogen headlights, LED tail lamps, speed-sensitive wipers, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB ports, SYNC with MyFord multimedia system with 4.3-inch screen, Bluetooth, 16-inch steel wheels and blind-spot mirrors. The Fusion SE adds power-adjustable driver's seats, rear armrest, 6-speaker stereo, outside temperature display and compass, rear a/c vents, mirror-mounted indicators, additional body-colour trim, keypad lock and 17-inch alloys. Options include 18-inch alloys, parking sensors, sunroof, fog lamps, rear spoiler, premium floor mats, auto a/c, rear camera, 8-inch touchscreen with additional 4.2-inch gauge-cluster LCD displays, front memory power seats, rain-sensing wipers, leather upholstery and navigation. The 2.0-litre Ecoboost version comes only in SE trim and gets additional paddle shifters. Standard safety features include front and side/curtain airbags, knee airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, hill-start assist, and alarm. Optional safety features include auto high beams, blind-spot monitors, cross-traffic alert and lane-keeping assist.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is a popular rear-wheel-drive roadster from Mazda. Completely overhauled for the 2016 model year, this purebred sports car is now powered by an all-new SkyActiv-G 2.0-litre four-cylinder motor, and mated to a 6-speed SkyActiv-Drive automatic transmission with paddle-shifters. There is a 6-speed manual variant available elsewhere, which is not offered in the GCC at the moment. Featuring the usual soft-top passed down from its predecessors, there is also a retractable hard-top variant known as the MX-5 RF (Retractable Fastback) available from 2017 model year. Besides a few kilos of weight, there are no significant differences between the soft and hard top variants, even in terms of performance. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 9 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, auto a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-key for keyless entry and ignition, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, navigation, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, LED headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind-spot monitoring, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats.

The Toyota C-HR is the Japanese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. In the GCC, they have opted to sell only the hybrid version, which comes with a 1.8-litre engine coupled with an electric motor and power delivered via an eCVT. Standard features in the Thai-built C-HR include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fabric seats, dual AC, 4.2-inch info display, power liftgate, 7-inch screen for audio, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, WIFI, 6-speakers, LED headlamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. The top model gets two-tone paint, heated seats, lumbar support, air ionizer, wireless charger, fabric+leather seats, adaptive and auto leveling LED headlamps and smart keyless entry. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, brake hold, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, hill-start assist, cruise control, rear view camera and rear parking sensors.

The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe was launched as a 2015 model year. It received a slight facelift in 2018. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 430i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 440i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Carnival, now known as Grand Carnival, is undoubtedly Kia's largest offering, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. It comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The Australian-built Caprice has been redesigned from the ground up, but still remains one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers a choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the V8 engine as an option. The V6 was dropped by 2011, leaving the V8 as standard. The big V8 is standard on the sport-tuned SS and the luxury-tuned Royale. The Caprice continues to use a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, a cloth or leather interior, and more. ABS brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

The Dodge Ram had been extensively re-engineered for 2006, with a minor restyling and an upgraded interior, having been originally redesigned in 2002. It has a new hydroformed frame that's boxed its full length to provide more strength than in any previous model. New suspension and body mounts also improve ride and handling, though it is still no luxury sports sedan. Inside the Ram, the instrument panel, centre console and seats have been redesigned for more car-like comfort, while new entertainment features have been introduced. The standard motor for the Middle East is the 5.7-litre Hemi V8 engine, which featured the new Multi-Displacement System from 2006, a setup that shuts down four of the Hemi's eight cylinders when they are not needed. Dodge claims the switchover is seamless, and that fuel economy is improved by as much as 20 percent. Adding to the Hemi's responsive nature is a five-speed automatic transmission. The Ram comes standard with air conditioning, AM/FM/CD stereo, rear-wheel ABS, 17-inch wheels and a full-size spare tyre. Also available are power windows and door locks, keyless entry, an overhead console with mini-trip computer and compass, cruise control and larger aluminium wheels.

The Spanish-built Seat Ibiza is based on the VW Polo and even shares engines and gearboxes, but with a completely unique exterior and interior. In the Middle East, this front-wheel-drive is offered in 3-door or five-door hatchback as well as "Ibiza ST" station-wagon body styles. As the VW-owned company is nearly inactive in promoting the brand in the GCC, drivetrain availability is vague, although numerous VW-derived powerplants can be optioned up, including a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all 4-cylinder engines, the former with a 5-speed manual and the latter with either a 5-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch DSG automanual. The sporty FR and Cupra models both get 1.4-litre "twin" supercharged-turbocharged 4-cylinder engines with 7-speed DSG automanual gearboxes. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, power front windows, electric mirrors, remote central locking, 15-inch to 17-inch wheels, CD stereo, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, traction control and even an optional stability control system. These cars are quite well-packed with features for their size. Sport and FR models get larger alloy wheels, stiffer suspension, body-colour rear spoiler, sports seats and unique exhausts as standard. The limited-availability 3-door Cupra gets the top turbo engine and further sports tuning.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. In 2020, the GLC got a slight facelift and more power. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Kia Rio is all-new for the 2012 model year. Attractively designed, it is available in 4-door sedan and 5-door hatchback form. The only engine for the GCC is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with variable-valve timing, mated to a 4-speed automatic. While mechanically basic, the Rio can be had with a host of features unseen in the sub-compact segment. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, adjustable steering wheel, central locking, power windows, electric mirrors and only one airbag. The mid-range model gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, centre-console armrest, fog lamps, keyless entry, USB port, Bluetooth, steering-wheel audio controls, sun-visor lights, folding mirrors with indicators and a split-folding rear seat. The top model gets rear parking sensors, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, padded leatherette door trim, LED front running lights and tail lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, more speakers for the stereo, cruise control, cooled glovebox, auto headlights, sunroof, and finally, ABS and a passenger-side airbag in addition to the driver's one. The Rio is offered in Europe and the States with full front-side-curtain airbags and stability control, and has a 5-star crash-test rating in Europe, but that model is not sold in the GCC.

The 2015 Mazda 3 was slightly longer in height and length than the previous generation. The exterior of the Mazda3 got the new Mazda "KODO" treatment, their new trademark design at the time.The 5-door hatchback came with two engines in the GCC - a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor with a 4-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Mechanical features include independent suspension, disc brakes, electric power steering and an all-new platform unrelated to the Ford Focus, unlike before. The basic S-grade 1.6L model came with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, power windows, manual a/c, Bluetooth, central locking, starter button, 16-inch steel wheels, cruise control, tilt/telescoping steering column and a single-piece folding rear seat. The V-grade 1.6L model added some chrome trim, running lamps, 16-inch alloys, fog lamps, split-folding rear seat, leather steering wheel and mirror-mounted indicators. An optional package added a 6-speaker stereo, sunroof, auto-dimming mirror, adaptive headlights, MZD Connect multimedia system with LCD screen and rotary controller, headlamp washers, rear camera with sensors, LED tail lamps, auto-levelling HID headlights, single-zone auto a/c and, as a further option, navigation. The R-grade 2.0L model got the larger engine as well as additional features such as a basic heads-up display, standard navigation, smart keyless entry, piano-black front grille, leather seats, auto headlights and wipers, adaptive cruise, 18-inch alloys, power-folding mirrors, rear spoiler and better safety features. Standard safety features included dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, while top-spec R-grade models get side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The Tiguan, small in size and conservative in design, was mildly facelifted for the 2012 model year to incorporate the latest VW design cues, mostly involving LEDs and a new grille. Three different trim levels include the Trend&Fun, the Sport&Style and the Track&Style, the latter of which is supposedly tuned for offroading, given its underbody plates and higher front bumper, though there is no low-range gearing for the 4Motion all-wheel-drive vehicle. There are two turbocharged engines, both 2.0-litre and in different states of tune. The engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. For additional cargo area, there is also an optional double-floor trunk-floor setup, including a cargo management system. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parallel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera.

Maxus G10 is a the Chinese brand's MPV offering. Under the hood, there are two engines. The cargo vans get a naturally aspirated 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox, while the people carrier gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the G10 people carrier include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric mirrrors, keyless entry, manual dual-zone A/C, radio with MP3/AUX support and 6 speakers, halogen headlights, front & rear foglights, sliding doors, lift tailgate and 16-inch wheels. The higher models gets LED headlamps, LED taillamps, dual-sliding doors, rear panorama sunroof, leather seats,  7-inch touch screen with DVD system, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control and traction control.

The 2018 Zotye T600 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. Looking a lot like a Volkswagen Tiguan due to the loose copyright laws in China, the 2018 Zotye T600 features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the T600 include, standard or optional, include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, touch screen, multi-functional steering wheel, leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C and alloy wheels. Safety features on the 2018 Zotye T600  include airbags, ABS, brake assist, stability control and traction control.

Porsche released the all-new Porsche Taycan in 2020. It is their first all-electric only model in the lineup. Initially released in only a higher 4S trim, a base model Taycan made its debut in 2021, which can be had with two different battery options - the regular 79.2 kWh battery or a more powerful 93.4 kWh battery (Performance Battery Plus) which improves highway acceleration and range. Power comes via two synchronous motors, one mounted on each axle, making the four-door saloon an all-wheel drive. It gets the world’s first two-speed transmission in an EV, installed on the rear axle. The Taycan is paired with variable torque distribution and Porsche Traction Management (PTM). Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The Trajet is Hyundai's latest attempt at conquering the world of minivans, but it is a completely typical minivan, with nothing over the competition except a lower price and an underpowered 2.7-litre V6. Standard features include power steering, front and rear a/c, roof rack, front and rear power windows, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, central door locks, funky tail lights and an automatic transmission. Options include a sunroof, fog lamps, All models come with 15-inch wheels, though the lower model gets steel rims with plastic covers, while the top model gets alloys. Unique features include four forward-opening doors, which is a rarity in the large minivan set. The basic model actually comes with 8-seater capacity, thanks to a bunch of bench seats, but the top model is more of a 7-seater, with more comfortable accommodations. The cabin is of course versatile, with movable and foldable seats to increase or decrease luggage space as needed. Safety features are conspicuously absent in the Middle East model, though overseas versions get all sorts of airbags, traction control and ABS, some of which you could probably special-order.

From 2014, the Infiniti JX35 became the QX60 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive, the Infiniti QX60 is aimed at the family crowd for whom the other Infiniti SUVs are too "unique" for their own good. With three-row seating, leather upholstery and a touchscreen multimedia computer, all models are generously equipped as luxury vehicles, unlike the cloth-wearing base models peddled as premium vehicles by German competitors. Depending on trim level, available features include smart keyless entry and start, tri-zone auto a/c with air purifier, 15-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth, powered front seats with memory and ventilation, split-folding second and third-row seats, wood trim, hard-drive navigation, around-view parking cameras, parking-guidance system, blind-spot monitor, multiple airbags, lane departure warning and prevention, adaptive cruise control with collision warning, cross-traffic alert and auto braking, rear DVD screens, pre-crash seatbelts, ABS and stability control.

The S80 is the flagship of Volvo range, and though it looks big in size, it is actually more of a large midsize sedan than a true fullsize sedan. In 2014, it got minor exterior and interior changes, as well as new added safety features. The only model available in most GCC markets now is a front-wheel-drive S80 T5 model with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Features include the wafer-thin centre console that houses the digital climate controls and the Dolby Pro-Logic II surround sound system. The car is filled to the brim with the usual luxury features such as power windows, mirrors and seats, leather trim, 16-inch and 17-inch alloy rims, adaptive cruise control, Bluetooth, sunroof and more. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection, as well as Pedestrian Detection, Collision Warning with Full Auto Brake, Driver Alert Control, Lane Departure Warning and Active Bending Lights.

The radical C4 offers a hip and modern hatchback with out-of-this-world styling and innovative new ideas, with items such as a multi-functional fixed-centred steering wheel and an built-in air freshener. Available as either a three-door or a five-door, it is already popular on the Internet for its dancing-robot TV ads. Besides eye-catching styling, it comes with a long list of standard equipment. Firstly, the base engine is a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with either a manual or an automatic. The top model is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic. The C4 comes standard with alloy wheels, cruise control and the power features features. Options include a panoramic sunroof and xenon dual-function directional headlamps. On the inside, where the C4 pays attention to detail with touches like the damped push-open drawers on the dashboard and an abundance of soft-touch trim. There are six airbags as standard, as well as ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Emergency Braking Assistance. Electronic Stability Programme with Traction Control is optional.

The Dodge Neon made a come back to the GCC market in 2017. Under the hood, the front-wheel drive sedan is powered by a 1.6-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Three trims are available - the SE, SXT and SXT Plus. Standard features on the SE include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, remote key, manual A/C, steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, cruise control, audio system with radio and MP3/USB/AUX support, Bluetooth, 4 speakers, fog lamps with cornering function and 15-inch steel wheels. The SXT gets additional chrome grille, parking sensors, TFT instrument panel display, automatic A/C, navigation, audio system with 7-inch touch screen and 6 speakers, and 16-inch steel wheels. The SXT Plus gets front seat lumbar adjustment, rear head restraints, electrochromic rearview mirror, rain sensing wipers and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features are top-notch which include ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitoring system, driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, curtain airbags and hill-assist function.

Citroen is such a low-volume player in the Middle East that most people here think the brand is not available here any more. The C2 is the replacement for the Saxo at the lower end of the Citroen range. Based on the same platform as the larger C3, the C2 is only available as a three-door model, while the C3 is the five-door version. The C2 has distinctive styling. It offers a lot of interior room in the front and a decent driving position, as well as rear seats which optionally fold, recline, slide and come out altogether. Its dashboard is shared with the C3 with trim of decent enough material. There are coloured plastic inserts on the door trim and gearknob to dress up the cabin. The driving position is good, with good visibility to the front and somewhat limited to the rear thanks to a small rear window. The C2 only with one engine in this region. The 1.6-litre four-cylinder isn't very powerful, but it is quite a revelation given the size of the car. It is mated to a 5-speed automatic SensoDrive transmission. It has four airbags as standard, but ABS brakes, with electronic brakeforce distribution and brake assist, are only an option.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. For 2013, a Roadster version was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

The new GL-Class, built in USA, was intended to be the replacement for the classic Gelaendewagen, but criticism from the general public killed that idea. The GL-Class is now a separate model, supposedly a state-of-the-art luxury 4WD that offers typical Mercedes-Benz luxury with true off-road capability. The GL uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. In addition to the newly developed 5.5-litre V8 in the GL 500, the second model is the GL 450 with a 4.6-litre V8. Both come exclusively with a 7-speed automatic. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GL-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

The Clio was completely redesigned in 2006, but this new version is only available in the GCC in sporting form. The Renault-Sport Clio now has bumped-up power, so it is called the Clio 200 now. The Clio Renault-Sport 200 models will be sold in limited numbers across the GCC, due to low demand rather than to maintain exclusivity. Derived from the basic New Clio available in Europe, both the Renault-Sport cars are powered by a highly-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual gearbox. Renault says the cars were apparently tested locally to ensure suitability for local driving conditions, and fitted with air-conditioning systems to suit the local heat. The car will be available in various funky colours and now has a better interior. Features include sports suspension, upgraded brakes, 17-inch alloy wheels and racing-bucket seats. There is no spare tyre due to the dual-exhaust setup. Safety features include stability and traction control with "off" switch, ABS brakes, up to eight airbags, and energy-absorbing head restraints.

The McLaren 540C is the second release from the Sports Series lineup after the 570S and is set to be the lowest-priced McLaren on offer. It features a revised aerodynamics package when compared to the 570S, and also features new alloy wheels. For the interior it gets leather-wrapped seats, dashboard and door panels. The infotainment system includes a 7-inch screen, Bluetooth and navigation. Under the hood, is the usual turbocharged 3.8-litre V8, while power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic gearbox. McLaren have also retuned the dampers of the 540C to make it more suitable for daily driving.

Proton claimed that the Waja was their first in-house car designed by Malaysians. However, its petrol engine is bought directly from Mitsubishi, and the suspension work was done by their independent Lotus division. The Waja is sold as the Impian in some markets, or referred to as the Waja Campro sometimes to advertise its latest engine. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this four-door sedan can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, sunroof, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Waja is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This "compact" pickup has grown substantially for 2013, larger in every dimension, with more cabin and cargo room. In 2016, it received a facelift and it continues in that shape for 2017. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more. A D-Max GT model was launched in 2014, with the 3.0-litre engine, bumper-skirts, racing stripes, optional 17-inch grey alloys, red-black seats, bedliner and stereo choices.

The M6 Cabriolet uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Fuel economy is apparently better by 30% compared to the old V10-powered model. Other mechanical features include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option. The M6 features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Roadster debuted in 2011, a year after the Coupe. It is supposed to be an everyday-use supercar, a product of in-house development by AMG. The coupe's trademark 'gullwing' doors are lost here in favour of conventional doors, easing entry and exit. Underneath the long bonnet is the usual AMG-built 6.2-litre V8 engine, and mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox in this application. A lightweight structure molded largely from carbon-fibre and aluminium double-wishbone suspension form the basics of the SLS. Among other things, the centre console incorporates the AMG DRIVE UNIT, which enables SLS owners to customise their vehicle set-up, while the AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission is operated by means of the E-SELECT lever. Beyond the usual power accessories and comfort features such as automatic a/c, "airscarf" headrests and cruise control, the simplistic interior can be customised in various colours, and can be fitted with options such as sports seats, metal trim, various leather choices, nicer paint and carbon-fibre appliquÃ©s. Further options include different 19-inch and 20-inch alloy wheels, carbon-ceramic brakes, pricey Bang & Olufsen stereo and a sports steering wheel.

A 2-door coupe joins the Cadillac CTS range in October 2010 as a 2011 model. Alongside the regular V6 base model is a supercharged 6.2-litre V8-powered CTS-V. The Cadillac CTS-V Coupe can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. All the cars are rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterised by a large chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The Fisker Karma is the first plug-in hybrid electric car to go on sale in the GCC. Aimed at the luxury end of the market, the Karma was created by a Danish designer, headquartered in the United States, and assembled in Finland. It is a 4-door, 4-seater sedan that runs purely on electric power, and requires a 6-hour overnight recharge via a 220V outlet for an 80-km city trip, with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder petrol engine acting as a backup generator to power the rear-wheel electric motors for 400-km more range. The car has a large battery pack mounted along the middle of the aluminium space-frame, making up part of the centre console. A solar-panelled roof provides power for the dual-zone auto a/c. Regenerative braking also helps in recharging the battery. The car can be driven in electric-only mode, or in sport mode with petrol-generated power. External speakers play a fake sound to warn pedestrians of its silent presence. Features include a multimedia touchscreen that integrates the stereo with USB support, a/c controls, navigation and on-board computer, as well as leather upholstery, eco-friendly wood trim, power accessories and smart key start. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS.

The new-for-2013 Subaru XV, known also as Crosstrek elsewhere, is a completely new nameplate on the Impreza platform, but with hatchback styling, raised suspension, and roof rails. While appearing tough, this compact crossover is powered by a small 2.0-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. The standard XV 2.0i comes with the usual power options, cloth upholstery, auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys, cruise control and halogen headlights. The 2.0i-S Premium adds smart keyless entry and start, rear camera, aluminium pedals, dual-zone auto a/c, HID headlights with washers, power-folding mirrors with LED indicators, and a sunroof. Front and side-curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control are standard on all models.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro was launched in 2016. The 2018 remains the same with few minor software upgrades to the infotainment system for better usability. Under the hood, it gets two engine options - a 3.6-litre V6 and a 6.2-litre V8 engine. The Camaro also has a  4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, but it is not sold in the GCC. They can all be had with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof, leather seats and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The facelifted-for-2010 Mazda 3 receives a brand new front end, a redone rear end, and a completely new interior. However, it still comes with a carryover 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, which was already an outclassed unit to begin with. American and European markets get 2.0-litre, 2.5-litre and turbocharged motors. The Japanese-built Mazda3 shares its platform, engine and some mechanicals with the European-built Ford Focus. The basic Mazda3 S sedan comes with 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, ABS, power windows, electric mirrors, two front airbags, a 4-speaker CD stereo, cloth seats, a new interior design and a manual a/c. A 4-speed automatic is standard. The mid-range Mazda3 V sedan adds 16-inch alloy wheels, a rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio controls, automatic a/c and a better stereo. The Mazda3 V hatchback features rain-sensing wipers, front fog lamps, side skirts, a roof spoiler, and options such as HID headlights, sunroof, LCD info display and push-button start with keyless entry. The fully-optioned Mazda3 R sedan and hatchback adds automatic wipers, electric-folding side mirrors, cruise control and different cloth upholstery, with all other options as standard. Apparently the "˜R' trim is only available in Saudi Arabia.

The Hyundai Palisade is the Korean brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, it gets a 3.8-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 8-seater midsize SUV include power steering, power windows, cruise control, infotainment system with touchscreen, Apple Carplay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, 5 USB charging ports, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, and alloy wheels. The higher trims get a bigger 10.25-inch touchscreen, better audio system, 6 USB ports, sunroof and leather seats. Standard safety features include traction control, stability control, ABS, BA and EBD. The top model gets seven airbags, lane departure warning, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, forward collision alert, cross traffic alert and blind spot monitor.

The Abarth 595 Competizione is based on the Fiat 500. The front end was redesigned with a much larger air scoop to improve heat management in the engine compartment and increase cooling capacity by 18%. The extractor is quite pronounced on the rear bumper. To enhance its looks, specific bumper inserts have also been created with the Tar Cold Grey finish on the 595 Competizione. It has polyelliptical headlights and LED daytime running lights as standard equipment. Xenon headlights, on the other hand, are available on request. The standard flat-bottomed steering wheel, as well as other striking interior details, on the Competizione version is made of technical materials, such as carbon and Alcantara. Abarth 595 Competizione is equipped with a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to an Abarth sequential gearbox and fits the new Record Monza Attivo exhaust. The 595 Competizione is equipped with supporting shell-shaped "Abarth Corsa by Sabelt" seats. Braking is secured by a Brembo system with 4-piston aluminium monobloc fixed callipers paired with self-ventilating, perforated 305 mm discs. Koni FSD (Frequency Selective Damping) shock absorbers are standard on both front and rear. The Sport button can be used to adjust various parameters of the car, such as torque delivery and power steering calibration, as well as managing the exhaust. Furthermore, the system adjusts engine response to the accelerator pedal and the TFT instrument panel switches to racing configuration. Safety standards are high with the Abarth 595 equipped with seven airbags as standard equipment. It also gets ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESC), anti-slip regulation (ASR) system, the Hill Holder devices and hydraulic brake assistance (HBA) to help with emergency stops.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received 2 major makeovers for 2008 and 2019, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The Q50 is also longer, wider and sits lower than the previous generation, which was the G37. For 2017, it got new engines and for the 2018 model year it got a slight facelift. The interior gets Infiniti's InTouch system, a touch screen which displays information and navigation. Owners will also be able to download, update and synch personal apps through their smartphones and USB drives.  The standard motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit which made its debut in 2015. In 2017, a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine was introduced, available in two different tunes. There is also a 3.5-litre V6 engine coupled with an electric motor, which will be available in select markets. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

An all-new Hyundai Sonata was released as a 2020 model. Mechanically, there is a new 2.5-litre 4-cylinder MPI engine , but there is barely any upgrade in power compared to the previous generation, and it is still mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. In Saudi Arabia, a 2.0-litre engine is also available. The base model, known as Sonata Smart in UAE, comes with 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and mirrors, fog lamps, keyless entry, rear camera, cruise control, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, ABS and one only airbag. The higher spec versions called Smart Plus and Comfort comes with 16-inch or 17-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, panoramic sunroof, leatherette steering, electric folding mirrors and a second passenger airbag. The top-spec Sonata Premium comes with auto a/c, subwoofer, front parking sensors, smart key with starter button, chrome door handles, blind-spot monitor, navigation, rear and side-rear sunblinds, electric parking brake, auto-dimming mirror, HID headlights with auto-levelling and washers, leather seats with front heating/ventilation, puddle lamps, solar glass, stability control and a total of 6 airbags.

The Savvy is the third car developed by Proton itself, after the Waja and the Gen2. This five-door hatchback is sized somewhere between a mini hatchback and a sub-compact, thus making this entry level Proton one of the larger offerings in this market segment. Hilariously touted as a cheap "Lotus" in early marketing materials, the Savvy benefits from numerous unique features, such as actual suspension tuning by Lotus, stepped side windows and a clamshell-style hood. Lifting the hood reveals a Renault 1.2-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to either a five-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. Standard features include cloth upholstery, 50:50 flat folding rear seats, keyless entry, power steering, rear window wiper, 14-inch steel wheels and a CD player with four speakers. Options include front power windows, 15-inch alloy wheels and metallic paint. The Savvy is available with ABS brakes and dual front airbags. The Savvy is not available in all GCC markets.

The Suburban, alongside the shorter Tahoe, has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Suburban and Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Suburban, with better fuel economy to boot, but a bigger 6.0-litre V8 is available. The 5.3-litre's aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. The 6.0-litre V8 gets a 6-speed automatic. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Suburban is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The eight-seater Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, so it offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The Brilliance FSV, known as the BS2 elsewhere, is a Chinese-built compact sedan that's benefitted from technology partnerships from companies such as BMW and Toyota, with a Mitsubishi-design powertrain. Even the simplistic platform with independent-front torsion beam-rear suspension is said to be Lotus-tuned, while Italdesign Giugiaro had a hand in the styling. Available with a single 1.5-litre 4-cylinder "MIVEC" engine mated to a 4-speed automatic, the front-wheel-drive 5-seater is fairly class-competitive. Features in the base "Comfortable" trim level include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, front disc and rear drum brakes, power windows, tilt-adjustable power steering, speed-sensitive central locking, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, fabric upholstery, split-folding rear seats and a single rear foglamp. The "Deluxe" model adds 15-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, front and rear ventilated disc brakes, rear parking sensors, digital a/c, power mirrors, sunroof and front foglamps. All trim levels get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, alarm and collision beams in the doors.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's 5-door hatchback offering, facelifted for 2017 with new headlights and other minor trim changes. The V40 T5 is fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder for the Middle East. It is connected to a 8-speed automatic. In 2019, the V40 T3 was offered which gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged unit mated to a 6-speed automatic. Variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels and a Polestar version with more power. All versions are front-wheel-drive. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. The wagon version is available with a 2.0-litre "SkyActiv" direct-injection engine. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. In the GCC, the wagon is not offered in top trim. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

The Infiniti Q30 is Nissan's first entry in the premium compact hatchback category. Sharing a front-wheel-drive platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it shares engines with its joint-venture German cousin as well, including the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor. Standard options in the Q30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, infotainment system with touch screen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Facelifted inside and out for 2008, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight, even with the power upgrade for 2008. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional 4-speed automatic. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are many other comfort and utility features. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

The rugged Xterra debuted in the GCC during late 2007 and got a facelift for the 2009 model year. The Xterra is a simple but capable alternative to the Pathfinder, incorporating as much off-road gear while originally forgoing most luxury features, but Nissan did add a few conveniences in 2009 due to customer demand. The five-seater Xterra is powered by the Pathfinder's 4.0-litre V6 engine, with four-wheel-drive, low-range gearing and either a six-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. All 2009 Xterra trims now have a redesigned front end featuring two new grilles, namely sandblast aluminium finish on X, S and Off-Road models, and satin chrome finish for Xterra SE models. New features include rear a/c ducts, new audio package including six-disc in-dash changer, redesigned centre cluster, push-button a/c, Bluetooth handsfree phone and iPod connectivity. Side steps and cloth upholstery are standard on the S model, while leather seats and illuminated steering-wheel switches are standard on the SE model. A new Off Road model includes body side molding, unique two-tone seat fabric, rear differential lock, heavy duty Bilstein shock absorbers, and BF Goodrich off-road tyres on new 16 inch alloy wheels. A GPS navigation system is also available. All models feature power windows and mirrors, power steering, CD audio system, remote keyless entry, alloy wheels, low tyre-pressure indicator, 60/40 split folding rear seat, available fold-down front passenger seat, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS brakes with brake-force distribution and brake assist, although side-curtain airbags may be available in some markets. Key exterior styling features include large flared fenders, big roof rails and a rear bumper design with side steps for easy access to the roof rack.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

The seventh generation BMW 5-series arrived in 2017. The 530i has a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 540i model gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Odyssey is a best-seller in America, but has yet to make an impact in this region, where 4WDs rule. The Odyssey has a car-like ride and handling quality since it is based on the Accord. It is powered by the same fuel-efficient 3.5-litre V6 engine as the MR-V, mated to an automatic. The interior features a clever seating system that can accommodate up to eight passengers. The Odyssey comes standard with side curtain airbags, electronic stability control and ABS brakes, as well as power door locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, 60/40 split fold-down rear seats, power sliding doors, tri-zone climate control, a stowable second-row PlusOne seat, in-dash CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, cruise control, power driver seat controls, alloy wheels and other features. Leather upholstery is available, as is a power moonroof and heated front seats. The Odyssey aims to be more of a luxury cruiser than a basic family or labour hauler.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Boxster have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Boxster gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Boxster S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Peugeot 2008 is a five-seater crossover loosely based on the 208 hatchback. In 2022, an all-new model came out in the GCC. The base Active model gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, with the higher Allure+ and GT models get a 1.2-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder engine connected to an 8-speed automatic. Standard features on the Active model include rear parking sensors & rear view camera, automatic dual zone A/C, cruise control with speed limiter, mirrorscreen, ventilated glovebox, leather steering wheel, 7-inch colour touchscreen, and 17-inch dual tone alloy wheels. The Allure+ model gets panoramic sunroof, 10-inch HD colour touchscreen, wireless phone charger, half leather and half fabric seats. The GT model gets additional 18-inch dual tone alloy wheels, active parking system, lane keep assist, blind sport monitor, driver attention alert, high beam assist and automatic emergency braking. Standard safety features include dual airbags, ABS, ESP and brake assist.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. An all-new model came out in 2016. Under the hood of the 2021 Chevrolet Spark, it gets a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT.  Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, push start button, chrome grille, parking sensors, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port. Safety features in the 2021 Chevrolet Spark include front airbags for both driver and passenger, tyre pressure monitoring system and stability control.

The LFA is the Lexus brand's "halo" model, serving more as a publicity stunt for their potential engineering prowess rather than an actual profitable product. Production of the LFA is limited to 500 units worldwide, with only a handful making it to the GCC, and purchase is by invitation only. The LFA, available only in coupe form for now, is powered by a 4.8-litre V10 with a 9000 rpm redline. It is mated to a 6-speed sequential automanual gearbox and a rear-wheel-drive platform with limited-slip differential. The LFA has a 48:52 front-to-rear weight distribution, and a 65% carbon-fibre body. It comes with 20-inch BBS alloy wheels, Brembo six-piston front and four-piston rear brakes, launch control, 3-mode stability control with sport mode and a speed-sensitive rear wing. The LFA interior incorporates carbon fibre, leather, alcantara, and metallic surfaces. Tech features include the Lexus Remote Touch controller interface, an LCD speedometer with customisable themes, alloy paddle-shifters, a 12-speaker Mark Levinson sound system with compact lightweight components, custom-made Tumi suitcases with a two-piece set made from carbon-fiber style materials and inscribed with the VIN and more. Safety features include several airbags for the two passengers, including seat-belt airbags. Customers invited to buy the car can personalise the Lexus LFA in undefined ways, in terms of colour schemes inside and out. There are apparently enough customisable options to ensure no two identical models will exist in the UAE. Only 20 cars per month, with cars built to order, and production is expected to end before 2013.

The 3008, a crossover in the truest sense of the word, first debuted in Europe back in 2009 before making its way to the GCC in 2010 as a 2011 model. It got a facelift in 2014. The 3008 is Peugeot's attempt to fill a vague niche, somewhere between a compact SUV and a midsize sedan. Only a 1.6-litre turbo 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic is offered here. Despite minivan looks, it seats just five, with a split tailgate, split-folding rear seat, rear-seat floor storage compartment, foldable front passenger seat and a two-level cargo hold. Features include tinted glass, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear wiper, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear ducts, panoramic roof with electric curtain, CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, automatic headlights and wipers, one-touch power windows, electric foldable mirrors with indicator lights, adjustable leather steering wheel, cruise control, cooled front storage compartment, cargo net, fog lamps, speed-sensitive power steering, parking sensors, keyless entry, rear-seat 12V plug-point, heads-up display and a detachable map-reading torch in the boot. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist.

The new Avalon is Toyota's rendition of the traditional big car. The Avalon was designed, engineered and built by the Toyota Technical Center in the United States. Its understated styling is more distinctive than any previous-generation Avalon, presenting a quiet look of grace. There was a very minor facelift in 2008, though no one noticed.
