The American-built two-door coupes are also a common sight. This new-for-1998 model was completely redesigned compared to the previous model, but retained the fancy double-wishbone suspension system that made Honda famous. There are two engines, the standard 2.3-litre 4-cylinder with a manual or automatic, and the hard-to-find optional 3.0-litre V6 with an automatic only. The popular sedans are great everyday cars with comfort and convenience features. Available features include cruise control, power locks, keyless entry, steel or alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with ABS, CD player, leather upholstery, a power glass sunroof, front airbags and more.

The Accord is of one the best midsize sedans available. It may not be best in class for every little thing, but its all-rounder package makes it popular among consumers. The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, offered with either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. Only the basic 2.4-litre sedan will get a five-speed manual, while all the other trims get a five-speed automatic only. Standard features on all models include power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, cruise control, CD/MP3 player with steering wheel controls, dual front airbags, ABS brakes, head restraint system and keyless entry. Optional features available in higher models include 17-inch alloys, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps.

The Hyundai i40 is a midsize station wagon. A basic, mid-range and top model are sold here. All the models get the same 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, steel wheels, AM/FM radio and CD player with MP3 playback capability and six speakers. Available features, standard on higher trim levels, include parking sensors and alloy wheels. The rear seat backrests feature a 60:40 split, so you can still carry the luggage plus a rear seat passenger or two. If more space is required, rear seat backrests fold flat into the floor while the floor rail system helps keep your luggage secured.

The BMW X2 is a brand new model introduced as a 2018 model year. It is based on the X1 and Mini Countryman chassis, but offers the "SUV" coupe design. An optional M sport package consisting of sporty suspension, cabin trim and body kit is also offered. The new engines available include the entry-level sDrive18i getting a new 1.5-litre 3-cylinder turbocharged engine. The sDrive20i and sDrive28i gets a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit.  The X2 M35i gets a turbocharged 6-cylinder 3.0-litre all-aluminum motor. An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered, although there is also a 6-speed manual available that will likely never be shipped here by local dealers.The interior features an optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

A new generation Kia Optima came out for the 2016 model year.  Under the hood, two engines are available. One is the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the other a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Optima include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, ventilated seats, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Kia is offering proper safety features only in the top model.

The Mini Paceman got a minor facelift in 2015, with the Cooper S variant getting a minor horsepower increase. It is just a 3-door chopped-top version of the Countryman. Under the bonnet are the same 1.6-litre engines that power the smaller Minis, with Cooper and Cooper S variants, all with a 6-speed automatic gearbox. All-wheel-drive is optional on the Cooper S variant. A John Cooper Works model is also available, with lowered sports suspension as well as 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheel options. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The midsize Toyota Camry sedan has been redesigned heavily for 2012, with a new engine, new interior, new suspension and an overall repackage to make it more appealing. A 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic is standard, and it makes a little less horsepower on the base model than in the rest of the range, as it is the only one to receive a single exhaust tip, while the other trims receive dual exhaust tips. The base model can be had with a manual gearbox in Saudi Arabia, but not in the UAE. Now available in four new trim levels, the base model also looks visibly different than the rest of the range, with its basic bumpers, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps and more hard plastics in the interior. Known as S or GL, depending on market, it comes with a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags. The mid-range model, known as SE or GLX, also gets fake wood trim, dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, 16-inch alloys, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, and a "sport" front bumper, "sport" grille, rear boot spoiler and dual exhaust tips. Also available are stability control, sunroof, DVD, keyless start and navigation, although the mid-range specs vary between GCC countries. The top-spec "Sport" model, known as GLX S in some markets, gets a unique rear bumper, paddle-shifters, stability control, leather seats, 17-inch alloys and fake metal cabin trim, with some markets like Oman getting intelligent keyless entry with starter button and DVD player. In terms of safety, all models get dual front airbags and ABS, but only some of the top trim levels get side airbags and stability control, though again specs vary, as the most-expensive Sport model in the UAE does not get those latter features. In late 2012, a "Royale" model was offered in the UAE, essentially a base model with a few extra features tacked on, identified by dealer-installed LEDs on the front bumper.

PGO proclaims itself to be a 'French automobile craftsman' to highlight their hand-crafted aspect and small-scale production. The range expands from the Speedster II with the addition of the CÃ©vennes. Both share the same technical foundation and differ only in style, with the CÃ©vennes looking more modern with restyled bumpers and trim. Indeed, the overall styling is still based on the 1950s Porsche 356. However, it is powered by a recent 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Peugeot engine, with no additional tuning. The rear-mounted motor is mated to a rear-wheel-drive platform and a choice of 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. While the car is very basic and very expensive, customisation options offer 15 paintjobs, 8 soft-top colours, 14 types of leather and 10 types of carpet. Standard features include a basic a/c, power windows, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with 2 speakers, keyless entry, electric mirrors, black manual soft top and a set of eight instrumentation gauges. Options include chrome wheels, two-tone leather, CD changer, alarm and more.

An all-new Jeep Compass came out in 2018. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission for the 4x2 models and a 9-speed automatic transmission for the 4x4 variants , but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

The Outlander crossover was redesigned for 2008, based on the Lancer platform, but only two years later, it got a new Evo-inspired nose for 2010. Engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, and a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a 6-speedautomatic. The all-wheel-drive system distributes power as needed under various conditions and also with a 4WD Lock mode, but it does not have the equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with a six-CD changer and 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and Brake Assist, power steering, power windows, cloth upholstery, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 18-inch alloys, Rockford Fosgate stereo with 6-CD changer and 9 speakers, full keyless system, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, paddle shifters and faux leather seats. Only the five-seater version is sold in the GCC.

The Lexus ES is pretty much the luxury carmaker's bread-and-butter sedan, with its comfort-biased approach and focus on convenience features. In 2016, the ES got a facelift. It features corporate styling similar to the pricier GS. It comes in two trim levels, the ES 250 with the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, and the ES 350 with the 3.5-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The ES 250 comes in one "Premier" trim and features HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, front-rear parking sensors, 17-inch alloys, moonroof, headlamp cleaner, leather interior, powered front seats, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, power-adjustable steering, and dual-zone auto a/c. The ES 350 "Prestige" adds the V6 engine, nicer leather, navigation, power rear sunshade and a blind-spot monitor. The "Platinum" adds a front DVD player, rear camera and a remote-touch computer. The "Titanium" further adds adaptive headlights, different wheels, panoramic glass roof, even semi-aniline leather, front ventilated seats, 3-zone a/c, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist and a pre-crash safety system. All models come with front, knee, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. An all new generation Koleos came out in 2017, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. In 2020, it got a minor facelift. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment in the 2020 Renault Koleos, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Navigation is a new option for 2014. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

Porsche released an all-new generation 911 GT3 variant in 2021. The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4.0-litre racing engine, from the previous gen 911 GT3 R. Customers can choose between the 6-speed manual gearbox and 7-speed PDK automatic. It also has rear-axle steering and Porsche Torque Vectoring Plus with fully variable rear axle differential lock. The GT3 comes with a full interior, including a touchscreen multimedia system, auto a/c, a full set of airbags and other safety features.

An all-new Audi A4 came out in 2016. It is a more spacious car, while at the same time is lighter than its predecessor. Under the hood, there are 2 available engines. There is the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and is available only as front-wheel-drive. Then there is the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and comes with all-wheel drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

Continuing to be based on a joint platform with Mazda, the Focus remains one of the best handling cars in its class, getting a  makeover for the 2008 model year. It comes in two different body styles, namely a sedan and a five-door hatchback. The Focus is a popular car in Europe where it is built, and is fairly well-built at that. Both the versions cost the same, but all are available in various trim levels. The standard motor is an anaemic 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the top engine is a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. Features include electro-hydraulic power steering, and choice of a 5-speed manual transmission and a 4-speed automatic. Standard conveniences include power windows, basic stereo, cloth seating and not much else. Options include LED tail-lights, CD changer, USB audio connector, keyless starter button, Xenon adaptive headlights, tyre pressure monitor, sunroof, fog lights and a 230-volt inverter. Safety features include optional side thorax airbags and inflatable side curtains alongside the standard dual front airbags.

The all-new Volvo C30 is Volvo's new entry-level attempt at capturing younger buyers. This sporting new hatchback has provocative body sculpting, room for four average-sized adults and a range of competitive engines. It looks very original, except for the front-end face, which is lifted directly off its larger siblings and looks dated already. It offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers, and features very basic interior styling, save for a few unique touches such as the floating centre console. Available in this region are three engines, the base being a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with a manual gearbox offered only in 2008. The higher ones are both five-cylinder, one being a 2.4-litre and the other a turbocharged 2.5-litre, both with automatic gearboxes and tiptronic functionality. All three versions are front-wheel-drive. Standard features include cloth upholstery, power windows, trip computer and CD audio. Standard safety features typical of Volvo include ABS brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, and a whiplash protection system. Options include alloy rims between 15-inch and 18-inch sizes, three levels of audio equipment, customisable centre console trim, stability control and a blind-spot warning system for inattentive drivers.

Toyota introduced an all-new model in 2019 of the Avalon. The design has been completely changed, however, mechanically it gets the same 3.5-litre V6 engine, but with more power. It is built on the Toyota New Global Architecture platform (TNGA) which underpins the current Camry and Prius. This promises a quieter ride. Every dimension of the Avalon has grown compared to the old model. The rear cabin is almost 20 cm longer which has translated to more space for the rear passengers. The looks of the Toyota Avalon builds on the smaller Camry but with many sharper lines. The LED headlights and taillights are not enough to balance out that desperately massive grille, intended to make the car stand out more. The XSE and Touring trims will have even better looks with piano black finishes, a boot spoiler, diffuser panels and quad exhausts. The interior of the Avalon is obviously a lot more opulent. Though it takes some stuff from the Camry, it looks far more luxurious than it. In the dash, there is a 9-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system which comes with Apple CarPlay making it the first Toyota vehicle to feature it. But it still doesn’t get Android Auto. Other amenities include five USB charging ports, wireless charging, a 7-inch trip computer and a 10-inch heads-up-display. There are a bunch of standard safety systems like 10 airbags, pre-collision braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keep assist, adaptive cruise control, automatic high beams and blind spot monitoring. Over these, you can add a panoramic parking camera system and a rear cross-traffic braking system.

An all-new Ford Expedition model came out as in 2018. Engine specs for the 2021 Ford Expedition include a second generation 3.5-litre twin-turbocharged "Ecoboost" engine, available in two different tunes, and connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. The Expedition’s terrain-management system allows the driver to select from seven modes in 4WD models, so whatever terrain you’re tackling (be it sand, mud/ruts, gravel, grass or snow), there’s a mode that optimises the drivetrain for it. Needless to say that when driving in the Sport mode, you get an improved throttle response and gearbox mapping. The big Ford offers the best towing capability of any full-size SUV, and it comes with features such as Pro Trailer Backup Assist, which negates the need for repeated back- and forth when reversing with a trailer. There’s also an available hands-free, foot-activated liftgate to make loading bulky cargo into the load bay less of a back-breaking exercise. Aside from offering best-in-class second-row and third-row legroom as well as hip-room, the Expedition is also the first in this segment to feature a sliding second-row seat with tip-and-slide functionality, providing easy access to the third row without the need to first remove a child safety seat. The Expedition’s second-row and third-row seats not only provide best-in-class roominess but can be quickly folded flat with the push of a button to provide access to a cargo area wide and flat enough to handle 4×8-foot sheets of plywood and other gear. There’s no shortage of luxury kit in the Expedition, and among the goodies on offer is plush leather trim, multicontour driver seat with massage feature, a power reclining 3rd row seat, capacitive touchscreen with SYNC 3 (which also offers Arabic voice capability) and Apple CarPlay / Android Auto compatibility, adaptive cruise control with Stop-and-Go (keeps a set distance to the vehicle in front, and will automatically bring the car to a complete stop, and accelerate away again when required), dual-headrest rear entertainment system and a premium 12-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system with enough bass to make the windows reverberate. Add to that, a class-leading Panoramic VistaRoof that covers not only the 1st row but also the 2nd. Your devices are also well catered to, as there’s wireless charging, four 12-volt power points, up to six USB ports positioned across all three rows and a 230-volt outlet. The Platinum gets collision-avoidance detection (for both pedestrians and vehicles), lane-keeping system, blind-spot warning with cross-traffic alert and enhanced active park assist (for both parallel and perpendicular parking needs). There’s also a 360-degree camera to give you a bird’s eye view of the car’s immediate surrounds.

Ford has been overly careful not to mess with a winner, so when Ford redesigned the Explorer in 2006, America's favorite midsize sport utility for the last 15 years in a row, they barely changed anything. The latest Explorer is available with a big 4.0-litre V6, with a five-speed automatic. The wagon can seat seven, while the Sport Trac pickup can seat five. The wagon is a traditional midsize 4WD with a body-on-frame construction, and features new steering, new suspension and new brakes. Standard equipment include Roll Stability Control, independent rear suspension, keyless entry, cruise control, compass and thermometer, power windows, locks and mirrors, air conditioning, a floor console, rear vent windows and added 12-volt power point, AM/FM stereo with single CD or MP3 player, driver manual lumbar adjuster, a tyre-pressure monitoring system and alloy wheels. Options include running boards, roof rails, bigger wheels, more wood and leather, 10-way power seat and a six-disc changer. The Sport Trac has a composite cargo box with two-tier storage ability, available hard tonneau cover and three integrated tool bins.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019. The 8-Series comes two engines - a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 engine and a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, both motors coming with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 8-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Suzuki Vitara is a completely new model, making its debut in the GCC in 2016. Smaller, lighter and losing its offroad capabilities, the new Vitara is designed to compete in the road-going crossover segment and is a separate vehicle line from the existing Grand Vitara. It is only available as a 5-door wagon, and gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available in both two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive. In the UAE, two trims are available, the GLX and GLX+, all of which come with automatic transmission as standard. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, central locking, keyless push start system, sunroof, LED daytime running lamps, leather seats, cruise control,  automatic A/C, roof rails, front & rear parking sensors, front skid plate, chrome front grille and alloy wheels. The higher GLX+ model gets panoramic roof and polished aluminium wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ABS and brake assist.

The third-generation Kia Cerato sedan boasts sleeker styling that is 30 mm longer, 15 mm lower and 5 mm wider than the outgoing car, with a 50 mm extended wheelbase. It also features an all-new bodyshell, upgraded equipment, a host of additional convenience and safety features, a more spacious cabin with better quality, improved suspension and an upgraded powertrain line-up that delivers class-leading performance and fuel economy. Two 4-cylinder engines will be offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Interior comfort is enhanced by lowering the cabin floor and the seats, and by fitting wider front seat cushions with an increased cushion angle for greater thigh support. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors.

The Nissan Micra made its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. A facelifted version became available for 2019. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are fewer trim levels from 2014 onwards, with higher trims having features such as power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

Based on the E-Class platform, the Mercedes-Benz CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Facelifted for 2015, the CLS 63 AMG comes with a new 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 and a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base. Standard features include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps, sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more. The CLS 63 AMG can be had with a limited-slip rear diff, adjustable suspension, carbon-fibre trim inside and out, ceramic brakes and other optional items at extra cost, including an AMG performance package that adds additional horsepower.

The Edge debuted for the 2007 model year, and has been heavily revised for 2011, with a new face, higher-quality interior, better entertainment features and two engines to choose from. The updated Edge features a big new version of the corporate chrome grille, along with new headlights, tail lamps and wheel designs externally. A new Edge Sport model can be had with a blacked-out grille, smoked headlights and huge 22-inch alloys. The newly-designed interior still features seating for five with a fold-down rear seat to maximise cargo room, as well as a soft-touch dashboard, optional mood lighting and better materials. The Edge SE, Edge SEL and Edge Limited models are powered by an upgraded 3.5-litre V6, while the Edge Sport gets a 3.7-litre V6. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, and available with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Standard features include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC voice-controlled multimedia computer and Sony stereo, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. The Edge Limited is the only one to be offered with options such as HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and 20-inch alloys, but the Edge Sport is the only one to get the black grille, paddle shifters, larger engine, stiffer suspension and 22-inch wheels. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

Completely revamped for the 2012 model year, the Ford Focus now becomes the best compact car available in the GCC, if a tad higher-priced than some competitors. That's because it offers optional tech features that no other player has. Available in sedan, station-wagon and hatchback forms, the latter 5-door is being pitched as a high-end model. There is a base 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automanual, available in the "Ambiente" and "Trend" trim levels. In fact, the sedan and the wagon will only be available in the basic "Ambiente" trim level alongside the hatchback. The hatchback can be had in all trim levels, including "Trend", "Sport" and "Titanium" editions. Only the "Sport" and the "Titanium" get the 2.0-litre direct-injected 4-cylinder "GDI" engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automanual. While all models in the UAE get the manually-shiftable automatic, some other GCC markets may get a 5-speed manual option as well. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a manual a/c. Other features, available on higher models, include 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, leather upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, "sports" front seats, cruise control with speed limiter, sunroof, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights, LED tail lamps, footwell courtesy lights, and an optional park-assist system with parking sensors and the ability to control the steering automatically during parallel-parking. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

In 2020, an all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz GLS-Class came out. There are two engine choices, the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 in the GLS 450 and the 4.7-litre turbo V8 motor in the GLS 580. The V8 engine is a mild hybrid to aid acceleration and improve fuel economy. It comes with a ton of standard features, including the MBUX infotainment system, a 12.3-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch configurable digital instrument cluster, wireless device charging, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, navigation, nine USB ports, Bluetooth, 360-camera parking system, and a 13-speaker Burmester surround-sound stereo. Keyless entry, remote start, dual-zone automatic climate control, a sunroof, alloy wheels, and a power liftgate are also standard. Optional equipment include E-Active Body Control which aids off-roading, five-zone climate control, panoramic sunroof, and a suite of advanced safety features, such as lane keep assist, lane change assist, a following distance indicator, and stop-and-go adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability and traction control, ABS, EBD, blind spot monitor, forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking.

The Passat has been a trendsetter for VW over the years, earning a distinction as the most copied design in automotive history. Many cars now look like a Passat, so the new one is now a larger car that attempts to reinvent itself. The all-new VW Passat boasts a few powerful new engines, a few weak engines, generous standard content and a high-quality interior mixed with high-tech hijinks. Volkswagen has rolled out a full line of four-door sedans, ranging from the poor 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre affordable models with nice leatherette upholstery to the more-powerful 2.0-litre turbocharged 2.0T model that just manages to be likeable, and a purely leather-clad V6-powered 3.2-litre V6 model that is destined to be extremely rare thanks to a bloated price tag. All cars are front-wheel-drive, with the exception of the all-wheel drive V6 model. All Passats come standard with the latest in safety features and electronics, including power features, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, ESP, tyre-pressure monitoring system and MP3-capable CD player.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year, and facelifted for 2009. Along with the mildly-changed face, the new variants include the base Quattroporte Automatica, the mid-range Quattroporte S Automatica and the top Quattroporte Sport GT-S. The base engine is the 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 6-speed automatic, while the mid-range S model has a 4.7-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto. The Sport GT-S has an upgraded 4.7-litre V8 and is now the only version with a 6-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. All Quattroporte models have the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The new model has expanded the already-staggering array of interior trim choices to 10 leather colours with 11 piping hues and myriad woods or lacquers from which to choose. Other interior upgrades include new cluster graphics, reshaped seats and a new multifunction wood and leather steering wheel with sporty thumb rests. Standard features include directionally-adaptive bi-xenon headlights heated leather power seats with memory, automatic dual-zone climate control, rear parking sensors and a Bose sound system with hard drive and navigation system. The Quattroporte S adds Brembo brakes and 19-inch wheels. Heating, ventilation and massage functions are optional for front and rear seats. An electronically-controlled Skyhook suspension, standard on the S and optional on the base trim, automatically adjusts to the conditions of the road. The Sport GT-S adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals, as well as a noisier exhaust, uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts.

The Mitsubishi Lancer EX, first introduced in 2008, got some minor trim changes for 2010. It comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.5-litre and a 2.0-litre. The smaller engine gets a four-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Features in the most basic model includes a driver's airbag, CD player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers. There are various trim levels right up to the top GT model which adds a sporting body kit, sunroof, adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio switches, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, rear split seats with centre armrest, dual front airbags, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, paddle-shifters with the CVT, and a full keyless operation system.

An all-new Jeep Compass came out in 2018. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission for the 4x2 models and a 9-speed automatic transmission for the 4x4 variants , but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

An all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz A 45 AMG came out in 2020. It gets an upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, available in two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. All models are all-wheel-drive. The 5-seater hatchback's features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans in this region, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. Fully redesigned for the 2008 model year, the Corolla sedan was facelifted for the 2011 model year, featuring new front and rear ends. The base Corolla offers long-term value for money and comes standard with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine with a new 6-speed manual or an old 4-speed automatic, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows, dual front airbags, 15-inch steel wheels and a cloth interior. Everything else is optional depending on trim, including power windows and mirrors, ABS brakes, keyless entry, fake wood trim, parking sensors and a CD/MP3 player. The better engine is a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder again with either a new 6-speed manual or an outdated 4-speed automatic, with similar options. The top-spec 1.8 model can be outfitted with an automatic a/c, cruise control, 16-inch alloys, rear spoiler, side curtain airbags, leather, sunroof, Bluetooth, split-folding rear seat and even a CD changer. Some cars are imported from Japan, but others come from Taiwan.

The Lexus NX 200t, the Japanese brand's first entry in the compact crossover field, received a facelift for 2018. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. All models come with 18-inch alloys, LED headlights, synthetic or real leather, power front seats, premium multimedia system with navigation, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, power tilt/telescoping steering wheel with buttons, Bluetooth, USB and more. The higher-spec models gain adaptive cruise, Mark Levinson stereo, wood trim, illuminated scuff plates, ventilated seats, remote starter, power-folding rear seats, wireless phone charger, power tailgate, panoramic parking cameras, heads-up display, adaptive suspension and more. The F-Sport models additionally get a mesh grille for the different front bumper, firmer suspension tuning and different wheel designs, optionally with wider tyres. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags as well as stability control and ABS with brake assist, with options including a pre-crash safety system, lane-change assist with blind-spot monitoring and cross-traffic alert, and lane-keeping assist with lane-departure alert and steering assist.

The Maserati Ghibli was revived by Fiat as a 2014 model and is intended to compete in the luxury midsize segment which is dominated by the Germans. The rear-wheel drive Ghibli gets two 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engines in different states of tune. Both versions get an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2015, the Ghibli S was also available with all-wheel-drive. In 2019, a Gran Lusso trim was introduced with a body kit, sports seats and steering wheel, and full-LED adaptive Matrix headlights. Standard options include power windows, electric mirrors, power steering, cruise control, leather seats, infotainment screen with navigation, parking sensors, reverse camera and 19-inch alloy rims. The higher models get a better audio entertainment system, 20-inch alloys and all sorts of cabin trim choices. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Lamborghini HuracÃ¡n, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the HuracÃ¡n LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

An all-new Cadillac CT4-V made its debut in 2020, replacing the ATS-V. In the GCC, the CT4-V model gets a 2.7-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the CT4 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, updated CUE entertainment system with BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

From 2014, the Infinti FX model became the QX70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure, but has since remained unchanged. The QX70 is available in four trim levels and two different engines. The Excellence, Luxury and Elite Sport get a 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the Luxury Sport variant gets the 5.0-litre V8, with both engines mated to 7-speed automatic transmissions. Built on the all-wheel-drive front-midship platform, the the QX70 features an extensive list of available equipment. Available features include Continuous Damping Control, Rear Active Steer, and 21-inch lightweight aluminium-alloy wheels designed by Enkei. Inside, the interior has available "sport" seating and advanced audio, optional navigation and technology ranging from an 11-speaker Bose-developed audio system to the intelligent key, available active cruise control and available around-view monitor system. The QX70 offers numerous safety and convenience technologies such as intelligent brake assist, distance control assist, adaptive front lighting system, standard HID headlights, integrated fog lights, rear LED taillights, functional side air vents, aluminium roof rails, leather and wood trim, sunroof, "self-healing" clearcoat paint finish, stability control, and the usual power accessories and multiple airbags. Available safety features include object-detection for the around-view parking camera system as well as voice instructions on how to parallel-park into a specific space.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The Q60 Coupe underwent a full redesign in 2017. The base motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, while a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine is available is the more powerful option. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

The Infiniti Q30 is Nissan's first entry in the premium compact hatchback category. Sharing a front-wheel-drive platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it shares engines with its joint-venture German cousin as well, including the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor. Standard options in the Q30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, infotainment system with touch screen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. Based on a Nissan platform, the Koleos was facelifted with a new front-end for 2012, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The Chinese Tiggo 5 made its way to the GCC in 2015 and got a minor facelift for 2017, largely in the front bumper and headlights with LED running lights. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, and comes with a 4-speed automatic transmission. The five-door five-seater Tiggo gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so expect decent handling.

The popular 7th-generation Lancer, receiving a major facelift in 2004, uses three four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.3-litre and 1.6-litre in the basic models, while a 2.0-litre Ralliart Edition was briefly available before being dropped in 2008. The aging non-Ralliart variants are so popular that they continued to be sold alongside the all-new 2008 Lancer EX. The 1.3-litre has a choice of a five-speed manual and a four-speed automatic. The 1.6-litre has a choice of a manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre came exclusively with an automatic gearbox. None of the engines are particularly sporting. Features, either standard or optional, include driver's & front passenger's SRS dual airbags, simple radio cassette player or a better radio cassette stereo with CD changer and 4 speakers, tachometer, optional rear spoiler, steel wheels with hubcaps or light alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, optional keyless entry system, and a rear seat centre armrest with cup holders. The Ralliart Edition specifically adds a rear spoiler, 15-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel, special interior trim, body kit and better brakes. All cars have a cloth interior, with standard power windows and mirrors.

The CLS-Class "four-door coupe" is completely redesigned for the 2012 model year. Based on the latest E-Class platform, the CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Models on offer include the CLS 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and the CLS 500 with a 4.6-litre twin-turbo V8. Both come with a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base. Standard features on all models include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps. Some models gets a standard sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry and start and a sports package for the non-AMG models. Options include metallic paint, nicer leather, wooden steering wheel, night vision, various 18-inch and 19-inch alloy-wheel designs, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more.

The VW Golf has reached its sixth generation, although receiving largely an exterior facelift on the outside. Under the skin, many new features can be found that improves the Golf MK6 as a driver's car. Most noticeable is the new corporate front-end with the black-out grille, while the rest of the car is very similar to the outgoing model. The Golf VI gets a choice of two engines on debut, namely a carryover 1.6-litre 4-cylinder and a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder, the latter of which uses both supercharging and turbocharging. Both models can be had with either a manual gearbox or a new 7-speed DSG automanual transmission. The interior is very similar to the previous Golf, but some new bits include the steering wheel, 'climatronic' a/c and better noise reduction. The Golf is offered as a 2-door or a 4-door, in Trendline, Comfortline and Highline trim levels. Depending on trim, the regular Golf can be had with seven airbags including a knee airbag, stability control, adaptive cruise control, adaptive chassis control with adjustable suspension, Park Assist, alloy wheels, sunroof, and the usual power accessories.

The Lincoln Continental is all-new flagship sedan offered by the American luxury brand. Three engine choices are available - the base model gets 3.7-litre V6 engine, while there is a turbocharged 2.7 V6 and turbocharged 3.0 V6 motors on offer as well. All engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Only the all-wheel drive models are available in the GCC but other markets get a front-wheel drive option as well. Standard features on the Continental include adaptive power steering, power windows, adaptive HID headlamps and LED daytime running lamps, power mirrors, premium sound system with 10 speakers, 8-inch touchscreen with SYNC 3, 2 USB ports, push start engine, push button shift transmission, front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera, leather seats, and 19-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get more interior trim choices, premium LED headlamps, massage seats for the rear, better sound system with 19 speakers, more adjustable power seats for the front, voice activated touch screen, 360 camera for parking and 20-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include front, side and knee airbags, stability control, brake assist, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and ABS. Higher models get lane-keeping assist, blind spot monitor and driver alert system.

Toyota has finally launched the 2011 Scion tC in the GCC, only it will be known as the Toyota Zelas in the GCC, and will come standard with an aggressive body kit. The all-new 5-seater Zelas is powered by a Camry-derived 2.5-litre VVT-i 4-cylinder engine, with front-wheel-drive and a standard 6-speed automatic with tiptronic. The two-door coupe has four-wheel-independent suspension with MacPherson struts up front and double-wishbone rear, as well as four-wheel-disc brakes, vented at the front and solid rear. The Zelas comes in only two trim levels. The rather-loaded base trim comes with an 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and 6-disc CD changer, Bluetooth, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, manual a/c, power windows, folding electric mirrors, ABS, stability control, front and side airbags, spilt-folding rear seat, fog lamps, 17-inch alloys with 215/50 tyres, parking sensors, leather steering wheel with controls, rear spoiler and the body kit. The top version adds leather upholstery, cruise control, paddle shifters and smart keyless entry with starter button. Curiously, neither a sunroof nor a manual gearbox is available. Toyota says they are going to promote it as a tuner car.

The Liana is pitched into the ultra-competitive compact segment. It was introduced as a 2002 model, and mildly facelifted for 2005. The only model offered here is the 1.6-litre four-cylinder version with either a manual or an automatic. It can be fully equipped with air-conditioning, ABS brakes, dual airbags, CD stereo, full electrics, keyless entry and an engine immobiliser. The interior has undergone a respectable makeover, with a new quality look, new materials and better bolstered front seats. Front seat occupants will enjoy the airy cabin. The seats are supportive and well contoured, and even rear passengers are not lacking for headroom or legroom. The high seating position contributes to good visibility. The luggae trunk is not particularly roomy, but split-fold rear seats allow more load space. There are faux aluminium and chrome highlights all over, while optional accesories include a rear spoiler and alloy wheels. The Liana used to come in sedan and hatchback body styles in other markets, but in its final years, only the sedan survived in most markets. European and American markets get larger engine choices.

Porsche released an all-new generation 911 GT3 variant in 2021. The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4.0-litre racing engine, from the previous gen 911 GT3 R. Customers can choose between the 6-speed manual gearbox and 7-speed PDK automatic. It also has rear-axle steering and Porsche Torque Vectoring Plus with fully variable rear axle differential lock. The GT3 comes with a full interior, including a touchscreen multimedia system, auto a/c, a full set of airbags and other safety features.

The Superb is an upper-medium segment car, with an extended wheelbase to increase interior room. The Superb name first appeared on a Skoda in 1934 and is the company's flagship model. The modern-day version Superb is available in various trim levels, with names like Classic, Comfort and Elegance. The Superb offers many of the benefits of a luxury car, with large rear doors and optional rear-seat DVD entertainment. The rear passenger space is exceptional for a vehicle in this segment and high quality trim materials are used throughout the model range. Customisation options include a sunroof and a host of alloy wheel designs and sizes. In the Middle East, the Superb is available with two petrol engines, namely the entry-level turbocharged 1.8-litre four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre V6. Both are coupled with a 5-speed automatic gearbox to drive the front wheels. Standard safety features include ABS brakes, front and side airbags, and even curtain airbags, while the V6 model gets electronic stability control as standard.

The S-Type sporting sedan is a great example of a polarising retro design, and though we love its looks, many out there don't. It was originally launched for 2000, then upgraded for 2003, and received a facelift in 2005. The 2003 update apparently had improved the car dramatically, while adding a set of new V8 motors. For 2005, Jaguar updated the styling, revised the interior, and retuned the suspension. Engines include the adequate base 3.0-litre V6, the decent 4.2-litre V8 and the over-the-top supercharged 4.2-litre V8, all mated to a ZF six-speed automatic with basic manual shift capability. Jaguar's quality has been dramatically improved over the past few years. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, power adjustable steering column with tilt-away entry and exit action, twin-function trip computer, and cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Options include satellite navigation, power adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, and rain-sensing wipers. Front and rear parking sensors, adaptive cruise control, upgraded upholstery, sports suspension and other options are also available.

The Fortuner is Toyota's cheapest SUV offering. Although this Thai-built 4WD is based on a pickup, its styling is very softly finished, with none of its truck-like toughness showing. It has true off-road ability, thanks to four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. It also has space for five, or optionally seven, and its value-packed price has attracted families rather than desert junkies. The Fortuner is available here with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as a 4.0-litre V6 engine. Some markets such as Saudi Arabia, it gets a 2.4 turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine option as well. Most markets offer four-wheel-drive as standard, but a two-wheel-drive version is also offered in Saudi markets. It has space for five adults and two kids. Features include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, and fabric upholstery, although the basic model is only offered in some GCC countries. Higher trim levels, which is standard now in the UAE, get fake wood, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear diff lock, ABS, multi-information display, 6-speaker CD stereo and optional leather. Top-spec Saudi models get HID headlights, power driver's seat and wi-fi features as well.

The 2014 model BMW Z4 got some new engine choices in some of the GCC countries. The Z4 was completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, shifting focus and becoming a comfort-cruiser rather than the focused sports car that it was before. Along with all-new styling, the Z4 now sports a folding hard-top convertible roof that folds down in 20 seconds at the touch of a button. While still a two-seater, the Z4 now has more space for two passengers and their luggage, although not much cargo room is left with the roof down. Changes to the cabin now include more premium materials as well as an integrated iDrive multimedia computer. The Z4 comes in 5 variants with two engine choices, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit and a 3.0-litre inline-6 turbocharged motor, all with different levels of horsepower ratings. The 4-cylinder sDrive18i, sDrive20i and sDrive28i get 8-speed automatic transmissions, while the sDrive35i and sDrive35is get 7-speed double clutch automatic transmission. The Z4 comes with Dynamic Drive Control as standard, which allows NORMAL, SPORT and SPORT+ modes, each of which changes throttle response and gearbox characteristics. Other features include the iDrive system with a high-resolution display that integrates entertainment, navigation, Bluetooth phone and climate control functionality. All the usual luxury features are available, either standard or optional, such as cloth or leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, powered seats, keyless entry with starter button, alloy wheels, and HID headlights, among other options. On the safety front, the Z4 Roadster comes with stability control, ABS, front airbags, head and thorax airbags, reinforced A-pillars and roll bars behind the headrests.

The Rexton II is the latest version Ssangyong's attractive original Rexton. It was launched in the Middle East alongside two other now-defunct 4WDs back in 2002, and has survived with a facelift for 2007. The five-door Rexton can seat up to seven people and comes with a host of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, fake wood trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control is also available.

The long-running Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van has been facelifted for the 2014 model year. It can be classified as one of the largest "light" commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value. Optional safety features include lane-keeping assist, blind-spot assist, collision-prevention assist and high-beam assist.

The Lancer Evolution is different enough from the bargain front-wheel-drive Lancer to be considered a completely different car. Powered by a 2.0-litre turbocharged and intercooled engine, riding on a modified all-wheel-drive platform, and putting power down through a six-speed manual gearbox, the ninth generation of the Evo is a true sports car. All are fitted with a special front fascia, a big rear wing, and a rear-window wiper, sports seats and a few special interior features, though not much different from the basic Lancer in terms on trim. The Evo comes with 17-inch alloy wheels and grippy P235/45WR17 tyres. In addition to these features, the Evo IX gets an active center differential switch and Brembo brakes with sport ABS and EBD, plus  convenience and safety features like power windows and mirrors, and dual airbags. The all-wheel-drive system is computer-controlled to determine how much power to send to each wheel in varying situations.

As with the previous model, the new TT is built on the VW Golf platform. The new TT will be available with numerous engines, including a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo and a 3.2-litre V6. The TT RS model debuted in 2011 with a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo while the V6 was cancelled. The TT roadster will debut late into 2007. The new TT is a far more aggressive sports car than the model it replaces, which was more of a show car than a sports car. Like its predecessor, the curvy profile generates a lot of aerodynamic lift at the rear end, so the new TT adopts a rear spoiler which recesses smoothly into the tail at low speeds and raises automatically at over 120 kph. The new car is larger and heavier, so to compensate for the additional metal, the hood, front fenders, roof and doors are made of aluminium, while the panels of the rear body remain steel to help balance the car. "Quattro" all-wheel-drive is optional on the front-driven 2.0 turbo, while standard on the 3.2 V6 and the RS. Manual gearbox is standard, but a DSG automanual is optional. Features include cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry, alloy wheels and the usual power accessories. As was the case with the previous TT, the new car is built as part of a joint effort, with bodywork and paint done at the German plant in Ingolstadt, and vehicle assembly is completed at Audi's Hungarian plant in Gyor.

The Vectra is Opel's attempt at the upper end of the midsize car market, although more conservative pricing would've helped it compete against the larger Japanese midsize sedans. The Vectra was the first European application of GM's front-wheel-drive Epsilon platform, shared with the Saab 9-3. This architecture uses aluminium in the suspension and bonnet, magnesium in the dashboard cross member and lots of high-tensile steel. The Vectra, available as a sedan or a liftback, received a new front end during the 2006 model year. The largish interior can hold five people, and luggage space can be increased by folding down the rear bench seat. The extensive range of engines available in Europe has been cut down to a single 2.2-litre four-cylinder in the Middle East, mated with only a five-speed automatic transmission. Features include power windows, cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD stereo, cruise control, keyless entry and more. The rigid passenger cell is complemented by standard safety equipment including front airbags, side airbags for driver and front passenger, as well as curtain airbags in front and rear. Also available are active head restraints in front with lumbar supports to reduce whiplash injury.

The E-Class is the bestseller in the Mercedes-Benz line-up, with its perfect size and luxurious accessories, if optioned out properly. Available in sedan and unpopular wagon body styles, the E-Class comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, though the diesel engines are close to unwanted in this region. It underwent a pointless facelift recently, but features the same carryover internals. Models include the 1.8-litre supercharged E 200 Kompressor, the 3.0-litre E 280, the 3.5-litre E 350, the new 5.5-litre E 500 and the new 6.2-litre E 63 AMG. All come with automatic transmissions officially, though the base model can be had with a manual. Options include bi-xenon headlamps with Active Light System and cornering light function, COMAND control and display system for radio and navigation, Distronic proximity control, upholstery options, headlamp cleaning system, keyless start, parking sensors, semi-active air suspension, four-zone automatic climate control and a tyre pressure-loss warning system. A new AMG sports package is also available for sedans makes any trim look like the AMG model.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. For 2018, the Huracan Performante was released with higher performance numbers. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

Launched here in 2005 and facelifted in 2007, the Scorpio is the first Indian consumer vehicle to grace Middle East roads since the disastrous Padmini. Unlike the Fiat-derived outdated Padmini, this 4WD wagon is mostly an original inhouse design and arguably more modern, though not quite up to current standards. Yet, it is good enough to win multiple Indian "Car of the Year" awards. This Mahindra & Mahindra product is available here only in top trim, complete with leather seats, possibly fake wood trim, power windows, central locking, power steering, keyless entry, CD stereo and rear a/c vents. It was restyled lightly for 2007. Interesting features include a low-range transfer case, seating for seven and a Renault-derived engine. However, this 2.0-litre four-cylinder is too weak to move a compact car, let alone this heavyweight 4WD. And even in top trim, there is an obvious lack of safety features other than its perceived bulk. Five of the seven passengers manage with seat belts only, with nothing for the last two inward-facing seats.

The new-for-2010 E-Class Cabriolet debuted in the summer of 2009, featuring much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door convertible format. But the engines are still carried over from the previous generation, with the 3.0-litre E 300, the 3.5-litre E 350 and the 5.5-litre E 500. The base E 200 CGI and E 250 CGI models appeared later, both with 1.8-litre engines, each with a different tune. An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard cabriolet models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

A new generation model of the Kia Soul came in 2020. Engines are carried over from the previous model, being powered by a 1.6-litre mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available only as front-wheel-drive. The basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, roof rack mounting points, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth, split-folding rear seat, cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better infotainment system, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, luggage net, some extra trim and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of different two-tone interiors.

An all-new GMC Yukon was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. In 2018, the top Denali variant got a new front grille. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. The more luxurious Denali version, identified by its chrome grille and trimmings, gets a 6.2-litre V8. In 2018 the Yukon Denali got a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features for the 2019 Yukon include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The attractive GranTurismo is derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. For the 2018 model year, it got a facelift and much needed upgrade under the hood and tech inside. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.7-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of many colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium audio system, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The McLaren 540C is the second release from the Sports Series lineup after the 570S and is set to be the lowest-priced McLaren on offer. It features a revised aerodynamics package when compared to the 570S, and also features new alloy wheels. For the interior it gets leather-wrapped seats, dashboard and door panels. The infotainment system includes a 7-inch screen, Bluetooth and navigation. Under the hood, is the usual turbocharged 3.8-litre V8, while power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic gearbox. McLaren have also retuned the dampers of the 540C to make it more suitable for daily driving.

The Mercedez-Benz GLS-Class is the new name for the GL-Class. In 2016, it received a facelift, along with mechanical updates. The GLS uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. The GLS 500 comes with a 4.7-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GLS-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too. The AMG body-kit is offered on the GLS 500 as an exterior package.

The Zotye T700 is the brand's midsize SUV offering. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features in the T700 include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, engine start-stop button, front and rear parking sensors, rear camera, LED headlamps, LCD touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB, sunroof, electric seats driver & passenger, leather ventilated seats,  and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor, ABS, brake assist, stability control and traction control.

The Chevrolet Traverse received a facelift for 2013. It is a crossover wagon that combines the functionality of a minivan with the look of an SUV, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, with either front-wheel-drive or optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include 6.5 inches touch screen for navigation, entertainment and display vehicle information, rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Audi RS 3 is the top performance trim for the A3 model. Under the hood, the all-wheel-drive hatchback gets a turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the car include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start-stop engine button, Nappa leather upholstery, Bang & Olufsen sound system with sub-woofer, Bluetooth, USB/AUX support, front sports seats, front electric seats with 4-way lumbar support, rear folding back seats, fog lamps, rear spoiler and alloy wheels. Some optional features include Audi magnetic ride, 19-inch polished alloy wheels with matte titanium finish, 5-spoke rotor arm design, red brake calipers and roof rails with matte titanium look. Standard safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front airbags and knee airbags.

The third-generation Kia Cerato sedan boasts sleeker styling that is 30 mm longer, 15 mm lower and 5 mm wider than the outgoing car, with a 50 mm extended wheelbase. It also features an all-new bodyshell, upgraded equipment, a host of additional convenience and safety features, a more spacious cabin with better quality, improved suspension and an upgraded powertrain line-up that delivers class-leading performance and fuel economy. Two 4-cylinder engines will be offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission.
