Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The Lexus IS debuted in its current form back in 2014, and got a facelift in 2017. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, later renamed to IS300 in 2018, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

The Fiat 500X is the Italian brand's sub-compact SUV offering. For 2019 it got a facelift and only the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is offered, with front-wheel drive and all-wheel drive configurations, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base "Popstar" model gets power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, fog lights, manual A/C, cruise control, radio with 5-inch touch screen and Bluetooth/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, tow hook and alloy wheels. The "Lounge" model gets a sunroof, automatic AC, leather seats, better quality stereo system and paddle shifters. Safety features include front,side and side head airbags, traction control, vehicle dynamic control, hill holder and electronic roll mitigation system.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received 2 major makeovers for 2008 and 2019, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013 and more power in 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The limited-production twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 G65 AMG has been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. It comes over here as only a 5-door wagon. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. Other features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Other features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Maxima was a hot car when it was first unveiled in this iteration. However, Nissan's GCC division chose to let this model stagnate to the point where it was easily overshadowed by the newer Altima, even when the Maxima was redesigned in other markets and transformed into a luxury cruiser. The GCC-spec Maxima also still uses Nissan's older version of the corporate V6, with a displacement of 3.0-litre, combined with front-wheel-drive, and with a choice of five-speed manual and four-speed auto gearboxes. Performance is very respectable even after all these years. It comes with automatic air-conditioning, CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, ABS-assisted disc brakes, cloth seats, front airbags and many wheel choices, depending on model. The basic model gets 15-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include an in-dash CD changer with subwoofer, cruise control, sunroof, rear electric sunshade and leather cabin trim. Changes from year to year largely involve a new grille style every few years.

The Acadia is GMC's first crossover wagon that combines car-like handling with the utility of a 4WD wagon, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. First introduced in 2007, the Acadia got an upgrade under the bonnet in 2009, with a slightly more powerful 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. An Acadia Denali version debuted for 2011, with identical drivetrains as the base model, but with 20-inch wheels, unique front and rear bumpers, chrome mesh grille and upgraded interior trim.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 is a facelifted model which came out in 2013. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Mercedez-Benz GL-Class was changed for 2013. Even though it is slight bigger now, they have managed to shave off up some weight as well in the new model. The GL uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. In addition to the 4.7-litre V8 in the GL 500, the second model is the GL 63 AMG with a turbocharged 5.5-litre V8. Both come with a 7-speed automatic. The new turbocharged engines are much more fuel-efficient now. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GL-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too. The AMG body-kit is offered on the GL 500 as an exterior package.

The Audi RS Q3 is the top performance trim for the sub-compact SUV. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features in the RS Q3 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start-stop button, multi-functional steering wheel, 6.5-inch display screen, MMI entertainment system, aluminium look pedals, black cloth headlining, dual-zone electric climate control, sports seats with leather upholstery and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, anti-slip regulation (ASR), electronic differential lock and electronic stability control (ESC).

This generation of the Subaru Forester debuted in 2015 and carries on unchanged except for a facelift and minor trim updates in 2017. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The Audi S3 sedan made its debut in 2015 and is the performance version of the A3. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The 6-speed manual gearbox version is available in some GCC markets on special order. All-wheel drive is standard in the S3. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, sports seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and alloy wheels. Safety standards are high as in all Audi models with features which include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The X5 M debuted in late 2009, with a higher-tuned turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 than the regular X5. The M has a 6-speed auto with proper paddle-shifters. Features include iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, side-view cameras, top-view camera, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M gets 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, aluminium roof rails, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements. It also gets  features such as sports suspension, 'M' driving mode, paddle-shifted quicker-response automatic, launch control and a body kit.

The Chevrolet Aveo is the American brand's sub-compact offering, which is built in Korea. Features in this economy car include advanced dual-stage frontal airbags with passenger sensing system, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with bolt-on wheel covers on the base models or 14-inch alloy wheels on the top model, tilting front seat headrests, fabric interior  electronic throttle control and CD player. The Aveo comes in one trim and available as a four-door sedan. It is powered by a 1.4-litre in-line four-cylinder and come with a four-speed automatic.

The Chery Arrizo 3 is the Chinese brand's smallest sedan. It does not aspire to be anything more than an inoffensive 5-seater subcompact sedan, but actually a bit bigger than most of its sub-compact rivals. Powered by a typical 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 4-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, other features include split-folding rear seats, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and all the usual basics. Touchscreen stereo, leatherette seats and more are also available. Safety features include at least 2 airbags and ABS.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. The lengthened four-door wheelbase provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

In 2019, a new generation of the Porsche 911 Cabriolet was revealed. The 2+2 seater coupe gets an updated exterior design, along with updates to the engine. The 911 Carrera and Carrera S is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine with two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The Carrera 4 and 4S is all-wheel drive. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The Carrera S and Carrera T models also have the option of all-wheel-steer.

The fancy FX35 aims to please city-going rich folks. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6, it comes with a standard five-speed automatic and a sporting chassis. It has a leather interior, power driver's and passenger seats, 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, aluminium roof rails, rearview monitor, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, 300-watt six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo with ten speakers, power mirrors and an advanced airbag system. The FX's on-demand all-wheel-drive system, known as ATTESA E-TS, or Advanced Total Traction Engineering System for All Electronic Torque Split, runs at 99 per cent rear wheel bias under most conditions. When slip is detected, up to 50 per cent power goes to the front wheels, but there is no low-range gearing. The FX35 also comes with automatic rear hatch closure assist system, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, aluminium interior trim, dual-zone climate control, information display monitor, and three-spoke leather-wrapped wheel with audio controls.

The Audi E-Tron is the German luxury brand's first all-electric vehicle offering. Built on Audi’s new battery-electric vehicle or BEV platform, the E-tron packs a 95 kWhr battery and two motors to power the front and rear wheels. Audi intentionally kept the design similar to their petrol-powered cars, to make potential customers switching to electric feel more comfortable with the initial transition. The interior features the new “virtual cockpit” we saw already in the A8 and Q8, which includes the infotainment system with dual haptic touchscreens. The shifter is new and unique — it looks like a hand rest but has a tab at the end, which can be moved to change gears. Another unique feature is the side-view “mirrors” which are actually screens on the upper door panels, and on the outside were just sticks with cameras. While it takes a moment to get used to, rest assured it is just as option for people who still want the traditional side mirrors. The regenerative braking technology on the E-tron is one of the highlights of the car. What Audi managed to do is keep the drive similar to a combustion-engined Audi. During normal driving, most of the braking is done by the electric motors, which then send the captured energy to the battery. The best feature of this system is the brake pedal feel, which is not like the “switch” feel of other electric cars, but gives that linear braking smoothness of non-electric cars. At speeds below 11 kph, it switches to normal hydraulic brakes so you don’t get that jerky feeling when parking or moving slowly through traffic.

Previously speculated to be named the 620 GT, the replacement for the 599 has actually been named the Ferrari F12 Berlinetta, which is their most powerful road-going car at the time of release. The F12 is powered by a 6.3-litre V12. It only comes with an "F1"³ dual-clutch 7-speed automatic gearbox, in keeping with their official promise to eliminate the traditional manual gearbox forever, one model at a time. Other features include carbon-ceramic brakes, updated magnetorheological suspension control system, and numerous jumbled electronic aids, including E-Diff, ESP Premium, F1-Trac, and high-performance ABS.

BAIC is a Chinese car company which made its debut in the UAE in late 2014. The BAIC A1 sedan is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They are come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Lexus GX 460 last received a facelift in 2014. Sporting a new front-end, actual changes are minimal, but the midsize luxury SUV in now available in three trim levels. On the outside, the most obvious changes include the redesigned front-end with the corporate "spindle" grille, adaptive LED-HID combination headlights, LED running lamps, new tail lamp clusters, redone 18-inch wheels and other minor bits. The engine is a carryover 4.6-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. The base Premier model is well-equipped, with standard features such as a multi-terrain select system, smart keyless entry and start, sunroof, rear camera and side camera with park assist, synthetic leather trim for the 7-seater cabin, 9-speaker stereo with new 8-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, DVD navigation, tri-zone a/c, crawl control, ESP, basic cruise control and a full set of airbags that includes knee bags. The mid-range Prestige model adds semi-aniline leather, heated/ventilated seats, cool box and lane-change assist with blind-spot monitor. The top Platinum model adds a 17-speaker Mark Levinson stereo, pre-crash safety system, radar cruise control and a rear-seat entertainment system.

The Volvo S90 debuted as an all-new model in 2017, introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new S90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring elongated taillights and dual exhaust tips. In 2021, the S60 Recharge model was introduced, which is hybrid model. It gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine connected to an electric motor. Power is delivered via an 8-speed automatic transmission. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Picanto is one of the smallest cars plying the Middle East's aggressive roads. Introduced for 2005, it has been facelifted for 2008. Powered by a tiny 1.1-litre four-cylinder, it is smaller than a family-size Coke bottle, mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The tall styling makes sure there is fair headroom, though legroom is conservative at best. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, radio cassette player with roof antenna and 4 speakers, manual air-conditioning, combination vinyl-cloth cabin, variable intermittent front wipers, front cup holder, seat belts and, thankfully, a tachometer. Available features in higher trim levels include a rear wiper and washer, rear shelf cover over the luggage area, body-coloured exterior trim pieces and bumpers, a luggage net, and not much else. We believe most markets do not get anything more than seat belts as safety features, although a few markets do get the front-wheel-drive Picanto with all sorts of optional airbags.

The Opel Mokka is the German brand's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 4-cylinder 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The South Korean-made Mokka comes in two trims. The base-model comes in only front-wheel drive, while the higher model gets all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/AUX support and alloy wheels. Optional features include bigger alloy wheels, better sound system and chrome door handles. Safety-wise, the Trax gets traction control, stability control and 4-wheel ABS with panic brake assist.

The Haval H8 is the Chinese brand's midsize SUV offering. Under the hood is a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the H8 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric seats with lumbar support, leather or fabric upholstery, infotainment system with 8-inch touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, parking sensors, front and rear fog lamps, 3-zone climate control and alloy wheels. Safety features include front,side and curtain airbags, driver condition monitoring, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. Other features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. The 2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features in the 2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's arsenal. Competing in a peculiar segment defined by expensive small cars, the 1-Series is the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive. First offered in mid-2004 as a 5-door hatchback using its own platform, it replaced the slow-selling 3-Series Compact. Facelifted for 2008, the five-door hatchback was joined by a three-door hatchback. The range was soon expanded to include a two-door coupe and a two-door convertible. Petrol versions now include the 2.0-litre 118i, the 2.0-litre 120i, the 3.0-litre 125i and the 3.0-litre turbocharged 135i, although the higher engines are reserved for the two-door models. In 2009, a basic 120i convertible debuted. All models come with a choice of 6-speed transmissions, both manual or automatic. In late 2011, a limited-edition 1M Coupe was offered with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder and manual only. While the hatchback was completely redesigned for 2012, the coupe and convertible continued unchanged for one more year. All non-M trims come standard with common power accesories, cloth or leather upholstery, front and side airbags, stability control and ABS, alongside various optional features such as HID headlights, "active" steering, stereo choices and various wheel sizes. Considering the price, the way it looks, and the number of these seen on the streets, BMW is having trouble moving these off the showroom floor in this region.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. In 2017, it got a facelift and a new base engine. Engine choices include the SL 400 with a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 and SL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8. Both are mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2015, the RS 7 got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Mercedes-Benz A 45 AMG is the range-topping variant of the A-Class line. It received a facelift in 2016 and a power boost. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. Externally, it can be identified by its AMG-specific bumpers and wheels, although these are also available with lower-spec A-Class models with an AMG package as well. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. Other available features include HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, cruise control, navigation and more.

The A8 is the most imposing of the Audi range. Most noticeable is the big single-frame grille on all models. Engines available in front-wheel-drive form include the 2.8-litre V6 and the 3.2-litre V6 in this region, while all-wheel-drive Quattro offerings include the 4.2-litre V8, although some dealers do offer the 6.0-litre V12 too. All these models are sold here only in long wheelbase form, but there is also a sweet short-wheelbase S8 model, again only from some dealers, that is powered by a Lamborghini-sourced 5.2-litre V10. Basic features on A8 models include a parking system with graphic display, adaptive front lighting, new 18-inch wheel designs, optional 19-inch performance tyres with the Sport Package, a revamped Driver Information Centre; a glove box lock and a leather interior. The 4.2-litre, 6.0-litre and 5.2-litre models all use Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive. The A8 uses an all-aluminium frame with a fully pneumatic suspension system. Its aluminium four-link front axle and trapezoidal-link rear axle suspension has air spring struts at each wheel, with sensors that continually monitor and adjust the damping, and automatically level the car. The 3.2-litre uses a CVT automatic transmission, while the rest of the models use a six-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission with manual mode and available wheel-mounted paddles. Audi's Multi Media Interface control system can be used to monitor or control such things as the radio, phone, climate control, stereo or lighting profiles of the LED illumination in the door trim and foot wells. The Quattro models are at least a step in the right direction in combating its German brethren.

The Mercedez-Benz GLS-Class is the new name for the GL-Class. In 2016, it received a facelift, along with mechanical updates. The GLS uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. The GLS 63 AMG comes with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GLS-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

The Suzuki Kizashi tries to make an entry into the highly-competitive midsize segment, by being slightly smaller than the competition. There is only one engine choice, a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Only the Sport grade is offered in most GCC countries, thereby coming with a sporty front bumper and rear spoiler as default on all cars. Standard options on the Kizashi include power windows, power mirrors, power locks, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/USB capability, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start engine, sunroof, leather seats, cruise control, power adjustable driver and passenger seats, fog lamps and parking sensors. Six airbags come as standard on all models.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets even better with the addition of the 469 hp STS-V. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models include all-wheel-drive as an available option on V6 models. A Bose 5.1 Studio Surround Sound system with Navigation is standard on the highest V8 model, while 18-inch wheels are available on the V6 and V8 rear-wheel-drive models. Engine choices on the STS are a 3.6-litre V6 and a longitudinally-mounted 4.6-litre Northstar V8. Both hook up to their own versions of a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. The STS-V features a 4.4-litre supercharged Northstar V8 engine with variable valve timing, also found in the XLR-V, mated to an all-new Hydra-Matic 6L80 six-speed automatic transmission. The STS-V is supposedly capable of zero to 100 kph in five seconds. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, standard 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, and rear parking assist. A starter button is standard on the STS. Cornering and handling are superb, while the Magnetic Ride Control soaks up road imperfections for a firm ride. In price, it competes with smaller midsize Germans.

The GMC Yukon got a new 6-speed automatic transmission from 2009 onward and also the Yukon Denali got a slight power increase. A beefy Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Yukon, with better fuel economy to boot. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include power windows, electric mirrors and additional power equipment, along with a folding third-row seat. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, Yukon is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Yukon XL is the long-wheelbase GMC version of the Suburban, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. The Denali version adds a 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto, chrome trim and some luxury interior features, but loses off-road gearing.

The Audi A5 originally debuted for 2008 in the GCC as a four-seater coupe based on the latest stretched A4 platform, with the range later diluted by the addition of a 5-door model. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.2-litre V6 engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive version, and a 6-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive version. For 2009, an underwhelming Audi S5 Quattro coupe model debuted, with a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. The front-wheel-drive A5 Cabrio convertible also eventually joined the line-up with only a detuned 2.0T engine and a CVT, offering less power than the coupe. For 2010, the new A5 Sportback 5-door liftback model joined the range, with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, a 7-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel-drive. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The new platform moves the engine more rearward in relation to the front axle for better balance and handling, but ultimately the car loses out on the fun factor in any form, either due to its front-driven underpinnings or to its overly-safe Quattro system.

The Cadiilac CTS-V is the top sports variant which with a supercharged 6.2-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps, fog lamp, Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The CLS-Class "four-door coupe" was completely redesigned for the 2012 model year and facelifted for 2015. Based on the latest E-Class platform, the CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Models on offer include the CLS 400 with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 and the CLS 500 with a 4.6-litre twin-turbo V8. The V6 model gets a 7-speed automatic transmission, while the V8 model gets a new 9-speed automatic gearbox. Standard features on all models include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps. Some models gets a standard sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry and start and a sports package for the non-AMG models. Options include metallic paint, nicer leather, wooden steering wheel, night vision, various 18-inch and 19-inch alloy-wheel designs, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more.

The BMW X2 is a brand new model introduced as a 2018 model year. It is based on the X1 and Mini Countryman chassis, but offers the "SUV" coupe design. An optional M sport package consisting of sporty suspension, cabin trim and body kit is also offered. The new engines available include the entry-level sDrive18i getting a new 1.5-litre 3-cylinder turbocharged engine. The sDrive20i and sDrive28i gets a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit.  The X2 M35i gets a turbocharged 6-cylinder 3.0-litre all-aluminum motor. An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered, although there is also a 6-speed manual available that will likely never be shipped here by local dealers.The interior features an optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

The all-new Chevrolet Sonic is a sub-compact replacement for the Aveo. Available in sedan and hatchback body-styles, the Sonic was sold in the GCC with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic function, while a 5-speed manual available in some markets. The base model comes with 5-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, fold-down rear seat, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, optional keyless entry and only one airbag. The mid-range LS model additionally gets steel wheels or optional 15-inch alloy wheels, optional sunroof, power windows, 4-way manually-adjustable driver's seat, better stereo with Bluetooth and more optional speakers, split-folding rear seat, optional parking sensors, optional ABS and two airbags. The top LT model additionally gets 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, standard ABS, 6-speaker stereo, and front as well as side airbags.

The aging 9-5 was given a makeover in 2006, which includes a new look inside and out, and some minor mechanical modifications. Sold in Linear, Arc and Aero versions, there is only the four-door sedan form available here, although a SportCombi wagon could probably be ordered. The 9-5 now features two 2.3-litre four-cylinder turbo engines in different states of tune, mated to five-speed manual or optional automatic transmissions. The 9-5 features consist of leather upholstery, sport-tuned suspension, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, computer information display, Xenon headlamps, anti-theft alarm, sunroof, CD stereo, aumatic climate control, alloy wheels, parking sensors, keyless entry and more. Safety features are extensive, with an active head restraint system, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control and stability control. This car certainly is loaded with features, but it loses out with an inflated price tag for what is essentially a four-cylinder front-wheel-drive sedan, living only on facelifts since the last millenium.

The Korean-built Captiva, originally GM's first proper entry into the softroader market, received a facelift in 2011, along with a change in engines and cabin design. On offer is a choice of two powertrains, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive form, and a 3.0-litre V6 with direct-injection and all-wheel-drive. All models get a new 6-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, standard power windows and mirrors, seating for seven, 4-speaker or 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c and keyless entry. There are four trim levels, with the top LTZ model getting optional 19-inch alloy wheels, single-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, 8-speaker stereo with AUX port and CD changer, optional fog lamps, electronic parking brake, cloth or leather upholstery, optional Bluetooth, chrome door handles, optional sunroof and optional parking sensors. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags, standard ABS, and optional traction control, stability control, hill-descent control and hydraulic brake assist.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. Other features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Other features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Mercedes-Benz ML-Class, officially referred to as the M-Class for whatever reason, has been completely revamped for the 2012 model year, taking on a puffier styling theme while retaining all the characteristics of the previous model. This ML 63 AMG, which is the performance version of the midsize SUV, comes with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8, all with a 7-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and AMG alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers alcantara and leather upholstery, carbon-fibre trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. The ML 63 also option of AMG performance package which adds even more power.

The Abarth 595 Competizione is based on the Fiat 500. The front end was redesigned with a much larger air scoop to improve heat management in the engine compartment and increase cooling capacity by 18%. The extractor is quite pronounced on the rear bumper. To enhance its looks, specific bumper inserts have also been created with the Tar Cold Grey finish on the 595 Competizione. It has polyelliptical headlights and LED daytime running lights as standard equipment. Xenon headlights, on the other hand, are available on request. The standard flat-bottomed steering wheel, as well as other striking interior details, on the Competizione version is made of technical materials, such as carbon and Alcantara. Abarth 595 Competizione is equipped with a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to an Abarth sequential gearbox and fits the new Record Monza Attivo exhaust. The 595 Competizione is equipped with supporting shell-shaped "Abarth Corsa by Sabelt" seats. Braking is secured by a Brembo system with 4-piston aluminium monobloc fixed callipers paired with self-ventilating, perforated 305 mm discs. Koni FSD (Frequency Selective Damping) shock absorbers are standard on both front and rear. The Sport button can be used to adjust various parameters of the car, such as torque delivery and power steering calibration, as well as managing the exhaust. Furthermore, the system adjusts engine response to the accelerator pedal and the TFT instrument panel switches to racing configuration. Safety standards are high with the Abarth 595 equipped with seven airbags as standard equipment. It also gets ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESC), anti-slip regulation (ASR) system, the Hill Holder devices and hydraulic brake assistance (HBA) to help with emergency stops.

The Mountaineer is supposed to be a more upscale version of the Ford Explorer, and it certainly looks like it from the outside. It shares its structure and most major components with the Explorer, but apparently it shares a lot of the interior as well, thus diminishing brand differences. The Mountaineer is also powered by the Explorer's 4.0-litre V6, mated to a five-speed automatic, but it loses low-range gearing for its four-wheel-drive system The interior theoretically offers seating for up to eight people with three rows of seats, with a third-row seat that can fold flat. Standard interior features include a CD stereo, power windows and mirrors, available CD changer and sunroof, cruise control, available leather upholstery, and standard alloy wheels. The Mountaineer also builds on Ford's strong safety offerings, offering standard AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, ABS brakes, dual front airbags and a tyre-pressure monitoring system, while the Safety Canopy side-curtain airbag system is optional.

The Octavia is based on the new-generation Volkswagen Golf platform, and offers a wide range of trim and engine options. The range is littered with various motors, but only a handful are officially offered in the Middle East. Among these are the 1.6-litre four-cylinder, the 2.0-litre four-cylinder and the 1.8-litre turbocharged four-cylinder. By 2008, only the 1.6-litre was remaining, alongside a new 2.0-litre FSI engine with more power. Different trim levels go by various names like Ambiente, Choice, Elegance and what not. The Octavia is one of the more unique cars in its segment, with the look of a proper sedan, but surprising with a lift-up rear hatch for loading luggage. A station wagon version is also available to further increase cargo room, but mated to only to the base engine. The interior has a clean look with high-quality materials, and featuring power accessories for windows, mirrors, seats and sunroof, depending on which trim level one chooses. ABS brakes with Brake Assist are available, as is a traction control system. Safety wise, four airbags, two front and two side, are available. Rear side airbags and full-length side curtain airbags are optional.

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive 6.2-litre V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lambo to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. Introduced in 2002, the Roadster came in 2004, while production ended by 2006, to be replaced by the Murcielago LP640 coupe model with a larger 6.5-litre V12. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops. The rear air intakes and spoiler are adjusted automatically, depending on speed, to improve aerodynamics. Unlike older Lamborghinis, these cars are known to be a bit more forgiving for casual cruising.

This iteration of the Honda Jazz was launched in the GCC for the 2009 model year, and facelifted for 2012 with a few minor mechanical upgrades. The 'New Jazz' is powered by an upgraded 1.5-litre 4-cylinder i-VTEC engine. In a move to deter true enthusiasts, a 5-speed automatic gearbox with optional paddle-shifters is the only choice. For 2012, the suspension has been retuned to ease the firm ride a bit, while retaining the tight handling. The speedometer features a large LED display providing of a broad range of information, including current fuel economy and range indications. An integrated single-CD stereo is fitted on all models, with MP3/WMA capability and speed-dependent volume adjustment. Features include four speakers, two tweeters and a USB adaptor in the centre console storage box. The Jazz is also equipped with the latest version of Honda's 'Magic Seats' in the back that can fold up or fold down in one motion. All models get power-folding mirrors, air-cooled double glovebox, keyless entry, alarm, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and front power windows. The EX adds rear power windows, paddle shifters, faux-leather steering wheel with audio controls, 16-inch alloy wheels and cruise control. A panoramic sunroof and fog lamps are standard on the top version. The Jazz also comes in several bright colours. All Jazz models are equipped with ABS and Electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags as standard, with optional side airbags.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. Changes were made in 2015 which included standard Attention Assist and Crosswind Assist, optional Intelligent Light System which included LED indicators, LED daytime running lamps, LED low-beam headlamps, and main beam with cornering light function. There were no changes for the 2017 model year. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Changan CS35 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering, currently being sold only in a few GCC countries. Under the hood of the CS35 is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB/CD support, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, parking sensors, fog lamps and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get sunroof, leather wrapped steering wheel and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features on the car include ABS, electronic brake distribution and brake assist, and front driver & passenger airbags, while higher models get side curtain airbags.

The VW Touareg is a luxurious and comfortable 4WD that is surprisingly capable both on the road and off it too. Facelifted and mildly upgraded for 2007, it is a practical vehicle, and on the highway, the Touareg offers a firm but smooth ride, and its handling is responsive for its mass, while in the desert, a full set of off-roading equipment comes in handy, including locking diffs and low-range gearing. The range includes a new 3.6-litre V6, an upgraded 4.2-litre V8 and a very limited 6.0-litre W12. All models come with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Also standard is Volkswagen's 4Motion permanent all-wheel-drive system. The Touareg seats five, and there is no third row of seats available. The 4WD comes standard with leatherette upholstery, dual-zone climate control with rear seat controls, wood trim, power windows, mirrors and sunroof, electrically adjustable front seating, alloy wheels of various sizes, ABS and many more items. Higher models get leather, auto-dimming outside mirrors with memory; and other luxuries. All models include front, side-impact and curtain airbags.

The Hyundai Grand i10 comes in both hatchback and sedan body styles. It has a longer wheelbase than the regular i10, therefore interior space is better. Features, either standard or optional, include smart key, engine start button, a rear parking assist system, AUX, IPOD, USB, Bluetooth and audio control buttons on the steering wheel. Only the hatchback model offers Electronic Stability Control and Vehicle Stability Management. A two-tone colour scheme has been applied to the instrument panel and seats. Two engine options will be available, a 3-cylinder 1.0-litre motor and 4-cylinder 1.25-litre unit. Consumers can choose between a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic.

The Foton Tunland is the Chinese manufacturer's midsize pickup offering. Currently only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine is available in select GCC countries. Standard features on the Tunland include power steering, power windows, remote locking, central locking, fabric seats, rear fog lamp, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB support, 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. It gets ABS but no airbags. There is a higher model with leather seats, 16-inch alloy rims, and driver and passenger side front airbags.

The Toyota Prado got a minor facelift for 2014, with a redesigned front-end and other trim changes. The only engine available with the short-wheelbase 3-door variant is a carryover 2.7-litre 4-cylinder. In 2016, it got a 6-speed automatic gearbox. It is only available in some markets, such as the UAE in GXR trim; and Bahrain in TX and TXL trim. It gets standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing and a locking centre-differential. In the UAE, the Prado 2.7L GXR comes with 17-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, rear spoiler, mud guards, fabric seating for five, keyless entry, front and rear manual a/c, CD/MP3 6-speaker stereo, ABS with EBD and brake-assist, dual front airbags, cool box, steering audio controls, USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, smart keyless entry and start, leather steering wheel and shift lever, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, front fog lamps and some other basic features.

The Peugeot 508 midsize sedan was heavily facelifted for the 2015 model year. The only engine on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan is a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. The base model features 16-inch alloy wheels, LED running lights, auto a/c, power windows, electric folding mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, cruise control with speed limiter, fog lamps, and a cooled glove box. The mid-range model adds 17-inch alloys, power seats, dual-zone a/c, one-touch power windows, AUX port for the stereo, auto-dimming mirror and rear parking sensors. The top "Allure" model gets 18-inch alloys, four-zone a/c, turning HID headlights, navigation, 8-speaker JBL stereo, sunroof, smart keyless entry with starter button, electric parking brake with hill assist, side and rear sun-blinds, heads-up display, leather and front-rear parking sensors with distance display. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. All markets do not get all trim levels.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. The GTC4Lusso is offered in a four-wheel-drive configuration, and powered by Ferrari’s 6.3-litre V12 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission. There is a rear-wheel-drive variant namely the GTC4Lusso T offered from 2017 model year. Both variants employ electronic rear differential and an all-wheel-steering system. Features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128gb in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays and more.

The FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The 2021 FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. In UAE, the manual gearbox is not offered anymore, with the 2021 Toyota FJ Cruiser GXR model coming with power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, infotainment system with a 12-inch screen, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, navigation, radio and Bluetooth, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear parking sensors, full-time 4x4, rear-diff lock and 17-inch alloy wheels, automatic gearbox, power mirrors, crawl control, dashboard display, navigation, rear-view camera, rear window wiper and part-time 4x4, 8 speakers, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, leather-stitched steering wheel, front skid plate protector, spare wheel hard cover, and lot of chrome pieces such as the exhaust tip, grille, door mirrors and door handles. In Saudi Arabia, the base FJ stopped getting a manual gearbox in 2020. Features include power steering, power windows, manual side mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear diff-lock and 17-inch alloy wheels, side-step, rear-window wiper, no traction control and no rear diff-lock; the FJ 1 gets power mirrors, Bluetooth, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, rear parking sensors, iPod support, driver arm rest, 10 JBL speakers & subwoofer, rear-view camera, spare wheel cover and no diff lock; the FJ 2 gets rear diff-lock, front skid plate, traction control, wi-fi and two-hitch. Safety features include standard front airbags as well as ABS and vehicle stability control. In Saudi Arabia, the top model gets side airbags as well. A new Adventure version was launched in the GCC in 2021, which gets smoked lights, blackened grille, bumpers, door handles and door mirrors, Bushwacker fender flares, Fox suspensions, 2-inch lift and Borla performance exhaust.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The Mitsubishi Outlander got a facelift in 2016 and carries on unchanged. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

The Subaru WRX is in its fifth generation, debuting in 2015 and getting a facelift for 2018. Redesigned 18-inch wheels, revised electric power steering and optional turning LED headlights are also new for 2018. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler. It will be coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission. There's a new Sport Lineartronic CVT as an option, which also comes with 6-speed and 8-speed paddle-shifter mode. The new lighter engine ensures that this WRX with the manual gearbox is 30 kg heavier than the previous 2014 model. Of the two alternatives, torque will be equally (50:50) distributed to all four wheels in the 6-speed manual variant and the CVT will receive a torque distribution split of 45:55 with Subarua's Variable Torque Distribution system. The new WRX is 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Rio is Kia's sub-compact nameplate that started life in 2000. It can always be depended on for the most unique exterior designs in this segment. This generation of the Rio debuted in 2006 and received a minor frontal facelift in 2010, before being replaced in 2012. The interior offers decent space for its size, although the cabin is a hard plastic tomb, like most others in its class. Powered by a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive runabout comes in either sedan or hatchback body styles. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, battery saver, wind-up windows and AM/FM radio cassette player. Higher models add a few items, such as body-coloured outer trimmings and power windows, along with electric mirrors, front fog lamps, driver's seat height adjustability, luggage undertray and central door locks. We could not verify what safety features are available besides seat belts, although we believe many markets get ABS brakes and front airbags, standard or otherwise.

The all-new Chevrolet Sonic is a sub-compact replacement for the Aveo. Available in sedan and hatchback body-styles, the Sonic is available in the GCC with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic function, with a 5-speed manual available in some markets. The base model comes with 5-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, fold-down rear seat, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, optional keyless entry and only one airbag. The mid-range LS model additionally gets steel wheels or optional 15-inch alloy wheels, optional sunroof, power windows, 4-way manually-adjustable driver's seat, better stereo with Bluetooth and more optional speakers, split-folding rear seat, optional parking sensors, optional ABS and two airbags. The top LT model additionally gets 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, standard ABS, 6-speaker stereo, and front as well as side airbags.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is a popular rear-wheel-drive roadster from Mazda. Completely overhauled for the 2016 model year, this purebred sports car is now powered by an all-new SkyActiv-G 2.0-litre four-cylinder motor, and mated to a 6-speed SkyActiv-Drive automatic transmission with paddle-shifters. There is a 6-speed manual variant available elsewhere, which is not offered in the GCC at the moment. Featuring the usual soft-top passed down from its predecessors, there is also a retractable hard-top variant known as the MX-5 RF (Retractable Fastback) available from 2017 model year. Besides a few kilos of weight, there are no significant differences between the soft and hard top variants, even in terms of performance. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 9 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, auto a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-key for keyless entry and ignition, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, navigation, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, LED headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind-spot monitoring, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats.

After a decade, Toyota launched a redesigned Land Cruiser for the 2008 model year. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a carryover 4.0-litre V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a carryover 4.7-litre V8 with a 5-speed auto, a rare 4.5-litre turbodiesel V8 with the 6-speed automatic version getting more power than the 5-speed manual version, and the new 5.7-litre version with a 6-speed automatic, launched in the GCC as part of a 2011 special-edition 60th anniversary model line that can optionally be had with the smaller V8 and V6 engines too, depending on market. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. Features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 17-inch alloy or steel wheels, smart key, start/stop button, optional parking sensors, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional leather, ABS brakes, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, and Bluetooth among other items. A limited-edition Land Cruiser "Xtreme" model, modified locally with fender flares, 17-inch wheels with beefy tyres and lifted suspension, became available for 2010, with any of the engine choices. Depending on market, the 2011 60th Anniversary special-edition features coloured roof rails, colour-matched rear mud guards, LED bumper lights and an optional bespoke spare tyre cover.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is a big 4WD that dates back to the 1992 version, relaunched with a new skin in 1998. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its reasonable on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder came for 2002, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A 4-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the 5-speed manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features.

The Jaguar F-Type SVR convertible is the top performance model trim. Under the hood, it gets the supercharged 5.0-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate, retractable rear wing spoiler, sports seats, dual-zone a/c, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. Performance upgrades include a high-performance braking system, an electronic rear-differential, and a sport-tuned suspension with adaptive dampers.

The Toyota Avanza got a facelift for the 2016 model year. It got a facelift in 2020. The rear-wheel drive Avanza, which is actually a rebadged Daihatsu, is a reasonably priced seven-seater minivan. Only the 1.5-litre engine will be offered in this region. It comes either with a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. In the UAE, an SE model is offered which features automatic transmission, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, A/C with rear vents, fabric seats, audio entertainment system with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support, audio controls on steering wheel, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. In Saudi Arabia, the same specs is sold as an XL model. The fleet spec model gets a manual transmission, 14-inch steel wheels, and does not get the fog lamps, mud guards, steering controls and chrome linings in the exterior. On the safety side it gets standard dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The third-generation Kia Cerato sedan boasts sleeker styling that is 30 mm longer, 15 mm lower and 5 mm wider than the outgoing car, with a 50 mm extended wheelbase. It also featured an all-new bodyshell, upgraded equipment, a host of additional convenience and safety features, a more spacious cabin with better quality, improved suspension and an upgraded powertrain line-up that delivers class-leading performance and fuel economy. In 2017, the Cerato got a facelift. No changes were made in 2018. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors. Safety features include ABS brakes, brake assist, stability control, and two front airbags.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. The real news is under the bonnet, with the all-new 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive, is enough to challenge exotic cars that cost three times as much. Each hand-built engine seems to vary by up to 60 horsepower. But the motor officially gained 7 hp by 2010 with minor tweaks. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Prices also vary wildly, as various dealers are heavily marking up what was supposed to be a 'budget' exotic car.

An all-new BMW X5 launched as a 2014 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X5 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X5 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. Models mostly include long-wheelbase versions for now, which are the S 350 L, the S 500 L and the S 600, all with automatic gearboxes. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Options include a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodystyling and either 19-inch or 20-inch light-alloy wheels.

The Suburban, alongside the shorter Tahoe, has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Suburban and Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Suburban, with better fuel economy to boot, but a bigger 6.0-litre V8 is available.
