The 5.3-litre's aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. The 6.0-litre V8 gets a 6-speed automatic. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Suburban is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The eight-seater Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, so it offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

For 2009, an underwhelming Audi S5 Quattro coupe model debuted, with a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed manual or an automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new Nissan Navara Pickup was released as a 2017 model year. In the GCC, the engines are carried over from the previous generation but with new transmissions. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, both of which come with either a 6-speed manual or 7-speed automatic transmission. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloy wheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signal lamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensing wipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment.

In 2015, the Audi A7 Sportback got a facelift. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. Almost 5 metres long with a low roofline, the Audi A7 Sportback is a full-sizer riding on 18-inch to 20-inch wheels, and as with all Audi sedans,  really rides a front-wheel-drive platform, with optional 'Quattro' all-wheel-drive tacked onto the higher trim levels. Three engines are on offer - 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 2.8-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre supercharged unit, all of which are mated to an 'S-tronic' 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system. Optional equipment include interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound.

The Japanese-built Tiida has been replaced by a Mexican-built version for the 2011 model year, the benefits of which include a lower price and more available features. Available as a 5-door hatchback or a 4-door sedan, the new-for-2011 Tiida is available with a standard 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine, with a 6-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. There is good head room and even tall passengers will find rear seat legroom as good as that in many much larger cars. Two trim levels are available, namely the 1.8S and the 1.8SL. Standard features on the 1.8S include electric power steering, tilt steering column, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch steel wheels, a/c with micro filter, trip computer and a CD/MP3 stereo with AUX input. Moving up the range to a 1.8SL adds cruise control, front fog lamps, power door mirrors and windows, leather-wrapped steering wheel and a wood-grain interior finish and optional 16-inch alloy wheels, among other items. On the safety front, only a driver-side airbag is standard, while ABS, EBD, Brake-Assist, passenger-side front airbag and side-curtain airbags are all extra-cost options.

The Ford F-150 is new from the ground up for 2015. Starting from its redesigned steel ladder-frame chassis, every aspect of the truck is new, including a shift to aluminium body construction and a general push towards "EcoBoost" turbocharged engines. Available in single cab, "SuperCab" quad-cab and "SuperCrew" double-cab body styles, engines on offer include a 3.5-litre V6, a 2.7-litre turbo V6, a 3.5-litre turbo V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, all with 6-speed automatics. Further configurations include a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive with low-range, while an "FX4" package can add offroad suspension, rear locking diff and skidplates to any model except the base one. Aside from the usual basic features such as power windows, keyless entry and electric mirrors, new features, depending on trim level, include remote tailgate locking and release, unique "BoxLink" tailgate attachment points that accept standard attachments used in moving trucks and trailers, stowable loading ramps that attach to the BoxLink points, optional LED headlights, optional all-around LED lighting including side-mirror "flashlights" and in-bed lighting, 170-degree opening half-doors on SuperCab models, flat rear load floor in SuperCab and SuperCrew cabins, 360-degree camera view, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot warning and even a panoramic sunroof. And it still has that built-in step in its tailgate to climb onto the bed, aside from new pop-out steps on the sides of the bed. Standard safety features include ABS, ESP, front and side-airbags, and optional rear inflatable belts.

The McLaren 570S gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S, but has 30% new components. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570S weighs just 1,313 kg and is longer than the 650S. It benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a new TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD and has been completely overhauled for 2008. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. For the GCC, a 3.0-litre V6 is standard, and it only gets a 4-speed automatic. The 2008 version's carryover V6 was replaced by an upgraded V6 for 2009, with more power and a 6-speed automatic. The Escape also comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, electric power steering, 15-inch steel wheels and CD stereo with iPod jack. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. The Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC Coupe 250 gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Lamborghini Urus is the Italian brand's SUV offering. As has long been the tradition at Lamborghini, the name Urus is derived from the world of bulls. The Urus is powered by a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The Lamborghini Urus adopts the rear-wheel steering introduced in the Aventador S over the whole speed range. The rear steering angle varies up to +/- 3.0 degrees, according to vehicle speed and driving mode selected: at low speeds the rear-axle steering angle is opposite to that of the front wheels (counter-phase steering), effectively shortening the wheelbase up to 600 mm for increased agility and a reduced turning circle for increased maneuverability. At high speeds the rear axle steering angle is in the same direction as the front wheels (in-phase steering), elongating the wheelbase up to 600 mm for increased stability and ride comfort as well as optimum driving dynamics. An optional Off-Road Package includes specific metal-reinforced bumpers and additional underfloor protection for off-roading in snow, forest or even dune surfing. The standard front DNA memory sport seats are fully electric, heated and 12-way adjustable. More luxurious, 18-way fully-electric front seats are available as an option, including features such as ventilation and massage. The rear bench seat as standard comes with a movable and folding seat back and ISOFIX fixings. Providing a five-seat configuration, the ability to fold and move the rear seat offers increased luggage capacity for daily use. The rear bench seat can be lowered to substantially extend the trunk space from 616 liters to 1.596 liters. As an option in conjunction with the fully-electric front seats, a more exclusive two-seat rear layout can be specified. The Lamborghini Smartphone Interface (LSI) allows fully integrated connection of iOS (Apple) and Android (Google) smartphones, supporting the Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The cabin is replete with high quality materials including the finest leather, Alcantara, aluminum, carbon-fibre and wood. The Lamborghini Urus Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) systems provide safety, security and driving assistance on level 2 (SAE scale). A High Beam Assistant automatically fades headlights in and out of high beam mode as required; front and rear parking sensors and cruise control are also included as standard, as is the PreCognition system preventing or mitigating collision. Optional ADAS systems include traffic management systems, top-view camera and a trailer coupling mode.

In 2016, the Ford ditched the naturally aspirated engines in the Focus, leaving only the turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder Ecoboost engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a manual a/c. Other features, available on higher models, include 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, leather upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, "sports" front seats, cruise control with speed limiter, sunroof, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights, LED tail lamps, footwell courtesy lights, and an optional park-assist system with parking sensors and the ability to control the steering automatically during parallel-parking. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

Maserati Levante is the Italian premium car maker's first venture into the SUV market. Under the hood is a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, available in two different tunes. Power is delivered to the wheels via an 8-speed automatic. Standard features on the all-wheel drive Levante include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, 4-zone AC, electric seats and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include interior leather packages, sports kit, roof rails, adaptive bi-xenon headlights, skid plate, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy rims. Safety features include 6 airbags, lane departure warning system, forward collision alert, blind spot monitor, adaptive cruise control and traction control.

An all-new Cadillac Escalade was revealed for 2015. The front fascia gets the new corporate design with the LED headlights. The engine under the hood will be the same 6.2-litre V8 engine, but tweaked to produce slightly more power than the previous model. Power is delivered through a new 10-speed automatic transmission. All-wheel-drive is standard, and low-range gearing is finally available. There will also be an extended version, based on the Chevrolet Suburban. Standard features include new electric power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic dual-zone A/C, power-adjustable pedals, Bluetooth, heated and ventilated seats, and cylinder deactivation. Standard alloy-wheel size is 20-inch, with 22-inch alloys as optional. The interior features a new centre console, which includes their CUE touchscreen interface. The six or seven seats configuration is still available on the new Escalade, with the rear seats having the ability to fold completely flat. Magnetic Ride Control has been added as well to improve ride quality. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS and stability control. A Driver Awareness package includes Forward Collision Alert, Lane Departure Warning System, and the patented Safety Alert Seat, which offers directional vibrations to alert the driver about potential crash threats. A Driver Assist package adds Full Speed Range Adaptive Cruise Control, Front and Rear Automatic Braking and Automatic Safety Belt Tightening. Additionally, Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Lane Change Alert are standard on higher models.

The H3 is the smallest addition to the Hummer line-up. Based on the Chevrolet Trailblazer platform, it is a midsized, five-passenger 4WD wagon that carries the military design cues and off-road capabilities of the Hummer H1, but puts them in a smaller and ultimately more affordable package. The H3 provides a good level of off-roading equipment, with luxury features to boot, and at a very good price. With rising petrol prices, the H3 is awkwardly marketed by touting its improved fuel economy for a Hummer, though still hardly impressive. The first-year 2006 models, built in USA, came with a 3.5-litre inline-5 briefly. The South-African-built 2007-onwards models come with a new 3.7-litre five-cylinder engine, with a standard five-speed manual or an optional four-speed automatic. The H3 delivers serious off-road capability, with low-range gearing and good ground clearance. The base price includes cloth seating for five, power windows and locks, remote keyless entry, a CD audio system, cruise control and all-terrain tyres on 16-inch wheels. Safety features include ABS brakes, traction control, frontal and side-impact airbags and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. Options include leather seating, chrome wheels, in-dash six-CD changer, navigation, a power sunroof and more.

The Mercedes-AMG GT 4-door Coupe came to existence in 2020. Under the hood, the GT 43 and GT 53 gets a 3.0-litre turbo V6 with 2 different tunes and the GT 63 S gets a V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine . Power is delivered in all variants through a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights and 19-inch alloy wheels. The GT 4-door also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT 4-door with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control. More advanced safety features include front collision alert, auto braking, lane departure warning alert, blind spot monitor, pedestrian alert, evasive steering assist, and parking assist.

All new Kia Rio came out for the 2018 model year. It is a slightly larger car from its predecessor so interior room has marginally gone up as well. Two 4-cylinder engines are available on the front-wheel drive 2018 Kia Rio hatchback - one a 1.4-litre and the other a 1.6-litre. Standard features on the Rio include power steering, power windows, central locking, halogen lamps, manual A/C, fabric seats, USB port and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher models get a 5.0-inch touchscreen audio system, 3.5-inch LCD screen on the instrument cluster, automatic A/C, leather seats, fog lamps and 15 inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features in the 2018 Kia Rio hatchback include ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, stability control, electronic brake distribution and brake assist.

The Scirocco is revival of Volkswagen's odd-shaped 1970s model that attempted to bridge the gap between a hatchback and a coupe. It last died out in 1992, until its revival as a concept car in 2006 and a production car by 2008. Debuting in the GCC as a 'sportier' alternative to the VW Golf, the Scirocco lifts platforms, engines and even interior panels from the Golf. However, the cabin itself has a lower roofline while retaining seating for four. Engines include a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder with both a supercharger and a turbocharger, as well as a 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. The GCC dealers will be pushing the automatic version locally, with the 'DSG' automanual gearbox, but it can be special-ordered with a 6-speed manual. A higher-tuned Scirocco R model became available in 2012, with more power, a body kit and firmer suspension. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

The Getz, new in 2003 and facelifted in 2006, is known for offering "European" levels of refinement. We feel it is let down only by its weak range of engines, namely a tiny 1.1-litre, followed by a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all four-cylinder units, some with a manual gearbox and others with an automatic. This front-wheel-drive hatchback comes standard with very little, but includes air-conditioning, a rear wiper with washer, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, and wind-up windows. Options in the higher trim levels include power steering, ABS brakes, a single airbag, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, sunroof, rear spoiler, fog lamps, keyless entry system, a radio and cassette player and fake carbon-fibre trim. The interior is well-made, with good materials. It is not too cramped inside either, with seating for five and decent legroom both front and back. All trim levels come with a cloth cabin and a useful rear luggage area with a lift-up tailgate. Small 14-inch steel wheels with plastic hubcaps.

An all-new Cadillac Escalade was revealed as a new model for 2015. The front fascia gets the new corporate design with the LED headlights. The engine under the hood will be the same 6.2-litre V8 engine, but tweaked to produce slightly more power than the previous model. Power is delivered through an 8-speed automatic transmission. All-wheel-drive is standard, and low-range gearing is finally available. There will also be an extended version, based on the Chevrolet Suburban. Standard features include new electric power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic dual-zone A/C, power-adjustable pedals, Bluetooth, heated and ventilated seats, and cylinder deactivation. Standard alloy-wheel size is 20-inch, with 22-inch alloys as optional. The interior features a new centre console, which includes their CUE touchscreen interface. The six or seven seats configuration is still available on the new Escalade, with the rear seats having the ability to fold completely flat. Magnetic Ride Control has been added as well to improve ride quality. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS and stability control. A Driver Awareness package includes Forward Collision Alert, Lane Departure Warning System, and the patented Safety Alert Seat, which offers directional vibrations to alert the driver about potential crash threats. A Driver Assist package adds Full Speed Range Adaptive Cruise Control, Front and Rear Automatic Braking and Automatic Safety Belt Tightening. Additionally, Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Lane Change Alert are standard on higher models.

Big and conservative, the Kia Mohave is supposed to strengthen Kia's "family" SUV line-up and brand image in the world market. With a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated with the 6-speed automatic transmission, the Kia Mohave is characterized by fully-independent air suspension and its various safety systems, including the ABS brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), brake assist, stability control, traction control, and front and side airbags. Furthermore, the Mohave is equipped with Downhill Assist Control, keeping the vehicle's speed steady while going down straight and strong slopes, while a Hill-Start Assist Control is also available. The Mohave comes with a 600W stereo with six-CD changer, seven-seater capability, cloth or leather trim, DVD player, reverse camera and all the usual power accessories. The Mohave rides on a  truck-like body-on-frame platform and comes with four-wheel-drive and low-range gearing, which allows it to be classified as an off-road vehicle by default.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The Grand Marquis is the longest running Mercury-badged vehicle ever. The mechanical underpinnings date back to the 70s, but a revision in 2003 involved a new frame, a revised independent front suspension, a new steering rack and rear suspension tuning. More updates in 2005 included a facelifted exterior, interior trim changes and more convenience features.The Grand Marquis is powered by a heavily detuned version of the Mustang's 4.6-litre V8 powerplant, mated to a four-speed automatic. If not obvious yet, the Grand Marquis is just a rebadged version of the Ford Crown Victoria. Features include three-person bench seats front and back, optional leather trim, a new instrument panel, burl woodgrain, a two-tone colour package and standard power windows. It is available in the Middle East in GS, GS Convenience, GS-L, LS Premium, LSE and LS Ultimate trims, at last count. A handling package, optional on GS and LS series, aims to improve the boat-like drive with 16-inch  aluminium wheels, a 3.27 axle, heavy duty rear stabiliser bar and rear air suspension with unique springs. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The C 63 AMG model is the sports model of the C-Class range. For 2012, a new coupe model was introduced for the first time alongside the sedan. The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG comes with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. The centre console comes with an electronic rotary switch for selecting the four transmission modes and the race start function. The sports seats are optionally available in single-tone or two-tone designo leather. A limited-edition C 63 AMG Coupe Black Series was briefly offered in 2012, with a higher-tuned engine, track-ready suspension, aggressive body kit and no speed limiter. In 2013, a special "Edition 507" version was offered with an uprated engine, identified by its black wheels and badges, with only 10 hp less than the aggressive Black Series and a higher-speed limiter. The C 63 AMG comes with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags.

The Audi RS 3 is the top performance trim for the A3 model. For the 2018 model year, it got a slight facelift, more power and reduced weight. Under the hood, the all-wheel-drive hatchback gets a turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the car include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start-stop engine button, Nappa leather upholstery, Bang & Olufsen sound system with sub-woofer, Bluetooth, USB/AUX support, front sports seats, front electric seats with 4-way lumbar support, rear folding back seats, fog lamps, rear spoiler and alloy wheels. Some optional features include Audi magnetic ride, 19-inch polished alloy wheels with matte titanium finish, 5-spoke rotor arm design, red brake calipers and roof rails with matte titanium look. Standard safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front airbags and knee airbags.

The Fortuner is Toyota's cheapest SUV offering. Although this Thai-built 4WD is based on a pickup, its styling is very softly finished, with none of its truck-like toughness showing. It has true off-road ability, thanks to four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. It also has space for five, or optionally seven, and its value-packed price has attracted families rather than desert junkies. The Fortuner is available here with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as a 4.0-litre V6 engine. Most markets offer four-wheel-drive as standard, but a two-wheel-drive version is also offered in Saudi markets. It has space for five adults and two kids. Features include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, and fabric upholstery, although the basic model is only offered in some GCC countries. Higher trim levels, which is standard now in the UAE, get fake wood, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear diff lock, ABS, multi-information display, 6-speaker CD stereo and optional leather. Top-spec Saudi models get HID headlights, power driver's seat and wi-fi features as well.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Bentley Mulsanne got a facelift and engine upgrades in 2015. The extra-large sedan has a turbocharged 6.75-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Power in the standard Mulsanne remains the same, with upgrades made to improve fuel efficiency. A Mulsanne Speed joined the lineup later on the year with the same engine, but tuned to give more power. The Mulsanne comes standard with a premium cabin treatment consisting of leather on every inch of the interior, supplemented by real wood and metal trim. Each car takes twelve weeks to produce, and customers have a choice of 114 paint colours, 21 carpet colours, 9 wood veneers and 24 interior leather hides, and be able to specify a custom colour scheme. Additionally, the car can be specified to feature a Naim 2200W audio system with MP3 compatibility, Bluetooth, iPod port and navigation. Further available features include powered massage seats, four-zone auto a/c, keyless start, HID headlights and more. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control and multiple airbags.

The XC70 was Volvo's first attempt at a 4WD vehicle. Based on a jacked-up V70 wagon with all-wheel-drive, it has been heavily revamped for the 2008 model year, although it is still not really that good off-road, and gets by on gravel and flat sand, given its fairly impressive ground clearance. It is powered by a 3.2-litre 6-cylinder engine, with an automatic offering tiptronic manual shifting. The second-row has a three-section bench seat with removable centre position for various setups. Standard features include keyless entry, CD player, trip computer, air-conditioning, xenon headlights, power windows, doors, locks, sunroof and mirrors. Available features also include leather or vinyl seats, ventilated front seats with perforated leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an optional rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, collision Warning with brake support and emergency brake lamps, adaptive cruise control helps keeping a safe distance to vehicles ahead, hydraulic brake assist, optimised hydraulic brakes and fading brake support. .

Available from early 2013, the "Mark 7" VW Golf may look the same, but is really completely new, the big news being several weight-saving enhancements that form the car. It got a facelift and new engine for 2018. Only the 1.0-litre 4-cylinder TSI engine unit was available mated to 7-speed "DSG" automanual transmissions. All Golf models now have touchscreen systems as standard, starting with a 5.8-inch colour display and rising to the range-topping satellite navigation system with 8-inch colour display that operates with finger gestures. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, power windows, keyless entry and such, with optional features such as sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, 5.8-inch touchscreen, fog lamps and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. Standard on all new Golf models is a multi-collision brake system which automatically brakes the vehicle after a collision, to reduce kinetic energy significantly and thus minimise the chance of a second impact. Other available electronic aids include adaptive cruise control and city emergency braking, both capable of applying full braking to a stop. Further options include a Driver Alert System that monitors the driver's inputs to detect any signs of tiredness, while a camera-operated Lane Assist system can help keep the car in a specific lane, providing countersteering assistance where necessary, while the Dynamic Light Assist system optionally masks the vehicle's high beam lighting to avoid dazzling oncoming traffic.

The B-Series is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines include a 2.2-litre and a 2.6-litre petrol engines, while the diesel offering is a 2.9-litre unit, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual, or even an automatic in some markets. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include overfender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

This is the second generation of Toyota RAV-4. Often credited with creating the soft-roader genre, th e RAV-4 is one of the most fuel-efficient crossover SUVs on the market. It has to be, given that it is powered by a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, it comes standard with all-wheel drive for the GCC. The RAV-4 has a unibody construction with all-wheel independent suspension, making it more of a car than any sort of offroader. It seats five, and is available with power windows, dual front airbags, cassette or CD player, keyless entry, 16-inch wheels, rear spoiler, optional ABS and sunroof, depending on model. The rear cargo door opens sideways, and has a spare tyre mounted on it, so the rear window does not open. Higher-trim models had body-coloured plastic body trim, which come in standard black on base models. In 2005, it became available with a cheesy locally-installed body kit that gave it a sporty low-rider look, although there were no mechanical changes.

The Mini Roadster is just a soft-top version of the Mini Coupe, which itself is the latest edition for 2012 to the ever-expanding Mini line-up. Based on the standard Mini, the only real difference is in the upper half. While the regular Cabrio had tight back seats, the Roadster ditches the rear seats completely. Models include the Cooper, the turbocharged Cooper S, and the upgraded turbocharged John Cooper Works. The Cooper uses a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with the S adding a turbocharger, and the JCW featuring an upgraded turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic for all except the JCW, which only comes with a manual. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. The John Cooper Works package bumps up the horsepower and handling. Further options on all Minis include bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

An all-new model of the BMW X5 came out in 2019. It is longer, wider and higher than the outgoing model. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Bugatti Chiron is a mid-engined two-seated sports car developed and manufactured in France. It is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron. It still carries from the Veyron is the 8-litre W16 quad-turbocharged engine, but it has been significantly upgraded. Like its predecessor, it has a carbon-fibre body structure, independent suspension and a Haldex AWD system.A 7-speed dual-clutch automatic routes power to all four wheels. This one is 82 mm longer, 40 mm wider and 53 mm higher than the Veyron, and is also 155 kg heavier. For 2021, a new variant, the Bugatti Chiron Pur Sport was revealed, which is a more track-focused version. The Chiron Pur Sport gets a new aerodynamic configuration generating more downforce while the lower weight increases agility. It also gets a close-ratio transmission, and high-performance tyres with a new material mix geared towards extreme grip.

The second generation Acura NSX made a comeback to the world after years of teasing in 2016. The NSX brings supercar looks and performance, with the advantage of being a daily driver. While the previous generation, which had ended back in 2007, had poor fuel economy, that department has massively improved thanks to its hybrid setup. Mechanically, the NSX gets a twin-turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to 3 electric motors, and mated to a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission with an all-wheel-drive system. Standard features in the 2-seater NSX include electric power steering, power windows, central locking, remote key access, engine start-stop button, cruise control with steering wheel buttons, leather and Alcantara upholstery, a mix of digital and analog instrument cluster, manual sports seats, dual-zone front A/C, adaptive suspension, backup camera, premium audio system which includes 8 speakers with subwoofer, 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, MP3/auxiliary input jack, USB audio interface, SMS text message function, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels in the front while gets 20-inch. Safety features include knee, side, curtain and front airbags, ABS, tyre pressure monitoring system, traction control, and vehicle stability control.

The Hyundai Sonata has received a complete makeover for the 2015 model-year, taking a more conservative approach to its styling while retaining mostly the same mechanical specs. All models come with a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. A new turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder was introduced later in 2015. The base model, known as Sonata GL in UAE, comes with 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and mirrors, fog lamps, keyless entry, rear camera, cruise control, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, ABS and one only airbag. The GL can be optioned up with 16-inch or 17-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, panoramic sunroof, leatherette steering, electric folding mirrors and a second passenger airbag. The top-spec Sonata GLS comes with auto a/c, subwoofer, front parking sensors, smart key with starter button, chrome door handles, blind-spot monitor, navigation, rear and side-rear sunblinds, electric parking brake, auto-dimming mirror, HID headlights with auto-levelling and washers, leather seats with front heating/ventilation, puddle lamps, solar glass, stability control and a total of 6 airbags. The Turbo Sport gets sports suspension, 18-inch alloy wheels and dual twin-tip exhaust mufflers. The front-grille is slightly different and it also gets LED daytime running lights. The interior gets a new 3-spoke steering wheel, gear knob, instrument cluster and interior trim, along with Turbo stitching.

The 407 is an oddity in the midsize car segment, with bold styling that puts form over function. The exterior features a long hood and a compact trunk, all of which compromises interior space. Available in four-door sedan, two-door coupe or five-door station wagon body styles, there are at least three engines littering the range. The entry level engine is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine combined with a 4-speed automatic with tiptronic sequential control. Then there is a 2.2-litre four-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Manual gearbox models have been discontinued here. The top model is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with an all-new 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. The sedan gets all engine options, while the SW wagon gets only the 2.0-litre. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 4-cylinder models get six airbags, while the V6 model gets as many as nine airbags.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets a major interior and exterior facelift for 2008. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models an upgraded 3.6-litre V6 engine. Engine choices also include the carryover 4.6-litre Northstar V8 and the 4.4-litre supercharged V8, the latter of which is reserved for the sporting STS-V. All engines hook up to a new six-speed automatic transmission, and all-wheel-drive is optional in the non-V models. The V8 models were cancelled after 2010. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, 17-inch or 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, automatic climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, rear parking assist, and a starter button. New technological features in the 2008 STS, available in some markets, include active steering technology in the StabiliTrak electronic stability control system, a Lane Department Warning System and Size Blind Zone Alert System. A Chinese-built long-wheelbase version of the rear-wheel-drive car, dubbed the SLS, is also available in Middle East markets.
A new generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class debuted as a 2022 model.

The V5 Crossover is aptly named, although we'd say it is more of a minivan segment player. From what we can gather from vague press materials, it aims to include all the comforts of a luxury car with the space and versatility of a wagon. The interior is beautiful in design, though the build quality is far from perfect. The centrally-mounted gauges and the fake wood trim are expected downsides. Powered by the same 2.4-litre four-cylinder Mitsubishi engine that serves most other Chery models, it comes with a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power windows, remote central locking, CD player with optional 6-disc changer, 16-inch alloy wheels, manual cloth seats or optional electric leather seats, dual front airbags with optional front-side airbags, ABS-assisted four-wheel-disc brakes with EBD, power mirrors, parking sensors, power steering, optional DVD navigation, sunroof and of course an alarm system should someone try to steal your Chery.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The goofy B-Class is touted as a Compact Sports Tourer, when it really is a tall hatchback. Though the A-Class is still in production, its sale seems to have been cancelled here, with this one taking its place. Mercedes-Benz is also touting their the sandwich concept, to which it credits the space-saving arrangement of the engine and transmission partly in front of and partly beneath the passenger cell, which in turn offers the interior spaciousness of larger saloons and estate cars despite its compact external dimensions. There is a height-adjustable load compartment floor, an asymmetrically divided, folding and removable rear seat unit plus an optionally removable front passenger seat, all of which allows conversion from a comfortable touring car to a practical van. Models include the B 150, the B 170, the B 200 and the B 200 Turbo, all four-cylinder, rear-wheel-drive, and available with a choice of manual or CVT automatic, plus all the creature comforts and safety features of a Mercedes-Benz.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

An all-new GMC Yukon was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. The more luxurious Denali version, identified by its chrome grille and trimmings, gets a 6.2-litre V8 debuting initially with a 6-speed automatic, but later upgraded to an 8-speed auto in late 2014. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The CLS, first launched in 2006, combines the elegance of a coupÃ© with the practicality of a saloon. Facelifted for 2008, Mercedes-Benz marketing folks like to incorrectly call it a coupe. Anyway, the CLS is a very expensive alternative to the car on which it is based, namely the E-Class. The CLS comes with an extensive list of standard features, including a 7-speed automatic transmission, ABS with stability program, CD radio with telephone keypad and 8 loudspeakers, cruise control with variable speed limiter, infrared remote control and visual locking-verification signal, speed-sensitive power steering, automatic climate control and two-stage front airbags and side bags, plus window bags. The new entry for 2008 is the CLS 280 with the 3.0-litre V6. Other models include an upgraded 3.5-litre CLS 350, the 5.5-litre CLS 500 and the 6.2-litre CLS 63 AMG, the latter two being new in 2007. Options include bi-xenon headlamps with Active Light System and cornering light function, COMAND control and display system for radio and navigation, Distronic proximity control, upholstery options, headlamp cleaning system, keyless start, parking sensors, semi-active air suspension, four-zone automatic climate control and a tyre pressure warning system.

The Dodge Neon returned to the GCC market in 2017. Under the hood, the front-wheel drive sedan is powered by a 1.6-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Three trims are available - the SE, SXT and SXT Plus. Standard features on the SE include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, remote key, manual A/C, steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, cruise control, audio system with radio and MP3/USB/AUX support, Bluetooth, 4 speakers, fog lamps with cornering function and 15-inch steel wheels. The SXT gets additional chrome grille, parking sensors, TFT instrument panel display, automatic A/C, navigation, audio system with 7-inch touch screen and 6 speakers, and 16-inch steel wheels. The SXT Plus gets front seat lumbar adjustment, rear head restraints, electrochromic rearview mirror, rain sensing wipers and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features are top-notch which include ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitoring system, driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, curtain airbags and hill-assist function.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. In 2017, the convertible joined the lineup. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

Named after its 5.6-litre V8 engine, the QX56 is based on the Nissan Armada, which is itself is based on a pickup truck platform. It is basically an upscale version of a less expensive model, although the QX56 does have unique styling. The QX56 four-wheel-drive system uses a part-time transfer case with low gear, with settings for rear-wheel-drive, 4-high and 4-low. Its three rows of seats can be ordered in seven- or eight-passenger configurations. The QX56 comes in a single trim line and includes a five-speed automatic transmission with tow/haul mode, heavy-duty skid plates, rear auto-levelling air suspension, 18-inch seven-spoke chromed alloy wheels, tyre pressure monitoring system, intelligent cruise control, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, LED tail and brake lights, power-operated liftgate with opening rear glass, rear proximity sensor,  leather interior, real wood trim, ten-way driver and eight-way power passenger heated seats, second-row heated seats, front and side airbags, automatic dual-zone climate control, navigation system with seven-inch LCD screen, and six-CD Bose system with ten speakers and wheel-mounted controls.

The Spark is a typical urban runabout based wholly on the Korean Daewoo Matiz, and is built in Korea too. It is a best seller in the supermini market, which is a market with few buyers in this region. The Spark is a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering just enough interior space for four inside a compact body. Its big windows and tight turning circle make it easy to park and cut through traffic, if you have the guts to cut in front of big 4WDs. The design tries to be cute, but unlike the Mini or the Beetle, this thing still looks like half a car. Inside, centre-mounted instruments greet you, as does cheap plastics. Depending on which of the upholstery fabrics and body colours is chosen, the displays have a blue, green or orange background. All interior mouldings and seating fabrics are robust but still cheap. It is powered by either a 0.8-litre three-cylinder or a 1.0-litre four-cylinder unit, and comes with a standard five-speed manual gearbox which features an all-new gearchange mechanism with damping for improved shift quality. A four-speed auto is optional. GM claims increased percentage of 'super steel' in the structure, but we'd still feel uncomfortable travelling in one of these.

The Volvo V60 Polestar is the top performance trim of the little wagon. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged and supercharged 2.0-llitre inline-4 cylinder engine for 2017, along with a new 8-speed automatic transmission, revised electric steering, slightly redesigned wheels and retuned suspension. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. It is available at very few GCC dealers.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. In 2009, a removable roof model was added to the lineup, called the Veyron Grand Sport. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The Chevrolet Aveo is the American brand's sub-compact offering, which is built in Korea. Features in this economy car include advanced dual-stage frontal airbags with passenger sensing system, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with bolt-on wheel covers on the base models or 14-inch alloy wheels on the top model, tilting front seat headrests, fabric interior  electronic throttle control and CD player. The Aveo comes in one trim and available as a four-door sedan. It is powered by a 1.4-litre in-line four-cylinder and come with a four-speed automatic.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro Convertible was launched for the 2017 model year. While the exterior may not be that different from the previous generation, under the hood the 3.6-litre V6 and 6.2-litre V8 engines have been upgraded with more power. In 2019, the Chevrolet Camaro Convertible got a facelift and some interior upgrades. In 2019, the V6 and V8 models got a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 6-speed manual transmission is only available on the V8 model. Standard features on the 2020 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features on the 2020 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

Acura made its entry into the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift for 2018, along with a new dual-screen user interface, complemented with a 7-inch touchscreen. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura TLX is their midsize luxury sedan offering. Under the hood, two engines are on offer - a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.5-litre V6 unit. The 4-cylinder engine is mated to a 8-speed automatic, while the V6 gets a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the TLX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, smart keyless entry, sunroof, auto-headlight system, LED daytime running lights, engine start-stop button, cruise control, power seats with lumbar support, dual-zone automatic A/C, entertainment system with AM/FM radio/CD/AUX/HDMI support, navigation, speakers & sub-woofer, hands-free telephone with voice recognition, heated & ventilated front seats, front & rear parking sensors, and rearview camera. The higher model gets push-button shifter, adaptive cruise control, and front & rear smart keyless entry. Standard safety features on the TLX include front, side curtain & knee airbags, all-wheel steering, ABS, agile handle assist (AGH), blind spot indicator, vehicle stability assist (VSA) and hill-start assist. The higher model gets lane-keeping assist system, crash mitigation brake system, forward collision warning system, road departure mitigation system and low speed following system.

Considering the Seat range was made up exclusively of hatchbacks by 2010, the Exeo is a desperate attempt at expanding the line-up with an addition of a regular sedan. The VW accomplished this in the cheapest possible way by moving the tooling for their old pre-2008 A4 sedan to the Seat factory in Spain, and simply giving the car a frontal and rear facelift. The Audi connection is obvious on the rest of the car, and the standard engine for the GCC is the usual VW-sourced turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a CVT transmission and front-wheel-drive. The five-seater sedan comes with power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo, alloy wheels and more. Available features include sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, dual-zone automatic a/c, power-adjustable front seats and fog lamps, among other items. Standard safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, front airbags, side and curtain airbags.

The Haval H9 is the Chinese brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed ZF automatic transmission. Standard features on the H9 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop button, xenon headlamps, front and rear fog lamps, leather seats, infotainment system with touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, radio, AUX-in, USB, CD player and GPS. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The F430 is heavily influenced by F1 Racing technology, and makes it known to everyone openly. The F430's compact 4.3-litre V8 engine offers blistering high-revving performance, and the experience is enhanced by an optional F1-style paddle-shifting gearbox which has made its way to every other Ferrari model too. The F430's aerodynamics are honed to generate special flows to increase downforce and improve cooling. One technical feature is the electronic differential, transferring massive torque levels to the track under high cornering g-forces, and guarantees maximum grip out of bends, eliminating wheel spin. The larger interior can be personalized with carbon-fibre or aluminium inserts, with space behind the seats accessed using an electrically operated compartment. The standard electric seats can be substituted by more sporting items with four-point harnesses to order. Even with all this the interior is noticeably barebones in keeping with its sporting nature. For 2008, a more powerful, lighter and track-focussed F430 Scuderia was introduced, with a faster clutchless-manual gearbox and other chassis enhancements.

The Infiniti G37 Convertible convertible with a folding hard-top debuted in early 2010. The sedan then received a frontal facelift for 2011. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. It is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Legacy is the fifth-generation model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive sedan. Like all Subaru models for more than a decade, the Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and gets an entirely new design for 2010, featuring a larger body and carryover engines. Not all engine choices are offered in all countries however. The base Legacy 2.0R comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder while the Legacy 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, both boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 2.5 GT, with a turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated to a paddle-shifted 5-speed automatic, and externally identified by its bonnet scoop. By 2012, the 2.0R was discontinued, leaving the 2.5i and the GT. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The all-new M4 Convertible came out as a 2015 model year and is the replacement for the M3 Convertible. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

An all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz GLE-Class came out in 2019. In the GCC, only the GLE 450 is currently available. Under the hood, it gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine with EQ boost technology. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and a choice of 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers, depending on trim level, leather upholstery, wood trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, optional keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. An AMG package is optional, and it adds a body kit and sportier suspension.

The Jaguar F-Type Coupe hit showrooms in mid-2014, joining the range almost a year after the Roadster's launch. It comes with two supercharged 3.0-litre engine choices, in V6 and V6 S form, as well as with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8, in V8 R form, the latter more powerful than the V8 S Roadster. There is no V8 S version for the Coupe. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive. Components include adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. The F-Type R Coupe additionally gets a new electronic active differential and a torque vectoring system, as well as larger brakes with optional carbon-ceramic discs.

When the new Nissan Patrol was launched in 2010, the carmaker elected to keep producing the older-generation Patrol Safari alongside the new one. It remains the same for the 2021 model year. The long-running Safari continues to be Nissan's best four-wheel-drive model. It gets the 4.8-litre inline 6-cylinder engine as standard, with the choice of a 5-speed automatic with tiptronic or a proper 5-speed manual. It is available as a 3-door and a 5-door model. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol also has a decent interior featuring quality materials, wood trim, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, fog lamps, 16-inch wheels and other equipment. In 2017, the Patrol Super Safari trim was introduced which comes with new tan leather seats and door trim with 8-way power seats for the driver and 4-way for the front passenger. New features include a navigation system as well as front and rear parking sensors with rear view camera, Bluetooth, USB, CD, AUX input and FM/AM radio. The vehicle comes equipped with automatic climate control and a built-in refrigerated cool box. The Super Safari can be distinguished from other Patrol models by its unique machine-cut 17-inch black alloy wheels, dual-tone body colour, a rear spoiler and a Super Safari body stripe. In 2021, additional dual-tone colour schemes were offered on the Super Safari.Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, the wagon model has room for seven. A sunroof and an electric front winch are optional. In late 2018, a trio of locally-modified versions were introduced -- the Falcon with chrome trim and leather; the Gazelle with a 2-inch lift kit, remote-reservoir shocks, fender flares and snorkel; and the Gazelle X with a 4-inch lift kit, off-road wheels, regeared diffs, metal bumpers, boot drawer set, louder exhaust and more. These versions will be built based on demand.Stability control and a tyre-pressure monitor are standard now, as per current regulations. Dual front airbags, ABS, an immobiliser and cruise control are also included, as are the classic rear locking differential, as well as front and rear-pintle tow hooks.

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Later in 2017, a 6.6-litre V12 engine was added to the lineup with all-wheel drive, called the M760Li. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The new Taurus, while still based on the Five Hundred platform, actually has reduced interior volume due to its stylised exterior. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive was offered from late 2011. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are optional.

The Opel Meriva is the German manufacturer's MPV offering. The Spanish-built Meriva has been around since 2010 but only made its Middle East debut in 2013. It gets a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Standard features in the Meriva include power steering, power windows, AM/FM/CD player with MP3/AUX support. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags and ABS.

An all-new BMW X6 launched as a 2015 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X6 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X6 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

The Peugeot RCZ received a minor facelift for 2013. The RCZ is a racy sports car built on the 308 hatchback's foundations, but featuring a futuristic coupe body. This front-wheel-drive 2-door can be had with a turbocharged 1.6-litre mated to either a 6-speed manual in the THP200 model or a 6-speed automatic in the THP156. The THP200 makes more power than the THP156, but only the latter is offered in most GCC markets now. Standard features include 19-inch alloy wheels, active rear spoiler, electric leather sports seats with memory, leather dashboard, cruise control with speed limiter, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/iPod connectivity, Bluetooth phone, auto dual-zone a/c, cooled glove box, electric mirrors with automatic-tilting on reverse, power windows, auto-dimming rear-view mirrors, automatic wipers, auto headlights, keyless entry, puncture repair kit, front and rear parking aid with screen display, and aluminium pedals. Also available is a navigation system in the top version. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, front and rear fog lights, and hill-start assist on the manual version. The manual THP200 also has slightly sportier suspension tuning, some shorter gearing and bigger front brakes.

The Kia Rio is all-new for the 2012 model year. Attractively designed, it is available in 4-door sedan and 5-door hatchback form. The only engine for the GCC is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with variable-valve timing, mated to a 4-speed automatic. While mechanically basic, the Rio can be had with a host of features unseen in the sub-compact segment. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, adjustable steering wheel, central locking, power windows, electric mirrors and only one airbag. The mid-range model gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, centre-console armrest, fog lamps, keyless entry, USB port, Bluetooth, steering-wheel audio controls, sun-visor lights, folding mirrors with indicators and a split-folding rear seat. The top model gets rear parking sensors, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, padded leatherette door trim, LED front running lights and tail lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, more speakers for the stereo, cruise control, cooled glovebox, auto headlights, sunroof, and finally, ABS and a passenger-side airbag in addition to the driver's one. The Rio is offered in Europe and the States with full front-side-curtain airbags and stability control, and has a 5-star crash-test rating in Europe, but that model is not sold in the GCC.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily redesigned for 2003, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and third-row seat, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. The interior was different from its Ford cousin, with faux satin-nickel trim and real wood inserts.
