Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, sports suspension and other options.

The 2015 Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift. It remained the same in 2017. The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. Powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a multimedia entertainment system, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

Supposed to be Peugeot's flagship model, the 607 offers premium levels of refinement and equipment. First launched in 2002 and mildly facelifted a few times, the 607 was the first Peugeot sedan to push design boundaries, but lost out in drive due to an unremarkable front-wheel-drive chassis. The 607 was restyled in 2004, and still looks good as ever. Among the exterior cosmetic changes, the front of the 607 was restyled and its overall length increased slightly, but it is still not big enough to qualify as a full-size car. The interior of the 607 is more spacious than any other Peugeot model. The only engine is a 3.0-litre V6 with a six-speed automatic transmission with tiptronic function. Standard features include bi-zone digital air conditioning with climate control, a heat reflective windshield and lightly tinted glass, leather with aluminium detailing, electrically-adjustable front seats, and power windows, locks and mirrors. It is well-equipped in terms of passive safety, with eight airbags as standard, including front-and-rear side and curtain bags.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, followed by the C-Class. The Mercedes-AMG E43 is a performance model and gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The GAC GS8 is the Chinese brand's midsize SUV offering. The body of the GS8 is made completely of 95% high-strength steel to meet the North American SUV roof anti-force standard. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The 2017 GAC GS8 is available as a front wheel drive or four wheel drive. Standard features in the 2017 GAC GS8 includes power steering, power windows, power folding side mirrors, rain sensing wipers, HID auto headlights, LED tail-lamps, front and rear fog lamps, 10-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with 6 speakers, Bluetooth, USB port, steering wheel with audio and phone controls, sunroof, rear view camera system, front and rear parking sensors, keyless entry, smart key and button starter, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get engine start stop, LED auto headlights, interior ambient lighting, side mirror memory function, navigation, 10 speakers, panoramic sunroof, wireless charging and 19-inch alloy wheels. The 2017 GAC GS8 integrates intelligent driving assistance such as a 9th-generation extreme edition of ESP (Electronic Stability Program), an optional 360-degree panorama visual imaging system, an optional ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) system and standard eight airbags. Other safety features include ABS, hill start assist and hold control, hill descent control, and optional lane change assist system.

The Alto is a tiny hatchback originally conceived as a "kei" car for the Japanese market, meaning it had to be restricted to this tiny size to qualify for tax breaks in Japan. Built in India since 2004, for foreign markets it is powered by a tiny 1.1-litre engine driving the front wheels through a five-speed manual or a three-speed automatic. The suspension is made up of MacPherson struts and coil springs at the front and Suzuki's isolated trailing link and coil spring system at the rear.Very popular in India, it offers low fuel consumption, low maintenance costs and even safety features such as dual airbags, side impact beams and even seat belts. It offers enough seating for four people as well as their wallets in the rear luggage compartment. Available features, standard or optional, include front power windows, cloth upholstery, power steering, central locking, CD player and steel wheels with plastic hubcaps. Parking one of these things is easy in tight city streets, but it could run out of breath on the highway fast lane. The new version of the Alto was launched during the summer of 2009, and is being sold in the GCC as the Celerio alongside this old Alto.

The Cadillac XT6 is the luxury brand's midsize SUV offering. It comes equipped with a 3.6-litre V6 engine, which is the only engine option, and a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the XT6 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, push start button, AM/FM stereo with 8-inch diagonal color information display, 7 speakers, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, parking sensors with rear camera, sunroof, LED headlamps and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment includes Bose Sound System, "Technology Package" which includes Air Ionizer, 8-inch diagonal color reconfigurable gauge cluster, head-up display, power rake, and telescoping steering column and wireless charging, 20-inch diamond cut alloy wheels, interior ambient lighting, navigation, AM/FM stereo with connected navigation providing real-time traffic, 8” diagonal color information display, one type A and one type C full function USBs, personalized profiles for each driver’s settings, Natural Voice Recognition (English only) and NFC (Near Field Communications) mobile device pairing. Safety features include airbags - dual-stage frontal, knee and seat-mounted side-impact for driver and front passenger; head-curtain for all outboard seating positions with rollover protection, stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor and ABS. Optional safety features include "Driver Awareness Package", which includes Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking, Front Pedestrian Braking, Following Distance Indicator, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and IntelliBeam. Also available is a "Driver Assist Package", which includes Adaptive Cruise Control, and Forward and Reverse Automatic Braking.

All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions.  It gets a 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 7-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The T-Series, also known as the Chevy LUV sometimes, is a range of light pickup trucks that are actually rebadged models from Isuzu. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are these nifty stickers along the sides that hint at the T's non-sporting intentions. On a serious note, if these things came with a bigger engine and an automatic gearbox, we'd totally buy one in black, outfit it with big wheels, slap on some black-out tint and build a cheap blingmobile to cruise the streets in style.

Quietly put on the showroom floor by local Hyundai dealers, the unknown i30 is a new-for-2008 hatchback alternative to the Elantra. Powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the i30 is being positioned as a cheaper alternative to better-equipped compact Japanese and European rivals. It is available with only a 4-speed automatic gearbox. The i30 benefits from a spacious-enough interior and the flexibility of a hatchback cargo area, especially with the folding rear seatback. Standard features are limited, with height-adjustable front seats, 60/40 split rear seats, cloth or partial leatherette seats, power windows, electric mirrors, body-coloured exterior trim and LED cabin lighting. Other available features include keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with USB support, fog lights, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. The i30 was originally designed to compete in the European market, so it benefits from tighter suspension tuning and better cabin materials. Sadly, GCC-spec cars are underequipped, especially in terms safety, as there is only one standard airbag and no ABS brakes.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The Lotus Exige S is a super-light sports coupe with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine. It gets go-kart handling, thanks to its light weight as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. It is only available with a 6-speed manual gearbox, although an automatic is expected to come later. Standard features for the GCC include leather seats, plain black leather sun-visors, lightweight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand brake sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. There are two new interior package options available: Premium and Premium Sport. The Premium Pack provides added comfort and style where as the Premium Sport option focuses on creating an internal space optimised for ultimate driver involvement. Built for the adrenalin hungry sportscar aficionado, the Lotus Exige S features high performance bespoke tyre package with Pirelli P-Zero Corsa tyres as standard. A Lotus DPM (Dynamic Performance Management) switch allows the driver to switch between three driving modes: Touring, Sport and DPM off. And if three dynamic settings are not enough, an additional Race Pack option is available which adds a fourth driving mode setting: Race. This setting provides the maximum possible traction out of corners. The Race Pack also features Launch Control and an optimised suspension setting making the car perfect for letting rip on the track. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The ZNA Rich is a midsize pickup available in single and double-cab body styles, with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. In 2017 it got a facelift. Features include a 5-speed manual, 15-inch steel wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes, power steering, adjustable steering column, central locking, power windows, power mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and SD card, manual antenna, manual a/c and front seat belts.

The Murano attempts to combine the smooth ride and responsive handling of a car, the cargo space of a wagon, and the high driving position of a 4WD, and it succeeds on all counts. What it loses out on is off-road ruggedness, though that matters to few buyers. The Murano can be considered a crossover vehicle, with its 4WD looks and car-like drive, but we'll leave the 4WD classification for vehicles which truly cannot be categorised anywhere. The Murano delivers decent performance, thanks to the same 3.5-litre V6 engine that is used in the 350Z sports car, but detuned and mated to an CVT automatic gearbox in this application. The CVT is a high-tech automatic that actually has no gears to shift, while offering superior gas mileage compared to a regular auto. This Nissan does not have three rows of seats, so it accommodates only five passengers. Standard equipment on all three versions includes dual-zone automatic temperature control, a good CD audio system, power windows with auto up/down feature in front, keyless remote entry, reclining rear seats, and large 18-inch alloy wheels. Only dual front airbags are offered, with no side-airbags available.

The Honda CR-V is roomy little 4WD that is convenient and easy to drive on the streets, but no hero on the rough stuff. There lots of stuff in it and the back seats are quite comfortable. It rides as smoothly as a car, especially since it is based on the Civic. It offers the cargo versatility of a sport utility, an upright seating position, and all-wheel drive. Besides being less expensive, the CR-V is smaller and more maneuverable than a full-sized 4WD. The styling was revised for 2005. The CR-V comes with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine lifted from the Accord, now with only a five-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning with micron filtration, AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with 6-CD changer, an adjustable steering column, power mirrors, power windows, front and rear power outlets and a removable folding picnic table, along with front airbags, integrated keyless entry and 16-inch steel wheels. Aluminium alloy wheels are available, as is a moonroof, leather and cruise control.

New from the ground up for 2006 and much more better-looking, the M-Class, which actually uses the ML moniker, is a better on-road and off-road 4WD now. The ML 63 AMG is the top performance variant and it uses a 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic. Features include AMG alloy wheels, leather upholstery, tyre pressure loss warning system, crash sensors, front and side airbags, CD radio with pre-installation for mobile phone and more.

The Toyota Prado got a minor facelift for 2014, with a redesigned front-end and other trim changes. The only engine available with the short-wheelbase 3-door variant is a carryover 2.7-litre 4-cylinder with an automatic gearbox. It is only available in some markets, such as the UAE in GXR trim; and Bahrain in TX and TXL trim. It gets standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing and a locking centre-differential. In the UAE, the Prado 2.7L GXR comes with 17-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, rear spoiler, mud guards, fabric seating for five, keyless entry, front and rear manual a/c, CD/MP3 6-speaker stereo, ABS with EBD and brake-assist, dual front airbags, cool box, steering audio controls, USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, smart keyless entry and start, leather steering wheel and shift lever, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, front fog lamps and some other basic features.

JAC J4 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact offering. Under the hood is a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features for the J4 include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, keyless entry, fog lamps, AM/FM radio with USB, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Safety features include dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The all-new 2018 Volkwagen Arteon replaces the ageing Passat CC. Built on a new platform and featuring an entirely new fastback design, the Arteon is dimensionally a tad larger than its predecessor, and a whole lot more charismatic. Featuring an improved turbocharged 2.0-litre engine, the Arteon boasts power and performance figures similar to the V6 unit in the CC it replaces. Notable features include 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster display, 9.2-inch capacitive touchscreen infotainment system with gesture control, heads-up display, ventilated power seats with massage function and memory preset, adaptive dampers, leather interior, LED headlamps and tail lamps, and DRL. Safety tech includes multitude of airbags, blind spot monitor, traction and stability control systems, parking assist, pre-crash safety system, and   the innovative Emergency Assist system which automatically pulls over the car to the side if it cannot detect any response from the driver for a certain period of time.

The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe was launched as a 2015 model year. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 428i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Jaguar F-Type is a two-seater convertible based on a shortened XK platform. It comes with two supercharged engine choices, one a 3.0-litre V6 and the other a 5.0-litre V8. The V6 has two variants with the higher model, known as the S, getting more power. The V8 only comes in R form. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive. It gets adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The roof is said to close or open in 12 seconds. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more.

The Chery Arrizo 7 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering in a tough market dominated by the Japanese. Under the hood, the Arrizo 7 gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 5-speed manual gearbox or a CVT automatic. The suspension has been tuned by British sports car company Lotus. Standard features on the Arrizo 7 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, manual A/C, radio with CD/AUX/USB/Bluetooth support, fabric seats and steal wheels. The higher models get sunroof, cruise control, leather seats, automatic A/C, rear-view camera, 7-inch screen and alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

The XC90 is Volvo's first proper 4WD vehicle, and a fairly good one at that. The seven-seater is powered by either a 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbo, a 3.2-litre V6 or a 4.4-litre V8, all with an automatic with tiptronic function. The V8 came only in 2005. Among the three rows of seats, the second row moves front and back offering adjustable legroom, while the foldable third row seats can be tucked away to increase luggage space. Standard features include keyless entry, 17-inch wheels, CD player, trip computer, rear air-conditioning, power windows, doors, locks and mirrors, and an eight-way power driver's seat with memory. Available features also include leather seats, a power front passenger seat, memory mirrors, a power moonroof, upgraded audio with a six CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels and self-leveling rear suspension. A sports package adds 19-inch rims, stiffer suspension and some trim pieces. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, and a rollover protection system.

The all-new Nissan Pathfinder competes in the hotly-contested midsize crossover segment. The 7-seater Pathfinder is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT and a choice of either front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive in all trim levels. The all-wheel-drive model gets a selector for choosing 2WD, 4WD or Auto. The base Pathfinder S comes standard with a second-row 60/40-split fold-flat bench seat, a third-row 50/50-split fold-flat reclining bench seat, 18-inch alloys, tri-zone automatic a/c, keyless entry with push-button ignition, power windows, CD/MP3/DVD/HDD audio system with 6 speakers, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth phone, auto headlights, 6 airbags, stability control, tyre-pressure monitor and apparently a standard power liftgate in some markets. The Pathfinder SV adds power-adjustable front seats, 7-inch QVGA colour monitor, rear camera, 20-inch alloy wheels, remote starter, auxiliary audio/video input jack, power windows with front one-touch auto-up/down, front fog lamps, chrome body side trim, welcome lighting, stainless-steel kick plates, speed-sensitive intermittent wipers, illuminated sun-visor mirrors, sunroof, wood-tone trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, leather seats, and a tow hitch receiver with 7-pin trailer tow wiring harness on the rear bumper. The top-spec Pathfinder SL further adds a key-linked memory seat and other settings for individual drivers, side-curtain airbags front and rear, digital compass, 9GB hard drive, 8-inch VGA colour monitor with navigation, Bose audio system with 12 speakers, climate-controlled front seats, and a power-tilt/telescoping steering column. An around-view four-camera parking aid is optional, as is a rear DVD entertainment system with 2 screens. Available accessories include roof rail bars, rear-installing tent and more.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 was launched in 2017. In 2020, it received a slight facelift and small increase in power. It came with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 engine. It comes with an 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry, heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system with touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 20-inch ones for the ZL1. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Wrangler has been redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The all-new real jeep is longer and wider and more refined. Now powered by a 3.8-litre V6, with a manual or automatic, it still offers low-range gearing and off-road capability. In 2011, the interior was redesigned completely, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were offered. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

The Brilliance FRV is the Chinese company's sub-compact hatchback offering.  The FRV Cross has been around since 2009, but only made its debut in the UAE in 2013. It comes with 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the FRV include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, radio with single CD player and MP3/USB support, and steel wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Abarth 695 Rivale is a tribute to the Riva brand, a famous luxury boat manufacturer. The bodywork is presented in a two-tone blue and grey colouring, separated by a “Waterline” in Aquamarine colour. The intent is to give the idea of the sky that meets the grey asphalt, separated by a thin line that represents the sea. Door sills, dashboard and some details of the steering wheel, are covered with mahogany wood. It gets the UConnect multimedia system with a 7-inch screen, compatible with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Under the hood, it gets a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to an Abarth 5-speed automatic transmission. The engine note is enhanced with the addition of an Akrapovic exhaust system. Safety standards are high with the Abarth 695 equipped with seven airbags as standard equipment. It also gets ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESC), anti-slip regulation (ASR) system, the Hill Holder devices and hydraulic brake assistance (HBA) to help with emergency stops.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The Citroen C4 is the compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Only one engine option is available, which is the naturally aspirated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, heated power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, daytime running headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD player/AUX and MP3 capability, front fog lamps with cornering capability, hill-start assist and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features are good as it gets front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA) and Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) with traction control.

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the MDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, roof rack, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power seats with lumbar support, 3 rows for 7 seaters, 3-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 12 speakers, DVD player with Dolby Pro Logic II (PL2)/MP3/WMA/USB/AUX support & 100 GD hard-disk, handsfree telephone with voice recognition, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard. The higher model gets adaptive cruise control, premium MILANO leather and bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the MDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), traction control, hill-start assist and trailer stability assist. The higher model gets additional blind spot information, crash mitigation brake system & forward collision warning system.

An all-new Audi S4 made its debut in the UAE and GCC in 2020. Under the hood, the all-wheel-drive S4 gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The S4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Hyundai Sante Fe comes to the UAE and GCC as a seven-seater version. While it competes with compact crossover SUVs, it is only slightly smaller than most midsize SUVs. It comes with a choice 2 engines - the 'Theta' 4-cylinder 2.4-litre and the 'Lambda' V6 3.3-litre. Two-wheel drive is standard in the 2.4-litre base model, while all the other trims are in four-wheel drive in the higher 2.4-litre and 3.3-litre models. Some of the optional features include panoramic sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, reverse camera, leather seats, memory seats with cooling & heating for front passengers, memory package for mirrors with auto folding, smart key with engine start, automatic lights and rain sensing wipers. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution(EBD) and traction control.

The Chery Arrizo 7 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering in a tough market dominated by the Japanese. Under the hood, the Arrizo 7 gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 5-speed manual gearbox or a CVT automatic. The suspension has been tuned by British sports car company Lotus. Standard features on the Arrizo 7 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, manual A/C, radio with CD/AUX/USB/Bluetooth support, fabric seats and steal wheels. The higher models get sunroof, cruise control, leather seats, automatic A/C, rear-view camera, 7-inch screen and alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

The Accord may not be best in class for every little thing, but its all-rounder package makes it popular among consumers. The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, and now offered in an American-built coupe form as well. The coupe debuted in the middle of 2008. It's offered with either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. The 2.4-litre in the coupe has a bit more power than the one in the sedan. All trims get a five-speed automatic only. Standard features on all models include power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, cruise control, CD/MP3 player with steering wheel controls, dual front airbags, ABS brakes, head restraint system and keyless entry. Optional features available in higher models include 17-inch alloys, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps.

The new-for-2011 Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

The Camaro continued with minor changes for 2013. The ZL1 gets a supercharged 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed manual or automatic. StabiliTrak traction control and front-side airbags are standard. There is a new frameless rearview mirror for 2013 as well. In 2015, it got a slight facelift, with the major change being the rear taillights. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and a new MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2018. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

Mini released all-new Clubman model as a 2016 model. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. Unlike the old one, this one features proper 4 doors on the side. The Mini Cooper Clubman will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S Clubman gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The Cooper can be  had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the Cooper S Clubman is available with a 6-speed manual gear or an 8-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The BT-50 is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines for the B-Series include 2.2-litre and 2.6-litre petrol engines, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include plastic fender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

An all-new model of the Toyota Camry made its debut in 2018 in the GCC. The 2020 Toyota Camry has three engine choices - a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic transmission, a 3.5-litre V6 coupled to an 8-speed automatic transmission and 2.5-litre hybrd engine connected to a CVT. The 2020 Toyota Camry base model has 16-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 17-inch and 18-inch alloys. Base features, depending on the market, include a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags, as standard. The upper trims offer dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, stability control, side airbags, sunroof, DVD navigation, smart keyless start and navigation. In the UAE, the Sport variant gets a body kit, quad exhaust tips, paddle shifters and unique seats.

Ford brought back the Bronco name in the lineup, releasing a new model for 2021. The proper off-road SUV will have two Ecoboost engine options - a 2.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a 2.7-litre turbocharged V6 engine, both mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission or 7-speed manual.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

The 2020 Toyota Fortuner shares the same underpinnings as the Toyota Hilux. However, the design is much more pleasing than its commercial cousin and also more comfortable, thanks to tweaks made to the suspension. The advantages of sharing a pickup chassis gives it superior off-road ability, as it gets four-wheel drive and low-range gearing. Customers can add two extra seats at the back at the expense of luggage space, if they want a 7-seater, making the Forturner a firm family-favourite here in the GCC.  The 2020 Toyota Fortuner is available here with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as a 4.0-litre V6 engine. Some markets such as in Saudi Arabia, there is a 2.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine option as well. Most markets such as the UAE offer four-wheel-drive as standard, but a two-wheel-drive version is available in KSA markets. Standard features for the 2020 Fortuner include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo system with USB port, and fabric upholstery, although only few GCC countries get the basic model. Higher trim levels get replica wood panels, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear-diff lock, ABS, multi-information display, 6-speaker CD stereo and optional leather upholstery. Top-spec of the 2020 Toyota Fortuner in Saudi Arabia models get additional features such as HID headlights, power driver's seat and wi-fi features.

The Mercedes-Benz A-Class got a facelift in 2016. Offered in one version, the A 250 is powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. It got a very slight power boost in 2016, along with interior updates. A manual gearbox was also introduced in 2016, but only available in the GCC through special order. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Hyundai Sante Fe comes to the UAE and GCC as a seven-seater version. While it competes with compact crossover SUVs, it is only slightly smaller than most midsize SUVs. It comes with a choice 2 engines - the 'Theta' 4-cylinder 2.4-litre and the 'Lambda' V6 3.3-litre. Two-wheel drive is standard in the 2.4-litre base model, while all the other trims are in four-wheel drive in the higher 2.4-litre and 3.3-litre models. Some of the optional features include panoramic sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, reverse camera, leather seats, memory seats with cooling & heating for front passengers, memory package for mirrors with auto folding, smart key with engine start, automatic lights and rain sensing wipers. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution(EBD) and traction control.

In 2013, the Audi R8 got a facelift. The R8 is German brand's two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. In mid-2009, a 5.2-litre V10 engine was introduced. In 2013, the R8 V10 plus was introduced. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or a new 7-speed S-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. However in most GCC countries, the manual gearbox is only offered on the V8, possibly on special order. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Convertible replaced the 3-series convertible model. It is offered as two variants in the GCC. The 428i features a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 motor. Both are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The new BMW 4 Series Coupe is visibly larger in width and wheelbase than the outgoing BMW 3 Series Coupe. The BMW 4 Series Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and stability control.

The fifth-generation BMW 7-Series was all-new for the 2009 model year and facelifted for 2013. The first models to be relaunched include the 730Li, the 740Li, the 750Li, and the 760Li, all long-wheelbase variants as most GCC dealers chose to import only the stretched models. The confusing naming convention continues, with the 740i and 740Li powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-6 engine and the 750i and 750Li powered by an updated 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, although the 730i and 730Li models get a naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline-6. The limited-availability 760Li gets a 6.0-litre turbo V12. Badge deception notwithstanding, all engines are capable performers, featuring Double-VANOS variable valve technology, direct injection, and a new 8-speed automatic. The range come equipped with EfficientDynamics technologies as standard, all aimed at improving fuel economy. All 7-Series can now be specified with a side-view camera system, Park Distance Control, two forward-facing cameras, night-vision system, a pedestrian recognition system, blind-spot warning, a heads-up display, speed-related active steering, variable air-suspension damping control, stability control, hill-start assistant, ABS, brake drying, brake-fade compensation, iDrive with larger 10.2-inch screen, instrument cluster with a high-resolution colour display, navigation, 8 GB hard drive, rear-seat DVD entertainment with integrated screens, four-zone automatic air-conditioning, multiple front and side-curtain airbags, optional rear-seat ventilation system with massage function, and other electronic gimmicks. All the usual luxury basics are obviously also included, such as leather, power accessories, sunroof and 18-inch or larger alloys.

For 2012, the midsize Cadillac SRX received a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with paddle-shifting functions and all-wheel-drive. Even the base model is generously loaded, with a limited-slip differential, common power accessories, 18-inch wheels, LED tail lamps, chrome roof rails, 8-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, dual-zone a/c with rear vents and controls, cruise control, keyless entry, power-adjustable pedals, power-adjustable front seats and a leatherette interior. The top 'Luxury' version gets variable-effort power steering, continuously-variable real-time dampers, turning HID headlights, parking sensors with rear camera, navigation, 20-inch wheels, 10-speaker Bose stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, 40 GB hard drive, rear DVD screens, full keyless entry with push-button start, ventilated front seats, LED cabin lighting and a panoramic glass roof. For 2013, changes included an unnoticeable facelift and the introduction of the CUE multimedia entertainment system, along with some minor cabin alterations and an active noise-cancellation system. All models get front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Audi Q2 made its debut in the GCC in 2017. It is the smallest SUV offering from Audi. It is offered in two engines - the front-wheel-drive 3-cylinder 1.0-litre turbocharged motor and the four-wheel-drive 4-cylinder 1.4-litre turbocharged unit, both of which are connected to a 7-speed DSG transmission.   Standard equipment on the Q2 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C, and HID headlamps. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The 350Z, launched GCC-wide in 2004, is the halo model for the Nissan lineup. It is very fast, looks outrageous and easier on the pocket than a comparable German product. The car is home to a powerful 3.5-litre V6, with either a manual or an automatic transmission. Features that make the 350Z such a performance bargain are a carbon-fibre driveshaft, drive-by-wire throttle, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution and brake assist and convenience features such as automatic temperature control and a premium stereo. Other standard features on this rear-wheel-drive sports car includes power windows with auto up-down, power door locks, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, vehicle security system, heated outside mirrors, cloth seats with eight-way manual driver and four-way manual passenger adjustments and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shifter boot. A bunch of airbags and traction control are standard. The convertible is officially not sold here, although American-spec grey imports are making their way to the GCC.

The son of the Orient is the most impressive to look at. The design seems derivative, but is largely original and non-offensive, though what is under the hood is outsourced from Mitsubishi. Boasting the most advanced engine in this raggedy range, it comes with only an automatic transmission in this region. The underpowered 2.4-litre engine is of the same design as the one that did duty in various large Mitsubishi models in the past. There is also a 2.0-litre engine that has almost as much power as the 2.4-litre. With a Delphi ABS system and four airbags, it does not skimp on safety items, and with options such a visual reverse sensor, a 3-screen DVD stereo system, a CD changer, an automatic thermostatic air-conditioner and 8-way adjustable power leather seats, you'd be hard-pressed to find better value anywhere else, even among the Koreans. Other options on this front-wheel-drive compact include an electric sunroof, keyless entry and even GPS navigation. We just hope it is not loaded with a map of mainland China.

The Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG was new for 2007, replacing the E 55 AMG. It has the 6.2-litre naturally-aspirated V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. It was one of the fastest production sedans at the time. Standard options include an AMG-tuned suspension, bi-xenon headlamps with Active Light System and cornering light function, COMAND control and display system for radio and navigation, Distronic proximity control, leather seats, headlamp cleaning system, keyless start, parking sensors, four-zone automatic climate control and a tyre pressure-loss warning system.

In 2013, the Audi A5 Sportback received a facelift and new engine options. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The 4-door A5 Sportback comes with three engine options; a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. Power is delivered through a CVT automatic for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic is mated to the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions. Available technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, smart keyless entry and start, and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new GMC Acadia came in 2017. The crossover offers three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. The Acadia gets a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry, tri-zone climate control and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19 or 20-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The luxury car of the Kia range, the Opirus is a large front-wheel-drive sedan aiming for the entry-level luxury segment. Its most obvious feature is the mixed-salad styling, though it has been improved for 2007, with a less prominent grille and a redesigned rear end. This front-wheel-drive comes with a new 3.8-litre V6 and a five-speed automatic gearbox with manual shift capability. Features, standard or otherwise, include a radio cassette player with MP3 and 8 speakers, ABS brakes, standard front and side airbags, leather, power driver's seat with electric lumbar support, power passenger's seat, electric power steering, keyless entry system, auto light control system, fake wood grain, front fog lamps, power door locks, power windows, power mirrors, audio controls on the steering wheel, immobilizer, battery saver, active head restraint, cup holders front and back, body-coloured  exterior trim, 17-inch alloy wheels, and automatic air-conditioning with dual independent controls.

The new 5-Series reared its rakish head back in 2004. Facelifted for 2006, the extensive models available include the 523i, 525i, 530i, and, newly replacing the 545i are the 540i and the 550i. The 5-Series is available in both saloon and Touring wagon platforms, but the slow-selling wagons are not actively peddled in this region. The exterior design by Chris Bangle is controversial, especially the aptly-named "Bangle-butt" rear end. Its iDrive system has been simplified compared to the first-generation system that debuted in the 7-Series. It can be ordered with options such as Active Cruise Control, head-up display, active steering and a Harman Kardon Logic7 stereo system. Most of the 5-Series models are capable of high speeds but the electronic 250 kph limiter on all cars means that both the 530i and the M5 have the same top speed.

The all-new M4 Convertible came out as a 2021 model year. Under the hood, is a highly-tuned 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The M4 comes standard with a carbon-fibre roof or an optional no-cost moonroof. The M4 also gets an optional M Drive Professional feature, which helps drivers analyse driving lines and times on race tracks. An M Drift Analyser records the duration of a drift, distance covered, and the line and angle, displaying a final rating on the Control Display after each drift. Users can also download an iPhone app that corresponds with the car to give them a bird’s-eye view of the track and access to a lap time comparison chart, as well as data like speed, accelerator position, and total G forces. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera. Other standard safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control and brake assist.

The Morris Garages nameplate, an off-shoot of the defunct Rover brand, has been resurrected by the Chinese SAIC group, and their first product is the MG 750, midsize front-wheel-drive sedan based fully on a facelifted Rover 75. The MG 750 comes with an updated 183 hp 2.5-litre V6, 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, independent suspension, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, dual front airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, leather seats, power-adjustable driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, steering-mounted radio controls, automatic climate control a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, CD changer, sunroof, keyless entry, auto headlights, cooled central cubby box, illuminated sunshade mirrors and parking sensors. Options such as GPS and side airbags are apparently not yet available in GCC-spec models, but may be offered later.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur made its debut as a 2014 model year, and ditches the "Continental" from its name. The exterior shape now has a lower and wider appearance, new wing vents in the front fenders, slightly flared rear fenders and a more sloping roofline. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. It gets an 8-channel, 8-speaker audio system. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split. The suspension has been made softer for the new Flying Spur for a more comfortable ride. A Mulliner Driving Specification is available which adds diamond-quilted seats, drilled alloy foot pedals, a sports shift lever, jeweled filler cap and unique 21-inch two-piece alloy rims.

The Grandis is a slick minivan that offers buyers a genuine three-row seating configuration to take the kids to school and pick up their buddies at picnics on the weekend, but without the higher running costs associated with a 4WD alternative thanks to their small 4-cylinder engines and car-like demeanour. It is also interesting to note that this people mover forego sliding rear doors in favour of a car-like 4-door configuration. The MPV is kitted out with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, andÂ  gets a standard 4-speed automatic with manual shift capability, transferring its engine power to the ground via the front wheels. With seating for seven, standard safety features include front airbags, though front side and curtain airbags are optional. Also standard are ABS-assisted disc brakes, rear a/c and power windows and mirrors. Options include such niceties as dual sunroofs, leather, CD changer and more. Just be ready to be mistaken for a professional van driver on the streets, even though the Grandis is far too good to be a commercial vehicle.

The Mini is a thrill ride that offers extremely excellent handling, enough to kill exotic cars at twisty tracks. It is also one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a bit of cargo. Engineered by BMW, the Mini has been given a major overhaul in styling and cabin space for 2007, though the basic underpinnings are still the same. New-generation Cabrio convertibles join the lineup in late 2009. Models include the Cooper and the turbocharged Cooper S. The basic One model has been dropped, while the Cooper models use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine in different states of tune, with the S adding a turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, along with a number of airbags. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works package, available from 2009, that bumps up horsepower and handling, while a Sport package offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. It got a facelift for its 2017 model, along with interior upgrades. In 2020 it got a major facelift. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

The Lincoln MKZ makes its comeback in the GCC as a 2014 model year. The MKZ comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre EcoBoost 4-cylinder engine or a 3.7-litre V6 unit, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters, but initially, only the V6 model will be offered. Both can be had in either front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. Not all versions are available in all GCC markets. The MKZ will be available with SYNC and MyLincoln Touch as standard, along with large 10.1-inch LCD instrument cluster and an 8-inch centre touchscreen. As for safety, there is a mono-vision camera integrated into the rearview mirror to read lane markers on the road. It will be complemented by radar sensors for the adaptive cruise control and active Collision Warning with Brake Support. Also included are wide-angle radar sensors for help with parking and backing up. It will also sport inflatable second-row seatbelts and eight airbags.

Porsche is offering a "new" Boxster model from 2009, and while the facelift is barely noticeable, the real changes are under the bonnet. Still available in base and S versions, both models feature more horsepower, new gearbox choices and modern multimedia options. A new lightweight Boxster Spyder model debuted in 2010. The base Boxster now has a 2.9-litre flat-6, while the Boxster S has a 3.4-litre flat-6 with direct fuel injection technology. The Spyder uses the 3.4-litre engine, with slightly more power. While a 6-speed manual is standard on both, the optional new 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK) dual-clutch automanual gearbox is also available, which actually improves acceleration and fuel economy. Cosmetic changes from 2009 include new headlights and tail lamps, larger front intakes with integrated running lights, and an altered lower rear-end with twin diffusers. Both models can be fitted with a never-ending list of optional features, which can drive up the total price by 30% or more. While the basic models are very bare on features, the car can be optionally outfitted with a hardtop, various types of expensive cloth or leather sports seats, different 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheel designs, a new Porsche Communication Management System (PCM) with a touchscreen, Bluetooth, TV tuner, DVD changer, metallic paint, stickers, wind deflector, roll bars, headlamp cleaners, Xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, and a cabin that can be trimmed with carbon-fibre, aluminium, alcantara or wood.

In 2015, the third generation Ford Focus got a facelift. Available in sedan, station-wagon and hatchback forms, the latter 5-door is being pitched as a high-end model. There is a base 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automanual, available in the "Ambiente" and "Trend" trim levels. In fact, the sedan and the wagon will only be available in the basic "Ambiente" trim level alongside the hatchback. The hatchback can be had in all trim levels, including "Trend", "Sport" and "Titanium" editions. Only the "Sport" and the "Titanium" get the 2.0-litre direct-injected 4-cylinder "GDI" engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automanual. While all models in the UAE get the manually-shiftable automatic, some other GCC markets may get a 5-speed manual option as well. In 2015, a new turbocharged 1.5-litre Ecoboost made its way to the lineup. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a manual a/c. Other features, available on higher models, include 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, leather upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, "sports" front seats, cruise control with speed limiter, sunroof, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights, LED tail lamps, footwell courtesy lights, and an optional park-assist system with parking sensors and the ability to control the steering automatically during parallel-parking. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The 2015 Suzuki Celerio got a facelift, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The McLaren 570GT Coupe is a more tamed road-trip-friendly variant of the 570S. It gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 motor mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570GT sports a side opening cargo hatch above the mid-mounted engine for additional cargo space, and has slightly softer suspension, whilst offering better sound insulation. As with the 570S, it benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. But unlike the 570S, carbon ceramic brakes are missing in the 570GT. Features include a 7-inch portrait touchscreen infotainment navigation system, smart keyless entry and push-start button, 3 USB ports, LED headlights with LED running lamps and tails, power windows and mirrors, a detailed LCD gauge cluster, non-opening panoramic glass roof and memory seats. Safety features include front, side and knee airbags, ABS, ESP, parking sensors and a rear camera awkwardly placed close to the ground.

From 2012, the design all-new Porsche 911 incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than the previous generation. It is still a 2+2 seater coupe. In 2016, the 911 got turbocharged engines and minor exterior upgrades. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S gets the same engine specs but with more power. A new Carrera T model was also introduced for 2018, featuring lighter weight and standard adaptive suspension. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The 2016 Carrera S and Carrera T models also have the option of all-wheel-steer.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz A-Class Sedan came out in 2019. The A-Class now comes in two variants, the A 200 and A 250. Under the hood, is the same turbocharged 2.0-litre engine carried over from the previous generation, mated to an a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, but gains more power. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo came out as a 2018 model year. It is the estate or "shooting brake" variant of the regular Panamera. Initially, only two all-wheel drive variants were made available in the GCC - the 4S and Turbo. Later on the base Panamera was available, along with the, Panamera 4, Panamera 4 E-Hybrid Turbo S E-Hybrid. The base model and the Panamera 4S gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6,  while the Panamera Turbo gets a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8. The Turbo S E-Hybrid gets a V8 4.0-litre turbo unit combined with an electric motor. Some updates on the new generation include an improved adaptive air suspension system and optional rear-axle steering. Inside, the interior gets a new instrument cluster with two 7-inch displays. The centre console gets a 12.3-inch touch screen, while the rear passenger get their own set of infotainment and climate controls. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The Bentley Mulsanne got its second facelift in 2017. The turbocharged 6.75-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission, carries on unchanged. A Mulsanne Speed joined the lineup later on in the year with the same engine, but tuned for more power. The Mulsanne comes standard with a premium cabin treatment consisting of leather on every inch of the interior, supplemented by real wood and metal trim. Each car takes twelve weeks to produce, and customers have a choice of 114 paint colours, 21 carpet colours, 9 wood veneers and 24 interior leather hides, and be able to specify a custom colour scheme. Additionally, the car can be specified to feature a Naim 2200W audio system with MP3 compatibility, Bluetooth, iPod port and navigation. Further available features include powered massage seats, four-zone auto a/c, keyless start, HID headlights and more. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control and multiple airbags.

The Pagani Huayra supercar made its debut in 2012, to succeed the company's previous offering, the Zonda. Powering the Huayra is a bespoke 6.0-litre twin-turbo, V12 engine developed by Mercedes-AMG.  It uses a 7-speed sequential gearbox and a single disc clutch. The choice not to use a dual-clutch in an oil bath was due to the increase in weight of over 70 kg, thus negating any advantage of the faster gear changes in a double-clutch transmission. As a result, the entire transmission weighs 96 kg. The car is equipped with Brembo brake calipers, rotors and pads. The calipers have four pistons in front and four in the rear. The rotors are drilled carbon ceramic.

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Volkswagen is attempting to move upscale and the Phaeton is its new flagship luxury sedan, built alongside its platform-mate, the Bentley Continental GT. The VW Phaeton is available in three models, namely a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a 6.0-litre W12, all mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission and all impressively powerful. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a navigation system, all-wheel drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies. Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

The Sierra range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling truck in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado. The Sierra 1500 light pickup version is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending everyone around you with your show of excess, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The Sierra is available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a 4.3-litre V6, a 4.8-litre V8 and a 5.3-litre V8, all with 4-speed automatics. A luxury Sierra Denali version was introduced in 2009, with a 6.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. All versions come in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. Along with leather and special exterior trim, the Denali gets standard features such as Bluetooth, power-adjustable pedals, auto-dimming inside mirror, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, remote starting system, rear parking sensors, MP3-capable stereo with a six-disc in-dash CD changer, Bose premium speakers, rear-seat audio, power-sliding rear window, navigation, sunroof and an optional DVD rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include at least front airbags and ABS brakes, while higher trim levels get side-curtain airbags and stability control, among other options.

The 2009 Mitsubishi Galant receives fresh styling with a new grille, hood and lower air intake at the front, and more changes at the rear including wider rear glass, a new trunk lid, taillights and rear bumper. The Galant is powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic transmission, and the 3.8-litre V6 engine with a 5-speed automatic. Bot gearboxes come with Sportronic manual shifting ability. The base model includes variable intermittent wipers, power mirrors, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, cloth seats, air conditioning, power windows, power locks with keyless entry and CD player with four speakers. The higher models get bright interior accents, cruise control, premium cloth seats, ABS brakes with EBD, and CD/MP3 player with six speakers, along with 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an eight-way power driver's seat.
