Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received a new face and other minor styling updates for 2009. The minivan attempts to resemble a 4WD in height, with a high waistline and four forward-opening doors, but it ends up looking like a van. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a manual or automatic. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include a cassette/MP3/CD player with 6 speakers, dual-zone a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The big van rides on comparatively tiny 15-inch alloy wheels. New features added in 2009 include rear parking sensors and an in-dash CD changer. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The range-topping M6 arrived for 2006, in coupe and convertible form, using the same V10 engine as the M5. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a 7-speed SMG automanual in the M6. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The 2020 GAC GS7 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. It is offered with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbo, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The 2020 GAC GS7 is available as a front wheel drive or four wheel drive. Standard features in the GS7 includes power steering, power windows, power folding side mirrors, rain sensing wipers, HID auto headlights, LED tail-lamps, front and rear fog lamps, 10-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with 6 speakers, Bluetooth, USB port, steering wheel with audio and phone controls, sunroof, rear view camera system, front and rear parking sensors, keyless entry, smart key and button starter, and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get engine start stop, LED auto headlights, interior ambient lighting, side mirror memory function, navigation, 8 speakers, panoramic sunroof, wireless charging, and 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels. The 2018 GAC GS7 integrates intelligent driving assistance such as a 9th-generation extreme edition of ESP (Electronic Stability Program), an optional 360-degree panorama visual imaging system, an optional ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) system and standard eight airbags. Other safety features in the 2020 GAC GS7 include ABS,  hill descent control, and optional lane change assist system.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015, in coupe and this cloth-top convertible form. Two engines have carried over to the new model, the 3.7-litre V6 and 5.0-litre V8, while there is a new turbocharged 2.3-litre 4-cylinder motor in the line-up. All engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The interior has been significantly improved as well with higher quality materials and upgraded MyFord infotainment system with SYNC 3. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ertiga is a seven-seater minivan offering from the Japanese brand. In 2019, an all-new model of the Ertiga came out, weighing 50 kg lighter than its predecessor.The front-wheel drive people carrier features a 1.5-litre engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ertiga include power steering, AM/FM radio, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C with rear vents, halogen headlamps and steel wheels. Higher options get alloy wheels, fog lamps, chrome grille and side body moulding. Depending on trim level, the Ertiga gets dual airbags and ABS.

Completely revamped for the 2012 model year, the Ford Focus now becomes the best compact car available in the GCC, if a tad higher-priced than some competitors. That's because it offers optional tech features that no other player has. Available in sedan, station-wagon and hatchback forms, the latter 5-door is being pitched as a high-end model. There is a base 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automanual, available in the "Ambiente" and "Trend" trim levels. In fact, the sedan and the wagon will only be available in the basic "Ambiente" trim level alongside the hatchback. The hatchback can be had in all trim levels, including "Trend", "Sport" and "Titanium" editions. Only the "Sport" and the "Titanium" get the 2.0-litre direct-injected 4-cylinder "GDI" engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automanual. While all models in the UAE get the manually-shiftable automatic, some other GCC markets may get a 5-speed manual option as well. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a manual a/c. Other features, available on higher models, include 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, leather upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, "sports" front seats, cruise control with speed limiter, sunroof, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights, LED tail lamps, footwell courtesy lights, and an optional park-assist system with parking sensors and the ability to control the steering automatically during parallel-parking. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The Dodge Challenger SRT received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the all-new Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It also gets forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection. The Challenger SRT gets the 6.4-litre V8. A new addition to the engine lineup is the 6.2-litre supercharged unit for the Challenger SRT Hellcat. The SRT models gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, bi-xenon headlights, heated and ventilated seats wrapped in Nappa leather and Alcantara and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

An all new Porsche Cayenne came out for 2018. The variants initially available were the Cayenne, Cayenne S and Cayenne Turbo. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. The Cayenne S gets a new 2.9-litre turbo V6. The Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Later on, an E-Hybrid model joined the lineup which got a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine combined to an electric motor. All engines get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Porsche updated the interior of the 2018 Cayenne by doing away with many buttons and by replacing them with a 12.3-inch touchscreen and a few touch-capacitive controls. The interior retains the analog tachometer which now comes with two 7-inch color displays on either sides that read out driver information. The new Cayenne comes with a list of goodies that are offered in other Porsche products. Rear wheel steering, a Porsche Active Suspension Management system for “finer degree of specific calibration” of the air suspension, a new Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control that uses a 48-volt electrical system and a new semi-autonomous driving tech called Innodrive are a few of them. Features available on the Cayenne optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch and higher quality audio systems. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

As evolutionary developments of the America's most popular minivan, the 2005 facelift model features larger headlights than the older pre-2004 model, optional power operation of the sliding side doors, a power rear liftgate and revised interiors that are quieter, nicer and more comfortable. The new Grand Voyager also features Stow "˜n Go rear seats, giving the ability to easily fold the second and third-row seats into the floor in as little as 30 seconds with a simple one-hand operation. Featuring 256 possible seating positions and an additional 340 litres of available storage, Stow "˜n Go provides for immense flexibility and convenience. More options include a rear-seat audio system, a tyre-pressure warning system, electronically adjustable pedals and a rear-seat DVD entertainment. Chrysler minivans, in various shapes and names, are best sellers in the United States, but failed to make any headway in this region, firstly because minivans are not popular here, and secondly, engine options are limited to just one aging V6 here.

The Infiniti G37 Convertible convertible with a folding hard-top debuted in early 2010. The sedan then received a frontal facelift for 2011. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. It is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Civic grew up in 1984, in terms of size as well as image, spawning a new CRX sports model. The larger new model looked very modern for its time. A new 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine was offered alongside a 1.3-litre 4-cylinder unit on base models. Transmission choices included 4-speed and 5-speed manuals and a 3-speed automatic. The revamped suspension was a temporary step backwards for Honda, since it didn't have an independent rear setup, like in previous and later Civics. But this offered a space-efficient cabin design while retaining reasonable ride and handling characteristics. The  base models were barren, but higher models had sport seats, reclining rear seats, a rear stabilizer bar and more. The new CRX was basically the Civic chassis under a sporty body. All CRXs had a two-tone paint scheme, with a silver lower bodyside and bumper treatment. Introduced in 1985, the hot-rod CRX Si came ready with a fuel-injected version of the 1.6-litre engine. The Si also boasted handling enhancements, such as 14-inch alloy wheels with performance tyres, as well as a power sunroof, sports seats, and a monotone paint scheme. The base CRX HF now had a detuned 1.5-litre. The Shuttle wagon was later available with all-wheel drive and a six-speed manual gearbox. Changes  in 1986 included a 4-speed automatic.

The Ford Mustang has become an icon since the first one was introduced in 1964. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, with big power and low price. For 2010, the Mustang is no more the most powerful or the most affordable, but it does continue the retro styling theme introduced in 2005. It is hard to spot the differences between the previous model and this newer one, but the Mustang continues to ride on a rear-wheel-drive platform with live-axle rear suspension. However, improvements have apparently been made to the entire mechanical package. For 2010, only the Mustang GT was officially sold in the GCC, with an upgraded 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The Mustang is offered in coupe and glass-roof versions. Only the metal-top coupe will be offered with the manual gearbox with either engine, while the glass-roof will only be sold with an automatic. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, 18-inch to 19-inch aluminium wheel choices, power mirrors, 8-speaker "Shaker 500" CD/MP3 stereo with a six-disc changer, standard SYNC multimedia system with Bluetooth, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, variable "MyColor" gauge illumination, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe.

For 2015, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class received a massive facelift. From heavily-revised exterior styling to a redesigned interior, the refreshed E-Class looked more like an overhauled model. While the E 200, E 250, E 350, and E 500 continued life in its newer form, the older E 300 was replaced by the E 400. The E 200 and E 250 get a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. The E 350 is fitted with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, while the new E400 came with a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine. The E 500 has a 4.7-litre under the hood. They all have a 7-speed automatic transmission. The E-Class Coupe has much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door format.  An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard coupe models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. It gets the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive. In 2017, it received a facelift and further power was added. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Safey-wise, the car include six airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control, electronic brakeforce distribution and seatbelts with pretensioners.

The Volvo S60 got a facelift for the 2014 model year. The S60 straddles the line between compact and midsize. Available in the GCC with three engine choices, the entry-level S60 1.6T model comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and front-wheel-drive, available only in certain GCC markets. There is a 2.0T which gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, also in front-wheel drive. The top-spec model is the S60 T6 AWD, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine and all-wheel-drive, and available only in loaded 'Prestige' trim in certain GCC markets.  They all get a 6-speed automatic transmission. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The 'Prestige' model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. A simple silver body kit is optional. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. A software-based Polestar power upgrade is also offered, adding 20-30 hp, depending on the model.

The Cadillac XTS debuted in late 2012 as a new flagship, replacing the STS as well as the DTS. Based on a front-wheel-drive Chevrolet platform, the XTS is powered by a 3.6-litre direct-injection V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. It comes with a electronically-controlled limited-slip differential, adjustable suspension and Brembo brakes, with standard 20-inch wheels. For 2014, a V-Sport model with a turobcharged 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive joined the range. Features include leather upholstery, configurable 12.3-inch LCD display, CUE multimedia system, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, HID headlights, smart keyless entry/start and all the usual power accessories, with further available features such as heads-up display, adaptive cruise control. Safety features include multiple airbags, lane departure warning, collision alert, safety alert seat, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert and available automatic emergency braking.

BMW made its leap into the large SUV category with the flagship X7. Under the hood, two engine options are available - the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder engine and the turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 motor, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and electrically adjustable third-row seating. The middle row features three seats with a two-seat "captain's chair" configuration also available. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. The X7 also receives driver assistance systems including autonomous cruise control and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Jaguar XE is the smallest car offering from the British brand. The XE is offered with two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. The turbocharged engine is offered in two different tunes. All models get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options in the XE include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, dual-zone AC, smart key system with keyless start, 8-inch display screen, 6 speakers, cloth seasts, paddle shifters and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher option models get leather seats, sunroof, ventilated seats, xenon headlights, adaptive cruise control, head-up display, bodykit, and 18 to 19-inch rims. Safety features include All Surface Progress Control (ASPC), Torque Vectoring by Braking (TVbB), ABS, dynamic stability control (DSC), lane departure warning, closing vehicle sensing, autonomous emergency braking, driver and passenger front and side airbags.

The Dzire is the supposedly-desirable sedan version of the Suzuki Swift hatchback. Built in India and available only in some GCC markets, it is powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Mechanically, it has independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension, with front disc and rear drum brakes. The DZire comes in three variants, all with cloth upholstery, power steering, dual airbags, ABS with EBD and a CD/MP3 player as standard. The first two trims come with 14-inch steel wheels, while the top model gets 15-inch alloys. Options include full power features, keyless entry system, trip computer, fog lamps, 4-speaker stereo, tweeters, stereo steering controls, USB port and automatic climate control. So far, the Dzire is only on sale in Saudi Arabia and Oman that we are aware of.

The Golf intends to be a German-designed, German-engineered and German-built alternative to the Asian-nameplate vehicles that dominate the entry level of the automotive marketplace. Unlike many of its competitors, the Golf is a hatchback and therefore offers the advantage of cargo-carrying utility not provided by the typical four-door sedans. Hatchbacks were never popular, but the VW Golf always had some sort of following here. Though the base models, namely the 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, are no rockets, they are still responsive and fun to drive. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

The BMW 8-Series Gran Coupe was revealed in 2020. The 8-Series Gran Coupe comes with a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The 2020 BMW 8-Series Gran Coupe comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Wrangler has been redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The all-new real jeep is longer and wider and more refined. Now powered by a 3.8-litre V6, with a manual or automatic, it still offers low-range gearing and off-road capability. In 2011, the interior was redesigned completely, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were offered. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Toyota Prado got a second facelift in 2018. The "VVT-i" engine offerings include a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder and a 4.0-litre V6. In Saudi Arabia there is also a 3.0-litre turbocharged diesel V6 engine on offer. All models offer standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing and available locking centre-differential. All petrol engines get a 6-speed automatic transmission whereas the diesel motor is mated to a 5-speed automatic. The basic Prado 2.7L, known as TX in KSA and EXR in UAE, comes with 17-inch alloy wheels, front LED fog lamps, black front grille, black power mirrors and door handles, rear spoiler, side steps, mud guards, fabric seating for seven, front and rear manual a/c, CD/MP3 6-speaker stereo,rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and brake-assist, dual front airbags and floor-mounted spare tyre, a cool box, steering audio controls, USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth. The mid-range Prado 2.7L, known as TXL in KSA and GXR in UAE, gets 18-inch alloy wheels, front parking sensors, body-coloured trim, leather steering wheel and shift lever, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cool box and more, dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control and rear view camera. The UAE also gets a Prado 2.7L in VXR trim that adds powered front seats, chrome front grille, silver roof rails, leather upholstery and navigation. The basic Prado 4.0L, known as EXR in UAE, comes with a 6-speaker stereo with Bluetooth and USB/AUX ports, steering audio controls, rear parking sensors, LED fog lamps, manual a/c, fabric seats, dual airbags, stability control, ABS, smart key with engine start/stop button, cruise control, side steps and hill start/descent assist. All UAE-bound V6 Prado models have a door-mounted spare tyre. The mid-range Prado 4.0L, known as TXL in KSA and GXR in UAE, comes with roof rails, sunroof, front bumper guard and uphill/downhill assist on all automatic models. The TXL additionally gets a tow hitch and side mouldings, while the GXR instead gets side/curtain/knee airbags, dual-zone a/c, extra chrome trim, rear camera and navigation. A higher-spec Prado 4.0L trim, known as TXL2 in KSA and VXR in UAE, comes with sunroof, dual auto a/c, rear camera, navigation, auto-levelling LED headlights, sunshades, remote start, leather, front and rear parking sensors and power front seats. The Prado 4.0L in top Limited trim gains 18-inch alloy wheels, LED headlights with daytime running lamps, leather seats, power front seats with memory, front and rear parking sensors with rear camera, side/curtain/knee airbags, 14-speaker JBL stereo with voice control and steering-wheel buttons, multi-touch screen with navigation, remote engine starter, self-leveling KDSS suspension, power-folding third row, ventilated front seats, Multi-Terrain Select with four cameras, rear entertainment system, blind-spot monitor, crawl control and rear cross traffic alert.

A new generation Renault Megane debuted in 2017, powered by a 1.6-litre with a CVT automatic. In 2018, they introduced a more powerful 2.0-litre version. Standard features in the 2019 Renault Megane include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4.2-inch display, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX port and Bluetooth and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, dual zone automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo, 8.7-inch screen, 8 speakers, navigation, parking sensors, rearview camera, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 16-inch,17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models. Higher models get blind spot warning as well.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

For 2013, an Audi S5 Quattro coupe debuted, with a 3.0-litre supercharged engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic. Audi has also introduced a new rear diffuser that appears to be more cosmetic than the one found on previous models.Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Getz, new in 2003 and facelifted in 2006, is known for offering "European" levels of refinement. We feel it is let down only by its weak range of engines, namely a tiny 1.1-litre, followed by a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all four-cylinder units, some with a manual gearbox and others with an automatic. This front-wheel-drive hatchback comes standard with very little, but includes air-conditioning, a rear wiper with washer, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, and wind-up windows. Options in the higher trim levels include power steering, ABS brakes, a single airbag, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, sunroof, rear spoiler, fog lamps, keyless entry system, a radio and cassette player and fake carbon-fibre trim. The interior is well-made, with good materials. It is not too cramped inside either, with seating for five and decent legroom both front and back. All trim levels come with a cloth cabin and a useful rear luggage area with a lift-up tailgate. Small 14-inch steel wheels with plastic hubcaps.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This "compact" pickup has grown substantially for 2013, larger in every dimension, with more cabin and cargo room. In 2016, it received a facelift and it continues in that shape for 2017. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more. A D-Max GT model was launched in 2014, with the 3.0-litre engine, bumper-skirts, racing stripes, optional 17-inch grey alloys, red-black seats, bedliner and stereo choices.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. In 2018 it received a facelift and some power upgrades. There is no more V6 engine offered, with only 2.3-litre turbo and the V8 engines carrying over. All engines can be had with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a new 10-speed automatic transmission. The interior gets the MyFord infotainment system with SYNC 3. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards on 2021 Ford Mustang include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

An all-new Cadillac CT4-V made its debut in 2020, replacing the ATS-V. In the GCC, the CT4-V model gets a 2.7-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the CT4 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, updated CUE entertainment system with BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Chevrolet Equinox has been around since 2018, entering the highly competetive market of compact SUVs, dominated by the Japanese and Koreans. In 2021, the Equinox got a facelift and some interior upgrades. Under the hood, the 2021 Chevrolet Equinox gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. The base engine gets a 6-speed automatic, while the 2.0-litre gets a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2021 Chevrolet Equinox LS model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, manual AC, rear AC vents, Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 2020 Chevrolet Equinox LT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, and  optional leather seats. The top Premier model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled driver and front passenger seats, leather interior, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Chevrolet MyLink with 8-inch touchscreen display, optional navigation, Bose premium 9-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features on the 2021 Chevrolet Equinox include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with some simple comforts. Facelifted for 2010, the Ranger is a midsize pickup based on an Asian truck platform and built in Thailand. It can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The engine range includes a 2.2-litre petrol, a 2.6-litre petrol and a 3.0-litre turbodiesel, all 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual gearbox, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, features include air-conditioning, CD/MP3 stereo with 2 speakers, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and 15-inch steel wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, power locks, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing.

The 7-Series is a 4-door, 5-passenger luxury sedan with a more sporting nature than most of its rivals. Available in various trims, ranging from the 730i standard sedan to the 760Li long-wheelbase sedan. Other petrol models include the 730Li, the 750i and the 750Li. There are also two diesel models, namely the 730d and the 730Ld. The L simply designates models which have a slightly longer wheelbase, with all the extra space going to the rear passengers. The pick of the range is the 750i sedan equipped with a standard 4.8-litre V8 that achieves fuel economy numbers comparable to a big V6 rather than a reasonably-sized V8. The 760Li sedan equipped with a standard 6.0-litre V12 engine is only available in long-wheelbase trim, sadly. A 6-speed automatic transmission is standard on all trim levels. The 7-Series was freshened with a facelift for the 2006 model year because the older model that launched in 2002 was universally hated for its looks, while sending customers directly to rivals Mercedes-Benz. The iDrive computer is easier to use in these latest models than it was when it launched in 2002.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. Only the Cross Country model was sold in the GCC. It is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Outlander crossover was redesigned for 2008, based on the Lancer platform, but only two years later, it got a new Evo-inspired nose for 2010. Engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, and a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a 6-speedautomatic. The all-wheel-drive system distributes power as needed under various conditions and also with a 4WD Lock mode, but it does not have the equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with a six-CD changer and 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and Brake Assist, power steering, power windows, cloth upholstery, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 18-inch alloys, Rockford Fosgate stereo with 6-CD changer and 9 speakers, full keyless system, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, paddle shifters and faux leather seats. Only the five-seater version is sold in the GCC.

Launched in 2006, the Lexus GS already started to feel dated a few years later, and the 2009 update didn't help matters too much. Lexus openly admitted that the BMW 5-Series was their benchmark for this rear-wheel-drive GS, and yet it never caught on, especially with its detuned engine choices in the GCC when compared to foreign markets. The GS 300 gets a basic 3.0-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, while the new-for-2009 GS 460 gets a 4.6-litre V8 paired with an 8-speed automatic. The list of standard equipment includes 18-inch alloy wheels, leather-trimmed seats with front power adjustment, keyless entry, pushbutton starter, 14-speaker Mark Levinson audio system with both CD and DVD capability, Bluetooth wireless telephone technology, rear camera, multiple airbags, ABS and various stability systems, sunroof, adaptive front lighting, and a 7-inch multi-information touch screen. Options on higher trim levels include DVD navigation, power rear sunshade, active cruise control and a "Pre-Crash" safety system.

An all-new GMC Yukon was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. In 2018, the top Denali variant got a new front grille. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. The more luxurious Denali version, identified by its chrome grille and trimmings, gets a 6.2-litre V8. In 2018 the Yukon Denali got a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features for the 2019 Yukon include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. It is a compact sedan with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

The 2019 Zotye T600 Sport is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. Looking a lot like a Volkswagen Tiguan due to the loose copyright laws in China, the 2019 Zotye T600 Sport features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the T600 Sport include, standard or optional, include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, touch screen, multi-functional steering wheel, leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C and alloy wheels. Safety features on the 2019 Zotye T600 Sport include airbags, ABS, brake assist, stability control and traction control.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Mildly facelifted for 2007, its classic boxy looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, sharp lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a limited-edition soft-top version of the three-door. Versions for the latest incarnation include the carryover 5.5-litre G 500 and the upgraded 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Standard specification includes permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is Mazda's excellent two-seat, rear-wheel-drive convertible sports car that was completely redesigned for the 2006 model year, but is available for the first time in the GCC from 2008. It was facelifted for the 2009 model year, but only reached this region for 2010. Powered by a high-revving 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, this little runner is now mated to a 6-speed auto with paddle-shifters now, dumping the slow-selling manual in the GCC. Only the version with the powered folding hard top is offered here. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 7 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, manual a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-card for keyless entry and ignition, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats. A bit pricey and a favourite among women, but a great alternative to German roadsters for carving up roads.

The Lexus NX 200t is the Japanese brand's first entry in the compact crossover field. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. All models come with 18-inch alloys, LED headlights, synthetic or real leather, power front seats, premium multimedia system with navigation, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, power tilt/telescoping steering wheel with buttons, Bluetooth, USB and more. The higher-spec models gain adaptive cruise, Mark Levinson stereo, wood trim, illuminated scuff plates, ventilated seats, remote starter, power-folding rear seats, wireless phone charger, power tailgate, panoramic parking cameras, heads-up display, adaptive suspension and more. The F-Sport models additionally get a mesh grille for the different front bumper, firmer suspension tuning and different wheel designs, optionally with wider tyres. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags as well as stability control and ABS with brake assist, with options including a pre-crash safety system, lane-change assist with blind-spot monitoring and cross-traffic alert, and lane-keeping assist with lane-departure alert and steering assist.

An all-new Nissan Navara Pickup was released as a 2017 model year. In the GCC, the engines are carried over from the previous generation but with new transmissions. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, both of which come with either a 6-speed manual or 7-speed automatic transmission. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloy wheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signal lamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensing wipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

The Octavia is based on the new-generation Volkswagen Golf platform, and offers a wide range of trim and engine options. The range is littered with various motors, but only a handful are officially offered in the Middle East. Among these are the 1.6-litre four-cylinder, the 2.0-litre four-cylinder and the 1.8-litre turbocharged four-cylinder. By 2008, only the 1.6-litre was remaining, alongside a new 2.0-litre FSI engine with more power. Different trim levels go by various names like Ambiente, Choice, Elegance and what not. The Octavia is one of the more unique cars in its segment, with the look of a proper sedan, but surprising with a lift-up rear hatch for loading luggage. A station wagon version is also available to further increase cargo room, but mated to only to the base engine. The interior has a clean look with high-quality materials, and featuring power accessories for windows, mirrors, seats and sunroof, depending on which trim level one chooses. ABS brakes with Brake Assist are available, as is a traction control system. Safety wise, four airbags, two front and two side, are available. Rear side airbags and full-length side curtain airbags are optional.

This mini-car, also known as the Atos Prime occassionally, is in such a rare category that few people heard about it, and even fewer have bought one. It is amazingly cheap, but even more amazingly small, which seems to be to its detriment in this region. Powered by either 1.0-litre or 1.1-litre four-cylinder engines, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or automatic, while the slightly larger engine gets only an automatic as well as better fuel economy, Standard features include air- conditioning, seat under-tray for the front passenger, AM/FM radio and cassette player, a fold-down rear seat and, of course, wind-up windows. Move up to the better trims, and available features include power steering, front fog lamps, central door locking, power windows, rear wiper with washer, seat back pockets, better cloth upholstery, body-coloured door handles and outside mirrors, and the all-important seat under-tray both under the passenger as well as the driver's seat, to store your dirty magazines. Safety features include nothing more than the metal holding up the body panels.

The Uplander is a new attempt by General Motors to conquer the world of minivan by offering something different. It is a minivan that tries to look a little like a 4WD, and hopes that people won't notice that it is indeed just a minivan. This new seven-passenger minivan is a front-driver that is about 90 percent minivan, and the other 10% could become a quasi-4WD with the optional Versatrak all-wheel-drive, but this option is apparently not offered here. GM is calling their new line a crossover sport van. Power came from a 3.5-litre V6 powerplant in the early models, while a 3.9-litre V6 was later offered optionally, only to become the only choice since 2007. Interior features include fold-down second and third row seating, ceiling rail storage system with DVD and other entertainment features, along with a series of in-floor rear storage bins. The van still utilizes a walkthrough between seats and sliding doors for inner access, while the back has a lift-up tailgate. This van is effectively a replacement for the unloved Venture minivan, which few people knew even existed. The only Uplanders visible on the road seems to be airport taxi vehicles.

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Volkswagen is attempting to move upscale and the Phaeton is its new flagship luxury sedan, built alongside its platform-mate, the Bentley Continental GT. The VW Phaeton is available in three models, namely a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a 6.0-litre W12, all mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission and all impressively powerful. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a navigation system, all-wheel drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies. Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

The C-Class Coupe was introduced new in 2012. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. For the coupe is a 4-cylinder turbocharged 1.8-litre "BlueEfficiency" engine in the C 250. The 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standard range, on which the C 63 AMG version is based. All models come with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many premium features, such as 16-inch to 18-inch wheels, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. The "Sport" models offer stiffer suspension and quicker-shifting transmission. The optional AMG sports package offers stiffer suspension, 18-inch light-alloy wheels and cosmetic add-ons to most non-AMG models. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

Hyundai continues its march for world dominance by ditching the old Elantra and introducing this completely new model for 2012, featuring a longer wheelbase and more cabin space. The spacious 5-seater comes standard with a new 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a standard 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Later, a 1.6-litre engine was also offered in some GCC markets such as the UAE, with an automatic gearbox. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The MG HS is the brand's compact SUV offering. Only the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine is sold here, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the HS Comfort model include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric folding mirrors, halogen auto headlamps, cruise control, single zone electric A/C, fabric seats, driver seat manual lumbar adjustment, 7-inch display instrument cluster, 10.1-inch touch screen with USB ports, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 6 speakers, front and rear fog lamps, roof rails, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The HS Luxury models gets all-wheel drive, leather sports seats, front driver and passenger powered seats, LED headlamps, LED taillamps, 12.3-inch instrument cluster screen, dual-zone automatic A/C and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, ABS, stability control, hill assist control, and tyre pressure monitor. The higher models get additional curtain airbags, blind spot monitor and lane departure warning.

For 2014, the Renault Safrance received a minor facelift but mechanically remains the same. It comes with three Nissan-sourced engines. The base model comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and comes standard with a CVT automatic, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lights, manual a/c, keyless entry, power windows, alarm, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth phone, Renault key card, cruise control with speed limiter, grey fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. The base model can be optioned up with a package that includes a tyre pressure monitoring system, dual front-side thorax and curtain airbags, auto headlights, auto windscreen wipers, electrically adjustable and folding door mirrors, dual-zone climate control, leather steering wheel, air quality ioniser, fragrance diffuser, dark carbon fabric seat trim, 17-inch alloys and a rear spoiler. The mid-range model comes with a 2.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, and additionally features stability control with traction control. The top model comes with a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, and additionally comes with an athermic windshield, electric mirrors with memory function, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, tri-zone climate control, deadlocking with an anti-intruder device, electric rear windows with anti-pinch, Bose CD/MP3 stereo with 10 speakers, Bluetooth phone, Renault keyless smart card, panoramic sunroof, floor mats, cream leather seats, power front seats with massage, integrated rear sunblind, as well as front and rear parking sensors. Items such as HID headlights, dark leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels and an electronic parking brake are optional in some markets.

The Lexus LX 570 got a makeover for the 2016 model year. Heavily based on the Toyota Land Cruiser, new model gets a new front-end, LED headlights, new alloy wheels, new LED tail-lamps and new interior colours. The Lexus is powered by a 5.7-litre V8 mated with an 8-speed automatic transmission. The full-time all-wheel drive features a 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a crawl-control feature when in low range. The "overturn" assist feature can lock one inside rear tyre to help make slow turns tighter in offroad conditions. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. The leather interior can be had in tan, beige or black. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes, and traction control, as well as multiple airbags, with available tech such as the Pre-Crash Safety System that can detect and prepare for a crash, Lane Departure Alert, Automatic High Beam System, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control with auto  braking, and Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert.

The Ford Fusion is midsize sedan offering from the American brand. It is powered by a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the front-wheel-drive sedan only comes with a 6-speed automatic. A 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder Ecoboost engine was available later on. Available in two trim levels, the Fusion S comes with independent front and rear suspension, torque-vectoring control, electric parking brake, trip computer, steering wheel with cruise and audio buttons, power windows with one-touch open/close, capless fuel filler, auto halogen headlights, LED tail lamps, speed-sensitive wipers, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB ports, SYNC with MyFord multimedia system with 4.3-inch screen, Bluetooth, 16-inch steel wheels and blind-spot mirrors. The Fusion SE adds power-adjustable driver's seats, rear armrest, 6-speaker stereo, outside temperature display and compass, rear a/c vents, mirror-mounted indicators, additional body-colour trim, keypad lock and 17-inch alloys. Options include 18-inch alloys, parking sensors, sunroof, fog lamps, rear spoiler, premium floor mats, auto a/c, rear camera, 8-inch touchscreen with additional 4.2-inch gauge-cluster LCD displays, front memory power seats, rain-sensing wipers, leather upholstery and navigation. The 2.0-litre Ecoboost version comes only in SE trim and gets additional paddle shifters. Standard safety features include front and side/curtain airbags, knee airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, hill-start assist, and alarm. Optional safety features include auto high beams, blind-spot monitors, cross-traffic alert and lane-keeping assist.

The new-for-2010 Camaro, which more or less looks just like the overexposed prototype, took the car world by storm on launch. The convertible debuted in 2011. Powered by a 3.6-litre V6 or a 6.2-litre V8, it rides on a shortened rear-wheel-drive Lumina SS platform, with four-wheel independent suspension and 2+2 seating. The Camaro comes in V6 LT and V8 SS trims, with an RS package adding some appearance enhancements. The V6 is only available with a 6-speed paddle-shifted automatic in the GCC. The SS gets a choice of two V8 engines, each customised for use with a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic. The automatic V8 features cylinder deactivation to improve fuel economy. In 2011, the V6 got a mild power upgrade. StabiliTrak traction control and front-side airbags are standard, while Brembo brakes are available on the SS version. The SS, recognisable by its fake bonnet vent, also gets stiffer suspension and adjustable Competitive/Sport modes for stability control and Launch Control on manual models. The hard-plastic cabin comes with cloth or leather interior, with standard blue LED lighting and optional glow-in-the-dark trim panels. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 20-inch ones for the V8. The RS appearance package includes HID headlamps with integrated halo rings, spoiler, chrome tail-light rings, sticker stripes and 21-inch wheels.

The Lexus ES was all-new for 2007 and mildly facelifted for 2010. With a 3.5-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic, the only changes for 2010 include a new front bumper, new tail lamps and optional USB support for the stereo. This entry-level luxury car is based on the Toyota Camry chassis, with a unique body, equipment and interior. The front-wheel drive ES 350 does come with an impressive set of standard features that the Toyota Camry can only dream about. Three trim levels are available, namely the Premier, Prestige and Platinum. Standard features include an 8-speaker audio system with CD changer, Bluetooth, AUX port, leather, power-adjustable front seats, wood trim, auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive HID headlights, headlamp cleaner, power mirrors with memory, sunroof and parking sensors. The mid-range model adds navigation, rear camera, USB port and a rear spoiler. The top model adds a panoramic glass roof, 14-speaker Mark Levinson stereo with DVD changer, semi-aniline leather seats and adaptive cruise control. Safety features that come standard on the ES 350 include dual front airbags, a knee airbag, side-impact airbags, curtain airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, electronic brake-force distribution, also known as EBD, and a tyre-pressure monitor system.

Combining extreme power and a chop-top body, the all-new Dodge Charger delivers an experience like no other, except maybe for its sibling, the Chrysler 300C. Available with a 3.5-litre "High-Output" V6 engine or the infamous 5.7-litre HEMI V8 engine, but the SRT-8 6.1-litre HEMI V8 has been left out of the GCC. The Dodge Charger races into the local market with contemporary, provocative styling and substance with all the conveniences of a modern sedan. The 5.7-litre HEMI V8 engine comes with the Multi-Displacement System, also known as MDS, that seamlessly deactivates four cylinders in just 40 milliseconds when full V8 power is not needed, improving fuel economy by as much as 20 percent, though fuel economy is still far from impressive. Either engine is mated to a fully automatic five-speed transmission with AutoStick. In addition to the Charger's aggressive design, features include standard Electronic Stability Program (ESP), ABS brakes, all-speed traction control and optional DVD entertainment. Some dealers offer an expensive upgrade kit to make the R/T look like a faux SRT-8.

Ford brought back the Bronco name in the lineup, releasing a new model for 2021. The proper off-road SUV will have two Ecoboost engine options - a 2.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a 2.7-litre turbocharged V6 engine, both mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission or 7-speed manual.

The Kia Cerato Koup is a 2-door coupe version of the well-received Cerato sedan. Mildly sporty in its demeanour, the Koup is available with a 2.0-litre "MPI" 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. Interior comfort is enhanced by lowering the cabin floor and the seats, and by fitting wider front seat cushions with an increased cushion angle for greater thigh support. Available features, depending on market, include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, intelligent key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors.

An all-new Bentley Continental GT was released in 2018. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Continental GT is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

Citroen has a tradition for breaking design conventions and building quiry cars, and the Picasso, a compact people-carrier, is no exception. The Picasso offers a roomy and versatile interior designed around the need for differing seating configurations in a vehicle with car-like handling characteristics. Compact tall wagons have become popular family vehicles in europe, though people here are reluctant to give up their stupid 4WDs. The only powerplant is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder with front-wheel-drive and an automatic gearbox. The sloping front end offers a commanding driving position. The dash-mounted shifter is within easy reach and the digital instrumentation is clear. The cabin is filled with accessories like cup-holders, fold-down aeroplane-style tables in the back, and a low luggage floor for easy loading, with numerous other stowage facilities and cubby holes, including huge door pockets and under-floor storage boxes. Safety features include the requisite airbags and ABS brakes.

The Lexus RC F is the Japanese luxury brand's performance compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC F carries on with a naturally-aspirated 5.0-litre V8 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control. A carbon package replaces the bonnet, roof and boot with carbon-fibre body panels.

The Audi S8 was the performance version of their flagship A8 model. It featured a Lamborghini-derived 5.2-litre V10 engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission and their trademark "quattro" all-wheel drive system. The center differential distributes 40 percent of the torque to the front and 60 per cent to the rear. The S8 was not too heavy for its size, thanks to its all-aluminium body panels.  As well as adaptive light technology and 20-inch wheels, other features include new, noise-insulating double glazing for the windows, a DVD navigation system and BOSE Surround audio system with CD changer. The door armrests, the center console, and the seats in the Audi S8 are upholstered in leather. Safety features include traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, front and side airbags.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013 and getting more power in 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The twin-turbochared 5.5-litre V8 G63 AMG is fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Dodge Challenger SRT received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. From 2020 onwards, Dodge Challenger SRT interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It also gets forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection. The 2020 Dodge Challenger SRT gets the 6.4-litre V8, while the SRT Hellcat gets the 6.2-litre supercharged V8 motor. All SRT models gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, bi-xenon headlights, heated and ventilated seats wrapped in Nappa leather and Alcantara and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. An optional widebody kit is also available on the SRT Hellcat. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2015. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution.

The Lincoln MKC is the Ford-owned luxury brand's compact SUV offering. It received a major frontal facelift for 2019, bringing it in line with the new corporate Lincoln look. It gets two 4-cylinder turbocharged units, one a 2.0-litre and the other a 2.3-litre. Both are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. While the 2.0-litre is available in front-wheel-drive, the 2.3-litre gets all-wheel-drive in the GCC. Standard features in the MKC include the latest SYNC 3 multimedia touchscreen, power windows, electric mirrors, automatic A/C, central locking with keyless entry, pust-start engine, signature push button gear shiftter, leather seats and alloy-wheels. Optional features include panoramic roof and better infotainment system. Lincoln MKC offers advanced technology such as collision warning with brake support, a Lane-Keeping System and driver assist to help drivers avoid common accidents. The MKC has park-assist as well as park-out assist technology to steer in and out of tight parallel parking situations. Dashboard-mounted cameras monitor driver alertness, a Blind Spot Information System continuously monitors blind spots with radar sensors, and cross-traffic alert detects traffic as the vehicle backs from a parking space. The MKC gets 7 standard airbags, including a driver's knee airbag, aside from ESP and ABS.

The Volkswagen Teramont is the German brand's first entry into the seven-seater SUV market. While it is longer than the Touareg, it is not their flagship SUV. It is built in the United States and sold as the Atlas over there. VW felt the demand for SUVs and 7-seaters in this region was healthy enough to be introduced here. Teramont continues the tradition of naming their SUV line-up starting with a "T". Under the hood, the crossover has two engine options. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit, which is available in FWD and AWD, while there is the optional 3.6-litre V6 motor available only as AWD. Largely optional features include cloth or leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, navigation, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry, starter button, panoramic sunroof, real wood trim, power-folding rear seat, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go function, lane departure warning system, blind-spot monitor, pre-crash system with full automatic emergency braking, ABS, a full set of front and side airbags, parking assist with four cameras, LED tail lamps, LED headlights, power-adjustable front seats with memory, seat heaters and a choice of 18-inch, 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels.

The Bugatti Chiron is a mid-engined two-seated sports car developed and manufactured in France. It is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron. It still carries from the Veyron is the 8-litre W16 quad-turbocharged engine, but it has been significantly upgraded. Like its predecessor, it has a carbon-fibre body structure, independent suspension and a Haldex AWD system.A 7-speed dual-clutch automatic routes power to all four wheels. This one is 82 mm longer, 40 mm wider and 53 mm higher than the Veyron, and is also 155 kg heavier.

From 2014, the Infiniti JX35 became the QX60 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure, and it received a facelift for 2016.  It has remained the same for the 2017 model year. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive, the Infiniti QX60 is aimed at the family crowd.
