With three-row seating, leather upholstery and a touchscreen multimedia computer, all models are generously equipped as luxury vehicles, unlike the cloth-wearing base models peddled as premium vehicles by German competitors. Depending on trim level, available features include smart keyless entry and start, tri-zone auto a/c with air purifier, 15-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth, powered front seats with memory and ventilation, split-folding second and third-row seats, wood trim, hard-drive navigation, around-view parking cameras, parking-guidance system, blind-spot monitor, multiple airbags, lane departure warning and prevention, adaptive cruise control with collision warning, cross-traffic alert and auto braking, rear DVD screens, pre-crash seatbelts, ABS and stability control. The 2016 QX60 also adds Forward Emergency Braking with pedestrian detection.

The Honda Odyssey J is a smaller Japanese version of the larger US-built Odyssey. It gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. It has been facelifted for 2018 with a new grille, new front bumper with available LED running lights and fog lights, and new 17-inch wheels. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlights, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Other new features include a touch-panel for a/c controls, rear camera and more. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). For 2018, the EX-V additionally gets the Honda Sensing suite of active safety features that include Adaptive Cruise Control, Collision Mitigation Braking System, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Road Departure Mitigation System (RDM), Blind Spot Information System, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Pedestrian Detection System and Lane Keeping Assist System.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. In 2017, the convertible joined the lineup. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

The Gen2 is probably the most competitive model in Proton's line-up. Its chassis is engineered with the help of Proton-owned sports car maker Lotus, with engines derived from Mitsubishi. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this five-door hatchback can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, rear spoiler, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include optional ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Gen2 is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras. It first came to Saudi Arabia in 2007, and UAE in late 2011.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The Geely Emgrand 8 or EC8 is the Chinese brand's midsize sedan offering. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered for the GCC market, the 2.0-litre and the 2.4-litre, with both motors coupled to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options on the EC8 include power steering, power windows, central locking, manual seats, remote entry key, halogen headlamps, auto A/C, rear air outlets, AM/FM radio with CD player, Bluetooth and 4 speakers, leather seats, rear sensors and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get fog lamps, electric seats, 17-inch alloy wheels, auto A/C with dual-area control, LED lights, cruise control, sunroof, DVD player and 6 speakers. Safety features include driver and passenger side airbags, while the top model gets side airbags as well. ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD) is standard.

The Legacy is the fifth-generation model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive sedan. Like all Subaru models for more than a decade, the Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and gets an entirely new design for 2010, featuring a larger body and carryover engines. Not all engine choices are offered in all countries however. The base Legacy 2.0R comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder while the Legacy 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, both boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 2.5 GT, with a turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated to a paddle-shifted 5-speed automatic, and externally identified by its bonnet scoop. By 2012, the 2.0R was discontinued, leaving the 2.5i and the GT. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Porsche Panamera received a facelift for its 2014 model, as well as some engine updates and introduction of new variants. The 'Gran Turismo' has expanded to a confusing 10 different versions now, not including the Turbo S which will return later. This includes the base Panamera,  Panamera Diesel, Panamera 4, Panamera S, Panamera 4S, Panamera 4S Executive, Panamera S E-Hybrid, Panamera GTS, Panamera Turbo and Panamera Turbo Executive. All come with a 7-speed PDK automanual gearbox except for the S E-Hybrid which gets an 8-speed automatic, while the 4 V6, 4S and Turbo feature all-wheel-drive. The base 3.6-litre V6 model can also be had with a 6-speed manual. The Panamera S is no more a V8 and has been replaced with a more fuel-efficient and faster V6 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine. The Panamera GTS still has the 4.8-litre V8 engine. Also newly introduced is the S E-Hybrid model which gets a V6 supercharged 3.0-litre engine combined with an electric motor. The Panamera Diesel also seems to have been introduced for the UAE market for the first time, featuring a turbocharged V6 3.0-litre engine. The 'Executive' models are 150 mm longer wheelbase than the standard size. All versions come with Porsche's new fuel-saving start-stop function. Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM) is a standard feature on the Turbo and an option on the Panamera S and 4S, with adjustable damping for the adaptive air suspension. In the Sport Plus Mode, the Panamera is lowered by 25 mm. The Panamera comes on 18-inch and 19-inch wheels, with 20-inch aluminium wheels available as an option. Available on the Panamera Turbo is an active adjustable rear spoiler. The four-seater Panamera boasts a unique leather-draped interior, with four sports seats and useable cargo room. Optional is a four-zone automatic a/c with individual adjustments for each seat. The Panamera S and 4S come with the "CDR" stereo as standard, while the Turbo is equipped with "PCM" multimedia computer, with navigation optional on the other two models. As an option, rear passengers can enjoy two consoles integrated in the headrests of the front seats with swivelling 7-inch touchscreens. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The Jaguar XF luxury-sports sedan got an all-new model for 2016. In 2021, it got a facelift and newer tech. Only the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engines were now available in the UAE and GCC, with standard rear-wheel-drive and optional all-wheel-drive. All engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The Mitsubishi Montero Sport is the Japanese brand's midsize SUV offering, replacing the Pajero Sport for 2016. Carrying over unchanged for 2018, it gets a 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base model comes with side steps, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, multi-mode dash display, CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers, manual a/c with rear vents, dual airbags, power windows, keyless entry, chrome-plated power mirrors, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, immobilizer, front skid plate, and three rows of cloth-upholstered seating. The higher models gets cruise control, fog lamps, upgraded stereo with 8 speakers, automatic a/c, leather upholstery, sunroof and 18-inch alloy wheels.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The Volkswagen Beetle Cabriolet made its debut in the GCC in 2016. It remains unchanged for 2017. It is powered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. It gets either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels.

The Mitsubishi Outlander got a facelift in 2016 and carries on unchanged. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.
The BMW 2-Series active tourer is a front-wheel drive compact hatchback.

The Kia Sportage was redesigned from the ground up in 2011, and continues largely unchanged for 2013. Based on Hyundai underpinnings, it is powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, or a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre AWD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, navigation and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. The Sportage received high ratings in European crash tests, but keep in mind that they apply to a model with six airbags.

The Subaru Legacy is in its sixth-generation, and has received a facelift for 2018, along with minor updates such as better sound insulation. The Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and got an entirely new design back in 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. The 2018 Subaru Legacy is also available with a 3.6-litre flat 6-cylinder engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The MG ZS is a small 5-seater crossover. Powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 4-speed automatic, it has no sporting or offroad pretensions, but it does aim to appear the "premium" choice within its category. The 2019 MG ZS rides on a front-wheel-drive platform with independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension. There are three trim choices, with the base one getting 16-inch wheels, fabric seats, manual a/c, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and a 4-speaker stereo with 1 USB port. The mid-range model adds LED running lights, front fog lamps, faux leather, roof rails, cruise control, additional USB port, 8-inch touchscreen with Apple Carplay and 6 speakers, steering wheel buttons, parking sensors and more. The top model only adds 17-inch alloys and a rear camera. All versions of the 2019 MG ZS get ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor, ISOFIX latches and seat-belts with pretensioners. The base model gets front airbags, while the rest also get side airbags.

The Everest will appeal to customers who are ready to consider the purchase of a 4WD product which provides versatile usage, but aren't too concerned about where the vehicle is built or what it is based on. The Everest is positioned under the Explorer in some markets, precisely to meet the needs of this customer group while offering exceptional value for money. The Everest is a midsize 4WD based on the Asian Mazda-based Ford Ranger pickup truck platform and built in Thailand. The 4WD has three-row seating, a 2.6-litre petrol engine and a five-speed manual gearbox. Features include 7-seater capacity, with a slightly higher level for each row of seating, dual climate control a/c system, ABS brakes, seat belts for all seating positions including 3rd row seat, dual airbags, decent off-road capability, a side-hinged tailgate, tailgate-mounted spare tyre, standard audio system with a CD player, MP3, tweeters and additional speakers, power windows, power doorlocks and power plug-in points for TVs, fridges and Playstations. Not very fast though.

The Subaru B9 Tribeca is the Japanese carmaker's attempt at a midsize 4x4. Built on the same all-wheel-drive platform as the Outback, the Tribeca is longer, wider and much inches taller than the Outback, and offers five or seven-passenger seating. The overall styling is controversial, while the interior attempts to be more modern and upscale than competitive makes, with an amazingly unique design. The oddly-named B9 Tribeca is powered by Subaru's 3.0-litre horizontally-opposed flat six-cylinder "boxer" engine, a rare type of engine design shared only with Porsche. Also standard is a five-speed automatic gearbox. The B9 Tribeca offers power windows, electric mirrors, standard roll sensing system, ABS brakes with Brake Assist, CD stereo, and standard two-position memory system for front driver's seat and more. Options include reverse-assist sensors, remote starter, and rear cargo cover with shade-type functionality. Safety features include dual front and side airbags.

An all-new Chevrolet Suburban came as a 2015 model year. There hasn't been much change for the 2018 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering, continuing with minor upgrades and a facelift for 2009. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini cues, available as Coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. A 5.2-litre V10 engine, upgraded again for 2009, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type limited slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard. Now officially known as the Gallardo LP560-4, it supercedes all previous versions. The LP560-4 Spyder is heavier and slightly slower. A LP 570-4 Superleggera coupe and LP570-4 Spyder Performante models made its debut later, which are slightly more powerful and weighed lighter. A track-focussed LP 570-4 Trofeo Stradale model was also briefly offered before being cancelled by late 2012. The rear-wheel drive LP 550-2 Coupe was offered by Lamborghini in 2011 as the lowest-priced model in the Gallardo line-up, followed by a Spyder model later on. A special edition LP 560-4 Bicolore was released in 2010 which features a unique two-tone paintjob, black roof and special alloy wheels. Meanwhile, the original LP 560-4 got a facelift for 2013, with triangle-heavy front and rear bumpers to differentiate it from lesser models.

The Cayenne, the black sheep of the Porsche family, is a sporty 4WD that is surprisingly as capable on the road as it is off the road. Developed in conjunction with Volkswagen, it is available in three guises, namely the base Cayenne, the Cayenne S and the  Cayenne Turbo. All the models have been upgraded for the 2008 model year, adding a mid-level GTS model, and later reintroducing the top Turbo S version. The entry-level Cayenne has a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, the S and the lowered GTS versions uses two separate versions of the 4.8-litre V8, while the Turbo and Turbo S uses two turbocharged versions of the 4.8-litre V8. All versions utilise a four-wheel-drive system and a six-speed automatic gearbox, but a rare six-speed manual is available with the non-turbo models. The Cayenne models include traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and an active suspension system. An extensive equipment list includes leather upholstery, alarm system, central locking with remote control, on board computers, tinted glass, electric windows and wing mirrors, as well as a full set of front and side airbags. Options include a panoramic glass roof, reverse camera, various wheels, and different cabin-trim choices.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets even better with the addition of the 469 hp STS-V. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models include all-wheel-drive as an available option on V6 models. A Bose 5.1 Studio Surround Sound system with Navigation is standard on the highest V8 model, while 18-inch wheels are available on the V6 and V8 rear-wheel-drive models. Engine choices on the STS are a 3.6-litre V6 and a longitudinally-mounted 4.6-litre Northstar V8. Both hook up to their own versions of a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. The STS-V features a 4.4-litre supercharged Northstar V8 engine with variable valve timing, also found in the XLR-V, mated to an all-new Hydra-Matic 6L80 six-speed automatic transmission. The STS-V is supposedly capable of zero to 100 kph in five seconds. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, standard 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, and rear parking assist. A starter button is standard on the STS. Cornering and handling are superb, while the Magnetic Ride Control soaks up road imperfections for a firm ride. In price, it competes with smaller midsize Germans.

The Lexus LS has been completely overhauled for 2018, featuring major changes inside out. The handsome exterior and extravagant interior aside, this new LS will be the first Lexus LS ever to sport a V6 engine, deviating from the customary V8 application since the first LS rolled off into the international market during the 90's. There will be two models available initially - the LS 500 which sports a twin-turbo V6 engine mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, and a LS 500 h hybrid model sporting a naturally-aspirated Atkinson-cycle V6 engine mated to two electric motors, and an industry-first hybrid automatic transmission, which is a combination of the traditional 4-speed automatic with a CVT. There will also be the F-Sport versions available, which are essentially the short wheelbase versions of the standard LS, sporting a unique body kit, chassis management system, and 20-inch alloys. Standard features include Bi-Xenon HID+halogen headlamps with AFS and daytime running lamps, Smart Entry & Start system, 19-inch alloy wheels, moonroof, blind spot monitor, leather seats, cruise control, HDD navigation system. The F-Sport further gets air suspension, paddle shifters, rear-seat entertainment system with Blu-Ray player, lane discipline system and night vision. The higher models get the options of massage seats and a pre-crash safety system.

In 2016, the Ford ditched the naturally aspirated engines in the Focus, leaving only the turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder Ecoboost engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a manual a/c. Other features, available on higher models, include 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, leather upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, "sports" front seats, cruise control with speed limiter, sunroof, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights, LED tail lamps, footwell courtesy lights, and an optional park-assist system with parking sensors and the ability to control the steering automatically during parallel-parking. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The Jeep Patriot got a new transmission and minor interior and exterior upgrades in 2014. The Patriot is a compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

The 7-Series is a 4-door, 5-passenger luxury sedan with a more sporting nature than most of its rivals. Available in various trims, ranging from the 730i standard sedan to the 760Li long-wheelbase sedan. Other petrol models include the 730Li, the 750i and the 750Li. There are also two diesel models, namely the 730d and the 730Ld. The L simply designates models which have a slightly longer wheelbase, with all the extra space going to the rear passengers. The pick of the range is the 750i sedan equipped with a standard 4.8-litre V8 that achieves fuel economy numbers comparable to a big V6 rather than a reasonably-sized V8. The 760Li sedan equipped with a standard 6.0-litre V12 engine is only available in long-wheelbase trim, sadly. A 6-speed automatic transmission is standard on all trim levels. The 7-Series was freshened with a facelift for the 2006 model year because the older model that launched in 2002 was universally hated for its looks, while sending customers directly to rivals Mercedes-Benz. The iDrive computer is easier to use in these latest models than it was when it launched in 2002.

The Toyota Corolla is all-new for 2014, with completely-redone styling and an extended wheelbase for more cabin space. Engine offerings include a 1.6-litre and a new 2.0-litre, both 4-cylinder "VVT-i" units mated to 4-speed automatics, although a base model with a 6-speed manual is available in some GCC markets. The front-wheel-drive platform still rides on independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension. The five-seater is available in various trim levels. In Saudi Arabia, there is a 1.6 XLi model with a manual or automatic gearbox, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, black front grille, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and a 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo. Moving up to the 1.6 GLi adds fog lamps, 16-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, trunk liner, better upholstery with leather steering wheel, split-folding rear seats, 6-speaker touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with starter button and several other smaller convenience features. The 2.0 GLi adds LED headlights with LED running lamps, sunroof, rear manual curtains, auto a/c and cruise control. In the UAE, there are 5 trim levels, starting with an uber-basic 1.6 S model that includes a standard automatic gearbox, 15-inch steelies, 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo, power mirrors and a black grille. The next-level 1.6 SE version adds power windows, keyless entry and body-colour door handles. The 1.6 SE+ adds better upholstery with leather steering wheel, chrome grille, split-folding rear seats, LED running lamps, smart keyless entry and start, LCD info display, a better 6-speaker stereo and a few other extra bits. Moving on to the larger engine, the 2.0 SE has all the features of the 1.6 SE, but additionally gets 15-inch alloys and 6 speakers for the basic stereo. The 2.0 SE+ model gets all the features of the 1.6 SE+ model. And the 2.0 Limited gets a sunroof, auto-levelling projector headlights and cruise control. Other markets may get slightly different trim levels. All models get standard dual front airbags, ABS with brake assist and EBD, and an alarm immobiliser.

The Haval H6 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. An all-new model was launched in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and traction control.

The Opel Astra OPC is the German brand's hot-hatch offering. It is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-litre direct injection engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Basic options include central locking with remote, power windows, cruise control, daytime running lamps, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, speed sensitive power steering, driver seat manual adjustable, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/Aux in support, 19-inch alloy wheels, dual zone automatic A/C, leather steering wheel, outside mirror power foldable and flex-ride with continuous damping control. Safety features include driver and passenger front, side and curtain airbags, electronic stability program (ESP) and ABS as standard.

Maserati Levante is the Italian premium car maker's first venture into the SUV market. Under the hood is a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, available in two different tunes. Power is delivered to the wheels via an 8-speed automatic. Standard features on the all-wheel drive Levante include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, 4-zone AC, electric seats and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include interior leather packages, sports kit, roof rails, adaptive bi-xenon headlights, skid plate, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy rims. Safety features include 6 airbags, lane departure warning system, forward collision alert, blind spot monitor, adaptive cruise control and traction control.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's arsenal. Built to compete in the same market segment as the Volkswagen Golf and the Peugeot 307, the 1-Series is the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive. The 1-Series was first offered to the market in 2004 as a 5-door hatchback using its own platform. It replaced the slow-selling 3-Series Compact range and is the most affordable BMW ever. The 1-Series shares many components with the E90 3 Series. These include MacPherson strut suspension in the front, and a trapezoidal-link rear axle. Petrol versions include the 116i, the 118i, the 120i and the 130i, while the unloved diesel versions include the 120d, and many other body styles joined the range after the 2008 facelift, including a three-door hatchback, a two-door coupe and a convertible. The 130i is one of the few hot hatches that offer a six-cylinder engine. The 1-Series is built in Regensburg, Germany, with some of the engines coming from the Hams Hall plant in Birmingham, England. Considering the price, the way it looks, and the number of these we've seen on the streets, we'll guess BMW is having trouble moving these out of showrooms in this region.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. For 2013, a Roadster version was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

From 2014, the Infiniti JX35 became the QX60 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure, and it received a facelift for 2016.  It has remained the same for the 2017 model year. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive, the Infiniti QX60 is aimed at the family crowd. With three-row seating, leather upholstery and a touchscreen multimedia computer, all models are generously equipped as luxury vehicles, unlike the cloth-wearing base models peddled as premium vehicles by German competitors. Depending on trim level, available features include smart keyless entry and start, tri-zone auto a/c with air purifier, 15-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth, powered front seats with memory and ventilation, split-folding second and third-row seats, wood trim, hard-drive navigation, around-view parking cameras, parking-guidance system, blind-spot monitor, multiple airbags, lane departure warning and prevention, adaptive cruise control with collision warning, cross-traffic alert and auto braking, rear DVD screens, pre-crash seatbelts, ABS and stability control. The 2016 QX60 also adds Forward Emergency Braking with pedestrian detection.

The Mitsubishi Attrage is the Japanese brand's sub-compact sedan offering, introduced in 2014 GCC market. It got a facelift in 2021. The Thai-built Attrage gets a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual in fleet-spec trim or a CVT in all other versions. The small engine, combined with the lightweight body makes it very fuel-efficient. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry with central locking, fabric seats, manual a/c, AM/FM radio with CD player and 4 speakers, tachometer and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional equipment include a full-auto a/c, better entertainment system, leather-strapped steering wheel and gear knob, 15-inch alloy wheels and USB port. For safety, only the top model gets 2 airbags for the driver and passenger, whereas as the rest get only one for the driver. All models get ABS with EBD.

Renault Logan Van is a Romanian-built small commercial van. It is only available as a panel van. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. It is capable of carrying up to 800 kg payload and transporting long objects ranging to 194 cm. Access to the loading zone is facilitated by a high roof, 2 side doors and rear doors. Standard features in the Logan Van include a manual A/C, power steering, manual windows, AM/FM radio, tinted windows, 15-inch steel wheels, cabin light, front storage boxes and driver's side airbag.

The Nissan Kicks arrives in the GCC market to replace the Nissan Juke and Nissan Tiida. The Nissan Kicks is a front-wheel-drive sub-compact based on the Juke platform, but it's a bit larger in overall size. The Nissan Kicks is powered by the company's usual 118 hp 1.6-litre engine with 149 Nm of torque, mated to a CVT automatic. Features are minimal on the base car, with keyless entry, manual a/c, simple 2-speaker stereo with USB and Bluetooth, with safety features that include 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP with hill-start assist, tyre-pressure monitor, as well as front disc brakes and rear drums. Nissan's "Intelligent Mobility" features such as the Around View Monitor (AVM) and the Moving Object Detection system (MOD) are restricted to the top 'SL' model, as are parking sensors and side airbags. The base 'S' model, which is sold as a fleet model in most GCC countries, won't get you the LED running lamps, auto headlights, fog lamps, auto a/c, smart key, 7-inch touchscreen navigation, digital gauge cluster and such either.

Zhengzhou Nissan Automobile Company, established in 1993 and located in Zhengzhou in central China, is a 50/50 joint venture between DongFeng Group and Nissan. The ZNA Oting is a product of that affair, dating back to 2007. However, the Oting 5-seater SUV is based on the decade-old first-generation Nissan Xterra, only with a different front end and an underpowered 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Sold only in the UAE for now, only one trim level is available with rear-wheel-drive, although the four-wheel-drive version may make an appearance later. The rear-seat bench folds flat to increase cargo room. Standard features include front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, adjustable steering column, remote locks, power windows, leather seats, power mirrors, roof rack, side-steps, CD/MP3 stereo with SD card, power antenna, 16-inch alloy wheels, body-colour bumpers, manual a/c, rear parking sensors and one airbag.

The Mercedes-Benz A-Class got a facelift in 2016. It is only offered in one version, the A 250, powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. It got a very slight power boost in 2016, along with interior updates. A manual gearbox was also introduced in 2016, but only available in the GCC through special order. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.
An all-new Cadillac Escalade was revealed for 2021.

All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 Cabriolet is powered by either a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Renault Laguna Coupe is a French-built 2-door that comes with a Nissan-developed 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. Featuring a unique design, one of the best features of the Laguna Coupe is its four-wheel steering, or 4-control as they like to call it, which turns the rear wheels slightly along with the front for better cornering ability. Basic features include leather seats, Bose stereo system, alloy wheels, hands-free key card, auto headlamps and auto wipers. Safety features include six airbags, ABS and electronic stability control.

The McLaren 570S Spider gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S Spider gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Audi A5 originally debuted for 2008 in the GCC as a four-seater coupe based on the latest stretched A4 platform, with the range later diluted by the addition of a 5-door model. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.2-litre V6 engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive version, and a 6-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive version. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The new platform moves the engine more rearward in relation to the front axle for better balance and handling, but ultimately the car loses out on the fun factor in any form, either due to its front-driven underpinnings or to its overly-safe Quattro system.

The Nissan Murano is a crossover SUV, designed pretty much exclusively for on-road cruising rather than off-road excursions. The Murano is available in three trim levels, all featuring a 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to Nissan's Xtronic CVT transmission with adaptive shift control, as well as all-wheel-drive. Standard features for the Murano include 18-inch alloy wheels, six airbags, ABS, stability control and front seat active head restraints. Additional features include bi-xenon headlights, LED tail lamps, cruise control and an in-dash six-disc CD player with AUX socket for MP3 players. Also available are an intelligent Key with memory for the powered front seats and steering wheel, as well as a Bose audio system with 11 speakers, including a pair of Richbass woofers mounted in the spare-wheel well. The Murano's new interior is makes abundant use of soft-touch materials and upholstery trimmed in cloth or leather and aluminium detailing. Depending on trim level, the Murano can also be had with ambient mood lighting, auto climate-control, split 60/40 rear seats with powered raising function, power-operated tailgate, parking cameras for the front and rear, twin "˜top loader' sunroof, navigation system, Bluetooth, and a DVD entertainment system.

An all-new Hyundai Elantra was released as a 2016 model year. It remains the same for the 2017 model. It is wider than the previous generation. Under the hood, the Elantra gets two 4-cylinder engines, a 1.6-litre and a 1.8-litre. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The Legacy-based Subaru Outback was redesigned in 2015 and got a minor facelift for 2018. The base Outback 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 3.6R, with a turbocharged 3.6-litre 6-cylinder boxer engine mated to a CVT automatic as well. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Sirion is Daihatsu's entry in the sub-compact segment, packed with features and space. It received a minor facelift for the 2008 model year, along with a bigger 1.5-litre engine. The little Sirion offers a generous amount of space for the front passengers, including a fair bit of room between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Rear passengers aren't so lucky, but they still get reasonable amounts of leg space between front and rear seats. The rear doors open wide to an angle of around 80 degrees, allowing easy entry and exit, and the tailgate eases handling of large luggage. There is a full 630 litres of luggage space with two people on board and the rear seats folded down. With five on board, it still has 225 litres. The top of the back door has decent head clearance and a pull handle also makes it easy to close the door. A luggage room lamp adds convenience, along with the CD/AM/FM Radio, power windows, central locking, front airbags, cup holders in the doors and the centre console, and split rear seats that are 60:40 foldable. It is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder motor, the Sirion shifts gears using a 4-speed automatic, as the manual is not offered here. 14-inch steel wheels are standard, while alloys are optional, among other things. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

An all-new Jeep Compass came out in 2018. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission for the 4x2 models and a 9-speed automatic transmission for the 4x4 variants , but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

The Mitsubishi Montero Sport is the Japanese brand's midsize SUV offering, replacing the Pajero Sport for 2016. Carrying over unchanged for 2018, it gets a 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base model comes with side steps, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, multi-mode dash display, CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers, manual a/c with rear vents, dual airbags, power windows, keyless entry, chrome-plated power mirrors, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, immobilizer, front skid plate, and three rows of cloth-upholstered seating. The higher models gets cruise control, fog lamps, upgraded stereo with 8 speakers, automatic a/c, leather upholstery, sunroof and 18-inch alloy wheels.

The Honda Accord has been redesigned for the 2013 model. The coupe shares no body panels with the sedan version. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a new 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. The 2.4 EX coupe comes with halogen headlights with LEDs, 17-inch alloys, fog lights, sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, power-folding mirrors, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel, dual-zone auto a/c, rear camera, 7-speaker stereo with touchscreen panel and USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, power driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, floor mats and all safety features. The 3.5 EX coupe adds the V6 engine, LED headlights, 18-inch alloys, dual exhaust tips, paddle-shifters, navigation, LaneWatch camera, "i-Dual" a/c and leather upholstery. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips.

The Nissan Kicks arrives in the GCC market to replace the Nissan Juke and Nissan Tiida. The Nissan Kicks is a front-wheel-drive sub-compact based on the Juke platform, but it's a bit larger in overall size. The Nissan Kicks is powered by the company's usual 118 hp 1.6-litre engine with 149 Nm of torque, mated to a CVT automatic. Features are minimal on the base car, with keyless entry, manual a/c, simple 2-speaker stereo with USB and Bluetooth, with safety features that include 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP with hill-start assist, tyre-pressure monitor, as well as front disc brakes and rear drums. Nissan's "Intelligent Mobility" features such as the Around View Monitor (AVM) and the Moving Object Detection system (MOD) are restricted to the top 'SL' model, as are parking sensors, cruise control and side airbags. The base 'S' model, which is sold as a fleet model in most GCC countries, won't get you the LED running lamps, auto headlights, fog lamps, auto a/c, smart key, 7-inch touchscreen navigation, digital gauge cluster and such either.

The Changan Eado is a compact sedan offering from the Chinese brand. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Eado include power windows, central locking, remote control on key, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 4 speakers, leather steering wheel with audio controls, USB+AUX ports, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and hologen headlamps. Safety features includes front dual airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. No changes were made for the 2019 model year. It has four models - the E200, E250, E300 which get the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and the all-wheel drive E400 which gets the 4.0-litre turbocharged V6 motor. All models get the 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad.  For the first time, air suspension is now offered. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The Audi A6 got a redesign for 2011. Three engine variants are offered in the UAE - 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 2.8-litre V6 and 3.0-litre supercharged V6. Only the 2.0 TFSI comes in front-wheel drive and CVT transmission, while the rest enjoy all-wheel drive systems mated to a 7-speed. An S6 model has been introduced as a 2013 model which gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well as 18-inch, 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. In terms of performance, the A6 can match there German rivals BMW and Mercdes-Benz with its engine power and AWD systems, but the 2.0 TFSI disappoints with its FWD system and average power output.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. Powered by either a 3.0-litre V6 or a 3.8-litre V6 engine, it can only be had with an automatic transmission nowadays. It can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box and leather seats.

The Peugeot 5008 started life as a minivan, but has been reinvented as a 7-seater crossover SUV for 2018. Basically an extended version of the Peugeot 3008, the 5008 is powered by the same 1.6-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats and alloy wheels. Further available features include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Android Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist, as well as options such as lane-departure warning, collision alert, hill-descent control and more.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Receiving a major facelift for 2008, the car comes in various confusingly-named trims, including a new Turbo X model. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. The Turbo X model gets an upgraded version of the 2.8T, and gets a Haldex "XWD" all-wheel-drive system. Not all engines come in all body styles. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The Citroen DS5 is the French brand's compact wagon offering. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There are two variants available in the GCC, the 'So Chic' and 'Sport Chic'. Standard features on the DS5 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, automatic a/c with dual-zone temperature control, radio stereo with CD/AUX support, Bluetooth, USB port, steering mounted controls, navigation system, cruise control, interior mood lighting, aluminium drilled pedals, automatic xenon headlamps, automatic wipers, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, daytime running LEDs, leather seats with lumbar support and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get front parking sensors, electric heated sports seats, and driver's seat with electric lumbar adjustment, massage function and memory settings. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA), Electronic Stability Program (ESP) with traction control, driver's, front passengers and front lateral airbags, and front and rear curtain airbags.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

The Toyota C-HR is the Japanese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. In the GCC, they have opted to sell only the hybrid version, which comes with a 1.8-litre engine coupled with an electric motor and power delivered via an eCVT. Standard features in the Thai-built C-HR include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fabric seats, dual AC, 4.2-inch info display, power liftgate, 7-inch screen for audio, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, WIFI, 6-speakers, LED headlamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. The top model gets two-tone paint, heated seats, lumbar support, air ionizer, wireless charger, fabric+leather seats, adaptive and auto leveling LED headlamps and smart keyless entry. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, brake hold, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, hill-start assist, cruise control, rear view camera and rear parking sensors.

The Lexus LS has been completely overhauled for 2018, featuring major changes inside out. The handsome exterior and extravagant interior aside, this new LS will be the first Lexus LS ever to sport a V6 engine, deviating from the customary V8 application since the first LS rolled off into the international market during the 90's. There will be two models available initially - the LS 500 which sports a twin-turbo V6 engine mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, and a LS 500 h hybrid model sporting a naturally-aspirated Atkinson-cycle V6 engine mated to two electric motors, and an industry-first hybrid automatic transmission, which is a combination of the traditional 4-speed automatic with a CVT. There will also be the F-Sport versions available, which are essentially the short wheelbase versions of the standard LS, sporting a unique body kit, chassis management system, and 20-inch alloys. Standard features include Bi-Xenon HID+halogen headlamps with AFS and daytime running lamps, Smart Entry & Start system, 19-inch alloy wheels, moonroof, blind spot monitor, leather seats, cruise control, HDD navigation system. The F-Sport further gets air suspension, paddle shifters, rear-seat entertainment system with Blu-Ray player, lane discipline system and night vision. The higher models get the options of massage seats and a pre-crash safety system.

The Clubman is an extension of the Mini ethos, to provide more cabin space while maintaining its excellent handling. It remains one of the smallest cars on the road and and it still seats four. But conventional design standards, it has to be called a three-door, but with two front doors, one half-door on the right side, and two barnyard doors to access the cargo compartment, it offers the weirdest definition of a five-door hatchback. The back seats remain tight, but it can carry more cargo. Engineered by BMW, the Mini was been given a major overhaul in styling, and the new-for-2008 Clubman follows a similar look. Models include the Cooper and the turbocharged Cooper S. The Cooper got an upgraded 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine for 2010, while the S adds a turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, along with a number of airbags. A Sport package offers stability control, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

A new Sebring makes Chrysler a little more than a bit player in the midsize segment, with a funky new exterior and a revamped interior. It even comes in four-seater convertible form with a choice of a cloth top or a folding hardtop. Features include optional remote start, express-down front windows on the key fobs, 60/40 fold-flat rear seats, stain-proof cloth seats or optional leather seats, sliding centre console armrest bin with dual-bin front seat storage, heated cup-holders, optional Harmon-Kardon CD/MP3 stereo with digital storage space, and a multitude of airbags. On the technical front, Electronic Stability Program and Traction Control are optional, as is Brake Assist. Other features include a tyre pressure monitoring system, ABS and keyless entry. Three engine options power the new Sebring in other markets, but the region only gets a 2.7-litre V6 as far as we know. The 2.7-litre has a five-speed automatic gearbox with AutoStick. The funky styling may not appeal to buyers used to Japanese midsizers, but the generous Sebring offers a host of standard interior and safety features that are not even available as options in its competitors.

A new generation of the Kia Soul came out as a 2015 model year. Being touted as a crossover, it is really a tall compact hatchback, designed to be appealing for our misguided urban youth. Featuring tons of cabin space, the Kia Soul is powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Also the Soul gets more soft-touch material inside than the previous generation. Available in two trim levels, the basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, a single driver's airbag, roof rack, fog lamps, CD stereo with iPod input, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seat, black cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better CD stereo with a sub-woofer and illuminated speakers, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, underfloor tray and power outlet in the boot, luggage net, some extra trim. dual front airbags and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of black, beige and red two-tone interiors. Optional features are extensive, largely limited to appearance kits, such as funkier alloy wheels, stickers, chrome trim, front and rear skirts, and shiny fuel caps. In addition to front airbags, ABS is available on all except the base model, but stability control and side airbags are not available on GCC-spec models.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

The Volkswagen Toureg got a facelift in 2015. The petrol engines on offer in this 5-seater is a carryover 3.6-litre V6, and a 4.2-litre V8, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. This VW is a crossover, with independent four-wheel-suspension and a simple terrain-select system. Largely optional features include cloth or leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, navigation, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry, starter button, panoramic sunroof, real wood trim, power-folding rear seat, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go function, lane departure warning system, blind-spot monitor, pre-crash system with full automatic emergency braking, ABS, a full set of front and side airbags, parking assist with four cameras, adaptive air suspension with continuous damping control and adaptive roll compensation, LED tail lamps, HID headlights, power-adjustable front seats with memory, seat heaters and a choice of 18-inch, 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro Convertible was launched for the 2017 model year. While the exterior may not be that different from the previous generation, under the hood the 3.6-litre V6 and 6.2-litre V8 engines have been upgraded with more power. In 2019, the Chevrolet Camaro Convertible got a facelift and some interior upgrades. In 2019, the V6 and V8 models got a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 6-speed manual transmission is only available on the V8 model. Standard features on the 2021 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features on the 2020 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Mini, heavily updated in 2007, was mildly updated for 2010 in looks, features and power. It is one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a bit of cargo. Engineered by BMW, the Mini has been given a major overhaul in styling and cabin space for 2007, though the basic underpinnings are still the same. Cabrio convertibles offer an electrically-folding soft-top and pop-up rollover hoops. Models include the Cooper and the turbocharged Cooper S. The Cooper models use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine in different states of tune, with the S adding a turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works (JCW) package that bumps up horsepower and handling, while a Sport package offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps. Originally, the JCW models were only available with a manual gearbox, but automatic versions became available by late 2012. Special edition models are offered from time to time, such as the 50th-anniversary Mayfair Cooper S in 2010. A limited "Inspired by Goodwood" Cooper S model was launched with real leather and other upscale trim, for a lot of money. A limited Cooper S JCW GP edition came in 2013, featuring a bit more power over the regular JCW, Recaro front seats, rear seats deleted, stiffer suspension and unique wheels.

The second generation Volkswagen Tiguan came as a 2017 model. It's 60mm longer, while the wheelbase has stretched by 77mm as a result of moving the front and rear axles closer to the extremities of the car. Width, too, is expanded by 30mm, when compared to the previous generation. There are two 4-cyinder turbocharged engines, one a 1.4-litre and the other a 2.0-litre but available in two different states of tune. The front-wheel-drive 1.4 engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic 'DSG' gearbox, whereas the all-wheel-drive 2.0 gets the 7-speed 'DSG' gearbox. The Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parallel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera. Safety features include front and side curtain airbags, parking sensors, traction control, ABS and brake assist.

Ferrari introduced a new chapter in its history with the introduction of its first series production PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), the SF90 Stradale in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, coupled with three electric motors. Power is delivered via an 8-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.
