The Kia Picanto, one of the few superminis available in the GCC, underwent a complete redesign for 2012, increasing slightly in size to improve interior space. In 2016, it got a slight facelift. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. Only the base model can be had with a 5-speed manual, while the three higher trims get a 4-speed automatic. Features, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 14-inch or 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control with "˜welcome and escort' modes, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Safety features, available only on the top model, includes ABS and one airbag.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. In 2017, the convertible joined the lineup. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. In 2019, the Mini Cooper got a facelift, and a new 7-speed automatic gearbox, along with new features inside such as a touchscreen with AppleCarPlay. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The 2014 VW Golf GTI is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine and having a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed "DSG" automanual gearboxes. It features a body kit with a built-in rear diffuser and wider side sills. Compared to the regular Golf, the GTI also rides on 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with lower suspension. Inside it gets sportier seats, steering wheel and pedals than the standard Golf. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, USB/auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, optional sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, common power accessories and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport.

An all-new Ford Escape was released in 2021 for the GCC. For the 2021 Ford Escape, two engines are available. The first is an all-new turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the other is the carried over 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor, which has been upgraded for better performance and fuel efficiency. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base 2020 Ford Escape model is two-wheel drive, with optional 4-wheel drive. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering. The Sync infotainment system gets Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as well. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. The 2020 Ford Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, blind spot monitor,  and adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support. Active Park Assist is also available to park the car itself, whether parallel or perpendicular. Higher models gets adaptive front lighting system which automatically adjust the bi-xenon headlamps according to the environment.

An all-new model of the Audi Q3 came out in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Later in the year, a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine with all-wheel drive was offered as well. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

An all-new BMW X6 launched as a 2015 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X6 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X6 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

The facelifted-for-2010 Mazda 3 receives a brand new front end, a redone rear end, and a completely new interior. However, it still comes with a carryover 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, which was already an outclassed unit to begin with. American and European markets get 2.0-litre, 2.5-litre and turbocharged motors. The Japanese-built Mazda3 shares its platform, engine and some mechanicals with the European-built Ford Focus. The basic Mazda3 S sedan comes with 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, ABS, power windows, electric mirrors, two front airbags, a 4-speaker CD stereo, cloth seats, a new interior design and a manual a/c. A 4-speed automatic is standard. The mid-range Mazda3 V sedan adds 16-inch alloy wheels, a rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio controls, automatic a/c and a better stereo. The Mazda3 V hatchback features rain-sensing wipers, front fog lamps, side skirts, a roof spoiler, and options such as HID headlights, sunroof, LCD info display and push-button start with keyless entry. The fully-optioned Mazda3 R sedan and hatchback adds automatic wipers, electric-folding side mirrors, cruise control and different cloth upholstery, with all other options as standard. Apparently the "˜R' trim is only available in Saudi Arabia.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

Based on the latest E-Class platform, the Mercedes-Benz CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. The CLS 63 AMG comes with a new 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 and a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base. Standard features include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps, sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more. The CLS 63 AMG can be had with a limited-slip rear diff, adjustable suspension, carbon-fibre trim inside and out, ceramic brakes and other optional items at extra cost, including an AMG performance package that adds additional horsepower.

Changan Alsvin is the Chinese brand compact sedan offering. In 2020, it got a facelift along with an engine and gearbox update. Under the hood it gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features of the Alsvin include power windows, power steering, central locking, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD/AUX/USB, 4 speakers, manual A/C, fabric seats, halogen headlamps and 15-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, engine push start, 6-speakers, sunroof and parking sensors. Safety features include front airbags, hill-start assist, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control (TCS) and stability control (ESC).

The XF luxury-sports sedan is still based on the previous S-Type's mechanicals, but is still a real step forward towards competing in the real world. While Jaguar is owned by India-based Tata now, the XF was the last car developed under Ford ownership. For 2013, the engines include a new turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a new supercharged 3.0-litre V6, and the carryover supercharged 5.0-litre V8 for the XFR. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The most interesting feature of the car is its simplistic interior which consists of toys such as a rotary-dial gear selector and hideway a/c vents. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, in-dash 7-inch screen, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options. The audio unit comes with 30GB of storage and a standard 400-watt system, an optional 600-watt system, or a 1200-watt system which features 17-speakers with subwoofer from Bowers & Wilkins, also as an option. The XFR gets unique bumpers, skirts, wheels and interior upholstery, as well as sportier suspension and drivetrain components.

The Lexus RC F is the Japanese luxury brand's performance compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC F carries on with a naturally-aspirated 5.0-litre V8 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control. A carbon package replaces the bonnet, roof and boot with carbon-fibre body panels.

The Lumina remains the only rear-wheel-drive sedan in the affordable midsize segment. The engine range has been confusingly expanded for 2010, starting with an outdated 3.6-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed auto for the LTZ, and now adding an upgraded 3.6-litre with a 6-speed auto for the Lumina S. There are two variations of the 6.0-litre V8, one with a 6-speed auto and the higher-powered one with a 6-speed manual. Built in Australia alongside the Caprice, it is brand new from the ground up, and comes in four-door trim only. The Lumina comes in three variants, namely the LTZ, S and SS. The base LS and LTZ models fulfill the basic needs of a commuter car that doubles as a family vehicle, with decent space and adequate power, while the SS models merge muscle-car attitude with a traditional sedan. Available features, standard or optional depending on model, include an MP3-capable CD stereo, CD changer, stability control, ABS brakes, traction control, 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, comfort or sports suspension, trip computer, Bluetooth, cloth or leather upholstery, and various power features.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. In 2020, it got a slight facelift and updated infotainment system. Under the hood, the GLC 200 Coupe and GLC 300 Coupe gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine connected to a small battery to make it a mild hybrid system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year. It can be had in many variants, including in Sport GT and Executive GT trims. All models have the 4.2-litre V8 engine that powers the Coupe and Spyder, and come with either a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual and, for the luxury model only, a true six-speed automatic. The standard Quattroporte model has all the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The Sport GT adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals. The exhaust has been tuned to provide a deeper rumble, and other changes include uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts. The Quattroporte Executive GT model is recognizable by its chrome grille and air intakes, and is equipped with heating, ventilation and massage for rear passengers, retractable wood rear tables, alcantara roof lining, a leather-trimmed steering wheel with wood inserts and a climate control panel for the rear seat passengers. The new Quattroporte Automatic model is fitted with an automatic six-speed ZF gearbox for more casual driving.

The 2019 GAC GS3 is the brand's small SUV offering. Under the hood it gets a 1.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, smart key, AM/FM radio with MP3/WMA support, 2 USB ports, 8-inch screen, Bluetooth, 6 speakers, steering wheel with audio controls, manual A/C, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, reverse parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include automatic AC, auto headlights, automatic A/C, rear A/C vents, folding side mirrors with defogging and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include dual front airbags, ABS, EPS, TCS, EBD, brake assist, and tire pressure monitoring system.

The Fortuner is the latest 4WD to join the over-extended Toyota 4WD lineup. The Fortuner is the product of Toyota's International Multi-Purpose Project family, which also includes the new Hilux pick-up and the Innova. These three vehicles all share the new platform and are built in Indonesia, so any thought about this Toyota being purely Japanese is an allusion. Although this 4WD is based on a pickup, its styling is very softly finished, with none of the toughness inherent in its larger siblings. It has true off-road ability, thanks to four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. It also has space for five, or optionally seven, and its value-packed price is sure to attract families rather than desert junkies. The Fortuner is available here with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as two 4.0-litre V6 engines, one with manual and a higher-torque one with the automatic. The Fortuner sits high up from the ground, so it can be a bit of a climb for the kind of people who are expected to buy it. It has space for five adults and two kids. Features include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 16-inch wheels and an MP3-compatible CD player. Higher trim levels get fake wood, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, alloy wheels, rear diff lock, ABS and a multi-information display.

The 2015 Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift. The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. Powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a multimedia entertainment system, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

In 2013, the Audi R8 Spyder got a facelift. The R8 is Audi's two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The convertible made its debut in 2011. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. There is also a more powerful 5.2-litre V10 engine. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or a R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The Hyundai Sonata received a facelift for 2018 which included notable design changes, thus bringing the Sonata in line with its Elantra brethren aesthetically. The interior has been revised too, albeit slightly, featuring better quality materials. Mechanically, things remain the same, except for the turbocharged 2.0-litre variant now getting an eight-speed automatic gearbox, and a few touches to the suspension components for ensuring better ride and handling. The base model, known as Sonata GL in UAE, comes with 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and mirrors, fog lamps, keyless entry, rear camera, cruise control, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, ABS and one only airbag. The GL can be optioned up with 16-inch or 17-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, panoramic sunroof, leatherette steering, electric folding mirrors and a second passenger airbag. The top-spec Sonata GLS comes with auto a/c, subwoofer, front parking sensors, smart key with starter button, chrome door handles, blind-spot monitor, navigation, rear and side-rear sunblinds, electric parking brake, auto-dimming mirror, HID headlights with auto-levelling and washers, leather seats with front heating/ventilation, puddle lamps, solar glass, stability control and a total of 6 airbags. The Turbo Sport gets sports suspension, 18-inch alloy wheels and dual twin-tip exhaust mufflers. The front-grille is slightly different and it also gets LED daytime running lights. The interior gets a new 3-spoke steering wheel, gear knob, instrument cluster and interior trim, along with Turbo stitching.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

The Audi A4 received its first major redesign for its second generation. Available as a sedan from 2001 and as a convertible from 2003, the wagon is not offered here, for obvious reasons. Engines for the sedan include a 2.0-litre normally-aspirated four and a 1.8-litre turbocharged four, along with a 3.0-litre V6. The sedan could also be ordered in hot S4 form from a few dealerships, which adds a V8 engine and sporting suspension, among other goodies. The cabriolet can be had in this region with a 3.0-litre V6 as well as the 1.8-litre turbo four. There is a choice of a manual for all engines, though not officially offered on most models. Standard on the front-wheel-drive models is the Multitronic CVT automatic. The all-wheel-drive models get a traditional automatic. Changes over the previous first-gen model include a new look, better suspension, upgraded engines and brighter front lighting. Features include aluminium or wood trim, six-CD changer, auto door locking, a bunch of airbags, a tyre pressure monitoring system and an optional S-Line body kit. The S4 or even the 3.0-litre sedan are rare models.

The Audi Q8 is the German luxury brand's answer to the BMW X6 and Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe. Under the hood, it gets a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine, mated to a 8-speed transmission. Standard features in the all-wheel drive Q8 include tandard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. It comes standard in 18-inch alloy wheels, which can go up to 21-inch alloy wheels, while optional equipment panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. The optional "Audi pre sense basic" initiates preventive protective measures for the occupants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts.

The Audi S8 was the performance version of their flagship A8 model. It featured a Lamborghini-derived 5.2-litre V10 engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission and their trademark "quattro" all-wheel drive system. The center differential distributes 40 percent of the torque to the front and 60 per cent to the rear. The S8 was not too heavy for its size, thanks to its all-aluminium body panels.  As well as adaptive light technology and 20-inch wheels, other features include new, noise-insulating double glazing for the windows, a DVD navigation system and BOSE Surround audio system with CD changer. The door armrests, the center console, and the seats in the Audi S8 are upholstered in leather. Safety features include traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, front and side airbags.

The 2015 Dodge Charger SRT received a significant facelift. Two SRT models are available. The first gets a naturally-aspirated 6.4-litre V8 engine, while the second one is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 motor. They all get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Charger SRT Hellcat receives a larger, power-bulge aluminium hood, which features a dedicated air intake. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

All-new in 2007, the Q7 is the first proper SUV to bear the Audi name. It is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 was first available with a fuel-guzzling 4.2-litre V8 in this region, so as not to compete directly with the Touareg. A 3.6-litre V6 version came later. Both come with a six-speed automatic with Tiptronic manual mode. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Standard features include self-levelling bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

From 2014, the Infiniti G37 Convertible became the Q60 Convertible to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted 7-speed automatic gearbox. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. It is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Compass is an all-new compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that throws Jeep's off-road reputation out the window. It is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. The windshield is steeply raked and the lower than that of a traditional 4WD, but it comes with sculpted fenders, standard 17-inch wheels or optional 18-inch wheels, and a simulated locking differential. The Compass is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine with either a standard 5-speed manual transmission or an optional second-generation CVT automatic transmission. The Compass Limited with CVT offers the AutoStick feature that allows drivers to control the transmission manually so that it simulates a 6-speed gearbox. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control, fog lights and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, and power features.

The Audi RS 4 is made to combine high performance with practicality, so it comes only as a 5-door station wagon, which is rather unpopular in the GCC region. The all-wheel drive RS 4 gets a high-revving naturally aspirated 4.2-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets some aggressive styling for the bumpers and rims to differentiate from the standard Audi A4, while thei interior gets bits of carbon-fibre.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. In 2019, it got a facelift and a new engine. It is a compact sedan with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional 4-speed automatic. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are many other comfort and utility features. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

The Lexus LS has been completely redesigned for 2013. However, mechanically it remains the same. There are two models, the LS 460 and the hybrid LS 600h. The LS 460 are all rear-wheel drive and LS 600h is all-wheel drive. The LS 460 has  five models - Premier, F Sport, Prestige, Platinum and Titanium. The Premier and F Sport are the short-wheel base versions, whereas the Prestige, Platinum and Titanium are the long-wheel base models. The all-wheel drive LS 600h has Platinum and Titanium model options. The LS 460 gets a 4.6-litre V8 mated to an eight-speed transmission and the LS 600h has 5.0-litre V8 engine connected to an electric motor and mated to a CVT transmission. Base options include Bi-Xenon HID+halogen headlamps with AFS and daytime running lamps, Smart Entry & Start system, 19-inch alloy wheels, moonroof, blind spot monitor, leather seats, cruise control, HDD navigation system with 12.3-inch screen and DVD player with 10 Speakers. The F-Sport gets bodykit, air suspension, paddle shifters, 19-speaker Mark Levinson audio/DVD system, rear-seat entertainment system with Blue Ray player, lane discipline system and night vision. The higher models get the options of massage seats and a pre-crash safety system.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2015, the RS 7 got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

An all-new Skoda Octavia came out in 2014 in the GCC. It got a facelift for the 2018 model. Compared to its predecessor, the Octavia has grown significantly in length and width. The new model is 90 mm longer and 45 mm wider than the second-generation Skoda Octavia. At the same time, the wheelbase has grown by 108 mm, mainly benefiting the interior and space on the rear seats. In 2017, there are two 4-cylinder turbocharged engines to choose from, the 1.4-litre and the 1.8-litre, both mated to a 7-speed DSG gearbox. The base Octavia Ambition model comes with 16-inch steel wheels, fabric interior, rear mud flaps, automatic A/C, electric adjustable, heated & foldable door mirrors, electric windows, parking sensors, radio with CD player and MP3 support,  4 speakers, remote central locking, fog lights and front & side front airbags. The Octavia Style model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, leather interior, chrome package, cruise control, Apply connectivity, mobile device interface (MDI), electric seats, sunroof and xenon headlamps. The Octavia RS gets 19-inch alloy wheels, carbon-fibre inlays for dashboard and door panels, boot spoiler, red brake calipers, sports suspension, Bluetooth and Apple connectivity.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Trim levels include the confusing Linear, Arc, Vector and Aero trims. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The top Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. Not all engines come in all body styles, though all are available in Aero form. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a glass sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. An all-new model came out in 2020. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Audi RS 4 is made to combine high performance with practicality, so it comes only as a 5-door station wagon, which is rather unpopular in the GCC region. The all-wheel drive RS 4 gets a high-revving naturally aspirated 4.2-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets some aggressive styling for the bumpers and rims to differentiate from the standard Audi A4, while thei interior gets bits of carbon-fibre.

The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. This Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street and came out first in 2008, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track.

The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, and mildly facelifted for 2011. Aside from the sedan, the Accord is offered in this American-built coupe body style. It is offered with either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. The 2.4-litre in the coupe has a bit more power than the one in the sedan. All models get a 5-speed automatic only. Standard features on the base model includes power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, manual a/c,cruise control, CD/MP3 player with USB and AUX ports, and keyless entry. Features available in higher models include auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps. For 2011, new options include a navigation system with 8-inch screen, a dual-zone automatic a/c that uses GPS to adjust temperature according to the position of vehicle relative to the sun, a Bluetooth phone and a rear-view camera. Available wheel sizes are 17-inch or 18-inch alloys in the coupe, depending on trim. For 2011, all models got ABS, stability control, active headrests and dual front airbags, with optional side and curtain airbags in the higher models. For 2012, all six airbags became standard on all models.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

An all-new Mazda CX-5 was launched as a 2018 model year. The standard engine is a direct-injection 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There is one front-wheel-drive and two all-wheel-drive versions available. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. The Mercedes-AMG E53 is a performance model replacing the E43. It gets a mild hybrid engine with   a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine coupled with a small electric motor. Power is controlled through a 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The MG 350 is the Chinese-owned brand's attempt to enter into the compact hatchback segment. Under  the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, DVD entertainment system, sunroof, rear parking sensor,bluetooth connectivity and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports convertible with a supercharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. The soft-top is standard on the Elise, with the option of a hard-top as well. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Jaguar F-Type is a two-seater convertible based on a shortened XK platform. From 2018, it came with one 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, two supercharged engine choices - a 3.0-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8. The V8 only comes in R form. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive and later on only as all-wheel-drive. It gets adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The roof is said to close or open in 12 seconds. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more.

Tougher than most compact 4WDs, the Jeep Cherokee, also known as the Liberty in some markets, seats five people and can carry their gear too. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it is just about adequate for the streets. Early models got a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, while post-facelift models got the automatic or a 6-speed manual. Fold the rear seats and it can move two people and some serious cargo. Turn off the pavement, and it can negotiate most trails with confidence. All-new for 2002, the Cherokee was extensively updated for 2005. From 2006, all models come with Jeep's Electronic Stability Program, ABS brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, and all-speed traction control. Standard on all models is Command-Trac, a conventional part-time four-wheel-drive system with a two-speed transfer case. Full-time Selec-Trac is optional, and retains a low range for serious off-roading. Standard features also include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, six-speaker AM/FM/CD stereo, grey fender flares, 16-inch steel wheels and traction control. Options include leather, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, fog lamps, body-colour fender flares, roof rails, functional rock rails and more.

The Jaguar F-Type Coupe hit showrooms in mid-2014, joining the range almost a year after the Roadster's launch. It comes with two supercharged 3.0-litre engine choices, in V6 and V6 S form, as well as with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8, in V8 R form, the latter more powerful than the V8 S Roadster. There is no V8 S version for the Coupe. In 2018, a 2.0-litre turbo joined the lineup as well. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive. Components include adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. The F-Type R Coupe additionally gets a new electronic active differential and a torque vectoring system, as well as larger brakes with optional carbon-ceramic discs.

The Azera is Hyundai's attempt at the high end executive car market, occupied by only a handful of models which combine luxury with a affordable price. The Azera actually offers a lot more for its price than its Japanese and American competitors however, and this 3.3-litre V6-powered automatic sedan is an impressive effort on Hyundai's part. A 2.7-litre V6 joined the range later. A minor frontal facelift added a larger grille in 2010. Standard features on the base model include just a single airbag for the driver, power steering, power windows, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD and MP3 capability and six speakers, cruise control, dual zone fully automatic air conditioning, dual exhaust system, power mirrors, trip computer, illuminated sun visors with vanity mirrors, rear centre armrest with cup holders, and alloy wheels. Options include dual airbags with side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, Electronic Stability Program, HID Xenon headlights, power sunroof, leather upholstery, power front seats, integrated memory system for driver's seat and mirrors, in-dash 6-CD changer with two more speakers including an Infinity subwoofer and amplifier, rear parking sensors, electric rear curtain, rain-sensing front wipers and some wood on the steering wheel.

The Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Roadster debuted in 2011, a year after the Coupe. It is supposed to be an everyday-use supercar, a product of in-house development by AMG. The coupe's trademark 'gullwing' doors are lost here in favour of conventional doors, easing entry and exit. Underneath the long bonnet is the usual AMG-built 6.2-litre V8 engine, and mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox in this application. A lightweight structure molded largely from carbon-fibre and aluminium double-wishbone suspension form the basics of the SLS. Among other things, the centre console incorporates the AMG DRIVE UNIT, which enables SLS owners to customise their vehicle set-up, while the AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission is operated by means of the E-SELECT lever. Beyond the usual power accessories and comfort features such as automatic a/c, "airscarf" headrests and cruise control, the simplistic interior can be customised in various colours, and can be fitted with options such as sports seats, metal trim, various leather choices, nicer paint and carbon-fibre appliquÃ©s. Further options include different 19-inch and 20-inch alloy wheels, carbon-ceramic brakes, pricey Bang & Olufsen stereo and a sports steering wheel.

The GMC Terrain made its debut in the GCC as a 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. Both engines get a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base SLE model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, HID headlamps with LED daytime running lamps, fog lamps, single-zone AC, rear AC vents, infotainment system with 7-inch screen, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The SLT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, infotainment system with 8-inch touchscreen display with navigation, 6-speaker audio system and leather seats. The Denali model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled front seats, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Bose premium 7-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Juke is a new sub-compact crossover by Nissan, based on the Tiida platform. Powered by a choice of either a 1.6-litre naturally-aspirated or a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, the latter also featuring direct-injection. Available transmissions include a special-order manual or a standard CVT automatic. Unfortunately, only the front-wheel-drive version is offered in the GCC, while an all-wheel-drive version is offered elsewhere. Standard features include cloth upholstery, red or silver painted console, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, power front window, electric mirrors, 60/40 folding rear seats and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher-trim models get a sunroof, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, USB port, fog lamps, automatic a/c, four power windows, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Juke can also be customised with various optional alloy-wheel designs, stickers, decal stripes, roof spoilers and more. Safety features include front airbags, optional side-curtain airbags, ABS disc brakes with EBD, and stability control.

The SX4 is an all-new compact car from Suzuki. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model that is not actually offered in most GCC markets. The crossover-style hatchback came first, then a tall sedan came in mid-2008. Originally fitted with a standard 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the SX4 can be equipped with a five-speed manual transmission, while also coming with an optional four-speed automatic. A 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine debuted with the sedan. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Receiving a major facelift for 2008, the car comes in various confusingly-named trims, including a new Turbo X model. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. The Turbo X model gets an upgraded version of the 2.8T, and gets a Haldex "XWD" all-wheel-drive system. Not all engines come in all body styles. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

Finally making its official debut in the GCC, the rally-bred Subaru Impreza WRX STI landed for the 2008 model year with a hatchback-only body and no warranty. By 2010, it could finally be bought with a warranty. The sedan came for 2011. The standard engine is a 2.5-litre turbocharged and intercooled horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed manual and Subaru's 'symmetrical' all-wheel-drive system. In 2011, a minor range-wide facelift debuted along with the sedan, as well as a 5-speed automatic option. An SI-DRIVE system offers three modes, namely Intelligent, Sport, and Sport Sharp, with the first mode reducing power and improving fuel economy. The 'Driver Controlled Center Differential,' also known as DCCD, has three automatic modes in addition to allowing manual torque-split adjustment. The VDC stability control system can be left on, fully turned off, or set to a sport mode. Features include ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, LED tail lamps, torque-sensitive limited slip differential, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, common power accessories and a CD stereo, with options such as Recaro sport seats and navigation. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in.

All new Kia Rio came out for the 2018 model year. It is a slightly larger car from its predecessor so interior room has marginally gone up as well. Two 4-cylinder engines are available on the front-wheel drive 2020 Kia Rio sedan - one a 1.4-litre and the other a 1.6-litre. Standard features on the Rio include power steering, power windows, central locking, halogen lamps, manual A/C, fabric seats, USB port and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher models get a 5.0-inch touchscreen audio system, 3.5-inch LCD screen on the instrument cluster, automatic A/C, leather seats, fog lamps and 15 inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features on the 2020 Kia Rio include ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, stability control, electronic brake distribution and brake assist.

The Peugeot 5008 is the French automaker's entry in the MPV market. The 7-seater 5008 comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include power steering, power windows, digital and bi-zone air conditioning, tilt and telescopic leather steering wheel, heater power mirrors, radio with CD/AUX support, front and rear fog lamps, rear parking sensors and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher model called 'Premium' gets additional options such as tinted windows, auto headlamps, automatic wipers, panoramic roof, bi-zone AC with rear ducts, power-foldable mirrors, sundshade curtains for the back row seats and rear parking sensors with distance measurement. Standard safety features include 6 airbags and seatbelt sensors, electric parking break with hill assist, ABS brakers, electronic stability control (ESP), electronic brake distribution (EBD), emergency brake assist (EBA) and anti-slip regulation (ASR).

The Toyota Granvia made its debut to the GCC market in 2020, to cater to the high-end commercial transportation services. With seating for six, including four captain’s chairs as a standard feature, the Granvia includes adjustable interior illumination, fine woodgrain trim and metallic finishing, as well as rear air conditioning that incorporates ion generators with nanotechnology to help remove bacteria and odours. Driver assistance technologies comprise a 4.2-inch display, a 7.0-inch infotainment unit, multifunctional steering wheel and a digital rear-view mirror ensuring a clear view regardless of how much luggage is in the back.Power is courtesy of a high compression, direct-injection 3.5-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a six-speed automatic transmission. In some GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia, a 2.8-litre turbodiesel version is also offered. The frame is coupled to MacPherson strut front suspension and a four-link rear.The new Granvia is built using high-tensile strength materials to provide a lightweight yet rigid structure. The Granvia additionally minimizes risk to pedestrians by incorporating energy-absorbing reinforcements which have been adopted on the front end. Standard features on the new model include emergency brake warning, tyre pressure monitoring, plus driver and passenger airbags, knee airbags, as well as curtain airbags.The 2020 Toyota Granvia SE model comes with leather seats, a rearview camera, cruise control, 17-inch wheels, LEDs, parking sensors and hill-assist control.The Toyota Granvia top of the range Premium model includes additional luxury quilted Ottoman leather seats, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring, lane departure assist, surround-view camera, digital rearview mirror, pre-crash system and an electrically operated side door.

The Subaru XV debuted in its current form in 2013. Known also as Crosstrek elsewhere, it is a based on the Impreza platform, but with hatchback styling, raised suspension, and roof rails. While appearing tough, this compact crossover is powered by a small 2.0-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. The standard XV 2.0i comes with the usual power options, cloth upholstery, auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys, cruise control and halogen headlights. The 2.0i-S Premium adds smart keyless entry and start, rear camera, aluminium pedals, dual-zone auto a/c, HID headlights with washers, power-folding mirrors with LED indicators, and a sunroof. Front and side-curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control are standard on all models.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 is immensely powerful, and features cylinder deactivation technology, seamlessly turning off the fuel consumption in four cylinders of the 5.7-liter HEMI engine when V8 power is not needed, improving fuel economy by up to 20 percent, though one would be hardpressed to notice a difference. The ride is smooth, but corners should be handled with care.

The Ferrari 812 GTS made its debut in 2020, which is the convertible version of the 812 Superfast. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. The 812 GTS has the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Aveo was formerly known as the Kalos, a subcompact automobile built by GM Daewoo, a South Korean subsidiary of General Motors. The Aveo is based on Daewoo's latest small car platform and was originally styled by Giorgetto Giugiaro. For 2006, the Aveo, the smallest Chevy-badged car, underwent a number of changes that also gave the sedan a new face. Features in this economy car include advanced dual-stage frontal airbags with passenger sensing system, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with bolt-on wheel covers on the base models or 14-inch alloy wheels on the top model, a retuned suspension with improved steering response and larger-diameter front stabilizer bar, tilting front seat headrests, revised interior fabrics, electronic throttle control and optional CD player. The Aveo comes in three trim lines, and available as a four-door sedan or a carryover five-door hatchback. All are powered by a 1.4-litre in-line four-cylinder, though the pre-facelift Aveo5 hatchback gets a weaker motor, and both come with a good five-speed manual that can be switched for an optional four-speed automatic. The hatchback was restyled for the 2008 model year after a brief hiatus, and remains different from the sedan. After the Sonic was introduced for 2012, the Aveo sedan continued to be offered as a fleet model.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee got a second facelift for the 2017 model year. Offered with a choice of the 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or the 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a new 8-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and four trim levels. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. Another trim level introduced for 2014 is the Summit which also comes in only V8 form. The SRT8 version gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. Another feature on all models is the new 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds chrome bumper trim, painted wheel arches, real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The Summit has similar options to the Limited, with the addition of a unique SRT-like front bumper, more premium leather and wood panels for the interior. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The RAV-4 is credited for being the original small 4WD built on a car chassis. It's not that there is anything fundamentally wrong with the vehicle. It's just that the RAV-4 is not a strong off-roader, but insists on looking like one, and people buy it for that reason. It continues with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder in this market even though a V6 model has been introduced elsewhere. Most markets, including UAE and KSA, get the all-wheel-drive model, but KSA additionally gets a two-wheel-drive option as well, the base one with a manual gearbox. The RAV4 range has an array of comfort and convenience features including auto air- conditioning, a MP3 compatible CD player with 6 speakers, power windows and central locking, keyless entry, and cruise control. Its rugged yet stylish exterior appearance is enhanced by a rear spoiler, roof rails, fog lamps and alloy wheels. The high series models also feature a powered driver's seat, leather seats, a moonroof and rear corner sensors. Safety features on all models include dual-stage frontal airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control and traction control. Side airbags are optional. Minor facelifts over the years are too small to notice.

A new generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class debuted as a 2015 model. It is 95 mm longer with 80 mm extra wheelbase, 40 mm wider and up to 100 kg lighter than the previous model. In 2019, it got a slight facelift. There are three variants on offer in the GCC which is the C 180 which gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor, the C 200 and the C 250, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. More variants are expected to join later. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Cherry E5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. The front-wheel drive E5 gets a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT automatic. The ACTECO engine, jointly developed by Chery and AVL, Austria, has also passed a 3,000,000km road test and 10,000 hours tough bench test following European and American standards. The chassis of E5 is accurately tuned by Lotus on parts, including spring, shock absorber, horizontal stabiliser bar and redirector. Its gets ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD) as standard. The instrument cluster ahs multifunctional display and the central blue multifunctional window displays the comprehensive driver info including time, odometer, instant fuel consumption, average fuel consumption, etc. The integrated audio control switches on the steering wheel are easy to recognise and operate enhancing driving comfort and pleasure. Fourway adjustable seats with fabric or soft and fine leather with ventholes and contoured sides provide perfect lumbar, back and leg support. Height adjustable neck and head support relieve fatigue and protect head and neck in collision. Foldin rear seats provide large flat space for additional storage. Front ventilated disc and rear solid disc braking systems ensure stable braking performance even in tough conditions. An all metal cage with high strength steel beams in the front and back, anticollision board in the front doors and steel bars in the rear doors are designed to absorb the force of the impact during collision. Front driver and passenger airbags are standard.

The Mitsubishi Lancer Fortis arrived to finally replace the 'regular' Lancer, a massive rental favourite in the GCC. However, this time the engine in the offered in the Lancer Fortis will actually move the car, a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features include fabric cloth seats, CD player with AM/FM radio and MP3 support, halogen lamps, power windows, power mirrors, disc brakes front and back, and steel wheels. Optional equipment include alloy wheels and fog lamps. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags.

The Mercedes-Benz GLB is a new SUV model in the lineup. The compact SUV gets a 1.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine in the GLB 200 and a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder motor in the GLB 250. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

This seriously outdated version of the Land Cruiser, updated in 2001, is technically a fullsize pickup, staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The pickup, known as Land Cruiser 75 in some markets, is not as big and brawny as the V8 muscle from Ford, Dodge and Chevrolet/GMC, but it is a tough truck. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both lifted from the Land Cruiser wagon and mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. But no matter how much you pay, you won't get ABS or airbags, but you do get a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, this pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee has received a facelift as well as a few mechanical upgrades for the 2014 model year. Offered with a choice of the 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or the 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a new 8-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and four trim levels. The introduction of the 8-speed automatic transmission boosts fuel economy numbers. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only.
