Options include fog lamps, special climate control console,  steering wheel with audio controls, power sunroof, leather-trimmed seats, and a premium six-CD/MP3 player with eight speakers. Safety features include standard front airbags, although curtain and side airbags were standard on all models in the 2007 model year only, while ABS with EBD and traction control were available on higher models only..

Toyota tacks on the Land Cruiser badge on up to three of their 4WD models, including a pickup, but there is only one true Land Cruiser that everyone knows and loves for reasons unknown. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon remains at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. It is still one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. Few vehicles offer the off-road capability of the Land Cruiser, and fewer still combine this with its level of luxury. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.5-litre six-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto, and a new 4.7-litre V8 and a five-speed auto. There is also a 4.2-litre diesel with a manual. It can transport anywhere from eight to ten passengers depending on model. It is an expensive vehicle, but everything is still optional, including ABS, airbags and cruise control. Other options include leather sunroof and navigation. We'd love to love this outdated 4WD, but we hate the people who buy these, as any other road user will know why.

The facelifted-for-2010 Mazda 3 receives a brand new front end, a redone rear end, and a completely new interior. However, it still comes with a carryover 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, which was already an outclassed unit to begin with. American and European markets get 2.0-litre, 2.5-litre and turbocharged motors. The Japanese-built Mazda3 shares its platform, engine and some mechanicals with the European-built Ford Focus. The basic Mazda3 S sedan comes with 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, ABS, power windows, electric mirrors, two front airbags, a 4-speaker CD stereo, cloth seats, a new interior design and a manual a/c. A 4-speed automatic is standard. The mid-range Mazda3 V sedan adds 16-inch alloy wheels, a rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio controls, automatic a/c and a better stereo. The Mazda3 V hatchback features rain-sensing wipers, front fog lamps, side skirts, a roof spoiler, and options such as HID headlights, sunroof, LCD info display and push-button start with keyless entry. The fully-optioned Mazda3 R sedan and hatchback adds automatic wipers, electric-folding side mirrors, cruise control and different cloth upholstery, with all other options as standard. Apparently the "˜R' trim is only available in Saudi Arabia.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class came out in 2019, along with a new AMG model. Gone is the CLS 63 AMG, now replaced by the Mercedes-AMG CLS 53.  The exterior and interior have been completely changed to incorporate their new design language, first seen on the Mercedes-Benz A-Class. New engines now power the CLS-Class with the 3.0-litre turbo inline-6 engine coupled with an electric motor installed in the CLS-53 AMG. Power is delivered by a 9-speed automatic transmission and is available only in all-wheel-drive. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights, air suspension and a widescreen cockpit consisting of two 12.3-inch displays on the dashboard. Other AMG features include diamond pattern radiator grille, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a flat-bottomed sports steering wheel. Safety standards are high, which include front, side curtain and knee airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, brake assist, front collision alert, auto-braking and ABS.

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. For 2020 it got a facelift and new tech features, along with slight bump up in horsepower and torque. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Later in 2017, a 6.6-litre V12 engine was added to the lineup with all-wheel drive, called the M760Li. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

The Renault Dokker Van is a light commercial vehicle made in Morocco. In 2020 it got a new front grille design. It comes with one engine option in the GCC, which is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. The panel van version has a luggage capacity of 3,300 litres and a maximum load length of 1.90 metres, thanks to the foldable front passenger seat, that can also be tipped forward against the glove box to free up space for a load length of up to 2.42 metres. If the front seat is removed altogether it provides a carrying capacity of 3,900 litres and a maximum load length of up to 3.11 metres. The payload capacity is 750 kg. It can be equipped with the Media Nav system, that combines navigation and audio functions, featuring Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and auxiliary USB and jack sockets. phone wirelessly and directly onto the Dokker Van's music system. 8 mobile phone devices can be connected to the Bluetooth enabled Media Nav with phonebook and call history.Wooden flooring and interior panelling in the cargo area are amongst the various accessories available. The wood protection kits are designed to protect the Dokker Van's rear loading space and are made from marine-quality plywood with non-slip treatment. Storage bin kit is another wooden accessory to arrange and store tools and is the perfect complement to a full wooden protection kit.Accessorized high-strength grilles for the rear window protect goods against theft and deter vehicle break-ins. Accessories in the range also include transverse roof bars, textile carpet mats, volume and perimeter alarm with or without remote control, and 15-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features in the Dokker include ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), and one driver side front airbag.

The rugged Xterra debuted in the GCC during late 2007 and got a facelift for the 2009 model year. The Xterra is a simple but capable alternative to the Pathfinder, incorporating as much off-road gear while originally forgoing most luxury features, but Nissan did add a few conveniences in 2009 due to customer demand. The five-seater Xterra is powered by the Pathfinder's 4.0-litre V6 engine, with four-wheel-drive, low-range gearing and either a six-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. All 2009 Xterra trims now have a redesigned front end featuring two new grilles, namely sandblast aluminium finish on X, S and Off-Road models, and satin chrome finish for Xterra SE models. New features include rear a/c ducts, new audio package including six-disc in-dash changer, redesigned centre cluster, push-button a/c, Bluetooth handsfree phone and iPod connectivity. Side steps and cloth upholstery are standard on the S model, while leather seats and illuminated steering-wheel switches are standard on the SE model. A new Off Road model includes body side molding, unique two-tone seat fabric, rear differential lock, heavy duty Bilstein shock absorbers, and BF Goodrich off-road tyres on new 16 inch alloy wheels. A GPS navigation system is also available. All models feature power windows and mirrors, power steering, CD audio system, remote keyless entry, alloy wheels, low tyre-pressure indicator, 60/40 split folding rear seat, available fold-down front passenger seat, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS brakes with brake-force distribution and brake assist, although side-curtain airbags may be available in some markets. Key exterior styling features include large flared fenders, big roof rails and a rear bumper design with side steps for easy access to the roof rack.

An all-new Cadillac CT4 made its debut in 2020, replacing the ATS. In the GCC, the CT4 gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission, while a CT4-V model gets a 2.7-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the CT4 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE entertainment system with BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Infiniti G37 Convertible convertible with a folding hard-top debuted in early 2010. The sedan then received a frontal facelift for 2011. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. It is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z Roadster includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The powered soft top model almost have the same rigidity as the coupe. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

Ferrari has broken tradition and made their first ever four-wheel-drive, the FF, short for Ferrari Four. It replaced the stunning 612 Scaglietti. A love-hate design, the FF gets a roaring 6.3-litre V12 engine which revs all the way up to 8000 rpm. That power is controlled using the dual-clutch F1 gearbox. Along with the plush leather interior, a 6.5-inch display with touch screen control, a Bluetooth connection with Audio Streaming, navigation, voice command function, two USB connections, and a display with alphanumeric keypad for phone dialling. Also, for the first time something more than golf clubs can actually fit in the boot of a Ferrari, with the rear seats of the FF able to fold down to expand the luggage space. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car such as the engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions.

The Audi S6 got an all-new model in 2020. The all-wheel drive S6 has a 2.9-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Optional features for the S6 include heads-up display, sports differential, dynamic steering and ceramic brakes. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control. Optional safety features include rear side airbags, park assist, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, night vision and pre-sense assist.

The S2000 is a small two-seat roadster that can easily chase the likes of the snobby Porsche Boxster. It is a technological innovation from Honda, whose aim with this car was to pump as much horsepower out of a small 2.0-litre engine as possible, without any turbo or supercharging trickery. The S2000 is said to drive like a superbike, because big horsepower from small displacement with a narrow powerband and extremely high rpm produces a very frantic experience. Driving it slowly, shifting the manual at low rpm apparently results in very weak performance in traffic. The latest model has refinements to the engine and suspension put in place back in 2005. Changes to the S2000 in 2006 include more shoulder and elbow room, and some tweaks, most notably 17-inch wheels, drive-by-wire throttle, stability control and new headlights with a triple-beam design. Early models had a plastic rear window, while 2002-plus models get a glass one. The last external facelift was in 2004. Interior features are basic, but include leather upholstery, electric power steering, starter button, power windows, power mirrors, remote central locking, air-conditioning and a pathetic radio cassette stereo with 2 speakers.

From 2012, the design all-new Porsche 911 incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than the previous generation. It is still a 2+2 seater coupe. In 2016 the 911 got turbocharged engines and minor exterior upgrades. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S gets the same engine specs but with more power. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The 2016 Carrera S models also has the option of all-wheel-steer.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. In 2015, it got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Carnival, now known as Grand Carnival, is undoubtedly Kia's largest offering, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. It comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

Quietly put on the showroom floor by local Hyundai dealers, the unknown i30 is a new-for-2008 hatchback alternative to the Elantra. Powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the i30 is being positioned as a cheaper alternative to better-equipped compact Japanese and European rivals. It is available with only a 4-speed automatic gearbox. The i30 benefits from a spacious-enough interior and the flexibility of a hatchback cargo area, especially with the folding rear seatback. Standard features are limited, with height-adjustable front seats, 60/40 split rear seats, cloth or partial leatherette seats, power windows, electric mirrors, body-coloured exterior trim and LED cabin lighting. Other available features include keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with USB support, fog lights, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. The i30 was originally designed to compete in the European market, so it benefits from tighter suspension tuning and better cabin materials. Sadly, GCC-spec cars are underequipped, especially in terms safety, as there is only one standard airbag and no ABS brakes.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The eight-generation Hilux made its debut in the GCC as a 2016 model year. In 2021, it got a facelift. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Mechanically, the 2016 Hilux will offer a new 6-speed automatic transmission, which gives a 15-percent better fuel economy rating than the previous generation model. Engine choices include the 2.0-litre and 2.7-litre petrol engines, and a new more powerful 2.4-litre diesel engine. While the 2.0-litre is available only in rear-wheel-drive, the other two engines can be had in either four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive. Safety features for it includes front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbag for the driver, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) seat-belt equipped on all seats except the centre seat. In 2021, a lifestyle version was introduced called the Hilux Adventure. It gets 4.0-litre V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Additional features include painted bumpers, fender flares, infotainment system with touch screen and some fake wood interior trim bits.

The popular 7th-generation Lancer, receiving a major facelift in 2004, uses three four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.3-litre and 1.6-litre in the basic models, while a 2.0-litre Ralliart Edition was briefly available before being dropped in 2008. The aging non-Ralliart variants are so popular that they continued to be sold alongside the all-new 2008 Lancer EX. The 1.3-litre has a choice of a five-speed manual and a four-speed automatic. The 1.6-litre has a choice of a manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre came exclusively with an automatic gearbox. None of the engines are particularly sporting. Features, either standard or optional, include driver's & front passenger's SRS dual airbags, simple radio cassette player or a better radio cassette stereo with CD changer and 4 speakers, tachometer, optional rear spoiler, steel wheels with hubcaps or light alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, optional keyless entry system, and a rear seat centre armrest with cup holders. The Ralliart Edition specifically adds a rear spoiler, 15-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel, special interior trim, body kit and better brakes. All cars have a cloth interior, with standard power windows and mirrors.

The 2015 Dodge Charger received a significant facelift. The previous engines are there, which includes the 3.6-litre V6 and 5.7-litre V8, aside from the SRT models. They all get the 8-speed automatic transmission. The base SE V6 model gets a manual a/c, cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. The SXT V6 trim level additionally comes with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more, with some of these features reserved for the SXT Plus version offered in certain markets such as the UAE. The Rallye V6, available only in some markets such as KSA, comes with an appearance package. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, comes in three trim levels. The base "Full House" V8 trim, available in some markets such as KSA, gets almost all the features of the top V6 model except for leather and fancy cup-holders, but gains sportier suspension and brakes, with options such as power seats, the fancy cup-holders, premium audio and a few other features, depending on market. The top "R/T" model gets the "Road and Track" performance package with sportier suspension, steering, exhaust, grille, spoiler and 20-inch alloys. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

An all-new GMC Sierra will be available in 2019. There is a 2.7-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder joining the line-up, along with the V8 engines. While the 4.3-litre V8 work truck is available with a 6-speed automatic transmission, the 2.7-litre and 5.3-litre get a 8-speed automatic transmission. The 6.2-litre gets the 10-speed auto. The Middle East exclusive regular cab Sierra AT4 comes with the 5.3-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission (regular cab models get the 8-speed auto).It includes stronger shocks, front tow hooks and extra under-body protection. The interior gets a 4.2-inch display on the dashboard. The Sierra  pickups get 12-volt outlets, five USB ports and a SD-card slot. For improving fuel economy, all V8 engines have cylinder deactivation and direct injection.

The Sirion is Daihatsu's entry in the sub-compact segment, packed with features and space. It received a minor facelift for the 2008 model year, along with a bigger 1.5-litre engine. The little Sirion offers a generous amount of space for the front passengers, including a fair bit of room between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Rear passengers aren't so lucky, but they still get reasonable amounts of leg space between front and rear seats. The rear doors open wide to an angle of around 80 degrees, allowing easy entry and exit, and the tailgate eases handling of large luggage. There is a full 630 litres of luggage space with two people on board and the rear seats folded down. With five on board, it still has 225 litres. The top of the back door has decent head clearance and a pull handle also makes it easy to close the door. A luggage room lamp adds convenience, along with the CD/AM/FM Radio, power windows, central locking, front airbags, cup holders in the doors and the centre console, and split rear seats that are 60:40 foldable. It is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder motor, the Sirion shifts gears using a 4-speed automatic, as the manual is not offered here. 14-inch steel wheels are standard, while alloys are optional, among other things.

An all-new model came out for the Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S in 2020. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The Jaguar F-Type is a two-seater convertible based on a shortened XK platform. It comes with two supercharged engine choices, one a 3.0-litre V6 and the other a 5.0-litre V8. The V6 has two variants with the higher model, known as the S, getting more power. The V8 only comes in S form. It gets adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The roof is said to close or open in 12 seconds. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more.

The Epica is Chevrolet's attempt at the lower end of the midsize car market, considering the Lumina is handling the slightly higher market that is occupied by the Accord and the Camry. Launched as part of a trio with the Aveo and the Optra for 2004, it is built by GM Daewoo in Korea on a front-wheel-drive platform. The car received a restyle for 2007 and maintains the traditional sedan three-box profile instead of being over-tall like the Camry, so it looks good from far away, though its details are derivative. The interior is fairly spacious considering its price. The cabin is well-designed with plenty of convenient storage spaces, while instruments and controls are well-placed. Two engines are on offer, namely a small 2.0-litre six-cylinder that works well but is fairly underpowered, and a 2.5-litre six-cylinder that has more power but only matches four-cylinder motors from Japanese midsizers. The optional four-speed automatic transmission is smooth, while a manual gearbox is also offered for that last bit of fuel efficiency. Front airbags and ABS brakes are available. The Epica competes well in a segment that only sees action from the Koreans.

More a tall wagon than a true off-roader, the Outlander is based on the Lancer platform and uses a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine that mates to a four-speed automatic transmission only. The all-wheel-drive system splits the torque evenly between the front and rear under normal driving conditions, and distributes it wherever necessary when the going gets slippery. It does not have he equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 6-CD changer with 6 speakers, and leather seats. The Outlander is gutsy for a four-cylinder, but far from quick. It is easy to climb into, with a fair amount of room up up front and good all-round visibility as it is taller than a car but shorter than a proper 4WD. Mitsubishi decided to ditch this ambiguous genre with the next-generation 2008 Outlander, which took on the appearance of a proper 4WD.

The S80 is the flagship of Volvo range, and though it looks big in size, it is actually more of a large midsize sedan than a true fullsize barge. The front-wheel-drive models get either a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo or a 3.2-litre 6-cylinder, both with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. The top model is an all-wheel-drive sedan with a 4.4-litre V8 and a six-speed automatic, again with tiptronic. New and improved for the 2007 model year, it adds new Volvo innovations such as the wafer-thin center console that houses the digital climate controls and the Dolby Pro-Logic II surround sound system. The car is filled to the brim with the usual luxury features such as power windows, mirrors and seats, leather trim, large alloy rims and what not, but the big news is the all-new engine range. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection.

The Mercedes-AMG GT 4-door Coupe came to existence in 2020. Under the hood, the GT 43 and GT 53 gets a 3.0-litre turbo V6 with 2 different tunes and the GT 63 S gets a V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine . Power is delivered in all variants through a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights and 19-inch alloy wheels. The GT 4-door also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT 4-door with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control. More advanced safety features include front collision alert, auto braking, lane departure warning alert, blind spot monitor, pedestrian alert, evasive steering assist, and parking assist.

The Mercedes-Benz GLE-Class is essentially the new facelifted M-Class following the German brand's new nomenclature. For 2017, this midsize SUV came in three versions. The GLE 400 comes with a 3.0-litre turbo engine, the hybrid GLE 500e gets the 3.0-litre turbo V6 combined with an electric motor and the GLE 500 has the 4.7-litre V8. Both engines get a 7-speed automatic transmission. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and a choice of 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers, depending on trim level, leather upholstery, wood trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, optional keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. An AMG package is optional, and it adds a body kit and sportier suspension.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA 35 AMG 4Matic joined the lineup for the first time in 2020. It is a new performance variant, sitting below the CLA 45 AMG. It uses the same 2.0-litre turbocharged engine as the standard version, but tuned to produce more horsepower. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. The sedan features include 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Completely different from the model it replaces, the new-for-2010 Cadillac SRX is a midsize crossover 4x4 based on a front-wheel-drive platform. The new range started off in the GCC with a 3.0-litre V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic with paddle-shifting functions and all-wheel-drive. Even the base model is generously loaded, with a limited-slip differential, common power accessories, 18-inch wheels, LED tail lamps, chrome roof rails, 8-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, dual-zone a/c with rear vents and controls, cruise control, keyless entry, power-adjustable pedals, power-adjustable front seats and a leatherette interior. The top 'Luxury' version gets variable-effort power steering, continuously-variable real-time dampers, turning HID headlights, parking sensors with rear camera, navigation, 20-inch wheels, 10-speaker Bose stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, 40 GB hard drive, rear DVD screens, full keyless entry with push-button start, ventilated front seats, LED cabin lighting and a panoramic glass roof. All models get front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The BMW X3 compact crossover got a facelift in 2015. There are two variants. One is the naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the xDrive28i, and the other is the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the xDrive35i, both with 8-speed automatic gearboxes and all-wheel-drive. The new interior integrates either a 6.5-inch or an 8.8-inch screen, and new features, standard or optional depending on trim, include a heads-up display with night vision, active and passive systems such as the lane change and lane departure warnings, optional parking assistant, adaptive cruise control, surround-view cameras, Variable Damper Control to pick between Normal, Sport and Sport+, Bluetooth phone with audio connectivity, navigation, multiple front and side airbags, leather or cloth upholstery, HID headlights, keyless start, sunroof, BlackBerry smartphone connectivity to gain access to e-mails and other distractions which can be shown on the control display and read out via the optional voice output. An M package is available that adds a body kit and more. New features available on the 2015 X3 include iDrive Controller with integrated touchpad (for text input using finger movements), Parking Assistant, the full-colour BMW Head-Up Display, the anti-dazzle High Beam Assistant and Driving Assistant Plus, including Lane Departure Warning, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function and preventive pedestrian protection.

The Cordoba is designed to appeal to sedan customers who like the Ibiza hatchback. Though similar to the Ibiza, it somehow appears a lot more conservative than the Ibiza, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. It is keeping pace in the market with variations of the original car, by adding new Seat styling features to what is essentially the same car that was launched ages ago. In the Middle East, it is offered with only a VW-derived 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine, with an automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, front power windows, remote central locking, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, CD radio with six speakers, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, height and reach adjustable steering wheel, double headlamps, three-point rear seatbelts and three rear headrests, among others. Stability system with brake assistance is an option, as are rear power windows, alloy wheels and what not.

An all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz CLA 45 AMG came out in 2020. It gets an upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, available in two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. All models are all-wheel-drive. The standard features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. It got a facelift for its 2017 model, along with interior upgrades. In 2020 it got a major facelift. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, followed by the C-Class. The Mercedes-AMG E43 is a performance model and gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

Zhengzhou Nissan Automobile Company, established in 1993 and located in Zhengzhou in central China, is a 50/50 joint venture between DongFeng Group and Nissan. The ZNA Oting is a product of that affair, dating back to 2007. However, the Oting 5-seater SUV is based on the decade-old first-generation Nissan Xterra, only with a different front end and an underpowered 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Sold only in the UAE for now, only one trim level is available with rear-wheel-drive, although the four-wheel-drive version may make an appearance later. The rear-seat bench folds flat to increase cargo room. Standard features include front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, adjustable steering column, remote locks, power windows, leather seats, power mirrors, roof rack, side-steps, CD/MP3 stereo with SD card, power antenna, 16-inch alloy wheels, body-colour bumpers, manual a/c, rear parking sensors and one airbag.

Launched in 2006, the Lexus GS already started to feel dated a few years later, and the 2009 update didn't help matters too much. Lexus openly admitted that the BMW 5-Series was their benchmark for this rear-wheel-drive GS, and yet it never caught on, especially with its detuned engine choices in the GCC when compared to foreign markets. The GS 300 gets a basic 3.0-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, while the new-for-2009 GS 460 gets a 4.6-litre V8 paired with an 8-speed automatic. The list of standard equipment includes 18-inch alloy wheels, leather-trimmed seats with front power adjustment, keyless entry, pushbutton starter, 14-speaker Mark Levinson audio system with both CD and DVD capability, Bluetooth wireless telephone technology, rear camera, multiple airbags, ABS and various stability systems, sunroof, adaptive front lighting, and a 7-inch multi-information touch screen. Options on higher trim levels include DVD navigation, power rear sunshade, active cruise control and a "Pre-Crash" safety system.

An all-new Mazda CX-5 was launched as a 2018 model year. The standard engine is a direct-injection 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There is one front-wheel-drive and two all-wheel-drive versions available. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

As with the previous model, the new TT is built on the VW Golf platform. The new TT will be available with numerous engines, including a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo and a 3.2-litre V6. The TT RS model debuted in 2011 with a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo while the V6 was cancelled. The TT roadster will debut late into 2007. The new TT is a far more aggressive sports car than the model it replaces, which was more of a show car than a sports car. Like its predecessor, the curvy profile generates a lot of aerodynamic lift at the rear end, so the new TT adopts a rear spoiler which recesses smoothly into the tail at low speeds and raises automatically at over 120 kph. The new car is larger and heavier, so to compensate for the additional metal, the hood, front fenders, roof and doors are made of aluminium, while the panels of the rear body remain steel to help balance the car. "Quattro" all-wheel-drive is optional on the front-driven 2.0 turbo, while standard on the 3.2 V6 and the RS. Manual gearbox is standard, but a DSG automanual is optional. Features include cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry, alloy wheels and the usual power accessories. As was the case with the previous TT, the new car is built as part of a joint effort, with bodywork and paint done at the German plant in Ingolstadt, and vehicle assembly is completed at Audi's Hungarian plant in Gyor.

The Cadillac ATS-V is the American luxury brand's compact sports sedan offering. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS-V gets a twin-turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. A 6-speed manual is available but will most likely not be offered in the GCC. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, automatic headlamps, automatic dual-zone A/C, Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The BMW M2 made its debut in the GCC in 2016. The exterior of the M2 Coupe may look no different than that of the M235i at first glance. But there are visual changes such as aggressively-flared front and rear bumpers, quad-exhausts and sporty alloys. As much as 80% of parts can be different when comparing M cars versus their non-M versions. Underneath the bonnet is a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. The car gets an overboost function that increases the torque for a few seconds. The engine will be mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The car also receives M4-derived aluminium front and rear axles, aluminium suspension components, tuned electronic power-steering and an Active M-Differential. The longer M4-sourced axles are what led the M2 to have wider fenders, so the tyres wouldn't stick out.

The Envoy is powerful and capable midsize off-road vehicle, which is just the right size to not be a pain on the roads. It has a rigid chassis, good off-road suspension, powerful brakes and a spacious enough interior to compete in this class. It is stable at high speeds, wobbly around curves, and comfortable over rough surfaces, while being quite capable off-road, thanks to a proper four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The Envoy also comes in an XL trim with an extended wheelbase that adds a third row seat. The Envoy comes with an upgraded-for-2006 Vortec 4.2-litre inline 6-cylinder engine that generates very respectable numbers, similar to the V8 motors of some competitors. And then there is 5.3-litre V8 engine that can be had as an option only on the EXT. The V8 is equipped with GM's Displacement on Demand technology as standard which deactivates four cylinders under certain driving conditions to aid fuel efficiency, returning the full complement of power once the controller senses vehicle speed or load requires additional power. Both engines use a Hydra-Matic four-speed auto transmission. The Denali version adds chrome trim and some luxury interior features.

The Chery Arrizo 3 is the Chinese brand's smallest sedan. It does not aspire to be anything more than an inoffensive 5-seater subcompact sedan, but actually a bit bigger than most of its sub-compact rivals. Powered by a typical 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 4-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, other features include split-folding rear seats, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and all the usual basics. Touchscreen stereo, leatherette seats and more are also available. Safety features include at least 2 airbags and ABS.

A new generation Golf R debuted in 2014 in the Middle East. It got a slight facelift for the 2018 model year. Under the hood is a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, mated to a dual-clutch 6-speed automanual transmission. The all-wheel drive Golf R is lighter and more powerful than the previous generation. It features power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, sports seats, standard XDS electronic differential lock, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist, adaptive cruise control, 19-inch alloys and rear camera. Safety standards are high as it comes with seven airbags including a knee airbag, ABS brakes, traction control and stability control.

The attractive GranTurismo is a modern replacement for the 4200GT coupe, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. An S version ups the ante with a new 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale made its debut later on in 2011 and had little more power, as well as some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This new-for-2008 two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The Audi A5 originally debuted for 2008 in the GCC as a four-seater coupe based on the latest stretched A4 platform, with the range later diluted by the addition of a 5-door model. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.2-litre V6 engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive version, and a 6-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive version. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The new platform moves the engine more rearward in relation to the front axle for better balance and handling, but ultimately the car loses out on the fun factor in any form, either due to its front-driven underpinnings or to its overly-safe Quattro system.

The Kia Niro is the Korean brand's hybrid sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre engine coupled with an electric motor, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 2022 Kia Niro include power steering, power windows, halogen headlamps, cruise control, fabric seats, 8.0-inch screen with the infotainment system, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, automatic AC and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features on the 2022 Kia Niro include front airbags, tyre pressure monitor, stability control and rear camera.

The Mercedes-Benz GLA-Class is a compact crossover offering. It is powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

A new generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class debuted as a 2015 model. It is 95 mm longer with 80 mm extra wheelbase, 40 mm wider and up to 100 kg lighter than the previous model. In 2019, it got a slight facelift. There are three variants on offer in the GCC which is the C 180 which gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor, the C 200 and the C 250, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. More variants are expected to join later. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Suzuki Jimny got a complete overhaul, debuting in late 2018 with much fanfare. However, the hype was muted once it became clear that it is still following the old formula, with an outdated 1.5-litre engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic gearbox. It only comes in 3-door "wide body" form for the UAE and GCC. A ladder-frame chassis, three-link rigid axle suspension and part-time four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing are all standard. Also standard is a hard plastic interior, with features such as fabric upholstery, power windows, manual a/c and a stereo system. It now has 377 litres of luggage space with the rear seats folded down. When all four seats are occupied, the capacity gets reduced to 85 litres. For easy dirt removal, the backs of the rear seats and the boot floor are now coated with plastic. Dual front airbags and ESP are also standard.

The Magna was an all-new model back in 1997, replacing Mitsubishi's Sigma as their top-of-the-line sedan. Competing in the near-luxury segment against upscale brands, it never stood a chance, but soldiered on anyway unchanged right up to 2003, at which point it got a facelift. The Magna features a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine, a 4-speed automatic gearbox, a modern-at-the-time dashboard, decent suspension tuning and improvements in body structure that promise fair handling. Offered only as a sedan, the fairly-large Magna rode on a front-wheel-drive platform, and didn't overlap with the more-popular Galant, which was originally in between a compact and a midsize at that time. The Magna was available in essentially two flavours, namely a standard model and a sportier VR-X version. The Magna VR-X upgrades include a mesh grille, colour-keyed rear spoiler, aerodynamic side skirts, wheel lip moldings, sport-style bucket seats, unique seat fabric, and possibly sportier suspension tuning with slightly-increased engine power. Standard features on this redesigned sedan include dual airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, tinted glass, a power driver seat, an AM/FM stereo with cassette and CD player, remote keyless entry, optional leather, optional ABS and a security system. A minor facelift came for 2000, before the major one in 2004.

The all-new Toyota Supra is a co-production with the unloved 2019 BMW Z4, sharing its platform, drivetrain and other bits with the German roadster. While it may never live down the stigma attached with potential German reliability, Toyota claims there are enough changes in the tuning and overall final product to differentiate the two cars substantially. Built in Austria by Magna-Steyr and powered by a turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder BMW engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission, adaptive suspension with Normal and Sport driving modes will be standard. The new Supra is the smallest one out of all five generations, reduced to a two-seater with no back seat or not enough boot space. About the size of a Toyota 86, the Supra costs twice as much and competes with premium-badged German sports cars. The basic 3.0 model has a 6.5-inch center touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and standard Alcantara trimmed seats, while the top-spec 3.0 has a larger 8.8-inch touchscreen, navigation, wireless Apple CarPlay, 12-speaker JBL stereo sound system, wireless phone charging, head-up display and heated leather seats. Available safety features include collision warning, automatic high beams, automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, lane departure warning and more.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

An all-new model of Chevrolet Traverse came out in 2018. In 2022, the Traverse got a facelift, along with interior upgrades. Under the hood, the 2022 Chevrolet Traverse gets the same 3.6-litre V6 engine is carried over but tweaked with more power and mated to a new 9-speed automatic transmission. The model can be had in either front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. Standard trim available on the 2021 Chevrolet Traverse is the "LS", which comes with  black body side moldings, LED daytime running lights, HID headlamps, body color door handles, black rocker moldings, 18-inch aluminum wheels, solar-absorbing glass, LED tail lamps, rear view camera, switchable AWD selector, tri-zone automatic air conditioning, Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system with 7-inch diagonal color touch-screen, keyless entry and push button start. The "LT" trim gets additional front fog lamps, driver seat power lumbar support, multi-directional power driver seat adjuster, leather-wrapped steering wheel, rear park assist, optional side blind zone alert and optional rear cross traffic alert. The "LT leather" adds standard side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, surround vision camera, Bose 10-speaker system, 6-way power front passenger seat adjuster, auto-dimming rearview mirror with wide angle camera modeChevrolet MyLink audio system with 8-inch diagonal color touch-screen with navigation, heated driver and front passenger seats, available 20-inch aluminum wheels and power liftgate. The "LT Premier" option adds D-optic LED headlamps, Intellibeam headlamps, panoramic power sunroof, 20-inch aluminium wheels, power tilt and telescopic steering column, ventilated driver and front passenger seats, driver seat memory settings, heated rear seats, low speed front automatic braking, front pedestrian detection, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and following distance indicator. The top "High Country" trim adds full speed front automatic braking, twin-clutch AWD, automatic rear locking differential, inductive wireless charging, power folding third row 60/40 split-bench seat, adaptive cruise control with Stop/Go technology and 20-inch aluminium wheels.

The second-generation Clio hatchback was launched as a 1999 model, and was heavily facelifted for 2002, coinciding with the release of the Turkish-built sedan version. The all-new Mark-3 Clio was already out in European markets by 2006, but the Middle East soldiered with the older Mark-2 model. Therefore in 2006, the model received a second unnoticeable facelift, and the hatchback was renamed the Clio Campus, while the sedan became the Clio Classic. The Clio is the smallest car in Renault's range, and offers buyers a number of trim options and petrol engines, in either hatchback or sedan form. The basic 1.4-litre engine powers the standard five-door hatchback and four-door sedan, with a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. The hot 2.0-litre engine powers the rare three-door Clio 182 model, with a stock manual transmission. The unique combination of sizeable engines, unique styling, competitive pricing, safety features and equipment levels make other cars in this category look bad. The Clio is available with a host of trim levels, with names like Authentique, Expression, Privilege, Initiale, Dynamique and, for the hot 182 model, Renaultsport. Standard features include electric power steering, some sort of stereo, available power features and more. Class-leading levels of equipment include ABS with brake assist, dual front airbags, remote control central locking, power windows.

The Peugeot 5008 is the French automaker's entry in the MPV market. The 7-seater 5008 comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include power steering, power windows, digital and bi-zone air conditioning, tilt and telescopic leather steering wheel, heater power mirrors, radio with CD/AUX support, front and rear fog lamps, rear parking sensors and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher model called 'Premium' gets additional options such as tinted windows, auto headlamps, automatic wipers, panoramic roof, bi-zone AC with rear ducts, power-foldable mirrors, sundshade curtains for the back row seats and rear parking sensors with distance measurement. Standard safety features include 6 airbags and seatbelt sensors, electric parking break with hill assist, ABS brakers, electronic stability control (ESP), electronic brake distribution (EBD), emergency brake assist (EBA) and anti-slip regulation (ASR).

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The eight-generation Hilux made its debut in the GCC as a 2016 model year. In 2021, it got a facelift. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Mechanically, the 2016 Hilux will offer a new 6-speed automatic transmission, which gives a 15-percent better fuel economy rating than the previous generation model. Engine choices include the 2.0-litre and 2.7-litre petrol engines, and a new more powerful 2.4-litre diesel engine. While the 2.0-litre is available only in rear-wheel-drive, the other two engines can be had in either four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive. Safety features for it includes front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbag for the driver, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) seat-belt equipped on all seats except the centre seat. In 2021, a lifestyle version was introduced called the Hilux Adventure. It gets 4.0-litre V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Additional features include painted bumpers, fender flares, infotainment system with touch screen and some fake wood interior trim bits.

The Porsche Cayman has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Cayman have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Cayman gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Cayman S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Cayman comes standard with 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The American-built Avalon now shares its front-wheel-drive platform as well as several mechanical bits with the Lexus ES, including the engine. The 3.5-litre V6 is mated with a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic functionality. In the UAE, the base Avalon S model comes with 17-inch alloys, smart key, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, 6.1-inch touchscreen, auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror with compass, power front seats, cruise control, leatherette seats, halogen auto headlights with fog lamps, 10 airbags, ABS, stability control and dealer-installed front-rear parking sensors. The Avalon SE model adds a 7-inch touchscreen, HDD navigation, rear camera and an 11-speaker stereo with voice-control. The Avalon SE Plus model further adds further-adjustable power front seats with ventilation, premium leather, remote starter, paddle shifters, mirror puddle-lamps, HID headlights, and a power rear sun-shade.  The Avalon Limited additionally comes with adaptive cruise control and a pre-crash safety system. For KSA, the Avalon XLE base model is similar to the S trim above, lacking fog lamps and parking sensors, but gaining a WiFi feature. The Avalon Limited in KSA corresponds to the SE Plus trim above, but without nav or rear camera, which are optional.

The Forester was Subaru's first attempt at a proper small 4WD, already being the first company to offer all-wheel drive across its entire model line. The Forester was introduced for the 1998 model year and has only survived on facelifts, being heavily revamped for 2003. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester features Subaru's symmetrical all-wheel-drive system. In the Middle East, only the 2.5X model is offered, powered by a 2.5-litre flat four-cylinder, mated to a four-speed automatic. The Forester includes a MP3/WMA CD stereo, 6-CD changer, automatic climate control system, power windows, electric mirrors, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, cruise control, cloth upholstery and an automatic air conditioner. The higher models include a sunroof, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather-wrapped surfaces such as the steering wheel, gear shift knob and handbrake. The Forester is different than most compact 4WDs since, in addition to being a soft-roader with no low-range gearing, it also has a lower car-like body.

The Peugeot 508 midsize sedan got a minor facelift for the 2015 model year. It gets a new front grille, bonnet, rear bumper and tail-lights. The only engine on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan is a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. The base model features 16-inch alloy wheels, LED running lights, auto a/c, power windows, electric folding mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, cruise control with speed limiter, fog lamps, and a cooled glove box. The mid-range model adds 17-inch alloys, power seats, dual-zone a/c, one-touch power windows, AUX port for the stereo, auto-dimming mirror and rear parking sensors. The top "Allure" model gets 18-inch alloys, four-zone a/c, turning HID headlights, navigation, 8-speaker JBL stereo, sunroof, smart keyless entry with starter button, electric parking brake with hill assist, side and rear sun-blinds, heads-up display, leather and front-rear parking sensors with distance display. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. All markets do not get all trim levels.

The Renault Talisman replaces the Safrane in the French-brand's lineup. Under the hood, the Talisman gets two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT and a turbocharged 1.6-litre motor connected to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the base Talisman PE model include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors with demisting function, central locking, keyless entry, automatic dual zone A/C with rear vents, automatic wipers, steering wheel with audio/Bluetooth/voice command controls, multi-information display, fabric seats, 4.2-inch screen with AM/FM, USB, AUX, audio streaming via Bluetooth and voice command/recognition for phone, 6 speakers and 16-inch alloy wheels. The SE model gets additional daytime running lamps, fog lamps, Renault Multi-Sense system, central jog-dial, speed limiter and cruise control, height adjustable passenger seat, electric folding side mirrors, Renault R-Link multimedia system with 7-inch touchscreen, navigation, 3D sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, AM/FM, 2 USBs, AUX, audio/photo streaming via Bluetooth, voice command/recognition for phone, navigation, media and text-to-speech, refrigerated storage in front centre console armrest, rear power socket, higher quality upholstery and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 1.6TC SE model gets all of the above, plus engine start-stop, acoustic windscreen, smart engine management and twin chrome exhaust tips. The top 1.6TC LE model gets added goodies such as LED headlights, LED taillights, LED interior lamps, parking assist, 7-inch TFT digital instrument cluster, push engine start-stop button, power seats with memory function and lumbar support, auto sliding seats for easy entry and exit, rear-glass sunblind, Renault R-Link 2 multimedia system with 8.7-inch touchscreen, 3D sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, AM/FM, 2 USBs, 1 SD card, AUX, audio/photo streaming via Bluetooth, voice command/recognition for phone, navigation, media and text-to-speech, leather upholstery, wood accents, panoramic sunroof, front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, stability control, brake assist, hill-start assist and traction control. The higher models get side airbags, while only the top LE model gets blind sport monitor, moving object detection and flank guard protection.

The Rodius is the only Ssangyong-badged vehicle in the line-up that is not a 4WD wagon. Considerably ugly before, it underwent a recent facelift to improve its looks, although it is still a nightmare to look at. The five-door Rodius can seat seven or eight people, depending on how many people you want to cram in, and comes with a good set of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through either a rear-wheel-drive or a four-wheel-drive system. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, aluminium-look trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, electric mirrors and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control and electronic stability control are also available.

Zhengzhou Nissan Automobile Company, established in 1993 and located in Zhengzhou in central China, is a 50/50 joint venture between DongFeng Group and Nissan. The ZNA Oting is a product of that affair, dating back to 2007. However, the Oting 5-seater SUV is based on the decade-old first-generation Nissan Xterra, only with a different front end and an underpowered 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Sold only in the UAE for now, only one trim level is available with rear-wheel-drive, although the four-wheel-drive version may make an appearance later. The rear-seat bench folds flat to increase cargo room. Standard features include front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, adjustable steering column, remote locks, power windows, leather seats, power mirrors, roof rack, side-steps, CD/MP3 stereo with SD card, power antenna, 16-inch alloy wheels, body-colour bumpers, manual a/c, rear parking sensors and one airbag.

The current-generation Kia Optima that debuted in 2011 gets a minor facelift for 2014, mostly involving bumpers and lights. Based on the Hyundai Sonata, the midsize Optima continues to run on two economical engines in the GCC, mainly a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, with some countries receiving a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. Both are available with 6-speed manual and 6-speed automatic transmissions, though some countries will only get a standard automatic with paddle-shifters. The UAE dealer seems to bring a few units of the 2.0-litre turbocharged version of the Optima once in a while. The base model comes with power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, ventilated seats, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Kia is offering proper safety features only in the top model.

An all-new Mitsubishi L200 was released as a 2016 model year. It is sold in the GCC purely as a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Safety features include ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

New from the ground up for 2006 and much more better-looking, the M-Class, which actually uses the ML moniker, is a better on-road and off-road 4WD now. The M-Class is built for better off-road performance, with permanent all-wheel-drive plus 4ETS, a hill-start aid to help when climbing, and Downhill Speed Regulation to ensure constant speed on downhill tracks. In addition, the optional AIRMATIC package and ADS adaptive damping system so you can increase the ground clearance up to 110 millimetres at the touch of a button. Various aesthetic options include the Off-road styling package, the Chrome package, the Sports package and the Interior equipment package. Models include the 3.7-litre ML 350 and the 5.5-litre ML 500 that still uses the old V8 for now. All come with a 7-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, man-made leather/Aspen fabric or leather upholstery, tyre pressure loss warning system, crash sensors, front and side airbags, CD radio with pre-installation for mobile phone and more.

The 2015 Suzuki Celerio got a facelift, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The second-generation Punto, codenamed Project 188, was launched in 1999 for the 2000 model year. The styling was all-new while retaining the original Punto's distinctive shape and design, while the chassis and interior were completely overhauled. The new Punto also became the first Fiat in decades to carry the original round Fiat badge, to celebrate Fiat's centenary. The entry-level engine had two forms of the 1.2-litre petrol unit, with either 8 valves or 16 valves, with various manual or CVT transmission choices. A sporty two-door 1.8-litre model with a manual gearbox, called the Punto HGT, was briefly offered before 2003. The Punto had adopted the Dualdrive electric power steering and came with two operation modes, using an electric motor, rather than a hydraulic pump driven by the engine, for reduced fuel consumption. Driver and passenger airbags are fitted to all models, while side and roof airbags came as extras. ABS is also fitted to all but the most basic models. The Punto was facelifted from the 2004 model year, with new headlights and a new grilled front end, but it is unclear if many of them came to the GCC, at a time when the brand was being phased out.

The BMW X6 M got a new model for the 2020 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission.
