Standard features in the X6 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Geely Emgrand GS Sport is a Chinese-built high-riding hatchback that benefits from some Volvo input, considering Volvo is owned by Geely. The powertrain is conservative, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic. It rides on a basic independent front, torsion-beam rear suspension with four-wheel-disc brakes. Features include 18-inch alloy wheels, smart keyless entry and start, 8-inch touchscreen with Apply Carplay and Android Auto, AUX and USB ports, 6 speakers, Bluetooth, Eco/Normal/Sport drive mode selector, 3.5-inch dash display, one-touch up/down power windows, power-folding mirrors, auto a/c, rear camera with rear sensors, cruise control, panoramic sunroof, LED running lights and tail lights, halogen headlights and split-folding rear seats. Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, electric parking brake with auto-hold, seatbelt pretensioners, ISOFIX latches and 6 airbags.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Boxster have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Boxster gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Boxster S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Brilliance FSV, known as the BS2 elsewhere, is a Chinese-built compact sedan that's benefitted from technology partnerships from companies such as BMW and Toyota, with a Mitsubishi-design powertrain. Even the simplistic platform with independent-front torsion beam-rear suspension is said to be Lotus-tuned, while Italdesign Giugiaro had a hand in the styling. Available with a single 1.5-litre 4-cylinder "MIVEC" engine mated to a 4-speed automatic, the front-wheel-drive 5-seater is fairly class-competitive. Features in the base "Comfortable" trim level include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, front disc and rear drum brakes, power windows, tilt-adjustable power steering, speed-sensitive central locking, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, fabric upholstery, split-folding rear seats and a single rear foglamp. The "Deluxe" model adds 15-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, front and rear ventilated disc brakes, rear parking sensors, digital a/c, power mirrors, sunroof and front foglamps. All trim levels get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, alarm and collision beams in the doors.

The XC90 is Volvo's first proper 4WD vehicle, and a fairly good one at that. The seven-seater is powered by either a 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbo, a 3.2-litre V6 or a 4.4-litre V8, all with an automatic with tiptronic function. The V8 came only in 2005. Among the three rows of seats, the second row moves front and back offering adjustable legroom, while the foldable third row seats can be tucked away to increase luggage space. Standard features include keyless entry, 17-inch wheels, CD player, trip computer, rear air-conditioning, power windows, doors, locks and mirrors, and an eight-way power driver's seat with memory. Available features also include leather seats, a power front passenger seat, memory mirrors, a power moonroof, upgraded audio with a six CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels and self-leveling rear suspension. A sports package adds 19-inch rims, stiffer suspension and some trim pieces. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, and a rollover protection system.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2015, the RS 7 got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The BMW Z4 was completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, shifting focus and becoming a comfort-cruiser rather than the focused sports car that it was before. Along with all-new styling, the Z4 now sports a folding hard-top convertible roof that folds down in 20 seconds at the touch of a button. While still a two-seater, the Z4 now has more space for two passengers and their luggage, although not much cargo room is left with the roof down. Changes to the cabin now include more premium materials as well as an integrated iDrive multimedia computer. The Z4 comes with a choice between three inline-6 engines. The Z4 sDrive23i with a 2.5-litre, the Z4 sDrive30i with a 3.0-litre, and the Z4 sDrive35i with a turbocharged 3.0-litre, all available with a manual or automatic, with the exception of the turbo motor, which can be mated to a clutchless automanual gearbox. The Z4 comes with Dynamic Drive Control as standard, which allows NORMAL, SPORT and SPORT+ modes, each of which changes throttle response and gearbox characteristics. Other features include the iDrive system with a high-resolution display that integrates entertainment, navigation, Bluetooth phone and climate control functionality. All the usual luxury features are available, either standard or optional, such as cloth or leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, powered seats, keyless entry with starter button, alloy wheels, and HID headlights, among other options. On the safety front, the Z4 Roadster comes with stability control, ABS, front airbags, head and thorax airbags, reinforced A-pillars and roll bars behind the headrests.

The compact Actyon looks like nothing else on the road. If there ever was a sporty-looking 4WD, this is it. Too bad its 2.3-litre four-cylinder joke of an engine does not back up its looks. The engine is mated to a manual or an automatic gearbox, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Based on the same platform as other Ssangyong 4WD vehicles, the five-door Actyon can seat up to five people and comes with a host of cabin features, including a liftgate rear end.  Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, electric mirrors, alloy wheels of different sizes, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, whatever that is, while traction control, hill descent control and stability control are all also available.

The Mulsanne is a direct replacement to Bentley's flagship Arnage. Redesigned from the ground up, the extra-large sedan still retains its trademark turbocharged 6.75-litre V8, heavily modified for lesser emissions, better fuel efficiency and more power. The Mulsanne comes standard with a premium cabin treatment consisting of leather on every inch of the interior, supplemented by real wood and metal trim. Each car takes twelve weeks to produce, and customers have a choice of 114 paint colours, 21 carpet colours, 9 wood veneers and 24 interior leather hides, and be able to specify a custom colour scheme. Additionally, the car can be specified to feature a Naim 2200W audio system with MP3 compatibility, Bluetooth, iPod port and navigation. Further available features include powered massage seats, four-zone auto a/c, keyless start, HID headlights and more. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control and multiple airbags.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

GM revived an old badge for the all-new Thailand-built 2013 Chevrolet Trailblazer, completely unrelated to the old American-built one. The Trailblazer comes in LT and LTZ trim levels. The Isuzu-based pickup chassis is modified to have an independent rear suspension, so it loses some off-road cred, but it does gain a 3.6-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox, with the base model being two-wheel-drive and the top model getting four-wheel-drive. Other available features include the usual split-folding second-row and cramped third-row seats, CD stereo with USB and Bluetooth, rear a/c vents, 18-inch wheels, stability control, ABS, hill-start assist, parking sensors and six airbags.

The 360 is a mid-engined two-seater sports car, designed as a high-tech replacement for the simplistic F355, while itself being replaced by the F430 for 2005, effectively giving the 360 the short shelf-life. For this model, occasionally known as the F360, Ferrari partnered with Alcoa to produce an all-aluminium space-frame chassis. Also new was the Pininfarina styling that gave up flip-up headlights, replacing them with rounded fixed units. The new 3.6-litre V8 engine came with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed F1-style automanual. The cabin was sparse on gadgets, but the basics were standard, including leather, CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, front airbags, ABS brakes, and stability control. The coupe version was called the 360 Modena, while the new-for-2001 convertible was called the 360 Spider. The lightweight 360 Challenge Stradale came later, with  110 kg shaved off, a bump up in power from the upgraded V8, and featuring 19-inch BBS wheels, carbon-fibre side-mirrors, updated front bumper, lower ride height, and a black mesh grille at the rear.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. In 2020, it got a minor facelift in front, along with a slight power bump. Other features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. The 2020 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features in the 2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

From the 2014 model year, the Infiniti M became the Q70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

The Sorento is an attractive entry into the crowded affordable 4WD market. Offering either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.5-litre V6 with a 4-speed automatic in early models and a 5-speed automatic since 2005, the Sorento offers decent off-road ability and a fair bit of interior space, making it a good buy, given its price. Standard features include 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette with antenna and 6 speakers, manual air-conditioning, power steering, 8-way adjustable driver seat, 4-way adjustable passenger seat, power windows, 60/40 split folding rear seat, battery saver, driver airbag, proper rear lift gate, power door locks, and limited slip differential. Available features in higher models include a CD player with power antenna and 8 speakers, ABS brakes, power folding mirrors and cruise control. Four-wheel independent suspension and four-wheel disc brakes make it a good road cruiser, unlike truck-based 4WDs, although it is still no sports car.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's midsize sedan offering. It got minor exterior and interior changes for the 2015 model year. Only sold in some GCC countries, the Insignia gets a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine with front-wheel-drive. Some features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, heated leather seats with memory, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, daytime running lights, fog lamps and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, lane-departure warning, ESP and ABS.

The Ferrari LaFerrari is a limited series special, where all 499 units will be built. It is also the first Ferrari to introduce hybrid technology into their cars. An electronic motor combines with a naturally aspirated 6.3-litre V12 engine to achieve the highest horsepower numbers, but with the lowest fuel economy among any Ferrari model at the time. Power is delivered via the 7-speed automanual dual-clutch gearbox. The interior is custom-made to the buyer's liking and will of-course include all the usual safety nannies.

The Bentley Mulsanne got its second facelift in 2017. The turbocharged 6.75-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission, carries on unchanged. A Mulsanne Speed joined the lineup later on in the year with the same engine, but tuned for more power. The Mulsanne comes standard with a premium cabin treatment consisting of leather on every inch of the interior, supplemented by real wood and metal trim. Each car takes twelve weeks to produce, and customers have a choice of 114 paint colours, 21 carpet colours, 9 wood veneers and 24 interior leather hides, and be able to specify a custom colour scheme. Additionally, the car can be specified to feature a Naim 2200W audio system with MP3 compatibility, Bluetooth, iPod port and navigation. Further available features include powered massage seats, four-zone auto a/c, keyless start, HID headlights and more. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control and multiple airbags.

An all-new model of the Peugeot 508 came out in 2019. In 2021, only the 508 GT was on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan, which came with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. Standard features in the 508 include power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, push engine start, digital instrument cluster, infortainment system with touch screen, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, multifunction steering wheel, and alloy wheels. Higher models get leather seats, ventilated heating and cooling seats and panoramic roof. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. Higher models get blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keeping assist.

The Picanto is one of the smallest cars plying the Middle East's aggressive roads. Introduced for 2005, it has been facelifted for 2008. Powered by a tiny 1.1-litre four-cylinder, it is smaller than a family-size Coke bottle, mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The tall styling makes sure there is fair headroom, though legroom is conservative at best. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, radio cassette player with roof antenna and 4 speakers, manual air-conditioning, combination vinyl-cloth cabin, variable intermittent front wipers, front cup holder, seat belts and, thankfully, a tachometer. Available features in higher trim levels include a rear wiper and washer, rear shelf cover over the luggage area, body-coloured exterior trim pieces and bumpers, a luggage net, and not much else. We believe most markets do not get anything more than seat belts as safety features, although a few markets do get the front-wheel-drive Picanto with all sorts of optional airbags.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's line-up. Completely redesigned for 2012 and receiving a facelift in 2016, it remains the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive and is offered in the GCC as a 5-door hatchback. Petrol versions include the turbocharged 1.5-litre 116i, turbocharged 1.6-litre 118i and 120i and the turbocharged 2.0-litre 125i, although all models are not offered in all GCC markets. All models, except the 116i, come with a choice of 6-speed manual transmissions or 8-speed automatics, although only the automatic version is offered here. An M 135i model is offered in 5-door form, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a choice of 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic. To differentiate the sub-models, BMW offers Sport Line and Urban Line models which differ by alloy wheels, kidney grille and other appearance-related features. All trims come standard with common power accesories, cloth or leather upholstery, front and side airbags, stability control and ABS, alongside various optional features such as HID headlights, "active" steering, stereo choices and various wheel sizes. BMW claims to have improved cabin materials from the last 1 series. All models are equipped with start-stop and a/c as standard. Higher trims will include a 8.8-inch LCD monitor and Bluetooth hands-free with USB connectivity. BMW's Drive Performance Control is standard on all models. Drive Performance Control allows the driver to select one of four modes. These include Comfort, Sport, Sport+, and ECO PRO. ECO PRO aims to save fuel by adjusting throttle response to encourage slower acceleration and by limiting the use of accessories like air-conditioning, heated mirrors and seats.

The Ignis is categorized as a supermini by the Europeans, but we see it as something a little bigger and, as Suzuki claims, a little more of a 4WD wagon alternative for hauling purposes. The Ignis was facelifted for 2006, but the model had reached its last year in the GCC. Alloy wheels and foglamps are standard. Inside, all five seats provide decent space and comfort as well as firm support. The front seats slide and recline, and the driver's seat is fitted with a height adjuster. Interior amenities include door trim pockets, bottle holders on all doors, cup holders, a glove box, under-dash storage space, a front-seat back pocket, a 12-volt accessory socket, a centre console, a storage tray under the front passenger seat and more. The Ignis lives with a 1.3-litre engine with variable valve timing, and a five-speed manual gearbox is standard, while a four-speed automatic transmission is available as an option. Safety features include numerous airbags and active safety head restraints for the driver and front seat passenger.

The Hyundai Veloster Turbo finally debuted in the GCC market in 2015, after several delays over a couple of years. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side.The Veloster Turbo has a more aggressive look than the standard model, with a black hexagonal grille, fog lamps and a revised rear fascia which features two centre-mounted exhaust-tips. Under the hood is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a new 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available include a full set of airbags, LED front running lamps, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The Lexus LX 570, which was all-new for 2008, received a minor facelift for 2012. Heavily based on the Toyota Land Cruiser, new model gets a new front-end, bi-xenon headlights, new 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, new tail-lamp clusters and a couple of features such as "overturn" assist and new interior colours. The Lexus is powered by a 5.7-litre V8 mated with a 6-speed automatic transmission. In 2014, a limited-to-200 LX 570 Supercharged was offered exclusively for the Middle East market, with a 5.7-litre supercharged V8. The full-time all-wheel drive features a new 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a crawl-control feature when in low range. The "overturn" assist feature can lock one inside rear tyre to help make slow turns tighter in offroad conditions. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as multiple airbags. The leather interior can be had in tan, beige or black. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. A "Sport" kit with a unique front bumper was introduced for 2013 in the top models. The touchscreen computer gets a new interface for 2012.

The attractive GranTurismo is a modern replacement for the 4200GT coupe, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. An S version ups the ante with a new 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale made its debut later on in 2011 and had little more power, as well as some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This new-for-2008 two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The Brilliance H530 is the Chinese company's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design was styled by Italy's Pininfarina. The front-wheel drive H530 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with MP3/USB/AUX support, manual A/C, rear sensors and 15-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets leather seats, keyless start and keyless entry system, digital A/C, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

Originally introduced in Malaysia back in 1993, the Wira was based on the early-90s Mitsubishi Lancer, and continued in its early form all the way to the new century, and ending up being the most outdated car on the market. Available as a sedan or a liftback, the engine and gearbox were sourced from Mitsubishi, namely a 1.5-litre and a 1.6-litre, both 4-cylinder. The smaller engine came with a 5-speed manual or a 3-speed automatic, while the larger one came standard with a 4-speed auto. Features included cloth interior, manual or power windows, radio-cassette player, optional sunroof, optional spoiler, and not much else. Safety features were limited to seat-belts in early models, with later ones receiving a driver-side airbag, ABS brakes and safety-bars in the doors. As unrefined as the car is, proven Mitsubishi mechanicals under the skin means on-road reliability is as good as most Japanese cars, although the car itself will be falling apart from the inside out, starting with the cheap cabin trim. The car flopped in the GCC region, except in places like Kuwait, where it was marketed as a commercial vehicle.

The Toyota Yaris Sedan received a facelift in 2009. The sedan comes with either a very weak 1.3-litre or a 1.5-litre engine mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto. From 2012 however, only the 1.3-litre has been available. Standard items include power steering, a tilt-adjustable steering wheel, front and rear cupholders, two airbags, radio cassette player, 14-inch steel wheels, and ABS brakes. The suspension is independent in front and torsion beam in the rear. Options include a CD player with MP3 capability, a 60/40 split fold-down rear seat, 15-inch alloy wheels and a rear spoiler.

In 2013, the Audi R8 Spyder got a facelift. The R8 is Audi's two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The convertible made its debut in 2011. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. There is also a more powerful 5.2-litre V10 engine. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or a R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

Named after its 5.6-litre V8 engine, the QX56 is based on the Nissan Armada, which is itself is based on a pickup truck platform. It is basically an upscale version of a less expensive model, although the QX56 does have unique styling. The QX56 four-wheel-drive system uses a part-time transfer case with low gear, with settings for rear-wheel-drive, 4-high and 4-low. Its three rows of seats can be ordered in seven- or eight-passenger configurations. The QX56 comes in a single trim line and includes a five-speed automatic transmission with tow/haul mode, heavy-duty skid plates, rear auto-levelling air suspension, 18-inch seven-spoke chromed alloy wheels, tyre pressure monitoring system, intelligent cruise control, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, LED tail and brake lights, power-operated liftgate with opening rear glass, rear proximity sensor,  leather interior, real wood trim, ten-way driver and eight-way power passenger heated seats, second-row heated seats, front and side airbags, automatic dual-zone climate control, navigation system with seven-inch LCD screen, and six-CD Bose system with ten speakers and wheel-mounted controls.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Jaguar E-Pace sub-compact crossover slots in under the F-Pace in its lineup. It is based on a front-wheel-drive platform, but comes standard with all-wheel-drive and a choice of two turbocharged 2.0-litre "Ingenium" engines and a 9-speed automatic. A Jaguar Touch Pro infotainment system comes standard with a 10-inch capacitive touchscreen system. It offers 4G connectivity, 8 WiFi hotspots and a bunch of apps. The instrument panel is a 12.3-inch TFT unit which is coupled with a heads-up display. The rear offers 577 litres of space with the seats up. The E-Pace will be available in two flavours, a standard model and the R-Design model. On top of this, three specification packs are offered along with a bunch of options.

The Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year and replaces the CL65 AMG. In 2018, it got a facelift, a new engine and major interior upgrades. It is now equipped with a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8. From 2018, it was available only as an all-wheel drive. The engine is coupled to an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 9-speed automatic transmission. There's also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Lexus RX continues its grip on womenly drivers everywhere, with a new design for 2010 that isn't a radical change compared to the outgoing model. The RX 350 still comes with only one engine, namely a 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 19-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations. A front lower-bumper spoiler is optional. On debut in 2010, three trim levels were offered, namely the Premium, Premium Plus and Luxury. For 2011, the trim levels changed to Premier, Vogue, Prestige and Platinum, as a well as a mid-range 'Stone Designs' edition with a custom red-beige cloth interior.

The 2019 GAC GS8 is the Chinese brand's midsize SUV offering. The body of the GS8 is made completely of 95% high-strength steel to meet the North American SUV roof anti-force standard. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The 2019 GAC GS8 is available as a front wheel drive or four wheel drive. Standard features in the 2019 GAC GS8 includes power steering, power windows, power folding side mirrors, rain sensing wipers, HID auto headlights, LED tail-lamps, front and rear fog lamps, 10-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with 6 speakers, Bluetooth, USB port, steering wheel with audio and phone controls, sunroof, rear view camera system, front and rear parking sensors, keyless entry, smart key and button starter, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get engine start stop, LED auto headlights, interior ambient lighting, side mirror memory function, navigation, 10 speakers, panoramic sunroof, wireless charging and 19-inch alloy wheels. The 2019 GAC GS8 integrates intelligent driving assistance such as a 9th-generation extreme edition of ESP (Electronic Stability Program), an optional 360-degree panorama visual imaging system, an optional ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) system and standard eight airbags. Other safety features in the 2019 GAC GS8 include ABS, hill start assist and hold control, hill descent control, and optional lane change assist system.

The Kia Telluride is the Korean brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, the US-built Telluride gets a 3.8-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 2022 Kia Telluride, the 8-seater midsize SUV, include power steering, power windows, cruise control, infotainment system with touchscreen, Apple Carplay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, 5 USB charging ports, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, and alloy wheels. The higher trims get a bigger 10.25-inch touchscreen, better audio system, 6 USB ports, sunroof and leather seats. Standard safety features on the 2022 Kia Telluride include traction control, stability control, ABS, BA and EBD. The top model gets seven airbags, lane departure warning, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, forward collision alert, cross traffic alert and blind spot monitor.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

The sixth-generation Nissan Z shrinks in overall size and gains in engine size to become a more focussed sports car. The all-new 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. Initially launched in late 2009 in coupe form, the drop-top 370Z Roadster came in summer 2010, offering almost the same chassis rigidity as the coupe and a power soft-top. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Renault Clio RS got a new model in 2014 and started making its way to the GCC as a 2015 model year. It gets 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed EDC automatic gearbox with paddle shifters. The standard RS model gets remote central locking, auto A/C, LED daytime running lamps, power windows, power-foldable door mirrors, rain sensing wipers, cruise control, leather steering wheel and gear knob, sports front seats, automatic headlamps, rear sensors, radio and entertainment system with Bluetooth, USB & iPod connectivity and jack plug, navigation system,  handsfree entry and start system, 18-inch alloy wheels, rear bumper air diffuser with twin exhausts and rear spoiler. The RS+ model gets additional leather front bucket seats with red-stitching and rear-view camera. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD) and electronic stability program (ESP) with anti-skid regulation (ASR).

The YRV has been billed as a young and innovative car, posing as a direct rival to models in a niche that no one wants to deal with. It's cheap to own, easy to drive and offers a similar package to the Toyota Yaris hatchback, with which it shares an engine, all for a cheaper price. The car has adequate space for two adults in the front, while the back may accomodate two adults in tight settings, or maybe three kids comfortably. The car is a comfortable cruiser on long journeys, although it will lose this advantage when the roads get slightly bumpy. The 1.3-litre 4-cylinder, with the manual or auto, lacks power for swift overtaking manouevres, but is fine for town traffic driving, as it is exceptionally light and easy to handle, paticularly when parking. Features include a radio cassette player, power windows, central locking, rear foldable seat, 14-inch steel wheels and not much else. It has a 40-litre fuel tank, which should last a while as the car is very frugal indeed. It looks like a little van though, which can put many buyers off.

An all-new Volkswagen Touareg came out in 2019. It is slightly wider and longer than the previous model. It is also lighter because of its mixed material construction of aluminium (48 per cent) and high-tech steels (52 per cent). The new dimensions help it achieve more cargo room at the back. The UAE and GCC market gets two engine options - a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 unit. Notable features include the Digital Cockpit with a 12-inch display and the infotainment system with a 15-inch display. It gets a lot of new safety features as well. Along with the multitude of airbags, blind spot detection, traction control and stability control, it gets technologies such as the 'Night Vision' assistance system (detects people and animals in darkness via a thermal imaging camera), Roadwork Lane Assist (semi-automated steering and lane keeping, accelerating and braking up to 60 km/h), Front Cross Traffic Assist (reacts to cross traffic in front), and 'IQ.Light - LED matrix headlights' (interactive, camera-based dipped and main beam headlight control).

The CL-Class, the coupe version of the S-Class on which it is based, received a minor facelift for the 2011 model. This coupe features numerous innovative safety technology, such as up-front sensors which make it possible to assess the impact severity at an early stage during a crash and activate the front passenger airbag in two stages depending on the severity of the accident. Other features include Active Body Control for better handling, Intelligent Light System using bi-xenon headlights with five different lighting functions to match weather conditions. Options include night-view assist with infrared headlamps, reversing camera, voice control for car radio, DVD changer and navigation as well as tyre pressure monitoring system. Some new engines were introduced as well. Models include the CL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The CL 600 has the same 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8 carried over, which is mated to the old 5-speed automatic transmission. The performance model CL 63 AMG gets the new twin-turbocharged 5.5-litre V8, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. The CL 65 AMG still has the same 6.0-litre V12 bi-turbo engine, connected to a 5-speed automatic, but tweaked to give more power.

The McLaren 675LT or "Longtail" is a special model, limited to just 500 units, which were all sold before its official launch. It is based on the 650S but is more powerful, lighter and track-focused.The exterior includes a newly designed front splitter, Formula 1-style nose end-plates and larger 'Longtail' Airbrake. The rear deck is also new. These bodywork changes contribute to a significant increase in downforce levels, up 40 percent over the 650S. Weight has been reduced by 100 kg through the increased usage of carbon-fibre and by lighter components throughout, including newly developed suspension geometry derived from the McLaren P1. The windscreen is 1 mm thinner, saving 3 kg, while the rear bulkhead glass is 0.5 mm thinner, saving a further 500 g. The weight saving measures also include a louvred polycarbonate engine cover. These revisions to the glazing save a combined 4.7 kg. The cabin is upholstered in lightweight Alcantara, and features a four-speaker Meridian hi-fi and a satellite navigation system as standard. Front and rear track are widened over other Super Series models by 20 mm, improving grip levels and agility, while the front ride height has been lowered by 20 mm over the 650S. Gear changes are upto twice as face, thanks to Ignition Cut technology, a technique adopted from Formula 1 which sees a momentary cut of the fuel spark on gearshift.

The McLaren 570S gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S, but has 30% new components. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570S weighs just 1,313 kg and is longer than the 650S. It benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a new TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. In 2015, it got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the MDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, roof rack, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power seats with lumbar support, 3 rows for 7 seaters, 3-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 12 speakers, DVD player with Dolby Pro Logic II (PL2)/MP3/WMA/USB/AUX support & 100 GD hard-disk, handsfree telephone with voice recognition, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard. The higher model gets adaptive cruise control, premium MILANO leather and bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the MDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), traction control, hill-start assist and trailer stability assist. The higher model gets additional blind spot information, crash mitigation brake system & forward collision warning system.

Created by Ford's SVT team, the updated-for-2010 Shelby GT500 is the most powerful car you can buy at its price. Powered by a supercharged and intercooled 5.4-litre DOHC V8 engine, it comes with a 6-speed manual,and a new final drive ratio changed from 3.31 to 3.55 for better acceleration. For 2011, Ford switched to an aluminium engine block, making it 55 kg lighter while adding 10 hp. Features include a twin-disc clutch to improve driveability, a resonator to reduce the supercharger whine, a domed aluminium bonnet to help in cooling, and a conical air filter for better breathing. The suspension system remains independent at the front and live-axle at the rear. Brakes, suspension and steering have also been improved. The GT500 gets Goodyear F1 Supercar tyres and aluminium wheels. The coupe gets forged 19-inch rims while the convertible gets cast 18-inch ones. A redesigned front splitter, a revised duck-tail spoiler, and a fake rear diffuser housing large dual exhaust tips complete the exterior package for the beefed-up facelifted Mustang. The interior uses genuine leather, real aluminium trim and upscale Alcantara inserts. Convenience features include Ford's SYNC voice-activated hands-free in-car communication and entertainment system, Bluetooth, power windows and mirrors, customisable ambient lighting and cruise control. The GT500 also features safety devices such as stability control with sport mode, ABS, dual front airbags, side-impact airbags and more. It might be available through special order in GCC markets.

The quasi-legendary Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift in 2015, but it remains largely unchanged since the debut of this version a decade ago. The Pajero is a true off-roader, but has carved a niche as a family wagon. Powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a multimedia entertainment system, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The McLaren 720S is the successor to the 650S, built on a modified carbon chassis which is lighter and stiffer than that in the 650S. The 720S Spider came out a year later with a retractable hard-top roof. The 720S Spider sports a turbocharged 4.0-litre engine, which is basically a reworked variant of the 3.8-litre unit in the 650S, featuring a lengthened stroke and 41 percent new components, and mated to a carryover 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. An adaptive hydraulic suspension system with Proactive Chassis Control II, a redesigned air-brake spoiler which doubles the downforce compared to its counterpart in the 650S, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system, are all standard. Other features include an 8-inch capacitive touchscreen, folding driver display, premium audio system from JBL-Kenwood, ambient lighting, and Static Adaptive Headlamp with 17-LEDs per unit. Safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS, and stability control. Some interesting driver aids include Variable Drift Control and launch control.

Toyota introduced an all-new Camry for 2007. The carryover model has been facelifted for 2010, with a new grille, reshaped headlights, LED-style tail lamps and new wheel designs. The Camry remains the same on the inside however. The engine choice remains the same, with the existing 2.4-litre 4-cylinder that dates back to the 2003 version, while the 3.5-litre V6 option is reserved only for the Aurion sedan. The 4-cylinder can be had with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. Among various trim levels, the Camry is available with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a keyless entry system, front and optional side airbags, and either steel or alloy wheels. The SE version, known as Touring in some markets, made a comeback in 2011 with a body kit and firmer sports suspension. The Toyota Camry continues to define the commuter-class midsize 4-door sedan segment and should remain competitive, even with its rising base price.

The 2018 Ford Transit is the brand's large commercial van offering. It seats up to 2 people, and comes in 3 roof heights: Low, Medium and High. It comes in 2 wheelbases and 3 lengths:RWB, LWB and LWB EL. Under the hood, the 2018 Ford Transit gets the 3.7-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, vinyl seats, halogen headamps, AM/FM stereo, 4 front speakers, auxiliary audio input jack and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features include AdvanceTrac with RSC (Roll Stability Control), airbags – driver and front-passenger, airbags – Safety Canopy System with side-curtain airbags for front row, passenger-side front airbag with deactivation switch and rear view camera with trailer hitch assist, SOS Post Crash Alert System, and tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS).

The SL has undergone a major redesign for 2009. Models now include a new 3.0-litre SL 280 base model, the continuing 3.5-litre SL 350, the carryover 5.5-litre SL 500 and the existingtwin-turbo 5.5-litre SL 600 rocketship. Upping the ante are two sport-tuned models, namely the new 6.3-litre SL 63 AMG and the twin-turbo 6.0-litre SL 65 AMG. Interesting features include optional Active Body Control suspension and optional neck-ventilation fan thingies. The redesigned front end sports different headlights and bumper, while the rear is mildly updated by new tail-lights and bumper spoilers. Along with new wheels on the outside, new interior appointments include new materials and colour schemes. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The JAC S3 is a sub-compact crossover SUV, with styling derived from Hyundai no less. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine from 2017 onwards, mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Externally, the S3 SUV also has 16-inch alloy wheels and LED running lights as highlights. Under the skin, electric power steering, independent front suspension, semi-independent rear suspension and four-wheel-disc brakes are standard. Features include all the basics, such as power windows and mirrors, sunroof, keyless entry, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, faux leather upholstery, split-folding rear seat, cruise control and more. Safety features include 6 airbags, hill-start assist, ABS with EBD and hydraulic brake assist, ESP, rear camera and tyre-pressure monitor.

Maxus G10 is a the Chinese brand's MPV offering. Under the hood, there are two engines. The cargo vans get a naturally aspirated 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox, while the people carrier gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the G10 people carrier include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric mirrrors, keyless entry, manual dual-zone A/C, radio with MP3/AUX support and 6 speakers, halogen headlights, front & rear foglights, sliding doors, lift tailgate and 16-inch wheels. The higher models gets LED headlamps, LED taillamps, dual-sliding doors, rear panorama sunroof, leather seats,  7-inch touch screen with DVD system, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control and traction control.

The Magna was an all-new model back in 1997, replacing Mitsubishi's Sigma as their top-of-the-line sedan. Competing in the near-luxury segment against upscale brands, it never stood a chance, but soldiered on anyway unchanged right up to 2003, at which point it got its 2004 facelift. The Magna features a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine, a 4-speed automatic gearbox, a decent interior and fair handling. Offered only as a sedan, the largish Magna rode on a front-wheel-drive platform, but once the new larger Galant was introduced, it essentially meant the death knell for the Magna. The Magna was available in essentially two flavours, namely a standard model and a sportier VR-X version. The Magna VR-X upgrades include a colour-keyed rear spoiler, aerodynamic side skirts, wheel lip moldings, sport-style bucket seats, unique seat fabric, and possibly sportier suspension tuning with slightly-increased engine power. Standard features on this redesigned sedan include dual front airbags, available side airbags, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, tinted glass, a power driver seat, an AM/FM stereo with cassette and CD player, remote keyless entry, optional leather, optional ABS and a security system. This version, though attractive, only lasted for two models years, and unsold stocks were available at discounted dealer prices all the way till late 2006.

The all-new Porsche Panamera is the German manufacturer's first ever 4-door sedan model. The 'Gran Turismo' is available in five versions, namely the Panamera S, the Panamera 4S and the top-of-the-range Panamera Turbo, with the base Panamera V6 and the Panamera 4 V6 joining the range in the summer of 2010, while the flagship Panamera Turbo S debuted in early 2011. The Panamera S and the Panamera 4S have a 4.8-litre V8, while the Panamera Turbo has a turbocharged 4.8-litre V8. An upgraded 4.8-litre turbo V8 comes the Panamera Turbo S, with an overboost function as well. All come with a 7-speed PDK automanual gearbox, while the 4 V6, 4S and Turbo feature all-wheel-drive. The base V6 and the S can also be had with a 6-speed manual. All versions come with Porsche's new fuel-saving start-stop function. Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM) is a standard feature on the Turbo and an option on the Panamera S and 4S, with adjustable damping for the adaptive air suspension. In the Sport Plus Mode, the Panamera is lowered by 25 mm. The Panamera comes on newly developed 18-inch and 19-inch wheels, with 20-inch aluminium wheels available as an option. Available on the Panamera Turbo is an active adjustable rear spoiler. The four-seater Panamera boasts a unique leather-draped interior, with four sports seats and useable cargo room. Optional is a four-zone automatic a/c with individual adjustments for each seat. The Panamera S and 4S come with the "CDR" stereo as standard, while the Turbo is equipped with "PCM" multimedia computer, with navigation optional on the other two models. As an option, rear passengers can enjoy two consoles integrated in the headrests of the front seats with swivelling 7-inch touchscreens. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The popular 7th-generation Lancer, receiving a major facelift in 2004, uses three four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.3-litre and 1.6-litre in the basic models, while a 2.0-litre Ralliart Edition was briefly available before being dropped in 2008. The aging non-Ralliart variants are so popular that they continued to be sold alongside the all-new 2008 Lancer EX. The 1.3-litre has a choice of a five-speed manual and a four-speed automatic. The 1.6-litre has a choice of a manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre came exclusively with an automatic gearbox. None of the engines are particularly sporting. Features, either standard or optional, include driver's & front passenger's SRS dual airbags, simple radio cassette player or a better radio cassette stereo with CD changer and 4 speakers, tachometer, optional rear spoiler, steel wheels with hubcaps or light alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, optional keyless entry system, and a rear seat centre armrest with cup holders. The Ralliart Edition specifically adds a rear spoiler, 15-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel, special interior trim, body kit and better brakes. All cars have a cloth interior, with standard power windows and mirrors.

The new-for-2011 Mazda 2 is a facelifted version of the Mazda2 that has been on sale in Europe since 2008. Offered for the first time in the GCC, it comes in sedan and hatchback versions, and competitively priced when compared to its platform-mate, the Ford Fiesta. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloys are optional. The interior can be had in either black or two-tone, with ten exterior colours available. The glove-box lid is a unique two-compartment design, with one compartment exposed on top to keep files and papers in. The seats are cloth-upholstered, and every other piece of cabin trim is hard plastic, with no padded armrests. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The Mazda2 is highly rated in European crash tests, but those safety ratings are based on Euro-spec models with side airbags, not available here.

The Sierra 1500 range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado, which sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Sierra 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

The Hyundai Azera fills the gap between the mid-size Sonata and the luxury Genesis sedan. It has been completely overhauled for the 2018 model year. The new Azera, known as Grandeur in Korea, comes with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2021, it got a significant facelift to align itself with the new corporate design first seen in the 2020 Sonata. Features in the 2021 Hyundai Azera include smart keyless entry with starter button, mood lighting, available panoramic sunroof, fake wood trim, rear sunshade, Apple Carplay system with Smartphone mirroring, premium analogue clock, auto-dimming mirror, electric parking brake with auto hold, leather powered seats, fog lamps, and parking sensors. Optional features in higher trims include xenon lights, memory and seat massage for driver, heating & cooling for front seats, electric tilt & telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth, tyre pressure monitoring system, electric folding mirrors, adaptive cruise control, rain sensor, dual-zone a/c, and a DVD Navigation system with rear camera. Safety features include up to 8 airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control.

The new-for-2011 Safrane is the second iteration of Renault's Korean-built midsize sedan offering in the GCC. It has been completely redesigned compared to the previous Nissan-derived model, and now comes with three Nissan-sourced engines. The base model comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and comes standard with a CVT automatic, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lights, manual a/c, keyless entry, power windows, alarm, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth phone, Renault key card, cruise control with speed limiter, grey fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. The base model can be optioned up with a package that includes a tyre pressure monitoring system, dual front-side thorax and curtain airbags, auto headlights, auto windscreen wipers, electrically adjustable and folding door mirrors, dual-zone climate control, leather steering wheel, air quality ioniser, fragrance diffuser, dark carbon fabric seat trim, 17-inch alloys and a rear spoiler. The mid-range model comes with a 2.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, and additionally features stability control with traction control. The top model comes with a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, and additionally comes with an athermic windshield, electric mirrors with memory function, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, tri-zone climate control, deadlocking with an anti-intruder device, electric rear windows with anti-pinch, Bose CD/MP3 stereo with 10 speakers, Bluetooth phone, Renault keyless smart card, panoramic sunroof, floor mats, cream leather seats, power front seats with massage, integrated rear sunblind, as well as front and rear parking sensors. Items such as HID headlights, dark leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels and an electronic parking brake are optional in some markets.

The Pagani Huayra supercar made its debut in 2012, to succeed the company's previous offering, the Zonda. Powering the Huayra is a bespoke 6.0-litre twin-turbo, V12 engine developed by Mercedes-AMG.  It uses a 7-speed sequential gearbox and a single disc clutch. The choice not to use a dual-clutch in an oil bath was due to the increase in weight of over 70 kg, thus negating any advantage of the faster gear changes in a double-clutch transmission. As a result, the entire transmission weighs 96 kg. The car is equipped with Brembo brake calipers, rotors and pads. The calipers have four pistons in front and four in the rear. The rotors are drilled carbon ceramic.

While at first glance the Renault Zoe may appear to be a regular econo-hatchback, it is a bespoke design with squinty headlights and intricate tail lamps. The cabin is all hard plastic, but the design is space-age, from the LCD gauges to the unique seats. The electric motor seems to offer adequate acceleration for city driving. The brakes are very strong, if a little uneven-feeling, probably because they are of the regenerative variety, sending energy back to the battery every time you brake hard. Depending on the type of charger and socket, it can take between 2 hours to 25 hours to charge the full battery. There isn't any engine noise, therefore road and wind noise are obviously more noticeable. Two models are available - a short-range model with a range of 80 km, while the long-range model can go up to 300 km. Only the long-range model will be offered in the GCC. Both models have a top speed of 140 kph making it just about suitable for highways.

The 2020 GAC GS3 is the brand's small SUV offering. Under the hood it gets a 1.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, smart key, AM/FM radio with MP3/WMA support, 2 USB ports, 8-inch screen, Bluetooth, 6 speakers, steering wheel with audio controls, manual A/C, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, reverse parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include automatic AC, auto headlights, automatic A/C, rear A/C vents, folding side mirrors with defogging and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include dual front airbags, ABS, EPS, TCS, EBD, brake assist, and tire pressure monitoring system.

The Patriot is an all-new compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine with either a standard 5-speed manual transmission or an optional second-generation CVT automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. The optional off-road package has simulated low-range gearing using the CVT gearbox. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

The Haval H6 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. An all-new model was launched in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, Bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and traction control.

Ford decided to build this uber-expensive mid-engine supercar to celebrate the Blue Oval's Centennial. The Ford GT is to be built for two or three years in a limited run. Powered by a massive 5.4-litre V8, it is fitted with a six-speed manual transmission and capable of speeds in excess of 300 kph. It lacks the amenities of a Ferrari V12 cruiser, but it is supposedly comfortable and accommodating for a high-performance sports car. It does however outperform many Ferrari models that cost more than the GT, so the price is considered a bargain by many. There is no trunk to speak of so it can't be your only car, which is a shame. Standard features include air conditioning, AM/FM/CD/MP3 two-speaker stereo, tilt-and-telescope steering wheel, power windows, seats and mirrors, leather trim, keyless remote, and textured rubber floormats. An optional McIntosh stereo adds an eight-inch subwoofer and one-inch A-pillar speakers. Other options include forged aluminium wheels, painted brake calipers, and painted racing logo stripes. Standard safety equipment includes frontal airbags, ABS brakes and a tyre inflation kit.

The Dodge Durango was completely redesigned in 2011. Mildly facelifted for 2014 with a whole lot of LED lighting, the three-row crossover SUV is based on a stretched Jeep platform. There are now three trim levels, namely the base SXT V6 and SXT Plus V6, the Limited V6 and Limited V8, the R/T V8 and the Citadel V8. The carryover engines, a 3.6-litre V6 and a 5.7-litre V8, all now get a new 8-speed automatic with tiptronic as standard. The base model can be had in rear-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. All higher trim levels are all-wheel-drive, although only the V8 Hemi models get low-range gearing. The SXT model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, tri-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, built-in rechargeable torch, cargo cover, 6-speaker CD/DVD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with 30GB hard drive and audio jack, fog lamps, automatic headlights, hill-start assist and keyless entry. The Limited adds LED running lamps, leather steering wheel, remote start, front power seats with memory, Bluetooth, navigation, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, 9-speaker stereo with subwoofer, power liftgate, chrome roof rails, chrome mirrors with indicators, chrome exhaust tip, rear parking sensors, tyre pressure display, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, and rear-view camera. The R/T model adds leather seats, 20-inch wheels, power-adjustable steering wheel, heated first and second-row seats, HID headlights, body-colour exterior trim, sports suspension, rain-sensitive wipers and more. The top Citadel model adds 20-inch chrome alloys, bigger brakes, heated steering wheel, Nappa perforated leather, ventilated front seats, HID headlights, sunroof, blindspot monitor & cross-path detection, forward collision warning and adaptive cruise control. Some of the Citadel's features seem to be optionally available on the lower trim levels. Standard safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, rain brake support, anti-theft alarm, active headrests and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The V5 Crossover is aptly named, although we'd say it is more of a minivan segment player. From what we can gather from vague press materials, it aims to include all the comforts of a luxury car with the space and versatility of a wagon. The interior is beautiful in design, though the build quality is far from perfect. The centrally-mounted gauges and the fake wood trim are expected downsides. Powered by the same 2.4-litre four-cylinder Mitsubishi engine that serves most other Chery models, it comes with a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power windows, remote central locking, CD player with optional 6-disc changer, 16-inch alloy wheels, manual cloth seats or optional electric leather seats, dual front airbags with optional front-side airbags, ABS-assisted four-wheel-disc brakes with EBD, power mirrors, parking sensors, power steering, optional DVD navigation, sunroof and of course an alarm system should someone try to steal your Chery.

The Q60 Coupe underwent a full redesign in 2017. The base motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, while a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine is available is the more powerful option. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

A new generation Audi TT came out as a 2015 model year. Under the hood, it gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit with two different tunes. The standard TT can be had in front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive "quattro" format, while the TTS gets more power and is only available with all-wheel drive.
