A 6-speed manual gearbox is standard on both models, with an optional 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission optional. Standard features in the TT include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fabric seats, radio with CD/USB/AUX support, parking sensors and manual A/C. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system with a touch-screen, navigation, rear-camera, hard-drive, card readers, Bluetooth, voice control system, leather seats and automatic A/C. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic stability control (ESC) while lane assist is optional.

The YRV has been billed as a young and innovative car, posing as a direct rival to models in a niche that no one wants to deal with. It's cheap to own, easy to drive and offers a similar package to the Toyota Yaris hatchback, with which it shares an engine, all for a cheaper price. The car has adequate space for two adults in the front, while the back may accomodate two adults in tight settings, or maybe three kids comfortably. The car is a comfortable cruiser on long journeys, although it will lose this advantage when the roads get slightly bumpy. The 1.3-litre 4-cylinder, with the manual or auto, lacks power for swift overtaking manouevres, but is fine for town traffic driving, as it is exceptionally light and easy to handle, paticularly when parking. Features include a radio cassette player, power windows, central locking, rear foldable seat, 14-inch steel wheels and not much else. It has a 40-litre fuel tank, which should last a while as the car is very frugal indeed. It looks like a little van though, which can put many buyers off.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class came out in 2019, along with a new AMG model. Gone is the CLS 63 AMG, now replaced by the Mercedes-AMG CLS 53.  The exterior and interior have been completely changed to incorporate their new design language, first seen on the Mercedes-Benz A-Class. New engines now power the CLS-Class with the 3.0-litre turbo inline-6 engine coupled with an electric motor installed in the CLS-53 AMG. Power is delivered by a 9-speed automatic transmission and is available only in all-wheel-drive. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights, air suspension and a widescreen cockpit consisting of two 12.3-inch displays on the dashboard. Other AMG features include diamond pattern radiator grille, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a flat-bottomed sports steering wheel. Safety standards are high, which include front, side curtain and knee airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, brake assist, front collision alert, auto-braking and ABS.

The Prado has become a popular choice among people who want a true off-roader but never go off-road. The Prado also shares a bade with the legendary Land Cruiser which makes it more attractive. The latest Land Cruiser Prado is a refined animal, taking advantage of technical and engineering advances that offer reasonably smooth performance on the road and reasonably capable off-roading ability. One look at it reveals rock-solid build quality so obviously missing from competitors from American manufacturers. The Prado is offered with a 2.7-litre four-cylinder, a 4.0-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesel. The petrol engines get Toyota's more modern manual and automatic gearboxes, while the weak diesel gets only a manual. The cabin is spacious and roomy with abundant headroom and legroom. Features of the interior include dual-zone air-conditioning and a CD/cassette audio system with either 4 or 6 speakers, depending on model. The Prado comes with dual front airbags and ABS as standard, with seating for either five or eight people. Side-airbags and stability control are not offered in this aging SUV.

The BAIC A5 is the Chinese brand's large sedan offering. Since BAIC bought off SAAB in 2009, the A5 uses the Swedish company's 9-5 chassis. Under the hood, there are two turbocharged 4-cylinder engine options - the 2.0-litre and 2.3-litre, both of which are mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission.  Standard features on the A5 include power steering, power windows, central locking, remote control entry, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 6 speakers, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, electric sunroof, push-start button, paddle shifters, Bluetooth, and 8 speakers. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, ABS, brake assist, electronic brake distribution and hill start assist.

The Fortuner is Toyota's cheapest SUV offering. Although this Thai-built 4WD is based on a pickup, its styling is very softly finished, with none of its truck-like toughness showing. It has true off-road ability, thanks to four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. It also has space for five, or optionally seven, and its value-packed price has attracted families rather than desert junkies. The Fortuner is available here with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as a 4.0-litre V6 engine. Some markets such as Saudi Arabia, it gets a 2.4 turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine option as well. Most markets offer four-wheel-drive as standard, but a two-wheel-drive version is also offered in Saudi markets. It has space for five adults and two kids. Features include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, and fabric upholstery, although the basic model is only offered in some GCC countries. Higher trim levels, which is standard now in the UAE, get fake wood, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear diff lock, ABS, multi-information display, 6-speaker CD stereo and optional leather. Top-spec Saudi models get HID headlights, power driver's seat and wi-fi features as well.

The Ford Escape gets a completely new design for the 2013 model. Slightly longer than the previous model and ditching the V6 motor, the new shape will arrive in the GCC with just the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and only front-wheel-drive for now. The interior will also receive a major upgrade as it will have the Microsoft SYNC entertainment system we have all come to expect in all Fords. The  Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering.  Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It might get all-wheel-drive in the future, and has decent ground clearance, but it will not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The Nissan Altima, a roomy and practical midsize sedan, has been completely redesigned for the 2008 model year, with slightly more sporty handling and a little more extrovert styling than the competition. The Altima sits at the top of the class in terms of power. Available are a 2.5-litre four-cylinder and a 3.5-litre V6, both with a choice of six-speed manual or CVT automatic transmissions. The Altima is the only one in its segment to offer a manual gearbox with the V6. Also, it will be sold in either sedan or coupe form, although the coupe will only be available with the V6. The spacious Altima offers standard features such as power windows, keyless entry and start, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, power steering, and an in-glass antenna for the nine-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity. Also available are power mirrors, optional electric seats, sunroof, cruise control, leather, 17-inch alloy wheels and HID headlights. ABS brakes with Electronic Brake-force Distribution and Brake Assist are standard, as are front airbags. Side and curtain airbags are also available.

The latest ScÃ©nic is based on the Megane platform. It is what could be called a compact people carrier, with a longer seven-seater version also available, called the Grand ScÃ©nic, with a longer wheelbase and rear overhang, and with two small child-sized seats in the enlarged luggage area. It is available in the region with a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with an automatic. The Scenic employs Renault's new corporate styling cues and technology, such as the Renault Card keyless immobiliser and an automatic parking brake on some trim levels. Features include folding front passenger seat with integrated table, automatic headlights and windscreen wipers, 'child minder' mirror, and front and rear electric windows. An optional upgrade enables all the exterior body mouldings to be painted to match the bodywork. Safety features include dual front airbags, front lateral airbags, side curtain airbags, and ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Brake Assist.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. For 2013, a Roadster version was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

The Volvo C70 is a coupe and a convertible thanks to its power-folding hard-top. First introduced in its current guide back in 2007, it received a frontal facelift for 2011. The C70 has room for four average-sized adults. The three-piece retractable steel roof folds up or down electrically in 30 seconds. Development of the trick top was apparently helped along by Pininfarina in Italy. The new car is slightly shorter and lower than the old model, though it offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers. Available in this region is only one turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, with a 5-speed automatic gearbox and front-wheel-drive. Standard features include dual zone automatic climate control, power seats, trip computer, automatic dimming rear-view mirror and a CD audio system. Safety features typical of Volvo include emergency pop-up roll bars, ABS brakes, a front side-impact protection system also known as SIPS, and a whiplash protection they like to call WHIPS.

The Jaguar F-Pace is the British luxury brand's first SUV in their lineup. It comes with a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine with two different tunes. Later on, a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine joined the lineup. Power is delivered via an 8-speed automatic transmission for all motors. A limited production "First Edition" model was released initially. The Pure, Prestige, R-Sport and Portfolio models get the standard 2.0-litre and 3.0-litre engines, while the F-Pace S and the First Edition trims get the more powerful 3.0-litre engine. Standard options on the all-wheel drive F-Pace include power windows, power mirrors, power steering, speed proportional steering, electric parking brake, hill launch assist, LED taillights, 2-zone climate control, paddle shifters,  5-inch screen, Bluetooth connectivity and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include 19-inch rims, luxury sports seats, electric seats with lumbar support, sliding panoramic roof, interior mood lighting, body kit, and Meridian Digital sound system. Safety features include front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera, 360-degree parking view, valet mode, blind spot monitor, traction control, front and curtain airbags.

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lamborghini to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. The upgraded LP640 model with a larger 6.5-litre V12,  with a unique body kit and more power, is the only version on sale now. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops.

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive 6.2-litre V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lambo to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. Introduced in 2002, the Roadster came in 2004, while production ended by 2006, to be replaced by the Murcielago LP640 coupe model with a larger 6.5-litre V12. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops. The rear air intakes and spoiler are adjusted automatically, depending on speed, to improve aerodynamics. Unlike older Lamborghinis, these cars are known to be a bit more forgiving for casual cruising.

The Korean-built Captiva is the General's first proper entry into the softroader market, offering a choice of two powertrains, namely the 2.4-litre four-cylinder with manual or automatic, and the 3.2-litre V6 with automatic. Features include wheels from 16-inch up to 18-inch, turn signals integrated into its exterior mirrors and holes in the front fenders. Protective moldings and front-rear skid plates define its look. Generous interior dimensions offer decent cargo space and seating for as many as seven. Class-leading safety features include an optional rollover protection system, dual front airbags, optional traction control and standard ABS brakes. There is also hill descent control system to go down steep hills, which is an odd addition since the Captiva can be had in front-wheel-drive trim too, in addition to the all-wheel-drive model. Additional features, standard or optional, include an MP3-capable CD stereo with steering wheel controls and MP3 player inputs, parking sensors, sunroof and a trip computer.

Renault introduced an all-new entry-level model in 2009 to replace the aging Clio. Named the Renault Symbol, it is basically more of the same, but with a new skin. That means the Symbol is based on the outgoing Clio Classic sedan, and continues its production in Turkey. Also continuing are the same weak 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Also, while the interior design is largely the same, the exterior gets a total makeover, for better or worse. The Symbol is said to benefit from the old Clio's sporty suspension tuning as well as its frugal fuel consumption. Apparently the Symbol is also more aerodynamic, while losing a bit of weight too. The cheap Renault can be outfitted with power windows, 14-inch or 15-inch alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, fog lamps, automatic a/c, folding rear seat, and various types of cloth upholstery. In terms of safety, the Symbol can be had with ABS and dual front airbags.

The Chevrolet Corvette C6 is the most capable Corvette ever. The LS2 V8 powerplant has grown to 6.2 litres for 2008, with power and torque that is killer at the track and useable in regular driving. The standard tranny is an updated 6-speed manual gearbox, while a new 6-speed automatic with paddles is optional since 2007. The steering is improved for 2008. Large 18-inch wheels at the front and 19-inch at the rear and exposed headlamps with fixed Xenon HID lights continue to define the Corvette. Available as a hatchback coupe with a lift-off roof panel or as a convertible with a fabric soft-top and heated glass rear window, while a power top is also available, as are optional magnetic shocks and a two-mode exhaust. The new race-bred Corvette Z06 packs a massive 7.0-litre V8 engine, and comes in manual coupe form only, offering performance that rivals Ferrari. In 2009, the Corvette ZR1 was launched, with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 and 6-speed manual, along with various upgrades such as some carbon-fibre body panels, stiffer suspension, bigger brakes and more. The Corvette's only letdown is the less-than-stellar interior, although GM makes up for it with gadgets such as keyless start, button-actuated door opening and a heads-up display. Other available features include touchscreen navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, power seats, front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, leather and more. Previously, a Z51 package was available for the base Corvette with upgraded suspension, close-ratio manual gearbox and other mods, but from 2010, a Grand Sport version based on the regular model replaced that package with similar mods derived from the Z06.

The Oullim Spirra is a sports car manufactured by Oullim Motors, a Korean company co-founded by former Ssangyong designers. Power comes from a mid-mounted Hyundai-sourced 2.7-litre V6, available in several states of tune. The Spirra S adds a small turbocharger to that mill, and it's the version that was shipped in to the UAE. All models are fitted with a 6-speed manual transmission, and power is sent to the rear wheels. The Spirra is constructed as light as possible through a full carbon-fibre body over a tubular spaceframe. The entire process is done by hand by a team of professional craftsmen and mechanics. Grip is provided by 225/40R 19 front tyres and 275/40R 19 rear tyres. Not much else is known about this rare car.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 got a second lift in 2019, featuring a new front grille. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The A3 hatchback slips into Audi's line-up as the company's smallest and cheapest model. It was introduced in 2004, received a minor facelift in 2005, and has undergone a second facelift to keep it fresh. Sharing its platform with the MKV-generation VW Golf, the main A3 models now available here are a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, both turbocharged 4-cylinder engines mated to front-wheel-drive platforms and dual-clutch automanual gearboxes. Most dealers do not offer Quattro, manual or V6 models, as found in Europe, although Audi's clueless GCC-office people might argue otherwise. Since the three-door flopped here, the only bodystyle offered now is the five-door Sportback. Standard features include four-wheel disc brakes, 16-inch alloy wheels, automatic climate control, power windows, power locks with keyless remote, cloth seats and a CD player. The list of options vary, depending on who you ask. AS for the facelift, changes include new headlights, re-sculpted front bumper and possibly new tail-light lenses. The compact A3 tries to justify its high price with a well-built exterior and a pleasant interior, as well as a badge that no one respects yet.

The Mercedes-Benz ML-Class, officially referred to as the M-Class for whatever reason, has been completely revamped for the 2012 model year, taking on a puffier styling theme while retaining all the characteristics of the previous model. This midsize SUV comes in three versions, namely the ML 350 with a 3.5-litre V6, the ML500 with a 4.7-litre V8, and the ML 63 AMG with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8, all with 7-speed automatics and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and a choice of 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels. The revamped 5-seater interior offers, depending on trim level, leather upholstery, wood trim, mood lighting, Harmon-Kardon Logic7 surround sound, HDD navigation, optional panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, optional keyless start, optional ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking. An AMG package is optional, and it adds a body kit and sportier suspension. The ML 63 also option of AMG performance package which adds even more power.

The Honda Civic undergoes a mild makeover for 2013 after playing it safe with a conservative new model in 2012 and taking a lot of flak for it. Refreshed after just one year, the latest Civic comes with a carryover 1.8-litre engine and a 5-speed automatic. Changes for 2013 include a new front-end, redone tail lamps, new wheels, retuned suspension, reconfigured electric power-steering and a generous helping of soft-touch materials on the dash and front doors. All versions come with an "Eco Assist" feature that provides feedback to the driver to promote more efficient driving styles. Standard features on basic trims include cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, keyless entry, body-coloured exterior trim, manual a/c, fold-flat rear seat, power windows and electric mirrors. The base LXi model specifically gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a 2-speaker stereo. The mid-range EXi model gets a 6-speaker stereo with USB port and steering-wheel audio controls, cruise control, Bluetooth phone, 60/40 split-folding rear seat and an LCD info display with rear-view camera, and 16-inch alloy wheels, while fog lamps and a sunroof are extra-cost options. The top VTi version gets everything as well as 17-inch alloys, an automatic single-zone a/c, HID headlights, chrome door handles and leather upholstery. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS, active headrests and stability control, while only the VTi gets side and curtain airbags.

Suzuki gave up its image as a small car manufacturer with the introduction of the XL7 crossover 4WD, originally designed specifically for the American market. The XL7 is all-new, and is longer, wider and more powerful than the outgoing model. It is based on the same platform as the Chevrolet Equinox model from GM, though it shares no sheetmetal with them. The XL7 is assembled in Canada alongside the Equinox, with the V6 engine coming from Japan. It is a large midsize 4WD that offers even more space for three rows of seats with sufficient room for adults to sit in reasonable comfort in the third row. The name XL7 denotes that this Suzuki can be equipped to carry up to seven passengers. Fold all the passenger seats down, including the front one, and there's a generous amount of cargo space. It uses a basic all-wheel drive system with no low range gearing. The 3.6-litre V6 is aided by a smooth-shifting five-speed automatic. Standard features include remote keyless entry, power windows, door locks and mirrors, cruise control, trip computer, alloy wheels, automatic climate control and a CD stereo system. Options include leather seating surfaces, power seats, sunroof and more. Safety features include numerous airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution, electronic stability control and a tyre pressure monitoring system.

The Toyota Avanza got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The rear-wheel drive Avanza, which is actually a rebadged Daihatsu, is a reasonably priced seven-seater minivan. Only the 1.5-litre engine will be offered in this region. It comes either with a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. In the UAE, an SE model is offered which features automatic transmission, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, A/C with rear vents, fabric seats, audio entertainment system with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support, audio controls on steering wheel, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. In Saudi Arabia, the same specs is sold as an XL model. The fleet spec model gets a manual transmission, 14-inch steel wheels, and does not get the fog lamps, mud guards, steering controls and chrome linings in the exterior. On the safety side it gets standard dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. An all-new model came out in 2016. Under the hood of the 2019 Chevrolet Spark, it gets a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Few GCC countries offer the manual transmission. Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, push start button, chrome grille, parking sensors, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port. Safety features in the 2019 Chevrolet Spark include front airbags for both driver and passenger, tyre pressure monitoring system and stability control.

The Ford Shelby GT500 is the most powerful car you can buy at its price. The two-door coupe can be had with a regular hard top or a panoramic glass roof. Under the hood, the Shelby GT500 comes with a supercharged 5.8-litre V8 engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Functional features include launch control, Brembo brakes, one-piece carbon-fibre driveshaft, Torsen differential with 3.31.1 axle ratio, 19-inch alloy wheels in the front and 20-inch alloy wheels at the back wrapped with Goodyear Eagle F1 Supercar G2 tyres, and SVT Engineered Bilstein cockpit selectable dampers. Exterior features include auto HID headlamps and fog lamps with integrated park/turn lamps, aluminium hood, remote keyless entry, power mirrors, racing stripes over the top and "GT500" side stripes. Interior features include navigation system, power steering, leather seats with Alcantara Suede accents, 6-way power driver's seat with power lumber, power windows, cruise control, Shaker Pro audio system with AM/FM/Stereo/CD/MP3/input jacks and 9 speakers and 4.2-inch LCD display. Safety features include electronic stability control (ESC), ABS, traction control, driver and passenger front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system and anti theft alarm system.

The latest Durango has been redesigned, mostly with a minor facelift, and it appears to be a well-built light duty 4WD capable of transporting seven people almost anywhere in very comfortable surroundings, even though it is ultimately one of the ugliest vehicles on the road. The only engine option available here is the 5.7-litre, Hemi V8, which helps the two-and-a-half ton Durango move off with reasonable verve. It's interior design conserves space, which permits a 3rd row of relatively accessible seating. It is obvious that parent company Mercedes-Benz has had an influence on the lowly Dodge. The seams are tight and the materials are of a high quality. The ergonomics work well too, with all the minor luxuries, including a good sound system and a rear seat DVD-entertainment system. Excellent sound insulation means passengers aren't too distracted by road or wind noise, while the third row folds flat into the floor and the 2nd row folds up and out of way very easily. Standard features include air conditioning, power mirrors, illuminated entry lighting, front and rear power outlets, bucket seats, 40/20/40 folding second-row seat, AM/FM stereo radio with in-dash single-disc CD player, cruise control, tilting steering column, and remote keyless entry. Also available are rear climate controls, a power sunroof, AM/FM/6CD/MP3 player and a two-speed transfer case for off-roading.

The Colorado is a range of light pickup trucks. This midsize pickup can be had with two bed options, only one petrol engine, and comes standard with rear-wheel-drive. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, we beileve there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Available as a two-door single-cab or a four-door double-cab, four-wheel-drive is optional on the double cab only. Thankfully, amenities such as air-conditioning, dual front airbags, power steering, vinyl flooring, cloth bench seat and an ashtray are all standard. Upgrading to a higher trim level adds such luxuries as floor carpets, power windows, remote central locking, cloth bucket seats, chrome trimmings and body-colour door handles. Purely sold as a work truck here, the Colorado is actually marketed as a lifestyle truck in America, where it comes with cool colours, stylish trimmings, more luxuries and much bigger engines.

The Renault Symbol is a sub-compact offering from the French car manufacturer. The Romanian-built Symbol made its way back to the GCC market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. It comes with only one engine, a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the basic Symbol PE model include power steering, front electric windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/USB, Bluetooth, steering wheel mounted controls, fabric seats, front fog lamps and steel wheels with 15-inch hubcaps. The SE model gets additional rear electric windows, electric mirrors, trip computer, temperature sensor, body colour door handles with chrome, automatic A/C, cruise control and leather steering wheel. The top SE model gets 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, 7-inch touchscreen with GPS and navigation, and optional leather seats. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS.

An all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz CLA 45 AMG came out in 2020. It gets an upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, available in two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. All models are all-wheel-drive. The standard features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. In 2009, a removable roof model was added to the lineup, called the Veyron Grand Sport. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The all-new Jaguar XK is the long-awaited successor to Jaguar's sports car franchise, and though its new face is decidedly controversial, it is still a very desirable car. The new-for-2007  XK comes as both a coupe and a convertible. Riding on a much longer wheelbase, the new aluminium-built XK offers substantially more interior space than the old model. The XK 4.2 model is powered by the corporate 4.2-litre V8, while the XKR gets a supercharged version of that engine. Both engines are mated to a six-speed manual gearbox with paddle shifters. Its rigid chassis and the latest CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a 520-watt Alpine sound system with eight speakers. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

The Borgward BX-5 is the brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engine options, which include the 1.4-litre turbocharged motor and the 1.8-litre turbo unit. Both engines can be had in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive. Standard features on the BX-5 include power steering, power windows, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, single-zone A/C, fabric seats, front-centre 8-inch touch screen, bluetooth, AUX, USB, Apple Car Play, Android Auto, parking sensors, reverse camera and alloy wheels. The higher models gets dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, panoramic sunroof, xenon headlamps, cruise control, auto headlamps, 8 speakers, engine start/stop, WIFI and 360-degree parking assist. Safety features include front and side airbags ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ESP, traction control, brake assist, auto hold and tire pressure monitoring system.

An all-new Mazda CX-9 crossover SUV made its debut in 2016. Powered by a new turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, it comes with a six-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in four trims, the GS, GT, GTX and GTX Limited are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The higher spec CX-9 gets  20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console. Safety-wise, the CX-9 comes with standard stability control and ABS, and is optionally equipped with Forward Obstruction Warning, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Control.

This seriously outdated version of the Land Cruiser, updated in 2001, is technically a fullsize pickup, staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The pickup, known as Land Cruiser 75 in some markets, is not as big and brawny as the V8 muscle from Ford, Dodge and Chevrolet/GMC, but it is a tough truck. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both lifted from the Land Cruiser wagon and mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. But no matter how much you pay, you won't get ABS or airbags, but you do get a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, this pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Audi RS Q8 is the top sports variant of their 7-seater model. Under the hood, it gets a hybrid engine - a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine coupled with an electric motor, mated to a 8-speed transmission. Standard features in the all-wheel drive Q8 include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system, 21-inch alloy wheels, panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. ants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts.

In 2016, the Infiniti QX50 got a minor facelift. The wheelbase also increased slightly as well to provide increased legroom to rear passengers. The small QX50 is what Infiniti likes to call a coupe-crossover, although it is really a compact five-door wagon. It is powered by a 3.7-litre V6.  It comes with a 7-speed automatic, as well as standard all-wheel-drive. It has an excellent leather interior, power front seats, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain airbag system. There is no low-range gearing as the QX50 sits low and the chassis is tuned for on-road dynamics. The QX50 also comes with nifty features such as a seven-inch colour display with Infiniti controller for the trip computer and additional vehicle information, including the Infiniti DVD navigation system. But the most interesting feature by far is the around-view parking system that uses four cameras to simulate a 360-degree image of what is around the vehicle, thereby making parking easier in tight spots.

The 2009 Mitsubishi Galant receives fresh styling with a new grille, hood and lower air intake at the front, and more changes at the rear including wider rear glass, a new trunk lid, taillights and rear bumper. The Galant is powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic transmission, and the 3.8-litre V6 engine with a 5-speed automatic. Bot gearboxes come with Sportronic manual shifting ability. The base model includes variable intermittent wipers, power mirrors, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, cloth seats, air conditioning, power windows, power locks with keyless entry and CD player with four speakers. The higher models get bright interior accents, cruise control, premium cloth seats, ABS brakes with EBD, and CD/MP3 player with six speakers, along with 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an eight-way power driver's seat. Options include reverse camera, fog lamps, special climate control console, steering wheel with audio controls, power sunroof, leather-trimmed seats, and a premium CD/MP3 player with changer and eight speakers. Safety features include only dual front airbags standard on all models, with ABS and traction control available on higher models only.

The Zotye T600 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. Looking a lot like a Volkswagen Tiguan due to the loose copyright laws in China, the T600 features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the T600 include, standard or optional, include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, touch screen, multi-functional steering wheel, leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C and alloy wheels. Safety features include airbags, ABS, brake assist, stability control and traction control.

The Colorado is a range of light pickup trucks. This midsize pickup can be had with two bed options, only one petrol engine, and comes standard with rear-wheel-drive. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, we beileve there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Available as a two-door single-cab or a four-door double-cab, four-wheel-drive is optional on the double cab only. Thankfully, amenities such as air-conditioning, dual front airbags, power steering, vinyl flooring, cloth bench seat and an ashtray are all standard. Upgrading to a higher trim level adds such luxuries as floor carpets, power windows, remote central locking, cloth bucket seats, chrome trimmings and body-colour door handles. Purely sold as a work truck here, the Colorado is actually marketed as a lifestyle truck in America, where it comes with cool colours, stylish trimmings, more luxuries and much bigger engines.

The CMC Z7 is actually an iteration of a Taiwanese model called the Mitsubishi Zinger, and sharing a chassis with the Mitsubishi Nativa. Facelifted for 2016, with a new 5-speed automatic transmission, the Z7 people-carrier is powered by a Mitsubishi-sourced 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Features include four forward-opening doors with a rear tailgate, 7 seats, CD/MP# stereo, cloth upholstery, parking sensors, keyless entry, power windows, power locks, power steering, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. Higher trim levels get 16-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, cruise control, climate control, rear camera, USB port and leather upholstery. Safety features include ABS and two airbags.

The Brilliance FRV Cross is the Chinese company's sub-compact SUV offering. The FRV Cross has been around since 2009, but only made its debut in the UAE in 2013. It comes with 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the FRV Cross include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, radio with single CD player and MP3/USB support, and steel wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Volkswagen Beetle, which has been around since 2012 in other countries, made its debut in the GCC as a 2015 model. It remains the same for 2018. It is powered by a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels. In 2016, the Beetle R-Line model was added to lineup.For the exterior, the Beetle R-Line front fascia features bigger air intakes in the bumper, while the rear gets a lower diffuser and large spoiler. It also gets 20-inch "Monterey" alloy wheels to complete the look.Inside, it gets two-tone cloth sport seats, a multi-function leather-wrapped steering wheel with R-Line badging and a set of sport gauges mounted on the top of the centre console, along with R-Line door entry sills. Other standard options on the Beetle R-Line include panoramic sunroof, xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights, touch screen, Bluetooth and USB connection.

The Dodge Challenger SRT received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The 2019 Dodge Challenger SRT interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It also gets forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection. The 2019 Dodge Challenger SRT gets the 6.4-litre V8. A new addition to the engine lineup is the 6.2-litre supercharged unit for the 2019 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat. The SRT models gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, bi-xenon headlights, heated and ventilated seats wrapped in Nappa leather and Alcantara and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. An optional widebody kit is also available on the SRT Hellcat. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

The Thai-built Honda City received a facelift in 2012. The front bumper gets a sportier look and the front grille is now chrome plated. The rear bumper and tail-lights also received changes. Coupled with the good looks, the City also has enough cabin space to rival some midsize cars. Based on the platform shared with the Jazz, and powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 5-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive sedan has grown in size, with a full list of interesting options. Standard features on the basic City LX include 15-inch steel wheels, power mirrors, body-colour bumpers, electric power steering, power windows, power door locks, manual a/c, CD/MP3 player with USB/AUX connector and 2 speakers, stereo volume-compensation depending on speed, trip computer, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, and an immobiliser. The City EX adds paddle shifters, 16-inch alloy wheels, chrome exhaust tip, front and rear armrests, split-folding rear seat, stereo controls on the steering wheel and 4 speakers, and keyless entry.

The Lexus CT 200h is the first hybrid in the small-car segment to debut in the GCC. It got a facelift in 2014, getting the new front "spindle grille" design. This premium hatchback comes only in front-wheel-drive hybrid form, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a self-charging electric motor and a CVT automatic. The platform has its roots in Toyota models, but the suspension is fully independent, MacPherson-strut front and double-wishbone rear. Standard features include an info display to show battery usage, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with cloth upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, parking sensors, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, split-folding rear seat, sunroof, LED side and tail lamps, LED front driving lamps, fog lamps and alarm. The top trim additionally gets leather upholstery, wood trim, power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, front seat heaters, navigation system with flip-up 7-inch LCD screen, rear camera, Bluetooth, auto-levelling LED headlights, rain-sensing wipers, sport front bumper, and a 10-speaker audio system. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The Tesla Model X is a fully electric midsize crossover SUV, which combines high performance and zero emission. The available variants from 2018 are 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. All variants come in all-wheel-drive configuration, and with seating for up to seven if optioned up with two booster seats in the boot. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, falcon-wing rear doors, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate, 19-inch alloy wheels, and air suspension. Optional equipment include enhanced autopilot, complete self-driving capability, auto-opening front doors, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system, up to 22-inch alloy wheels, and a towing package including a steel tow bar and a 2-inch hitch receiver. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features include traffic-aware cruise control, auto steer and auto park.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 is a facelifted model which came out in 2013. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Dakota is a mid-size pickup with a full-size attitude, as Dodge likes to brag, and they are not far from the truth. The Dakota is the largest pickup in its class and the only mid-size truck available with a V8. The Dakota looks big, thanks to a complete redesign recently, making it larger than before and making it look almost as big and tough as the full-size Dodge Ram. The standard engine is a 3.7-litre V6. It comes with a six-speed manual transmission. An optional four-speed automatic is available on the higher trim levels. A 4.7-litre V8 engine is available for all models. A "high-output" version of the 4.7-litre V8 is also available on the higher models. With either V8, a six-speed manual transmission is standard, while a five-speed automatic is optional. Two available transfer cases, either full-time or part-time, are available on the 4WD models. Available steering wheel mounted audio controls allow easy control of the standard AM/FM/Cassette radio or the optional AM/FM/CD radio with eight speakers.

The Pilot is Honda's midsize 4x4 offering, and their largest offering at this time. The facelifted-for-2012 SUV attempts to move slightly upscale with its available luxury options. The new look features a new standard grille, new front and rear bumpers, and optional new wheels, along with a few other cabin additions. The Pilot can seat eight people at a pinch. The standard 3.5-litre V6 engine features Variable Cylinder Management (VCM) which allows it to operate on half the cylinders when power is not needed, improving fuel economy. Also standard is a basic 5-speed automatic. Based on the same platform as the Odyssey minivan, the Pilot claims to be an off-roader, but only succeeds moderately, with an all-wheel-drive system that can lock itself in a 50:50 front/rear power split, but with no low-range gearing. Standard features include cloth upholstery, fog lights, roof rails, cruise control, tri-zone auto a/c, 7-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, auto headlights, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seats and 17-inch alloy wheels. The top Touring model can be had with leather upholstery, 10-speaker stereo with hard-drive navigation, rear DVD entertainment, rear camera, rear sun blinds, powered front seats, sunroof and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, front-side airbags and curtain airbags.

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

The Brilliance V5 is the Chinese company's compact SUV offering. It features a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design has similarities to the BMW X1, since BMW produces the X1 in China in partnership with Brilliance. The front-wheel drive V5 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with AUX, manual A/C, rear sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets, keyless start and keyless entry system, pretinted windows, sunroof, driver side glasses box and luggage carrier. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

An all-new Ford Expedition model came out as in 2018. Engine specs for the 2019 Ford Expedition include a second generation 3.5-litre twin-turbocharged "Ecoboost" engine, available in two different tunes, and connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. The Expedition’s terrain-management system allows the driver to select from seven modes in 4WD models, so whatever terrain you’re tackling (be it sand, mud/ruts, gravel, grass or snow), there’s a mode that optimises the drivetrain for it. Needless to say that when driving in the Sport mode, you get an improved throttle response and gearbox mapping. The big Ford offers the best towing capability of any full-size SUV, and it comes with features such as Pro Trailer Backup Assist, which negates the need for repeated back- and forth when reversing with a trailer. There’s also an available hands-free, foot-activated liftgate to make loading bulky cargo into the load bay less of a back-breaking exercise. Aside from offering best-in-class second-row and third-row legroom as well as hip-room, the Expedition is also the first in this segment to feature a sliding second-row seat with tip-and-slide functionality, providing easy access to the third row without the need to first remove a child safety seat. The Expedition’s second-row and third-row seats not only provide best-in-class roominess but can be quickly folded flat with the push of a button to provide access to a cargo area wide and flat enough to handle 4×8-foot sheets of plywood and other gear. There’s no shortage of luxury kit in the Expedition, and among the goodies on offer is plush leather trim, multicontour driver seat with massage feature, a power reclining 3rd row seat, capacitive touchscreen with SYNC 3 (which also offers Arabic voice capability) and Apple CarPlay / Android Auto compatibility, adaptive cruise control with Stop-and-Go (keeps a set distance to the vehicle in front, and will automatically bring the car to a complete stop, and accelerate away again when required), dual-headrest rear entertainment system and a premium 12-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system with enough bass to make the windows reverberate. Add to that, a class-leading Panoramic VistaRoof that covers not only the 1st row but also the 2nd. Your devices are also well catered to, as there’s wireless charging, four 12-volt power points, up to six USB ports positioned across all three rows and a 230-volt outlet. The Platinum gets collision-avoidance detection (for both pedestrians and vehicles), lane-keeping system, blind-spot warning with cross-traffic alert and enhanced active park assist (for both parallel and perpendicular parking needs). There’s also a 360-degree camera to give you a bird’s eye view of the car’s immediate surrounds.

An all-new Jeep Wrangler came out in 2018.  It is slightly bigger, faster and lighter than the previous generation. The engine has been carried over from the older model, the 3.6-litre V6 “Pentastar” motor. Acceleration and fuel economy numbers have been improved, thanks to the new 8-speed automatic transmission replacing the ancient 5-speed. Manual gear lovers will be left disappointed though, as it is not offered anymore in this region. The electronically assisted steering has replaced the hydraulic steering. The interior has more quality materials than the older model, with the Sahara and Rubicon models getting more of the leather treatment. Even the standard equipment has improved, with the Wrangler Sport getting a touchscreen for the infotainment system. Safety features include four airbags, ABS, stability control, and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monitor, and rear cross path detection.

The CSV CR8 is a high-performance variation of the Lumina SS. It is simply a rebadged version of the Australian-built HSV supersedan, but using a "Chevrolet Special Vehicles" badge for the GCC region. The 2008 model was powered by a Corvette-sourced 6.0-litre LS2 V8, to be replaced by a 6.2-litre LS3 V8 in 2009.The CR8 is one of the quickest sedans available today, but without the overblown German price tag. Standard features include a six-speed manual or automatic, rear-wheel-drive with limited-slip differential, 19-inch alloy wheels, full body kit with spoiler, two-tone leather interior, better brakes and other upgrades. Convenience and safety features include dual front and side-curtain airbags, stability and traction control, ABS brakes, CD/MP3 player with in-dash CD changer, Bluetooth phone, power windows and mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry and a basic a/c. Options include a rear-seat DVD player and a sunroof. It is a large and heavy car, while lacking the last bit of refinement that puts the Germans at the top of this class. But for the price, even if high at first glance, the CR8 is a performance bargain.

The Ferrari 488 replaced the 458 in late 2015. The 488 Spider is the hard-top convertible version of the 488 GTB coupe. Under the hood, the 488 gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The exterior is still pretty similar to the 458, but gets a few visual updates, most of which have been added to improve aerodynamics and performance. The interior is quite similiar to the 458 with minor tweaks such as angled air vents and improved graphics on the infotainment and instrument panel, as well as keyless start. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Nissan Sunny got a facelift for the 2015 model year. Not much changes has been done since then, pretty much being the same for the 2019 model. The 2019 Nissan Sunny sedan comes from India, and is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT. The basic 'S' model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, AUX jack, cloth upholstery, trip computer and a black grille surround. The 'SV' model, identified by a chrome grille surround and door handles, adds power mirrors, front power windows, keyless entry, upgraded cloth seats and hubcaps, with an optional comfort package that adds fog lights, rear power windows, rear fan vents, parking sensors, more speakers and a central rear armrest. The top 'SL' model comes only in automatic, with 15-inch alloys, Bluetooth, steering-wheel stereo controls, nicer gauges with more readings, push-start, Display Audio system with Facebook support, cloth trim on the doors, LED side mirrors, rear spoiler and mud guards. All models get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, brake assist, and seatbelts for all five seating positions.

Introduced in 2004, the Jazz got a minor update and a new engine for 2006. Honda claims that the new Jazz rewrites the small car concept, offering benchmark space, functionality, style, performance, fuel economy and world class safety. It is at least partially true, considering the car was created by two design teams, one from Japan and another from Germany. Their innovations have led to a vehicle which is fun to drive and versatile too, though very dorky to look at. It is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic from 2006, but it is the space that Honda is touting. During the design process, every part of the Jazz was examined for space efficiency. Engineers have even located the fuel tank beneath the front cabin floor to make efficient use of cabin space. Therefore by centrally locating the fuel tank, Honda has boosted body rigidity, increased crash protection in all directions as well as improved protection of the fuel tank. Jazz has a range of standard features that include driver and passenger airbags, anti-lock brakes, CD player and unique "Magic Seats", though it does skimp on interior materials, and power windows are only available for the front.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The S2000 is a small two-seat roadster that can easily chase the likes of the snobby Porsche Boxster. It is a technological innovation from Honda, whose aim with this car was to pump as much horsepower out of a small 2.0-litre engine as possible, without any turbo or supercharging trickery. The S2000 is said to drive like a superbike, because big horsepower from small displacement with a narrow powerband and extremely high rpm produces a very frantic experience. Driving it slowly, shifting the manual at low rpm apparently results in very weak performance in traffic. The latest model has refinements to the engine and suspension put in place back in 2005. Changes to the S2000 in 2006 include more shoulder and elbow room, and some tweaks, most notably 17-inch wheels, drive-by-wire throttle, stability control and new headlights with a triple-beam design. Early models had a plastic rear window, while 2002-plus models get a glass one. The last external facelift was in 2004. Interior features are basic, but include leather upholstery, electric power steering, starter button, power windows, power mirrors, remote central locking, air-conditioning and a pathetic radio cassette stereo with 2 speakers.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The Corsa is the smallest car among Opel models offered in the Middle East. Its extensive safety package and rigid galvanized body have been tested to excel in passenger protection. Body styles available in the Middle East are three-door and five-door hatchbacks, as well as a 4-door sedan. Opel went the extra step and added colour-keyed bumpers and high-level safety features, which is rare in this class of cars. Two engine options are available here, namely a 1.4-litre unit and a 1.8-litre unit, both four-cylinder. Both powerplants power the front wheels using the available standard manual transmission, but the smaller motor has an optional automatic five-speed transmission with manual shifting mode. All cars can seat five. A fold-down rear backrest can be fixed at two different angles and a rear bench can be fully folded down. Available features include power windows, cloth upholstery and CD stereo. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

Ford brought back the Bronco name in the lineup, releasing a new model for 2021. The proper off-road SUV will have two Ecoboost engine options - a 2.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a 2.7-litre turbocharged V6 engine, both mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission or 7-speed manual.

The new-for-2007 Aurion serves as a direct replacement to the previous V6-powered Camry Grande model. It uses the same front-wheel-drive platform as the all-new Camry. The Aurion features more aggressive front and rear styling, but is largely the same size as the Camry. The new Camry is thoroughly revamped, reworked and upgraded from the ground up, and the Aurion benefits directly. Inside is a huge airy interior that features some slight changes when compared to the Camry. The engine choice is the singular 3.5-litre V6 mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox. The Aurion can be had with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual array of power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a fancy keyless entry system, front and side airbags, and alloy wheels. Dynamic safety features also include electronic stability control and ABS brakes. Toyota has been smart in differentiating the common Camry from the fast V6 model, for the benefit of those who pay more for the extra power. A 'Touring' model appeared in 2011 with a body kit.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. Engine choices include SL 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and SL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8. Both are mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's performance sedan offering. Only sold in some GCC countries, Opel Insignia OPC gets a turbocharged 2.8-litre V6 with all-wheel drive. Features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, heated leather seats with memory, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, daytime running lights, fog lamps, 20-inch wheels with xenon headlights and LED daytime running lamps. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, lane-departure warning, ESP and ABS.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The tenth-generation Honda Civic looks to have gone more upmarket, with LED daytime running lights and taillights given as standard, and LED headlights offered as an option. The new body is also said to be more rigid, thanks to the use of ultra-high strength steel. First released in the GCC in 2016, this generation Civic is not only bigger, but 31 kg lighter than the previous generation as well. It is pretty much the same for the 2018 model year. The interior also has been upgraded with better fit and finish, while the increase in overall size has helped improve legroom and trunk capacity. Three engines are on offer in the GCC, a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and the top-spec turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder unit. Standard features in the compact sedan include automatic climate control, electronic parking brake with brake hold, auto up/down front power windows and walk-away auto door locks. Higher models get dual-zone climate control. All models also get a new centre console which includes a new infotainment system featuring a 7-inch touchscreen display and supports both Android Auto and Apple CarPlayUnder the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor mated to a CVT transmission in base trim. The top model gets a 1.5-litre turbo 4-cylinder. Safety features include airbags, ABS and traction control.

The Toyota Highlander is the Japanese brand's midsize hybrid SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets a 2.5-litre engine coupled with two electric motors, and power being delivered via an eCVT.  Standard features in the American-made Highlander include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, fabric seats, tri-zone automatic AC, 4.2-inch information display, 8-inch screen for the display audio, 6 speakers, LED headlights and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher model gets leather seats, power seats with memory function, navigation, panoramic roof and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include 7 airbags (dual, front, side, curtain, knee airbags), adaptive cruise control, lane assist, pre-collision system, lane departure assist, stability control and tyre pressure monitor. The top model gets additional blind spot monitor, 360 camera and front parking sensors.

The GMC Terrain made its debut in the GCC as a 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. Both engines get a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base SLE model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, HID headlamps with LED daytime running lamps, fog lamps, single-zone AC, rear AC vents, infotainment system with 7-inch screen, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The SLT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, infotainment system with 8-inch touchscreen display with navigation, 6-speaker audio system and leather seats. The Denali model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled front seats, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Bose premium 7-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Chery E8 is the Chinese brand's midsize sedan offering. The front-wheel drive E8 gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to CVT automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, fog lamps, manual fabric seats, radio with CD player, USB port, six speakers, parking sensors, chrome-plated front grille and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include electric sunroof and leather electric seats. Front driver and passenger airbags are standard, as is ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Hyundai Grand Santa Fe is basically a larger version of the regular Santa Fe, with a bigger boot. Powered by a standard 3.3-litre V6, it comes with a 6-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive on the base model or all-wheel-drive in the rest of the trim levels. The Grand Santa Fe crossover comes well-equipped in even base trim, including three-row seating, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, rear spoiler, power mirrors with indicators, rear parking sensors, cruise control, keyless entry, adjustable power steering and 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB/AUX ports. The higher-level versions add all-wheel-drive, 19-inch alloys and, depending on trim, chrome door handles, auto a/c, auto headlights with optional HIDs, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power-adjustable memory front seats, power tailgate, electric parking brake, 4.3-inch multimedia screen, navigation, smart keyless start, compass and rain sensor. All six trim levels get ABS, while 2 airbags are standard on all but the highest two trim levels, which get 6 airbags; and the top two trim levels get stability control.

The Musso is a sleek Korean 4WD with a Mercedes-Benz heart. It comes with a Mercedes-Benz 3.2-litre inline-6, with the choice of a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, with power transmitted to all four wheels. The cabin seats five, or seven with the optional third-row bench. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, driver's airbag, CD player, ABS-assisted disc brakes, independent front suspension, limited-slip differential, central locking, engine immobilizer, auto antenna, cloth upholstery, fake wood trim, adjustable steering, and a rear spoiler. Also standard is a full-time 4WD system with low-range gearing. Interestingly, the Musso was originally launched during 1993 in its home market of South Korea. Even more interesting is that it was on sale in Australia as a Mercedes-Benz GX320, in the days before the German company had a 4WD of its own. The final year with its original face was 1999, when bankrupt Ssangyong was purchased by Daewoo, marked with a major facelift.

The Kia Rio is all-new for the 2012 model year. Attractively designed, it is available in 4-door sedan and 5-door hatchback form. The only engine for the GCC is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with variable-valve timing, mated to a 4-speed automatic. While mechanically basic, the Rio can be had with a host of features unseen in the sub-compact segment. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, adjustable steering wheel, central locking, power windows, electric mirrors and only one airbag.
