A new generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class debuted as a 2015 model. It is 95 mm longer with 80 mm extra wheelbase, 40 mm wider and up to 100 kg lighter than the previous model. For 2018, no changes have been made. There are three variants on offer in the GCC which is the C 180 which gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor, the C 200 and the C 250, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. More variants are expected to join later. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Citroen DS3 is the smallest car offered in the GCC from the French brand. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. The exterior can be had in contrasting body and roof colours, with many different colour combinations available for customers. The standard features on the "So Chic" DS3 variant include power windows, power steering, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, automatic A/C, cruise control, scented air-freshner, interior mood lighting, stereo radio with MP3/AUX/CD compatibility, steering mounted controls, LED daytime-running lights, chrome door handles, sports suspension and 16-inch alloy wheels. The "Ultra Prestige" trim-level gets a rear spoiler with integrated brake-lamp, double chrome exhaust tips, side-impact chrome bar, roof-coloured wing mirror, front and rear carpet mats, aluminium drilled pedals, navigation system, automatic headlamps and wipers, rear-parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), emergency braking assistance, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), driver, front passenger, front lateral and curtain airbags and, front seat belt pre-tensioners with force-limiters.

The new Challenger marked the return of the legendary muscle-car nameplate from Dodge. Unfamiliar to GCC residents, but revered by American enthusiasts, the Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. Sold only in top-spec SRT-8 trim with a steep GCC price tag, the Challenger isn't the affordable muscle it used to be back in the day. Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger packs a 6.1-litre Hemi V8 mated to an aging 5-speed automatic with manual-shift functionality. Standard features include sporty suspension, bi-xenon headlights, leather-alcantara sport seats, keyless entry with starter button, CD stereo, and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control, power windows and electric mirrors. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front and side airbags, and big honking Brembo brakes. Too bad a high price and a non-existent marketing campaign will make the Challenger a rarity on local roads.

The Mercedes-Benz V-Class replaces the Viano and Vito in the lineup. In  2017, the V-Class was released in the GCC with a petrol engine. Under the hood, it gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, cruise control, leather seats, Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get added options such as 17-inch alloy wheels, their AGILITY CONTROL suspension with selective damping system and more premium Lugano leather trim on the seats. The Exclusive edition gets interior trim in brushed aluminium look, air vents in silver chrome, a roof liner in DINAMICA, panoramic sliding sunroof, the new large centre console with integral refrigerated compartment and thermo-cupholders, climatised single seats in nappa leather for the driver, front and rear passengers, 19-inch light-alloy wheels and Burmester surround sound system. There is also a sports package and AMG package. Safety standards are high with optional systems such as Collision Prevention Assist and Distronic Plus, along with multiple airbags for driver and passengers. It also gets traction control, stability control, blind spot assist and lane-tracking system.

The Dodge Durango was completely redesigned in 2011. Mildly facelifted for 2014 with a whole lot of LED lighting, the three-row crossover SUV is based on a stretched Jeep platform. In 2018, a Durango SRT model was introduced in the lineup but it only made it to the GCC in 2020. Under the hood, the Durango SRT gets a 6.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include tri-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, power windows, electric mirrors, built-in rechargeable torch, cargo cover, fog lamps, automatic headlights, hill-start assist and keyless entry, LED running lamps, leather steering wheel, remote start, front power seats with memory, Bluetooth, navigation, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, 9-speaker stereo with subwoofer, power liftgate, rear parking sensors, tyre pressure display, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, and rear-view camera, 20-inch wheels, power-adjustable steering wheel, heated first and second-row seats, HID headlights, sports suspension, rain-sensitive wipers, sunroof, blindspot monitor & cross-path detection, forward collision warning and adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, rain brake support, anti-theft alarm, active headrests and a tyre-pressure monitor.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. First released as a 2016 model year, it remains pretty much the same for 2017. Under the hood, the GLC250 and GLC 300 get a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with two different tunes, both of which can be had in either two-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

From 2014, the Infiniti JX35 became the QX60 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure, and it received a facelift for 2016.  It has remained the same for the 2017 model year. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive, the Infiniti QX60 is aimed at the family crowd. With three-row seating, leather upholstery and a touchscreen multimedia computer, all models are generously equipped as luxury vehicles, unlike the cloth-wearing base models peddled as premium vehicles by German competitors. Depending on trim level, available features include smart keyless entry and start, tri-zone auto a/c with air purifier, 15-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth, powered front seats with memory and ventilation, split-folding second and third-row seats, wood trim, hard-drive navigation, around-view parking cameras, parking-guidance system, blind-spot monitor, multiple airbags, lane departure warning and prevention, adaptive cruise control with collision warning, cross-traffic alert and auto braking, rear DVD screens, pre-crash seatbelts, ABS and stability control. The 2016 QX60 also adds Forward Emergency Braking with pedestrian detection.

The Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is an all-new model, to compete against the BMW X6. Mercedes-AMG GLE Coupe 63 is the top performance model. There are two variants, which includes the standard GLE 63 and then the GLE 63 S. Under the hood, both come with the 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and 21-inch cross-spoke AMG alloy wheels. The 5-seater interior offers leather upholstery, mood lighting, HDD navigation, panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The Suzuki Vitara is a completely new model, making its debut in the GCC in 2016. Smaller, lighter and losing its offroad capabilities, the new Vitara is designed to compete in the road-going crossover segment and is a separate vehicle line from the existing Grand Vitara. It is only available as a 5-door wagon, and gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available in both two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive. In the UAE, two trims are available, the GLX and GLX+, all of which come with automatic transmission as standard. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, central locking, keyless push start system, sunroof, LED daytime running lamps, leather seats, cruise control,  automatic A/C, roof rails, front & rear parking sensors, front skid plate, chrome front grille and alloy wheels. The higher GLX+ model gets panoramic roof and polished aluminium wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ABS and brake assist.

An all-new generation Volvo XC90 came out in the middle of 2015. Under the hood, there are two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine options, the base engine being the turbocharged T5 unit, while the more powerful model gets a turbocharged and supercharged T6 motor. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base engine is called the T5 and and the more powerful motor is known as the T6. Available features, depending on trim, include integrated rear-door sunshades, illuminated front and rear treadplates, Bowers & Wilkins Premium 19-speaker audio system with USB/AUX inputs and CD player, Bluetooth, heads-up display, navigation, in-car wifi, 4-zone auto a/c with numerous rear vents, power-adjustable front seats, panoramic glass roof, power tailgate with foot-waving opening operation, front and rear parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, turning LED headlights and foglights, and auto-dimming mirrors. Safety features include City Safety which brakes automatically if a pedestrian runs across the road, driver-alertness detection, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, land-departure warning, road-sign detection that displays speed limits on the graphical LCD gauge cluster, whiplash protection, front and side/curtain airbags, and adaptive cruise control that can come to a complete stop and crawl in traffic automatically. Further safety features include a run-off road protection package, which detects what is happening and the front safety belts are tightened to keep the occupants in position, and auto brake at intersection capability.

From 2012, the design all-new Porsche 911 incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than the previous generation. It is still a 2+2 seater. In 2016 the 911 got turbocharged engines and minor exterior upgrades. The base 911 Carrera Cabriolet is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S Cabriolet gets the same engine specs but with more power. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The 2016 Carrera S models also has the option of all-wheel-steer.

The C-Class range was all-new for the 2008 model year, and updated with a minor facelift and new engines for 2012. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. Starting off the new line-up are three new turbocharged 1.8-litre "BlueEfficiency" engines in the C 180, the C 200 and the C 250, at different states of tune. The 3.0-litre V6-powered C 300 and the 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standardrange. All models come with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many premium features, such as 16-inch to 18-inch wheels, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. The optional AMG sports package offers stiffer suspension, 18-inch light-alloy wheels and cosmetic add-ons to most non-AMG models. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

The 2018 GAC GS7 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. It is offered with two 4-cylinder engines choices- a 1.8 turbo and a 2.0-litre turbo. Both engines get the 6-speed automatic transmission. The 2018 GAC GS7 is available as a front wheel drive or four wheel drive. Standard features in the 2018 GAC GS7 includes power steering, power windows, power folding side mirrors, rain sensing wipers, HID auto headlights, LED tail-lamps, front and rear fog lamps, 10-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with 6 speakers, Bluetooth, USB port, steering wheel with audio and phone controls, sunroof, rear view camera system, front and rear parking sensors, keyless entry, smart key and button starter, and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get engine start stop, LED auto headlights, interior ambient lighting, side mirror memory function, navigation, 8 speakers, panoramic sunroof, wireless charging, and 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels. The 2018 GAC GS7 integrates intelligent driving assistance such as a 9th-generation extreme edition of ESP (Electronic Stability Program), an optional 360-degree panorama visual imaging system, an optional ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) system and standard eight airbags. Other safety features in the 2018 GAC GS7 include ABS,  hill descent control, and optional lane change assist system.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Trim levels include the confusing Linear, Arc, Vector and Aero trims. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The top Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. Not all engines come in all body styles, though all are available in Aero form. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a glass sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The Toyota Aurion got a complete redesign for the 2012 model year alongside its Camry sibling. The Aurion is essentially a redone version of the Camry, but fitted with a V6 engine and better interior appointments. All models get a carryover 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. In the UAE, the Toyota Aurion comes in only three grades, namely Sports, Limited and TRD. In other markets such as Saudi Arabia, the grades are dubbed as Touring, SE and Grande, with a base model that isn't offered in the UAE. Only the Aurion Grande or Limited gets leather trim, 7-inch touchscreen navigation & DVD player, Bi-Xenon headlights with intelligent "AFS" and headlamp cleaner, and 8 way memory seats for the driver, all standard for the UAE. Navigation is optional in the Saudi model. The Aurion SE model loses those features, but is instead fitted with a sport-tuned suspension, fabric sport seats with enhanced support, a newly-designed three spoke steering, paddle shifters, stereo with 6.1-inch display, 17-inch wheels and an exclusive front grille as well as sporty front and rear bumper skirts. The TRD model in the UAE gets a complete sports package which includes springs and alloy rims. Other features include covered cup-holders, dual-zone auto a/c, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, keyless start, cruise control, rear parking sensors, front and side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control and more.

The range-topping M6 arrived for 2006, in coupe and convertible form, using the same V10 engine as the M5. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a 7-speed SMG automanual in the M6. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The Audi A3 Sedan is the German brand's sub-compact sedan offering. It will be available with two engine choices, either a 1.4-litre or a 1.8-litre, both of which are 4-cylinder and turbocharged units. While the 1.4-litre is only available in front-wheel drive format, the 1.8-litre can be had with all-wheel drive. The front-wheel drive versions get a 7-speed DSG automatic transmissions and the all-wheel drive model gets the 6-speed DSG. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The all-new weirdly-named Qashqai is built on Nissan's new "C" platform, providing high body stiffness with reduced body weight. The Qashqai offers a choice of 2WDand full-time 4WD with a single underpowered 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine mated to an advanced CVT transmission. The fancy interior seats five, and includes features such as intelligent key, power windows and mirrors, rear 60/40 split-fold bench seat, cloth upholstery, automatic headlights and wipers, and xenon  headlights. Also available are steering wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, aCD audio system with six speakers and 6-disc CD changer, auto air-conditioning with dual zone temperature control and a Bluetooth hands-free phone system. While it looks like a 4WD, the poseur 2WD model should prove popular as a hatchback alternative, considering it does not offer much more cargo space than a standard hatchback anyway. Aside from the strong bodyshell, safety features include stability control and front airbags, while side and curtain airbags are optional.

The Nissan Micra makes its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic, although a 5-speed manual is also available in the most basic model. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are four further trim levels, progressively adding features such two or four power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

The rugged Xterra debuted in the GCC during late 2007 and got a facelift for the 2009 model year. The Xterra is a simple but capable alternative to the Pathfinder, incorporating as much off-road gear while originally forgoing most luxury features, but Nissan did add a few conveniences in 2009 due to customer demand. The five-seater Xterra is powered by the Pathfinder's 4.0-litre V6 engine, with four-wheel-drive, low-range gearing and either a six-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. All 2009 Xterra trims now have a redesigned front end featuring two new grilles, namely sandblast aluminium finish on X, S and Off-Road models, and satin chrome finish for Xterra SE models. New features include rear a/c ducts, new audio package including six-disc in-dash changer, redesigned centre cluster, push-button a/c, Bluetooth handsfree phone and iPod connectivity. Side steps and cloth upholstery are standard on the S model, while leather seats and illuminated steering-wheel switches are standard on the SE model. A new Off Road model includes body side molding, unique two-tone seat fabric, rear differential lock, heavy duty Bilstein shock absorbers, and BF Goodrich off-road tyres on new 16 inch alloy wheels. A GPS navigation system is also available. All models feature power windows and mirrors, power steering, CD audio system, remote keyless entry, alloy wheels, low tyre-pressure indicator, 60/40 split folding rear seat, available fold-down front passenger seat, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS brakes with brake-force distribution and brake assist, although side-curtain airbags may be available in some markets. Key exterior styling features include large flared fenders, big roof rails and a rear bumper design with side steps for easy access to the roof rack.

The Changan CS75 is a compact SUV offering from the Chinese brand. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the CS75 "Fashion" trim include power windows, central locking, remote on key, cruise control, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 8 speakers, multifunctional steering wheel, USB+AUX ports, leather seats, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and LED headlamps. Higher "Elite" trim gets additional 7-inch screen, keyless entry and start and auto climate control.Safety features includes dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist. The top option gets addition side curtain airbags.

The MKT is Lincoln's full-size luxury crossover that is based on the Ford Flex, with three rows of seating and tons of space. It got a facelift in 2013, along with minor improvements to the interior. According to Lincoln, the "T" in MKT, stands for Touring. Larger than the MKX midsize crossover and more efficient than the Navigator, the MKT is offered in the UAE with the turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Offered in either 6-seater or 7-seater configurations, a second-row 60/40 split folding bench seat, optional power "fold and tumble" second-row bucket seats include heating, cooling and power lumbar adjustment, and an available 5-quart refrigerator in the centre console, alongside all the usual features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, CD/MP3 stereo and Bluetooth phone. A fixed-glass panoramic roof with power-assisted front and rear sunshades is standard and an opening panoramic sunroof is optional. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as ABS and stability control.

The Touran 7-seater is a minivan smaller than the Sharan, with four forward-opening doors and a rear tailgate. Engines include the small 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, both four-cylinder units with a manual or automatic. Standard equipment includes stability control, ABS with brake assist system, six airbags, active head restraints for driver and front passenger, and three-point automatic seat belts for all seats. Among the most important features of this new Volkswagen are its versatile interior layout and the good amount of space it provides, with a load area that can be as large as 1,989 litres. The three separate seats in the second row each weigh less than 16 kilograms and can be individually slid forward and back, repositioned sideways, folded into a very small space or removed completely. Similarly, the two rear seats can be folded flat into the floor when not in use. There are up to 39 storage spaces and compartments inside the well-planned interior.

An Hyundai Elantra received a significant facelift in 2019. Under the hood, the 2020 Hyundai Elantra gets two 4-cylinder engines, a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models of the 2020 Hyundai Elantra get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features on the 2020 Hyundai Elantra include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports convertible with a supercharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. The soft-top is standard on the Elise, with the option of a hard-top as well. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The Toyota Granvia made its debut to the GCC market in 2020, to cater to the high-end commercial transportation services. With seating for six, including four captain’s chairs as a standard feature, the Granvia includes adjustable interior illumination, fine woodgrain trim and metallic finishing, as well as rear air conditioning that incorporates ion generators with nanotechnology to help remove bacteria and odours. Driver assistance technologies comprise a 4.2-inch display, a 7.0-inch infotainment unit, multifunctional steering wheel and a digital rear-view mirror ensuring a clear view regardless of how much luggage is in the back.Power is courtesy of a high compression, direct-injection 3.5-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a six-speed automatic transmission. In some GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia, a 2.8-litre turbodiesel version is also offered. The frame is coupled to MacPherson strut front suspension and a four-link rear.The new Granvia is built using high-tensile strength materials to provide a lightweight yet rigid structure. The Granvia additionally minimizes risk to pedestrians by incorporating energy-absorbing reinforcements which have been adopted on the front end. Standard features on the new model include emergency brake warning, tyre pressure monitoring, plus driver and passenger airbags, knee airbags, as well as curtain airbags.The 2020 Toyota Granvia SE model comes with leather seats, a rearview camera, cruise control, 17-inch wheels, LEDs, parking sensors and hill-assist control.The Toyota Granvia top of the range Premium model includes additional luxury quilted Ottoman leather seats, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring, lane departure assist, surround-view camera, digital rearview mirror, pre-crash system and an electrically operated side door.

Originally introduced in Malaysia back in 1993, the Wira was based on the early-90s Mitsubishi Lancer, and continued in its early form all the way to the new century, and ending up being the most outdated car on the market. Available as a sedan or a liftback, the engine and gearbox were sourced from Mitsubishi, namely a 1.5-litre and a 1.6-litre, both 4-cylinder. The smaller engine came with a 5-speed manual or a 3-speed automatic, while the larger one came standard with a 4-speed auto. Features included cloth interior, manual or power windows, radio-cassette player, optional sunroof, optional spoiler, and not much else. Safety features were limited to seat-belts in early models, with later ones receiving a driver-side airbag, ABS brakes and safety-bars in the doors. As unrefined as the car is, proven Mitsubishi mechanicals under the skin means on-road reliability is as good as most Japanese cars, although the car itself will be falling apart from the inside out, starting with the cheap cabin trim. The car flopped in the GCC region, except in places like Kuwait, where it was marketed as a commercial vehicle.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City. It is slightly larger in every dimension, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The second-generation Audi R8 came out in 2016. Under the hood, there is no more a V8 engine option, but V10 is still available, which has been reworked for better performance. It has also managed to reduce 200 kg by using more carbon-fibre and aluminium for the body.  In 2019, it got a facelift and a slight power bump. Other mechanical changes include the choice of Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tyres, larger carbon ceramic brakes and a new steering rack system for a more direct response. The power is delivered through a 7-speed S-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The sixth generation BMW 5-series received a facelift for the 2014 model year. The 520i gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and 8-speed auto. The 535i has a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 528i model gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. The 550i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto has been upgraded with more power and torque. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The third-generation Kia Cerato sedan boasts sleeker styling that is 30 mm longer, 15 mm lower and 5 mm wider than the outgoing car, with a 50 mm extended wheelbase. It also featured an all-new bodyshell, upgraded equipment, a host of additional convenience and safety features, a more spacious cabin with better quality, improved suspension and an upgraded powertrain line-up that delivers class-leading performance and fuel economy. In 2017, the Cerato got a facelift. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors. Safety features include ABS brakes, brake assist, stability control, and two front airbags.

The MK6 Golf GTI debuted in the summer of 2009, with a mildly-upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and a choice of 6-speed manual or DSG automanual, though the manual version isn't imported by most GCC dealers. The interior is very similar to the previous Golf, but some new bits include the steering wheel, 'climatronic' a/c and better noise reduction. It comes with seven airbags including a knee airbag, stability control, adaptive cruise control, adaptive chassis control with adjustable suspension, Park Assist, alloy wheels, sunroof, and the usual power accessories. The Golf GTI has features such as sports seats, GTI alloy wheels, and a standard XDS electronic differential lock, and optional features such as adaptive suspension, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist and more.

BMW introduced the X4 in the lineup for the first time as a 2015 model. It looks like a smaller version of the X6. Under the hood, two engine choices will be available. One is a turbocharged 4-cylinder 2.0-litre engine, while the other is a turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 motor. The BMW X4 is equipped with BMW ConnectedDrive features that include high-resolution, full-colour Head-Up Display, which projects all important driving information and the assistance systems displays into the driver's field of view. The Navigation System Professional with ECO PRO route guidance teams up with the iDrive Touch Controller whose touchpad allows texts  e.g. a navigation destination to be easily inputted by using a finger. The tailgate can opened automatically and can be further specified with the Comfort Access Option for extra convenience, which allows it to be opened with a movement of the foot. Safety and convenience can be further enhanced by optional premium features like the anti-dazzle High Beam Assistant, Driving Assistant Plus including Pedestrian and Collision Warning, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function and Lane Departure Warning. Available as options are Lane Change Warning, Surround View and the Parking Assistant.

The 206 is one of Peugeot's more popular models, with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, although new derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet joined the line-up in 2001. There are various petrol engines in the range, although after 2006, the local offerings had decreased. The standard five-door hatchback can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic. The 206 CC coupe-cabriolet can only be had as a 1.6-litre automatic in the later years, although the manual 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre CC models were available here for a few years in between. There is a more powerful 2.0-litre engine with a manual offered in three-door RC hatchback form, which is a true sporting contender. The tuned RC debuted in 2003, replacing the competent GTi 2.0-litre model. All models come with front power windows, a cloth interior, driver's airbag and other basics as standard. Comprehensive safety equipment such as ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, along with passenger front airbag, were all optional. Available features included a CD player, alloy wheels and more.

The tenth-generation Honda Civic looks to have gone more upmarket, with LED daytime running lights and taillights given as standard, and LED headlights offered as an option. The new body is also said to be more rigid, thanks to the use of ultra-high strength steel. First released in the GCC in 2016, this generation Civic is not only bigger, but 31 kg lighter than the previous generation as well. The interior also has been upgraded with better fit and finish, while the increase in overall size has helped improve legroom and trunk capacity. In 2017, a Turkish-built Civic with a 1.6-litre engine joined the lineup. Three engines are on offer in the GCC for the 2020 Honda Civic -  a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and the top-spec turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder unit. Standard features in the 2020 Honda Civic compact sedan include automatic climate control, electronic parking brake with brake hold, auto up/down front power windows and walk-away auto door locks. Higher models get dual-zone climate control. All models also get a new centre console which includes a new infotainment system featuring a 7-inch touchscreen display and supports both Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. Safety features in the 2020 Honda Civic include airbags, ABS, brake assist and traction control.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in three versions currently. The Maybach 62 is the long wheelbase version of the 57, which is quite large already, and this body style comes in either standard 62 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in a new-for-2008 62 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. All models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems. A handful of limited-edition Landaulet four-door convertible models were built in 2010 for a four times higher price.

The Volkswagen Golf R32 came with a 3.2-litre V6 engine, and featured a dual-clutch automanual gearbox that is still rare in any class of car that was affordable at the time. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

The Ibiza is based on the VW Polo and is the hatchback variant of the Cordoba. Though similar to the Cordoba, it somehow appears a lot more sporty than the dull Cordoba, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. In the Middle East, this front-wheel-drive is offered in three-door or five-door body styles, with numerous VW-derived powerplants, including a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre and two turbocharged 1.8-litre units, all 4-cylinder engines, with some manual and some automatic transmissions available, depending on model. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, power front windows, electric mirrors, remote central locking, 15-inch to 17-inch wheels, CD stereo, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, traction control and even an optional stability control system. These cars are quite well-packed with features for their size. Sport and FR models get larger alloy wheels, stiffer suspension, body-colour rear spoiler, sports seats and unique exhausts as standard. The limited-availability 3-door Cupra gets the top turbo engine and further sports tuning.

The all-new weirdly-named Qashqai is built on Nissan's new "C" platform, providing high body stiffness with reduced body weight. The Qashqai offers a choice of 2WDand full-time 4WD with a single underpowered 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine mated to an advanced CVT transmission. The fancy interior seats five, and includes features such as intelligent key, power windows and mirrors, rear 60/40 split-fold bench seat, cloth upholstery, automatic headlights and wipers, and xenon  headlights. Also available are steering wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, aCD audio system with six speakers and 6-disc CD changer, auto air-conditioning with dual zone temperature control and a Bluetooth hands-free phone system. While it looks like a 4WD, the poseur 2WD model should prove popular as a hatchback alternative, considering it does not offer much more cargo space than a standard hatchback anyway. Aside from the strong bodyshell, safety features include stability control and front airbags, while side and curtain airbags are optional.

The Volkswagen Jetta underwent a full redesign for 2011, growing in size to offer class-leading interior space. The only engine on offer is an old 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a manually-shiftable 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel-drive. There are three trim levels, named Trendline, Comfortline and Comfortline Plus. The base Trendline comes with keyless entry, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. The Comfortline additionally comes with chrome trim, 16-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone a/c, steering-wheel buttons, fog lamps, alarm system and parking sensors. The top Comfortline Plus version comes with 17-inch alloys, intelligent keyless entry and starter button, electric-adjustable sports seats with partial leather, and a touchscreen audio system. All VW Jetta models come with ABS, traction control, six airbags and auto hazard lights as standard.

An all-new Infiniti QX50 came out in mid 2018 as a 2019 model. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a CVT. It comes in standard front-wheel drive and optional all-wheel drive. Standard features on the base "Luxe" model include electric power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, LED headlamps, LED foglamps, auto headlights, leatherette seats, power seats, power lumbar for driver seat, leather wrapped steering wheel, paddle shifts, power liftgate, dual display Navigation system, with upper 8-inch and lower 7-inch VGA LCD touch screens, voice recognition, Bluetooth, 6-speaker AM/FM/CD with 4 USBs, Tri-zone automatic climate control with rear seat vents, cruise control, rearview camera with front and back sensors, and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, ABS, traction control system (TCS), stability control (VDC), electronic brake force distribution (EBD), tyre pressure monitoring  system (TPMS) and hill start assist. The "Luxe Essential ProAssist" model gets leather seats, rear-seat slide, recline, and fold-flat function, panoramic moonroof, remote engine-start, push-button start, rain-sensing wipers, high beam assist, Bose®Performance Series audio system with 16 speakers and 360 camera with moving object detection and front and rear sonar system. Additional safety features include adaptive cruise control, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, blind spot warning, and predictive forward collision warning. The "Luxe Sensory ProAssist" variant gets additional 20-inch dark painted alloy wheels, higher quality leather seats, climate control front seats, and motion activated tailgate. The top "Autograph" variant gets premium grade leather, seats with quilted stitching, with blue piping between white leather and blue suede, blue suede upper door, and centre console lid accents. Additional safety equipment include intelligent cruise control with full speed range and hold, and blind spot intervention.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily facelifted and revised for 2007, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features. Also new to the range is the Navigator L, an extended version which has a longer wheelbase and additional cargo space.

The compact V50 wagon and its S40 sedan sibling are based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the V50 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The V50 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre and a higher-tuned 2.4-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The Epica is Chevrolet's attempt at the lower end of the midsize car market, considering the Lumina is handling the slightly higher market that is occupied by the Accord and the Camry. Launched as part of a trio with the Aveo and the Optra for 2004, it is built by GM Daewoo in Korea on a front-wheel-drive platform. The car received a restyle for 2007 and maintains the traditional sedan three-box profile instead of being over-tall like the Camry, so it looks good from far away, though its details are derivative. The interior is fairly spacious considering its price. The cabin is well-designed with plenty of convenient storage spaces, while instruments and controls are well-placed. Two engines are on offer, namely a small 2.0-litre six-cylinder that works well but is fairly underpowered, and a 2.5-litre six-cylinder that has more power but only matches four-cylinder motors from Japanese midsizers. The optional four-speed automatic transmission is smooth, while a manual gearbox is also offered for that last bit of fuel efficiency. Front airbags and ABS brakes are available. The Epica competes well in a segment that only sees action from the Koreans.

An all-new Honda City model came out in 2021. It is slightly larger in every dimension from the previous generation, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The BMW 5-Series Gran Turismo received a facelift for the 2014 model year. The 5-Series GT is supposed to be a coupe-like crossover vehicle that aims to appeal to markets where the 5-Series wagon is ignored. The 'F07' platform features a unique "bi-modal" trunk which may be opened in traditional sedan fashion, or the entire hatch may open like a hatchback. The 2014 model gets a new front air intake, while the back has been extended rearwards to give it a lower slung appearance. Also boot capacity has been increased by 60 litres to total up to 500 litres. Tech features include four-wheel multilink suspension, standard 8-speed automatic gearboxes and turbo engines, namely the 3.0-litre inline-6 for the 535i GT and the 4.4-litre V8 for the 550i GT. Depending on trim level, the 4-seater GT can be outfitted with features such as leather upholstery, 4-zone automatic a/c, Bluetooth, navigation, USB/iPod port, CD/MP3 stereo with 80 GB hard disc, rear DVD entertainment system, heads-up display, panoramic glass roof, adaptive cruise control with stop-&-go feature, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning system, night vision, active steering, rear-wheel steering, rearview camera, side-view cameras, parking sensors, run-flat tyres and keyless button-start, among others. Also included are various selectable driving modes, adjustable air suspension, stability control and numerous airbags. The niche vehicle is almost as long as the 7-Series and has as much headroom as the X5.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering yet, and takes its name from a fighting bull or something. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini, available as coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. An Audi-derived 5.0-litre V10 engine, upgraded for 2006, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type limited-slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard. The track-ready Superleggera version, built in the final year, offers weight savings and a minor power increase.

In addition to a sedan version, the Impreza has now become a hatchback for 2008, with interior and exterior styling solidly in the mainstream of conservative design. It remains the only car in its class with standard full-time all-wheel drive. Subaru likes to tout their rally heritage, but none of the Middle East models are anywhere near rally cars. The models offered here are the new 1.5-litre, known as the 1.5i, and the 2.0-litre, known as the 2.0R. Both have flat 4-cylinder "boxer" engines, and both mated to either a 5-speed manual or an outdated 4-speed automatic. Base models have a standard AM/FM stereo system, cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking and steel wheels, along with dual front airbags. The full-spec 2.0R model features the same full power options, alloy wheels, rear spoiler, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, sunroof and not much else. Western and Eastern world markets receive turbocharged WRX sports models, but local dealers do not officially offer them in the GCC.

The Citroen C5 is a compact SUV offering by the French manufacturer. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base C5 Live nclude electric power steering, leather wrapped steering wheel, steering wheel audio controls, power windows, rear parking sensors, central 8-inch capacitive touch screen, 4.2 inch instrument display, AM/FM and MP3 compatible radio with two tweeters and four speakers, Bluetooth, 2 USB sockets, mirror screen (Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and MirrorLink), automatic dual-zone AC, automatic halogen headlights, LED rear lights, fog lamps, LED daytime running lamps, electric door mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The mid-range C5 Feel includes additionally wireless charging, LED indicator lamps, rear fog lamp, mood lighting, central 8-inch capacitive touch screen and 12.3 inch customisable TFT instrument display, front parking sensors, panoramic opening glass-roof and 18-inch alloy wheels. The top C5 Shine model gets more features such as rear camera, electric driver seat with massage function, LED headlamps, and keyless start. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, hill- start assist, ABS, stability and traction control, and tyre pressure monitor, while the higher models get additional side airbags and blind spot monitor.

The Nissan Sentra carries on with no major changes since its introduction in 2013. In 2019, it got slight changes in the front such as a new grille. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. The 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in only CVT. Both engines are not available in all GCC countries. The 1.6S and 1.8S gets power steering, power mirrors, power windows, halogen headlamps, rear LED lamps, keyless entry, manual seats, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/RDS support and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. The 1.6SV gets LED accent headlamps, intelligent key with engine push-start button, wood trim and 4 speakers. The 1.6 SV Sports gets fog lamps, leather steering, rear spoiler, 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors and indicators on side-view mirror.  Both 1.6 SV and 1.8 SV sports have the option of USB/iPod connectivity, bluetooth, navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. The 1.8 SV gets the same as S but with rear parking sensors and bluetooth. The 1.8 SL gets the same options as 1.6 SV Sports plus rear spoiler with brake lamp, 6 speakers and USB/iPod connectivity. The 1.8 SL Premium gets more features such as leather seats, sunroof, cruise control, dual-zone climate control A/C. The 1.8 SL and SL Premium have the option of adding navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. Safety features include electronic brake-force distribution (EBD), ABS and Brake Assist (BA), along with driver and passenger front airbags. Only the 1.8 SL Premium gets side and curtain airbags.

Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is a combination of both coupe and crossover, designed to the tackle the BMW X6. Currently only the GLE 450 AMG is being sold, which comes with a 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged V6 motor, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Exterior-wise, it shares a few design cues of the new S-Class Coupe, such as the roofline and rear tail-lights. The interior features sports seats, a sports steering wheel and a new infotainment display. The cabin is covered in silver shadow accents, and aluminum or wood trim.Safety features include Driving Assistance package which includes features such as DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist and PRE-SAFE PLUS. The Parking package includes the 360-degree camera and Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC. Night-time vision is improved by the LED Intelligent Light System which is a standard feature on all models; adverse weather conditions with impaired view are defused by MAGIC VISION CONTROL the heated, adaptive windscreen wiper system.

The MG 6 comes in two body shapes, either as a sedan or as a liftback version. There are two 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engines to choose from, one being naturally aspirated and the other a turbocharged unit. They can be had in either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission with optional paddle shifters. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with CD/MP3 support and 8 speakers, trip computer and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, power mirrors, cruise control, parking rear camera, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C, radio with DVD/MP3 support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. In 2020, it got a slight facelift and updated infotainment system. Under the hood, the GLC 200 and GLC 300 gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine connected to a small battery to make it a mild hybrid system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Lexus CT 200h is the first hybrid in the small-car segment to debut in the GCC. It got a facelift in 2014, getting the new front "spindle grille" design. This premium hatchback comes only in front-wheel-drive hybrid form, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a self-charging electric motor and a CVT automatic. The platform has its roots in Toyota models, but the suspension is fully independent, MacPherson-strut front and double-wishbone rear. Standard features include an info display to show battery usage, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with cloth upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, parking sensors, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, split-folding rear seat, sunroof, LED side and tail lamps, LED front driving lamps, fog lamps and alarm. The top trim additionally gets leather upholstery, wood trim, power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, front seat heaters, navigation system with flip-up 7-inch LCD screen, rear camera, Bluetooth, auto-levelling LED headlights, rain-sensing wipers, sport front bumper, and a 10-speaker audio system. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The Nissan Maxima was all-new back in 2010, and has continued since then with only minor changes in the grille area. The America-built front-wheel-drive midsizer has moved upscale and aims to be a budget 'sports' sedan, although betrayed by its drivetrain layout. It is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. The entry-level Maxima S model comes with an auto-dimming mirror, cloth upholstery, cruise control, CD stereo, Bluetooth, power windows, intelligent key with starter button, power front seats, fake wood trim, sunroof, 19-inch rims, and dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents. The Maxima SV adds power outside mirrors with LED turn signals, digital compass, HID headlights, fog lights, power-adjustable steering column with memory, power-adjustable pedals, front and rear parking sensors. The top Maxima SR gets additional features such as auto-dimming driver-side mirror, leather seats, driver's seat thigh support extension and ventilation fans, rear bucket seats, rear-window power sunshade, navigation system touchscreen with rearview camera, and a rear spoiler. All come standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control. Equipment packages between trim levels change slightly, depending on market.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's performance sedan offering. Only sold in some GCC countries, Opel Insignia OPC gets a turbocharged 2.8-litre V6 with all-wheel drive. Features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, heated leather seats with memory, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, daytime running lights, fog lamps, 20-inch wheels with xenon headlights and LED daytime running lamps. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, lane-departure warning, ESP and ABS.

Proton claimed that the Waja was their first in-house car designed by Malaysians. However, its petrol engine is bought directly from Mitsubishi, and the suspension work was done by their independent Lotus division. The Waja is sold as the Impian in some markets, or referred to as the Waja Campro sometimes to advertise its latest engine. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this four-door sedan can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, sunroof, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Waja is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras.

After the MP4-12C coupe marked McLaren Automotive's return to building their own street cars, the MP4-12 C Spider, a hard-top convertible made its debut in late 2012. Their "affordable" supercar is still pricey, but it is positioned as a no-compromises piece of engineering, with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a "pre-cog" 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised, and can generally be had with manual sports seats, leather-alcantara upholstery, touchscreen multimedia system, MP3 stereo with USB port, power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry, HID headlights, carbon-fibre interior trim, auto a/c, cruise control, cup-holders and all that, though there is no Bluetooth, rear camera or CD player. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

The Rio is Kia's sub-compact nameplate that started life in 2000. It can always be depended on for the most unique exterior designs in this segment. This generation of the Rio debuted in 2006 and received a minor frontal facelift in 2010, before being replaced in 2012. The interior offers decent space for its size, although the cabin is a hard plastic tomb, like most others in its class. Powered by a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive runabout comes in either sedan or hatchback body styles. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, battery saver, wind-up windows and AM/FM radio cassette player. Higher models add a few items, such as body-coloured outer trimmings and power windows, along with electric mirrors, front fog lamps, driver's seat height adjustability, luggage undertray and central door locks. We could not verify what safety features are available besides seat belts, although we believe many markets get ABS brakes and front airbags, standard or otherwise.

The Passat attempted to reinvent itself back in 2006 with a list of weak base engines. It entered 2008 with a new list of engine choices, and some carrying over, although the latest model still looks the same as the all-new Passat that debuted in 2006. A wagon called the Passat Variant has also joined the lineup. The Passat boasts generous standard content and a high-quality interior mixed with high-tech hijinks. Volkswagen has rolled out a full line of four-door sedans, ranging from  1.8-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors, both turbocharged, to the 3.2-litre and 3.6 V6 models, the latter of which is for the body-kitted R36 model. All basic cars are front-wheel-drive, while V6 models get 4Motion all-wheel-drive. V6 models also get a dual-clutch DSG automanual gearbox, while the base cars get standard manuals and autos. All Passats come standard with the latest in safety features and electronics, including power features, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, ESP, tyre-pressure monitoring system and MP3-capable CD player. R-Line package is largely just an expensive bodykit.

The facelifted-for-2008 R-Class, a so-called Grand Sports Tourer from Mercedes-Benz, is certainly a trendsetter. This unprecedented vehicle concept attempts to mesh the qualities of a sporty saloon, a wagon, a minivan and a 4WD. All we see is a very sleek-looking minivan. Packed under the hood are rather powerful engines, but that hardly makes it a sporting vehicle. Models from 2008 onwards include the new R 280, the carryover R 350 and the upgraded R 500, most available only in long-wheelbase trim here, and then there is the shorter R 63 AMG. Amazingly, it is very hard to tell the difference between long and short models. Originally available only as a luxurious six-seater, the R-Class is now optionally available with five or seven seats too. Sadly, few on the road recognise its eccentricity and price tag, so it gets as much respect in public as a typical cargo hauler. Features include a 7-speed automatic transmission, cruise control with variable speed limiter, automatic climate control and all-wheel-drive. Options include a panoramic sunroof, air suspension and navigation.

The Maxus V80 is a large commercial vehicle offering from the Chinese brand. They are offered in three specifications - 15 seater passenger vehicle, 18 seater minibus and as a cargo vehicle. It is powered by a 2.5-litre turbo diesel engine, mated to a standard 5-speed manual transmission, and a 6-speed manual transmission in the minibus configuration. Standard features include electric front windows, front and rear A/C, central locking, remote key, audio system with radio and mp3 support, fog lamps and halogen headlamps. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and dual front airbags.

Common hard-working people desire to own a car with a decent amount of interior space, fuel economy, reliability and adequate performance, all for a reasonable price. The all-new Tiida arrives as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. The fact that it's partly based on the Renault Megane, a European stalwart, means you get some Euro driving dynamics alongside traditional Japanese reliability. It is pleasantly surprising how big the Tiida feels inside. There is good head room and even tall passengers will find rear seat legroom as good as that in many much larger cars. Available as a five-door hatchback or a four-door sedan, the Tiida is available with either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine, with manual or automatic transmissions. Standard features include electric power steering, tilt steering column, 60/40 split folding rear seats, air conditioning with micro filter and a CD stereo system. Safety features include front airbags and ABS brakes. Power accessories are optional. The Tiida received a minor facelift for the 2009 model year, as Nissan made available a "sport" body kit option. Other new available features include cruise control, 6-CD changer, MP3 capability, IPod-ready AUX input, a 6-speaker audio system, fully automated air-conditioning and a trip computer.

The Mercedes-Maybach, which was introduced back in 2015, got a facelift in 2018 and a power upgrade. The S650 Maybach is being sold in the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include a full panoramic sunroof, powered privacy shades for the rear windows, acres of leather trim, night-vision display in the LCD gauge-cluster, chrome-plated speaker grilles, fibre-optic ambient lighting, Burmester 3D surround sound, and back-lit tweeters on all the doors that spiral out on start-up, although these things can even be had in a standard S-Class, if you tick everything on the options list. The lounge-worthy rear seats both offer a full range of power adjustability, and includes extending calf-supports, a massaging function, heated/cooled cup-holders and a seat heating/cooling feature, while the right-side rear seat gets an additional footrest that can be motored out of the front passenger seatback for sleeping. It's so intricate that the dual LCD screens on the front seat-backs automatically adjust their angles as the front seats are adjusted, so the rear passengers always get the best view. The massage and multimedia features are controlled with a remote, with animated settings showing on the screens. Its "Magic Body Control" system that scans the road ahead for bumps and adjusts the suspension to drive over them as smoothly as possible. Further options include flip-out tray-tables and a fridge that comes with a pair of silver-plated champagne flute-glasses as well as space for three chilled bottles. Along with the front and side airbags, ABS, traction control, the Mercedes-Maybach can be added with PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, Brake Assist BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Night View Assist Plus. In the shape of the seat belt buckle extender, Beltbag (both part of the PRE-SAFE rear package) and seat cushion airbag.

The second-generation Audi R8 came out in 2016. In 2019, the Audi R8 got a facelift. Under the hood, there is no more a V8 engine option, but V10 is still available, which has been reworked for better performance. In 2020, a rear-wheel drive version was released.
