It has also managed to reduce 200 kg by using more carbon-fibre and aluminium for the body.The power is delivered through a 7-speed S-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The ZNA Yumsun is a 7-seater minivan that turns out to be the unlikely flagship, with its 2.5-litre Nissan 4-cylinder engine. The single trim level includes soft-touch cabin trim, 4-speed automatic, 15-inch alloy wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, fake wood and leather trim, CD/MP3 stereo with steering controls and 6-CD changer, remote locking, power windows and mirrors, table on the backrest of front seats, 3.9-inch LCD screen with rear audio controls and 6 speakers, automatic antenna, rear parking sensors, auto front and rear a/c, and two airbags.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. It's probably advisable to avoid highways as it comes with a tiny 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine under its hood, with the 4-speed automatic not doing any favours either. Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, enlarged spoiler, front sports bumper, chrome grill, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port.

The Honda CR-V is roomy little 4WD that is convenient and easy to drive on the streets, but no hero on the rough stuff. There lots of stuff in it and the back seats are quite comfortable. It rides as smoothly as a car, especially since it is based on the Civic. It offers the cargo versatility of a sport utility, an upright seating position, and all-wheel drive. Besides being less expensive, the CR-V is smaller and more maneuverable than a full-sized 4WD. The styling was revised for 2005. The CR-V comes with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine lifted from the Accord, now with only a five-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning with micron filtration, AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with 6-CD changer, an adjustable steering column, power mirrors, power windows, front and rear power outlets and a removable folding picnic table, along with front airbags, integrated keyless entry and 16-inch steel wheels. Aluminium alloy wheels are available, as is a moonroof, leather and cruise control.

The F-150 delivers all the manly attributes of toughness, strength, and imposing size, but does anyone who isn't involved in a job with physical labour need one? The fully-loaded models of the F-150 is sold here as more of a lifestyle vehicle, offering interior design and comfort that would rival some luxury cars. Properly equipped, it can haul more than a tonne in its bed. The F-150 is comfortable as well, with a quiet and refined ride. It comes with dual frontal airbags, cloth seats, a CD player, and air conditioning as standard. A host of power and luxury options are available too. For all these reasons, the F-150 has sadly been America's best-selling full-size pickup for 28 consecutive years. It is the most most profitable vehicle Ford makes. It is available in various trim levels, variations, and specialty models, including quad cab, single cab and dual cab model, with various bed sizes. At the bottom of the lineup is a V6 work truck, though the only options apparently offered here are the 4.6-litre V8 and the 5.4-litre V8 engines, with automatic trannies.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. In 2020, it got a slight facelift and updated infotainment system. Under the hood, the GLC 200 Coupe and GLC 300 Coupe gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine connected to a small battery to make it a mild hybrid system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Luxgen7 SUV is a seven-seater crossover, currently only sold in UAE and Oman. It is available as either a front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. The top feature is the Luxgen Think+ system, co-developed with smartphone makers HTC, that comes with built-in HSPDA 3.5G communications, GPS Navigation and a 10.2-inch LCD display screen for a comprehensive tech package. The system also includes the "Eagle View+" 360-degree parking assist which utilises four cameras to provide a real-time visual display of the surrounding environment. The "Side View+" feature automatically displays live video images of the vehicle's rear blind spot to reduce the chance of an accident during lane changes. The "Night Vision+" high-sensitivity night vision camera system helps illuminate the road and traffic conditions at night beyond the range of the headlamps. "LDWS+" constantly reads the road surface for lane markers and dividers and gives audible and visual warnings when the vehicle veers too close to the lane markings. Overall, the SUV is equipped with 23 advanced ECUs and 8 video cameras to provide these features. Also available are power-opening doors, leather upholstery, rear DVD screen, Bluetooth and more. The Luxgen7 SUV is powered by a turbocharged-and-intercooled 2.2-litre DOHC 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. To improve driving feel, the steering system was tuned by Delphi, noise suppression engineering was handled by LMS, the suspension system was developed by Magna, and the overall chassis tuning was done by both Magna and Prodrive.

The Audi Q7 is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 has two 3.0-litre supercharged V6 "TFSI" engines at different states of tune, although the marketeers like to give only the more powerful one the "supercharged" label. There is a 4.2-litre turbodiesel V8 and a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V12 "TDI" engine available for order as well, for whatever reason. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. The new engines came in 2011, but visual changes to the Audi Q7 came in 2010, including new LED headlights and indicators, LED taillights, a chromed front grille, new bumpers, new instrument cluster, ambient lighting and new cabin trim choices, along with new paint colours. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The Getz, new in 2003 and facelifted in 2006, is known for offering "European" levels of refinement. We feel it is let down only by its weak range of engines, namely a tiny 1.1-litre, followed by a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all four-cylinder units, some with a manual gearbox and others with an automatic. This front-wheel-drive hatchback comes standard with very little, but includes air-conditioning, a rear wiper with washer, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, and wind-up windows. Options in the higher trim levels include power steering, ABS brakes, a single airbag, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, sunroof, rear spoiler, fog lamps, keyless entry system, a radio and cassette player and fake carbon-fibre trim. The interior is well-made, with good materials. It is not too cramped inside either, with seating for five and decent legroom both front and back. All trim levels come with a cloth cabin and a useful rear luggage area with a lift-up tailgate. Small 14-inch steel wheels with plastic hubcaps.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Only the more powerful GLC 63 AMG S version is sold in the GCC. In 2020, the GLC 63 AMG got a slight facelift. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

From the 2014 model year, the Infiniti M became the Q70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

An all-new Mini Countryman was released in 2017. No changes were made in 2018. The Countryman is 8-inches longer than the previous generation. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and powered by the same engines. The standard model gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder motor, while the Cooper S gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, both of which can be had in front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive formats. It can be had with a 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The Mitsubishi Lancer EX, first introduced in 2008, got some minor trim changes for 2010. From 2013 onwards, it comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a new 1.6-litre and a carryover 2.0-litre. In 2016, it got another facelift and underwent a big price drop. The smaller engine gets a 4-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Offering a choice of either engine, features in the most basic GLX model includes power steering, locally-installed CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, manual a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers, but only a driver's airbag. The mid-range GLS model can only be had with the larger engine, and includes a sporting body kit, rear spoiler, leather-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, smart key with starter button, sunroof, 6-speaker stereo with USB port, rear camera and faux-wood panelling. The top GT model adds adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, "sport-type" front seats, rear split seats with centre armrest, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels and just two front airbags.

The new-for-2011 Mazda 2 is a facelifted version of the Mazda2 that has been on sale in Europe since 2008. Offered for the first time in the GCC, it comes in sedan and hatchback versions, and competitively priced when compared to its platform-mate, the Ford Fiesta. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloys are optional. The interior can be had in either black or two-tone, with ten exterior colours available. The glove-box lid is a unique two-compartment design, with one compartment exposed on top to keep files and papers in. The seats are cloth-upholstered, and every other piece of cabin trim is hard plastic, with no padded armrests. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The Mazda2 is highly rated in European crash tests, but those safety ratings are based on Euro-spec models with side airbags, not available here.

The Korean-built Captiva, originally GM's first proper entry into the softroader market, received a facelift in 2011, along with a change in engines and cabin design. On offer is a choice of two powertrains, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive form, and a 3.0-litre V6 with direct-injection and all-wheel-drive. All models get a new 6-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, standard power windows and mirrors, seating for seven, 4-speaker or 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c and keyless entry. There are four trim levels, with the top LTZ model getting optional 19-inch alloy wheels, single-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, 8-speaker stereo with AUX port and CD changer, optional fog lamps, electronic parking brake, cloth or leather upholstery, optional Bluetooth, chrome door handles, optional sunroof and optional parking sensors. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags, standard ABS, and optional traction control, stability control, hill-descent control and hydraulic brake assist.

Toyota introduces an all-new Camry for 2007. The new one features aerodynamic new styling reminiscent of Lexus, which is no surprise since the expensive ES 350 is based on this car. The new Camry is thoroughly revamped, reworked and upgraded from the ground up. Inside is an airy new interior. The engine choice remains the same, with a carried-over 2.4-litre four-cylinder popular with most commuters and taxi companies, but the new 3.5-litre V6 available in other markets is not offered here, saved instead for the Aurion. The four-cylinder can have a five-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. The Camry can be had with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual array of power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a keyless entry system, front and optional side airbags, and either steel or alloy wheels. There is now a wannabe Sport version that adds a body kit and stiffer suspension. The Toyota Camry defines the dull midsize four-door sedan segment and now it has set the bar higher.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was released as a 2014 model year. For 2017, it is only available with a 1.5-litre engine and a CVT automatic in the UAE, in SE and SE+ trims. In Saudi Arabia, the 1.3-litre is available as a fleet, standard, Y and YX trims, while the 1.5-litre is available in Y and YX trims. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the SE+, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, auto a/c, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels and more. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD). Tyre-pressure monitor and stability control are now standard in the UAE on all trims.

The Jeep Compass, based on the feeble Dodge Caliber, gets heavily worked over for 2011, with a facelift that mimics the Jeep Grand Cherokee. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe was launched as a 2015 model year. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 428i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its second facelift for the 2012 model-year. The minivan attempts to resemble a 4WD in height, with a high waistline and four forward-opening doors, but it ends up looking like a van. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Ferrari 812 Superfast replaced the F12 Berlinetta and is the fastest naturally aspirated model they have ever produced at the time. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Electric power steering was introduced in this model. The car also saw the introduction of the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Clio was completely redesigned in 2006, but this new version is only available in the GCC in sporting form. The Renault-Sport Clio now has bumped-up power, so it is called the Clio 200 now. The Clio Renault-Sport 200 models will be sold in limited numbers across the GCC, due to low demand rather than to maintain exclusivity. Derived from the basic New Clio available in Europe, both the Renault-Sport cars are powered by a highly-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual gearbox. Renault says the cars were apparently tested locally to ensure suitability for local driving conditions, and fitted with air-conditioning systems to suit the local heat. The car will be available in various funky colours and now has a better interior. Features include sports suspension, upgraded brakes, 17-inch alloy wheels and racing-bucket seats. There is no spare tyre due to the dual-exhaust setup. Safety features include stability and traction control with "off" switch, ABS brakes, up to eight airbags, and energy-absorbing head restraints.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2015. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The RX 350 rides like a car, and very easy to drive, with a luxurious interior. All this makes it popular with the upscale set, rather than its non-existent off-road ability. The RX is based on a unibody car platform rather than a heavy-duty truck frame. Redesigned for the 2004 model year, the RX gained a new 3.5-litre V6 engine for 2007, with very few other changes. The V6 in this all-wheel drive wagon is mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The list of standard luxuries include automatic climate control, premium audio, cruise control, traction and stability control, automatic headlamps, ten-way power for both front seats, a power rear liftgate, parking sensors, Bluetooth phone system and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Cloth upholstery comes standard, as do high-intensity discharge headlamps. Options include leather upholstery, reverse parking camera and a one-touch moonroof. The sports package includes some sort of body add-ons and other nonsense. Safety features include dual frontal airbags, front-seat side-impact airbags, side curtain airbags, ABS brakes and a stability system.

The Honda Odyssey J is a smaller Japanese version of the larger US-built Odyssey. It gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. It has been facelifted for 2018 with a new grille, new front bumper with available LED running lights and fog lights, and new 17-inch wheels. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlights, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Other new features include a touch-panel for a/c controls, rear camera and more. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). For 2018, the EX-V additionally gets the Honda Sensing suite of active safety features that include Adaptive Cruise Control, Collision Mitigation Braking System, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Road Departure Mitigation System (RDM), Blind Spot Information System, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Pedestrian Detection System and Lane Keeping Assist System.

The BMW M3 convertible debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in four trim levels, namely S, SE, SEL and SPORT, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level S is designed specifically for fleet customers, and features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo, 60/40 folding rear seat, and electronic vehicle immobilisation. The SE model includes a six-CD changer, leather steering wheel, rear a/c vents and 16-inch "San Jose" alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the S and SE models, the SEL has 17-inch "Sonoma" alloy wheels, leatherette seats and a high-end Fender sound system with a subwoofer in the boot. A media input with iPod cable is also standard on the SEL, as is a powered driver's seat, front fog and cornering lamps, keyless entry, pushbutton start, a sunroof and dual-zone climatronic air conditioning with air quality sensors. The flagship SPORT model adds part-leather seats, 18-inch "Bristol" alloy wheels, touch-screen navigation system, 30GB hard disc, SD card reader and DVD drive, memory function for the driver's seat and a powered front passenger seat. Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise.

The M6 Cabriolet uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Fuel economy is apparently better by 30% compared to the old V10-powered model. Other mechanical features include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option. The M6 features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The Toyota Prius was the world's first mass-produced hybrid vehicle when initially launched in 1997. The 2020 Prius retains the 2,700mm wheelbase of the previous Prius, but is 60mm longer overall at 4,540mm, 15mm wider at 1,760mm and 20mm lower. That's about the size of a Corolla. The Prius retains its 1.8-litre VVT-i Atkinson-cycle petrol engine. Features include a heads-up display, wireless charging, 7 airbags, blind-spot monitor and rear cross-traffic alert, ESP and regenerative braking.

The TrailBlazer is powerful and capable midsize off-road vehicle, which is just the right size to not be a pain on the roads. Launched in 2002, it received a minor facelift in 2006. It has a rigid chassis, good off-road suspension, powerful brakes and a spacious enough interior to compete in this class. It is stable at high speeds, wobbly around curves, and comfortable over rough surfaces, while being quite capable off-road, thanks to a proper four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The TrailBlazer also comes in an EXT trim with an extended wheelbase that adds a third row seat. The early TrailBlazer comes with a Vortec 4.2-litre inline 6-cylinder engine that generates very respectable numbers, similar to the V8 motors of some competitors. And then there is 5.3-litre V8 engine that can be had as an option only on the EXT. The V8 is equipped with GM's Displacement on Demand technology as standard which deactivates four cylinders under certain driving conditions to aid fuel efficiency, returning the full complement of power once the controller senses vehicle speed or load requires additional power. Both engines use a Hydra-Matic 4-speed auto transmission.

The Porsche Cayman has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Cayman have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Cayman gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Cayman S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Cayman comes standard with 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

Lexus has a competitive flagship luxury sedan in the LS. The fourth-generation debuted in 2007 as the LS 460, powered by a 4.6-litre V8 engine without direct injection, but mated to an 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. For 2010, the LS 600hL joins the line-up, featuring a 5.0-litre hybrid V8 engine mated to a CVT transmission, an electric motor and all-wheel-drive. For 2011, the direct-injected 4.6-litre V8 finally debuted in the LS 460 with more power, replacing the old V8. Available features include navigation, Bluetooth, navigation, ventilated leather seats, sunroof, front and rear parking sensors with optional camera, 19-inch alloy wheels, adaptive cruise control, numerous airbags including front knee airbag and rear side airbags, adaptive turning headlights, four-zone automatic a/c, and an updated Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system. The cabin has all the customary Lexus luxury touches, including seats covered in one of four leathers to coordinate with three woodgrain trims. A power reclining seat equipped with power leg rests and massage is available for the right rear, along with a folding table. The LS 460 also offers a nine-inch rear monitor mounted in the headliner along with a new 19-speaker Mark Levinson audio system with an onboard hard drive that holds 4000 songs. The LS 460 is available in regular-length and stretched-wheelbase versions, while the LS 600hL only comes in long-wheelbase form. Many new features debuted with the LS 600hL hybrid model, such as the automatic parking function that wasn't available on GCC-spec LS models before.

The all-new Chery Tiggo 7 is the first Chery to have the new corporate face with its wavy grille and boomerang-shaped xenon headlights. It comes standard with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and CVT automatic, with a 1.5-litre turbo 4-cylinder and dual-clutch automatic joining a bit later. All are front-wheel-drive. The new Chery features a dual-tone interior with a patch of stitched leatherette across the dashboard and onto the inner door handles, matching the leather seats. The 9-inch capacitive touchscreen includes multimedia features, a/c settings and vehicle settings, while there’s also a 4.8-inch LCD dashboard screen. Other available features include smart keyless entry and start, dual-zone auto a/c and 360-degree camera as well as a panoramic roof. The Tiggo 7 received a five-star safety rating in the Chinese NCAP crash tests (which in theory is similar to EuroNCAP). Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, hill-start, tyre-pressure monitor and 6 airbags.

The Sorento is an attractive entry into the crowded affordable 4WD market. Offering either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.5-litre V6 with a 4-speed automatic in early models and a 5-speed automatic since 2005, the Sorento offers decent off-road ability and a fair bit of interior space, making it a good buy, given its price. Standard features include 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette with antenna and 6 speakers, manual air-conditioning, power steering, 8-way adjustable driver seat, 4-way adjustable passenger seat, power windows, 60/40 split folding rear seat, battery saver, driver airbag, proper rear lift gate, power door locks, and limited slip differential. Available features in higher models include a CD player with power antenna and 8 speakers, ABS brakes, power folding mirrors and cruise control. Four-wheel independent suspension and four-wheel disc brakes make it a good road cruiser, unlike truck-based 4WDs, although it is still no sports car.

The Renault Megane came back to the GCC market with an all-new design in 2011, and got a minor facelift for 2013. Engine choices, all 4-cylinder, include a 1.6-litre with a 5-speed manual, an updated 1.6-litre with a CVT automatic, and a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The front-wheel-drive Megane is available in hatchback form, with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features in the hatchback include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

The Volkswagen Golf R32 came with a 3.2-litre V6 engine, and featured a dual-clutch automanual gearbox that is still rare in any class of car that was affordable at the time. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

The Continental Flying Spur was launched in 2006 as the 4-door version of the Continental GT. It is also their first sedan model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the unloved VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets. Standard equipment on the Spur includes HID headlights, 19-inch alloy wheels, a tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, keyless entry and ignition, rain-sensing wipers, powered trunk lid and a choice of 16 colours. On the inside, one has a choice of 17 colours for the leather-appointed interior with matching carpets and seatbelts. The cabin features steering-column mounted shift paddles, sunroof with electronic sunshade, DVD navigation, six-CD changer and Bluetooth. Almost all seats feature lumbar massage, memory and heat settings. Options include a choice of three 19-inch wheel styles and a 20-inch wheel and tyre package, ceramic brakes, and the sunroof can be had with a solar panel to power ventilation fans to maintain interior temperature when parked, a full-length centre console and numerous trim choices. Convenience options include a cordless privacy handset with keypad in centre console, a rear telephone system, and a rear-view camera. The Continental Flying Spur is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. An unnoticeable facelift came in mid-2008, as well as a new Flying Spur Speed variant, adding more power, while improving performance and handling.

The CK is Geely's first offering in a few GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia and the UAE, although it first went on sale in China a couple of years prior. The name "CK" somehow stands for "Freedom Ship" or "Free Cruiser" in Chinese. The CK holds the distinction of being the first Chinese automobile ever displayed at an American auto show, although it has never been allowed to be on sale there. The reasons are that it failed crash tests and emissions regulations. The small car was developed in China, but is supposedly based on a South Korean design by Daewoo. Its 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine is licenced from Toyota. The front-wheel-drive sedan comes with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Features include manual air-conditioning, remote locking, fog lamps, CD stereo, power steering, painted bumpers, power windows, intermittent wipers, 14-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery and more. Options include leather upholstery, ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, dual front airbags,

The XC90 is Volvo's largest 4x4 vehicle. From 2012, the 7-seater is powered by only a 3.2-litre V6 engine option, with an automatic gearbox and all-wheel-drive, as the other engine choices have been dropped. The 2012 facelift also added LEDs front and rear, new bumper bits and new wheel designs. Among the three rows of seats, the second row moves front and back offering adjustable legroom, while the foldable third row seats can be tucked away to increase luggage space. Standard features include keyless entry, 18-inch wheels, CD player, trip computer, rear air-conditioning, power windows, doors, locks and mirrors, and an eight-way power driver's seat with memory. Available features also include leather seats, a power front passenger seat, memory mirrors, a power moonroof, upgraded audio with a six-CD changer, turning HID headlights and self-leveling rear suspension. An R-Design sports package adds 19-inch rims, redesigned upholstery, extra cabin trim and unique 19-inch wheels.stiffer suspension. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, and a rollover protection system.

The Mini is a thrill ride that offers extremely excellent handling, enough to kill exotic cars at twisty tracks. It is also one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a amount of cargo. Its cute looks still generates smiles years after its introduction. Engineered by BMW, the Mini is a high-quality piece of equipment, boasting a multitude of passive and active safety systems. Convertibles were added to the lineup for 2005 and lasted till 2007. All models were enhanced then with new interior lighting, storage space and trim options, plus revised styling. Models include the Cooper and the supercharged Cooper S, but the base Mini One has been cancelled. The Cooper also comes in Seven, Checkmate and Park Lane trims. All use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, but the S uses a supercharger. Gearbox choices include a manual, CVT and automatic. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, along with a number of airbags. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works package that bumps up horsepower, and a Sport package that offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter can be classified as one of the largest commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value.

The Dodge Ram had been extensively re-engineered for 2006, with a minor restyling and an upgraded interior, having been originally redesigned in 2002. It has a new hydroformed frame that's boxed its full length to provide more strength than in any previous model. New suspension and body mounts also improve ride and handling, though it is still no luxury sports sedan. Inside the Ram, the instrument panel, centre console and seats have been redesigned for more car-like comfort, while new entertainment features have been introduced. The standard motor for the Middle East is the 5.7-litre Hemi V8 engine, which featured the new Multi-Displacement System from 2006, a setup that shuts down four of the Hemi's eight cylinders when they are not needed. Dodge claims the switchover is seamless, and that fuel economy is improved by as much as 20 percent. Adding to the Hemi's responsive nature is a five-speed automatic transmission. The Ram comes standard with air conditioning, AM/FM/CD stereo, rear-wheel ABS, 17-inch wheels and a full-size spare tyre. Also available are power windows and door locks, keyless entry, an overhead console with mini-trip computer and compass, cruise control and larger aluminium wheels.

The Toyota RAV4 got a complete redesign for 2013, with a new styling language, a new drivetrain, and new features. In 2016, it got a facelift. The existing platform has been updated with new suspension tuning, while the standard engine now is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. There is also a choice of front-wheel-drive with limited-slip diff or all-wheel-drive with 50:50 lock mode. New items in this 5-seater crossover include a lift-up tailgate with the spare wheel now stored under the boot floor. In the UAE, there was a reshuffle of trims for 2016, with the 2WD available in EX  and VX grade, while the AWD is sold in GXR and VXR grades. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, fold-flat split rear seating and more. The base model gets cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic keyless entry and 17-inch alloy wheels. Additional available features, depending on trim level, include smart keyless entry and start, LED headlights and running lamps, LED tail lamps, auto-dimming mirror, roof rails, cargo net, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, cruise control and dual-zone auto a/c. Also offered on higher-spec models are touchscreen navigation, DVD player, rear camera, power driver's seat, sunroof, leather upholstery and 18-inch alloy wheels. All RAV4 models get two front airbags as well as ABS with EBD, while higher-spec models get additional side and curtain airbags, stability control, brake assist, downhill assist, and hill-start assist.

The Wrangler has been redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The all-new real jeep is longer and wider and more refined. Now powered by a 3.8-litre V6, with a manual or automatic, it still offers low-range gearing and off-road capability. In 2011, the interior was redesigned completely, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were offered. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The new-for-2012 BMW 6-Series Gran Coupe is essentially a 6-Series with four doors on a 5-Series platform. The 640i gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The 650i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto came at the end of 2012. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 6-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport +, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. BMW claims the Gran Coupe is a 4+1 seater, but the rear middle seat offers zero legroom. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inchers, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The Hyundai Centennial is a full-size high-end luxury sedan that serves as the flagship model for the Korean manufacturer. Also known as the Equus elsewhere, it is the most expensive sedan in the company's lineup ever. Introduced in 2010, this rear-wheel-drive cruiser underwent an unnoticeable external facelift for 2014, and is now offered with a choice of two engines, namely a 3.8-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, both direct-injection "GDI" units mated to an 8-speed automatic. The facelift also brought along with it a completely new interior. Standard features include 18-inch alloy wheels, dial-controlled multimedia screen, rear parking camera with guidelines, HID headlights, adaptive front lighting, fog lamps, electric parking brake, leather upholstery, ventilated power-adjustable front seats with reclining/massaging rear ones, power-adjustable headrests and steering column, CD/MP3 stereo with steering buttons, Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with push-button start, luggage net, auto-dimming mirror, power-folding side mirrors, leather upholstery, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, rear electric sunshade, and a 7-inch screen within the gauges. Optional features include 19-inch alloys, power-closing door latches, sunroof, rear armrest cool box, rear tray-tables, rear DVD entertainment screens, mud guards, easy-access sliding driver's seat with power lumbar adjustment, LED headlights, adaptive cruise control, heads-up display, around-view camera system, haptic steering-wheel controls, rear-side electric sunshades and a full 12.3-inch LCD gauge cluster. Standard safety features include stability control, nine airbags including knee airbags, tyre-pressure monitor, ABS with EBD and seatbelt pretensioners, with optional features such as lane departure warning, blind-spot monitor, and a pre-safety system which automatically applies full braking force and reels in the front seat belts when a collision is detected.

The Mitsubishi Mirage takes on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. In 2017, it got a facelift and few interior upgrades. In Saudi Arabia, it is sold as the Spacestar. This sub-compact hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

The Haval H6 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and traction control.

An all-new Nissan Maxima came out in 2016, featuring the company's "V-Motion" front end, boomerang lights and floating roof look. The 2019 Nissan Maxima got a slight facelift, along with some tech and safety upgrades . The new chassis is lighter and more rigid than the previous generation. The American-built front-wheel-drive midsizer is powered by the same 3.5-litre V6 as the previous model but updated with 60% new parts. The engine is mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. Inside, the 2019 Nissan Maxima gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, Alcantara accents and a centre console that is angled 7-degrees toward the driver. It also gets 7-inch Advanced Drive Assist Display in the instrument cluster that can be paired with an optional 8-inch screen with multi-touch control. Other options include HID headlights, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic glass roof, cloth or leather upholstery and more. The Nissan Maxima comes standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control, with options such as blind-spot monitoring, around-view parking cameras and adaptive cruise control with auto-braking. Equipment packages between trim levels change slightly, depending on market.

An all-new BMW M5 came out in 2018. It gets the same 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, upgraded to produce more power. It is mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Also new in this generation is it comes in all-wheel drive. When the engine is first started, the new BMW M5 will be in all-wheel-drive mode with Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) switched on. The driver is then able to vary the handling characteristics of the M5 by activating various driving dynamics modes, including a rear-wheel-drive mode with no DSC. Some of the wide range of driving and comfort features offered in the BMW M5 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. The BMW M5 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

Acura made its entry into the Middle East market in 2015. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura TLX is their midsize luxury sedan offering. Under the hood, two engines are on offer - a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.5-litre V6 unit. The 4-cylinder engine is mated to a 8-speed automatic, while the V6 gets a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the TLX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, smart keyless entry, sunroof, auto-headlight system, LED daytime running lights, engine start-stop button, cruise control, power seats with lumbar support, dual-zone automatic A/C, entertainment system with AM/FM radio/CD/AUX/HDMI support, navigation, speakers & sub-woofer, hands-free telephone with voice recognition, heated & ventilated front seats, front & rear parking sensors, and rearview camera. The higher model gets push-button shifter, adaptive cruise control, and front & rear smart keyless entry. Standard safety features on the TLX include front, side curtain & knee airbags, all-wheel steering, ABS, agile handle assist (AGH), blind spot indicator, vehicle stability assist (VSA) and hill-start assist. The higher model gets lane-keeping assist system, crash mitigation brake system, forward collision warning system, road departure mitigation system and low speed following system.

For 2009, an underwhelming Audi S5 Quattro coupe model debuted, with a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed manual or an automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The 5-door Peugeot 208 is the French manufacturer's smallest car on offer as it replaces the 207. The base Active model comes with traction control, ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, key-less entry, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player as standard. The Allure model comes with: 16-inch 'Black Diamond' alloy wheels, tinted rear windows, a 6 speaker sound system, a USB/deported Jack plug, Bluetooth and remote controls on the steering wheel all as standard. Optional equipment is also on offer: the panoramic glass roof with manual curtain, speed limiter and cruise control, dynamic leather seats, LED lighting package with mood lighting, LED ceiling lights and halogen elliptical module headlights.

The original B9 Tribeca, Subaru's attempt at a midsize 4WD, has received a facelift for 2008, getting a dull new look instead of the ugly old face. Built on the same all-wheel-drive platform as the Outback, the Tribeca is longer, wider and much inches taller than the Outback, and offers five or seven-passenger seating. The overall styling has been toned down after the previous design was deemed too controversial. The interior attempts to be more modern and upscale than competitive makes, with an amazingly unique design. The oddly-named B9 Tribeca has now dropped "B9" from its name, and is now powered by Subaru's 3.6-litre horizontally-opposed flat six-cylinder "boxer" engine, a rare type of engine design shared only with Porsche. Also standard is a five-speed automatic gearbox. The B9 Tribeca offers power windows, electric mirrors, standard roll sensing system, ABS brakes with Brake Assist, CD stereo, and standard two-position memory system for front driver's seat and more. Options include reverse-assist sensors, remote starter, and rear cargo cover with shade-type functionality. Safety features include dual front and side airbags.

The Chinese Tiggo 5 made its way to the GCC in 2015 and got a minor facelift for 2017, largely in the front bumper and headlights with LED running lights. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, and comes with a 4-speed automatic transmission. The five-door five-seater Tiggo gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so expect decent handling.

The Audi RS Q3 is the top performance trim for the sub-compact SUV. In 2021, an all-new model came to the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features in the RS Q3 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start-stop button, multi-functional steering wheel, MMI entertainment system with touch display, aluminium look pedals, black cloth headlining, dual-zone electric climate control, sports seats with leather upholstery and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, anti-slip regulation (ASR), electronic differential lock and electronic stability control (ESC).

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, there is only one petrol engine on offer, which is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The other engines options are the diesel units which include a 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre, which will most likely not make it to the GCC just yet. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with AUX/USB/iPOD/MP3/CD player, and 4 speakers. Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, 5-inch touchscreen, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

The Ram 1500 is offered in the GCC with a standard 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8. From 2014, it received the new rotary knob-controlled 8-speed automatic with available manual-shift feature. Available in regular cab, quad cab and crew cab, with three box lengths depending on model, the two trim levels available in the UAE are the SLT and the Laramie. Features available in the RAM include heated and ventilated front seats, surround-sound Alpine audio system, common power accessories, voice-controlled UConnect multimedia touchscreen system with Bluetooth phone and 30 GB hard drive, rear DVD screen, basic keyless entry with remote start, 17-inch basic or 20-inch chrome wheels, dual-zone auto a/c and a choice of cloth or leather upholstery, all depending on trim level. Standard safety features include standard ABS, stability control with hill-start assist and trailer sway control, front airbags and side airbags, as well as optional adjustable pedals, rear parking sensors and back-up camera.

The Nissan Micra made its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. It remains the same for the 2016 model year. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are fewer trim levels from 2014 onwards, with higher trims having features such as power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Convertible and M8 Competition Convertible was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

JAC J4 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact offering. Under the hood is a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features for the J4 include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, keyless entry, fog lamps, AM/FM radio with USB, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Safety features include dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

An all-new BMW M5 came out in 2018. It gets the same 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, upgraded to produce more power. It is mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Also new in this generation is it comes in all-wheel drive. When the engine is first started, the new BMW M5 will be in all-wheel-drive mode with Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) switched on. The driver is then able to vary the handling characteristics of the M5 by activating various driving dynamics modes, including a rear-wheel-drive mode with no DSC. Some of the wide range of driving and comfort features offered in the BMW M5 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. The BMW M5 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

After a decade, Toyota finally redesigned the Land Cruiser for the 2008 model year. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon is at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. However, it really is one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. The new Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.0-litre V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, and an upgraded 4.7-litre V8 with a 5-speed auto. There is also a 4.5-litre turbodiesel V8 option, with the 6-speed automatic version getting more power than the 5-speed manual version. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. Features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 17-inch alloy or steel wheels, smart key, start/stop button, optional parking sensors, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional leather, ABS brakes, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, and Bluetooth among other items.

The Legacy is Subaru's midsize model, available in all-wheel-drive form as standard. For 2005, Subaru introduced the fourth-generation Legacy with fresh styling and better handling. The same model, available in sedan and wagon body styles, has been facelifted for the 2007 model year. The Legacy is available in the Middle East with either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder, known as the 2.0R, and the 3.0-litre six-cylinder, known as the 3,0R. Both are flat "boxer" engines, mated to automatic gearboxes. Standard equipment in the base 2.0R model includes MP3/WMA CD stereo, a 6-disc CD changer, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, alloy Wheels, fog lamps, climate control, cruise control and cloth upholstery. Leather and sunroof are optional. The top 3.0R trim level adds the advanced Vehicle Dynamics Control stability and traction control system, eight airbags, sunroof, leather upholstery with power-adjustable seats and more. The wagon is only available in 2.0R form.

Mini released an all-new Cooper and Cooper S 5-door hatchback model in 2015 model. In 2022, it received a facelift. The Mini Cooper gets a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They both get a 7-speed transmission, with the Cooper S getting the dual-clutch transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The 407 is an oddity in the midsize car segment, with bold styling that puts form over function, and the 2-door coupe version goes even further. Standard is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with an all-new 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. Basic features include power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind, automatic climate control, and as many as nine airbags.

The painfully cute QQ symbolises China's history of producing bootlegged electronics and brand-name clothes. Except in this case, they've managed to pirate a complete car. As unbelievable as it might sound, the QQ was copied from a previous-generation Daewoo Matiz, now sold as the Chevrolet Spark. It is said that the cars are so alike that parts can be interchanged between the two cars. Needless to say, General Motors is pissed and they've been fighting in Chinese courts for ages now. Apparently, former Daewoo engineers got jobs at Chery, and they brought Daewoo blueprints with them. The car, however, is cheaper than dirt and you can have the same car for less money. The tiny 3-cylinder and 4-cylinder engines in the QQ produce almost as much power as the Spark, so it is still a painfully slow car. Keyless entry and power windows are standard, while dual airbags and CD player are optional. If anyone is interested in a brand new pint-sized car as small as this for fuel economy or whatever other reason, they might actually be happy with this thing. From what we hear, they are far from perfectly reliable, but we haven't exactly heard good things about GM-Daewoo either.

The radical C4 offers a hip and modern hatchback with out-of-this-world styling and innovative new ideas, with items such as a multi-functional fixed-centred steering wheel and an built-in air freshener. Available as either a three-door or a five-door, it is already popular on the Internet for its dancing-robot TV ads. Besides eye-catching styling, it comes with a long list of standard equipment. Firstly, the base engine is a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with either a manual or an automatic. The top model is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic. The C4 comes standard with alloy wheels, cruise control and the power features features. Options include a panoramic sunroof and xenon dual-function directional headlamps. On the inside, where the C4 pays attention to detail with touches like the damped push-open drawers on the dashboard and an abundance of soft-touch trim. There are six airbags as standard, as well as ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Emergency Braking Assistance. Electronic Stability Programme with Traction Control is optional.

The Infiniti Q30 is Nissan's first entry in the premium compact hatchback category. Sharing a front-wheel-drive platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it shares engines with its joint-venture German cousin as well, including the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor. Standard options in the Q30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, infotainment system with touch screen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The Jaguar XJ is generally available in four trim levels in SWB and LWB versions. The UAE and some other GCC markets will only see the Premium Luxury, Portfolio and SuperSport versions, all in LWB form. The XJ Premium Luxury and the Portfolio will be available with a 5.0-litre naturally-aspirated V8. The XJ Portfolio can also be optioned up with a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The SuperSport comes exclusively with a higher-tuned 5.0-litre supercharged V8. Finally a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 engine completes the line-up. All models are rear-wheel-drive mated with 8-speed automatic gearboxes. Features include an aluminium body, air suspension, "Adaptive Dynamics" continuously-variable damping, adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, "Active Differential Control" and quick-ratio power steering. Customers can have their choice in colours, veneers and leathers. Inside the car, there is a 12.3-inch LCD with virtual Instruments, Dual-View 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, optional 1200W Bowers & Wilkins system, hard drive and connectivity for portable audio and video devices via a "Media Hub." Other available features include a panoramic glass roof, power accessories, automatic climate control, electric seats with ventilation, turning headlights and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS, pre-charged braking technology, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor and more. The V6 is available in regular or long-wheelbase form, while the V8 is only available in long-wheelbase form, with regular-wheelbase models available upon request.

The Toledo used to be a handsome compact sedan in a previous life. Now it is one of those weird cars which cannot be categorised with any certainty. We saw one in person and believe it could be competition for compact sedans, but with an upward-opening tailgate instead. In reality, it is an extended version of the Altea, but aiming for a more conservative crowd, but unfortunately with an unconservative design. Sold here with a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with manual or automatic, it does pack a lot of features. Equipment includes power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, standard six airbags, split-folding rear seat, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, folding electric mirrors, front fog lamps and ESP stability control with EBA brake assist and DSR traction control. Options include turning front lighting system  with bi-xenon headlights, special upholsteries, stereo controls on the steering wheel,  better speakers, rain-sensing wipers, anti-dazzle rear-view mirror, rear parking sensor, cruise control, 17-inch alloy wheels, lowered suspension and sports seats.

The Toyota Land Cruiser Prado SWB got a second facelift in 2018. with a redesigned front-end and other trim changes.
