Its 1.5-litre engine is based on the Daihatsu 1.3-litre, with variable valve timing and its torque curve is virtually flat from 3200 to 4000 rpm. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic transmission. A centre differential transfers power with a fixed 50/50 torque split to the front and rear axles via separate propshafts. A fascia-mounted switch activates the electronically-controlled differential lock. ABS and airbags are available too.

The MG GS is the Chinese company's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It comes standard in front-wheel-drive format, with optional four-wheel-drive. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, LED daytime running lamps, manual-adjustable seats, manual A/C, stereo with USB/AUX support, 4 speakers and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include automatic headlamps, xenon headlamps, keyless entry, engine start-stop button, 18-inch alloy wheels, leather seats with lumbar support, sunroof, automatic A/C, infotainment system with 6.1-inch touch screen and 6 or 8 speakers, Bluetooth, electric folding side mirrors,  glovebox cooling and rear camera. Safety features include stability control, ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist, auto hold and front airbags. The higher models get additional airbags, hill descent control and anti-roll program.

The Lotus Exige S is a super-light sports coupe with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine. It gets go-kart handling, thanks to its light weight as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. It is only available with a 6-speed manual gearbox, although an automatic is expected to come later. Standard features for the GCC include leather seats, plain black leather sun-visors, lightweight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand brake sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. There are two new interior package options available: Premium and Premium Sport. The Premium Pack provides added comfort and style where as the Premium Sport option focuses on creating an internal space optimised for ultimate driver involvement. Built for the adrenalin hungry sportscar aficionado, the Lotus Exige S features high performance bespoke tyre package with Pirelli P-Zero Corsa tyres as standard. A Lotus DPM (Dynamic Performance Management) switch allows the driver to switch between three driving modes: Touring, Sport and DPM off. And if three dynamic settings are not enough, an additional Race Pack option is available which adds a fourth driving mode setting: Race. This setting provides the maximum possible traction out of corners. The Race Pack also features Launch Control and an optimised suspension setting making the car perfect for letting rip on the track. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

This generation Mazda 3, which came to the GCC in 2015, is slightly longer in height and length than the previous generation. The exterior of the Mazda 3 got the new Mazda "KODO" treatment, their new trademark design at the time. For 2016, there were no changes. The compact sedan came with two engine choices in the GCC, a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor with a 4-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Mechanical features include independent suspension, disc brakes, electric power steering and an all-new platform unrelated to the Ford Focus, unlike before. The basic S-grade 1.6L model comes with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, power windows, manual a/c, Bluetooth, central locking, starter button, 16-inch steel wheels, cruise control, tilt/telescoping steering column and a single-piece folding rear seat. The V-grade 1.6L model adds some chrome trim, running lamps, 16-inch alloys, fog lamps, split-folding rear seat, leather steering wheel and mirror-mounted indicators. An optional package adds a 6-speaker stereo, sunroof, auto-dimming mirror, adaptive headlights, MZD Connect multimedia system with LCD screen and rotary controller, headlamp washers, rear camera with sensors, LED tail lamps, auto-levelling HID headlights, single-zone auto a/c and, as a further option, navigation. The R-grade 2.0L model gets the larger engine as well as additional features such as a basic heads-up display, standard navigation, smart keyless entry, piano-black front grille, leather seats, auto headlights and wipers, adaptive cruise, 18-inch alloys, power-folding mirrors, rear spoiler and better safety features. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, while top-spec R-grade models get side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The Rexton II is the latest version Ssangyong's attractive original Rexton. It was launched in the Middle East alongside two other now-defunct 4WDs back in 2002, and has survived with a facelift for 2007. The five-door Rexton can seat up to seven people and comes with a host of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, fake wood trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control is also available.

The Mazda CX-3 is the Japanese brand's smallest SUV offering. Under the hood, it comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2-wheel drive model includes power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push button start, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/USB, Bluetooth, 4 speakers and alloy wheels. The mid-spec models get all-wheel drive, rear camera, auto A/C, 7-inch touch screen, 6 speakers, steering wheel with Bluetooth controls, daytime running lamps and fog lamps. The top model gets navigation, 6 Bose speakers, adaptive cruise control, leather seats, head up display, digital tachometer and DVD player. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, ABS with EBD and traction control and stability control. The higher models get blind spot monitor, auto-braking system, lane departure warning system and side curtain airbags.

Porsche introduced this generation of the 911 model series as a new model, even though it looks almost identical to the older one. The GT3 and GT3 RS get a further upgraded version of the 3.8-litre engine. It is available only with a 6-speed manual transmission. Additional new features include front and rear LED driving lights, bi-xenon headlights, dynamic cornering lights, and a mild overall facelift. Interior features include a CD stereo, leather upholstery, optional multimedia system, common power accessories and more. Safety includes multiple airbags, stability control, ABS and traction control.

Daihatsu aims to boost sales with its new Terios 4WD. With short front and rear overhangs, a long wheelbase and wide track, it looks like it can go off-road, but not with any real verve. It's apparently aimed at people looking for the traditional 4x4 qualities of high seating position, bad-weather traction and versatility combined with small car running costs and manoeuvrability. It is longer and wider than the previous model. The interior is about the same size as a mid-sized hatchback, with a split fold-and-tumble rear seat that frees up luggage space supposedly long enough to take a mountain bike. The front floor cross-member, tunnel, sills, B-pillars and roof-side rails are all strengthened to secure the cabin. With the rear seat in use the boot capacity is 380 litres. Its 1.5-litre engine is based on the Daihatsu 1.3-litre, with variable valve timing and its torque curve is virtually flat from 3200 to 4000 rpm. The engine is mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. A centre differential transfers power with a fixed 50/50 torque split to the front and rear axles via separate propshafts. A fascia-mounted switch activates the electronically-controlled differential lock. ABS, EBD and front driver & passenger airbags are available too. There are two grades - the SVP and SX. The SVP gets power steering, power windows, remote central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, steering mounted audio controls, AM/FM audio system with CD/MP3/AUX support and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps.  The SX grade gets additional automatic A/C, 12V power supply socket, chrome plated door handles, chrome plated side mirrors, roof rails and 16-inch alloy wheels.

An all-new Kia Sportage came out for the 2016 model year. It has remained the same for 2019. The Sportage is powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, or a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, or a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder will all-wheel drive. The naturally-aspirated engines get a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the turbo engine is mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre AWD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, navigation and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. The top "GT Line" option comes with a different front bumper with four-cube fog lamps, different front grille, front and back skid plates, dual exhaust tips, D-shaped steering wheel and 20-inch alloy wheels

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. The Corolla can be equipped to be a luxurious compact, with the decent top-spec 1.8-litre four-cylinder, as well as optional leather interior and a DVD system, which are hard to find in any other compact besides the overpriced German cars. We even compared this version of the Corolla to an Audi, which no doubt made Audi angry. However, the base Corolla offers excellent value and comes standard with a 1.3-litre four-cylinder, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows and a cloth interior. Airbags are standard, but everything else is optional. Both engines can be had with either a five-speed manual or a smooth but outdated four-speed automatic. Everything is simple about this car. The air-conditioning controls and radio controls are straightforward, the cup holders work well, and storage holes are available all over. The sedan is surprisingly roomy and comfortable, while the wagon has a spacious luggage area.

The SC 430 switches from luxury hardtop coupe to open roadster at the touch of a button. Dropping the power hardtop turns it into a true convertible, but the SC is far from a sporting vehicle. Its exterior and interior were freshened for 2006. This rear-wheel drive car is powered by a 4.3-litre V8 engine mated to a new six-speed automatic transmission and soft comfort-biased suspension. It comes as one model that features a power retractable hardtop, soft leather with wood and chrome accents, a navigation system and a Mark Levinson audio with nine speakers, 6-CD changer, a/c system that auto-adjusts temperature for top-up and top-down, eight-way power adjustable front seats with memory function, power door mirrors, Bluetooth mobile phone, HID headlamps with adaptive front-lighting system and auto-leveling system, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, front and rear corner sensors, and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include dual front & side airbags, whiplash injury lessening concept seats, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, Vehicle Stability Control, traction control, and a tyre pressure warning system.

The BT-50 is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines for the B-Series include 2.2-litre and 2.6-litre petrol engines, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include plastic fender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

In 2020, the Audi Q7 got updated visually and technically. The Q7 has a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. It comes standard in 18-inch alloy wheels, which can go up to 21-inch alloy wheels, while optional equipment include three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. The optional "Audi pre sense basic" initiates preventive protective measures for the occupants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts. Optional solutions are bundled in the packages "Parking", "City" and "Tour". The "Parking" package includes the surround view camera and the park assist system, which autonomously steers the car backwards into parallel and perpendicular parking spots. The driver only has to apply the brakes and the gas. The "City" package comprises new systems. The cross-traffic assist warns the driver of other vehicles when driving slowly in reverse, such as when pulling out from a perpendicular parking spot. The exit warning system indicates vehicles or cyclists approaching from the rear before the door is opened.  "Audi side assist" uses radar measurements behind the car to ensure safe lane changes. "Audi pre sense rear" tensions the seat belts in the event of an impending collision from behind. The parking system plus and the reversing cameras round out the "City" package.

An all-new GMC Yukon was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. The more luxurious Denali version, identified by its chrome grille and trimmings, gets a 6.2-litre V8 debuting initially with a 6-speed automatic, but later upgraded to an 8-speed auto in late 2014. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The Terracan is odd one out in the Hyundai range. It is a capable midsize off-road vehicle based on the old Mitsubishi Pajero, just the right size to not be too big on the roads. The problem is that it became outdated as soon as it was released. This 80s-style 4WD does have a fairly spacious  interior and loaded with features to compete in this class, with a low price to boot. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to an automatic, it comes with beefy tyres on 16-inch alloy wheels and a full-time 4WD system with active torque transfer. Standard features include power steering, single airbag, a nifty limited slip differential, central door locking system, side steps, roof rack, power windows and electric mirrors, front and rear a/c, front fog lamps, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and hidden antenna, and rear wiper with washer. Options include dual airbags, ABS brakes, keyless entry with anti-theft system, leather interior upholstery, useless rear spoiler, fake wood trim, cruise control, digital multi-metre, electric driver's seat, CD player with 6 speakers, and a few more storage areas.

The Porsche Cayenne received its first major redesign with this model, after surviving on facelifts for nearly a decade. While it looks more like a facelift again, the new-for-2011 model has been extensively revamped, effectively from a offroader to a crossover in the process. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine, the Cayenne S gets a 4.8-litre V8 engine, whereas the Turbo gets a 4.8-litre V8 with twin-turbochargers. A hybrid model, the Cayenne S Hybrid, is fitted with a 3.0-litre supercharged engine and electric motor. There is also a Cayenne D model now with a 3.0-litre turbodiesel V6. The Cayenne GTS, a lowered sporty model powered by a higher-tuned 4.8-litre V8, came in mid-2012. All the models get a new 8-speed Tiptronic S automatic transmission and an Automatic Start-Stop function. Only the base V6 can be had with a 6-speed manual. Porsche claims the Cayenne is a capable off-roader, but there isn't even a low-range gearing option any more. A feature called Porsche Traction Management manages the permanent all-wheel-drive, self-locking centre differential, automatic brake differential, stability control and on-demand hill control. A PASM air suspension controls the damping firmness, and available as standard or optional, depending on model. As usual, everything on a Porsche is largely optional, with few exceptions. Features available on the Cayenne include a 7-inch TFT touchscreen, optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch, and a choice of an optional 14-speaker BOSE CD stereo or an optional 16-speaker Burmester CD stereo, both with USB and iPod support. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

The Lexus GX 460 received a second facelift in 2020. It gets an updated signature spindle grille, and new triple bean LED headlamps. The engine is a carryover 4.6-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. The base Premier model is well-equipped, with standard features such as a multi-terrain select system, smart keyless entry and start, sunroof, rear camera and side camera with park assist, synthetic leather trim for the 7-seater cabin, 9-speaker stereo with new 8-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, DVD navigation, tri-zone a/c, crawl control, ESP, basic cruise control and a full set of airbags that includes knee bags. The Platinum model adds semi-aniline leather, heated/ventilated seats, cool box and lane-change assist with blind-spot monitor, 17-speaker Mark Levinson stereo, pre-crash safety system, radar cruise control and a rear-seat entertainment system.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk is the top variant of the midsize SUV offering from the American brand. It gets insanely powerful supercharged 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. The 2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features in the 2019 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The long-running Town Car is Lincoln's full-size luxury sedan based on the Ford Crown Victoria rear-wheel-drive platform. Numerous trim series are available, including the Signature, the Signature Limited, and the long-wheelbase Signature L. Power comes from a 4.6-litre V8 mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. Town Car puts power to the ground through its rear wheels via a 3.27:1 rear-axle ratio, with traction control and ABS brakes as standard. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch wheels, rear parking assist, keyless entry, CD stereo, leather seats, auto-dimming rearview mirror, front and side airbags, automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals and power-adjustable front seats. Options in higher trims include HID headlights, CD changer, sunroof, two-tone paint and power-operated luggage trunk lid. The car is pretty dated now, but a mild redesign in 2003 involved upgrades both inside and out.

An all-new Nissan Maxima came out in 2016, featuring the company's "V-Motion" front end, boomerang lights and floating roof look. The 2018 Nissan Maxima remains the same. The new chassis is lighter and more rigid than the previous generation. The American-built front-wheel-drive midsizer is powered by the same 3.5-litre V6 as the previous model but updated with 60% new parts. The engine is mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. Inside, the 2018 Nissan Maxima gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, Alcantara accents and a centre console that is angled 7-degrees toward the driver. It also gets 7-inch Advanced Drive Assist Display in the instrument cluster that can be paired with an optional 8-inch screen with multi-touch control. Other options include HID headlights, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic glass roof, cloth or leather upholstery and more. The 2018 Nissan Maxima comes standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control, with options such as blind-spot monitoring, around-view parking cameras and adaptive cruise control with auto-braking. Equipment packages between trim levels change slightly, depending on market.

The Chevrolet Aveo sedan is built in Korea. An all-new model came out in 2017. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Three trim levels are on offer - a base, LS and LT. The standard model gets steering wheel controls, Bluetooth, radio and phone handsfree controls, driver and passenger dual air bags, 15-inch steel wheels and front power windows. The LS trim gets addtiional 4-way driver seat adjuster, rear park assist, rear seat full folding, 40/60 split, front fog lamps and optional 15-inch alloy wheels. The LT trim gets additional 7-inch MyLinkTM screen with phone integration, 6 speakers and 15-inch alloy wheels.

Changan Alsvin V7 is the Chinese brand compact sedan offering. Under the hood it gets  a1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features of the Alsvin include power windows, power steering, central locking, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD/AUX/USB, 4 speakers, manual A/C, fabric seats, halogen headlamps and 15-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, engine push start, 6-speakers, sunroof and parking sensors. Safety features include front airbags, hill-start assist, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control (TCS) and stability control (ESC).

The BT-50 is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines for the B-Series include 2.2-litre and 2.6-litre petrol engines, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include plastic fender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is a combination of both coupe and crossover, designed to the tackle the BMW X6. In 2020, it got a facelift. Currently only the GLE 53 AMG is being sold, which comes with a 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged V6 motor, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The engine is coupled with a small electric motor to improve acceleration and fuel economy. Exterior-wise, it shares a few design cues of the new S-Class Coupe, such as the roofline and rear tail-lights. The interior features sports seats, a sports steering wheel and a new infotainment display. The cabin is covered in silver shadow accents, and aluminum or wood trim.Safety features include Driving Assistance package which includes features such as DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist and PRE-SAFE PLUS. The Parking package includes the 360-degree camera and Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC. Night-time vision is improved by the LED Intelligent Light System which is a standard feature on all models; adverse weather conditions with impaired view are defused by MAGIC VISION CONTROL the heated, adaptive windscreen wiper system.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee has received a facelift as well as a few mechanical upgrades for the 2014 model year. Offered with a choice of the 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or the 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a new 8-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and four trim levels. The introduction of the 8-speed automatic transmission boosts fuel economy numbers. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. Another trim level introduced for 2014 is the Summit which also comes in only V8 form. The SRT8 version gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. A new added feature on all models is the new 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds chrome bumper trim, painted wheel arches, real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The Summit has similar options to the Limited, with the addition of a unique SRT-like front bumper, more premium leather and wood panels for the interior. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The Jeep Patriot got a new transmission and minor interior and exterior upgrades in 2014. The Patriot is a compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This latest generation of midsize pickups feature roomier cabins, improved ride quality and increased stability. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with only a manual gearbox, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player.

Hyundai's first ever rear-wheel-drive sports car, the Genesis Coupe is a 2+2 seater was mildly revamped for 2013 with a new front end, new tail lamps and a nicer interior. It continues unchanged for 2016, aside from a sizeable price drop. The Genesis Coupe is based on the same rear-drive platform as found under the full-size Genesis sedan, but with almost five inches chopped out of the wheelbase. The Coupe features a MacPherson strut dual-link front suspension and a five-link rear suspension. The GCC-spec Genesis Coupe will only be available as a fully-optioned V6 automatic model. That means the two-door coupe will come with power windows, electric mirrors, 18-inch wheels, leather seats, cruise control, sunroof, HID headlights, 10-speaker Infinity audio and Brembo brakes. The 3.8-litre V6 engine is mated to a new 8-speed automatic. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side airbags, ABS and stability control. The "GDI" V6 manual and the base turbo 4-cylinder engines, as sold in other overseas markets, will not be offered as of now.

The new-for-2012 Honda CR-V is an all-new design that is slightly lighter and apparently more aerodynamic. Built in the United States, it comes in LX, EX and EX-Leather flavours. It is still powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a basic 5-speed automatic transmission, but power has been bumped up a fair bit. Honda now tacks on an improved all-wheel-drive system that still drives the front wheels most of the time but can send torque to the rear wheels anytime, instead of like the old system that used to wait for the front wheels to lose traction and spin first. The 5-seater cabin comes with a quick 60:40 fold-flat rear bench. The LX gets 17-inch alloys, a 4-speaker CD stereo with AUX port, mirror-mounted indicators, ABS, stability control and front airbags. Only the EX and EX-L models get 18-inch wheels, a 6-speaker stereo with USB/AUX ports, cruise control, HID headlights, fog lamps, dual-zone auto a/c, sunroof, Bluetooth, rear camera and an 'i-MID' LCD display. The EX-L itself further gets side-curtain airbags, leather and a power driver's seat.

The Volkswagen Toureg got a facelift in 2015. The petrol engines on offer in this 5-seater is a carryover 3.6-litre V6, and a 4.2-litre V8, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. This VW is a crossover, with independent four-wheel-suspension and a simple terrain-select system. Largely optional features include cloth or leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, navigation, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry, starter button, panoramic sunroof, real wood trim, power-folding rear seat, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go function, lane departure warning system, blind-spot monitor, pre-crash system with full automatic emergency braking, ABS, a full set of front and side airbags, parking assist with four cameras, adaptive air suspension with continuous damping control and adaptive roll compensation, LED tail lamps, HID headlights, power-adjustable front seats with memory, seat heaters and a choice of 18-inch, 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels.

The Mondeo is a midsize front-wheel-drive built in Europe that is based on a Mazda platform. It loses out to the Japanese with a combination of engines that lag behind in power, its smaller size and its expensive dealer maintenance charges. The Mondeo actually a good family sedan, but its image is also diluted due to fleet sales as taxis. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for a very affordable price. The interior is fairly attractive and put together well. The Mondeo does have a sizeable interior for its size. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, available with either a manual or an automatic transmission. A 2.5-litre V6 engine is coupled with a five-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. The sporty Mondeo ST220, a great car, is powered by a 3.0-litre V6 engine and a six-speed manual transmission. The Mondeo can also be had as a wagon.

Toyota tacks on the Land Cruiser badge on up to three of their 4WD models, including a pickup, but there is only one true Land Cruiser that everyone knows and loves for reasons unknown. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon remains at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. It is still one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. Few vehicles offer the off-road capability of the Land Cruiser, and fewer still combine this with its level of luxury. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.5-litre six-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto, and a new 4.7-litre V8 and a five-speed auto. There is also a 4.2-litre diesel with a manual. It can transport anywhere from eight to ten passengers depending on model. It is an expensive vehicle, but everything is still optional, including ABS, airbags and cruise control. Other options include leather sunroof and navigation. We'd love to love this outdated 4WD, but we hate the people who buy these, as any other road user will know why.

The R8 is Audi's all-new two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. In mid-2009, a 5.2-litre V10 engine was introduced. The V8 Coupe came first, followed by the V10 Coupe, and then the V10 Spyder in 2010. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or an R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The coupe and powered soft top models almost have the same rigidity. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

Launched in 2006, the Lexus GS already started to feel dated a few years later, and the 2009 update didn't help matters too much. Lexus openly admitted that the BMW 5-Series was their benchmark for this rear-wheel-drive GS, and yet it never caught on, especially with its detuned engine choices in the GCC when compared to foreign markets. The GS 300 gets a basic 3.0-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, while the new-for-2009 GS 460 gets a 4.6-litre V8 paired with an 8-speed automatic. The list of standard equipment includes 18-inch alloy wheels, leather-trimmed seats with front power adjustment, keyless entry, pushbutton starter, 14-speaker Mark Levinson audio system with both CD and DVD capability, Bluetooth wireless telephone technology, rear camera, multiple airbags, ABS and various stability systems, sunroof, adaptive front lighting, and a 7-inch multi-information touch screen. Options on higher trim levels include DVD navigation, power rear sunshade, active cruise control and a "Pre-Crash" safety system.

An all-new Ford F-150 Raptor was made available in the GCC in 2017. It comes with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. This generation gets an all-aluminium body making it lighter than the previous generation. The Raptor is available as a SuperCab or as a SuperCrew. Standard features on the 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor include power steering, power windows, cruise control, keyless entry, manual single-zone A/C, bucket seats with manual lumbar support, fabric upholstery, SYNC voice recognition communications and entertainment system, 1 USB, AM/FM stereo with 7 speakers, leather wrapped steering-wheel with mounted audio controls, reverse parking sensors with camera, and 17-inch alloy wheels with all-terrain tyres. Optional features on the 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor include the SYNC 3 system with an 8-inch touch screen, 2 USB ports, Sony audio system with 10 speakers and sub-woofer, power seats, navigation, moonroof, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, ventilated seats, active park assist, adaptive cruise control and blind spot monitor. All models of the 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor get front driver and passenger airbags, side curtain airbags, rollover sensor and stability control.

The Superb is an upper-medium segment car, with an extended wheelbase to increase interior room. The Superb name first appeared on a Skoda in 1934 and is the company's flagship model. The modern-day version Superb is available in various trim levels, with names like Classic, Comfort and Elegance. The Superb offers many of the benefits of a luxury car, with large rear doors and optional rear-seat DVD entertainment. The rear passenger space is exceptional for a vehicle in this segment and high quality trim materials are used throughout the model range. Customisation options include a sunroof and a host of alloy wheel designs and sizes. In the Middle East, the Superb is available with two petrol engines, namely the entry-level turbocharged 1.8-litre four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre V6. Both are coupled with a 5-speed automatic gearbox to drive the front wheels. Standard safety features include ABS brakes, front and side airbags, and even curtain airbags, while the V6 model gets electronic stability control as standard.

The Countryman continues BMW's trend to make the Mini model range not-so-mini any more. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and yet powered by the same Mini engines, namely the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder in turbo and non-turbo forms. The base model for the GCC will be the Mini Cooper Countryman in front-wheel-drive, while the Cooper S Countryman will come with the turbo engine as well as a choice of front-wheel-drive or "ALL4" all-wheel-drive. Both come with a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The rugged Xterra debuted in the GCC during late 2007 and got a facelift for the 2009 model year. The Xterra is a simple but capable alternative to the Pathfinder, incorporating as much off-road gear while originally forgoing most luxury features, but Nissan did add a few conveniences in 2009 due to customer demand. The five-seater Xterra is powered by the Pathfinder's 4.0-litre V6 engine, with four-wheel-drive, low-range gearing and either a six-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. All 2009 Xterra trims now have a redesigned front end featuring two new grilles, namely sandblast aluminium finish on X, S and Off-Road models, and satin chrome finish for Xterra SE models. New features include rear a/c ducts, new audio package including six-disc in-dash changer, redesigned centre cluster, push-button a/c, Bluetooth handsfree phone and iPod connectivity. Side steps and cloth upholstery are standard on the S model, while leather seats and illuminated steering-wheel switches are standard on the SE model. A new Off Road model includes body side molding, unique two-tone seat fabric, rear differential lock, heavy duty Bilstein shock absorbers, and BF Goodrich off-road tyres on new 16 inch alloy wheels. A GPS navigation system is also available. All models feature power windows and mirrors, power steering, CD audio system, remote keyless entry, alloy wheels, low tyre-pressure indicator, 60/40 split folding rear seat, available fold-down front passenger seat, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS brakes with brake-force distribution and brake assist, although side-curtain airbags may be available in some markets. Key exterior styling features include large flared fenders, big roof rails and a rear bumper design with side steps for easy access to the roof rack.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in three versions currently. The Maybach 62 is the long wheelbase version of the 57, which is quite large already, and this body style comes in either standard 62 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in a new-for-2008 62 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. All models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems. A handful of limited-edition Landaulet four-door convertible models were built in 2010 for a four times higher price.

Ford has been overly careful not to mess with a winner, so when Ford redesigned the Explorer in 2006, America's favorite midsize sport utility for the last 15 years in a row, they barely changed anything. The latest Explorer is available with a big 4.0-litre V6, with a five-speed automatic. The wagon can seat seven, while the Sport Trac pickup can seat five. The wagon is a traditional midsize 4WD with a body-on-frame construction, and features new steering, new suspension and new brakes. Standard equipment include Roll Stability Control, independent rear suspension, keyless entry, cruise control, compass and thermometer, power windows, locks and mirrors, air conditioning, a floor console, rear vent windows and added 12-volt power point, AM/FM stereo with single CD or MP3 player, driver manual lumbar adjuster, a tyre-pressure monitoring system and alloy wheels. Options include running boards, roof rails, bigger wheels, more wood and leather, 10-way power seat and a six-disc changer. The Sport Trac has a composite cargo box with two-tier storage ability, available hard tonneau cover and three integrated tool bins.

The Renault Twizy is designed as an "ultramobile" and is just 2.34 metres long, 1.24 metres wide and 1.45 metres tall. It is available in only four colours blue, white, red and black -- from which customers can choose many styling combinations. Different stickers can also be added to the doors and rims. We're classifying it as a mini-hatchback, but the truth is this four-wheeled 2-seater is hard to categorise. The passenger sits behind the driver, crammed in somehow. The Twizy's electric motor can run up to 85 km on a single charge. The lithium-ion batteries takes about 3.5 hours to charge completely using a 220-240v powerpoint. For safety, the Twizy comes with a 4-point seatbelt and a steering-wheel airbag. It is equipped with disc brakes as well and an optional rear-parking aid.

The Volkswagen Scirocco received a minor facelift for the 2015 model year. Engines include a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder with both a supercharger and a turbocharger, as well as a 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. The GCC dealers will be pushing the automatic version locally, with the 'DSG' automanual gearbox, but it can be special-ordered with a 6-speed manual. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

Toyota had been selling a slightly-altered version of the Prado in the United States since 2002, calling it the Lexus GX 470. That model has now been replaced by a new-for-2010 GX 460 model, based on the latest-generation Prado. The most obvious difference between the GCC-spec Prado and the US-spec GX460 is the front-end styling, with small changes to the rear light clusters and a completely unique dashboard. The cabin trim quality is also a notch better, while even a few control buttons have been changed for a more premium feel. The real news is under the bonnet, as the Lexus version comes exclusively with a 4.6-litre V8, slighty detuned compared to the U.S. version. The V8 is mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. In terms of standard equipment, this 7-seater comes with three-zone auto a/c, 9-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, front and side-curtain airbags, front knee airbags, hands-free keyless entry with starter button, wood and leather trim, Bluetooth and USB jack, as well as a centre-diff lock, KDSS air suspension, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID turning headlights, sunroof, parking assist, common power accessories, cruise control, ABS and stability control. Adding to the base 'Premium' model, the 'Premium Plus' trim adds a 17-speaker stereo with DVD changer, 8-inch navigation screen, rear DVD entertainment system, roof rails, 4-camera 360-degree system and crawl control. The top 'Luxury' trim adds semi-aniline leather, active cruise control and a remote engine starter.

The Laguna is supposed to be an alternative to the average car in the boring midsize segment. The Laguna looks somewhat like a sedan, but is actually a liftback, with a rear hatch that opens upwards for easier access to the luggage trunk. There are two new engines. The base model comes with a simple 2.0-litre four-cylinder, mated to an automatic gearbox in this region. The top model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder setup with unique suspension that is lowered by 10 mm and comes with stiffened springs and dampers. The Laguna became the first car in Europe to achieve the top rating in European governmental crash tests, and is one of the safest cars in its class. Standard safety features include ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Brake Assist, anti-whiplash head restraints, front, front-lateral and front/rear curtain airbags, with de-activation for the front passenger seat. Other standard features include remote central locking, immobiliser and alarm, power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and more.

The Grand Cherokee was all-new for the 2006 model year, and for 2008, it has been updated with a new front end, HID headlights with integrated turn lenses and new 17-inch and 18-inch wheels. Interior updates include a new centre console and a four-gauge instrument cluster with LED illumination. The new base engine is a 3.7-litre V6. It also continues with an upgraded 4.7-litre V8, a carryover 5.7-litre Hemi V8 and an SRT-exclusive 6.1-litre V8. Cloth upholstery is standard, as are power windows, power locks with remote keyless entry, eight-way power driver's seat,  CD audio, driver information center, 60/40 split folding rear seat, and available parking sensors. All models offer full-time four-wheel drive, with low-range gearing. Higher models get leather upholstery, Boston Acoustics six-speaker six-CD changer and MP3 capability, power adjustable pedals, power front seats, rain-sensing automatic wipers, electrochromic rearview mirror, tyre pressure monitor with display, adjustable roof rack crossrails, and more.  The fancy Overland model adds real wood accents on the doors and console, two-tone leather and ultra-suede seats, leather-covered console and armrest, reverse-parking sensor and more. The rocket-like SRT-8 gets stiff suspension for the road, but gives up its off-road ability. Safety features include a stability system with roll mitigation, ABS brakes with brake assist, traction control, and numerous airbags.

The Lexus IS debuted as an all-new sedan in 2007, limited to a single engine choice for the GCC, although other markets get better engines. Saddled with a GCC-specific 3.0-litre V6 engine, the IS 300 offers the most sporting ride of the Lexus range. The rear-wheel drive IS 300 comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof; ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Changes for 2009 include minor tweaks such as restyled mirrors and rear headrests. The major news was the addition of the IS 300 C four-seater convertible. Along with the folding hard-top, the IS C features LED rear lights, parking sensors, revised instrument gauges, climate control designed for top-down motoring, 12-speaker Mark Levinson sound system and an in-dash CD changer. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

The Audi S6 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. The all-wheel drive S6 has a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Optional features for the S6 include heads-up display, sports differential, dynamic steering and ceramic brakes. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control. Optional safety features include rear side airbags, park assist, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, night vision and pre-sense assist.

As with the previous model, the new TT is built on the VW Golf platform. The new TT will be available with numerous engines, including a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo and a 3.2-litre V6. The TT RS model debuted in 2011 with a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo while the V6 was cancelled. The TT roadster will debut late into 2007. The new TT is a far more aggressive sports car than the model it replaces, which was more of a show car than a sports car. Like its predecessor, the curvy profile generates a lot of aerodynamic lift at the rear end, so the new TT adopts a rear spoiler which recesses smoothly into the tail at low speeds and raises automatically at over 120 kph. The new car is larger and heavier, so to compensate for the additional metal, the hood, front fenders, roof and doors are made of aluminium, while the panels of the rear body remain steel to help balance the car. "Quattro" all-wheel-drive is optional on the front-driven 2.0 turbo, while standard on the 3.2 V6 and the RS. Manual gearbox is standard, but a DSG automanual is optional. Features include cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry, alloy wheels and the usual power accessories. As was the case with the previous TT, the new car is built as part of a joint effort, with bodywork and paint done at the German plant in Ingolstadt, and vehicle assembly is completed at Audi's Hungarian plant in Gyor.

The PT Cruiser is Chrysler's unique retro wagon, and it got a makeover inside and out with updated front and rear fascias, a new grille with Chrysler winged badge, new headlights, redesigned taillights, round fog lights and a new discrete spoiler on the tailgate roof. The PT receives an all-new interior to add refinement to the versatility. This new interior includes new seat materials, a new larger three-dial instrument panel colour-coded to the exterior paintwork, and an analogue clock, of all things. The versatile PT has a tall profile that gives it a high seating position and tons of interior space. The interior can be arranged in 32 different seating configurations. This front-driven wagon is powered by either a 2.0-litre or a 2.4-litre engine, with a choice of five-speed manual or an optional four-speed automatic transmission featuring driver-adaptive shift logic along with AutoStick manual gear selection. The PT Cruiser continues to inspire other manufacturers to delve into the retro craze. Too bad the turbo models are not offered here. The standard PT Cruiser sold so slowly here that it was discontinued in the GCC long before it went out of production in America.

The Hyundai Grand i10 comes in both hatchback and sedan body styles. It has a longer wheelbase than the regular i10, therefore interior space is better. Features, either standard or optional, include smart key, engine start button, a rear parking assist system, AUX, IPOD, USB, Bluetooth and audio control buttons on the steering wheel. Only the hatchback model offers Electronic Stability Control and Vehicle Stability Management. A two-tone colour scheme has been applied to the instrument panel and seats. Two engine options will be available, a 3-cylinder 1.0-litre motor and 4-cylinder 1.25-litre unit. Consumers can choose between a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT Roadster, or Mercedes-AMG GT Roadster as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Two variants of the AMG GT Roadster are available as of 2018, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT Roadster gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT C gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT C also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Audi RS 5 is being sold, but probably only on special order. It gets a 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 7-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5.

The Jeep Renegade is the smallest SUV offering from the brand. It gets 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under the hood, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The base 2021 Jeep Renegade Sport model comes in front-wheel-drive format, while the Latitude, Trailhawk and Limited models are all-wheel drive platforms. Standard options in the 2021 Jeep Renegade include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, manual A/C, FM radio with AUX/USB support and alloy wheels. Higher options include automatic A/C, Infotainment system with screen, navigation, automatic A/C and leather seats. Safety features in the 2021 Jeep Renegade include driver and passenger airbags, traction control and vehicle stability control.

The 5th-generation 3-Series convertible was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Carnival, also known as Grand Carnival or Sedona in some markets, is undoubtedly Kia's largest non-commercial vehicle, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. Powered by a 3.8-litre V6, it comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

Hyundai's Genesis G70 is the Korean carmaker's attempt at cracking the entry-level premium sports sedan niche. Starting off with a shortened platform derived from the Kia Stinger, the compact sedan appears to derive a lot from its rivals and brings nothing new to the table, aside from offering a bit more power, based on preliminary reports. The engines on offer include a 2.0-litre turbo four and a 3.3-litre twin-turbo V6, both mated to 8-speed automatics. Features include LED lighting, an 8-inch touch screen, electronic shifter. available 15-speaker Lexicon audio system, Apple CarPlay and a heads-up display. Safety features include the usual set of airbags, ABS, ESP and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as active-driving aids such as adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane-departure warning, etc.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Toyota Hiace has been the market leader for years in the UAE and continues to be a popular choice in the commercial sector, whether for transporting the work-force or cargo. There is only one engine choice in the Hiace, a 2.7-litre four cylinder petrol engine mated to a standard 5-speed manual, while some markets such as UAE occasionally get a 4-speed automatic option. The Saudi market additionally gets a 2.5-litre diesel model with a 5-speed manual. It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

The Cadillac ATS Coupe was released at the end of 2014 for the GCC market. The rear-wheel drive coupe is offered only with the 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, rearview camera, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard, automatic collision preparationmotorized safety belts, electronic park brake, front and rear automatic braking, blind zone alert, rear cross-traffic alert, and front & passenger airbags and curtain airbags.

The Tesla Model X is a fully electric midsize crossover SUV, which combines high performance and zero emission. The available variants from 2018 are 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. All variants come in all-wheel-drive configuration, and with seating for up to seven if optioned up with two booster seats in the boot. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, falcon-wing rear doors, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate, 19-inch alloy wheels, and air suspension. Optional equipment include enhanced autopilot, complete self-driving capability, auto-opening front doors, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system, up to 22-inch alloy wheels, and a towing package including a steel tow bar and a 2-inch hitch receiver. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features include traffic-aware cruise control, auto steer and auto park.

The Sierra 1500 range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado, which sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Sierra 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models.

The Cadillac ATS Coupe was released at the end of 2014 for the GCC market. The rear-wheel drive coupe is offered only with the 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, navigation, magnetic ride control, rearview camera, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard, automatic collision preparation motorised safety belts, electronic park brake, front and rear automatic braking, blind zone alert, rear cross-traffic alert, and front & passenger airbags and curtain airbags.

The V70, based on the S60, is tuned to be a sports wagon, but is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis and weak regional engine choices. The interior is fairly spacious and the luggage area is huge thanks to its upright boxy shape. For the Middle East market, there is a basic 2.4-litre 5-cylinder only for the V70 wagon, although European markets get as many engines as the S60 sedan. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet and Turbo S Cabriolet got a minor facelift in 2017, as well as a slight power upgrade, thanks to modified inlet ports in the cylinder head, new injection nozzles and higher fuel pressure. Fuel economy improves slightly as well for the 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet due to further advanced electronic engine and transmission management with revised gear change mappings. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The second-generation Peugeot 308 went on sale in the GCC in 2015. The same  is turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. This Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street and came out first in 2008, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track.

The Cordoba is designed to appeal to sedan customers who like the Ibiza hatchback. Though similar to the Ibiza, it somehow appears a lot more conservative than the Ibiza, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. It is keeping pace in the market with variations of the original car, by adding new Seat styling features to what is essentially the same car that was launched ages ago. In the Middle East, it is offered with only a VW-derived 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine, with an automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, front power windows, remote central locking, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, CD radio with six speakers, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, height and reach adjustable steering wheel, double headlamps, three-point rear seatbelts and three rear headrests, among others. Stability system with brake assistance is an option, as are rear power windows, alloy wheels and what not.

The 206 is one of Peugeot's more popular models, with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, although new derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet joined the line-up in 2001. There are various petrol engines in the range, although after 2006, the local offerings had decreased. The standard five-door hatchback can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic. The 206 CC coupe-cabriolet can only be had as a 1.6-litre automatic in the later years, although the manual 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre CC models were available here for a few years in between. There is a more powerful 2.0-litre engine with a manual offered in three-door RC hatchback form, which is a true sporting contender. The tuned RC debuted in 2003, replacing the competent GTi 2.0-litre model. All models come with front power windows, a cloth interior, driver's airbag and other basics as standard. Comprehensive safety equipment such as ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, along with passenger front airbag, were all optional. Available features included a CD player, alloy wheels and more.

The Pathfinder is a 4-door, 5-passenger luxury 4WD, and a popular performer. This unit-body shape was introduced in 2000, but got the newer 3.5-litre V6 only in 2002. This model range ran till 2005. A 5-speed manual is standard while a 4-speed automatic transmission with overdrive is optional. The manual-mated V6 is slightly more powerful than the automatic-mated V6.
