The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models.

The compact Actyon looks like nothing else on the road. If there ever was a sporty-looking 4WD, this is it. Too bad its 2.3-litre four-cylinder joke of an engine does not back up its looks. The engine is mated to a manual or an automatic gearbox, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Based on the same platform as other Ssangyong 4WD vehicles, the five-door Actyon can seat up to five people and comes with a host of cabin features, including a liftgate rear end.  Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, electric mirrors, alloy wheels of different sizes, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, whatever that is, while traction control, hill descent control and stability control are all also available.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Facelifted inside and out for 2008, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight, even with the power upgrade for 2008. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

The Renault Duster, a rebadged Dacia, has been designed to suit all types of roads across the world's less-developed countries. This new sub-compact SUV is based on a stretched Nissan Tiida platform, and comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available in either a two-wheel-drive 4-speed automatic form or in an all-wheel-drive 6-speed manual form, the latter capable of locking the diff for a 50:50 front/rear torque split. Interestingly, the 2WD model comes with a torsion-beam rear suspension, while the 4WD model gives up some boot space to make way for an independent rear suspension. The rear seats fold down as standard, and split-folding on all but the base model, while you can transport longer items if the front passenger seat is folded down as well. The basic PE version comes with two-wheel-drive, 4-speed automatic, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth with buttons behind steering wheel, unpainted bumpers, 16-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, folding rear bench seat, power steering and manual a/c. Early models came with one airbag, but by mid-2012, all models had two standard airbags. The higher-spec SE can be had in 2WD automatic or special-order 4WD manual drivetrains, and adds standard fog lamps, trip computer, ABS with Emergency Brake Assist, extra front-passenger airbag, rear power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, painted bumpers, leatherette steering wheel and extra chrome trim. The SE version can be further upgraded with leather seats with additional pyrotechnic pre-tensioners on the front seatbelts as well as side airbags. The exterior package on the SE version also adds standard chrome door mirrors, longitudinal roof rails, front/rear skid plates and side-skirt covers. Extra tinted rear windows, rear quarter glass and rear windscreen round up the list, as is a split-folding rear seat, height adjustable driver's seat and height-adjustable steering wheel. A comprehensive range of accessories,including wind reflectors, side steps, wheel arch mouldings, chrome exhaust trim and mudflaps, is also available.

The American Grand Cherokee was redesigned for the 2005 model year, but the Austrian-built GCC models arrived here only in 2006, packing a 4.7-litre V8 and a 5.7-litre Hemi V8 in this market, both with an automatic gearbox, though both engines offer the same fuel economy. A rare 6.1-litre V8-powered SRT-8 model joined the range for 2007. Cloth upholstery is standard, as are power windows, power locks with remote keyless entry, eight-way power driver's seat, AM/FM/CD audio, driver information center, 60/40 split folding rear seat, and 17-inch wheels. All models offer full-time four-wheel drive, with low-range gearing. Higher models get leather upholstery, Boston Acoustics six-speaker AM/FM stereo with six-CD changer and MP3 capability, power adjustable pedals, power front seats, rain-sensing automatic wipers, electrochromic rearview mirror, tyre pressure monitor with display, adjustable roof rack crossrails, and more. The fancy Overland model adds real wood accents on the doors and console, two-tone leather and ultra-suede seats, leather-covered console and armrest, reverse-parking sensor and more. The rocket-like SRT-8 gets stiff suspension for the road, but gives up its off-road ability. Safety features include a stability system with roll mitigation, ABS brakes with brake assist, traction control, and numerous airbags.

The Audi S3 sedan made its debut in 2015 and is the performance version of the A3. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The 6-speed manual gearbox version is available in some GCC markets on special order. All-wheel drive is standard in the S3. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, sports seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and alloy wheels. Safety standards are high as in all Audi models with features which include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The GAC GS4 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, the front-wheel GS4 gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, fabric seats, halogen lamps, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with USB/AUX/CD support and 6 speakers. The higher models get a sunroof, fog lamps, cruise control, leather seats, xenon headlamps and automatic A/C. Safety features include airbags for front driver and  passenger, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist, traction control, hill assist and hill descent control.

The Q60 Coupe underwent a full redesign in 2017. The base motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, while a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine is available is the more powerful option. Standard features on the 2021 Infiniti Q60 Coupe include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q60's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

The SC 430 switches from luxury hardtop coupe to open roadster at the touch of a button. Dropping the power hardtop turns it into a true convertible, but the SC is far from a sporting vehicle. Its exterior and interior were freshened for 2006. This rear-wheel drive car is powered by a 4.3-litre V8 engine mated to a new six-speed automatic transmission and soft comfort-biased suspension. It comes as one model that features a power retractable hardtop, soft leather with wood and chrome accents, a navigation system and a Mark Levinson audio with nine speakers, 6-CD changer, a/c system that auto-adjusts temperature for top-up and top-down, eight-way power adjustable front seats with memory function, power door mirrors, Bluetooth mobile phone, HID headlamps with adaptive front-lighting system and auto-leveling system, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, front and rear corner sensors, and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include dual front & side airbags, whiplash injury lessening concept seats, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, Vehicle Stability Control, traction control, and a tyre pressure warning system.

Ever so slightly redesigned in 2006, the 350Z is the halo model for the Nissan lineup. It is very fast, looks outrageous and easier on the pocket than a comparable German product. For 2007, the car received an upgraded 3.5-litre V6, with either a manual or an automatic transmission. A new hood design also marks 2007. Features that make the 350Z such a performance bargain are a carbon-fibre driveshaft, drive-by-wire throttle, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution and brake assist and convenience features such as automatic temperature control and a premium stereo. Other standard features on this rear-wheel-drive sports car includes power windows with auto up-down, power door locks, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, vehicle security system, heated outside mirrors, cloth seats with eight-way manual driver and four-way manual passenger adjustments and a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shifter boot. A bunch of airbags and traction control are standard. Navigation and Bluetooth phone are available. The convertible is officially not sold here.

An all-new generation of Honda Accord came for the 2018 model year. The naturally-aspirated engines has been replaced by two 4-cylinder turbocharged motors - a 1.5-litre, mated to CVT and a 2.0-litre connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features on the standard 2018 Honda Accord LX model include power windows, power mirrors, remote engine start, push button start, dual-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, 160-watt audio system with 4 speakers, 7-inch audio display, Bluetooth, USB, LED headlights, LED taillamps, dual exhausts and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 2018 Honda Accord Sport variant gets additional power seats with lumbar support, aluminium sports pedals, paddle shifts, 2-mode drive system (ECO/Sport), LED fog lamps, sunroof, dark chrome front grille, spoiler and 18-inch alloy wheels. The 2018 Honda Accord EX gets additional leather seats, 180-watt audio system with 8 speakers, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and 8-inch audio display. The top 2018 Honda Accord 2.0T Sport gets additional 450-watt audio system with 10 speakers and subwoofer and head-up display. Standard safety features on the 2018 Honda Accord include front,side, curtain and knee airbags (total 8 airbags), ABS, EBD, brake assist, stability control, emergency stop signal, brake booster and tyre pressure monitoring system. The Honda EX and 2.0T Sport get additional Honda Lane Watch and rear-view camera.

The Navara is a stylish work truck, and essentially a pickup version of the Pathfinder. Like the Pathfinder, it offers good hauling capability and marginal on-road handling. It offers decent interior space and more convenience features than most competitors. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with a five-speed automatic and 2WD, or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine with a six-speed manual transmission and 4WD. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloywheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,4-speaker audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signallamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensingwipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment. It is apparently only available in double cab five-seater body style with a long rear load bay.

The Jaguar E-Pace sub-compact crossover slots in under the F-Pace in its lineup. It is based on a front-wheel-drive platform, but comes standard with all-wheel-drive and a choice of two turbocharged 2.0-litre "Ingenium" engines and a 9-speed automatic. A Jaguar Touch Pro infotainment system comes standard with a 10-inch capacitive touchscreen system. It offers 4G connectivity, 8 WiFi hotspots and a bunch of apps. The instrument panel is a 12.3-inch TFT unit which is coupled with a heads-up display. The rear offers 577 litres of space with the seats up. The E-Pace will be available in two flavours, a standard model and the R-Design model. On top of this, three specification packs are offered along with a bunch of options.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD and has been completely overhauled for 2008. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. For the GCC, a 3.0-litre V6 is standard, and it only gets a 4-speed automatic. The 2008 version's carryover V6 was replaced by an upgraded V6 for 2009, with more power and a 6-speed automatic. The Escape also comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, electric power steering, 15-inch steel wheels and CD stereo with iPod jack. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. The Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The Lotus Evora is the British manufacturer's first offering of combining superb race track handling with everyday practicality. There are two models to choose from, the Evora and Evora S. The Evora comes with a Toyota-sourced 3.5-litre V6 engine, whereas the Evora S gets the same engine, but supercharged. Both model engines are mated to either a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual transmission. The mid-engined Evora has a 2+2 configuration, although the back seats can be used for storage purposes than anything else. Standard options include central door locking, flat bottomed magnesium steering wheel trimmed in leather, leather gear knob, leather handbrake sleeve, bespoke aluminium illuminated control knobs and switches, power windows, remote release glove box, door storage bins and integrated cup holders, Alpine CD/MP3/WMA receiver, and Lotus command centre with auxiliary trip computer and vehicle monitoring displays. It comes with standard 18-inch alloy wheels and optional 19-inch/20-inch alloys with wider tyres. Additional packages can be added. The Tech Pack offers Alpine multi-media in car entertainment system with 7" WVGA touch screen, bluetooth connectivity, satellite navigation, tyre pressure monitoring, cruise control, rear parking sensors. The Sport Pack offers switchable sports mode with sharper throttle response, increased rpm limit and sports traction control setting, sports diffuser, titanium sports exhaust tailpipe, cross drilled brake discs, engine oil cooler and black painted brake callipers. The Premium Pack offers accent lighting, upgraded interior trim, centre arm-rest and further extensive use of premium grade leathers. Further options include electric power-fold door mirrors, xenon headlights, Alpine Imprint dynamic audio EQ system , reversing camera and body colour door handles.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The Mercedes-Benz G500 is fitted with 5.5-litre V8 engine and is now been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. In 2017, it got a slight facelift and power upgrade. The SL 63 AMG comes with a turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more. An optional performance package bumps up power by 25 hp, and removes the speed limiter.

The Veracruz is a midsize crossover 4WD that aims for luxury and onroad performance. Hyundai positions the Veracruz as an alternative to luxury crossovers but with a lower price. However, it is still the company's most expensive 4WD model, and base models are pretty bare on safety. The Veracruz is longer and wider than the Santa Fe, and comes standard with three rows of seats for seven passengers on all but the base model. The Veracruz comes in three trim levels here. All are powered by the same 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a six-speed automatic. All models ride on 17-inch wheels, and come standard with all-wheel-drive and ABS with EBD. Basic features include power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, alarm, CD/MP3 with 6 speakers, manual air-conditioning, side steps, and only a single airbag. The mid-level model adds cruise control, faux leather and a power liftgate. The top model adds xenon headlights, power driver seat, sunroof, rain-sensing wipers, six-CD changer and more speakers, dual-zone a/c, stability control, dual airbags, side airbags and curtain airbags. Navigation is optional, but there is no low-range gearing.

An all-new MG 6 came out as a 2019 model. The MG 6 comes as a liftback version. It gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay support and 6 speakers, trip computer. rear parking camera, push start button and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, cruise control, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The Audi RS 5 is being sold, but mostly only on special order. An all-new model came out in 2018. It gets a twin turbocharged 2.9-litre V6 engine with a 8-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5.

The Prado has become a popular choice among people who want a true off-roader but never go off-road. The Prado also shares a bade with the legendary Land Cruiser which makes it more attractive. The latest Land Cruiser Prado is a refined animal, taking advantage of technical and engineering advances that offer reasonably smooth performance on the road and reasonably capable off-roading ability. One look at it reveals rock-solid build quality so obviously missing from competitors from American manufacturers. The Prado is offered with a 2.7-litre four-cylinder, a 4.0-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesel. The petrol engines get Toyota's more modern manual and automatic gearboxes, while the weak diesel gets only a manual. The cabin is spacious and roomy with abundant headroom and legroom. Features of the interior include dual-zone air-conditioning and a CD/cassette audio system with either 4 or 6 speakers, depending on model. The Prado comes with dual front airbags and ABS as standard, with seating for either five or eight people. Side-airbags and stability control are not offered in this aging SUV.

The Mountaineer is supposed to be a more upscale version of the Ford Explorer, and it certainly looks like it from the outside. It shares its structure and most major components with the Explorer, but apparently it shares a lot of the interior as well, thus diminishing brand differences. The Mountaineer is also powered by the Explorer's 4.0-litre V6, mated to a five-speed automatic, but it loses low-range gearing for its four-wheel-drive system The interior theoretically offers seating for up to eight people with three rows of seats, with a third-row seat that can fold flat. Standard interior features include a CD stereo, power windows and mirrors, available CD changer and sunroof, cruise control, available leather upholstery, and standard alloy wheels. The Mountaineer also builds on Ford's strong safety offerings, offering optional AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, ABS brakes, dual front airbags and a tyre-pressure monitoring system, while the Safety Canopy side-curtain airbag system is optional.

The all-new Jaguar XK is the long-awaited successor to Jaguar's sports car franchise, and though its new face is decidedly controversial, it is still a very desirable car. The new-for-2007  XK comes as both a coupe and a convertible. Riding on a much longer wheelbase, the new aluminium-built XK offers substantially more interior space than the old model. The XK 4.2 model is powered by the corporate 4.2-litre V8, while the XKR gets a supercharged version of that engine. Both engines are mated to a six-speed manual gearbox with paddle shifters. Its rigid chassis and the latest CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a 520-watt Alpine sound system with eight speakers. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

The SX4 is Suzuki's compact car offering. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model. For 2013, Suzuki started offering only the all-wheel drive hatchback version. It is fitted with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

The MG 350 is the Chinese-owned brand's attempt to enter into the competitive compact sedan segment. Under  the hood, it gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 350 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, DVD entertainment system, sunroof, rear parking sensor,bluetooth connectivity and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The Juke is a new sub-compact crossover by Nissan, based on the Tiida platform. Powered by a choice of either a 1.6-litre naturally-aspirated or a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, the latter also featuring direct-injection. Available transmissions include a special-order manual or a standard CVT automatic. Unfortunately, only the front-wheel-drive version is offered in the GCC, while an all-wheel-drive version is offered elsewhere. Standard features include cloth upholstery, red or silver painted console, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, power front window, electric mirrors, 60/40 folding rear seats and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher-trim models get a sunroof, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, USB port, fog lamps, automatic a/c, four power windows, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Juke can also be customised with various optional alloy-wheel designs, stickers, decal stripes, roof spoilers and more. Safety features include front airbags, optional side-curtain airbags, ABS disc brakes with EBD, and stability control.

The Fiat 500L Trekking is the only trim level offered here in the GCC. The design is based on the Fiat 500 and the L stands for large. It gets a 4-cylinder 1.4-litre turbocharged unit under the hood, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, central-locking, cruise control, 17-inch alloy wheels, two-tone interior, steering-wheel mounted audio controls, entertainment system with touchscreen and Bluetooth connectivity. Safety standards are high as expected, which include electronic stability control (ESP), traction control, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor, electronic brake-force distribution (EBD) and four-wheel disc antilock brakes with brake assist. Also the 500L gets front and side airbags, along with driver's knee blocker airbag.

An all new Porsche Cayenne Coupe came out in 2020. The variants initially available were the Cayenne Coupe, Cayenne Coupe S and Cayenne Coupe Turbo. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. The Cayenne S gets a new 2.9-litre turbo V6. The Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. In 2021, it was joined by the Cayenne E-Hybrid Coupe, the Cayenne GTS Coupe and the Cayenne Turbo S E-Hybrid Coupe. The GTS gets a 4.0-litre V8 engine, whereas the E-Hybrid is 3.0-litre turbo engine coupled with an electric motor and the Turbo S E-Hybird is V8 turbo engine combined with an electric motor. The interior is pretty much the same as the Cayenee, with a 12.3-inch touchscreen and a few touch-capacitive controls. The interior gets the analog tachometer which comes with two 7-inch color displays on either sides that read out driver information. Rear wheel steering, a Porsche Active Suspension Management system for “finer degree of specific calibration” of the air suspension, a new Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control that uses a 48-volt electrical system and a new semi-autonomous driving tech called Innodrive are a few of the goodies offered. Features available on the Cayenne Coupe include optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch and higher quality audio systems. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

The Abarth 595 Competizione is based on the Fiat 500. The front end was redesigned with a much larger air scoop to improve heat management in the engine compartment and increase cooling capacity by 18%. The extractor is quite pronounced on the rear bumper. To enhance its looks, specific bumper inserts have also been created with the Tar Cold Grey finish on the 595 Competizione. It has polyelliptical headlights and LED daytime running lights as standard equipment. Xenon headlights, on the other hand, are available on request. The standard flat-bottomed steering wheel, as well as other striking interior details, on the Competizione version is made of technical materials, such as carbon and Alcantara. Abarth 595 Competizione is equipped with a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to an Abarth sequential gearbox and fits the new Record Monza Attivo exhaust. The 595 Competizione is equipped with supporting shell-shaped "Abarth Corsa by Sabelt" seats. Braking is secured by a Brembo system with 4-piston aluminium monobloc fixed callipers paired with self-ventilating, perforated 305 mm discs. Koni FSD (Frequency Selective Damping) shock absorbers are standard on both front and rear. The Sport button can be used to adjust various parameters of the car, such as torque delivery and power steering calibration, as well as managing the exhaust. Furthermore, the system adjusts engine response to the accelerator pedal and the TFT instrument panel switches to racing configuration. Safety standards are high with the Abarth 595 equipped with seven airbags as standard equipment. It also gets ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESC), anti-slip regulation (ASR) system, the Hill Holder devices and hydraulic brake assistance (HBA) to help with emergency stops.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2015, the RS 7 got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Tucson is a player in the rare breed of tiny 4WD vehicles that offer little off-road capability, but drive rather well on the road. It comes with either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or, surprisingly, a 2.7-litre V6, with a range of manual or automatic transmissions depending on model. It also comes in either a blasphemous front-wheel-drive version or a more realistic four-wheel-drive version with full-time 4WD. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power outside mirrors, central door locking, roof rack, cloth seats, front fog lamps, rear wiper with washer, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a range of storage spaces, while riding on 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include dual airbags, sunroof, probably faux leather upholstery, two-tone paint job, body-colour outside mirrors, AM/FM CD and cassette player with 4 speakers and tweeters, dual mufflers and a whole lot of cuteness for an affordable amount of cash.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG Coupe gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

An all-new model of the Peugeot 508 came out in 2019. The only engine on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan is a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, which is carried over from the previous model. It is mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. Standard features in the 508 include power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, push engine start, digital instrument cluster, infortainment system with touch screen, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, multifunction steering wheel, and alloy wheels. Higher models get leather seats, ventilated heating and cooling seats and panoramic roof. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. Higher models get blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keeping assist.

The Subaru XV debuted in its current form in 2013. Known also as Crosstrek elsewhere, it is a based on the Impreza platform, but with hatchback styling, raised suspension, and roof rails. While appearing tough, this compact crossover is powered by a small 2.0-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. The standard XV 2.0i comes with the usual power options, cloth upholstery, auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys, cruise control and halogen headlights. The 2.0i-S Premium adds smart keyless entry and start, rear camera, aluminium pedals, dual-zone auto a/c, HID headlights with washers, power-folding mirrors with LED indicators, and a sunroof. Front and side-curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control are standard on all models.

The McLaren 650S is based on the 12C but with 25% new parts. The 650S comes with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

The new-for-2011 Mazda 2 is a facelifted version of the Mazda2 that has been on sale in Europe since 2008. Offered for the first time in the GCC, it comes in sedan and hatchback versions, and competitively priced when compared to its platform-mate, the Ford Fiesta. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloys are optional. The interior can be had in either black or two-tone, with ten exterior colours available. The glove-box lid is a unique two-compartment design, with one compartment exposed on top to keep files and papers in. The seats are cloth-upholstered, and every other piece of cabin trim is hard plastic, with no padded armrests. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The Mazda2 is highly rated in European crash tests, but those safety ratings are based on Euro-spec models with side airbags, not available here.

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. The redesigned 2008 Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track. An optional performance kit was offered in 2009 to boost power by 37 hp.

The Continental GT is the first new model to come out of the Bentley since it separated from Rolls-Royce under VW ownership. The Continental is smaller and less expensive than any past Bentley, but it still remains out of reach for pretty much anyone who doesn't have a seven-figure bank account. It is also their first model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the ill-received VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental coupe is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GT Speed coupe for 2008 adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling. Also introduced in 2009 is the Continental GT Supersports with even more power and capable of running on both petrol and biofuel. The Supersports had a more aggressive exterior, while mechanically it had revised suspension settings to make it more sporty, bigger ceramic brakes and an automatic retractable spoiler.

The Ford Focus ST got a facelift for its 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder EcoBoost engine, mated to a 6-speed manual. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, cruise control with speed limiter, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights and LED tail lamps. The Focus ST hatchback also gets a body kit, Recaro seats, sports suspension and an overboost feature for extra torque when needed. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The Foton View C1 minibus is the Chinese manufacturer's light commercial van offering. It is sold in select GCC countries. Only the 2.2-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine is sold in this region. Standard features include power steering, manual mirrors, manual windows, central locking, fabric seats, manual front and rear A/C, radio with USB and 15-inch steel rims with hubcaps.

A classic if there ever was one in this modern world, the Arnage stands as a symbol of what Bentley once was, before the VW-based Continental came along. Bentley claims an unrivalled heritage thanks to a skill-set handed down through three generations working on the same site, and an ability to tailor cars to precise customer wishes. Every Arnage is built to order, and over half are further modified by Bentley's coachbuilding arm, Bentley Mulliner. Bentley also claims that the Arnage is the culmination of over 80 years continual experience of building Grand Touring Limousines. It is odd though that at least in the last decade, the Arnage, in R, T and RL trims, has remained largely untouched, except for a minor facelift. Bentley also likes to brag about one regular customer, who said that determining the specification of an Arnage is like having your own private car company. An exclusive club for sure, but we have to wonder what they pay for. The impressive 6.8-litre turbo V8 engines are massive and yet they are easily surpassed in power and economy by, of all people, the Americans. Changes in 2007 included a switch from the old 4-speed automatic to a new 6-speed auto, as well as a bump-up in power due to new Mitsubishi turbochargers. The higher-tuned engine is reserved for the sportier T model.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year, and facelifted for 2009. Along with the mildly-changed face, the new variants include the base Quattroporte Automatica, the mid-range Quattroporte S Automatica and the top Quattroporte Sport GT-S. The base engine is the 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 6-speed automatic, while the mid-range S model has a 4.7-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto. The Sport GT-S has an upgraded 4.7-litre V8 and is now the only version with a 6-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. All Quattroporte models have the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The new model has expanded the already-staggering array of interior trim choices to 10 leather colours with 11 piping hues and myriad woods or lacquers from which to choose. Other interior upgrades include new cluster graphics, reshaped seats and a new multifunction wood and leather steering wheel with sporty thumb rests. Standard features include directionally-adaptive bi-xenon headlights heated leather power seats with memory, automatic dual-zone climate control, rear parking sensors and a Bose sound system with hard drive and navigation system. The Quattroporte S adds Brembo brakes and 19-inch wheels. Heating, ventilation and massage functions are optional for front and rear seats. An electronically-controlled Skyhook suspension, standard on the S and optional on the base trim, automatically adjusts to the conditions of the road. The Sport GT-S adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals, as well as a noisier exhaust, uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts.

The Kyron is this Korean carmaker's entry into the hotly-contested traditional soft-roader category, only they do it with a real 4WD using truck underpinnings and low-range gearing. Two adults will have no trouble fitting in either front or second row. Behind them is plenty of room for their luggage too. The bench seat also folds down nearly flat to accommodate big, awkward loads like bicycles. The weak part is the 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. The drive system offers a choice of two-wheel drive, four-wheel high, or four-wheel low. The suspension utilizes double wishbones at the front and a multilink design at the rear. Available electronic aids include ABS, hill descent control, traction control, and brake assist. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags.

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports coupe with a supercharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. The Performance Pack Performance Pack increases power, a revised engine specification and engine management calibration, 308 mm front discs with AP Racing four-piston calipers, upgraded brake pads and hoses, full length Lotus Sport roof scoop, variable slip traction control, launch control, uprated clutch plate and cover. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

An all-new BMW X6 launched as a 2015 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X6 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X6 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

The Civic grew up in 1984, in terms of size as well as image. The larger new model looked very modern for its time, making Civic four-doors and wagons identical to the Accord in wheelbase. A new 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine was offered alongside a 1.3-litre 4-cylinder unit on base models. Transmission choices included 4-speed and 5-speed manuals and a 3-speed automatic. The revamped suspension was a temporary step backwards for Honda, since it didn't have an independent rear setup, like in previous and later Civics. But this offered a space-efficient cabin design while retaining reasonable ride and handling characteristics. The lineup consisted of a hatchback, a sedan, a tall Shuttle wagon, and separately, a new CRX sports coupe. The base models were barren, but higher models had sport seats, reclining rear seats, a rear stabilizer bar and more. The Shuttle wagon was later available with all-wheel drive and a six-speed manual gearbox. Changes  in 1986 included a 4-speed automatic. The top-spec Civic hatchback included a removable glass sunroof, a full-width tail-light panel and colour-keyed front airdam and roof spoiler.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Convertible replaced the 3-series convertible model. It is offered as two variants in the GCC. The 428i features a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 motor. Both are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The new BMW 4 Series Coupe is visibly larger in width and wheelbase than the outgoing BMW 3 Series Coupe. The BMW 4 Series Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and stability control.

This seriously outdated version of the Land Cruiser, updated in 2001, is technically a fullsize pickup, staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The pickup, known as Land Cruiser 75 in some markets, is not as big and brawny as the V8 muscle from Ford, Dodge and Chevrolet/GMC, but it is a tough truck. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both lifted from the Land Cruiser wagon and mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. But no matter how much you pay, you won't get ABS or airbags, but you do get a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, this pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

BMW's American-built 4WD comes in three models in this region, namely the 3.0i with a 6-cylinder engine, the 4.4i with a V8, and the 4.8is with a bigger V8. Debuting in 2000 and receiving a facelift in 2004, the X5 has all-wheel drive without low-range gearing, but does come with ABS and traction control. The 3.0i offers manual and automatic transmissions, but the V8 models only come with an automatic. The automatics do have a manual shift gate, but they are still essentially automatics. Standard on V8s and optional on the 3.0i are load-leveling suspension, leather upholstery, front and rear obstacle detection, and steering-linked xenon headlights. Other available features include adjustable ride-height suspension, heated rear seats, navigation system and sunroof. The X5 is far from an off-roader, but it has built up a reputation for excellent on-road driving dynamics for a 4WD, and has become popular with rich people who like to terrorise other road users with some deft moves. The V8 models drive more like sport wagons rather than any 4WD, though it seems a little pointless when BMW itself has much more capable V8-powered 5-Series wagons in its European stable.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional 4-speed automatic. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are many other comfort and utility features. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

An all-new Nissan Pathfinder was introduced in 2013, when it ditched its body-on-frame chassis and gained some length to compete in the hotly-contested midsize crossover segment. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. The 7-seater Pathfinder is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT and a choice of either front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive in all trim levels. The hybrid model is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.5-litre supercharged engine combined with an electric motor. The all-wheel-drive model gets a selector for choosing 2WD, 4WD or Auto. The base Pathfinder S comes standard with a second-row 60/40-split fold-flat bench seat, a third-row 50/50-split fold-flat reclining bench seat, 18-inch alloys, tri-zone automatic a/c, keyless entry with push-button ignition, power windows, CD/MP3/DVD/HDD audio system with 6 speakers, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth phone, auto headlights, 6 airbags, stability control, tyre-pressure monitor and apparently a standard power liftgate in some markets. The Pathfinder SV adds power-adjustable front seats, 7-inch QVGA colour monitor, rear camera, 20-inch alloy wheels, remote starter, auxiliary audio/video input jack, power windows with front one-touch auto-up/down, front fog lamps, chrome body side trim, welcome lighting, stainless-steel kick plates, speed-sensitive intermittent wipers, illuminated sun-visor mirrors, sunroof, wood-tone trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, leather seats, and a tow hitch receiver with 7-pin trailer tow wiring harness on the rear bumper. The top-spec Pathfinder SL further adds a key-linked memory seat and other settings for individual drivers, side-curtain airbags front and rear, digital compass, 9GB hard drive, 8-inch VGA colour monitor with navigation, Bose audio system with 12 speakers, climate-controlled front seats, and a power-tilt/telescoping steering column. An around-view four-camera parking aid is optional, as is a rear DVD entertainment system with 2 screens. Available accessories include roof rail bars, rear-installing tent and more.

A new-generation Kia Sorento made its debut in 2015. The Sorento is a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension. The available engines for the GCC are a 3.3-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive as well as a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available with cloth or leather upholstery. The Sorento can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, xenon headlamps, LED indicators on the mirrors, seat cooler and warmer in the front, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch or 19-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering, continuing with minor upgrades and a facelift for 2009. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini cues, available as Coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. A 5.2-litre V10 engine, upgraded again for 2009, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type limited slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard. Now officially known as the Gallardo LP560-4, it supercedes all previous versions. The LP560-4 Spyder is heavier and slightly slower. A LP 570-4 Superleggera coupe and LP570-4 Spyder Performante models made its debut later, which are slightly more powerful and weighed lighter. A track-focussed LP 570-4 Trofeo Stradale model was also briefly offered before being cancelled by late 2012. The rear-wheel drive LP 550-2 Coupe was offered by Lamborghini in 2011 as the lowest-priced model in the Gallardo line-up, followed by a Spyder model later on. A special edition LP 560-4 Bicolore was released in 2010 which features a unique two-tone paintjob, black roof and special alloy wheels. Meanwhile, the original LP 560-4 got a facelift for 2013, with triangle-heavy front and rear bumpers to differentiate it from lesser models.

The Lotus Evora is the British manufacturer's first offering of combining superb race track handling with everyday practicality. In 2017, it got power upgrades and a slight facelift. There are two models to choose from, the Evora 400 and Evora Sport 410.The Evora comes with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine in two states of tune, both mated to either a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual transmission. The mid-engined Evora has a 2+2 configuration, although the back seats can be used for storage purposes than anything else. Standard options include central door locking, flat bottomed magnesium steering wheel trimmed in leather, leather gear knob, leather handbrake sleeve, bespoke aluminium illuminated control knobs and switches, power windows, remote release glove box, door storage bins and integrated cup holders, Alpine CD/MP3/WMA receiver, and Lotus command centre with auxiliary trip computer and vehicle monitoring displays. It comes with standard 18-inch alloy wheels and optional 19-inch/20-inch alloys with wider tyres. Additional packages can be added. The Tech Pack offers Alpine multi-media in car entertainment system with 7" WVGA touch screen, bluetooth connectivity, satellite navigation, tyre pressure monitoring, cruise control, rear parking sensors. The Sport Pack offers switchable sports mode with sharper throttle response, increased rpm limit and sports traction control setting, sports diffuser, titanium sports exhaust tailpipe, cross drilled brake discs, engine oil cooler and black painted brake callipers. The Premium Pack offers accent lighting, upgraded interior trim, centre arm-rest and further extensive use of premium grade leathers. Further options include electric power-fold door mirrors, xenon headlights, Alpine Imprint dynamic audio EQ system , reversing camera and body colour door handles.

The Sierra 1500 range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado, which sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Sierra 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. It got a facelift and engine upgrades in 2015. The Navigator's four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features.

Volvo's new-for-2011 S60 sedan redefines the Swedish firm's styling trends yet again. New from the ground up, it again straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level S60 2.0T model comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, as well as three trim levels to choose from, including the top 'Prestige' trim. The top-spec model is the S60 T6 AWD, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, and available only in loaded 'Prestige' trim in certain GCC markets. Later, a T4 base model became available, with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, which is the only version available at some GCC dealerships. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The 'Prestige' model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. A simple silver body kit is optional. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. An R-Design package became available for 2013, which adds unique bumpers, 18-inch alloys, sports suspension and more. A software-based Polestar power upgrade is also offered from 2013 onwards, adding 20-30 hp, depending on the model.

This generation of the G37 Coupe was first offered in 2008. The G coupe uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. The G37 coupe originally had a 5-speed automatic transmission in 2008, while from 2009 onwards it received a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Continental GT is the first new model to come out of the Bentley since it separated from Rolls-Royce under VW ownership. The Continental is smaller and less expensive than any past Bentley, but it still remains out of reach for pretty much anyone who doesn't have a seven-figure bank account. It is also their first model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the ill-received VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental coupe is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GT Speed coupe for 2008 adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling. Also introduced in 2009 is the Continental GT Supersports with even more power and capable of running on both petrol and biofuel. The Supersports had a more aggressive exterior, while mechanically it had revised suspension settings to make it more sporty, bigger ceramic brakes and an automatic retractable spoiler.

The Maserati Ghibli was revived by Fiat as a 2014 model and is intended to compete in the luxury midsize segment which is dominated by the Germans. The rear-wheel drive Ghibli gets two 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engines in different states of tune. Both versions get an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2015, the Ghibli S was also available with all-wheel-drive. Standard options include power windows, electric mirrors, power steering, cruise control, leather seats, infotainment screen with navigation, parking sensors, reverse camera and 19-inch alloy rims. The higher models get a better audio entertainment system, 20-inch alloys and all sorts of cabin trim choices. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The S2000 is a small two-seat roadster that can easily chase the likes of the snobby Porsche Boxster. It is a technological innovation from Honda, whose aim with this car was to pump as much horsepower out of a small 2.0-litre engine as possible, without any turbo or supercharging trickery. The S2000 is said to drive like a superbike, because big horsepower from small displacement with a narrow powerband and extremely high rpm produces a very frantic experience. Driving it slowly, shifting the manual at low rpm apparently results in very weak performance in traffic. The latest model has refinements to the engine and suspension put in place back in 2005. Changes to the S2000 in 2006 include more shoulder and elbow room, and some tweaks, most notably 17-inch wheels, drive-by-wire throttle, stability control and new headlights with a triple-beam design. Early models had a plastic rear window, while 2002-plus models get a glass one. The last external facelift was in 2004. Interior features are basic, but include leather upholstery, electric power steering, starter button, power windows, power mirrors, remote central locking, air-conditioning and a pathetic radio cassette stereo with 2 speakers.

The Jaguar XE is the smallest car offering from the British brand. The XE is offered with two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. The turbocharged engine is offered in two different tunes. All models get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options in the XE include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, dual-zone AC, smart key system with keyless start, 8-inch display screen, 6 speakers, cloth seasts, paddle shifters and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher option models get leather seats, sunroof, ventilated seats, xenon headlights, adaptive cruise control, head-up display, bodykit, and 18 to 19-inch rims. Safety features include All Surface Progress Control (ASPC), Torque Vectoring by Braking (TVbB), ABS, dynamic stability control (DSC), lane departure warning, closing vehicle sensing, autonomous emergency braking, driver and passenger front and side airbags.

The Renault Twizy is designed as an "ultramobile" and is just 2.34 metres long, 1.24 metres wide and 1.45 metres tall. It is available in only four colours blue, white, red and black -- from which customers can choose many styling combinations. Different stickers can also be added to the doors and rims. We're classifying it as a mini-hatchback, but the truth is this four-wheeled 2-seater is hard to categorise. The passenger sits behind the driver, crammed in somehow. The Twizy's electric motor can run up to 85 km on a single charge. The lithium-ion batteries takes about 3.5 hours to charge completely using a 220-240v powerpoint. For safety, the Twizy comes with a 4-point seatbelt and a steering-wheel airbag. It is equipped with disc brakes as well and an optional rear-parking aid.

The VW Polo recently received a fresh redesign and upgraded equipment. The Polo, though simply a sub-compact hatchback, has a more upmarket feel, thanks to judicious use of materials. High quality interiors are synonymous with Volkswagen, and the high quality plastics and fabrics found in the Polo is no exception. Standard equipment includes a CD stereo system, along with power windows and other electricals. Sadly, the only available powerplant in the Polo is the 1.4-litre four-cylinder unit. Available with a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic gearbox, this engine kills the upscale illusion. The new Polo includes standard safety systems such as ABS brakes, Hydraulic Brake Assist, and dual front airbags. Side airbags, a curtain airbag system and Electronic Stabilisation Programme are optional. The Polo also has high levels of torsional rigidity, leading to improved crash performance, impressive refinement and driving dynamics.

An all-new Ford Figo came out as a 2016 model year. It is now available as a 4-door sedan and a 5-door hatchback and features a new exterior design. Under the hood are two 4-cylinder engine options; a 1.2-litre unit mated to a 5-speed manual transmission and a 1.5-litre motor mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente and Trend trims, both getting cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include manual windows, power mirrors, 2-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, soft-touch dashboard and a manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 14-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, fog lamps, ABS brakes, front power windows and height-adjustable driver's seat.

As evolutionary developments of the America's most popular minivan, the latest model features a more square design, optional power operation of the sliding side doors, dual front airbags, a power rear liftgate and revised interiors that are quieter, nicer and more comfortable. The new Grand Voyager comes with a 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic. It also features Stow 'n' Go rear seats, giving the ability to easily fold the second and third-row seats into the floor in as little as 30 seconds with a simple one-hand operation. More options include a rear-seat audio system, traction control, parking sensors, side-curtain airbags, a tyre-pressure warning system, electronically adjustable pedals and a rear-seat DVD entertainment. Chrysler minivans, in various shapes and names, are best sellers in the United States, but failed to make any headway in this region because minivans are not popular here.

The Mercedes-Benz GLA-Class is a compact crossover offering. It is powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive 6.2-litre V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lambo to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. Introduced in 2002, the Roadster came in 2004, while production ended by 2006, to be replaced by the Murcielago LP640 coupe model with a larger 6.5-litre V12. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops. The rear air intakes and spoiler are adjusted automatically, depending on speed, to improve aerodynamics.
