In fact, all versions come with an "Eco Assist" feature that provides feedback to the driver to promote more efficient driving styles. Standard features on all trims include cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, keyless entry, body-coloured exterior trim, manual a/c, power windows and electric mirrors. The base LXi model specifically gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and a 2-speaker stereo. The mid-range EXi model gets a 6-speaker stereo with USB port and steering-wheel audio controls, cruise control, Bluetooth phone, 60/40 split-folding rear seat and an LCD info display with rear-view camera, and 16-inch alloy wheels, while fog lamps and a sunroof are extra-cost options. The top VTi version gets everything as well as an automatic single-zone a/c and optional leather upholstery. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS, active headrests and stability control, while only the VTi gets side and curtain airbags.

The Tiguan is VW's new "crossover" 4WD model. Small in size and conservative in design, the Tiguan is being embarrassingly marketed as the "GTI of SUVs" in some places. Three different trim levels include the Trend&Fun, the Sport&Style and the Track&Field, the latter of which is supposedly tuned for offroading, given its underbody plates and higher front bumper, though there is no low-range gearing for the 4Motion all-wheel-drive vehicle. There are two turbocharged engines, both 2.0-litre and in different states of tune. The engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic that can hold gears in offroad conditions, later replaced by a 7-speed DSG automanual in 2011. The Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. For additional cargo area, there is also an optional double-floor trunk-floor setup, including a cargo management system. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parellel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera.

The Juke is a new sub-compact crossover by Nissan, based on the Tiida platform. It got a facelift in 2015. Powered by a choice of either a 1.6-litre naturally-aspirated or a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, the latter also featuring direct-injection. Available transmissions include a special-order manual or a standard CVT automatic. Unfortunately, only the front-wheel-drive version is offered in the GCC, while an all-wheel-drive version is offered elsewhere. Standard features include cloth upholstery, red or silver painted console, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, power front window, electric mirrors, 60/40 folding rear seats and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher-trim models get a sunroof, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, USB port, fog lamps, automatic a/c, four power windows, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Juke can also be customised with various optional alloy-wheel designs, stickers, decal stripes, roof spoilers and more. Safety features include front airbags, optional side-curtain airbags, ABS disc brakes with EBD, and stability control.

The Ferrari F8 Spider replaced the 488 Spider in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Peugeot 5008 started life as a minivan, but has been reinvented as a 7-seater crossover SUV for 2018. In 2022, the 5008 received a facelift and interior upgrades. Basically an extended version of the Peugeot 3008, the 5008 is powered by the same 1.6-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. Standard features in the 2022 Peugeot 5008 Active include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, 12.3-inch digital cluster, 8-inch capacitive touchscreen, mirror screen with Apple CarPlay, front & rear Sensors & 180-degree rear view camera, leather steering wheel, keyless entry & engine push start, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Further available features on the 2022 Peugeot 5008 GT include a 10-inch touch screen, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Android Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof, adaptive cruise control, navigation and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features on the 2022 Peugeot 5008 include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist, as well as options such as lane-departure warning, collision alert, hill-descent control and more.

The Lexus CT 200h is the first hybrid in the small-car segment to debut in the GCC. This premium hatchback comes only in front-wheel-drive hybrid form, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a self-charging electric motor and a CVT automatic. The platform has its roots in Toyota models, but the suspension is fully independent, MacPherson-strut front and double-wishbone rear. Standard features include an info display to show battery usage, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with cloth upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, parking sensors, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, split-folding rear seat, sunroof, LED side and tail lamps, LED front driving lamps, fog lamps and alarm. The top trim additionally gets leather upholstery, wood trim, power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, front seat heaters, navigation system with flip-up 7-inch LCD screen, rear camera, Bluetooth, auto-levelling LED headlights, rain-sensing wipers, sport front bumper, and a 10-speaker audio system. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist. An F-Sport version with a body kit was introduced in 2012.

Completely redesigned for the 2008 model year, the Cherokee is tougher than most compact 4WDs. Also known as the Liberty in some markets, it seats five people and can carry their gear too. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it is mated to a 4-speed automatic. Fold the rear seats and it can move two people and their cargo. The entry-level Sport has a body-coloured grille, while the upscale Limited has a chrome grille. Turn off the pavement, and it can negotiate most trails with confidence. All models come with stability control, ABS brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, front airbags, available side airbags, and all-speed traction control. Standard on all models is a full-time four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. Available features also include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, CD stereo, cruise control, parking sensors, rain-sensing wipers, 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, and a cloth or faux-leather interior, among other items. Options include a trick roof that can open the full length of the ceiling to the elements. By 2010, a minor update included the addition of the optional excellent voice-controlled UConnect multimedia-communications computer, with integrates navigation, Bluetooth, hard drive and USB-ready CD stereo in one touchscreen unit.

An all-new Hyundai Genesis sedan debuts in early 2014 as a 2015 model year. It is slightly longer and taller than the previous generation. The Genesis can be had with a choice of either a 3.8-litre V6 or 5.0-litre V8. Both engines are mated to a Hyundai-designed 8-speed automatic transmission. Rear-wheel-drive is standard in both models. An "Intelligent Drive Mode" system offers Normal, Eco, Sport and Snow settings that alter transmission mapping, throttle responsiveness, stability control to suit driving conditions. The Genesis V8 can be optioned with an adaptive damping suspension that promises both sportier roadholding and a cushier ride. It, too, can be controlled by Intelligent Drive Mode.  The Genesis 3.8 is fitted as standard with leather upholstery, 12-way power-adjustable front seats, a navigation system with an 8.0-inch screen, a seven-speaker AM/FM/CD radio stereo with AUX and USB input jacks, auto on/off headlight, LED headlight accents, LED taillights, rain-sensing windshield wipers, automatic climate control, Bluetooth connectivity, cruise control, hands-free trunk opening capability, a 4.3-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display and 18-inch alloy wheels. To those features, the Genesis 5.0 adds or substitutes a Lexicon Discrete Logic 7 surround sound system with 14 speakers, premium leather upholstery, genuine matte wood trim, 16-way power adjustable front seats, HID headlights with auto-leveling, high-beam assist, LED fog lights, a rear-view camera, front and rear parking sensors, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection with rear cross traffic alert and lane change assist, lane departure warning system with lane keep assist, a 7.0-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display, manual rear side window sunshades, a power rear sunshade, memory functionality for power driver's seat and outside mirrors and steering column, adaptive cruise control and 19-inch alloy wheels. Much of the 5.0's features can be added to the 3.8 in the form of optional extras. All Genesis models come with dual front, front side, rear side and full-length side curtain airbags in addition to a driver's knee airbag and traction and stability control systems. Optional equipment includes an automatic emergency braking system that applies the brakes if it detects an impending collision; a blind spot warning system with a rear cross traffic alert system that warns the driver of approaching traffic in backup situations; a lane departure warning system with lane keep assist setup that warns the driver if the Genesis begins to wander into an adjacent lane and provides slight steering corrections to bring the sedan back on course; and an emergency steering support mode that automatically changes the setting of suspension and electronic stability control in the direction suitable for emergency steering, to help avoid frontal crash situations.

Ford brought back the Bronco name in the lineup, releasing a new model for 2021. The proper off-road SUV will have two Ecoboost engine options - a 2.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a 2.7-litre turbocharged V6 engine, both mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission or 7-speed manual.

The Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, and has been mildly facelifted for 2014. In 2017, the major change was the new V6 engine and no manual option was available. In 2018, everything was pretty much the same. In 2019, the Patrol got a host of new accessories which include fender flares, front and rear diffusers and different roof rails. In 2020, it got a major facelift for the front and back, along with major interior tech upgrades and new exterior colour choices. Engine options for the 2021 Nissan Patrol include a base 4.0-litre V6 with a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol XE or SE, as well as a 5.6-litre V8 with direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic body motion control system for the suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, infotainment with touchscreen, Apple Carplay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top Platinum "City" trim gets a slightly-lower unique bumper. Safety features in the 2021 Nissan Patrol include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The latest Astra is a competitive five-door hatchback from General Motors' German division, with a decent-sized wheelbase that aims for comfort and space. The Astra received an unnoticeable facelift for 2007 that now adds a chrome crossbar on the radiator grille, and black roof trim strips and bumper guards. It comes with a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine for the Middle East market, mated specifically to a four-speed automatic transmission driving the  front wheels. Features include power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, 60/40 split-folding rear seat back, keyless entry, power steering, CD stereo, trip computer and alloy wheels. The Astra comes with a standard tyre repair kit instead of a spare tyre to improve luggage volume, which expands when the rear seat backs are folded down. Safety features include front airbags, front-side airbags, ABS brakes with emergency brake assist, and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro was launched in 2016. It remains unchanged for the 2017 model year. Under the hood, it gets two engine options - a 3.6-litre V6 and a 6.2-litre V8 engine. The Camaro also has a  4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, but it is not sold in the GCC. They can all be had with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof, leather seats and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. In 2017, the convertible joined the lineup. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. In 2021, the Mini Cooper got a facelift, along with new features inside such as a 8.8-inch touchscreen as standard. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera. In 2021, a special Paddy Hopkirk edition was available, a model inspired by their 1964 Monte Carlo rally wins, and features the number 37 livery, a body finished in red, alongside a contrast white roof.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S Cabriolet made its debut in 2014. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. There is no more manual transmission. Standard features on the 2016 911 Turbo Cabriolet include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the 2016 Turbo S Cabriolet, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The 2017 Ford Tourneo Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying passengers. It can seat up to 8 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2017 Ford Tourneo Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 4 speakers,  SYNC, 3.5-multifunctional display, Bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, manual A/C, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2017 Ford Tourneo Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

European motorcycle-maker KTM, introduced their first ever car with the X-Bow. KTM basically transferred its principles from two wheels to four, with a track-biased car that can be driven on the street. But KTM developers have kept the weight of the vehicle extremely light by removing everything that is not needed, including body panels, doors and a windshield. Parts of the suspension are intentionally visible. Built on a carbon-fibre chassis, a 'crash box' in the front nose absorbs collision energy, while roll bars are integrated into the structure, which is all good considering there are no airbags. An options kit is available on request which includes having additional struts mounted at designated points. The Audi-sourced 4-cylinder FSI turbo engine is made of aluminium and mated to a 6-speed manual. In 2016, it got a power upgrade and removed the DSG transmission option, and called itself the X-Bow GT. Brembo brakes, a limited-slip differential, and four-point seat-belts round out the standard package. There are no electronic driving aids, no power steering and no roof, although a cloth tarpaulin is available to cover the interior when not in use.

The SQ 5 is the top performance version of the Q5 compact SUV. An all-new model came out in 2018. Under the hood, it comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. The four-wheel-drive model gets standard features like power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, Nappa leather interior, cruise control, keyless entry and start, auto headlamps, auto headlight range adjustment, fog lamps, xenon headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, navigation, panoramic glass roof, 3-zone automatic A/C, Bluetooth, Bang & Olufsen sound system, front and rear parking sensors and 21-inch ally wheels. Optional equipment include electric front seats with memory function, electric folding mirrors with heated and memory, side steps, adaptive cruise control, adaptive lights, red brake callipers, dynamic steering, more leather padding and sports seats. Safety features include front, side and head airbags, traction control, brake assist and stability control.

The C 63 AMG model is the sports model of the C-Class range. For 2012, a new coupe model was introduced for the first time alongside the sedan. The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG comes with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. The centre console comes with an electronic rotary switch for selecting the four transmission modes and the race start function. The sports seats are optionally available in single-tone or two-tone designo leather. A limited-edition C 63 AMG Coupe Black Series was briefly offered in 2012, with a higher-tuned engine, track-ready suspension, aggressive body kit and no speed limiter. In 2013, a special "Edition 507" version was offered with an uprated engine, identified by its black wheels and badges, with only 10 hp less than the aggressive Black Series and a higher-speed limiter. The C 63 AMG comes with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags.

The Audi Q7 is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 has two 3.0-litre supercharged V6 "TFSI" engines at different states of tune, although the marketeers like to give only the more powerful one the "supercharged" label. There is a 4.2-litre turbodiesel V8 and a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V12 "TDI" engine available for order as well, for whatever reason. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. The new engines came in 2011, but visual changes to the Audi Q7 came in 2010, including new LED headlights and indicators, LED taillights, a chromed front grille, new bumpers, new instrument cluster, ambient lighting and new cabin trim choices, along with new paint colours. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The Indica is an outdated hatchback launched in India back in 1998, spawning variants such as the Indigo sedan and the Indigo Marina station wagon. They went on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica and Indigo were considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger cars. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

Big and conservative, the Kia Mohave is supposed to strengthen Kia's "family" SUV line-up and brand image in the world market. With a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated with the 6-speed automatic transmission, the Kia Mohave is characterized by fully-independent air suspension and its various safety systems, including the ABS brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), brake assist, stability control, traction control, and front and side airbags. Furthermore, the Mohave is equipped with Downhill Assist Control, keeping the vehicle's speed steady while going down straight and strong slopes, while a Hill-Start Assist Control is also available. The Mohave comes with a 600W stereo with six-CD changer, seven-seater capability, cloth or leather trim, DVD player, reverse camera and all the usual power accessories. The Mohave rides on a  truck-like body-on-frame platform and comes with four-wheel-drive and low-range gearing, which allows it to be classified as an off-road vehicle by default.

The Renault Dokker Van is a light commercial vehicle made in Morocco. It comes with one engine option in the GCC, which is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. The panel van version has a luggage capacity of 3,300 litres and a maximum load length of 1.90 metres, thanks to the foldable front passenger seat, that can also be tipped forward against the glove box to free up space for a load length of up to 2.42 metres. If the front seat is removed altogether it provides a carrying capacity of 3,900 litres and a maximum load length of up to 3.11 metres. The payload capacity is 750 kg. It can be equipped with the Media Nav system, that combines navigation and audio functions, featuring Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and auxiliary USB and jack sockets. phone wirelessly and directly onto the Dokker Van's music system. 8 mobile phone devices can be connected to the Bluetooth enabled Media Nav with phonebook and call history.Wooden flooring and interior panelling in the cargo area are amongst the various accessories available. The wood protection kits are designed to protect the Dokker Van's rear loading space and are made from marine-quality plywood with non-slip treatment. Storage bin kit is another wooden accessory to arrange and store tools and is the perfect complement to a full wooden protection kit.Accessorized high-strength grilles for the rear window protect goods against theft and deter vehicle break-ins. Accessories in the range also include transverse roof bars, textile carpet mats, volume and perimeter alarm with or without remote control, and 15-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features in the Dokker include ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), and one driver side front airbag.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. The Dzire is the sedan version of the Swift hatchback, boasting a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, it is mated to an automated-manual "AGS" gearbox. Features include a CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, tilt-adjustable steering wheel with audio controls, Bluetooth, 14-inch steel wheels and front/rear fog lamps on the base GL trim. The GLX trim additionally gets 15-inch alloy wheels, driver-seat height adjuster, smart key with starter button, and rear parking sensors. Safety features includes front airbags, ESP, ABS with EBD and tyre-pressure monitor..

The Mondeo is a midsize front-wheel-drive built in Europe that is based on a Mazda platform. It loses out to the Japanese with a combination of engines that lag behind in power, its smaller size and its expensive dealer maintenance charges. The Mondeo actually a good family sedan, but its image is also diluted due to fleet sales as taxis. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for a very affordable price. The interior is fairly attractive and put together well. The Mondeo does have a sizeable interior for its size. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, available with either a manual or an automatic transmission. A 2.5-litre V6 engine is coupled with a five-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. The sporty Mondeo ST220, a great car, is powered by a 3.0-litre V6 engine and a six-speed manual transmission. The Mondeo can also be had as a wagon.

Acura made its entry into the Middle East market in 2015. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura TLX is their midsize luxury sedan offering. Under the hood, two engines are on offer - a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.5-litre V6 unit. The 4-cylinder engine is mated to a 8-speed automatic, while the V6 gets a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the TLX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, smart keyless entry, sunroof, auto-headlight system, LED daytime running lights, engine start-stop button, cruise control, power seats with lumbar support, dual-zone automatic A/C, entertainment system with AM/FM radio/CD/AUX/HDMI support, navigation, speakers & sub-woofer, hands-free telephone with voice recognition, heated & ventilated front seats, front & rear parking sensors, and rearview camera. The higher model gets push-button shifter, adaptive cruise control, and front & rear smart keyless entry. Standard safety features on the TLX include front, side curtain & knee airbags, all-wheel steering, ABS, agile handle assist (AGH), blind spot indicator, vehicle stability assist (VSA) and hill-start assist. The higher model gets lane-keeping assist system, crash mitigation brake system, forward collision warning system, road departure mitigation system and low speed following system.

The Renault Captur is a small SUV offering from the French brand. Under the hood, the Spanish-made Captur gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. A lot of customisation can be done on the car's bodywork, interior trim and upholstery. Standard features on the front-wheel drive Captur include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, fabric seats, radio with MP3/AUX/CD player support, USB, Blutetooth, manual A/C, alloy rims, LED daytime lights, tire pressure monitoring system, push button start, central locking & keyless entry. Top model features include navigation, rear view camera, 17-inch 2-tone alloy wheels, parking sensors, automatic A/C, power folding mirrors, 2-tone body color and removable seat covers. Standard safety features include front and passenger airbags, ABS and ESP.

The Volkswagen Polo Sedan is powered by a 1.6-litre four cylinder engine mated to a six-speed automatic transmission. The front fascia of the Polo Sedan has the distinct look of all new Volkswagen models, with fog lamps and 15-inch alloys coming as standard. For the 2016 model year, it got a very minor facelift. The Polo sedan is slightly longer than the European hatchback model, thereby offering more rear legroom for passengers. Standard features include electrically adjustable side mirrors, electric remote unlocking for the boot lid and central locking. Parking sensors and automatic air-conditioning are optional extras. A radio with a CD/MP3 player is included in the base model. You get leather wrapped around the steering wheel and gear knob. Volkswagen offers ABS and dual airbags as standard on the Polo sedan.

The sixth generation BMW 5-series received a facelift for the 2014 model year. The 520i gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and 8-speed auto. The 535i has a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 528i model gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. The 550i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto has been upgraded with more power and torque. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Clubman is an extension of the Mini ethos, to provide more cabin space while maintaining its excellent handling. It remains one of the smallest cars on the road and and it still seats four. But conventional design standards, it has to be called a three-door, but with two front doors, one half-door on the right side, and two barnyard doors to access the cargo compartment, it offers the weirdest definition of a five-door hatchback. The back seats remain tight, but it can carry more cargo. Engineered by BMW, the Mini was been given a major overhaul in styling, and the new-for-2008 Clubman follows a similar look. Models include the Cooper and the turbocharged Cooper S. The Cooper got an upgraded 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine for 2010, while the S adds a turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, along with a number of airbags. A Sport package offers stability control, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The Q45 is Infiniti's unloved flagship fullsize sedan, available in a single trim line. It uses a 4.5-litre V8 and five-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include 18-inch chrome-finish alloy wheels, power mirrors with memory, puddle lights and driver's side auto-dimming, seriously cool seven-lens Xenon headlights, fully automatic trunk open and close function, performance-tuned active dampening suspension; tyre pressure monitoring system, dual-zone climate control; DVD-based navigation system with seven-inch LCD screen and rearview monitor; heated and cooled front seats with ten-way driver and eight-way passenger adjust, heated rear seats, six-CD/cassette Bose system with eight speakers, voice recognition system, power rear and manual rear door window sunshades, and laser-based intelligent cruise control with preview braking feature, whatever that is. Safety features include numerous front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control, among other things.

The Renault Laguna Coupe is a French-built 2-door that comes with a Nissan-developed 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. Featuring a unique design, one of the best features of the Laguna Coupe is its four-wheel steering, or 4-control as they like to call it, which turns the rear wheels slightly along with the front for better cornering ability. Basic features include leather seats, Bose stereo system, alloy wheels, hands-free key card, auto headlamps and auto wipers. Safety features include six airbags, ABS and electronic stability control.

The Mazda CX-5 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Inside, the 5-seater cabin offers features such as a 4:2:4 three-way split-folding rear seat. As far as the upholstery goes, leather and two kinds of fabric are available for the seats and trim in two colours. The soft-touch material adopted for the majority of dash surfaces and door trim is offset by a central panel featuring glossy piano-black treatment. Engine specs include a direct-injection 2.0-litre "SKYACTIV-G" 4-cylinder that has a 13:1 compression for more torque, better fuel economy and lower emissions, although slightly detuned compared to the motors offered in Western countries. The engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There also a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine which offers more power. There is front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive available for the 2.0, but the 2.5 only comes with all-wheel-drive. Each engine variant has two trim levels. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top 2.5-litre version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. An all-new model came out in 2020. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The 911 is Porsche's original legendary rear-engined sports car, produced in coupe, cabriolet and glass-roofed targa body styles based on model, and with numerous flat-six engines and drivetrains. The 911 first went into production in 1964, and now includes the rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2, GT3, and GT3 RS models, and the all-wheel-drive Carrera 4, Carrera 4S and Turbo models. The top GT2 model was added later. All use Porsche's flat six-cylinder engine in various states of tune. The Carrera 2 and Carrera 4 models use a 3.6-litre with either a manual or a tiptronic gearbox. The Carerra 4S uses a 3.8-litre, with a choice of manual or tiptronic. The race-tuned GT3 and GT3 RS are the lightest cars in the range, and use a modified high-output version of the 3.6-litre engine, with only a manual gearbox. The all-wheel-drive 911 Turbo supercar uses a turbocharged version of the 3.6-litre engine. The lightened rear-wheel-drive GT2 uses an upgraded version of the turbo motor. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and a full set of airbags. Both the GT3 and 911 Turbo is fitted with an Active Suspension Management system, while the Turbo has an optional Sports Chrono Package that temporarily boosts turbocharger pressure for up to 10 seconds by 2.9 psi, increasing torque.

The Ford Ecosport is a new addition to the American brand's increasingly international line-up. Built in several countries around the world, this little crossover comes from India for the GCC market. The standard engine is a simple 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic gearbox, and it only comes in front-wheel-drive form with SUV-like ground clearance. Measuring only a little more than a sub-compact hatchback in length, the Ecosport seats five, with a small boot behind the sideways-opening tailgate. Standard features on the base Ambiente trim include a 2-way manual-adjustable driver's seat, 60:40-split folding rear seat, electric power steering, front-disc rear-drum brakes, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, power windows, front floor mats, adjustable steering column, rear wiper, rear fog lamp, cooled glovebox, basic keyless entry, and 15-inch steel wheels with covers or optional 16-inch alloys. The mid-range Trend trim adds a 4-way manual-adjustable driver's seat, additional storage spaces, 6-speaker stereo, voice-activated SYNC multimedia system, USB port, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, one-touch function on power windows, standard 16-inch alloys, body-colour trim, light-coloured grille, front fog lamps, roof rack, and cruise control with the optional automatic transmission. The top Titanium model additionally gets a lumbar-adjustable driver's seat with armrest, standard automatic gearbox, unique 16-inch alloys, Bluetooth, extra map lights, climate control, rain-sensing front wipers, auto headlights, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra power-point in the boot, rear floor mats, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, silver roof rack, trip computer, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and a seatbelt warning for front passengers, with optional features such as leather upholstery and soft-touch door armrests. All versions get dual front airbags, ABS, stability control and engine immobiliser, with the Trend and Titanium further getting side and curtain airbags as well as a perimeter alarm. Optional accessories include roof-rack crossbars, spare wheel cover, metal pedal covers, carpeted floor mats, rear spoiler, mud guards and more.

The Volkswagen Polo Sedan is powered by a 1.6-litre four cylinder engine mated to a six-speed automatic transmission. The front fascia of the Polo Sedan has the distinct look of all new Volkswagen models, with fog lamps and 15-inch alloys coming as standard. The Polo sedan is slightly longer than the European hatchback model, thereby offering more rear legroom for passengers. Standard features include electrically adjustable side mirrors, electric remote unlocking for the boot lid and central locking. Parking sensors and automatic air-conditioning are optional extras. A radio with a CD/MP3 player is included in the base model. You get leather wrapped around the steering wheel and gear knob. Volkswagen offers ABS and dual airbags as standard on the Polo sedan.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

The Ford Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. It got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The engine range for the 2020 Ford Ranger includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features in the 2020 Ford Ranger include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ford Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts. In 2020, the WidTrak got new safety features such lane keeping assist, lane departure warning, blind spot warning and adaptive cruise control.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This "compact" pickup has grown substantially for 2013, larger in every dimension, with more cabin and cargo room. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form now in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more. A D-Max GT model was launched in 2014, with the 3.0-litre engine, bumper-skirts, racing stripes, optional 17-inch grey alloys, red-black seats, bedliner and stereo choices.

PGO proclaims itself to be a 'French automobile craftsman' to highlight their hand-crafted aspect and small-scale production. The CÃ©vennes got slight facelift and improvements in 2013. Both share the same technical foundation and differ only in style, with the CÃ©vennes looking more modern with restyled bumpers and trim. Indeed, the overall styling is still based on the 1950s Porsche 356. However, it is powered by a recent 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Peugeot engine, with no additional tuning. The rear-mounted motor is mated to a rear-wheel-drive platform and a choice of 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. While the car is very basic and very expensive, customisation options offer 15 paintjobs, 8 soft-top colours, 14 types of leather and 10 types of carpet. Standard features include a basic a/c, power windows, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with 2 speakers, keyless entry, electric mirrors, black manual soft top and a set of eight instrumentation gauges. Options include chrome wheels, two-tone leather, CD changer, alarm and more.

The Lumina remains the only rear-wheel-drive sedan in the affordable midsize segment. The available 3.6-litre V6 and 6.0-litre V8 motors offer value no one can match. Built in Australia alongside the Caprice, it is brand new from the ground up, and comes in four-door trim only. The Lumina comes in four variants, namely the LS, LTZ, S and SS. The power for the LS, LTZ and body-kitted S comes from the Alloytec 3.6-litre V6 engine with an automatic transmission. The 6.0-litre V8 does its work in the SS sedan with either a 6-speed manual or new 6-speed automatic that replaced the old 4-speed automatic since 2008. The base LS and LTZ models fulfil the basic needs of a commuter car that doubles as a family vehicle, with decent space and adequate power, while the SS models merge muscle-car attitude with a traditional sedan. Available features, standard or optional depending on model, include an MP3-capable CD stereo, CD changer, stability control, ABS brakes, traction control, 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, comfort or sports suspension, trip computer, Bluetooth, cloth or leather upholstery, and various power features.

The undeniable mascot of the VW range, the car popularly known as the New Beetle isn't that new anymore, but still a weird head-turning cruiser. Launched in 1999, it hass received a few facelifts over the years, but is still essentially the same. Passengers must make some concessions for retro style. Interior ergonomics are not as good as that in a traditional car, and there isn't a lot of trunk space. But the Beetle does come in an assortment of bright colours, including sunflowery yellow and limey green. Its exterior and interior design details are fun and creative, but very much on the feminine side. On the road, the Beetle is smooth and handles fairly okay. The convertible adds to the fun with its ability to drop the top. But the New Beetle hardly offers blistering performance, with a choice of 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre four-cylinder engines, with either a manual or an automatic. All Beetles are well equipped, with an AM/FM/cassette stereo, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual airbags, power exterior mirrors and windows, among others. Options include a CD changer and electronic stability control.

The Azera is Hyundai's attempt at the high end executive car market, occupied by only a handful of models which combine luxury with a affordable price. The Azera actually offers a lot more for its price than its Japanese and American competitors however, and this 3.3-litre V6-powered automatic sedan is an impressive effort on Hyundai's part. A 2.7-litre V6 joined the range later. A minor frontal facelift added a larger grille in 2010. Standard features on the base model include just a single airbag for the driver, power steering, power windows, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD and MP3 capability and six speakers, cruise control, dual zone fully automatic air conditioning, dual exhaust system, power mirrors, trip computer, illuminated sun visors with vanity mirrors, rear centre armrest with cup holders, and alloy wheels. Options include dual airbags with side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, Electronic Stability Program, HID Xenon headlights, power sunroof, leather upholstery, power front seats, integrated memory system for driver's seat and mirrors, in-dash 6-CD changer with two more speakers including an Infinity subwoofer and amplifier, rear parking sensors, electric rear curtain, rain-sensing front wipers and some wood on the steering wheel.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The Volvo C70 is a coupe and a convertible thanks to its power-folding hard-top. First introduced in its current guide back in 2007, it received a frontal facelift for 2011. The C70 has room for four average-sized adults. The three-piece retractable steel roof folds up or down electrically in 30 seconds. Development of the trick top was apparently helped along by Pininfarina in Italy. The new car is slightly shorter and lower than the old model, though it offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers. Available in this region is only one turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, with a 5-speed automatic gearbox and front-wheel-drive. Standard features include dual zone automatic climate control, power seats, trip computer, automatic dimming rear-view mirror and a CD audio system. Safety features typical of Volvo include emergency pop-up roll bars, ABS brakes, a front side-impact protection system also known as SIPS, and a whiplash protection they like to call WHIPS.

For 2014, the Lexus GS is the same, except that the GS 350 received a new transmission. The Lexus GS is all-new from the 2012 model year, gaining a new entry-level trim but losing the V8 at the top end. The models include the GS 250 and the GS 350, with the GS 450h hybrid joining the range later. The GS 250 comes with a 2.5-litre direct-injection V6 and a 6-speed automatic with paddles. The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 8-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its Lexus trademark 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The GS 250 can be had in various trims. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 250, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The Odyssey is a best-seller in America, but has yet to make an impact in this region, where 4WDs rule. The Odyssey has a car-like ride and handling quality since it is based on the Accord. It is powered by the same fuel-efficient 3.5-litre V6 engine as the MR-V, mated to an automatic. The interior features a clever seating system that can accommodate up to eight passengers. The Odyssey comes standard with side curtain airbags, electronic stability control and ABS brakes, as well as power door locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, 60/40 split fold-down rear seats, power sliding doors, tri-zone climate control, a stowable second-row PlusOne seat, in-dash CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, cruise control, power driver seat controls, alloy wheels and other features. Leather upholstery is available, as is a power moonroof and heated front seats. The Odyssey aims to be more of a luxury cruiser than a basic family or labour hauler.

The Suburban, alongside the shorter Tahoe, has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Suburban and Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Suburban, with better fuel economy to boot, but a bigger 6.0-litre V8 is available. The 5.3-litre's aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. The 6.0-litre V8 gets a 6-speed automatic. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Suburban is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The eight-seater Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, so it offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The Lexus ES was all-new for 2007 and mildly facelifted for 2010. With a 3.5-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic, the only changes for 2010 include a new front bumper, new tail lamps and optional USB support for the stereo. This entry-level luxury car is based on the Toyota Camry chassis, with a unique body, equipment and interior. The front-wheel drive ES 350 does come with an impressive set of standard features that the Toyota Camry can only dream about. Three trim levels are available, namely the Premier, Prestige and Platinum. Standard features include an 8-speaker audio system with CD changer, Bluetooth, AUX port, leather, power-adjustable front seats, wood trim, auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive HID headlights, headlamp cleaner, power mirrors with memory, sunroof and parking sensors. The mid-range model adds navigation, rear camera, USB port and a rear spoiler. The top model adds a panoramic glass roof, 14-speaker Mark Levinson stereo with DVD changer, semi-aniline leather seats and adaptive cruise control. Safety features that come standard on the ES 350 include dual front airbags, a knee airbag, side-impact airbags, curtain airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, electronic brake-force distribution, also known as EBD, and a tyre-pressure monitor system.

The Chery Arrizo 7 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering in a tough market dominated by the Japanese. Under the hood, the Arrizo 7 gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 5-speed manual gearbox or a CVT automatic. The suspension has been tuned by British sports car company Lotus. Standard features on the Arrizo 7 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, manual A/C, radio with CD/AUX/USB/Bluetooth support, fabric seats and steal wheels. The higher models get sunroof, cruise control, leather seats, automatic A/C, rear-view camera, 7-inch screen and alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

The Fiat Fiorino is a compact commercial vehicle offering by the Italian brand. The Turkish-built Fiorino comes with a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual. Standard features include power steering, sliding side door, foldable passenger seat, adjustable driver's seat, heat reflecting windows, radio with CD/MP3 player, and ABS. It has 2.8 cubic-metre volume of cargo space with a 600 kg payload capacity.

The Sirion is Daihatsu's entry in the sub-compact segment, packed with features and space. It received a minor facelift for the 2008 model year, along with a bigger 1.5-litre engine. The little Sirion offers a generous amount of space for the front passengers, including a fair bit of room between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Rear passengers aren't so lucky, but they still get reasonable amounts of leg space between front and rear seats. The rear doors open wide to an angle of around 80 degrees, allowing easy entry and exit, and the tailgate eases handling of large luggage. There is a full 630 litres of luggage space with two people on board and the rear seats folded down. With five on board, it still has 225 litres. The top of the back door has decent head clearance and a pull handle also makes it easy to close the door. A luggage room lamp adds convenience, along with the CD/AM/FM Radio, power windows, central locking, front airbags, cup holders in the doors and the centre console, and split rear seats that are 60:40 foldable. It is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder motor, the Sirion shifts gears using a 4-speed automatic, as the manual is not offered here. 14-inch steel wheels are standard, while alloys are optional, among other things. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

The A3 hatchback slips into Audi's line-up as the company's smallest and cheapest model, starting in 2004 and receiving a minor facelift in 2005. Sharing its platform with the MKV-generation VW Golf, the main A3 models available here are a 1.6-litre four and a 2.0-litre four, both with front-wheel-drive, but while engines such as a 2.0-litre turbo four are not officially offered, a few local dealers offer the 3.2-litre V6, complete with Quattro all-wheel-drive. We confirmed that many local dealerships do not stock the faster models, but Audi's PR people, apparently disconnected from the local dealer network, argue that they are in fact available. Transmission choices are limited to a six-speed automatic in this region, although the V6 does get a DSG automanual. The four-cylinder engines can be had in either three-door or five-door Sportback form, though again it depends on the local dealer. Standard features on the four-cylinder models include four-wheel disc brakes, 16-inch alloy wheels, automatic climate control, power windows, power locks with keyless remote, cloth seats and a CD player. Although itï¿½s a compact car, the A3 is pricey. It tries to justify its price with a well-built exterior and a pleasant interior, as well as a badge that no one respects yet. The biggest challenge the A3 faces is getting buyers to accept its relatively high price tag. For what is offered, we wouldn't.

The second generation Porsche Panamera came out as a 2017 model year. The trims available in the GCC include the base Panamera, along with the, Panamera 4, Panamera 4 E-Hybrid Turbo S E-Hybrid. In 2019, the Panamera GTS and GTS Sport Turismo joined the range. The base model and the Panamera 4S gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6,  while the Panamera Turbo and Panamera GTS gets a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8. The Turbo S E-Hybrid gets a V8 4.0-litre turbo unit combined with an electric motor. Some updates on the new generation include an improved adaptive air suspension system and optional rear-axle steering. Inside, the interior gets a new instrument cluster with two 7-inch displays. The centre console gets a 12.3-inch touch screen, while the rear passenger get their own set of infotainment and climate controls. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class came out in 2019. The exterior and interior have been completely changed to incorporate their new design language, first seen on the Mercedes-Benz A-Class. New engines now power the CLS-Class which includes a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo for the CLS 350, the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 motor for the CLS-450 and the 3.0-litre turbo inline-6 engine coupled with an electric motor for the CLS-53 AMG. All of them get the 9-speed automatic transmission. The CLS 450 and CLS 53 AMG are available only in all-wheel-drive. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment includes air suspension and a widescreen cockpit consisting of two 12.3-inch displays on the dashboard. An AMG line is also available and includes AMG body styling, a diamond pattern radiator grille, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a flat-bottomed sports steering wheel.

The Accent is Hyundai's long-running sub-compact nameplate, though it could be more successful than it is. The new model is a decent upgrade over the old Accent, though still using lightly-modifed carryover engines. Now available in 5-door sedan and 3-door hatchback form in this region, the most basic Accent thankfully comes with power steering, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine with a manual or automatic gearbox at a dirt-cheap price. Step up to the higher models, and buyers are treated to a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with a manual or an automatic, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, fog lamps, better cloth seats, a 60/40 split-folding rear seat with centre armrest and cup holders, and not much else. An agreeably spacious interior and steel 14-inch wheels with plastic covers are standard on all trim levels, but there is no mention of airbags or ABS brakes in the spec sheet on cars bound for the Middle East market.

The sub-compact Figo is Ford's newest and smallest offering in the GCC. Intended to be a cheaper motoring option than even the Fiesta, the Figo is built in India, based on a shortened older-generation Fiesta, and comes in 5-door hatchback form. It comes with a choice of 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with a manual gearbox and 1.6-litre 4-cylinder with an automatic. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente and Trend trims, both getting cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include manual windows, power mirrors, 2-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, soft-touch dashboard and a claimed "best-in-class" manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 14-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, fog lamps, ABS brakes, front power windows and height-adjustable driver's seat.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering yet, and takes its name from a fighting bull or something. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini, available as coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. An Audi-derived 5.0-litre V10 engine, upgraded for 2006, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type 45-per cent limited slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard.

Volkswagen has expanded its model spectrum with a new Golf-based weirdo called the Golf Plus. With added extras in terms of bodywork and seating height, it is essentially a tall Golf. This allows cabin space that rivals many small 4WD offerings, all in a small exterior. There is even a CrossGolf variant of this model, with 20 mm extra ground clearance and tough-looking plastic body cladding, but it is still really a front-driven hatchback. The clever interior fittings include a rear seating system which can be shifted lengthwise by means of a new folding kinematic system. This method automatically causes the seating area to be lowered as soon as the backs of the asymmetrically adjustable, divisible seats have been folded down, resulting in a nearly level storage area. The possibility to integrate the optional CD-changer or DVD player from the Volkswagen Individual range is available. Apart from ESP and various airbags, other standard features include LED tail-lights, power windows and various other electric bits. Engines for the Plus currently include a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre, both four-cylinder and both available with either a manual or an automatic. The CrossGolf only gets the 1.6-litre engine.

Expanding their midsize 5-Series line-up, the 5-Series Gran Turismo is supposed to be a coupe-like crossover vehicle that aims to appeal to markets where the 5-Series wagon is ignored. The 'F07' platform features a unique "bi-modal" trunk which may be opened in traditional sedan fashion, or the entire hatch may open like a hatchback. Various new BMW tech features debuted in the GT that appear in the next 5-Series range, such as four-wheel multilink suspension, standard 8-speed automatic gearboxes and turbo engines, namely the 3.0-litre inline-6 for the 535i GT and the 4.4-litre V8 for the 550i GT. Depending on trim level, the 4-seater GT can be outfitted with features such as leather upholstery, 4-zone automatic a/c, Bluetooth, navigation, USB/iPod port, CD/MP3 stereo with 80 GB hard disc, rear DVD entertainment system, heads-up display, panoramic glass roof, adaptive cruise control with stop-&-go feature, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning system, night vision, active steering, rear-wheel steering, rearview camera, side-view cameras, parking sensors, run-flat tyres and keyless button-start, among others. Also included are various selectable driving modes, adjustable air suspension, stability control and numerous airbags. The niche vehicle is almost as long as the 7-Series and has as much headroom as the X5.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. The S 63 AMG came by 2008. It gets the 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Also features such as a reversing camera, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels are included.

The Toyota Highlander is the Japanese brand's midsize hybrid SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets a 2.5-litre engine coupled with two electric motors, and power being delivered via an eCVT.  Standard features in the American-made Highlander include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, fabric seats, tri-zone automatic AC, 4.2-inch information display, 8-inch screen for the display audio, 6 speakers, LED headlights and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher model gets leather seats, power seats with memory function, navigation, panoramic roof and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include 7 airbags (dual, front, side, curtain, knee airbags), adaptive cruise control, lane assist, pre-collision system, lane departure assist, stability control and tyre pressure monitor. The top model gets additional blind spot monitor, 360 camera and front parking sensors.

In 2020, the Audi Q7 got updated visually and technically. The Q7 has a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. It comes standard in 18-inch alloy wheels, which can go up to 21-inch alloy wheels, while optional equipment include three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. The optional "Audi pre sense basic" initiates preventive protective measures for the occupants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts. Optional solutions are bundled in the packages "Parking", "City" and "Tour". The "Parking" package includes the surround view camera and the park assist system, which autonomously steers the car backwards into parallel and perpendicular parking spots. The driver only has to apply the brakes and the gas. The "City" package comprises new systems. The cross-traffic assist warns the driver of other vehicles when driving slowly in reverse, such as when pulling out from a perpendicular parking spot. The exit warning system indicates vehicles or cyclists approaching from the rear before the door is opened.  "Audi side assist" uses radar measurements behind the car to ensure safe lane changes. "Audi pre sense rear" tensions the seat belts in the event of an impending collision from behind. The parking system plus and the reversing cameras round out the "City" package.

The Peugeot 5008 is the French automaker's entry in the MPV market. The 7-seater 5008 comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include power steering, power windows, digital and bi-zone air conditioning, tilt and telescopic leather steering wheel, heater power mirrors, radio with CD/AUX support, front and rear fog lamps, rear parking sensors and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher model called 'Premium' gets additional options such as tinted windows, auto headlamps, automatic wipers, panoramic roof, bi-zone AC with rear ducts, power-foldable mirrors, sundshade curtains for the back row seats and rear parking sensors with distance measurement. Standard safety features include 6 airbags and seatbelt sensors, electric parking break with hill assist, ABS brakers, electronic stability control (ESP), electronic brake distribution (EBD), emergency brake assist (EBA) and anti-slip regulation (ASR).

With the Sharan, VW properly wets its feet in the minivan segment, though it is falling behind the modern competition nowadays, considering its 1995 origins. The Sharan is not a true VW, being based on a Ford minivan, and also sold as a rebadged Seat. Revamped in 2000, and facelifted for 2004, it provides ample room for the driver and six adult passengers to sit back, relax and enjoy their individually formed 'business class' seats. The Sharan offers the flexibility of removing the rear seats to open up a massive 2,610 cubic litres of storage space. Powered by two aging VW engines, namely the 1.8-litre turbo four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre VR6 units, they can be had with a manual or an automatic. Built in Portugal, the Sharan comes standard with five removable rear seats, ABS brakes with electronic brake-pressure distribution, electronic climate control both front and rear, alarm with interior protection and remote central locking, front side airbag system, driver's and front passenger's airbags, electric front windows, electrically adjustable door mirrors, radio/CD stereo with 10 speakers, and seat belts for all three rows of seating.

An all-new BMW 3-Series made its debut in 2019. The BMW 320i and 330i get a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit.  An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered. In addition, all the tech features offered in the 5-Series seems to be offered in the BMW 3-Series as well, including variable steering, dynamic damper control, brake energy regeneration, iDrive computer, heads-up display, surround-view cameras, parking assistant and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, seatbelt pretensioners, optional automatic braking and more.

Maxus G10 is a the Chinese brand's MPV offering. Under the hood, there are two engines. The cargo vans get a naturally aspirated 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox, while the people carrier gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the G10 people carrier include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric mirrrors, keyless entry, manual dual-zone A/C, radio with MP3/AUX support and 6 speakers, halogen headlights, front & rear foglights, sliding doors, lift tailgate and 16-inch wheels. The higher models gets LED headlamps, LED taillamps, dual-sliding doors, rear panorama sunroof, leather seats,  7-inch touch screen with DVD system, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control and traction control.
