If not obvious yet, the Grand Marquis is just a rebadged version of the Ford Crown Victoria. Features include three-person bench seats front and back, optional leather trim, a new instrument panel, burl woodgrain, a two-tone colour package and standard power windows. It is available in the Middle East in GS, GS Convenience, GS-L, LS Premium, LSE and LS Ultimate trims, at last count. A handling package, optional on GS and LS series, aims to improve the boat-like drive with 16-inch  aluminium wheels, a 3.27 axle, heavy duty rear stabiliser bar and rear air suspension with unique springs. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The BMW M5 is the high performance version of the 5-series and debuted in 2006 with a high-revving 5.0-litre V10 engine, mated to 7-speed automanual transmission. It was the first production sedan to feature a V10 engine, said to have been made as a tribute to the Formula 1 V10 era. It was the fastest production sedan in the world at the time of its release. It also has a launch control function. Standard options include power windows, climate control, active cruise control, head-up display, active steering, Harman Kardon Logic7 stereo system, ESP, Dynamic Stability Control (DSC), voice control, adaptive headlights, night vision, active headrests, xenon headlights, run-flat tyres, active cruise control, LED rear lights, lane departure warning and brake force display.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

In 2019, a new generation of the Porsche 911 Cabriolet was revealed. The 2+2 seater coupe gets an updated exterior design, along with updates to the engine. The 911 Carrera and Carrera S is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine with two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The Carrera 4 and 4S is all-wheel drive. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The Carrera S and Carrera T models also have the option of all-wheel-steer.

For 2013, the Audi A4 received a minor facelift. Available engines include the weak 1.8 TFSI with two versions of the 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder, mated to front-wheel-drive and CVT automatic, and a 3.0T Quattro which gets a 7-speed transmission and all-wheel-drive. There is also a 2.0T with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and all-wheel-drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings, with up to 24 combinations available to create individual driving profiles. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Dakota is a mid-size pickup with a full-size attitude, as Dodge likes to brag, and they are not far from the truth. The Dakota is the largest pickup in its class and the only mid-size truck available with a V8. The Dakota looks big, thanks to a complete redesign recently, making it larger than before and making it look almost as big and tough as the full-size Dodge Ram. The standard engine is a 3.7-litre V6. It comes with a six-speed manual transmission. An optional four-speed automatic is available on the higher trim levels. A 4.7-litre V8 engine is available for all models. A "high-output" version of the 4.7-litre V8 is also available on the higher models. With either V8, a six-speed manual transmission is standard, while a five-speed automatic is optional. Two available transfer cases, either full-time or part-time, are available on the 4WD models. Available steering wheel mounted audio controls allow easy control of the standard AM/FM/Cassette radio or the optional AM/FM/CD radio with eight speakers.

The V5 Crossover is aptly named, although we'd say it is more of a minivan segment player. From what we can gather from vague press materials, it aims to include all the comforts of a luxury car with the space and versatility of a wagon. The interior is beautiful in design, though the build quality is far from perfect. The centrally-mounted gauges and the fake wood trim are expected downsides. Powered by the same 2.4-litre four-cylinder Mitsubishi engine that serves most other Chery models, it comes with a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power windows, remote central locking, CD player with optional 6-disc changer, 16-inch alloy wheels, manual cloth seats or optional electric leather seats, dual front airbags with optional front-side airbags, ABS-assisted four-wheel-disc brakes with EBD, power mirrors, parking sensors, power steering, optional DVD navigation, sunroof and of course an alarm system should someone try to steal your Chery.

An all-new Cadillac Escalade was revealed as a new model for 2015. The front fascia gets the new corporate design with the LED headlights. The engine under the hood will be the same 6.2-litre V8 engine, but tweaked to produce slightly more power than the previous model. Power is delivered through an 8-speed automatic transmission. All-wheel-drive is standard, and low-range gearing is finally available. There will also be an extended version, based on the Chevrolet Suburban. Standard features include new electric power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic dual-zone A/C, power-adjustable pedals, Bluetooth, heated and ventilated seats, and cylinder deactivation. Standard alloy-wheel size is 20-inch, with 22-inch alloys as optional. The interior features a new centre console, which includes their CUE touchscreen interface. The six or seven seats configuration is still available on the new Escalade, with the rear seats having the ability to fold completely flat. Magnetic Ride Control has been added as well to improve ride quality. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS and stability control. A Driver Awareness package includes Forward Collision Alert, Lane Departure Warning System, and the patented Safety Alert Seat, which offers directional vibrations to alert the driver about potential crash threats. A Driver Assist package adds Full Speed Range Adaptive Cruise Control, Front and Rear Automatic Braking and Automatic Safety Belt Tightening. Additionally, Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Lane Change Alert are standard on higher models.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class came out in 2019, along with a new AMG model. Gone is the CLS 63 AMG, now replaced by the Mercedes-AMG CLS 53.  The exterior and interior have been completely changed to incorporate their new design language, first seen on the Mercedes-Benz A-Class. New engines now power the CLS-Class with the 3.0-litre turbo inline-6 engine coupled with an electric motor installed in the CLS-53 AMG. Power is delivered by a 9-speed automatic transmission and is available only in all-wheel-drive. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights, air suspension and a widescreen cockpit consisting of two 12.3-inch displays on the dashboard. Other AMG features include diamond pattern radiator grille, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a flat-bottomed sports steering wheel. Safety standards are high, which include front, side curtain and knee airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, brake assist, front collision alert, auto-braking and ABS.

The new Civic was a breath of fresh air in the crowded compact class back in 2006, and continues with a 2009 facelift that includes a reshaped front end and more features. Trim levels include the basic LXi, the mid-level EXi and the top VTi, all sharing the same 1.8-litre engine. Standard features on all trims now include 16-inch wheels, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, CD/MP3 player, cruise control, body-coloured exterior trim, power windows and mirrors, and a 5-speed automatic gearbox, with a manual gearbox available only on the LXi. The EXi receives a standard automatic gearbox only, and adds stability control, optional sunroof, turn signals on the mirrors, upgraded stereo with 4 speakers, USB jack and steering wheel controls, and outside temperature gauge. The VTi adds side-curtain airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, standard automatic gearbox with paddle shifters, standard sunroof, optional leather, automatic a/c, chrome exhaust tip, foglights and HID headlights. The Civic only gets more expensive, overlapping with the Accord now in terms of price.

The Maserati Ghibli was revived by Fiat as a 2014 model and is intended to compete in the luxury midsize segment which is dominated by the Germans. The rear-wheel drive Ghibli gets two 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engines in different states of tune. Both versions get an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2015, the Ghibli S was also available with all-wheel-drive. In 2019, a Gran Lusso trim was introduced with a body kit, sports seats and steering wheel, and full-LED adaptive Matrix headlights. Standard options include power windows, electric mirrors, power steering, cruise control, leather seats, infotainment screen with navigation, parking sensors, reverse camera and 19-inch alloy rims. The higher models get a better audio entertainment system, 20-inch alloys and all sorts of cabin trim choices. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Lexus GX 460 last received a facelift in 2014. Sporting a new front-end, actual changes are minimal, but the midsize luxury SUV in now available in three trim levels. On the outside, the most obvious changes include the redesigned front-end with the corporate "spindle" grille, adaptive LED-HID combination headlights, LED running lamps, new tail lamp clusters, redone 18-inch wheels and other minor bits. The engine is a carryover 4.6-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. The base Premier model is well-equipped, with standard features such as a multi-terrain select system, smart keyless entry and start, sunroof, rear camera and side camera with park assist, synthetic leather trim for the 7-seater cabin, 9-speaker stereo with new 8-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, DVD navigation, tri-zone a/c, crawl control, ESP, basic cruise control and a full set of airbags that includes knee bags. The mid-range Prestige model adds semi-aniline leather, heated/ventilated seats, cool box and lane-change assist with blind-spot monitor. The top Platinum model adds a 17-speaker Mark Levinson stereo, pre-crash safety system, radar cruise control and a rear-seat entertainment system.

The Hyundai Veloster Turbo finally debuted in the GCC market in 2015, after several delays over a couple of years. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side.The Veloster Turbo has a more aggressive look than the standard model, with a black hexagonal grille, fog lamps and a revised rear fascia which features two centre-mounted exhaust-tips. Under the hood is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a new 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available include a full set of airbags, LED front running lamps, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The Mercedes-Benz V-Class replaces the Viano and Vito in the lineup. In  2017, the V-Class was released in the GCC with a petrol engine. In 2020 it got a facelift, getting a new front bumper and grille. Under the hood, it gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, cruise control, leather seats, Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get added options such as 17-inch alloy wheels, their "AGILITY CONTROL" suspension with selective damping system and more premium Lugano leather trim on the seats. The Exclusive edition gets interior trim in brushed aluminium look, air vents in silver chrome, a roof liner in DINAMICA, panoramic sliding sunroof, the new large centre console with integral refrigerated compartment and thermo-cupholders, climatised single seats in Nappa leather for the driver, front and rear passengers, 19-inch light-alloy wheels and Burmester surround sound system. There is also a sports package and AMG package. Safety standards are high with optional systems such as Collision Prevention Assist and Distronic Plus, along with multiple airbags for driver and passengers. It also gets traction control, stability control, blind-spot assist and lane-tracking system.

The Suzuki Jimny got a complete overhaul, debuting in late 2018 with much fanfare. However, the hype was muted once it became clear that it is still following the old formula, with an outdated 1.5-litre engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic gearbox. It only comes in 3-door "wide body" form for the UAE and GCC. A ladder-frame chassis, three-link rigid axle suspension and part-time four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing are all standard. Also standard is a hard plastic interior, with features such as fabric upholstery, power windows, manual a/c and a stereo system. It now has 377 litres of luggage space with the rear seats folded down. When all four seats are occupied, the capacity gets reduced to 85 litres. For easy dirt removal, the backs of the rear seats and the boot floor are now coated with plastic. Dual front airbags and ESP are also standard.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is Mazda's excellent two-seat, rear-wheel-drive convertible sports car that was completely redesigned for the 2006 model year, but is available for the first time in the GCC from 2008. It was facelifted for the 2009 model year, but only reached this region for 2010. Powered by a high-revving 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, this little runner is now mated to a 6-speed auto with paddle-shifters now, dumping the slow-selling manual in the GCC. Only the version with the powered folding hard top is offered here. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 7 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, manual a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-card for keyless entry and ignition, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats. A bit pricey and a favourite among women, but a great alternative to German roadsters for carving up roads.

The 206 is one of Peugeot's more popular models, with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, although new derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet joined the line-up in 2001. There are various petrol engines in the range, although after 2006, the local offerings had decreased. The standard five-door hatchback can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic. The 206 CC coupe-cabriolet can only be had as a 1.6-litre automatic in the later years, although the manual 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre CC models were available here for a few years in between. There is a more powerful 2.0-litre engine with a manual offered in three-door RC hatchback form, which is a true sporting contender. The tuned RC debuted in 2003, replacing the competent GTi 2.0-litre model. All models come with front power windows, a cloth interior, driver's airbag and other basics as standard. Comprehensive safety equipment such as ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, along with passenger front airbag, were all optional. Available features included a CD player, alloy wheels and more.

The V70, based on the S60, is tuned to be a sports wagon, but is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis and weak regional engine choices. The interior is fairly spacious and the luggage area is huge thanks to its upright boxy shape. For the Middle East market, there is a basic 2.4-litre 5-cylinder only for the V70 wagon, although European markets get as many engines as the S60 sedan. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The Morris Garages nameplate, an off-shoot of the defunct Rover brand, has been resurrected by the Chinese SAIC group, and their first product is the MG 750, midsize front-wheel-drive sedan based fully on a facelifted Rover 75. The MG 750 comes with an updated 183 hp 2.5-litre V6, 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, independent suspension, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, dual front airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, leather seats, power-adjustable driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, steering-mounted radio controls, automatic climate control a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, CD changer, sunroof, keyless entry, auto headlights, cooled central cubby box, illuminated sunshade mirrors and parking sensors. Options such as GPS and side airbags are apparently not yet available in GCC-spec models, but may be offered later.

A new generation Kia Optima came out for the 2016 model year. In 2019, it got a facelift. Under the hood, two engines are available in the 2020 Kia Optima. One is the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the other a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 2020 Kia Optima include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, ventilated seats, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Kia is offering proper safety features only in the top model.

For 2012, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class received engine upgrades for some models. There are six models to choose from - the E 200, E 250, E 300, E 350, E 500 and E 63 AMG. The E 200 and E 250 get a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. The E 300 gets a 3.0-litre V6 whereas the E 350 is fitted with a 3.5-litre V6 engine. The E 500 has a 4.7-litre under the hood. They all have a 7-speed automatic transmission. An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard sedan models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Chrysler 200 is a reborn Sebring, but with a major facelift, new engines, retuned suspension and a better interior. Now offered with a choice of 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and 3.6-litre V6 engines, both mated to 6-speed automatics, the front-wheel-drive midsize sedan gets a second chance in the GCC market. The base 200 LX model comes with the 4-cylinder engine, cloth upholstery, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, 17-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, cruise control and manual a/c. The mid-range 200 Touring model adds 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone auto a/c, leather-wrapped steering wheel, trip computer, power driver's seat and 6-speaker stereo, with available options such as remote start, sunroof and voice-controlled UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and hard-drive. The top 200 Limited model adds a V6 engine, exterior chrome trim, 18-inch alloys, auto up/down windows, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather upholstery, while the same extra-cost options as the Touring are also available, with the addition of an optional Boston Acoustics stereo. All models get standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, alarm and a tyre-pressure monitoring system.

In what could possibly be the most hotly-anticipated sports car of the decade, the Toyota 86 finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. The 86 is a collaborative effort with Subaru, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates. Available in various trim levels, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a Subaru-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or automatic. For 2014, the base model was dropped in some GCC markets. In the UAE, there are GT and GTX trims for the manual now, while the automatic gets VT and VTX trims. Some markets, such as Oman, apparently do not offer the manual. Standard features include cloth sports seats, halogen headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, manual a/c, common power accessories and 16-inch alloy wheels with 205/55 tyres, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. Most versions get a limited-slip differential. Available features in higher trims include auto a/c, HID headlights, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and 17-inch alloys with 215/45 tyres, aside from dealer-installed leather upholstery. An optional TRD body kit is available separately. In the UAE, the top non-TRD model gets aftermarket navigation now. The Saudi market gets navigation with the mid-range model, while the top GT model gets a body kit. Specs may vary between different GCC countries.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016. It is available with "SkyActiv" engines, a 2.0-litre and a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, both direct-injection with high compression ratios. There are two body styles, namely a sedan and a station-wagon. The sedan is available with both engine options, while the wagon only comes with the smaller motor. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. The top model includes 19-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera, bi-xenon headlights, daytime running lights, 11-speaker Bose sound system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents and a sunroof. Navigation and adaptive cruise control can be further added to the top-spec version, but they're not offered in all GCC markets. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. While shorter than the outgoing model by 10mm, the new Swift boasts a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a new 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. There is also a turbocharged 1.0-litre 3-cylinder motor offered elsewhere, which may make a debut in the GCC later on. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. Features include 4 or 6 speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, automatic a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel with audio controls, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD.

Hyundai's first ever rear-wheel-drive sports car, the Genesis Coupe is a 2+2 seater that has quickly earned some respect in the affordable performance category, and has been revamped for 2013 with a new front end, new tail lamps and a nicer interior. The Genesis Coupe is based on the same rear-drive platform as found under the full-size Genesis sedan, but with almost five inches chopped out of the wheelbase. The Coupe features a MacPherson strut dual-link front suspension and a five-link rear suspension. The GCC-spec Genesis Coupe will only be available as a fully-optioned V6 automatic model. That means the two-door coupe will come with power windows, electric mirrors, 18-inch wheels, leather seats, cruise control, sunroof, HID headlights, 10-speaker Infinity audio and Brembo brakes. The 3.8-litre V6 engine is mated to a new 8-speed automatic. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side airbags, ABS and stability control. The "GDI" V6 manual and the base turbo 4-cylinder engines, as sold in other overseas markets, will not be offered as of now.

The Gullwing is back for 2010 on a completely new and unique platform, paying homage to the original 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300SL Gullwing. But the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG is supposed to be an everyday-use supercar, ditching McLaren in favour of in-house development by AMG. The car's trademark feature is the set of 'gullwing' doors that open upwards, requiring less room to open than conventional coupe doors. Underneath the long bonnet is the usual AMG-built 6.2-litre V8 engine, retuned and mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox in this application. A lightweight structure molded largely from carbon-fibre and aluminium double-wishbone suspension form the basics of the SLS. Among other things, the centre console incorporates the AMG DRIVE UNIT, which enables SLS owners to customise their vehicle set-up, while the AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission is operated by means of the E-SELECT lever. Beyond the usual power accessories and comfort features such as automatic a/c and cruise control, the simplistic interior can be customised in various colours, and can be fitted with options such as sports seats, metal trim, various leather choices, nicer paint and carbon-fibre appliquÃ©s. Further options include different 19-inch and 20-inch alloy wheels, carbon-ceramic brakes, pricey Bang & Olufsen stereo and a sports steering wheel.

The MG 6 comes in two body shapes, either as a sedan or as a liftback version. There are two 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engines to choose from, one being naturally aspirated and the other a turbocharged unit. They can be had in either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission with optional paddle shifters. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with CD/MP3 support and 8 speakers, trip computer and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, power mirrors, cruise control, parking rear camera, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C, radio with DVD/MP3 support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The CK is Geely's first offering in a few GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia and the UAE, although it first went on sale in China a couple of years prior. The name "CK" somehow stands for "Freedom Ship" or "Free Cruiser" in Chinese. The CK holds the distinction of being the first Chinese automobile ever displayed at an American auto show, although it has never been allowed to be on sale there. The reasons are that it failed crash tests and emissions regulations. The small car was developed in China, but is supposedly based on a South Korean design by Daewoo. Its 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine is licenced from Toyota. The front-wheel-drive sedan comes with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Features include manual air-conditioning, remote locking, fog lamps, CD stereo, power steering, painted bumpers, power windows, intermittent wipers, 14-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery and more. Options include leather upholstery, ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, dual front airbags,

Volkswagen has expanded its model spectrum with a new Golf-based weirdo called the Golf Plus. With added extras in terms of bodywork and seating height, it is essentially a tall Golf. This allows cabin space that rivals many small 4WD offerings, all in a small exterior. There is even a CrossGolf variant of this model, with 20 mm extra ground clearance and tough-looking plastic body cladding, but it is still really a front-driven hatchback. The clever interior fittings include a rear seating system which can be shifted lengthwise by means of a new folding kinematic system. This method automatically causes the seating area to be lowered as soon as the backs of the asymmetrically adjustable, divisible seats have been folded down, resulting in a nearly level storage area. The possibility to integrate the optional CD-changer or DVD player from the Volkswagen Individual range is available. Apart from ESP and various airbags, other standard features include LED tail-lights, power windows and various other electric bits. Engines for the Plus currently include a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre, both four-cylinder and both available with either a manual or an automatic. The CrossGolf only gets the 1.6-litre engine.

The Ford Mustang received a GT500-inspired facelift for 2013, along with a few mild tweaks. All Ford Mustang models get a new front-end with revised lower air intakes and a new splitter. HID headlights are now standard on all versions, while GT models get a new bonnet with functional air extractors as well as optional HID foglamps. New body-coloured side-skirts and rear lower bumper as well as new 17-inch, 18-inch and 19-inch wheels are also available. There is now a high-gloss black panel in the rear between the redesigned taillamps. The side mirrors have LED lamps in them that project the Mustang pony logo onto the ground when the doors are unlocked. New colours include new shades of green and blue. The 5.0-litre V8 engine also receives a slight increase in horsepower. The Mustang is offered in coupe, convertible and glass-roof versions. The convertible will only be sold with an automatic transmission. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, power mirrors, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. The SL 65 AMG comes with a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The VW Polo recently received a fresh redesign and upgraded equipment. The Polo, though simply a sub-compact hatchback, has a more upmarket feel, thanks to judicious use of materials. High quality interiors are synonymous with Volkswagen, and the high quality plastics and fabrics found in the Polo is no exception. Standard equipment includes a CD stereo system, along with power windows and other electricals. Sadly, the only available powerplant in the Polo is the 1.4-litre four-cylinder unit. Available with a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic gearbox, this engine kills the upscale illusion. The new Polo includes standard safety systems such as ABS brakes, Hydraulic Brake Assist, and dual front airbags. Side airbags, a curtain airbag system and Electronic Stabilisation Programme are optional. The Polo also has high levels of torsional rigidity, leading to improved crash performance, impressive refinement and driving dynamics.
An all-new GMC Yukon came out in 2021.

The Opel Crossland X is a sub-compact SUV offering with a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder turbocharged engine under the hood. Mated to the motor is a 6-speed automatic transmission. For 2022, the Crossland X received a facelift, especially for the front fascia which got new headlights, grille and bumper. The interior remains the same, with the top-spec model getting smart key with start button, heads-up display, wireless charger, cruise control, LED lighting front and back, a touchscreen with a slightly slow-but-useable interface, and a decent dual-zone auto a/c. Safety features include a full set of airbags, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor, rear camera, ABS and brake assist.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

One of the longest-running nameplates in the region, the Sunny has become popular for its reasonable price and traditional reliability, all while competitors drove their own prices up. However, the Sunny soon fell behind in terms of equipment, and the all-new Tiida arrived as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. Nissan Middle East is openly pushing the Sunny as a fleet car now, leaving the Tiida for individual sales. That fact has led to the Sunny receiving only a facelift in its latest iteration, while having its engine lineup reduced to just one. The new car is in fact a rebadged Samsung SM3, sold only in Korea. There is good head room, but other interior dimensions fall behind its competitors. Available as a four-door sedan, the Sunny is now available only with a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with a manual or automatic transmissions. Standard features include electric power steering, air conditioning and a cloth interior. Options include a CD stereo system and power accessories. Optional safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The ninth generation Chevrolet Malibu made its debut in the GCC as a 2017 model year. It got a slight facelift in 2019, along with a new base engine and improved tech. Under the hood the base model now gets a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed transmission. The other engine on offer is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. That one gets an 6-speed auto transmission. Standard features on the base LS model include power steering, electric windows, central locking, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, single zone A/C, 6-speaker audio system, 7-inch touch screen with Bluetooth, phone projection and navigation, keyless entry, engine push start, fabric seats, cruise control and 16-inch steel wheels. The LT gets additional remote vehicle starter and 17-inch alloy wheels. The sunroof, 8-inch touch screen, and power seats are optional on the LT. On the Premier, additional features include dual exhausts, HID headlamps, LED tail lamps, auto headlight leveling function, dual-zone A/C, 9-speaker Bose audio system, 8-inch touch screen with navigation, USB charge port, leather seats, power seats and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the Premier include sunroof, rearview camera and adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS), and traction control. The Premier gets side airbags as well. Other optional safety equipment include lane-keeping assist, blind spot monitor, forward collision alert and rear cross traffic alert.

The 2016 Mazda 2 is a new generation model. It is a hatchback and now uses its own "Skyactiv" chassis and engine. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a new 6-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. LED headlights, fog lamps, leather seats, heads-up display, rear spoiler and 16-inch alloys are some of the optional features. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The top-spec model gets 6 airbags.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The Continental GTC made its debut as a 2006 model. It gets the same twin turbocharged 6.0-litre W12 engine as the coupe and all-wheel drive is standard. It comes with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental GT convertible is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags.

The SX4 is Suzuki's compact car offering. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model. For 2013, Suzuki started offering only the all-wheel drive hatchback version. It is fitted with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

Foton SUP is a compact pickup made in China, and offered in certain GCC countries. Only the double-cab is sold. Only a weak 2.2-litre engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission is available. It is offered in only two-wheel drive setup. Features offered include remote control with central door locking, power steering, power mirrors, manual antenna, indicators on side mirrors, fog lamps, PVC floor carpet, manual air-conditioner, fake-wood interior trim, CD player, power windows and metallic paint.

The Lexus RC is the Japanese luxury brand's compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC carries on with a 3.5-litre V6 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, it got a facelift. Enhancements have been made to the RC's aerodynamics, tyres and suspension, and there are also improvements to engine response and steering feel. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control.

The Jeep Cherokee offers both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, with a choice between a 2.4-litre "Tigershark" 4-cylinder and a new 3.2-litre "Pentastar" V6. A 9-speed automatic transmission is standard on all models. It features four-wheel-independent suspension. There will be four different versions Sport, Longitude, Limited and Trailhawk. The last one is the most offroad-capable version and has Jeep's "Trail Rated" badges, and comes with a Selec-Terrain system, 1-inch lift and a locking rear differential. Other available features include a park-assist system that gives you directions on how to park into a particular space, an 8.4-inch touchscreen with optional navigation and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with auto-braking, and more.

An all-new Chrysler 200 model debuted for 2015. It gets a new Alfa-Romeo based chassis and the new 9-speed automatic transmission. Under the hood, the new Chrysler 200 will have two engines to choose from. One will be a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and the other will be the 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 unit. The base 200 LX model comes with the cloth upholstery, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, cruise control and manual a/c. The mid-range 200 Touring model adds 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone auto a/c, leather-wrapped steering wheel, trip computer, power driver's seat and 6-speaker stereo, with available options such as remote start, sunroof and voice-controlled UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and hard-drive. The top 200 Limited model adds a V6 engine, exterior chrome trim, 18-inch alloys, auto up/down windows, auto-dimming rearview mirror and leather upholstery. All models get standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, alarm and a tyre-pressure monitoring system.

The Cadillac SRX aims more for road-going luxury than any sort of off-roading ability. There's a standard power rear liftgate, reduced step-over for easy exiting, stylish 17-inch and 18-inch wheels and an enhanced optional wood package, all of which signify its intentions. Bigger than a wagon but not quite a 4WD, the SRX is one of the rare vehicles that truly deserves the "crossover" designation. It uses GM's Sigma platform serving the Cadillac CTS. Engine choices are a 3.6-litre V6 and a 4.6-litre Northstar V8, both of which use a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. Both engine sizes can be optioned up to all-wheel-drive. Standard features include fog lights, heated mirrors, roof rack side rails, rear wiper/washer, 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather-wrapped wheel with controls for audio and voice recognition systems, express up/down on all windows, leather interior, eight-way power driver's seat, 60/40 folding rear seat, CD player with seven speakers, automatic headlamps, and rear parking assist. The V8 model adds driver's side auto-dimming exterior mirror, 18-inch aluminum wheels, CD changer and more. The SRX handles like a car rather than a lumpy 4WD, and the optional Magnetic Ride Control, which automatically adjusts the shocks to compensate for any road imperfections, makes it even smoother on the roads, where it belongs.

The Wrangler has been redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The all-new real jeep is longer and wider and more refined. Now powered by a 3.8-litre V6, with a manual or automatic, it still offers low-range gearing and off-road capability. In 2011, the interior was redesigned completely, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were offered. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The sister-model to the hotly-anticipated Toyota 86, the Subaru BRZ finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. In 2017, it got a minor facelift and other small handling tweaks. The BRZ is a collaborative effort with Toyota, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates, with only a front bumper different between the two. Usually available in only one trim level in most GCC markets, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. Depending on the dealer, standard features include cloth or leather sports seats, HID headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, auto a/c, common power accessories and 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. It additionally gets a limited-slip diff, paddle-shifters, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and and floor illumination. Specs may vary between different GCC countries, with most offering only the automatic version.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The second-generation Peugeot 308 went on sale in the GCC in 2015. The same  is turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, it got a slight facelift and interior upgrades. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The Epica is Chevrolet's attempt at the lower end of the midsize car market, considering the Lumina is handling the slightly higher market that is occupied by the Accord and the Camry. Launched as part of a trio with the Aveo and the Optra for 2004, it is built by GM Daewoo in Korea on a front-wheel-drive platform. The car received a restyle for 2007 and maintains the traditional sedan three-box profile instead of being over-tall like the Camry, so it looks good from far away, though its details are derivative. The interior is fairly spacious considering its price. The cabin is well-designed with plenty of convenient storage spaces, while instruments and controls are well-placed. Two engines are on offer, namely a small 2.0-litre six-cylinder that works well but is fairly underpowered, and a 2.5-litre six-cylinder that has more power but only matches four-cylinder motors from Japanese midsizers. The optional four-speed automatic transmission is smooth, while a manual gearbox is also offered for that last bit of fuel efficiency. Front airbags and ABS brakes are available. The Epica competes well in a segment that only sees action from the Koreans.

The Changan CS35 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering, currently being sold only in a few GCC countries. Under the hood of the CS35 is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB/CD support, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, parking sensors, fog lamps and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get sunroof, leather wrapped steering wheel and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features on the car include ABS, electronic brake distribution and brake assist, and front driver & passenger airbags, while higher models get side curtain airbags.

JAC J4 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact offering. Under the hood is a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features for the J4 include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, keyless entry, fog lamps, AM/FM radio with USB, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Safety features include dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Ignis is categorized as a supermini by the Europeans, but we see it as something a little bigger and, as Suzuki claims, a little more of a 4WD wagon alternative for hauling purposes. The Ignis was facelifted for 2006, but the model had reached its last year in the GCC. Alloy wheels and foglamps are standard. Inside, all five seats provide decent space and comfort as well as firm support. The front seats slide and recline, and the driver's seat is fitted with a height adjuster. Interior amenities include door trim pockets, bottle holders on all doors, cup holders, a glove box, under-dash storage space, a front-seat back pocket, a 12-volt accessory socket, a centre console, a storage tray under the front passenger seat and more. The Ignis lives with a 1.3-litre engine with variable valve timing, and a five-speed manual gearbox is standard, while a four-speed automatic transmission is available as an option. Safety features include numerous airbags and active safety head restraints for the driver and front seat passenger.

The Rio is Kia's sub-compact nameplate that started life in 2000. It can always be depended on for the most unique exterior designs in this segment. This generation of the Rio debuted in 2006 and received a minor frontal facelift in 2010, before being replaced in 2012. The interior offers decent space for its size, although the cabin is a hard plastic tomb, like most others in its class. Powered by a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive runabout comes in either sedan or hatchback body styles. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, battery saver, wind-up windows and AM/FM radio cassette player. Higher models add a few items, such as body-coloured outer trimmings and power windows, along with electric mirrors, front fog lamps, driver's seat height adjustability, luggage undertray and central door locks. We could not verify what safety features are available besides seat belts, although we believe many markets get ABS brakes and front airbags, standard or otherwise.

The 2015 Legacy is the sixth-generation model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive sedan. Like all Subaru models for more than a decade, the Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and gets an entirely new design for 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic or 3.6-litre flat 6-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Later in 2017, a 6.6-litre V12 engine was added to the lineup with all-wheel drive, called the M760Li. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. In 2017, an Aventador S model was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

The Lincoln MKX got an all-new model for 2016. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, it gets a standard 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the higher models get a turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

The Dodge Durango was completely redesigned in 2011. Mildly facelifted for 2014 with a whole lot of LED lighting, the three-row crossover SUV is based on a stretched Jeep platform. In 2018, a Durango SRT model was introduced in the lineup but it only made it to the GCC in 2020. Under the hood, the Durango SRT gets a 6.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include tri-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, power windows, electric mirrors, built-in rechargeable torch, cargo cover, fog lamps, automatic headlights, hill-start assist and keyless entry, LED running lamps, leather steering wheel, remote start, front power seats with memory, Bluetooth, navigation, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, 9-speaker stereo with subwoofer, power liftgate, rear parking sensors, tyre pressure display, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, and rear-view camera, 20-inch wheels, power-adjustable steering wheel, heated first and second-row seats, HID headlights, sports suspension, rain-sensitive wipers, sunroof, blindspot monitor & cross-path detection, forward collision warning and adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, rain brake support, anti-theft alarm, active headrests and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Traverse is a crossover wagon that combines car-like handling with the utility of a 4WD wagon, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Lamborghini Urus is the Italian brand's SUV offering. As has long been the tradition at Lamborghini, the name Urus is derived from the world of bulls. The Urus is powered by a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The Lamborghini Urus adopts the rear-wheel steering introduced in the Aventador S over the whole speed range. The rear steering angle varies up to +/- 3.0 degrees, according to vehicle speed and driving mode selected: at low speeds the rear-axle steering angle is opposite to that of the front wheels (counter-phase steering), effectively shortening the wheelbase up to 600 mm for increased agility and a reduced turning circle for increased maneuverability. At high speeds the rear axle steering angle is in the same direction as the front wheels (in-phase steering), elongating the wheelbase up to 600 mm for increased stability and ride comfort as well as optimum driving dynamics. An optional Off-Road Package includes specific metal-reinforced bumpers and additional underfloor protection for off-roading in snow, forest or even dune surfing. The standard front DNA memory sport seats are fully electric, heated and 12-way adjustable. More luxurious, 18-way fully-electric front seats are available as an option, including features such as ventilation and massage. The rear bench seat as standard comes with a movable and folding seat back and ISOFIX fixings. Providing a five-seat configuration, the ability to fold and move the rear seat offers increased luggage capacity for daily use. The rear bench seat can be lowered to substantially extend the trunk space from 616 liters to 1.596 liters. As an option in conjunction with the fully-electric front seats, a more exclusive two-seat rear layout can be specified. The Lamborghini Smartphone Interface (LSI) allows fully integrated connection of iOS (Apple) and Android (Google) smartphones, supporting the Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The cabin is replete with high quality materials including the finest leather, Alcantara, aluminum, carbon-fibre and wood. The Lamborghini Urus Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) systems provide safety, security and driving assistance on level 2 (SAE scale). A High Beam Assistant automatically fades headlights in and out of high beam mode as required; front and rear parking sensors and cruise control are also included as standard, as is the PreCognition system preventing or mitigating collision. Optional ADAS systems include traffic management systems, top-view camera and a trailer coupling mode.

The Chinese Chery Tiggo received a makeover for its 2016 model year and a rebranding to Tiggo 3, while also making it the second facelift for this aging crossover. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, it comes with a CVT automatic now. The five-door five-seater Tiggo 3 gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling.

The Cadenza near-luxury full-size sedan is part of the Korean manufacturer's revamped range, and among the first Kia models to feature the new corporate design theme. The conservative-yet-handsome front-wheel-drive sedan replaces the Opirus, and comes with a new 3.5-litre V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox with manual shift capability. Features, standard or otherwise, include a CD/MP3 stereo with six JBL speakers and iPod/USB support, 6-disc CD changer, cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes.

An all-new Cadillac CT4 made its debut in 2020, replacing the ATS. In the GCC, the CT4 gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission, while a CT4-V model gets a 2.7-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine with a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the CT4 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE entertainment system with BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

Mercedes-Maybach S-Class sees the return of the "Maybach" brand. The S600 Maybach is being sold in the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include a full panoramic sunroof, powered privacy shades for the rear windows, acres of leather trim, night-vision display in the LCD gauge-cluster, chrome-plated speaker grilles, fibre-optic ambient lighting, Burmester 3D surround sound, and back-lit tweeters on all the doors that spiral out on start-up, although these things can even be had in a standard S-Class, if you tick everything on the options list. The lounge-worthy rear seats both offer a full range of power adjustability, and includes extending calf-supports, a massaging function, heated/cooled cup-holders and a seat heating/cooling feature, while the right-side rear seat gets an additional footrest that can be motored out of the front passenger seatback for sleeping. It's so intricate that the dual LCD screens on the front seat-backs automatically adjust their angles as the front seats are adjusted, so the rear passengers always get the best view. The massage and multimedia features are controlled with a remote, with animated settings showing on the screens. Its "Magic Body Control" system that scans the road ahead for bumps and adjusts the suspension to drive over them as smoothly as possible. Further options include flip-out tray-tables and a fridge that comes with a pair of silver-plated champagne flute-glasses as well as space for three chilled bottles. Along with the front and side airbags, ABS, traction control, the Mercedes-Maybach can be added with PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, Brake Assist BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Night View Assist Plus. In the shape of the seat belt buckle extender, Beltbag (both part of the PRE-SAFE rear package) and seat cushion airbag.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. From 2017, a derivation of the GTC4Lusso, namely the GTC4Lusso T was offered. The GTC4Lusso T differentiates itself from the GTC4Lusso with a rear-wheel-drive layout, and being powered by Ferrari’s 3.9-litre V8 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission, whilst retaining the electronic rear differential and all-wheel-steering system. Other features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128GB in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays and more.

The Hyundai Kona is a sub-compact crossover with no offroad abilities whatsoever, although it sports black plastic cladding and half-baked roof rails to imitate it. Powered by either a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic or a turbocharged 1.6-litre with a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic, both 4-cylinder and with either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, the Kona seems to rival the company's own Creta crossover. Available features include LED running lights and tail lights, alloy wheels, cruise control, and an LCD multimedia touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB and all that. Safety features include at least 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP and a tyre-pressure monitor. It has a 5-star EuroNCAP crash-test rating, but only when equipped with side airbags in full-option trim.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 3.0-litre diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

After more than a decade with minimal changes, the Nissan Patrol has been redesigned from the ground up, aiming to regain some of the market-share lost to its rivals. The all-new Patrol can be optioned up with enough features to classify it as a full-fledged luxury vehicle, with some class-leading features and new technology. Engine options include a base 5.6-litre V8 with a 5-speed automatic and later with a base 6-speed manual, known as the Patrol SE; as well as a brand-new 5.6-litre V8 with more power, direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top trims get a slightly-lower 'city' bumper. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems. The previous version of the Patrol continued to be on sale alongside this new model during 2010, as a basic offroader. However, the new model is so popular that buyers put down hefty deposits before performance specs were even released.

An all-new model of the Toyota Camry made its debut in 2018 in the GCC. The 2020 Toyota Camry has three engine choices - a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic transmission, a 3.5-litre V6 coupled to an 8-speed automatic transmission and 2.5-litre hybrd engine connected to a CVT. The 2020 Toyota Camry base model has 16-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 17-inch and 18-inch alloys. Base features, depending on the market, include a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags, as standard. The upper trims offer dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, stability control, side airbags, sunroof, DVD navigation, smart keyless start and navigation. In the UAE, the Sport variant gets a body kit, quad exhaust tips, paddle shifters and unique seats.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. An all-new model came out in 2016, now with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under its hood, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, push start button, chrome grille, parking sensors, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port. Safety features include front airbags for both driver and passenger, and stability control.

For 2017, the Mercedes-Benz SLK-Class was renamed to SLC-Class. It received a significant facelift, along with engine and interior upgrades. No changes were made for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre engine with two different tunes, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment include automatic engine start/stop function, driver and passenger front airbags, ABS, acceleration skid control(ASR), electronic stability control (ESP), cruise control and radio with AUX/USB support. Optional extras include steering wheel with shift paddles, parking sensors, LED daytime running lights, rain sensor, headlamp cleaning system, Harmon Kardon surround sound system, navigation, memory seats and AMG bodykits.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

The Canadian-built MKX is the Lincoln-badged version of the Ford Edge, an all-new soft-roader that debuted for the 2007 model year. The Edge features a car-derived platform, a raked windshield, a fast-sloping back window, a high-mounted rear spoiler, a high beltline and standard 18-inch alloy wheels. The interior features seating for five and cargo space can be maximized when the rear seats are folded. The Edge is powered by a new 3.5-liter V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available with an intelligent all-wheel-drive system in the GCC, the MKX is not equipped with low-range gearing. The interior features a center console that can fit a laptop computer and a number of standard features including leather upholstery, a panoramic Vista Roof, rear DVD screen, an MP3 audio jack and six-way power-adjustable front seats.
