Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, seat-mounted side airbags and Safety Canopy air curtain system with rollover detection and side-curtain airbags.

The Ford Mustang has become an icon since the first one was introduced in 1964. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, with big power and low price. For 2010, the Mustang is no more the most powerful or the most affordable, but it does continue the retro styling theme introduced in 2005. It is hard to spot the differences between the previous model and this newer one, but the Mustang continues to ride on a rear-wheel-drive platform with live-axle rear suspension. However, improvements have apparently been made to the entire mechanical package. For 2010, only the Mustang GT was officially sold in the GCC, with an upgraded 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed automatic. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, 18-inch to 19-inch aluminium wheel choices, power mirrors, 8-speaker "Shaker 500" CD/MP3 stereo with a six-disc changer, standard SYNC multimedia system with Bluetooth, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, variable "MyColor" gauge illumination, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe.

The Tesla Model X is a fully electric midsize crossover SUV, which combines high performance and zero emission. The available variants from 2018 are 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. All variants come in all-wheel-drive configuration, and with seating for up to seven if optioned up with two booster seats in the boot. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, falcon-wing rear doors, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate, 19-inch alloy wheels, and air suspension. Optional equipment include enhanced autopilot, complete self-driving capability, auto-opening front doors, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system, up to 22-inch alloy wheels, and a towing package including a steel tow bar and a 2-inch hitch receiver. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features include traffic-aware cruise control, auto steer and auto park.

The Kyron is this Korean carmaker's entry into the hotly-contested traditional soft-roader category, only they do it with a real 4WD using truck underpinnings and low-range gearing. Two adults will have no trouble fitting in either front or second row. Behind them is plenty of room for their luggage too. The bench seat also folds down nearly flat to accommodate big, awkward loads like bicycles. The weak part is the 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. The drive system offers a choice of two-wheel drive, four-wheel high, or four-wheel low. The suspension utilizes double wishbones at the front and a multilink design at the rear. Available electronic aids include ABS, hill descent control, traction control, and brake assist. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags.

The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe was launched as a 2015 model year. It received a slight facelift in 2018. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 430i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 440i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Lincoln MKS is an all-new full-size luxury sedan produced by Ford's upscale division, continuing the brand's confusing new letter-based naming system. And although it can be considered the marque's technological flagship sedan, it still falls behind leaders in the wider market. For starters, it is based on a front-wheel-drive platform shared with the Ford Taurus. But while this can be overlooked thanks to all-wheel-drive being standard on all GCC-spec models, the main engine for this full-sizer is a new 3.7-litre V6, instead of a V8. It rides on fully-independent suspension and 20-inch polished aluminium wheels. Features include a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, keyless entry and start, adaptive cruise control, SYNC voice-activated multimedia system, Bluetooth, rain-sensing windshield wipers, a rearview camera system, front and rear park assist, a THX sound system with full 5.1 surround sound, vented power seats, sunroof, HID headlights, LED taillamps, wood and leather interior trim, and Ford's capless fuel-filler system. Safety features include standard front, side and curtain airbags, stability control and ABS brakes.

The Magna was an all-new model back in 1997, replacing Mitsubishi's Sigma as their top-of-the-line sedan. Competing in the near-luxury segment against upscale brands, it never stood a chance, but soldiered on anyway unchanged right up to 2003, at which point it got a facelift. The Magna features a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine, a 4-speed automatic gearbox, a modern-at-the-time dashboard, decent suspension tuning and improvements in body structure that promise fair handling. Offered only as a sedan, the fairly-large Magna rode on a front-wheel-drive platform, and didn't overlap with the more-popular Galant, which was originally in between a compact and a midsize at that time. The Magna was available in essentially two flavours, namely a standard model and a sportier VR-X version. The Magna VR-X upgrades include a mesh grille, colour-keyed rear spoiler, aerodynamic side skirts, wheel lip moldings, sport-style bucket seats, unique seat fabric, and possibly sportier suspension tuning with slightly-increased engine power. Standard features on this redesigned sedan include dual airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, tinted glass, a power driver seat, an AM/FM stereo with cassette and CD player, remote keyless entry, optional leather, optional ABS and a security system. A minor facelift came for 2000, before the major one in 2004.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The RCZ is a racy sports car built on the 308 hatchback's foundations, but featuring a futuristic coupe body. This front-wheel-drive 2-door can be had with a turbocharged 1.6-litre mated to either a 6-speed manual or automatic, but the manual THP200 version is tuned much more power than the automatic THP156 model. Standard features include 19-inch alloy wheels, active rear spoiler, electric leather sports seats with memory, leather dashboard, cruise control with speed limiter, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/iPod connectivity, Bluetooth phone, auto dual-zone a/c, cooled glove box, electric mirrors with automatic-tilting on reverse, power windows, auto-dimming rear-view mirrors, automatic wipers, auto headlights, keyless entry, puncture repair kit, front and rear parking aid with screen display, and aluminium pedals. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, front and rear fog lights, and hill-start assist on the manual version. The manual THP200 also has slightly sportier suspension tuning, some shorter gearing and bigger front brakes.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The Honda Accord has been updated for the 2017 model year, essentially switching to the American version again and sporting a facelift. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with direct injection, mated to a CVT, available in the DX and LX. The EX and EXL trim get slightly more horsepower and torque. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. Standard features on the 2.4 DX model include electric power steering, power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows and mirrors, LED front running lamps and tail lights, 16-inch steel wheels, manual a/c, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, cruise control, cloth upholstery, ABS, floor mats, stability control and hill-start assist, as does all other trim levels. The LX model gets additional sunroof, dual-zone A/C, 17-inch aluminium wheels, and a touchscreen control panel for multimedia functions. The 2.4 EX sedan further adds front fog lights, power-folding mirrors, Bluetooth, dual exhaust tips, leather seats, leather steering wheel, power rear sunshade, smart keyless entry and start, auto-dimming mirror, rear parking sensors and a power driver's seat. The 2.4 EX sedan can be upgraded with navigation, rear camera, "i-Dual" a/c, 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, USB/AUX ports, and a power-adjustable passenger seat. The 3.5 EX sedan adds the V6 engine and transmission, wooden steering wheel, rear-side window sunshades, full LED headlights, and a new feature called "LaneWatch" that adds a camera under the right-side mirror to visually monitor your right blindspot. The 3.5 Sport sedan additionally gets 18-inch alloys, little paddle-shifters, and leather steering. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips. All trim levels get front, side and side curtain aribags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA) and traction control system.

Launched here in 2005 and facelifted in 2007, the Scorpio is the first Indian consumer vehicle to grace Middle East roads since the disastrous Padmini. Unlike the Fiat-derived outdated Padmini, this 4WD wagon is mostly an original inhouse design and arguably more modern, though not quite up to current standards. Yet, it is good enough to win multiple Indian "Car of the Year" awards. This Mahindra & Mahindra product is available here only in top trim, complete with leather seats, possibly fake wood trim, power windows, central locking, power steering, keyless entry, CD stereo and rear a/c vents. It was restyled lightly for 2007. Interesting features include a low-range transfer case, seating for seven and a Renault-derived engine. However, this 2.0-litre four-cylinder is too weak to move a compact car, let alone this heavyweight 4WD. And even in top trim, there is an obvious lack of safety features other than its perceived bulk. Five of the seven passengers manage with seat belts only, with nothing for the last two inward-facing seats.

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

Looking like an exotic sports car, but based on more conservative roots, the striking Mitsubishi Eclipse officially debuted for the 2009 model year in the GCC for the first time, after years of grey imports. This version of the Eclipse has actually been around in American markets for years now, and what the GCC gets is the facelifted version with a new grille. Under the hood, the new-for-2009 Eclipse comes with either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Both engines MIVEC variable valve timing, while all automatics feature a Sportronic mode to allow manual gearshifts. Safety includes standard advances dual-stage front airbags, seat-mounted side airbags and front seat curtain side airbags. Available cabin features, depending on trim, include a CD/MP3 stereo with changer and subwoofer, power windows, keyless entry, electric mirrors, split-folding rear seatbacks, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power-adjustable seats, sunroof, digital a/c and a two-tone interior. Mitsubishi has made the 650W Rockford Fosgate audio system with 9 speakers a standard fitment on all Eclipse trims. All models are equipped with front-wheel-drive, four-wheel disc brakes, ABS and electronic brake-force distribution. The V6-powered Eclipse GT features larger ventilated rear discs and standard 18-inch alloy wheels.

The Jaguar E-Pace sub-compact crossover slots in under the F-Pace in its lineup. It is based on a front-wheel-drive platform, but comes standard with all-wheel-drive and a choice of two turbocharged 2.0-litre "Ingenium" engines and a 9-speed automatic. A Jaguar Touch Pro infotainment system comes standard with a 10-inch capacitive touchscreen system. It offers 4G connectivity, 8 WiFi hotspots and a bunch of apps. The instrument panel is a 12.3-inch TFT unit which is coupled with a heads-up display. The rear offers 577 litres of space with the seats up. The E-Pace will be available in two flavours, a standard model and the R-Design model. On top of this, three specification packs are offered along with a bunch of options.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013 and getting more power in 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The twin-turbochared 5.5-litre V8 G63 AMG is fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Porsche Panamera received a facelift for its 2014 model, as well as some engine updates and introduction of new variants. The 'Gran Turismo' has expanded to a confusing 10 different versions now, not including the Turbo S which will return later. This includes the base Panamera,  Panamera Diesel, Panamera 4, Panamera S, Panamera 4S, Panamera 4S Executive, Panamera S E-Hybrid, Panamera GTS, Panamera Turbo and Panamera Turbo Executive. All come with a 7-speed PDK automanual gearbox except for the S E-Hybrid which gets an 8-speed automatic, while the 4 V6, 4S and Turbo feature all-wheel-drive. The base 3.6-litre V6 model can also be had with a 6-speed manual. The Panamera S is no more a V8 and has been replaced with a more fuel-efficient and faster V6 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine. The Panamera GTS still has the 4.8-litre V8 engine. Also newly introduced is the S E-Hybrid model which gets a V6 supercharged 3.0-litre engine combined with an electric motor. The Panamera Diesel also seems to have been introduced for the UAE market for the first time, featuring a turbocharged V6 3.0-litre engine. The 'Executive' models are 150 mm longer wheelbase than the standard size. All versions come with Porsche's new fuel-saving start-stop function. Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM) is a standard feature on the Turbo and an option on the Panamera S and 4S, with adjustable damping for the adaptive air suspension. In the Sport Plus Mode, the Panamera is lowered by 25 mm. The Panamera comes on 18-inch and 19-inch wheels, with 20-inch aluminium wheels available as an option. Available on the Panamera Turbo is an active adjustable rear spoiler. The four-seater Panamera boasts a unique leather-draped interior, with four sports seats and useable cargo room. Optional is a four-zone automatic a/c with individual adjustments for each seat. The Panamera S and 4S come with the "CDR" stereo as standard, while the Turbo is equipped with "PCM" multimedia computer, with navigation optional on the other two models. As an option, rear passengers can enjoy two consoles integrated in the headrests of the front seats with swivelling 7-inch touchscreens. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG has been completely redesigned, in line with the rest of the S-Class range. It is still motivated by a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, but produces more power than its predecessor. The engine can be coupled with rear-wheel-drive or an AMG-tuned 4Matic all-wheel-drive system, as well as an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 7-speed automatic transmission. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. There's also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. It rides on optional 19-inch or 20-inch light-weight alloys too. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The DTS is the new name for the Deville. The change is mostly to bring it in line with the company's new policy of naming its car models with letters. The DTS is the only remaining front-wheel-drive car in Cadillac's fleet. It comes in a single line that is stepped up with available options, such as Xenon headlamps, LED taillamps, six standard airbags including a dual-depth front passenger airbag, a factory-installed remote start with personalization feature, and an in-dash, six-CD changer with MP3 player. The DTS comes with a 275 hp Northstar V8 engine that can be optioned up to a version that makes 291 hp. A four-speed Hydra-Matic transmission is the sole choice. Features on the DTS include dual-firmness seats, four-channel anti-lock brakes with traction control, StabiliTrak and brake assist, Magnetic Ride Control, 17-inch wheels, heated and cooled front seats, heated rear seats, heated steering wheel, tri-zone climate control, heated windshield washer nozzles, power folding outside mirrors, and front and rear park assist. In the face of its sportier siblings, the DTS seems stodgy, but it's still powerful, and extremely comfortable. Not being rear-wheel-drive hinders it from being a true luxury contender.

The Kia Picanto, one of the few superminis available in the GCC, underwent a complete redesign for 2012, increasing slightly in size to improve interior space. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. Only the base model can be had with a 5-speed manual, while the three higher trims get a 4-speed automatic. Features, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 14-inch or 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control with "˜welcome and escort' modes, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Safety features, available only on the top model, includes ABS and one airbag.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year. It can be had in many variants, including in Sport GT and Executive GT trims. All models have the 4.2-litre V8 engine that powers the Coupe and Spyder, and come with either a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual and, for the luxury model only, a true six-speed automatic. The standard Quattroporte model has all the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The Sport GT adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals. The exhaust has been tuned to provide a deeper rumble, and other changes include uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts. The Quattroporte Executive GT model is recognizable by its chrome grille and air intakes, and is equipped with heating, ventilation and massage for rear passengers, retractable wood rear tables, alcantara roof lining, a leather-trimmed steering wheel with wood inserts and a climate control panel for the rear seat passengers. The new Quattroporte Automatic model is fitted with an automatic six-speed ZF gearbox for more casual driving.

An all-new Ford Figo came out as a 2016 model year. It is now available as a 4-door sedan and a 5-door hatchback and features a new exterior design. Under the hood are two 4-cylinder engine options; a 1.2-litre unit mated to a 5-speed manual transmission and a 1.5-litre motor mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente and Trend trims, both getting cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include manual windows, power mirrors, 2-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, soft-touch dashboard and a manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 14-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, fog lamps, ABS brakes, front power windows and height-adjustable driver's seat.

The Nissan GT-R carries on after it got a facelift inside and out for 2017, with more focus on comfort. It is still a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. The GT-R gets the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive. In 2017, it received a facelift and further power was added. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Safey-wise, the car include six airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control, electronic brakeforce distribution and seatbelts with pretensioners.

The GAC Trumpchi GA3 is a compact sedan manufactured in China. It is based on the Alfa Romeo 166 platform. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the GA3 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB port, 4 speakers, steel wheels, halogen headlamps, dual front airbags, ABS and EBD. Higher models get sunroof, cruise control, leather seats, CD player with 6 speakers, parking sensors, fog lamps, automatic A/C, power seats, alloy wheels, occupant detection sensors and ESP.

The 5th-generation 3-Series was introduced in 2006 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2009. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. A base 316i sedan-only model debuted in 2011, with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo, optional sunroof, and a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The VW GTI received a minor facelift for 2017 which included new bumpers, new LED headlights, new LED taillights and new wheels. The 3-door model was being sold again in the GCC market. Under the hood, it is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine and having a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed DSG automanual gearboxes. It features a body kit with a built-in rear diffuser and wider side sills. Compared to the regular Golf, the GTI also rides on 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with lower suspension. Inside it gets sportier seats, steering wheel and pedals than the standard Golf. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, USB/auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, optional sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, common power accessories and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. For 2016, a limited edition 40th anniversary Clubsport variant was released with a more powerful engine and a revised bodykit. Along with the DSG gearbox, a 6-speed manual transmission was offered later on for the Clubsport.

The Ford Mustang received a GT500-inspired facelift for 2013, along with a few mild tweaks. All Ford Mustang models get a new front-end with revised lower air intakes and a new splitter. HID headlights are now standard on all versions, while GT models get a new bonnet with functional air extractors as well as optional HID foglamps. New body-coloured side-skirts and rear lower bumper as well as new 17-inch, 18-inch and 19-inch wheels are also available. There is now a high-gloss black panel in the rear between the redesigned taillamps. The side mirrors have LED lamps in them that project the Mustang pony logo onto the ground when the doors are unlocked. New colours include new shades of green and blue. The 5.0-litre V8 engine also receives a slight increase in horsepower. The Mustang is offered in coupe, convertible and glass-roof versions. The convertible will only be sold with an automatic transmission. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, power mirrors, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe.

The Nissan Patrol Nismo debuted in the GCC in 2016 and gets a whole host of upgrades. The 5.6-litre V8 engine has been upgraded to produce slightly more power. The exterior gets a bodykit which includes Nismo sports headlights, 22-inch forged-alloy wheels, chrome-plated radiator grille, front and rear sports bumpers. The interior gets a sportier design for the leather upholstery with Nismo logos. The suspension has been upgraded with Nismo-tuned Bilstein shock absorbers. The rest of the features you will find similar to the Patrol Platinum edition which includes Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The Chevrolet Corvette C6 is the most capable Corvette ever. The LS2 V8 powerplant has grown to 6.2 litres for 2008, with power and torque that is killer at the track and useable in regular driving. The standard tranny is an updated 6-speed manual gearbox, while a new 6-speed automatic with paddles is optional since 2007. The steering is improved for 2008. Large 18-inch wheels at the front and 19-inch at the rear and exposed headlamps with fixed Xenon HID lights continue to define the Corvette. Available as a hatchback coupe with a lift-off roof panel or as a convertible with a fabric soft-top and heated glass rear window, while a power top is also available, as are optional magnetic shocks and a two-mode exhaust. The new race-bred Corvette Z06 packs a massive 7.0-litre V8 engine, and comes in manual coupe form only, offering performance that rivals Ferrari. In 2009, the Corvette ZR1 was launched, with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 and 6-speed manual, along with various upgrades such as some carbon-fibre body panels, stiffer suspension, bigger brakes and more. The Corvette's only letdown is the less-than-stellar interior, although GM makes up for it with gadgets such as keyless start, button-actuated door opening and a heads-up display. Other available features include touchscreen navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, power seats, front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, leather and more. Previously, a Z51 package was available for the base Corvette with upgraded suspension, close-ratio manual gearbox and other mods, but from 2010, a Grand Sport version based on the regular model replaced that package with similar mods derived from the Z06.

The redesigned-for-2011 Chrysler 300C looks similar to the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but in reality has many major changes, including a sharper-sloping windshield and a lower belt-line for better visibility. The new 300C thankfully remains rear-wheel-drive and features updated suspension, upgraded engine and a much nicer interior. The new 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual capability, debuted in 2012. The base model gets cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. Higher trim levels additionally come with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with a 5-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. Standard features include cruise control, 18-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inch wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry with starter button. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The top model, the 300C SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The C4 Picasso is a modern replacement for the oddball Xsara Picasso. Based on the C4 compact platform, it is a tall stylish minivan-type vehicle that drives like a car and has the practicality of a big 4WD. It seats only five, and the larger seven-seater Grand Picasso is not offered here. When all five seats are up, has 500 litres of boot space underneath the luggage cover, extending to a maximum 1,734 litres once the rear seats are folded down. Only two 4-cylinder engines are offered, one a 1.8-litre and one a 2.0-litre, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes that vary by model. According to trim level, the metal suspension can be replaced with pneumatic suspension on the rear axle on 2.0-litre models. CitroÃ«n has paid close attention to achieving the best levels of acoustic comfort and vibration control, as well as a new air-conditioning system. Its cloth-lined cabin can be outfitted with a variety of options, such as a panoramic glass roof, high-quality stereo system and folding video screens in the back of the front seats. The C4 Picasso has four Isofix seat tethers, audible seatbelt warnings for all seats and seven airbags as standard. Automatic electronic parking brake and Hill Start Assist are also fitted as standard.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Citroen DS3 is the smallest car offered in the GCC from the French brand. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. The exterior can be had in contrasting body and roof colours, with many different colour combinations available for customers. The standard features on the "So Chic" DS3 variant include power windows, power steering, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, automatic A/C, cruise control, scented air-freshner, interior mood lighting, stereo radio with MP3/AUX/CD compatibility, steering mounted controls, LED daytime-running lights, chrome door handles, sports suspension and 16-inch alloy wheels. The "Ultra Prestige" trim-level gets a rear spoiler with integrated brake-lamp, double chrome exhaust tips, side-impact chrome bar, roof-coloured wing mirror, front and rear carpet mats, aluminium drilled pedals, navigation system, automatic headlamps and wipers, rear-parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), emergency braking assistance, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), driver, front passenger, front lateral and curtain airbags and, front seat belt pre-tensioners with force-limiters.

The Tesla Model S is a fully electric sedan, which combines high performance and zero emission. Currently the variants available are 60, 75, 90, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth, and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include air suspension, self-driving capability, enhanced autopilot, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features feature traffic-aware cruise control, autosteer and autopark.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The MG 5 is the Chinese-owned brand's compact segment offering. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, infotainment system with Android Auto, Apple Carplay and Bluetooth, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats,sunroof, rear parking sensor and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The Kia Picanto, one of the few superminis available in the GCC, underwent a complete redesign for 2012, increasing slightly in size to improve interior space. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. Only the base model can be had with a 5-speed manual, while the three higher trims get a 4-speed automatic. Features, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 14-inch or 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control with "˜welcome and escort' modes, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Safety features, available only on the top model, includes ABS and one airbag.

The Audi Q3 is the German manufacturer's 'baby SUV' offering. It got a facelift for the 2015 model year. There are three engine options, namely the turbocharged 1.4-litre with a 6-speed automatic, and two tunes of the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged powerplant mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and "Quattro" all-wheel drive. The Q3 gets a lot of the standard features in the base model such as automatic xenon headlamps, LED rear lights, 17-inch alloy rims, automatic air-conditioning, 8-speaker audio system, AUX-IN port, front and side airbags, hill-start assist and ESC. The higher spec model gets hill-hold assist, parking sensors, driver information system, Bluetooth and cruise control.

The Toyota Avanza debuted in the GCC as a 2015 model year. The rear-wheel drive Avanza, which is actually a rebadged Daihatsu, is a reasonably priced seven-seater minivan. Only the 1.5-litre engine will be offered in this region. It comes either with a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. In the UAE, an SE model is offered which features automatic transmission, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, A/C with rear vents, fabric seats, audio entertainment system with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support, audio controls on steering wheel, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. In Saudi Arabia, the same specs is sold as an XL model. The fleet spec model gets a manual transmission, 14-inch steel wheels, and does not get the fog lamps, mud guards, steering controls and chrome linings in the exterior. On the safety side it gets standard dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

An all-new Skoda Octavia came out in 2014 in the GCC. It got a facelift for the 2018 model. Compared to its predecessor, the Octavia has grown significantly in length and width. The new model is 90 mm longer and 45 mm wider than the second-generation Skoda Octavia. At the same time, the wheelbase has grown by 108 mm, mainly benefiting the interior and space on the rear seats. In 2017, there are two 4-cylinder turbocharged engines to choose from, the 1.4-litre and the 1.8-litre, both mated to a 7-speed DSG gearbox. The base Octavia Ambition model comes with 16-inch steel wheels, fabric interior, rear mud flaps, automatic A/C, electric adjustable, heated & foldable door mirrors, electric windows, parking sensors, radio with CD player and MP3 support,  4 speakers, remote central locking, fog lights and front & side front airbags. The Octavia Style model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, leather interior, chrome package, cruise control, Apply connectivity, mobile device interface (MDI), electric seats, sunroof and xenon headlamps. The Octavia RS gets 19-inch alloy wheels, carbon-fibre inlays for dashboard and door panels, boot spoiler, red brake calipers, sports suspension, Bluetooth and Apple connectivity.

The Chevrolet Aveo hatchback is the American brand's sub-compact offering built in Korea. An all-new model came out in 2017. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Two trim levels are on offer - LS and LT. The LS gets steering wheel controls, Bluetooth, radio and phone handsfree controls, driver and passenger dual air bags, front power windows, 4-way driver seat adjuster, rear park assist, rear seat full folding, 40/60 split, front fog lamps and optional 15-inch alloy wheels. The LT trim gets additional 7-inch MyLinkTM screen with phone integration, 6 speakers and 15-inch alloy wheels.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Cruze gets a minor facelift for the 2016 model. The front-wheel-drive compact features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a rare 5-speed manual or a common 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. The Chevrolet 'My Link' infotainment system is also available in higher models, which includes a 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth and USB port. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

The Hyundai Azera fills the gap between the mid-size Sonata and the luxury Genesis sedan. It has been completely overhauled for the 2018 model year. The new Azera, known as Grandeur in Korea, comes with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2021, it got a significant facelift to align itself with the new corporate design first seen in the 2020 Sonata. Features in the 2022 Hyundai Azera include smart keyless entry with starter button, mood lighting, available panoramic sunroof, fake wood trim, rear sunshade, Apple Carplay system with Smartphone mirroring, premium analogue clock, auto-dimming mirror, electric parking brake with auto hold, leather powered seats, fog lamps, and parking sensors. Optional features in higher trims include xenon lights, memory and seat massage for driver, heating & cooling for front seats, electric tilt & telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth, tyre pressure monitoring system, electric folding mirrors, adaptive cruise control, rain sensor, dual-zone a/c, and a DVD Navigation system with rear camera. Safety features include up to 8 airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre. Next are three supercharged 1.8-litre engines, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon, also depending on model year. The 2.6-litre is also available, as is a 3.2-litre, both V6. The V6 models can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The supercharged 3.2-litre C 32 AMG comes in sedan form only, as the wagon wasn't offered here. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers were hesitant to bring any over. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

An all-new Subaru Outback came out in 2015. The base Outback 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 3.6R, with a turbocharged 3.6-litre 6-cylinder boxer engine mated to a CVT automatic as well. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Cadillac XTS debuted in late 2012 as a new flagship, replacing the STS as well as the DTS. By 2018, the XTS became a budget alternative to the CT6 that is selling well in some markets, so Cadillac has updated it with new front and rear designs, an updated infotainment system and more comfortable seats. Based on a front-wheel-drive Chevrolet platform, the XTS is powered by a 3.6-litre direct-injection V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. It comes with a electronically-controlled limited-slip differential, adjustable suspension and Brembo brakes, with standard 20-inch wheels. For 2014, a V-Sport model with a turbocharged 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive joined the range. Features include leather upholstery, configurable 12.3-inch LCD display, latest CUE multimedia system, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, HID headlights, smart keyless entry/start and all the usual power accessories, with further available features such as heads-up display, adaptive cruise control. Safety features include multiple airbags, lane departure warning, collision alert, safety alert seat, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert and available automatic emergency braking.

The Suburban, alongside the shorter Tahoe, has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Suburban and Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Suburban, with better fuel economy to boot, but a bigger 6.0-litre V8 is available. The 5.3-litre's aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. The 6.0-litre V8 gets a 6-speed automatic. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Suburban is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The eight-seater Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, so it offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The 308 is a completely new version of the outgoing 307, and is available in 3-door and 5-door versions, both in hatchback trim. The 308 SW wagon debuted in 2009, while a hard-top convertible 308 CC model came in 2010. Two 1.6-litre engines were initially available, one naturally-aspirated and one turbocharged. The CC came only with the turbo engine. All versions come with an automatic gearbox, with only the basic 5-door non-turbo model getting a manual. Later on, the 3-door 308 GT quietly became available, with an upgraded 1.6-litre turbo and a 6-speed manual. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, CD player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with GSM built-in telephone, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The Matrix is a typical urban runabout built in Korea, but with its own little twist. It is halfway between a minivan and a hatchback, while looking better than neither. The Matrix is probably a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering good interior space inside a compact body, but we are not sure if the Middle East is ready for such a car. Powered by either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or an automatic, while the larger engine gets only an automatic. Basic features include power steering, power windows, simple a/c, cloth seats, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, 14-inch steel wheels with plastic covers, and a roof rack. Safety is apparently optional, as only the higher models get dual airbags and ABS brakes, paired up with other options like fake metal-look trim, central door locking, rear wiper and washer, electrically-adjustable mirrors and 15-inch alloy wheels. Sometimes being named after a hit movie just isn't enough.

The Opel Corsa OPC is the performance model of the standard version. The sporty Corsa OPC model comes with a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, and connected to a 6-speed manual transmission. There is more higher tuned Corsa OPC Nurburgring Edition which produces more power and an aggressive suspension setup.  The OPC is available only as a 3-door model. Standard options include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, automatic A/C, leather upholstery and alloy wheels, entertainment system with a touch screen, CD player and MP3/iPod/AUX support, fog lamps, automatic headlamps and alloy wheels. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, traction control, ABS brakes featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution.

The McLaren 570S gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S, but has 30% new components. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570S weighs just 1,313 kg and is longer than the 650S. It benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a new TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Brilliance FRV Cross is the Chinese company's sub-compact SUV offering. The FRV Cross has been around since 2009, but only made its debut in the UAE in 2013. It comes with 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the FRV Cross include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, radio with single CD player and MP3/USB support, and steel wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

For 2012, the Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG received the new twin-turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. A multimedia computer is  awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. It also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Chevrolet Camaro Convertible received a facelift for the 2014 model year. Aside from the pointier front-end, the generic tail lamps, the functional new bonnet vents and optional Recaro seats, there aren't any other visible changes. Powered by a 3.6-litre V6 or a 6.2-litre V8, it rides on a shortened rear-wheel-drive Lumina SS platform, with four-wheel independent suspension and 2+2 seating. The Camaro comes in V6 LT and V8 SS trims. The V6 is only available with a 6-speed paddle-shifted automatic in the GCC. The SS gets a choice of two V8 engines, each customised for use with a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic. The automatic V8 features cylinder deactivation to improve fuel economy. StabiliTrak traction control and front-side airbags are standard, while Brembo brakes are available on the SS version. The SS also gets stiffer suspension and adjustable Competitive/Sport modes for stability control and Launch Control on manual models. The ZL1 gets a supercharged 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed manual or automatic. The hard-plastic cabin comes with cloth or leather interior, with standard blue LED lighting and optional glow-in-the-dark trim panels. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display and a new MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new Honda City model came out in 2021. It is slightly larger in every dimension from the previous generation, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The X6 M debuted in late 2009, with a higher-tuned turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 than the regular X6. The M has a 6-speed auto with proper paddle-shifters. Features include iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, side-view cameras, top-view camera, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M gets 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements. It also gets  features such as sports suspension, 'M' driving mode, paddle-shifted quicker-response automatic, launch control and a body kit.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The Swift offers eye-catching looks, quality and good driving dynamics all in an affordable sub-compact package. Built and sold in many countries, this "world car" is a break from previously dull Suzuki iterations and adopts a muscular body with bold sides, spread-out wheels, and a broad-shouldered beltline that continues all the way to the tail lights, while the roof's rear edge is shaped as a spoiler to improve aerodynamics. The Swift has one of the widest bodies in its class, and together with a long wheelbase, permits a spacious enough cabin. The functional interior uses aluminium-look trim highlights, tight fit and finish, and high-grade hard plastics. The little Suzuki is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder powerplant, while power is sent to the front-wheels using either the standard five-speed manual transmission or a four-speed automatic with a gated shift lever option. Standard features include power windows, CD/MP3 player, power steering and more, positioning the Swift as a semi-upscale runabout in the GCC. An expensive body kit is optional. All models have standard driver and passenger front and side airbags, as well as available full-length curtain airbags.

The Renault Captur is a small SUV offering from the French brand. Under the hood, the Spanish-made Captur gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. A lot of customisation can be done on the car's bodywork, interior trim and upholstery. Standard features on the front-wheel drive Captur include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, fabric seats, radio with MP3/AUX/CD player support, USB, Blutetooth, manual A/C, alloy rims, LED daytime lights, tire pressure monitoring system, push button start, central locking & keyless entry. Top model features include navigation, rear view camera, 17-inch 2-tone alloy wheels, parking sensors, automatic A/C, power folding mirrors, 2-tone body color and removable seat covers. Standard safety features include front and passenger airbags, ABS and ESP.

The Swift offers eye-catching looks, quality and good driving dynamics all in an affordable sub-compact package. Built and sold in many countries, this "world car" is a break from previously dull Suzuki iterations and adopts a muscular body with bold sides, spread-out wheels, and a broad-shouldered beltline that continues all the way to the tail lights, while the roof's rear edge is shaped as a spoiler to improve aerodynamics. The Swift has one of the widest bodies in its class, and together with a long wheelbase, permits a spacious enough cabin. The functional interior uses aluminium-look trim highlights, tight fit and finish, and high-grade hard plastics. The little Suzuki is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder powerplant, while power is sent to the front-wheels using either the standard five-speed manual transmission or a four-speed automatic with a gated shift lever option. Standard features include power windows, CD/MP3 player, power steering and more, positioning the Swift as a semi-upscale runabout in the GCC. An expensive body kit is optional. All models have standard driver and passenger front and side airbags, as well as available full-length curtain airbags.

The JAC S3 is a sub-compact crossover SUV, with styling derived from Hyundai no less. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine from 2017 onwards, mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Externally, the S3 SUV also has 16-inch alloy wheels and LED running lights as highlights. Under the skin, electric power steering, independent front suspension, semi-independent rear suspension and four-wheel-disc brakes are standard. Features include all the basics, such as power windows and mirrors, sunroof, keyless entry, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, faux leather upholstery, split-folding rear seat, cruise control and more. Safety features include 6 airbags, hill-start assist, ABS with EBD and hydraulic brake assist, ESP, rear camera and tyre-pressure monitor.

The Lexus LX 570 got a makeover for the 2016 model year. It has pretty much remained the same for the 2018 model year. A limited edition model, known as LX 570 Signature in UAE and as Sport in other GCC countries, was introduced, featuring a new front spindle grille, new front bumper spoiler, black door mirror cover, darker door molding and a rear bumper diffuser. The Lexus is powered by a 5.7-litre V8 mated with an 8-speed automatic transmission. The full-time all-wheel drive features a 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a crawl-control feature when in low range. The "overturn" assist feature can lock one inside rear tyre to help make slow turns tighter in offroad conditions. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. The leather interior can be had in tan, beige or black. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes, and traction control, as well as multiple airbags, with available tech such as the Pre-Crash Safety System that can detect and prepare for a crash, Lane Departure Alert, Automatic High Beam System, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control with auto  braking, and Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert.

The Jaguar F-Pace is the British luxury brand's first SUV in their lineup. It comes with a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine with two different tunes. Later on, a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine joined the lineup. Power is delivered via an 8-speed automatic transmission for all motors. A limited production "First Edition" model was released initially. The Pure, Prestige, R-Sport and Portfolio models get the standard 2.0-litre and 3.0-litre engines, while the F-Pace S and the First Edition trims get the more powerful 3.0-litre engine. Standard options on the all-wheel drive F-Pace include power windows, power mirrors, power steering, speed proportional steering, electric parking brake, hill launch assist, LED taillights, 2-zone climate control, paddle shifters,  5-inch screen, Bluetooth connectivity and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include 19-inch rims, luxury sports seats, electric seats with lumbar support, sliding panoramic roof, interior mood lighting, body kit, and Meridian Digital sound system. Safety features include front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera, 360-degree parking view, valet mode, blind spot monitor, traction control, front and curtain airbags.

The Cadillac CTS got a redesign for the 2014 model year. The base engine is now a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, coupled with 6-speed automatic transmission. The 3.6-litre V6 is still there, with a new 8-speed automatic. A new CTS VSport variant joins the lineup later, with a twin turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Luxgen7 SUV is a seven-seater crossover, currently only sold in UAE and Oman. It is available as either a front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. The top feature is the Luxgen Think+ system, co-developed with smartphone makers HTC, that comes with built-in HSPDA 3.5G communications, GPS Navigation and a 10.2-inch LCD display screen for a comprehensive tech package. The system also includes the "Eagle View+" 360-degree parking assist which utilises four cameras to provide a real-time visual display of the surrounding environment. The "Side View+" feature automatically displays live video images of the vehicle's rear blind spot to reduce the chance of an accident during lane changes. The "Night Vision+" high-sensitivity night vision camera system helps illuminate the road and traffic conditions at night beyond the range of the headlamps. "LDWS+" constantly reads the road surface for lane markers and dividers and gives audible and visual warnings when the vehicle veers too close to the lane markings. Overall, the SUV is equipped with 23 advanced ECUs and 8 video cameras to provide these features. Also available are power-opening doors, leather upholstery, rear DVD screen, Bluetooth and more. The Luxgen7 SUV is powered by a turbocharged-and-intercooled 2.2-litre DOHC 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. To improve driving feel, the steering system was tuned by Delphi, noise suppression engineering was handled by LMS, the suspension system was developed by Magna, and the overall chassis tuning was done by both Magna and Prodrive.

The Ram 1500 is offered in the GCC with a standard 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8. From 2014, it received the new rotary knob-controlled 8-speed automatic with available manual-shift feature. Available in regular cab, quad cab and crew cab, with three box lengths depending on model, the two trim levels available in the UAE are the SLT and the Laramie. Features available in the RAM include heated and ventilated front seats, surround-sound Alpine audio system, common power accessories, voice-controlled UConnect multimedia touchscreen system with Bluetooth phone and 30 GB hard drive, rear DVD screen, basic keyless entry with remote start, 17-inch basic or 20-inch chrome wheels, dual-zone auto a/c and a choice of cloth or leather upholstery, all depending on trim level. Standard safety features include standard ABS, stability control with hill-start assist and trailer sway control, front airbags and side airbags, as well as optional adjustable pedals, rear parking sensors and back-up camera.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

The Lexus IS received a full redesign for 2014, and got a mild makeover in 2017. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

The Toyota Land Cruiser got a makeover for its 2016 model year. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. Engine choices include a 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with an 8-speed automatic. In 2017, Saudi Arabia started offering a 4.5-litre V8 turbo-diesel model as well. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. In the UAE, there are three trim levels, namely EXR, GXR and VXR. The KSA market has GX, GXR and VXR trims, with further variants within them. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 18-inch alloys on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional dealer-installed rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional dealer-installed leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items.
