Further available features include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, a front chin spoiler and extra chrome trim on some GXR and all VXR models, with 20-inch wheels and more on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, factory leather, adaptive cruise, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system.  In some GCC countries a special edition VXS model was available in 2017, which had a JBL audio system, wireless charging, rear entertainment system with wireless headphones, and diamond stitched leather seats. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on V8 models only.

The Citroen C3 is the sub-compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Only one engine choice is sold in the GCC, the naturally aspirated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the C3 include power steering, power windows, halogen headlamps, automatic A/C, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, AM/FM stereo with CD player and MP3 compatibility, front fog lamps and 16-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front passenger and driver airbags, curtain airbags, ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and emergency braking assistance (EBA), and automatic activation of hazard warning lights (in case of rapid deceleration, change of direction or impact).

The Dodge Charger received a significant facelift in 2015. The previous engines are there, which includes the 3.6-litre V6 and 5.7-litre V8, aside from the SRT models. They all get the 8-speed automatic transmission. The base 2018 Dodge Charger SE V6 model gets a manual a/c, cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. The 2018 Dodge Charger SXT V6 trim level additionally comes with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more, with some of these features reserved for the SXT Plus version offered in certain markets such as the UAE. The Rallye V6, available only in some markets such as KSA, comes with an appearance package. The 2018 Dodge Charger 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, comes in three trim levels. The base "Full House" V8 trim, available in some markets such as KSA, gets almost all the features of the top V6 model except for leather and fancy cup-holders, but gains sportier suspension and brakes, with options such as power seats, the fancy cup-holders, premium audio and a few other features, depending on market. The top "R/T" model gets the "Road and Track" performance package with sportier suspension, steering, exhaust, grille, spoiler and 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

Toyota tacks on the Land Cruiser badge on up to three of their 4WD models, including a pickup, but there is only one true Land Cruiser that everyone knows and loves for reasons unknown. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon remains at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. It is still one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. Few vehicles offer the off-road capability of the Land Cruiser, and fewer still combine this with its level of luxury. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.5-litre six-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto, and a new 4.7-litre V8 and a five-speed auto. There is also a 4.2-litre diesel with a manual. It can transport anywhere from eight to ten passengers depending on model. It is an expensive vehicle, but everything is still optional, including ABS, airbags and cruise control. Other options include leather sunroof and navigation. We'd love to love this outdated 4WD, but we hate the people who buy these, as any other road user will know why.

The Passat attempted to reinvent itself back in 2006 with a list of weak base engines. It entered 2008 with a new list of engine choices, and some carrying over, although the latest model still looks the same as the all-new Passat that debuted in 2006. A wagon called the Passat Variant has also joined the lineup. The Passat boasts generous standard content and a high-quality interior mixed with high-tech hijinks. Volkswagen has rolled out a full line of four-door sedans, ranging from  1.8-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors, both turbocharged, to the 3.2-litre and 3.6 V6 models, the latter of which is for the body-kitted R36 model. All basic cars are front-wheel-drive, while V6 models get 4Motion all-wheel-drive. V6 models also get a dual-clutch DSG automanual gearbox, while the base cars get standard manuals and autos. All Passats come standard with the latest in safety features and electronics, including power features, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, ESP, tyre-pressure monitoring system and MP3-capable CD player. R-Line package is largely just an expensive bodykit.

The fifth-generation BMW 7-Series was all-new for the 2009 model year and facelifted for 2013. The first models to be relaunched include the 730Li, the 740Li, the 750Li, and the 760Li, all long-wheelbase variants as most GCC dealers chose to import only the stretched models. The confusing naming convention continues, with the 740i and 740Li powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-6 engine and the 750i and 750Li powered by an updated 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, although the 730i and 730Li models get a naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline-6. The limited-availability 760Li gets a 6.0-litre turbo V12. Badge deception notwithstanding, all engines are capable performers, featuring Double-VANOS variable valve technology, direct injection, and a new 8-speed automatic. The range come equipped with EfficientDynamics technologies as standard, all aimed at improving fuel economy. All 7-Series can now be specified with a side-view camera system, Park Distance Control, two forward-facing cameras, night-vision system, a pedestrian recognition system, blind-spot warning, a heads-up display, speed-related active steering, variable air-suspension damping control, stability control, hill-start assistant, ABS, brake drying, brake-fade compensation, iDrive with larger 10.2-inch screen, instrument cluster with a high-resolution colour display, navigation, 8 GB hard drive, rear-seat DVD entertainment with integrated screens, four-zone automatic air-conditioning, multiple front and side-curtain airbags, optional rear-seat ventilation system with massage function, and other electronic gimmicks. All the usual luxury basics are obviously also included, such as leather, power accessories, sunroof and 18-inch or larger alloys.

An all-new Nissan Pathfinder was introduced in 2013, when it ditched its body-on-frame chassis and gained some length to compete in the hotly-contested midsize crossover segment. In 2018 it got a facelift, along with engine and interior upgrades. The 7-seater Pathfinder is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT and a choice of either front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive in all trim levels. The hybrid model is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.5-litre supercharged engine combined with an electric motor. The all-wheel-drive model gets a selector for choosing 2WD, 4WD or Auto. The base Pathfinder S comes standard with a second-row 60/40-split fold-flat bench seat, a third-row 50/50-split fold-flat reclining bench seat, LED running lights, 18-inch alloys, tri-zone automatic a/c, keyless entry with push-button ignition, power windows, CD/MP3/DVD/HDD audio system with 8-inch screen and 6 speakers, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth phone, auto headlights, 6 airbags, stability control, tyre-pressure monitor and apparently a standard power liftgate in some markets. The Pathfinder SV adds power-adjustable front seats, rear camera, 20-inch alloy wheels, remote starter, auxiliary audio/video input jack, power windows with front one-touch auto-up/down, front fog lamps, chrome body side trim, welcome lighting, stainless-steel kick plates, speed-sensitive intermittent wipers, illuminated sun-visor mirrors, sunroof, wood-tone trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, leather seats, and a tow hitch receiver with 7-pin trailer tow wiring harness on the rear bumper. The top-spec Pathfinder SL further adds a key-linked memory seat and other settings for individual drivers, side-curtain airbags front and rear, digital compass, 9GB hard drive, 8-inch VGA colour monitor with navigation, Bose audio system with 13 speakers, climate-controlled front seats, and a power-tilt/telescoping steering column. An around-view four-camera parking aid is optional, as is a rear DVD entertainment system with 2 screens. Available accessories include roof rail bars, rear-installing tent and more. For 2019, a "Midnight Edition" was launched. It is available only on the mid-option SV and features all the chrome bits blacked out, a front splitter and black rims.

The X6 is what you get when you chop the top off an X5. It is dubbed the world's first "Sport Activity Coupe," which unfortunately abbreviates down to "SAC." While still technically a 4WD, the new-for-2009 X6 comes in two models, namely the XDrive35i and the XDrive50i, both being powerful high-end models, in keeping with its exclusive nature. It is therefore powered by either a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 or a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8, both mated to 6-speed manually-shiftable automatics. The X6 gets a new all-wheel drive system, without low-range gearing, but improving on-road handling. Redesigned to be shorter in height than its practical sibling, the X6 offers seating for only four in its chop-top cabin. A whole host of features include standard bi-xenon headlights, BMW's controversial iDrive computer, 19-inch alloy wheels, run-flat tyres, tyre-pressure monitor, 10-way power front seats, and new leather colour schemes. Other available features include active steering, automatic tailgate, adaptive headlights, rear-mounted DVD system, reverse-view camera, satellite-navigation, four-zone air-conditioning, and bigger rims. Standard safety features include front, side and side head airbags, and crash-activated front-seat headrests, as well as stability control, ABS and a fancy new driving aid called Dynamic Performance Control.

Foton SUP is a compact pickup made in China, and offered in certain GCC countries. Only the double-cab is sold. Only a weak 2.2-litre engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission is available. It is offered in only two-wheel drive setup. Features offered include remote control with central door locking, power steering, power mirrors, manual antenna, indicators on side mirrors, fog lamps, PVC floor carpet, manual air-conditioner, fake-wood interior trim, CD player, power windows and metallic paint.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year, and facelifted for 2009. Along with the mildly-changed face, the new variants include the base Quattroporte Automatica, the mid-range Quattroporte S Automatica and the top Quattroporte Sport GT-S. The base engine is the 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 6-speed automatic, while the mid-range S model has a 4.7-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto. The Sport GT-S has an upgraded 4.7-litre V8 and is now the only version with a 6-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. All Quattroporte models have the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The new model has expanded the already-staggering array of interior trim choices to 10 leather colours with 11 piping hues and myriad woods or lacquers from which to choose. Other interior upgrades include new cluster graphics, reshaped seats and a new multifunction wood and leather steering wheel with sporty thumb rests. Standard features include directionally-adaptive bi-xenon headlights heated leather power seats with memory, automatic dual-zone climate control, rear parking sensors and a Bose sound system with hard drive and navigation system. The Quattroporte S adds Brembo brakes and 19-inch wheels. Heating, ventilation and massage functions are optional for front and rear seats. An electronically-controlled Skyhook suspension, standard on the S and optional on the base trim, automatically adjusts to the conditions of the road. The Sport GT-S adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals, as well as a noisier exhaust, uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts.

The Colorado is a range of light pickup trucks. This midsize pickup can be had with two bed options, only one petrol engine, and comes standard with rear-wheel-drive. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, we beileve there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Available as a two-door single-cab or a four-door double-cab, four-wheel-drive is optional on the double cab only. Thankfully, amenities such as air-conditioning, dual front airbags, power steering, vinyl flooring, cloth bench seat and an ashtray are all standard. Upgrading to a higher trim level adds such luxuries as floor carpets, power windows, remote central locking, cloth bucket seats, chrome trimmings and body-colour door handles. Purely sold as a work truck here, the Colorado is actually marketed as a lifestyle truck in America, where it comes with cool colours, stylish trimmings, more luxuries and much bigger engines.

For 2012, the midsize Cadillac SRX received a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with paddle-shifting functions and all-wheel-drive. Even the base model is generously loaded, with a limited-slip differential, common power accessories, 18-inch wheels, LED tail lamps, chrome roof rails, 8-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, dual-zone a/c with rear vents and controls, cruise control, keyless entry, power-adjustable pedals, power-adjustable front seats and a leatherette interior. The top 'Luxury' version gets variable-effort power steering, continuously-variable real-time dampers, turning HID headlights, parking sensors with rear camera, navigation, 20-inch wheels, 10-speaker Bose stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, 40 GB hard drive, rear DVD screens, full keyless entry with push-button start, ventilated front seats, LED cabin lighting and a panoramic glass roof. For 2013, changes included the introduction of the CUE multimedia entertainment system, along with some minor cabin alterations and an active noise-cancellation system. All models get front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Mitsubishi Attrage is the Japanese brand's sub-compact sedan offering, introduced in 2014 GCC market. The Thai-built Attrage gets a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual in fleet-spec trim or a CVT in all other versions. The small engine, combined with the lightweight body makes it very fuel-efficient. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry with central locking, fabric seats, manual a/c, AM/FM radio with CD player and 4 speakers, tachometer and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional equipment include a full-auto a/c, better entertainment system, leather-strapped steering wheel and gear knob, 15-inch alloy wheels and USB port. For safety, only the top model gets 2 airbags for the driver and passenger, whereas as the rest get only one for the driver. All models get ABS with EBD.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz A-Class Sedan came out in 2019. The A-Class now comes in two variants, the A 200 and A 250. Under the hood, is the same turbocharged 2.0-litre engine carried over from the previous generation, mated to an a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, but gains more power. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Audi RS 5 is being sold, but probably only on special order. It gets a 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 7-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5.

The GAC GS5 is the Chinese brand's compact crossover SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engine choices, which is the naturally aspirated 2.0-litre motor and the turbocharged 1.8-litre unit. They both can be had in either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 5-speed automatic transmission. While the 2.0-litre version is front-wheel drive, the 1.8-litre turbocharged version can be had in four-wheel-drive as well. Standard feature for the GS5 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fog lamps, parking sensors, AM/FM radio with CD/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, fabric seats, automatic A/C with dual-zone, rear A/C vents and manual seats. The higher models get leather seats, power seats, sunroof and audio controls on steering wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and EBD.

The Chevrolet Traverse received a facelift for 2013. It is a crossover wagon that combines the functionality of a minivan with the look of an SUV, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, with either front-wheel-drive or optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include 6.5 inches touch screen for navigation, entertainment and display vehicle information, rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The MG GS is the Chinese company's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It comes standard in front-wheel-drive format, with optional four-wheel-drive. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, LED daytime running lamps, manual-adjustable seats, manual A/C, stereo with USB/AUX support, 4 speakers and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include automatic headlamps, xenon headlamps, keyless entry, engine start-stop button, 18-inch alloy wheels, leather seats with lumbar support, sunroof, automatic A/C, infotainment system with 6.1-inch touch screen and 6 or 8 speakers, Bluetooth, electric folding side mirrors,  glovebox cooling and rear camera. Safety features include stability control, ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist, auto hold and front airbags. The higher models get additional airbags, hill descent control and anti-roll program.

The CLK underwent a minor facelift for 2007, along with receiving a new range of modern engines. Available in both luxury convertible and pillar-less coupe models, the CLK-Class is an attractive extension of the C-Class platform. It packs the usual comfort and safety features typical of Mercedes-Benz, either standard or optional. Standard features include front and side airbags, ABS with Brake Assist and Electronic Stability Programme, common power features, pneumatically operated retractable rear head restraints, alloy wheels, good stereo and a host of upholstery options. The model range includes the 1.8-litre supercharged CLK 200 Kompressor, the 3.0-litre CLK 280, the 3.5-litre CLK 350, the 5.5-litre CLK 500 and the 6.2-litre CLK 63 AMG rocketship. Only the lower models have a manual gearbox option in addition to the automatic, though they make have to be special order. A new optional AMG package adds a sporty body kit, suspension and wheels to any CLK model. Other options include keyless start, navigation, an even better stereo and parking sensors.

The Renault Duster, a rebadged Dacia, has been designed to suit all types of roads across the world's less-developed countries. It got a minor facelift in 2015 and updated interior materials. This sub-compact SUV is based on a stretched Nissan Tiida platform, and comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available in either a two-wheel-drive 4-speed automatic form or in an all-wheel-drive 6-speed manual form, the latter capable of locking the diff for a 50:50 front/rear torque split. Interestingly, the 2WD model comes with a torsion-beam rear suspension, while the 4WD model gives up some boot space to make way for an independent rear suspension. The rear seats fold down as standard, and split-folding on all but the base model, while you can transport longer items if the front passenger seat is folded down as well. The basic PE version comes with two-wheel-drive, 4-speed automatic, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth with buttons behind steering wheel, unpainted bumpers, 16-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, folding rear bench seat, power steering and manual a/c. Early models came with one airbag, but by mid-2012, all models had two standard airbags. The higher-spec SE can be had in 2WD automatic or special-order 4WD manual drivetrains, and adds standard fog lamps, trip computer, ABS with Emergency Brake Assist, extra front-passenger airbag, rear power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, painted bumpers, leatherette steering wheel and extra chrome trim. The SE version can be further upgraded with leather seats with additional pyrotechnic pre-tensioners on the front seatbelts as well as side airbags. The exterior package on the SE version also adds standard chrome door mirrors, longitudinal roof rails, front/rear skid plates and side-skirt covers. Extra tinted rear windows, rear quarter glass and rear windscreen round up the list, as is a split-folding rear seat, height adjustable driver's seat and height-adjustable steering wheel. A comprehensive range of accessories,including wind reflectors, side steps, wheel arch mouldings, chrome exhaust trim and mudflaps, is also available.

The McLaren 570S Spider gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S Spider gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. A minor frontal facelift and other trim changes marked the changes for 2012. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard. From early 2012, a few hundred 30th Anniversary edition models were offered, signified by LED lights in the bumpers and a few other trim bits.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class. In 2017, an all-new C63 Coupe made its debut. It has remained the same for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, they get twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. The Dzire is the sedan version of the Swift hatchback, boasting a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, it is mated to an automated-manual "AGS" gearbox. Features include a CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, tilt-adjustable steering wheel with audio controls, Bluetooth, 14-inch steel wheels and front/rear fog lamps on the base GL trim. The GLX trim additionally gets 15-inch alloy wheels, driver-seat height adjuster, smart key with starter button, and rear parking sensors. Safety features includes front airbags, ESP, ABS with EBD and tyre-pressure monitor..

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. Changes were made in 2015 which included standard Attention Assist and Crosswind Assist, optional Intelligent Light System which included LED indicators, LED daytime running lamps, LED low-beam headlamps, and main beam with cornering light function. There were no changes for the 2017 model year. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

Finally making its official debut in the GCC, the rally-bred Subaru Impreza WRX STI landed for the 2008 model year with a hatchback-only body and no warranty. By 2010, it could finally be bought with a warranty. The sedan came for 2011. The standard engine is a 2.5-litre turbocharged and intercooled horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed manual and Subaru's 'symmetrical' all-wheel-drive system. In 2011, a minor range-wide facelift debuted along with the sedan, as well as a 5-speed automatic option. An SI-DRIVE system offers three modes, namely Intelligent, Sport, and Sport Sharp, with the first mode reducing power and improving fuel economy. The 'Driver Controlled Center Differential,' also known as DCCD, has three automatic modes in addition to allowing manual torque-split adjustment. The VDC stability control system can be left on, fully turned off, or set to a sport mode. Features include ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, LED tail lamps, torque-sensitive limited slip differential, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, common power accessories and a CD stereo, with options such as Recaro sport seats and navigation. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in.

The Navara is a stylish work truck, and essentially a pickup version of the Pathfinder. Like the Pathfinder, it offers good hauling capability and marginal on-road handling. It offers decent interior space and more convenience features than most competitors. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with a five-speed automatic and 2WD, or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine with a six-speed manual transmission and 4WD. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloywheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,4-speaker audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signallamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensingwipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment. It is apparently only available in double cab five-seater body style with a long rear load bay.

The SX4 is an all-new compact car from Suzuki. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model that is not actually offered in most GCC markets. The crossover-style hatchback came first, then a tall sedan came in mid-2008. Originally fitted with a standard 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the SX4 can be equipped with a five-speed manual transmission, while also coming with an optional four-speed automatic. A 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine debuted with the sedan. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

This generation of the Lexus RX debuted back in 2016. In 2020, it got a facelift. Under the hood, the RX 350 gets the 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. However there is also an F Sport model which gets a bodykit. The RX 450h gets a similar 3.5-litre V6 engine combined to three electric motors. In 2020, a long wheel base version RX 450hL was added to the lineup. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 20-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was all-new in 2014 and facelifted for 2018. It is only available with a 1.5-litre engine and a CVT automatic in the UAE, in SE and SE+ trims. In Saudi Arabia, the 1.3-litre is available as a fleet standard Y trim with a manual transmission, while the 1.5-litre is available in Y and YX trims with CVT. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the SE+, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, auto a/c, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels and more. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD). Tyre-pressure monitor and stability control are now standard in the UAE on all trims.

The Infiniti M is completely new compared to the outgoing model, with new engines, tech and style to boot. Available in M37 guise with a 3.7-litre V6 or in M56 guise with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the M37 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the M56, called Luxury and Sport. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

The futuristic Audi TT Coupe was first launched in late 1998, followed by the Roadster in 1999. It became a trend-setter in terms of style, but mechanical mediocrity meant it was never a true sports car, being based on the same platform that served the VW Golf and the Skoda Octavia. Originally available with two original engine choices, both were turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder units, at different states of tune. The lower model got front-wheel-drive, while the higher-powered model benefitted from standard Quattro all-wheel-drive. First-year models suffered from dangerous high-speed handling due to lift-off oversteer and led to many deaths, so stability control, better stabilisers and a rear lip-spoiler were added from 2000. All versions only had a manual gearbox up till 2003, when an automatic gearbox with manual-shift capability was offered in the lower-powered model. Model-year 2003 also saw a minor unnoticeable facelift as well as the introduction of a 3.2-litre V6 option, available with either a manual or, from 2004, a newly-developed DSG automanual gearbox. The V6 also got standard Quattro all-wheel-drive, stiffer suspension and slightly upgraded body trim. The coupe was a 2+2 seater, while the roadster only had two seats. All versions got a cramped but stylish interior, and could be had with special leather upholstery, the usual power accessories, and more. Variations over the years meant different wheel designs and interior options were available. Final-year 2006 models can be identified by a two-tone paintjob. The original TT was a popular entry into the compact sports-car market due to its looks, but it was always the worst in terms of driving dynamics compared to its more-capable competitors.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. From 2017, a derivation of the GTC4Lusso, namely the GTC4Lusso T was offered. The GTC4Lusso T differentiates itself from the GTC4Lusso with a rear-wheel-drive layout, and being powered by Ferrari’s 3.9-litre V8 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission, whilst retaining the electronic rear differential and all-wheel-steering system. Other features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128GB in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays and more.

The Liana is pitched into the ultra-competitive compact segment. It was introduced as a 2002 model, and mildly facelifted for 2005. The only model offered here is the 1.6-litre four-cylinder version with either a manual or an automatic. It can be fully equipped with air-conditioning, ABS brakes, dual airbags, CD stereo, full electrics, keyless entry and an engine immobiliser. The interior has undergone a respectable makeover, with a new quality look, new materials and better bolstered front seats. Front seat occupants will enjoy the airy cabin. The seats are supportive and well contoured, and even rear passengers are not lacking for headroom or legroom. The high seating position contributes to good visibility. The luggae trunk is not particularly roomy, but split-fold rear seats allow more load space. There are faux aluminium and chrome highlights all over, while optional accesories include a rear spoiler and alloy wheels. The Liana used to come in sedan and hatchback body styles in other markets, but in its final years, only the sedan survived in most markets. European and American markets get larger engine choices.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. The Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Cadiilac CTS-V is the top sports variant which with a supercharged 6.2-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps, fog lamp, Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Mercedes-Benz GLE-Class is essentially the new facelifted M-Class following the German brand's new nomenclature. Mercedes-AMG GLE 63 is the top performance model and got more power and torque in 2016. In 2018, the two variants offered were the standard GLE 63 and then the GLE 63 S. Under the hood, both come with the 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and 21-inch cross-spoke AMG alloy wheels. The 5-seater interior offers leather upholstery, mood lighting, HDD navigation, panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily facelifted and revised for 2007, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features. Also new to the range is the Navigator L, an extended version which has a longer wheelbase and additional cargo space.

The B-Series is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines include a 2.2-litre and a 2.6-litre petrol engines, while the diesel offering is a 2.9-litre unit, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual, or even an automatic in some markets. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include overfender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

The Peugeot 301 is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. While claiming class-leading cabin and boot space, the Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

The top-spec IS-F sports sedan model finally debuted in 2011 in the GCC with a 5.0-litre V8 and paddle-shifted 8-speed automatic. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof, ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats. The IS-F comes with lowered sports suspension, special wheels, sports seats, special cabin trim and a body kit along with the uniquely-tuned V8.

The GMC Acadia received a facelift for its 2013 model. The crossover offers three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. The Acadia gets a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19 or 20-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The long-running Town Car is Lincoln's full-size luxury sedan based on the Ford Crown Victoria rear-wheel-drive platform. Numerous trim series are available, including the Signature, the Signature Limited, and the long-wheelbase Signature L. Power comes from a 4.6-litre V8 mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. Town Car puts power to the ground through its rear wheels via a 3.27:1 rear-axle ratio, with traction control and ABS brakes as standard. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch wheels, rear parking assist, keyless entry, CD stereo, leather seats, auto-dimming rearview mirror, front and side airbags, automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals and power-adjustable front seats. Options in higher trims include HID headlights, CD changer, sunroof, two-tone paint and power-operated luggage trunk lid. The car is pretty dated now, but a mild redesign in 2003 involved upgrades both inside and out.

The 599 GTB Fiorano is a new all-aluminium two-seater, named after the circuit Ferrari uses to hone the performance of its track and road cars, while GTB stands for Gran Turismo Berlinetta, after classic Ferrari berlinettas, and 599 reflects the displacement of its V12 engine divided by 10. Talk about overdoing it. The passenger areas of the Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano are trimmed in leather while the driver area and controls boast more high-tech detailing in carbon-fibre and aluminium. Other standard accessories include front bi-xenon headlamps and rear LED lights, dusk and rain sensors, dual-zone climate control, electrically adjustable steering-wheel column, hideaway radio/CD player and key with integrated volumetric anti-theft device with motion sensors. Accessories include front and rear parking sensors, iPod-friendly set-up, satellite anti-theft system and a luggage set specially tailored to fit this model. Development work for the Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano focused specifically on the distinctive sound the 6.0-litre V12 makes, to pretty much make it sound like a Ferrari.

The GMC Yukon got a new 6-speed automatic transmission from 2009 onward and also the Yukon Denali got a slight power increase. A beefy Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Yukon, with better fuel economy to boot. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include power windows, electric mirrors and additional power equipment, along with a folding third-row seat. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, Yukon is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Yukon XL is the long-wheelbase GMC version of the Suburban, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. The Denali version adds a 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto, chrome trim and some luxury interior features, but loses off-road gearing.

The Honda Accord got a facelift for the 2016 version. The coupe shares no body panels with the sedan version. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a CVT automatic. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. The 2.4 EX coupe comes with halogen headlights with LEDs, 17-inch alloys, fog lights, sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, power-folding mirrors, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel, dual-zone auto a/c, rear camera, 7-speaker stereo with touchscreen panel and USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, power driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, floor mats and all safety features. The 3.5 EX coupe adds the V6 engine, LED headlights, 18-inch alloys, dual exhaust tips, paddle-shifters, navigation, LaneWatch camera, "i-Dual" a/c and leather upholstery. For 2016, 'Honda Sensing' was introduced and is available only in the top grade Accord trim. This includes adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist system, collision mitigation braking system and road departure mitigation system. Also featured in the 3.5L V6 grades is the Honda Lanewatch feature which uses a camera located below the passenger side window to display an expanded rear view of the passenger side road way on the centre display. The display can show cars up to two lanes. Rear parking sensors is standard, along with Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), ABS, Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA).

The Veloster is Hyundai's head-on dive into the sport-compact segment, with an entry that will be controversial forever. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side. The standard engine for the GCC is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, which puts a downer on its sporting intentions, especially since the standard gearbox is a 6-speed automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available in some GCC markets include a full set of airbags, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that.

The 3-Series is the king of compact entry-level luxury sedans, while also available in coupe and convertible body styles. Also available is the Touring wagon model, but it is not exactly made available here since no one wants one. Now in its fifth generation, models currently available in the Middle East include the 320i with 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, and the amazing 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder as well as the all-wheel-drive versions of some the models, namely the 325xi, the 330xi and the 330xd. A new engine was introduced into the series with the new coupe and later the sedan, dubbed the 335i with a 3.0-litre twin turbo 6-cylinder motor. The new V8-powered M3 debuted for 2008, also in coupe, sedan and convertible styles, with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer option is available, and it is a pain to use, since BMW chooses to use a little joystick in the centre console instead of a simple touch screen. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, alloy wheels, ABS brakes and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

Released in 2003, and ever so slightly redesigned for 2006, the Mazda 6, also known as the grammatically-incorrect Mazda6, is the sportiest among the current crop of front-wheel-drive midsize family cars, but only in terms of handling. The Mazda 6 was originally designed for the driving enthusiast, with choices of V6 and turbocharged engines, but the Middle East market only gets a pathetic 2.0-litre and a reasonable 2.3-litre engine, both of which are four-cylinder and come with a choice of manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre comes in the four-door sedan and an attractive five-door station wagon body style, while the 2.3-litre comes in the four-door sedan shape as well as a sporty five-door liftback , as long in length as the sedan. Standard features include power windows, central locking, basic stereo system with 4 speakers, dual airbags for driver and front passenger, and available ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. Options include a full body kit, rear spoiler, fog lamps, 6 CD changer, cruise control, alloy wheels, sunroof and leather seats.

An all-new model of the Audi Q3 Sportback came out in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

Named after Mitsubishi's famed now-dead sports car, the Eclipse Cross is an economical crossover with no sporting pretensions beyond its sharply sloping rear roofline. Powered by a 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, the Eclipse Cross seats five and is based on the Outlander platform, just like the brand's ASX crossover. The rear seat reclines and slides front-back as needed, to increase legroom or boot space. It has the all modern amenities available, such as power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry and start, multimedia screen, and more. It rides on a choice of 16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor and dual front with optional side-curtain airbags.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Big and powerful, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

A new generation of the Mazda 3 hatchback came out in 2020. Mechanically, the engines have carried over from the previous model. One engine is offered in the GCC, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The Q50 is also longer, wider and sits lower than the previous generation, which was the G37. For 2017, it got new engines and for the 2018 model year it got a slight facelift. The interior gets Infiniti's InTouch system, a touch screen which displays information and navigation. Owners will also be able to download, update and synch personal apps through their smartphones and USB drives.  The standard motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit which made its debut in 2015. In 2017, a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine was introduced, available in two different tunes. There is also a 3.5-litre V6 engine coupled with an electric motor, which will be available in select markets. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

Finally making its official debut in the GCC, the rally-bred Subaru Impreza WRX STI landed for the 2008 model year with a hatchback-only body and no warranty. By 2010, it could finally be bought with a warranty. The sedan came for 2011. The standard engine is a 2.5-litre turbocharged and intercooled horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed manual and Subaru's 'symmetrical' all-wheel-drive system. In 2011, a minor range-wide facelift debuted along with the sedan, as well as a 5-speed automatic option. An SI-DRIVE system offers three modes, namely Intelligent, Sport, and Sport Sharp, with the first mode reducing power and improving fuel economy. The 'Driver Controlled Center Differential,' also known as DCCD, has three automatic modes in addition to allowing manual torque-split adjustment. The VDC stability control system can be left on, fully turned off, or set to a sport mode. Features include ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, LED tail lamps, torque-sensitive limited slip differential, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, common power accessories and a CD stereo, with options such as Recaro sport seats and navigation. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in.

The Genesis GV80 is the South Korean brand's first premium SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets two engine options - a 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and a 3.5-litre turbocharged V6 motor. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The 2.5-litre model can be had with two-wheel-drive or optional four-wheel-drive whereas the 3.5 model comes only as an all-wheel-drive. Standard options in the GV80 include power steering, power windows, electric folding mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop, leather upholstery, memory and ventilated seats, audio system with AUX/USB support, auto A/C, navigation, auto defog system, rain sensors, sunroof, parking assist system, rear electric curtain, xenon headlamps, LED headlights and taillights with LED daytime running lamps, front and rear camera, air suspension and 20-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include 9 airbags, lane keep assist, adaptive cruise control, ABS, traction control, stability control, brake assist, blind spot detection and autonomous emergency braking (AEB).

The 599 GTB Fiorano is a new all-aluminium two-seater, named after the circuit Ferrari uses to hone the performance of its track and road cars, while GTB stands for Gran Turismo Berlinetta, after classic Ferrari berlinettas, and 599 reflects the displacement of its V12 engine divided by 10. Talk about overdoing it. The passenger areas of the Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano are trimmed in leather while the driver area and controls boast more high-tech detailing in carbon-fibre and aluminium. Other standard accessories include front bi-xenon headlamps and rear LED lights, dusk and rain sensors, dual-zone climate control, electrically adjustable steering-wheel column, hideaway radio/CD player and key with integrated volumetric anti-theft device with motion sensors. Accessories include front and rear parking sensors, iPod-friendly set-up, satellite anti-theft system and a luggage set specially tailored to fit this model. Development work for the Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano focused specifically on the distinctive sound the 6.0-litre V12 makes, to pretty much make it sound like a Ferrari.

The Skoda Kodiaq is the VW-owned Czech brand's first proper foray into the crossover market after the van-like Skoda Yeti was cancelled. There is a choice of two engines , one a 1.4-litre turbo in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive forms, and another a 2.0-litre turbo in all-wheel-drive form. The smaller engine comes with a 6-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic while the larger one gets a 7-speed DSG auto. Seating can be 5 or 7, depending on trim level. Features include a touchscreen multimedia system, cruise control, keyless entry, ABS with EBD, a full set of airbags and all the other other usual bits and bobs.

The BMW X6 M got a new model for the 2020 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X6 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Toyota RAV4 got a complete redesign for 2013, with a new styling language, a new drivetrain, and new features. In 2016, it got a facelift. It has remained the same in 2018. The existing platform has been updated with new suspension tuning, while the standard engine now is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. There is also a choice of front-wheel-drive with limited-slip diff or all-wheel-drive with 50:50 lock mode. New items in this 5-seater crossover include a lift-up tailgate with the spare wheel now stored under the boot floor. In the UAE, there was a reshuffle of trims for 2016, with the 2WD available in EX  and VX grade, while the AWD is sold in GXR and VXR grades. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, fold-flat split rear seating and more. The base model gets cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic keyless entry and 17-inch alloy wheels. Additional available features, depending on trim level, include smart keyless entry and start, LED headlights and running lamps, LED tail lamps, auto-dimming mirror, roof rails, cargo net, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, cruise control and dual-zone auto a/c. Also offered on higher-spec models are touchscreen navigation, DVD player, rear camera, power driver's seat, sunroof, leather upholstery and 18-inch alloy wheels. All RAV4 models get two front airbags as well as ABS with EBD, while higher-spec models get additional side and curtain airbags, stability control, brake assist, downhill assist, and hill-start assist.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ertiga is a seven-seater minivan offering from the Japanese brand. The front-wheel drive people carrier features a 1.4-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ertiga include power steering, AM/FM radio, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C with rear vents, halogen headlamps and steel wheels. Higher options get alloy wheels, fog lamps, chrome grille and side body moulding. Depending on trim level, the Ertiga gets dual airbags and ABS.

The perfectly-sized CX-9 is an award-winning crossover 4WD that drives like a sporty car and goes off-road like a sporty car too. Built on an all-new architecture, the CX-9 shares the V6 engine sourced from Ford. Powered by a new-for-2008 3.7-litre V6, it also comes with a six-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, which means no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one hand operation for an extra 26 inches of space between the folded second-row seat and the door opening. The 60-40 split second row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Other available features include 18-inch rims, CD stereo,  and HID headlights. The disc brakes are assisted by ABS, traction control, dynamic stability control, and an advanced roll stability control system. A six airbag system is fitted as standard and includes side-curtain airbags that extend to the third row. The CX-9 now becomes the flagship family vehicle in the Mazda lineup.

The Nissan Pathfinder Classic is a return of the old-shape model to the GCC market. This one is made in Spain, rather than the United States. Now only available as a basic model, it is built on a body-on-frame platform, offering good off-road capability but marginal on-road handling. The Pathfinder Classic offers third-row seating to carry up to seven people. A 4.0-litre V6 powers the SUV and its five-speed automatic transmission is geared to use the engine's torque characteristics. Standard features include fabric upholstery, cruise control, power mirrors, windows and door locks with keyless remote, CD stereo with six speakers, reclining backs on the middle row seats, front airbags, ABS and steel wheels.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Boxster have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Boxster gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Boxster S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City. For 2018, it got a facelift. It is slightly larger in every dimension from the previous generation, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Caprice soldiered on for years on just minor updates, but it is still one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers the choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the Generation III V8 engine. However, there is a higher-output version of the V8 that is standard on the SS and the Royale. The Caprice uses a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Latest optional features include front and rear proximity sensors, twin DVD screens, satellite navigation and a leather interior. ABS Brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

An all-new model came out for the Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S Cabriolet in 2020. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the Porsche 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. Originally available in the GCC with two engine choices, there is only a V60 2.0T model now, that comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to an 8-speed automatic. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians.

The quasi-legendary Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift in 2015, but it remains largely unchanged since the debut of this version a decade ago.
