Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The long-running Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van has been facelifted for the 2014 model year. It can be classified as one of the largest "light" commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value. Optional safety features include lane-keeping assist, blind-spot assist, collision-prevention assist and high-beam assist.

The Lexus GX 460 received a second facelift in 2020. It gets an updated signature spindle grille, and new triple bean LED headlamps. The engine is a carryover 4.6-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. The base Premier model is well-equipped, with standard features such as a multi-terrain select system, smart keyless entry and start, sunroof, rear camera and side camera with park assist, synthetic leather trim for the 7-seater cabin, 9-speaker stereo with new 8-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, DVD navigation, tri-zone a/c, crawl control, ESP, basic cruise control and a full set of airbags that includes knee bags. The Platinum model adds semi-aniline leather, heated/ventilated seats, cool box and lane-change assist with blind-spot monitor, 17-speaker Mark Levinson stereo, pre-crash safety system, radar cruise control and a rear-seat entertainment system.

The 2018 Peugeot 2008 is a five-seater crossover loosely based on the 208 hatchback. In 2017, the 2008 got a facelift and new engine and transmission. It gets a 1.2-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder engine connected to a 6-speed automatic. Features of the 2018 Peugeot 2008 include tiptronic gear-shifting, panoramic glass roof, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, multimedia LCD display, 16-inch alloy wheels, split-folding rear seats, keyless entry, cruise control with speed limiter, power windows, eletric mirrors, front airbags and ABS, among other options.

The Jaguar XJ is generally available in four trim levels in SWB and LWB versions. The UAE and some other GCC markets will only see the Premium Luxury, Portfolio and SuperSport versions, all in LWB form. The XJ Premium Luxury and the Portfolio will be available with a 5.0-litre naturally-aspirated V8. The XJ Portfolio can also be optioned up with a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The SuperSport comes exclusively with a higher-tuned 5.0-litre supercharged V8. Finally a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 engine completes the line-up. All models are rear-wheel-drive mated with 8-speed automatic gearboxes. Features include an aluminium body, air suspension, "Adaptive Dynamics" continuously-variable damping, adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, "Active Differential Control" and quick-ratio power steering. Customers can have their choice in colours, veneers and leathers. Inside the car, there is a 12.3-inch LCD with virtual Instruments, Dual-View 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, optional 1200W Bowers & Wilkins system, hard drive and connectivity for portable audio and video devices via a "Media Hub." Other available features include a panoramic glass roof, power accessories, automatic climate control, electric seats with ventilation, turning headlights and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS, pre-charged braking technology, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor and more. The V6 is available in regular or long-wheelbase form, while the V8 is only available in long-wheelbase form, with regular-wheelbase models available upon request.

The MG RX8 is the brand's midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base model include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric folding mirrors, LED headlamps and taillamps, LED daytime running lamps, cruise control, single zone electric A/C, fabric seats, driver seat manual lumbar adjustment, mechanical instrument cluster, 10.1-inch touch screen with USB ports, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 6 speakers, front and rear fog lamps, roof rails, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models gets all-wheel drive, leather seats, front driver and passenger powered seats, ventilated seats, 7-inch virtual instrument cluster screen, dual-zone automatic A/C, wireless charger, rear climate control, panoramic sunroof and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, hill assist control, and tyre pressure monitor. The higher models get additional blind spot monitor and lane departure warning.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016, and then another minor facelift in 2019. It is available with "SkyActiv" engines, a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder,direct-injection with high compression ratios. In 2020, a 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine joined the lineup. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. The top model includes 19-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera, bi-xenon headlights, daytime running lights, 11-speaker Bose sound system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents and a sunroof. Navigation and adaptive cruise control can be further added to the top-spec version, but they're not offered in all GCC markets. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

From 2014, the Infinti FX model became the QX70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure, but has since remained unchanged. The QX70 is available in four trim levels and two different engines. The Excellence, Luxury and Elite Sport get a 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the Luxury Sport variant gets the 5.0-litre V8, with both engines mated to 7-speed automatic transmissions. Built on the all-wheel-drive front-midship platform, the the QX70 features an extensive list of available equipment. Available features include Continuous Damping Control, Rear Active Steer, and 21-inch lightweight aluminium-alloy wheels designed by Enkei. Inside, the interior has available "sport" seating and advanced audio, optional navigation and technology ranging from an 11-speaker Bose-developed audio system to the intelligent key, available active cruise control and available around-view monitor system. The QX70 offers numerous safety and convenience technologies such as intelligent brake assist, distance control assist, adaptive front lighting system, standard HID headlights, integrated fog lights, rear LED taillights, functional side air vents, aluminium roof rails, leather and wood trim, sunroof, "self-healing" clearcoat paint finish, stability control, and the usual power accessories and multiple airbags. Available safety features include object-detection for the around-view parking camera system as well as voice instructions on how to parallel-park into a specific space.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i and the M235i. The 220i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M235i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto or a 6-speed manual. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M235i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Nissan Patrol Nismo debuted in the GCC in 2016 and in 2021 it got a new facelifted version. The 5.6-litre V8 engine has been upgraded to produce slightly more power. The exterior gets a bodykit which includes Nismo sports headlights, 22-inch forged-alloy wheels, chrome-plated radiator grille, front and rear sports bumpers. The interior gets a sportier design for the leather upholstery with Nismo logos. The suspension has been upgraded with Nismo-tuned Bilstein shock absorbers. The rest of the features you will find similar to the Patrol Platinum edition which includes Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The SL has undergone a major redesign for 2009. Models now include a new 3.0-litre SL 280 base model, the continuing 3.5-litre SL 350, the carryover 5.5-litre SL 500 and the existingtwin-turbo 5.5-litre SL 600 rocketship. Upping the ante are two sport-tuned models, namely the new 6.3-litre SL 63 AMG and the twin-turbo 6.0-litre SL 65 AMG. Interesting features include optional Active Body Control suspension and optional neck-ventilation fan thingies. The redesigned front end sports different headlights and bumper, while the rear is mildly updated by new tail-lights and bumper spoilers. Along with new wheels on the outside, new interior appointments include new materials and colour schemes. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. The V60 straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level V60 T4 model comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The higher-spec V60 2.0T model comes with 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic as well. Later on the more powerful V60 T5 2.0-litre turbocharged engine came was offered. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. Very few were sold in the GCC.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

The Optima had its first credible entry in the midsize field back in 2006. The model has received a facelift for 2009, but remains smaller than the usual Japanese makes. This front-wheel-drive sedan is powered by either an upgraded 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, or a respectable 2.7-litre V6 with a 5-speed automatic. The makeover continues within the cabin with new trims and colour schemes. Features include a CD/MP3 player, new instrument cluster with red illumination, and seat trims in grey or beige, with cloth or leather, power windows and door locks, a six-way adjustable driver's seat and four-way adjustable front passenger seat as well as 60/40-split folding rear seats. EX models upgrade to a leather-wrapped steering wheel with tilt and telescopic functions, leather seat and door trim, leather-wrapped shift knob, automatic temperature control, and an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat. Safety features continue to be marginalised here, as only a driver's airbag is standard, a passenger airbag is optional, and no side airbags available. Other features include front active headrests, ide-impact door beams, brake assist and ABS brakes.

The Hyundai i10 received a facelift for the 2011 model year. It also gets a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with VTVT (Variable Timing and Valve Train) technology, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The all-new Porsche Panamera is the German manufacturer's first ever 4-door sedan model. The 'Gran Turismo' is available in five versions, namely the Panamera S, the Panamera 4S and the top-of-the-range Panamera Turbo, with the base Panamera V6 and the Panamera 4 V6 joining the range in the summer of 2010, while the flagship Panamera Turbo S debuted in early 2011. The Panamera S and the Panamera 4S have a 4.8-litre V8, while the Panamera Turbo has a turbocharged 4.8-litre V8. An upgraded 4.8-litre turbo V8 comes the Panamera Turbo S, with an overboost function as well. All come with a 7-speed PDK automanual gearbox, while the 4 V6, 4S and Turbo feature all-wheel-drive. The base V6 and the S can also be had with a 6-speed manual. All versions come with Porsche's new fuel-saving start-stop function. Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM) is a standard feature on the Turbo and an option on the Panamera S and 4S, with adjustable damping for the adaptive air suspension. In the Sport Plus Mode, the Panamera is lowered by 25 mm. The Panamera comes on newly developed 18-inch and 19-inch wheels, with 20-inch aluminium wheels available as an option. Available on the Panamera Turbo is an active adjustable rear spoiler. The four-seater Panamera boasts a unique leather-draped interior, with four sports seats and useable cargo room. Optional is a four-zone automatic a/c with individual adjustments for each seat. The Panamera S and 4S come with the "CDR" stereo as standard, while the Turbo is equipped with "PCM" multimedia computer, with navigation optional on the other two models. As an option, rear passengers can enjoy two consoles integrated in the headrests of the front seats with swivelling 7-inch touchscreens. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2015 model year and will now be available only as a 4-door sedan. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

All-new in 2007 and facelifted for 2010, the Q7 is the first proper SUV to bear the Audi name. It is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 is available with a 3.6-litre V6 and a 4.2-litre V8 in the GCC, now available with an energy recovery system to run the electrical system. Both come with a six-speed automatic with Tiptronic manual mode. However, both engines were cancelled by 2011 in favour of two 3.0-litre supercharged V6 "TFSI" engines, one more powerful than the other, with only the higher-powered one getting a "supercharged" title. There is a 4.2-litre turbodiesel V8 and a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V12 "TDI" engine available for order as well, for whatever reason. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Changes to the 2010 Audi Q7 include new LED headlights and indicators, LED taillights, a chromed front grille, new bumpers, new instrument cluster, ambient lighting and new cabin trim choices, along with new paint colours. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The Bentley Continental GTC received a facelift for the 2012 model. Also a new turbocharged V8 model was added to the line-up, to join the W12 engine. It now comes with an 8-speed automatic transmission which gives better fuel economy numbers and ever so slight increase in acceleration figures. The Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental GT convertible is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GTC Speed, which debuted in 2013 with the same W12 engine, adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling.

An all-new Bentley Continental GT was released in 2018. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Continental GT is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet made its debut back in 2007. In 2010 it received power upgrades and a new automatic gearbox. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets an updated all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Another option in the Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 3.0-litre diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Dodge Ram had been extensively re-engineered for 2006, with a minor restyling and an upgraded interior, having been originally redesigned in 2002. It has a new hydroformed frame that's boxed its full length to provide more strength than in any previous model. New suspension and body mounts also improve ride and handling, though it is still no luxury sports sedan. Inside the Ram, the instrument panel, centre console and seats have been redesigned for more car-like comfort, while new entertainment features have been introduced. The standard motor for the Middle East is the 5.7-litre Hemi V8 engine, which featured the new Multi-Displacement System from 2006, a setup that shuts down four of the Hemi's eight cylinders when they are not needed. Dodge claims the switchover is seamless, and that fuel economy is improved by as much as 20 percent. Adding to the Hemi's responsive nature is a five-speed automatic transmission. The Ram comes standard with air conditioning, AM/FM/CD stereo, rear-wheel ABS, 17-inch wheels and a full-size spare tyre. Also available are power windows and door locks, keyless entry, an overhead console with mini-trip computer and compass, cruise control and larger aluminium wheels.

The McLaren 650S is based on the 12C but with 25% new parts. The 650S comes with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. It got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The engine range includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts.

The Porsche Cayenne gets a minor facelift and engine upgrades for 2015. The variants available are the Cayenne, Cayenne S, Cayenne GTS, Cayenne Turbo, Cayenne Turbo S, Cayenne Diesel, Cayenne S Diesel and, for the first time, the Cayenne S E-Hybrid, the first plug-in hybrid in the premium SUV segment. All new models get a slight boost in performance and reduced fuel economy numbers. The new models get a new front fascia, similar to the design of the Porsche Macan, as well as new taillamps and exhaust pipes. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine. The Cayenne S and Cayenne GTS gets a new 3.6-litre turbo V6, while the Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.8-litre turbo V8. The hybrid and diesel models will be available only on special-order. The Cayenne S E-Hybrid has a lithium-ion traction battery with an all-electric driving range of 18 to 36 km. Inside, a new multifunction sport steering wheel featuring shift paddles is fitted as standard. Optional seat ventilation is now available for the first time. More variants of the Cayenne should be available later. As usual, everything on a Porsche is largely optional, with few exceptions. Features available on the Cayenne include a 7-inch TFT touchscreen, optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch, and a choice of an optional 14-speaker BOSE CD stereo or an optional 16-speaker Burmester CD stereo, both with USB and iPod support. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

A new Sebring makes Chrysler a little more than a bit player in the midsize segment, with a funky new exterior and a revamped interior. It even comes in four-seater convertible form with a choice of a cloth top or a folding hardtop. Features include optional remote start, express-down front windows on the key fobs, 60/40 fold-flat rear seats, stain-proof cloth seats or optional leather seats, sliding centre console armrest bin with dual-bin front seat storage, heated cup-holders, optional Harmon-Kardon CD/MP3 stereo with digital storage space, and a multitude of airbags. On the technical front, Electronic Stability Program and Traction Control are optional, as is Brake Assist. Other features include a tyre pressure monitoring system, ABS and keyless entry. Three engine options power the new Sebring in other markets, but the region only gets a 2.7-litre V6 as far as we know. The 2.7-litre has a five-speed automatic gearbox with AutoStick. The funky styling may not appeal to buyers used to Japanese midsizers, but the generous Sebring offers a host of standard interior and safety features that are not even available as options in its competitors.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This latest generation of midsize pickups feature roomier cabins, improved ride quality and increased stability. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with only a manual gearbox, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur debuted as a 2020 model year. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split. In 2022, the Bentley Flying Spur Mulliner made its debut. The exterior features exclusive Mulliner 22-inch wheels, in a grey painted and polished finish, with self-levelling wheel caps that remain upright as the wheels rotate.  A “Double Diamond” front grille and chrome front lower grille are matched by bespoke Mulliner branded wing vents and Satin Silver painted mirror caps. The iconic Bentley Flying B is electronically deployed and illuminated, while the Flying Spur Mulliner also features jewel fuel and oil caps.Mulliner illuminated outer treadplates and deep-pile Mulliner overmats welcome passengers inside. The trimmed cockpit is complemented by accent colour piping and unique Mulliner embroidery to the hand-stitched seats.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2015. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution.

The all-new Chevrolet Sonic is a sub-compact replacement for the Aveo. Available in sedan and hatchback body-styles, the Sonic is available in the GCC with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic function, with a 5-speed manual available in some markets. The base model comes with 5-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, fold-down rear seat, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, optional keyless entry and only one airbag. The mid-range LS model additionally gets steel wheels or optional 15-inch alloy wheels, optional sunroof, power windows, 4-way manually-adjustable driver's seat, better stereo with Bluetooth and more optional speakers, split-folding rear seat, optional parking sensors, optional ABS and two airbags. The top LT model additionally gets 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, standard ABS, 6-speaker stereo, and front as well as side airbags.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City and remained the same for the 2016 model year. It is slightly larger in every dimension, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Fiesta got a facelift and new engine in 2014. Available only in 5-door form, it gets 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 6-speed automatic. Available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trim levels, basic features include 15-inch steel wheels, electric power steering, capless fuel-filler system, full-size spare tyre, dual front airbags, cloth seats and manual windows. The top model can be outfitted with 15-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, rear 'sport' spoiler, front/rear parking sensors, automatic a/c, power windows, fog lamps, optional stability control, front and optional side-curtain airbags, driver's knee airbag, optional trip computer, keyless entry with push-button start, CD/MP3 with 6 speakers and steering-wheel controls, AUX input jack, Bluetooth, optional cruise control and more.

The MG 350 is the Chinese-owned brand's attempt to enter into the competitive compact sedan segment. Under  the hood, it gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 350 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, DVD entertainment system, sunroof, rear parking sensor,bluetooth connectivity and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The Lincoln MKZ made its comeback in the GCC as a 2014 model year, with a major frontal facelift and new engine coming in 2017. The MKZ comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine or a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters. The 2.0T comes in front-wheel-drive form while the 3.0T comes with all-wheel-drive for the GCC market. The MKZ will be available with SYNC3 and MyLincoln Touch as standard, along with large 10.1-inch LCD instrument cluster and an 8-inch centre touchscreen. Options include a huge opening panoramic glass roof. As for safety, there is a mono-vision camera integrated into the rearview mirror to read lane markers on the road. It will be complemented by radar sensors for the adaptive cruise control and active Collision Warning with Brake Support. Also included are wide-angle radar sensors for help with parking and backing up. It also has inflatable second-row seatbelts and eight airbags.

The oddly-named xA offers solid construction, tons of headroom and low maintenance costs. The xA doesn't set the world on fire with its styling, but it comes well-equipped with convenience and safety features. It's comfortable in the front seats, though the rear is a bit cramped, and it offers decent cargo space. The ride is firm and it handles reasonably well. It doesn't have a lot of power, but offers impressive fuel economy. The xA is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder and comes standard with a five-speed manual transmission, while a four-speed automatic is optional. The motor is spritely, but ultimately still underpowered. The list of standard features is surprisingly long for a car in this price class, and includes ABS brakes with Electronic Brake Distribution which boosts braking pressure in emergency situations, power windows, door locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, tilt steering wheel, tachometer and trip meter, 60/40 split folding rear seat and a six-speaker MP3/CD sound system.

The 2009 Mitsubishi Galant receives fresh styling with a new grille, hood and lower air intake at the front, and more changes at the rear including wider rear glass, a new trunk lid, taillights and rear bumper. The Galant is powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic transmission, and the 3.8-litre V6 engine with a 5-speed automatic. Bot gearboxes come with Sportronic manual shifting ability. The base model includes variable intermittent wipers, power mirrors, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, cloth seats, air conditioning, power windows, power locks with keyless entry and CD player with four speakers. The higher models get bright interior accents, cruise control, premium cloth seats, ABS brakes with EBD, and CD/MP3 player with six speakers, along with 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an eight-way power driver's seat. Options include reverse camera, fog lamps, special climate control console, steering wheel with audio controls, power sunroof, leather-trimmed seats, and a premium CD/MP3 player with changer and eight speakers. Safety features include only dual front airbags standard on all models, with ABS and traction control available on higher models only.

This VW marks the return of the Jetta nameplate to the Middle East, replacing the Bora lineup. However, it could have been better. Engines choices include a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit and an odd 2.5-litre 5-cylinder unit that is conspicuously underpowered for its size. Both engines are equipped with either a 5-speed manual gearbox or the new 6-speed Tiptronic automatic. The Jetta GLI debuted later in 2008, with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine and 6-speed DSG automanual gearbox. Volkswagens are known for better-than-average handling, and the new Jetta is said to be no exception. The new Jetta is larger than the previous Bora, and it features a more spacious interior stuffed with convenience and lavished with Volkswagen's attention to detail. Even the least-expensive model offers an elegant, high-quality cabin. Standard equipment include power windows, AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power outside mirrors, split/folding rear seats, remote central power locking, front airbags, side-impact airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and available electronic stability control. The GLI exclusively gets black-out body trim, 17-inch wheels, and a slightly-upgraded interior.

The Azera is Hyundai's attempt at the high end executive car market, occupied by only a handful of models which combine luxury with a affordable price. The Azera actually offers a lot more for its price than its Japanese and American competitors however, and this 3.3-litre V6-powered automatic sedan is an impressive effort on Hyundai's part. A 2.7-litre V6 joined the range later. A minor frontal facelift added a larger grille in 2010. Standard features on the base model include just a single airbag for the driver, power steering, power windows, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD and MP3 capability and six speakers, cruise control, dual zone fully automatic air conditioning, dual exhaust system, power mirrors, trip computer, illuminated sun visors with vanity mirrors, rear centre armrest with cup holders, and alloy wheels. Options include dual airbags with side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, Electronic Stability Program, HID Xenon headlights, power sunroof, leather upholstery, power front seats, integrated memory system for driver's seat and mirrors, in-dash 6-CD changer with two more speakers including an Infinity subwoofer and amplifier, rear parking sensors, electric rear curtain, rain-sensing front wipers and some wood on the steering wheel.

The 2020 Megane GT is a higher version of the compact offering from the French brand. It only comes as a hatchback. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push-button engine start, dual-zone A/C, rear air vents, cruise control, auto headlamps, 7-inch touchscreen, navigation, 3D Sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, 2 USBs, AUX, streaming via Bluetooth, cruise control and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include panoramic roof, techno Pack( full LED headlights, electric parking brake) or Premium Pack (Alcantara trim, heated driver & passenger seats, 8.7-inch touchscreen navigation, Bose sound system, 8 speakers, 2 USBs, AUX, Streaming via Bluetooth. Safety features include front and side airbags,  front & rear curtain airbags, ABS, emergency brake assist, blind spot warning, tyre pressure monitoring system and ESP with Hill Start Assist.

The MG 350 is the Chinese-owned brand's attempt to enter into the competitive compact sedan segment. Under  the hood, it gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 350 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, DVD entertainment system, sunroof, rear parking sensor,bluetooth connectivity and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. This Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street and came out first in 2008, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. The S 65 AMG gets a twin turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. It also  includes a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. For 2018, the Huracan Performante was released with higher performance numbers. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Lexus CT 200h is the first hybrid in the small-car segment to debut in the GCC. It got a facelift in 2014, getting the new front "spindle grille" design. This premium hatchback comes only in front-wheel-drive hybrid form, with a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder mated to a self-charging electric motor and a CVT automatic. The platform has its roots in Toyota models, but the suspension is fully independent, MacPherson-strut front and double-wishbone rear. Standard features include an info display to show battery usage, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with cloth upholstery, dual-zone auto a/c, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, parking sensors, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, split-folding rear seat, sunroof, LED side and tail lamps, LED front driving lamps, fog lamps and alarm. The top trim additionally gets leather upholstery, wood trim, power-adjustable driver's seat with memory, front seat heaters, navigation system with flip-up 7-inch LCD screen, rear camera, Bluetooth, auto-levelling LED headlights, rain-sensing wipers, sport front bumper, and a 10-speaker audio system. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The M6 Gran Coupe was introduced as a 2014 model year. The four door sedan uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Other mechanical features on the rear-wheel drive M6 Gran Coupe include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option, and a carbon-fibre roof. The M6 Gran Coupe features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The new Avalon is Toyota's rendition of the traditional big car. The Avalon was designed, engineered and built by the Toyota Technical Center in the United States. Its understated styling is more distinctive than any previous-generation Avalon, presenting a quiet look of grace. There was a very minor facelift in 2008, though no one noticed. Power produced by the powerful 3.5-litre V6 goes to the front wheels, originally via a smooth 5-speed automatic. A 6-speed automatic replaced the previous unit from 2008 onwards. Inside is a comfortable cabin lavished with tasteful materials and ergonomically-designed controls that makes this car a pleasant and cheap alternative to a Lexus. This newest Avalon is significantly larger than previous models. The front seats are roomy and comfortable and special attention was paid to back-seat comfort. The Avalon is smooth and comfortable, quiet and serene, as the suspension was tuned for ride comfort. Trim variations are limited to accessories. Standard features include a premium AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers, remote keyless entry, multi-function information display for audio, climate control, temperature and trip computer, among other things.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019. The 8-Series Convertible came to the GCC in 2020. Under the hood, it comes with a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, coupled with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 8-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Trooper was Isuzu's first well-known 4WD vehicle, and is a vehicle that was very competitive in terms of looks and features, but never caught on due to poor marketing and even poorer dealer support. It came in 3-door and 5-door body styles, both five-seaters, although both looked very similar to each other, except for the number of doors. While previous Trooper models were basic utilitarian offroaders, this version actually was well-endowed with basic luxury features of the time. This particular model line ended in 2002, at which point Isuzu discontinued its passenger-vehicle line and concentrated on work trucks. The Trooper came with an acceptable 3.5-litre V6, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. All trims had standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. Available features included cloth or leather interior, power windows, electric mirrors, monotone or two-tone paintjob, sunroof, cassette stereo with CD changer, cruise control and alloy wheels. Safety features included four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and front airbags.

An all-new model of the Hyundai Elantra came out in 2021. It is longer, lower and wider than the previous generation Elantra. Under the hood, the 2022 Hyundai Elantra gets two 4-cylinder engines, a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre, both engines mated to a CVT. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models of the 2022 Hyundai Elantra get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features on the 2022 Hyundai Elantra include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The McLaren 720S is the successor to the 650S, built on a modified carbon chassis which is lighter and stiffer than that in the 650S. The 720S sports a turbocharged 4.0-litre engine, which is basically a reworked variant of the 3.8-litre unit in the 650S, featuring a lengthened stroke and 41 percent new components, and mated to a carryover 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. An adaptive hydraulic suspension system with Proactive Chassis Control II, a redesigned air-brake spoiler which doubles the downforce compared to its counterpart in the 650S, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system, are all standard. Other features include an 8-inch capacitive touchscreen, folding driver display, premium audio system from JBL-Kenwood, ambient lighting, and Static Adaptive Headlamp with 17-LEDs per unit. Safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS, and stability control. Some interesting driver aids include Variable Drift Control and launch control.

The Tesla Model S is a fully electric sedan, which combines high performance and zero emission. Dropping rear-wheel-drive models altogther, all versions are now all-wheel-drive with air suspension as standard for 2018 -- 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth, and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include, self-driving capability, enhanced autopilot, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features feature traffic-aware cruise control, autosteer and autopark.

The 308 is a completely new version of the outgoing 307, and is available in 3-door and 5-door versions, both in hatchback trim. The 308 SW wagon debuted in 2009, while a hard-top convertible 308 CC model came in 2010. Two 1.6-litre engines were initially available, one naturally-aspirated and one turbocharged. The CC came only with the turbo engine. All versions come with an automatic gearbox, with only the basic 5-door non-turbo model getting a manual. Later on, the 3-door 308 GT quietly became available, with an upgraded 1.6-litre turbo and a 6-speed manual. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, CD player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with GSM built-in telephone, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The ZNA Rich is a midsize pickup available in single and double-cab body styles, with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. There are no changes for 2014, aside from a grille change for some markets. Features include a 5-speed manual, 15-inch steel wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes, power steering, adjustable steering column, central locking, power windows, power mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and SD card, manual antenna, manual a/c and front seat belts.

The Wrangler has been redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The all-new real jeep is longer and wider and more refined. Now powered by a 3.8-litre V6, with a manual or automatic, it still offers low-range gearing and off-road capability. In 2011, the interior was redesigned completely, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were offered. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Scirocco is revival of Volkswagen's odd-shaped 1970s model that attempted to bridge the gap between a hatchback and a coupe. It last died out in 1992, until its revival as a concept car in 2006 and a production car by 2008. Debuting in the GCC as a 'sportier' alternative to the VW Golf, the Scirocco lifts platforms, engines and even interior panels from the Golf. However, the cabin itself has a lower roofline while retaining seating for four. Engines include a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder with both a supercharger and a turbocharger, as well as a 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. The GCC dealers will be pushing the automatic version locally, with the 'DSG' automanual gearbox, but it can be special-ordered with a 6-speed manual. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

The A3 hatchback slips into Audi's line-up as the company's smallest and cheapest model, starting in 2004 and receiving a minor facelift in 2005. Sharing its platform with the MKV-generation VW Golf, the main A3 models available here are a 1.6-litre four and a 2.0-litre four, both with front-wheel-drive, but while engines such as a 2.0-litre turbo four are not officially offered, a few local dealers offer the 3.2-litre V6, complete with Quattro all-wheel-drive. We confirmed that many local dealerships do not stock the faster models, but Audi's PR people, apparently disconnected from the local dealer network, argue that they are in fact available. Transmission choices are limited to a six-speed automatic in this region, although the V6 does get a DSG automanual. The four-cylinder engines can be had in either three-door or five-door Sportback form, though again it depends on the local dealer. Standard features on the four-cylinder models include four-wheel disc brakes, 16-inch alloy wheels, automatic climate control, power windows, power locks with keyless remote, cloth seats and a CD player. Although itï¿½s a compact car, the A3 is pricey. It tries to justify its price with a well-built exterior and a pleasant interior, as well as a badge that no one respects yet. The biggest challenge the A3 faces is getting buyers to accept its relatively high price tag. For what is offered, we wouldn't.

The Volvo V70 is a midsize station wagon available in a few GCC countries. Currently only the V70 Comfort is sold here with the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment in the car include power mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with CD player, foldable three-split rear seats and alloy wheels. Volvo, never to compromise on safety, has driver, passenger, side and curtain airbags as standard, along with WHIPS whiplash protection. Luggage space is quite big thanks to its upright shape. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.
The BMW 2-Series active tourer is a front-wheel drive compact hatchback.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S 65 AMG gets a mid-cycle refresh, in line with the rest of the S-Class range, with ever-so-subtle design changes. The most significant changes for the S65 AMG include a new transmission, and ends with a slightly redesigned front-fascia and DRL's. It is still propelled by a 6.0-litre twin-turbocharged V12 engine, and is now mated to an all-new 9-speed automatic transmission. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. Theres also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

Chevrolet Colorado is the American manufacturer's commercial midsize pickup offering, essentially a rebadged version of the Isuzu D-Max and built in Thailand. It comes in two engines - either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 5-speed manual or a 3.6-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, with no diesel options. Only the crew cab four-wheel drive models are available in the GCC. Entertainment is provided by the radio with a  single-disc CD drive and FM/AM/CD supporting MP3/WMA plus available four  speakers. Other standard features include power windows, power mirrors, painted front and rear bumpers and remote key entry. Safety-wise, the front driver and passenger get airbags and anti-lock braking (ABS) with electronic brake force distribution (EBD).

The Vectra is Opel's attempt at the upper end of the midsize car market, although more conservative pricing would've helped it compete against the larger Japanese midsize sedans. The Vectra was the first European application of GM's front-wheel-drive Epsilon platform, shared with the Saab 9-3. This architecture uses aluminium in the suspension and bonnet, magnesium in the dashboard cross member and lots of high-tensile steel. The Vectra, available as a sedan or a liftback, received a new front end during the 2006 model year. The largish interior can hold five people, and luggage space can be increased by folding down the rear bench seat. The extensive range of engines available in Europe has been cut down to a single 2.2-litre four-cylinder in the Middle East, mated with only a five-speed automatic transmission. Features include power windows, cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD stereo, cruise control, keyless entry and more. The rigid passenger cell is complemented by standard safety equipment including front airbags, side airbags for driver and front passenger, as well as curtain airbags in front and rear. Also available are active head restraints in front with lumbar supports to reduce whiplash injury.

The new-for-2011 BMW X1 is the smallest crossover SUV in the German manufacturer's overgrowing range. Based on the 1-Series platform, complete with four-wheel-independent suspension and disc brakes, the X1 is their first SUV to be available in rear-wheel-drive form with the sDrive18i base model, sporting a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The other two models in the range are the all-wheel-drive xDrive25i and the xDrive 28i, both fitted with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine in different states of tune, one with more power than the other. The interior features a new melted-look dashboard, with optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

The Maxus V80 is a large commercial vehicle offering from the Chinese brand. They are offered in three specifications - 15 seater passenger vehicle, 18 seater minibus and as a cargo vehicle. It is powered by a 2.5-litre turbo diesel engine, mated to a standard 5-speed manual transmission, and a 6-speed manual transmission in the minibus configuration. Standard features include electric front windows, front and rear A/C, central locking, remote key, audio system with radio and mp3 support, fog lamps and halogen headlamps. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and dual front airbags.

The 2018 Ford Transit is the brand's large commercial van offering. It seats up to 2 people, and comes in 3 roof heights: Low, Medium and High. It comes in 2 wheelbases and 3 lengths:RWB, LWB and LWB EL. Under the hood, the 2018 Ford Transit gets the 3.7-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, vinyl seats, halogen headamps, AM/FM stereo, 4 front speakers, auxiliary audio input jack and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features include AdvanceTrac with RSC (Roll Stability Control), airbags – driver and front-passenger, airbags – Safety Canopy System with side-curtain airbags for front row, passenger-side front airbag with deactivation switch and rear view camera with trailer hitch assist, SOS Post Crash Alert System, and tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS).

The all-new Volvo C30 is Volvo's new entry-level attempt at capturing younger buyers. This sporting new hatchback has provocative body sculpting, room for four average-sized adults and a range of competitive engines. It looks very original, except for the front-end face, which is lifted directly off its larger siblings and looks dated already. It offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers, and features very basic interior styling, save for a few unique touches such as the floating centre console. Available in this region are three engines, the base being a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with a manual gearbox offered only in 2008. The higher ones are both five-cylinder, one being a 2.4-litre and the other a turbocharged 2.5-litre, both with automatic gearboxes and tiptronic functionality. All three versions are front-wheel-drive. Standard features include cloth upholstery, power windows, trip computer and CD audio. Standard safety features typical of Volvo include ABS brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, and a whiplash protection system. Options include alloy rims between 15-inch and 18-inch sizes, three levels of audio equipment, customisable centre console trim, stability control and a blind-spot warning system for inattentive drivers.

Spyker is largely an unknown name to the general public, but this Dutch name was apparently around as far back as 1898. The company was resurrected in 2000 with the C8 Spyder, a unique and expensive hand-built supercar with an open-top roof. The Spyker C8 Laviolette coupe soon joined the Spyder. In 2002, the street version of their LeMans racer was unveiled as the C8 Double12 S coupe, with an extended rear end. The C8 was finally launched in this region in 2007. The Spyker C8 range has a 4.2-litre Audi V8, manual or automatic six-speed gearbox, limited slip differential and ABS brakes. Optional features for all cars include a turned-aluminium dashboard fascia, 19-inch Aeroblade magnesium wheels, several leather options, Chronoswiss dashboard instruments, supercharger or even a custom-fitted Louis Vuitton luggage set. The body is built in Germany and the car is assembled in Holland.

The Indica is an outdated hatchback launched in India back in 1998, spawning variants such as the Indigo sedan and the Indigo Marina station wagon. They went on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica and Indigo were considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger cars. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The Toyota Hiace has been the market leader for years in the UAE and continues to be a popular choice in the commercial sector, whether for transporting the work-force or cargo. There is only one engine choice in the Hiace, a 2.7-litre four cylinder petrol engine mated to a standard 5-speed manual, while some markets such as UAE occasionally get a 4-speed automatic option. The Saudi market additionally gets a 2.5-litre diesel model with a 5-speed manual. It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

The Kia Picanto, one of the few superminis available in the GCC, underwent a complete redesign for 2012, increasing slightly in size to improve interior space. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. Only the base model can be had with a 5-speed manual, while the three higher trims get a 4-speed automatic. Features, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 14-inch or 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control with "˜welcome and escort' modes, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Safety features, available only on the top model, includes ABS and one airbag.

The Infiniti G35 is company's first serious rear-wheel-drive honest-to-goodness sports sedan. It uses a 3.5-litre V6 with a 5-speed automatic transmission. Its platform is the corporate front-midship, which it shares with the Nissan 350Z. Features include 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlamps, fog lamps, heated mirrors, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, cloth or leather seats with power adjustment, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo and wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a rear spoiler, power sunroof, rosewood interior trim, dual HVAC controls and a DVD-based navigation system. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Sentra has the design cues of the Altima and Maxima which Nissan have adopted lately in their cars. It will get a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. The 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in only CVT. The 1.6S and 1.8S gets power steering, power mirrors, power windows, halogen headlamps, rear LED lamps, keyless entry, manual seats, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/RDS support and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. The 1.6SV gets LED accent headlamps, intelligent key with engine push-start button, wood trim and 4 speakers. The 1.6 SV Sports gets fog lamps, leather steering, rear spoiler, 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors and indicators on side-view mirror.  Both 1.6 SV and 1.8 SV sports have the option of USB/iPod connectivity, bluetooth, navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. The 1.8 SV gets the same as S but with rear parking sensors and bluetooth. The 1.8 SL gets the same options as 1.6 SV Sports plus rear spoiler with brake lamp, 6 speakers and USB/iPod connectivity. The 1.8 SL Premium gets more features such as leather seats, sunroof, cruise control, dual-zone climate control A/C. The 1.8 SL and SL Premium have the option of adding navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. Safety features include electronic brake-force distribution (EBD), ABS and Brake Assist (BA), along with driver and passenger front airbags. Only the 1.8 SL Premium gets side and curtain airbags.

The Haval H2 is the Chinese SUV brand's smallest offering. It got a slight facelift in 2020. It comes with a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor and traction control.

Released in 2003, and ever so slightly redesigned for 2006, the Mazda 6, also known as the grammatically-incorrect Mazda6, is the sportiest among the current crop of front-wheel-drive midsize family cars, but only in terms of handling. The Mazda 6 was originally designed for the driving enthusiast, with choices of V6 and turbocharged engines, but the Middle East market only gets a pathetic 2.0-litre and a reasonable 2.3-litre engine, both of which are four-cylinder and come with a choice of manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre comes in the four-door sedan and an attractive five-door station wagon body style, while the 2.3-litre comes in the four-door sedan shape as well as a sporty five-door liftback , as long in length as the sedan. Standard features include power windows, central locking, basic stereo system with 4 speakers, dual airbags for driver and front passenger, and available ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. Options include a full body kit, rear spoiler, fog lamps, 6 CD changer, cruise control, alloy wheels, sunroof and leather seats.

The Expedition is a full-size 4WD that has yet to blaze a trail in the Middle East. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. The Expedition comes with a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it.
