What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

The Jaguar XE is the smallest car offering from the British brand. It got a slight facelift and some interior updates in 2020. The XE is offered with two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. The turbocharged engine is offered in two different tunes. All models get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options in the XE include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, dual-zone AC, smart key system with keyless start, 8-inch display screen, 6 speakers, cloth seasts, paddle shifters and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher option models get leather seats, sunroof, ventilated seats, xenon headlights, adaptive cruise control, head-up display, bodykit, and 18 to 19-inch rims. Safety features include All Surface Progress Control (ASPC), Torque Vectoring by Braking (TVbB), ABS, dynamic stability control (DSC), lane departure warning, closing vehicle sensing, autonomous emergency braking, driver and passenger front and side airbags.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The Accord is of one the best midsize sedans available. It may not be best in class for every little thing, but its all-rounder package makes it popular among consumers. The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, offered with either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. Only the basic 2.4-litre sedan will get a five-speed manual, while all the other trims get a five-speed automatic only. Standard features on all models include power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, cruise control, CD/MP3 player with steering wheel controls, dual front airbags, ABS brakes, head restraint system and keyless entry. Optional features available in higher models include 17-inch alloys, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps.

The MG HS is the brand's compact SUV offering. Only the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine is sold here, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the HS Comfort model include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric folding mirrors, halogen auto headlamps, cruise control, single zone electric A/C, fabric seats, driver seat manual lumbar adjustment, 7-inch display instrument cluster, 10.1-inch touch screen with USB ports, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 6 speakers, front and rear fog lamps, roof rails, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The HS Luxury models gets all-wheel drive, leather sports seats, front driver and passenger powered seats, LED headlamps, LED taillamps, 12.3-inch instrument cluster screen, dual-zone automatic A/C and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, ABS, stability control, hill assist control, and tyre pressure monitor. The higher models get additional curtain airbags, blind spot monitor and lane departure warning.

Based on a stretched version of the latest 'B6' Passat platform, the redesigned Skoda Superb is a 5-door liftback sedan, with an innovative tailgate that can open as a regular sedan boot or as a full liftback boot, known as 'Twin-Door.' A traditional station-wagon joined the range in 2012. Various VW-derived engines are available, although the only engines available for the GCC, from 2012, is the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and front-wheel-drive for the wagon, and a 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive for the sedan. Both are mated to a 6-speed "DSG" automanual. The Superb 2.0 TSI wagon is available with power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc CD changer and a 6.5-inch touchscreen, SD card and AUX inputs, automatic climate-control a/c, and a choice of upholstery. The Superb 3.6 sedan adds various other luxuries, such as a 12-speaker sound system, 18-inch alloys, standard leather interior and more. Available features include a Bluetooth phone, pull-up rear sun blinds, parking sensors with visual aid and a 'Park Assist' automatic parallel-parking system. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control and ABS. The Superb may not be available in all markets in the GCC.

The M6 Coupe uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Fuel economy is apparently better by 30% compared to the old V10-powered model. Other mechanical features include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option, and a carbon-fibre roof. The M6 features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The Mercedes-Benz A 45 AMG is the range-topping variant of the A-Class line. It received a facelift in 2016 and a power boost. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. Externally, it can be identified by its AMG-specific bumpers and wheels, although these are also available with lower-spec A-Class models with an AMG package as well. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. Other available features include HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, cruise control, navigation and more.

The all-new Chevrolet Corvette debuted as a 2020 model year. The eighth generation model, or "C8" gets an upgraded version of the 6.2-litre V8 engine, which is now located behind the passenger seat instead of in front. Power is delivered via an 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. There will be no more manual gearbox option. The base Corvette 1LT gets a removable roof panel, Bose premium 10-speaker system, Chevrolet Infotainment 3 System, standard 8-way power GT1 seats and tilt/telescope steering wheel, rear park Assist and HD rear view camera. The Corvette 2LT adds a number of comfort and convenience features in addition to color-matched interior options. It includes front curb view cameras, Bose Performance Series 14-Speaker audio system, heated/vented seats and heated steering wheel and optional GT2 seats in Nappa leather. The Corvette 3LT gets a leather-wrapped interior. Also included is 13 interior color options, custom leather-wrapped instrument panel and door, suede microfiber upper interior trim and standard GT2 seats in Nappa leather. The Z51 Package includes summer-only performance tires, bigger brakes, eLSD, front splitter and performance exhaust.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year, to replace the CL-Class. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class Coupe features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. It got a facelift for the 2018 model year. The Mercedes-Benz S500 Coupe comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine.. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class Coupe gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Aveo was formerly known as the Kalos, a subcompact automobile built by GM Daewoo, a South Korean subsidiary of General Motors. The Aveo is based on Daewoo's latest small car platform and was originally styled by Giorgetto Giugiaro. For 2006, the Aveo, the smallest Chevy-badged car, underwent a number of changes that also gave the sedan a new face. Features in this economy car include advanced dual-stage frontal airbags with passenger sensing system, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with bolt-on wheel covers on the base models or 14-inch alloy wheels on the top model, a retuned suspension with improved steering response and larger-diameter front stabilizer bar, tilting front seat headrests, revised interior fabrics, electronic throttle control and optional CD player. The Aveo comes in three trim lines, and available as a four-door sedan or a carryover five-door hatchback. All are powered by a 1.4-litre in-line four-cylinder, though the pre-facelift Aveo5 hatchback gets a weaker motor, and both come with a good five-speed manual that can be switched for an optional four-speed automatic. The hatchback was restyled for the 2008 model year after a brief hiatus, and remains different from the sedan. After the Sonic was introduced for 2012, the Aveo sedan continued to be offered as a fleet model.

The Rexton II is the latest version Ssangyong's attractive original Rexton. It was launched in the Middle East alongside two other now-defunct 4WDs back in 2002, and has survived with a facelift for 2007. The five-door Rexton can seat up to seven people and comes with a host of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, fake wood trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control is also available.

The Porsche 911 is all-new after spending more than a decade in its current form, with continuous updates of course. For 2012, the design incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than before. It is still a 2+2 seater coupe. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.4-litre direct-injection flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The 911 Carrera 4, which was introduced in 2013, adds all-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S upgrades the motor to a 3.8-litre, while the, new for 2013, 911 Carrera 4S adds all-wheel-drive. The Porsche 911 Targa and Targa 4S was revealed as a 2014 model year, getting the same engine specs as the Carrera 4 and 4S. The 911 Turbo and Turbo S was released in 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre turbocharged engine, and comes only with the PDK transmission. The Porsche 911 GT3 was revealed in mid 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre motor and for the first time, will not have a manual gearbox option. It will be available only with the PDK. The 911 GTS was revealed in the GCC in late 2014 and is available as rear-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. It is powered by a 3.8-litre motor, coupled with either a 7-speed manual or PDK transmission. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

The Grand Marquis is the longest running Mercury-badged vehicle ever. The mechanical underpinnings date back to the 70s, but a revision in 2003 involved a new frame, a revised independent front suspension, a new steering rack and rear suspension tuning. More updates in 2005 included a facelifted exterior, interior trim changes and more convenience features.The Grand Marquis is powered by a heavily detuned version of the Mustang's 4.6-litre V8 powerplant, mated to a four-speed automatic. If not obvious yet, the Grand Marquis is just a rebadged version of the Ford Crown Victoria. Features include three-person bench seats front and back, optional leather trim, a new instrument panel, burl woodgrain, a two-tone colour package and standard power windows. It is available in the Middle East in GS, GS Convenience, GS-L, LS Premium, LSE and LS Ultimate trims, at last count. A handling package, optional on GS and LS series, aims to improve the boat-like drive with 16-inch  aluminium wheels, a 3.27 axle, heavy duty rear stabiliser bar and rear air suspension with unique springs. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The Edge is an all-new softroader from Ford that debuted for the 2007 model yearand is aimed to compete in the hot crossover market. The Edge features a bold three-bar corporate grille, a raked windshield, a fast-sloping back window, a high-mounted rear spoiler, a high beltline and wheels that are pushed to the far corners to deliver an aggressive stance. The interior features seating for five and cargo space can be maximised when the rear seats are folded. The Edge is powered by a new 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available with front-wheel-drive or an intelligent all-wheel-drive system, the Edge is not equipped with low-range gearing. The interior features a centre console that can fit a laptop computer and a number of options including a panoramic Vista Roof, an MP3 audio jack and six-way power-adjustable front seats. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, seat-mounted side airbags and Safety Canopy air curtain system with rollover detection and side-curtain airbags.

The new-for-2013 Subaru XV, known also as Crosstrek elsewhere, is a completely new nameplate on the Impreza platform, but with hatchback styling, raised suspension, and roof rails. While appearing tough, this compact crossover is powered by a small 2.0-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. The standard XV 2.0i comes with the usual power options, cloth upholstery, auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys, cruise control and halogen headlights. The 2.0i-S Premium adds smart keyless entry and start, rear camera, aluminium pedals, dual-zone auto a/c, HID headlights with washers, power-folding mirrors with LED indicators, and a sunroof. Front and side-curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control are standard on all models.

In what could possibly be the most hotly-anticipated sports car of the decade, the Toyota 86 finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. The 86 is a collaborative effort with Subaru, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates. Available in various trim levels, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a Subaru-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or automatic. For 2014, the base model was dropped in some GCC markets. In the UAE, there is the GTX trims for the manual now, while the automatic gets VT and VTX trims. Also for 2016 model years, all trims get the TRD bodykit package. Some markets, such as Oman, apparently do not offer the manual. Standard features include cloth sports seats, halogen headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, manual a/c, common power accessories and 16-inch alloy wheels with 205/55 tyres, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. Most versions get a limited-slip differential. Available features in higher trims include auto a/c, HID headlights, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and 17-inch alloys with 215/45 tyres, aside from dealer-installed leather upholstery. The Saudi market gets navigation with the mid-range model, while the top GT model gets a body kit. Specs may vary between different GCC countries.

The 5th-generation 3-Series convertible was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Audi A6 got a facelift for the 2015 model year. Three engine variants are offered in the UAE - 1.8-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and 3.0-litre supercharged V6. The S6 model has a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine.The 1.8 TFSI and 2.0 TFSI comes in front-wheel drive, while the rest enjoy all-wheel drive systems. All the models get a 7-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well as 18-inch, 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control.

The Ram 1500 is offered in the GCC with a standard 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8. From 2014, it received the new rotary knob-controlled 8-speed automatic with available manual-shift feature. Available in regular cab, quad cab and crew cab, with three box lengths depending on model, the two trim levels available in the UAE are the SLT and the Laramie. Features available in the RAM include heated and ventilated front seats, surround-sound Alpine audio system, common power accessories, voice-controlled UConnect multimedia touchscreen system with Bluetooth phone and 30 GB hard drive, rear DVD screen, basic keyless entry with remote start, 17-inch basic or 20-inch chrome wheels, dual-zone auto a/c and a choice of cloth or leather upholstery, all depending on trim level. Standard safety features include standard ABS, stability control with hill-start assist and trailer sway control, front airbags and side airbags, as well as optional adjustable pedals, rear parking sensors and back-up camera.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This generation of the pickup has been around since 2006, but has been facelifted for 2012. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with a manual gearbox as standard, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player. However, the 2.7-litre double-cab is available in automatic transmission.

In 2013, the Audi S7 Sportback made its debut. It gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected, as it gets front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, ESP and traction control.

A new generation Golf R debuted in 2014 in the Middle East. Under the hood is a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, mated to a dual-clutch 6-speed automanual transmission. The all-wheel drive Golf R is lighter and more powerful than the previous generation. It features power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, sports seats, standard XDS electronic differential lock, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist, adaptive cruise control, 19-inch alloys and rear camera. Safety standards are high as it comes with seven airbags including a knee airbag, ABS brakes, traction control and stability control.

The Cherry E5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. The front-wheel drive E5 gets a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT automatic. The ACTECO engine, jointly developed by Chery and AVL, Austria, has also passed a 3,000,000km road test and 10,000 hours tough bench test following European and American standards. The chassis of E5 is accurately tuned by Lotus on parts, including spring, shock absorber, horizontal stabiliser bar and redirector. Its gets ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD) as standard. The instrument cluster ahs multifunctional display and the central blue multifunctional window displays the comprehensive driver info including time, odometer, instant fuel consumption, average fuel consumption, etc. The integrated audio control switches on the steering wheel are easy to recognise and operate enhancing driving comfort and pleasure. Fourway adjustable seats with fabric or soft and fine leather with ventholes and contoured sides provide perfect lumbar, back and leg support. Height adjustable neck and head support relieve fatigue and protect head and neck in collision. Foldin rear seats provide large flat space for additional storage. Front ventilated disc and rear solid disc braking systems ensure stable braking performance even in tough conditions. An all metal cage with high strength steel beams in the front and back, anticollision board in the front doors and steel bars in the rear doors are designed to absorb the force of the impact during collision. Front driver and passenger airbags are standard.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The engine range includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts.

The Volvo V70 is a midsize station wagon available in a few GCC countries. Currently only the V70 Comfort is sold here with the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment in the car include power mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with CD player, foldable three-split rear seats and alloy wheels. Volvo, never to compromise on safety, has driver, passenger, side and curtain airbags as standard, along with WHIPS whiplash protection. Luggage space is quite big thanks to its upright shape. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

Finally making its official debut in the GCC, the rally-bred Subaru Impreza WRX STI landed for the 2008 model year with a hatchback-only body and no warranty. By 2010, it could finally be bought with a warranty. The sedan came for 2011. The standard engine is a 2.5-litre turbocharged and intercooled horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed manual and Subaru's 'symmetrical' all-wheel-drive system. In 2011, a minor range-wide facelift debuted along with the sedan, as well as a 5-speed automatic option. An SI-DRIVE system offers three modes, namely Intelligent, Sport, and Sport Sharp, with the first mode reducing power and improving fuel economy. The 'Driver Controlled Center Differential,' also known as DCCD, has three automatic modes in addition to allowing manual torque-split adjustment. The VDC stability control system can be left on, fully turned off, or set to a sport mode. Features include ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, LED tail lamps, torque-sensitive limited slip differential, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, common power accessories and a CD stereo, with options such as Recaro sport seats and navigation. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

A new generation Nissan X-Trail debuted in the GCC in 2015. It remained the same for the 2016 model year. Featuring a completely revised exterior and interior, it gets a 2.5-litre 4 cylinder engine, mated to a CVT gearbox. The base model is front-wheel-drive, but all other trim levels are all-wheel-drive with an electronic 4x4 lock feature. There's also a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater layouts. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, keyless entry with central locking, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, and steel or 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include better entertainment system with screen and more speakers, bigger alloy wheels, parking sensors, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power front seats, navigation, 18-inch alloys and automatic a/c, among other things. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags with optional side airbags, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist (BA).

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2018. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the high roof version is sold in the GCC region. There are two different versions, each with a different length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

Just 40 examples of the Bugatti Divo are going to be built and sold (five units are bound for the Middle East), with the entire production run already spoken for well before the first car rolled out of the Molsheim factory. The Divo was offered only to existing Bugatti customers. Apart from the Divo’s low-volume status, its main drawcards are bespoke bodywork that reprises Bugatti’s coachbuilding tradition, plus sharpened dynamics that stem from fettled suspension and a comprehensive aero package that delivers almost 500 kg of downforce at the car’s 380 kph v-max.The Divo is actually slower than the 420 kph Chiron it’s derived from, in terms of outright straight-line speed as its high downforce and the aggressive negative camber it runs on the front and rear tyres necessitated a drop in ultimate velocity. But the payoff of these modifications, in addition to stiffer springs and dampers, is that the Divo serves up sharper steering response and corner-devouring capabilities that eclipse the Chiron – it’s eight seconds a lap quicker than the latter around the 6.2 km Nardo handling circuit.

The F-150 delivers all the manly attributes of toughness, strength, and imposing size, but does anyone who isn't involved in a job with physical labour need one? The fully-loaded models of the F-150 is sold here as more of a lifestyle vehicle, offering interior design and comfort that would rival some luxury cars. Properly equipped, it can haul more than a tonne in its bed. The F-150 is comfortable as well, with a quiet and refined ride. It comes with dual frontal airbags, cloth seats, a CD player, and air conditioning as standard. A host of power and luxury options are available too. For all these reasons, the F-150 has sadly been America's best-selling full-size pickup for 28 consecutive years. It is the most most profitable vehicle Ford makes. It is available in various trim levels, variations, and specialty models, including quad cab, single cab and dual cab model, with various bed sizes. At the bottom of the lineup is a V6 work truck, though the only options apparently offered here are the 4.6-litre V8 and the 5.4-litre V8 engines, with automatic trannies.

An all-new Mini Countryman was released in 2017. It received a slight facelift and interior upgrades in 2021. The Countryman is 8-inches longer than the previous generation. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and powered by the same engines. The standard model gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder motor, while the Cooper S gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, both of which can be had in front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive formats. It can be had with a 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The Aveo was formerly known as the Kalos, a subcompact automobile built by GM Daewoo, a South Korean subsidiary of General Motors. The Aveo is based on Daewoo's latest small car platform and was originally styled by Giorgetto Giugiaro. For 2006, the Aveo, the smallest Chevy-badged car, underwent a number of changes that also gave the sedan a new face. Features in this economy car include advanced dual-stage frontal airbags with passenger sensing system, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with bolt-on wheel covers on the base models or 14-inch alloy wheels on the top model, a retuned suspension with improved steering response and larger-diameter front stabilizer bar, tilting front seat headrests, revised interior fabrics, electronic throttle control and optional CD player. The Aveo comes in three trim lines, and available as a four-door sedan or a carryover five-door hatchback. All are powered by a 1.4-litre in-line four-cylinder, though the pre-facelift Aveo5 hatchback gets a weaker motor, and both come with a good five-speed manual that can be switched for an optional four-speed automatic. The hatchback was restyled for the 2008 model year after a brief hiatus, and remains different from the sedan. After the Sonic was introduced for 2012, the Aveo sedan continued to be offered as a fleet model.

The Volvo S90 debuted as an all-new model in 2017, introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new S90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring elongated taillights and dual exhaust tips. In the GCC, it is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 with front-wheel-drive (T5) and a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), both mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Cadillac ATS is the smallest offering from the American luxury brand. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS will be offered with two engine choices. One will be a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine and other a 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. Models mostly include long-wheelbase versions for now, which are the S 350 L, the S 500 L and the S 600, all with automatic gearboxes. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Options include a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodystyling and either 19-inch or 20-inch light-alloy wheels.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class made its debut as a 2014 model year. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S500 comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine, while the S400 gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2015 model year and will now be available only as a 4-door sedan. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.
An all-new model of the Kia Sorenta came out in 2021. The Sorento is a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension.

The Ford Expedition is a full-size 4WD that's carried on virtually unchanged since 2007, but started gaining ground in some markets after the demise of the Crown Victoria in 2012. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. In 2015, the Expedition comes with turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

The latest Durango has been redesigned, mostly with a minor facelift, and it appears to be a well-built light duty 4WD capable of transporting seven people almost anywhere in very comfortable surroundings, even though it is ultimately one of the ugliest vehicles on the road. The only engine option available here is the 5.7-litre, Hemi V8, which helps the two-and-a-half ton Durango move off with reasonable verve. It's interior design conserves space, which permits a 3rd row of relatively accessible seating. It is obvious that parent company Mercedes-Benz has had an influence on the lowly Dodge. The seams are tight and the materials are of a high quality. The ergonomics work well too, with all the minor luxuries, including a good sound system and a rear seat DVD-entertainment system. Excellent sound insulation means passengers aren't too distracted by road or wind noise, while the third row folds flat into the floor and the 2nd row folds up and out of way very easily. Standard features include air conditioning, power mirrors, illuminated entry lighting, front and rear power outlets, bucket seats, 40/20/40 folding second-row seat, AM/FM stereo radio with in-dash single-disc CD player, cruise control, tilting steering column, and remote keyless entry. Also available are rear climate controls, a power sunroof, AM/FM/6CD/MP3 player and a two-speed transfer case for off-roading.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre C 160 sports coupe. Next are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the C 180 Kompressor and the C 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon. The 2.5-litre C 230 is also available in all body styles. The 3.0-litre C 280 is available as a sedan or wagon only, while the 3.7-litre C 350 is again available in all three body styles. The C 280 and C 350 can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The 5.4-litre C 55 AMG comes in sedan form only. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

The Geely Emgrand X7 Sport is the Chinese brand's latest compact SUV offering. It comes with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. Features in the X7 Sport include electric power steering, power windows, 3.5-inch info display, keyless entry, automatic A/C with rear vents, leather seats, infotainment system with touchscreen, Bluetooth, AUX/USB support, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy rims. Tech features in the top "Flagship" model are extensive, with a 7-inch colour LCD between the gauges, a mostly-responsive 8-inch touchscreen multimedia system with AUX and USB ports, Dolby Surround Pro-logic II stereo, navigation, Bluetooth, rear parking camera with front/rear sensors, smart keyless entry, cruise control, power-folding mirrors, LED headlights, a half-sized panoramic sunroof, and a dual-zone climate control a/c.Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, 4 airbags for the standard model and 6 airbags for the full option model.

The Mitsubishi Outlander got a facelift in 2016 and carries on unchanged. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

The CCX is the latest mid-engined supercar from Swedish manufacturer Koenigsegg. It is an evolutionary design that replaced the original Koenigsegg CCR. The removable roof can be stored in the front cargo area of the carbon-fibre and kevlar-reinforced body. This new model has been designed to be more practical, so its scissor-doors reveal a cabin with Sparco sports seats and decent headroom. While previous Koenigsegg models were powered by a Ford Modular V8 engine sourced from America, the CCX engine was designed in-house, based on the Ford Modular architecture and assembled by Grainger & Worrall, a British outfit that produces drivetrain components for Formula 1 cars. The engine is a 4.7-litre V8 boosted by two centrifugal superchargers and mated to a 6-speed manual. A vortex-generator behind the seats and a flat underbelly improve downforce, while a rear spoiler is optional. Large 19-inch front and 20-inch rear magnesium-alloy wheels are standard. Also standard are electronically-adjustable ride height, climate control, electric mirrors, leather interior, central locking, power windows, alarm with immobilizer, toolkit, driver-side airbag, power steering, ABS brakes, traction control and a CD stereo. Options include custom-colour leather, custom paint, parking sensors, navigation, rearview camera, carbon-fibre wheels and fitted luggage. CCX is an abbreviation for Competition Coupe X. The X refers to the 10th anniversary of the completion and test drive of the first Koenigsegg vehicle in 1996.

Named after its 5.6-litre V8 engine, the QX56 is based on the Nissan Armada, which is itself is based on pickup truck platform. It is basically an upscale version of a less expensive model, although the QX56 does have unique styling. The QX56 four-wheel-drive system uses a transfer case with with settings for rear-wheel-drive, all-wheel-drive, 4-high and 4-low. It has three rows of seats, with the third row easy to fold flat. New for 2007 was a tiny increase in power, while 2008 added 20-inch chromed alloy wheels, redone interior and a restyled grille. The QX56 comes in a single trim line that includes a five-speed automatic transmission with tow/haul mode, heavy-duty skid plates, rear auto-levelling air suspension, tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, xenon headlights, fog lamps, LED tail and brake lights, power-operated liftgate with opening rear glass, rear proximity sensor,  leather interior, real wood trim, ten-way driver and eight-way power passenger heated seats, second-row heated seats, front and side airbags, automatic dual-zone climate control, seven-inch LCD screen, and six-CD Bose system with ten speakers and wheel-mounted controls. Options include a rear-view camera, among other items.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Coupe replaced 3-series coupe model. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 428i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The new BMW 4 Series Coupe is visibly larger in width and wheelbase than the outgoing BMW 3 Series Coupe. The BMW 4 Series Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. The SL 63 AMG comes with a turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more. An optional performance package bumps up power by 25 hp, and removes the speed limiter.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

Though the new-for-2011 Volkswagen Touareg looks a lot like a simple facelift, this is apparently an all-new model compared to the last one. The only petrol engine on offer in this 5-seater at launch is a carryover 3.6-litre V6, and later also with a 4.2-litre V8, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive, but now without low-range gearing. This VW is a proper crossover now, with independent four-wheel-suspension and a simple terrain-select system. Largely optional features include cloth or leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, navigation, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry, starter button, panoramic sunroof, real wood trim, power-folding rear seat, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go function, lane departure warning system, blind-spot monitor, pre-crash system with full automatic emergency braking, ABS, a full set of front and side airbags, parking assist with four cameras, adaptive air suspension with continuous damping control and adaptive roll compensation, LED tail lamps, HID headlights, power-adjustable front seats with memory, seat heaters and a choice of 18-inch, 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels.

Hyundai redesigned the Sonata from the ground up in 2011, and facelifted it for 2013. It takes on a 'four-door coupe' profile but without the impracticality or high price. The GCC market receives a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic transmissions with available paddle-shifters. The base model comes with power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, 'amplitude selective' dampers, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist.

An all-new Ford Expedition model came out as in 2018. Engine specs for the 2019 Ford Expedition include a second generation 3.5-litre twin-turbocharged "Ecoboost" engine, available in two different tunes, and connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. The Expedition’s terrain-management system allows the driver to select from seven modes in 4WD models, so whatever terrain you’re tackling (be it sand, mud/ruts, gravel, grass or snow), there’s a mode that optimises the drivetrain for it. Needless to say that when driving in the Sport mode, you get an improved throttle response and gearbox mapping. The big Ford offers the best towing capability of any full-size SUV, and it comes with features such as Pro Trailer Backup Assist, which negates the need for repeated back- and forth when reversing with a trailer. There’s also an available hands-free, foot-activated liftgate to make loading bulky cargo into the load bay less of a back-breaking exercise. Aside from offering best-in-class second-row and third-row legroom as well as hip-room, the Expedition is also the first in this segment to feature a sliding second-row seat with tip-and-slide functionality, providing easy access to the third row without the need to first remove a child safety seat. The Expedition’s second-row and third-row seats not only provide best-in-class roominess but can be quickly folded flat with the push of a button to provide access to a cargo area wide and flat enough to handle 4×8-foot sheets of plywood and other gear. There’s no shortage of luxury kit in the Expedition, and among the goodies on offer is plush leather trim, multicontour driver seat with massage feature, a power reclining 3rd row seat, capacitive touchscreen with SYNC 3 (which also offers Arabic voice capability) and Apple CarPlay / Android Auto compatibility, adaptive cruise control with Stop-and-Go (keeps a set distance to the vehicle in front, and will automatically bring the car to a complete stop, and accelerate away again when required), dual-headrest rear entertainment system and a premium 12-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system with enough bass to make the windows reverberate. Add to that, a class-leading Panoramic VistaRoof that covers not only the 1st row but also the 2nd. Your devices are also well catered to, as there’s wireless charging, four 12-volt power points, up to six USB ports positioned across all three rows and a 230-volt outlet. The Platinum gets collision-avoidance detection (for both pedestrians and vehicles), lane-keeping system, blind-spot warning with cross-traffic alert and enhanced active park assist (for both parallel and perpendicular parking needs). There’s also a 360-degree camera to give you a bird’s eye view of the car’s immediate surrounds.

The Clio was completely redesigned in 2006, but this new version is only available in the GCC in sporting form. The two versions available are the Renault-Sport Clio 197 RS and the Renault-Sport Clio F1 Team R27. As confusing as the naming system is, the RS is the generic model and the F1 is a special-edition model with red Brembo four-piston brake calipers, yellow paint and various "F1 Team" and "world champion" stickers. Both the RS and the F1 versions of the Clio Renault-Sport models will be sold in limited numbers across the GCC, due to low demand rather than to maintain exclusivity. Derived from the basic New Clio available in Europe, both the Renault-Sport cars are powered by a highly-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual gearbox. Renault says the cars were apparently tested locally to ensure suitability for local driving conditions, and fitted with air-conditioning systems to suit the local heat. Apart from the bright yellow paint finish which is exclusively for the R27 model, both cars will also be available in various colours. The yellow paint finish, red Brembo four-piston brake calipers at the front, Recaro seats and its exclusive stickers are the only differences that set the Clio F1 Team R27 apart from the RS 197. The F1 also benefits from BeBop 17-inch smoked wheels and a numbered plate alongside the handbrake. There is no spare tyre due to the dual-exhaust setup. Safety features include stability and traction control with "off" switch, ABS brakes, up to eight airbags, and energy-absorbing head restraints.

Launched in 2005 and facelifted for 2008, the compact S40 sedan is based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the S40 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The S40 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre, a higher-tuned 2.4-litre and a turbocharged 2.5-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

Mini released all-new Clubman model as a 2016 model. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. Unlike the old one, this one features proper 4 doors on the side. The Mini Cooper Clubman will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S Clubman gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The Cooper can be  had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the Cooper S Clubman is available with a 6-speed manual gear or an 8-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The Honda Accord got a facelift for the 2016 version. The coupe shares no body panels with the sedan version. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a CVT automatic. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. The 2.4 EX coupe comes with halogen headlights with LEDs, 17-inch alloys, fog lights, sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, power-folding mirrors, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel, dual-zone auto a/c, rear camera, 7-speaker stereo with touchscreen panel and USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, power driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, floor mats and all safety features. The 3.5 EX coupe adds the V6 engine, LED headlights, 18-inch alloys, dual exhaust tips, paddle-shifters, navigation, LaneWatch camera, "i-Dual" a/c and leather upholstery. For 2016, 'Honda Sensing' was introduced and is available only in the top grade Accord trim. This includes adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist system, collision mitigation braking system and road departure mitigation system. Also featured in the 3.5L V6 grades is the Honda Lanewatch feature which uses a camera located below the passenger side window to display an expanded rear view of the passenger side road way on the centre display. The display can show cars up to two lanes. Rear parking sensors is standard, along with Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), ABS, Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA).

The Toyota Avanza got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The rear-wheel drive Avanza, which is actually a rebadged Daihatsu, is a reasonably priced seven-seater minivan. Only the 1.5-litre engine will be offered in this region. It comes either with a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. In the UAE, an SE model is offered which features automatic transmission, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, A/C with rear vents, fabric seats, audio entertainment system with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support, audio controls on steering wheel, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. In Saudi Arabia, the same specs is sold as an XL model. The fleet spec model gets a manual transmission, 14-inch steel wheels, and does not get the fog lamps, mud guards, steering controls and chrome linings in the exterior. On the safety side it gets standard dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Chery E8 is the Chinese brand's midsize sedan offering. The front-wheel drive E8 gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to CVT automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, fog lamps, manual fabric seats, radio with CD player, USB port, six speakers, parking sensors, chrome-plated front grille and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include electric sunroof and leather electric seats. Front driver and passenger airbags are standard, as is ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Changan Eado is a compact sedan from China. An all-new model came out in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Eado include power windows, central locking, remote control on key, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 4 speakers, leather steering wheel with audio controls, USB+AUX ports, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and hologen headlamps. Safety features includes front dual airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre C 160 sports coupe. Next are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the C 180 Kompressor and the C 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon. The 2.5-litre C 230 is also available in all body styles. The 3.0-litre C 280 is available as a sedan or wagon only, while the 3.7-litre C 350 is again available in all three body styles. The C 280 and C 350 can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The 5.4-litre C 55 AMG comes in sedan form only. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

The Carnival, now known as Grand Carnival, is undoubtedly Kia's largest offering, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. It comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The redesigned-for-2011 Dodge Charger looks a bit like the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but feels like a completely different car compared to its predecessor. Identifiable by its larger snout and 164-LED tail lamps, the new rear-wheel-drive Charger features updated suspension, upgraded engines and a much nicer interior. The new 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to a 5-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in two trim levels. For 2012, an 8-speed automatic also became available for the V6. The base "Express" model gets a manual a/c, cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. The "Lux" trim level additionally comes with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with a 5-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. The base "Full House" trim gets almost all the features of the top V6 model except for leather and fancy cup-holders, but gains sportier suspension and brakes. The "Lux" adds power seats, the fancy cup-holders, premium audio and a few other features. The top "R/T" model gets the "Road and Track" performance package with sportier suspension, steering, exhaust, grille, spoiler, 20-inch alloys and a 3.06 axle ratio instead of the stock 2.65 one. The top model, the Charger SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Superbee SRT8 gained special graphics, but came with standard suspension rather than the full-spec SRT8's adaptive ones, along with fewer other features. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The new GL-Class, built in USA, was intended to be the replacement for the classic Gelaendewagen, but criticism from the general public killed that idea. The GL-Class is now a separate model, supposedly a state-of-the-art luxury 4WD that offers typical Mercedes-Benz luxury with true off-road capability. The GL uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. In addition to the newly developed 5.5-litre V8 in the GL 500, the second model is the GL 450 with a 4.6-litre V8. Both come exclusively with a 7-speed automatic. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GL-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

An all-new 2019 Mercedes-Benz G 63 AMG was revealed. Under the hood, it gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission.  It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before. Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

BMW made its leap into the large SUV category with the flagship X7. Under the hood, two engine options are available - the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder engine and the turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 motor, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and electrically adjustable third-row seating. The middle row features three seats with a two-seat "captain's chair" configuration also available. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. The X7 also receives driver assistance systems including autonomous cruise control and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. It is a compact sedan with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

At first glance, this Chinese-built car looks like nothing more than a cheap copy of the Toyota Corolla, with the rear end of a Honda City mixture, but wearing a fake BMW badge. And it is exactly that, but if you look past the lame attempts at plagiarism, you'll find a package that actually might be a decent deal for a new car. The F3 is powered by a 1.6-litre Mitsubishi-sourced engine, mated to a 5-speed manual Mitsubishi gearbox. It includes an interior that is exactly like that of a last-generation Toyota Corolla, but with softer touchable surfaces. Available features, standard or optional, include 15-inch wheels, leather upholstery, dual front airbags, sunroof, manual air-conditioning, CD player, remote keyless entry, fake wood trim, height-adjustable steering wheel, power windows, ABS brakes and the price tag of a car half its size. Build quality seems to be of passing-grade, although some plastic pieces have an unfinished feel to them. If only they'd try a bit harder and be a bit more original. The price may make up for it though, in the eyes of some cost-conscious buyers.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. An all new generation Koleos came out in 2017, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment in the 2019 Renault Koleos, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Navigation is a new option for 2014. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The Mercedes-Benz A-Class changes focus completely from a half-sized runabout to a proper hatchback for 2013. Aiming to gain a larger share of the younger-driver market that the German carmaker has so far failed to impact in this region, the A-Class will only be offered in one version, the A 250, powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Dodge's new entry-level vehicle is a five-passenger hatchback that replaces the Neon sedan and attempts to be a replacement for the common 4WD wagon too. It has a liftgate and split-folding rear seats. All trim levels use a 4-cylinder engine. The base model is a 2.0-litre with CVT automatic. The larger 2.4-litre is available with either manual or CVT. For 2009, the Caliber SRT-4 model was quietly released, with a 2.4-litre turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual. Available features include a fold-flat front passenger seat, refrigerated glovebox, and removable cargo light/flashlight. Unique features include oddities such as flip-down speakers when the liftgate is open, illuminated cup-holders and a central armrest that moves front and back. Also available are leather upholstery, nine-speaker Boston Acoustics stereo and alloy wheels. ABS is optional on the base models, and standard on the top trim, where it comes with rear disc brakes instead of drums. A tyre pressure monitor is optional. All Calibers have available front airbags and side airbags.

The Luxgen7 MPV is a 7-passenger minivan equipped with surprisingly upscale technologies, and the company intends to compete on an entry-level luxury footing with pricing to match regular non-luxury brands. It is currently only sold in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Oman. The top feature is the Luxgen Think+ system, co-developed with smartphone makers HTC, that comes with built-in HSPDA 3.5G communications, GPS Navigation and a 10.2-inch LCD display screen for a comprehensive tech package. The system also includes the "Eagle View+" 360-degree parking assist which utilises four cameras to provide a real-time visual display of the surrounding environment.
