The "Side View+" feature automatically displays live video images of the vehicle's rear blind spot to reduce the chance of an accident during lane changes. The "Night Vision+" high-sensitivity night vision camera system helps illuminate the road and traffic conditions at night beyond the range of the headlamps. "LDWS+" constantly reads the road surface for lane markers and dividers and gives audible and visual warnings when the vehicle veers too close to the lane markings. Overall, the MPV is equipped with 23 advanced ECUs and 8 video cameras to provide these features. Also available are power-opening doors, leather upholstery, rear DVD screen, Bluetooth and more. The Luxgen7 MPV is powered by a turbocharged-and-intercooled 2.2-litre DOHC 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. To improve driving feel, the steering system was tuned by Delphi, noise suppression engineering was handled by LMS, the suspension system was developed by Magna, and the overall chassis tuning was done by both Magna and Prodrive.

The Renault Dokker Van is a light commercial vehicle made in Morocco. It comes with one engine option in the GCC, which is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. The panel van version has a luggage capacity of 3,300 litres and a maximum load length of 1.90 metres, thanks to the foldable front passenger seat, that can also be tipped forward against the glove box to free up space for a load length of up to 2.42 metres. If the front seat is removed altogether it provides a carrying capacity of 3,900 litres and a maximum load length of up to 3.11 metres. The payload capacity is 750 kg. It can be equipped with the Media Nav system, that combines navigation and audio functions, featuring Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and auxiliary USB and jack sockets. phone wirelessly and directly onto the Dokker Van's music system. 8 mobile phone devices can be connected to the Bluetooth enabled Media Nav with phonebook and call history.Wooden flooring and interior panelling in the cargo area are amongst the various accessories available. The wood protection kits are designed to protect the Dokker Van's rear loading space and are made from marine-quality plywood with non-slip treatment. Storage bin kit is another wooden accessory to arrange and store tools and is the perfect complement to a full wooden protection kit.Accessorized high-strength grilles for the rear window protect goods against theft and deter vehicle break-ins. Accessories in the range also include transverse roof bars, textile carpet mats, volume and perimeter alarm with or without remote control, and 15-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features in the Dokker include ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), and one driver side front airbag.

The Tucson is a player in the rare breed of tiny 4WD vehicles that offer little off-road capability, but drive rather well on the road. It comes with either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or, surprisingly, a 2.7-litre V6, with a range of manual or automatic transmissions depending on model. It also comes in either a blasphemous front-wheel-drive version or a more realistic four-wheel-drive version with full-time 4WD. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power outside mirrors, central door locking, roof rack, cloth seats, front fog lamps, rear wiper with washer, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a range of storage spaces, while riding on 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include dual airbags, sunroof, probably faux leather upholstery, two-tone paint job, body-colour outside mirrors, AM/FM CD and cassette player with 4 speakers and tweeters, dual mufflers and a whole lot of cuteness for an affordable amount of cash.

The Pilot is Honda's midsize 4WD replacement for the MR-V. The new-for-2009 SUV increases a bit in size while attempting to move slightly upscale with its available luxury options. An all-new look features slab-sided styling, and a weird new standard grille which can be replaced by an optional better-looking grille. The longer wheelbase adds second-row and third-row legroom as well as additional cargo space. It can supposedly seat eight people. New to the Pilot is Variable Cylinder Management (VCM) which allows the 3.5-litre V6 engine to operate on half the cylinders when power is not needed, improving fuel economy. Also standard is a 5-speed automatic. Based on the same platform as the Odyssey minivan, the Pilot claims to be an off-roader, but only succeeds moderately, with an all-wheel-drive system that can lock itself in a 50:50 front/rear power split, but with no low-range gearing. Standard safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, front-side airbags and curtain airbags. A power tailgate, front and rear obstacle detection, rear-view camera, side-mirror indicators, leather upholstery, side-steps, power-adjustable front seats and sunroof are all optional.

For 2009, the previous C-Class Sports Coupe breaks away from the C-Class range and gets its own name. Now dubbed the CLC-Class, the  model gets a new front and rear end, and an upgraded interior. And yes, it is a hatchback, even if the marketing people insist it's a coupe. However, it is still heavily based on the previous C-Class version, and is now being built in Brazil. Starting off the new line-up are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the CLC 180 Kompressor and the CLC 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune. The 2.5-litre V6-powered CLC 230 comes next. The 3.5-litre V6-powered CLC 350 rounds off the range. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. Features include power windows, electric mirrors, cloth or leather upholstery, optional panoramic sunroof, alloy wheels, automatic a/c, keyless entry, CD stereo, sports seats and more.

The sub-compact Figo is Ford's newest and smallest offering in the GCC. Intended to be a cheaper motoring option than even the Fiesta, the Figo is built in India, based on a shortened older-generation Fiesta, and comes in 5-door hatchback form. It comes with a choice of 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with a manual gearbox and 1.6-litre 4-cylinder with an automatic. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente and Trend trims, both getting cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include manual windows, power mirrors, 2-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, soft-touch dashboard and a claimed "best-in-class" manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 14-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, fog lamps, ABS brakes, front power windows and height-adjustable driver's seat.

Renault is pushing the limits of design with their Megane. While the four-door sedan and two-door hard-top convertible are more or less ordinary designs, the three-door and five-door hatchback range features unique shapes not seen on any other car in this category. The Megane is available in four trim levels, namely Authentique, Expression, Dynamique and Privilege, while the sportiest models are the Renaultsport hatchbacks, available in both three-door and five-door form. Engines for these front-wheel-drive cars include a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre, both with manual or automatic, while the Renaultsport gets a 2.0-litre turbo, with only a manual. Unlocking and starting the car is by means of the Renault Card, a card which slips into a slot on the dash. Other notable features include remote central locking, variable power steering, height adjustable driver's seat, five height-adjustable headrests, and trip computer. The Megane also offers dual front airbags, front lateral airbags, side curtain airbags, and ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Brake Assist.

The Spark is a typical urban runabout based wholly on the Korean Daewoo Matiz, and is built in Korea too. It is a best seller in the supermini market, which is a market with few buyers in this region. The Spark is a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering just enough interior space for four inside a compact body. Its big windows and tight turning circle make it easy to park and cut through traffic, if you have the guts to cut in front of big 4WDs. The design tries to be cute, but unlike the Mini or the Beetle, this thing still looks like half a car. Inside, centre-mounted instruments greet you, as does cheap plastics. Depending on which of the upholstery fabrics and body colours is chosen, the displays have a blue, green or orange background. All interior mouldings and seating fabrics are robust but still cheap. It is powered by either a 0.8-litre three-cylinder or a 1.0-litre four-cylinder unit, and comes with a standard five-speed manual gearbox which features an all-new gearchange mechanism with damping for improved shift quality. A four-speed auto is optional. GM claims increased percentage of 'super steel' in the structure, but we'd still feel uncomfortable travelling in one of these.

The Altima received a second face-lift for the 2016 model. They still get the same 2.5-litre 4-cylinder and 3.5-litre V6 engine from the previous shape, along with CVT transmissions. Features in the 2018 Nissan Altima included in the base 2.5 S include ABS, traction-control, vehicle stability control, remote keyless entry with Push Button Ignition, radio with CD player with Aux-in and 4 speakers, audio controls on steering wheel and dual airbags. The 2018 Nissan Altima 2.5 SV adds to that cruise control, 6-speaker audio system with 5-inch display, bluetooth, USB port with iPod connectivity, rear-view camera, auto-headlamps, parking sensors, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy rims. Moving up to the 2018 Nissan Altima 2.5 SL,  additional features include 6-way power seats, dual zone auto A/C, side and curtain airbags and remote engine start. For the V6, the 3.5 SV is the same options as 2.5 SV but included are paddle shifters on the steering column. The 2018 Nissan Altima 3.5 SL gets leather seats, driver 8-way power seat, lumbar support, Bose audio system with 9 speakers, sunroof, xenon head lamps and LED tail lamps. The top 2018 Nissan Altima SL versions can be specced out with a navigation system.

An all-new generation Volvo XC90 debuted in the middle of 2015. Under the hood, there are two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine options, the base engine being the turbocharged T5 unit, while the more powerful model gets a turbocharged and supercharged T6 motor. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base engine is called the T5 and and the more powerful motor is known as the T6. Available features, depending on trim, include integrated rear-door sunshades, illuminated front and rear treadplates, Bowers & Wilkins Premium 19-speaker audio system with USB/AUX inputs and CD player, Bluetooth, heads-up display, navigation, in-car wifi, 4-zone auto a/c with numerous rear vents, power-adjustable front seats, panoramic glass roof, power tailgate with foot-waving opening operation, front and rear parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, turning LED headlights and foglights, and auto-dimming mirrors. Safety features include City Safety which brakes automatically if a pedestrian runs across the road, driver-alertness detection, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, land-departure warning, road-sign detection that displays speed limits on the graphical LCD gauge cluster, whiplash protection, front and side/curtain airbags, and adaptive cruise control that can come to a complete stop and crawl in traffic automatically. Further safety features include a run-off road protection package, which detects what is happening and the front safety belts are tightened to keep the occupants in position, and auto brake at intersection capability.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Subaru WRX STi  was all-new in 2015 and got a minor facelift for 2018. It is available only as a sedan. Under the hood, it gets a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler. It is coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission as standard. It is 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, traction control, stability control and ABS.

An all-new Ford Escape was released in 2021 for the GCC. For the 2021 Ford Escape, two engines are available. The first is an all-new turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the other is the carried over 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor, which has been upgraded for better performance and fuel efficiency. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The base 2022 Ford Escape model is two-wheel drive, with optional 4-wheel drive. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering. The Sync infotainment system gets Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as well. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. The 2022 Ford Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, blind spot monitor,  and adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support. Active Park Assist is also available to park the car itself, whether parallel or perpendicular. Higher models gets adaptive front lighting system which automatically adjust the bi-xenon headlamps according to the environment.

Soon after the launch of the all-new nearly-midsize Japanese-built Mazda 6, GCC dealers chose to launch the new American-built Mazda 6 as well. The American 6 is a good bit larger than the Japanese 6, with a longer wheelbase offering more legroom and cargo space. Dubbed the Mazda 6 Ultra, the larger car is offered in two versions, namely the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed automatic and the 3.7-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The Ultra only comes in the sedan body-style. Available features include intelligent keyless entry with starter button, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, power accessories, alloy wheels, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, Bose stereo with six-disc CD changer and ten speakers, manual-shifting functionality with all automatics, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, and automatic a/c with rear vents. Available safety features include dual front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control. Specifically for the GCC version, there are special chrome side-mirror housings, chrome on the upper grille, and a gold-plated ULTRA badge at the rear. With this larger model, Mazda can finally compete with the oversized Japanese midsize sedans that dominate the current market.

The Veloster is Hyundai's head-on dive into the sport-compact segment, with an entry that will be controversial forever. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side. The standard engine for the GCC is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, which puts a downer on its sporting intentions, especially since the standard gearbox is a 6-speed automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available in some GCC markets include a full set of airbags, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT, or Mercedes-AMG GT as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Two variants of the AMG GT will be available, both with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT S gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT S also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is a combination of both coupe and crossover, designed to the tackle the BMW X6. Under the hood, is a 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged V6 motor, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Exterior-wise, it shares a few design cues of the new S-Class Coupe, such as the roofline and rear tail-lights. The interior features sports seats, a sports steering wheel and a new infotainment display. The cabin is covered in silver shadow accents, and aluminum or wood trim.Safety features include Driving Assistance package which includes features such as DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist and PRE-SAFE PLUS. The Parking package includes the 360-degree camera and Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC. Night-time vision is improved by the LED Intelligent Light System which is a standard feature on all models; adverse weather conditions with impaired view are defused by MAGIC VISION CONTROL the heated, adaptive windscreen wiper system.

The Infiniti QX30 is pretty much the same as the Q30 hatchback, but with a very minor increase in ground clearance, to become a crossover. Sharing a platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it also shares an engine with its joint-venture German cousin as well, namely the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. Standard options in the QX30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, 7-inch infotainment touchscreen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. For 2011, the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive, got a massive power upgrade. For 2012, it was upgraded again by 20 hp, along with better fuel economy. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Structural stiffness, suspension and aerodynamics had all been upgraded for 2011. The shocks were upgraded again for 2012. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Prices had gone up by 20% compared to the pre-facelift version, but then came down again for 2012, even while is was upgraded. A 'VVIP' edition debuted in 2011 that costs twice as much while offering a customisable leather interior and gold-plated exterior trimmings. A Black edition debuted in 2012 that added some red cabin trim and Recaro seats.

The latest Astra is a competitive five-door hatchback from General Motors' German division, with a decent-sized wheelbase that aims for comfort and space. The Astra received an unnoticeable facelift for 2007 that now adds a chrome crossbar on the radiator grille, and black roof trim strips and bumper guards. It comes with a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine for the Middle East market, mated specifically to a four-speed automatic transmission driving the  front wheels. Features include power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, 60/40 split-folding rear seat back, keyless entry, power steering, CD stereo, trip computer and alloy wheels. The Astra comes with a standard tyre repair kit instead of a spare tyre to improve luggage volume, which expands when the rear seat backs are folded down. Safety features include front airbags, front-side airbags, ABS brakes with emergency brake assist, and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

The Peugeot 408 is the work of a joint venture set up between PSA Peugeot CitroÃ«n and the Chinese group DFM, so the car is built in China. It could be considered as the sedan version of the 308 hatchback. The 408 gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Cabin space is very impressive, while all upper trim materials are suitably soft-touch, both front and back, which is more than can be said about several of its rivals. There are two trim levels, with the top one getting 17-inch alloys, all one-touch power windows, fog lamps, dual-zone auto a/c, ABS with EBD and stability control, parking sensors, front airbags, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, lightly-tinted windows, heated electric mirrors, cooled glove-box and a fully-adjustable leatherette steering wheel.

Toyota launched a redesigned Land Cruiser for the 2008 model year, and 2012 marked its first major makeover. For 2015, there are only minor trim changes, with engine choices still being a 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with a 6-speed automatic. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. In the UAE, there are three trim levels, namely EXR, GXR and VXR with several variants of each, as well as a stripped-down safari fleet model. The KSA market has GX, GXR and VXR trims, with further variants within them. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 17-inch alloy or steel wheels on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional dealer-installed rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional dealer-installed leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items. Further available features include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, a front chin spoiler and extra chrome trim on some GXR and all VXR models, with 18-inch wheels and a new multimedia system on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, factory leather, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on V8 models only.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It got a second major facelift in 2020, along with additional new tech inside. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in three trim levels, namely Comfortline, Trendline and Highline, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level Comfortline features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, 60/40 folding rear seat, infotainment system with touch screen, Apply CarPlay, Android Auto, MirrorLink, electronic vehicle immobilisation and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Comfortline model includes a leather steering wheel, 2 USB ports, automatic climate control with dual zone, rearview camera and 17-inch alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the CL and TL models, the Highline has leatherette sports seats, high-end sound system with a subwoofer in the boot, LED headlights with light assist, electric driver seat adjustment, sunroof and 18-inch alloy wheels .  Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise.

The Audi E-Tron is the German luxury brand's first all-electric vehicle offering. Built on Audi’s new battery-electric vehicle or BEV platform, the E-tron packs a 95 kWhr battery and two motors to power the front and rear wheels. Audi intentionally kept the design similar to their petrol-powered cars, to make potential customers switching to electric feel more comfortable with the initial transition. The interior features the new “virtual cockpit” we saw already in the A8 and Q8, which includes the infotainment system with dual haptic touchscreens. The shifter is new and unique — it looks like a hand rest but has a tab at the end, which can be moved to change gears. Another unique feature is the side-view “mirrors” which are actually screens on the upper door panels, and on the outside were just sticks with cameras. While it takes a moment to get used to, rest assured it is just as option for people who still want the traditional side mirrors. The regenerative braking technology on the E-tron is one of the highlights of the car. What Audi managed to do is keep the drive similar to a combustion-engined Audi. During normal driving, most of the braking is done by the electric motors, which then send the captured energy to the battery. The best feature of this system is the brake pedal feel, which is not like the “switch” feel of other electric cars, but gives that linear braking smoothness of non-electric cars. At speeds below 11 kph, it switches to normal hydraulic brakes so you don’t get that jerky feeling when parking or moving slowly through traffic.

The BAIC D20 is a facelifted version of the A1 hatchback. It is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

An all-new model, called the Kia K5 joined the lineup, replacing the Optima. The midsize sedan gets two 4-cylinder engines - a 2.0-litre and a 2.5-lire engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. The SL 65 AMG comes with a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. In the GCC, it is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 with front-wheel-drive (T5) and a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), both mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Mitsubishi Attrage is the Japanese brand's sub-compact sedan offering, introduced in 2014 GCC market. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. The Thai-built Attrage gets a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual in fleet-spec trim or a CVT in all other versions. The small engine, combined with the lightweight body makes it very fuel-efficient. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry with central locking, fabric seats, manual a/c, AM/FM radio with CD player and 4 speakers, tachometer and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional equipment include a full-auto a/c, better entertainment system, leather-strapped steering wheel and gear knob, 15-inch alloy wheels and USB port. For safety, only the top model gets 2 airbags for the driver and passenger, whereas as the rest get only one for the driver. All models get ABS with EBD.

The Fiesta is a pint-sized runabout, and looks funny next to the Crown Victoria, but it is a product of Ford's European effort. Released for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, the Fiesta is built in Germany and few in this region know about this. Even fewer have even heard of this car. The Fiesta is a bestseller in Europe but failed to make an impact here, mostly because of impossibly snobby dealership prices for servicing this cheap car. Otherwise it is a very good sub-compact. Handling and ride  is even better than the highly acclaimed late-90's version thanks to the ultra-stiff bodyshell. Power comes from a Duratec 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine that offers fuel economy expected from cars of this size. There is also a choice of manual and automatic gearboxes for this front-wheel-drive hatchback. Safety equipment includes ABS brakes, airbags and other items. Small on the outside, decent packaging allows the Fiesta to offer decent space for people and cargo in its small body. It doesn't look too bad either.

The Honda Accord has been redesigned for the 2013 model. The coupe shares no body panels with the sedan version. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a new 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. The 2.4 EX coupe comes with halogen headlights with LEDs, 17-inch alloys, fog lights, sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, power-folding mirrors, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel, dual-zone auto a/c, rear camera, 7-speaker stereo with touchscreen panel and USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, power driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, floor mats and all safety features. The 3.5 EX coupe adds the V6 engine, LED headlights, 18-inch alloys, dual exhaust tips, paddle-shifters, navigation, LaneWatch camera, "i-Dual" a/c and leather upholstery. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2018. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the high roof version is sold in the GCC region. There are two different versions, each with a different length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The 2015 Dodge Charger SRT received a significant facelift. Two SRT models are available. The first gets a naturally-aspirated 6.4-litre V8 engine, while the second one is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 motor. They all get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Charger SRT Hellcat receives a larger, power-bulge aluminium hood, which features a dedicated air intake. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The all-new Chery Tiggo 7 is the first Chery to have the new corporate face with its wavy grille and boomerang-shaped xenon headlights. It comes standard with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and CVT automatic, with a 1.5-litre turbo 4-cylinder and dual-clutch automatic joining a bit later. All are front-wheel-drive. The new Chery features a dual-tone interior with a patch of stitched leatherette across the dashboard and onto the inner door handles, matching the leather seats. The 9-inch capacitive touchscreen includes multimedia features, a/c settings and vehicle settings, while there’s also a 4.8-inch LCD dashboard screen. Other available features include smart keyless entry and start, dual-zone auto a/c and 360-degree camera as well as a panoramic roof. The Tiggo 7 received a five-star safety rating in the Chinese NCAP crash tests (which in theory is similar to EuroNCAP). Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, hill-start, tyre-pressure monitor and 6 airbags.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year. In 2018, it got a facelift and interior upgrades, but no mechanical changes. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG Coupe gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The fourth generation of the VW Golf was a huge success during its long run. The clean and conservative styling combined with a vague sense of being a status symbol made it a hit among well-to-do yuppies. Available only as a 5-door hatchback here, with a variety of engine options upgraded over the years. Even a 4Motion all-wheel-drive model is available, though it may be hard to find in these parts. After its 1998 makeover, the Golf got considerably more tasteful inside, with nicely contrasting colours and patterns. The cabin offers sufficient room for six-footers, while the rear compartment is as small as any other compact. The cargo area under the hatch is huge for a compact, and the rear seats fold flat. Available features included power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, sunroof, alloy wheels and more, depending on trim level. A pair of airbags is standard on all models, with some getting side airbags as well, while ABS is standard. Engines included 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors. Sportier early models included the FWD or AWD GTI with a 2.3-litre V5, and an AWD 4Motion model with a 2.8-litre V6. In the later years, the V5 got more power. For its premium price, equipment levels were limited, with an underlying platform that had independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension.

The attractive GranCabrio is convertible version of the GranTurismo, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is offered with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. The cloth roof drops electrically in 28 seconds and this can be done on the move at speeds of up to 30 kph. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. It is equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The fifth-generation BMW 7-Series was launched for the 2009 model year, returning to form as an attractive full-size luxury sedan, after years of looking like a troll in its previous generation. The first models to be launched include the standard-wheelbase 740i and 750i as well as the long-wheelbase 740Li and 750Li. The long-wheelbase 760Li came in 2010. Most GCC dealers import only the long-wheelbase version of all the models. In a misleading move dreamt up by retarded marketeers, the 740i and 740Li are now powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-6 engine, instead of the V8 that the badge implies. The 750i and 750Li are now powered by a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, although the 760Li moniker is accurate, with its 6.0-litre twin-turbo V12. The 730i and 730Li models debuted later in 2010, with naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline-6. Badge deception notwithstanding, all engines are capable performers, featuring Double-VANOS variable valve technology, direct injection, and a 6-speed automatic for all except the V12, which comes with an 8-speed automatic. The range now comes equipped with EfficientDynamics technologies as standard, all aimed at improving fuel economy. All 7-Series can now be specified with a side-view camera system, Park Distance Control, two forward-facing cameras, night-vision system, a pedestrian recognition system, blind-spot warning, a heads-up display, speed-related active steering, variable air-suspension damping control, stability control, hill-start assistant, ABS, brake drying, brake-fade compensation, iDrive with larger 10.2-inch screen, instrument cluster with a high-resolution colour display, navigation, 8 GB hard drive, rear-seat DVD entertainment with integrated screens, four-zone automatic air-conditioning, multiple front and side-curtain airbags, optional rear-seat ventilation system with massage function, and other electronic gimmicks. All the usual luxury basics are obviously also included, such as leather, power accessories, sunroof and 18-inch alloys.

A new generation Renault Megane debuted in 2017, powered by a 1.6-litre with a CVT automatic. In 2018, they introduced a more powerful 2.0-litre version. Standard features in the hatchback include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4.2-inch display, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX port and Bluetooth and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, dual zone automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo, 8.7-inch screen, 8 speakers, navigation, parking sensors, rearview camera, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 16-inch,17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models. Higher models get blind spot warning as well.

The Lincoln debuted for the 2007 model year, and has been heavily revised for 2011, with a new face, higher-quality interior and better entertainment features, while still looking like a Ford Edge derivative, on which is based. The updated MKX features a new chrome grille, along with new headlights, tail lamps and wheel designs externally. The newly-designed interior still features seating for five with a fold-down rear seat to maximise cargo room, as well as soft-touch materials, mood lighting and wood trim. The MKX features a standard 3.7-litre V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, and available with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Available features include leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, adaptive HID turning headlights, MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC voice-controlled multimedia computer and Sony stereo, optional THX-certified audio system, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

The Jeep Compass, based on the feeble Dodge Caliber, gets heavily worked over for 2011, with a facelift that mimics the Jeep Grand Cherokee. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

It is trying to be Chevrolet's volume seller in the Middle East, but we have trouble spotting an Optra on the streets even though the car has been on the market for some time now. On paper at least, this car seems to have what it takes to go head-on with the opposition. Positioned in the lower compact segment, the Optra offers good value for money, selling in 4-door sedan, 5-door hatchback and 5-door station wagon trims. Styled by Italians but barely showing it, the styling can best be described as interesting without being ambitious. The cabin is basic, but there are lots of storage spaces and space for five adults. Engine options include a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder unit. These are combined with a five-speed manual or four-speed auto transmission transmitting juice to the front wheels. While both engines have enough grunt for the segment, they fall short of leaders like the top Civic and Corolla models. Ride and handling are quite good, and bodes well for the Optra. All we ask for are better engines.

Looking more like a minor facelift than a major update, the new-for-2011 Suzuki Swift is actually a fair bit longer, with a new engine on offer, and now is built in India. Powered by a new 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. A new Japanese-built Swift Sport model was offered in 2012 with a 1.6-litre engine and a CVT automatic. The base Swift model comes with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher trim levels are available with a leather steering wheel with audio controls, 6-speaker stereo, tachometer, 16-inch alloy wheels, adjustable steering wheel, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD. Only the top version gets rear disc brakes, while the lower ones get drums. The Swift Sport gets a unique front bumper, firmer suspension and some additional trimmings.

The Jaguar F-Type SVR Coupe is the top performance model trim. Under the hood, it gets the supercharged 5.0-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate, retractable rear wing spoiler, sports seats, dual-zone a/c, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. Performance upgrades include a high-performance braking system, an electronic rear-differential, and a sport-tuned suspension with adaptive dampers.

Toyota introduced an all-new model in 2019 of the Avalon. The design has been completely changed, however, mechanically it gets the same 3.5-litre V6 engine, but with more power. It is built on the Toyota New Global Architecture platform (TNGA) which underpins the current Camry and Prius. This promises a quieter ride. Every dimension of the Avalon has grown compared to the old model. The rear cabin is almost 20 cm longer which has translated to more space for the rear passengers. The looks of the Toyota Avalon builds on the smaller Camry but with many sharper lines. The LED headlights and taillights are not enough to balance out that desperately massive grille, intended to make the car stand out more. The XSE and Touring trims will have even better looks with piano black finishes, a boot spoiler, diffuser panels and quad exhausts. The interior of the Avalon is obviously a lot more opulent. Though it takes some stuff from the Camry, it looks far more luxurious than it. In the dash, there is a 9-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system which comes with Apple CarPlay making it the first Toyota vehicle to feature it. But it still doesn’t get Android Auto. Other amenities include five USB charging ports, wireless charging, a 7-inch trip computer and a 10-inch heads-up-display. There are a bunch of standard safety systems like 10 airbags, pre-collision braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keep assist, adaptive cruise control, automatic high beams and blind spot monitoring. Over these, you can add a panoramic parking camera system and a rear cross-traffic braking system.

The Mitsubishi Lancer EX, first introduced in 2008, got some minor trim changes for 2010. From 2013 onwards, it comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a new 1.6-litre and a carryover 2.0-litre. The smaller engine gets a 4-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Offering a choice of either engine, features in the most basic GLX model includes power steering, locally-installed CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, manual a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers, but only a driver's airbag. The mid-range GLS model can only be had with the larger engine, and includes a sporting body kit, rear spoiler, leather-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, smart key with starter button, sunroof, 6-speaker stereo with USB port, rear camera and faux-wood panelling. The top GT model adds adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, "sport-type" front seats, rear split seats with centre armrest, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels and just two front airbags.

The Forester, after many years being Subaru's compact crossover wagon-like 4WD, has been completely redesigned for 2009 with a more SUV-like appearance. The new Forester is larger in every way than its predecessor, improving cargo capacity and rear-seat legroom. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester also comes standard with a 4-speed automatic features SportShift manual shifting. The basic 2.5X model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The range-topping M6 arrived for 2006, in coupe and convertible form, using the same V10 engine as the M5. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a 7-speed SMG automanual in the M6. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The redesigned-for-2012 BMW 3-Series has a wider track and is now 93 mm longer than the outgoing model, with the wheelbase stretched by 50 mm. That makes the 3-Series more spacious than before, but the new car is also 40 kg lighter. It is now also available in three trim variants the Sport Line, Luxury Line and Modern Line. An optional M sport package consisting of sporty suspension, cabin trim and body kit is also offered. A choice of two "TwinPower" turbo engines are available. In addition to the 3.0-litre 6-cylinder turbo engine powering the 335i, there is a new 240 hp 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine in the BMW 328i. A detuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine in the base 320i model and a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine in the base 316i model became available later. An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered for the first time, although there is also a 6-speed manual available that will likely never be shipped here by local dealers. In addition, all the tech features offered in the 5-Series seems to be offered in the 3-Series as well, including variable steering, dynamic damper control, brake energy regeneration, iDrive computer, heads-up display, surround-view cameras, parking assistant and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, seatbelt pretensioners, optional automatic braking and more.

The quasi-legendary Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift in 2015, but it remains largely unchanged since the debut of this version a decade ago. The Pajero is a true off-roader, but has carved a niche as a family wagon. Powertrain options in the 2021 Mitsubishi Pajero is either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features in the 2021 Mitsubishi Pajero include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a multimedia entertainment system, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The Corsa is the smallest car among Opel models offered in the Middle East. Its extensive safety package and rigid galvanized body have been tested to excel in passenger protection. Body styles available in the Middle East are three-door and five-door hatchbacks, as well as a 4-door sedan. Opel went the extra step and added colour-keyed bumpers and high-level safety features, which is rare in this class of cars. Two engine options are available here, namely a 1.4-litre unit and a 1.8-litre unit, both four-cylinder. Both powerplants power the front wheels using the available standard manual transmission, but the smaller motor has an optional automatic five-speed transmission with manual shifting mode. All cars can seat five. A fold-down rear backrest can be fixed at two different angles and a rear bench can be fully folded down. Available features include power windows, cloth upholstery and CD stereo. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

The Toyota RAV4 got a complete redesign for 2013, with a new styling language, a new drivetrain, and new features. The existing platform has been updated with new suspension tuning, while the standard engine now is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability, although Saudi Arabia also gets a 6-speed manual base model. There is also a choice of front-wheel-drive with limited-slip diff or all-wheel-drive with 50:50 lock mode. New items in this 5-seater crossover include a lift-up tailgate with the spare wheel now stored under the boot floor. In the UAE, there was a reshuffle of trims for 2014 along with a price drop, with the 2WD available in EX grade, while the AWD is sold in EXR, GXR and VXR grades. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, fold-flat split rear seating and more. The base model gets cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic keyless entry and 17-inch alloy wheels. Additional available features, depending on trim level, include smart keyless entry and start, LED running lamps, auto-dimming mirror, roof rails, cargo net, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, cruise control and dual-zone auto a/c. Only the top 4x4 model gets touchscreen navigation, DVD player, rear camera, power driver's seat, sunroof, leather upholstery and 18-inch alloy wheels. All RAV4 models get two front airbags as well as ABS with EBD. Only the top 4WD model gets additional side and curtain airbags. The top two 4WD trims get stability control, brake assist, downhill assist, and hill-start assist.

After a decade, Toyota launched a redesigned Land Cruiser for the 2008 model year, and 2012 marked its first major makeover. The updated Land Cruiser comes with the choice of an upgraded 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, an all-new 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with a 6-speed automatic. A rare 4.5-litre turbodiesel V8 is discontinued in UAE, but continues to be offered in Saudi Arabia, with the 6-speed automatic version getting more power than the 5-speed manual version. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 17-inch alloy or steel wheels on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items. New features for 2012 include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, new rear lights and new front bumper on all models, as well as a front chin spoiler, 18-inch wheels and a new multimedia system on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system. In the UAE, there are three trim levels as well as a stripped-down safari fleet model. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on V8 models only.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. A minor frontal facelift and other trim changes marked the changes for 2012. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard. From early 2012, a few hundred 30th Anniversary edition models were offered, signified by LED lights in the bumpers and a few other trim bits.

The Volvo V70 is a midsize station wagon available in a few GCC countries. Currently only the V70 Comfort is sold here with the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment in the car include power mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with CD player, foldable three-split rear seats and alloy wheels. Volvo, never to compromise on safety, has driver, passenger, side and curtain airbags as standard, along with WHIPS whiplash protection. Luggage space is quite big thanks to its upright shape. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The first product from the takeover of Chrysler by Daimler-Benz was the Crossfire, a stylish sports coupe that rides on the old Mercedes-Benz SLK platform, while sharing many of its components with other Mercedes models, and built in Germany too. The Crossfire has a long hood with streaks on it, while the fastback roofline ends with a "boat tail." The car also has a centre spine that runs the length of the car, from the grille in front to between the dual, centre-mounted rear exhausts. The Crossfire's stance is enhanced by rear tyres that are larger than those in front, and by its broad shoulders, tall body sides and minimal glass area. The car's central spine reappears as an element in the car's interior design. The car's two bucket seats are trimmed in two-tone leather. Gauges have white-on-black faces with metallic bezels and chrome trim rings, while the centre console has a metallic look too. Other features for the two-seat coupe include a speed-activated rear spoiler and six-speaker audio system with dual subwoofers. By now, it would seem like the Crossfire is more of a design exercise than an attempt to build a true sports car. This is confirmed by the old 3.2-litre V6 that doesn't pull the car with enough verve.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

The CL-Class is a rare breed, always in the shadow of its S-Class sibling, on which is is based. Receiving a complete overhaul like the sedan, this coupe features numerous innovative safety technology, such as up-front sensors which make it possible to assess the impact severity at an early stage during a crash and activate the front passenger airbag in two stages depending on the severity of the accident. Other features include Active Body Control for better handling, Intelligent Light System using bi-xenon headlights with five different lighting functions to match weather conditions. Options include night-view assist with infrared headlamps, reversing camera, voice control for car radio, DVD changer and navigation as well as tyre pressure monitoring system. Models include the CL 500 with a 5.5-litre V8 and a CL 600 with a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, both with automatic transmissions. The standard automatic has the new DIRECT SELECT gearshift, which allows selection of the gear by nudging a lever on the steering column. Operating commands are transmitted electronically by wire.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2020, an all-new model of the RS 7 came out. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, and mildly facelifted for 2011. Aside from the sedan, the Accord is offered in this American-built coupe body style. It is offered with either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. The 2.4-litre in the coupe has a bit more power than the one in the sedan. All models get a 5-speed automatic only. Standard features on the base model includes power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, manual a/c,cruise control, CD/MP3 player with USB and AUX ports, and keyless entry. Features available in higher models include auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps. For 2011, new options include a navigation system with 8-inch screen, a dual-zone automatic a/c that uses GPS to adjust temperature according to the position of vehicle relative to the sun, a Bluetooth phone and a rear-view camera. Available wheel sizes are 17-inch or 18-inch alloys in the coupe, depending on trim. For 2011, all models got ABS, stability control, active headrests and dual front airbags, with optional side and curtain airbags in the higher models. For 2012, all six airbags became standard on all models.

The 7-seater Mahinda XUV500 SUV debuted in the UAE with a 140 hp 2.2-litre turbocharged petrol engine and a 6-speed automatic, with features such as 6 airbags, a 7-inch infotainment system and cruise control. Available in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive variants, options include faux-leather upholstery, sunroof and more.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class. In 2017, an all-new C63 Coupe made its debut. It has remained the same for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, they get twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The Chevrolet Blazer made a comeback in 2019, slotting in between the Equinox and Traverse. Both engine options offered on the Blazer are naturally aspirated - with the base model getting the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the higher model gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine, both of which are mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The 2.5-litre is available in front-wheel drive and all-wheel-drive, while the 3.6-litre model only comes as all-wheel-drive. However, the rear axle can be completely cut-off in the AWD models to run only in FWD mode. Standard features in the Blazer include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, 4.2-inch driver information display screen, infotainment system with an 8-inch touch screen including Bluetooth, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay, 6 speakers and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control, traction control, and front, side and knee airbags. Higher models include options such as adaptive cruise control, leather seats, premium Bose audio system with sub-woofer, panoramic sunroof, surround vision camera, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy wheels, and wireless charging. The higher trims also get more safety features such as forward collision alert, automatic braking, pedestrian braking, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, blind spot monitor and park assist.

The Subaru Impreza WRX is available as a sedan or hatchback. It started off in its current iteration back in 2008, but criticism led to it gaining more power and sportier suspension in 2009 and a widebody kit from the STI in 2011. The turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine can be had with only a 5-speed manual, with all-wheel-drive. The front suspension uses a MacPherson strut setup, while the rear has a double wishbone suspension. Features include ABS-assisted disc brakes, LED tail lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, power windows, electric mirrors and a CD stereo. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in. While a new fully-redesigned version of the regular Impreza was launched in late 2011, the WRX continued in this older iteration for one more year.

The Tesla Model X is a fully electric midsize crossover SUV, which combines high performance and zero emission. The available variants from 2018 are 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. All variants come in all-wheel-drive configuration, and with seating for up to seven if optioned up with two booster seats in the boot. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, falcon-wing rear doors, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate, 19-inch alloy wheels, and air suspension. Optional equipment include enhanced autopilot, complete self-driving capability, auto-opening front doors, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system, up to 22-inch alloy wheels, and a towing package including a steel tow bar and a 2-inch hitch receiver. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features include traffic-aware cruise control, auto steer and auto park.

The Borgward BX7 marks the rebirth of the long-defunct German luxury brand as a Chinese-built crossover. It is a compact crossover powered by a 2.0-litre direct-injection turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive. The BX7 comes in S trims with 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as SE and SL trims with 18-inch alloys. There is a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater confingurations, and three levels of leather upholstery, depending on trim. All models get basics such as power windows and mirrors, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, 12.3-inch touchscreen, USB/AUX ports, smart keyless entry and start, LED tail lamps and parking sensors. Higher models get Xenon auto headlights, LED running lights, panoramic glass roof, power folding mirrors, power seats, 360-degree parking camera with sensors, and a 10-speaker stereo with nav. All models get ABS, ESP, electronic diff lock, brake assist, fatigue detection, hill-start assist and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as front-side airbags and options such as curtain airbags, hill-descent control on AWD models and blind-spot monitoring.

An all-new Audi A4 came out in 2016. It is a more spacious car, while at the same time is lighter than its predecessor. Under the hood, there are 2 available engines. There is the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and is available only as front-wheel-drive. Then there is the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and comes with all-wheel drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Skoda Kodiaq is the VW-owned Czech brand's first proper foray into the crossover market after the van-like Skoda Yeti was cancelled. There is a choice of two engines , one a 1.4-litre turbo in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive forms, and another a 2.0-litre turbo in all-wheel-drive form. The smaller engine comes with a 6-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic while the larger one gets a 7-speed DSG auto. Seating can be 5 or 7, depending on trim level. Features include a touchscreen multimedia system, cruise control, keyless entry, ABS with EBD, a full set of airbags and all the other other usual bits and bobs.

The Haval H8 is the Chinese brand's midsize SUV offering. Under the hood is a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the H8 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric seats with lumbar support, leather or fabric upholstery, infotainment system with 8-inch touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, parking sensors, front and rear fog lamps, 3-zone climate control and alloy wheels. Safety features include front,side and curtain airbags, driver condition monitoring, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The Porsche 918 Spyder is a mid-engined hybrid supercar. It gets a high-revving 4.6-litre V8, combined with three electric motors and mated to a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission. The 918 Spyder offers five different running modes: E-Drive allows the car to run under battery power alone, using the rear electric motor and front motor, giving a range of 29 km and the car can reach 150 kph in this mode. Three hybrid modes - Hybrid, Sport and Race, use both the engine and electric motors to provide the desired levels of economy and performance. In Race mode a push-to-pass button initiates the Hot Lap setting, which delivers additional electrical power. The chassis is made of carbon-fibre-reinforced plastic monocoque. An optional Weissach package-equipped 918 reduces the hybrid supercar's weight through the deletion of some interior items, more generous use of carbon-fibre and magnesium alloy wheels.

The A3 hatchback slips into Audi's line-up as the company's smallest and cheapest model, starting in 2004 and receiving a minor facelift in 2005. Sharing its platform with the MKV-generation VW Golf, the main A3 models available here are a 1.6-litre four and a 2.0-litre four, both with front-wheel-drive, but while engines such as a 2.0-litre turbo four are not officially offered, a few local dealers offer the 3.2-litre V6, complete with Quattro all-wheel-drive. We confirmed that many local dealerships do not stock the faster models, but Audi's PR people, apparently disconnected from the local dealer network, argue that they are in fact available. Transmission choices are limited to a six-speed automatic in this region, although the V6 does get a DSG automanual.
