The four-cylinder engines can be had in either three-door or five-door Sportback form, though again it depends on the local dealer. Standard features on the four-cylinder models include four-wheel disc brakes, 16-inch alloy wheels, automatic climate control, power windows, power locks with keyless remote, cloth seats and a CD player. Although itï¿½s a compact car, the A3 is pricey. It tries to justify its price with a well-built exterior and a pleasant interior, as well as a badge that no one respects yet. The biggest challenge the A3 faces is getting buyers to accept its relatively high price tag. For what is offered, we wouldn't.

An all-new Ford Edge made its way to the GCC in 2016, and the range got a facelift for 2019, including rebadging the Sport model as the Edge ST. It comes with two engine options. The two engines are turbocharged "Ecoboost" engines, of which one is the base 2.0-litre and the top ST variant with 2.7-litre. They all get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base models include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC 3 voice-controlled multimedia system, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Optional features include HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and bigger alloy wheel options. The Edge ST gets a mild body kit, black mesh grille, body-colour exterior trim and black wheels. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

The Audi A3 Sedan is the German brand's sub-compact sedan offering. It will be available with two engine choices, either a 1.4-litre or a 1.8-litre, both of which are 4-cylinder and turbocharged units. While the 1.4-litre is only available in front-wheel drive format, the 1.8-litre can be had with all-wheel drive. The front-wheel drive versions get a 7-speed DSG automatic transmissions and the all-wheel drive model gets the 6-speed DSG. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The Lexus GX 460 received a facelift for 2014. Sporting a new front-end, actual changes are minimal, but the midsize luxury SUV in now available in three trim levels. On the outside, the most obvious changes include the redesigned front-end with the corporate "spindle" grille, adaptive LED-HID combination headlights, LED running lamps, new tail lamp clusters, redone 18-inch wheels and other minor bits. The engine is a carryover 4.6-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. The base Premier model is well-equipped, with standard features such as a multi-terrain select system, smart keyless entry and start, sunroof, rear camera and side camera with park assist, synthetic leather trim for the 7-seater cabin, 9-speaker stereo with new 8-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, DVD navigation, tri-zone a/c, crawl control, ESP, basic cruise control and a full set of airbags that includes knee bags. The mid-range Prestige model adds semi-aniline leather, heated/ventilated seats, cool box and lane-change assist with blind-spot monitor. The top Platinum model adds a 17-speaker Mark Levinson stereo, pre-crash safety system, radar cruise control and a rear-seat entertainment system.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i and the M235i. The 220i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M235i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto or a 6-speed manual. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M235i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The original Continental by Bentley is a large, expensive, luxury coupÃƒÂ© made by Rolls-Royce for a 10-year run. It was the first Bentley in 25 years to not feature a body shared with a Rolls-Royce model. It was also the first Bentley to use a GM  4-speed automatic transmission to work Bentley's long-running twin-turbo 6.8-litre V8. Power output of the earliest models are unknown, as Rolls Royce was too snobby to reveal numbers. But back then, the Continental was still the quickest, most expensive, and most powerful Bentley ever. The convertible version was called the Bentley Azure, launched in 1995. The cabin featured usual Bentley traits such as acres of wood, leather and chrome. The standard model was known as the Continental R, but 1994 saw production of a severely-limited Continental S, and then the shortened Continental T was introduced in 1996 as a performance model. Mulliner editions, which started in 1999, added performance upgrades on both the R and the T. A handful of Continental SC models were built in 1999, with a huge lift-out glass sunroof.

The Lotus Exige S is a super-light sports coupe with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine. It gets go-kart handling, thanks to its light weight as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. It is only available with a 6-speed manual gearbox . Standard options include  light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. There are two new interior package options available: Premium and Premium Sport. The Premium Pack provides added comfort and style where as the Premium Sport option focuses on creating an internal space optimised for ultimate driver involvement. Built for the adrenalin hungry sportscar aficionado, the Lotus Exige S features high performance bespoke tyre package with Pirelli P-Zero Corsa tyres as standard. A Lotus DPM (Dynamic Performance Management) switch allows the driver to switch between three driving modes: Touring, Sport and DPM off.And if three dynamic settings are not enough, an additional Race Pack option is available which adds a fourth driving mode setting: Race. This setting provides the maximum possible traction out of corners. The Race Pack also features Launch Control and an optimised suspension setting making the car perfect for letting rip on the track. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The VW Touareg is a luxurious and comfortable 4WD that is surprisingly capable both on the road and off it too. Facelifted and mildly upgraded for 2007, it is a practical vehicle, and on the highway, the Touareg offers a firm but smooth ride, and its handling is responsive for its mass, while in the desert, a full set of off-roading equipment comes in handy, including locking diffs and low-range gearing. The range includes a new 3.6-litre V6, an upgraded 4.2-litre V8 and a very limited 6.0-litre W12. All models come with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Also standard is Volkswagen's 4Motion permanent all-wheel-drive system. The Touareg seats five, and there is no third row of seats available. The 4WD comes standard with leatherette upholstery, dual-zone climate control with rear seat controls, wood trim, power windows, mirrors and sunroof, electrically adjustable front seating, alloy wheels of various sizes, ABS and many more items. Higher models get leather, auto-dimming outside mirrors with memory; and other luxuries. All models include front, side-impact and curtain airbags.

An all-new Skoda Octavia came out in 2014 in the GCC. Compared to its predecessor, the Octavia has grown significantly in length and width. The new model is 90 mm longer and 45 mm wider than the second-generation Skoda Octavia. At the same time, the wheelbase has grown by 108 mm, mainly benefiting the interior and space on the rear seats. There are three 4-cylinder turbocharged engines to choose from, the 1.4-litre, the 1.8-litre and the 2.0-litre. The base Octavia Ambition model comes with 16-inch steel wheels, fabric interior, rear mud flaps, automatic A/C, electric adjustable, heated & foldable door mirrors, electric windows, parking sensors, radio with CD player and MP3 support,  4 speakers, remote central locking, fog lights and front & side front airbags. The Octavia Elegance model gets additional 17-inch alloy wheels, leather and fabric interior, cruise control, 8 speakers, LED rear lights and curtain airbags. The Elegance Plus model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, leather interior, sunroof and xenon headlamps. The Octavia RS gets 19-inch alloy wheels, carbon-fibre inlays for dashboard and door panels, boot spoiler, red brake calipers, sports suspension, Bluetooth and Apple connectivity.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

Common hard-working people desire to own a car with a decent amount of interior space, fuel economy, reliability and adequate performance, all for a reasonable price. The all-new Tiida arrives as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. The fact that it's partly based on the Renault Megane, a European stalwart, means you get some Euro driving dynamics alongside traditional Japanese reliability. It is pleasantly surprising how big the Tiida feels inside. There is good head room and even tall passengers will find rear seat legroom as good as that in many much larger cars. Available as a five-door hatchback or a four-door sedan, the Tiida is available with either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine, with manual or automatic transmissions. Standard features include electric power steering, tilt steering column, 60/40 split folding rear seats, air conditioning with micro filter and a CD stereo system. Safety features include front airbags and ABS brakes. Power accessories are optional. The Tiida received a minor facelift for the 2009 model year, as Nissan made available a "sport" body kit option. Other new available features include cruise control, 6-CD changer, MP3 capability, IPod-ready AUX input, a 6-speaker audio system, fully automated air-conditioning and a trip computer.

The Citroen C-Elysee is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic gearbox. The Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

Based on a stretched version of the latest 'B6' Passat platform, the redesigned Skoda Superb is a 5-door liftback sedan, with an innovative tailgate that can open as a regular sedan boot or as a full liftback boot, known as 'Twin-Door.' A traditional station-wagon joined the range in 2012. Various VW-derived engines are available, although the only engines available for the GCC, from 2012, is the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and front-wheel-drive for the wagon, and a 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive for the sedan. Both are mated to a 6-speed "DSG" automanual. The Superb 2.0 TSI wagon is available with power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc CD changer and a 6.5-inch touchscreen, SD card and AUX inputs, automatic climate-control a/c, and a choice of upholstery. The Superb 3.6 sedan adds various other luxuries, such as a 12-speaker sound system, 18-inch alloys, standard leather interior and more. Available features include a Bluetooth phone, pull-up rear sun blinds, parking sensors with visual aid and a 'Park Assist' automatic parallel-parking system. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control and ABS. The Superb may not be available in all markets in the GCC.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

An all-new Cadillac CT5 made its debut in 2020, replacing the CTS. In the GCC, the CT5 gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CT5 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE entertainment system with 10-inch screen and BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

Porsche is offering a "new" Cayman model from 2009, and while the facelift is barely noticeable, the real changes are under the bonnet. Still available in base and S versions, both models feature more horsepower, new gearbox choices and modern multimedia options. A lightweight Cayman R model debuted in early 2011 with slightly more power. The base Cayman now has a 2.9-litre flat-6, while the Cayman S and Cayman R have a 3.4-litre flat-6 with direct fuel injection technology. A Cayman S Black Edition model also gets the R engine. While a 6-speed manual is standard on all, the optional new 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK) dual-clutch automanual gearbox is also available, which actually improves acceleration and fuel economy. The Cayman is priced at a premium over the Boxster, for what amounts to a slight bump in power and a fixed top. Cosmetic changes from 2009 include new headlights and tail lamps, larger front intakes with integrated running lights, and an altered lower rear-end with twin diffusers. Both models can be fitted with a never-ending list of optional features, which can drive up the total price by 30% or more. While the basic models are very bare on features, the car can be optionally outfitted with a hardtop, various types of expensive cloth or leather sports seats, different 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheel designs, a new Porsche Communication Management System (PCM) with a touchscreen, Bluetooth, TV tuner, DVD changer, metallic paint, stickers, wind deflector, roll bars, headlamp cleaners, Xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, and a cabin that can be trimmed with carbon-fibre, aluminium, alcantara or wood.

The Volvo S90 is an all-new model introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new S90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring elongated taillights and dual exhaust tips. In the GCC, it is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 with front-wheel-drive (T5) and a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), both mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Forester was Subaru's first attempt at a proper small 4WD, already being the first company to offer all-wheel drive across its entire model line. The Forester was introduced for the 1998 model year and has only survived on facelifts, being heavily revamped for 2003. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester features Subaru's symmetrical all-wheel-drive system. In the Middle East, only the 2.5X model is offered, powered by a 2.5-litre flat four-cylinder, mated to a four-speed automatic. The Forester includes a MP3/WMA CD stereo, 6-CD changer, automatic climate control system, power windows, electric mirrors, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, cruise control, cloth upholstery and an automatic air conditioner. The higher models include a sunroof, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather-wrapped surfaces such as the steering wheel, gear shift knob and handbrake. The Forester is different than most compact 4WDs since, in addition to being a soft-roader with no low-range gearing, it also has a lower car-like body.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. Changes were made in 2015 which included standard Attention Assist and Crosswind Assist, optional Intelligent Light System which included LED indicators, LED daytime running lamps, LED low-beam headlamps, and main beam with cornering light function. There were no changes for the 2017 model year. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Matrix is a typical urban runabout built in Korea, but with its own little twist. It is halfway between a minivan and a hatchback, while looking better than neither. The Matrix is probably a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering good interior space inside a compact body, but we are not sure if the Middle East is ready for such a car. Powered by either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or an automatic, while the larger engine gets only an automatic. Basic features include power steering, power windows, simple a/c, cloth seats, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, 14-inch steel wheels with plastic covers, and a roof rack. Safety is apparently optional, as only the higher models get dual airbags and ABS brakes, paired up with other options like fake metal-look trim, central door locking, rear wiper and washer, electrically-adjustable mirrors and 15-inch alloy wheels. Sometimes being named after a hit movie just isn't enough.

A new generation model of the Kia Soul came in 2020. Engines are carried over from the previous model, being powered by a 1.6-litre mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available only as front-wheel-drive. The basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, roof rack mounting points, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth, split-folding rear seat, cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better infotainment system, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, luggage net, some extra trim and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of different two-tone interiors.

The X5 M debuted in late 2009, with a higher-tuned turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 than the regular X5. The M has a 6-speed auto with proper paddle-shifters. Features include iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, side-view cameras, top-view camera, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M gets 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, aluminium roof rails, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements. It also gets  features such as sports suspension, 'M' driving mode, paddle-shifted quicker-response automatic, launch control and a body kit.

The Forester was Subaru's first attempt at a proper small 4WD, already being the first company to offer all-wheel drive across its entire model line. The Forester was introduced for the 1998 model year and has only survived on facelifts, being heavily revamped for 2003. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester features Subaru's symmetrical all-wheel-drive system. In the Middle East, only the 2.5X model is offered, powered by a 2.5-litre flat four-cylinder, mated to a four-speed automatic. The Forester includes a MP3/WMA CD stereo, 6-CD changer, automatic climate control system, power windows, electric mirrors, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, cruise control, cloth upholstery and an automatic air conditioner. The higher models include a sunroof, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather-wrapped surfaces such as the steering wheel, gear shift knob and handbrake. The Forester is different than most compact 4WDs since, in addition to being a soft-roader with no low-range gearing, it also has a lower car-like body.

The Infiniti QX30 is pretty much the same as the Q30 hatchback, but with a very minor increase in ground clearance, to become a crossover. Sharing a platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it also shares an engine with its joint-venture German cousin as well, namely the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. Standard options in the QX30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, 7-inch infotainment touchscreen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The Fiesta is a pint-sized runabout, and looks funny next to the Crown Victoria, but it is a product of Ford's European effort. Released for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, the Fiesta is built in Germany and few in this region know about this. Even fewer have even heard of this car. The Fiesta is a bestseller in Europe but failed to make an impact here, mostly because of impossibly snobby dealership prices for servicing this cheap car. Otherwise it is a very good sub-compact. Handling and ride  is even better than the highly acclaimed late-90's version thanks to the ultra-stiff bodyshell. Power comes from a Duratec 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine that offers fuel economy expected from cars of this size. There is also a choice of manual and automatic gearboxes for this front-wheel-drive hatchback. Safety equipment includes ABS brakes, airbags and other items. Small on the outside, decent packaging allows the Fiesta to offer decent space for people and cargo in its small body. It doesn't look too bad either.
Coming Soon..

The Nissan Kicks arrives in the GCC market to replace the Nissan Juke and Nissan Tiida. The Nissan Kicks is a front-wheel-drive sub-compact based on the Juke platform, but it's a bit larger in overall size. The Nissan Kicks is powered by the company's usual 118 hp 1.6-litre engine with 149 Nm of torque, mated to a CVT automatic. Features are minimal on the base car, with keyless entry, manual a/c, simple 2-speaker stereo with USB and Bluetooth, with safety features that include 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP with hill-start assist, tyre-pressure monitor, as well as front disc brakes and rear drums. Nissan's "Intelligent Mobility" features such as the Around View Monitor (AVM) and the Moving Object Detection system (MOD) are restricted to the top 'SL' model, as are parking sensors and side airbags. The base 'S' model, which is sold as a fleet model in most GCC countries, won't get you the LED running lamps, auto headlights, fog lamps, auto a/c, smart key, 7-inch touchscreen navigation, digital gauge cluster and such either.

The Lincoln MKS is the full-size luxury sedan produced by Ford's upscale division. It got a facelift in 2013. Although the MKS can be considered the marque's technological flagship sedan, it still falls behind leaders in the wider market. For starters, it is based on a front-wheel-drive platform shared with the Ford Taurus. But while this can be overlooked thanks to all-wheel-drive being standard on all GCC-spec models, the main engine for this full-sizer is a new 3.7-litre V6, instead of a V8. It rides on fully-independent suspension and 20-inch polished aluminium wheels. Features include a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, keyless entry and start, adaptive cruise control, SYNC voice-activated multimedia system, Bluetooth, rain-sensing windshield wipers, a rearview camera system, front and rear park assist, a THX sound system with full 5.1 surround sound, vented power seats, sunroof, HID headlights, LED taillamps, wood and leather interior trim, and Ford's capless fuel-filler system. Safety features include standard front, side and curtain airbags, stability control and ABS brakes.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Coupe and M8 Competition Coupe was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. In 2017, it got a facelift and a new base engine. Engine choices include the SL 400 with a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 and SL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8. Both are mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The new-for-2010 Jaguar XJ was redesigned from the ground up to continue the British brand's sharper new image, first introduced via the smaller XF model. The XJ is generally available in four trim levels in SWB and LWB versions. The UAE and some other GCC markets will only see the Premium Luxury, Portfolio and SuperSport versions, all in LWB form. The XJ Premium Luxury and the Portfolio will be available with a 5.0-litre naturally-aspirated V8. The XJ Portfolio can also be optioned up with a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The SuperSport comes exclusively with a higher-tuned 5.0-litre supercharged V8. In 2011, a GCC-specific 3.0-litre V6 base model was introduced. All models are rear-wheel-drive mated with 6-speed automatic gearboxes. Features include an aluminium body, air suspension, "Adaptive Dynamics" continuously-variable damping, adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, "Active Differential Control" and quick-ratio power steering. Customers can have their choice in colours, veneers and leathers. Inside the car, there is a 12.3-inch LCD with virtual Instruments, Dual-View 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, optional 1200W Bowers & Wilkins system, hard drive and connectivity for portable audio and video devices via a "Media Hub." Other available features include a panoramic glass roof, power accessories, automatic climate control, electric seats with ventilation, turning headlights and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS, pre-charged braking technology, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor and more. The V6 is available in regular or long-wheelbase form, while the V8 is only available in long-wheelbase form, with regular-wheelbase models available upon request.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 3.0-litre diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. In UAE, the manual gearbox is not offered anymore, with the GXR model coming with power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX/Bluetooth support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear parking sensors, full-time 4x4, rear-diff lock and 17-inch alloy wheels, automatic gearbox, power mirrors, crawl control, dashboard display, navigation, rear-view camera, rear window wiper and part-time 4x4, 8 speakers, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, leather-stitched steering wheel, front skid plate protector, spare wheel hard cover, and lot of chrome pieces such as the exhaust tip, grille, door mirrors and door handles. In Saudi Arabia, the base FJ gets a manual gearbox, power steering, power windows, manual side mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, full-time 4x4, rear diff-lock and 17-inch alloy wheels; the base automatic gets part-time 4x4, side-step, rear-window wiper, smaller fuel tank, no traction control and no rear diff-lock; the FJ 1 gets power mirrors, Bluetooth, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, rear parking sensors, iPod support, driver arm rest, 10 JBL speakers & subwoofer, rear-view camera, spare wheel cover and no diff lock; the FJ 2 gets rear diff-lock, front skid plate, traction control, wi-fi and two-hitch. Safety features include standard front airbags as well as ABS and vehicle stability control. In Saudi Arabia, the top model gets side airbags as well. A new Xtreme version was launched in the UAE in 2016, which gets smoked lights, blackened grille, door handles and door mirrors, hood scoop, Bushwacker fender flares, Fox suspensions and performance exhaust with catback system. From 2020, the manual gearbox version was not available anymore.

Ferrari has broken tradition and made their first ever four-wheel-drive, the FF, short for Ferrari Four. It replaced the stunning 612 Scaglietti. A love-hate design, the FF gets a roaring 6.3-litre V12 engine which revs all the way up to 8000 rpm. That power is controlled using the dual-clutch F1 gearbox. Along with the plush leather interior, a 6.5-inch display with touch screen control, a Bluetooth connection with Audio Streaming, navigation, voice command function, two USB connections, and a display with alphanumeric keypad for phone dialling. Also, for the first time something more than golf clubs can actually fit in the boot of a Ferrari, with the rear seats of the FF able to fold down to expand the luggage space. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car such as the engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions.

The F430 is heavily influenced by F1 Racing technology, and makes it known to everyone openly. The F430's compact 4.3-litre V8 engine offers blistering high-revving performance, and the experience is enhanced by an optional F1-style paddle-shifting gearbox which has made its way to every other Ferrari model too. The F430's aerodynamics are honed to generate special flows to increase downforce and improve cooling. One technical feature is the electronic differential, transferring massive torque levels to the track under high cornering g-forces, and guarantees maximum grip out of bends, eliminating wheel spin. The larger interior can be personalized with carbon-fibre or aluminium inserts, with space behind the seats accessed using an electrically operated compartment. The standard electric seats can be substituted by more sporting items with four-point harnesses to order. Even with all this the interior is noticeably barebones in keeping with its sporting nature.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. In 2016, it received a facelift. It remains the same for 2018. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

European motorcycle-maker KTM, introduced their first ever car with the X-Bow. KTM basically transferred its principles from two wheels to four, with a track-biased car that can be driven on the street. But KTM developers have kept the weight of the vehicle extremely light by removing everything that is not needed, including body panels, doors and a windshield. Parts of the suspension are intentionally visible. Built on a carbon-fibre chassis, a 'crash box' in the front nose absorbs collision energy, while roll bars are integrated into the structure, which is all good considering there are no airbags. An options kit is available on request which includes having additional struts mounted at designated points. The Audi-sourced 4-cylinder FSI turbo engine is made of aluminium and mated to a 6-speed manual. In 2016, it got a power upgrade and removed the DSG transmission option, and called itself the X-Bow GT. Brembo brakes, a limited-slip differential, and four-point seat-belts round out the standard package. There are no electronic driving aids, no power steering and no roof, although a cloth tarpaulin is available to cover the interior when not in use.

Just 40 examples of the Bugatti Divo are going to be built and sold (five units are bound for the Middle East), with the entire production run already spoken for well before the first car rolled out of the Molsheim factory. The Divo was offered only to existing Bugatti customers. Apart from the Divo’s low-volume status, its main drawcards are bespoke bodywork that reprises Bugatti’s coachbuilding tradition, plus sharpened dynamics that stem from fettled suspension and a comprehensive aero package that delivers almost 500 kg of downforce at the car’s 380 kph v-max.The Divo is actually slower than the 420 kph Chiron it’s derived from, in terms of outright straight-line speed as its high downforce and the aggressive negative camber it runs on the front and rear tyres necessitated a drop in ultimate velocity. But the payoff of these modifications, in addition to stiffer springs and dampers, is that the Divo serves up sharper steering response and corner-devouring capabilities that eclipse the Chiron – it’s eight seconds a lap quicker than the latter around the 6.2 km Nardo handling circuit.

The Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, and has been mildly facelifted for 2014. External changes include a redone grille and front bumper, new headlight clusters with LED running lights, new tail-lamp clusters and new wheel options. Engine options include a base 5.6-litre V8 with 5-speed automatic or 6-speed manual, known as the Patrol SE, as well as a 5.6-litre V8 with more power, direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top Platinum "City" trim gets a slightly-lower unique bumper. A VIP Edition of the City model was also launched later, with matte-black paint and red seats. Also offered for 2014 is a limited-edition matte-black Platinum model, dubbed the VVIP Edition, with red leather seats and chrome wheels. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The Touran 7-seater is a minivan smaller than the Sharan, with four forward-opening doors and a rear tailgate. Engines include the small 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, both four-cylinder units with a manual or automatic. Standard equipment includes stability control, ABS with brake assist system, six airbags, active head restraints for driver and front passenger, and three-point automatic seat belts for all seats. Among the most important features of this new Volkswagen are its versatile interior layout and the good amount of space it provides, with a load area that can be as large as 1,989 litres. The three separate seats in the second row each weigh less than 16 kilograms and can be individually slid forward and back, repositioned sideways, folded into a very small space or removed completely. Similarly, the two rear seats can be folded flat into the floor when not in use. There are up to 39 storage spaces and compartments inside the well-planned interior.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. In 2018 it got a slight facelift and updated interior, and the M235i changed to M240i with more power. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i, 230i and the M240i. The 220i and 230i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M240i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M240i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2020, an all-new model of the RS 7 came out. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The all-new C-Class Coupe made its debut in 2016. The exterior and interior has been completely revamped from the previous generation. In 2018, two variants are on offer which is the C 200 and the C 300, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Lexus IS debuted as an all-new sedan in 2007, limited to a single engine choice for the GCC, although other markets get better engines. Saddled with a GCC-specific 3.0-litre V6 engine, the IS 300 offers the most sporting ride of the Lexus range. The rear-wheel drive IS 300 comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof; ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Changes for 2009 include minor tweaks such as restyled mirrors and rear headrests. The major news was the addition of the IS 300 C four-seater convertible. Along with the folding hard-top, the IS C features LED rear lights, parking sensors, revised instrument gauges, climate control designed for top-down motoring, 12-speaker Mark Levinson sound system and an in-dash CD changer. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

The Lincoln MKC is the luxury brand's compact SUV offering. It gets two 4-cylinder turbocharged units to choose from, one 2.0-litre and the other 2.3-litre. Both are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. While the 2.0-litre is available in front-wheel drive, the 2.3-litre gets all-wheel drive. Standard features in the MKC include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, automatic A/C, central locking with keyless entry, pust-start engine, signature push button gear shiftter, leather seats and alloy-wheels. Optional features include panoramic roof and better infotainment system. Lincoln MKC offers advanced technology such as collision warning with brake support, a Lane-Keeping System and driver assist to help drivers avoid common accidents. The collision warning system is designed to alert the driver if it detects a potential front-end crash. The system issues an audible alert in the cabin, a visual alert on the windshield and automatic brake assist sensitivity. MKC has park-out assist technology, a class-exclusive feature that enhances the vehicle's active park assist capabilities. Where active park assist helps guide drivers into tight parallel parking situations, park-out assist steers drivers out of tight parking spots. The vehicle's Lane-Keeping System uses rearview mirror-mounted cameras to identify lane markers and help drivers avoid unintentionally straying from their lane. Dashboard-mounted cameras monitor driver alertness. If the system detects a driver's alertness level dropping below a given threshold, a warning is issued via a chime and a pop-up message appears on the left-hand cluster screen. MKC also offers a Blind Spot Information System, which continuously monitors the vehicle's blind spots with radar sensors, and class-exclusive cross-traffic alert, which detects traffic as the vehicle backs from a parking space. The MKC gets 7 standard airbags, including a class-exclusive driver's knee airbag.

The Cadillac ATS is the smallest offering from the American luxury brand. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS will be offered with two engine choices. One will be a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine and other a 3.6-litre V6. External changes include three new colours. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, navigation, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The M6 Cabriolet uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Fuel economy is apparently better by 30% compared to the old V10-powered model. Other mechanical features include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option. The M6 features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The RAV-4 is credited for being the original small 4WD built on a car chassis. It's not that there is anything fundamentally wrong with the vehicle. It's just that the RAV-4 is not a strong off-roader, but insists on looking like one, and people buy it for that reason. It continues with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder in this market even though a V6 model has been introduced elsewhere. Most markets, including UAE and KSA, get the all-wheel-drive model, but KSA additionally gets a two-wheel-drive option as well, the base one with a manual gearbox. The RAV4 range has an array of comfort and convenience features including auto air- conditioning, a MP3 compatible CD player with 6 speakers, power windows and central locking, keyless entry, and cruise control. Its rugged yet stylish exterior appearance is enhanced by a rear spoiler, roof rails, fog lamps and alloy wheels. The high series models also feature a powered driver's seat, leather seats, a moonroof and rear corner sensors. Safety features on all models include dual-stage frontal airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control and traction control. Side airbags are optional. Minor facelifts over the years are too small to notice.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The 407 Coupe has always been a niche product, with styling that still looks good today as it did when the model was launched. For 2009, the 407 Coupe has received a minor facelift comprising on exterior trim add-ons and new tail-lights. The coupe got a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with a 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 407 comes with 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, depneding on trim level. All models get eight or more airbags, as well as stability control and ABS.

Based on a stretched version of the latest 'B6' Passat platform, the redesigned Skoda Superb is a 5-door liftback sedan, with an innovative tailgate that can open as a regular sedan boot or as a full liftback boot, known as 'Twin-Door.' A traditional station-wagon joined the range in 2012. Various VW-derived engines are available, although the only engines available for the GCC, from 2012, is the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and front-wheel-drive for the wagon, and a 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive for the sedan. Both are mated to a 6-speed "DSG" automanual. The Superb 2.0 TSI wagon is available with power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc CD changer and a 6.5-inch touchscreen, SD card and AUX inputs, automatic climate-control a/c, and a choice of upholstery. The Superb 3.6 sedan adds various other luxuries, such as a 12-speaker sound system, 18-inch alloys, standard leather interior and more. Available features include a Bluetooth phone, pull-up rear sun blinds, parking sensors with visual aid and a 'Park Assist' automatic parallel-parking system. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control and ABS. The Superb may not be available in all markets in the GCC.

The Toyota Camry is a favourite among individuals and fleet buyers. The Camry sedan was completely redesigned and greatly improved for 2003, becoming a much larger car than its predecessor. For 2005, the Toyota Camry received a minor facelift, although most buyers will not be able to spot the changes. By the end of production, the Camry was being offered as four models, namely the XLi, GLi, Touring V6 and Grande V6. All 4-cylinder models come standard with a five-speed manual transmission, while a four-speed automatic transmission is standard on the V6 and optional on the 4-cylinder models. The base four-cylinder Camry XLi and GLi sedans come with air conditioning, power windows, central locking, AM/FM/cassette stereo, a 60/40 split rear seat and 15-inch steel wheels. The Touring and Grande Mid-Range grades add a V6 engine ABS with Electronic Brake force Distribution (EBD), an engine immobilizer, and aluminium wheels, front fog lamps and rear spoiler, while the top-of-the-range Grande adds cruise control, moonroof, keyless entry, leatherette and CD changer. Front airbags were standard on all models. These cars are very spacious, and used to sell when new midsize cars were actually affordable.

The Foton Tunland is the Chinese manufacturer's midsize pickup offering. Two engines are on offer - a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine and a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features on the Tunland include power steering, power windows, remote locking, central locking, fabric seats, rear fog lamp, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB support, 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. It gets ABS but no airbags. There is a higher model with leather seats, 16-inch alloy rims, and driver and passenger side front airbags.

The MG 6 comes in two body shapes, either as a sedan or as a liftback version. There are two 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engines to choose from, one being naturally aspirated and the other a turbocharged unit. They can be had in either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission with optional paddle shifters. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with CD/MP3 support and 8 speakers, trip computer and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, power mirrors, cruise control, parking rear camera, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C, radio with DVD/MP3 support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

A new-generation Kia Sorento made its debut in 2015. The Sorento is a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension. The available engines for the GCC are a 3.3-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive as well as a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available with cloth or leather upholstery. The Sorento can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, xenon headlamps, LED indicators on the mirrors, seat cooler and warmer in the front, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch or 19-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

The Ram 1500 is offered in the GCC with a standard 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8. For 2014, it received the new rotary knob-controlled 8-speed automatic with available manual-shift feature. Available in regular cab, quad cab and crew cab, with three box lengths depending on model, the two trim levels available in the UAE are the SLT and the Laramie. Features available in the RAM include heated and ventilated front seats, surround-sound Alpine audio system, common power accessories, voice-controlled UConnect multimedia touchscreen system with Bluetooth phone and 30 GB hard drive, rear DVD screen, basic keyless entry with remote start, 17-inch basic or 20-inch chrome wheels, dual-zone auto a/c and a choice of cloth or leather upholstery, all depending on trim level. Standard safety features include standard ABS, stability control with hill-start assist and trailer sway control, front airbags and side airbags, as well as optional adjustable pedals, rear parking sensors and back-up camera.

The front-wheel-drive C5 is available in a 5-door sedan or a 5-door wagon form, both with upward-opening rear liftgates, and it can be credited with a smooth ride with lots of space, thanks to a restyling back in 2005 that also saw equipment levels upgraded and suspension modified to meet earlier criticisms of ride comfort. Sound-proofing and insulation have been improved too. The long front and rear overhangs makes the C5 look bloated, but its details make it stand out in a crowd. The engine line-up in this region consists of a 2.0-litre four-cylinder and a 3.0-litre V6. The 2.0-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the range-topping 3.0-litre comes with a six-speed tiptronic-style auto gearbox. The C5 features the latest Hydractive 3 version of Citroen's hydro-pneumatic suspension, with automatic height adjustment according to speed and terrain, and continuous alteration of characteristics to suit driving styles. This technically complex car comes with features such as automatic window-closing when it rains, rain-sensing wipers and adaptive headlights which 'bend' around corners and options like a lane-departure warning system, which vibrates the driver's seat if you drift over the white lines without indicating. Seven airbags are standard, along with traction control, ESP and ABS.

The 2015 Legacy is the sixth-generation model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive sedan. Like all Subaru models for more than a decade, the Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and gets an entirely new design for 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic or 3.6-litre flat 6-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The new Porsche Cayman, like the Boxter, has been completely redesigned for 2013. There are four models currently offered, the Cayman, Cayman S, Cayman GTS and Cayman GT4. The mid-engined coupe is now wider and has a longer wheelbase. Delivering more power and better fuel economy, the flat-six cylinder engines is mounted just in front of the rear axle, surrounded by its lightweight aluminium and steel body. The Cayman is powered by a new 2.7-liter engine and the 3.4-liter engine is in the Cayman S with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The Cayman GTS also gets a 3.4-litre flat-6 engine, but tuned for slightly more power and gets Porsche's adaptive chassis system as standard. The Cayman GT4 gets a 3.8-litre flat-6 engine and comes only with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard features include 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Ferrari 458 Italia is the successor to the F430. Going on sale in 2011, the 458 Spider has a new mid-mounted 4.5-litre V8 engine, incorporating direct injection and mated only to a 7-speed dual-clutch automated manual gearbox that shifts in 0.05 seconds. It has a retractable hardtop roof which can open or close in 14 seconds. Technology includes an E-Diff differential and an F1-Trac skid control system. The brakes feature a new system called "˜prefill' so when the driver's foot lifts off the throttle, the pistons in the calipers move the pads towards the discs to reduce the stopping distance. The 458 Italia's body and chassis are all aluminium, with a Pininfarina-designed exterior. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions. The 458 is also available with modern conveniences like Bluetooth, CD stereo, rear camera, navigation, stability control and ABS, as well as a full set of front and side airbags.

The Ford F-150 is new from the ground up for 2015. Starting from its redesigned steel ladder-frame chassis, every aspect of the truck is new, including a shift to aluminium body construction and a general push towards "EcoBoost" turbocharged engines. Available in single cab, "SuperCab" quad-cab and "SuperCrew" double-cab body styles, engines on offer include a 3.5-litre V6, a 2.7-litre turbo V6, a 3.5-litre turbo V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, all with 6-speed automatics. Further configurations include a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive with low-range, while an "FX4" package can add offroad suspension, rear locking diff and skidplates to any model except the base one. Aside from the usual basic features such as power windows, keyless entry and electric mirrors, new features, depending on trim level, include remote tailgate locking and release, unique "BoxLink" tailgate attachment points that accept standard attachments used in moving trucks and trailers, stowable loading ramps that attach to the BoxLink points, optional LED headlights, optional all-around LED lighting including side-mirror "flashlights" and in-bed lighting, 170-degree opening half-doors on SuperCab models, flat rear load floor in SuperCab and SuperCrew cabins, 360-degree camera view, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot warning and even a panoramic sunroof. And it still has that built-in step in its tailgate to climb onto the bed, aside from new pop-out steps on the sides of the bed. Standard safety features include ABS, ESP, front and side-airbags, and optional rear inflatable belts.

The Korean-built Captiva, originally GM's first proper entry into the softroader market, received a facelift in 2011, along with a change in engines and cabin design. On offer is a choice of two powertrains, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive form, and a 3.0-litre V6 with direct-injection and all-wheel-drive. All models get a new 6-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, standard power windows and mirrors, seating for seven, 4-speaker or 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c and keyless entry. There are four trim levels, with the top LTZ model getting optional 19-inch alloy wheels, single-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, 8-speaker stereo with AUX port and CD changer, optional fog lamps, electronic parking brake, cloth or leather upholstery, optional Bluetooth, chrome door handles, optional sunroof and optional parking sensors. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags, standard ABS, and optional traction control, stability control, hill-descent control and hydraulic brake assist.

The MG 360 is the Chinese-owned brand's offering in the compact sedan segment. Under the hood, it gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 350 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, an “InkaLink Vehicle System” that is Android Mobile compatible, an 8-inch touchscreen, a digital speedometer, Bluetooth hands-free telephone, sunroof, rear parking camera, parking sensors and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include front airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESP), brake assist and tyre pressure monitoring system.

The Subaru Impreza WRX is available as a sedan or hatchback. It started off in its current iteration back in 2008, but criticism led to it gaining more power and sportier suspension in 2009 and a widebody kit from the STI in 2011. The turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine can be had with only a 5-speed manual, with all-wheel-drive. The front suspension uses a MacPherson strut setup, while the rear has a double wishbone suspension. Features include ABS-assisted disc brakes, LED tail lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, power windows, electric mirrors and a CD stereo. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in. While a new fully-redesigned version of the regular Impreza was launched in late 2011, the WRX continued in this older iteration for one more year.

This generation of the Genesis G80 sedan debuted in 2015 model year as the Hyundai Genesis, before the rebranding in 2017 as a separate marque. The Genesis can be had with a choice of either a 3.8-litre V6 or 5.0-litre V8. Both engines are mated to a Hyundai-designed 8-speed automatic transmission. Rear-wheel-drive is standard in both models. An "Intelligent Drive Mode" system offers Normal, Eco, Sport and Snow settings that alter transmission mapping, throttle responsiveness, stability control to suit driving conditions. The Genesis V8 can be optioned with an adaptive damping suspension that promises both sportier roadholding and a cushier ride. It, too, can be controlled by Intelligent Drive Mode.  The Genesis 3.8 is fitted as standard with leather upholstery, 12-way power-adjustable front seats, a navigation system with an 8.0-inch screen, a seven-speaker AM/FM/CD radio stereo with AUX and USB input jacks, auto on/off headlight, LED headlight accents, LED taillights, rain-sensing windshield wipers, automatic climate control, Bluetooth connectivity, cruise control, hands-free trunk opening capability, a 4.3-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display and 18-inch alloy wheels. To those features, the Genesis 5.0 adds or substitutes a Lexicon Discrete Logic 7 surround sound system with 14 speakers, premium leather upholstery, genuine matte wood trim, 16-way power adjustable front seats, HID headlights with auto-leveling, high-beam assist, LED fog lights, a rear-view camera, front and rear parking sensors, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection with rear cross traffic alert and lane change assist, lane departure warning system with lane keep assist, a 7.0-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display, manual rear side window sunshades, a power rear sunshade, memory functionality for power driver's seat and outside mirrors and steering column, adaptive cruise control and 19-inch alloy wheels. Much of the 5.0's features can be added to the 3.8 in the form of optional extras. All Genesis models come with dual front, front side, rear side and full-length side curtain airbags in addition to a driver's knee airbag and traction and stability control systems. Optional equipment includes an automatic emergency braking system that applies the brakes if it detects an impending collision; a blind spot warning system with a rear cross traffic alert system that warns the driver of approaching traffic in backup situations; a lane departure warning system with lane keep assist setup that warns the driver if the Genesis begins to wander into an adjacent lane and provides slight steering corrections to bring the sedan back on course; and an emergency steering support mode that automatically changes the setting of suspension and electronic stability control in the direction suitable for emergency steering, to help avoid frontal crash situations.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in four trim levels, namely S, SE, SEL and SPORT, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level S is designed specifically for fleet customers, and features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo, 60/40 folding rear seat, and electronic vehicle immobilisation. The SE model includes a six-CD changer, leather steering wheel, rear a/c vents and 16-inch "San Jose" alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the S and SE models, the SEL has 17-inch "Sonoma" alloy wheels, leatherette seats and a high-end Fender sound system with a subwoofer in the boot. A media input with iPod cable is also standard on the SEL, as is a powered driver's seat, front fog and cornering lamps, keyless entry, pushbutton start, a sunroof and dual-zone climatronic air conditioning with air quality sensors. The flagship SPORT model adds part-leather seats, 18-inch "Bristol" alloy wheels, touch-screen navigation system, 30GB hard disc, SD card reader and DVD drive, memory function for the driver's seat and a powered front passenger seat. Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise.

This generation of the G37 Coupe was first offered in 2008. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe and the convertible are proper 2+2 seater cars, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Laguna is supposed to be an alternative to the average car in the boring midsize segment. The Laguna looks somewhat like a sedan, but is actually a liftback, with a rear hatch that opens upwards for easier access to the luggage trunk. There are two new engines. The base model comes with a simple 2.0-litre four-cylinder, mated to an automatic gearbox in this region. The top model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder setup with unique suspension that is lowered by 10 mm and comes with stiffened springs and dampers. The Laguna became the first car in Europe to achieve the top rating in European governmental crash tests, and is one of the safest cars in its class. Standard safety features include ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Brake Assist, anti-whiplash head restraints, front, front-lateral and front/rear curtain airbags, with de-activation for the front passenger seat. Other standard features include remote central locking, immobiliser and alarm, power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and more.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Lexus GS received a facelift back in 2016 and gained a new entry-level model, the 200t, which replaced the GS 250. Other models include the GS 350 and the GS 450h hybrid. The GS 200t comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 8-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its Lexus trademark 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 200t, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

An all-new Subaru Forester came out in 2015. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine.
