Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The Jaguar XF Sportbrake is the wagon version of the XF luxury-sports sedan that was all-new for 2016. Engines include a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder in the XF Prestige and XF R-Sport, and a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 in the XF S. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 got a second lift in 2019, featuring a new front grille. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Avalon, in this rendition since 2005, has been facelifted for 2011, with new front and rear designs as well as a mildly updated interior. Engineered and built by Toyota's U.S. division, it remains unchanged mechanically. Power comes from a carryover 3.5-litre V6, mated to front-wheel-drive and a 6-speed automatic. Inside is a comfortable cabin lavished with tasteful materials and ergonomically-designed controls that makes this car a pleasant and cheaper alternative to a Lexus. Now available in only one trim level in the UAE, standard features include a sunroof, 17-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, HID headlights, power windows and mirrors, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and USB port as well as 9 speakers, Bluetooth, navigation, rear-view monitor, leather seats, wood trim, cruise control, dual-zone auto a/c, power sunshade, powered front seats with driver-side memory, and most importantly, front seat heaters. However, Saudi Arabia gets two lower-trim models more, with fabric seats and fewer features. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, a front knee airbag, stability control and ABS with EBD.

This generation of the Subaru Forester debuted in 2015 and carries on unchanged except for a facelift and minor trim updates in 2017. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The Hyundai i10 received a facelift for the 2011 model year. It also gets a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with VTVT (Variable Timing and Valve Train) technology, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The sister-model to the hotly-anticipated Toyota 86, the Subaru BRZ finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. The BRZ is a collaborative effort with Toyota, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates, with only a front bumper different between the two. Usually available in only one trim level in most GCC markets, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. Depending on the dealer, standard features include cloth or leather sports seats, HID headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, auto a/c, common power accessories and 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. It additionally gets a limited-slip diff, paddle-shifters, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and and floor illumination. Specs may vary between different GCC countries, with most offering only the automatic version.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. A 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine comes standard while a 3.0-litre V6 is optional. The 2.3-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the 3.0-litre only gets an automatic. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 15-inch steel wheels and AM/FM/6CD stereo. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. Available safety features include front-and-side airbags along with ABS. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

An all-new model of the Volkswagen Golf GTI came out in 2021. Under the hood, it is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine and having a 7-speed DSG automanual gearbox. It features a body kit with a built-in rear diffuser and wider side sills. Compared to the regular Golf, the GTI also rides on 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with lower suspension. Inside it gets sportier seats, steering wheel and pedals than the standard Golf. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, USB/auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, optional sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, common power accessories and more. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport.

After a two-year hiatus to clear old stocks, the Renault Megane came back to the GCC market with an all-new design and, aside from the hatchback version, there was this hard-top convertible Megane CC model as well. Engine choices were limited to a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The CC comes with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include cloth upholstery, fog lamps, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and more. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Most markets got one loaded trim with two-tone cloth or leather upholstery. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in two versions currently. The Maybach 57 is the shorter wheelbase model, which is still very large, and this body style comes in either standard 57 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in 57 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. Both models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems.

The Jaguar XJ is generally available in four trim levels in SWB and LWB versions. The UAE and some other GCC markets will only see the Premium Luxury, Portfolio and SuperSport versions, all in LWB form. The XJ Premium Luxury and the Portfolio will be available with a 5.0-litre naturally-aspirated V8. The XJ Portfolio can also be optioned up with a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The SuperSport comes exclusively with a higher-tuned 5.0-litre supercharged V8. Finally a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 engine completes the line-up. All models are rear-wheel-drive mated with 8-speed automatic gearboxes. Features include an aluminium body, air suspension, "Adaptive Dynamics" continuously-variable damping, adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, "Active Differential Control" and quick-ratio power steering. Customers can have their choice in colours, veneers and leathers. Inside the car, there is a 12.3-inch LCD with virtual Instruments, Dual-View 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, optional 1200W Bowers & Wilkins system, hard drive and connectivity for portable audio and video devices via a "Media Hub." Other available features include a panoramic glass roof, power accessories, automatic climate control, electric seats with ventilation, turning headlights and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS, pre-charged braking technology, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor and more. The V6 is available in regular or long-wheelbase form, while the V8 is only available in long-wheelbase form, with regular-wheelbase models available upon request.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. There is a rare three-door short-wheelbase version known as the LC70, as well as a popular pickup version known as the LC75. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both shared with previous Land Cruiser models, mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Uplander is a new attempt by General Motors to conquer the world of minivan by offering something different. It is a minivan that tries to look a little like a 4WD, and hopes that people won't notice that it is indeed just a minivan. This new seven-passenger minivan is a front-driver that is about 90 percent minivan, and the other 10% could become a quasi-4WD with the optional Versatrak all-wheel-drive, but this option is apparently not offered here. GM is calling their new line a crossover sport van. Power came from a 3.5-litre V6 powerplant in the early models, while a 3.9-litre V6 was later offered optionally, only to become the only choice since 2007. Interior features include fold-down second and third row seating, ceiling rail storage system with DVD and other entertainment features, along with a series of in-floor rear storage bins. The van still utilizes a walkthrough between seats and sliding doors for inner access, while the back has a lift-up tailgate. This van is effectively a replacement for the unloved Venture minivan, which few people knew even existed. The only Uplanders visible on the road seems to be airport taxi vehicles.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year. In 2018, it got a facelift and interior upgrades, but no mechanical changes. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG Coupe gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Haval H8 is the Chinese brand's midsize SUV offering. Under the hood is a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the H8 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric seats with lumbar support, leather or fabric upholstery, infotainment system with 8-inch touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, parking sensors, front and rear fog lamps, 3-zone climate control and alloy wheels. Safety features include front,side and curtain airbags, driver condition monitoring, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The Sonata is supposed to be the highlight of the Hyundai range, designed to go head-to-head with established world-class midsize sedans. It can do everything that the Japanese class leaders can do, but at a much lower price. However, it still isn't noticed much due to poor marketing, and the ugly new facelift doesn't help its cause. The choice of two new competitive engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.3-litre V6, both with manually-shiftable automatics, though the smaller engine can be had with a proper manual too. The cabin facelift fares much better.Standard features include power windows, power outside mirrors, manual a/c, central door lock, front fog lamps, cloth seats, 15-inch steel wheels and a radio cassette player with 4 speakers and a hidden antenna. Options spread over the range includes dual airbags, ABS brakes, dual exhaust, automatic a/c, electric sunroof, cruise control, leather upholstery, electric driver's seat, trip computer, rear parking warning sensor, rear sunblind, fake wood and metal cabin trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel, 6-CD changer with 6 speakers and a subwoofer and an electronic auto-dimming rearview mirror, along with 17-inch alloy wheels.

The Suzuki Kizashi tries to make an entry into the highly-competitive midsize segment, by being slightly smaller than the competition. There is only one engine choice, a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Only the Sport grade is offered in most GCC countries, thereby coming with a sporty front bumper and rear spoiler as default on all cars. Largely unchanged for 2014, it got a price reduction in most markets. Standard features on the Kizashi include power windows, power mirrors, power locks, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/USB capability, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start engine, sunroof, leather seats, cruise control, power adjustable driver and passenger seats, fog lamps and parking sensors. ABS and six airbags come as standard in most markets.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Gran Coupe Competition was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 Gran Coupe comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Nissan Sentra remains the same for the 2015 model year, since its introduction in 2013 . It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. The 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in only CVT. Both engines are not available in all GCC countries. The 1.6S and 1.8S gets power steering, power mirrors, power windows, halogen headlamps, rear LED lamps, keyless entry, manual seats, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/RDS support and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. The 1.6SV gets LED accent headlamps, intelligent key with engine push-start button, wood trim and 4 speakers. The 1.6 SV Sports gets fog lamps, leather steering, rear spoiler, 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors and indicators on side-view mirror.  Both 1.6 SV and 1.8 SV sports have the option of USB/iPod connectivity, bluetooth, navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. The 1.8 SV gets the same as S but with rear parking sensors and bluetooth. The 1.8 SL gets the same options as 1.6 SV Sports plus rear spoiler with brake lamp, 6 speakers and USB/iPod connectivity. The 1.8 SL Premium gets more features such as leather seats, sunroof, cruise control, dual-zone climate control A/C. The 1.8 SL and SL Premium have the option of adding navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. Safety features include electronic brake-force distribution (EBD), ABS and Brake Assist (BA), along with driver and passenger front airbags. Only the 1.8 SL Premium gets side and curtain airbags.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. The SL 63 AMG comes with a turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more. An optional performance package bumps up power by 25 hp, and removes the speed limiter.

A new generation Golf R debuted in 2014 in the Middle East. Under the hood is a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, mated to a dual-clutch 6-speed automanual transmission. The all-wheel drive Golf R is lighter and more powerful than the previous generation. It features power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, sports seats, standard XDS electronic differential lock, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist, adaptive cruise control, 19-inch alloys and rear camera. Safety standards are high as it comes with seven airbags including a knee airbag, ABS brakes, traction control and stability control.

The BMW M2 made its debut in the GCC in 2016. The exterior of the M2 Coupe may look no different than that of the M235i at first glance. But there are visual changes such as aggressively-flared front and rear bumpers, quad-exhausts and sporty alloys. As much as 80% of parts can be different when comparing M cars versus their non-M versions. Underneath the bonnet is a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. The car gets an overboost function that increases the torque for a few seconds. The engine will be mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The car also receives M4-derived aluminium front and rear axles, aluminium suspension components, tuned electronic power-steering and an Active M-Differential. The longer M4-sourced axles are what led the M2 to have wider fenders, so the tyres wouldn't stick out.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily facelifted and revised for 2007, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features. Also new to the range is the Navigator L, an extended version which has a longer wheelbase and additional cargo space.

The Grandis is a slick minivan that offers buyers a genuine three-row seating configuration to take the kids to school and pick up their buddies at picnics on the weekend, but without the higher running costs associated with a 4WD alternative thanks to their small 4-cylinder engines and car-like demeanour. It is also interesting to note that this people mover forego sliding rear doors in favour of a car-like 4-door configuration. The MPV is kitted out with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, andÂ  gets a standard 4-speed automatic with manual shift capability, transferring its engine power to the ground via the front wheels. With seating for seven, standard safety features include front airbags, though front side and curtain airbags are optional. Also standard are ABS-assisted disc brakes, rear a/c and power windows and mirrors. Options include such niceties as dual sunroofs, leather, CD changer and more. Just be ready to be mistaken for a professional van driver on the streets, even though the Grandis is far too good to be a commercial vehicle.

The smallest 4WD in BMW's lineup debuted in 2004, and got a facelift in 2005 to improve its ugly looks. The X3 slots in below the more expensive first-generation X5, but has almost the same passenger space, more cargo volume, and is also lighter and therefore more fuel-efficient. Like the X5, the X3 seats five passengers, has a liftgate with a fixed glass window, and includes BMW's xDrive all-wheel drive. Engines include a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder and a 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder. A 6-speed manual transmission is standard on all models, while a 5-speed automatic with manual shift gate is an option. The ground clearance is far from impressive, so X3 is only good for light-duty off-roading. The all-wheel-drive system lacks low-range gearing, but includes a hill descent control that automatically limits speed down steep grades. ABS and traction/antiskid control are standard. Standard wheels are 17-inch, but 18-inch are available in a Sport Package that also includes firmer suspension and sport front seats. A sunroof and rear glass skylight are optional. Leather upholstery is available, while other options include a crude navigation system, steering-linked xenon headlamps, and front and rear parking sensors.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016. The wagon is available with a "SkyActiv" 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection engine. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. There is no top-spec model offered in the GCC. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

An all-new model of the Toyota Corolla came out in mid 2019 as a 2020 model. Engine offerings include a 1.6-litre and a new 2.0-litre, both 4-cylinder "VVT-i" units. A new hybrid engine joins the lineup which is a 1.8-litre combined with electric motors. The five-seater is available in various trim levels. In Saudi Arabia, there is a 1.6 XLi model with 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, black front grille, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and a 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo. Moving up to the 1.6 GLi adds fog lamps, 16-inch alloys, rear AC vents, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, trunk liner, better upholstery with leather steering wheel, split-folding rear seats, 6-speaker touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with starter button and several other smaller convenience features. The 2.0 GLi adds LED headlights with LED running lamps, sunroof, rear manual curtains, auto a/c and cruise control. In the UAE, there are 5 trim levels, starting with the 1.6 XLi model that includes a standard automatic gearbox, 15-inch steelies, 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo, power mirrors and a black grille. power windows, keyless entry and central locking. The 1.6 GLi adds better upholstery with leather steering wheel, chrome grille, split-folding rear seats, LED running lamps, smart keyless entry and start, LCD info display, a better 6-speaker stereo and 16-inch alloy wheels. Moving on to the larger engine, the 2.0 XLi has all the features of the 1.6 XLi, but additionally gets 16-inch alloys and 6 speakers for the basic stereo. The 1.8 XLi HEV gets similar features to the 1.6 XLi, while the 1.8 GLi HEV gets a moonroof, 7-inch screen for the infotainment system, auto-leveling LED headlamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. Other markets may get slightly different trim levels. All models get standard dual front airbags, ABS with brake assist and EBD, stability control and an alarm immobiliser.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo made its debut in 2007. It remains unchanged for 2008. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets a new all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 2007 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Further options include an powered steel sliding/lift sunroof and a roof-transport system. Another option in the Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

As evolutionary developments of the America's most popular minivan, the 2005 facelift model features larger headlights than the older pre-2004 model, optional power operation of the sliding side doors, a power rear liftgate and revised interiors that are quieter, nicer and more comfortable. The new Grand Voyager also features Stow "˜n Go rear seats, giving the ability to easily fold the second and third-row seats into the floor in as little as 30 seconds with a simple one-hand operation. Featuring 256 possible seating positions and an additional 340 litres of available storage, Stow "˜n Go provides for immense flexibility and convenience. More options include a rear-seat audio system, a tyre-pressure warning system, electronically adjustable pedals and a rear-seat DVD entertainment. Chrysler minivans, in various shapes and names, are best sellers in the United States, but failed to make any headway in this region, firstly because minivans are not popular here, and secondly, engine options are limited to just one aging V6 here.

Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is a combination of both coupe and crossover, designed to the tackle the BMW X6. In 2020, it got a facelift. Currently only the GLE 53 AMG is being sold, which comes with a 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged V6 motor, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The engine is coupled with a small electric motor to improve acceleration and fuel economy. Exterior-wise, it shares a few design cues of the new S-Class Coupe, such as the roofline and rear tail-lights. The interior features sports seats, a sports steering wheel and a new infotainment display. The cabin is covered in silver shadow accents, and aluminum or wood trim.Safety features include Driving Assistance package which includes features such as DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist and PRE-SAFE PLUS. The Parking package includes the 360-degree camera and Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC. Night-time vision is improved by the LED Intelligent Light System which is a standard feature on all models; adverse weather conditions with impaired view are defused by MAGIC VISION CONTROL the heated, adaptive windscreen wiper system.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. In 2009, a removable roof model was added to the lineup, called the Veyron Grand Sport. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The Jaguar F-Type Coupe hit showrooms in mid-2014, joining the range almost a year after the Roadster's launch. It comes with two supercharged 3.0-litre engine choices, in V6 and V6 S form, as well as with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8, in V8 R form, the latter more powerful than the V8 S Roadster. There is no V8 S version for the Coupe. In 2018, a 2.0-litre turbo joined the lineup as well. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive. Components include adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. The F-Type R Coupe additionally gets a new electronic active differential and a torque vectoring system, as well as larger brakes with optional carbon-ceramic discs.

The Mitsubishi Outlander got a facelift in 2016. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

Daihatsu aims to boost sales with its new Terios 4WD. With short front and rear overhangs, a long wheelbase and wide track, it looks like it can go off-road, but not with any real verve. It's apparently aimed at people looking for the traditional 4x4 qualities of high seating position, bad-weather traction and versatility combined with small car running costs and manoeuvrability. It is longer and wider than the previous model. The interior is about the same size as a mid-sized hatchback, with a split fold-and-tumble rear seat that frees up luggage space supposedly long enough to take a mountain bike. The front floor cross-member, tunnel, sills, B-pillars and roof-side rails are all strengthened to secure the cabin. With the rear seat in use the boot capacity is 380 litres. Its 1.5-litre engine is based on the Daihatsu 1.3-litre, with variable valve timing and its torque curve is virtually flat from 3200 to 4000 rpm. The engine is mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. A centre differential transfers power with a fixed 50/50 torque split to the front and rear axles via separate propshafts. A fascia-mounted switch activates the electronically-controlled differential lock. ABS, EBD and front driver & passenger airbags are available too. There are two grades - the SVP and SX. The SVP gets power steering, power windows, remote central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, steering mounted audio controls, AM/FM audio system with CD/MP3/AUX support and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps.  The SX grade gets additional automatic A/C, 12V power supply socket, chrome plated door handles, chrome plated side mirrors, roof rails and 16-inch alloy wheels.

The BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo came out in 2018. Under the hood, it got a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine as standard, while the higher models got a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. Both engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The BMW 5-Series Gran Turismo received a facelift for the 2014 model year. The 5-Series GT is supposed to be a coupe-like crossover vehicle that aims to appeal to markets where the 5-Series wagon is ignored. The 'F07' platform features a unique "bi-modal" trunk which may be opened in traditional sedan fashion, or the entire hatch may open like a hatchback. The 2014 model gets a new front air intake, while the back has been extended rearwards to give it a lower slung appearance. Also boot capacity has been increased by 60 litres to total up to 500 litres. Tech features include four-wheel multilink suspension, standard 8-speed automatic gearboxes and turbo engines, namely the 3.0-litre inline-6 for the 535i GT and the 4.4-litre V8 for the 550i GT. Depending on trim level, the 4-seater GT can be outfitted with features such as leather upholstery, 4-zone automatic a/c, Bluetooth, navigation, USB/iPod port, CD/MP3 stereo with 80 GB hard disc, rear DVD entertainment system, heads-up display, panoramic glass roof, adaptive cruise control with stop-&-go feature, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning system, night vision, active steering, rear-wheel steering, rearview camera, side-view cameras, parking sensors, run-flat tyres and keyless button-start, among others. Also included are various selectable driving modes, adjustable air suspension, stability control and numerous airbags. The niche vehicle is almost as long as the 7-Series and has as much headroom as the X5.

The Lincoln Continental is the Ford-owned luxury brand's all-new flagship sedan. Three engine choices are available - the base model gets 3.7-litre V6 engine, while there is a turbocharged 2.7 V6 and turbocharged 3.0 V6 motors on offer as well. All engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Only the all-wheel drive models are available in the GCC but other markets get a front-wheel drive option as well. Standard features on the Continental include adaptive power steering, power windows, adaptive HID headlamps and LED daytime running lamps, power mirrors, premium sound system with 10 speakers, 8-inch touchscreen with SYNC 3, 2 USB ports, push start engine, push button shift transmission, front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera, leather seats, and 19-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get more interior trim choices, premium LED headlamps, massage seats for the rear, better sound system with 19 speakers, more adjustable power seats for the front, voice activated touch screen, 360 camera for parking and 20-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include front, side and knee airbags, stability control, brake assist, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and ABS. Higher models get lane-keeping assist, blind spot monitor and driver alert system.

The Audi A1 is the smallest car offered by the German manufacturer. There are two versions - the 'Attraction' and the 'Ambition'. They all have a 1.4-litre engine, with the base and mid-option "122" models getting a turbocharger and the higher spec "185" models having a turbo-supercharger combo. The cramped platform offers a cheap independent-front and solid torsion-beam rear suspension. Standard options include electric mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with 8 speakers, start-stop engine system and  daytime running headlamps. Optional equipment include xenon headlamps, fog lamps, automatic air-conditioning,  leather seats, cruise control, headlight washers, LED rear lights, sports seats with lumbar support and parking sensors. Safety-wise, front and side-curtain airbags, ESC with electronic limited slip differential and hill-start assist come standard in all models.

The BMW X3 compact crossover got a facelift in 2015. There are two variants. One is the naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the xDrive28i, and the other is the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the xDrive35i, both with 8-speed automatic gearboxes and all-wheel-drive. The new interior integrates either a 6.5-inch or an 8.8-inch screen, and new features, standard or optional depending on trim, include a heads-up display with night vision, active and passive systems such as the lane change and lane departure warnings, optional parking assistant, adaptive cruise control, surround-view cameras, Variable Damper Control to pick between Normal, Sport and Sport+, Bluetooth phone with audio connectivity, navigation, multiple front and side airbags, leather or cloth upholstery, HID headlights, keyless start, sunroof, BlackBerry smartphone connectivity to gain access to e-mails and other distractions which can be shown on the control display and read out via the optional voice output. An M package is available that adds a body kit and more. New features available on the 2015 X3 include iDrive Controller with integrated touchpad (for text input using finger movements), Parking Assistant, the full-colour BMW Head-Up Display, the anti-dazzle High Beam Assistant and Driving Assistant Plus, including Lane Departure Warning, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function and preventive pedestrian protection.

The Jeep Patriot got a new transmission and minor interior and exterior upgrades in 2014. The Patriot is a compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

An all-new Nissan Navara Pickup was released as a 2017 model year. In the GCC, the engines are carried over from the previous generation but with new transmissions. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, both of which come with either a 6-speed manual or 7-speed automatic transmission. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloy wheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signal lamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensing wipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2015, the RS 7 got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Cadillac SRX aims more for road-going luxury than any sort of off-roading ability. There's a standard power rear liftgate, reduced step-over for easy exiting, stylish 17-inch and 18-inch wheels and an enhanced optional wood package, all of which signify its intentions. Bigger than a wagon but not quite a 4WD, the SRX is one of the rare vehicles that truly deserves the "crossover" designation. It uses GM's Sigma platform serving the Cadillac CTS. Engine choices are a 3.6-litre V6 and a 4.6-litre Northstar V8, both of which use a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. Both engine sizes can be optioned up to all-wheel-drive. Standard features include fog lights, heated mirrors, roof rack side rails, rear wiper/washer, 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather-wrapped wheel with controls for audio and voice recognition systems, express up/down on all windows, leather interior, eight-way power driver's seat, 60/40 folding rear seat, CD player with seven speakers, automatic headlamps, and rear parking assist. The V8 model adds driver's side auto-dimming exterior mirror, 18-inch aluminum wheels, CD changer and more. The SRX handles like a car rather than a lumpy 4WD, and the optional Magnetic Ride Control, which automatically adjusts the shocks to compensate for any road imperfections, makes it even smoother on the roads, where it belongs.

The Mercedez-Benz GLS-Class is the new name for the GL-Class. In 2016, it received a facelift, along with mechanical updates. The GLS uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. The GLS 63 AMG comes with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GLS-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

Citroen has a tradition for breaking design conventions and building quiry cars, and the Picasso, a compact people-carrier, is no exception. The Picasso offers a roomy and versatile interior designed around the need for differing seating configurations in a vehicle with car-like handling characteristics. Compact tall wagons have become popular family vehicles in europe, though people here are reluctant to give up their stupid 4WDs. The only powerplant is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder with front-wheel-drive and an automatic gearbox. The sloping front end offers a commanding driving position. The dash-mounted shifter is within easy reach and the digital instrumentation is clear. The cabin is filled with accessories like cup-holders, fold-down aeroplane-style tables in the back, and a low luggage floor for easy loading, with numerous other stowage facilities and cubby holes, including huge door pockets and under-floor storage boxes. Safety features include the requisite airbags and ABS brakes.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. In 2015, it got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Renault Duster, a rebadged Dacia, has been designed to suit all types of roads across the world's less-developed countries. It got a minor facelift in 2015 and once more for 2018, with updated interior materials. This sub-compact SUV is based on a stretched Nissan Tiida platform, and comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available in either a two-wheel-drive 4-speed automatic form or in an all-wheel-drive 6-speed manual form, the latter capable of locking the diff for a 50:50 front/rear torque split. Interestingly, the 2WD model comes with a torsion-beam rear suspension, while the 4WD model gives up some boot space to make way for an independent rear suspension. The rear seats fold down as standard, and split-folding on all but the base model, while you can transport longer items if the front passenger seat is folded down as well. The basic PE version comes with two-wheel-drive, 4-speed automatic, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth with buttons behind steering wheel, unpainted bumpers, 16-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, folding rear bench seat, power steering and manual a/c. Early models came with one airbag, but by mid-2012, all models had two standard airbags. The higher-spec SE can be had in 2WD automatic or special-order 4WD manual drivetrains, and adds standard fog lamps, trip computer, ABS with Emergency Brake Assist, extra front-passenger airbag, rear power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, painted bumpers, leatherette steering wheel and extra chrome trim. The SE version can be further upgraded with leather seats with additional pyrotechnic pre-tensioners on the front seatbelts as well as side airbags. The exterior package on the SE version also adds standard chrome door mirrors, longitudinal roof rails, front/rear skid plates and side-skirt covers. Extra tinted rear windows, rear quarter glass and rear windscreen round up the list, as is a split-folding rear seat, height adjustable driver's seat and height-adjustable steering wheel. A comprehensive range of accessories,including wind reflectors, side steps, wheel arch mouldings, chrome exhaust trim and mudflaps, is also available.

Hyundai's Genesis G70 is the Korean carmaker's attempt at cracking the entry-level premium sports sedan niche. Starting off with a shortened platform derived from the Kia Stinger, the compact sedan appears to derive a lot from its rivals and brings nothing new to the table, aside from offering a bit more power, based on preliminary reports. In 2021, the Genesis G70 received a significant facelift. The engines on offer include a 2.0-litre turbo four and a 3.3-litre twin-turbo V6, both mated to 8-speed automatics. Features include LED lighting, an 8-inch touch screen, electronic shifter. available 15-speaker Lexicon audio system, Apple CarPlay and a heads-up display. Safety features include the usual set of airbags, ABS, ESP and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as active-driving aids such as adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane-departure warning, etc.

The Magna was an all-new model back in 1997, replacing Mitsubishi's Sigma as their top-of-the-line sedan. Competing in the near-luxury segment against upscale brands, it never stood a chance, but soldiered on anyway unchanged right up to 2003, at which point it got a facelift. The Magna features a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine, a 4-speed automatic gearbox, a modern-at-the-time dashboard, decent suspension tuning and improvements in body structure that promise fair handling. Offered only as a sedan, the fairly-large Magna rode on a front-wheel-drive platform, and didn't overlap with the more-popular Galant, which was originally in between a compact and a midsize at that time. The Magna was available in essentially two flavours, namely a standard model and a sportier VR-X version. The Magna VR-X upgrades include a mesh grille, colour-keyed rear spoiler, aerodynamic side skirts, wheel lip moldings, sport-style bucket seats, unique seat fabric, and possibly sportier suspension tuning with slightly-increased engine power. Standard features on this redesigned sedan include dual airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, tinted glass, a power driver seat, an AM/FM stereo with cassette and CD player, remote keyless entry, optional leather, optional ABS and a security system. A minor facelift came for 2000, before the major one in 2004.

The MG 360 is the Chinese-owned brand's offering in the compact sedan segment. Under the hood, the 2019 MG 360 gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 2019 MG 360 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, an “InkaLink Vehicle System” that is Android Mobile compatible, an 8-inch touchscreen, a digital speedometer, Bluetooth hands-free telephone, sunroof, rear parking camera, parking sensors and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features in the 2019 MG 360 include front airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESP), brake assist and tyre pressure monitoring system.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2015. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution.

The Dodge Ram had been extensively re-engineered for 2006, with a minor restyling and an upgraded interior, having been originally redesigned in 2002. It has a new hydroformed frame that's boxed its full length to provide more strength than in any previous model. New suspension and body mounts also improve ride and handling, though it is still no luxury sports sedan. Inside the Ram, the instrument panel, centre console and seats have been redesigned for more car-like comfort, while new entertainment features have been introduced. The standard motor for the Middle East is the 5.7-litre Hemi V8 engine, which featured the new Multi-Displacement System from 2006, a setup that shuts down four of the Hemi's eight cylinders when they are not needed. Dodge claims the switchover is seamless, and that fuel economy is improved by as much as 20 percent. Adding to the Hemi's responsive nature is a five-speed automatic transmission. The Ram comes standard with air conditioning, AM/FM/CD stereo, rear-wheel ABS, 17-inch wheels and a full-size spare tyre. Also available are power windows and door locks, keyless entry, an overhead console with mini-trip computer and compass, cruise control and larger aluminium wheels.

The Audi A5 originally debuted for 2008 in the GCC as a four-seater coupe based on the latest stretched A4 platform, with the range later diluted by the addition of a 5-door model. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.2-litre V6 engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive version, and a 6-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive version. For 2009, an underwhelming Audi S5 Quattro coupe model debuted, with a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. The front-wheel-drive A5 Cabrio convertible also eventually joined the line-up with only a detuned 2.0T engine and a CVT, offering less power than the coupe. For 2010, the new A5 Sportback 5-door liftback model joined the range, with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, a 7-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel-drive. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The new platform moves the engine more rearward in relation to the front axle for better balance and handling, but ultimately the car loses out on the fun factor in any form, either due to its front-driven underpinnings or to its overly-safe Quattro system.

The BMW 8-Series Gran Coupe was revealed in 2020. The 8-Series Gran Coupe comes with a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The 2020 BMW 8-Series Gran Coupe comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Renault Captur is a small SUV offering from the French brand. Under the hood, the Spanish-made Captur gets a turbocharged 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. A lot of customisation can be done on the car's bodywork, interior trim and upholstery. Standard features on the front-wheel drive Captur include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, fabric seats, radio with MP3/AUX/CD player support, USB, Blutetooth, manual A/C, alloy rims, LED daytime lights, tire pressure monitoring system, push button start, central locking & keyless entry. Top model features include navigation, rear view camera, 17-inch 2-tone alloy wheels, parking sensors, automatic A/C, power folding mirrors, 2-tone body color and removable seat covers. Standard safety features include front and passenger airbags, ABS and ESP.

The Jaguar XE is the smallest car offering from the British brand. The XE is offered with two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. The turbocharged engine is offered in two different tunes. All models get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options in the XE include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, dual-zone AC, smart key system with keyless start, 8-inch display screen, 6 speakers, cloth seasts, paddle shifters and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher option models get leather seats, sunroof, ventilated seats, xenon headlights, adaptive cruise control, head-up display, bodykit, and 18 to 19-inch rims. Safety features include All Surface Progress Control (ASPC), Torque Vectoring by Braking (TVbB), ABS, dynamic stability control (DSC), lane departure warning, closing vehicle sensing, autonomous emergency braking, driver and passenger front and side airbags.

The Lexus RC F is the Japanese luxury brand's performance compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC F gets a 5.0-litre V8 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control. A carbon package replaces the bonnet, roof and boot with carbon-fibre body panels.

An all-new Dodge Ram was released for 2019. Available only in the four-door crew-cab body style for now, the new Ram 1500 is offered in Big Horn, Rebel, Laramie and Limited trims for the GCC region. The exterior styling is a departure from the Ram’s previous three generations’ “big rig” looks, with a selection of grille designs and headlight configurations based on the trim you buy. The top-dog Limited features the most chrome, and also comes with 22-inch wheels and electric-folding side-steps. The Rebel gets a black plastic-cladded look with 18-inch wheels, slightly lifted ride height and fixed side steps. Inside, the abundantly-spacious Ram features stitched-leatherette on the dash, doors and sides of the centre-console as well as a huge 12-inch touchscreen in the Limited version. The screen is fairly responsive, and there are still physical buttons for the main a/c controls along the sides. The Rebel gets an 8.4-inch touchscreen. Aside from the wonderfully-configurable centre-console storage and two glove-boxes, there are also underfloor and underseat storage compartments in the rear-seat area. The useful lockable RamBox feature in the bed is carried over from the previous model and remains optional. The bed itself has LED lights and the tailgate is damped so it doesn’t slam open. It is still powered by a 5.7-litre “Hemi” V8 and mated to a knob-controlled 8-speed automatic. The motor has cylinder-deactivation tech. A 3.6-litre V6 will be offered later on the base trim. Underneath, the Ram’s ladder frame is held up by coil-spring rear suspension in contrast to rivals’ rear leaf springs. Height-adjustable air suspension is optional, as is a locking rear differential.

An all-new MG 6 came out as a 2019 model. The MG 6 comes as a liftback version. It gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay support and 6 speakers, trip computer. rear parking camera, push start button and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, cruise control, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The Jaguar F-Type Coupe hit showrooms in mid-2014, joining the range almost a year after the Roadster's launch. It comes with two supercharged 3.0-litre engine choices, in V6 and V6 S form, as well as with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8, in V8 R form, the latter more powerful than the V8 S Roadster. There is no V8 S version for the Coupe. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive. Components include adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. The F-Type R Coupe additionally gets a new electronic active differential and a torque vectoring system, as well as larger brakes with optional carbon-ceramic discs.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering, continuing with minor upgrades and a facelift for 2009. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini cues, available as Coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. A 5.2-litre V10 engine, upgraded again for 2009, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type limited slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard. Now officially known as the Gallardo LP560-4, it supercedes all previous versions. The LP560-4 Spyder is heavier and slightly slower. A LP 570-4 Superleggera coupe and LP570-4 Spyder Performante models made its debut later, which are slightly more powerful and weighed lighter. A track-focussed LP 570-4 Trofeo Stradale model was also briefly offered before being cancelled by late 2012. The rear-wheel drive LP 550-2 Coupe was offered by Lamborghini in 2011 as the lowest-priced model in the Gallardo line-up, followed by a Spyder model later on. A special edition LP 560-4 Bicolore was released in 2010 which features a unique two-tone paintjob, black roof and special alloy wheels. Meanwhile, the original LP 560-4 got a facelift for 2013, with triangle-heavy front and rear bumpers to differentiate it from lesser models.

The M is a car very similar to the G35, only slightly larger in size. Ever so lightly facelifted for 2008, it is offered with either a 3.5-litre V6 or a 4.5-litre V8 mated to the usual five-speed automatic transmission with manual-shift mode and a rear-wheel-drive chassis. The M35 and M45 are also a little more luxurious than the G35, by virtue of its extra cabin space. The suspension is independent double-wishbone in front and multi-link independent rear. Rear Active Steer adjusts the geometry of the rear suspension, according to steering input and vehicle speed, to enhance low-speed manoeuvrability and high-speed stability. Standard features on the M35 sedans include heated and cooled leather seats, ten-way power driver's seat, six-way power passenger seat, intelligent key with pushbutton ignition, Bluetooth, 18-inch wheels, six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo, vehicle information system with seven-inch screen, xenon headlamps with adaptive front lighting, and power sunroof. Optional features include surround sound with 14 speakers, DVD-based navigation system with eight-inch colour monitor, DVD entertainment system, and laser-based intelligent cruise control.

The Nissan Altima, a roomy and practical midsize sedan, has been completely redesigned for the 2008 model year, with slightly more sporty handling and a little more extrovert styling than the competition. The Altima sits at the top of the class in terms of power. Available are a 2.5-litre four-cylinder and a 3.5-litre V6, both with a choice of six-speed manual or CVT automatic transmissions. The Altima is the only one in its segment to offer a manual gearbox with the V6. Also, it will be sold in either sedan or coupe form, although the coupe will only be available with the V6. The spacious Altima offers standard features such as power windows, keyless entry and start, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, power steering, and an in-glass antenna for the nine-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity. Also available are power mirrors, optional electric seats, sunroof, cruise control, leather, 17-inch alloy wheels and HID headlights. ABS brakes with Electronic Brake-force Distribution and Brake Assist are standard, as are front airbags. Side and curtain airbags are also available.

The British Morris Garages brand, a spin-off of Rover, is back in a new guise under Chinese ownership. The new-for-2011 MG 550 1.8T compact sedan is designed by MG's British team and comes with a newly-developed 1.8-litre light-pressure turbo 4-cylinder engine and a 5-speed automatic, on a front-wheel-drive platform vaguely derived from the old Rover 75, with independent suspension and disc brakes on all four wheels. The base model gets 16-inch alloys wheels, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, stability control, two front airbags, ABS with EBD, fabric seats, one-press engine start with the key still requiring insertion, steering-mounted radio controls, power windows and mirrors, automatic climate control a/c, faux wood trim, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, keyless entry, illuminated sunshade mirrors, digital gauges and fog lights. The top "Deluxe" model gets 17-inch alloys, side-curtain airbags, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, tinted windows, electric driver's seat, parking sensors, sunroof and a basic GPS system. There are many more options available, such as Bluetooth, rear camera and cooler box, but the dealer will not offer those for now.

The Accord may not be best in class for every little thing, but its all-rounder package makes it popular among consumers. The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, and now offered in an American-built coupe form as well. The coupe debuted in the middle of 2008. It's offered with either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. The 2.4-litre in the coupe has a bit more power than the one in the sedan. All trims get a five-speed automatic only. Standard features on all models include power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, cruise control, CD/MP3 player with steering wheel controls, dual front airbags, ABS brakes, head restraint system and keyless entry. Optional features available in higher models include 17-inch alloys, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps.

The Audi A3 Sedan is the German brand's sub-compact sedan offering. A new model of the A3 came out in 2021. It is available with one engine which is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

An all-new model of the Kia Cerato came out as a 2019 model year. For 2022, it got a facelift and some new tech for the interior. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors. Safety features include ABS brakes, brake assist, stability control, and two front airbags.

The Nissan Micra made its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. It remains the same for the 2016 model year. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are fewer trim levels from 2014 onwards, with higher trims having features such as power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. The V60 straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot.
