This generation of the G37 Coupe was first offered in 2008. The G coupe uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. The G37 coupe originally had a 5-speed automatic transmission in 2008, while from 2009 onwards it received a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Audi S8 was the performance version of their flagship A8 model. It featured a Lamborghini-derived 5.2-litre V10 engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission and their trademark "quattro" all-wheel drive system. The center differential distributes 40 percent of the torque to the front and 60 per cent to the rear. The S8 was not too heavy for its size, thanks to its all-aluminium body panels.  As well as adaptive light technology and 20-inch wheels, other features include new, noise-insulating double glazing for the windows, a DVD navigation system and BOSE Surround audio system with CD changer. The door armrests, the center console, and the seats in the Audi S8 are upholstered in leather. Safety features include traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, front and side airbags.

More a tall wagon than a true off-roader, the Outlander is based on the Lancer platform and uses a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine that mates to a four-speed automatic transmission only. The all-wheel-drive system splits the torque evenly between the front and rear under normal driving conditions, and distributes it wherever necessary when the going gets slippery. It does not have he equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 6-CD changer with 6 speakers, and leather seats. The Outlander is gutsy for a four-cylinder, but far from quick. It is easy to climb into, with a fair amount of room up up front and good all-round visibility as it is taller than a car but shorter than a proper 4WD. Mitsubishi decided to ditch this ambiguous genre with the next-generation 2008 Outlander, which took on the appearance of a proper 4WD.

The Dodge Challenger debuted in 2008, went on sale in the GCC by 2010, and has already been upgraded for the 2011 model year. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. From this version, the Challenger became available in top-spec V8-powered SRT-8 trim in the GCC. Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger packs a 6.4-litre Hemi V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual. The SRT-8 gets bi-xenon headlights, leather-alcantara sport seats, CD stereo, and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front and side airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG gets a mid-cycle refresh, in line with the rest of the S-Class range, with ever-so-subtle design changes. The most significant changes are under the hood, which then rounds off with a slightly redesigned front-fascia and DRL's. It is now propelled by a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8, and mated to an all-new 9-speed automatic transmission, and available only with the AMG-tuned 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. Theres also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. It rides on optional 19-inch or 20-inch light-weight alloys too. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Nissan Murano is a crossover SUV, designed pretty much exclusively for on-road cruising rather than off-road excursions. The Murano is available in three trim levels, all featuring a 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to Nissan's Xtronic CVT transmission with adaptive shift control, as well as all-wheel-drive. Standard features for the Murano include 18-inch alloy wheels, six airbags, ABS, stability control and front seat active head restraints. Additional features include bi-xenon headlights, LED tail lamps, cruise control and an in-dash six-disc CD player with AUX socket for MP3 players. Also available are an intelligent Key with memory for the powered front seats and steering wheel, as well as a Bose audio system with 11 speakers, including a pair of Richbass woofers mounted in the spare-wheel well. The Murano's new interior is makes abundant use of soft-touch materials and upholstery trimmed in cloth or leather and aluminium detailing. Depending on trim level, the Murano can also be had with ambient mood lighting, auto climate-control, split 60/40 rear seats with powered raising function, power-operated tailgate, parking cameras for the front and rear, twin "˜top loader' sunroof, navigation system, Bluetooth, and a DVD entertainment system.

The Nissan Altima received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year, including a restyled front end, new wheel designs, and new interior options. The Altima is available with a choice of a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6 in the coupe. All versions get the CVT automatic as standard, although the 2.5 coupe can actually be had with a 6-speed manual in some markets. All GCC-spec Altima models come with a beige interior, in cloth or optional leather, but red upholstery is optionally available for the coupe. The entertainment system has been upgraded with a optional new Bose premium stereo with nine speakers, optional 4.3-inch colour display, USB port with iPod connectivity, Bluetooth hands-free Phone System, MP3/WMA CD playback, and rear monitor. Also offered is an optional hard-drive navigation system with 6.5-inch VGA colour display, 9.3GB Music Box for music storage and playback, Bluetooth Streaming Audio, DVD player and an RCA input for auxiliary audio/video connectivity. The 2.5 models gets 16-inch alloy wheels, Bose stereo, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, manually-adjusted seatsfog lamps, rear camera and cloth upholstery with options such as sunroof and spoiler. And the 3.5 gets 17-inch alloys, power driver's seat, spoiler and optional leather. All Altima models now come with stability control, front and side airbags, and ABS, with options such as side-curtain airbags and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Octavia is based on the Volkswagen Golf platform, and has received a facelift for 2009. The range of engines and options has seemingly been paired down for the GCC, considering its low sales volumes. The base engine on offer is the outdated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed auto, while a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder with a 7-speed automanual was offered in some GCC countries. By late 2010, only the base engine and a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder were offered. The Octavia is one of the more unique cars in its segment, with the look of a proper sedan, but with a lift-up rear hatch for loading luggage. It was initially available in most markets here in basic Classic and upmarket Ambiente trims. The Classic version offers steel wheels with hubcaps, manually operated rear windows, halogen headlights and black rubbing strips. Later, most local markets got only Ambiente, Ambiente Plus, Elegance and sporty RS trims. Available features, depending on trim, include power windows with anti-pinch feature, height adjustable steering wheel dual-tone fabric seats, remote central locking, dual-zone climate control a/c, cruise control, a multi-function display, a CD/MP3 stereo with AUX input, electric mirrors with integrated turn signals, Xenon headlights with washer system, 17-inch alloy wheels and colour-coded exterior trim. The RS gets the VW GTI engine, Bluetooth, 18-inch wheels, parking sensors, sunroof, rear spoiler and directional Xenon headlights. Among the available safety features are stability control, ABS, dual front and side airbags and optional rear park sensors.

The 3 is a fairly roomy and affordable compact car, with the sportiest handling and the poorest engine in this class of cars. The Mazda 3, or Mazda3 as company likes to call it, is available as a four-door sedan in this region, while a five-door has been released from 2006 onwards, all with only the base engine available. The 3 has an interesting rounded shape that hides the height which is necessary for a roomier cabin. The Mazda 3 features a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with five trim levels, of which only the base version has a standard manual gearbox, with the rest having a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Available features, depending on trim level, includes leather, sunroof, and a premium sound system with a CD changer. As with the engine choices, safety options are limited in the Middle East too. Available airbags only include a standard driver side and an optional passenger-side bag. And ABS brakes are standard only on the higher models. Available on all but the base model are power windows, mirrors, central locking and keyless entry. A sporty appearance kit is optional.

The 206 is  Peugeot's most popular model, originally available with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. The 206 has technically been replaced by the 207, but the 206 continues to be in production due to its popularity. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, with derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet and a fast RC hatchback joining and leaving the line-up. Now available only in 5-door hatchback trim built in Slovakia and in new 4-door sedan trim built in Iran, it acts as a cheaper alternative to the 207. There are only two petrol engines offered since late 2007. The 206 can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic with tiptronic shifting. By mid-2010, only 1.6-litre sedan models remained on sale. All models come with at least front power windows, a cloth interior and other basics as standard. Add-ons such as sunroof, CD player, a single airbag and alloy wheels come in the higher models. Optional comprehensive safety equipment include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, along with dual front airbags.

The Changan Eado is a compact sedan from China. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Eado include power windows, central locking, remote control on key, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 4 speakers, leather steering wheel with audio controls, USB+AUX ports, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and hologen headlamps. Safety features includes front dual airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist.

The Lexus IS is all-new for 2007 in the Middle East, although other markets have been getting 2.5-litre and 3.5-litre versions since 2006. The local market only gets a 3.0-litre V6 engine. The IS 300 offers the most sporting ride of the Lexus range, going head-to-head directly with the Germans in the enthusiast market. The rear-wheel drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof; ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include dual front airbags, knee airbags, side-impact airbags, curtain airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, and electronic brake-force distribution.

The Haval H9 is the Chinese brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed ZF automatic transmission. Standard features on the H9 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop button, xenon headlamps, front and rear fog lamps, leather seats, infotainment system with touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, radio, AUX-in, USB, CD player and GPS. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The Liana is pitched into the ultra-competitive compact segment. It was introduced as a 2002 model, and mildly facelifted for 2005. The only model offered here is the 1.6-litre four-cylinder version with either a manual or an automatic. It can be fully equipped with air-conditioning, ABS brakes, dual airbags, CD stereo, full electrics, keyless entry and an engine immobiliser. The interior has undergone a respectable makeover, with a new quality look, new materials and better bolstered front seats. Front seat occupants will enjoy the airy cabin. The seats are supportive and well contoured, and even rear passengers are not lacking for headroom or legroom. The high seating position contributes to good visibility. The luggae trunk is not particularly roomy, but split-fold rear seats allow more load space. There are faux aluminium and chrome highlights all over, while optional accesories include a rear spoiler and alloy wheels. The Liana used to come in sedan and hatchback body styles in other markets, but in its final years, only the sedan survived in most markets. European and American markets get larger engine choices.

The Audi A4 received a recent facelift which gave it a corporate nosejob, among other things. Available as a sedan and a convertible in this region. The wagon is not offered here, for obvious reasons. Engines for the sedan include a 2.0-litre normally-aspirated four and a 2.0-litre turbocharged four, along with a 1.8-litre turbocharged model cropping up at random dealerships. The sedan can also be ordered in hot S4 and hotter RS4 form from a few dealerships, which adds a V8 engine and sporting suspension, among other goodies. The cabriolet can be had in this region with a 3.2-litre V6 as well as the 2.0-litre turbo four. There is a choice of a six-speed manual for all engines, though they are not officially offered. Standard on the front-wheel-drive models is the Multitronic CVT automatic, a transmission system which does not use gears. The all-wheel-drive models get a traditional automatic only. Changes over the previous model include new dynamic suspension, a new braking system with larger discs and automatic brake disc wiping for better performance in wet weather, advanced front lighting with available pivoting front lights, advanced rollover and better on-road stability. Features include aluminium or wood trim, six-CD changer, auto door locking, a bunch of airbags, a tyre pressure monitoring system and an optional S-Line body kit. The S4 or even the 3.2-litre sedan are normally not offered at most dealers, though you could probably get one if you pay them enough.

The Toyota RAV4 got a complete redesign for 2013, with a new styling language, a new drivetrain, and new features. The existing platform has been updated with new suspension tuning, while the standard engine now is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability, although Saudi Arabia also gets a 6-speed manual base model. There is also a choice of front-wheel-drive with limited-slip diff or all-wheel-drive with 50:50 lock mode. New items in this 5-seater crossover include a lift-up tailgate with the spare wheel now stored under the boot floor. In the UAE, there was a reshuffle of trims for 2014 along with a price drop, with the 2WD available in EX grade, while the AWD is sold in EXR, GXR and VXR grades. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, fold-flat split rear seating and more. The base model gets cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic keyless entry and 17-inch alloy wheels. Additional available features, depending on trim level, include smart keyless entry and start, LED running lamps, auto-dimming mirror, roof rails, cargo net, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, cruise control and dual-zone auto a/c. Only the top 4x4 model gets touchscreen navigation, DVD player, rear camera, power driver's seat, sunroof, leather upholstery and 18-inch alloy wheels. All RAV4 models get two front airbags as well as ABS with EBD. Only the top 4WD model gets additional side and curtain airbags. The top two 4WD trims get stability control, brake assist, downhill assist, and hill-start assist.

Porsche is offering a "new" Cayman model from 2009, and while the facelift is barely noticeable, the real changes are under the bonnet. Still available in base and S versions, both models feature more horsepower, new gearbox choices and modern multimedia options. A lightweight Cayman R model debuted in early 2011 with slightly more power. The base Cayman now has a 2.9-litre flat-6, while the Cayman S and Cayman R have a 3.4-litre flat-6 with direct fuel injection technology. A Cayman S Black Edition model also gets the R engine. While a 6-speed manual is standard on all, the optional new 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK) dual-clutch automanual gearbox is also available, which actually improves acceleration and fuel economy. The Cayman is priced at a premium over the Boxster, for what amounts to a slight bump in power and a fixed top. Cosmetic changes from 2009 include new headlights and tail lamps, larger front intakes with integrated running lights, and an altered lower rear-end with twin diffusers. Both models can be fitted with a never-ending list of optional features, which can drive up the total price by 30% or more. While the basic models are very bare on features, the car can be optionally outfitted with a hardtop, various types of expensive cloth or leather sports seats, different 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheel designs, a new Porsche Communication Management System (PCM) with a touchscreen, Bluetooth, TV tuner, DVD changer, metallic paint, stickers, wind deflector, roll bars, headlamp cleaners, Xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, and a cabin that can be trimmed with carbon-fibre, aluminium, alcantara or wood.

The Bentley Continental GT received a facelift for the 2016 model. There are two 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 models in the lineup with different power ratings, and a W12 6.0-litre which got a power upgrade. It now comes with an 8-speed automatic transmission which gives better fuel economy numbers and ever so slight increase in acceleration figures. The Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental coupe is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GT Speed coupe, with the same W12 engine adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling.

The 2-door Cerato Koup comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 4-speed automatic. In 2011, it got a 6-speed automatic. The interior feature in the Cerato that Kia is proud of seems to be a new "super vision" LCD cluster with reddish lighting with warning-message and trip-computer functionality. at the bottom of the cluster. Also available is a basic four-speaker audio system, with the option of six-speaker system that adds tweeters, plus a choice of three radio/CD players and the option of MP3 and iPod connectivity. Standard are power windows, electric mirrors, 15-inch wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery and central locking. Other available features in higher models include 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, some chrome exterior trim, "super vision" gauge cluster, fog lamps, sunroof, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, aluminium pedals and automatic headlights. Safety is being downplayed again, as the basic Cerato comes with a single driver's airbag. The higher model gets ABS, active headrests and rear disc brakes instead of drums. Side-curtain airbags and stability control, though not initially available, became standard on the top-spec model later.

A new generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class debuted as a 2015 model. It is 95 mm longer with 80 mm extra wheelbase, 40 mm wider and up to 100 kg lighter than the model it replaces.There are three variants on offer which is the C 180 which gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor, the C 200 and the C 250, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. More variants are expected to join later. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's performance sedan offering. Only sold in some GCC countries, Opel Insignia OPC gets a turbocharged 2.8-litre V6 with all-wheel drive. Features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, heated leather seats with memory, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, daytime running lights, fog lamps, 20-inch wheels with xenon headlights and LED daytime running lamps. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, lane-departure warning, ESP and ABS.

An all-new model of the Audi A6 came out in 2019. In 2020, more engine options became available. The A6 lineup includes a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, and a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine. Both engines are mild hybrid systems, connected to small batteries to aid performance. A 7-speed dual-clutch transmission sends power to the wheels for all the models.  Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A6 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Audi A6 got a facelift for the 2015 model year. Three engine variants are offered in the UAE - 1.8-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and 3.0-litre supercharged V6. The S6 model has a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine.The 1.8 TFSI and 2.0 TFSI comes in front-wheel drive, while the rest enjoy all-wheel drive systems. All the models get a 7-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well as 18-inch, 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. It gets the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive. In 2015, it received minor facial changes and tweeks have been done to the suspension to improve handling, as well as comfort. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Structural stiffness, suspension and aerodynamics had all been upgraded for 2011. The shocks were upgraded again for 2012. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Prices had gone up by 20% compared to the pre-facelift version, but then came down again for 2012, even while is was upgraded. A 'VVIP' edition debuted in 2011 that costs twice as much while offering a customisable leather interior and gold-plated exterior trimmings. A Black edition debuted in 2012 that added some red cabin trim and Recaro seats.

The Audi RS 5 is being sold, but mostly only on special order. An all-new model came out in 2018. In 2020 it got a facelift and some upgraded tech inside. It gets a twin turbocharged 2.9-litre V6 engine with a 8-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5.

Ferrari has broken tradition and made their first ever four-wheel-drive, the FF, short for Ferrari Four. It replaced the stunning 612 Scaglietti. A love-hate design, the FF gets a roaring 6.3-litre V12 engine which revs all the way up to 8000 rpm. That power is controlled using the dual-clutch F1 gearbox. Along with the plush leather interior, a 6.5-inch display with touch screen control, a Bluetooth connection with Audio Streaming, navigation, voice command function, two USB connections, and a display with alphanumeric keypad for phone dialling. Also, for the first time something more than golf clubs can actually fit in the boot of a Ferrari, with the rear seats of the FF able to fold down to expand the luggage space. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car such as the engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions.

Tougher than most compact 4WDs, the Jeep Cherokee, also known as the Liberty in some markets, seats five people and can carry their gear too. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it is just about adequate for the streets. Early models got a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, while post-facelift models got the automatic or a 6-speed manual. Fold the rear seats and it can move two people and some serious cargo. Turn off the pavement, and it can negotiate most trails with confidence. All-new for 2002, the Cherokee was extensively updated for 2005. From 2006, all models come with Jeep's Electronic Stability Program, ABS brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, and all-speed traction control. Standard on all models is Command-Trac, a conventional part-time four-wheel-drive system with a two-speed transfer case. Full-time Selec-Trac is optional, and retains a low range for serious off-roading. Standard features also include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, six-speaker AM/FM/CD stereo, grey fender flares, 16-inch steel wheels and traction control. Options include leather, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, fog lamps, body-colour fender flares, roof rails, functional rock rails and more.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. While shorter than the outgoing model by 10mm, the new Swift boasts a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a new 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. There is also a turbocharged 1.0-litre 3-cylinder motor offered elsewhere, which may make a debut in the GCC later on. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. Features include 4 or 6 speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, automatic a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel with audio controls, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD.

The Alto is a tiny hatchback originally conceived as a "kei" car for the Japanese market, meaning it had to be restricted to this tiny size to qualify for tax breaks in Japan. Built in India since 2004, for foreign markets it is powered by a tiny 1.1-litre engine driving the front wheels through a five-speed manual or a three-speed automatic. The suspension is made up of MacPherson struts and coil springs at the front and Suzuki's isolated trailing link and coil spring system at the rear.Very popular in India, it offers low fuel consumption, low maintenance costs and even safety features such as dual airbags, side impact beams and even seat belts. It offers enough seating for four people as well as their wallets in the rear luggage compartment. Available features, standard or optional, include front power windows, cloth upholstery, power steering, central locking, CD player and steel wheels with plastic hubcaps. Parking one of these things is easy in tight city streets, but it could run out of breath on the highway fast lane. The new version of the Alto was launched during the summer of 2009, and is being sold in the GCC as the Celerio alongside this old Alto.

In 2021, a new generation of the Porsche 911 Targa was revealed. The 2+2 seater coupe gets an updated exterior design, along with updates to the engine. The 911 Carrera and Carrera S is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 8-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The Targa 4 and 4S are all-wheel drive. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lamborghini to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. The upgraded LP640 model with a larger 6.5-litre V12,  with a unique body kit and more power, is the only version on sale now. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops.

The latest Astra is a competitive five-door hatchback from General Motors' German division, with a decent-sized wheelbase that aims for comfort and space. The Astra received an unnoticeable facelift for 2007 that now adds a chrome crossbar on the radiator grille, and black roof trim strips and bumper guards. It comes with a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine for the Middle East market, mated specifically to a four-speed automatic transmission driving the  front wheels. Features include power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, 60/40 split-folding rear seat back, keyless entry, power steering, CD stereo, trip computer and alloy wheels. The Astra comes with a standard tyre repair kit instead of a spare tyre to improve luggage volume, which expands when the rear seat backs are folded down. Safety features include front airbags, front-side airbags, ABS brakes with emergency brake assist, and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK back in 2016. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. In 2020 it got a slight facelift and a better infotainment system. Under the hood, the GLC200 and GLC 300 get a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with two different tunes, both available only in four-wheel drive (4Matic). Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. In 2020, the engine became a mild hybrid, due to the addition of a small battery to aid performance and fuel economy. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class came out in 2019, along with a new AMG model. Gone is the CLS 63 AMG, now replaced by the Mercedes-AMG CLS 53.  The exterior and interior have been completely changed to incorporate their new design language, first seen on the Mercedes-Benz A-Class. New engines now power the CLS-Class with the 3.0-litre turbo inline-6 engine coupled with an electric motor installed in the CLS-53 AMG. Power is delivered by a 9-speed automatic transmission and is available only in all-wheel-drive. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights, air suspension and a widescreen cockpit consisting of two 12.3-inch displays on the dashboard. Other AMG features include diamond pattern radiator grille, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a flat-bottomed sports steering wheel. Safety standards are high, which include front, side curtain and knee airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, brake assist, front collision alert, auto-braking and ABS.

The Lotus Evora is the British manufacturer's first offering of combining superb race track handling with everyday practicality. In 2017, it got power upgrades and a slight facelift. There were two models to choose from, the Evora 400 and Evora Sport 410.The Evora comes with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine. Both model engines are mated to either a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual transmission. The mid-engined Evora has a 2+2 configuration, although the back seats can be used for storage purposes than anything else. Standard options include central door locking, flat bottomed magnesium steering wheel trimmed in leather, leather gear knob, leather handbrake sleeve, bespoke aluminium illuminated control knobs and switches, power windows, remote release glove box, door storage bins and integrated cup holders, Alpine CD/MP3/WMA receiver, and Lotus command centre with auxiliary trip computer and vehicle monitoring displays. It comes with standard 18-inch alloy wheels and optional 19-inch/20-inch alloys with wider tyres. Additional packages can be added. The Tech Pack offers Alpine multi-media in car entertainment system with 7" WVGA touch screen, bluetooth connectivity, satellite navigation, tyre pressure monitoring, cruise control, rear parking sensors. The Sport Pack offers switchable sports mode with sharper throttle response, increased rpm limit and sports traction control setting, sports diffuser, titanium sports exhaust tailpipe, cross drilled brake discs, engine oil cooler and black painted brake callipers. The Premium Pack offers accent lighting, upgraded interior trim, centre arm-rest and further extensive use of premium grade leathers. Further options include electric power-fold door mirrors, xenon headlights, Alpine Imprint dynamic audio EQ system , reversing camera and body colour door handles.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. Changes to 2015 Vito included standard Attention Assist and Crosswind Assist, optional Intelligent Light System which included LED indicators, LED daytime running lamps, LED low-beam headlamps, and main beam with cornering light function. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The SL has undergone a major redesign for 2009. Models now include a new 3.0-litre SL 280 base model, the continuing 3.5-litre SL 350, the carryover 5.5-litre SL 500 and the existingtwin-turbo 5.5-litre SL 600 rocketship. Upping the ante are two sport-tuned models, namely the new 6.3-litre SL 63 AMG and the twin-turbo 6.0-litre SL 65 AMG. Interesting features include optional Active Body Control suspension and optional neck-ventilation fan thingies. The redesigned front end sports different headlights and bumper, while the rear is mildly updated by new tail-lights and bumper spoilers. Along with new wheels on the outside, new interior appointments include new materials and colour schemes. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Toyota Rush is an all-new model for the 2018 model year. It is based on the rear-wheel drive Avanza micro-van. Only the 1.5-litre engine will be offered in this region. It comes with a 4-speed automatic transmission. Sized larger than its direct rivals, it offers 3-row seating. In the UAE, only one loaded version is offered, with features such as power steering, power windows and mirrors, central locking, smart keyless entry and start, auto a/c, fabric seats, audio entertainment system with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support, audio controls on steering wheel, 6 speakers, LED headlights, front and rear fog lamps, rear spoiler and 17-inch alloy wheels. On the safety side it gets standard dual airbags and side/curtain airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD), rear parking sensors, ESP, hill-start assist and tyre-pressure monitor.

The C-Class range was all-new for the 2008 model year, and updated with a minor facelift and new engines for 2012. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. Starting off the new line-up are three new turbocharged 1.8-litre "BlueEfficiency" engines in the C 180, the C 200 and the C 250, at different states of tune. The 3.0-litre V6-powered C 300 and the 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standardrange. All models come with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many premium features, such as 16-inch to 18-inch wheels, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. The optional AMG sports package offers stiffer suspension, 18-inch light-alloy wheels and cosmetic add-ons to most non-AMG models. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

The Espace is famous for being the first minivan to grace European roads back in the 1980s. Packed with abundant space and numerous safety features, it has the maximum rating in crash tests conducted by European governmental agencies. It comes in short-wheelbase and long-wheelbase body styles, all seating as many as seven passengers, with luggage space to spare. With the new slide and lock seating system, the latest Espace can offer even greater versatility. At the rear, passengers can adjust the position of their seat for better legroom. Whether the cargo is a large number of passengers or a large load, switching between 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 or even 2 seat configurations is a simple affair. Standard features include a stereo, power windows and more. It is equipped with ABS brakes and Emergency Brake Assist, plus an Electronic Stability Programme with understeer control, as well as ASR traction control. Passive safety features eight airbags, including thorax airbags in the second row of seats.

The B-Series is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines include a 2.2-litre and a 2.6-litre petrol engines, while the diesel offering is a 2.9-litre unit, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual, or even an automatic in some markets. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include overfender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

The Luxgen7 MPV is a 7-passenger minivan equipped with surprisingly upscale technologies, and the company intends to compete on an entry-level luxury footing with pricing to match regular non-luxury brands. It is currently only sold in UAE, Saudi Arabia and Oman. The top feature is the Luxgen Think+ system, co-developed with smartphone makers HTC, that comes with built-in HSPDA 3.5G communications, GPS Navigation and a 10.2-inch LCD display screen for a comprehensive tech package. The system also includes the "Eagle View+" 360-degree parking assist which utilises four cameras to provide a real-time visual display of the surrounding environment. The "Side View+" feature automatically displays live video images of the vehicle's rear blind spot to reduce the chance of an accident during lane changes. The "Night Vision+" high-sensitivity night vision camera system helps illuminate the road and traffic conditions at night beyond the range of the headlamps. "LDWS+" constantly reads the road surface for lane markers and dividers and gives audible and visual warnings when the vehicle veers too close to the lane markings. Overall, the MPV is equipped with 23 advanced ECUs and 8 video cameras to provide these features. Also available are power-opening doors, leather upholstery, rear DVD screen, Bluetooth and more. The Luxgen7 MPV is powered by a turbocharged-and-intercooled 2.2-litre DOHC 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. To improve driving feel, the steering system was tuned by Delphi, noise suppression engineering was handled by LMS, the suspension system was developed by Magna, and the overall chassis tuning was done by both Magna and Prodrive.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The second-generation Clio hatchback was launched as a 1999 model, and was heavily facelifted for 2002, coinciding with the release of the Turkish-built sedan version. The all-new Mark-3 Clio was already out in European markets by 2006, but the Middle East soldiered with the older Mark-2 model. Therefore in 2006, the model received a second unnoticeable facelift, and the hatchback was renamed the Clio Campus, while the sedan became the Clio Classic. The Clio is the smallest car in Renault's range, and offers buyers a number of trim options and petrol engines, in either hatchback or sedan form. The basic 1.4-litre engine powers the standard five-door hatchback and four-door sedan, with a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. The hot 2.0-litre engine powers the rare three-door Clio 182 model, with a stock manual transmission. The unique combination of sizeable engines, unique styling, competitive pricing, safety features and equipment levels make other cars in this category look bad. The Clio is available with a host of trim levels, with names like Authentique, Expression, Privilege, Initiale, Dynamique and, for the hot 182 model, Renaultsport. Standard features include electric power steering, some sort of stereo, available power features and more. Class-leading levels of equipment include ABS with brake assist, dual front airbags, remote control central locking, power windows.

The Tiguan is VW's new "crossover" 4WD model. Small in size and conservative in design, the Tiguan is being embarrassingly marketed as the "GTI of SUVs" in some places. Three different trim levels include the Trend&Fun, the Sport&Style and the Track&Field, the latter of which is supposedly tuned for offroading, given its underbody plates and higher front bumper, though there is no low-range gearing for the 4Motion all-wheel-drive vehicle. There are two turbocharged engines, both 2.0-litre and in different states of tune. The engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic that can hold gears in offroad conditions, later replaced by a 7-speed DSG automanual in 2011. The Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. For additional cargo area, there is also an optional double-floor trunk-floor setup, including a cargo management system. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parellel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera.

The second-generation SLK, a hard-top convertible, boasts a better-looking design than its limited competition from Germany. Several details take their cue from Formula 1, like its arrow-shaped nose. The range starts with the 1.8-litre supercharged SLK 200 Kompressor, and goes up to V6 models such as the 3.0-litre SLK 280 and the new 3.5-litre SLK 350, while Mercedes-AMG builds the top 5.4-litre SLK 55 AMG. Standard equipment includes light-alloy wheels of various sizes, projection-beam headlamps, LED tail-lights, manual six-speed transmission on non-AMG models, stability control, remote control locking system and cruise control. Options, standard on high-spec models, include 18-inch alloy wheels, AMG bodystyling, Designo upholstery, sports suspension, speed-sensitive power steering, steering wheel gearshift buttons for the optional automatic transmission, bi-xenon headlamps with cornering light, parking sensors, electric seats with memory function, infrared remote control for the vario-roof, COMAND navigation system with DVD player, and a Harman/Kardon LOGIC7 surround-sound system with 11 speakers.

The long-running Nativa has been replaced with a new model for 2009, but Mitsubishi has chosen to rename it the Pajero Sport. Based on the latest L200 pickup-truck platform, the Pajero Sport also shares its entire front end with the L200, although the rest of the wagon body is completely new. Under the bonnet beats an easy-going 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic mode, and a four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The base model comes with side steps, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, multi-mode dash display, CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers, manual a/c with rear vents, dual airbags, power windows, keyless entry, chrome-plated power mirrors, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, immobilizer, under-engine cover, front skid plate, and three rows of cloth-upholstered seating. The mid-range model gets cruise control, fog lamps, upgraded stereo with 8 speakers, automatic a/c, parking sensors and roof rails. The top model gets faux leather upholstery, sunroof, chrome interior bits and a rear differential lock.

The Mercedes-Benz V-Class replaces the Viano and Vito in the lineup. In  2017, the V-Class was released in the GCC with a petrol engine. No changes were made in 2018. Under the hood, it gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, cruise control, leather seats, Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get added options such as 17-inch alloy wheels, their AGILITY CONTROL suspension with selective damping system and more premium Lugano leather trim on the seats. The Exclusive edition gets interior trim in brushed aluminium look, air vents in silver chrome, a roof liner in DINAMICA, panoramic sliding sunroof, the new large centre console with integral refrigerated compartment and thermo-cupholders, climatised single seats in nappa leather for the driver, front and rear passengers, 19-inch light-alloy wheels and Burmester surround sound system. There is also a sports package and AMG package. Safety standards are high with optional systems such as Collision Prevention Assist and Distronic Plus, along with multiple airbags for driver and passengers. It also gets traction control, stability control, blind spot assist and lane-tracking system.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's arsenal. Competing in a peculiar segment defined by expensive small cars, the 1-Series is the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive. First offered in mid-2004 as a 5-door hatchback using its own platform, it replaced the slow-selling 3-Series Compact. Facelifted for 2008, the five-door hatchback was joined by a three-door hatchback. The range was soon expanded to include a two-door coupe and a two-door convertible. Petrol versions now include the 2.0-litre 118i, the 2.0-litre 120i, the 3.0-litre 125i and the 3.0-litre turbocharged 135i, although the higher engines are reserved for the two-door models. In 2009, a basic 120i convertible debuted. All models come with a choice of 6-speed transmissions, both manual or automatic. In late 2011, a limited-edition 1M Coupe was offered with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder and manual only. While the hatchback was completely redesigned for 2012, the coupe and convertible continued unchanged for one more year. All non-M trims come standard with common power accesories, cloth or leather upholstery, front and side airbags, stability control and ABS, alongside various optional features such as HID headlights, "active" steering, stereo choices and various wheel sizes. Considering the price, the way it looks, and the number of these seen on the streets, BMW is having trouble moving these off the showroom floor in this region.

The X-Trail is Nissan's entry for the small road-going 4WD market, though for a long time we thought it was really a midsize comparable to the old Pathfinder in size. Developed to attract young adventurous buyers, we find the X-Trail particularly unattractive, but it has proved to be a runaway success with older people just looking for a conservative vehicle that looks like a 4WD. The X-Trail has undergone only slight exterior redesigns and interior upgrades ever since it was launched years ago and is beginning to look dated. Powered by a 2.5-litre four-cylinder engine coupled with a 4-speed automatic or a 5-speed manual transmission, it isn't particularly fast, but a reasonable long-distance cruiser. Full-time four-wheel drive is available when the computer system senses the need for all wheels to be driven to suit demand, but it will get stuck if you take it beyond the beach. The interior is full of storage spaces, including cup-holders, centre console box and other nooks and crannies. ABS brakes and 2 airbags are standard.

The Mondeo is a midsize front-wheel-drive built in Europe that is based on a Mazda platform. It loses out to the Japanese with a combination of engines that lag behind in power, its smaller size and its expensive dealer maintenance charges. The Mondeo actually a good family sedan, but its image is also diluted due to fleet sales as taxis. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for a very affordable price. The interior is fairly attractive and put together well. The Mondeo does have a sizeable interior for its size. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, available with either a manual or an automatic transmission. A 2.5-litre V6 engine is coupled with a five-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. The sporty Mondeo ST220, a great car, is powered by a 3.0-litre V6 engine and a six-speed manual transmission. The Mondeo can also be had as a wagon.

The Lexus GS is a showcase of the Japanese company's advanced technology. It was released in 2006, it's not only loaded with more gadgetry than ever, but offers a degree of luxury that matches the best from Germany. Lexus openly admits that the BMW 5-Series was their benchmark for the new rear-wheel-drive GS. The appeal of the GS line-up lies with a fully-equipped base model. The GS 300 has most of the available features from the GS 430, except of course for the larger engine. The GS 300 gets a 3.0-litre V6 while the GS 430 gets a 4.3-litre V8, both paired with six-speed automatic with a sequential manual shift mode. Both engines lack the direct injection feature of American-spec versions apparently due to damaging high-sulphur petrol in some GCC countries, so power ratings are lower. The list of standard equipment includes leather-trimmed seats with front power adjustment, keyless entry, pushbutton starter, a premium sound system with both CD and DVD capability, Bluetooth wireless telephone technology, multiple airbags, various stability systems and a 7-inch multi-information touch screen. Options include DVD navigation, rear backup camera, moonroof, power rear sunshade, Mark Levinson audio system and adaptive front lighting.

The McLaren 570S gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S, but has 30% new components. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570S weighs just 1,313 kg and is longer than the 650S. It benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a new TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Hyundai Elantra Coupe was launched by the end of 2012 in some GCC markets. It comes with two 4-cylinder engine choices, either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Audi A4 received its first major redesign for its second generation. Available as a sedan from 2001 and as a convertible from 2003, the wagon is not offered here, for obvious reasons. Engines for the sedan include a 2.0-litre normally-aspirated four and a 1.8-litre turbocharged four, along with a 3.0-litre V6. The sedan could also be ordered in hot S4 form from a few dealerships, which adds a V8 engine and sporting suspension, among other goodies. The cabriolet can be had in this region with a 3.0-litre V6 as well as the 1.8-litre turbo four. There is a choice of a manual for all engines, though not officially offered on most models. Standard on the front-wheel-drive models is the Multitronic CVT automatic. The all-wheel-drive models get a traditional automatic. Changes over the previous first-gen model include a new look, better suspension, upgraded engines and brighter front lighting. Features include aluminium or wood trim, six-CD changer, auto door locking, a bunch of airbags, a tyre pressure monitoring system and an optional S-Line body kit. The S4 or even the 3.0-litre sedan are rare models.

The 2-door Cerato Koup comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 4-speed automatic. In 2011, it got a 6-speed automatic. The interior feature in the Cerato that Kia is proud of seems to be a new "super vision" LCD cluster with reddish lighting with warning-message and trip-computer functionality. at the bottom of the cluster. Also available is a basic four-speaker audio system, with the option of six-speaker system that adds tweeters, plus a choice of three radio/CD players and the option of MP3 and iPod connectivity. Standard are power windows, electric mirrors, 15-inch wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery and central locking. Other available features in higher models include 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, some chrome exterior trim, "super vision" gauge cluster, fog lamps, sunroof, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, aluminium pedals and automatic headlights. Safety is being downplayed again, as the basic Cerato comes with a single driver's airbag. The higher model gets ABS, active headrests and rear disc brakes instead of drums. Side-curtain airbags and stability control, though not initially available, became standard on the top-spec model later.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Facelifted inside and out for 2008, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight, even with the power upgrade for 2008. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Mildly facelifted for 2009, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. Versions for the latest incarnation include the upgraded 5.5-litre G 500 and the 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Standard specification includes permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Lamborghini HuracÃ¡n, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the HuracÃ¡n LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Jaguar F-Type is a two-seater convertible based on a shortened XK platform. From 2018, it came with one 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, two supercharged engine choices - a 3.0-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8. The V6 has two variants with the higher model, known as the S, getting more power. The V8 only comes in R form. The F-Type comes standard in rear-wheel drive from, but from 2016, the R versions were available in optional all-wheel-drive. It gets adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The roof is said to close or open in 12 seconds. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more.

The new L200 offers versatility combined with a tough new look that makes it seem more like a lifestyle vehicle than a commercial pickup. It obviously is tough enough to be a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The spacious interior places the L200 firmly in the midsize class, unlike the previous compact model. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's new L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. The brakes, the rear axle, the steering gear and the chassis have all been substantially beefed up for the new L200, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Volvo XC70 got minor exterior and interior upgrades, as well as new added safety features in 2014. Although it is still not really that good off-road as we know it, the XC70 gets by on gravel and flat sand, given its fairly impressive ground clearance. Available only in T6 trim now, it is powered by a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine, with an automatic offering tiptronic manual shifting. The second-row has a three-section bench seat with removable centre position for various setups. Standard features include keyless entry, CD player, trip computer, air-conditioning, xenon headlights, power windows, doors, locks, sunroof and mirrors. Available features also include leather or vinyl seats, ventilated front seats with perforated leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, an in-dash computer system with USB and Bluetooth support, and an optional rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, collision Warning with brake support and emergency brake lamps, adaptive cruise control helps keeping a safe distance to vehicles ahead, hydraulic brake assist, optimised hydraulic brakes and fading brake support. An optional Polestar ECU upgrade is available to bump up the power by 25 hp.

An all-new generation Volvo XC90 came out in the middle of 2015. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder 2.0-litre engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Available features, depending on trim, include integrated rear-door sunshades, illuminated front and rear treadplates, Bowers & Wilkins Premium 19-speaker audio system with USB/AUX inputs and CD player, Bluetooth, heads-up display, navigation, in-car wifi, 4-zone auto a/c with numerous rear vents, power-adjustable front seats, panoramic glass roof, power tailgate with foot-waving opening operation, front and rear parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, turning LED headlights and foglights, and auto-dimming mirrors. Safety features include City Safety which brakes automatically if a pedestrian runs across the road, driver-alertness detection, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, land-departure warning, road-sign detection that displays speed limits on the graphical LCD gauge cluster, whiplash protection, front and side/curtain airbags, and adaptive cruise control that can come to a complete stop and crawl in traffic automatically. Further safety features include a run-off road protection package, which detects what is happening and the front safety belts are tightened to keep the occupants in position, and auto brake at intersection capability.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016. It is available with "SkyActiv" engines, a 2.0-litre and a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, both direct-injection with high compression ratios. There are two body styles, namely a sedan and a station-wagon. The sedan is available with both engine options, while the wagon only comes with the smaller motor. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. The top model includes 19-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera, bi-xenon headlights, daytime running lights, 11-speaker Bose sound system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents and a sunroof. Navigation and adaptive cruise control can be further added to the top-spec version, but they're not offered in all GCC markets. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

The Toyota Land Cruiser got a makeover for its 2016 model year. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. Engine choices include a 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with an 8-speed automatic. In 2017, Saudi Arabia started offering a 4.5-litre V8 turbo-diesel model as well. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. In the UAE, there are three trim levels, namely EXR, GXR and VXR. The KSA market has GX, GXR and VXR trims, with further variants within them. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 18-inch alloys on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional dealer-installed rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional dealer-installed leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items. Further available features include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, a front chin spoiler and extra chrome trim on some GXR and all VXR models, with 20-inch wheels and more on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, factory leather, adaptive cruise, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system.  In some GCC countries a special edition VXS model was available in 2017, which had a JBL audio system, wireless charging, rear entertainment system with wireless headphones, and diamond stitched leather seats. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on V8 models only.

After more than a decade with minimal changes, the Nissan Patrol has been redesigned from the ground up, aiming to regain some of the market-share lost to its rivals. The all-new Patrol can be optioned up with enough features to classify it as a full-fledged luxury vehicle, with some class-leading features and new technology. Engine options include a base 5.6-litre V8 with a 5-speed automatic and later with a base 6-speed manual, known as the Patrol SE; as well as a brand-new 5.6-litre V8 with more power, direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top trims get a slightly-lower 'city' bumper. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems. The previous version of the Patrol continued to be on sale alongside this new model during 2010, as a basic offroader. However, the new model is so popular that buyers put down hefty deposits before performance specs were even released.

This is the second generation of Toyota RAV-4. Often credited with creating the soft-roader genre, th e RAV-4 is one of the most fuel-efficient crossover SUVs on the market. It has to be, given that it is powered by a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, it comes standard with all-wheel drive for the GCC. The RAV-4 has a unibody construction with all-wheel independent suspension, making it more of a car than any sort of offroader.
