An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 cabriolet is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The 2018 Ford Transit Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying cargo. It can seat up to 3 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2018 Ford Transit Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine, available in two different tunes. All models get the 6-speed manual transmission. The van has a payload capacity up to 1,024 kg, a maximum cargo volume of 8.3 cubic metre square and a wide space between the wheel arches allowing for the storage of 1.2-m x 2.4-m boards vertically or horizontally. The load-through bulkhead lets you carry up to 3-meter-long cargo, such as pipes, ladders or carpet rolls. Fixing points and 8 tie-down loops are positioned on the bodysides, leaving the floor clear for easier loading, unloading and cleaning. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2018 Ford Transit Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The eight-generation Hilux made its debut in the GCC as a 2016 model year. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Mechanically, the 2016 Hilux will offer a new 6-speed automatic transmission, which gives a 15-percent better fuel economy rating than the previous generation model. Engine choices include the 2.0-litre and 2.7-litre petrol engines, and a new more powerful 2.4-litre diesel engine. While the 2.0-litre is available only in rear-wheel-drive, the other two engines can be had in either four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive. Safety features for it includes front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbag for the driver, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) seat-belt equipped on all seats except the centre seat.

The Volvo XC40 debuted as a new subcompact crossover model for 2018, slotting in under the XC60. Initially, the only version on offer is the XC40 T5 with a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. The two trim levels at launch are R-Design and Momentum. The interior features Volvo's latest design ideas such as the vertical a/c vents, aside from the portrait-mode touchscreen. The mid-range Momentum model is generously equipped with a 12.3-inch digital instrument display, a 9-inch touchscreen infotainment system, dual-zone climate control, rear parking assist, and leather seats as standard. Stepping up to the R-Design trim will add leather and aluminum trim, twin exhaust tips, and sport suspension. Safety features include a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking, City Safety for pedestrian detection, and the Pilot Assist system for semi-autonomous steering, acceleration, and braking on “well-marked” roads, a feature that will work up to 128 kph.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. In 2015, it got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Hyundai Azera fills the gap between the mid-size Sonata and the luxury Genesis sedan. It has been completely overhauled for the 2018 model year. The new Azera, known as Grandeur in Korea, comes with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include smart keyless entry with starter button, mood lighting, available panoramic sunroof, fake wood trim, rear sunshade, Apple Carplay system with Smartphone mirroring, premium analogue clock, auto-dimming mirror, electric parking brake with auto hold, leather powered seats, fog lamps, and parking sensors. Optional features in higher trims include xenon lights, memory and seat massage for driver, heating & cooling for front seats, electric tilt & telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth, tyre pressure monitoring system, electric folding mirrors, adaptive cruise control, rain sensor, dual-zone a/c, and a DVD Navigation system with rear camera. Safety features include up to 8 airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control.

The Australian-built Caprice has been redesigned from the ground up, but still remains one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers a choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the V8 engine as an option. The V6 was dropped by 2011, leaving the V8 as standard. The big V8 is standard on the sport-tuned SS and the luxury-tuned Royale. The Caprice continues to use a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, a cloth or leather interior, and more. ABS brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

The Lumina is the only rear-wheel-drive sedan in the affordable midsize segment, which is about the only reason why we do not want to see this aging car fail. Well that, and the available V6 and V8 motors that no one can match in terms of price. Built in Australia alongside the Caprice, it has been receiving minor updates every year since a major facelift in 2003, with an updated front end and new gearbox for 2005. The Lumina comes in five variants, namely the LS, LTZ, S, SS, SS Coupe and the new Royale. The power for the LS, LTZ and body-kitted S comes from the Alloytec 3.6-litre V6 engine, while the 5.7-litre V8 does its work in the Royale, the SS sedan and the SS Coupe. The base LS and LTZ models fulfil the basic needs of a commuter car that doubles as a family vehicle, with decent space and adequate power, while the SS models merge muscle-car attitude with a traditional sedan.The Royale attempts to be a luxury sports sedan with a host of luxury styling cues. The V8-powered Coupe is great value for money, though it goes for more money than the equally fast sedan. The Australians already had a 6.0-litre V8 downunder while we here still played with the old 5.7-litre.
An all-new model of the Audi A6 came out in 2019.

As with the previous model, the new TT is built on the VW Golf platform. The new TT will be available with numerous engines, including a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo and a 3.2-litre V6. The TT RS model debuted in 2011 with a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo while the V6 was cancelled. The TT roadster will debut late into 2007. The new TT is a far more aggressive sports car than the model it replaces, which was more of a show car than a sports car. Like its predecessor, the curvy profile generates a lot of aerodynamic lift at the rear end, so the new TT adopts a rear spoiler which recesses smoothly into the tail at low speeds and raises automatically at over 120 kph. The new car is larger and heavier, so to compensate for the additional metal, the hood, front fenders, roof and doors are made of aluminium, while the panels of the rear body remain steel to help balance the car. "Quattro" all-wheel-drive is optional on the front-driven 2.0 turbo, while standard on the 3.2 V6 and the RS. Manual gearbox is standard, but a DSG automanual is optional. Features include cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry, alloy wheels and the usual power accessories. As was the case with the previous TT, the new car is built as part of a joint effort, with bodywork and paint done at the German plant in Ingolstadt, and vehicle assembly is completed at Audi's Hungarian plant in Gyor.

The Australian-built Chevrolet Caprice received a change for the 2014 model year and now offers only one engine, the 6.0-litre V8. While the exterior hardly looks any different, the interior is where most of the change has happened. There are four variants to choose from, starting with the LS and the LTZ, and topping out with the sport-tuned SS and the more luxury-inclined Royale. The Caprice now gets a 6-speed automatic transmission for all their models. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, leather interior, 16-inch to 18-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/USB support, Bluetooth and more. Safety features include driver and passenger side airbags, ABS brakes and traction control.

The all-new M4 came out as a 2015 model year and is the replacement for the M3 Coupe. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 3.0-litre diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The CX-9 crossover SUV received a facelift for the 2013 model year that incorporates their new 'Kodo' design theme. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it comes with a six-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in two trims, both the base CX-9 and the CX-9 GT are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The top-spec CX-9 GT has 20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console. Safety-wise, the CX-9 comes with standard stability control and ABS, and is optionally equipped with Forward Obstruction Warning, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Control.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA 45 AMG is a sub-compact sports sedan of the German brand. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. It gets the AMG-specific bumpers and wheels. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. The CLA 45 AMG "Edition 1" model includes red highlights on certain trim bits, red brake calipers, 19-inch AMG light-alloy wheels in matte black, and special seat upholstery, AMG Performance steering wheel and other doodads. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, ABS brakes, ESP and traction control.

The Ford Transit Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying cargo. It can seat up to 3 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). It comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine, available in two different tunes. All models get the 6-speed manual transmission. The van has a payload capacity up to 1,024 kg, a maximum cargo volume of 8.3 cubic metre square and a wide space between the wheel arches allowing for the storage of 1.2-m x 2.4-m boards vertically or horizontally. The load-through bulkhead lets you carry up to 3-meter-long cargo, such as pipes, ladders or carpet rolls. Fixing points and 8 tie-down loops are positioned on the bodysides, leaving the floor clear for easier loading, unloading and cleaning. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in three versions currently. The Maybach 62 is the long wheelbase version of the 57, which is quite large already, and this body style comes in either standard 62 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in a new-for-2008 62 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. All models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems. A handful of limited-edition Landaulet four-door convertible models were built in 2010 for a four times higher price.

Finally making its official debut in the GCC, the rally-bred Subaru Impreza WRX STI landed for the 2008 model year with a hatchback-only body and no warranty. By 2010, it could finally be bought with a warranty. The sedan came for 2011. The standard engine is a 2.5-litre turbocharged and intercooled horizontally-opposed 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed manual and Subaru's 'symmetrical' all-wheel-drive system. In 2011, a minor range-wide facelift debuted along with the sedan, as well as a 5-speed automatic option. An SI-DRIVE system offers three modes, namely Intelligent, Sport, and Sport Sharp, with the first mode reducing power and improving fuel economy. The 'Driver Controlled Center Differential,' also known as DCCD, has three automatic modes in addition to allowing manual torque-split adjustment. The VDC stability control system can be left on, fully turned off, or set to a sport mode. Features include ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, LED tail lamps, torque-sensitive limited slip differential, 18-inch alloy wheels, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter button, retractable headlight washers, common power accessories and a CD stereo, with options such as Recaro sport seats and navigation. However, options lists keep changing every year, depending on what the dealers choose to bring in.

The British Morris Garages brand, a spin-off of Rover, is back in a new guise under Chinese ownership. The new-for-2011 MG 550 1.8T compact sedan is designed by MG's British team and comes with a newly-developed 1.8-litre light-pressure turbo 4-cylinder engine and a 5-speed automatic, on a front-wheel-drive platform vaguely derived from the old Rover 75, with independent suspension and disc brakes on all four wheels. The base model gets 16-inch alloys wheels, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, stability control, two front airbags, ABS with EBD, fabric seats, one-press engine start with the key still requiring insertion, steering-mounted radio controls, power windows and mirrors, automatic climate control a/c, faux wood trim, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, keyless entry, illuminated sunshade mirrors, digital gauges and fog lights. The top "Deluxe" model gets 17-inch alloys, side-curtain airbags, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, tinted windows, electric driver's seat, parking sensors, sunroof and a basic GPS system. There are many more options available, such as Bluetooth, rear camera and cooler box, but the dealer will not offer those for now.

The Odyssey is a best-seller in America, but has yet to make an impact in this region, where 4WDs rule. The Odyssey has a car-like ride and handling quality since it is based on the Accord. It is powered by the same fuel-efficient 3.5-litre V6 engine as the MR-V, mated to an automatic. The interior features a clever seating system that can accommodate up to eight passengers. The Odyssey comes standard with side curtain airbags, electronic stability control and ABS brakes, as well as power door locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, 60/40 split fold-down rear seats, power sliding doors, tri-zone climate control, a stowable second-row PlusOne seat, in-dash CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, cruise control, power driver seat controls, alloy wheels and other features. Leather upholstery is available, as is a power moonroof and heated front seats. The Odyssey aims to be more of a luxury cruiser than a basic family or labour hauler.

The all-new Celerio is Suzuki's latest mini-car offering, launching in the middle of 2009 to be sold alongside the existing Alto. In reality, the Celerio is sold as an Alto replacement in other countries, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

For 2009, the previous C-Class Sports Coupe breaks away from the C-Class range and gets its own name. Now dubbed the CLC-Class, the  model gets a new front and rear end, and an upgraded interior. And yes, it is a hatchback, even if the marketing people insist it's a coupe. However, it is still heavily based on the previous C-Class version, and is now being built in Brazil. Starting off the new line-up are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the CLC 180 Kompressor and the CLC 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune. The 2.5-litre V6-powered CLC 230 comes next. The 3.5-litre V6-powered CLC 350 rounds off the range. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. Features include power windows, electric mirrors, cloth or leather upholstery, optional panoramic sunroof, alloy wheels, automatic a/c, keyless entry, CD stereo, sports seats and more.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in three versions currently. The Maybach 62 is the long wheelbase version of the 57, which is quite large already, and this body style comes in either standard 62 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in a new-for-2008 62 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. All models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems. A handful of limited-edition Landaulet four-door convertible models were built in 2010 for a four times higher price.

The 5-door Peugeot 208 is the French manufacturer's smallest car on offer as it replaced the 207. The 2017 model year remains the same. The base Active model comes with traction control, ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, key-less entry, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player as standard. The Allure model comes with: 16-inch 'Black Diamond' alloy wheels, tinted rear windows, a 6 speaker sound system, a USB/deported Jack plug, Bluetooth and remote controls on the steering wheel all as standard. Optional equipment is also on offer: the panoramic glass roof with manual curtain, speed limiter and cruise control, dynamic leather seats, LED lighting package with mood lighting, LED ceiling lights and halogen elliptical module headlights.

The Carnival, now known as Grand Carnival, is undoubtedly Kia's largest offering, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. It comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

An all-new Mazda CX-5 was launched as a 2018 model year. The standard engine is a direct-injection 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There is one front-wheel-drive and two all-wheel-drive versions available. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

The Caterham Seven is the lightweight sports car based on an ancient chassis simple enough to build it yourself if you wanted to. The Seven 270 comes in 1.6-litre Ford-engined ‘R’ pack form with 5-speed manual, as offered in the UAE. The ‘R’ pack is more track-focused and includes a limited-slip differential, sports suspension, a four-point race harness and many other race-orientated upgrades. The Seven 270 is available in the standard narrow-body S3 chassis, although a wide-body and a 6-speed gearbox can be ordered. The Seven 360 model adds a 2.0-litre Ford engine, and is offered in 'R' pack wide-body form in the UAE. The wide-body SV chassis benefits from a wider-track front suspension and a larger fuel tank, with only a 25 kg weight gain over the S3 chassis. Finally, the Seven 420 model adds a higher-tuned 2.0-litre Ford engine. There are no safety features to speak of, aside from a roll hoop and harness belts.

For 2017, the Mercedes-Benz SLK-Class was renamed to SLC-Class. It received a significant facelift, along with engine and interior upgrades. No changes were made for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre engine with two different tunes, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment include automatic engine start/stop function, driver and passenger front airbags, ABS, acceleration skid control(ASR), electronic stability control (ESP), cruise control and radio with AUX/USB support. Optional extras include steering wheel with shift paddles, parking sensors, LED daytime running lights, rain sensor, headlamp cleaning system, Harmon Kardon surround sound system, navigation, memory seats and AMG bodykits.

The VW Golf GTI received a facelift for the 2017 model year. The 3-door model was introduced into the GCC market later on in the year. Under the hood, it is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine and having a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed DSG automanual gearboxes. It features a body kit with a built-in rear diffuser and wider side sills. Compared to the regular Golf, the GTI also rides on 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with lower suspension. Inside it gets sportier seats, steering wheel and pedals than the standard Golf. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, USB/auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, optional sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, common power accessories and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. For 2016, a limited edition 40th anniversary Clubsport variant was released with a more powerful engine and a revised bodykit. Along with the DSG gearbox, a 6-speed manual transmission was offered later on for the Clubsport.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The Geely Emgrand X7 Sport is the Chinese brand's latest compact SUV offering. It comes with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. Features in the X7 Sport include electric power steering, power windows, 3.5-inch info display, keyless entry, automatic A/C with rear vents, leather seats, infotainment system with touchscreen, Bluetooth, AUX/USB support, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy rims. Tech features in the top "Flagship" model are extensive, with a 7-inch colour LCD between the gauges, a mostly-responsive 8-inch touchscreen multimedia system with AUX and USB ports, Dolby Surround Pro-logic II stereo, navigation, Bluetooth, rear parking camera with front/rear sensors, smart keyless entry, cruise control, power-folding mirrors, LED headlights, a half-sized panoramic sunroof, and a dual-zone climate control a/c.Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, 4 airbags for the standard model and 6 airbags for the full option model.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

Hyundai's first ever rear-wheel-drive sports car, the Genesis Coupe is a 2+2 seater that has quickly earned some respect in the affordable performance category. The Genesis Coupe is based on the same rear-drive platform as found under the full-size Genesis sedan, but with almost five inches chopped out of the wheelbase. The Coupe features a MacPherson strut dual-link front suspension and a five-link rear suspension. The GCC-spec Genesis Coupe will only be available as a fully-optioned V6 automatic model. That means the two-door coupe will come with power windows, electric mirrors, 18-inch wheels, leather seats, cruise control, sunroof, HID headlights, 10-speaker Infinity audio and Brembo brakes. The 3.8-litre V6 engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic. The V6 manual and the base turbo 4-cylinder engine, as sold in other overseas markets, will not be offered as of now. While details on this limited-import model are vague, safety features should at least include dual front airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Dodge Challenger SRT received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The 2020 Dodge Challenger SRT interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It also gets forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection. The 2020 Dodge Challenger SRT gets the 6.4-litre V8, while the SRT Hellcat gets the 6.2-litre supercharged V8 motor. All SRT models gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, bi-xenon headlights, heated and ventilated seats wrapped in Nappa leather and Alcantara and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. An optional widebody kit is also available on the SRT Hellcat. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

The 2018 Ford Transit is the brand's large commercial van offering. It seats up to 2 people, and comes in 3 roof heights: Low, Medium and High. It comes in 2 wheelbases and 3 lengths:RWB, LWB and LWB EL. Under the hood, the 2018 Ford Transit gets the 3.7-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, vinyl seats, halogen headamps, AM/FM stereo, 4 front speakers, auxiliary audio input jack and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features include AdvanceTrac with RSC (Roll Stability Control), airbags – driver and front-passenger, airbags – Safety Canopy System with side-curtain airbags for front row, passenger-side front airbag with deactivation switch and rear view camera with trailer hitch assist, SOS Post Crash Alert System, and tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS).

Volvo continues to move up the premium-luxury ladder with the new-for-2018 Volvo XC60, featuring an updated corporate look and a stunning interior. Engines for the GCC include a 2.0-litre turbo in the T5 and a 2.0-litre twin-charged 4-cylinder in the T6 model. All-wheel-drive and an 8-speed automatic gearbox are standard. Various cabin trim options are available, including burled aluminium and driftwood. The new CleanZone four-zone climate system removes harmful pollutants and particles from outside the cabin to deliver “Scandinavian-fresh” air on the inside. Volvo's driver infotainment touchscreen offers smartphone integration with CarPlay and Android Auto where available. The 5-seater XC60 expectedly offers loads of safety technology. Steer Assist has been added to the ground-breaking City Safety system. A new safety system called Oncoming Lane Mitigation uses steer assist to help mitigate head-on collisions, while Volvo’s Blind Spot Indication System (BLIS) now uses Steer Assist functionality to reduce the risk of lane-changing collisions. Pilot Assist, Volvo’s advanced semi-autonomous driver assistance system, which takes care of steering, acceleration and braking on well-marked roads up to 130 kph, is available as an option.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year. It can be had in many variants, including in Sport GT and Executive GT trims. All models have the 4.2-litre V8 engine that powers the Coupe and Spyder, and come with either a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual and, for the luxury model only, a true six-speed automatic. The standard Quattroporte model has all the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The Sport GT adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals. The exhaust has been tuned to provide a deeper rumble, and other changes include uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts. The Quattroporte Executive GT model is recognizable by its chrome grille and air intakes, and is equipped with heating, ventilation and massage for rear passengers, retractable wood rear tables, alcantara roof lining, a leather-trimmed steering wheel with wood inserts and a climate control panel for the rear seat passengers. The new Quattroporte Automatic model is fitted with an automatic six-speed ZF gearbox for more casual driving.

The F430 is heavily influenced by F1 Racing technology, and makes it known to everyone openly. The F430's compact 4.3-litre V8 engine offers blistering high-revving performance, and the experience is enhanced by an optional F1-style paddle-shifting gearbox which has made its way to every other Ferrari model too. The F430's aerodynamics are honed to generate special flows to increase downforce and improve cooling. One technical feature is the electronic differential, transferring massive torque levels to the track under high cornering g-forces, and guarantees maximum grip out of bends, eliminating wheel spin. The larger interior can be personalized with carbon-fibre or aluminium inserts, with space behind the seats accessed using an electrically operated compartment. The standard electric seats can be substituted by more sporting items with four-point harnesses to order. Even with all this the interior is noticeably barebones in keeping with its sporting nature.

As evolutionary developments of the America's most popular minivan, the latest model features a more square design, optional power operation of the sliding side doors, dual front airbags, a power rear liftgate and revised interiors that are quieter, nicer and more comfortable. The new Grand Voyager comes with a 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic. It also features Stow 'n' Go rear seats, giving the ability to easily fold the second and third-row seats into the floor in as little as 30 seconds with a simple one-hand operation. More options include a rear-seat audio system, traction control, parking sensors, side-curtain airbags, a tyre-pressure warning system, electronically adjustable pedals and a rear-seat DVD entertainment. Chrysler minivans, in various shapes and names, are best sellers in the United States, but failed to make any headway in this region because minivans are not popular here.

Volvo's new-for-2011 S60 sedan redefines the Swedish firm's styling trends yet again. New from the ground up, it again straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level S60 2.0T model comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, as well as three trim levels to choose from, including the top 'Prestige' trim. The top-spec model is the S60 T6 AWD, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, and available only in loaded 'Prestige' trim in certain GCC markets. Later, a T4 base model became available, with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, which is the only version available at some GCC dealerships. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The 'Prestige' model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. A simple silver body kit is optional. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. An R-Design package became available for 2013, which adds unique bumpers, 18-inch alloys, sports suspension and more. A software-based Polestar power upgrade is also offered from 2013 onwards, adding 20-30 hp, depending on the model.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

The JAC S3 is a sub-compact crossover SUV, with styling derived from Hyundai no less. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine from 2017 onwards, mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Externally, the S3 SUV also has 16-inch alloy wheels and LED running lights as highlights. Under the skin, electric power steering, independent front suspension, semi-independent rear suspension and four-wheel-disc brakes are standard. Features include all the basics, such as power windows and mirrors, sunroof, keyless entry, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, faux leather upholstery, split-folding rear seat, cruise control and more. Safety features include 6 airbags, hill-start assist, ABS with EBD and hydraulic brake assist, ESP, rear camera and tyre-pressure monitor.

Available only as a sedan for now, the latest C-Class range is all-new for the 2008 model year, with some upgraded and some carryover engines. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional AMG sports package offers attractive suspension, a special grille and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the new line-up are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the C 180 Kompressor and the C 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune. The 2.5-litre C 230 four-cylinder comes next. The 3.0-litre V6-powered C 280 and the 3.5-litre V6-powered C 350 round off the standard range. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. The diesel models are not promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags, but many luxury features, such as 17-inch rims, navigation and even leather are optional on the base models. Trim lines include Classic, Elegance and Avantgarde. Depending on dealer, prices might be much higher in some countries.

The Chery Arrizo 3 is the Chinese brand's smallest sedan. It does not aspire to be anything more than an inoffensive 5-seater subcompact sedan, but actually a bit bigger than most of its sub-compact rivals. Powered by a typical 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 4-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, other features include split-folding rear seats, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and all the usual basics. Touchscreen stereo, leatherette seats and more are also available. Safety features include at least 2 airbags and ABS.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Renault Symbol is a sub-compact offering that's actually sourced from sister-brand Dacia. The Romanian-built Symbol made its way back to the GCC market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. It comes with only one engine, a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the basic Symbol PE model include power steering, front electric windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/USB, Bluetooth, steering wheel mounted controls, fabric seats, front fog lamps and steel wheels with 15-inch hubcaps. The SE model gets additional rear electric windows, electric mirrors, trip computer, temperature sensor, body colour door handles with chrome, automatic A/C, cruise control and leather steering wheel. The top SE model gets 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, 7-inch touchscreen with GPS and navigation, and optional leather seats. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS.

The Toyota Avanza got a facelift for the 2016 model year. It got a facelift in 2020. The rear-wheel drive Avanza, which is actually a rebadged Daihatsu, is a reasonably priced seven-seater minivan. Only the 1.5-litre engine will be offered in this region. It comes either with a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. In the UAE, an SE model is offered which features automatic transmission, power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, A/C with rear vents, fabric seats, audio entertainment system with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support, audio controls on steering wheel, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. In Saudi Arabia, the same specs is sold as an XL model. The fleet spec model gets a manual transmission, 14-inch steel wheels, and does not get the fog lamps, mud guards, steering controls and chrome linings in the exterior. On the safety side it gets standard dual airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Montego is the Mercury version of Ford's Five Hundred fullsizer, offering pretty much the same deal as its twin. Based on a Volvo platform, this American model features slightly different front and rear designs than the Ford, with an identical cabin as well as the standard 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The standard model is front-wheel-drive, but all-wheel-drive is optional. Features include ABS brakes, traction control, keypad autolock, power mirrors, power windows, remote keyless entry, eight cupholders, CD stereo with MP3 audio jack, anti-theft system, and optional tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher models include dual-zone a/c, memory power seats, leather, fake wood trim and more. Available options include heated front seats, 18-inch chrome wheels, adjustable pedals, stability control, sunroof, reverse sensors, in-dash six-disc CD audio system and other items. Standard safety equipment includes dual-stage driver and passenger front air bags, seat-deployed side airbags for driver and front passenger, and side curtain airbags for both rows.

The Honda Accord has been redesigned for the 2015 model. The base engine is a new 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with direct injection, mated to a CVT, so gets a slight bump in horsepower and torque. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. Standard features on the base 2.4 LX model include electric power steering, power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows and mirrors, LED front running lamps and tail lights, 16-inch alloy wheels, dual exhaust tips, manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, cruise control, cloth upholstery, ABS, floor mats, stability control and hill-start assist, as does all other trim levels. In certain markets, it is additionally offered with a sunroof, 17-inch aluminium wheels, and a touchscreen control panel for multimedia functions. The 2.4 EX sedan further adds front fog lights, power-folding mirrors, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, leather seats, leather steering wheel, power rear sunshade, smart keyless entry and start, auto-dimming mirror, rear parking sensors and a power driver's seat. The 2.4 EX sedan can be upgraded with navigation, rear camera, "i-Dual" a/c, 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, USB/AUX ports, and a power-adjustable passenger seat. The 3.5 EX sedan adds the V6 engine and transmission, wooden steering wheel, rear-side window sunshades, full LED headlights, and a new feature called "LaneWatch" that adds a camera under the right-side mirror to visually monitor your right blindspot. The 3.5 Sport sedan additionally gets 18-inch alloys, little paddle-shifters, and leather steering. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips. All trim levels get front, side and side curtain aribags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA) and traction control system.

The Volkswagen Jetta underwent a full redesign for 2011, growing in size to offer class-leading interior space. The only engine on offer is an old 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a manually-shiftable 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel-drive. There are three trim levels, named Trendline, Comfortline and Comfortline Plus. The base Trendline comes with keyless entry, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. The Comfortline additionally comes with chrome trim, 16-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone a/c, steering-wheel buttons, fog lamps, alarm system and parking sensors. The top Comfortline Plus version comes with 17-inch alloys, intelligent keyless entry and starter button, electric-adjustable sports seats with partial leather, and a touchscreen audio system. All VW Jetta models come with ABS, traction control, six airbags and auto hazard lights as standard.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City. For 2018, it got a facelift. It is slightly larger in every dimension from the previous generation, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in two versions currently. The Maybach 57 is the shorter wheelbase model, which is still very large, and this body style comes in either standard 57 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in 57 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. Both models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems.

The new-for-2008 i10 is an overlapping replacement for the anonymous Atos Prime supermini, boasting sleeker styling but retaining its predecessor's geekiness. Built in India to avoid increasing Korean labour costs, the i10 is only available with a 1.1-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a manual or automatic gearbox. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The Ferrari 458 Italia is the successor to the F430. Going on sale in 2010, the 458 has a new mid-mounted 4.5-litre V8 engine, incorporating direct injection and mated only to a 7-speed dual-clutch automated manual gearbox that shifts in 0.05 seconds. In 2014, a more powerful 458 Speciale made its debut. Technology includes an E-Diff differential and an F1-Trac skid control system. The brakes feature a new system called "˜prefill' so when the driver's foot lifts off the throttle, the pistons in the calipers move the pads towards the discs to reduce the stopping distance. The 458 Italia's body and chassis are all aluminium, with a Pininfarina-designed exterior. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions. The 458 is also available with modern conveniences like Bluetooth, CD stereo, rear camera, navigation, stability control and ABS, as well as a full set of front and side airbags.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The American-built Sequoia is Toyota's largest ever passenger vehicle. Its claim to fame is space, with three rows of adult seating and impressive cargo volume. In the GCC, this big SUV will be promoted as a family hauler rather than an offroader, considering the initial availability of a rear-wheel-drive variant. The four-wheel-drive model with low-range gearing came in 2010. By 2013, the 2WD model was dropped in UAE, but carried on in KSA. The second row can either seat two or three, depending on the setup chosen. It is powered by a 5.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. It may be based on the Tundra pickup-truck platform, but it comes standard with four-wheel independent suspension, stability control, CD/MP3 stereo, automatic three-zone a/c, stability control, front airbags, and side-curtain airbags. The only trim levels are SR5 and Limited, dropping the previously top-spec Platinum. Depending on trim level, this 'city SUV' comes with options such two rear-seat DVD screens, 20-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera and parking sensors, CD changer, powered tailgate, power-folding third-row seats, power tailgate, cloth or leather upholstery, navigation, rear air suspension and more. The KSA models are optionally available with in-car wifi as well.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG Coupe gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

Citroen has a tradition for breaking design conventions and building quiry cars, and the Picasso, a compact people-carrier, is no exception. The Picasso offers a roomy and versatile interior designed around the need for differing seating configurations in a vehicle with car-like handling characteristics. Compact tall wagons have become popular family vehicles in europe, though people here are reluctant to give up their stupid 4WDs. The only powerplant is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder with front-wheel-drive and an automatic gearbox. The sloping front end offers a commanding driving position. The dash-mounted shifter is within easy reach and the digital instrumentation is clear. The cabin is filled with accessories like cup-holders, fold-down aeroplane-style tables in the back, and a low luggage floor for easy loading, with numerous other stowage facilities and cubby holes, including huge door pockets and under-floor storage boxes. Safety features include the requisite airbags and ABS brakes.

Looking more like a minor facelift than a major update, the new-for-2011 Suzuki Swift is actually a fair bit longer, with a new engine on offer, and now is built in India. Powered by a new 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. A new Japanese-built Swift Sport model was offered in 2012 with a 1.6-litre engine and a CVT automatic. The base Swift model comes with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher trim levels are available with a leather steering wheel with audio controls, 6-speaker stereo, tachometer, 16-inch alloy wheels, adjustable steering wheel, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD. Only the top version gets rear disc brakes, while the lower ones get drums. The Swift Sport gets a unique front bumper, firmer suspension and some additional trimmings.

The Cadillac CT6 is the American luxury brand's flagship sedan. It takes on the Germans, but it weighs less than a 5-Series and an E-Class. Under the hood, there are three engine choices available. The standard model gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, which is currently not sold in the GCC. Then there is the naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine and the current top trim gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 unit. All motors get a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the rear-wheel drive CT6 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. A washer for the rear camera is new for 2018. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 2.6 entertainment system, 34 BOSE speakers, rear seat infotainment system with 10-inch-diagonal screens that retract into the front seatbacks, quad-zone climate control, bigger alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Subaru Legacy is in its sixth-generation, and has received a facelift for 2018, along with minor updates such as better sound insulation. The Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and got an entirely new design back in 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. The 2018 Subaru Legacy is also available with a 3.6-litre flat 6-cylinder engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Expedition is a full-size 4WD that has yet to blaze a trail in the Middle East. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. The Expedition comes with a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

The F430 is heavily influenced by F1 Racing technology, and makes it known to everyone openly. The F430's compact 4.3-litre V8 engine offers blistering high-revving performance, and the experience is enhanced by an optional F1-style paddle-shifting gearbox which has made its way to every other Ferrari model too. The F430's aerodynamics are honed to generate special flows to increase downforce and improve cooling. One technical feature is the electronic differential, transferring massive torque levels to the track under high cornering g-forces, and guarantees maximum grip out of bends, eliminating wheel spin. The larger interior can be personalized with carbon-fibre or aluminium inserts, with space behind the seats accessed using an electrically operated compartment. The standard electric seats can be substituted by more sporting items with four-point harnesses to order. Even with all this the interior is noticeably barebones in keeping with its sporting nature. For 2008, a more powerful, lighter and track-focussed F430 Scuderia was introduced, with a faster clutchless-manual gearbox and other chassis enhancements.

The Maxima was a hot car when it was first unveiled in this iteration. However, Nissan's GCC division chose to let this model stagnate to the point where it was easily overshadowed by the newer Altima, even when the Maxima was redesigned in other markets and transformed into a luxury cruiser. The GCC-spec Maxima also still uses Nissan's older version of the corporate V6, with a displacement of 3.0-litre, combined with front-wheel-drive, and with a choice of five-speed manual and four-speed auto gearboxes. Performance is very respectable even after all these years. It comes with automatic air-conditioning, CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, ABS-assisted disc brakes, cloth seats, front airbags and many wheel choices, depending on model. The basic model gets 15-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include an in-dash CD changer with subwoofer, cruise control, sunroof, rear electric sunshade and leather cabin trim. Changes from year to year largely involve a new grille style every few years.

The McLaren 650S is based on the 12C but with 25% new parts. The 650S comes with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The VW Golf has reached its sixth generation, although receiving largely an exterior facelift on the outside. Under the skin, many new features can be found that improves the Golf MK6 as a driver's car. Most noticeable is the new corporate front-end with the black-out grille, while the rest of the car is very similar to the outgoing model. The Golf VI gets a choice of two engines on debut, namely a carryover 1.6-litre 4-cylinder and a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder, the latter of which uses both supercharging and turbocharging. Both models can be had with either a manual gearbox or a new 7-speed DSG automanual transmission. The interior is very similar to the previous Golf, but some new bits include the steering wheel, 'climatronic' a/c and better noise reduction. The Golf is offered as a 2-door or a 4-door, in Trendline, Comfortline and Highline trim levels. Depending on trim, the regular Golf can be had with seven airbags including a knee airbag, stability control, adaptive cruise control, adaptive chassis control with adjustable suspension, Park Assist, alloy wheels, sunroof, and the usual power accessories.

An all-new Ford Explorer came out in 2020. The new chassis has gone back to becoming a proper SUV instead of a crossover, so off-road ability has improved. Under the hood, the standard engine gets a 2.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. Then there is a hybrid model which gets a 3.3-litre V6 engine combined with an electric motor. The top model is the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. All engines are mated to an 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, tri-zone A/C, LED auto headlamps, 8-inch infotainment system, 6 speakers Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, cloth seats, 8-way adjustable power driver's seat, power liftgate reverse camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, hand's free liftgate, 20 and 21-inch wheels, digital instrument cluster, and better audio system. Standard safety features include 7 airbags, ABS, brake assist, pedestrian detection, blind spot monitor, forward-collision warning and post-collision braking. Higher models get lane centering and evasive steering assist.

The MG 5 is the Chinese-owned brand's compact segment offering. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, infotainment system with Android Auto, Apple Carplay and Bluetooth, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats,sunroof, rear parking sensor and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

An all-new model of the BMW X5 came out in 2019. It is longer, wider and higher than the outgoing model. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The A8 is the most imposing of the Audi range. Most noticeable is the big single-frame grille on all models. Engines available in front-wheel-drive form include the 2.8-litre V6 and the 3.2-litre V6 in this region, while all-wheel-drive Quattro offerings include the 4.2-litre V8, although some dealers do offer the 6.0-litre V12 too. All these models are sold here only in long wheelbase form, but there is also a sweet short-wheelbase S8 model, again only from some dealers, that is powered by a Lamborghini-sourced 5.2-litre V10. Basic features on A8 models include a parking system with graphic display, adaptive front lighting, new 18-inch wheel designs, optional 19-inch performance tyres with the Sport Package, a revamped Driver Information Centre; a glove box lock and a leather interior. The 4.2-litre, 6.0-litre and 5.2-litre models all use Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive. The A8 uses an all-aluminium frame with a fully pneumatic suspension system. Its aluminium four-link front axle and trapezoidal-link rear axle suspension has air spring struts at each wheel, with sensors that continually monitor and adjust the damping, and automatically level the car. The 3.2-litre uses a CVT automatic transmission, while the rest of the models use a six-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission with manual mode and available wheel-mounted paddles. Audi's Multi Media Interface control system can be used to monitor or control such things as the radio, phone, climate control, stereo or lighting profiles of the LED illumination in the door trim and foot wells. The Quattro models are at least a step in the right direction in combating its German brethren.

The Hyundai Accent is all-new for 2012, being longer, wider and lower than the outgoing model. It now features Hyundai's swoopy new corporate styling and superb build quality. The spacious sub-compact 4-door sedan comes with a choice of 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines, both with 5-speed manual and 4-speed automatic geabox options. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features, all optional, includes stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Espace is famous for being the first minivan to grace European roads back in the 1980s. Packed with abundant space and numerous safety features, it has the maximum rating in crash tests conducted by European governmental agencies. It comes in short-wheelbase and long-wheelbase body styles, all seating as many as seven passengers, with luggage space to spare.
