Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as stability control and ABS brakes. On the road, the long-wheelbase Avalanche is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. Versions include the Avalanche Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension and other accessories.

The Ferrari California T replaces the California, the T signifying the turbocharged 3.9-litre V8 engine it now  gets, which is mated to and improved 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox and rear-wheel-drive. The car also gets a new front fascia that was influenced by the F12, a revised rear and a revised interior. Another improvement to the car is the reduction of emission pollution by 15% compared to its naturally aspirated predecessor. The car also utilizes small turbos and a variable boost management system to create no turbo lag. Focused slightly more on comfort than on track prowess, the F149-designated California comes with a customisable leather-clad cabin, CD stereo with LCD multimedia screen, and a multi-function steering wheel with starter button and driving-mode selection. It seats only two and has a shelf behind the seats along with a useable luggage trunk, as well as all the usual power accessories, airbags and electronic safety nannies. The Ferrari California is also equipped with the exclusive F1-Trac traction control system. Brembo brakes featuring carbon-ceramic material discs are standard.

The Peugeot 2008 is a five-seater crossover loosely based on the 208 hatchback. Available only with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, it is designed to be a city-runner rather than a beach-goer. Available features include tiptronic gear-shifting, panoramic glass roof, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, multimedia LCD display, 16-inch alloy wheels, split-folding rear seats, keyless entry, cruise control with speed limiter, power windows, eletric mirrors, front airbags and ABS, among other options.

Daihatsu aims to boost sales with its new Terios 4WD. With short front and rear overhangs, a long wheelbase and wide track, it looks like it can go off-road, but not with any real verve. It's apparently aimed at people looking for the traditional 4x4 qualities of high seating position, bad-weather traction and versatility combined with small car running costs and manoeuvrability. It is longer and wider than the previous model. The interior is about the same size as a mid-sized hatchback, with a split fold-and-tumble rear seat that frees up luggage space supposedly long enough to take a mountain bike. The front floor cross-member, tunnel, sills, B-pillars and roof-side rails are all strengthened to secure the cabin. With the rear seat in use the boot capacity is 380 litres. Its 1.5-litre engine is based on the Daihatsu 1.3-litre, with variable valve timing and its torque curve is virtually flat from 3200 to 4000 rpm. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic transmission. A centre differential transfers power with a fixed 50/50 torque split to the front and rear axles via separate propshafts. A fascia-mounted switch activates the electronically-controlled differential lock. ABS and airbags are available too.

The Haval H2 is the Chinese SUV brand's smallest offering. It comes with a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and traction control.

The Grandis is a slick minivan that offers buyers a genuine three-row seating configuration to take the kids to school and pick up their buddies at picnics on the weekend, but without the higher running costs associated with a 4WD alternative thanks to their small 4-cylinder engines and car-like demeanour. It is also interesting to note that this people mover forego sliding rear doors in favour of a car-like 4-door configuration. The MPV is kitted out with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, andÂ  gets a standard 4-speed automatic with manual shift capability, transferring its engine power to the ground via the front wheels. With seating for seven, standard safety features include front airbags, though front side and curtain airbags are optional. Also standard are ABS-assisted disc brakes, rear a/c and power windows and mirrors. Options include such niceties as dual sunroofs, leather, CD changer and more. Just be ready to be mistaken for a professional van driver on the streets, even though the Grandis is far too good to be a commercial vehicle.

The Volkswagen Polo Sedan is powered by a 1.6-litre four cylinder engine mated to a six-speed automatic transmission. The front fascia of the Polo Sedan has the distinct look of all new Volkswagen models, with fog lamps and 15-inch alloys coming as standard. The Polo sedan is slightly longer than the European hatchback model, thereby offering more rear legroom for passengers. Standard features include electrically adjustable side mirrors, electric remote unlocking for the boot lid and central locking. Parking sensors and automatic air-conditioning are optional extras. A radio with a CD/MP3 player is included in the base model. You get leather wrapped around the steering wheel and gear knob. Volkswagen offers ABS and dual airbags as standard on the Polo sedan.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Facelifted inside and out for 2008, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight, even with the power upgrade for 2008. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

The SX4 is Suzuki's compact car offering. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model. For 2013, Suzuki started offering only the all-wheel drive hatchback version. It is fitted with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

In 2015, the Audi S7 Sportback got a facelift. It gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission, Horsepower also goes up in the new model. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected, as it gets front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, ESP and traction control.

The Mini, heavily updated in 2007, was mildly updated for 2010 in looks, features and power. It is one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a bit of cargo. Engineered by BMW, the Mini has been given a major overhaul in styling and cabin space for 2007, though the basic underpinnings are still the same. Cabrio convertibles offer an electrically-folding soft-top and pop-up rollover hoops. Models include the Cooper and the turbocharged Cooper S. The Cooper models use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine in different states of tune, with the S adding a turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works (JCW) package that bumps up horsepower and handling, while a Sport package offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps. Originally, the JCW models were only available with a manual gearbox, but automatic versions became available by late 2012. Special edition models are offered from time to time, such as the 50th-anniversary Mayfair Cooper S in 2010. A limited "Inspired by Goodwood" Cooper S model was launched with real leather and other upscale trim, for a lot of money. A limited Cooper S JCW GP edition came in 2013, featuring a bit more power over the regular JCW, Recaro front seats, rear seats deleted, stiffer suspension and unique wheels.

The Lexus RX continues its grip on womenly drivers everywhere, with a new design for 2010 that isn't a radical change compared to the outgoing model. The RX 350 still comes with only one engine, namely a 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 19-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations. A front lower-bumper spoiler is optional. On debut in 2010, three trim levels were offered, namely the Premium, Premium Plus and Luxury. For 2011, the trim levels changed to Premier, Vogue, Prestige and Platinum, as a well as a mid-range 'Stone Designs' edition with a custom red-beige cloth interior.

The Chrysler 200 is a reborn Sebring, but with a major facelift, new engines, retuned suspension and a better interior. Now offered with a choice of 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and 3.6-litre V6 engines, both mated to 6-speed automatics, the front-wheel-drive midsize sedan gets a second chance in the GCC market. The base 200 LX model comes with the 4-cylinder engine, cloth upholstery, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, 17-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, cruise control and manual a/c. The mid-range 200 Touring model adds 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone auto a/c, leather-wrapped steering wheel, trip computer, power driver's seat and 6-speaker stereo, with available options such as remote start, sunroof and voice-controlled UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and hard-drive. The top 200 Limited model adds a V6 engine, exterior chrome trim, 18-inch alloys, auto up/down windows, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather upholstery, while the same extra-cost options as the Touring are also available, with the addition of an optional Boston Acoustics stereo. All models get standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, alarm and a tyre-pressure monitoring system.

A 2-door coupe joins the Cadillac CTS range in October 2010 as a 2011 model. Alongside the mainstay 3.6-litre direct-injection V6 base model is a supercharged 6.2-litre V8-powered CTS-V. The V6 engine only comes with a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the CTS-V can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. All the cars are rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterised by a large chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 17-inch to 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro was launched in 2016. In 2019, it got a facelift along with few software upgrades to the infotainment system for better usability. Under the hood, it gets two engine options - a 3.6-litre V6 and a 6.2-litre V8 engine. The Camaro also has a  4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, but it is not sold in the GCC. In 2019, the V6 and V8 models got a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 6-speed manual transmission is only available on the V8 model. Standard features on the 2021 Chevrolet Camaro include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof, leather seats and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The hard-top convertible 308 CC model came in 2010. The CC came only with the turbo engine. All versions come with an automatic gearbox. Standard features include driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, CD player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats and remote key with central locking. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with GSM built-in telephone, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors.

The Mitsubishi Attrage is the Japanese brand's sub-compact sedan offering, introduced in 2014 GCC market. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. The Thai-built Attrage gets a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual in fleet-spec trim or a CVT in all other versions. The small engine, combined with the lightweight body makes it very fuel-efficient. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry with central locking, fabric seats, manual a/c, AM/FM radio with CD player and 4 speakers, tachometer and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional equipment include a full-auto a/c, better entertainment system, leather-strapped steering wheel and gear knob, 15-inch alloy wheels and USB port. For safety, only the top model gets 2 airbags for the driver and passenger, whereas as the rest get only one for the driver. All models get ABS with EBD.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. In 2021, the Volvo V90 got a facelift. Only the Cross Country model was sold in the GCC. It is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Audi S8 is the sports version of the carmaker's flagship A8 model. It comes with a powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It also gets cylinder deactivation so it can run on only 4 cylinders for better fuel economy. Features include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon headlamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, rear-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and sunroof. Safety standards are high, with electronic stability control, various collision prevention systems and numerous airbags. Different equipment packages are available as well for further customisation.

The Cadillac XT5 debuted in 2017 as an all-new model and is considered a luxury midsize crossover. Under the hood, it gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The V6 engine features cylinder deactivation and engine stop/start when idle to improve fuel economy. A 2.0-litre turbocharged engine could debut later. The all-wheel-drive is powered by a "twin-clutch" system which is capable of sending 100-percent torque to the front or rear axle. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Bentley Mulsanne got a facelift and engine upgrades in 2015. The extra-large sedan has a turbocharged 6.75-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Power in the standard Mulsanne remains the same, with upgrades made to improve fuel efficiency. A Mulsanne Speed joined the lineup later on the year with the same engine, but tuned to give more power. The Mulsanne comes standard with a premium cabin treatment consisting of leather on every inch of the interior, supplemented by real wood and metal trim. Each car takes twelve weeks to produce, and customers have a choice of 114 paint colours, 21 carpet colours, 9 wood veneers and 24 interior leather hides, and be able to specify a custom colour scheme. Additionally, the car can be specified to feature a Naim 2200W audio system with MP3 compatibility, Bluetooth, iPod port and navigation. Further available features include powered massage seats, four-zone auto a/c, keyless start, HID headlights and more. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control and multiple airbags.

The CK is Geely's first offering in a few GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia and the UAE, although it first went on sale in China a couple of years prior. The name "CK" somehow stands for "Freedom Ship" or "Free Cruiser" in Chinese. The CK holds the distinction of being the first Chinese automobile ever displayed at an American auto show, although it has never been allowed to be on sale there. The reasons are that it failed crash tests and emissions regulations. The small car was developed in China, but is supposedly based on a South Korean design by Daewoo. Its 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine is licenced from Toyota. The front-wheel-drive sedan comes with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Features include manual air-conditioning, remote locking, fog lamps, CD stereo, power steering, painted bumpers, power windows, intermittent wipers, 14-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery and more. Options include leather upholstery, ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, dual front airbags,

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's arsenal. Competing in a peculiar segment defined by expensive small cars, the 1-Series is the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive. First offered in mid-2004 as a 5-door hatchback using its own platform, it replaced the slow-selling 3-Series Compact. Facelifted for 2008, the five-door hatchback was joined by a three-door hatchback. The range was soon expanded to include a two-door coupe and a two-door convertible. Petrol versions now include the 2.0-litre 118i, the 2.0-litre 120i, the 3.0-litre 125i and the 3.0-litre turbocharged 135i, although the higher engines are reserved for the two-door models. In 2009, a basic 120i convertible debuted. All models come with a choice of 6-speed transmissions, both manual or automatic. In late 2011, a limited-edition 1M Coupe was offered with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder and manual only. While the hatchback was completely redesigned for 2012, the coupe and convertible continued unchanged for one more year. All non-M trims come standard with common power accesories, cloth or leather upholstery, front and side airbags, stability control and ABS, alongside various optional features such as HID headlights, "active" steering, stereo choices and various wheel sizes. Considering the price, the way it looks, and the number of these seen on the streets, BMW is having trouble moving these off the showroom floor in this region.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The Australian-built Chevrolet Caprice received a change for the 2014 model year and now offers only one engine, the 6.0-litre V8. While the exterior hardly looks any different, the interior is where most of the change has happened. There are four variants to choose from, starting with the LS and the LTZ, and topping out with the sport-tuned SS and the more luxury-inclined Royale. The Caprice now gets a 6-speed automatic transmission for all their models. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, leather interior, 16-inch to 18-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/USB support, Bluetooth and more. Safety features include driver and passenger side airbags, ABS brakes and traction control.

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Based on a platform shared with the Bentley Continental GT, the Phaeton received a minor facelift for 2012, incorporating LEDs both front and back. The VW Phaeton is available with two carryover engines, namely a 3.2-litre V6 and a 4.2-litre V8, while a 6.0-litre W12 is supposedly available on special order. All are mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a new touchscreen navigation system, all-wheel-drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies. Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The new Taurus, while still based on the Five Hundred platform, actually has reduced interior volume due to its stylised exterior. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive was offered from late 2011. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are optional.

The Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. It got a facelift for its 2017 model, along with interior upgrades and it carries over to 2018 unchanged. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

The Audi RS 5 is being sold, but mostly only on special order. An all-new model came out in 2018. In 2020 it got a facelift and some upgraded tech inside. It gets a twin turbocharged 2.9-litre V6 engine with a 8-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5.

Hyundai's Genesis G70 is the Korean carmaker's attempt at cracking the entry-level premium sports sedan niche. Starting off with a shortened platform derived from the Kia Stinger, the compact sedan appears to derive a lot from its rivals and brings nothing new to the table, aside from offering a bit more power, based on preliminary reports. In 2021, the Genesis G70 received a significant facelift. The engines on offer include a 2.0-litre turbo four and a 3.3-litre twin-turbo V6, both mated to 8-speed automatics. Features include LED lighting, an 8-inch touch screen, electronic shifter. available 15-speaker Lexicon audio system, Apple CarPlay and a heads-up display. Safety features include the usual set of airbags, ABS, ESP and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as active-driving aids such as adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane-departure warning, etc.

The all-new 2018 Volkwagen Arteon replaces the ageing Passat CC. Built on a new platform and featuring an entirely new fastback design, the Arteon is dimensionally a tad larger than its predecessor, and a whole lot more charismatic. Featuring an improved turbocharged 2.0-litre engine, the Arteon boasts power and performance figures similar to the V6 unit in the CC it replaces. Notable features include 12.3-inch digital instrument cluster display, 9.2-inch capacitive touchscreen infotainment system with gesture control, heads-up display, ventilated power seats with massage function and memory preset, adaptive dampers, leather interior, LED headlamps and tail lamps, and DRL. Safety tech includes multitude of airbags, blind spot monitor, traction and stability control systems, parking assist, pre-crash safety system, and   the innovative Emergency Assist system which automatically pulls over the car to the side if it cannot detect any response from the driver for a certain period of time.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Gran Coupe Competition was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 Gran Coupe comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The C4 Picasso is a modern replacement for the oddball Xsara Picasso. Based on the C4 compact platform, it is a tall stylish minivan-type vehicle that drives like a car and has the practicality of a big 4WD. It seats only five, and the larger seven-seater Grand Picasso is not offered here. When all five seats are up, has 500 litres of boot space underneath the luggage cover, extending to a maximum 1,734 litres once the rear seats are folded down. Only two 4-cylinder engines are offered, one a 1.8-litre and one a 2.0-litre, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes that vary by model. According to trim level, the metal suspension can be replaced with pneumatic suspension on the rear axle on 2.0-litre models. CitroÃ«n has paid close attention to achieving the best levels of acoustic comfort and vibration control, as well as a new air-conditioning system. Its cloth-lined cabin can be outfitted with a variety of options, such as a panoramic glass roof, high-quality stereo system and folding video screens in the back of the front seats. The C4 Picasso has four Isofix seat tethers, audible seatbelt warnings for all seats and seven airbags as standard. Automatic electronic parking brake and Hill Start Assist are also fitted as standard.

The X6 M debuted in late 2009, with a higher-tuned turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 than the regular X6. The M has a 6-speed auto with proper paddle-shifters. Features include iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, side-view cameras, top-view camera, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M gets 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements. It also gets  features such as sports suspension, 'M' driving mode, paddle-shifted quicker-response automatic, launch control and a body kit.

An all-new Ford F-150 Raptor was made available in the GCC in 2017. It comes with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. This generation gets an all-aluminium body making it lighter than the previous generation. The Raptor is available as a SuperCab or as a SuperCrew. Standard features on the 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor include power steering, power windows, cruise control, keyless entry, manual single-zone A/C, bucket seats with manual lumbar support, fabric upholstery, SYNC voice recognition communications and entertainment system, 1 USB, AM/FM stereo with 7 speakers, leather wrapped steering-wheel with mounted audio controls, reverse parking sensors with camera, and 17-inch alloy wheels with all-terrain tyres. Optional features on the 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor include the SYNC 3 system with an 8-inch touch screen, 2 USB ports, Sony audio system with 10 speakers and sub-woofer, power seats, navigation, moonroof, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, ventilated seats, active park assist, adaptive cruise control and blind spot monitor. All models of the 2019 Ford F-150 Raptor get front driver and passenger airbags, side curtain airbags, rollover sensor and stability control.

The Hyundai Elantra Coupe was launched by the end of 2012 in some GCC markets. It comes with two 4-cylinder engine choices, either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Suzuki Vitara is a completely new model, making its debut in the GCC in 2016. Smaller, lighter and losing its offroad capabilities, the new Vitara is designed to compete in the road-going crossover segment and is a separate vehicle line from the existing Grand Vitara. It is only available as a 5-door wagon, and gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available in both two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive. In the UAE, two trims are available, the GLX and GLX+, all of which come with automatic transmission as standard. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, central locking, keyless push start system, sunroof, LED daytime running lamps, leather seats, cruise control,  automatic A/C, roof rails, front & rear parking sensors, front skid plate, chrome front grille and alloy wheels. The higher GLX+ model gets panoramic roof and polished aluminium wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ABS and brake assist.

The Altima received a face-lift for the 2013 model. They still get the same 2.5-litre 4-cylinder and 3.5-litre V6 engine from the previous shape, along with CVT transmissions. Some GCC markets don't offer the 3.5-litre version. Features included in the base 2.5 S include ABS, traction-control, vehicle stability control, remote keyless entry with Push Button Ignition, radio with CD player with Aux-in and 4 speakers, audio controls on steering wheel and dual airbags. The 2.5 SV adds to that cruise control, 6-speaker audio system with 5-inch display, bluetooth, USB port with iPod connectivity, rear-view camera, auto-headlamps, parking sensors, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy rims. Moving up to 2.5 SL,  additional features include 6-way power seats, dual zone auto A/C, side and curtain airbags and remote engine start. For the V6, the 3.5 SV is the same options as 2.5 SV but included are paddle shifters on the steering column. The 3.5 SL gets leather seats, driver 8-way power seat, lumbar support, Bose audio system with 9 speakers, sunroof, xenon head lamps and LED tail lamps. The top SL versions can be specced out with a navigation system.

The CMC Z7 is actually an iteration of a Taiwanese model called the Mitsubishi Zinger, and sharing a chassis with the Mitsubishi Nativa. Facelifted for 2016, with a new 5-speed automatic transmission, the Z7 people-carrier is powered by a Mitsubishi-sourced 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Features include four forward-opening doors with a rear tailgate, 7 seats, CD/MP# stereo, cloth upholstery, parking sensors, keyless entry, power windows, power locks, power steering, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. Higher trim levels get 16-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, cruise control, climate control, rear camera, USB port and leather upholstery. Safety features include ABS and two airbags.

The Gallardo is Lamborghini's smallest offering, continuing with minor upgrades and a facelift for 2009. The cab-forward cockpit and mid-engine design are traditional Lamborghini cues, available as Coupe or Spyder convertible, but the biggest deletion are upward-opening scissor doors like on the Murcielago and earlier Diablo, offering conventional doors instead. A 5.2-litre V10 engine, upgraded again for 2009, with drive-by-wire throttle control sits behind the front seats, while the standard transmission is a six-speed manual. An optional E-gear sequential manual transmission features variable modes such as sport, automatic and low-traction. An active rear spoiler pops up at high speeds for aerodynamic stability. Safety features include front airbags and dual side head-and-thorax airbags, along with ABS and EBD, equipped with a front automatic brake differential and a rear differential equipped with a friction-type limited slip feature. The Gallardo offers 42/58 front/rear weight distribution, all-wheel-drive, 19-inch rims with low-profile tyres and massive Brembo disc brakes as standard. Now officially known as the Gallardo LP560-4, it supercedes all previous versions. The LP560-4 Spyder is heavier and slightly slower. A LP 570-4 Superleggera coupe and LP570-4 Spyder Performante models made its debut later, which are slightly more powerful and weighed lighter. A track-focussed LP 570-4 Trofeo Stradale model was also briefly offered before being cancelled by late 2012. The rear-wheel drive LP 550-2 Coupe was offered by Lamborghini in 2011 as the lowest-priced model in the Gallardo line-up, followed by a Spyder model later on. A special edition LP 560-4 Bicolore was released in 2010 which features a unique two-tone paintjob, black roof and special alloy wheels. Meanwhile, the original LP 560-4 got a facelift for 2013, with triangle-heavy front and rear bumpers to differentiate it from lesser models.

BAIC is a Chinese car company which made its debut in the UAE in late 2014. The BAIC A1 hatchback comes is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They are come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Toyota Corolla is all-new for 2014, with completely-redone styling and an extended wheelbase for more cabin space. Engine offerings include a 1.6-litre and a new 2.0-litre, both 4-cylinder "VVT-i" units mated to 4-speed automatics, although a base model with a 6-speed manual is available in some GCC markets. The front-wheel-drive platform still rides on independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension. The five-seater is available in various trim levels. In Saudi Arabia, there is a 1.6 XLi model with a manual or automatic gearbox, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, black front grille, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and a 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo. Moving up to the 1.6 GLi adds fog lamps, 16-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, trunk liner, better upholstery with leather steering wheel, split-folding rear seats, 6-speaker touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with starter button and several other smaller convenience features. The 2.0 GLi adds LED headlights with LED running lamps, sunroof, rear manual curtains, auto a/c and cruise control. In the UAE, there are 5 trim levels, starting with an uber-basic 1.6 S model that includes a standard automatic gearbox, 15-inch steelies, 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo, power mirrors and a black grille. The next-level 1.6 SE version adds power windows, keyless entry and body-colour door handles. The 1.6 SE+ adds better upholstery with leather steering wheel, chrome grille, split-folding rear seats, LED running lamps, smart keyless entry and start, LCD info display, a better 6-speaker stereo and a few other extra bits. Moving on to the larger engine, the 2.0 SE has all the features of the 1.6 SE, but additionally gets 15-inch alloys and 6 speakers for the basic stereo. The 2.0 SE+ model gets all the features of the 1.6 SE+ model. And the 2.0 Limited gets a sunroof, auto-levelling projector headlights and cruise control. Other markets may get slightly different trim levels. All models get standard dual front airbags, ABS with brake assist and EBD, and an alarm immobiliser.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The Bolt EUV made its debut in the UAE and GCC in 2022. The Bolt EUV is based on the regular Bolt EV, but packaged in "SUV-like proportions". Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors. keyless entry, central locking, push start stop engine, 10.2-inch screen in the centre console and 8.0-inch screen in the instrument cluster, fabric seats, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatible infotainment system and alloy wheels. Safety features include 10 airbags and tire pressure monitoring system.

The Expedition is a full-size 4WD that has yet to blaze a trail in the Middle East. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. The Expedition comes with a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

An all-new GMC Acadia came in 2017. The crossover offers three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. The Acadia gets a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry, tri-zone climate control and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19 or 20-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Veloster is Hyundai's head-on dive into the sport-compact segment, with an entry that will be controversial forever. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side. The standard engine for the GCC is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, which puts a downer on its sporting intentions, especially since the standard gearbox is a 6-speed automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. A lower-spec base model was released in 2013 with fewer features. Additional features available in some GCC markets include a full set of airbags, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The Lexus ES, the luxury carmaker's bread-and-butter sedan, carries on with its comfort-biased approach and focus on convenience features. A new generation ES sedan came out in 2019. It comes with three engine options, a 4-cylinder 2.5-litre, a 3.5-litre V6, both mated to an 8-speed automatic, and a 2.5-litre coupled with an electric motor, connected to a CVT. All models are front wheel drive. The ES 250 model comes in one "Prlatinum" trim and features HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, front-rear parking sensors, 18-inch alloys, moonroof, headlamp cleaner, leather interior, powered front seats, 8-speaker navigation, 12.3-inch screen with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, power-adjustable steering, and dual-zone auto a/c. The ES 350 "Prestige" adds the V6 engine, nicer leather, navigation, power rear sunshade and a blind-spot monitor. The "Platinum" adds a front screen, rear camera and a remote-touch computer. The "Titanium" further adds adaptive headlights, different wheels, panoramic glass roof, even semi-aniline leather, front ventilated seats, 3-zone a/c, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist and a pre-crash safety system. All models come with front, knee, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The Nativa is an off-road capable 4WD that fits in an odd spot between the Pajero and the Outlander. Powered by a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a four-speed automatic, the Nativa is a dated design, but still a decent wagon. Standard features for the low base price include AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, driver's and front passenger's front airbags, part time 4WD with synchronized front free-wheel differential, transfer protector, power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, alloy wheels, keyless entry system and seating for five. Features available on higher models include gauges for a thermometer, compass, oil pressure and voltage meter, faux wood trim, front fog lights, CD player with 6 speakers, leather seats, sunroof, limited slip differential, ABS with EBD, cruise control and more. The Nativa rides on the older L200 pickup platform, and was discontinued in a number of markets since 2004. Shipments have continued from Thailand since 2008, alongside the Pajero Sport. However, few 4WDs are offered at this price that are properly equipped to go off-road. Some dealers only offered one fully-loaded trim in the later years.

Almost 5 metres long with a low roofline, the Audi A7 Sportback is a full-sizer riding on 18-inch to 20-inch wheels, and as with all Audi sedans,  really rides a front-wheel-drive platform, with optional 'Quattro' all-wheel-drive tacked onto the higher trim levels. Two V6 engines are offered in the UAE - a 2.8-litre and a supercharged 3.0-litre, both of which are mated to an 'S-tronic' automatic transmission. An S7 was introduced as a 2013 model with a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system. Optional equipment include interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound.

The Chevrolet Blazer made a comeback in 2019, slotting in between the Equinox and Traverse. Both engine options offered on the Blazer are naturally aspirated - with the base model getting the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the higher model gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine, both of which are mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The 2.5-litre is available in front-wheel drive and all-wheel-drive, while the 3.6-litre model only comes as all-wheel-drive. However, the rear axle can be completely cut-off in the AWD models to run only in FWD mode. Standard features in the Blazer include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, 4.2-inch driver information display screen, infotainment system with an 8-inch touch screen including Bluetooth, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay, 6 speakers and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control, traction control, and front, side and knee airbags. Higher models include options such as adaptive cruise control, leather seats, premium Bose audio system with sub-woofer, panoramic sunroof, surround vision camera, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy wheels, and wireless charging. The higher trims also get more safety features such as forward collision alert, automatic braking, pedestrian braking, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, blind spot monitor and park assist.

The Korean-built Captiva, originally GM's first proper entry into the softroader market, received a facelift in 2011, along with a change in engines and cabin design. On offer is a choice of two powertrains, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive form, and a 3.0-litre V6 with direct-injection and all-wheel-drive. All models get a new 6-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, standard power windows and mirrors, seating for seven, 4-speaker or 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c and keyless entry. There are four trim levels, with the top LTZ model getting optional 19-inch alloy wheels, single-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, 8-speaker stereo with AUX port and CD changer, optional fog lamps, electronic parking brake, cloth or leather upholstery, optional Bluetooth, chrome door handles, optional sunroof and optional parking sensors. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags, standard ABS, and optional traction control, stability control, hill-descent control and hydraulic brake assist.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is a combination of both coupe and crossover, designed to the tackle the BMW X6. Currently only the GLE 43 AMG is being sold, known as the GLE 450 when it was initially launched in 2016, which comes with a 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged V6 motor, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Exterior-wise, it shares a few design cues of the new S-Class Coupe, such as the roofline and rear tail-lights. The interior features sports seats, a sports steering wheel and a new infotainment display. The cabin is covered in silver shadow accents, and aluminum or wood trim.Safety features include Driving Assistance package which includes features such as DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist and PRE-SAFE PLUS. The Parking package includes the 360-degree camera and Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC. Night-time vision is improved by the LED Intelligent Light System which is a standard feature on all models; adverse weather conditions with impaired view are defused by MAGIC VISION CONTROL the heated, adaptive windscreen wiper system.

This VW marks the return of the Jetta nameplate to the Middle East, replacing the Bora lineup. However, it could have been better. Engines choices include a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit and an odd 2.5-litre 5-cylinder unit that is conspicuously underpowered for its size. Both engines are equipped with either a 5-speed manual gearbox or the new 6-speed Tiptronic automatic. The Jetta GLI debuted later in 2008, with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine and 6-speed DSG automanual gearbox. Volkswagens are known for better-than-average handling, and the new Jetta is said to be no exception. The new Jetta is larger than the previous Bora, and it features a more spacious interior stuffed with convenience and lavished with Volkswagen's attention to detail. Even the least-expensive model offers an elegant, high-quality cabin. Standard equipment include power windows, AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power outside mirrors, split/folding rear seats, remote central power locking, front airbags, side-impact airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and available electronic stability control. The GLI exclusively gets black-out body trim, 17-inch wheels, and a slightly-upgraded interior.

Based on a Mazda platform, the Focus is one of the best handling cars in its class. It comes in two different body styles, namely a sedan and a five-door hatchback. The Focus is a popular car in Europe where it is built, and is fairly well-built at that. The hatchback is especially unique, with an aggressively sloping roofline and high-mounted slim tail lamps, while offering a usable load space without wheel arch intrusion. The sedan looks more like the ugly tall small cars running around nowadays. Both the versions cost the same, but all are available in various trim levels. The interior is especially nice, with the centre console being the hub of the interior design. The standard motor is an anaemic 1.6-litre Duratec four-cylinder engine. Features include electric-hydraulic power-assisted steering, and choice of a Durashift 5-speed manual transmission and a Durashift 4-speed automatic. Safety features include optional side thorax airbags and inflatable side curtains alongside the standard dual front airbags.

The Cadillac ATS is the smallest offering from the American luxury brand. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS will be offered with two engine choices. One will be a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine and other a 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive 6.2-litre V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lambo to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. Introduced in 2002, the Roadster came in 2004, while production ended by 2006, to be replaced by the Murcielago LP640 coupe model with a larger 6.5-litre V12. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops. The rear air intakes and spoiler are adjusted automatically, depending on speed, to improve aerodynamics. Unlike older Lamborghinis, these cars are known to be a bit more forgiving for casual cruising.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 sportback is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new model of the Audi Q3 Sportback came out in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

An all-new Honda Pilot was released as a 2016 model. It got a facelift for the 2019 model year. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-liter Direct Injected V6 engine with Variable Cylinder Management (VCM), mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base EX model can be had in 2WD or AWD form, while the EX-L and Touring trims only come with AWD and no low-range gearing. The Pilot includes a traction management system and is featured on all models except the EX 2WD, with pushbutton mode selection and TFT mode display on the cockpit instrument panel. In addition, EX (AWD) & EXL grades offer 200 mm of ground clearance for better off-road ability. There is also a sand-mode feature. Features include halogen projector headlights in EX and EXL grades whereas LED projector headlights in Touring grade, which also gets a panoramic glass roof. Some of the other features standard in all grades includes front fog lights, LED taillights and LED daytime running lights along with Tailgate Spoiler, power door mirrors and LED turn light indicators. For the interior, an 8-inch touchscreen, standard in all grades, gives you access to audio system controls and other display features. The Touring grade includes second row captain's chairs, which provides easy walk through between the second and third row for a 7 passenger configuration. Other amenities include tri-zone automatic climate control, rear air conditioning duct in the second and third row seats, rear door sunshade, sun glass holder and conversation mirror, cargo area hidden storage for extra luggage, active noise control (ANC) for a quieter cabin, with a rear entertainment system with a 9-inch display screen available in the Touring grade. Safety features include Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD), Hill Start Assist (HSA), Agile Handle Assist (AHA) and Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS).

The 2016 Mazda 2 is a new generation model. It is a hatchback and now uses its own "Skyactiv" chassis and engine. In 2020, it got a slight facelift. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a new 6-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. LED headlights, fog lamps, leather seats, heads-up display, rear spoiler and 16-inch alloys are some of the optional features. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The top-spec model gets 6 airbags.

The basis for the Mazda CX-5's new look is the company's new "KODO Soul of Motion" design theme, with a new front-end that features a five-point grille and new signature wings. Inside, the 5-seater cabin offers features such as a 4:2:4 three-way split-folding rear seat. As far as the upholstery goes, leather and two kinds of fabric are available for the seats and trim in two colours. The soft-touch material adopted for the majority of dash surfaces and door trim is offset by a central panel featuring glossy piano-black treatment. The only engine available is a direct-injection 2.0-litre "SKYACTIV-G" 4-cylinder that has a 13:1 compression for more torque, better fuel economy and lower emissions, although slightly detuned compared to the motors offered in Western countries. The engine is mated is mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There is front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive available for the 2.0. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard.

The SX4 is Suzuki's compact car offering. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model. For 2013, Suzuki started offering only the all-wheel drive hatchback version. It is fitted with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

The SQ 5 is the top performance version of the Q5 compact SUV. An all-new model came out in 2018. Under the hood, it comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. The four-wheel-drive model gets standard features like power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, Nappa leather interior, cruise control, keyless entry and start, auto headlamps, auto headlight range adjustment, fog lamps, xenon headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, navigation, panoramic glass roof, 3-zone automatic A/C, Bluetooth, Bang & Olufsen sound system, front and rear parking sensors and 21-inch ally wheels. Optional equipment include electric front seats with memory function, electric folding mirrors with heated and memory, side steps, adaptive cruise control, adaptive lights, red brake callipers, dynamic steering, more leather padding and sports seats. Safety features include front, side and head airbags, traction control, brake assist and stability control.

The sixth-generation Nissan Z shrinks in overall size and gains in engine size to become a more focussed sports car. The all-new 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. Initially launched in late 2009 in coupe form, the drop-top 370Z Roadster came in summer 2010, offering almost the same chassis rigidity as the coupe and a power soft-top. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. The V60 straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level V60 T4 model comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The higher-spec V60 2.0T model comes with 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic as well. Later on the more powerful V60 T5 2.0-litre turbocharged engine came was offered. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. Very few were sold in the GCC.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is smaller than the Armada, but still big enough to qualify as a big 4WD. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its smooth on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The latest engine is a 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A new five-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features. After the launch of the all-new 2010 model, this older version continued to be sold briefly in a stripped-down format at a lower base price.

The compact Actyon looks like nothing else on the road. If there ever was a sporty-looking 4WD, this is it. Too bad its 2.3-litre four-cylinder joke of an engine does not back up its looks. The engine is mated to a manual or an automatic gearbox, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Based on the same platform as other Ssangyong 4WD vehicles, the five-door Actyon can seat up to five people and comes with a host of cabin features, including a liftgate rear end.  Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, electric mirrors, alloy wheels of different sizes, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, whatever that is, while traction control, hill descent control and stability control are all also available.

The Optima is a credible entry into the midsize field. Not as big as the usual Japanese models, it still offers good interior space and a comfortable drive. This front-wheel-drive offers much improved quality over previous Kia creations, and its derivative actually looks pleasant. Powered by either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, or a respectable 2.7-litre V6 with a 5-speed automatic, both cars offer a fair bit of standard equipment. Available features, standard or otherwise, include basic air-conditioning, glass-integrated antenna, AM/FM radio cassette player with CD and MP3 capability, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, luggage net hook and luggage net for the spacious trunk, optional electric sunroof, keyless entry with alarm, cloth or leather seats, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, dual power mirrors, power windows, front fog lamps, battery saver, 60/40 split-folding rear seat and 16-inch alloy wheels.

The Skoda Kodiaq is the VW-owned Czech brand's first proper foray into the crossover market after the van-like Skoda Yeti was cancelled. There is a choice of two engines , one a 1.4-litre turbo in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive forms, and another a 2.0-litre turbo in all-wheel-drive form. The smaller engine comes with a 6-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic while the larger one gets a 7-speed DSG auto. Seating can be 5 or 7, depending on trim level. Features include a touchscreen multimedia system, cruise control, keyless entry, ABS with EBD, a full set of airbags and all the other other usual bits and bobs.

An all-new Ford F-150 was made available in the GCC in 2021. It comes with a 5.0-litre V8, a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine and 3.5 turbo hybrid, all mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor include power steering, power windows, cruise control, keyless entry, manual single-zone A/C, bucket seats with manual lumbar support, fabric upholstery, SYNC voice recognition communications and entertainment system, AM/FM stereo with 7 speakers, leather wrapped steering-wheel with mounted audio controls, reverse parking sensors with camera, and 17-inch alloy wheels with all-terrain tyres. Optional features on the 2021 Ford F-150 include the SYNC 3 system with an 12-inch touch screen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, B & O audio system and sub-woofer, power seats, navigation, moonroof, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, ventilated seats, active park assist, adaptive cruise control and blind spot monitor. All models of the 2021 Ford F-150 get front driver and passenger airbags, side curtain airbags, rollover sensor and stability control.

The Mitsubishi Mirage takes on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. In 2017, it got a facelift and few interior upgrades. In Saudi Arabia, it is sold as the Spacestar. This sub-compact hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

The S-Type sporting sedan is a great example of a polarising retro design, and though we love its looks, many out there don't. It was originally launched for 2000, then upgraded for 2003, and received a facelift in 2005. The 2003 update apparently had improved the car dramatically, while adding a set of new V8 motors. For 2005, Jaguar updated the styling, revised the interior, and retuned the suspension. Engines include the adequate base 3.0-litre V6, the decent 4.2-litre V8 and the over-the-top supercharged 4.2-litre V8, all mated to a ZF six-speed automatic with basic manual shift capability. Jaguar's quality has been dramatically improved over the past few years. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, power adjustable steering column with tilt-away entry and exit action, twin-function trip computer, and cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Options include satellite navigation, power adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, and rain-sensing wipers. Front and rear parking sensors, adaptive cruise control, upgraded upholstery, sports suspension and other options are also available.

The BAIC D20 is a facelifted version of the A1 hatchback. It is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They are come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Volkswagen is attempting to move upscale and the Phaeton is its new flagship luxury sedan, built alongside its platform-mate, the Bentley Continental GT. The VW Phaeton is available in three models, namely a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a 6.0-litre W12, all mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission and all impressively powerful. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a navigation system, all-wheel drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies.
