Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

The Kia Cerato Koup is a 2-door coupe version of the well-received Cerato sedan. Mildly sporty in its demeanour, the Koup is available with a 2.0-litre "MPI" 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. Interior comfort is enhanced by lowering the cabin floor and the seats, and by fitting wider front seat cushions with an increased cushion angle for greater thigh support. Available features, depending on market, include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, intelligent key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors.

The Grand Cherokee was all-new for the 2006 model year, and for 2008, it has been updated with a new front end, HID headlights with integrated turn lenses and new 17-inch and 18-inch wheels. Interior updates include a new centre console and a four-gauge instrument cluster with LED illumination. The new base engine is a 3.7-litre V6. It also continues with an upgraded 4.7-litre V8, a carryover 5.7-litre Hemi V8 and an SRT-exclusive 6.1-litre V8. Cloth upholstery is standard, as are power windows, power locks with remote keyless entry, eight-way power driver's seat,  CD audio, driver information center, 60/40 split folding rear seat, and available parking sensors. All models offer full-time four-wheel drive, with low-range gearing. Higher models get leather upholstery, Boston Acoustics six-speaker six-CD changer and MP3 capability, power adjustable pedals, power front seats, rain-sensing automatic wipers, electrochromic rearview mirror, tyre pressure monitor with display, adjustable roof rack crossrails, and more.  The fancy Overland model adds real wood accents on the doors and console, two-tone leather and ultra-suede seats, leather-covered console and armrest, reverse-parking sensor and more. The rocket-like SRT-8 gets stiff suspension for the road, but gives up its off-road ability. Safety features include a stability system with roll mitigation, ABS brakes with brake assist, traction control, and numerous airbags.

An all-new model came out in 2019 for the Hyundai Santa Fe. The new generation model is longer than the previous model. The 2019 Hyundai Santa Fe comes with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 3.5-litre V6 motor, with both units mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Two-wheel drive is standard in the 2.4-litre base model, while all the other trims are in four-wheel drive in the higher 2.4-litre and 3.5-litre models. Some of the optional features include panoramic sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, reverse camera, leather seats, memory seats with cooling & heating for front passengers, memory package for mirrors with auto folding, smart key with engine start, automatic lights and rain sensing wipers. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution(EBD) and traction control.

From 2012, the design all-new Porsche 911 incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than the previous generation. It is still a 2+2 seater. In 2016 the 911 got turbocharged engines and minor exterior upgrades. The base 911 Carrera Cabriolet is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S Cabriolet gets the same engine specs but with more power. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The 2016 Carrera S models also has the option of all-wheel-steer.

An all-new Chevrolet Captiva was released as 2021 model year. The Captiva name comes back into the GCC market after a 4 year absence as a Chinese-built 7-seater compact SUV. Under the hood is a 1.4-turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features on the front-wheel-drive Captiva LS include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fabric seats, cruise control, 8-inch touch screen for the infotainment system, four speakers, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lights, fog lights, reverse camera, multi-function steering wheel and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Captiva LT gets additional keyless entry, push start engine,  6 speakers, sunroof and automatic climate control.  The top Captiva Premier gets more options such as 17-inch alloy wheels, electrically adjustable driver's seat, 7-inch multi-function dashboard, electric parking brake, front parking sensors and power-folding mirrors. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, EBD and ABS.

The radical C4 offers a hip and modern hatchback with out-of-this-world styling and innovative new ideas, with items such as a multi-functional fixed-centred steering wheel and an built-in air freshener. Available as either a three-door or a five-door, it is already popular on the Internet for its dancing-robot TV ads. Besides eye-catching styling, it comes with a long list of standard equipment. Firstly, the base engine is a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with either a manual or an automatic. The top model is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic. The C4 comes standard with alloy wheels, cruise control and the power features features. Options include a panoramic sunroof and xenon dual-function directional headlamps. On the inside, where the C4 pays attention to detail with touches like the damped push-open drawers on the dashboard and an abundance of soft-touch trim. There are six airbags as standard, as well as ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Emergency Braking Assistance. Electronic Stability Programme with Traction Control is optional.

The Toyota Aurion got a complete redesign for the 2012 model year alongside its Camry sibling. The Aurion is essentially a redone version of the Camry, but fitted with a V6 engine and better interior appointments. All models get a carryover 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. In the UAE, the 2012 Toyota Aurion comes in only two grades, namely Sports and Grande. In other markets such as Saudi Arabia, the grades are dubbed as Touring, SE and Grande, with a base model that isn't offered in the UAE. Only the Aurion Grande gets leather trim, 7-inch touchscreen navigation & DVD player, Bi-Xenon headlights with intelligent "AFS" and headlamp cleaner, and 8 way memory seats for the driver, all standard for the UAE. Navigation is optional in the Saudi model. The Aurion Sports model loses those features, but is instead fitted with a sport-tuned suspension, fabric sport seats with enhanced support, a newly-designed three spoke steering, paddle shifters, stereo with 6.1-inch display, 17-inch wheels and an exclusive front grille as well as sporty front and rear bumper skirts, all standard for the UAE. The moonroof and 17-inch alloys is optional on the Saudi Touring model. Other features include covered cup-holders, dual-zone auto a/c, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, keyless start, cruise control, rear parking sensors, front and side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control and more.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class made its debut as a 2014 model year. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S500 comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine, while the S400 gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The BLS offers all the looks of a Cadillac CTS, with all the driving dynamics of a Saab 9-3, on which is is based. Built on GM's corporate front-wheel-drive platform, the BLS is an entry-level model with three turbo engines taken straight from Saab. There are two 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engines that can be mated to  a five-speed automatic transmission. The top engine is a 2.8-litre V6 turbo. Built in Europe to somehow compete with German sports sedans, the usual power features are all there, as are six airbags and stability control features. The base model is fitted with 16-inch alloy wheels, climate control, cruise control, electric windows and door mirrors, a seven speaker CD system with MP3 inlet, and wheel-mounted controls for the cruise controls and stereo. Additional features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloys, fog lights and rain sensing wipers, leather trim, dual zone climate control, electric adjustment for driver and front passenger seats, a Bose stereo system with nine speakers and a six-CD changer, auto dimming rearview mirrors inside and out and rear parking sensors.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. In 2019, it got a facelift and a new engine. It is a compact sedan with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

An all-new Infiniti QX50 came out in mid 2018 as a 2019 model. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a CVT. It comes in standard front-wheel drive and optional all-wheel drive. Standard features on the base "Luxe" model include electric power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, LED headlamps, LED foglamps, auto headlights, leatherette seats, power seats, power lumbar for driver seat, leather wrapped steering wheel, paddle shifts, power liftgate, dual display Navigation system, with upper 8-inch and lower 7-inch VGA LCD touch screens, voice recognition, Bluetooth, 6-speaker AM/FM/CD with 4 USBs, Tri-zone automatic climate control with rear seat vents, cruise control, rearview camera with front and back sensors, and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, ABS, traction control system (TCS), stability control (VDC), electronic brake force distribution (EBD), tyre pressure monitoring  system (TPMS) and hill start assist. The "Luxe Essential ProAssist" model gets leather seats, rear-seat slide, recline, and fold-flat function, panoramic moonroof, remote engine-start, push-button start, rain-sensing wipers, high beam assist, Bose®Performance Series audio system with 16 speakers and 360 camera with moving object detection and front and rear sonar system. Additional safety features include adaptive cruise control, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, blind spot warning, and predictive forward collision warning. The "Luxe Sensory ProAssist" variant gets additional 20-inch dark painted alloy wheels, higher quality leather seats, climate control front seats, and motion activated tailgate. The top "Autograph" variant gets premium grade leather, seats with quilted stitching, with blue piping between white leather and blue suede, blue suede upper door, and centre console lid accents. Additional safety equipment include intelligent cruise control with full speed range and hold, and blind spot intervention.

The Ferrari Roma is the Italian luxury brand's front-engine grand tourer model. Under the hood is a 3.9-litre turbocharged V8 motor, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Dodge Challenger debuted in 2008, went on sale in the GCC by 2010, and has already been upgraded for the 2011 model year. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. From this version, the Challenger became available in V6-powered base trim and top-spec V8-powered SRT-8 trim in the GCC. Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger packs either a 3.6-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 6.4-litre Hemi V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual. In 2013, the Challenger R/T was introduced in this region, which comes with a 5.7-litre V8 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the V6 include sporty suspension, cloth upholstery, alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo, power accessories and not much else. The SRT8 "392" gets bi-xenon headlights, leather-alcantara sport seats, CD stereo, and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front and side airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was all-new in 2014 and facelifted for 2018. It is only available with a 1.5-litre engine and a CVT automatic in the UAE, in SE and SE+ trims. In Saudi Arabia, the 1.3-litre is available as a fleet standard Y trim with a manual transmission, while the 1.5-litre is available in Y and YX trims with CVT. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the SE+, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, auto a/c, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels and more. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD). Tyre-pressure monitor and stability control are now standard in the UAE on all trims.

The Citroen C4 is the compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Only one engine option is available, which is the naturally aspirated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, heated power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, daytime running headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD player/AUX and MP3 capability, front fog lamps with cornering capability, hill-start assist and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features are good as it gets front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA) and Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) with traction control.

The Tata Xenon is the Indian manufacturer's answer to commercial vehicles which is currently dominated by the Japanese. Featuring a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine, the Xenon comes standard with power steering, power windows and air-conditioning. Unlike the name, it does not come with xenon headlamps. The Xenon can be had in either single cab or double cab, with the option of two-wheel drive or four-wheel-drive.

Supposed to be Peugeot's flagship model, the 607 offers premium levels of refinement and equipment. First launched in 2002 and mildly facelifted a few times, the 607 was the first Peugeot sedan to push design boundaries, but lost out in drive due to an unremarkable front-wheel-drive chassis. The 607 was restyled in 2004, and still looks good as ever. Among the exterior cosmetic changes, the front of the 607 was restyled and its overall length increased slightly, but it is still not big enough to qualify as a full-size car. The interior of the 607 is more spacious than any other Peugeot model. The only engine is a 3.0-litre V6 with a six-speed automatic transmission with tiptronic function. Standard features include bi-zone digital air conditioning with climate control, a heat reflective windshield and lightly tinted glass, leather with aluminium detailing, electrically-adjustable front seats, and power windows, locks and mirrors. It is well-equipped in terms of passive safety, with eight airbags as standard, including front-and-rear side and curtain bags.

The Ferrari 812 Superfast replaced the F12 Berlinetta and is the fastest naturally aspirated model they have ever produced at the time. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Electric power steering was introduced in this model. The car also saw the introduction of the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Citroen DS3 is the smallest car offered in the GCC from the French brand. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. The exterior can be had in contrasting body and roof colours, with many different colour combinations available for customers. The standard features on the "So Chic" DS3 variant include power windows, power steering, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, automatic A/C, cruise control, scented air-freshner, interior mood lighting, stereo radio with MP3/AUX/CD compatibility, steering mounted controls, LED daytime-running lights, chrome door handles, sports suspension and 16-inch alloy wheels. The "Ultra Prestige" trim-level gets a rear spoiler with integrated brake-lamp, double chrome exhaust tips, side-impact chrome bar, roof-coloured wing mirror, front and rear carpet mats, aluminium drilled pedals, navigation system, automatic headlamps and wipers, rear-parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), emergency braking assistance, Electronic Stability Control (ESC), driver, front passenger, front lateral and curtain airbags and, front seat belt pre-tensioners with force-limiters.

The hard-top convertible 308 CC model came in 2010. The CC came only with the turbo engine. All versions come with an automatic gearbox. Standard features include driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, CD player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats and remote key with central locking. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with GSM built-in telephone, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors.

The Tata Indica is an outdated hatchback first launched in India back in 1998, and on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica is considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger car. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The Asian-market Ford Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a work truck which provides versatile usage, but are slightly concerned about basic comforts. The Ranger is designed to meet the needs of this customer group while offering exceptional value for money. It is a midsize pickup based on the Asian Mazda-based truck platform and built in Thailand. It can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The extensive engine range includes a 2.2-litre petrol engine, a 2.6-litre petrol engine and a 3.0-litre turbodiesel engine, all with a five-speed manual gearbox. Features include air-conditioning, basic radio cassette player, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, 15-inch or 16-inch wheels, available power locks and windows, and decent off-road capability due to low-range gearing in 4WD models. The Ranger can be had in either two-door single cab or four-door double cab body styles.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT, or Mercedes-AMG GT as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Four variants of the AMG GT will be available as of 2017, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT C gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT C also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT R comes with more power, modified suspension and more aerodynamic thanks to exterior mods. The GT R also gets all-wheel steering for better handling performance. For the 2020 model year, Mercedes released the AMG GT R Pro version, The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control. In 2021, an AMG GT Black Series joined the lineup with much more power and even sportier suspension setup. A lot of carbon-fibre has been used for the body parts and the aerodynamic kit.

The 3 is a fairly roomy and affordable compact car, with the sportiest handling and the poorest engine in this class of cars. The Mazda 3, or Mazda3 as company likes to call it, is available as a four-door sedan in this region, while a five-door has been released from 2006 onwards, all with only the base engine available. The 3 has an interesting rounded shape that hides the height which is necessary for a roomier cabin. The Mazda 3 features a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with five trim levels, of which only the base version has a standard manual gearbox, with the rest having a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Available features, depending on trim level, includes leather, sunroof, and a premium sound system with a CD changer. As with the engine choices, safety options are limited in the Middle East too. Available airbags only include a standard driver side and an optional passenger-side bag. And ABS brakes are standard only on the higher models. Available on all but the base model are power windows, mirrors, central locking and keyless entry. A sporty appearance kit is optional.

The Sirion is Daihatsu's entry in the sub-compact segment, packed with features and space. The little Sirion offers a generous amount of space for the front passengers, including a fair bit of room between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Rear passengers aren't so lucky, but they still get reasonable amounts of leg space between front and rear seats. The rear doors open wide to an angle of around 80 degrees, allowing easy entry and exit, and the tailgate eases handling of large luggage. There is a full 630 litres of luggage space with two people on board and the rear seats folded down. With five on board, it still has 225 litres. The top of the back door has decent head clearance and a pull handle also makes it easy to close the door. A luggage room lamp adds convenience, along with the CD/AM/FM Radio, power windows, central locking, front airbags, cup holders in the doors and the centre console, and split rear seats that are 60:40 foldable. Powered by a 1.3-litre 4-cylinder motor, the Sirion shifts gears using a 4-speed automatic, as the manual is not offered here. 14-inch steel wheels are standard, while alloys are optional, among other things.

The attractive GranCabrio is convertible version of the GranTurismo, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is offered with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. The cloth roof drops electrically in 28 seconds and this can be done on the move at speeds of up to 30 kph. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. It is equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Edge debuted for the 2007 model year, and has been heavily revised for 2011, with a new face, higher-quality interior, better entertainment features and two engines to choose from. The updated Edge features a big new version of the corporate chrome grille, along with new headlights, tail lamps and wheel designs externally. A new Edge Sport model can be had with a blacked-out grille, smoked headlights and huge 22-inch alloys. The newly-designed interior still features seating for five with a fold-down rear seat to maximise cargo room, as well as a soft-touch dashboard, optional mood lighting and better materials. The Edge SE, Edge SEL and Edge Limited models are powered by an upgraded 3.5-litre V6, while the Edge Sport gets a 3.7-litre V6. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, and available with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Standard features include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC voice-controlled multimedia computer and Sony stereo, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. The Edge Limited is the only one to be offered with options such as HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and 20-inch alloys, but the Edge Sport is the only one to get the black grille, paddle shifters, larger engine, stiffer suspension and 22-inch wheels. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter can be classified as one of the largest commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value.

The compact Actyon looks like nothing else on the road. If there ever was a sporty-looking 4WD, this is it. Too bad its 2.3-litre four-cylinder joke of an engine does not back up its looks. The engine is mated to a manual or an automatic gearbox, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Based on the same platform as other Ssangyong 4WD vehicles, the five-door Actyon can seat up to five people and comes with a host of cabin features, including a liftgate rear end.  Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, electric mirrors, alloy wheels of different sizes, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, whatever that is, while traction control, hill descent control and stability control are all also available.

The SLR McLaren is an impressive celebration of Mercedes-Benz and its Formula 1 partner McLaren in the development and production of high-performance sports cars. The two-seater, with its striking swing-wing doors and styling elements borrowed from the Formula 1 Silver Arrows, builds on the legacy of the famous SLR racecars of the 1950s. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, it is designed to ensure a high standard of safety, comfort and class-leading speed. The specially-developed supercharged 5.4-litre V8 engine, with an automatic, delivers an impressive output rivaling traditional super cars, powering up to as much as 334 kph. The body of the new SLR, like F1 racecars, is made from lightweight carbon-fibre composites. However, the body itself is hardly the most attractive of supercars, with an overlong snout and a short rear. Many might confuse it for a 'bargain' SL or SLK, though it should still attract a lot of attention. The SLR has a spoiler mounted on the rear which pops up when braking from high speeds. A special lighter 722 edition has black alloy rims and more power. A convertible Roadster joined the range for 2008.

An all-new Mercedes-G Class was revealed in 2019. The first generation had run from 1990 till 2018. The G 500 comes with a twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 model, combined with a 9-speed automatic transmission. It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before.  Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. It got a facelift and engine upgrades in 2015. The Navigator's four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The Jeep Gladiator is a 4-door pickup based on a stretched Wrangler platform. Standard power comes from a 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 mated to an 8-speed automatic and four-wheel-drive. All Gladiator models are Trail Rated. Available features include LED headlights and taillights, an 8.4-inch touchscreen, a nine-speaker Alpine premium sound system, keyless entry, front TrailCam camera, blind-spot monitoring, Rear Cross Path detection, rear parking sensors, Advanced Brake Assist, Full-Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus, Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop, Trail Rail Cargo Management System, spray-in bedliner and trailer towing features. Gladiator Rubicon models are equipped with signature red tow hooks, Rock-Trac 4x4 system, featuring a two-speed transfer case with a 4:1 low-range gear ratio, front and rear heavy-duty Dana 44 axles, Tru-Lok electric front- and rear-axle lockers, segment-exclusive electronic sway bar disconnect, cab and bed rock rails. A limited run of 300 Jeep Gladiator Launch Edition models were made available in the Middle East. Along with a Launch Edition badge, the Gladiator has unique design elements including 17-inch mid-gloss black aluminium wheels, 33-inch BFgoodrich tyres, a wrapped instrument panel mid-bolster painted in Monaco silver and black leather seats with red accent stitching. The Launch Edition also features a body-colour hard top and fender flares.

Mini released all-new Clubman model as a 2016 model. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. Unlike the old one, this one features proper 4 doors on the side. In 2020, it got a slight facelift and new tech inside. The Mini Cooper Clubman will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S Clubman gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The Cooper can be  had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the Cooper S Clubman is available with a 6-speed manual gear or an 8-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The all-new Chevrolet Corvette debuted as a 2014 model year. It features a new LT1 V8 engine, but still has the same 6.2-litre displacement. Power has gone up however, with the new Corvette Stingray producing more horsepower and torque. More interesting is the 7-speed manual transmission it has, with rev-matching technology. For customers who don't like the third pedal, there is a 6-speed automatic transmission, the same gearbox as the previous generation, but tweaked with different internals for better performance. A new electric power steering system and cylinder deactivation help to improve fuel economy, said to be now less than the previous generation. There is a Drive Mode Selector which has 5 settings Weather, Eco, Tour, Sport and Track. Looking at the exterior, we see some similar design elements from other brands such as the new 2013 SRT Viper from the front, the vents and windows of a Nissan GT-R on the side, and rear fender-top vents like that of a Ferrari 458 Italia. The rear still incorporates the trademark four-lamp design, however it looks more like a modified design from the Chevrolet Camaro. The four exhaust tips lined up together is one of those things you either love or hate. The interior is where they have made some much-needed improvements. The designers made sure they cover as much of the interior as possible with soft-touch materials. It features a more driver-focused cockpit and a smaller steering wheel. New seats with more bolstering have been added. A Z51 package adds more sporting suspension as well as extra trim such as a rear spoiler. Safety features include front and side airbags, ESP, ABS and seat-belt pretensioners.

The Volkswagen Teramont is the German brand's first entry into the seven-seater SUV market. While it is longer than the Touareg, it is not their flagship SUV. It is built in the United States and sold as the Atlas over there. VW felt the demand for SUVs and 7-seaters in this region was healthy enough to be introduced here. Teramont continues the tradition of naming their SUV line-up starting with a "T". In 2021 it received a facelift and some interior upgrades. Under the hood, the crossover has two engine options. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit, which is available in FWD and AWD, while there is the optional 3.6-litre V6 motor available only as AWD. Largely optional features include cloth or leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, navigation, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry, starter button, panoramic sunroof, real wood trim, power-folding rear seat, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go function, lane departure warning system, blind-spot monitor, pre-crash system with full automatic emergency braking, ABS, a full set of front and side airbags, parking assist with four cameras, LED tail lamps, LED headlights, power-adjustable front seats with memory, seat heaters and a choice of 18-inch, 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels.

In 2016, the Infiniti QX50 got a minor facelift. The wheelbase also increased slightly as well to provide increased legroom to rear passengers. The small QX50 is what Infiniti likes to call a coupe-crossover, although it is really a compact five-door wagon. It is powered by a 3.7-litre V6.  It comes with a 7-speed automatic, as well as standard all-wheel-drive. It has an excellent leather interior, power front seats, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain airbag system. There is no low-range gearing as the QX50 sits low and the chassis is tuned for on-road dynamics. The QX50 also comes with nifty features such as a seven-inch colour display with Infiniti controller for the trip computer and additional vehicle information, including the Infiniti DVD navigation system. But the most interesting feature by far is the around-view parking system that uses four cameras to simulate a 360-degree image of what is around the vehicle, thereby making parking easier in tight spots.

The Changan CS75 is a compact SUV from China. It got a facelift in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the CS75 "Fashion" trim include power windows, central locking, remote on key, cruise control, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 8 speakers, multifunctional steering wheel, USB+AUX ports, leather seats, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and LED headlamps. Higher "Elite" trim gets additional 7-inch screen, keyless entry and start and auto climate control.Safety features includes dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist. The top option gets addition side curtain airbags.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

Introduced in late 2016, the Bentley Bentayga is the British luxury brand's first SUV model. It is powered by a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre W12 engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive system. It gets a variable displacement system, which shuts down half of the engine under defined conditions. Intake and exhaust valves, fuel injection and ignition are all shut down on defined cylinders, with the engine running as a 6-cylinder for improved efficiency. A 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 model was introduced for 2018, also with an 8-speed automatic. Other notable features include LED headlights, a front skid-plate, front fender vents, aluminium roof-rails, panoramic glass roof and 20 to 22-inch alloy wheels. The interior is, as expected, nothing short of luxury, with its premium leather upholstery, metallic accents, an infotainment system with an 8-inch display and 22-way adjustable front seats with heating, ventilation and massage functions. Bentley is also offering a 4-seat variant with each seat having its own set of power controls and massage functions. The seats are divided by a small centre-console which consists of cup holders, storage compartments and USB charging ports. Other optional equipment include a high-end premium audio system and entertainment Android tablets with 4G, WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity, and even a self-winding Breitling dash-clock option that costs as much as the base price. A Mulliner specification adds more customisability in terms of paint, leather and wood.

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Based on a platform shared with the Bentley Continental GT, the Phaeton received a minor facelift for 2012, incorporating LEDs both front and back. The VW Phaeton is available with two carryover engines, namely a 3.2-litre V6 and a 4.2-litre V8, while a 6.0-litre W12 is supposedly available on special order. All are mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a new touchscreen navigation system, all-wheel-drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies. Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

The Volvo S90 debuted as an all-new model in 2017, introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new S90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring elongated taillights and dual exhaust tips. The 2021 Volvo S90 got a facelift along with some interior updates. In the GCC, the only petrol engine on offer was a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mild-hybrid engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's latest hatchback offering, replacing the C30 with this new 5-door model. The base engine offered here, for the V40 T4, is a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. The other version is the V40 T5, fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 5-cylinder for the GCC market. Available with either engine, variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels, as well as the V40 Cross Country model with faux skid-plates and a slightly-raised suspension. All versions are front-wheel-drive, although the Cross Country can be had with all-wheel-drive as well. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

The XJ remains the luxury flagship of the Jaguar range. It is a truly handsome large car, with elegant lines rather than the random curves of its German rivals. The XJ-Series comes in regular and long-wheelbase versions, depending on model. While the sportier option would be the standard-wheelbase models, the long-wheelbase models offer enough rear-seat room to recline and watch a movie while having lunch on a tray. The Jaguar XJ8 was launched as an all-new model for 2003, along with the high-performance XJR, offering superior ride and handling to their predecessors thanks to their rigid lightweight aluminium structure and computer-controlled suspension. Other model variations include the XJ6, the XJ8 Sovereign and the Super V8. Engines include the 3.0-litre V6, the 3.6-litre V6, the 4.2-litre V8 and the supercharged 4.2-litre V8, all mated to a six-speed automatic. Standard are leather upholstery, power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone climate control, alloy wheels, and an eight-speaker stereo with CD player.Available features include self-leveling air suspension, adaptive suspension damping, dynamic stability control, xenon headlamps, navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, an electronic parking brake, and reverse park assist.  Safety features standard on all models include frontal, side-impact and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control. The cars were facelifted in 2007 with a mildly-new front end.

Porsche released the all-new Porsche Taycan in 2020. It is their first all-electric only model in the lineup. Power comes via two synchronous motors, one mounted on each axle, making the four-door saloon an all-wheel drive. Only the Taycan 4S is currently available with a 79.2 kWh battery. It gets the world’s first two-speed transmission in an EV, installed on the rear axle. The Taycan is paired with variable torque distribution and Porsche Traction Management (PTM).

The all-new Celerio is Suzuki's latest mini-car offering, launching in the middle of 2009 to be sold alongside the existing Alto. In reality, the Celerio is sold as an Alto replacement in other countries, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The basis for the Mazda CX-5's new look is the company's new "KODO Soul of Motion" design theme, with a new front-end that features a five-point grille and new signature wings. Inside, the 5-seater cabin offers features such as a 4:2:4 three-way split-folding rear seat. As far as the upholstery goes, leather and two kinds of fabric are available for the seats and trim in two colours. The soft-touch material adopted for the majority of dash surfaces and door trim is offset by a central panel featuring glossy piano-black treatment. The base engine available is a direct-injection 2.0-litre "SKYACTIV-G" 4-cylinder that has a 13:1 compression for more torque, better fuel economy and lower emissions, although slightly detuned compared to the motors offered in Western countries. The engine is mated is mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. For the 2014 model year, a 2.5-litre engine was introduced with more power. There is front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive available for the 2.0, but the 2.5 only comes with all-wheel-drive. Each engine variant has two trim levels. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top 2.5-litre version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The all-new Celerio is Suzuki's latest mini-car offering, launching in the middle of 2009 to be sold alongside the existing Alto. In reality, the Celerio is sold as an Alto replacement in other countries, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class made its debut as a 2014 model year. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S500 comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine, while the S400 gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Volvo XC40 debuted as a new subcompact crossover model for 2018, slotting in under the XC60. Initially, the only version on offer is the XC40 T5 with a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. The two trim levels at launch are R-Design and Momentum. The interior features Volvo's latest design ideas such as the vertical a/c vents, aside from the portrait-mode touchscreen. The mid-range Momentum model is generously equipped with a 12.3-inch digital instrument display, a 9-inch touchscreen infotainment system, dual-zone climate control, rear parking assist, and leather seats as standard. Stepping up to the R-Design trim will add leather and aluminum trim, twin exhaust tips, and sport suspension. Safety features include a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking, City Safety for pedestrian detection, and the Pilot Assist system for semi-autonomous steering, acceleration, and braking on “well-marked” roads, a feature that will work up to 128 kph.

The redesigned-for-2008 CTS 4-door sedan gave rise to the Cadillac CTS-V sedan in 2009. Powering the rear-wheel-drive CTS-V is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 that can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. The exterior is characterized by a larger chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V also gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The Ford Expedition is a full-size 4WD that's carried on virtually unchanged since 2007, but started gaining ground in some markets after the demise of the Crown Victoria in 2012. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. The Expedition comes with a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Coupe is probably the only sports car in its price range among the hordes of boring sedans sold in the Middle East. It may be front-wheel-drive, not so powerful and hardly the best handler of them all, but darn does it look good from most angles. Powered by either a weak 2.0-litre four-cylinder or a decent 2.7-litre V6, only the smaller motor comes with a manual with optional available automatic, while the larger motor gets only an automatic. Standard basic features include a single airbag, power steering, central door locks, power windows, fog lamps, a rear spoiler with high-mounted brake lamp, outside electric mirrors, semi-cloth seats, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, rear wiper with washer, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The full options list includes dual airbags, ABS brakes, cruise control, keyless entry with burglar alarm, power sunroof, leather interior, CD player and 17-inch alloy wheels. Bumping up the horsepower would've made it a real contender in the sports car market.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

The Ferrari F8 Tributo replaced the 488 GTB in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

This seriously outdated version of the Land Cruiser, updated in 2001, is technically a fullsize pickup, staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The pickup, known as Land Cruiser 75 in some markets, is not as big and brawny as the V8 muscle from Ford, Dodge and Chevrolet/GMC, but it is a tough truck. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both lifted from the Land Cruiser wagon and mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. But no matter how much you pay, you won't get ABS or airbags, but you do get a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, this pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The all-new Chevrolet Corvette debuted as a 2014 model year. In 2017, it got a new transmission. It remains the same for the 2018 model year. It features a LT1 V8 engine, but still has the same 6.2-litre displacement as the previous generation. It gets a 7-speed manual transmission it has, with rev-matching technology. For customers who don't like the third pedal, there is the 8-speed automatic transmission, the same gearbox as the previous generation, but tweaked with different internals for better performance. A new electric power steering system and cylinder deactivation help to improve fuel economy. There is a Drive Mode Selector which has 5 settings Weather, Eco, Tour, Sport and Track. The interior is where they have made some much-needed improvements. The designers made sure they cover as much of the interior as possible with soft-touch materials. It features a more driver-focused cockpit and a smaller steering wheel. New seats with more bolstering have been added. A Z51 package adds more sporting suspension as well as extra trim such as a rear spoiler. Safety features include front and side airbags, ESP, ABS and seat-belt pretensioners.

The 308 is a completely new version of the outgoing 307, and is available in 3-door and 5-door versions, both in hatchback trim. The 308 SW wagon debuted in 2009, while a hard-top convertible 308 CC model came in 2010. Two 1.6-litre engines were initially available, one naturally-aspirated and one turbocharged. The CC came only with the turbo engine. All versions come with an automatic gearbox, with only the basic 5-door non-turbo model getting a manual. Later on, the 3-door 308 GT quietly became available, with an upgraded 1.6-litre turbo and a 6-speed manual. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, CD player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with GSM built-in telephone, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The Audi A4 received a recent facelift which gave it a corporate nosejob, among other things. Available as a sedan and a convertible in this region. The wagon is not offered here, for obvious reasons. Engines for the sedan include a 2.0-litre normally-aspirated four and a 2.0-litre turbocharged four, along with a 1.8-litre turbocharged model cropping up at random dealerships. The sedan can also be ordered in hot S4 and hotter RS4 form from a few dealerships, which adds a V8 engine and sporting suspension, among other goodies. The cabriolet can be had in this region with a 3.2-litre V6 as well as the 2.0-litre turbo four. There is a choice of a six-speed manual for all engines, though they are not officially offered. Standard on the front-wheel-drive models is the Multitronic CVT automatic, a transmission system which does not use gears. The all-wheel-drive models get a traditional automatic only. Changes over the previous model include new dynamic suspension, a new braking system with larger discs and automatic brake disc wiping for better performance in wet weather, advanced front lighting with available pivoting front lights, advanced rollover and better on-road stability. Features include aluminium or wood trim, six-CD changer, auto door locking, a bunch of airbags, a tyre pressure monitoring system and an optional S-Line body kit. The S4 or even the 3.2-litre sedan are normally not offered at most dealers, though you could probably get one if you pay them enough.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. Only the Cross Country model was sold in the GCC. It is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

An all-new Peugeot 3008 came out in 2017. The compact SUV is available in the GCC with only one engine option - the turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the 3008 include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats and alloy wheels. Optional features include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Andriod Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist.

The Forester was Subaru's first attempt at a proper small 4WD, already being the first company to offer all-wheel drive across its entire model line. The Forester was introduced for the 1998 model year and has only survived on facelifts, being heavily revamped for 2003. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester features Subaru's symmetrical all-wheel-drive system. In the Middle East, only the 2.5X model is offered, powered by a 2.5-litre flat four-cylinder, mated to a four-speed automatic. The Forester includes a MP3/WMA CD stereo, 6-CD changer, automatic climate control system, power windows, electric mirrors, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, cruise control, cloth upholstery and an automatic air conditioner. The higher models include a sunroof, 16-inch alloy wheels, leather-wrapped surfaces such as the steering wheel, gear shift knob and handbrake. The Forester is different than most compact 4WDs since, in addition to being a soft-roader with no low-range gearing, it also has a lower car-like body.

The Sierra range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling truck in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado. The Sierra 1500 light pickup version is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending everyone around you with your show of excess, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The Sierra is available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a 4.3-litre V6, a 4.8-litre V8 and a 5.3-litre V8, all with 4-speed automatics. A luxury Sierra Denali version was introduced in 2009, with a 6.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. All versions come in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. Along with leather and special exterior trim, the Denali gets standard features such as Bluetooth, power-adjustable pedals, auto-dimming inside mirror, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, remote starting system, rear parking sensors, MP3-capable stereo with a six-disc in-dash CD changer, Bose premium speakers, rear-seat audio, power-sliding rear window, navigation, sunroof and an optional DVD rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include at least front airbags and ABS brakes, while higher trim levels get side-curtain airbags and stability control, among other options.

The Tata Xenon is the Indian manufacturer's answer to commercial vehicles which is currently dominated by the Japanese. Featuring a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine, the Xenon comes standard with power steering, power windows and air-conditioning. Unlike the name, it does not come with xenon headlamps. The Xenon can be had in either single cab or double cab, with the option of two-wheel drive or four-wheel-drive.

The Maserati Spyder is a high-performance two-door two-seater based on the 4200 GT Coupe, except with a shorter wheelbase and a convertible top. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations was the GranSport Spyder, which featured sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport version, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

An all-new BMW 3-Series made its debut in 2019. The BMW 320i and 330i get a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit.  An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered. In addition, all the tech features offered in the 5-Series seems to be offered in the BMW 3-Series as well, including variable steering, dynamic damper control, brake energy regeneration, iDrive computer, heads-up display, surround-view cameras, parking assistant and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, seatbelt pretensioners, optional automatic braking and more.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, there is only one petrol engine on offer, which is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The other engines options are the diesel units which include a 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre, which will most likely not make it to the GCC just yet. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with AUX/USB/iPOD/MP3/CD player, and 4 speakers.
