Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, 5-inch touchscreen, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, and has been mildly facelifted for 2014. External changes include a redone grille and front bumper, new headlight clusters with LED running lights, new tail-lamp clusters and new wheel options. For 2016, minor changes included a rear diffuser-look bumper on some models. Engine options include a base 5.6-litre V8 with 5-speed automatic or 6-speed manual, known as the Patrol SE, as well as a 5.6-litre V8 with more power, direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top Platinum "City" trim gets a slightly-lower unique bumper. For 2016, there is a locally-fitted Patrol Desert Edition with bead-lock wheels, skid plates and more, built from the base Patrol LE model. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems. Also for a while in 2016, a full option Patrol SE was available with a manual gearbox.

The Renault Duster, a rebadged Dacia, released an all-new model for 2019. This sub-compact SUV comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine mated with a CVT or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available in either a two-wheel-drive or in an all-wheel-drive, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Interestingly, the 2WD model comes with a torsion-beam rear suspension, while the 4WD model gives up some boot space to make way for an independent rear suspension. The rear seats fold down as standard, and split-folding on all but the base model, while you can transport longer items if the front passenger seat is folded down as well. The basic 2021 Renault Duster PE version comes with two-wheel-drive, 4-speed automatic, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth with buttons behind steering wheel, unpainted bumpers, 16-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, folding rear bench seat, power steering and manual a/c. All 2021 Renault Duster models have two standard airbags. The higher-spec SE can be had in 2WD automatic or special-order 4WD manual drivetrains, and adds standard fog lamps, trip computer, ABS with Emergency Brake Assist, extra front-passenger airbag, rear power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, painted bumpers, leatherette steering wheel and extra chrome trim. The SE version can be further upgraded with leather seats with additional pyrotechnic pre-tensioners on the front seatbelts as well as side airbags. The exterior package on the SE version also adds standard chrome door mirrors, longitudinal roof rails, front/rear skid plates and side-skirt covers. Extra tinted rear windows, rear quarter glass and rear windscreen round up the list, as is a split-folding rear seat, height adjustable driver's seat and height-adjustable steering wheel. A comprehensive range of accessories,including wind reflectors, side steps, wheel arch mouldings, chrome exhaust trim and mudflaps, is also available.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was released as a 2014 model year. The Thai-built Yaris receives two 4-cylinder engines to choose from. The base gets a 1.3-litre, where as higher models get a 1.5-litre. They both get a 4-speed automatic transmission, while some select markets get the 5-speed manual transmission. The 1.3-litre is available in two packages - the S and SE, whereas the 1.5-litre gets an SE+ and a Sport option in the UAE. New exterior colours have also been introduced. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the Sport, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, steering wheel control for audio, sportier seats, 15-inch alloy wheels, smoker metallic plating, different analogue dashboard meter and a body kit with spoiler. The SE+ get automatic air-conditioning, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels, projector headlights and better quality seats. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD).

The Scirocco is revival of Volkswagen's odd-shaped 1970s model that attempted to bridge the gap between a hatchback and a coupe. It last died out in 1992, until its revival as a concept car in 2006 and a production car by 2008. Debuting in the GCC as a 'sportier' alternative to the VW Golf, the Scirocco lifts platforms, engines and even interior panels from the Golf. However, the cabin itself has a lower roofline while retaining seating for four. Engines include a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder with both a supercharger and a turbocharger, as well as a 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. The GCC dealers will be pushing the automatic version locally, with the 'DSG' automanual gearbox, but it can be special-ordered with a 6-speed manual. A higher-tuned Scirocco R model became available in 2012, with more power, a body kit and firmer suspension. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

The fourth generation of the VW Golf was a huge success during its long run. The clean and conservative styling combined with a vague sense of being a status symbol made it a hit among well-to-do yuppies. Available only as a 5-door hatchback here, with a variety of engine options upgraded over the years. Even a 4Motion all-wheel-drive model is available, though it may be hard to find in these parts. After its 1998 makeover, the Golf got considerably more tasteful inside, with nicely contrasting colours and patterns. The cabin offers sufficient room for six-footers, while the rear compartment is as small as any other compact. The cargo area under the hatch is huge for a compact, and the rear seats fold flat. Available features included power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, sunroof, alloy wheels and more, depending on trim level. A pair of airbags is standard on all models, with some getting side airbags as well, while ABS is standard. Engines included 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors. Sportier early models included the FWD or AWD GTI with a 2.3-litre V5, and an AWD 4Motion model with a 2.8-litre V6. In the later years, the V5 got more power. For its premium price, equipment levels were limited, with an underlying platform that had independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension.

The compact Mariner is the Mercury version of Ford's Escape 4WD, and new for 2008. Utilising a standard five-seater configuration, folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, as a typical crossover should be. The Mariner also comes standard with illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, electric power steering, 16-inch alloy wheels and CD stereo with iPod jack. Available features include leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, and parking sensors. The Mariner is the first vehicle to debut the "top of dash" display, Ice Blue Lighting and dials and buttons that "poke-through" the centre console. The centre console is large enough to hold a laptop computer and has three levels of storage space. Safety equipment includes standard side-curtain airbags with AdvanceTrac with the roll stability control system. For the GCC, a 3.0-litre V6 is standard, and it only gets a basic 4-speed automatic. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing.

The Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet and Turbo S Cabriolet got a minor facelift in 2017, as well as a slight power upgrade, thanks to modified inlet ports in the cylinder head, new injection nozzles and higher fuel pressure. Fuel economy improves slightly as well for the 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet due to further advanced electronic engine and transmission management with revised gear change mappings. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The 911 is Porsche's original legendary rear-engined sports car, produced in coupe, cabriolet and glass-roofed targa body styles based on model, and with numerous flat-six engines and drivetrains. The 911 first went into production in 1964, and now includes the rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2, GT3, and GT3 RS models, and the all-wheel-drive Carrera 4, Carrera 4S and Turbo models. The top GT2 model was added later. All use Porsche's flat six-cylinder engine in various states of tune. The Carrera 2 and Carrera 4 models use a 3.6-litre with either a manual or a tiptronic gearbox. The Carerra 4S uses a 3.8-litre, with a choice of manual or tiptronic. The race-tuned GT3 and GT3 RS are the lightest cars in the range, and use a modified high-output version of the 3.6-litre engine, with only a manual gearbox. The all-wheel-drive 911 Turbo supercar uses a turbocharged version of the 3.6-litre engine. The lightened rear-wheel-drive GT2 uses an upgraded version of the turbo motor. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and a full set of airbags. Both the GT3 and 911 Turbo is fitted with an Active Suspension Management system, while the Turbo has an optional Sports Chrono Package that temporarily boosts turbocharger pressure for up to 10 seconds by 2.9 psi, increasing torque.

The Jeep Cherokee got a facelift for the 2019 model year. It offers both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive. From 2020, only the 3.2-litre "Pentastar" V6 engine was available. A 9-speed automatic transmission is standard on all models. It features four-wheel-independent suspension. There will be four different versions Sport, Longitude, Limited and Trailhawk. The last one is the most offroad-capable version and has Jeep's "Trail Rated" badges, and comes with a Selec-Terrain system, 1-inch lift and a locking rear differential. Other available features include a park-assist system that gives you directions on how to park into a particular space, an 8.4-inch touchscreen with optional navigation and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with auto-braking, and more.

The BMW Z4 was completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, shifting focus and becoming a comfort-cruiser rather than the focused sports car that it was before. Along with all-new styling, the Z4 now sports a folding hard-top convertible roof that folds down in 20 seconds at the touch of a button. While still a two-seater, the Z4 now has more space for two passengers and their luggage, although not much cargo room is left with the roof down. Changes to the cabin now include more premium materials as well as an integrated iDrive multimedia computer. The Z4 comes with a choice between three inline-6 engines. The Z4 sDrive23i with a 2.5-litre, the Z4 sDrive30i with a 3.0-litre, and the Z4 sDrive35i with a turbocharged 3.0-litre, all available with a manual or automatic, with the exception of the turbo motor, which can be mated to a clutchless automanual gearbox. The Z4 comes with Dynamic Drive Control as standard, which allows NORMAL, SPORT and SPORT+ modes, each of which changes throttle response and gearbox characteristics. Other features include the iDrive system with a high-resolution display that integrates entertainment, navigation, Bluetooth phone and climate control functionality. All the usual luxury features are available, either standard or optional, such as cloth or leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, powered seats, keyless entry with starter button, alloy wheels, and HID headlights, among other options. On the safety front, the Z4 Roadster comes with stability control, ABS, front airbags, head and thorax airbags, reinforced A-pillars and roll bars behind the headrests.

The Nissan Murano is a crossover SUV, designed pretty much exclusively for on-road cruising rather than off-road excursions. The Murano is available in three trim levels, all featuring a 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to Nissan's Xtronic CVT transmission with adaptive shift control, as well as all-wheel-drive. Standard features for the Murano include 18-inch alloy wheels, six airbags, ABS, stability control and front seat active head restraints. Additional features include bi-xenon headlights, LED tail lamps, cruise control and an in-dash six-disc CD player with AUX socket for MP3 players. Also available are an intelligent Key with memory for the powered front seats and steering wheel, as well as a Bose audio system with 11 speakers, including a pair of Richbass woofers mounted in the spare-wheel well. The Murano's new interior is makes abundant use of soft-touch materials and upholstery trimmed in cloth or leather and aluminium detailing. Depending on trim level, the Murano can also be had with ambient mood lighting, auto climate-control, split 60/40 rear seats with powered raising function, power-operated tailgate, parking cameras for the front and rear, twin "˜top loader' sunroof, navigation system, Bluetooth, and a DVD entertainment system.

An all-new GMC Sierra was released as a 2014 model year and received a facelift in 2016. Exterior-wise, the styling carries pretty much the same DNA as the previous model but the new front fascia seems more imposing now. That is because they have added bigger headlights and a huge grille. GM consciously kept the design similar as, unlike the UAE where big pickup trucks are more of a statement, in the U.S. market it is a high volume seller among conservative buyers. A Z71 package is available which includes stronger shocks, front tow hooks and extra under-body protection. All All-Terrain model was introduced in 2017, with roll bars on the bed and losing the aerodynamic lip on the front bumper. The interior is where the main changes will be, with the new 4.2-inch display on the dashboard. More soft-touch material has been added around the cockpit. The new Sierra pickups will have 12-volt outlets, five USB ports and a SD-card slot. A new 4.3-litre V6 engine adds to the family of 5.3-litre and 6.2-litre V8 motors. They will all be mated to a six-speed automatic. For improving fuel economy, the V8 engines have cylinder deactivation and direct injection.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The RAV-4 is credited for being the original small 4WD built on a car chassis. It's not that there is anything fundamentally wrong with the vehicle. It's just that the RAV-4 is not a strong off-roader, but insists on looking like one, and people buy it for that reason. It continues with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder in this market even though a V6 model has been introduced elsewhere. Most markets, including UAE and KSA, get the all-wheel-drive model, but KSA additionally gets a two-wheel-drive option as well, the base one with a manual gearbox. The RAV4 range has an array of comfort and convenience features including auto air- conditioning, a MP3 compatible CD player with 6 speakers, power windows and central locking, keyless entry, and cruise control. Its rugged yet stylish exterior appearance is enhanced by a rear spoiler, roof rails, fog lamps and alloy wheels. The high series models also feature a powered driver's seat, leather seats, a moonroof and rear corner sensors. Safety features on all models include dual-stage frontal airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control and traction control. Side airbags are optional. Minor facelifts over the years are too small to notice.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

The Volvo XC70 got minor exterior and interior upgrades, as well as new added safety features in 2014. Although it is still not really that good off-road as we know it, the XC70 gets by on gravel and flat sand, given its fairly impressive ground clearance. Available only in T6 trim now, it is powered by a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine, with an automatic offering tiptronic manual shifting. The second-row has a three-section bench seat with removable centre position for various setups. Standard features include keyless entry, CD player, trip computer, air-conditioning, xenon headlights, power windows, doors, locks, sunroof and mirrors. Available features also include leather or vinyl seats, ventilated front seats with perforated leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, an in-dash computer system with USB and Bluetooth support, and an optional rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, collision Warning with brake support and emergency brake lamps, adaptive cruise control helps keeping a safe distance to vehicles ahead, hydraulic brake assist, optimised hydraulic brakes and fading brake support. An optional Polestar ECU upgrade is available to bump up the power by 25 hp.

The compact Actyon looks like nothing else on the road. If there ever was a sporty-looking 4WD, this is it. Too bad its 2.3-litre four-cylinder joke of an engine does not back up its looks. The engine is mated to a manual or an automatic gearbox, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Based on the same platform as other Ssangyong 4WD vehicles, the five-door Actyon can seat up to five people and comes with a host of cabin features, including a liftgate rear end.  Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, electric mirrors, alloy wheels of different sizes, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, whatever that is, while traction control, hill descent control and stability control are all also available.

This generation of the popular S-Class debuted in 2006, and was facelifted for 2010 with a mildly different grille, a revised bumper and optional LED marker lights. Almost all models offered in the GCC are the long-wheelbase version, which include the S 350 L, the S 500 L and the S 600 L, all with automatic gearboxes. A new entry-level S 300 short=wheelbase model and an S 400 HYBRID model both debuted for 2010, while the S 500 4MATIC all-wheel-drive model is also now offered in the GCC. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Options include a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodystyling and either 19-inch or 20-inch light-alloy wheels.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA-Class is a sub-compact 4-door sedan. The CLA-Class will only be offered in one version, the CLA 250, powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Suzuki Vitara is a completely new model, making its debut in the GCC in 2016. Smaller, lighter and losing its offroad capabilities, the new Vitara is designed to compete in the road-going crossover segment and is a separate vehicle line from the existing Grand Vitara. It is only available as a 5-door wagon, and gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available in both two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive. In the UAE, two trims are available, the GLX and GLX+, all of which come with automatic transmission as standard. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, central locking, keyless push start system, sunroof, LED daytime running lamps, leather seats, cruise control,  automatic A/C, roof rails, front & rear parking sensors, front skid plate, chrome front grille and alloy wheels. The higher GLX+ model gets panoramic roof and polished aluminium wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ABS and brake assist.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre. Next are three supercharged 1.8-litre engines, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon, also depending on model year. The 2.6-litre is also available, as is a 3.2-litre, both V6. The V6 models can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The supercharged 3.2-litre C 32 AMG comes in sedan form only, as the wagon wasn't offered here. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers were hesitant to bring any over. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

The Traverse is a crossover wagon that combines car-like handling with the utility of a 4WD wagon, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its third facelift for the 2016 model-year. It remains the same for 2018. The exterior and interior both get a major overhaul. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Lexus RX got a minor facelift for 2013, the main change being the new spindle grill being adopted by all the models. Also joining the RX 350, will be a hybrid model called the RX 450h. The RX 350 gets the 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. However there is also an F Sport model which gets a bodykit as well as an 8-speed transmission which does not improve performance figures at all. The RX 450h gets a similar 3.5-litre V6 engine combined to three electric motors. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 19-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations.

At first glance, this Chinese-built car looks like nothing more than a cheap copy of the Toyota Corolla, with the rear end of a Honda City mixture, but wearing a fake BMW badge. And it is exactly that, but if you look past the lame attempts at plagiarism, you'll find a package that actually might be a decent deal for a new car. The F3 is powered by a 1.6-litre Mitsubishi-sourced engine, mated to a 5-speed manual Mitsubishi gearbox. It includes an interior that is exactly like that of a last-generation Toyota Corolla, but with softer touchable surfaces. Available features, standard or optional, include 15-inch wheels, leather upholstery, dual front airbags, sunroof, manual air-conditioning, CD player, remote keyless entry, fake wood trim, height-adjustable steering wheel, power windows, ABS brakes and the price tag of a car half its size. Build quality seems to be of passing-grade, although some plastic pieces have an unfinished feel to them. If only they'd try a bit harder and be a bit more original. The price may make up for it though, in the eyes of some cost-conscious buyers.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. It got a facelift in 2015. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The new-for-2011 BMW 5-Series entered the Middle East market with two inline-6 engines, with more engines on the way later. The base 523i got a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder in 2011, but a new base model, the 520i, was added in 2012 with a lower-tuned turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and 8-speed auto, replacing the 523i. The 535i has a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, both mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 528i model joined the line-up later with yet another naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and 8-speed auto, replaced later by a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder by 2012. The 550i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto came closer to 2011. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The redesigned BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Gelaendewagen first debuted in 1979 as a utilitarian offroader and as military transport. In 1990, it got its first major revamp, upgrading it to luxury specs, but retaining its classic looks. Its boxy styling was again left alone during the 1997 update, which introduced a new range of engines, updated again and again over the years until its next major update in 2007. The trademark clean-cut, sharp lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a limited-edition soft-top version of the three-door.  The only petrol engine debuting in 1997 was the 3.2-litre V6 in the G 320, alongside various diesel motors. The 5.0-litre V8-powered G 500 debuted in 1998. In 2003 came the first AMG model, namely the 5.5-litre G 55 AMG. This was replaced in 2004 by the upgraded supercharged 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Along the way came turbodiesel models, such as the G 320 CDI in 1997 and the G 400 CDI in 2000. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. Stability control was added in 2001, and while dual front airbags are available, there are no side airbags. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

A new generation Kia Optima came out for the 2016 model year.  Under the hood, two engines are available. One is the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the other a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Optima include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, ventilated seats, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Kia is offering proper safety features only in the top model.

The Brilliance H530 is the Chinese company's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design was styled by Italy's Pininfarina. The front-wheel drive H530 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with MP3/USB/AUX support, manual A/C, rear sensors and 15-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets leather seats, keyless start and keyless entry system, digital A/C, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

The C 63 AMG model is the sports model of the C-Class range. For 2012, a new coupe model was introduced for the first time alongside the sedan. The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG comes with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. The centre console comes with an electronic rotary switch for selecting the four transmission modes and the race start function. The sports seats are optionally available in single-tone or two-tone designo leather. A limited-edition C 63 AMG Coupe Black Series was briefly offered in 2012, with a higher-tuned engine, track-ready suspension, aggressive body kit and no speed limiter. In 2013, a special "Edition 507" version was offered with an uprated engine, identified by its black wheels and badges, with only 10 hp less than the aggressive Black Series and a higher-speed limiter. The C 63 AMG comes with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags.

The X-Type is an elegant entry-level Jaguar that loses none of its charm thanks to great styling and suspension tuning. It is, however, based on the lowly Ford Mondeo platform, as evidenced by a front-wheel-drive base model. The higher models do benefit from full-time all-wheel drive, which improves traction in all road conditions. Sold mainly in sedan guise regionally, the basic front-driven car can be had with a 2.1-litre V6, while the all-wheel-drive models can be had with either a 2.5-litre V6 or a 3.0-litre V6. All cars land in this region with a five-speed automatic gearbox, though you could probably special-order a manual version if you really wanted one. Features include leather-trimmed seating, and power-operated windows, mirrors, door locks and driver's seat. All X-Types are also equipped with automatic climate control, remote locking, an auto-dimming interior mirror, tilt/telescope steering wheel and alloy wheels. Available features include a moonroof, Xenon headlights, parking sensors, navigation system and larger wheels. The sports package offers a mesh grille, a deeper front spoiler and lower side sills, a rear spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 18-inch wheels and high-performance tyres.  Safety features  include various airbags, ABS brakes and a stability control system.

The new-for-2012 BMW 6-Series Gran Coupe is essentially a 6-Series with four doors on a 5-Series platform. The 640i gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The 650i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto came at the end of 2012. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 6-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport +, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. BMW claims the Gran Coupe is a 4+1 seater, but the rear middle seat offers zero legroom. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inchers, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The attractive GranTurismo is a modern replacement for the 4200GT coupe, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. An S version ups the ante with a new 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale made its debut later on in 2011 and had little more power, as well as some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This new-for-2008 two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The ninth generation Chevrolet Malibu made its debut in the GCC as a 2017 model year. Under the hood is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Later on a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine joined the lineup. That one gets an 8-speed auto transmission. Standard features on the base LS model include power steering, electric windows, central locking, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, single zone A/C, 6-speaker audio system, 7-inch touch screen with Bluetooth, phone projection and navigation, keyless entry, engine push start, fabric seats, cruise control and 16-inch steel wheels. The LT gets additional remote vehicle starter and 17-inch alloy wheels. The sunroof, 8-inch touch screen, and power seats are optional on the LT. On the LTZ, additional features include dual exhausts, HID headlamps, LED tail lamps, auto headlight leveling function, dual-zone A/C, 9-speaker Bose audio system, 8-inch touch screen with navigation, USB charge port, leather seats, power seats and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the LTZ include sunroof, rearview camera and adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS), and traction control. The LTZ gets side airbags as well. Other optional safety equipment include lane-keeping assist, blind spot monitor, forward collision alert and rear cross traffic alert.

The Ford Escort is the American brand's compact car offering. This Escort is however built in China and gets a 1.5-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the Escort include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, auto headlamps, partial leather seats, infotainment system with 8-inch touchscreen, 2 USB ports, Bluetooth, auto headlamps, rear parking sensors, rear camera, auto start-stop, manual A/C and 15-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get 16-inch and 17-inch alloy wheels, full leather seats, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control and automatic A/C, Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, front and side airbags, ABS, stability control and hill-assist.

The Cadillac CTS got a redesign for the 2014 model year. The base engine is now a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, coupled with 6-speed automatic transmission. The 3.6-litre V6 is still there, with a new 8-speed automatic. A new CTS VSport variant joins the lineup later, with a twin turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.
An all-new Bentley Continental GTC was released in 2018.

Named after its 5.6-litre V8 engine, the QX56 is based on the Nissan Armada, which is itself is based on pickup truck platform. It is basically an upscale version of a less expensive model, although the QX56 does have unique styling. The QX56 four-wheel-drive system uses a transfer case with with settings for rear-wheel-drive, all-wheel-drive, 4-high and 4-low. It has three rows of seats, with the third row easy to fold flat. New for 2007 was a tiny increase in power, while 2008 added 20-inch chromed alloy wheels, redone interior and a restyled grille. The QX56 comes in a single trim line that includes a five-speed automatic transmission with tow/haul mode, heavy-duty skid plates, rear auto-levelling air suspension, tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, xenon headlights, fog lamps, LED tail and brake lights, power-operated liftgate with opening rear glass, rear proximity sensor,  leather interior, real wood trim, ten-way driver and eight-way power passenger heated seats, second-row heated seats, front and side airbags, automatic dual-zone climate control, seven-inch LCD screen, and six-CD Bose system with ten speakers and wheel-mounted controls. Options include a rear-view camera, among other items.

The new-for-2008 i10 is an overlapping replacement for the anonymous Atos Prime supermini, boasting sleeker styling but retaining its predecessor's geekiness. Built in India to avoid increasing Korean labour costs, the i10 is only available with a 1.1-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a manual or automatic gearbox. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The CLS-Class "four-door coupe" is completely redesigned for the 2012 model year. Based on the latest E-Class platform, the CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Models on offer include the CLS 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and the CLS 500 with a 4.6-litre twin-turbo V8. Both come with a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base. Standard features on all models include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps. Some models gets a standard sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry and start and a sports package for the non-AMG models. Options include metallic paint, nicer leather, wooden steering wheel, night vision, various 18-inch and 19-inch alloy-wheel designs, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more.

The Ford F-150 is new from the ground up for 2015. Starting from its redesigned steel ladder-frame chassis, every aspect of the truck is new, including a shift to aluminium body construction and a general push towards "EcoBoost" turbocharged engines. In 2018, it got a facelift, engine upgrades and new transmission. Available in single cab, "SuperCab" quad-cab and "SuperCrew" double-cab body styles, engines on offer include a 3.5-litre turbo V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, both with 10-speed automatics and power upgrades. Further configurations include a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive with low-range, while an "FX4" package can add offroad suspension, rear locking diff and skidplates to any model except the base one. Aside from the usual basic features such as power windows, keyless entry and electric mirrors, new features, depending on trim level, include remote tailgate locking and release, unique "BoxLink" tailgate attachment points that accept standard attachments used in moving trucks and trailers, stowable loading ramps that attach to the BoxLink points, optional LED headlights, optional all-around LED lighting including side-mirror "flashlights" and in-bed lighting, 170-degree opening half-doors on SuperCab models, flat rear load floor in SuperCab and SuperCrew cabins, 360-degree camera view, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot warning and even a panoramic sunroof. And it still has that built-in step in its tailgate to climb onto the bed, aside from new pop-out steps on the sides of the bed. Standard safety features include ABS, ESP, front and side-airbags, and optional rear inflatable belts.

The Lotus Evora is the British manufacturer's first offering of combining superb race track handling with everyday practicality. In 2017, it got power upgrades and a slight facelift. There are two models to choose from, the Evora 400 and Evora Sport 410.The Evora comes with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine in two states of tune, both mated to either a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual transmission. The mid-engined Evora has a 2+2 configuration, although the back seats can be used for storage purposes than anything else. Standard options include central door locking, flat bottomed magnesium steering wheel trimmed in leather, leather gear knob, leather handbrake sleeve, bespoke aluminium illuminated control knobs and switches, power windows, remote release glove box, door storage bins and integrated cup holders, Alpine CD/MP3/WMA receiver, and Lotus command centre with auxiliary trip computer and vehicle monitoring displays. It comes with standard 18-inch alloy wheels and optional 19-inch/20-inch alloys with wider tyres. Additional packages can be added. The Tech Pack offers Alpine multi-media in car entertainment system with 7" WVGA touch screen, bluetooth connectivity, satellite navigation, tyre pressure monitoring, cruise control, rear parking sensors. The Sport Pack offers switchable sports mode with sharper throttle response, increased rpm limit and sports traction control setting, sports diffuser, titanium sports exhaust tailpipe, cross drilled brake discs, engine oil cooler and black painted brake callipers. The Premium Pack offers accent lighting, upgraded interior trim, centre arm-rest and further extensive use of premium grade leathers. Further options include electric power-fold door mirrors, xenon headlights, Alpine Imprint dynamic audio EQ system , reversing camera and body colour door handles.

The 2009 Mitsubishi Galant receives fresh styling with a new grille, hood and lower air intake at the front, and more changes at the rear including wider rear glass, a new trunk lid, taillights and rear bumper. The Galant is powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic transmission, and the 3.8-litre V6 engine with a 5-speed automatic. Bot gearboxes come with Sportronic manual shifting ability. The base model includes variable intermittent wipers, power mirrors, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, cloth seats, air conditioning, power windows, power locks with keyless entry and CD player with four speakers. The higher models get bright interior accents, cruise control, premium cloth seats, ABS brakes with EBD, and CD/MP3 player with six speakers, along with 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an eight-way power driver's seat. Options include reverse camera, fog lamps, special climate control console, steering wheel with audio controls, power sunroof, leather-trimmed seats, and a premium CD/MP3 player with changer and eight speakers. Safety features include only dual front airbags standard on all models, with ABS and traction control available on higher models only.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. It got a facelift and infotainment updates in 2020. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The new L200 offers versatility combined with a tough new look that makes it seem more like a lifestyle vehicle than a commercial pickup. It obviously is tough enough to be a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The spacious interior places the L200 firmly in the midsize class, unlike the previous compact model. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's new L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. The brakes, the rear axle, the steering gear and the chassis have all been substantially beefed up for the new L200, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The GAC GS3 is the brand's small SUV offering. Under the hood it gets a 1.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, smart key, AM/FM radio with MP3/WMA support, 2 USB ports, 8-inch screen, Bluetooth, 6 speakers, steering wheel with audio controls, manual A/C, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, reverse parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include automatic AC, auto headlights, automatic A/C, rear A/C vents, folding side mirrors with defogging and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include dual front airbags, ABS, EPS, TCS, EBD, brake assist, and tire pressure monitoring system.

The ZNA Rich is a midsize pickup available in single and double-cab body styles, with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. There are no changes for 2014, aside from a grille change for some markets. Features include a 5-speed manual, 15-inch steel wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes, power steering, adjustable steering column, central locking, power windows, power mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and SD card, manual antenna, manual a/c and front seat belts.

The Quattroporte is Maserati's luxury sedan that joined the Maserati lineup in the 2005 model year, and facelifted for 2009. Along with the mildly-changed face, the new variants include the base Quattroporte Automatica, the mid-range Quattroporte S Automatica and the top Quattroporte Sport GT-S. The base engine is the 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 6-speed automatic, while the mid-range S model has a 4.7-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto. The Sport GT-S has an upgraded 4.7-litre V8 and is now the only version with a 6-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. All Quattroporte models have the usual power, safety and luxury trimmings, including premium audio and multiple airbags. The new model has expanded the already-staggering array of interior trim choices to 10 leather colours with 11 piping hues and myriad woods or lacquers from which to choose. Other interior upgrades include new cluster graphics, reshaped seats and a new multifunction wood and leather steering wheel with sporty thumb rests. Standard features include directionally-adaptive bi-xenon headlights heated leather power seats with memory, automatic dual-zone climate control, rear parking sensors and a Bose sound system with hard drive and navigation system. The Quattroporte S adds Brembo brakes and 19-inch wheels. Heating, ventilation and massage functions are optional for front and rear seats. An electronically-controlled Skyhook suspension, standard on the S and optional on the base trim, automatically adjusts to the conditions of the road. The Sport GT-S adds a black chrome treatment to the grille and side air intakes, carbon-fibre steering wheel trim and hand-brake grip, and aluminium pedals, as well as a noisier exhaust, uprated suspension, better brakes and a re-engineered gearbox for sportier shifts.

The Borgward BX-5 is the brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engine options, which include the 1.4-litre turbocharged motor and the 1.8-litre turbo unit. Both engines can be had in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive. Standard features on the BX-5 include power steering, power windows, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, single-zone A/C, fabric seats, front-centre 8-inch touch screen, bluetooth, AUX, USB, Apple Car Play, Android Auto, parking sensors, reverse camera and alloy wheels. The higher models gets dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, panoramic sunroof, xenon headlamps, cruise control, auto headlamps, 8 speakers, engine start/stop, WIFI and 360-degree parking assist. Safety features include front and side airbags ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ESP, traction control, brake assist, auto hold and tire pressure monitoring system.

The Indica is an outdated hatchback launched in India back in 1998, spawning variants such as the Indigo sedan and the Indigo Marina station wagon. They went on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica and Indigo were considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger cars. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The Maserati Spyder is a high-performance two-door two-seater based on the 4200 GT Coupe, except with a shorter wheelbase and a convertible top. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations was the GranSport Spyder, which featured sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport version, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Mulsanne is a direct replacement to Bentley's flagship Arnage. Redesigned from the ground up, the extra-large sedan still retains its trademark turbocharged 6.75-litre V8, heavily modified for lesser emissions, better fuel efficiency and more power. The Mulsanne comes standard with a premium cabin treatment consisting of leather on every inch of the interior, supplemented by real wood and metal trim. Each car takes twelve weeks to produce, and customers have a choice of 114 paint colours, 21 carpet colours, 9 wood veneers and 24 interior leather hides, and be able to specify a custom colour scheme. Additionally, the car can be specified to feature a Naim 2200W audio system with MP3 compatibility, Bluetooth, iPod port and navigation. Further available features include powered massage seats, four-zone auto a/c, keyless start, HID headlights and more. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control and multiple airbags.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

An all-new model of the Infiniti QX60 came out in 2022. Under the hood, it gets the same tried and tested 3.5-litre V6 engine, but now gets a Mercedes-sourced 9-speed automatic transmission. The dashboard design now swoops from the passenger side to the driver side, with the air-con controls nestled under it. A 12.3-inch screen stands on top, complete with Wi-Fi, wireless Apple Carplay and Android Auto. Other optional amenities include a 12.3-inch instrument cluster, a 10.8-inch HUD, a 17-speaker BOSE sound system, massaging front seats and wireless charging.

An all-new Toyota Avalon came out in 2019. It is a completely overhauled version of the previous one. Under the hood, it gets the same 3.5-litre V6 engine, but with more power. It is built on the Toyota New Global Architecture platform (TNGA) which underpins the current Camry and Prius. This promises a quieter ride. Every dimension of the 2019 Avalon has grown compared to the old model. The rear cabin is almost 20 cm longer which has translated to more space for the rear passengers. The looks of the 2019 Toyota Avalon builds on the smaller Camry but with many sharper lines. The LED headlights and taillights are not enough to balance out that desperately massive grille, intended to make the car stand out more. The XSE and Touring trims will have even better looks with piano black finishes, a boot spoiler, diffuser panels and quad exhausts. The interior of the 2019 Avalon is obviously a lot more opulent. Though it takes some stuff from the Camry, it looks far more luxurious than it. In the dash, there is a 9-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system which comes with Apple CarPlay making it the first Toyota vehicle to feature it. But it still doesn’t get Android Auto. Other amenities include five USB charging ports, wireless charging, a 7-inch trip computer and a 10-inch heads-up-display. There are a bunch of standard safety systems like 10 airbags, pre-collision braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keep assist, adaptive cruise control, automatic high beams and blind spot monitoring. Over these, you can add a panoramic parking camera system and a rear cross-traffic braking system.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in three versions currently. The Maybach 62 is the long wheelbase version of the 57, which is quite large already, and this body style comes in either standard 62 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in a new-for-2008 62 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. All models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems. A handful of limited-edition Landaulet four-door convertible models were built in 2010 for a four times higher price.

The Infiniti Q70 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

The XC90 is Volvo's first proper 4WD vehicle, and a fairly good one at that. The seven-seater is powered by either a 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbo, a 3.2-litre V6 or a 4.4-litre V8, all with an automatic with tiptronic function. The V8 came only in 2005. Among the three rows of seats, the second row moves front and back offering adjustable legroom, while the foldable third row seats can be tucked away to increase luggage space. Standard features include keyless entry, 17-inch wheels, CD player, trip computer, rear air-conditioning, power windows, doors, locks and mirrors, and an eight-way power driver's seat with memory. Available features also include leather seats, a power front passenger seat, memory mirrors, a power moonroof, upgraded audio with a six CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels and self-leveling rear suspension. A sports package adds 19-inch rims, stiffer suspension and some trim pieces. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, and a rollover protection system.

The Passat CC, better known as just the CC in the GCC, received a facelift for the 2013 model. The CC utilises a common platform with the Passat, including the same engines, mechanicals and interior components. Standard engine choices include a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, with a 7-speed and 6-speed DSG automanual respectively. Both TSI engines are turbocharged 4-cylinder units. A naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine is offered as well with a 6-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel drive. Features include fabric or leather upholstery in various colours, sports seats, common power accessories, 17-inch alloy wheels, adaptive suspension, electrically-adjustable driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, 'Press & Drive' starter with keyless entry, front and curtain airbags for front and rear passengers including side airbags, electric parking brake with hill-hold control, stability control, ABS, rain-sensing wipers, tyre pressure monitor and more. Options include various wood and aluminium cabin trims, automatic a/c, cruise control, reverse camera, Xenon headlights with bending feature, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic sunroof, and various stereo options that include CD/MP3, Bluetooth phone, six-disc changer and AUX inputs. Park Assist, Automatic Distance Control and Lane Assist features are also optionally available.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The McLaren 570S gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S, but has 30% new components. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570S weighs just 1,313 kg and is longer than the 650S. It benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a new TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The Audi A1 is the smallest car offered by the German manufacturer. There are two versions - the 'Attraction' and the 'Ambition'. They all have a 1.4-litre engine, with the base and mid-option "122" models getting a turbocharger and the higher spec "185" models having a turbo-supercharger combo. The cramped platform offers a cheap independent-front and solid torsion-beam rear suspension. Standard options include electric mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with 8 speakers, start-stop engine system and  daytime running headlamps. Optional equipment include xenon headlamps, fog lamps, automatic air-conditioning,  leather seats, cruise control, headlight washers, LED rear lights, sports seats with lumbar support and parking sensors. Safety-wise, front and side-curtain airbags, ESC with electronic limited slip differential and hill-start assist come standard in all models.

The Mercedez-Benz GLS-Class is the new name for the GL-Class. In 2016, it received a facelift, along with mechanical updates.
