For the GCC, a 3.0-litre V6 is standard, and it only gets a 4-speed automatic. The 2008 version's carryover V6 was replaced by an upgraded V6 for 2009, with more power and a 6-speed automatic. The Escape also comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, electric power steering, 15-inch steel wheels and CD stereo with iPod jack. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. The Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

Attempting to cash in on the four-door 'coupe' craze, Volkswagen jumped into the ring with their ill-conceived Passat CC. While 'CC' stands for 'Comfort Coupe,' there isn't much different from the standard Passat, except for a slightly-deformed exterior and a reduction in headroom. Priced to fail between the standard Passat and the large Phaeton, the Passat CC utilises a common platform with the Passat, including the same engines, mechanicals and interior components. The sporty looks are betrayed by its standard engine choices, which include a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, with a manual or DSG automanual. Both TSI engines are turbocharged 4-cylinder units. By 2010, we believe VW dropped the 1.8-litre and introduced the 3.6-litre V6 with all-wheel-drive and a 6-speed automanual. Features include fabric or leather upholstery in various colours, sports seats, common power accessories, 17-inch alloy wheels, adaptive suspension, electrically-adjustable driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, 'Press & Drive' starter with keyless entry, front and curtain airbags for front and rear passengers including side airbags, electric parking brake with hill-hold control, stability control, ABS, rain-sensing wipers, tyre pressure monitor and more. Options include various wood and aluminium cabin trims, automatic a/c, cruise control, reverse camera, Xenon headlights with bending feature, 18-inch wheels, panoramic sunroof, and various stereo options that include CD/MP3, Bluetooth phone, six-disc changer and AUX inputs. Park Assist, Automatic Distance Control and Lane Assist features are also optionally available. Incidentally, local VW dealers now call it the 'Volkswagen CC' because they feel their customers are too dumb to differentiate between this and the regular Passat.

The Lexus LC is the Japanese luxury brand's first attempt at a grand tourer model. The 2-door coupe gets two engine choices - the LC500 gets naturally aspirated 5.0-V8 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, the other a 3.5-litre V6 coupled with an electric motor, with power transmitted via a hybrid transmission, which is a combined 4-speed automatic and CVT. Standard features on the LC 500 include power steering, power windows, electric foldable mirrors, cruise control, LED headlamps, smart entry and start system, front and rear corner sensors, panoramic roof, leather seats, 10-way power front seats, Mark Levinson surround sound system, DVD player, 2 USB ports, Bluetooth, 13 speakers, navigation, head up display, LED interior lighting package, seat ventilation and 21-inch alloy wheels. There is a "Carbon" edition available for the V8, with carbon moon roof, carbon scuff plates, sports seats and Lexus Dynamic Handling, which is the luxury brand's 4-wheel steering wheel system. Safery features include pre-crash safety systems, lane keeping assist, automatic high beams system, blind spot monitor, rear cross traffic alert, ABS, traction control, vehicle stability control and front, side & knee, curtain airbags.

The Nissan Patrol Pickup is the commercial version of the more popular Nissan Patrol Safari model. It gets the 4.8-litre inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission.  It comes with a Straight-line drive transfer which allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol Pickup has a baisc interior featuring cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, and16-inch steel wheels. Front airbags, EBD, VDC and ABS are standard.

The five-door Leon is arguably the sportiest model in the Seat line-up, and the best interpretation of the new Seat design language yet. Named after a Spanish city, yet based on the VW Golf, the Leon offers an array of engines, including a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre and three turbocharged 2.0-litre units, all from Volkswagen. Depending on model, there are manual, automatic or DSG automanual gearboxes available. Standard features include power front windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, keyless entry, ABS brakes, traction control, electronic stability control and anti-slip regulation. Also available are front airbags, side and curtain airbags, a tyre pressure sensor, electric mirrors and a quality CD audio system. Basic models get 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, while climbing up the model range allows for 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include special upholstery, cruise control, onboard computer, rear power windows and side mirror with electric parking position. The sporty FR gets the first turbo engine, sports seats, lowered suspension and other trim bits. The Cupra carries the FR concept further with an upgraded turbo engine and a body kit, among other changes. The Cupra R replaced the Cupra later on with more power.

The Porsche Macan is a second SUV for the German premium brand and hopes to replicate the success of the Cayenne, albeit in the compact crossover segment. Taking the front fascia from its elder brother, the Macan doesn't disappoint in terms of looks. The rear of the vehicle however, is unique and could be termed as a love-or-hate affair. But the wide tyres which range from 18-inch to 21-inches do complement the somewhat muscular stance of the Macan. But it must be noted that it stands shorter and is marginally longer than its Q5 counterpart. As for the variants, Porsche has three. The first being the Macan S, which is equipped with a 3.0-litre twin-turbo V6 engine. It also features an active all-wheel-drive and a 7-speed double-clutch transmission. The second variant in the lineup is the Macan Turbo which gets a 3.6-litre turbocharged pertrol engine. Porsche claim that it is set to be the most powerful vehicle in the compact SUV segment. The third variant is the Macan Diesel which features a 3.0-litre turbo diesel engine, mated to a 7-speed transmission as well. The Diesel is not available in all GCC markets, unless special-ordered. Height-adjustable air suspension is optional on the S and standard on the Turbo. As with any Porsche, the interior is carefully setup. It follows the generic Porsche cockpit, but there happens to be a new steering wheel which is a welcome change from the one on the Cayenne. The Macan's interior comes in a variety of colours, but there also happens to be a Piano Black interior package with Alcantara inserts for the seats on the S variant. Available features include a multimedia touchscreen, navigation, rear camera, power seats, panoramic glass roof and much more from a long list of options. Safety features include Porsche Stability Management (PSM), as well as airbags for driver and passenger all around the vehicle.

The Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG has been completely redesigned, in line with the rest of the S-Class range. It is still motivated by a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, but produces more power than its predecessor. The engine can be coupled with rear-wheel-drive or an AMG-tuned 4Matic all-wheel-drive system, as well as an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 7-speed automatic transmission. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. There's also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. It rides on optional 19-inch or 20-inch light-weight alloys too. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The previous Lancer will continue to be sold alongside this new Lancer. The new model, dubbed the Lancer EX, comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.5-litre and a 2.0-litre. Both models come with a five-speed manual, while optionally, the smaller engine gets a four-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Features in the most basic model includes a driver's airbag, CD player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers. There are various trim levels right up to the top GT model which adds a sporting body kit, sunroof, adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio switches, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, rear split seats with centre armrest, dual front airbags, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, paddle-shifters with the CVT, and a full keyless operation system.

The Changan CS35 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering, currently being sold only in a few GCC countries. Under the hood of the CS35 is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB/CD support, 6 speakers, halogen headlamps, parking sensors, fog lamps and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get sunroof, leather wrapped steering wheel and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features on the car include ABS, electronic brake distribution and brake assist, and front driver & passenger airbags, while higher models get side curtain airbags.

The Terracan is odd one out in the Hyundai range. It is a capable midsize off-road vehicle based on the old Mitsubishi Pajero, just the right size to not be too big on the roads. The problem is that it became outdated as soon as it was released. This 80s-style 4WD does have a fairly spacious  interior and loaded with features to compete in this class, with a low price to boot. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to an automatic, it comes with beefy tyres on 16-inch alloy wheels and a full-time 4WD system with active torque transfer. Standard features include power steering, single airbag, a nifty limited slip differential, central door locking system, side steps, roof rack, power windows and electric mirrors, front and rear a/c, front fog lamps, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and hidden antenna, and rear wiper with washer. Options include dual airbags, ABS brakes, keyless entry with anti-theft system, leather interior upholstery, useless rear spoiler, fake wood trim, cruise control, digital multi-metre, electric driver's seat, CD player with 6 speakers, and a few more storage areas.

The Foton View C1 minibus is the Chinese manufacturer's light commercial van offering. It is sold in select GCC countries. Only the 2.2-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine is sold in this region. Standard features include power steering, manual mirrors, manual windows, central locking, fabric seats, manual front and rear A/C, radio with USB and 15-inch steel rims with hubcaps.

The original Continental by Bentley is a large, expensive, luxury coupÃƒÂ© made by Rolls-Royce for a 10-year run. It was the first Bentley in 25 years to not feature a body shared with a Rolls-Royce model. It was also the first Bentley to use a GM  4-speed automatic transmission to work Bentley's long-running twin-turbo 6.8-litre V8. Power output of the earliest models are unknown, as Rolls Royce was too snobby to reveal numbers. But back then, the Continental was still the quickest, most expensive, and most powerful Bentley ever. The convertible version was called the Bentley Azure, launched in 1995. The cabin featured usual Bentley traits such as acres of wood, leather and chrome. The standard model was known as the Continental R, but 1994 saw production of a severely-limited Continental S, and then the shortened Continental T was introduced in 1996 as a performance model. Mulliner editions, which started in 1999, added performance upgrades on both the R and the T. A handful of Continental SC models were built in 1999, with a huge lift-out glass sunroof.

With Honda going for premium prices nowadays, the City is about as low as you can go in the Honda range. Introduced for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, it is touted as the perfect `urban` vehicle, with its small exterior and tall interior. There is now a choice of two engines, namely a 1.3-litre four-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a gearless CVT automatic, or a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with a gearless CVT that can imitate a seven-speed gearbox using wheel-mounted buttons. Standard features on the base 1.3-litre model include multi-reflector headlamps, 14-inch steel wheel, air-conditioning with heater, power windows, electric power steering, radio CD player with 2 speakers, cup and card holders, dual airbags and side door beams. Upgrading to the 1.5-litre adds 15-inch alloy wheels, hidden radio antenna, rear 60/40 split seat, rear tip-up seat function, driver seat height adjuster, power locks, electric mirrors, 2 more speakers for the CD stereo, fake wood-finish consoles, keyless entry and ABS brakes.

The Brilliance FSV, known as the BS2 elsewhere, is a Chinese-built compact sedan that's benefitted from technology partnerships from companies such as BMW and Toyota, with a Mitsubishi-design powertrain. Even the simplistic platform with independent-front torsion beam-rear suspension is said to be Lotus-tuned, while Italdesign Giugiaro had a hand in the styling. Available with a single 1.5-litre 4-cylinder "MIVEC" engine mated to a 4-speed automatic, the front-wheel-drive 5-seater is fairly class-competitive. Features in the base "Comfortable" trim level include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, front disc and rear drum brakes, power windows, tilt-adjustable power steering, speed-sensitive central locking, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, fabric upholstery, split-folding rear seats and a single rear foglamp. The "Deluxe" model adds 15-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, front and rear ventilated disc brakes, rear parking sensors, digital a/c, power mirrors, sunroof and front foglamps. All trim levels get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, alarm and collision beams in the doors.

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. An all-new Creta came out in 2020 with a whole new design and updated interior. Under the hood, there are two engines on offer - a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with USB player, and 4 speakers. Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, infotainment with touchscreen, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

The V5 Crossover is aptly named, although we'd say it is more of a minivan segment player. From what we can gather from vague press materials, it aims to include all the comforts of a luxury car with the space and versatility of a wagon. The interior is beautiful in design, though the build quality is far from perfect. The centrally-mounted gauges and the fake wood trim are expected downsides. Powered by the same 2.4-litre four-cylinder Mitsubishi engine that serves most other Chery models, it comes with a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power windows, remote central locking, CD player with optional 6-disc changer, 16-inch alloy wheels, manual cloth seats or optional electric leather seats, dual front airbags with optional front-side airbags, ABS-assisted four-wheel-disc brakes with EBD, power mirrors, parking sensors, power steering, optional DVD navigation, sunroof and of course an alarm system should someone try to steal your Chery.

Common hard-working people desire to own a car with a decent amount of interior space, fuel economy, reliability and adequate performance, all for a reasonable price. The all-new Tiida arrives as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. The fact that it's partly based on the Renault Megane, a European stalwart, means you get some Euro driving dynamics alongside traditional Japanese reliability. It is pleasantly surprising how big the Tiida feels inside. There is good head room and even tall passengers will find rear seat legroom as good as that in many much larger cars. Available as a five-door hatchback or a four-door sedan, the Tiida is available with either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine, with manual or automatic transmissions. Standard features include electric power steering, tilt steering column, 60/40 split folding rear seats, air conditioning with micro filter and a CD stereo system. Safety features include front airbags and ABS brakes. Power accessories are optional. The Tiida received a minor facelift for the 2009 model year, as Nissan made available a "sport" body kit option. Other new available features include cruise control, 6-CD changer, MP3 capability, IPod-ready AUX input, a 6-speaker audio system, fully automated air-conditioning and a trip computer.

The new-for-2008 CTS receives a major update that features a redesigned exterior, a finer interior and available all-wheel drive for the first time. Powering the CTS will be the carryover 3.6-litre V6 engine or a new higher-output 3.6-litre direct-injection V6 with variable valve timing. The latest base engine is a 2.8-litre V6. A new 6-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive are standard on all GCC-spec V6 models. Sitting on a wider stance, the exterior is characterized by a larger chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights, signature LED lighting and a smoother look. Inside, the interior is more luxurious and adds more technological features including a DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy rims, Bluetooth, and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced.

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports convertible. In 2017, two 4-cylinder engines were available, a naturally aspirated 1.6-litre and a supercharged 1.8-litre engine. Both are available with a 6-speed manual transmission. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. The soft-top is standard on the Elise, with the option of a hard-top as well. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The Q50 is also longer, wider and sits lower than the previous generation, which was the G37. For 2017, it got new engines and for the 2018 model year it got a slight facelift. The interior gets Infiniti's InTouch system, a touch screen which displays information and navigation. Owners will also be able to download, update and synch personal apps through their smartphones and USB drives.  The standard motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit which made its debut in 2015. In 2017, a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine was introduced, available in two different tunes. There is also a 3.5-litre V6 engine coupled with an electric motor, which will be available in select markets. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Only the more powerful GLC 63 AMG S version is sold in the GCC. In 2020, the GLC 63 AMG got a slight facelift. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Countryman continues BMW's trend to make the Mini model range not-so-mini any more. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and yet powered by the same Mini engines, namely the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder in turbo and non-turbo forms. The base model for the GCC will be the Mini Cooper Countryman in front-wheel-drive, while the Cooper S Countryman will come with the turbo engine as well as a choice of front-wheel-drive or "ALL4" all-wheel-drive. Both come with a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The Renault Twizy is designed as an "ultramobile" and is just 2.34 metres long, 1.24 metres wide and 1.45 metres tall. It is available in only four colours blue, white, red and black -- from which customers can choose many styling combinations. Different stickers can also be added to the doors and rims. We're classifying it as a mini-hatchback, but the truth is this four-wheeled 2-seater is hard to categorise. The passenger sits behind the driver, crammed in somehow. The Twizy's electric motor can run up to 85 km on a single charge. The lithium-ion batteries takes about 3.5 hours to charge completely using a 220-240v powerpoint. For safety, the Twizy comes with a 4-point seatbelt and a steering-wheel airbag. It is equipped with disc brakes as well and an optional rear-parking aid.

The Brilliance H530 is the Chinese company's compact sedan offering, featuring a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design was penned by Italy's Pininfarina. The front-wheel drive H530 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with MP3/USB/AUX support, manual A/C, rear sensors and 15-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets leather seats, keyless start and keyless entry system, digital A/C, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

Based on a stretched version of the latest 'B6' Passat platform, the redesigned Skoda Superb is a 5-door liftback sedan, with an innovative tailgate that can open as a regular sedan boot or as a full liftback boot, known as 'Twin-Door.' A traditional station-wagon joined the range in 2012. Various VW-derived engines are available, although the only engines available for the GCC, from 2012, is the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and front-wheel-drive for the wagon, and a 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive for the sedan. Both are mated to a 6-speed "DSG" automanual. The Superb 2.0 TSI wagon is available with power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc CD changer and a 6.5-inch touchscreen, SD card and AUX inputs, automatic climate-control a/c, and a choice of upholstery. The Superb 3.6 sedan adds various other luxuries, such as a 12-speaker sound system, 18-inch alloys, standard leather interior and more. Available features include a Bluetooth phone, pull-up rear sun blinds, parking sensors with visual aid and a 'Park Assist' automatic parallel-parking system. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control and ABS. The Superb may not be available in all markets in the GCC.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. The S 63 AMG came by 2008. It gets the 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Also features such as a reversing camera, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels are included.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre. Next are three supercharged 1.8-litre engines, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon, also depending on model year. The 2.6-litre is also available, as is a 3.2-litre, both V6. The V6 models can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The supercharged 3.2-litre C 32 AMG comes in sedan form only, as the wagon wasn't offered here. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers were hesitant to bring any over. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

The 5th-generation 3-Series coupe was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The 9-7X is an American-sourced 4WD derived undeniably from the Chevrolet Trailblazer, although Saab tries hard to integrate typical Saab traits into it, such as the aircraft-like front end, sportier driving dynamics, and the ignition in the lower center console like in all the Swedish sedans. The 9-7X features standard automatic all-wheel drive, a 4.2-litre inline-6 or a 5.3-litre V8, and a four-speed automatic transmission. Features, standard or optional, 18-inch alloy wheels, Xenon headlamps, trailer-hitch wiring harness, headlamp washers, power windows and mirrors, optional moonroof, leather seats, adjustable pedals, wood-effect trim, leather steering wheel with audio controls, driver information centre, power door locks, remote keyless entry, cruise control, theft deterrent system, dual zone auto climate control, AM/FM stereo with 6-CD in-dash changer, Bose speaker audio system, rear seat audio controls, limited slip differential, sport-tuned chassis, and a tool kit. Safety features include front dual airbags, front side-curtain airbags, rollover sensor, 3-point seatbelts for all seating positions, ABS brakes and stability control.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro Convertible was launched for the 2017 model year. While the exterior may not be that different from the previous generation, under the hood the 3.6-litre V6 and 6.2-litre V8 engines have been upgraded with more power. The 2019 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible got a facelift and some interior upgrades. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 2019 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features on the 2019 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

The compact V50 wagon and its S40 sedan sibling are based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the V50 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The V50 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre and a higher-tuned 2.4-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in two different lengths. In 2019, a new generation model came out . It is capable of a 650 kg payload. All the models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with USB, AUX and Bluetooth, manual a/c and single-side sliding door. Safety features include 2 airbags in the front, ABS, EBD, ESC tire pressure monitor, hill assist and rear parking sensors.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. No changes were made for the 2019 model year. It has four models - the E200, E250, E300 which get the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and the all-wheel drive E400 which gets the 4.0-litre turbocharged V6 motor. All models get the 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad.  For the first time, air suspension is now offered. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's line-up. Completely redesigned for 2012, it remains the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive and is offered in the GCC as a 5-door hatchback alongside the older-generation 1-Series coupe and convertible that carried on into the 2012 model year. Petrol versions now include the 1.6-litre 116i, the 2.0-litre 118i and the turbocharged 2.0-litre 125i, although all models are not offered in all GCC markets. All models come with a choice of 6-speed transmissions, both manual or automatic, although only the automatic version is offered here. An M 135i model was offered from 2013, in 5-door form, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a choice of 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic. While the hatchback was completely redesigned for 2012, the coupe and convertible continued unchanged for one more year. To differentiate the sub-models, BMW offers Sport Line and Urban Line models which differ by alloy wheels, kidney grille and other appearance-related features. All trims come standard with common power accesories, cloth or leather upholstery, front and side airbags, stability control and ABS, alongside various optional features such as HID headlights, "active" steering, stereo choices and various wheel sizes. BMW claims to have improved cabin materials from the last 1 series. All models are equipped with start-stop and a/c as standard. Higher trims will include a 8.8-inch LCD monitor and Bluetooth hands-free with USB connectivity. BMW's Drive Performance Control is standard on all models. Drive Performance Control allows the driver to select one of four modes. These include Comfort, Sport, Sport+, and ECO PRO. ECO PRO aims to save fuel by adjusting throttle response to encourage slower acceleration and by limiting the use of accessories like air-conditioning, heated mirrors and seats.

The Rexton II is the latest version Ssangyong's attractive original Rexton. It was launched in the Middle East alongside two other now-defunct 4WDs back in 2002, and has survived with a facelift for 2007. The five-door Rexton can seat up to seven people and comes with a host of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, fake wood trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control is also available.

The Toyota Land Cruiser got a makeover for its 2016 model year. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. Engine choices include a 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with an 8-speed automatic. In 2017, Saudi Arabia started offering a 4.5-litre V8 turbo-diesel model as well. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. In the UAE, there are three trim levels, namely EXR, GXR and VXR. The KSA market has GX, GXR and VXR trims, with further variants within them. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 18-inch alloys on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional dealer-installed rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional dealer-installed leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items. Further available features include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, a front chin spoiler and extra chrome trim on some GXR and all VXR models, with 20-inch wheels and more on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, factory leather, adaptive cruise, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system.  In some GCC countries a special edition VXS model was available in 2017, which had a JBL audio system, wireless charging, rear entertainment system with wireless headphones, and diamond stitched leather seats. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on V8 models only.

The Cadenza has been redesigned for the 2014 model year. However, in the GCC it still comes with the same 3.5-litre "MPI" V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox from the previous model. Features, standard or otherwise, include a CD/MP3 stereo with six JBL speakers and iPod/USB support, 6-disc CD changer, cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 17-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes.

The Continental Flying Spur was launched in 2006 as the 4-door version of the Continental GT. It is also their first sedan model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the unloved VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets. Standard equipment on the Spur includes HID headlights, 19-inch alloy wheels, a tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, keyless entry and ignition, rain-sensing wipers, powered trunk lid and a choice of 16 colours. On the inside, one has a choice of 17 colours for the leather-appointed interior with matching carpets and seatbelts. The cabin features steering-column mounted shift paddles, sunroof with electronic sunshade, DVD navigation, six-CD changer and Bluetooth. Almost all seats feature lumbar massage, memory and heat settings. Options include a choice of three 19-inch wheel styles and a 20-inch wheel and tyre package, ceramic brakes, and the sunroof can be had with a solar panel to power ventilation fans to maintain interior temperature when parked, a full-length centre console and numerous trim choices. Convenience options include a cordless privacy handset with keypad in centre console, a rear telephone system, and a rear-view camera. The Continental Flying Spur is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. An unnoticeable facelift came in mid-2008, as well as a new Flying Spur Speed variant, adding more power, while improving performance and handling.

The Hyundai i10 received a facelift for the 2011 model year. It also gets a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with VTVT (Variable Timing and Valve Train) technology, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The CK is Geely's first offering in a few GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia and the UAE, although it first went on sale in China a couple of years prior. The name "CK" somehow stands for "Freedom Ship" or "Free Cruiser" in Chinese. The CK holds the distinction of being the first Chinese automobile ever displayed at an American auto show, although it has never been allowed to be on sale there. The reasons are that it failed crash tests and emissions regulations. The small car was developed in China, but is supposedly based on a South Korean design by Daewoo. Its 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine is licenced from Toyota. The front-wheel-drive sedan comes with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Features include manual air-conditioning, remote locking, fog lamps, CD stereo, power steering, painted bumpers, power windows, intermittent wipers, 14-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery and more. Options include leather upholstery, ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, dual front airbags,

The Hyundai Grand i10 comes in both hatchback and sedan body styles. It has a longer wheelbase than the regular i10, therefore interior space is better. Features, either standard or optional, include smart key, engine start button, a rear parking assist system, AUX, IPOD, USB, Bluetooth and audio control buttons on the steering wheel. Only the hatchback model offers Electronic Stability Control and Vehicle Stability Management. A two-tone colour scheme has been applied to the instrument panel and seats. Two engine options will be available, a 3-cylinder 1.0-litre motor and 4-cylinder 1.25-litre unit. Consumers can choose between a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic.

The BMW M3 convertible debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

JAC J5 is the Chinese brand's 7-seater minivan offering. It features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, fabric seats, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with MP3/USB/AUX support, 6 speakers, roof rails, parking sensors and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better stereo system with 8 speakers, fog lamps, automatic headlamps and leather seats. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Lexus RC F is the Japanese luxury brand's performance compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC F carries on with a naturally-aspirated 5.0-litre V8 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control. A carbon package replaces the bonnet, roof and boot with carbon-fibre body panels.

The Yaris is Toyota's replacement for the goofy Echo. But the Yaris is a much better basic transportation option than the Echo ever was. The Yaris actually looks somewhat stylish even though it is still a pudgy little car, but it offers perky performance and an interior that looks great, but is devoid of soft-touch materials. The sedan comes with a very weak 1.3-litre mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto. In 2008, an optional 1.5-litre engine was offered, bundled with a body kit. Standard items include power steering, a tilt-adjustable steering wheel, front and rear cupholders, two airbags, radio cassette player, 14-inch steel wheels, and ABS brakes. The suspension is independent in front and torsion beam in the rear. Options include a CD player with MP3 capability, a 60/40 split fold-down rear seat, 15-inch alloy wheels and a rear spoiler.

An all-new Mitsubishi L200 was released as a 2016 model year. It got a significant facelift in 2019. It is sold in the GCC purely as a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Safety features include ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Volkswagen Golf GTI always had a good following here, even though hatchbacks were never so popular in this region. The 4-cylinder turbocharged 2.0-litre GTI is satisfyingly fast and features a dual-clutch automanual gearbox that is still rare in any class of car that was affordable at the time. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

The Yaris is Toyota's replacement for the goofy Echo. But the Yaris is a much better basic transportation option than the Echo ever was. The Yaris actually looks somewhat stylish even though it is still a pudgy little car, but it offers perky performance and an interior that looks great, but is devoid of soft-touch materials. The hatchback comes with a very weak 1.3-litre mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto. Standard items include power steering, a tilt-adjustable steering wheel, front and rear cupholders, two airbags, radio cassette player, 14-inch steel wheels, and ABS brakes. The suspension is independent in front and torsion beam in the rear. Options include a CD player with MP3 capability, a 60/40 split fold-down rear seat, 15-inch alloy wheels and a rear spoiler.

From 2012, the design all-new Porsche 911 incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than the previous generation. It is still a 2+2 seater coupe. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.4-litre direct-injection flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The 911 Carrera 4, which was introduced in 2013, adds all-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S upgrades the motor to a 3.8-litre, while the, new for 2013, 911 Carrera 4S adds all-wheel-drive. The Porsche 911 Targa and Targa 4S was revealed as a 2014 model year, getting the same engine specs as the Carrera 4 and 4S. The 911 Turbo and Turbo S was released in 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre turbocharged engine, and comes only with the PDK transmission. The Porsche 911 GT3 was revealed in mid 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre motor and for the first time, will not have a manual gearbox option. It will be available only with the PDK. The 911 GTS was revealed in the GCC in late 2014 and is available as rear-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. It is powered by a 3.8-litre motor, coupled with either a 7-speed manual or PDK transmission. The Porsche Targa 4 and Targa 4S also made its debut as 2015 model year, which features the same engine specs as the base 911 Carrera and has all-wheel drive. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

The Ferrari 488 GTB replaced the 458 Italia in late 2015. Under the hood, the 488 GTB gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The exterior is still pretty similar to the 458, but gets a few visual updates, most of which have been added to improve aerodynamics and performance. The interior is quite similiar to the 458 with minor tweaks such as angled air vents and improved graphics on the infotainment and instrument panel, as well as keyless start. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Outback is the redesigned model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive crossover wagon. Like all previous Outback models for more than a decade, the new-for-2010 version continues to be based on the Legacy wagon, only with slightly better ground clearance. Compared to the previous version, it now features a larger body and carryover engines. The base Outback 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 3.6R, with a turbocharged 3.6-litre 6-cylinder boxer engine mated to a paddle-shifted 5-speed automatic. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Chevrolet Traverse received a facelift for 2013. It is a crossover wagon that combines the functionality of a minivan with the look of an SUV, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, with either front-wheel-drive or optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include 6.5 inches touch screen for navigation, entertainment and display vehicle information, rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Sportage is another of Kia's long-running nameplates, though the crossover itself has changed over time. Whereas the original Sportage was unreliable but could do basic off-roading, the new one is much more dependable but is allergic to sand dunes. It is even offered in a front-wheel-drive model alongside the four-wheel-drive, to dilute the nameplate further. Powered by either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, or a 2.7-litre V6 with a four-speed automatic, it is interesting to note that Kia and parent Hyundai are the first ones to officially offer a V6-powered small 4WD in the region. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, height-adjustable driver seat, power windows, front and rear power outlets, immobiliser, 60/40 split-folding rear seat, front and rear cup holders, 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette stereo with 4 speakers and a roof antenna. We could not verify what safety features are available on the Sportage, though ABS brakes and front airbags might possibly be options.

The Corsa is the smallest car among Opel models offered in the Middle East. Its extensive safety package and rigid galvanized body have been tested to excel in passenger protection. Body styles available in the Middle East are three-door and five-door hatchbacks, as well as a 4-door sedan. Opel went the extra step and added colour-keyed bumpers and high-level safety features, which is rare in this class of cars. Two engine options are available here, namely a 1.4-litre unit and a 1.8-litre unit, both four-cylinder. Both powerplants power the front wheels using the available standard manual transmission, but the smaller motor has an optional automatic five-speed transmission with manual shifting mode. All cars can seat five. A fold-down rear backrest can be fixed at two different angles and a rear bench can be fully folded down. Available features include power windows, cloth upholstery and CD stereo. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

The Mitsubishi Mirage takes on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. In 2017, it got a facelift and few interior upgrades. This sub-compact hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

The BMW M3 convertible debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The redesigned-for-2011 Chrysler 300 looks similar to the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but in reality has many major changes, including a sharper-sloping windshield and a lower belt-line for better visibility. The new 300 thankfully remains rear-wheel-drive and features updated suspension, upgraded engine and a much nicer interior. The top model, the 300 SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Suzuki Jimny got a complete overhaul, debuting in late 2018 with much fanfare. However, the hype was muted once it became clear that it is still following the old formula, with an outdated 1.5-litre engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic gearbox. It only comes in 3-door "wide body" form for the UAE and GCC. A ladder-frame chassis, three-link rigid axle suspension and part-time four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing are all standard. Also standard is a hard plastic interior, with features such as fabric upholstery, power windows, manual a/c and a stereo system. It now has 377 litres of luggage space with the rear seats folded down. When all four seats are occupied, the capacity gets reduced to 85 litres. For easy dirt removal, the backs of the rear seats and the boot floor are now coated with plastic. Dual front airbags and ESP are also standard.

The long-running Town Car is Lincoln's full-size luxury sedan based on the Ford Crown Victoria rear-wheel-drive platform. Numerous trim series are available, including the Signature, the Signature Limited, and the long-wheelbase Signature L. Power comes from a 4.6-litre V8 mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. Town Car puts power to the ground through its rear wheels via a 3.27:1 rear-axle ratio, with traction control and ABS brakes as standard. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch wheels, rear parking assist, keyless entry, CD stereo, leather seats, auto-dimming rearview mirror, front and side airbags, automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals and power-adjustable front seats. Options in higher trims include HID headlights, CD changer, sunroof, two-tone paint and power-operated luggage trunk lid. The car is pretty dated now, but a mild redesign in 2003 involved upgrades both inside and out.

The second generation Porsche Panamera came out as a 2017 model year. In 2021, some of the models got a slight facelift and more power. The trims available in the GCC include the base Panamera, along with the, Panamera 4, Panamera 4 E-Hybrid, Panamera 4S E-Hybrid, Panamera GTS, Panamera Turbo S, and Turbo S E-Hybrid. The base model and the Panamera 4 gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6,  while the Panamera Turbo S and Panamera GTS gets a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8. The Panamera 4/4S E-Hybrid gets a 2.9-litre turbo with an electric motor combined with it, whereas the Turbo S E-Hybrid gets a V8 4.0-litre turbo unit combined with an electric motor. Some updates on the new generation include an improved adaptive air suspension system and optional rear-axle steering. Inside, the interior gets a new instrument cluster with two 7-inch displays. The centre console gets a 12.3-inch touch screen, while the rear passenger get their own set of infotainment and climate controls. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

Maserati Levante is the Italian premium car maker's first venture into the SUV market. Under the hood is a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, available in two different tunes. Power is delivered to the wheels via an 8-speed automatic. Standard features on the all-wheel drive Levante include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, 4-zone AC, electric seats and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include interior leather packages, sports kit, roof rails, adaptive bi-xenon headlights, skid plate, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy rims. Safety features include 6 airbags, lane departure warning system, forward collision alert, blind spot monitor, adaptive cruise control and traction control.

The Touran 7-seater is a minivan smaller than the Sharan, with four forward-opening doors and a rear tailgate. Engines include the small 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, both four-cylinder units with a manual or automatic. Standard equipment includes stability control, ABS with brake assist system, six airbags, active head restraints for driver and front passenger, and three-point automatic seat belts for all seats. Among the most important features of this new Volkswagen are its versatile interior layout and the good amount of space it provides, with a load area that can be as large as 1,989 litres. The three separate seats in the second row each weigh less than 16 kilograms and can be individually slid forward and back, repositioned sideways, folded into a very small space or removed completely. Similarly, the two rear seats can be folded flat into the floor when not in use. There are up to 39 storage spaces and compartments inside the well-planned interior.

The Lexus IS debuted as an all-new sedan in 2007, and has received a very minor facelift as well as new versions to choose from in 2011. The facelift includes the addition of LED running lights and redone tail lamps. The carryover GCC-specific with the 3.0-litre V6 and 6-speed automatic continues in the IS 300 sedan. An IS 250 sedan with a 2.5-litre V6 and 6-speed automatic newly joined the range as a base model, but was dropped by the end of 2012. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof, ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

Supposed to be Peugeot's flagship model, the 607 offers premium levels of refinement and equipment. First launched in 2002 and mildly facelifted a few times, the 607 was the first Peugeot sedan to push design boundaries, but lost out in drive due to an unremarkable front-wheel-drive chassis. The 607 was restyled in 2004, and still looks good as ever. Among the exterior cosmetic changes, the front of the 607 was restyled and its overall length increased slightly, but it is still not big enough to qualify as a full-size car. The interior of the 607 is more spacious than any other Peugeot model. The only engine is a 3.0-litre V6 with a six-speed automatic transmission with tiptronic function. Standard features include bi-zone digital air conditioning with climate control, a heat reflective windshield and lightly tinted glass, leather with aluminium detailing, electrically-adjustable front seats, and power windows, locks and mirrors. It is well-equipped in terms of passive safety, with eight airbags as standard, including front-and-rear side and curtain bags.

The Azera is Hyundai's attempt at the high end executive car market, occupied by only a handful of models which combine luxury with a affordable price. The Azera actually offers a lot more for its price than its Japanese and American competitors however, and this 3.3-litre V6-powered automatic sedan is an impressive effort on Hyundai's part. A 2.7-litre V6 joined the range later. A minor frontal facelift added a larger grille in 2010. Standard features on the base model include just a single airbag for the driver, power steering, power windows, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD and MP3 capability and six speakers, cruise control, dual zone fully automatic air conditioning, dual exhaust system, power mirrors, trip computer, illuminated sun visors with vanity mirrors, rear centre armrest with cup holders, and alloy wheels. Options include dual airbags with side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, Electronic Stability Program, HID Xenon headlights, power sunroof, leather upholstery, power front seats, integrated memory system for driver's seat and mirrors, in-dash 6-CD changer with two more speakers including an Infinity subwoofer and amplifier, rear parking sensors, electric rear curtain, rain-sensing front wipers and some wood on the steering wheel.

The Dodge Challenger SRT received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It also gets forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection. The 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT gets the 6.4-litre V8. A new addition to the engine lineup is the 6.2-litre supercharged unit for the 2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat. The SRT models gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, bi-xenon headlights, heated and ventilated seats wrapped in Nappa leather and Alcantara and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

The Mercedes-Benz S 65 AMG received a minor facelift in 2010. It gets the same twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Options include a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels.

The Lexus RC is the Japanese luxury brand's compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC carries on with a 3.5-litre V6 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, it got a facelift. Enhancements have been made to the RC's aerodynamics, tyres and suspension, and there are also improvements to engine response and steering feel. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control.

The G sedan debuted in 2009 and received a frontal facelift in 2011, along with an entry-level G25 model that came with a 2.5-litre V6 engine. For 2014, the G37 has been dropped, but the G25 remains as a place-holder under the new Q50 sedan. The platform is the corporate front-midship with rear-wheel-drive. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Only a couple of trim levels are offered in markets such as the UAE. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

From 2014, the Infinti FX model became the QX70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. The QX70 will be available in two variants and two different engines. The basic model gets a 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the QX70 S variant gets the 5.0-litre V8, with both engines mated to 7-speed automatic transmissions. Built on the all-wheel-drive front-midship platform, the the QX70 features an extensive list of available equipment. Available features include Continuous Damping Control, Rear Active Steer, and 21-inch lightweight aluminium-alloy wheels designed by Enkei. Inside, the interior has available "sport" seating and advanced audio, optional navigation and technology ranging from an 11-speaker Bose-developed audio system to the intelligent key, available active cruise control and available around-view monitor system. The QX70 offers numerous safety and convenience technologies such as intelligent brake assist, distance control assist, adaptive front lighting system, standard HID headlights, integrated fog lights, rear LED taillights, functional side air vents, aluminium roof rails, leather and wood trim, sunroof, "self-healing" clearcoat paint finish, stability control, and the usual power accessories and multiple airbags. Available safety features include object-detection for the around-view parking camera system as well as voice instructions on how to parallel-park into a specific space.

The Nissan Tiida is all-new for 2014, and is essentially a hatchback version of the Sentra sedan. Two 4-cylinder engine options are available, namely a 1.6-litre and a 1.8-litre, both mated to a CVT automatic. The brakes are front discs with rear drums. The suspension is independent up front, with a torsion-beam rear. The basic 1.6-litre Tiida S features power steering, power windows, central door locking, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with CD player and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. For the 1.6-litre Tiida SV, there's audio controls on the steering wheel, 4 speakers and 16-inch alloy wheels. The 1.8-litre Tiida SV gets additional smoked halogen lamps, smoked-chrome front grille and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 1.8-litre Tiida SL also gets power folding mirrors with integrated side lamp, cruise control, intelligent key, starter button, steering wheel-mounted bluetooth buttons, rear armrest, leather shift knob, 6 speakers and automatic A/C. The Tiida SL Plus optionally adds leather seats and sunroof, although these are standard on the SL in some markets such as the UAE.
