For the UAE market specifically, the SV and SL models get a 5.8-inch display screen with Bluetooth, CD player, MP3, AUX, USB, Ipod connectivity, navigation and rear-view camera as standard, although these may be optional in other GCC markets. A fully body kit is also optionally available in some markets. Standard safety features for the Nissan Tiida include dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and brake assist (BA). The 1.8-litre models also get stability control, and only the top 1.8 SL Plus gets side and curtain airbags.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG made its debut as a 2014 model year. Slightly taller and wider, the new S65 features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Korean-built Captiva is the General's first proper entry into the softroader market, offering a choice of two powertrains, namely the 2.4-litre four-cylinder with manual or automatic, and the 3.2-litre V6 with automatic. Features include wheels from 16-inch up to 18-inch, turn signals integrated into its exterior mirrors and holes in the front fenders. Protective moldings and front-rear skid plates define its look. Generous interior dimensions offer decent cargo space and seating for as many as seven. Class-leading safety features include an optional rollover protection system, dual front airbags, optional traction control and standard ABS brakes. There is also hill descent control system to go down steep hills, which is an odd addition since the Captiva can be had in front-wheel-drive trim too, in addition to the all-wheel-drive model. Additional features, standard or optional, include an MP3-capable CD stereo with steering wheel controls and MP3 player inputs, parking sensors, sunroof and a trip computer.

Toyota introduced an all-new model in 2019 of the Avalon. The design has been completely changed, however, mechanically it gets the same 3.5-litre V6 engine, but with more power. It is built on the Toyota New Global Architecture platform (TNGA) which underpins the current Camry and Prius. This promises a quieter ride. Every dimension of the Avalon has grown compared to the old model. The rear cabin is almost 20 cm longer which has translated to more space for the rear passengers. The looks of the Toyota Avalon builds on the smaller Camry but with many sharper lines. The LED headlights and taillights are not enough to balance out that desperately massive grille, intended to make the car stand out more. The XSE and Touring trims will have even better looks with piano black finishes, a boot spoiler, diffuser panels and quad exhausts. The interior of the Avalon is obviously a lot more opulent. Though it takes some stuff from the Camry, it looks far more luxurious than it. In the dash, there is a 9-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system which comes with Apple CarPlay making it the first Toyota vehicle to feature it. But it still doesn’t get Android Auto. Other amenities include five USB charging ports, wireless charging, a 7-inch trip computer and a 10-inch heads-up-display. There are a bunch of standard safety systems like 10 airbags, pre-collision braking with pedestrian detection, lane-keep assist, adaptive cruise control, automatic high beams and blind spot monitoring. Over these, you can add a panoramic parking camera system and a rear cross-traffic braking system.

The 9-7X is an American-sourced 4WD derived undeniably from the Chevrolet Trailblazer, although Saab tries hard to integrate typical Saab traits into it, such as the aircraft-like front end, sportier driving dynamics, and the ignition in the lower center console like in all the Swedish sedans. The 9-7X features standard automatic all-wheel drive, a 4.2-litre inline-6 or a 5.3-litre V8, and a four-speed automatic transmission. Features, standard or optional, 18-inch alloy wheels, Xenon headlamps, trailer-hitch wiring harness, headlamp washers, power windows and mirrors, optional moonroof, leather seats, adjustable pedals, wood-effect trim, leather steering wheel with audio controls, driver information centre, power door locks, remote keyless entry, cruise control, theft deterrent system, dual zone auto climate control, AM/FM stereo with 6-CD in-dash changer, Bose speaker audio system, rear seat audio controls, limited slip differential, sport-tuned chassis, and a tool kit. Safety features include front dual airbags, front side-curtain airbags, rollover sensor, 3-point seatbelts for all seating positions, ABS brakes and stability control.

The long-running Town Car is Lincoln's full-size luxury sedan based on the Ford Crown Victoria rear-wheel-drive platform. Numerous trim series are available, including the Signature, the Signature Limited, and the long-wheelbase Signature L. Power comes from a 4.6-litre V8 mated to a four-speed automatic transmission. Town Car puts power to the ground through its rear wheels via a 3.27:1 rear-axle ratio, with traction control and ABS brakes as standard. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch wheels, rear parking assist, keyless entry, CD stereo, leather seats, auto-dimming rearview mirror, front and side airbags, automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals and power-adjustable front seats. Options in higher trims include HID headlights, CD changer, sunroof, two-tone paint and power-operated luggage trunk lid. The car is pretty dated now, but a mild redesign in 2003 involved upgrades both inside and out.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is smaller than the Armada, but still big enough to qualify as a big 4WD. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its smooth on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The latest engine is a 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A new five-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features. After the launch of the all-new 2010 model, this older version continued to be sold briefly in a stripped-down format at a lower base price.

Launched in 2005 and facelifted for 2008, the compact S40 sedan is based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the S40 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The S40 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre, a higher-tuned 2.4-litre and a turbocharged 2.5-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The Picanto is one of the smallest cars plying the Middle East's aggressive roads. Introduced for 2005, it has been facelifted for 2008. Powered by a tiny 1.1-litre four-cylinder, it is smaller than a family-size Coke bottle, mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The tall styling makes sure there is fair headroom, though legroom is conservative at best. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, radio cassette player with roof antenna and 4 speakers, manual air-conditioning, combination vinyl-cloth cabin, variable intermittent front wipers, front cup holder, seat belts and, thankfully, a tachometer. Available features in higher trim levels include a rear wiper and washer, rear shelf cover over the luggage area, body-coloured exterior trim pieces and bumpers, a luggage net, and not much else. We believe most markets do not get anything more than seat belts as safety features, although a few markets do get the front-wheel-drive Picanto with all sorts of optional airbags.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The goofy B-Class is touted as a Compact Sports Tourer, when it really is a tall hatchback. Though the A-Class is still in production, its sale seems to have been cancelled here, with this one taking its place. Mercedes-Benz is also touting their the sandwich concept, to which it credits the space-saving arrangement of the engine and transmission partly in front of and partly beneath the passenger cell, which in turn offers the interior spaciousness of larger saloons and estate cars despite its compact external dimensions. There is a height-adjustable load compartment floor, an asymmetrically divided, folding and removable rear seat unit plus an optionally removable front passenger seat, all of which allows conversion from a comfortable touring car to a practical van. Models include the B 150, the B 170, the B 200 and the B 200 Turbo, all four-cylinder, rear-wheel-drive, and available with a choice of manual or CVT automatic, plus all the creature comforts and safety features of a Mercedes-Benz.

The California is the first Ferrari ever with a front-mounted V8, as well as the first Ferrari with a direct-injection engine, a 7-speed transmission and a folding metal roof. The engine itself is a 4.3-litre V8, mated to the 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox and rear-wheel-drive. Focused slightly more on comfort than on track prowess, the F149-designated California comes with a customisable leather-clad cabin, CD stereo with LCD multimedia screen, and a multi-function steering wheel with starter button and driving-mode selection. It seats only two and has a shelf behind the seats along with a useable luggage trunk, as well as all the usual power accessories, airbags and electronic safety nannies. The comfort angle further enhanced by a new multilink rear suspension system instead of the usual sporting double-wishbones. The Ferrari California is also equipped with the exclusive F1-Trac traction control system which made its debut on the 599 GTB Fiorano. Brembo brakes featuring carbon-ceramic material discs are standard. Not much else to write home about though.

This mini-car, also known as the Atos Prime occassionally, is in such a rare category that few people heard about it, and even fewer have bought one. It is amazingly cheap, but even more amazingly small, which seems to be to its detriment in this region. Powered by either 1.0-litre or 1.1-litre four-cylinder engines, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or automatic, while the slightly larger engine gets only an automatic as well as better fuel economy, Standard features include air- conditioning, seat under-tray for the front passenger, AM/FM radio and cassette player, a fold-down rear seat and, of course, wind-up windows. Move up to the better trims, and available features include power steering, front fog lamps, central door locking, power windows, rear wiper with washer, seat back pockets, better cloth upholstery, body-coloured door handles and outside mirrors, and the all-important seat under-tray both under the passenger as well as the driver's seat, to store your dirty magazines. Safety features include nothing more than the metal holding up the body panels.

The Ford Transit is the brand's large commercial van offering. It seats up to 2 people, and comes in 3 roof heights: Low, Medium and High. It comes in 2 wheelbases and 3 lengths:RWB, LWB and LWB EL. Under the hood, the 2022 Ford Transit gets the 3.7-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, vinyl seats, halogen headamps, AM/FM stereo, 4 front speakers, auxiliary audio input jack and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features include AdvanceTrac with RSC (Roll Stability Control), airbags – driver and front-passenger, airbags – Safety Canopy System with side-curtain airbags for front row, passenger-side front airbag with deactivation switch and rear view camera with trailer hitch assist, SOS Post Crash Alert System, and tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS).

The Hyundai Azera fills the gap between the mid-size Sonata and the luxury Genesis sedan. It has been completely overhauled for the 2018 model year. The new Azera, known as Grandeur in Korea, comes with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Features in the 2019 Hyundai Azera include smart keyless entry with starter button, mood lighting, available panoramic sunroof, fake wood trim, rear sunshade, Apple Carplay system with Smartphone mirroring, premium analogue clock, auto-dimming mirror, electric parking brake with auto hold, leather powered seats, fog lamps, and parking sensors. Optional features in higher trims include xenon lights, memory and seat massage for driver, heating & cooling for front seats, electric tilt & telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth, tyre pressure monitoring system, electric folding mirrors, adaptive cruise control, rain sensor, dual-zone a/c, and a DVD Navigation system with rear camera. Safety features include up to 8 airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was released as a 2014 model year. The Thai-built Yaris receives two 4-cylinder engines to choose from. The base gets a 1.3-litre, where as higher models get a 1.5-litre. They both get a 4-speed automatic transmission, while some select markets get the 5-speed manual transmission. In 2016, only the 1.5-litre model is sold in the UAE available in SE, SE+ and Sport trims. In Saudi Arabia, the 1.3-litre is available as a fleet, standard, Y and YX trims, while the 1.5-litre is available in Y and YX trims. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the Sport, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, steering wheel control for audio, sportier seats, 15-inch alloy wheels, smoker metallic plating, different analogue dashboard meter and a body kit with spoiler. The SE+ get automatic air-conditioning, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels, projector headlights and better quality seats. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD).

The McLaren 540C is the second release from the Sports Series lineup after the 570S and is set to be the lowest-priced McLaren on offer. It features a revised aerodynamics package when compared to the 570S, and also features new alloy wheels. For the interior it gets leather-wrapped seats, dashboard and door panels. The infotainment system includes a 7-inch screen, Bluetooth and navigation. Under the hood, is the usual turbocharged 3.8-litre V8, while power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic gearbox. McLaren have also retuned the dampers of the 540C to make it more suitable for daily driving.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Cruze gets a minor facelift for the 2013 model. It is available in sedan and hatchback body-styles in the GCC. The front-wheel-drive compact features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a rare 5-speed manual or a common 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

The Cadillac ATS-V is the American luxury brand's compact sports sedan offering. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS-V gets a twin-turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. A 6-speed manual is available but will most likely not be offered in the GCC. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, automatic headlamps, automatic dual-zone A/C, Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Escalade is all-new for 2007, but still based on the latest version of the Chevrolet Tahoe. The King of Bling is back, bigger, gaudier, more powerful and more fuel efficient than before. Available in either standard five-door 4WD body, ESV long-wheelbase 4WD body or a retarded EXT long-wheelbase 4WD pick-up body, the Escalade ups the ante when it comes to showing off on the streets. The Escalade boasts a massive grille, tighter panel gaps, and a more streamlined exterior, which enables it to get better fuel mileage despite having a more powerful, 6.2-litre V8 engine that makes 403 hp and a whopping 565 Nm of torque. The Escalade models come with standard 18-inch wheels and tyres, but buyers can opt for 22-inchers. Stability control is standard and now incorporates a program to help avoid rollovers, while front side air bags are standard and a full-length head curtain system is available. Other features include automatic dual-zone climate control, tyre pressure monitoring system, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power-adjustable pedals, leather and wood steering wheel with audio controls, leather interior, 14-way power seats, six-CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers and rear-seat audio controls, four ventilated brake discs, speed-sensitive steering, automatic rear level control system, and rear parking assist. All off-roading equipment from the Chevy version has been stripped out in this one.

The futuristic Audi TT Coupe was first launched in late 1998, followed by the Roadster in 1999. It became a trend-setter in terms of style, but mechanical mediocrity meant it was never a true sports car, being based on the same platform that served the VW Golf and the Skoda Octavia. Originally available with two original engine choices, both were turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder units, at different states of tune. The lower model got front-wheel-drive, while the higher-powered model benefitted from standard Quattro all-wheel-drive. First-year models suffered from dangerous high-speed handling due to lift-off oversteer and led to many deaths, so stability control, better stabilisers and a rear lip-spoiler were added from 2000. All versions only had a manual gearbox up till 2003, when an automatic gearbox with manual-shift capability was offered in the lower-powered model. Model-year 2003 also saw a minor unnoticeable facelift as well as the introduction of a 3.2-litre V6 option, available with either a manual or, from 2004, a newly-developed DSG automanual gearbox. The V6 also got standard Quattro all-wheel-drive, stiffer suspension and slightly upgraded body trim. The coupe was a 2+2 seater, while the roadster only had two seats. All versions got a cramped but stylish interior, and could be had with special leather upholstery, the usual power accessories, and more. Variations over the years meant different wheel designs and interior options were available. Final-year 2006 models can be identified by a two-tone paintjob. The original TT was a popular entry into the compact sports-car market due to its looks, but it was always the worst in terms of driving dynamics compared to its more-capable competitors.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro was launched in 2016. In 2019, it got a facelift, along with few  software upgrades to the infotainment system for better usability. Under the hood, it gets two engine options - a 3.6-litre V6 and a 6.2-litre V8 engine. The Camaro also has a  4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, but it is not sold in the GCC.In 2019, the V6 and V8 models got a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 6-speed manual transmission is only available on the V8 model. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof, leather seats and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Chinese Tiggo beautifully illustrates the Koreans' fight for dominance in the small-4WD segment over the Japanese. The Tiggo has a bit of the Kia Sorento front end slapped onto the body of a previous-generation Toyota RAV-4. It kind of reminds us of a fake Rolex watch that has a Swatch lookalike face--a bit of the best and a bit of the average, but still ultimately neither. The five-door five-seater Tiggo does benefit from a versatile interior though, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Powered by a 2.4-litre Mitsubishi-sourced 4-cylinder engine, it comes with either a four-speed auto with two-wheel-drive, or a five-speed manual gearbox with all-wheel-drive. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling. Don't put too much faith in the incredibly low manufacturer-quoted fuel consumption numbers though.

The MG 6 comes in two body shapes, either as a sedan or as a liftback version. There are two 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engines to choose from, one being naturally aspirated and the other a turbocharged unit. They can be had in either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission with optional paddle shifters. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with CD/MP3 support and 8 speakers, trip computer and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, power mirrors, cruise control, parking rear camera, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C, radio with DVD/MP3 support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The Acadia is GMC's first crossover wagon that combines car-like handling with the utility of a 4WD wagon, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. First introduced in 2007, the Acadia got an upgrade under the bonnet in 2009, with a slightly more powerful 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. An Acadia Denali version debuted for 2011, with identical drivetrains as the base model, but with 20-inch wheels, unique front and rear bumpers, chrome mesh grille and upgraded interior trim.

The 9-7X is an American-sourced 4WD derived undeniably from the Chevrolet Trailblazer, although Saab tries hard to integrate typical Saab traits into it, such as the aircraft-like front end, sportier driving dynamics, and the ignition in the lower center console like in all the Swedish sedans. The 9-7X features standard automatic all-wheel drive, a 4.2-litre inline-6 or a 5.3-litre V8, and a four-speed automatic transmission. Features, standard or optional, 18-inch alloy wheels, Xenon headlamps, trailer-hitch wiring harness, headlamp washers, power windows and mirrors, optional moonroof, leather seats, adjustable pedals, wood-effect trim, leather steering wheel with audio controls, driver information centre, power door locks, remote keyless entry, cruise control, theft deterrent system, dual zone auto climate control, AM/FM stereo with 6-CD in-dash changer, Bose speaker audio system, rear seat audio controls, limited slip differential, sport-tuned chassis, and a tool kit. Safety features include front dual airbags, front side-curtain airbags, rollover sensor, 3-point seatbelts for all seating positions, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Cadenza has been redesigned for the 2014 model year. However, in the GCC it still comes with the same 3.5-litre "MPI" V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox from the previous model. Features, standard or otherwise, include a CD/MP3 stereo with six JBL speakers and iPod/USB support, 6-disc CD changer, cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 17-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 is immensely powerful, and features cylinder deactivation technology, seamlessly turning off the fuel consumption in four cylinders of the 5.7-liter HEMI engine when V8 power is not needed, improving fuel economy by up to 20 percent, though one would be hardpressed to notice a difference. The ride is smooth, but corners should be handled with care.

A 2-door coupe joins the Cadillac CTS range in October 2010 as a 2011 model. Alongside the mainstay 3.6-litre direct-injection V6 base model is a supercharged 6.2-litre V8-powered CTS-V. The V6 engine only comes with a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the CTS-V can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. All the cars are rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterised by a large chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 17-inch to 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The BMW X2 is a brand new model introduced as a 2018 model year. It is based on the X1 and Mini Countryman chassis, but offers the "SUV" coupe design. An optional M sport package consisting of sporty suspension, cabin trim and body kit is also offered. The new engines available include the entry-level sDrive18i getting a new 1.5-litre 3-cylinder turbocharged engine. The sDrive20i and sDrive28i gets a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit.  The X2 M35i gets a turbocharged 6-cylinder 3.0-litre all-aluminum motor. An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered, although there is also a 6-speed manual available that will likely never be shipped here by local dealers.The interior features an optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S made its debut in 2014. It is more or less the same specs for the 2016 model year. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. There is no more manual transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

New from the ground up in 2006 and much more better-looking, the American-built M-Class, which actually uses the ML moniker, is a better on-road and off-road 4WD now. Mildly worked over for 2008, and facelifted a few months later, including the addition of a new V8, the M-Class is built for better off-road performance, with permanent all-wheel-drive plus 4ETS, a hill-start aid to help when climbing, and Downhill Speed Regulation to ensure constant speed on downhill tracks. In addition, the optional AIRMATIC package and ADS adaptive damping system so you can increase the ground clearance up to 110 mm at the touch of a button. Various aesthetic options include the off-road styling package, the Chrome package, the Sports package and the Interior equipment package. Models include the 3.5-litre ML 350 and a new 5.5-litre ML 500. All come with a 7-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, man-made leather/Aspen fabric or leather upholstery, tyre pressure loss warning system, crash sensors, front and side airbags, CD radio with pre-installation for mobile phone and more. The AMG kit adds 20-inch or 21-inch alloy wheels.

The MG RX8 is the brand's midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base model include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric folding mirrors, LED headlamps and taillamps, LED daytime running lamps, cruise control, single zone electric A/C, fabric seats, driver seat manual lumbar adjustment, mechanical instrument cluster, 10.1-inch touch screen with USB ports, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and 6 speakers, front and rear fog lamps, roof rails, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models gets all-wheel drive, leather seats, front driver and passenger powered seats, ventilated seats, 7-inch virtual instrument cluster screen, dual-zone automatic A/C, wireless charger, rear climate control, panoramic sunroof and 20-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, hill assist control, and tyre pressure monitor. The higher models get additional blind spot monitor and lane departure warning.

The Lexus IS debuted in its current form back in 2014, and got a facelift in 2017. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, later renamed to IS300 in 2018, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2021, the IS got a major facelift. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

The Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG was changed in 2010, with an all new design. However the engine carried on from the previous generation but with slightly more power from the monster 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. It also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

Renault Logan Van is a Romanian-built small commercial van. It is only available as a panel van. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. It is capable of carrying up to 800 kg payload and transporting long objects ranging to 194 cm. Access to the loading zone is facilitated by a high roof, 2 side doors and rear doors. Standard features in the Logan Van include a manual A/C, power steering, manual windows, AM/FM radio, tinted windows, 15-inch steel wheels, cabin light, front storage boxes and driver's side airbag.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. In 2019, it got a facelift and a new engine. It is a compact sedan with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. The Corolla can be equipped to be a luxurious compact, with the decent top-spec 1.8-litre four-cylinder, as well as optional leather interior and a DVD system, which are hard to find in any other compact besides the overpriced German cars. We even compared this version of the Corolla to an Audi, which no doubt made Audi angry. However, the base Corolla offers excellent value and comes standard with a 1.3-litre four-cylinder, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows and a cloth interior. Airbags are standard, but everything else is optional. Both engines can be had with either a five-speed manual or a smooth but outdated four-speed automatic. Everything is simple about this car. The air-conditioning controls and radio controls are straightforward, the cup holders work well, and storage holes are available all over. The sedan is surprisingly roomy and comfortable, while the wagon has a spacious luggage area.

In 2022, an all-new Honda Civic was released. The eleventh-generation Civic has a redesigned body and interior, but the engines are carried over from the previous model. The base engine is the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the higher model gets the 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor. Both engines get a CVT.

The fifth-generation BMW 7-Series was launched for the 2009 model year, returning to form as an attractive full-size luxury sedan, after years of looking like a troll in its previous generation. The first models to be launched include the standard-wheelbase 740i and 750i as well as the long-wheelbase 740Li and 750Li. The long-wheelbase 760Li came in 2010. Most GCC dealers import only the long-wheelbase version of all the models. In a misleading move dreamt up by retarded marketeers, the 740i and 740Li are now powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-6 engine, instead of the V8 that the badge implies. The 750i and 750Li are now powered by a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, although the 760Li moniker is accurate, with its 6.0-litre twin-turbo V12. The 730i and 730Li models debuted later in 2010, with naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline-6. Badge deception notwithstanding, all engines are capable performers, featuring Double-VANOS variable valve technology, direct injection, and a 6-speed automatic for all except the V12, which comes with an 8-speed automatic. The range now comes equipped with EfficientDynamics technologies as standard, all aimed at improving fuel economy. All 7-Series can now be specified with a side-view camera system, Park Distance Control, two forward-facing cameras, night-vision system, a pedestrian recognition system, blind-spot warning, a heads-up display, speed-related active steering, variable air-suspension damping control, stability control, hill-start assistant, ABS, brake drying, brake-fade compensation, iDrive with larger 10.2-inch screen, instrument cluster with a high-resolution colour display, navigation, 8 GB hard drive, rear-seat DVD entertainment with integrated screens, four-zone automatic air-conditioning, multiple front and side-curtain airbags, optional rear-seat ventilation system with massage function, and other electronic gimmicks. All the usual luxury basics are obviously also included, such as leather, power accessories, sunroof and 18-inch alloys.

An all-new Ford Figo came out as a 2016 model year. It got a slight faceligt in 2019, as well as new tech upgrades. It is available as a 4-door sedan and a 5-door hatchback and features a new exterior design. Under the hood it gets a 1.5-litre motor mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trims. The base model gets cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include front power windows, rear manual windows, central locking, keyless entry, power mirrors, 4-speaker stereo with USB port, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, ABS, hill assist, soft-touch dashboard and a manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 15-inch alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat, and side-curtain airbags.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. The lengthened four-door wheelbase provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. The V60 straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level V60 T4 model comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The higher-spec V60 2.0T model comes with 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic as well. Later on the more powerful V60 T5 2.0-litre turbocharged engine came was offered. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. Very few were sold in the GCC.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S-Class gets a mid-cycle refresh, with ever-so-subtle design changes, and some major changes under the hood. While the most significant design changes end with a redesigned front-fascia and DRL's, the new S-Class boasts new trims and engine choices, along with a Hybrid model even. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class gets beltbags, which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and cushionbags, which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called thermotronic features improved filtering of outside air and also an active perfuming system for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class gets optional Magic Body Control which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. In UAE, the manual gearbox is not offered anymore, with the GXR model coming with power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX/Bluetooth support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear parking sensors, full-time 4x4, rear-diff lock and 17-inch alloy wheels, automatic gearbox, power mirrors, crawl control, dashboard display, navigation, rear-view camera, rear window wiper and part-time 4x4, 8 speakers, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, leather-stitched steering wheel, front skid plate protector, spare wheel hard cover, and lot of chrome pieces such as the exhaust tip, grille, door mirrors and door handles. In Saudi Arabia, the base FJ gets a manual gearbox, power steering, power windows, manual side mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, full-time 4x4, rear diff-lock and 17-inch alloy wheels; the base automatic gets part-time 4x4, side-step, rear-window wiper, smaller fuel tank, no traction control and no rear diff-lock; the FJ 1 gets power mirrors, Bluetooth, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, rear parking sensors, iPod support, driver arm rest, 10 JBL speakers & subwoofer, rear-view camera, spare wheel cover and no diff lock; the FJ 2 gets rear diff-lock, front skid plate, traction control, wi-fi and two-hitch. Safety features include standard front airbags as well as ABS and vehicle stability control. In Saudi Arabia, the top model gets side airbags as well. A new Xtreme version was launched in the UAE in 2016, which gets smoked lights, blackened grille, door handles and door mirrors, hood scoop, Bushwacker fender flares, Fox suspensions and performance exhaust with catback system.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The MR-V, introduced in 2003, was freshened for 2006 with a new front end along with enhancements to some interior features of this midsize 4WD. The MR-V is a typical Honda, with its trademark practicality, efficiency and reliability. It is built on the Accord platform, but drives like a tall and lumpy car with a smooth ride. It is not the best choice to take out into the desert as it lacks low-range gearing, but it can manage some light-duty work better than others. Capable of seating up to eight passengers, the MR-V is far from a small vehicle. The standard 3.5-litre V6 is paired with a five-speed automatic transmission. The power gets to the ground through the front wheels in normal operation, switching automatically to four-wheel-drive when slippage is detected. The MR-V still manages to deliver decent fuel economy. Interior includes all the usual power accessories. Safety features include ABS brakes and frontal and side-impact airbags. It is built in the United States alongside many other Honda products.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

After years of selling an outdated decade-old version of the car in the UAE, the all-new 2010 Nissan Maxima has finally gone on sale in the GCC. The America-built front-wheel-drive midsizer has moved upscale and aims to be a budget 'sports' sedan, although betrayed by its drivetrain layout. It is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. The entry-level Maxima S model comes with an auto-dimming mirror, cloth upholstery, cruise control, CD stereo, Bluetooth, power windows, intelligent key with starter button, power front seats, fake wood trim, sunroof, 19-inch rims, and dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents. The Maxima SV adds power outside mirrors with LED turn signals, digital compass, HID headlights, fog lights, power-adjustable steering column with memory, power-adjustable pedals, front and rear parking sensors. The top Maxima SR gets additional features such as auto-dimming driver-side mirror, leather seats, driver's seat thigh support extension and ventilation fans, rear bucket seats, rear-window power sunshade, navigation system touchscreen with rearview camera, and a rear spoiler. All come standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control. Equipment packages between trim levels changed slightly later during 2010. In 2011, the top model got chrome exhaust tips, a unique sport grille, smoked headlights, a new navigation-multimedia system and a price increase.

The new Commander is the first Jeep that offers three-row seating and the ability to carry seven passengers. Available with either a 4.7-litre V8 or a 5.7-litre Hemi V8, they are both mated to a five-speed automatic transmission, and both offer similar fuel economy. Standard is Jeep's Quadra-Trac I, which is an automatic full-time all-wheel-drive system enhanced by electronic traction control. Other standard features on the Commander include AM/FM stereo with CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power eight-way driver's seat, flipper glass on the liftgate with remote control, all-terrain tyres on 17-inch aluminium wheels, tyre-pressure monitoring, and cruise control. The higher-trim Commander comes with the Hemi V8 with fuel-saving Multi-Displacement System technology, a full-time active 4WD system known as Quadra-Trac II, that has a two-speed transfer case with front and rear electronic limited-slip differentials, dual-zone temperature control, leather-trimmed bucket seats with memory, power adjustable pedals, power sunroof,  power front seats and a six-disc in-dash CD player with MP3 capability. Options include rear DVD and 17-inch chrome wheels. Safety includes ABS, electronic stability control, Brake Assist, and numerous airbags.

An all-new Infiniti QX50 came out in mid 2018 as a 2019 model. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a CVT. It comes in standard front-wheel drive and optional all-wheel drive. Standard features on the base "Luxe" model include electric power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, LED headlamps, LED foglamps, auto headlights, leatherette seats, power seats, power lumbar for driver seat, leather wrapped steering wheel, paddle shifts, power liftgate, dual display Navigation system, with upper 8-inch and lower 7-inch VGA LCD touch screens, voice recognition, Bluetooth, 6-speaker AM/FM/CD with 4 USBs, Tri-zone automatic climate control with rear seat vents, cruise control, rearview camera with front and back sensors, and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, ABS, traction control system (TCS), stability control (VDC), electronic brake force distribution (EBD), tyre pressure monitoring  system (TPMS) and hill start assist. The "Luxe Essential ProAssist" model gets leather seats, rear-seat slide, recline, and fold-flat function, panoramic moonroof, remote engine-start, push-button start, rain-sensing wipers, high beam assist, Bose®Performance Series audio system with 16 speakers and 360 camera with moving object detection and front and rear sonar system. Additional safety features include adaptive cruise control, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, blind spot warning, and predictive forward collision warning. The "Luxe Sensory ProAssist" variant gets additional 20-inch dark painted alloy wheels, higher quality leather seats, climate control front seats, and motion activated tailgate. The top "Autograph" variant gets premium grade leather, seats with quilted stitching, with blue piping between white leather and blue suede, blue suede upper door, and centre console lid accents. Additional safety equipment include intelligent cruise control with full speed range and hold, and blind spot intervention.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its third facelift for the 2016 model-year. It remains the same for 2017. The exterior and interior both get a major overhaul. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Kia Quoris is a new nameplate for the Korean brand, becoming the flagship of the range by a long shot, in terms of pricing. The full-size sedan comes with a 3.8-litre "MPI" V6 as standard. The rear-wheel-drive platform is fed power via an 8-speed automatic and held up by electronically-adjustable air suspension riding on 18-inch alloy wheels. Available features include a full LCD gauge cluster, electronic gear-shift knob, 17-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, haptic-feedback steering wheel controls, 9.2-inch dual rear screens, heads-up display, power ventilated front seats, surround-view cameras, power rear sunblinds and more. Safety features include nine airbags including a knee airbag, as well as stability control and ABS, while adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights and blind-spot monitoring are also available.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is Mazda's excellent two-seat, rear-wheel-drive convertible sports car that was completely redesigned for the 2006 model year, but became available for the first time in the GCC from 2008. For 2013, it received its second facelift, the first one being in 2009. Powered by a high-revving 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, this little runner is only mated to a 6-speed auto with paddle-shifters now, forgoing the slow-selling manual in the GCC. Only the version with the powered folding hard top is offered here. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 7 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, manual a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-card for keyless entry and ignition, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats.

The Jeep Gladiator is a 4-door pickup based on a stretched Wrangler platform. Standard power comes from a 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 mated to an 8-speed automatic and four-wheel-drive. All Gladiator models are Trail Rated. Available features include LED headlights and taillights, an 8.4-inch touchscreen, a nine-speaker Alpine premium sound system, keyless entry, front TrailCam camera, blind-spot monitoring, Rear Cross Path detection, rear parking sensors, Advanced Brake Assist, Full-Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus, Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop, Trail Rail Cargo Management System, spray-in bedliner and trailer towing features. Gladiator Rubicon models are equipped with signature red tow hooks, Rock-Trac 4x4 system, featuring a two-speed transfer case with a 4:1 low-range gear ratio, front and rear heavy-duty Dana 44 axles, Tru-Lok electric front- and rear-axle lockers, segment-exclusive electronic sway bar disconnect, cab and bed rock rails. A limited run of 300 Jeep Gladiator Launch Edition models were made available in the Middle East. Along with a Launch Edition badge, the Gladiator has unique design elements including 17-inch mid-gloss black aluminium wheels, 33-inch BFgoodrich tyres, a wrapped instrument panel mid-bolster painted in Monaco silver and black leather seats with red accent stitching. The Launch Edition also features a body-colour hard top and fender flares.

An all-new model when released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets a major interior and exterior facelift for 2008. A variant of the STS is the new SLS. Based on the STS, the SLS is stretched 100 mm. The additional length results in extended rear legroom. Diamond-faceted contours echo the geometry of other Cadillac vehicles. Subtle V-shapes, inspired by Cadillac`s shield badge, are a recurring motif in both the exterior and interior design. Interestingly, the cabin is actually unique to the SLS, derived from the standard STS cabin styling, but with additional details that make it more attractive. The SLS interior design and fit-and-finish are claimed to be excellent, although we are not sure if Chinese assembly makes any difference. Ambient lighting, Tuscany leather and sapele-pommele wood accents all give the cabin a relaxing and premium look and feel. Under the hood is the Northstar 4.6-litre V8 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Magnetic Ride Control and StabilTrak are standard.

The C3 is a curvaceous hatchback that competes in the hot compact segment dominated by Toyota. The standard C3 is available in five-door form only, while the funky C3 Pluriel is only available as a two-door. Designed to be roomy and versatile, it is utterly more futuristic than the usual offerings in this segment, and fairly well-equipped. The C3 cabin has plenty of cubbyholes and storage spaces, a big windshield and the 'Moduboard' foldable false floor for the luggage trunk. There are more unexpected features such as speed-sensitive windshield wipers, follow-me-home headlights and one-touch electric windows. Current engine choices are the 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre four-cylinder motors. An upgraded 1.4-litre option came later. A manual is standard, with an optional auto on the 1.4-litre. The SensoDrive auto gearbox is offered on the upgraded 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre with a fuel-saving feature called the Stop-Start system, which automatically turns the engine off when idling in traffic and turns it on again when you lift off the brake. The Pluriel comes with a different front end and a 1.6-litre auto only, and this unique car can be converted into a hatchback, a pick-up and a convertible by playing with roof configurations. The Pluriel was discontinued here by 2007. Standard front and side airbags, as are ABS brakes.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. In the GCC, it is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 with front-wheel-drive (T5) and a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), both mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The 2019 Megane GT is a higher version of the compact offering from the French brand. It only comes as a hatchback. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push-button engine start, dual-zone A/C, rear air vents, cruise control, auto headlamps, 7-inch touchscreen, navigation, 3D Sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, 2 USBs, AUX, streaming via Bluetooth, cruise control and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include panoramic roof, techno Pack( full LED headlights, electric parking brake) or Premium Pack (Alcantara trim, heated driver & passenger seats, 8.7-inch touchscreen navigation, Bose sound system, 8 speakers, 2 USBs, AUX, Streaming via Bluetooth. Safety features include front and side airbags,  front & rear curtain airbags, ABS, emergency brake assist, blind spot warning, tyre pressure monitoring system and ESP with Hill Start Assist.

The Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet and Turbo S Cabriolet got a minor facelift in 2017, as well as a slight power upgrade, thanks to modified inlet ports in the cylinder head, new injection nozzles and higher fuel pressure. Fuel economy improves slightly as well for the 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet due to further advanced electronic engine and transmission management with revised gear change mappings. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 2017 Porsche 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The Audi A4 received its first major redesign for its second generation. Available as a sedan from 2001 and as a convertible from 2003, the wagon is not offered here, for obvious reasons. Engines for the sedan include a 2.0-litre normally-aspirated four and a 1.8-litre turbocharged four, along with a 3.0-litre V6. The sedan could also be ordered in hot S4 form from a few dealerships, which adds a V8 engine and sporting suspension, among other goodies. The cabriolet can be had in this region with a 3.0-litre V6 as well as the 1.8-litre turbo four. There is a choice of a manual for all engines, though not officially offered on most models. Standard on the front-wheel-drive models is the Multitronic CVT automatic. The all-wheel-drive models get a traditional automatic. Changes over the previous first-gen model include a new look, better suspension, upgraded engines and brighter front lighting. Features include aluminium or wood trim, six-CD changer, auto door locking, a bunch of airbags, a tyre pressure monitoring system and an optional S-Line body kit. The S4 or even the 3.0-litre sedan are rare models.

The all-new Chevrolet Sonic is a sub-compact replacement for the Aveo. Available in sedan and hatchback body-styles, the Sonic is available in the GCC with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic function, with a 5-speed manual available in some markets. The base model comes with 5-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, fold-down rear seat, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, optional keyless entry and only one airbag. The mid-range LS model additionally gets steel wheels or optional 15-inch alloy wheels, optional sunroof, power windows, 4-way manually-adjustable driver's seat, better stereo with Bluetooth and more optional speakers, split-folding rear seat, optional parking sensors, optional ABS and two airbags. The top LT model additionally gets 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, standard ABS, 6-speaker stereo, and front as well as side airbags.

An-all new Lexus RX came in 2016. Under the hood, the RX 350 gets the 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. However there is also an F Sport model which gets a bodykit. The RX 450h gets a similar 3.5-litre V6 engine combined to three electric motors. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 20-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations.

The Hyundai Accent is longer, wider and lower than the previous generation model. It features Hyundai's swoopy new corporate styling and superb build quality. The spacious sub-compact 4-door sedan comes with a choice of 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines, both with 5-speed manual and 4-speed automatic geabox options. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features, all optional, includes stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The JAC S3 is a sub-compact crossover SUV, with styling derived from Hyundai no less. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine from 2017 onwards, mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Externally, the S3 SUV also has 16-inch alloy wheels and LED running lights as highlights. Under the skin, electric power steering, independent front suspension, semi-independent rear suspension and four-wheel-disc brakes are standard. Features include all the basics, such as power windows and mirrors, sunroof, keyless entry, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, faux leather upholstery, split-folding rear seat, cruise control and more. Safety features include 6 airbags, hill-start assist, ABS with EBD and hydraulic brake assist, ESP, rear camera and tyre-pressure monitor.

The Chery Arrizo 7 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering in a tough market dominated by the Japanese. Under the hood, the Arrizo 7 gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 5-speed manual gearbox or a CVT automatic. The suspension has been tuned by British sports car company Lotus. Standard features on the Arrizo 7 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, manual A/C, radio with CD/AUX/USB/Bluetooth support, fabric seats and steal wheels. The higher models get sunroof, cruise control, leather seats, automatic A/C, rear-view camera, 7-inch screen and alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

The Mercedes-Benz A 45 AMG is the range-topping variant of the A-Class line. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. Externally, it can be identified by its AMG-specific bumpers and wheels, although these are also available with lower-spec A-Class models with an AMG package as well. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. Other available features include HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, cruise control, navigation and more. The pricier A 45 AMG "Edition 1" model includes white body colour, sports stripes in matte grey, red highlights on certain trim bits, red brake calipers, 19-inch AMG light-alloy wheels in matte black, AMG "Night" and "Aerodynamics" packages, black and red interior, special seat upholstery, AMG Performance steering wheel and other doodads.

The Superb is an upper-medium segment car, with an extended wheelbase to increase interior room. The Superb name first appeared on a Skoda in 1934 and is the company's flagship model. The modern-day version Superb is available in various trim levels, with names like Classic, Comfort and Elegance. The Superb offers many of the benefits of a luxury car, with large rear doors and optional rear-seat DVD entertainment. The rear passenger space is exceptional for a vehicle in this segment and high quality trim materials are used throughout the model range. Customisation options include a sunroof and a host of alloy wheel designs and sizes. In the Middle East, the Superb is available with two petrol engines, namely the entry-level turbocharged 1.8-litre four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre V6. Both are coupled with a 5-speed automatic gearbox to drive the front wheels. Standard safety features include ABS brakes, front and side airbags, and even curtain airbags, while the V6 model gets electronic stability control as standard.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This "compact" pickup has grown substantially for 2013, larger in every dimension, with more cabin and cargo room. In 2016, it received a facelift and it continues in that shape for 2017. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more. A D-Max GT model was launched in 2014, with the 3.0-litre engine, bumper-skirts, racing stripes, optional 17-inch grey alloys, red-black seats, bedliner and stereo choices.

The Tesla Model 3 is an all-electric car in the luxury compact car segment. It comes with a 52 or  75 kWh battery with a rear-wheel drive setup in the standard model and all-wheel drive in the higher performance setups. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, 15.4-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth, and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include, self-driving capability, enhanced autopilot, higher quality leather interior, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system and bigger alloy wheels. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features feature traffic-aware cruise control, autosteer and autopark.

Citroen has a tradition for breaking design conventions and building quiry cars, and the Picasso, a compact people-carrier, is no exception. The Picasso offers a roomy and versatile interior designed around the need for differing seating configurations in a vehicle with car-like handling characteristics. Compact tall wagons have become popular family vehicles in europe, though people here are reluctant to give up their stupid 4WDs.
