JAC J5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, fabric seats, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support, 2 speakers and steel wheels. Optional equipment include a better stereo system with 4 speakers, fog lamps, alloy wheels, leather seats, parking sensors and sunroof. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The MG ZS is a small 5-seater crossover. In 2020, it got a slight facelift, a new transmission and new engine option added to the lineup. Powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT, it has no sporting or offroad pretensions, but it does aim to appear the "premium" choice within its category. In 2020, the MG ZS got a new engine in the lineup - a 1.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit. The ZS rides on a front-wheel-drive platform with independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension. There are three trim choices, with the base one getting 16-inch wheels, fabric seats, manual a/c, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and a 4-speaker stereo with 1 USB port. The mid-range model adds LED running lights, front fog lamps, faux leather, roof rails, cruise control, additional USB port, 8-inch touchscreen with Apple Carplay and 6 speakers, steering wheel buttons, parking sensors and more. The top model only adds 17-inch alloys and a rear camera. All versions of the 2019 MG ZS get ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor, ISOFIX latches and seat-belts with pretensioners. The base model gets front airbags, while the rest also get side airbags.

The Opel Meriva is the German manufacturer's MPV offering. The Spanish-built Meriva has been around since 2010 but only made its Middle East debut in 2013. It gets a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Standard features in the Meriva include power steering, power windows, AM/FM/CD player with MP3/AUX support. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags and ABS.

For 2013, the Audi A4 received a minor facelift. Available engines include the weak 1.8 TFSI with two versions of the 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder, mated to front-wheel-drive and CVT automatic, and a 3.0T Quattro which gets a 7-speed transmission and all-wheel-drive. There is also a 2.0T with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and all-wheel-drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings, with up to 24 combinations available to create individual driving profiles. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Edge debuted for the 2007 model year, and has been heavily revised for 2011, with a new face, higher-quality interior, better entertainment features and two engines to choose from. The updated Edge features a big new version of the corporate chrome grille, along with new headlights, tail lamps and wheel designs externally. A new Edge Sport model can be had with a blacked-out grille, smoked headlights and huge 22-inch alloys. The newly-designed interior still features seating for five with a fold-down rear seat to maximise cargo room, as well as a soft-touch dashboard, optional mood lighting and better materials. The Edge SE, Edge SEL and Edge Limited models are powered by an upgraded 3.5-litre V6, while the Edge Sport gets a 3.7-litre V6. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, and available with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Standard features include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC voice-controlled multimedia computer and Sony stereo, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. The Edge Limited is the only one to be offered with options such as HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and 20-inch alloys, but the Edge Sport is the only one to get the black grille, paddle shifters, larger engine, stiffer suspension and 22-inch wheels. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

The Audi Q5 is the compact class offering in the VW-owned German manufacturer's SUV range. In 2018, an all-new model was released. Under the hood, the only engine on offer is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor, mated to an 7-speed automatic transmission. It is available with the all-wheel-drive "Quattro" system, and will be available with the Audi 'Drive-Select' system to change its settings. While exterior does not have a whole lot of changes from its predecessor, the interior has been fully revamped. It also weighs less than the previous generation. Features include LED running lights and taillights, alloy wheels of up to 20 inches in size, seating for five with folding rear bench and a foldable front seat, and the usual power accessories. The Q5 will be available in several different trim options, including an 'S-Line' trim option with aggressive body mouldings and mesh foglight grills. Other available features, whether standard or optional, include a roof load sensor to adjust the stability control for the higher centre of gravity, rearview camera, navigation, high-beam assistant that automatically switches between the high and low beams, blind-spot monitor, adaptive cruise control, triple-zone climate control, intelligent keyless entry, electric parking brake, multiple airbags, MMI multimedia with speech control system, Bluetooth telephone and Apple CarPlay

The Maserati Spyder is a high-performance two-door two-seater based on the 4200 GT Coupe, except with a shorter wheelbase and a convertible top. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations was the GranSport Spyder, which featured sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport version, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Cadillac ATS is the smallest offering from the American luxury brand. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS will be offered with two engine choices. One will be a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine and other a 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Brilliance H530 is the Chinese company's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design was styled by Italy's Pininfarina. The front-wheel drive H530 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with MP3/USB/AUX support, manual A/C, rear sensors and 15-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets leather seats, keyless start and keyless entry system, digital A/C, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

The Honda Accord has been redesigned for the 2013 model. It is available as a sedan or a coupe. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a new 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. Standard features on the base 2.4 DX model include electric power steering, power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows and mirrors, LED front running lamps and tail lights, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, cruise control, cloth upholstery, ABS and two front airbags. The 2.4 LX sedan adds floor mats, side and curtain airbags, stability control and hill-start assist, as does all other trim levels. In certain markets, it is additionally offered with a sunroof, 17-inch aluminium wheels, and a touchscreen control panel for multimedia functions. The 2.4 EX sedan further adds front fog lights, power-folding mirrors, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, leather seats, leather steering wheel, power rear sunshade, smart keyless entry and start, auto-dimming mirror, rear parking sensors and a power driver's seat. The 2.4 EX sedan can be upgraded with navigation, rear camera, "i-Dual" a/c, 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, USB/AUX ports, and a power-adjustable passenger seat. The 3.5 EX sedan adds the V6 engine and transmission, dual exhaust tips, wooden steering wheel, rear-side window sunshades, full LED headlights, and a new feature called "LaneWatch" that adds a camera under the right-side mirror to visually monitor your right blindspot. The 3.5 Sport sedan additionally gets 18-inch alloys, little paddle-shifters, and leather steering. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that. The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. In 2021, a Land Cruiser 70 Overland was introduced. Equipped with front and rear TJM XGS Series 4000 SX Shocks and TJM XGS Coil Springs on the front providing increased ride height. The Overlander edition also comes standard with a heavy-duty on-board air compressor, 12V electric factory winch and STEDI 7-inch LED spotlights. It gets a 9-inch display audio with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, along with navigation.

An all-new generation of Honda Accord came for the 2018 model year. In 2021, it got a slight facelift and some interior updates. The naturally-aspirated engines has been replaced by two 4-cylinder turbocharged motors - a 1.5-litre, mated to CVT and a 2.0-litre connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Features on the standard 2022 Honda Accord LX model include power windows, power mirrors, remote engine start, push button start, dual-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, 160-watt audio system with 4 speakers, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and 8-inch audio display, Bluetooth, USB, LED headlights, LED taillamps, dual exhausts and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 2022 Honda Accord Sport variant gets additional power seats with lumbar support, aluminium sports pedals, paddle shifts, 2-mode drive system (ECO/Sport), LED fog lamps, sunroof, dark chrome front grille, spoiler and 18-inch alloy wheels. The 2022 Honda Accord EX gets additional leather seats, 180-watt audio system with 8 speakers, The top 2022 Honda Accord 2.0T Sport gets additional 450-watt audio system with 10 speakers and subwoofer and head-up display. Available new features for 2021 include a wireless charger, rear USB ports and DAB radio for some markets. Standard safety features on the 2022 Honda Accord include front, side, curtain and knee airbags (total 8 airbags), ABS, EBD, brake assist, stability control, emergency stop signal, brake booster and tyre pressure monitoring system. The Honda Accord EX-L and 2.0T Sport additionally get Honda Lane Watch and updated Honda Sensing active safety features.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD and has been completely overhauled for 2008. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. For the GCC, a 3.0-litre V6 is standard, and it only gets a 4-speed automatic. The 2008 version's carryover V6 was replaced by an upgraded V6 for 2009, with more power and a 6-speed automatic. The Escape also comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, electric power steering, 15-inch steel wheels and CD stereo with iPod jack. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. The Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The Audi S6 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. The all-wheel drive S6 has a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Optional features for the S6 include heads-up display, sports differential, dynamic steering and ceramic brakes. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control. Optional safety features include rear side airbags, park assist, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, night vision and pre-sense assist.

Spyker is largely an unknown name to the general public, but this Dutch name was apparently around as far back as 1898. The company was resurrected in 2000 with the C8 Spyder, a unique and expensive hand-built supercar with an open-top roof. The Spyker C8 Laviolette coupe soon joined the Spyder. In 2002, the street version of their LeMans racer was unveiled as the C8 Double12 S coupe, with an extended rear end. The C8 was finally launched in this region in 2007. The Spyker C8 range has a 4.2-litre Audi V8, manual or automatic six-speed gearbox, limited slip differential and ABS brakes. Optional features for all cars include a turned-aluminium dashboard fascia, 19-inch Aeroblade magnesium wheels, several leather options, Chronoswiss dashboard instruments, supercharger or even a custom-fitted Louis Vuitton luggage set. The body is built in Germany and the car is assembled in Holland.

The second-generation Audi R8 came out in 2016. Under the hood, there is no more a V8 engine option, but V10 is still available, which has been reworked for better performance. It has also managed to reduce 200 kg by using more carbon-fibre and aluminium for the body.The power is delivered through a 7-speed S-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

In 2019, a new generation of the Porsche 911 was revealed. The 2+2 seater coupe gets an updated exterior design, along with updates to the engine. The 911 Carrera S is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 8-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The Carrera 4S is all-wheel drive. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The Carrera S and Carrera T models also have the option of all-wheel-steer.

The Lexus ES, the luxury carmaker's bread-and-butter sedan, carries on with its comfort-biased approach and focus on convenience features. The ES last got a facelift in 2016. It features corporate styling similar to the pricier GS. It comes in two trim levels, the ES 250 with the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, and the ES 350 with the 3.5-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The ES 250 comes in one "Premier" trim and features HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, front-rear parking sensors, 17-inch alloys, moonroof, headlamp cleaner, leather interior, powered front seats, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, power-adjustable steering, and dual-zone auto a/c. The ES 350 "Prestige" adds the V6 engine, nicer leather, navigation, power rear sunshade and a blind-spot monitor. The "Platinum" adds a front DVD player, rear camera and a remote-touch computer. The "Titanium" further adds adaptive headlights, different wheels, panoramic glass roof, even semi-aniline leather, front ventilated seats, 3-zone a/c, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist and a pre-crash safety system. All models come with front, knee, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

An all-new BMW X5 launched as a 2014 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X5 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X5 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

The VW Touareg is a luxurious and comfortable 4WD that is surprisingly capable both on the road and off it too. It is a practical vehicle, and on the highway, the Touareg offers a firm but smooth ride, and its handling is responsive for its mass, while in the desert, a full set of off-roading equipment comes in handy, including locking diffs and low-range gearing. The range includes a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a very limited 6.0-litre W12. All models come with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Also standard is Volkswagen's 4Motion permanent all-wheel-drive system. The Touareg seats five, and there is no third row of seats available. The Touareg comes standard with leatherette upholstery, dual-zone climate control with rear seat controls, wood trim, power windows, mirrors and sunroof, electrically adjustable front seating, alloy wheels of various sizes, ABS and many more items. Higher models get leather, auto-dimming outside mirrors with memory; and other luxuries. All models include front, side-impact and curtain airbags.

The Superb is an upper-medium segment car, with an extended wheelbase to increase interior room. The Superb name first appeared on a Skoda in 1934 and is the company's flagship model. The modern-day version Superb is available in various trim levels, with names like Classic, Comfort and Elegance. The Superb offers many of the benefits of a luxury car, with large rear doors and optional rear-seat DVD entertainment. The rear passenger space is exceptional for a vehicle in this segment and high quality trim materials are used throughout the model range. Customisation options include a sunroof and a host of alloy wheel designs and sizes. In the Middle East, the Superb is available with two petrol engines, namely the entry-level turbocharged 1.8-litre four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre V6. Both are coupled with a 5-speed automatic gearbox to drive the front wheels. Standard safety features include ABS brakes, front and side airbags, and even curtain airbags, while the V6 model gets electronic stability control as standard.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that.

The Citroen DS4 is the compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the DS4 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, automatic a/c with dual-zone temperature control, radio stereo with CD/AUX support, Bluetooth, USB port, steering mounted controls, navigation system, cruise control, interior mood lighting, aluminium drilled pedals, automatic headlamps, automatic wipers, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, daytime running LEDs, fabric seats with lumbar support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA), Electronic Stability Program (ESP) with traction control, driver's, front passengers and front lateral airbags, and front and rear curtain airbags.

The Cadillac XTS debuted in late 2012 as a new flagship, replacing the STS as well as the DTS. Based on a front-wheel-drive Chevrolet platform, the XTS is powered by a 3.6-litre direct-injection V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. It comes with a electronically-controlled limited-slip differential, adjustable suspension and Brembo brakes, with standard 20-inch wheels. For 2014, a V-Sport model with a turobcharged 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive joined the range. Features include leather upholstery, configurable 12.3-inch LCD display, CUE multimedia system, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, HID headlights, smart keyless entry/start and all the usual power accessories, with further available features such as heads-up display, adaptive cruise control. Safety features include multiple airbags, lane departure warning, collision alert, safety alert seat, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert and available automatic emergency braking.

The Fiat 500X is the Italian brand's sub-compact SUV offering. For 2019 it got a facelift and only the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is offered, with front-wheel drive and all-wheel drive configurations, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base "Popstar" model gets power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, fog lights, manual A/C, cruise control, radio with 5-inch touch screen and Bluetooth/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, tow hook and alloy wheels. The "Lounge" model gets a sunroof, automatic AC, leather seats, better quality stereo system and paddle shifters. Safety features include front,side and side head airbags, traction control, vehicle dynamic control, hill holder and electronic roll mitigation system.

The Australian-built Caprice has been redesigned from the ground up, but still remains one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers a choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the V8 engine as an option. The V6 was dropped by 2011, leaving the V8 as standard. The big V8 is standard on the sport-tuned SS and the luxury-tuned Royale. The Caprice continues to use a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, a cloth or leather interior, and more. ABS brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

The X-Trail is Nissan's entry for the small road-going 4WD market, though for a long time we thought it was really a midsize comparable to the old Pathfinder in size. Developed to attract young adventurous buyers, we find the X-Trail particularly unattractive, but it has proved to be a runaway success with older people just looking for a conservative vehicle that looks like a 4WD. The X-Trail has undergone only slight exterior redesigns and interior upgrades ever since it was launched years ago and is beginning to look dated. Powered by a 2.5-litre four-cylinder engine coupled with a 4-speed automatic or a 5-speed manual transmission, it isn't particularly fast, but a reasonable long-distance cruiser. Full-time four-wheel drive is available when the computer system senses the need for all wheels to be driven to suit demand, but it will get stuck if you take it beyond the beach. The interior is full of storage spaces, including cup-holders, centre console box and other nooks and crannies. ABS brakes and 2 airbags are standard.

The futuristic Audi TT Coupe was first launched in late 1998, followed by the Roadster in 1999. It became a trend-setter in terms of style, but mechanical mediocrity meant it was never a true sports car, being based on the same platform that served the VW Golf and the Skoda Octavia. Originally available with two original engine choices, both were turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder units, at different states of tune. The lower model got front-wheel-drive, while the higher-powered model benefitted from standard Quattro all-wheel-drive. First-year models suffered from dangerous high-speed handling due to lift-off oversteer and led to many deaths, so stability control, better stabilisers and a rear lip-spoiler were added from 2000. All versions only had a manual gearbox up till 2003, when an automatic gearbox with manual-shift capability was offered in the lower-powered model. Model-year 2003 also saw a minor unnoticeable facelift as well as the introduction of a 3.2-litre V6 option, available with either a manual or, from 2004, a newly-developed DSG automanual gearbox. The V6 also got standard Quattro all-wheel-drive, stiffer suspension and slightly upgraded body trim. The coupe was a 2+2 seater, while the roadster only had two seats. All versions got a cramped but stylish interior, and could be had with special leather upholstery, the usual power accessories, and more. Variations over the years meant different wheel designs and interior options were available. Final-year 2006 models can be identified by a two-tone paintjob. The original TT was a popular entry into the compact sports-car market due to its looks, but it was always the worst in terms of driving dynamics compared to its more-capable competitors.

The G37 sedan debuted in 2009 to replace the G35. It is a luxurious rear-wheel-drive midsize model. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted 7-speed automatic gearbox. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

Toyota introduces an all-new Camry for 2007. The new one features aerodynamic new styling reminiscent of Lexus, which is no surprise since the expensive ES 350 is based on this car. The new Camry is thoroughly revamped, reworked and upgraded from the ground up. Inside is an airy new interior. The engine choice remains the same, with a carried-over 2.4-litre four-cylinder popular with most commuters and taxi companies, but the new 3.5-litre V6 available in other markets is not offered here, saved instead for the Aurion. The four-cylinder can have a five-speed manual or a five-speed automatic. The Camry can be had with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual array of power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a keyless entry system, front and optional side airbags, and either steel or alloy wheels. There is now a wannabe Sport version that adds a body kit and stiffer suspension. The Toyota Camry defines the dull midsize four-door sedan segment and now it has set the bar higher.

The Honda Jazz made its come back into the GCC market in 2018. This generation of the Jazz was first released in 2014 elsewhere, and got a facelift for 2018. Under the hood is a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT with vestigial paddle shifters. Features include electronic power steering, 16-inch alloy wheels, front fog lights, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, auto a/c, fold-down and reclining rear seats, 7-inch multimedia screen with CD, AUX/HDMI/USB jacks and 4 speakers. Safety features are limited to 2 airbags, ABS with EBD and brake assist, ESP, hill-start assist, whiplash-limiting headrests, tyre-pressure monitor and ISOFIX latches. It received a 5-star crash-test rating in the United States, but those come with Honda Sensing active safety tech not offered in the GCC.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Coupe replaced 3-series coupe model. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 428i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The new BMW 4 Series Coupe is visibly larger in width and wheelbase than the outgoing BMW 3 Series Coupe. The BMW 4 Series Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The redesigned Boxster roadster was introduced in 2005, and it spawned the fixed-top Cayman for the 2006 model year. Considered the entry-level Porsche offering, the cars are powered by a 2.7-litre version of the traditional Porsche flat-six engine in their base trim, while the higher-performance S versions are powered by a 3.4-litre version of the sixer. The model is considered a benchmark for sports-car handling, with rear-wheel-drive and a choice of either a manual or a manually-shiftable automatic. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, among other luxury options. The Cayman offers head airbags in combination with thorax airbags, concealed on the outer side of the backrest, alongside the usual front airbags. Luggage is space is very limited, with two trunks, one in the front and one behind the mid-mounted engine in the back.

An all-new Chevrolet Suburban came as a 2015 model in mid-2014. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

One of the longest-running nameplates in the region, the Sunny has become popular for its reasonable price and traditional reliability, all while competitors drove their own prices up. However, the Sunny soon fell behind in terms of equipment, and the all-new Tiida arrived as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. Nissan Middle East is openly pushing the Sunny as a fleet car now, leaving the Tiida for individual sales. For 2010, and the engine lineup is limited to just one. There are now two versions, one a basic rebadged Samsung SM3 built in Korea and another a "Classic" model with a different front-end built in Japan. There is good head room, but other interior dimensions fall behind its competitors. Available as a four-door sedan, the Sunny is now available only with a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include electric power steering, air conditioning and a cloth interior. Options include a CD stereo system and power accessories. Optional safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The popular 7th-generation Lancer, receiving a major facelift in 2004, uses three four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.3-litre and 1.6-litre in the basic models, while a 2.0-litre Ralliart Edition was briefly available before being dropped in 2008. The aging non-Ralliart variants are so popular that they continued to be sold alongside the all-new 2008 Lancer EX. The 1.3-litre has a choice of a five-speed manual and a four-speed automatic. The 1.6-litre has a choice of a manual or automatic. The 2.0-litre came exclusively with an automatic gearbox. None of the engines are particularly sporting. Features, either standard or optional, include driver's & front passenger's SRS dual airbags, simple radio cassette player or a better radio cassette stereo with CD changer and 4 speakers, tachometer, optional rear spoiler, steel wheels with hubcaps or light alloy wheels, ABS with EBD, optional keyless entry system, and a rear seat centre armrest with cup holders. The Ralliart Edition specifically adds a rear spoiler, 15-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel, special interior trim, body kit and better brakes. All cars have a cloth interior, with standard power windows and mirrors.

The BMW 6-Series has been redesigned for the 2012 model year. The Convertible was first launched in the first half of 2011, with the Coupe coming later in the year. The 4-seater 2-door 6-Series can be had in 640i form with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, or in 650i form with a 4.4-litre turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. Both come with a 8-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for  stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

The Lexus RC is the Japanese luxury brand's compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC carries on with a 3.5-litre V6 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, it got a facelift. Enhancements have been made to the RC's aerodynamics, tyres and suspension, and there are also improvements to engine response and steering feel. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control.

Toyota tacks on the Land Cruiser badge on up to three of their 4WD models, including a pickup, but there is only one true Land Cruiser that everyone knows and loves for reasons unknown. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon remains at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. It is still one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. Few vehicles offer the off-road capability of the Land Cruiser, and fewer still combine this with its level of luxury. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.5-litre six-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto, and a new 4.7-litre V8 and a five-speed auto. There is also a 4.2-litre diesel with a manual. It can transport anywhere from eight to ten passengers depending on model. It is an expensive vehicle, but everything is still optional, including ABS, airbags and cruise control. Other options include leather sunroof and navigation. We'd love to love this outdated 4WD, but we hate the people who buy these, as any other road user will know why.

The G37 sedan debuted in 2009 to replace the G35. It is a luxurious rear-wheel-drive midsize model. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted 7-speed automatic gearbox. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee got a second facelift for the 2017 model year. Offered with a choice of the 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or the 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a new 8-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and four trim levels. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. Another trim level introduced for 2014 is the Summit which also comes in only V8 form. The SRT8 version gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. Another feature on all models is the new 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds chrome bumper trim, painted wheel arches, real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The Summit has similar options to the Limited, with the addition of a unique SRT-like front bumper, more premium leather and wood panels for the interior. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Pathfinder is a 4-door, 5-passenger luxury 4WD, and a popular performer. This unit-body shape was introduced in 2000, but got the newer 3.5-litre V6 only in 2002. This model range ran till 2005. A 5-speed manual is standard while a 4-speed automatic transmission with overdrive is optional. The manual-mated V6 is slightly more powerful than the automatic-mated V6. Later models also have an optional package consisting of electronic stability control, ABS brakes, traction control, and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. The top Pathfinder models got six-spoke 17-inch wheels and a leather interior in the later years, while lower models have 16-inch wheels and a cloth cabin. Exterior paint-jobs were two-colour for base models and monotone for upper models. Available features included a cassette or CD player, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and power front seats, among other accessories.

An all-new Subaru Forester came out in 2015. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The Escalade is all-new for 2007, but still based on the latest version of the Chevrolet Tahoe. The King of Bling is back, bigger, gaudier, more powerful and more fuel efficient than before. Available in either standard five-door 4WD body, ESV long-wheelbase 4WD body or a retarded EXT long-wheelbase 4WD pick-up body, the Escalade ups the ante when it comes to showing off on the streets. The Escalade boasts a massive grille, tighter panel gaps, and a more streamlined exterior, which enables it to get better fuel mileage despite having a more powerful, 6.2-litre V8 engine that makes 403 hp and a whopping 565 Nm of torque. The Escalade models come with standard 18-inch wheels and tyres, but buyers can opt for 22-inchers. Stability control is standard and now incorporates a program to help avoid rollovers, while front side air bags are standard and a full-length head curtain system is available. Other features include automatic dual-zone climate control, tyre pressure monitoring system, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power-adjustable pedals, leather and wood steering wheel with audio controls, leather interior, 14-way power seats, six-CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers and rear-seat audio controls, four ventilated brake discs, speed-sensitive steering, automatic rear level control system, and rear parking assist. All off-roading equipment from the Chevy version has been stripped out in this one.

The Q60 Coupe underwent a full redesign in 2017. The base motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, while a 3.0-litre turbocharged engine is available is the more powerful option. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

The Abarth 695 is a special edition model. Under the hood, it gets a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to an Abarth 5-speed automatic transmission. The engine note is enhanced with the addition of an Akrapovic exhaust system. Safety standards are high with the Abarth 695 equipped with seven airbags as standard equipment. It also gets ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESC), anti-slip regulation (ASR) system, the Hill Holder devices and hydraulic brake assistance (HBA) to help with emergency stops. In late 2020, the 695 70-degree Anniversario was introduced in the market. This model gets a manually adjustable spoiler, which can be adjusted to 12 positions with an inclination from 0 to 60 degrees. In the maximum inclination position, the spoiler increases the aerodynamic load by up to 42 kilograms at a speed of 200 kph. It comes in a special Monza green livery, a body kit, front and rears dams and mirror caps. The same colour is used for the Scorpion stickers on the bonnet and the chequered sticker on the roof. The 17" SuperSport alloy wheels and bright red Brembo calipers are also standard.

For 2012, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class received engine upgrades for some models. The models to choose from are the E 200, E 250, E 300, E 350 and E 500. The E 200 and E 250 get a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. The E 300 gets a 3.0-litre V6 whereas the E 350 is fitted with a 3.5-litre V6 engine. The E 500 has a 4.7-litre under the hood. They all have a 7-speed automatic transmission. The E-Class Coupe has much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door format.  An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard coupe models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The V70, based on the S60, is tuned to be a sports wagon, but is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis and weak regional engine choices. The interior is fairly spacious and the luggage area is huge thanks to its upright boxy shape. For the Middle East market, there is a basic 2.4-litre 5-cylinder only for the V70 wagon, although European markets get as many engines as the S60 sedan. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The Bentley line is headed by these land-yachts. Called the Azure in convertible form, the design of the four-seat shares its face as well as its 6.75-litre turbo V8 with the Arnage sedan. The Azure does not get the higher-tuned engine from the limited-edition Brooklands. The cabin and rear section of the car are a new design and the interior is crammed with every common luxury cue that defines a Bentley. The Azure is highlighted by a new laser-cut matrix grille that evokes the large sporting Bentleys that had won the 24 hours of Le Mans five times between 1924 and 1930. Bentley is now a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG. The spacious handcrafted interior features the highest level of leather and wood trim, individually tailored to the taste of each owner. The complex folding roof on the convertible is operated hydraulically at the touch of a switch and the three-layer fabric assembly stows beneath the leather-trimmed tonneau cover in less than 30 seconds. Safety features in this classic include multiple airbags and the usual electronic nannies found in any modern car. though the platform remains a remnant from the last century.

The Mitsubishi Lancer EX, first introduced in 2008, got some minor trim changes for 2010. It comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.5-litre and a 2.0-litre. The smaller engine gets a four-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Features in the most basic model includes a driver's airbag, CD player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers. There are various trim levels right up to the top GT model which adds a sporting body kit, sunroof, adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio switches, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, rear split seats with centre armrest, dual front airbags, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, paddle-shifters with the CVT, and a full keyless operation system.

The Maserati Spyder is a high-performance two-door two-seater based on the 4200 GT Coupe, except with a shorter wheelbase and a convertible top. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations was the GranSport Spyder, which featured sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport version, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

Hyundai has upped the game considerably in the midsize car market. Apparently taking four years to develop, the fruit of that labour is the new-for-2011 Hyundai Sonata. It takes on a 'four-door coupe' profile but without the impracticality or high price. The GCC market will receive two economy-biased engines, mainly a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, with some countries receiving a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. Both are available with 6-speed manual and 6-speed automatic transmissions, though some countries will only get a standard automatic with paddle-shifters. The base model comes with power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, 'amplitude selective' dampers, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Indeed, Hyundai is now offering proper safety features for those willing to pay for it.

The F-150 delivers all the manly attributes of toughness, strength, and imposing size, but does anyone who isn't involved in a job with physical labour need one? The fully-loaded models of the F-150 is sold here as more of a lifestyle vehicle, offering interior design and comfort that would rival some luxury cars. Properly equipped, it can haul more than a tonne in its bed. The F-150 is comfortable as well, with a quiet and refined ride. It comes with dual frontal airbags, cloth seats, a CD player, and air conditioning as standard. A host of power and luxury options are available too. For all these reasons, the F-150 has sadly been America's best-selling full-size pickup for 28 consecutive years. It is the most most profitable vehicle Ford makes. It is available in various trim levels, variations, and specialty models, including quad cab, single cab and dual cab model, with various bed sizes. At the bottom of the lineup is a V6 work truck, though the only options apparently offered here are the 4.6-litre V8 and the 5.4-litre V8 engines, with automatic trannies.

The first product from the takeover of Chrysler by Daimler-Benz was the Crossfire, a stylish sports coupe that rides on the old Mercedes-Benz SLK platform, while sharing many of its components with other Mercedes models, and built in Germany too. The Crossfire has a long hood with streaks on it, while the fastback roofline ends with a "boat tail." The car also has a centre spine that runs the length of the car, from the grille in front to between the dual, centre-mounted rear exhausts. The Crossfire's stance is enhanced by rear tyres that are larger than those in front, and by its broad shoulders, tall body sides and minimal glass area. The car's central spine reappears as an element in the car's interior design. The car's two bucket seats are trimmed in two-tone leather. Gauges have white-on-black faces with metallic bezels and chrome trim rings, while the centre console has a metallic look too. Other features for the two-seat coupe include a speed-activated rear spoiler and six-speaker audio system with dual subwoofers. By now, it would seem like the Crossfire is more of a design exercise than an attempt to build a true sports car. This is confirmed by the old 3.2-litre V6 that doesn't pull the car with enough verve.

The redesigned-for-2008 Mondeo is an attractive midsize car built in Europe that shares a Mazda platform. It looks excellent inside and out, but loses out to the Japanese with a weak combination of carryover engines, along with the stigma of expensive dealer maintenance charges. It was facelifted a bit for 2011, with a new front bumper and grille. The Mondeo is largely avaliable as a family sedan, but it is also available in sporty liftback and practical wagon form in some markets. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for an affordable price. The interior is especially attractive and put together well. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available with a 5-speed manual. A 2.3-litre 4-cylinder engine is coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. Various trim levels are available, all with power windows, trip computer, ABS brakes, front airbags, CD stereo with MP3 connector and more. Options include stability control, CD changer, keyless starter button, Xenon adaptive headlights, tyre pressure monitor, sunroof, fog lights, variable suspension settings, hill launch assist and adaptive cruise control.

The Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year and replaces the CL65 AMG. It is still motivated by a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, but produces more power than its predecessor. The engine can be coupled with rear-wheel-drive, as well as an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 7-speed automatic transmission. There's also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The all-new Volvo C70 is touted as being two cars in one, namely a coupe and a convertible, although the concept has been around for years now. This one has room for four average-sized adults. The three-piece retractable steel roof folds up or down electrically in 30 seconds. Development of the trick top was apparently helped along by Pininfarina in Italy. The new car is slightly shorter and lower than the old model, though it offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers. Available in this region are two oddball five-cylinder engines, one a 2.4-litre and the other a turbocharged 2.5-litre, both with automatic gearboxes with tiptronic, and all models are invariably front-wheel-drive. Standard features include dual zone automatic climate control, power seats, trip computer, automatic dimming rear-view mirror and a CD audio system. Safety features typical of Volvo include emergency pop-up roll bars, ABS brakes, a front side-impact protection system also known as SIPS, and a whiplash protection they like to call WHIPS.

This 4th generation of the long-running 3-Series remained BMW's best-selling car, and with good reason. Ignoring the 3-Series Compact that was based on an older platform, this iteration of the 3-Series came in sedan, coupe and convertible forms, as well as in wagon trim that never came to the GCC. These variations were enough to solidify this model as the arguably the top-selling entry-luxury car in the market. While lower models managed with cloth upholstery, steel wheels and basic power accessories, the higher trim levels enjoyed leather, premium CD stereo, navigation, alloy wheels, sunroof and other amenities. While all models were rear-wheel-drive, some markets may have gotten a few all-wheel-drive versions of the various models. Manual and automatic transmissions were standard, but some markets may also have automanual gearboxes on some higher models. The sedan debuted in 1999, followed by the coupe in 2000, with 2.0-litre, 2.2-litre, 2.5-litre and 2.8-litre engines, along with 318i, 320i, 323i and 328i designations respectively, and 2-door models getting "Ci" badging instead of "i" at the end. The year 2001 brought about the hot 3.2-litre M3 version, available in 2-door form only, while all other models got new engines and names, such as upgraded 2.5-litre 325i and new 3.0-litre 330i alongside the existing 318i and 320i. A minor front-end facelift came in 2002 for all models except the M3. A lightweight M3 CSL with an upgraded engine was briefly available unofficially. While the sedan was replaced by an all-new model by 2006, the coupe and convertible continued well into 2006 before their new versions came out.

The BMW X1 is the smallest crossover SUV in the German brand. An all-new model came out in 2016. Based on the 1-Series platform, complete with four-wheel-independent suspension and disc brakes, the X1 is available in rear-wheel-drive form with the sDrive20i base model, sporting a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The other model in the range is the all-wheel-drive xDrive25i, also fitted with same engine but producing more power. The interior features an optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

The Mazda CX-3 is the Japanese brand's smallest SUV offering. Under the hood, it comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2-wheel drive model includes power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push button start, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/USB, Bluetooth, 4 speakers and alloy wheels. The mid-spec models get all-wheel drive, rear camera, auto A/C, 7-inch touch screen, 6 speakers, steering wheel with Bluetooth controls, daytime running lamps and fog lamps. The top model gets navigation, 6 Bose speakers, adaptive cruise control, leather seats, head up display, digital tachometer and DVD player. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, ABS with EBD and traction control and stability control. The higher models get blind spot monitor, auto-braking system, lane departure warning system and side curtain airbags.

Hyundai continues its march for world dominance by ditching the old Elantra and introducing this completely new model for 2012, featuring a longer wheelbase and more cabin space. The spacious 5-seater comes standard with a new 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a standard 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Later, a 1.6-litre engine was also offered in some GCC markets such as the UAE, with an automatic gearbox. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

Available in other parts of the world since 2017, the Chevrolet Bolt EV made its debut in the UAE and some GCC countries as 2019 model year. The first electric car offering from the American brand, the Bolt EV  is a 4-door sub-compact hatchback. It is available offered in one trim. According to Chevrolet, the Bolt EV has a range of 520 km. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors. keyless entry, central locking, push start stop engine, 10.2-inch screen in the centre console and 8.0-inch screen in the instrument cluster, fabric seats, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatible infotainment system and alloy wheels. Safety features include 10 airbags and tire pressure monitoring system.

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. The Corolla can be equipped to be a luxurious compact, with the decent top-spec 1.8-litre four-cylinder, as well as optional leather interior and a DVD system, which are hard to find in any other compact besides the overpriced German cars. We even compared this version of the Corolla to an Audi, which no doubt made Audi angry. However, the base Corolla offers excellent value and comes standard with a 1.3-litre four-cylinder, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows and a cloth interior. Airbags are standard, but everything else is optional. Both engines can be had with either a five-speed manual or a smooth but outdated four-speed automatic. Everything is simple about this car. The air-conditioning controls and radio controls are straightforward, the cup holders work well, and storage holes are available all over. The sedan is surprisingly roomy and comfortable, while the wagon has a spacious luggage area.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The Ford Expedition is a full-size 4WD that's carried on virtually unchanged since 2007, but started gaining ground in some markets after the demise of the Crown Victoria in 2012. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. In 2015, the Expedition comes with turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

The Chinese Chery Tiggo received a makeover for its 2016 model year and a rebranding to Tiggo 3, while also making it the second facelift for this aging crossover. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, it comes with a CVT automatic now. The five-door five-seater Tiggo 3 gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling.

The futuristic Audi TT Coupe was first launched in late 1998, followed by the Roadster in 1999. It became a trend-setter in terms of style, but mechanical mediocrity meant it was never a true sports car, being based on the same platform that served the VW Golf and the Skoda Octavia. Originally available with two original engine choices, both were turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder units, at different states of tune. The lower model got front-wheel-drive, while the higher-powered model benefitted from standard Quattro all-wheel-drive. First-year models suffered from dangerous high-speed handling due to lift-off oversteer and led to many deaths, so stability control, better stabilisers and a rear lip-spoiler were added from 2000. All versions only had a manual gearbox up till 2003, when an automatic gearbox with manual-shift capability was offered in the lower-powered model. Model-year 2003 also saw a minor unnoticeable facelift as well as the introduction of a 3.2-litre V6 option, available with either a manual or, from 2004, a newly-developed DSG automanual gearbox. The V6 also got standard Quattro all-wheel-drive, stiffer suspension and slightly upgraded body trim. The coupe was a 2+2 seater, while the roadster only had two seats. All versions got a cramped but stylish interior, and could be had with special leather upholstery, the usual power accessories, and more. Variations over the years meant different wheel designs and interior options were available. Final-year 2006 models can be identified by a two-tone paintjob. The original TT was a popular entry into the compact sports-car market due to its looks, but it was always the worst in terms of driving dynamics compared to its more-capable competitors.

The American-built Honda Odyssey minivan has been redesigned for 2011. The upmarket minivan is aimed at big families, and is longer, wider and lower than the previous version. It comes in LX, EXL and Touring trim levels. Mechanical specs include a 3.5-litre V6 with cylinder-shutoff technology, a 5-speed automatic in the LX and EXL as well as a 6-speed automatic reserved for the Touring, MacPherson strut front and double-wishbone rear suspension, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and an 80-litre fuel tank. Depending on trim, features include three rows of seating for up to eight people, adjustable 2nd-row seats that can space outwards to fit three baby seats, 3rd-row "magic" seats that can flip forwards or backwards, power-adjustable driver's seat with optional powered passenger seat, optional HID headlights, optional rear DVD screen that is ultra-wide to play a movie and a video game at the same time, ports for USB and even HDMI, optional navigation with Bluetooth phone, optional 15GB hard drive or 2GB flash drive to store CDs instead of needing a CD changer, front and side airbags with three-row side-curtain airbags, stability control, power windows front and rear, cruise control, sunroof, cooler box, remote-controllable power tailgate and rear sliding doors, variable power steering, ABS and 15 bottle and cup holders.

This mini-car, also known as the Atos Prime occassionally, is in such a rare category that few people heard about it, and even fewer have bought one. It is amazingly cheap, but even more amazingly small, which seems to be to its detriment in this region.
