Powered by either 1.0-litre or 1.1-litre four-cylinder engines, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or automatic, while the slightly larger engine gets only an automatic as well as better fuel economy, Standard features include air- conditioning, seat under-tray for the front passenger, AM/FM radio and cassette player, a fold-down rear seat and, of course, wind-up windows. Move up to the better trims, and available features include power steering, front fog lamps, central door locking, power windows, rear wiper with washer, seat back pockets, better cloth upholstery, body-coloured door handles and outside mirrors, and the all-important seat under-tray both under the passenger as well as the driver's seat, to store your dirty magazines. Safety features include nothing more than the metal holding up the body panels.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Dodge Charger received a significant facelift in 2015. The previous engines are there, which includes the 3.6-litre V6 and 5.7-litre V8, aside from the SRT models. They all get the 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, Dodge added the 6.4-litre V8 engine from the SRT models into the R/T line. The base Dodge Charger model gets a manual a/c, cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. The 2021 Dodge Charger SXT V6 trim level additionally comes with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more, with some of these features reserved for the SXT Plus version offered in certain markets such as the UAE. The GT and GTS V6 models comes with an appearance package. The 2021 Dodge Charger R/T model comes in different trim levels. The base R/T gets almost all the features of the top V6 model except for leather and fancy cup-holders, but gains sportier suspension and brakes, with options such as power seats, the fancy cup-holders, premium audio and a few other features, depending on market. The top R/T Scat Pack model gets the bigger 6.4-litre V8 engine, sportier suspension, steering, exhaust, grille, spoiler and 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The CL-Class is a rare breed, always in the shadow of its S-Class sibling, on which is is based. Receiving a complete overhaul like the sedan, this coupe features numerous innovative safety technology, such as up-front sensors which make it possible to assess the impact severity at an early stage during a crash and activate the front passenger airbag in two stages depending on the severity of the accident. Other features include Active Body Control for better handling, Intelligent Light System using bi-xenon headlights with five different lighting functions to match weather conditions. Options include night-view assist with infrared headlamps, reversing camera, voice control for car radio, DVD changer and navigation as well as tyre pressure monitoring system. Models include the CL 500 with a 5.5-litre V8 and a CL 600 with a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, both with automatic transmissions. The standard automatic has the new DIRECT SELECT gearshift, which allows selection of the gear by nudging a lever on the steering column. Operating commands are transmitted electronically by wire.

The R8 is Audi's all-new two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. In mid-2009, a 5.2-litre V10 engine was introduced. The V8 Coupe came first, followed by the V10 Coupe, and then the V10 Spyder in 2010. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or an R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. In 2009, a removable roof model was added to the lineup, called the Veyron Grand Sport. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The A4 has been completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, featuring a new and improved platform, shared with the A5 coupe, that moves engine further back in the engine compartment for better handling balance. The new model is bigger than its predecessor in most dimensions, thus improving cabin space to almost midsize levels. Arriving in the GCC during the first quarter of 2008 only in sedan form, available engines include the weak "1.8T" with two versions of the 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder, mated to front-wheel-drive and a CVT automatic, and a "3.2 Quattro" with a 3.2-litre V6 with all-wheel-drive and 6-speed automatic. A couple of "2.0T" models joined the line-up by 2010, with two different 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engines, one with front-wheel-drive and the other with more power and all-wheel-drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a new dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings, with up to 24 combinations available to create individual driving profiles. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Mini, heavily updated in 2007, was mildly updated for 2010 in looks, features and power. It is one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a bit of cargo. Engineered by BMW, the Mini has been given a major overhaul in styling and cabin space for 2007, though the basic underpinnings are still the same. Cabrio convertibles offer an electrically-folding soft-top and pop-up rollover hoops. Models include the Cooper and the turbocharged Cooper S. The Cooper models use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine in different states of tune, with the S adding a turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works (JCW) package that bumps up horsepower and handling, while a Sport package offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps. Originally, the JCW models were only available with a manual gearbox, but automatic versions became available by late 2012. Special edition models are offered from time to time, such as the 50th-anniversary Mayfair Cooper S in 2010. A limited "Inspired by Goodwood" Cooper S model was launched with real leather and other upscale trim, for a lot of money. A limited Cooper S JCW GP edition came in 2013, featuring a bit more power over the regular JCW, Recaro front seats, rear seats deleted, stiffer suspension and unique wheels.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Fiesta got a facelift and new engine in 2014. Available only in 5-door form, it gets 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 6-speed automatic. Available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trim levels, basic features include 15-inch steel wheels, electric power steering, capless fuel-filler system, full-size spare tyre, dual front airbags, cloth seats and manual windows. The top model can be outfitted with 15-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, rear 'sport' spoiler, front/rear parking sensors, automatic a/c, power windows, fog lamps, optional stability control, front and optional side-curtain airbags, driver's knee airbag, optional trip computer, keyless entry with push-button start, CD/MP3 with 6 speakers and steering-wheel controls, AUX input jack, Bluetooth, optional cruise control and more.

An all-new Volkswagen Touareg came out in 2019. It is slightly wider and longer than the previous model. It is also lighter because of its mixed material construction of aluminium (48 per cent) and high-tech steels (52 per cent). The new dimensions help it achieve more cargo room at the back. The UAE and GCC market gets two engine options - a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 unit. Notable features include the Digital Cockpit with a 12-inch display and the infotainment system with a 15-inch display. It gets a lot of new safety features as well. Along with the multitude of airbags, blind spot detection, traction control and stability control, it gets technologies such as the 'Night Vision' assistance system (detects people and animals in darkness via a thermal imaging camera), Roadwork Lane Assist (semi-automated steering and lane keeping, accelerating and braking up to 60 km/h), Front Cross Traffic Assist (reacts to cross traffic in front), and 'IQ.Light - LED matrix headlights' (interactive, camera-based dipped and main beam headlight control).

The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The Opel Adam is the German brand's mini hatchback offering. Under the hood, the Adam gets a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. An automatic transmission will be available later. It is very fuel-efficient since it also comes with engine start/stop technology. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with USB/AUX support, manual A/C and fabric seats. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control (ESC).

The Lexus IS received a full redesign for 2014, completely shying away from their usual conservative styling. It comes with a choice of 2.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic transmission in the IS 250 or a 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350, both on a rear-wheel-drive platform, with new steering and rear suspension derived from the Lexus GS. New driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it now gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. A host of new standard items for 2014 include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

The Zotye T600 is the Chinese brand's compact SUV offering. Looking a lot like a Volkswagen Tiguan due to the loose copyright laws in China, the T600 features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the T600 include, standard or optional, include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, touch screen, multi-functional steering wheel, leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C and alloy wheels. Safety features include airbags, ABS, brake assist, stability control and traction control.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Coupe replaced 3-series coupe model. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 428i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 435i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The new BMW 4 Series Coupe is visibly larger in width and wheelbase than the outgoing BMW 3 Series Coupe. The BMW 4 Series Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. This new interpretation is a modern vehicle with  bold unique styling elements that reflect its heritage, such as the round headlights brought together by the grille, hood and fender lines. The most noticeable features are the white roof and wrap-around rear side windows that were signature elements of the original FJ40. The FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. Having made its American debut in the 2007 model year, the Japanese-built 2008 Toyota FJ Cruiser comes to the GCC, equipped with a 4.0-litre V6, five-speed automatic, low-range transfer case, standard front and side-curtain airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels with off-road tyres, a premium sound system, a washable interior and  loads of cheesy optional accessories.

The Volkswagen Golf GTI always had a good following here, even though hatchbacks were never so popular in this region. The 4-cylinder turbocharged 2.0-litre GTI is satisfyingly fast and features a dual-clutch automanual gearbox that is still rare in any class of car that was affordable at the time. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

The V6 also got standard Quattro all-wheel-drive, stiffer suspension and slightly upgraded body trim. The coupe was a 2+2 seater, while the roadster only had two seats. All versions got a cramped but stylish interior, and could be had with special leather upholstery, the usual power accessories, and more. A new-generation Kia Sorento made its debut in 2015. It received a minor facelift in 2019. along with few interior and tech upgrades. The Sorento is a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension. The available engines for the GCC are a 3.3-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive as well as a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available with cloth or leather upholstery. The Sorento can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, xenon headlamps, LED indicators on the mirrors, seat cooler and warmer in the front, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch or 19-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

An all-new Jeep Wrangler came out in 2018.  It is slightly bigger, faster and lighter than the previous generation. The engine has been carried over from the older model, the 3.6-litre V6 “Pentastar” motor. Acceleration and fuel economy numbers have been improved, thanks to the new 8-speed automatic transmission replacing the ancient 5-speed. Manual gear lovers will be left disappointed though, as it is not offered anymore in this region. The electronically assisted steering has replaced the hydraulic steering. The interior has more quality materials than the older model, with the Sahara and Rubicon models getting more of the leather treatment. Even the standard equipment has improved, with the Wrangler Sport getting a touchscreen for the infotainment system. Safety features include four airbags, ABS, stability control, and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monitor, and rear cross path detection.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK back in 2016. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. First released as a 2016 model year, it remains pretty much the same for 2018 as well. Under the hood, the GLC250 and GLC 300 get a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with two different tunes, both of which can be had in either two-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Sirion is Daihatsu's entry in the sub-compact segment, packed with features and space. It received a minor facelift for the 2008 model year, along with a bigger 1.5-litre engine. The little Sirion offers a generous amount of space for the front passengers, including a fair bit of room between the driver seat and the front passenger seat. Rear passengers aren't so lucky, but they still get reasonable amounts of leg space between front and rear seats. The rear doors open wide to an angle of around 80 degrees, allowing easy entry and exit, and the tailgate eases handling of large luggage. There is a full 630 litres of luggage space with two people on board and the rear seats folded down. With five on board, it still has 225 litres. The top of the back door has decent head clearance and a pull handle also makes it easy to close the door. A luggage room lamp adds convenience, along with the CD/AM/FM Radio, power windows, central locking, front airbags, cup holders in the doors and the centre console, and split rear seats that are 60:40 foldable. It is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder motor, the Sirion shifts gears using a 4-speed automatic, as the manual is not offered here. 14-inch steel wheels are standard, while alloys are optional, among other things.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in three versions currently. The Maybach 62 is the long wheelbase version of the 57, which is quite large already, and this body style comes in either standard 62 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in a new-for-2008 62 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. All models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems. A handful of limited-edition Landaulet four-door convertible models were built in 2010 for a four times higher price.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. The lengthened four-door wheelbase provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The 599 GTB Fiorano is a new all-aluminium two-seater, named after the circuit Ferrari uses to hone the performance of its track and road cars, while GTB stands for Gran Turismo Berlinetta, after classic Ferrari berlinettas, and 599 reflects the displacement of its V12 engine divided by 10. Talk about overdoing it. The passenger areas of the Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano are trimmed in leather while the driver area and controls boast more high-tech detailing in carbon-fibre and aluminium. Other standard accessories include front bi-xenon headlamps and rear LED lights, dusk and rain sensors, dual-zone climate control, electrically adjustable steering-wheel column, hideaway radio/CD player and key with integrated volumetric anti-theft device with motion sensors. Accessories include front and rear parking sensors, iPod-friendly set-up, satellite anti-theft system and a luggage set specially tailored to fit this model. Development work for the Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano focused specifically on the distinctive sound the 6.0-litre V12 makes, to pretty much make it sound like a Ferrari.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It is available with "SkyActiv" engines, a 2.0-litre and a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, both direct-injection with high compression ratios. There are two body styles, namely a sedan and a station-wagon. The sedan is available with both engine options, while the wagon only comes with the smaller motor. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. The top model includes 19-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera, bi-xenon headlights, daytime running lights, 11-speaker Bose sound system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents and a sunroof. Navigation and adaptive cruise control can be further added to the top-spec version, but they're not offered in all GCC markets. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The engine range includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts.

The Hyundai Sonata received a facelift for 2018 which included notable design changes, thus bringing the Sonata in line with its Elantra brethren aesthetically. The interior has been revised too, albeit slightly, featuring better quality materials. Mechanically, things remain the same, except for the turbocharged 2.0-litre variant now getting an eight-speed automatic gearbox, and a few touches to the suspension components for ensuring better ride and handling. The base model, known as Sonata GL in UAE, comes with 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and mirrors, fog lamps, keyless entry, rear camera, cruise control, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, ABS and one only airbag. The GL can be optioned up with 16-inch or 17-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, panoramic sunroof, leatherette steering, electric folding mirrors and a second passenger airbag. The top-spec Sonata GLS comes with auto a/c, subwoofer, front parking sensors, smart key with starter button, chrome door handles, blind-spot monitor, navigation, rear and side-rear sunblinds, electric parking brake, auto-dimming mirror, HID headlights with auto-levelling and washers, leather seats with front heating/ventilation, puddle lamps, solar glass, stability control and a total of 6 airbags. The Turbo Sport gets sports suspension, 18-inch alloy wheels and dual twin-tip exhaust mufflers. The front-grille is slightly different and it also gets LED daytime running lights. The interior gets a new 3-spoke steering wheel, gear knob, instrument cluster and interior trim, along with Turbo stitching.

An all-new model of the BMW X5 came out in 2019. It is longer, wider and higher than the outgoing model. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The 407 is an oddity in the midsize car segment, with bold styling that puts form over function. The exterior features a long hood and a compact trunk, all of which compromises interior space. Available in four-door sedan, two-door coupe or five-door station wagon body styles, there are at least three engines littering the range. The entry level engine is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine combined with a 4-speed automatic with tiptronic sequential control. Then there is a 2.2-litre four-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Manual gearbox models have been discontinued here. The top model is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with an all-new 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. The sedan gets all engine options, while the SW wagon gets only the 2.0-litre. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 4-cylinder models get six airbags, while the V6 model gets as many as nine airbags.

As with the previous model, the new TT is built on the VW Golf platform. The new TT will be available with numerous engines, including a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo and a 3.2-litre V6. The TT RS model debuted in 2011 with a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo while the V6 was cancelled. The TT roadster will debut late into 2007. The new TT is a far more aggressive sports car than the model it replaces, which was more of a show car than a sports car. Like its predecessor, the curvy profile generates a lot of aerodynamic lift at the rear end, so the new TT adopts a rear spoiler which recesses smoothly into the tail at low speeds and raises automatically at over 120 kph. The new car is larger and heavier, so to compensate for the additional metal, the hood, front fenders, roof and doors are made of aluminium, while the panels of the rear body remain steel to help balance the car. "Quattro" all-wheel-drive is optional on the front-driven 2.0 turbo, while standard on the 3.2 V6 and the RS. Manual gearbox is standard, but a DSG automanual is optional. Features include cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry, alloy wheels and the usual power accessories. As was the case with the previous TT, the new car is built as part of a joint effort, with bodywork and paint done at the German plant in Ingolstadt, and vehicle assembly is completed at Audi's Hungarian plant in Gyor.

The Zotye Z100 is the Chinese brand's small car offering. Based on the second-generation Suzuki Alto, the Z100 gets a 1.0-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features in the Z100 include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with MP3, 2 speakers, manual A/C and 14-inch alloy wheels. Safety feature include dual front airbags, ABS and EBD.

The third-generation Kia Cerato hatchback boasts sleeker styling that is 30 mm longer, 15 mm lower and 5 mm wider than the outgoing car, with a 50 mm extended wheelbase. It also featured an all-new bodyshell, upgraded equipment, a host of additional convenience and safety features, a more spacious cabin with better quality, improved suspension and an upgraded powertrain line-up that delivers class-leading performance and fuel economy. In 2017, the Cerato got a facelift. No changes were made in 2018. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors. Safety features include ABS brakes, brake assist, stability control, and two front airbags.

The all-new Honda Jazz was launched in the GCC for the 2009 model year, larger and more powerful than before. The 'New Jazz' is powered by an upgraded 1.5-litre 4-cylinder i-VTEC engine. In a move to deter true enthusiasts, only a 5-speed automatic gearbox is available for this market. The redesigned Jazz is supposed to be the first car in its class to be equipped with a 5-speed auto gearbox and optional paddle shifters. The speedometer features a large LED display providing of a broad range of information, including current fuel economy and range indications. This would be a first for Honda cars, as even their more expensive models do not have a trip computer yet. An integrated single-CD stereo is fitted on all models, with MP3/WMA capability and speed-dependent volume adjustment. Features include four speakers, two tweeters and a USB adaptor in the centre console storage box. The Jazz is also equipped with the latest version of Honda's 'Magic Seats' in the back that can fold up or fold down in one motion. All models get power-folding mirrors, air-cooled double glovebox, keyless entry, alarm, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and front power windows. The EX adds rear power windows, paddle shifters, faux-leather steering wheel with audio controls, 16-inch alloy wheels and cruise control. A panoramic sunroof is standard on the top EXL version. The Jazz also comes in 11 different colours, with a body-kit option as well. All Jazz models are equipped with ABS and Electronic brake-force distribution as standard. Dual front airbags are standard, while only the EXL gets side airbags.

The Lexus LC is the Japanese luxury brand's first attempt at a grand tourer model. The 2-door coupe gets two engine choices - the LC500 gets naturally aspirated 5.0-V8 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, the other a 3.5-litre V6 coupled with an electric motor, with power transmitted via a hybrid transmission, which is a combined 4-speed automatic and CVT. Standard features on the LC 500 include power steering, power windows, electric foldable mirrors, cruise control, LED headlamps, smart entry and start system, front and rear corner sensors, panoramic roof, leather seats, 10-way power front seats, Mark Levinson surround sound system, DVD player, 2 USB ports, Bluetooth, 13 speakers, navigation, head up display, LED interior lighting package, seat ventilation and 21-inch alloy wheels. There is a "Carbon" edition available for the V8, with carbon moon roof, carbon scuff plates, sports seats and Lexus Dynamic Handling, which is the luxury brand's 4-wheel steering wheel system. Safery features include pre-crash safety systems, lane keeping assist, automatic high beams system, blind spot monitor, rear cross traffic alert, ABS, traction control, vehicle stability control and front, side & knee, curtain airbags.

The Peugeot 301 is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. While claiming class-leading cabin and boot space, the Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

The redesigned 2014 Kia Carens is a seven-seater MPV, smaller than typical minivans. The Carens can be had with two 4-cylinder engines, one a direct-injection 1.6-litre "GDI" in LX and EX trim, and the other a fuel-injected 2.0-litre "MPI" in LX and two EX trims. All models get a 6-speed automatic, front-wheel-drive, fog lamps, cooled glovebox, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, roof rack and keyless entry. Base models get 16-inch steel wheels and a vinyl steering wheel. Higher trim levels get 17-inch alloy wheels, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, parking sensors, cruise control and more. Only the top model gets a panoramic glass roof. All models get ABS and only one airbag, except for the top model, which gets two front airbags to go with that glass roof.

The Ford Transit Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying cargo. It can seat up to 3 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2021 Ford Transit Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine, available in two different tunes. All models get the 6-speed manual transmission. The van has a payload capacity up to 1,024 kg, a maximum cargo volume of 8.3 cubic metre square and a wide space between the wheel arches allowing for the storage of 1.2-m x 2.4-m boards vertically or horizontally. The load-through bulkhead lets you carry up to 3-meter-long cargo, such as pipes, ladders or carpet rolls. Fixing points and 8 tie-down loops are positioned on the bodysides, leaving the floor clear for easier loading, unloading and cleaning. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2021 Ford Transit Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The all-new 6-Series  was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, which has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic.

The BMW i8 is a plug-in hybrid coupe powered by a high-performance electric motor in the front, which drives the front axle, and a mid-mounted turbocharged 3-cylinder 1.5-litre petrol engine powering the rear wheels. In 2019, it got a slight facelift and a bigger battery, giving it a small bump up in horsepower. The petrol engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic, while the electric motor is attached to a 2-stage automatic transmission. On electricity alone, the i8 can travel about 30 Km, before the petrol engine has to intervene and recharge the batteries. Another interesting feature is the car's ability to switch between front-wheel-drive, rear-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. But that very well depends on driver mood and more importantly, the existing electric juice. The i8 features a perfect 50:50 weight distribution, which BMW claims to have achieved using lightweight materials like carbon-fibre and aluminium. Safety standards are high in the i8 as the DSC (Dynamic Stability Control) system includes the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS), Cornering Brake Control (CBC), Dynamic Brake Control (DBC), Brake Assist, Brake Standby, Brake Drying function, Start-Off Assistant, Fading Compensation, Active Differential Brake (ADB-x), Driving dynamic impellent torque pre-control, E-Traction, as well as the push button-activated Dynamic Traction Control (DTC) mode. Front airbags and side airbags integrated into the seat backrests, plus head/curtain airbags for both rows of seats, are all fitted as standard, as are three-point inertia-reel seatbelts including belt tensioners and belt force limiters for all seats.

An all-new Ford Figo came out as a 2016 model year. It got a slight faceligt in 2019, as well as new tech upgrades. It is available as a 4-door sedan and a 5-door hatchback and features a new exterior design. Under the hood it gets a 1.5-litre motor mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All cars get independent MacPherson strut front suspension and a semi-independent rear twist beam. The Figo is available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trims. The base model gets cloth-upholstered interiors with features that include front power windows, rear manual windows, central locking, keyless entry, power mirrors, 4-speaker stereo with USB port, power steering, fold-flat second-row seating, intermittent wipers, dual front airbags, ABS, hill assist, soft-touch dashboard and a manual a/c. Also available on the higher model are 15-inch alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat, and side-curtain airbags.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In 2017, it got a slight facelift. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The Honda Odyssey J is a smaller Japanese version of the larger US-built Odyssey. It gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. It has been facelifted for 2018 with a new grille, new front bumper with available LED running lights and fog lights, and new 17-inch wheels. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlights, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Other new features include a touch-panel for a/c controls, rear camera and more. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). For 2018, the EX-V additionally gets the Honda Sensing suite of active safety features that include Adaptive Cruise Control, Collision Mitigation Braking System, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Road Departure Mitigation System (RDM), Blind Spot Information System, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Pedestrian Detection System and Lane Keeping Assist System.

The Volkswagen Beetle Cabriolet made its debut in the GCC in 2016. It remains unchanged for 2017. It is powered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. It gets either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels.

A classic if there ever was one in this modern world, the Arnage stands as a symbol of what Bentley once was, before the VW-based Continental came along. Bentley claims an unrivalled heritage thanks to a skill-set handed down through three generations working on the same site, and an ability to tailor cars to precise customer wishes. Every Arnage is built to order, and over half are further modified by Bentley's coachbuilding arm, Bentley Mulliner. Bentley also claims that the Arnage is the culmination of over 80 years continual experience of building Grand Touring Limousines. It is odd though that at least in the last decade, the Arnage, in R, T and RL trims, has remained largely untouched, except for a minor facelift. Bentley also likes to brag about one regular customer, who said that determining the specification of an Arnage is like having your own private car company. An exclusive club for sure, but we have to wonder what they pay for. The impressive 6.8-litre turbo V8 engines, mated to a 4-speed automatic, are massive and yet they are easily surpassed in power and economy by, of all people, the Americans. This facelift came in 2005, and the higher-output motor was reserved for the sporting T model.

The Audi S8 is the sports version of the carmaker's flagship A8 model. In 2020 an all-new Audi S8 model came out. Under the hood, the S8 comes with a powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine connected to a small electric motor, and mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It also gets cylinder deactivation so it can run on only 4 cylinders for better fuel economy. Features include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon headlamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, 360-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and panoramic roof. Safety standards are high, with electronic stability control, various collision prevention systems and numerous airbags. Different equipment packages are available as well for further customisation.

The Cadillac CT6 is the American luxury brand's flagship sedan. It takes on the Germans, but it weighs less than a 5-Series and an E-Class. Under the hood, there are three engine choices available. The standard model gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, which is currently not sold in the GCC. Then there is the naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine and the current top trim gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 unit. All motors get a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the rear-wheel drive CT6 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. A washer for the rear camera is new for 2018. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 2.6 entertainment system, 34 BOSE speakers, rear seat infotainment system with 10-inch-diagonal screens that retract into the front seatbacks, quad-zone climate control, bigger alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

Mercedes-Maybach S-Class sees the return of the "Maybach" brand. The S600 Maybach is being sold in the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include a full panoramic sunroof, powered privacy shades for the rear windows, acres of leather trim, night-vision display in the LCD gauge-cluster, chrome-plated speaker grilles, fibre-optic ambient lighting, Burmester 3D surround sound, and back-lit tweeters on all the doors that spiral out on start-up, although these things can even be had in a standard S-Class, if you tick everything on the options list. The lounge-worthy rear seats both offer a full range of power adjustability, and includes extending calf-supports, a massaging function, heated/cooled cup-holders and a seat heating/cooling feature, while the right-side rear seat gets an additional footrest that can be motored out of the front passenger seatback for sleeping. It's so intricate that the dual LCD screens on the front seat-backs automatically adjust their angles as the front seats are adjusted, so the rear passengers always get the best view. The massage and multimedia features are controlled with a remote, with animated settings showing on the screens. Its "Magic Body Control" system that scans the road ahead for bumps and adjusts the suspension to drive over them as smoothly as possible. Further options include flip-out tray-tables and a fridge that comes with a pair of silver-plated champagne flute-glasses as well as space for three chilled bottles. Along with the front and side airbags, ABS, traction control, the Mercedes-Maybach can be added with PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, Brake Assist BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Night View Assist Plus. In the shape of the seat belt buckle extender, Beltbag (both part of the PRE-SAFE rear package) and seat cushion airbag.

The S60 is tuned to be a sports sedan, but though it is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis, it looks like a sleek sports coupe from afar. The interior is fairly spacious even with the swooping roofline, and it offers more of a midsize package than a compact one, even though it is occassionally pitted against smaller German rivals in comparisons. For the Middle East market, there were four powerplants from 2001 up to 2003. These include a basic 2.4-litre, a 2.0-litre turbo and a 2.4-litre turbo for the run-of-the-mill S60 sedan models, and a higher-tuned 2.3-litre turbo for the sporty front-wheel-drive T5. All engines are five-cylinder, and have an automatic with tiptronic, although some can be had with a manual too. Standard equipment includes CD stereo, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, cloth or leather cabin, alloy wheels of various sizes, power windows, electric mirrors, optional sunroof, wood trim, automatic a/c and power-adjustable front seats. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection. The all-wheel-drive models available in Europe were not marketed in the GCC during these years.

The CMC Z7, new in the GCC, is actually an iteration of a Taiwanese model called the Mitsubishi Zinger, and sharing a chassis with the Mitsubishi Nativa. The Z7 people-carrier is powered by a Mitsubishi-sourced 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Features include four forward-opening doors with a rear tailgate, eight seats, cloth upholstery, parking sensors, keyless entry, power windows, power locks, power steering, rear spoiler and 18-inch alloy wheels. Higher trim levels get climate control, HID headlights and leather upholstery. Safety features include ABS and one standard airbag, with a second one optional. Local dealers are offering long warranties.

The Juke is a new sub-compact crossover by Nissan, based on the Tiida platform. Powered by a choice of either a 1.6-litre naturally-aspirated or a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, the latter also featuring direct-injection. Available transmissions include a special-order manual or a standard CVT automatic. Unfortunately, only the front-wheel-drive version is offered in the GCC, while an all-wheel-drive version is offered elsewhere. Standard features include cloth upholstery, red or silver painted console, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, power front window, electric mirrors, 60/40 folding rear seats and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher-trim models get a sunroof, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, USB port, fog lamps, automatic a/c, four power windows, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Juke can also be customised with various optional alloy-wheel designs, stickers, decal stripes, roof spoilers and more. Safety features include front airbags, optional side-curtain airbags, ABS disc brakes with EBD, and stability control.

The new-for-2011 Infiniti QX56 full-size luxury SUV, in its 2nd-generation, is now based on the Nissan Patrol. The exterior gives away its Nissan origins, save for unique front and rear ends, as well as some trim bits. The QX comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. A new 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available, which also includes optional 22-inch wheels and a number of other features. The 2011 QX also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. Inside, standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, available perforated semi-aniline leather seating, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 7-inch color monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the new QX's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA color touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

For 2018, the Infiniti QX80 got a major facelift which included new LED headlight clusters, new grille, reshaped bumpers, redone rear lights, new tailgate chrome trim, and redesigned 22-inch wheels. It still comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. In 2021, the interior got an update, featuring a big screen in the centre console. A 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available. The QX80 also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. The cabin can be trimmed in either leather as standard or semi-aniline leather with optional contrast-colour piping. Standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 8-inch colour monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the QX80's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA colour touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

The Chinese Tiggo beautifully illustrates the Koreans' fight for dominance in the small-4WD segment over the Japanese. The Tiggo has a bit of the Kia Sorento front end slapped onto the body of a previous-generation Toyota RAV-4. It kind of reminds us of a fake Rolex watch that has a Swatch lookalike face--a bit of the best and a bit of the average, but still ultimately neither. The five-door five-seater Tiggo does benefit from a versatile interior though, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Powered by a 2.4-litre Mitsubishi-sourced 4-cylinder engine, it comes with either a four-speed auto with two-wheel-drive, or a five-speed manual gearbox with all-wheel-drive. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling. Don't put too much faith in the incredibly low manufacturer-quoted fuel consumption numbers though.

The Mini Paceman got a minor facelift in 2015, with the Cooper S variant getting a minor horsepower increase. It is just a 3-door chopped-top version of the Countryman. Under the bonnet are the same 1.6-litre engines that power the smaller Minis, with Cooper and Cooper S variants, all with a 6-speed automatic gearbox. All-wheel-drive is optional on the Cooper S variant. A John Cooper Works model is also available, with lowered sports suspension as well as 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheel options. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The Lexus IS received a full redesign for 2014, completely shying away from their usual conservative styling. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

An all-new Hyundai Sonata was released as a 2020 model. Mechanically, there is a new 2.5-litre 4-cylinder MPI engine , but there is barely any upgrade in power compared to the previous generation, and it is still mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. In Saudi Arabia, a 2.0-litre engine is also available. The base model, known as Sonata Smart in UAE, comes with 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and mirrors, fog lamps, keyless entry, rear camera, cruise control, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, ABS and one only airbag. The higher spec versions called Smart Plus and Comfort comes with 16-inch or 17-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, panoramic sunroof, leatherette steering, electric folding mirrors and a second passenger airbag. The top-spec Sonata Premium comes with auto a/c, subwoofer, front parking sensors, smart key with starter button, chrome door handles, blind-spot monitor, navigation, rear and side-rear sunblinds, electric parking brake, auto-dimming mirror, HID headlights with auto-levelling and washers, leather seats with front heating/ventilation, puddle lamps, solar glass, stability control and a total of 6 airbags.

The MKT is Lincoln's full-size luxury crossover that is based on the Ford Flex, with three rows of seating and tons of space. It got a facelift in 2013, along with minor improvements to the interior. According to Lincoln, the "T" in MKT, stands for Touring. Larger than the MKX midsize crossover and more efficient than the Navigator, the MKT is offered in the UAE with the turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Offered in either 6-seater or 7-seater configurations, a second-row 60/40 split folding bench seat, optional power "fold and tumble" second-row bucket seats include heating, cooling and power lumbar adjustment, and an available 5-quart refrigerator in the centre console, alongside all the usual features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, CD/MP3 stereo and Bluetooth phone. A fixed-glass panoramic roof with power-assisted front and rear sunshades is standard and an opening panoramic sunroof is optional. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as ABS and stability control.

The Mercedes-Benz A 45 AMG is the range-topping variant of the A-Class line. It received a facelift in 2016 and a power boost. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. Externally, it can be identified by its AMG-specific bumpers and wheels, although these are also available with lower-spec A-Class models with an AMG package as well. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. Other available features include HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, cruise control, navigation and more.

The H3 is the smallest addition to the Hummer line-up. Based on the Chevrolet Trailblazer platform, it is a midsized, five-passenger 4WD wagon that carries the military design cues and off-road capabilities of the Hummer H1, but puts them in a smaller and ultimately more affordable package. For 2009, a pickup version with a longer wheelbase was added, dubbed the H3T, which can fit a dirt-bike or two in its sizeable bed. The H3 and the H3T provide a good level of off-roading equipment, with some luxury features to boot, and at a very good price. All models come with a 3.7-litre five-cylinder engine, with a standard 5-speed manual or an optional 4-speed automatic. The 5.3-litre V8 engine finally became available in the summer of 2009 for the H3 wagon, mated to a 4-speed automatic. The H3 delivers serious off-road capability, with low-range gearing and good ground clearance. The base price includes cloth seating for five, power windows and locks, remote keyless entry, a CD audio system, cruise control and all-terrain tyres on 16-inch wheels. Safety features include ABS brakes, traction control, frontal and side-impact airbags and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. Special features on the V8 Alpha model include a unique calibration for the ABS brakes in 4-Low mode, a rear axle is set to a 4.10 ratio compared with the previous 4.56, a standard rear-view camera system, and stability control designed to assist with hill starts. Options include leather seating, chrome wheels, in-dash six-CD changer, navigation, a power sunroof and more.

An all-new Ford Edge made its way to the GCC in 2016. It comes with three engine options. One is the same 3.5-litre V6 engine seen in the previous generation. The other two are turbocharged "Ecoboost" engines, of which one is the base 2.0-litre and the top variant with 2.7-litre. They all get a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC 3 voice-controlled multimedia system, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Optional features include HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and bigger alloy wheel options. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

The Mondeo is a midsize front-wheel-drive built in Europe that is based on a Mazda platform. It loses out to the Japanese with a combination of engines that lag behind in power, its smaller size and its expensive dealer maintenance charges. The Mondeo actually a good family sedan, but its image is also diluted due to fleet sales as taxis. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for a very affordable price. The interior is fairly attractive and put together well. The Mondeo does have a sizeable interior for its size. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, available with either a manual or an automatic transmission. A 2.5-litre V6 engine is coupled with a five-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. The sporty Mondeo ST220, a great car, is powered by a 3.0-litre V6 engine and a six-speed manual transmission. The Mondeo can also be had as a wagon.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedan made its debut as a 2017 model year. It got a significant facelift in 2021 along with newer tech inside, as well as updated safety features. It has four models - the E200, E250, E300 which get the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and the all-wheel drive E400 which gets the 4.0-litre turbocharged V6 motor. All models get the 9-speed automatic transmission. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad.  For the first time, air suspension is now offered. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The 5-door wagon is sold here, with the 3-door and soft top versions available only on special order. The Mercedes-Benz G 500 is fitted with 4.0-litre V8 twin-turbocharged engine coupled with a 7-speed automatic transmission. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG came in 2008. The high-performance eight cylinder engine is partnered by the AMG Speedshift Plus 7G-Tronic transmission. Equipped with AMG steering wheel shift paddles there are three driving modes with the 'M' mode changing gears 50 percent faster than the Comfort setting. Outstanding handling dynamics comes thanks to an all-new three-link front axle design with springs and gas shock absorbers ensuring optimal road contact and low body movement in cornering. The multi-link independent rear suspension has a 12 millimetre wider track and more camber than the standard C-Class giving improved cornering performance. Inside the AMG instrument cluster in a tubular design features newly styled dials, AMG-specific lettering and a new night-time design. The AMG main menu in a central display allows numerous settings including Warm Up, Set Up and Race modes activated via buttons on the steering wheel. Warm Up displays engine oil and coolant temperatures, Set Up the current ESP mode and transmission settings. Race mode makes the Racetimer available with which the driver can measure lap times on a race track.

The Renault Captur is a small SUV offering from the French brand. Under the hood, the Spanish-made Captur gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. A lot of customisation can be done on the car's bodywork, interior trim and upholstery. Standard features on the front-wheel drive Captur include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, fabric seats, radio with MP3/AUX/CD player support, USB, Blutetooth, manual A/C, alloy rims, LED daytime lights, tire pressure monitoring system, push button start, central locking & keyless entry. Top model features include navigation, rear view camera, 17-inch 2-tone alloy wheels, parking sensors, automatic A/C, power folding mirrors, 2-tone body color and removable seat covers. Standard safety features include front and passenger airbags, ABS and ESP.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

This was one of the most popular versions of the Accord, being the first model to actually offer interior space befitting a midsize family car. Its conservative styling proved to be just right for its target market, and it even became the only Accord generation to become the top-selling car in the competitive American market, even though it was mildly overshadowed by the Camry in the GCC. The American-built two-door coupes are also a common sight. This new-for-1998 model was completely redesigned compared to the previous model, but retained the fancy double-wishbone suspension system that made Honda famous. There are two engines, the standard 2.3-litre 4-cylinder with a manual or automatic, and the hard-to-find optional 3.0-litre V6 with an automatic only. The popular sedans are great everyday cars with comfort and convenience features. Available features include cruise control, power locks, keyless entry, steel or alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with ABS, CD player, leather upholstery, a power glass sunroof, front airbags and more.

The Suburban, alongside the shorter Tahoe, has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Suburban and Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Suburban, with better fuel economy to boot, but a bigger 6.0-litre V8 is available. The 5.3-litre's aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. The 6.0-litre V8 gets a 6-speed automatic. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Suburban is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The eight-seater Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, so it offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The Genesis G90 is the the first model to be released after its parent company Hyundai decided to make Genesis a separate luxury brand. The G90 is their flagship sedan and it comes in the GCC with three engine options. The base engine is the 3.8-litre V6 which was found in the Centennial, while the other two new additions are the turbocharged 3.3-litre V6 motor and the 5.0-litre V8.
