But KTM developers have kept the weight of the vehicle extremely light by removing everything that is not needed, including body panels, doors and a windshield. Parts of the suspension are intentionally visible. Built on a carbon-fibre chassis, a 'crash box' in the front nose absorbs collision energy, while roll bars are integrated into the structure, which is all good considering there are no airbags. An options kit is available on request which includes having additional struts mounted at designated points. The Audi-sourced 4-cylinder FSI turbo engine is made of aluminium and mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 6-speed DSG automanual transmission. Brembo brakes, a limited-slip differential, and four-point seat-belts round out the standard package. There are no electronic driving aids, no power steering and no roof, although a cloth tarpaulin is available to cover the interior when not in use.

The 360 is a mid-engined two-seater sports car, designed as a high-tech replacement for the simplistic F355, while itself being replaced by the F430 for 2005, effectively giving the 360 the short shelf-life. For this model, occasionally known as the F360, Ferrari partnered with Alcoa to produce an all-aluminium space-frame chassis. Also new was the Pininfarina styling that gave up flip-up headlights, replacing them with rounded fixed units. The new 3.6-litre V8 engine came with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed F1-style automanual. The cabin was sparse on gadgets, but the basics were standard, including leather, CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, front airbags, ABS brakes, and stability control. The coupe version was called the 360 Modena, while the new-for-2001 convertible was called the 360 Spider. The lightweight 360 Challenge Stradale came later, with  110 kg shaved off, a bump up in power from the upgraded V8, and featuring 19-inch BBS wheels, carbon-fibre side-mirrors, updated front bumper, lower ride height, and a black mesh grille at the rear.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. Two engines have carried over to the new model, the 3.7-litre V6 and 5.0-litre V8, while there is a new turbocharged 2.3-litre 4-cylinder motor in the line-up. All engines can be had with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. The interior has been significantly improved as well with higher quality materials and upgraded MyFord infotainment system. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

The Jeep Compass got a refresh for the 2014 model year and also gets a new 6-speed transmission. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

An all-new model of the Toyota Corolla came out in mid 2019 as a 2020 model. Engine offerings include a 1.6-litre and a new 2.0-litre, both 4-cylinder "VVT-i" units. A new hybrid engine joins the lineup which is a 1.8-litre combined with electric motors. The five-seater is available in various trim levels. In Saudi Arabia, there is a 1.6 XLi model with 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, black front grille, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and a 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo. Moving up to the 1.6 GLi adds fog lamps, 16-inch alloys, rear AC vents, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, trunk liner, better upholstery with leather steering wheel, split-folding rear seats, 6-speaker touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with starter button and several other smaller convenience features. The 2.0 GLi adds LED headlights with LED running lamps, sunroof, rear manual curtains, auto a/c and cruise control. In the UAE, there are 5 trim levels, starting with the 1.6 XLi model that includes a standard automatic gearbox, 15-inch steelies, 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo, power mirrors and a black grille. power windows, keyless entry and central locking. The 1.6 GLi adds better upholstery with leather steering wheel, chrome grille, split-folding rear seats, LED running lamps, smart keyless entry and start, LCD info display, a better 6-speaker stereo and 16-inch alloy wheels. Moving on to the larger engine, the 2.0 XLi has all the features of the 1.6 XLi, but additionally gets 16-inch alloys and 6 speakers for the basic stereo. The 1.8 XLi HEV gets similar features to the 1.6 XLi, while the 1.8 GLi HEV gets a moonroof, 7-inch screen for the infotainment system, auto-leveling LED headlamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. Other markets may get slightly different trim levels. All models get standard dual front airbags, ABS with brake assist and EBD, stability control and an alarm immobiliser.

The quasi-legendary Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift in 2015, but it remains largely unchanged since the debut of this version a decade ago. The Pajero is a true off-roader, but has carved a niche as a family wagon. Powertrain options in the 2020 Mitsubishi Pajero is either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features in the 2020 Mitsubishi Pajero include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a multimedia entertainment system, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The McLaren P1 comes with a hybrid powertrain, which consists of a twin-turbo, V8 3.8-litre mid-mounted engine supplemented by electric motors. Power is transferred to the ground via a 7-speed twin clutch "˜Graziano' gearbox. The hypercar comes with a host of new goodies like the "˜Instant Power Assist System' (IPAS), which basically activates the electric motor via a steering wheel-mounted button which gives the P1 better throttle response. Another button on the steering wheel is the DRS Drag Reduction System, which when pressed, reduces the rear wing angle to lower drag. McLaren estimates that the P1 can be driven on electric power for 20 km at an average speed of 48 kph. The P1 rides on bespoke Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres and stopping power comes from discs featuring a new type of carbon-ceramic material, which is stronger than the regular fit, as it dissipates heat more effectively. In addition, these discs are lighter than usual and boast a custom ceramic layer coat on the friction surfaces for a mirrored look. Inside the cabin, the McLaren P1 features a cockpit where carbon-fibre is the primary material. Amenities such as satellite navigation, climate control, premium audio system and a digital dash showing all relevant information is also present.

The Veracruz is a midsize crossover 4WD that aims for luxury and onroad performance. Hyundai positions the Veracruz as an alternative to luxury crossovers but with a lower price. However, it is still the company's most expensive 4WD model, and base models are pretty bare on safety. The Veracruz is longer and wider than the Santa Fe, and comes standard with three rows of seats for seven passengers on all but the base model. The Veracruz comes in three trim levels here. All are powered by the same 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a six-speed automatic. All models ride on 17-inch wheels, and come standard with all-wheel-drive and ABS with EBD. Basic features include power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, alarm, CD/MP3 with 6 speakers, manual air-conditioning, side steps, and only a single airbag. The mid-level model adds cruise control, faux leather and a power liftgate. The top model adds xenon headlights, power driver seat, sunroof, rain-sensing wipers, six-CD changer and more speakers, dual-zone a/c, stability control, dual airbags, side airbags and curtain airbags. Navigation is optional, but there is no low-range gearing.

The 5-door Peugeot 208 is the French manufacturer's smallest car on offer as it replaces the 207. The base Active model comes with traction control, ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, key-less entry, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player as standard. The Allure model comes with: 16-inch 'Black Diamond' alloy wheels, tinted rear windows, a 6 speaker sound system, a USB/deported Jack plug, Bluetooth and remote controls on the steering wheel all as standard. Optional equipment is also on offer: the panoramic glass roof with manual curtain, speed limiter and cruise control, dynamic leather seats, LED lighting package with mood lighting, LED ceiling lights and halogen elliptical module headlights.

The SC 430 switches from luxury hardtop coupe to open roadster at the touch of a button. Dropping the power hardtop turns it into a true convertible, but the SC is far from a sporting vehicle. Its exterior and interior were freshened for 2006. This rear-wheel drive car is powered by a 4.3-litre V8 engine mated to a new six-speed automatic transmission and soft comfort-biased suspension. It comes as one model that features a power retractable hardtop, soft leather with wood and chrome accents, a navigation system and a Mark Levinson audio with nine speakers, 6-CD changer, a/c system that auto-adjusts temperature for top-up and top-down, eight-way power adjustable front seats with memory function, power door mirrors, Bluetooth mobile phone, HID headlamps with adaptive front-lighting system and auto-leveling system, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, front and rear corner sensors, and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include dual front & side airbags, whiplash injury lessening concept seats, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, Vehicle Stability Control, traction control, and a tyre pressure warning system.

The Suzuki Kizashi tries to make an entry into the highly-competitive midsize segment, by being slightly smaller than the competition. There is only one engine choice, a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive. Only the Sport grade is offered in most GCC countries, thereby coming with a sporty front bumper and rear spoiler as default on all cars. Largely unchanged for 2014, it got a price reduction in most markets. Standard features on the Kizashi include power windows, power mirrors, power locks, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/USB capability, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start engine, sunroof, leather seats, cruise control, power adjustable driver and passenger seats, fog lamps and parking sensors. ABS and six airbags come as standard in most markets.

The Opel Corsa is the smallest offering from the German manufacturer in the Middle East market. It received a significant update to the exterior in 2015. The base model comes with a 4-cylinder 1.4-litre engine, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. There is a 3-door and 5-door hatchback version to choose from. Standard options include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, manual A/C, AM/FM radio, cloth upholstery and steel wheels. The higher models get a better entertainment system with a CD player and MP3/iPod/AUX support, and alloy wheels. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution.

The last new Japanese Sunny, launched in 2001 and facelifted in 2004, was available with a choice of three engines, all of which are available in 2 different trim levels. The 1.3-litre model comes in basic FE and a better EX trim. The 1.6-litre comes in EX and value-packed SG trims. The 1.8-litre comes in EX and fully-loaded Super Saloon trims. By the end of its lifecycle in 2006, only the 1.6-litre was eventually available. All cars came with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Interior gadgets are limited in this budget sedan. Power windows and mirrors are limited to the EX and Super Saloon models, while the sunroof, keyless entry and automatic a/c are only available on the Super Saloon. The standard stereo is adequate, with decent sound quality, but nothing to rave about. A CD player is available in the top models. Options include a rear spoiler and front passenger airbags, among other add-on accessories.

The 2015 Suzuki Celerio got a facelift, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The Toyota Land Cruiser got a makeover for its 2016 model year. Engine choices are the same with a 4.0-litre "Dual VVT-i" V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a 4.6-litre "Dual VVT-i" V8 with a 6-speed auto, and a 5.7-litre version with an 8-speed automatic. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. In the UAE, there are three trim levels, namely EXR, GXR and VXR. The KSA market has GX, GXR and VXR trims, with further variants within them. Available features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 18-inch alloys on lower models, standard smart keyless entry with start/stop button, standard parking sensors with optional dealer-installed rear camera, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional dealer-installed leather, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, optional rear DVD screens, and Bluetooth among other items. Further available features include bi-xenon headlights with integrated LEDs, a front chin spoiler and extra chrome trim on some GXR and all VXR models, with 20-inch wheels and more on V8 models. Higher models get navigation, crawl control with tight-turn assist, factory leather, adaptive cruise, four-camera view and a multi-terrain selection system. Dual front airbags and ABS are standard, with side-curtain airbags available on all but the most basic models, while knee airbags and stability control with hill-assist are available on V8 models only.

The Expedition is a full-size 4WD that has yet to blaze a trail in the Middle East. It's smooth, stable and refined for the most part, and this new version goes head-to-head with Chevrolet's non-descript Tahoe for top honours among American 4WDs. Its four-wheel-independent suspension is unusually sophisticated in this class, providing better ride and handling, on-road and off. The Expedition comes with a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. Expedition is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Expedition does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button. Able to carry up to eight passengers, the second row features a small center seat that slides forward to give parents in the front seat access to a small child. Options include a rear-seat DVD system and the reverse sensors, among the many standard power features. The longer Expedition EL model has a stretched wheelbase to offer more space.

The Lexus GS is a showcase of the Japanese company's advanced technology. It was released in 2006, it's not only loaded with more gadgetry than ever, but offers a degree of luxury that matches the best from Germany. Lexus openly admits that the BMW 5-Series was their benchmark for the new rear-wheel-drive GS. The appeal of the GS line-up lies with a fully-equipped base model. The GS 300 has most of the available features from the GS 430, except of course for the larger engine. The GS 300 gets a 3.0-litre V6 while the GS 430 gets a 4.3-litre V8, both paired with six-speed automatic with a sequential manual shift mode. Both engines lack the direct injection feature of American-spec versions apparently due to damaging high-sulphur petrol in some GCC countries, so power ratings are lower. The list of standard equipment includes leather-trimmed seats with front power adjustment, keyless entry, pushbutton starter, a premium sound system with both CD and DVD capability, Bluetooth wireless telephone technology, multiple airbags, various stability systems and a 7-inch multi-information touch screen. Options include DVD navigation, rear backup camera, moonroof, power rear sunshade, Mark Levinson audio system and adaptive front lighting.

An all-new Ford Edge made its way to the GCC in 2016, and the range got a facelift for 2019, including rebadging the Sport model as the Edge ST. It comes with two engine options. The two engines are turbocharged "Ecoboost" engines, of which one is the base 2.0-litre and the top ST variant with 2.7-litre. They all get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base models include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC 3 voice-controlled multimedia system, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Optional features include HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and bigger alloy wheel options. The Edge ST gets a mild body kit, black mesh grille, body-colour exterior trim and black wheels. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

The Mercedes-Benz E 55 AMG was the performance version of the E-Class and received a supercharged 5.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. It gets stiffer suspension for better handling. The E55 AMG was the fastest four door car in Mercedes-Benz's lineup at the time.

In 2020, an all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz GLS-Class came out. There are two engine choices, the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 in the GLS 450 and the 4.7-litre turbo V8 motor in the GLS 580. The V8 engine is a mild hybrid to aid acceleration and improve fuel economy. It comes with a ton of standard features, including the MBUX infotainment system, a 12.3-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch configurable digital instrument cluster, wireless device charging, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, navigation, nine USB ports, Bluetooth, 360-camera parking system, and a 13-speaker Burmester surround-sound stereo. Keyless entry, remote start, dual-zone automatic climate control, a sunroof, alloy wheels, and a power liftgate are also standard. Optional equipment include E-Active Body Control which aids off-roading, five-zone climate control, panoramic sunroof, and a suite of advanced safety features, such as lane keep assist, lane change assist, a following distance indicator, and stop-and-go adaptive cruise control. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability and traction control, ABS, EBD, blind spot monitor, forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking.

The Jaguar XF luxury-sports sedan got an all-new model for 2016. Engines include a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 unit with two different tunes. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The new-for-2013 Chevrolet Malibu is a car designed with priority to various other Asian markets, and the car coming to the Middle East is even built in Korea first now. Based on the front-wheel-drive Opel Insignia platform, the new Malibu is taller, wider, and has a shorter wheelbase than the outgoing model, with new engine choices. It is now offered with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.0-litre V6, mated to 6-speed automatics. Aside from common features such as power windows, cloth or leather upholstery, keyless entry and CD/MP3 stereo, available options include HID headlights and a choice of 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, ABS, available stability control with brake assist, and options such as rear-view camera with parking sensors.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. The lengthened four-door wheelbase provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Peugeot 301 is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. While claiming class-leading cabin and boot space, the Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

The all-new Honda Jazz was launched in the GCC for the 2009 model year, larger and more powerful than before. The 'New Jazz' is powered by an upgraded 1.5-litre 4-cylinder i-VTEC engine. In a move to deter true enthusiasts, only a 5-speed automatic gearbox is available for this market. The redesigned Jazz is supposed to be the first car in its class to be equipped with a 5-speed auto gearbox and optional paddle shifters. The speedometer features a large LED display providing of a broad range of information, including current fuel economy and range indications. This would be a first for Honda cars, as even their more expensive models do not have a trip computer yet. An integrated single-CD stereo is fitted on all models, with MP3/WMA capability and speed-dependent volume adjustment. Features include four speakers, two tweeters and a USB adaptor in the centre console storage box. The Jazz is also equipped with the latest version of Honda's 'Magic Seats' in the back that can fold up or fold down in one motion. All models get power-folding mirrors, air-cooled double glovebox, keyless entry, alarm, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, and front power windows. The EX adds rear power windows, paddle shifters, faux-leather steering wheel with audio controls, 16-inch alloy wheels and cruise control. A panoramic sunroof is standard on the top EXL version. The Jazz also comes in 11 different colours, with a body-kit option as well. All Jazz models are equipped with ABS and Electronic brake-force distribution as standard. Dual front airbags are standard, while only the EXL gets side airbags.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily facelifted and revised for 2007, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features. Also new to the range is the Navigator L, an extended version which has a longer wheelbase and additional cargo space.

The new Jeep Cherokee will offer both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, with a choice between a 2.4-litre "Tigershark" 4-cylinder and a new 3.2-litre "Pentastar" V6. A new 9-speed automatic transmission is standard on all models. It features four-wheel-independent suspension. There will be four different versions Sport, Longitude, Limited and Trailhawk. The last one is the most offroad-capable version and has Jeep's "Trail Rated" badges, and comes with a Selec-Terrain system, 1-inch lift and a locking rear differential. Other available features include a park-assist system that gives you directions on how to park into a particular space, an 8.4-inch touchscreen with optional navigation and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with auto-braking, and more.

The new-for-2011 Mazda 2 is a facelifted version of the Mazda2 that has been on sale in Europe since 2008. Offered for the first time in the GCC, it comes in sedan and hatchback versions, and competitively priced when compared to its platform-mate, the Ford Fiesta. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloys are optional. The interior can be had in either black or two-tone, with ten exterior colours available. The glove-box lid is a unique two-compartment design, with one compartment exposed on top to keep files and papers in. The seats are cloth-upholstered, and every other piece of cabin trim is hard plastic, with no padded armrests. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The Mazda2 is highly rated in European crash tests, but those safety ratings are based on Euro-spec models with side airbags, not available here.

An all-new Jeep Compass came out in 2018. The compact 5-seater crossover features four-wheel-independent suspension, disc brakes and all-wheel-drive. The standard engine is a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission for the 4x2 models and a 9-speed automatic transmission for the 4x4 variants , but no standard low-range gearing. Standard features do include electric mirrors, power windows, keyless entry, leather-wrapped steering wheel, fog lamps, roof rails, removable LED flashlight, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with wheel buttons, cloth seats, rear 60/40 reclining and folding seat-back, front-passenger fold-flat seat, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models include a UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, cruise control, leather seats, 18-inch alloys, power driver's seat, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, automatic a/c and nicer floor mats. All models feature front, side and curtain airbags as well as ABS and stability control.

The Subaru Impreza got a complete redesign for 2012, and is only offered in sedan form in the GCC. Interestingly, the WRX versions have spun off into a separate model line and continue unchanged from their pre-2012 forms, at least until 2014. The Impreza is now offered with either a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine, both mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. Standard features in the 1.6i model include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, power windows and mirrors, multi-function display, automatic a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, 60/40 folding rear seats and cloth upholstery. The 2.0i model adds the larger engine, 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, fog lamps, faux paddle-shifters and a rear-seat centre armrest with cup-holders. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, along with the all-weather traction of asymmetrical all-wheel-drive.

The Subaru Legacy is in its sixth-generation, and has received a facelift for 2018, along with minor updates such as better sound insulation. The Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and got an entirely new design back in 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. The 2018 Subaru Legacy is also available with a 3.6-litre flat 6-cylinder engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Toyota Prius was the world's first mass-produced hybrid vehicle when initially launched in 1997. The 2019 Prius retains the 2,700mm wheelbase of the previous Prius, but is 60mm longer overall at 4,540mm, 15mm wider at 1,760mm and 20mm lower. That's about the size of a Corolla. The Prius retains its 1.8-litre VVT-i Atkinson-cycle petrol engine. Features include a heads-up display, wireless charging, 7 airbags, blind-spot monitor and rear cross-traffic alert, ESP and regenerative braking.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Cruze got a minor facelift for 2016 and carries on largely unchanged. The front-wheel-drive compact features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a rare 5-speed manual or a common 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. The Chevrolet 'My Link' infotainment system is also available in higher models, which includes a 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth and USB port. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

The Lincoln Corsair is the premium brand's compact SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Available features include LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, 12.3-inch configurable driver's display, SYNC 3 multimedia touchscreen, optional Revel Ultima audio system, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

The Hyundai Genesis sedan got a minor facelift for 2012, the most obvious change being the LED running lights in the headlights. For 2013, the Hyundai Genesis added the direct injection 3.8-litre "GDI" V6 engine in their line-up, adding to the regular 3.8-litre "MPI" V6 option. The engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. A limited-to-1200-worldwide Genesis Prada model was also made available, with a 4.6-litre "MPI" V8 and unique leather upholstery. The interior gets a new 8-inch display with a user-interface, integrated with a joystick-type function. The Genesis sedan offers a host of upscale luxury features including Smart Cruise Control, adaptive HID headlights, air suspension and a Lexicon CD audio system with iPod input and 17 speakers. Further features include a power rear sunshade, automatic electronic parking brake, proximity key and push button starter, leather upholstery, eight parking sensors with optional reverse camera, soft-touch instrument panel with woodgrain accents, Bluetooth hands-free mobile phone interface, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, and a choice of 17-inch and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety aspects include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as active head restraints, stability control and big ABS-assisted disc brakes. The Genesis is a full-size luxury sedan competing in price with small and medium-sized models from established luxury marques, but Hyundai not having its own premium brand may be a downer for upscale buyers.

The 5-door Peugeot 208 is the French manufacturer's smallest car on offer as it replaced the 207. The base Active model comes with traction control, ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, key-less entry, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player as standard. The Allure model comes with: 16-inch 'Black Diamond' alloy wheels, tinted rear windows, a 6 speaker sound system, a USB/deported Jack plug, Bluetooth and remote controls on the steering wheel all as standard. Optional equipment is also on offer: the panoramic glass roof with manual curtain, speed limiter and cruise control, dynamic leather seats, LED lighting package with mood lighting, LED ceiling lights and halogen elliptical module headlights.

The  new-for-2007 Nitro is somewhere between a compact and a midsize in terms of size, but is actually based on the Jeep Cherokee, but without low-range gearing. It is a useful wagon  with room for five passengers, innovative cargo features, and hit-and-miss styling. Typically American in its outlook, the Austrian-built Nitro comes across as a vehicle with attitude, though for this region, it is powered by either a 3.7-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic for the base model or, new for 2008, a 4.0-litre V6 with a 5-speed for the R/T. The Nitro's unique fold-flat first-row passenger seat and usual fold-flat second-row seats offer a variety of loading options. Also new is the "Load N Go" cargo floor, which slides half-a-metre rearwards for easy loading and unloading, holding up to 181 kg when pulled out. With full power features, 16-inch steel wheels, keyless entry, a CD entertainment system, and a long list of standard safety and security features that include airbags, ABS brakes and more, the Dodge Nitro offers value for money in the confusing yet competitive compact-to-midsize 4WD segment.

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports convertible with a supercharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. The soft-top is standard on the Elise, with the option of a hard-top as well. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The Ferrari LaFerrari is a limited series special, where all 499 units will be built. It is also the first Ferrari to introduce hybrid technology into their cars. An electronic motor combines with a naturally aspirated 6.3-litre V12 engine to achieve the highest horsepower numbers, but with the lowest fuel economy among any Ferrari model at the time. Power is delivered via the 7-speed automanual dual-clutch gearbox. The interior is custom-made to the buyer's liking and will of-course include all the usual safety nannies.

The Tesla Model X is a fully electric midsize crossover SUV, which combines high performance and zero emission. The available variants are 75D, 90D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. All variants come in all-wheel-drive configuration, and with seating for up to seven if optioned up with two booster seats in the boot. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, falcon-wing rear doors, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate, 19-inch alloy wheels, and air suspension. Optional equipment include enhanced autopilot, complete self-driving capability, auto-opening front doors, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system, up to 22-inch alloy wheels, and a towing package including a steel tow bar and a 2-inch hitch receiver. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features include traffic-aware cruise control, auto steer and auto park.

The Peugeot 508 midsize sedan got a facelift for the 2015 model year. It gets a new front grille, bonnet, rear bumper and tail-lights. The only engine on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan is a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. The base model features 16-inch alloy wheels, LED running lights, auto a/c, power windows, electric folding mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, cruise control with speed limiter, fog lamps, and a cooled glove box. The mid-range model adds 17-inch alloys, power seats, dual-zone a/c, one-touch power windows, AUX port for the stereo, auto-dimming mirror and rear parking sensors. The top "Allure" model gets 18-inch alloys, four-zone a/c, turning HID headlights, navigation, 8-speaker JBL stereo, sunroof, smart keyless entry with starter button, electric parking brake with hill assist, side and rear sun-blinds, heads-up display, leather and front-rear parking sensors with distance display. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. All markets do not get all trim levels.

The Maserati Ghibli was revived by Fiat as a 2014 model and is intended to compete in the luxury midsize segment which is dominated by the Germans. The rear-wheel drive Ghibli gets two 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engines in different states of tune. Both versions get an 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2015, the Ghibli S was also available with all-wheel-drive. In 2019, a Gran Lusso trim was introduced with a body kit, sports seats and steering wheel, and full-LED adaptive Matrix headlights. Standard options include power windows, electric mirrors, power steering, cruise control, leather seats, infotainment screen with navigation, parking sensors, reverse camera and 19-inch alloy rims. The higher models get a better audio entertainment system, 20-inch alloys and all sorts of cabin trim choices. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. Based on a Nissan platform, the Koleos uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed manual or CVT automatic gearbox. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive, while optional is a basic all-wheel-drive system with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The Accord is of one the best midsize sedans available. It does everything well and is popular for doing so. It may not be best in class for every little thing, but it is more of an all-round package than its competitors. There are two engines, the standard 2.4-litre four-cylinder with a manual or automatic, and the optional 3.0-litre V6 with an automatic only. The popular sedans are great everyday cars with comfort and convenience features. Available optional features include cruise control, power locks, keyless entry, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD), in-dash six-CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, leather upholstery, a power glass sunroof, side mirrors with integrated turn signals, and VSA stability control. Safety is enhanced on all Accords by available side-impact and curtain airbags, in addition to the required dual front airbags. Anti-lock brakes (ABS) with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD) come standard. All V6 models come with Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) and Brake Assist with traction control.

Launched back in 2001, redone mechanically in 2004, and facelifted in 2007, the S60 is tuned to be a sports sedan, but though it is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis in all but the R model, it looks like a sleek sports coupe from afar. The interior is fairly spacious even with the swooping roofline, and it offers more of a midsize package than a compact one, even though it is occassionally pitted against smaller German rivals in comparisons. For the Middle East market, there are five powerplants. These include a basic 2.0-litre turbo and a 2.5-litre turbo for the run-of-the-mill S60 sedan models, a 2.4-litre turbo for the sporty front-wheel-drive T5 and a highly-tuned 2.5-litre turbo for the all-wheel-drive S60 R. All engines are five-cylinder, and have an automatic with tiptronic, although some can be had with a manual too. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection.

From 2014, the Infinti FX model became the QX70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. It has remained the same for the 2017 model year. The QX70 will be available in two variants and two different engines. The basic model gets a 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the QX70 S variant gets the 5.0-litre V8, with both engines mated to 7-speed automatic transmissions. Built on the all-wheel-drive front-midship platform, the the QX70 features an extensive list of available equipment. Available features include Continuous Damping Control, Rear Active Steer, and 21-inch lightweight aluminium-alloy wheels designed by Enkei. Inside, the interior has available "sport" seating and advanced audio, optional navigation and technology ranging from an 11-speaker Bose-developed audio system to the intelligent key, available active cruise control and available around-view monitor system. The QX70 offers numerous safety and convenience technologies such as intelligent brake assist, distance control assist, adaptive front lighting system, standard HID headlights, integrated fog lights, rear LED taillights, functional side air vents, aluminium roof rails, leather and wood trim, sunroof, "self-healing" clearcoat paint finish, stability control, and the usual power accessories and multiple airbags. Available safety features include object-detection for the around-view parking camera system as well as voice instructions on how to parallel-park into a specific space.

The first ever Opel-badged compact 4WD isn't even a real Opel. The Antara is a Korean product built at the Daewoo factory, and also sold in the GCC as a GMC Terrain. However, it does complete the dying Opel range, giving dealers their very own small soft-roader. Unlike the Terrain, the Antara is available with only one engine, namely a 3.2-litre V6 with a standard 5-speed automatic transmission offering basic manual-shift capability. All-wheel-drive is standard, but there is no low-range gearing. The Antara seats five and does not offer third-row seating. However, the rear seat folds flat to extend the cargo area. Active and passive safety systems include stability control, hill descent control and active rollover protection, as well as dual-stage front and side-impact airbags, as well as head-curtain airbags. Th high-quality interior offers numerous soft-touch surfaces and available two-tone leather upholstery. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD player, keyless entry, alloy wheels and more.

The BMW X5 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X5 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year, to replace the CL-Class. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class Coupe features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S500 Coupe comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine.. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class Coupe gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

Citroen is such a low-volume player in the Middle East that most people here think the brand is not available here any more. The C2 is the replacement for the Saxo at the lower end of the Citroen range. Based on the same platform as the larger C3, the C2 is only available as a three-door model, while the C3 is the five-door version. The C2 has distinctive styling. It offers a lot of interior room in the front and a decent driving position, as well as rear seats which optionally fold, recline, slide and come out altogether. Its dashboard is shared with the C3 with trim of decent enough material. There are coloured plastic inserts on the door trim and gearknob to dress up the cabin. The driving position is good, with good visibility to the front and somewhat limited to the rear thanks to a small rear window. The C2 only with one engine in this region. The 1.6-litre four-cylinder isn't very powerful, but it is quite a revelation given the size of the car. It is mated to a 5-speed automatic SensoDrive transmission. It has four airbags as standard, but ABS brakes, with electronic brakeforce distribution and brake assist, are only an option.

Changan Alsvin is the Chinese brand compact sedan offering. In 2020, it got a facelift along with an engine and gearbox update. Under the hood it gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features of the Alsvin include power windows, power steering, central locking, keyless entry, front fog lamps, radio with CD/AUX/USB, 4 speakers, manual A/C, fabric seats, halogen headlamps and 15-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, engine push start, 6-speakers, sunroof and parking sensors. Safety features include front airbags, hill-start assist, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control (TCS) and stability control (ESC).

The Navara is a stylish work truck, and essentially a pickup version of the Pathfinder. Like the Pathfinder, it offers good hauling capability and marginal on-road handling. It offers decent interior space and more convenience features than most competitors. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with a five-speed automatic and 2WD, or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine with a six-speed manual transmission and 4WD. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloywheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,4-speaker audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signallamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensingwipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment. It is apparently only available in double cab five-seater body style with a long rear load bay.

The Volkswagen Jetta received a facelift for 2015. There are two engines on offer, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder motor, both mated to a manually-shiftable 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel-drive. There are three trim levels, named S for the 2.0, and SE and SEL for the 2.5. The base S model comes with keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3/AUX stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. The SE additionally comes with 8-speakers, 6.5-inch colour touch screen, leather seats, 17-inch alloy wheels, automatic a/c, steering-wheel buttons, cruise control, fog lamps, sunroof, alarm system, rear camera and parking sensors. The top SEL comes with ESP, hill-hold control, xenon headlamps, rear LED lights, front fog lights with cornering lights. All VW Jetta models come with ABS, six airbags and auto hazard lights as standard.

The TrailBlazer is powerful and capable midsize off-road vehicle, which is just the right size to not be a pain on the roads. Launched in 2002, it received a minor facelift in 2006. It has a rigid chassis, good off-road suspension, powerful brakes and a spacious enough interior to compete in this class. It is stable at high speeds, wobbly around curves, and comfortable over rough surfaces, while being quite capable off-road, thanks to a proper four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The TrailBlazer also comes in an EXT trim with an extended wheelbase that adds a third row seat. The early TrailBlazer comes with a Vortec 4.2-litre inline 6-cylinder engine that generates very respectable numbers, similar to the V8 motors of some competitors. And then there is 5.3-litre V8 engine that can be had as an option only on the EXT. The V8 is equipped with GM's Displacement on Demand technology as standard which deactivates four cylinders under certain driving conditions to aid fuel efficiency, returning the full complement of power once the controller senses vehicle speed or load requires additional power. Both engines use a Hydra-Matic 4-speed auto transmission.

The 2015 Dodge Charger SRT received a significant facelift. Two SRT models are available. The first gets a naturally-aspirated 6.4-litre V8 engine, while the second one is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 motor. They all get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Charger SRT Hellcat receives a larger, power-bulge aluminium hood, which features a dedicated air intake. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Mercedes-AMG GT 4-door Coupe came to existence in 2020. Under the hood, the GT 43 and GT 53 gets a 3.0-litre turbo V6 with 2 different tunes and the GT 63 S gets a V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine . Power is delivered in all variants through a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights and 19-inch alloy wheels. The GT 4-door also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT 4-door with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control. More advanced safety features include front collision alert, auto braking, lane departure warning alert, blind spot monitor, pedestrian alert, evasive steering assist, and parking assist.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Brilliance FRV is a sub-compact hatchback offering around since 2009, but only made its debut in the UAE in 2013. It comes with 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the FRV include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, radio with single CD player and MP3/USB support, and steel wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Murcielago, named after a famous matador, is the truest of the current Lamborghinis, with traditional scissor doors and a massive 6.2-litre V12 engine sitting between the front and rear wheels. It was also the first Lambo to be developed under new parent Audi, and is available in a hard-top coupe and a soft-top Roadster trim. Introduced in 2002, the Roadster came in 2004, while production ended by 2006, to be replaced by the Murcielago LP640 coupe model with a larger 6.5-litre V12. Power is fed to the all-wheel-drive system through a standard six-speed manual or an optional E-gear sequential manual transmission on all versions. High-tech features include active spoilers and air intakes that adjust according to speed, while the suspension can be adjusted for ride height to clear bumpy roads. The Murcielago Roadster has a cut-down windscreen so overall height is 70 mm lower than the coupe. Standard features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, massive four-wheel disc brakes, power windows, air suspension and 18-inch alloy rims, while the Roadster has built-in rollover hoops. The rear air intakes and spoiler are adjusted automatically, depending on speed, to improve aerodynamics. Unlike older Lamborghinis, these cars are known to be a bit more forgiving for casual cruising.

The new-for-2011 Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

Volvo continues to move up the premium-luxury ladder with the new-for-2018 Volvo XC60, featuring an updated corporate look and a stunning interior. Engines for the GCC include a 2.0-litre turbo in the T5 and a 2.0-litre twin-charged 4-cylinder in the T6 model. All-wheel-drive and an 8-speed automatic gearbox are standard. Various cabin trim options are available, including burled aluminium and driftwood. The new CleanZone four-zone climate system removes harmful pollutants and particles from outside the cabin to deliver “Scandinavian-fresh” air on the inside. Volvo's driver infotainment touchscreen offers smartphone integration with CarPlay and Android Auto where available. The 5-seater XC60 expectedly offers loads of safety technology. Steer Assist has been added to the ground-breaking City Safety system. A new safety system called Oncoming Lane Mitigation uses steer assist to help mitigate head-on collisions, while Volvo’s Blind Spot Indication System (BLIS) now uses Steer Assist functionality to reduce the risk of lane-changing collisions. Pilot Assist, Volvo’s advanced semi-autonomous driver assistance system, which takes care of steering, acceleration and braking on well-marked roads up to 130 kph, is available as an option.

Spyker is largely an unknown name to the general public, but this Dutch name was apparently around as far back as 1898. The company was resurrected in 2000 with the C8 Spyder, a unique and expensive hand-built supercar with an open-top roof. The Spyker C8 Laviolette coupe soon joined the Spyder. In 2002, the street version of their LeMans racer was unveiled as the C8 Double12 S coupe, with an extended rear end. The C8 was finally launched in this region in 2007. The Spyker C8 range has a 4.2-litre Audi V8, manual or automatic six-speed gearbox, limited slip differential and ABS brakes. Optional features for all cars include a turned-aluminium dashboard fascia, 19-inch Aeroblade magnesium wheels, several leather options, Chronoswiss dashboard instruments, supercharger or even a custom-fitted Louis Vuitton luggage set. The body is built in Germany and the car is assembled in Holland.

The Audi S3 sedan made its debut in 2015 and is the performance version of the A3. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The 6-speed manual gearbox version is available in some GCC markets on special order. All-wheel drive is standard in the S3. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, sports seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and alloy wheels. Safety standards are high as in all Audi models with features which include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. A 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine comes standard while a 3.0-litre V6 is optional. The 2.3-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the 3.0-litre only gets an automatic. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 15-inch steel wheels and AM/FM/6CD stereo. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. Available safety features include front-and-side airbags along with ABS. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The BMW X6 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X6 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Nissan Sentra carries on with no major changes since its introduction in 2013. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. The 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in only CVT. Both engines are not available in all GCC countries. The 1.6S and 1.8S gets power steering, power mirrors, power windows, halogen headlamps, rear LED lamps, keyless entry, manual seats, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/RDS support and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. The 1.6SV gets LED accent headlamps, intelligent key with engine push-start button, wood trim and 4 speakers. The 1.6 SV Sports gets fog lamps, leather steering, rear spoiler, 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors and indicators on side-view mirror.  Both 1.6 SV and 1.8 SV sports have the option of USB/iPod connectivity, bluetooth, navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. The 1.8 SV gets the same as S but with rear parking sensors and bluetooth. The 1.8 SL gets the same options as 1.6 SV Sports plus rear spoiler with brake lamp, 6 speakers and USB/iPod connectivity. The 1.8 SL Premium gets more features such as leather seats, sunroof, cruise control, dual-zone climate control A/C. The 1.8 SL and SL Premium have the option of adding navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. Safety features include electronic brake-force distribution (EBD), ABS and Brake Assist (BA), along with driver and passenger front airbags. Only the 1.8 SL Premium gets side and curtain airbags.

An all-new Ford Explorer came out in 2020. The new chassis has gone back to becoming a proper SUV instead of a crossover, so off-road ability has improved. Under the hood, the standard engine gets a 2.3-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. Then there is a hybrid model which gets a 3.3-litre V6 engine combined with an electric motor. The top model is the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. All engines are mated to an 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, tri-zone A/C, LED auto headlamps, 8-inch infotainment system, 6 speakers Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, cloth seats, 8-way adjustable power driver's seat, power liftgate reverse camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, hand's free liftgate, 20 and 21-inch wheels, digital instrument cluster, and better audio system. Standard safety features include 7 airbags, ABS, brake assist, pedestrian detection, blind spot monitor, forward-collision warning and post-collision braking. Higher models get lane centering and evasive steering assist.

For 2014, the Lexus GS is the same, except that the GS 350 received a new transmission. The Lexus GS is all-new from the 2012 model year, gaining a new entry-level trim but losing the V8 at the top end. The models include the GS 250 and the GS 350, with the GS 450h hybrid joining the range later. The GS 250 comes with a 2.5-litre direct-injection V6 and a 6-speed automatic with paddles. The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 8-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its Lexus trademark 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The GS 250 can be had in various trims. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 250, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. It has remained the same for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, the GLC Coupe 250 gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

In 2011, the Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG got a new turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 engine. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. It also includes a reversing camera, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels.

The American-built Avalon now shares its front-wheel-drive platform as well as several mechanical bits with the Lexus ES, including the engine. The 3.5-litre V6 is mated with a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic functionality. In the UAE, the base Avalon S model comes with 17-inch alloys, smart key, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, 6.1-inch touchscreen, auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror with compass, power front seats, cruise control, leatherette seats, halogen auto headlights with fog lamps, 10 airbags, ABS, stability control and dealer-installed front-rear parking sensors. The Avalon SE model adds a 7-inch touchscreen, HDD navigation, rear camera and an 11-speaker stereo with voice-control. The Avalon SE Plus model further adds further-adjustable power front seats with ventilation, premium leather, remote starter, paddle shifters, mirror puddle-lamps, HID headlights, and a power rear sun-shade.  The Avalon Grande additionally comes with adaptive cruise control and a pre-crash safety system. For KSA, the Avalon XLE base model is similar to the S trim above, lacking fog lamps and parking sensors, but gaining a WiFi feature. The Avalon Limited in KSA corresponds to the SE Plus trim above, but without nav or rear camera, which are optional.

Lexus revealed an all-new entry model in their SUV line-up in 2019, the UX. Only the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in the GCC, mated to a CVT. The front-wheel drive UX gets standard features such as power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, leather seats, dual-zone A/C, Bluetooth, USB, 6 speakers, LED headlamps and taillamps, and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher "F-Sport" trims get a more aggressive body kit, 10.2-inch screen with navigation, 18-inch alloys, 8 speakers and adaptive suspension. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, vehicle stability control (VSC), ABS, brake assist system, back guide monitor system, and tyre pressure monitoring system.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 is immensely powerful, and features cylinder deactivation technology, seamlessly turning off the fuel consumption in four cylinders of the 5.7-liter HEMI engine when V8 power is not needed, improving fuel economy by up to 20 percent, though one would be hardpressed to notice a difference. The ride is smooth, but corners should be handled with care.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. In 2020, the GLC got a slight facelift and more power. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

An all new Porsche Cayenne came out for 2018. The variants initially available were the Cayenne, Cayenne S and Cayenne Turbo. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. The Cayenne S gets a new 2.9-litre turbo V6. The Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine.
