Porsche updated the interior of the 2018 Cayenne by doing away with many buttons and by replacing them with a 12.3-inch touchscreen and a few touch-capacitive controls. The interior retains the analog tachometer which now comes with two 7-inch color displays on either sides that read out driver information. The new Cayenne comes with a list of goodies that are offered in other Porsche products. Rear wheel steering, a Porsche Active Suspension Management system for “finer degree of specific calibration” of the air suspension, a new Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control that uses a 48-volt electrical system and a new semi-autonomous driving tech called Innodrive are a few of them. Features available on the Cayenne optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch and higher quality audio systems. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. It got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The engine range includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. In 2018 it got a slight facelift and updated interior, and the M235i changed to M240i with more power. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i, 230i and the M240i. The 220i and 230i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M240i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M240i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The bestselling E-Class is back with a bloated new look for the 2010 model year, likely to differentiate itself further from the sleek CLS 4-door "coupe" model. While the new styling is a massive failure, the sedan itself has improved under the skin. But the engines are still carried over from the previous generation, with the 3.0-litre E 300, the 3.5-litre E 350 and the 5.5-litre E 500. The base E 200 CGI and E 250 CGI models appeared later, both with 1.8-litre engines, each with a different tune. Externally, they all look the same. The standard models get 16-inch and 17-inch wheels. The new-for-2010 E-Class Coupe debuted in the summer of 2009, featuring much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door format. However, the Coupe is only available in E 350 and E 500 form, with an E 250 CGI base model debuting later. An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard sedan and coupe models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The new-for-2008 i10 is an overlapping replacement for the anonymous Atos Prime supermini, boasting sleeker styling but retaining its predecessor's geekiness. Built in India to avoid increasing Korean labour costs, the i10 is only available with a 1.1-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a manual or automatic gearbox. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The Audi S8 is the sports version of the carmaker's flagship A8 model. In 2016 it got a new S8 Plus trim. Under the hood, the S8 comes with a powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It also gets cylinder deactivation so it can run on only 4 cylinders for better fuel economy. Features include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon headlamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, rear-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and sunroof. Safety standards are high, with electronic stability control, various collision prevention systems and numerous airbags. Different equipment packages are available as well for further customisation.

The Lexus NX 200t is the Japanese brand's first entry in the compact crossover field. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. All models come with 18-inch alloys, LED headlights, synthetic or real leather, power front seats, premium multimedia system with navigation, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, power tilt/telescoping steering wheel with buttons, Bluetooth, USB and more. The higher-spec models gain adaptive cruise, Mark Levinson stereo, wood trim, illuminated scuff plates, ventilated seats, remote starter, power-folding rear seats, wireless phone charger, power tailgate, panoramic parking cameras, heads-up display, adaptive suspension and more. The F-Sport models additionally get a mesh grille for the different front bumper, firmer suspension tuning and different wheel designs, optionally with wider tyres. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags as well as stability control and ABS with brake assist, with options including a pre-crash safety system, lane-change assist with blind-spot monitoring and cross-traffic alert, and lane-keeping assist with lane-departure alert and steering assist.

The all-new Kia Stinger came out as a 2018 model year and is the Korean brand's grand tourer model on offer. Under the hood, the 2022 Kia Stinger gets two engine choices - the standard engine is a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and the higher option is the 3.3-litre turbocharged V6 unit. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The 2022 Kia Stinger comes as rear-wheel drive standard and optional all-wheel-drive. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, remote locking, central locking, leather seats, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include real leather upholstery, 8-inch screen with navigation, 19-inch alloy wheels, heads up display, ventilated front seats and remote start. Safety features in the 2022 Kia Stinger include front, side and knee airbags, ABS, ESP, traction control and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monition, front collision warning, parking distance warning front and back and rear cross-traffic alert.

The Fiat Fiorino is a compact commercial vehicle offering by the Italian brand. The Turkish-built Fiorino comes with a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual. Standard features include power steering, sliding side door, foldable passenger seat, adjustable driver's seat, heat reflecting windows, radio with CD/MP3 player, and ABS. It has 2.8 cubic-metre volume of cargo space with a 600 kg payload capacity.

The Accord is of one the best midsize sedans available. It may not be best in class for every little thing, but its all-rounder package makes it popular among consumers. The Accord was enlarged and redesigned for the 2008 model year, offered with either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. Only the basic 2.4-litre sedan will get a five-speed manual, while all the other trims get a five-speed automatic only. Standard features on all models include power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows, cruise control, CD/MP3 player with steering wheel controls, dual front airbags, ABS brakes, head restraint system and keyless entry. Optional features available in higher models include 17-inch alloys, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, sunroof, CD changer, leather, power driver's seat, fake wood trim and fog lamps.

The Infiniti Q70 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

An all-new GMC Acadia came in 2017. In 2020 it got a significant facelift and tech upgrades. The crossover offers three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. The Acadia gets a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and an optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry, tri-zone climate control and more. Optional features include rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19 or 20-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The Chinese Tiggo beautifully illustrates the Koreans' fight for dominance in the small-4WD segment over the Japanese. The Tiggo has a bit of the Kia Sorento front end slapped onto the body of a previous-generation Toyota RAV-4. It kind of reminds us of a fake Rolex watch that has a Swatch lookalike face--a bit of the best and a bit of the average, but still ultimately neither. The five-door five-seater Tiggo does benefit from a versatile interior though, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Powered by a 2.4-litre Mitsubishi-sourced 4-cylinder engine, it comes with either a four-speed auto with two-wheel-drive, or a five-speed manual gearbox with all-wheel-drive. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling. Don't put too much faith in the incredibly low manufacturer-quoted fuel consumption numbers though.

The range-topping M6 arrived for 2006, in coupe and convertible form, using the same V10 engine as the M5. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a 7-speed SMG automanual in the M6. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo came out in 2018. In 2021, it got a facelift. Under the hood, it got a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine as standard, while the higher models got a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. Both engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 6-Series Gran Turismo comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Octavia is based on the Volkswagen Golf platform, and has received a facelift for 2009. The range of engines and options has seemingly been paired down for the GCC, considering its low sales volumes. The base engine on offer is the outdated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed auto, while a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder with a 7-speed automanual was offered in some GCC countries. By late 2010, only the base engine and a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder were offered. The Octavia is one of the more unique cars in its segment, with the look of a proper sedan, but with a lift-up rear hatch for loading luggage. It was initially available in most markets here in basic Classic and upmarket Ambiente trims. The Classic version offers steel wheels with hubcaps, manually operated rear windows, halogen headlights and black rubbing strips. Later, most local markets got only Ambiente, Ambiente Plus, Elegance and sporty RS trims. Available features, depending on trim, include power windows with anti-pinch feature, height adjustable steering wheel dual-tone fabric seats, remote central locking, dual-zone climate control a/c, cruise control, a multi-function display, a CD/MP3 stereo with AUX input, electric mirrors with integrated turn signals, Xenon headlights with washer system, 17-inch alloy wheels and colour-coded exterior trim. The RS gets the VW GTI engine, Bluetooth, 18-inch wheels, parking sensors, sunroof, rear spoiler and directional Xenon headlights. Among the available safety features are stability control, ABS, dual front and side airbags and optional rear park sensors.

For 2012, the midsize Cadillac SRX received a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with paddle-shifting functions and all-wheel-drive. Even the base model is generously loaded, with a limited-slip differential, common power accessories, 18-inch wheels, LED tail lamps, chrome roof rails, 8-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, dual-zone a/c with rear vents and controls, cruise control, keyless entry, power-adjustable pedals, power-adjustable front seats and a leatherette interior. The top 'Luxury' version gets variable-effort power steering, continuously-variable real-time dampers, turning HID headlights, parking sensors with rear camera, navigation, 20-inch wheels, 10-speaker Bose stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, 40 GB hard drive, rear DVD screens, full keyless entry with push-button start, ventilated front seats, LED cabin lighting and a panoramic glass roof. For 2013, changes included the introduction of the CUE multimedia entertainment system, along with some minor cabin alterations and an active noise-cancellation system. All models get front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The S80 is the flagship of Volvo range, and though it looks big in size, it is actually more of a large midsize sedan than a true fullsize sedan. The only model available in most GCC markets now is a front-wheel-drive S80 T5 model with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The model underwent an unnoticeable facelift for 2011 which added more chrome to the exterior and some minor design changes to the interior. Features include the wafer-thin centre console that houses the digital climate controls and the Dolby Pro-Logic II surround sound system. The car is filled to the brim with the usual luxury features such as power windows, mirrors and seats, leather trim, 16-inch and 17-inch alloy rims, adaptive cruise control, Bluetooth, sunroof and more. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection, as well as Pedestrian Detection, Collision Warning with Full Auto Brake, Driver Alert Control, Lane Departure Warning and Active Bending Lights.

The DTS is the new name for the Deville. The change is mostly to bring it in line with the company's new policy of naming its car models with letters. The DTS is the only remaining front-wheel-drive car in Cadillac's fleet. It comes in a single line that is stepped up with available options, such as Xenon headlamps, LED taillamps, six standard airbags including a dual-depth front passenger airbag, a factory-installed remote start with personalization feature, and an in-dash, six-CD changer with MP3 player. The DTS comes with a 275 hp Northstar V8 engine that can be optioned up to a version that makes 291 hp. A four-speed Hydra-Matic transmission is the sole choice. Features on the DTS include dual-firmness seats, four-channel anti-lock brakes with traction control, StabiliTrak and brake assist, Magnetic Ride Control, 17-inch wheels, heated and cooled front seats, heated rear seats, heated steering wheel, tri-zone climate control, heated windshield washer nozzles, power folding outside mirrors, and front and rear park assist. In the face of its sportier siblings, the DTS seems stodgy, but it's still powerful, and extremely comfortable. Not being rear-wheel-drive hinders it from being a true luxury contender.

An all-new model of the Peugeot 508 came out in 2019. In 2022, the 508 came with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 6-speed automatic and the top GT model had the same engine with more power and mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the 508 include power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, push engine start, digital instrument cluster, infortainment system with touch screen, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, multifunction steering wheel, and alloy wheels. Higher models get leather seats, ventilated heating and cooling seats and panoramic roof. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. Higher models get blind spot monitor, lane departure warning, lane keeping assist.

The 2015 Suzuki Celerio got a facelift, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The Audi A6 got a redesign for 2011. Three engine variants are offered in the UAE - 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 2.8-litre V6 and 3.0-litre supercharged V6. Only the 2.0 TFSI comes in front-wheel drive and CVT transmission, while the rest enjoy all-wheel drive systems mated to a 7-speed. An S6 model has been introduced as a 2013 model which gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well as 18-inch, 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. In terms of performance, the A6 can match there German rivals BMW and Mercdes-Benz with its engine power and AWD systems, but the 2.0 TFSI disappoints with its FWD system and average power output.

The Volkswagen Beetle, which has been around since 2012 in other countries, made its debut in the GCC as a 2015 model. It remains the same for 2018. It is powered by a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels. In 2016, the Beetle R-Line model was added to lineup.For the exterior, the Beetle R-Line front fascia features bigger air intakes in the bumper, while the rear gets a lower diffuser and large spoiler. It also gets 20-inch "Monterey" alloy wheels to complete the look.Inside, it gets two-tone cloth sport seats, a multi-function leather-wrapped steering wheel with R-Line badging and a set of sport gauges mounted on the top of the centre console, along with R-Line door entry sills. Other standard options on the Beetle R-Line include panoramic sunroof, xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights, touch screen, Bluetooth and USB connection.

The Tahoe has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Tahoe, with better fuel economy to boot. However it still had the ageing Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Tahoe is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The Cadillac CT6 is the American luxury brand's flagship sedan. It takes on the Germans, but it weighs less than a 5-Series and an E-Class. Under the hood, there are three engine choices available. The standard model gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, which is currently not sold in the GCC. Then there is the naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine and the current top trim gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 unit. All motors get a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the rear-wheel drive CT6 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. A washer for the rear camera is new for 2018. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 2.6 entertainment system, 34 BOSE speakers, rear seat infotainment system with 10-inch-diagonal screens that retract into the front seatbacks, quad-zone climate control, bigger alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Volvo V90 is a wagon version of the S90, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. Only the Cross Country model was sold in the GCC. It is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Porsche Macan is a second SUV for the German premium brand and hopes to replicate the success of the Cayenne, albeit in the compact crossover segment. Taking the front fascia from its elder brother, the Macan doesn't disappoint in terms of looks. The rear of the vehicle however, is unique and could be termed as a love-or-hate affair. But the wide tyres which range from 18-inch to 21-inches do complement the somewhat muscular stance of the Macan. But it must be noted that it stands shorter and is marginally longer than its Q5 counterpart. As for the variants, Porsche has three. The first being the Macan S, which is equipped with a 3.0-litre twin-turbo V6 engine. It also features an active all-wheel-drive and a 7-speed double-clutch transmission. The second variant in the lineup is the Macan Turbo which gets a 3.6-litre turbocharged pertrol engine. Porsche claim that it is set to be the most powerful vehicle in the compact SUV segment. The third variant is the Macan Diesel which features a 3.0-litre turbo diesel engine, mated to a 7-speed transmission as well. The Diesel is not available in all GCC markets, unless special-ordered. Height-adjustable air suspension is optional on the S and standard on the Turbo. As with any Porsche, the interior is carefully setup. It follows the generic Porsche cockpit, but there happens to be a new steering wheel which is a welcome change from the one on the Cayenne. The Macan's interior comes in a variety of colours, but there also happens to be a Piano Black interior package with Alcantara inserts for the seats on the S variant. Available features include a multimedia touchscreen, navigation, rear camera, power seats, panoramic glass roof and much more from a long list of options. Safety features include Porsche Stability Management (PSM), as well as airbags for driver and passenger all around the vehicle.

The Q60 Coupe debuted in the GCC in 2017 and is longer, wider and sits lower than the previous generation.  The standard motor is a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit. A 3.0-litre turbocharged engine sits in the higher model. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, leather seats, LED headlights and taillights, automatic headlights, LED daytime running lamps, LED fog lights, twin exhaust pipes, dual-touch screens, Bluetooth, front and rear parking censors with rearview camera, dual-zone adaptive climate control with rear vents, AM/FM audio system with USB/iPod support, Bluetooth and 6 speakers, and 17-inch alloy rims. Optional equipment include sunroof, navigation system, 19-inch alloy rims, sports seats and sports suspension. Standard safety features include tyre pressure monitor, ABS, electronic brake force distribution (EBD), traction control, stability control, hill-start assist and 6 airbags. Optional safety equipment include Active Lane Control, which uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. Another optional safety feature is the Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

An all-new Kia Picanto debuted as a 2018 model year in the GCC. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. It comes with a 4-speed automatic. Features, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Standard safety features include ABS, tire pressure monitor and driver airbag, with only the top model get dual airbags.

The 2015 Suzuki Celerio got a facelift, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

For 2016, the Lexus GS received a facelift and gets a new entry-level model, the 200t which replaces the GS 250. Other models include the GS 350 and the GS 450h hybrid. The GS 200t comes with a  turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 8-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its Lexus trademark 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 200t, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. Engine choices include SL 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and SL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8. Both are mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Volkswagen Scirocco received a minor facelift for the 2015 model year. Engines include a 1.4-litre TSI 4-cylinder with both a supercharger and a turbocharger, as well as a 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. The GCC dealers will be pushing the automatic version locally, with the 'DSG' automanual gearbox, but it can be special-ordered with a 6-speed manual. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

The Brilliance V5 is the Chinese company's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design has similarities to the BMW X1, since BMW produces the X1 in China in partnership with Brilliance. The front-wheel drive V5 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with AUX, manual A/C, rear sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets, keyless start and keyless entry system, pretinted windows, sunroof, driver side glasses box and luggage carrier. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

The new L200 offers versatility combined with a tough new look that makes it seem more like a lifestyle vehicle than a commercial pickup. It obviously is tough enough to be a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The spacious interior places the L200 firmly in the midsize class, unlike the previous compact model. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's new L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. The brakes, the rear axle, the steering gear and the chassis have all been substantially beefed up for the new L200, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Haval H2 is the Chinese SUV brand's smallest offering. It got a slight facelift in 2020. It comes with a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor and traction control.

The Volvo XC40 debuted as a new subcompact crossover model for 2018, slotting in under the XC60. Initially, the only version on offer is the XC40 T5 with a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. The two trim levels at launch are R-Design and Momentum. The interior features Volvo's latest design ideas such as the vertical a/c vents, aside from the portrait-mode touchscreen. The mid-range Momentum model is generously equipped with a 12.3-inch digital instrument display, a 9-inch touchscreen infotainment system, dual-zone climate control, rear parking assist, and leather seats as standard. Stepping up to the R-Design trim will add leather and aluminum trim, twin exhaust tips, and sport suspension. Safety features include a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking, City Safety for pedestrian detection, and the Pilot Assist system for semi-autonomous steering, acceleration, and braking on “well-marked” roads, a feature that will work up to 128 kph.

An all-new Hyundai Genesis sedan debuts in early 2014 as a 2015 model year. It is slightly longer and taller than the previous generation. The Genesis can be had with a choice of either a 3.8-litre V6 or 5.0-litre V8. Both engines are mated to a Hyundai-designed 8-speed automatic transmission. Rear-wheel-drive is standard in both models. An "Intelligent Drive Mode" system offers Normal, Eco, Sport and Snow settings that alter transmission mapping, throttle responsiveness, stability control to suit driving conditions. The Genesis V8 can be optioned with an adaptive damping suspension that promises both sportier roadholding and a cushier ride. It, too, can be controlled by Intelligent Drive Mode.  The Genesis 3.8 is fitted as standard with leather upholstery, 12-way power-adjustable front seats, a navigation system with an 8.0-inch screen, a seven-speaker AM/FM/CD radio stereo with AUX and USB input jacks, auto on/off headlight, LED headlight accents, LED taillights, rain-sensing windshield wipers, automatic climate control, Bluetooth connectivity, cruise control, hands-free trunk opening capability, a 4.3-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display and 18-inch alloy wheels. To those features, the Genesis 5.0 adds or substitutes a Lexicon Discrete Logic 7 surround sound system with 14 speakers, premium leather upholstery, genuine matte wood trim, 16-way power adjustable front seats, HID headlights with auto-leveling, high-beam assist, LED fog lights, a rear-view camera, front and rear parking sensors, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection with rear cross traffic alert and lane change assist, lane departure warning system with lane keep assist, a 7.0-inch instrument cluster TFT LCD display, manual rear side window sunshades, a power rear sunshade, memory functionality for power driver's seat and outside mirrors and steering column, adaptive cruise control and 19-inch alloy wheels. Much of the 5.0's features can be added to the 3.8 in the form of optional extras. All Genesis models come with dual front, front side, rear side and full-length side curtain airbags in addition to a driver's knee airbag and traction and stability control systems. Optional equipment includes an automatic emergency braking system that applies the brakes if it detects an impending collision; a blind spot warning system with a rear cross traffic alert system that warns the driver of approaching traffic in backup situations; a lane departure warning system with lane keep assist setup that warns the driver if the Genesis begins to wander into an adjacent lane and provides slight steering corrections to bring the sedan back on course; and an emergency steering support mode that automatically changes the setting of suspension and electronic stability control in the direction suitable for emergency steering, to help avoid frontal crash situations.

The A4 has been completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, featuring a new and improved platform, shared with the A5 coupe, that moves engine further back in the engine compartment for better handling balance. The new model is bigger than its predecessor in most dimensions, thus improving cabin space to almost midsize levels. Arriving in the GCC during the first quarter of 2008 only in sedan form, available engines include the weak "1.8T" with two versions of the 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder, mated to front-wheel-drive and a CVT automatic, and a "3.2 Quattro" with a 3.2-litre V6 with all-wheel-drive and 6-speed automatic. A couple of "2.0T" models joined the line-up by 2010, with two different 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engines, one with front-wheel-drive and the other with more power and all-wheel-drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a new dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings, with up to 24 combinations available to create individual driving profiles. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Opel Astra GTC is the German brand's hot-hatch offering. It is powered by a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic. Basic options include central locking with remote, power windows, cruise control, daytime running lamps, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, speed sensitive power steering, driver seat manual adjustable, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/Aux in support, alloy wheels, dual zone automatic A/C, leather steering wheel, outside mirror power foldable and flex-ride with continuous damping control. Safety features include driver and passenger front, side and curtain airbags, electronic stability program (ESP) and ABS as standard.

The Audi S8 is the sports version of the carmaker's flagship A8 model. In 2016 it got a new S8 Plus trim. Under the hood, the S8 comes with a powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It also gets cylinder deactivation so it can run on only 4 cylinders for better fuel economy. Features include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon headlamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, rear-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and sunroof. Safety standards are high, with electronic stability control, various collision prevention systems and numerous airbags. Different equipment packages are available as well for further customisation.

The Bentley Bentayga is the British luxury brand's first SUV model. It is powered by a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre W12 engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive system. It gets a variable displacement system, which shuts down half of the engine under defined conditions. Intake and exhaust valves, fuel injection and ignition are all shut down on defined cylinders, with the engine running as a 6-cylinder for improved efficiency. Other notable features include LED headlights, a front skid-plate, front fender vents, aluminium roof-rails, panoramic glass roof and 20 to 22-inch alloy wheels. The interior is, as expected, nothing short of luxury, with its premium leather upholstery, metallic accents, an infotainment system with an 8-inch display and 22-way adjustable front seats with heating, ventilation and massage functions. Bentley is also offering a 4-seat variant with each seat having its own set of power controls and massage functions. The seats are divided by a small centre-console which consists of cup holders, storage compartments and USB charging ports. Other optional equipment include a high-end premium audio system and entertainment Android tablets with 4G, WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity, and even a self-winding Breitling dash-clock option that costs as much as the base price.

Combining extreme power and a chop-top body, the all-new Dodge Charger delivers an experience like no other, except maybe for its sibling, the Chrysler 300C. Available with a 3.5-litre "High-Output" V6 engine or the infamous 5.7-litre HEMI V8 engine, but the SRT-8 6.1-litre HEMI V8 has been left out of the GCC. The 5.7-litre received a power upgrade for 2009, and features cylinder-deactivation to save fuel by as much as 20%. The Dodge Charger races into the local market with contemporary, provocative styling and substance with all the conveniences of a modern sedan. Either engine is mated to a fully automatic 5-speed transmission with AutoStick. In addition to the Charger's aggressive design, features include all the usual power accessories, CD/MP3 stereo, available Bluetooth, cloth or leather upholstery, optional sunroof and optional DVD entertainment. Some dealers offer an expensive upgrade kit to make the R/T look like a faux SRT-8. Safety features include front and side airbags, standard stability control, ABS and all-speed traction control.

An all-new model of the Audi Q3 came out in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Later in the year, a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine was offered as well. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

With Honda going for premium prices nowadays, the City is about as low as you can go in the Honda range. Introduced for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, it is touted as the perfect `urban` vehicle, with its small exterior and tall interior. There is now a choice of two engines, namely a 1.3-litre four-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a gearless CVT automatic, or a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with a gearless CVT that can imitate a seven-speed gearbox using wheel-mounted buttons. Standard features on the base 1.3-litre model include multi-reflector headlamps, 14-inch steel wheel, air-conditioning with heater, power windows, electric power steering, radio CD player with 2 speakers, cup and card holders, dual airbags and side door beams. Upgrading to the 1.5-litre adds 15-inch alloy wheels, hidden radio antenna, rear 60/40 split seat, rear tip-up seat function, driver seat height adjuster, power locks, electric mirrors, 2 more speakers for the CD stereo, fake wood-finish consoles, keyless entry and ABS brakes.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class sedan. Under the hood, they gets twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The Caterham Seven is the lightweight sports car based on an ancient chassis simple enough to build it yourself if you wanted to. The Seven 270 was new in 2015, with the 1.6-litre Ford-engined ‘R’ pack with 5-speed manual offered in the UAE. The ‘R’ pack is more track-focused and includes a limited-slip differential, sports suspension, a four-point race harness and many other race-orientated upgrades. The Seven 270 is available in the standard narrow-body S3 chassis, although a wide-body and a 6-speed gearbox can be ordered. The Seven 360 model adds a 2.0-litre Ford engine, and is offered in 'R' pack wide-body form in the UAE. The wide-body SV chassis benefits from a wider-track front suspension and a larger fuel tank, with only a 25 kg weight gain over the S3 chassis. Finally, the Seven 420 model adds a higher-tuned 2.0-litre Ford engine. There are no safety features to speak of, aside from a roll hoop and harness belts.

Supposed to be Peugeot's flagship model, the 607 offers premium levels of refinement and equipment. First launched in 2002 and mildly facelifted a few times, the 607 was the first Peugeot sedan to push design boundaries, but lost out in drive due to an unremarkable front-wheel-drive chassis. The 607 was restyled in 2004, and still looks good as ever. Among the exterior cosmetic changes, the front of the 607 was restyled and its overall length increased slightly, but it is still not big enough to qualify as a full-size car. The interior of the 607 is more spacious than any other Peugeot model. The only engine is a 3.0-litre V6 with a six-speed automatic transmission with tiptronic function. Standard features include bi-zone digital air conditioning with climate control, a heat reflective windshield and lightly tinted glass, leather with aluminium detailing, electrically-adjustable front seats, and power windows, locks and mirrors. It is well-equipped in terms of passive safety, with eight airbags as standard, including front-and-rear side and curtain bags.

The 2015 Honda CR-V got a minor facelift and a new powertrain. Built in the United States, it comes in LX, EX and EX-Leather flavours. It is now powered by a direct-injected 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT transmission. The base model is now offered in front-wheel-drive form. The CR-V's optional all-wheel-drive system still drives the front wheels most of the time but can send torque to the rear wheels anytime. The 5-seater cabin comes with a quick 60:40 fold-flat rear bench. The LX gets 17-inch alloys, a 4-speaker CD stereo with USB/AUX port, Bluetooth, rear parking sensors, basic keyless entry, starter button, mirror-mounted indicators, cruise control, ABS, stability control and front-side airbags. Only the EX and EX-L models get 18-inch wheels, a 6-speaker stereo with touchscreen, HID headlights, fog lamps, dual-zone auto a/c, smart keyless entry, sunroof, rear camera, "LaneWatch" blind-spot camera and an 'i-MID' LCD display. The EX-L itself further gets side-curtain airbags, leather and a power driver's seat.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. An all new generation Koleos came out in 2017, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Navigation is a new option for 2014. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee got a second facelift for the 2017 model year. Offered with a choice of the 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or the 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a new 8-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and four trim levels. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. Another trim level introduced for 2014 is the Summit which also comes in only V8 form. The SRT8 version gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. Another feature on all models is the new 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds chrome bumper trim, painted wheel arches, real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The Summit has similar options to the Limited, with the addition of a unique SRT-like front bumper, more premium leather and wood panels for the interior. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Audi Q5 is the compact class offering in the VW-owned German manufacturer's SUV range. In 2018, an all-new model was released. Under the hood, the only engine on offer is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor, mated to an 7-speed automatic transmission. It is available with the all-wheel-drive "Quattro" system, and will be available with the Audi 'Drive-Select' system to change its settings. While exterior does not have a whole lot of changes from its predecessor, the interior has been fully revamped. It also weighs less than the previous generation. Features include LED running lights and taillights, alloy wheels of up to 20 inches in size, seating for five with folding rear bench and a foldable front seat, and the usual power accessories. The Q5 will be available in several different trim options, including an 'S-Line' trim option with aggressive body mouldings and mesh foglight grills. Other available features, whether standard or optional, include a roof load sensor to adjust the stability control for the higher centre of gravity, rearview camera, navigation, high-beam assistant that automatically switches between the high and low beams, blind-spot monitor, adaptive cruise control, triple-zone climate control, intelligent keyless entry, electric parking brake, multiple airbags, MMI multimedia with speech control system, Bluetooth telephone and Apple CarPlay

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. While shorter than the outgoing model by 10mm, the new Swift boasts a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. Features include 4 or 6 speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, automatic a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel with audio controls, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD.

An all-new Hyundai Accent came out for 2019. The new-generation Accent is slightly longer and wider than the previous model, with increased interior space. Two four-cylinder petrol engine options are being offered for the 2022 Hyundai Accent in the region, including a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, with multi-point fuel injection, matched to a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic transmission. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features in the 2019 Hyundai Accent include stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Cadillac ATS-V is the American luxury brand's compact sports sedan offering. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS-V gets a twin-turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. A 6-speed manual is available but will most likely not be offered in the GCC. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, automatic headlamps, automatic dual-zone A/C, Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

JAC J5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, fabric seats, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support, 2 speakers and steel wheels. Optional equipment include a better stereo system with 4 speakers, fog lamps, alloy wheels, leather seats, parking sensors and sunroof. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Nissan GT-R carries on after it got a facelift inside and out for 2017, with more focus on comfort. It is still a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. The GT-R gets the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive. In 2017, it received a facelift and further power was added. To celebrate 50 years since the launch of the first GT-R, Nissan has released a GT-R 50th Anniversary Edition package in 2020. The package offers three “heritage” exterior colour schemes – blue with white stripes, pearl white with red stripes and silver with white stripes. The colours are inspired from the KPGC10-based race cars. The “Bayside Blue” is the first time Nissan is offering the famous blue shade from the R34 Skyline GT-R model on the R35. Under the hood, the GT-R 50th Anniversary gets a power upgrade on the higher Track and Nismo variants. All 2020 GT-R models benefit from new turbochargers which produce less turbolag. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Safey-wise, the car include six airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control, electronic brakeforce distribution and seatbelts with pretensioners.

The long-running Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van has been facelifted for the 2014 model year. It can be classified as one of the largest "light" commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value. Optional safety features include lane-keeping assist, blind-spot assist, collision-prevention assist and high-beam assist.

The Wrangler was redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The interior was redesigned completely in 2011, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were optionally offered. From 2012, the Wrangler is now powered by a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6, with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with low-range gearing and full off-road capability. The lengthened four-door wheelbase provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The Porsche Cayman has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Cayman have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Cayman gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Cayman S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Cayman comes standard with 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Ford Transit Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying cargo. It can seat up to 3 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2020 Ford Transit Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine, available in two different tunes. All models get the 6-speed manual transmission. The van has a payload capacity up to 1,024 kg, a maximum cargo volume of 8.3 cubic metre square and a wide space between the wheel arches allowing for the storage of 1.2-m x 2.4-m boards vertically or horizontally. The load-through bulkhead lets you carry up to 3-meter-long cargo, such as pipes, ladders or carpet rolls. Fixing points and 8 tie-down loops are positioned on the bodysides, leaving the floor clear for easier loading, unloading and cleaning. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2020 Ford Transit Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The M6 Gran Coupe was introduced as a 2014 model year. The four door sedan uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Other mechanical features on the rear-wheel drive M6 Gran Coupe include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option, and a carbon-fibre roof. The M6 Gran Coupe features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's arsenal. Built to compete in the same market segment as the Volkswagen Golf and the Peugeot 307, the 1-Series is the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive. The 1-Series was first offered to the market in 2004 as a 5-door hatchback using its own platform. It replaced the slow-selling 3-Series Compact range and is the most affordable BMW ever. The 1-Series shares many components with the E90 3 Series. These include MacPherson strut suspension in the front, and a trapezoidal-link rear axle. Petrol versions include the 116i, the 118i, the 120i and the 130i, while the unloved diesel versions include the 120d, and many other body styles joined the range after the 2008 facelift, including a three-door hatchback, a two-door coupe and a convertible. The 130i is one of the few hot hatches that offer a six-cylinder engine. The 1-Series is built in Regensburg, Germany, with some of the engines coming from the Hams Hall plant in Birmingham, England. Considering the price, the way it looks, and the number of these we've seen on the streets, we'll guess BMW is having trouble moving these out of showrooms in this region.

The Korean-built Captiva is the General's first proper entry into the softroader market, offering a choice of two powertrains, namely the 2.4-litre four-cylinder with manual or automatic, and the 3.2-litre V6 with automatic. Features include wheels from 16-inch up to 18-inch, turn signals integrated into its exterior mirrors and holes in the front fenders. Protective moldings and front-rear skid plates define its look. Generous interior dimensions offer decent cargo space and seating for as many as seven. Class-leading safety features include an optional rollover protection system, dual front airbags, optional traction control and standard ABS brakes. There is also hill descent control system to go down steep hills, which is an odd addition since the Captiva can be had in front-wheel-drive trim too, in addition to the all-wheel-drive model. Additional features, standard or optional, include an MP3-capable CD stereo with steering wheel controls and MP3 player inputs, parking sensors, sunroof and a trip computer.

The Kia Quoris is a new nameplate for the Korean brand, becoming the flagship of the range by a long shot, in terms of pricing. The full-size sedan comes with a 3.8-litre "MPI" V6 as standard. The rear-wheel-drive platform is fed power via an 8-speed automatic and held up by electronically-adjustable air suspension riding on 18-inch alloy wheels. Available features include a full LCD gauge cluster, electronic gear-shift knob, 17-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, haptic-feedback steering wheel controls, 9.2-inch dual rear screens, heads-up display, power ventilated front seats, surround-view cameras, power rear sunblinds and more. Safety features include nine airbags including a knee airbag, as well as stability control and ABS, while adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights and blind-spot monitoring are also available.

The Peugeot 5008 started life as a minivan, but has been reinvented as a 7-seater crossover SUV for 2018. Basically an extended version of the Peugeot 3008, the 5008 is powered by the same 1.6-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. Standard features in the 2019 Peugeot 5008 include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats and alloy wheels. Further available features on the 2019 Peugeot 5008 include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Android Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features on the 2019 Peugeot 5008 include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist, as well as options such as lane-departure warning, collision alert, hill-descent control and more.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. In 2020, it got a facelift and upgraded tech inside. The Audi A5 sportback is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016, and then another minor facelift in 2019. It is available with "SkyActiv" engines, a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder,direct-injection with high compression ratios. In 2020, a 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine joined the lineup. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. The top model includes 19-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera, bi-xenon headlights, daytime running lights, 11-speaker Bose sound system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents and a sunroof. Navigation and adaptive cruise control can be further added to the top-spec version, but they're not offered in all GCC markets. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

The new GL-Class, built in USA, was intended to be the replacement for the classic Gelaendewagen, but criticism from the general public killed that idea. The GL-Class is now a separate model, supposedly a state-of-the-art luxury 4WD that offers typical Mercedes-Benz luxury with true off-road capability. The GL uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. In addition to the newly developed 5.5-litre V8 in the GL 500, the second model is the GL 450 with a 4.6-litre V8. Both come exclusively with a 7-speed automatic. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GL-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

The RX 350 rides like a car, and very easy to drive, with a luxurious interior. All this makes it popular with the upscale set, rather than its non-existent off-road ability. The RX is based on a unibody car platform rather than a heavy-duty truck frame. Redesigned for the 2004 model year, the RX gained a new 3.5-litre V6 engine for 2007, with very few other changes. The V6 in this all-wheel drive wagon is mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The list of standard luxuries include automatic climate control, premium audio, cruise control, traction and stability control, automatic headlamps, ten-way power for both front seats, a power rear liftgate, parking sensors, Bluetooth phone system and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Cloth upholstery comes standard, as do high-intensity discharge headlamps. Options include leather upholstery, reverse parking camera and a one-touch moonroof. The sports package includes some sort of body add-ons and other nonsense.
