Safety features include dual frontal airbags, front-seat side-impact airbags, side curtain airbags, ABS brakes and a stability system.

The 407 remains the odd-one-out in the overly-competitive midsize car segment, with styling that still looks good today as it did when the model was launched in 2005. For 2009, the 407 has received a minor facelift comprising on exterior trim add-ons, new tail-lights and mild changes in engine output. Now available in four-door sedan and two-door coupe body styles only, the wagon version has been dropped. There are three engine choices available for the sedan. The entry level engine is a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine combined with a 4-speed automatic with a tiptronic function. Then there is a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with the same 4-speed automatic gearbox. The top model is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with a 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 407 comes with 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, depneding on trim level. All models get eight or more airbags, as well as stability control and ABS.

The Chinese Tiggo 5 made its way to the GCC in 2015 and got a minor facelift for 2017, largely in the front bumper and headlights with LED running lights. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, and comes with a 4-speed automatic transmission. The five-door five-seater Tiggo gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so expect decent handling.

BMW's American-built 4x4 has been completely updated for the 2011 model year, and comes in three models in this region, namely the xDrive35i with a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine, and the xDrive50i with a turbocharged 4.4-litre V8. The non-M models now have an 8-speed automatic. The X5 has all-wheel-drive without low-range gearing, but does come with ABS and traction control. The X5 offers optional 7-passenger seating. The list of optional equipment now includes features such as 18-inch to 20-inch alloy wheels, roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M Sport package includes 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, aluminium roof rails, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements.

The third generation Peugeot 308 went on sale in the GCC in 2022. It gets a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, infotainment system with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and alloy wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests, and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The Audi A6 got a redesign for 2011. Three engine variants are offered in the UAE - 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, 2.8-litre V6 and 3.0-litre supercharged V6. Only the 2.0 TFSI comes in front-wheel drive and CVT transmission, while the rest enjoy all-wheel drive systems mated to a 7-speed. An S6 model has been introduced as a 2013 model which gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well as 18-inch, 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. In terms of performance, the A6 can match there German rivals BMW and Mercdes-Benz with its engine power and AWD systems, but the 2.0 TFSI disappoints with its FWD system and average power output.

The American-built Sequoia is Toyota's largest ever passenger vehicle. Its claim to fame is space, with three rows of adult seating and impressive cargo volume. In the GCC, this big SUV will be promoted as a family hauler rather than an offroader, considering the initial availability of a rear-wheel-drive variant. The four-wheel-drive model with low-range gearing came in 2010. By 2013, the 2WD model was dropped in UAE, but carried on in KSA. The second row can either seat two or three, depending on the setup chosen. It is powered by a 5.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. It may be based on the Tundra pickup-truck platform, but it comes standard with four-wheel independent suspension, stability control, CD/MP3 stereo, automatic three-zone a/c, stability control, front airbags, and side-curtain airbags. The only trim levels are SR5 and Limited, dropping the previously top-spec Platinum. Depending on trim level, this 'city SUV' comes with options such two rear-seat DVD screens, 20-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera and parking sensors, CD changer, powered tailgate, power-folding third-row seats, power tailgate, cloth or leather upholstery, navigation, rear air suspension and more. The KSA models are optionally available with in-car wifi as well.

The facelifted-for-2008 R-Class, a so-called Grand Sports Tourer from Mercedes-Benz, is certainly a trendsetter. This unprecedented vehicle concept attempts to mesh the qualities of a sporty saloon, a wagon, a minivan and a 4WD. All we see is a very sleek-looking minivan. Packed under the hood are rather powerful engines, but that hardly makes it a sporting vehicle. Models from 2008 onwards include the new R 280, the carryover R 350 and the upgraded R 500, most available only in long-wheelbase trim here, and then there is the shorter R 63 AMG. Amazingly, it is very hard to tell the difference between long and short models. Originally available only as a luxurious six-seater, the R-Class is now optionally available with five or seven seats too. Sadly, few on the road recognise its eccentricity and price tag, so it gets as much respect in public as a typical cargo hauler. Features include a 7-speed automatic transmission, cruise control with variable speed limiter, automatic climate control and all-wheel-drive. Options include a panoramic sunroof, air suspension and navigation.

The Yaris is Toyota's replacement for the goofy Echo. But the Yaris is a much better basic transportation option than the Echo ever was. The Yaris actually looks somewhat stylish even though it is still a pudgy little car, but it offers perky performance and an interior that looks great, but is devoid of soft-touch materials. The hatchback comes with a very weak 1.3-litre mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto. Standard items include power steering, a tilt-adjustable steering wheel, front and rear cupholders, two airbags, radio cassette player, 14-inch steel wheels, and ABS brakes. The suspension is independent in front and torsion beam in the rear. Options include a CD player with MP3 capability, a 60/40 split fold-down rear seat, 15-inch alloy wheels and a rear spoiler.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019 and BMW M8 Convertible and M8 Competition Convertible was introduced in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a  turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW M8 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW M8 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

Quietly put on the showroom floor by local Hyundai dealers, the unknown i30 is a new-for-2008 hatchback alternative to the Elantra. Powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the i30 is being positioned as a cheaper alternative to better-equipped compact Japanese and European rivals. It is available with only a 4-speed automatic gearbox. The i30 benefits from a spacious-enough interior and the flexibility of a hatchback cargo area, especially with the folding rear seatback. Standard features are limited, with height-adjustable front seats, 60/40 split rear seats, cloth or partial leatherette seats, power windows, electric mirrors, body-coloured exterior trim and LED cabin lighting. Other available features include keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with USB support, fog lights, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. The i30 was originally designed to compete in the European market, so it benefits from tighter suspension tuning and better cabin materials. Sadly, GCC-spec cars are underequipped, especially in terms safety, as there is only one standard airbag and no ABS brakes.

The Canadian-built MKX is the Lincoln-badged version of the Ford Edge, an all-new soft-roader that debuted for the 2007 model year. The Edge features a car-derived platform, a raked windshield, a fast-sloping back window, a high-mounted rear spoiler, a high beltline and standard 18-inch alloy wheels. The interior features seating for five and cargo space can be maximized when the rear seats are folded. The Edge is powered by a new 3.5-liter V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available with an intelligent all-wheel-drive system in the GCC, the MKX is not equipped with low-range gearing. The interior features a center console that can fit a laptop computer and a number of standard features including leather upholstery, a panoramic Vista Roof, rear DVD screen, an MP3 audio jack and six-way power-adjustable front seats. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, seat-mounted side airbags and Safety Canopy air curtain system with rollover detection and side-curtain airbags.

Tougher than most compact 4WDs, the Jeep Cherokee, also known as the Liberty in some markets, seats five people and can carry their gear too. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it is just about adequate for the streets. Early models got a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, while post-facelift models got the automatic or a 6-speed manual. Fold the rear seats and it can move two people and some serious cargo. Turn off the pavement, and it can negotiate most trails with confidence. All-new for 2002, the Cherokee was extensively updated for 2005. From 2006, all models come with Jeep's Electronic Stability Program, ABS brakes, Electronic Roll Mitigation, and all-speed traction control. Standard on all models is Command-Trac, a conventional part-time four-wheel-drive system with a two-speed transfer case. Full-time Selec-Trac is optional, and retains a low range for serious off-roading. Standard features also include power windows, power mirrors, remote keyless entry, six-speaker AM/FM/CD stereo, grey fender flares, 16-inch steel wheels and traction control. Options include leather, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, fog lamps, body-colour fender flares, roof rails, functional rock rails and more.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The Trajet is Hyundai's latest attempt at conquering the world of minivans, but it is a completely typical minivan, with nothing over the competition except a lower price and an underpowered 2.7-litre V6. Standard features include power steering, front and rear a/c, roof rack, front and rear power windows, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, central door locks, funky tail lights and an automatic transmission. Options include a sunroof, fog lamps, All models come with 15-inch wheels, though the lower model gets steel rims with plastic covers, while the top model gets alloys. Unique features include four forward-opening doors, which is a rarity in the large minivan set. The basic model actually comes with 8-seater capacity, thanks to a bunch of bench seats, but the top model is more of a 7-seater, with more comfortable accommodations. The cabin is of course versatile, with movable and foldable seats to increase or decrease luggage space as needed. Safety features are conspicuously absent in the Middle East model, though overseas versions get all sorts of airbags, traction control and ABS, some of which you could probably special-order.

The GMC Yukon got a new 6-speed automatic transmission from 2009 onward and also the Yukon Denali got a slight power increase. A beefy Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Yukon, with better fuel economy to boot. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include power windows, electric mirrors and additional power equipment, along with a folding third-row seat. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, Yukon is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Yukon XL is the long-wheelbase GMC version of the Suburban, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. The Denali version adds a 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto, chrome trim and some luxury interior features, but loses off-road gearing.

At first glance, this Chinese-built car looks like nothing more than a cheap copy of the Toyota Corolla, with the rear end of a Honda City mixture, but wearing a fake BMW badge. And it is exactly that, but if you look past the lame attempts at plagiarism, you'll find a package that actually might be a decent deal for a new car. The F3 is powered by a 1.6-litre Mitsubishi-sourced engine, mated to a 5-speed manual Mitsubishi gearbox. It includes an interior that is exactly like that of a last-generation Toyota Corolla, but with softer touchable surfaces. Available features, standard or optional, include 15-inch wheels, leather upholstery, dual front airbags, sunroof, manual air-conditioning, CD player, remote keyless entry, fake wood trim, height-adjustable steering wheel, power windows, ABS brakes and the price tag of a car half its size. Build quality seems to be of passing-grade, although some plastic pieces have an unfinished feel to them. If only they'd try a bit harder and be a bit more original. The price may make up for it though, in the eyes of some cost-conscious buyers.

The Spark is a typical urban runabout based wholly on the Korean Daewoo Matiz, and is built in Korea too. It is a best seller in the supermini market, which is a market with few buyers in this region. The Spark is a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering just enough interior space for four inside a compact body. Its big windows and tight turning circle make it easy to park and cut through traffic, if you have the guts to cut in front of big 4WDs. The design tries to be cute, but unlike the Mini or the Beetle, this thing still looks like half a car. Inside, centre-mounted instruments greet you, as does cheap plastics. Depending on which of the upholstery fabrics and body colours is chosen, the displays have a blue, green or orange background. All interior mouldings and seating fabrics are robust but still cheap. It is powered by either a 0.8-litre three-cylinder or a 1.0-litre four-cylinder unit, and comes with a standard five-speed manual gearbox which features an all-new gearchange mechanism with damping for improved shift quality. A four-speed auto is optional. GM claims increased percentage of 'super steel' in the structure, but we'd still feel uncomfortable travelling in one of these.

The Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, and has been mildly facelifted for 2014. In 2017, the major change was the new V6 engine and automatic transmission as standard. No more manual transmission is offered. Engine options include a base 4.0-litre V6 with a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol XE or SE, as well as a 5.6-litre V8 with direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE or Desert Edition. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top Platinum "City" trim gets a slightly-lower unique bumper. For the Desert Edition, it gets bead-lock wheels, skid plates and more, built from the base Patrol LE model. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City. For 2018, it got a facelift. It is slightly larger in every dimension from the previous generation, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Renault Dokker Van is a light commercial vehicle made in Morocco. In 2020 it got a new front grille design. It comes with one engine option in the GCC, which is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. The panel van version has a luggage capacity of 3,300 litres and a maximum load length of 1.90 metres, thanks to the foldable front passenger seat, that can also be tipped forward against the glove box to free up space for a load length of up to 2.42 metres. If the front seat is removed altogether it provides a carrying capacity of 3,900 litres and a maximum load length of up to 3.11 metres. The payload capacity is 750 kg. It can be equipped with the Media Nav system, that combines navigation and audio functions, featuring Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and auxiliary USB and jack sockets. phone wirelessly and directly onto the Dokker Van's music system. 8 mobile phone devices can be connected to the Bluetooth enabled Media Nav with phonebook and call history.Wooden flooring and interior panelling in the cargo area are amongst the various accessories available. The wood protection kits are designed to protect the Dokker Van's rear loading space and are made from marine-quality plywood with non-slip treatment. Storage bin kit is another wooden accessory to arrange and store tools and is the perfect complement to a full wooden protection kit.Accessorized high-strength grilles for the rear window protect goods against theft and deter vehicle break-ins. Accessories in the range also include transverse roof bars, textile carpet mats, volume and perimeter alarm with or without remote control, and 15-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features in the Dokker include ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), and one driver side front airbag.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily facelifted and revised for 2007, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features. Also new to the range is the Navigator L, an extended version which has a longer wheelbase and additional cargo space.

The McLaren 720S is the successor to the 650S, built on a modified carbon chassis which is lighter and stiffer than that in the 650S. The 720S Spider came out a year later with a retractable hard-top roof. The 720S Spider sports a turbocharged 4.0-litre engine, which is basically a reworked variant of the 3.8-litre unit in the 650S, featuring a lengthened stroke and 41 percent new components, and mated to a carryover 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. An adaptive hydraulic suspension system with Proactive Chassis Control II, a redesigned air-brake spoiler which doubles the downforce compared to its counterpart in the 650S, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system, are all standard. Other features include an 8-inch capacitive touchscreen, folding driver display, premium audio system from JBL-Kenwood, ambient lighting, and Static Adaptive Headlamp with 17-LEDs per unit. Safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS, and stability control. Some interesting driver aids include Variable Drift Control and launch control.

An all new Mitsubishi L200 was released as a 2016 model year. It is sold in the GCC purely as a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. An all-new Creta came out in 2020 with a whole new design and updated interior. Under the hood, there are two engines on offer - a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with USB player, and 4 speakers. Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, infotainment with touchscreen, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's 5-door hatchback offering, facelifted for 2017 with new headlights and other minor trim changes. The only version offered in most GCC markets is the V40 T5 now, fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder for the Middle East. Variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels and a Polestar version with more power. All versions are front-wheel-drive. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

The BT-50 is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines for the B-Series include 2.2-litre and 2.6-litre petrol engines, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include plastic fender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

The 2016 Subaru WRX is a fifth generation model. It first came out in 2015 and is only available in sedan body, as the Japanese brand scrapped the hatchback. Under the hood, it gets a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler, replacing the 2.5-litre unit. It will be coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission. There's a new Sport Lineartronic CVT as an option, which also comes with 6-speed and 8-speed paddle-shifter mode. The new lighter engine ensures that this WRX with the manual gearbox is just 30 kg heavier than the previous model. It gets 17-inch wheels wrapped within Dunlop SP Sport Maxx RT tires. Of the two alternatives, torque will be equally (50:50) distributed to all four wheels in the 6-speed manual variant and the CVT will receive a torque distribution split of 45:55 with Subaru's Variable Torque Distribution system.  The new WRX will be 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

From 2011, the Ford Mustang got two new aluminium engine choices, namely a 3.7-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, with a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. The Mustang is offered in coupe and glass-roof versions. Only the metal-top coupe will be offered with the manual gearbox with either engine, while the glass-roof will only be sold with an automatic. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, 18-inch to 19-inch aluminium wheel choices, power mirrors, 8-speaker "Shaker 500" CD/MP3 stereo with a six-disc changer, standard SYNC multimedia system with Bluetooth, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, variable "MyColor" gauge illumination, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe. A Roush model was made available in 2011, with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8.

The Cadillac XT4 is the luxury brand's compact SUV offering. It comes equipped with a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, which is the only engine option, and a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the XT4 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, push start button, AM/FM stereo with 8-inch diagonal color information display, 7 speakers, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, parking sensors with rear camera, sunroof, LED headlamps and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment includes Bose Sound System, "Technology Package" which includes Air Ionizer, 8-inch diagonal color reconfigurable gauge cluster, head-up display, power rake, and telescoping steering column and wireless charging, 20-inch diamond cut alloy wheels, interior ambient lighting, navigation, AM/FM stereo with connected navigation providing real-time traffic, 8” diagonal color information display, one type A and one type C full function USBs, personalized profiles for each driver’s settings, Natural Voice Recognition (English only) and NFC (Near Field Communications) mobile device pairing. Safety features include airbags - dual-stage frontal, knee and seat-mounted side-impact for driver and front passenger; head-curtain for all outboard seating positions with rollover protection, stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor and ABS. Optional safety features include "Driver Awareness Package", which includes Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking, Front Pedestrian Braking, Following Distance Indicator, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and IntelliBeam. Also available is a "Driver Assist Package", which includes Adaptive Cruise Control, and Forward and Reverse Automatic Braking.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT Roadster, or Mercedes-AMG GT Roadster as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Two variants of the AMG GT Roadster are available as of 2018, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT Roadster gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT C gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT C also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

The Jaguar E-Pace sub-compact crossover slots in under the F-Pace in its lineup. It is based on a front-wheel-drive platform, but comes standard with all-wheel-drive and a choice of two turbocharged 2.0-litre "Ingenium" engines and a 9-speed automatic. A Jaguar Touch Pro infotainment system comes standard with a 10-inch capacitive touchscreen system. It offers 4G connectivity, 8 WiFi hotspots and a bunch of apps. The instrument panel is a 12.3-inch TFT unit which is coupled with a heads-up display. The rear offers 577 litres of space with the seats up. The E-Pace will be available in two flavours, a standard model and the R-Design model. On top of this, three specification packs are offered along with a bunch of options.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

The CTS builds on Cadillac's push for technology and design innovation, and is a modern interpretation of the striking cars that made Cadillac famous. Built on GM's Sigma rear-wheel-drive architecture, CTS was rigourously tested at the famed Nurburgring racetrack in Germany. The CTS has an entry-level model with a 2.8-litre engine with decent power. The new-for-2005 2.8-litre V6 VVT is a modified version of the better new-for 2004 3.6-litre VVT CTS engine. Braking and suspension capabilities remain the same for both. Both engines can be mated to a six-speed manual transmission, though both are available with the five-speed automatic transmission. The automatic has an engine braking feature in all five gears. The CTS offers a unique exterior and interior, with 16-inch wheels on the base model, going up to 17-inch on this higher models. Standard features include the usual power options and multiple airbags, while available features include navigation, leather and sunroof. Wooden surfaces are used sparingly in the cabin, limited to trimmings on the steering wheel, shifter knob and door pulls. It is a convincing alternative to the Germans, but lacks the overall refinement to fully compete in anything other than in price.

The Jeep Renegade is the smallest SUV offering from the brand. It gets 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under the hood, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The base 2021 Jeep Renegade Sport model comes in front-wheel-drive format, while the Latitude, Trailhawk and Limited models are all-wheel drive platforms. Standard options in the 2021 Jeep Renegade include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, manual A/C, FM radio with AUX/USB support and alloy wheels. Higher options include automatic A/C, Infotainment system with screen, navigation, automatic A/C and leather seats. Safety features in the 2021 Jeep Renegade include driver and passenger airbags, traction control and vehicle stability control.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. In 2018 it received a facelift and some power upgrades. There is no more V6 engine offered, with only 2.3-litre turbo and the V8 engines carrying over. All engines can be had with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a new 10-speed automatic transmission. The interior gets the MyFord infotainment system with SYNC 3. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

The Hyundai i40 is a midsize station wagon. A basic, mid-range and top model are sold here. All the models get the same 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, steel wheels, AM/FM radio and CD player with MP3 playback capability and six speakers. Available features, standard on higher trim levels, include parking sensors and alloy wheels. The rear seat backrests feature a 60:40 split, so you can still carry the luggage plus a rear seat passenger or two. If more space is required, rear seat backrests fold flat into the floor while the floor rail system helps keep your luggage secured.

Equipped with a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, the Renault Megane RS is the brand's top performance model sold in the region. Channeling that power is a 6-speed dual-clutch transmission. It comes with launch control. As for now, the manual transmission version is not available. The suspension sits 5 mm lower than the GT and sits on a stiffer suspension set up. The handling is further improved with the four-wheel steering. The exhaust system also puts out a decent soundtrack which adds to the fun factor. The exterior gets additional 60 mm wings, front splitter, functional rear diffuser, and full LED headlamps.For the interior, optional features include seats upholstered in Alcantara, along with Alcantara steering wheel, exclusive black headliner and red stitching. The centre console feature Renault’s R-Link multimedia system with the big screen. Optionally it gets Bose surround sound system with a sub-woofer. Rear camera, front and rear sensors are standard.Safety features include front and curtain airbags, blind spot monitor, tyre pressure monitoring system, hill start assist, ESP and ABS.

The BMW M3 convertible debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Nissan Micra made its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. A facelifted version became available for 2019. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are fewer trim levels from 2014 onwards, with higher trims having features such as power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

The Volkswagen Jetta underwent a full redesign for 2011, growing in size to offer class-leading interior space. The only engine on offer is an old 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a manually-shiftable 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel-drive. There are three trim levels, named Trendline, Comfortline and Comfortline Plus. The base Trendline comes with keyless entry, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. The Comfortline additionally comes with chrome trim, 16-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone a/c, steering-wheel buttons, fog lamps, alarm system and parking sensors. The top Comfortline Plus version comes with 17-inch alloys, intelligent keyless entry and starter button, electric-adjustable sports seats with partial leather, and a touchscreen audio system. All VW Jetta models come with ABS, traction control, six airbags and auto hazard lights as standard.

The Alto is a tiny hatchback originally conceived as a "kei" car for the Japanese market, meaning it had to be restricted to this tiny size to qualify for tax breaks in Japan. Built in India since 2004, for foreign markets it is powered by a tiny 1.1-litre engine driving the front wheels through a five-speed manual or a three-speed automatic. The suspension is made up of MacPherson struts and coil springs at the front and Suzuki's isolated trailing link and coil spring system at the rear.Very popular in India, it offers low fuel consumption, low maintenance costs and even safety features such as dual airbags, side impact beams and even seat belts. It offers enough seating for four people as well as their wallets in the rear luggage compartment. Available features, standard or optional, include front power windows, cloth upholstery, power steering, central locking, CD player and steel wheels with plastic hubcaps. Parking one of these things is easy in tight city streets, but it could run out of breath on the highway fast lane. The new version of the Alto was launched during the summer of 2009, and is being sold in the GCC as the Celerio alongside this old Alto.

The new-for-2010 Camaro, which more or less looks just like the overexposed prototype, took the car world by storm on launch. Powered by a 3.6-litre V6 or a 6.2-litre V8, it rides on a shortened rear-wheel-drive Lumina SS platform, with four-wheel independent suspension and 2+2 seating. The Camaro comes in V6 LT and V8 SS trims, with an RS package adding some appearance enhancements. The V6 is only available with a 6-speed paddle-shifted automatic in the GCC. The SS gets a choice of two V8 engines, each customised for use with a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic. The automatic V8 features cylinder deactivation to improve fuel economy. In 2011, the V6 got a mild power upgrade. StabiliTrak traction control and front-side airbags are standard, while Brembo brakes are available on the SS version. The SS, recognisable by its fake bonnet vent, also gets stiffer suspension and adjustable Competitive/Sport modes for stability control and Launch Control on manual models. The hard-plastic cabin comes with cloth or leather interior, with standard blue LED lighting and optional glow-in-the-dark trim panels. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 20-inch ones for the V8. The RS appearance package includes HID headlamps with integrated halo rings, spoiler, chrome tail-light rings, sticker stripes and 21-inch wheels.

The Haval H2 is the Chinese SUV brand's smallest offering. It comes with a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and traction control.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG gets a mid-cycle refresh, in line with the rest of the S-Class range, with ever-so-subtle design changes. The most significant changes are under the hood, which then rounds off with a slightly redesigned front-fascia and DRL's. It is now propelled by a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8, and mated to an all-new 9-speed automatic transmission, and available only with the AMG-tuned 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. Theres also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. It rides on optional 19-inch or 20-inch light-weight alloys too. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that. The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. In 2021, a Land Cruiser 70 Overland was introduced. Equipped with front and rear TJM XGS Series 4000 SX Shocks and TJM XGS Coil Springs on the front providing increased ride height. The Overlander edition also comes standard with a heavy-duty on-board air compressor, 12V electric factory winch and STEDI 7-inch LED spotlights. It gets a 9-inch display audio with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, along with navigation.

An all-new Audi S4 made its debut in the UAE and GCC in 2020. Under the hood, the all-wheel-drive S4 gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The S4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Sierra 1500 range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado, which sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Sierra 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models.

For 2012, the midsize Cadillac SRX received a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with paddle-shifting functions and all-wheel-drive. Even the base model is generously loaded, with a limited-slip differential, common power accessories, 18-inch wheels, LED tail lamps, chrome roof rails, 8-speaker Bose CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, dual-zone a/c with rear vents and controls, cruise control, keyless entry, power-adjustable pedals, power-adjustable front seats and a leatherette interior. The top 'Luxury' version gets variable-effort power steering, continuously-variable real-time dampers, turning HID headlights, parking sensors with rear camera, navigation, 20-inch wheels, 10-speaker Bose stereo with Bluetooth and USB port, 40 GB hard drive, rear DVD screens, full keyless entry with push-button start, ventilated front seats, LED cabin lighting and a panoramic glass roof. For 2013, changes included an unnoticeable facelift and the introduction of the CUE multimedia entertainment system, along with some minor cabin alterations and an active noise-cancellation system. All models get front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and a tyre-pressure monitor.

Toyota had been selling a slightly-altered version of the Prado in the United States since 2002, calling it the Lexus GX 470. That model has now been replaced by a new-for-2010 GX 460 model, based on the latest-generation Prado. The most obvious difference between the GCC-spec Prado and the US-spec GX460 is the front-end styling, with small changes to the rear light clusters and a completely unique dashboard. The cabin trim quality is also a notch better, while even a few control buttons have been changed for a more premium feel. The real news is under the bonnet, as the Lexus version comes exclusively with a 4.6-litre V8, slighty detuned compared to the U.S. version. The V8 is mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. In terms of standard equipment, this 7-seater comes with three-zone auto a/c, 9-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, front and side-curtain airbags, front knee airbags, hands-free keyless entry with starter button, wood and leather trim, Bluetooth and USB jack, as well as a centre-diff lock, KDSS air suspension, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID turning headlights, sunroof, parking assist, common power accessories, cruise control, ABS and stability control. Adding to the base 'Premium' model, the 'Premium Plus' trim adds a 17-speaker stereo with DVD changer, 8-inch navigation screen, rear DVD entertainment system, roof rails, 4-camera 360-degree system and crawl control. The top 'Luxury' trim adds semi-aniline leather, active cruise control and a remote engine starter.

The new-for-2012 Nissan Sunny moves down to the sub-compact segment with a completely redesigned car, while offering more space than ever before. The Sunny sedan, based on the Micra hatchback platform, now comes from India, and is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. The basic 'S' model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, AUX jack, cloth upholstery, trip computer and a black grille surround. The 'SV' model, identified by a chrome grille surround and door handles, adds power mirrors, front power windows, keyless entry, upgraded cloth seats and hubcaps, with an optional comfort package that adds fog lights, rear power windows, rear fan vents, parking sensors, more speakers and a central rear armrest. The top 'SL' model comes only in automatic, with 15-inch alloys, Bluetooth, steering-wheel stereo controls, nicer gauges with more readings, cloth trim on the doors, rear spoiler and mud guards. All models get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, brake assist, and seatbelts for all five seating positions.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. There is a rare three-door short-wheelbase version known as the LC70, as well as a popular pickup version known as the LC75. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both shared with previous Land Cruiser models, mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is an all-new model, to compete against the BMW X6. Mercedes-AMG GLE Coupe 63 is the top performance model. In 2020, it got a facelift and power upgrades. Under the hood, it comes with the 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. A small electric motor has been added to the engine to provide better acceleration and response, as well as improve fuel economy. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and 21-inch cross-spoke AMG alloy wheels. The 5-seater interior offers leather upholstery, mood lighting, HDD navigation, panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking.

The redesigned Boxster roadster was introduced in 2005, and it got the upgrated engines from Cayman for the 2007 model year. Considered the entry-level Porsche offering, the cars are powered by a 2.7-litre version of the traditional Porsche flat-six engine in their base trim, while the higher-performance S versions are powered by a 3.4-litre version of the sixer. The model is considered a benchmark for sports-car handling, with rear-wheel-drive and a choice of either a manual or a manually-shiftable automatic. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, among other luxury options. The Boxster offers head airbags in combination with thorax airbags, concealed on the outer side of the backrest, alongside the usual front airbags. Luggage is space is very limited, with two trunks, one in the front and one behind the mid-mounted engine in the back. The Boxster can be ordered with a removable hard top.

The 2018 Ford Transit Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying cargo. It can seat up to 3 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2018 Ford Transit Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine, available in two different tunes. All models get the 6-speed manual transmission. The van has a payload capacity up to 1,024 kg, a maximum cargo volume of 8.3 cubic metre square and a wide space between the wheel arches allowing for the storage of 1.2-m x 2.4-m boards vertically or horizontally. The load-through bulkhead lets you carry up to 3-meter-long cargo, such as pipes, ladders or carpet rolls. Fixing points and 8 tie-down loops are positioned on the bodysides, leaving the floor clear for easier loading, unloading and cleaning. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2018 Ford Transit Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The goofy B-Class is touted as a Compact Sports Tourer, when it really is a tall hatchback. Though the A-Class is still in production, its sale seems to have been cancelled here, with this one taking its place. Mercedes-Benz is also touting their the sandwich concept, to which it credits the space-saving arrangement of the engine and transmission partly in front of and partly beneath the passenger cell, which in turn offers the interior spaciousness of larger saloons and estate cars despite its compact external dimensions. There is a height-adjustable load compartment floor, an asymmetrically divided, folding and removable rear seat unit plus an optionally removable front passenger seat, all of which allows conversion from a comfortable touring car to a practical van. Models include the B 150, the B 170, the B 200 and the B 200 Turbo, all four-cylinder, rear-wheel-drive, and available with a choice of manual or CVT automatic, plus all the creature comforts and safety features of a Mercedes-Benz.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. In 2020, it got a facelift and some tech upgrades inside. The Audi A5 cabriolet is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Outback is the redesigned model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive crossover wagon. Like all previous Outback models for more than a decade, the new-for-2010 version continues to be based on the Legacy wagon, only with slightly better ground clearance. Compared to the previous version, it now features a larger body and carryover engines. The base Outback 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 3.6R, with a turbocharged 3.6-litre 6-cylinder boxer engine mated to a paddle-shifted 5-speed automatic. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Lincoln MKX was an all-new model for 2016 and carries on unchanged in 2018 before being renamed Nautilus for 2019. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, it gets a standard 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the higher models get a turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

BMW introduced the X4 in the lineup for the first time as a 2015 model. It looks like a smaller version of the X6. Under the hood, two engine choices will be available. One is a turbocharged 4-cylinder 2.0-litre engine, while the other is a turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 motor. The BMW X4 is equipped with BMW ConnectedDrive features that include high-resolution, full-colour Head-Up Display, which projects all important driving information and the assistance systems displays into the driver's field of view. The Navigation System Professional with ECO PRO route guidance teams up with the iDrive Touch Controller whose touchpad allows texts  e.g. a navigation destination to be easily inputted by using a finger. The tailgate can opened automatically and can be further specified with the Comfort Access Option for extra convenience, which allows it to be opened with a movement of the foot. Safety and convenience can be further enhanced by optional premium features like the anti-dazzle High Beam Assistant, Driving Assistant Plus including Pedestrian and Collision Warning, Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function and Lane Departure Warning. Available as options are Lane Change Warning, Surround View and the Parking Assistant.

Chevrolet Colorado is the American manufacturer's commercial midsize pickup offering, essentially a rebadged version of the Isuzu D-Max and built in Thailand. It comes in two engines - either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 5-speed manual or a 3.6-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, with no diesel options. Only the crew cab four-wheel drive models are available in the GCC. Entertainment is provided by the radio with a  single-disc CD drive and FM/AM/CD supporting MP3/WMA plus available four  speakers. Other standard features include power windows, power mirrors, painted front and rear bumpers and remote key entry. Safety-wise, the front driver and passenger get airbags and anti-lock braking (ABS) with electronic brake force distribution (EBD).

The ZNA Yumsun is a 7-seater minivan that turns out to be the unlikely flagship, with its 2.5-litre Nissan 4-cylinder engine. The single trim level includes soft-touch cabin trim, 4-speed automatic, 15-inch alloy wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, fake wood and leather trim, CD/MP3 stereo with steering controls and 6-CD changer, remote locking, power windows and mirrors, table on the backrest of front seats, 3.9-inch LCD screen with rear audio controls and 6 speakers, automatic antenna, rear parking sensors, auto front and rear a/c, and two airbags.

The BMW M2 made its debut in the GCC in 2016. The exterior of the M2 Coupe may look no different than that of the M235i at first glance. But there are visual changes such as aggressively-flared front and rear bumpers, quad-exhausts and sporty alloys. As much as 80% of parts can be different when comparing M cars versus their non-M versions. Underneath the bonnet is a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. The car gets an overboost function that increases the torque for a few seconds. The engine will be mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The car also receives M4-derived aluminium front and rear axles, aluminium suspension components, tuned electronic power-steering and an Active M-Differential. The longer M4-sourced axles are what led the M2 to have wider fenders, so the tyres wouldn't stick out.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

With Honda going for premium prices nowadays, the City is about as low as you can go in the Honda range. Introduced for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, it is touted as the perfect `urban` vehicle, with its small exterior and tall interior. There is now a choice of two engines, namely a 1.3-litre four-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a gearless CVT automatic, or a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with a gearless CVT that can imitate a seven-speed gearbox using wheel-mounted buttons. Standard features on the base 1.3-litre model include multi-reflector headlamps, 14-inch steel wheel, air-conditioning with heater, power windows, electric power steering, radio CD player with 2 speakers, cup and card holders, dual airbags and side door beams. Upgrading to the 1.5-litre adds 15-inch alloy wheels, hidden radio antenna, rear 60/40 split seat, rear tip-up seat function, driver seat height adjuster, power locks, electric mirrors, 2 more speakers for the CD stereo, fake wood-finish consoles, keyless entry and ABS brakes.

The Changan CS75 is a compact SUV from China. It got a facelift in 2019. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the CS75 "Fashion" trim include power windows, central locking, remote on key, cruise control, manual A/C, radio and single CD player with MP3/WMA support, 8 speakers, multifunctional steering wheel, USB+AUX ports, leather seats, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors and LED headlamps. Higher "Elite" trim gets additional 7-inch screen, keyless entry and start and auto climate control.Safety features includes dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist. The top option gets addition side curtain airbags.

An all-new Peugeot 3008 came out in 2017. The compact SUV is available in the GCC with only one engine option - the turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the 3008 include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats and alloy wheels. Optional features include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Andriod Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist.

The 360 is a mid-engined two-seater sports car, designed as a high-tech replacement for the simplistic F355, while itself being replaced by the F430 for 2005, effectively giving the 360 the short shelf-life. For this model, occasionally known as the F360, Ferrari partnered with Alcoa to produce an all-aluminium space-frame chassis. Also new was the Pininfarina styling that gave up flip-up headlights, replacing them with rounded fixed units. The new 3.6-litre V8 engine came with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed F1-style automanual. The cabin was sparse on gadgets, but the basics were standard, including leather, CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, front airbags, ABS brakes, and stability control. The coupe version was called the 360 Modena, while the new-for-2001 convertible was called the 360 Spider. The lightweight 360 Challenge Stradale came later, with  110 kg shaved off, a bump up in power from the upgraded V8, and featuring 19-inch BBS wheels, carbon-fibre side-mirrors, updated front bumper, lower ride height, and a black mesh grille at the rear.

The McLaren 720S is the successor to the 650S, built on a modified carbon chassis which is lighter and stiffer than that in the 650S. The 720S sports a turbocharged 4.0-litre engine, which is basically a reworked variant of the 3.8-litre unit in the 650S, featuring a lengthened stroke and 41 percent new components, and mated to a carryover 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. An adaptive hydraulic suspension system with Proactive Chassis Control II, a redesigned air-brake spoiler which doubles the downforce compared to its counterpart in the 650S, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system, are all standard. Other features include an 8-inch capacitive touchscreen, folding driver display, premium audio system from JBL-Kenwood, ambient lighting, and Static Adaptive Headlamp with 17-LEDs per unit. Safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS, and stability control. Some interesting driver aids include Variable Drift Control and launch control.

Porsche introduced this generation of the 911 model series as a new model, even though it looks almost identical to the older one. The new models consist of Coupe, Cabriolet and Targa body styles. There was an initial choice of two all-new flat-6 powerplants, but later in 2010, the Turbo, GT3 and GT3 RS variants debuted, with the GT2 RS coming after that. A new Carrera GTS model debuted in 2011 with yet another engine tune, followed by an expensive Speedster limited-edition with the same engine, while a Carrera 4 GTS came later. The rear-wheel-drive Carrera 2 and Targa 4, and the all-wheel-drive Carrera 4, all get the 3.6-litre engine. The Carrera 2S, the Targa 4S and the Carrera 4S get the 3.8-litre engine. The new-for-2011 Carrera GTS Coupe and Cabriolet as well as the Speedster convertible get a mildly-tuned version of the 3.8-litre. The GT3 and GT3 RS get a further upgraded version of the 3.8-litre engine. And the Turbo and Turbo S get a turbocharged 3.8-litre in different states of tune, with all-wheel-drive. The GT2 RS gets a 3.6-litre turbo engine with even more power and rear-wheel-drive. For the first time among Porsche models, direct fuel injection has been introduced, as has a new optional 7-speed double-clutch automanual gearbox known as the Porsche-Doppelkupplung (PDK), available alongside the standard 6-speed manual on all but the GT3 and GT2 models. The PDK gearbox offers better acceleration and fuel economy than the manual version. There is the choice to combine PDK with Porsche's optional Sport Chrono Plus gearbox mapping, including Launch Control. Additional new features include front and rear LED driving lights, bi-xenon headlights, dynamic cornering lights, and a mild overall facelift. Interior features include a CD stereo, leather upholstery, optional multimedia system, common power accessories and more, though almost all other convenience features are optional. Safety includes multiple airbags, stability control and pop-up roll hoops for the convertible.

The Nativa is an off-road capable 4WD that fits in an odd spot between the Pajero and the Outlander. Powered by a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a four-speed automatic, the Nativa is a dated design, but still a decent wagon. Standard features for the low base price include AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, driver's and front passenger's front airbags, part time 4WD with synchronized front free-wheel differential, transfer protector, power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, alloy wheels, keyless entry system and seating for five.
