Features available on higher models include gauges for a thermometer, compass, oil pressure and voltage meter, faux wood trim, front fog lights, CD player with 6 speakers, leather seats, sunroof, limited slip differential, ABS with EBD, cruise control and more. The Nativa rides on the older L200 pickup platform, and was discontinued in a number of markets since 2004. Shipments have continued from Thailand since 2008, alongside the Pajero Sport. However, few 4WDs are offered at this price that are properly equipped to go off-road. Some dealers only offered one fully-loaded trim in the later years.

The Tata Indica is an outdated hatchback first launched in India back in 1998, and on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica is considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger car. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The CLS-Class "four-door coupe" was completely redesigned for the 2012 model year and facelifted for 2015. Based on the latest E-Class platform, the CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Models on offer include the CLS 400 with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 and the CLS 500 with a 4.6-litre twin-turbo V8. The V6 model gets a 7-speed automatic transmission, while the V8 model gets a new 9-speed automatic gearbox. Standard features on all models include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps. Some models gets a standard sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry and start and a sports package for the non-AMG models. Options include metallic paint, nicer leather, wooden steering wheel, night vision, various 18-inch and 19-inch alloy-wheel designs, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more.

The 5th-generation 3-Series coupe was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Cordoba is designed to appeal to sedan customers who like the Ibiza hatchback. Though similar to the Ibiza, it somehow appears a lot more conservative than the Ibiza, and the engine choices here carry forward that notion. It is keeping pace in the market with variations of the original car, by adding new Seat styling features to what is essentially the same car that was launched ages ago. In the Middle East, it is offered with only a VW-derived 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine, with an automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, front power windows, remote central locking, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, CD radio with six speakers, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, height and reach adjustable steering wheel, double headlamps, three-point rear seatbelts and three rear headrests, among others. Stability system with brake assistance is an option, as are rear power windows, alloy wheels and what not.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 6.1-litre V8-powered SRT-8 models is available in many GCC markets, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. The SRT8 gets larger 20-inch alloy wheels, sports leather seats, a mild body kit and sports suspension. All models feature front and side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The fourth generation of the VW Golf was a huge success during its long run. The clean and conservative styling combined with a vague sense of being a status symbol made it a hit among well-to-do yuppies. Available only as a 5-door hatchback here, with a variety of engine options upgraded over the years. Even a 4Motion all-wheel-drive model is available, though it may be hard to find in these parts. After its 1998 makeover, the Golf got considerably more tasteful inside, with nicely contrasting colours and patterns. The cabin offers sufficient room for six-footers, while the rear compartment is as small as any other compact. The cargo area under the hatch is huge for a compact, and the rear seats fold flat. Available features included power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, sunroof, alloy wheels and more, depending on trim level. A pair of airbags is standard on all models, with some getting side airbags as well, while ABS is standard. Engines included 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors. Sportier early models included the FWD or AWD GTI with a 2.3-litre V5, and an AWD 4Motion model with a 2.8-litre V6. In the later years, the V5 got more power. For its premium price, equipment levels were limited, with an underlying platform that had independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension.

The 307 is available in three body styles, namely a 3-door or 5-door hatchback, a 5-door station wagon and a 2-door retractable-top coupe-cabriolet. Launched in 2002, the facelifted front end made its appearance in 2006, consistent with the latest Peugeot corporate look, though not necessarily better-looking. All models retain the traditional triangular headlights, while now receiving fancy LED tail-lights. The tall 307 can be had in a standard five-door hatchback body, a CC hardtop-convertible body, and an SW or Break station wagon body. Available engines are all four-cylinder units. The 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic on any hatchback or wagon model. The 307 CC coupe-convertible, available from 2004 to 2007, can be had with only the 2.0-litre, but only with an automatic gearbox. All models come with standard power windows, cloth interior, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, and at least driver and front passenger air bags. Available features include side airbags and a leather interior.

An all-new model of the Acura RDX was released in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The all-wheel-drive RDX comes in one trim. Standard features in the RDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power driver's seat, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 10 speakers, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard, adaptive cruise control, bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the RDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), and traction control.

The all-new M4 came out as a 2021 model year. Under the hood, is a highly-tuned 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 8-speed automatic transmission. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The M4 comes standard with a carbon-fibre roof or an optional no-cost moonroof. The M4 also gets an optional M Drive Professional feature, which helps drivers analyse driving lines and times on race tracks. An M Drift Analyser records the duration of a drift, distance covered, and the line and angle, displaying a final rating on the Control Display after each drift. Users can also download an iPhone app that corresponds with the car to give them a bird’s-eye view of the track and access to a lap time comparison chart, as well as data like speed, accelerator position, and total G forces. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera. Other standard safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, traction control and brake assist.

The Volvo XC60 was launched with high hopes for the Swedish company, capitalising on the small crossover vehicle market. The XC60 is a new 5-seater crossover SUV that is aimed at attracting luxury-brand buyers. The XC60 T6 is powered by a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shifting capability, and an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. For 2010, an XC60 T5 model was introduced, with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The smallest XC model includes new safety technology, debuting Volvo's new City Safety system, designed to help a driver avoid a collision at under 30 kph, or reduce the speed of impact at higher speeds by hitting the brakes if the vehicle in front suddenly stops and City Safety determines that a collision is likely. Another new safety featured being introduced on the XC60 is Pre-Prepared Restraints that uses a laser sensor that interacts with other technology to control the airbags and adaptive seatbelt load limiters. Other features, depending on trim level, include cloth or leather upholstery, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, reverse camera, keyless entry, sunroof, alloy wheels, common power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. An R-Design body kit is optional. Standard safety features include front and side-surtain airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, and whiplash-protection headrests.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's 5-door hatchback offering, facelifted for 2017 with new headlights and other minor trim changes. The V40 T5 is fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder for the Middle East. It is connected to a 8-speed automatic. In 2019, the V40 T3 was offered which gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged unit mated to a 6-speed automatic. Variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels and a Polestar version with more power. All versions are front-wheel-drive. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that.

For 2016, the 300 SRT got a facelift, giving it a more aggressive look. It got some new safety features, updated entertainment system and a new automatic transmission. Under the hood is a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 8-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, ventilated seats, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 19 Harmon Kardon speakers, dual-pane panoramic sunroof, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Getting the "Black Vapor" option adds black chrome surround grille, black headlamp bezels, and black LED taillamps. Standard safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane departure warning, blind spot monitor, cross path detection and forward collision warning.

The Kia Rio is all-new for the 2012 model year. Attractively designed, it is available in 4-door sedan and 5-door hatchback form. The only engine for the GCC is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with variable-valve timing, mated to a 4-speed automatic. While mechanically basic, the Rio can be had with a host of features unseen in the sub-compact segment. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, adjustable steering wheel, central locking, power windows, electric mirrors and only one airbag. The mid-range model gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, centre-console armrest, fog lamps, keyless entry, USB port, Bluetooth, steering-wheel audio controls, sun-visor lights, folding mirrors with indicators and a split-folding rear seat. The top model gets rear parking sensors, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, padded leatherette door trim, LED front running lights and tail lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, more speakers for the stereo, cruise control, cooled glovebox, auto headlights, sunroof, and finally, ABS and a passenger-side airbag in addition to the driver's one. The Rio is offered in Europe and the States with full front-side-curtain airbags and stability control, and has a 5-star crash-test rating in Europe, but that model is not sold in the GCC.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur debuted in its current form as a 2014 model year, when it dropped the "Continental" from its name. The exterior shape continues unchanged, featuring 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. It gets an 8-channel, 8-speaker audio system. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split. The suspension has been made softer for the new Flying Spur for a more comfortable ride. A Mulliner Driving Specification is available which adds diamond-quilted seats, drilled alloy foot pedals, a sports shift lever, jeweled filler cap and unique 21-inch two-piece alloy rims.

A new-generation Honda CR-V made its debut in 2017. In 2020, it got slight facelift, along with upgraded tech inside. Under the hood, the same engine remains, which is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection engine mated to a CVT that can simulate a 7-speed in 'sport' mode. The DX and LX trims come in 2WD form, while the EX and Touring trims come in AWD form. Standard features on the base two-wheel-drive CR-V model include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, remote key, halogen headlights, daytime running lamps, single-zone A/C, rear camera, fabric seats, 5-inch audio screen, 1 USB, 4 speakers, cruise control and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models gets all-wheel-drive, LED headlights, fog lamps, paddle shifters, engine push start, 7-inch screen, 8 speakers, 4 USB ports, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, dual-zone A/C, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The 2020 Honda CR-Vs gets a redesigned center console that is easier to use, with more flexible storage options, while CR-V Touring grade now come standard with Wireless Cell phone charger. The 7-inch touch screen Display Audio is compatible with Apple CarPlay and AndroidAuto platforms. The 2020 CR-V gets the Hands-Free Access Power Tailgate with adjustable height feature standard in the EX and the Touring grade. Safety features include ABS, vehicle stability assist, traction control system, tyre pressure monitor, hill start assist, electric brake force distribution, and driver attention monitor. The AWD models get Honda's LaneWatch side camera. The top model gets side and curtain airbags as well.

The new Skoda Yeti is a sub-compact crossover SUV, and it comes standard with a 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine coupled to a 6-speed DSG automatic gearbox and an all-wheel-drive system that adapts for driving on rough terrain. Available in Comfort and Adventure trim levels, features are largely similar between the two. On the Comfort, these include 17-inch alloy wheels, fabric seating, black roof rails, auto a/c, cruise control, electric mirrors, folding table on rear-seat centre armrest and on the rear of front seats, cooled storage compartment, rear parking sensors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth and turning fog lamps. The Adventure gets different 17-inch wheels, silver roof rails, 6-CD changer with SD card reader, and a panoramic glass roof. Safety features include standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, hill-descent assist, and a whole host of electronics.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro Convertible was launched for the 2017 model year. While the exterior may not be that different from the previous generation, under the hood the 3.6-litre V6 and 6.2-litre V8 engines have been upgraded with more power. In 2019, the Chevrolet Camaro Convertible got a facelift and some interior upgrades. In 2019, the V6 and V8 models got a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 6-speed manual transmission is only available on the V8 model. Standard features on the 2021 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features on the 2020 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Freestar is a capable full-size minivan that is a solid performer, but is outclassed by newer entries. However, it is well-equipped, easily hauling seven passengers, and has a deep well behind the third row that is perfect for groceries. Fold the third-row seat into the floor, and the Freestar holds four passengers and offers a big, flat cargo area behind the seats. The third row can flip around to function as a tailgate seat, while options include a power rear liftgate and dual power sliding doors. On the highway, the Freestar is smooth and quiet, moved along by either a 4.2-litre V6. It doesn't feel as refined as the best and newest of the minivans, but it's strongest suit is safety, with dual-stage driver and front-passenger air bags standard, while the optional Safety Canopy airbags can help protect against head injuries in a rollover or side impact. The Freestar comes standard with ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, a tyre-pressure monitor is standard and optional AdvanceTrac electronic stability control.

The Chevrolet Tahoe got a new 6-speed transmission from 2009 onward. A beefy  Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Tahoe. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Tahoe is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

An all-new model of the BMW Z4 came out in 2019. The platform and drivetrain are shared with the revived Toyota Supra. It is available with two different engines. There is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine available in two different tunes, and there is the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder motor. All engines get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Like the older models, the Z4 will get separate convertible and coupe models. Standard features in the Z4 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, engine push start button, iDrive, cruise control, automatic A/C, leather seats and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control and tyre pressure monitor. Optional safety features include Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function, traffic sign recognition, distance information, Lane Change Warning system, Rear Collision Prevention and Cross-Traffic Alert, Active Park Distance Control and a rear-view camera.

An all-new model of the Acura RDX was released in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The all-wheel-drive RDX comes in one trim. Standard features in the RDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power driver's seat, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 10 speakers, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard, adaptive cruise control, bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the RDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), and traction control.

The Ferrari 458 Italia is the successor to the F430. Going on sale in 2011, the 458 Spider has a new mid-mounted 4.5-litre V8 engine, incorporating direct injection and mated only to a 7-speed dual-clutch automated manual gearbox that shifts in 0.05 seconds. It has a retractable hardtop roof which can open or close in 14 seconds. Technology includes an E-Diff differential and an F1-Trac skid control system. The brakes feature a new system called "˜prefill' so when the driver's foot lifts off the throttle, the pistons in the calipers move the pads towards the discs to reduce the stopping distance. The 458 Italia's body and chassis are all aluminium, with a Pininfarina-designed exterior. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions. The 458 is also available with modern conveniences like Bluetooth, CD stereo, rear camera, navigation, stability control and ABS, as well as a full set of front and side airbags.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It got a facelift for the 2016 model. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in four trim levels, namely S, SE, SEL and SPORT, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level S is designed specifically for fleet customers, and features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo, 60/40 folding rear seat, and electronic vehicle immobilisation. The SE model includes a six-CD changer, leather steering wheel, rear a/c vents and 16-inch "Carolina" alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the S and SE models, the SEL has 17-inch "Knoxville" alloy wheels, leatherette seats and a high-end Fender sound system with a subwoofer in the boot. A media input with iPod cable is also standard on the SEL, as is a powered driver's seat, front fog and cornering lamps, keyless entry, pushbutton start, a sunroof and dual-zone climatronic air conditioning with air quality sensors. The SPORT model adds part-leather seats, 18-inch "Chattanooga" alloy wheels, touch-screen navigation system, 30GB hard disc, SD card reader and DVD drive, memory function for the driver's seat and a powered front passenger seat. Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise. The R-Line model adds an exterior package which includes side skirts, front bumper and rear diffuser, and "Salvador" 19-inch alloy wheels.

Proton claimed that the Waja was their first in-house car designed by Malaysians. However, its petrol engine is bought directly from Mitsubishi, and the suspension work was done by their independent Lotus division. The Waja is sold as the Impian in some markets, or referred to as the Waja Campro sometimes to advertise its latest engine. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this four-door sedan can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, sunroof, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Waja is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

Standard options in the GV80 include power steering, power windows, electric folding mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop, leather upholstery, memory and ventilated seats, audio system with AUX/USB support, auto A/C, navigation, auto defog system, rain sensors, sunroof, parking assist system, rear electric curtain, xenon headlamps, LED headlights and taillights with LED daytime running lamps, front and rear camera, air suspension and 20-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include 9 airbags, lane keep assist, adaptive cruise control, ABS, traction control, stability control, brake assist, blind spot detection and autonomous emergency braking (AEB).

The Honda Odyssey J is a smaller Japanese version of the larger US-built Odyssey. It gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. It has been facelifted for 2018 with a new grille, new front bumper with available LED running lights and fog lights, and new 17-inch wheels. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlights, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Other new features include a touch-panel for a/c controls, rear camera and more. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). For 2018, the EX-V additionally gets the Honda Sensing suite of active safety features that include Adaptive Cruise Control, Collision Mitigation Braking System, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Road Departure Mitigation System (RDM), Blind Spot Information System, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Pedestrian Detection System and Lane Keeping Assist System.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA-Class is a sub-compact 4-door sedan. A new generation model came out in 2020. The CLA-Class is offered in 2 versions. The CLA 200 is equipped with  4-cylinder 1.3-litre turbocharged engine and the CLA 250 gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine. Both models are mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive platform. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist. An AMG Line version is available which includes a body kit and tuned sports suspension.

The Tesla Model S is a fully electric sedan, which combines high performance and zero emission. Dropping rear-wheel-drive models altogther, all versions are now all-wheel-drive with air suspension as standard for 2018 -- 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth, and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include, self-driving capability, enhanced autopilot, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features feature traffic-aware cruise control, autosteer and autopark.

The Cadillac ATS-V is the American luxury brand's compact sports sedan offering. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS-V gets a twin-turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. A 6-speed manual is available but will most likely not be offered in the GCC. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, automatic headlamps, automatic dual-zone A/C, Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ciaz made its debut in the UAE in 2015. It is a compact sedan with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ciaz GL model include power steering, power windows, power mirrors with built-in turn signals, central locking with remote key access, radio with CD/AUX/USB support, fabric seats, audio controls on steering wheel, manual A/C and steel wheels. The higher option Ciaz GLX gets electrically folding side mirrors, cruise control, keyless push start system, automatic A/C, rear parking sensors, Bluetooth, leather seats, fog lamps and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver & passenger airbag, ABS and EBD.

For 2012, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class received engine upgrades for some models. The models to choose from are the E 200, E 250, E 300, E 350 and E 500. The E 200 and E 250 get a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. The E 300 gets a 3.0-litre V6 whereas the E 350 is fitted with a 3.5-litre V6 engine. The E 500 has a 4.7-litre under the hood. They all have a 7-speed automatic transmission. The E-Class Cabriolet has much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door format.  An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is a big 4WD that dates back to the 1992 version, relaunched with a new skin in 1998. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its reasonable on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder came for 2002, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A 4-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the 5-speed manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features.

The painfully cute QQ symbolises China's history of producing bootlegged electronics and brand-name clothes. Except in this case, they've managed to pirate a complete car. As unbelievable as it might sound, the QQ was copied from a previous-generation Daewoo Matiz, now sold as the Chevrolet Spark. It is said that the cars are so alike that parts can be interchanged between the two cars. Needless to say, General Motors is pissed and they've been fighting in Chinese courts for ages now. Apparently, former Daewoo engineers got jobs at Chery, and they brought Daewoo blueprints with them. The car, however, is cheaper than dirt and you can have the same car for less money. The tiny 3-cylinder and 4-cylinder engines in the QQ produce almost as much power as the Spark, so it is still a painfully slow car. Keyless entry and power windows are standard, while dual airbags and CD player are optional. If anyone is interested in a brand new pint-sized car as small as this for fuel economy or whatever other reason, they might actually be happy with this thing. From what we hear, they are far from perfectly reliable, but we haven't exactly heard good things about GM-Daewoo either.

The Corolla is a bestseller among compact sedans in this region, relying on reliability and economy to keep it competitive. Fully redesigned for the 2008 model year, the Corolla sedan was facelifted for the 2011 model year, featuring new front and rear ends. The base Corolla offers long-term value for money and comes standard with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine with a new 6-speed manual or an old 4-speed automatic, air conditioning, a radio cassette player, manual windows, dual front airbags, 15-inch steel wheels and a cloth interior. Everything else is optional depending on trim, including power windows and mirrors, ABS brakes, keyless entry, fake wood trim, parking sensors and a CD/MP3 player. The better engine is a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder again with either a new 6-speed manual or an outdated 4-speed automatic, with similar options. The top-spec 1.8 model can be outfitted with an automatic a/c, cruise control, 16-inch alloys, rear spoiler, side curtain airbags, leather, sunroof, Bluetooth, split-folding rear seat and even a CD changer. Some cars are imported from Japan, but others come from Taiwan.

The CMC Z7 is an iteration of a Taiwanese-built model called the Mitsubishi Zinger, and sharing a chassis with the Mitsubishi Nativa. Facelifted for 2016, with a new 5-speed automatic transmission, the Z7 people-carrier is powered by a Mitsubishi-sourced 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Features include four forward-opening doors with a rear tailgate, 7 seats, CD/MP# stereo, cloth upholstery, parking sensors, keyless entry, power windows, power locks, power steering, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloy wheels. Higher trim levels get 16-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, cruise control, climate control, rear camera, USB port and leather upholstery. Safety features include ABS and two airbags.

The small EX35 is what Infiniti likes to call a coupe-crossover, although it is really a compact five-door wagon. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6, it comes with a new 7-speed automatic for 2011, as well as standard all-wheel-drive. It has an excellent leather interior, power front seats, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain airbag system. There is no low-range gearing as the EX35 sits low and the chassis is tuned for on-road dynamics. The EX35 also comes with nifty features such as a seven-inch colour display with Infiniti controller for the trip computer and additional vehicle information, including the Infiniti DVD navigation system. But the most interesting feature by far is the around-view parking system that uses four cameras to simulate a 360-degree image of what is around the vehicle, thereby making parking easier in tight spots.

The C4 Picasso is a modern replacement for the oddball Xsara Picasso. Based on the C4 compact platform, it is a tall stylish minivan-type vehicle that drives like a car and has the practicality of a big 4WD. It seats only five, and the larger seven-seater Grand Picasso is not offered here. When all five seats are up, has 500 litres of boot space underneath the luggage cover, extending to a maximum 1,734 litres once the rear seats are folded down. Only two 4-cylinder engines are offered, one a 1.8-litre and one a 2.0-litre, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes that vary by model. According to trim level, the metal suspension can be replaced with pneumatic suspension on the rear axle on 2.0-litre models. CitroÃ«n has paid close attention to achieving the best levels of acoustic comfort and vibration control, as well as a new air-conditioning system. Its cloth-lined cabin can be outfitted with a variety of options, such as a panoramic glass roof, high-quality stereo system and folding video screens in the back of the front seats. The C4 Picasso has four Isofix seat tethers, audible seatbelt warnings for all seats and seven airbags as standard. Automatic electronic parking brake and Hill Start Assist are also fitted as standard.

An all-new Subaru Impreza made its debut in 2017 in the GCC. The engines carry over from the previous model, which is either a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine, although only the 2.0-litre is offered in some markets for 2018. Both are mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. Standard features in the 1.6i model include 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, power windows and mirrors, multi-function display, automatic a/c, audio system with 6.5 inch screen, 4 speakers, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, 60/40 folding rear seats and cloth upholstery. The 2.0i model adds the larger engine, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, fog lamps, 6 speakers, faux paddle-shifters and a rear-seat centre armrest with cup-holders. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, knee airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, along with the all-weather traction of asymmetrical all-wheel-drive.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is smaller than the Armada, but still big enough to qualify as a big 4WD. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its smooth on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The latest engine is a 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A new five-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features. After the launch of the all-new 2010 model, this older version continued to be sold briefly in a stripped-down format at a lower base price.

The Hyundai i20 made a late debut into the GCC market. It replaces their previous subcompact, the Hyundai Getz. Three models are available in the UAE market. The basic model gets the 1.2 litre engine which is mated to a five-speed manual transmission. The GL and GLS models get a 1.4-litre engine connected to a four-speed automatic. Standard features on the 1.2-litre model include power steering, tilt/telescopic steering column, CD/MP3 Kenwood stereo with 6 speakers and AUX input, manual a/c, 60:40 split-folding rear seat and manual windows. The 1.4-litre model additionally gets body-coloured door handles, painted power mirrors with indicators, power windows, central locking, rear wiper, front fog lamps, rear shelf and a better-adjustable driver's seat. All the models get ABS and only one airbag as standard. Optional features include driver's armrest, USB port, steering audio controls, alloy wheels and parking sensors.

The sister-model to the hotly-anticipated Toyota 86, the Subaru BRZ finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. In 2017, it got a minor facelift and other small handling tweaks. The BRZ is a collaborative effort with Toyota, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates, with only a front bumper different between the two. Usually available in only one trim level in most GCC markets, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. Depending on the dealer, standard features include cloth or leather sports seats, HID headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, auto a/c, common power accessories and 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. It additionally gets a limited-slip diff, paddle-shifters, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and and floor illumination. Specs may vary between different GCC countries, with most offering only the automatic version.

The BMW 3-Series received a minor facelift for the 2016 model year, along with new engines. It is available in three trim variants the Sport Line, Luxury Line and Modern Line. An optional M sport package consisting of sporty suspension, cabin trim and body kit is also offered. The new engines available include the entry-level 318i getting a new 1.5-litre 3-cylinder turbocharged engine. The 320i and 330i gets a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit.  The 340i, which replaces the 335i, gets an all-new turbocharged 6-cylinder 3.0-litre all-aluminum motor. An 8-speed automatic gearbox with auto start-stop tech is offered, although there is also a 6-speed manual available that will likely never be shipped here by local dealers. In addition, all the tech features offered in the 5-Series seems to be offered in the 3-Series as well, including variable steering, dynamic damper control, brake energy regeneration, iDrive computer, heads-up display, surround-view cameras, parking assistant and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, seatbelt pretensioners, optional automatic braking and more.

The Carnival, also known as Grand Carnival or Sedona in some markets, is undoubtedly Kia's largest non-commercial vehicle, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. Powered by a 3.8-litre V6, it comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The Infiniti Q70 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

The 2018 GAC GS8 is the Chinese brand's midsize SUV offering. The body of the GS8 is made completely of 95% high-strength steel to meet the North American SUV roof anti-force standard. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The 2018 GAC GS8 is available as a front wheel drive or four wheel drive. Standard features in the 2018 GAC GS8 includes power steering, power windows, power folding side mirrors, rain sensing wipers, HID auto headlights, LED tail-lamps, front and rear fog lamps, 10-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with 6 speakers, Bluetooth, USB port, steering wheel with audio and phone controls, sunroof, rear view camera system, front and rear parking sensors, keyless entry, smart key and button starter, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get engine start stop, LED auto headlights, interior ambient lighting, side mirror memory function, navigation, 10 speakers, panoramic sunroof, wireless charging and 19-inch alloy wheels. The 2018 GAC GS8 integrates intelligent driving assistance such as a 9th-generation extreme edition of ESP (Electronic Stability Program), an optional 360-degree panorama visual imaging system, an optional ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) system and standard eight airbags. Other safety features in the 2018 GAC GS8 include ABS, hill start assist and hold control, hill descent control, and optional lane change assist system.

Porsche introduced this generation of the 911 model series as a new model, even though it looks almost identical to the older one. The GT3 and GT3 RS get a further upgraded version of the 3.8-litre engine. It is available only with a 6-speed manual transmission. Additional new features include front and rear LED driving lights, bi-xenon headlights, dynamic cornering lights, and a mild overall facelift. Interior features include a CD stereo, leather upholstery, optional multimedia system, common power accessories and more. Safety includes multiple airbags, stability control, ABS and traction control.

The Cadenza near-luxury full-size sedan is part of the Korean manufacturer's revamped range, and among the first Kia models to feature the new corporate design theme. The conservative-yet-handsome front-wheel-drive sedan replaces the Opirus, and comes with a new 3.5-litre V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox with manual shift capability. Features, standard or otherwise, include a CD/MP3 stereo with six JBL speakers and iPod/USB support, 6-disc CD changer, cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes.

The GMC Terrain got a minor facelift in 2016. There is a choice of two engines, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.6-litre V6, both featuring "SIDI" direct injection, a 6-speed automatic, and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior features ambient lighting, clever storage spaces, a closed compartment under the center armrest for a notebook binder, four power outlets, optional power liftgate, basic keyless entry with optional remote start, single-zone a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB support, optional 8-speaker premium audio with available 10GB hard drive with DVD and navigation, optional DVD rear-seat entertainment with two screens, optional power driver's seat, standard rear camera, optional sunroof, common power accessories, cloth or leather upholstery, and a choice of 17-inch, 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels. A Denali version was offered from 2013, with a chrome grille and some additional chrome trim. Safety features include stability control, traction control, six standard airbags and ABS disc brakes.

The Kyron is this Korean carmaker's entry into the hotly-contested traditional soft-roader category, only they do it with a real 4WD using truck underpinnings and low-range gearing. Two adults will have no trouble fitting in either front or second row. Behind them is plenty of room for their luggage too. The bench seat also folds down nearly flat to accommodate big, awkward loads like bicycles. The weak part is the 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. The drive system offers a choice of two-wheel drive, four-wheel high, or four-wheel low. The suspension utilizes double wishbones at the front and a multilink design at the rear. Available electronic aids include ABS, hill descent control, traction control, and brake assist. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in two different lengths. In 2019, a new generation model came out . It is capable of a 650 kg payload. All the models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with USB, AUX and Bluetooth, manual a/c and single-side sliding door. Safety features include 2 airbags in the front, ABS, EBD, ESC tire pressure monitor, hill assist and rear parking sensors.

The Accord is of one the best midsize sedans available. It does everything well and is popular for doing so. It may not be best in class for every little thing, but it is more of an all-round package than its competitors. There are two engines, the standard 2.4-litre four-cylinder with a manual or automatic, and the optional 3.0-litre V6 with an automatic only. The popular sedans are great everyday cars with comfort and convenience features. Available optional features include cruise control, power locks, keyless entry, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD), in-dash six-CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, leather upholstery, a power glass sunroof, side mirrors with integrated turn signals, and VSA stability control. Safety is enhanced on all Accords by available side-impact and curtain airbags, in addition to the required dual front airbags. Anti-lock brakes (ABS) with Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD) come standard. All V6 models come with Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) and Brake Assist with traction control.

An all-new Lincoln Navigator debuted for 2018, still a rebodied version of the new-for-2018 Ford Expedition. The new Navigator makes extensive use of high-strength aluminium-alloy to lose weight while offering more space inside. Power continues to be provided by an uprated twin-turbo V6 and mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, similar to the Ford F-150 Raptor. The top model is known as the Signature. Inside, both front seats feature heating/cooling/massaging functions and are adjustable in 30 ways. Rear seats have a recline function. Available rear-seat entertainment features include 10-inch adjustable screens. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are part of the standard SYNC 3 touchscreen system, along with navigation, Bluetooth, phone, etc. A total of 20 speakers with the optional Revel II audio system can create distinct listening modes including audience, on-stage, and stereo. A Lincoln “welcome mat” will illuminate on the ground beneath the front doors, and the Lincoln star badge in the grille lights up too. Other available notable features include powered side-steps, heads-up display, customisable LCD gauge cluster and USB ports for the power-adjustable third row. Safety features are extensive, with a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, al-round parking sensors with cameras and all that.

The Rexton II is the latest version Ssangyong's attractive original Rexton. It was launched in the Middle East alongside two other now-defunct 4WDs back in 2002, and has survived with a facelift for 2007. The five-door Rexton can seat up to seven people and comes with a host of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, fake wood trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control is also available.

The Optima is a credible entry into the midsize field. Not as big as the usual Japanese models, it still offers good interior space and a comfortable drive. This front-wheel-drive offers much improved quality over previous Kia creations, and its derivative actually looks pleasant. Powered by either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, or a respectable 2.7-litre V6 with a 5-speed automatic, both cars offer a fair bit of standard equipment. Available features, standard or otherwise, include basic air-conditioning, glass-integrated antenna, AM/FM radio cassette player with CD and MP3 capability, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, luggage net hook and luggage net for the spacious trunk, optional electric sunroof, keyless entry with alarm, cloth or leather seats, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, dual power mirrors, power windows, front fog lamps, battery saver, 60/40 split-folding rear seat and 16-inch alloy wheels.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in two versions currently. The Maybach 57 is the shorter wheelbase model, which is still very large, and this body style comes in either standard 57 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in 57 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. Both models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems.

The Honda Accord has been redesigned for the 2015 model. No changes were made for the 2016 model year. The base engine is a new 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with direct injection, mated to a CVT, so gets a slight bump in horsepower and torque. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. Standard features on the base 2.4 LX model include electric power steering, power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows and mirrors, LED front running lamps and tail lights, 16-inch alloy wheels, dual exhaust tips, manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, cruise control, cloth upholstery, ABS, floor mats, stability control and hill-start assist, as does all other trim levels. In certain markets, it is additionally offered with a sunroof, 17-inch aluminium wheels, and a touchscreen control panel for multimedia functions. The 2.4 EX sedan further adds front fog lights, power-folding mirrors, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, leather seats, leather steering wheel, power rear sunshade, smart keyless entry and start, auto-dimming mirror, rear parking sensors and a power driver's seat. The 2.4 EX sedan can be upgraded with navigation, rear camera, "i-Dual" a/c, 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, USB/AUX ports, and a power-adjustable passenger seat. The 3.5 EX sedan adds the V6 engine and transmission, wooden steering wheel, rear-side window sunshades, full LED headlights, and a new feature called "LaneWatch" that adds a camera under the right-side mirror to visually monitor your right blindspot. The 3.5 Sport sedan additionally gets 18-inch alloys, little paddle-shifters, and leather steering. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips. All trim levels get front, side and side curtain aribags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA) and traction control system.

The second-generation Peugeot 308 was released in 2014, but only went on sale in the GCC in 2015. The same  is turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The LX 470 offers luxurious comfort with outstanding off-road capability, but it is so obviously based on the Toyota Land Cruiser that few both to upgrade to this Lexus version. The eight-seater LX 470 is powered by a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a five-speed automatic transmission. The LX is available as one fully loaded model, with full-time four-wheel drive, a locking center differential and four-wheel traction control. It also comes with an adaptive suspension with variable-rate damping and adjustable height control, and big tyres on 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard is a leather interior, automatic climate control front and rear, power seats, door locks, windows and moonroof, a DVD-based navigation system, reverse camera, keyless entry and a Mark Levinson stereo system with a six-disc DVD/CD auto changer, automatic sound leveling and a separate rear-seat controls. Active safety features include Vehicle Stability Control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as six airbags.

The Lincoln MKZ made its comeback in the GCC as a 2014 model year, with a major frontal facelift and new engine coming in 2017. The MKZ comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine or a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters. The 2.0T comes in front-wheel-drive form while the 3.0T comes with all-wheel-drive for the GCC market. The MKZ will be available with SYNC3 and MyLincoln Touch as standard, along with large 10.1-inch LCD instrument cluster and an 8-inch centre touchscreen. Options include a huge opening panoramic glass roof. As for safety, there is a mono-vision camera integrated into the rearview mirror to read lane markers on the road. It will be complemented by radar sensors for the adaptive cruise control and active Collision Warning with Brake Support. Also included are wide-angle radar sensors for help with parking and backing up. It also has inflatable second-row seatbelts and eight airbags.

JAC M5 is the Chinese brand's large minivan offering. It features a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, trip computer, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 7-inch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system, rearview camera, folding mirrors. leather seats and xenon headlamps. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes, brake assist (BA) and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

Named after Mitsubishi's famed now-dead sports car, the Eclipse Cross is an economical crossover with no sporting pretensions beyond its sharply sloping rear roofline. Powered by a 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, the Eclipse Cross seats five and is based on the Outlander platform, just like the brand's ASX crossover. The rear seat reclines and slides front-back as needed, to increase legroom or boot space. It has the all modern amenities available, such as power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry and start, multimedia screen, and more. It rides on a choice of 16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor and dual front with optional side-curtain airbags.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its third facelift for the 2016 model-year. It remains the same for 2020. The exterior and interior both get a major overhaul. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Lexus IS debuted as an all-new sedan in 2007, and has received a very minor facelift as well as new versions to choose from in 2011. The facelift includes the addition of LED running lights and redone tail lamps. The carryover GCC-specific with the 3.0-litre V6 and 6-speed automatic continues in the IS 300 sedan. An IS 250 sedan with a 2.5-litre V6 and 6-speed automatic newly joined the range as a base model, but was dropped by the end of 2012. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof, ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

The McLaren 570GT Coupe is a more tamed road-trip-friendly variant of the 570S. It gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 motor mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570GT sports a side opening cargo hatch above the mid-mounted engine for additional cargo space, and has slightly softer suspension, whilst offering better sound insulation. As with the 570S, it benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. But unlike the 570S, carbon ceramic brakes are missing in the 570GT. Features include a 7-inch portrait touchscreen infotainment navigation system, smart keyless entry and push-start button, 3 USB ports, LED headlights with LED running lamps and tails, power windows and mirrors, a detailed LCD gauge cluster, non-opening panoramic glass roof and memory seats. Safety features include front, side and knee airbags, ABS, ESP, parking sensors and a rear camera awkwardly placed close to the ground.

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the MDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, roof rack, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power seats with lumbar support, 3 rows for 7 seaters, 3-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 12 speakers, DVD player with Dolby Pro Logic II (PL2)/MP3/WMA/USB/AUX support & 100 GD hard-disk, handsfree telephone with voice recognition, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard. The higher model gets adaptive cruise control, premium MILANO leather and bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the MDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), traction control, hill-start assist and trailer stability assist. The higher model gets additional blind spot information, crash mitigation brake system & forward collision warning system.

The Compass is an all-new compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that throws Jeep's off-road reputation out the window. It is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. The windshield is steeply raked and the lower than that of a traditional 4WD, but it comes with sculpted fenders, standard 17-inch wheels or optional 18-inch wheels, and a simulated locking differential. The Compass is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine with either a standard 5-speed manual transmission or an optional second-generation CVT automatic transmission. The Compass Limited with CVT offers the AutoStick feature that allows drivers to control the transmission manually so that it simulates a 6-speed gearbox. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control, fog lights and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, and power features.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. The engines remain the same though, with minor updates, so the base Boxster is powered by a 2.7-litre flat-6 and the Boxster S gets a 3.4-litre flat-6, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Lotus Evora is the British manufacturer's first offering of combining superb race track handling with everyday practicality. There are two models to choose from, the Evora and Evora S. The Evora comes with a Toyota-sourced 3.5-litre V6 engine, whereas the Evora S gets the same engine, but supercharged. Both model engines are mated to either a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual transmission. The mid-engined Evora has a 2+2 configuration, although the back seats can be used for storage purposes than anything else. Standard options include central door locking, flat bottomed magnesium steering wheel trimmed in leather, leather gear knob, leather handbrake sleeve, bespoke aluminium illuminated control knobs and switches, power windows, remote release glove box, door storage bins and integrated cup holders, Alpine CD/MP3/WMA receiver, and Lotus command centre with auxiliary trip computer and vehicle monitoring displays. It comes with standard 18-inch alloy wheels and optional 19-inch/20-inch alloys with wider tyres. Additional packages can be added. The Tech Pack offers Alpine multi-media in car entertainment system with 7" WVGA touch screen, bluetooth connectivity, satellite navigation, tyre pressure monitoring, cruise control, rear parking sensors. The Sport Pack offers switchable sports mode with sharper throttle response, increased rpm limit and sports traction control setting, sports diffuser, titanium sports exhaust tailpipe, cross drilled brake discs, engine oil cooler and black painted brake callipers. The Premium Pack offers accent lighting, upgraded interior trim, centre arm-rest and further extensive use of premium grade leathers. Further options include electric power-fold door mirrors, xenon headlights, Alpine Imprint dynamic audio EQ system , reversing camera and body colour door handles.

The Cadillac CTS got a redesign for the 2014 model year. The base engine is now a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, coupled with 6-speed automatic transmission. The 3.6-litre V6 is still there, with a new 8-speed automatic. A new CTS VSport variant joins the lineup later, with a twin turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The Mercedes-Benz G500 is fitted with 5.5-litre V8 engine and is now been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission.
