Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Audi Q5 is the compact class offering in the VW-owned German manufacturer's SUV range. In 2018, an all-new model was released. Under the hood, the only engine on offer is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor, mated to an 7-speed automatic transmission. It is available with the all-wheel-drive "Quattro" system, and will be available with the Audi 'Drive-Select' system to change its settings. While exterior does not have a whole lot of changes from its predecessor, the interior has been fully revamped. It also weighs less than the previous generation. Features include LED running lights and taillights, alloy wheels of up to 20 inches in size, seating for five with folding rear bench and a foldable front seat, and the usual power accessories. The Q5 will be available in several different trim options, including an 'S-Line' trim option with aggressive body mouldings and mesh foglight grills. Other available features, whether standard or optional, include a roof load sensor to adjust the stability control for the higher centre of gravity, rearview camera, navigation, high-beam assistant that automatically switches between the high and low beams, blind-spot monitor, adaptive cruise control, triple-zone climate control, intelligent keyless entry, electric parking brake, multiple airbags, MMI multimedia with speech control system, Bluetooth telephone and Apple CarPlay

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. In 2018 it received a facelift and some power upgrades. There is no more V6 engine offered, with only 2.3-litre turbo and the V8 engines carrying over. All engines can be had with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a new 10-speed automatic transmission. The interior gets the MyFord infotainment system with SYNC 3. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features on the 2022 Ford Mustang Convertible include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Hyundai i40 is a midsize station wagon. A basic, mid-range and top model are sold here. All the models get the same 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, steel wheels, AM/FM radio and CD player with MP3 playback capability and six speakers. Available features, standard on higher trim levels, include parking sensors and alloy wheels. The rear seat backrests feature a 60:40 split, so you can still carry the luggage plus a rear seat passenger or two. If more space is required, rear seat backrests fold flat into the floor while the floor rail system helps keep your luggage secured.

The Suzuki Vitara is a completely new model, making its debut in the GCC in 2016. Smaller, lighter and losing its offroad capabilities, the new Vitara is designed to compete in the road-going crossover segment and is a separate vehicle line from the existing Grand Vitara. It is only available as a 5-door wagon, and gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available in both two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive. In the UAE, two trims are available, the GLX and GLX+, all of which come with automatic transmission as standard. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, central locking, keyless push start system, sunroof, LED daytime running lamps, leather seats, cruise control,  automatic A/C, roof rails, front & rear parking sensors, front skid plate, chrome front grille and alloy wheels. The higher GLX+ model gets panoramic roof and polished aluminium wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ABS and brake assist.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City. It is slightly larger in every dimension, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Fiat 500X is the Italian brand's sub-compact SUV offering. For 2019 it got a facelift and only the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is offered, with front-wheel drive and all-wheel drive configurations, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base "Popstar" model gets power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, fog lights, manual A/C, cruise control, radio with 5-inch touch screen and Bluetooth/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, tow hook and alloy wheels. The "Lounge" model gets a sunroof, automatic AC, leather seats, better quality stereo system and paddle shifters. Safety features include front,side and side head airbags, traction control, vehicle dynamic control, hill holder and electronic roll mitigation system.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received a new face and other minor styling updates for 2009. The minivan attempts to resemble a 4WD in height, with a high waistline and four forward-opening doors, but it ends up looking like a van. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a manual or automatic. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include a cassette/MP3/CD player with 6 speakers, dual-zone a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The big van rides on comparatively tiny 15-inch alloy wheels. New features added in 2009 include rear parking sensors and an in-dash CD changer. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Continental GT is the first new model to come out of the Bentley since it separated from Rolls-Royce under VW ownership. The Continental is smaller and less expensive than any past Bentley, but it still remains out of reach for pretty much anyone who doesn't have a seven-figure bank account. It is also their first model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the ill-received VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental coupe is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GT Speed coupe for 2008 adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling. Also introduced in 2009 is the Continental GT Supersports with even more power and capable of running on both petrol and biofuel. The Supersports had a more aggressive exterior, while mechanically it had revised suspension settings to make it more sporty, bigger ceramic brakes and an automatic retractable spoiler.

The H3 is the smallest addition to the Hummer line-up. Based on the Chevrolet Trailblazer platform, it is a midsized, five-passenger 4WD wagon that carries the military design cues and off-road capabilities of the Hummer H1, but puts them in a smaller and ultimately more affordable package. For 2009, a pickup version with a longer wheelbase was added, dubbed the H3T, which can fit a dirt-bike or two in its sizeable bed. The H3 and the H3T provide a good level of off-roading equipment, with some luxury features to boot, and at a very good price. All models come with a 3.7-litre five-cylinder engine, with a standard 5-speed manual or an optional 4-speed automatic. The 5.3-litre V8 engine finally became available in the summer of 2009 for the H3 wagon, mated to a 4-speed automatic. The H3 delivers serious off-road capability, with low-range gearing and good ground clearance. The base price includes cloth seating for five, power windows and locks, remote keyless entry, a CD audio system, cruise control and all-terrain tyres on 16-inch wheels. Safety features include ABS brakes, traction control, frontal and side-impact airbags and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. Special features on the V8 Alpha model include a unique calibration for the ABS brakes in 4-Low mode, a rear axle is set to a 4.10 ratio compared with the previous 4.56, a standard rear-view camera system, and stability control designed to assist with hill starts. Options include leather seating, chrome wheels, in-dash six-CD changer, navigation, a power sunroof and more.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

The Kyron is this Korean carmaker's entry into the hotly-contested traditional soft-roader category, only they do it with a real 4WD using truck underpinnings and low-range gearing. Two adults will have no trouble fitting in either front or second row. Behind them is plenty of room for their luggage too. The bench seat also folds down nearly flat to accommodate big, awkward loads like bicycles. The weak part is the 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine. The engine is mated to a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. The drive system offers a choice of two-wheel drive, four-wheel high, or four-wheel low. The suspension utilizes double wishbones at the front and a multilink design at the rear. Available electronic aids include ABS, hill descent control, traction control, and brake assist. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags.

The Chevrolet Traverse received a facelift for 2013. It is a crossover wagon that combines the functionality of a minivan with the look of an SUV, offering three rows of seating for up to eight passengers. The design consists of polished aluminium roof rails, projector beam headlights, LED taillights and a rear spoiler. It has a 3.6-litre V6 with variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, with either front-wheel-drive or optional all-wheel-drive system with no low range. The interior features a "low and away" instrument panel and a Smart Slide second-row feature allows easier access to the third row. Features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with six speakers, electric mirrors, keyless entry and more. Optional features include 6.5 inches touch screen for navigation, entertainment and display vehicle information, rear-seat DVD entertainment, HID headlights, sunroof, parking sensors, leather seats, tri-zone climate control and more. Standard safety features includes StabiliTrak stability control system with rollover mitigation technology, six airbags and a tyre-pressure-monitoring system. Also standard is power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering, 18-inch wheels with optional 19-inchers, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. From 2017, a derivation of the GTC4Lusso, namely the GTC4Lusso T was offered. The GTC4Lusso T differentiates itself from the GTC4Lusso with a rear-wheel-drive layout, and being powered by Ferrari’s 3.9-litre V8 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission, whilst retaining the electronic rear differential and all-wheel-steering system. Other features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128GB in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays and more.

The F-150 delivers all the manly attributes of toughness, strength, and imposing size, although it is largely sold here as a fashion statement for tiny men. Redesigned for 2009 and updated in 2011, the fully-loaded F-150 crew-cab is sold here as more of a lifestyle vehicle, offering interior design and comfort that would rival some luxury cars. Properly equipped, it can haul more than a tonne in its bed. The F-150 is comfortable as well, with a quiet and refined ride. It comes with dual front and side airbags, cloth or leatherette seats, CD/MP3 stereo, and air conditioning as standard. Other available features include an optional 4.2-inch LCD screen, hill descent control, electronic locking differential settings and stability control. A host of power and luxury options are available too. For all these reasons, the F-150 has been America's best-selling full-size pickup for nearly 30 consecutive years. It is the most most profitable vehicle Ford makes. It is available in various trim levels, variations, and specialty models, including quad cab, single cab and dual cab model, with various bed sizes. New engines redefined the line-up for 2011, with a new 3.7-litre V6 and a new 5.0-litre V8, both from the Mustang, and fitted with automatic transmissions and a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive. The top version is called the Platinum, while a special Harley-Davidson trim is also available. The F-150 SVT Raptor also became available on special-order, in 6.2-litre V8 form, and identifiable by its unique body mods and aggressive offroad suspension.

The Grand Cherokee was all-new for the 2006 model year, and for 2008, it has been updated with a new front end, HID headlights with integrated turn lenses and new 17-inch and 18-inch wheels. Interior updates include a new centre console and a four-gauge instrument cluster with LED illumination. The new base engine is a 3.7-litre V6. It also continues with an upgraded 4.7-litre V8, a carryover 5.7-litre Hemi V8 and an SRT-exclusive 6.1-litre V8. Cloth upholstery is standard, as are power windows, power locks with remote keyless entry, eight-way power driver's seat,  CD audio, driver information center, 60/40 split folding rear seat, and available parking sensors. All models offer full-time four-wheel drive, with low-range gearing. Higher models get leather upholstery, Boston Acoustics six-speaker six-CD changer and MP3 capability, power adjustable pedals, power front seats, rain-sensing automatic wipers, electrochromic rearview mirror, tyre pressure monitor with display, adjustable roof rack crossrails, and more.  The fancy Overland model adds real wood accents on the doors and console, two-tone leather and ultra-suede seats, leather-covered console and armrest, reverse-parking sensor and more. The rocket-like SRT-8 gets stiff suspension for the road, but gives up its off-road ability. Safety features include a stability system with roll mitigation, ABS brakes with brake assist, traction control, and numerous airbags.

The Ferrari California T replaces the California, the T signifying the turbocharged 3.9-litre V8 engine it now  gets, which is mated to and improved 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox and rear-wheel-drive. The car also gets a new front fascia that was influenced by the F12, a revised rear and a revised interior. Another improvement to the car is the reduction of emission pollution by 15% compared to its naturally aspirated predecessor. The car also utilizes small turbos and a variable boost management system to create no turbo lag. Focused slightly more on comfort than on track prowess, the F149-designated California comes with a customisable leather-clad cabin, CD stereo with LCD multimedia screen, and a multi-function steering wheel with starter button and driving-mode selection. It seats only two and has a shelf behind the seats along with a useable luggage trunk, as well as all the usual power accessories, airbags and electronic safety nannies. The Ferrari California is also equipped with the exclusive F1-Trac traction control system. Brembo brakes featuring carbon-ceramic material discs are standard.

The Audi A3 Sedan is the German brand's sub-compact sedan offering. It will be available with two engine choices, either a 1.4-litre or a 1.8-litre, both of which are 4-cylinder and turbocharged units. While the 1.4-litre is only available in front-wheel drive format, the 1.8-litre can be had with all-wheel drive. The front-wheel drive versions get a 7-speed DSG automatic transmissions and the all-wheel drive model gets the 6-speed DSG. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The BMW i8 is a plug-in hybrid coupe powered by a high-performance electric motor in the front, which drives the front axle, and a mid-mounted turbocharged 3-cylinder 1.5-litre petrol engine powering the rear wheels. In 2019, it got a slight facelift and a bigger battery, giving it a small bump up in horsepower. The petrol engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic, while the electric motor is attached to a 2-stage automatic transmission. On electricity alone, the i8 can travel about 30 Km, before the petrol engine has to intervene and recharge the batteries. Another interesting feature is the car's ability to switch between front-wheel-drive, rear-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. But that very well depends on driver mood and more importantly, the existing electric juice. The i8 features a perfect 50:50 weight distribution, which BMW claims to have achieved using lightweight materials like carbon-fibre and aluminium. Safety standards are high in the i8 as the DSC (Dynamic Stability Control) system includes the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS), Cornering Brake Control (CBC), Dynamic Brake Control (DBC), Brake Assist, Brake Standby, Brake Drying function, Start-Off Assistant, Fading Compensation, Active Differential Brake (ADB-x), Driving dynamic impellent torque pre-control, E-Traction, as well as the push button-activated Dynamic Traction Control (DTC) mode. Front airbags and side airbags integrated into the seat backrests, plus head/curtain airbags for both rows of seats, are all fitted as standard, as are three-point inertia-reel seatbelts including belt tensioners and belt force limiters for all seats.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Mildly facelifted for 2009, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. Versions for the latest incarnation include the upgraded 5.5-litre G 500 and the 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Standard specification includes permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Mini is a thrill ride that offers extremely excellent handling, enough to kill exotic cars at twisty tracks. It is also one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a amount of cargo. Its cute looks still generates smiles years after its introduction. Engineered by BMW, the Mini is a high-quality piece of equipment, boasting a multitude of passive and active safety systems. Convertibles were added to the lineup for 2005 and lasted till 2007. All models were enhanced then with new interior lighting, storage space and trim options, plus revised styling. Models include the Cooper and the supercharged Cooper S, but the base Mini One has been cancelled. The Cooper also comes in Seven, Checkmate and Park Lane trims. All use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, but the S uses a supercharger. Gearbox choices include a manual, CVT and automatic. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, along with a number of airbags. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works package that bumps up horsepower, and a Sport package that offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The Carnival, also known as Grand Carnival or Sedona in some markets, is undoubtedly Kia's largest non-commercial vehicle, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. Powered by a 3.8-litre V6, it comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

An all-new Lincoln Navigator debuted for 2018, still a rebodied version of the new-for-2018 Ford Expedition. The new Navigator makes extensive use of high-strength aluminium-alloy to lose weight while offering more space inside. Power continues to be provided by an uprated twin-turbo V6 and mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, similar to the Ford F-150 Raptor. The top model is known as the Signature. Inside, both front seats feature heating/cooling/massaging functions and are adjustable in 30 ways. Rear seats have a recline function. Available rear-seat entertainment features include 10-inch adjustable screens. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are part of the standard SYNC 3 touchscreen system, along with navigation, Bluetooth, phone, etc. A total of 20 speakers with the optional Revel II audio system can create distinct listening modes including audience, on-stage, and stereo. A Lincoln “welcome mat” will illuminate on the ground beneath the front doors, and the Lincoln star badge in the grille lights up too. Other available notable features include powered side-steps, heads-up display, customisable LCD gauge cluster and USB ports for the power-adjustable third row. Safety features are extensive, with a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, al-round parking sensors with cameras and all that.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

The Subaru WRX STi  was all-new in 2015 and got a minor facelift for 2018. It is available only as a sedan. Under the hood, it gets a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler. It is coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission as standard. It is 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, traction control, stability control and ABS.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 and received very small changes for the 2011 model year. Under the hood, it is still powered by the high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Chinese Tiggo received a facelift for its 2014 model year. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, and comes with a 4-speed automatic transmission. The five-door five-seater Tiggo gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling.

The Getz, new in 2003 and facelifted in 2006, is known for offering "European" levels of refinement. We feel it is let down only by its weak range of engines, namely a tiny 1.1-litre, followed by a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all four-cylinder units, some with a manual gearbox and others with an automatic. This front-wheel-drive hatchback comes standard with very little, but includes air-conditioning, a rear wiper with washer, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, and wind-up windows. Options in the higher trim levels include power steering, ABS brakes, a single airbag, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, sunroof, rear spoiler, fog lamps, keyless entry system, a radio and cassette player and fake carbon-fibre trim. The interior is well-made, with good materials. It is not too cramped inside either, with seating for five and decent legroom both front and back. All trim levels come with a cloth cabin and a useful rear luggage area with a lift-up tailgate. Small 14-inch steel wheels with plastic hubcaps.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Facelifted inside and out for 2008, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight, even with the power upgrade for 2008. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

The Tata Indica is an outdated hatchback first launched in India back in 1998, and on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica is considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger car. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The all-new Kia Stinger came out as a 2018 model year and is the Korean brand's grand tourer model on offer. Under the hood, the 2021 Kia Stinger gets two engine choices - the standard engine is a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and the higher option is the 3.3-litre turbocharged V6 unit. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The 2021 Kia Stinger comes as rear-wheel drive standard and optional all-wheel-drive. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, remote locking, central locking, leather seats, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include real leather upholstery, 8-inch screen with navigation, 19-inch alloy wheels, heads up display, ventilated front seats and remote start. Safety features in the 2021 Kia Stinger include front, side and knee airbags, ABS, ESP, traction control and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monition, front collision warning, parking distance warning front and back and rear cross-traffic alert.

The Avalanche has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The new-for-2008 Avalanche gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Avalanche, with better fuel economy to boot. The aging Hydra-Matic 4L60-E four-speed automatic transmission transfers power to the ground, either through the rear wheels or through all four wheels when 4WD is engaged. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as stability control and ABS brakes. On the road, the long-wheelbase Avalanche is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. Versions include the Avalanche Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension and other accessories.

The Infiniti G37 Convertible convertible with a folding hard-top debuted in early 2010. The sedan then received a frontal facelift for 2011. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. It is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

This generation of the popular S-Class debuted in 2006, and was facelifted for 2010 with a mildly different grille, a revised bumper and optional LED marker lights. Almost all models offered in the GCC are the long-wheelbase version, which include the S 350 L, the S 500 L and the S 600 L, all with automatic gearboxes. A new entry-level S 300 short=wheelbase model and an S 400 HYBRID model both debuted for 2010, while the S 500 4MATIC all-wheel-drive model is also now offered in the GCC. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Options include a reversing camera, panoramic sunroof, AMG bodystyling and either 19-inch or 20-inch light-alloy wheels.

PGO proclaims itself to be a 'French automobile craftsman' to highlight their hand-crafted aspect and small-scale production. The range expands from the Speedster II with the addition of the CÃ©vennes. Both share the same technical foundation and differ only in style, with the CÃ©vennes looking more modern with restyled bumpers and trim. Indeed, the overall styling is still based on the 1950s Porsche 356. However, it is powered by a recent 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Peugeot engine, with no additional tuning. The rear-mounted motor is mated to a rear-wheel-drive platform and a choice of 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. While the car is very basic and very expensive, customisation options offer 15 paintjobs, 8 soft-top colours, 14 types of leather and 10 types of carpet. Standard features include a basic a/c, power windows, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with 2 speakers, keyless entry, electric mirrors, black manual soft top and a set of eight instrumentation gauges. Options include chrome wheels, two-tone leather, CD changer, alarm and more.

The Ferrari 812 Superfast replaced the F12 Berlinetta and is the fastest naturally aspirated model they have ever produced at the time. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Electric power steering was introduced in this model. The car also saw the introduction of the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Ford Focus ST got a facelift for its 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder EcoBoost engine, mated to a 6-speed manual. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, cruise control with speed limiter, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights and LED tail lamps. The Focus ST hatchback also gets a body kit, Recaro seats, sports suspension and an overboost feature for extra torque when needed. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The Korean-built Captiva, originally GM's first proper entry into the softroader market, received a facelift in 2011, along with a change in engines and cabin design. On offer is a choice of two powertrains, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder in either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive form, and a 3.0-litre V6 with direct-injection and all-wheel-drive. All models get a new 6-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, standard power windows and mirrors, seating for seven, 4-speaker or 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c and keyless entry. There are four trim levels, with the top LTZ model getting optional 19-inch alloy wheels, single-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, 8-speaker stereo with AUX port and CD changer, optional fog lamps, electronic parking brake, cloth or leather upholstery, optional Bluetooth, chrome door handles, optional sunroof and optional parking sensors. Safety features include dual front airbags with optional side airbags, standard ABS, and optional traction control, stability control, hill-descent control and hydraulic brake assist.

The Fiat Linea is a compact sedan, targeted mainly to sell as a fleet model. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. Available in three trim levels, features in the basic model include 15-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, power steering, CD stereo, manual a/c with rear ducts, body-coloured bumpers, cloth upholstery, trip computer, dual front airbags and ABS. The mid-range model adds 15-inch alloy wheels, 60/40-split rear seats, rear headrests, rear power windows,, electric mirrors, extra storage pockets and additional external trim. The top model gets 16-inch alloys, steering-mounted controls, Bluetooth, USB-port, electric driver's seat, rear sun blinds, extra chrome trim, front/rear armrests, automatic a/c with rear vents, side airbags, rear parking sensors, fog lights and more. Optional equipment include leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, auto-dimming mirror, auto headlights, 17-inch alloys, even more chrome trim and several other features.

A throwback to 50 years ago, the Ford Crown Victoria is a full-size sedan, cheap to buy, and as dull as a doormat in most cases. But Ford's largest sedan still has many virtues, including affordable V8 performance, rear-wheel-drive handling and tons of room. The Crown Victoria's passenger and cargo room is comparable to many 4WDs. The Crown Victoria is popular for its safety, roominess, pleasant ride quality, quiet interior, simple controls and massive road presence. Ford substantially updated the Crown Victoria back in 2003. A stiffer chassis provided front frame sections designed to better absorb crash energy. Handling precision was improved, thanks to more precise rack-and-pinion steering and an extensive redesign of the front and rear suspension. In 2004, Ford has made changes to the transmission for better acceleration. Powered by a 4.6-litre V8, the base Crown Victoria comes standard with ABS, power windows, power door locks, power mirrors, an eight-way power adjustable driver's seat, tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and more. An optional sports package bumps up the horsepower and adds firmer suspension.

The first product from the takeover of Chrysler by Daimler-Benz was the Crossfire, a stylish sports coupe that rides on the old Mercedes-Benz SLK platform, while sharing many of its components with other Mercedes models, and built in Germany too. The Crossfire has a long hood with streaks on it, while the fastback roofline ends with a "boat tail." The car also has a centre spine that runs the length of the car, from the grille in front to between the dual, centre-mounted rear exhausts. The Crossfire's stance is enhanced by rear tyres that are larger than those in front, and by its broad shoulders, tall body sides and minimal glass area. The car's central spine reappears as an element in the car's interior design. The car's two bucket seats are trimmed in two-tone leather. Gauges have white-on-black faces with metallic bezels and chrome trim rings, while the centre console has a metallic look too. Other features for the two-seat coupe include a speed-activated rear spoiler and six-speaker audio system with dual subwoofers. By now, it would seem like the Crossfire is more of a design exercise than an attempt to build a true sports car. This is confirmed by the old 3.2-litre V6 that doesn't pull the car with enough verve.

The Logan has been around in Europe since 2004 under the Dacia brand name, with the distinction of being the cheapest car in Europe, but has recently spread its wings and is now built in at least five developing countries. For the GCC, there is only one trim level for now that comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Also standard are front power windows, rear wind-up windows, power steering, cloth seats, 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, a Blaupunkt CD stereo, a manual a/c and one airbag. The Logan aims for the lowest end of the new car market without actually being too small, offering a reasonably spacious 5-seater cabin and a hard-plastic interior that goes for durability and simplicity rather than outright cushiness and aesthetics. Being a front-wheel-drive European car, it also comes with a well-tuned suspension setup that favours handling while also retaining a fair degree of ride comfort. Models with more optional features are expected later.

The Infiniti Q70 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. Available with a 3.7-litre V6 or with a 5.6-litre V8, all the rear-wheel-drive cars feature a 7-speed automatic, with optional paddle shifters. There are three versions of the 3.7-litre Q70 available, namely Excellence, Luxury and Sport; and two of the 5.6-litre, called Luxury and Sport. Some markets, such as the UAE, have only the V6 model available, in limited trim levels. Available features, depending on trim level, include "˜Infiniti Drive' which has four different settings for the throttle delivery and power mapping; Bose Surround Sound CD/MP3 stereo with iPod connectivity, DVD navigation, 9.3GB hard drive and speakers even in the front seats; rear-wheel active steering with Sport models; adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights, 18-inch or 20-inch wheels, rear camera with front and rear parking sensors, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry and start, power-adjustable ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic a/c with optional 'forest air' setting, leather upholstery with choice of wood trim, full power accessories and more. Sport models get aluminium pedals and magnesium paddle shifters. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, pre-crash automatic braking, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, intelligent brake assist, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor, and seat-belts that become tighter on hard braking.

The Fluence is an all-new budget model from Renault, built in Korea and designed for Eastern-European and Middle-Eastern markets. Sized somewhere between a compact and a midsize, it is value-priced and can be loaded with up with respectable features. Powered by a weak 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, this front-wheel-drive sedan can be had with either a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic. A 2.0-litre model comes later with a CVT. Standard features include variable electric power steering, anti-theft alarm, adjustable steering wheel, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 player, manual a/c and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher models can be specced up with a Arkamys or Bose stereo, USB/iPod ports, Bluetooth, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, auto headlights, keyless start button, dual-zone automatic a/c, fog lamps, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof and more. Standard safety features include ABS-assisted front disc and rear drum brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution, two front airbags and seatbelt pre-tensioners, with optional features such as stability control and side-curtain airbags.

The C 63 AMG model is the sports model of the C-Class range. The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG comes with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. The centre console comes with an electronic rotary switch for selecting the four transmission modes and the race start function. The sports seats are optionally available in single-tone or two-tone designo leather. In 2013, a special "Edition 507" version was offered, with black wheels and an upgraded engine. The C 63 AMG comes with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. In 2009, a removable roof model was added to the lineup, called the Veyron Grand Sport. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ertiga is a seven-seater minivan offering from the Japanese brand. The front-wheel drive people carrier features a 1.4-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ertiga include power steering, AM/FM radio, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C with rear vents, halogen headlamps and steel wheels. Higher options get alloy wheels, fog lamps, chrome grille and side body moulding. Depending on trim level, the Ertiga gets dual airbags and ABS.

The Suzuki Baleno is the brand's sub-compact hatchback offering. The Indian-made Baleno comes with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Two trims are available - the GL and GLX. On the inside, the top-spec Baleno GLX, features a 6.2-inch infotainment system. Other standard features in the GLX include cruise control, automatic A/C and rear park distance control. Safetywise, the GLX gains 4 additional airbags over the GL model, with a total of 6 airbags. The GLX also gains rear disc brakes, while the GL derivative has rear drum brakes. Standard fare across the range are USB and Aux ports.

The Bugatti Chiron is a mid-engined two-seated sports car developed and manufactured in France. It is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron. It still carries from the Veyron is the 8-litre W16 quad-turbocharged engine, but it has been significantly upgraded. Like its predecessor, it has a carbon-fibre body structure, independent suspension and a Haldex AWD system.A 7-speed dual-clutch automatic routes power to all four wheels. This one is 82 mm longer, 40 mm wider and 53 mm higher than the Veyron, and is also 155 kg heavier.

The Nissan Sentra carries on with no major changes since its introduction in 2013. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission or a CVT. The 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine is available in only CVT. Both engines are not available in all GCC countries. The 1.6S and 1.8S gets power steering, power mirrors, power windows, halogen headlamps, rear LED lamps, keyless entry, manual seats, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/RDS support and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. The 1.6SV gets LED accent headlamps, intelligent key with engine push-start button, wood trim and 4 speakers. The 1.6 SV Sports gets fog lamps, leather steering, rear spoiler, 16-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors and indicators on side-view mirror.  Both 1.6 SV and 1.8 SV sports have the option of USB/iPod connectivity, bluetooth, navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. The 1.8 SV gets the same as S but with rear parking sensors and bluetooth. The 1.8 SL gets the same options as 1.6 SV Sports plus rear spoiler with brake lamp, 6 speakers and USB/iPod connectivity. The 1.8 SL Premium gets more features such as leather seats, sunroof, cruise control, dual-zone climate control A/C. The 1.8 SL and SL Premium have the option of adding navigation, 5.8-inch display, rear view camera and 2 DIN face audio system with CD player. Safety features include electronic brake-force distribution (EBD), ABS and Brake Assist (BA), along with driver and passenger front airbags. Only the 1.8 SL Premium gets side and curtain airbags.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S-Class gets a mid-cycle refresh, with ever-so-subtle design changes, and some major changes under the hood. While the most significant design changes end with a redesigned front-fascia and DRL's, the new S-Class boasts new trims and engine choices, along with a Hybrid model even. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class gets beltbags, which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and cushionbags, which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called thermotronic features improved filtering of outside air and also an active perfuming system for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class gets optional Magic Body Control which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The 911 is Porsche's original legendary rear-engined sports car, produced in coupe, cabriolet and glass-roofed targa body styles based on model, and with numerous flat-six engines and drivetrains. The race-tuned GT3 and GT3 RS are the lightest cars in the range, and use a modified high-output version of the 3.6-litre engine, with only a 6-speed manual gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and a full set of airbags. Both the GT3 and GT3 RS are fitted with an Active Suspension Management system. Traction Control ties together three electronic control systems: Automatic Brake Differential (ABD), Automatic Slip Control (ASC), and Engine Drag Control (EDC). Masterminded by an electronic "brain", the Traction Control offers two different control maps, can be completely deactivated, and features both wheel-spin and drag-force management for extra smoothness. The limited-slip differential offers an asymmetric limited-slip function of 28 percent under load and 40 percent in overrun. Set to the Sports mode, the suspension system (PASM) allows a more precise driving style by reducing body movements to a minimum. By pressing the Sports button, the driver also activates a special engine control map which increases torque by approximately 15 Nm from 3000 - 4250 rpm, and boosts engine power by almost 14 hp.

The Lexus RC F is the Japanese luxury brand's performance compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC F carries on with a naturally-aspirated 5.0-litre V8 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control. A carbon package replaces the bonnet, roof and boot with carbon-fibre body panels.

The Pathfinder can be considered a proper off-roading 4WD. It is built on a fullsize pickup platform, thereby offering good off-road capability but marginal on-road handling. The current Pathfinder is significantly larger than previous models. It offers more interior space and more convenience features. It also offers third-row seating to carry up to seven people. The 4.0-litre V6 that powers the Pathfinder is a larger, retuned version of the engine that powers the 350Z. Its five-speed automatic transmission is geared to use the engine's torque characteristics. The 4WD features optional Hill Descent Control, which limits downhill speed without driver intervention, and Hill Start Assist, which briefly holds the Pathfinder on a slope while the driver releases the brake pedal and applies the accelerator. Standard features include fabric upholstery, cruise control, power mirrors, windows and door locks with keyless remote, CD stereo with six speakers, reclining backs on the middle row seats, front and side airbags, ABS and alloy wheels. Options include power seats, halogen foglights, running boards, roof rack cross bars and leather seating. For 2008, the Pathfinder received a very minor facelift, while gaining new available features such as Bluetooth, navigation, rear-seat DVD entertainment and intelligent keyless entry.

The 206 is one of Peugeot's more popular models, with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, although new derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet joined the line-up in 2001. There are various petrol engines in the range, although after 2006, the local offerings had decreased. The standard five-door hatchback can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic. The 206 CC coupe-cabriolet can only be had as a 1.6-litre automatic in the later years, although the manual 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre CC models were available here for a few years in between. There is a more powerful 2.0-litre engine with a manual offered in three-door RC hatchback form, which is a true sporting contender. The tuned RC debuted in 2003, replacing the competent GTi 2.0-litre model. All models come with front power windows, a cloth interior, driver's airbag and other basics as standard. Comprehensive safety equipment such as ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, along with passenger front airbag, were all optional. Available features included a CD player, alloy wheels and more.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. Based on a Nissan platform, the Koleos uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed manual or CVT automatic gearbox. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive, while optional is a basic all-wheel-drive system with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

New from the ground up, the all-new Chrysler Pacifica builds on the styling cues started by the failed Chrysler 200 sedan, and replacing the aging Chrysler Grand Voyager. It comes with a 3.6-litre V6, a 9-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The Pacifica offers 7-seater capacity (or 8 seats optionally), with a folding/collapsible second-row “Stow ‘n Go” seats, and a 60/40-split folding third-row seat. Available with sizeable 17-inch, 18-inch or 20-inch alloys, it aims to be a bit more premium than the usual minivan offerings. Options include two 10-inch multimedia touchscreens with built-in travel games, an 8.4-inch UConnect touchscreen up front, Blu-Ray player, a built-in vacuum cleaner, power sliding doors, power tailgate with hands-free operation, LED running lights and taillights, standard 3-zone automatic climate control, cooled front seats, two large sunroofs and an automated parallel/perpendicular parking system, aside from all the usual standard luxury trappings such as power windows, Bluetooth, cruise control and smart keyless start, although all features may not be offered in all markets. Stereo options include 6-speaker, 13-speaker and 20-speaker choices, the last one being Harmon Kardon. The models with the rear screens also get tons of USB and HDMI ports for rear passengers. Standard safety equipment includes stability control, ABS, front, front-side and curtain airbags as well as front knee airbags, and a rearview camera (although rear parking sensors are missing in the base model). The ABS can also dry the brake rotors in rainy conditions. Safety options include automatic braking for forward collision mitigation, blind-spot monitoring, rear-cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The Australian-built Caprice has been redesigned from the ground up, but still remains one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers a choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the V8 engine as an option. The V6 was dropped by 2011, leaving the V8 as standard. The big V8 is standard on the sport-tuned SS and the luxury-tuned Royale. The Caprice continues to use a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, a cloth or leather interior, and more. ABS brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

The Citroen DS5 is the French brand's compact wagon offering. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There are two variants available in the GCC, the 'So Chic' and 'Sport Chic'. Standard features on the DS5 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, automatic a/c with dual-zone temperature control, radio stereo with CD/AUX support, Bluetooth, USB port, steering mounted controls, navigation system, cruise control, interior mood lighting, aluminium drilled pedals, automatic xenon headlamps, automatic wipers, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, daytime running LEDs, leather seats with lumbar support and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get front parking sensors, electric heated sports seats, and driver's seat with electric lumbar adjustment, massage function and memory settings. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA), Electronic Stability Program (ESP) with traction control, driver's, front passengers and front lateral airbags, and front and rear curtain airbags.

The 360 is a mid-engined two-seater sports car, designed as a high-tech replacement for the simplistic F355, while itself being replaced by the F430 for 2005, effectively giving the 360 the short shelf-life. For this model, occasionally known as the F360, Ferrari partnered with Alcoa to produce an all-aluminium space-frame chassis. Also new was the Pininfarina styling that gave up flip-up headlights, replacing them with rounded fixed units. The new 3.6-litre V8 engine came with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed F1-style automanual. The cabin was sparse on gadgets, but the basics were standard, including leather, CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, front airbags, ABS brakes, and stability control. The coupe version was called the 360 Modena, while the new-for-2001 convertible was called the 360 Spider. The lightweight 360 Challenge Stradale came later, with  110 kg shaved off, a bump up in power from the upgraded V8, and featuring 19-inch BBS wheels, carbon-fibre side-mirrors, updated front bumper, lower ride height, and a black mesh grille at the rear.

Citroen has a tradition for breaking design conventions and building quiry cars, and the Picasso, a compact people-carrier, is no exception. The Picasso offers a roomy and versatile interior designed around the need for differing seating configurations in a vehicle with car-like handling characteristics. Compact tall wagons have become popular family vehicles in europe, though people here are reluctant to give up their stupid 4WDs. The only powerplant is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder with front-wheel-drive and an automatic gearbox. The sloping front end offers a commanding driving position. The dash-mounted shifter is within easy reach and the digital instrumentation is clear. The cabin is filled with accessories like cup-holders, fold-down aeroplane-style tables in the back, and a low luggage floor for easy loading, with numerous other stowage facilities and cubby holes, including huge door pockets and under-floor storage boxes. Safety features include the requisite airbags and ABS brakes.

The Clio was completely redesigned in 2006, but this new version is only available in the GCC in sporting form. The Renault-Sport Clio now has bumped-up power, so it is called the Clio 200 now. The Clio Renault-Sport 200 models will be sold in limited numbers across the GCC, due to low demand rather than to maintain exclusivity. Derived from the basic New Clio available in Europe, both the Renault-Sport cars are powered by a highly-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual gearbox. Renault says the cars were apparently tested locally to ensure suitability for local driving conditions, and fitted with air-conditioning systems to suit the local heat. The car will be available in various funky colours and now has a better interior. Features include sports suspension, upgraded brakes, 17-inch alloy wheels and racing-bucket seats. There is no spare tyre due to the dual-exhaust setup. Safety features include stability and traction control with "off" switch, ABS brakes, up to eight airbags, and energy-absorbing head restraints.

Renault Logan Van is a Romanian-built small commercial van. It is only available as a panel van. It comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. It is capable of carrying up to 800 kg payload and transporting long objects ranging to 194 cm. Access to the loading zone is facilitated by a high roof, 2 side doors and rear doors. Standard features in the Logan Van include a manual A/C, power steering, manual windows, AM/FM radio, tinted windows, 15-inch steel wheels, cabin light, front storage boxes and driver's side airbag.

An all-new Nissan Maxima came out in 2016, featuring the company's "V-Motion" front end, boomerang lights and floating roof look. It remained the same for 2017. The new chassis is lighter and more rigid than the previous generation. The American-built front-wheel-drive midsizer is powered by the same 3.5-litre V6 as the previous model but updated with 60% new parts. The engine is mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. Inside, the Maxima gets a flat-bottomed steering wheel, Alcantara accents and a centre console that is angled 7-degrees toward the driver. It also gets 7-inch Advanced Drive Assist Display in the instrument cluster that can be paired with an optional 8-inch screen with multi-touch control. Other options include HID headlights, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic glass roof, cloth or leather upholstery and more. All come standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control, with options such as blind-spot monitoring, around-view parking cameras and adaptive cruise control with auto-braking. Equipment packages between trim levels change slightly, depending on market.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. Changes were made in 2015 which included standard Attention Assist and Crosswind Assist, optional Intelligent Light System which included LED indicators, LED daytime running lamps, LED low-beam headlamps, and main beam with cornering light function. There were no changes for the 2017 model year. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The compact V50 wagon and its S40 sedan sibling are based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the V50 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The V50 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre and a higher-tuned 2.4-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The Eos is a resurrection of the Golf convertible, only with a different name. Sharing design cues, platforms and engines with the Golf, it is touted to be the first car in the world to feature a five-piece retractable hardtop. The car can somewhat seat four people, with good luggage room when the top is up. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Eos is available in the Middle East with three engine options, namely two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.2-litre V6, with choices of manual, automatic or DSG automanual, depending on model.  All models are well equipped, with a CD stereo, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front airbags, side airbags, lateral airbags, a roll-bar safety system, stability control, power mirrors and windows, among others.

The 2009 Mitsubishi Galant receives fresh styling with a new grille, hood and lower air intake at the front, and more changes at the rear including wider rear glass, a new trunk lid, taillights and rear bumper. The Galant is powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic transmission, and the 3.8-litre V6 engine with a 5-speed automatic. Bot gearboxes come with Sportronic manual shifting ability. The base model includes variable intermittent wipers, power mirrors, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, cloth seats, air conditioning, power windows, power locks with keyless entry and CD player with four speakers. The higher models get bright interior accents, cruise control, premium cloth seats, ABS brakes with EBD, and CD/MP3 player with six speakers, along with 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and an eight-way power driver's seat. Options include reverse camera, fog lamps, special climate control console, steering wheel with audio controls, power sunroof, leather-trimmed seats, and a premium CD/MP3 player with changer and eight speakers. Safety features include only dual front airbags standard on all models, with ABS and traction control available on higher models only.

The Lincoln MKZ makes its comeback in the GCC as a 2014 model year. The MKZ comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre EcoBoost 4-cylinder engine or a 3.7-litre V6 unit, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with paddle shifters, but initially, only the V6 model will be offered. Both can be had in either front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. Not all versions are available in all GCC markets. The MKZ will be available with SYNC and MyLincoln Touch as standard, along with large 10.1-inch LCD instrument cluster and an 8-inch centre touchscreen. As for safety, there is a mono-vision camera integrated into the rearview mirror to read lane markers on the road. It will be complemented by radar sensors for the adaptive cruise control and active Collision Warning with Brake Support. Also included are wide-angle radar sensors for help with parking and backing up. It will also sport inflatable second-row seatbelts and eight airbags.

The Thai-built Honda City returns in 2009 with a full redesign. Sporting one of Honda's numerous corporate front-ends, it looks good for the first time ever, and comes with enough cabin space to rival some midsize cars. Based on the new platform shared with the Jazz, and powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 5-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive sedan has grown in size, with a full list of interesting options. Standard features on the basic City LX include 15-inch steel wheels, power mirrors, body-colour bumpers, electric power steering, power windows, power door locks, manual a/c, CD/MP3 player with USB/AUX connector and 2 speakers, stereo volume-compensation depending on speed, trip computer, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, and an immobiliser. The City EX adds paddle shifters, 16-inch alloy wheels, chrome exhaust tip, front and rear armrests, split-folding rear seat, stereo controls on the steering wheel and 4 speakers, and keyless entry.

The Forester, after many years being Subaru's compact crossover wagon-like 4WD, has been completely redesigned for 2009 with a more SUV-like appearance. The new Forester is larger in every way than its predecessor, improving cargo capacity and rear-seat legroom. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model.
