Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester also comes standard with a 4-speed automatic features SportShift manual shifting. The basic 2.5X model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The Hyundai Veloster Turbo finally debuted in the GCC market in 2015, after several delays over a couple of years. The styling for this compact hatchback is one thing, but it has only three side doors, one on the driver's side and two on the passenger side.The Veloster Turbo has a more aggressive look than the standard model, with a black hexagonal grille, fog lamps and a revised rear fascia which features two centre-mounted exhaust-tips. Under the hood is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a new 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Available features include a smart key with starter button, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, faux leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, LED rear lights, rear camera with sensors, fog lamps, adjustable steering wheel, power windows and electric mirrors. Additional features available include a full set of airbags, LED front running lamps, ABS, stability control, automatic a/c, power driver's seat and a premium stereo with subwoofer.

The last new Japanese Sunny, launched in 2001 and facelifted in 2004, was available with a choice of three engines, all of which are available in 2 different trim levels. The 1.3-litre model comes in basic FE and a better EX trim. The 1.6-litre comes in EX and value-packed SG trims. The 1.8-litre comes in EX and fully-loaded Super Saloon trims. By the end of its lifecycle in 2006, only the 1.6-litre was eventually available. All cars came with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Interior gadgets are limited in this budget sedan. Power windows and mirrors are limited to the EX and Super Saloon models, while the sunroof, keyless entry and automatic a/c are only available on the Super Saloon. The standard stereo is adequate, with decent sound quality, but nothing to rave about. A CD player is available in the top models. Options include a rear spoiler and front passenger airbags, among other add-on accessories.

An all-new model of the Toyota Corolla came out in mid 2019 as a 2020 model. Engine offerings include a 1.6-litre and a new 2.0-litre, both 4-cylinder "VVT-i" units. A new hybrid engine joins the lineup which is a 1.8-litre combined with electric motors. The five-seater is available in various trim levels. In Saudi Arabia, there is a 1.6 XLi model with 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, black front grille, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and a 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo. Moving up to the 1.6 GLi adds fog lamps, 16-inch alloys, rear AC vents, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, trunk liner, better upholstery with leather steering wheel, split-folding rear seats, 6-speaker touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with starter button and several other smaller convenience features. The 2.0 GLi adds LED headlights with LED running lamps, sunroof, rear manual curtains, auto a/c and cruise control. In the UAE, there are 5 trim levels, starting with the 1.6 XLi model that includes a standard automatic gearbox, 15-inch steelies, 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo, power mirrors and a black grille. power windows, keyless entry and central locking. The 1.6 GLi adds better upholstery with leather steering wheel, chrome grille, split-folding rear seats, LED running lamps, smart keyless entry and start, LCD info display, a better 6-speaker stereo and 16-inch alloy wheels. Moving on to the larger engine, the 2.0 XLi has all the features of the 1.6 XLi, but additionally gets 16-inch alloys and 6 speakers for the basic stereo. The 1.8 XLi HEV gets similar features to the 1.6 XLi, while the 1.8 GLi HEV gets a moonroof, 7-inch screen for the infotainment system, auto-leveling LED headlamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. Other markets may get slightly different trim levels. All models get standard dual front airbags, ABS with brake assist and EBD, stability control and an alarm immobiliser.

The McLaren P1 comes with a hybrid powertrain, which consists of a twin-turbo, V8 3.8-litre mid-mounted engine supplemented by electric motors. Power is transferred to the ground via a 7-speed twin clutch "˜Graziano' gearbox. The hypercar comes with a host of new goodies like the "˜Instant Power Assist System' (IPAS), which basically activates the electric motor via a steering wheel-mounted button which gives the P1 better throttle response. Another button on the steering wheel is the DRS Drag Reduction System, which when pressed, reduces the rear wing angle to lower drag. McLaren estimates that the P1 can be driven on electric power for 20 km at an average speed of 48 kph. The P1 rides on bespoke Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres and stopping power comes from discs featuring a new type of carbon-ceramic material, which is stronger than the regular fit, as it dissipates heat more effectively. In addition, these discs are lighter than usual and boast a custom ceramic layer coat on the friction surfaces for a mirrored look. Inside the cabin, the McLaren P1 features a cockpit where carbon-fibre is the primary material. Amenities such as satellite navigation, climate control, premium audio system and a digital dash showing all relevant information is also present.

The aging 9-5 was given a makeover in 2006, which includes a new look inside and out, and some minor mechanical modifications. Sold in Linear, Arc and Aero versions, there is only the four-door sedan form available here, although a SportCombi wagon could probably be ordered. The 9-5 now features two 2.3-litre four-cylinder turbo engines in different states of tune, mated to five-speed manual or optional automatic transmissions. The 9-5 features consist of leather upholstery, sport-tuned suspension, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, computer information display, Xenon headlamps, anti-theft alarm, sunroof, CD stereo, aumatic climate control, alloy wheels, parking sensors, keyless entry and more. Safety features are extensive, with an active head restraint system, front and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control and stability control. This car certainly is loaded with features, but it loses out with an inflated price tag for what is essentially a four-cylinder front-wheel-drive sedan, living only on facelifts since the last millenium.

The Matrix is a typical urban runabout built in Korea, but with its own little twist. It is halfway between a minivan and a hatchback, while looking better than neither. The Matrix is probably a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering good interior space inside a compact body, but we are not sure if the Middle East is ready for such a car. Powered by either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or an automatic, while the larger engine gets only an automatic. Basic features include power steering, power windows, simple a/c, cloth seats, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, 14-inch steel wheels with plastic covers, and a roof rack. Safety is apparently optional, as only the higher models get dual airbags and ABS brakes, paired up with other options like fake metal-look trim, central door locking, rear wiper and washer, electrically-adjustable mirrors and 15-inch alloy wheels. Sometimes being named after a hit movie just isn't enough.

The Bentley line is headed by these land-yachts. Called the Azure in convertible form, the design of the four-seat shares its face as well as its 6.75-litre turbo V8 with the Arnage sedan. The Azure does not get the higher-tuned engine from the limited-edition Brooklands. The cabin and rear section of the car are a new design and the interior is crammed with every common luxury cue that defines a Bentley. The Azure is highlighted by a new laser-cut matrix grille that evokes the large sporting Bentleys that had won the 24 hours of Le Mans five times between 1924 and 1930. Bentley is now a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG. The spacious handcrafted interior features the highest level of leather and wood trim, individually tailored to the taste of each owner. The complex folding roof on the convertible is operated hydraulically at the touch of a switch and the three-layer fabric assembly stows beneath the leather-trimmed tonneau cover in less than 30 seconds. Safety features in this classic include multiple airbags and the usual electronic nannies found in any modern car. though the platform remains a remnant from the last century.

Citroen has a tradition for breaking design conventions and building quiry cars, and the Picasso, a compact people-carrier, is no exception. The Picasso offers a roomy and versatile interior designed around the need for differing seating configurations in a vehicle with car-like handling characteristics. Compact tall wagons have become popular family vehicles in europe, though people here are reluctant to give up their stupid 4WDs. The only powerplant is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder with front-wheel-drive and an automatic gearbox. The sloping front end offers a commanding driving position. The dash-mounted shifter is within easy reach and the digital instrumentation is clear. The cabin is filled with accessories like cup-holders, fold-down aeroplane-style tables in the back, and a low luggage floor for easy loading, with numerous other stowage facilities and cubby holes, including huge door pockets and under-floor storage boxes. Safety features include the requisite airbags and ABS brakes.

The Borgward BX7 marks the rebirth of the long-defunct German luxury brand as a Chinese-built crossover. It is a compact crossover powered by a 2.0-litre direct-injection turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive. The BX7 comes in S trims with 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as SE and SL trims with 18-inch alloys. There is a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater confingurations, and three levels of leather upholstery, depending on trim. All models get basics such as power windows and mirrors, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, 12.3-inch touchscreen, USB/AUX ports, smart keyless entry and start, LED tail lamps and parking sensors. Higher models get Xenon auto headlights, LED running lights, panoramic glass roof, power folding mirrors, power seats, 360-degree parking camera with sensors, and a 10-speaker stereo with nav. All models get ABS, ESP, electronic diff lock, brake assist, fatigue detection, hill-start assist and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as front-side airbags and options such as curtain airbags, hill-descent control on AWD models and blind-spot monitoring.

The Audi S3 sedan made its debut in 2015 and is the performance version of the A3. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The 6-speed manual gearbox version is available in some GCC markets on special order. All-wheel drive is standard in the S3. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, sports seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and alloy wheels. Safety standards are high as in all Audi models with features which include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The Espace is famous for being the first minivan to grace European roads back in the 1980s. Packed with abundant space and numerous safety features, it has the maximum rating in crash tests conducted by European governmental agencies. It comes in short-wheelbase and long-wheelbase body styles, all seating as many as seven passengers, with luggage space to spare. With the new slide and lock seating system, the latest Espace can offer even greater versatility. At the rear, passengers can adjust the position of their seat for better legroom. Whether the cargo is a large number of passengers or a large load, switching between 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 or even 2 seat configurations is a simple affair. Standard features include a stereo, power windows and more. It is equipped with ABS brakes and Emergency Brake Assist, plus an Electronic Stability Programme with understeer control, as well as ASR traction control. Passive safety features eight airbags, including thorax airbags in the second row of seats.

The Bugatti Chiron is a mid-engined two-seated sports car developed and manufactured in France. It is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron. It still carries from the Veyron is the 8-litre W16 quad-turbocharged engine, but it has been significantly upgraded. Like its predecessor, it has a carbon-fibre body structure, independent suspension and a Haldex AWD system.A 7-speed dual-clutch automatic routes power to all four wheels. This one is 82 mm longer, 40 mm wider and 53 mm higher than the Veyron, and is also 155 kg heavier.

The Sorento is an attractive entry into the crowded affordable 4WD market. Offering either a 2.4-litre four-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.5-litre V6 with a 4-speed automatic in early models and a 5-speed automatic since 2005, the Sorento offers decent off-road ability and a fair bit of interior space, making it a good buy, given its price. Standard features include 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette with antenna and 6 speakers, manual air-conditioning, power steering, 8-way adjustable driver seat, 4-way adjustable passenger seat, power windows, 60/40 split folding rear seat, battery saver, driver airbag, proper rear lift gate, power door locks, and limited slip differential. Available features in higher models include a CD player with power antenna and 8 speakers, ABS brakes, power folding mirrors and cruise control. Four-wheel independent suspension and four-wheel disc brakes make it a good road cruiser, unlike truck-based 4WDs, although it is still no sports car.

The Mercedes-Benz V-Class replaces the Viano and Vito in the lineup. In  2017, the V-Class was released in the GCC with a petrol engine. In 2020 it got a facelift, getting a new front bumper and grille. Under the hood, it gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, cruise control, leather seats, Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get added options such as 17-inch alloy wheels, their "AGILITY CONTROL" suspension with selective damping system and more premium Lugano leather trim on the seats. The Exclusive edition gets interior trim in brushed aluminium look, air vents in silver chrome, a roof liner in DINAMICA, panoramic sliding sunroof, the new large centre console with integral refrigerated compartment and thermo-cupholders, climatised single seats in Nappa leather for the driver, front and rear passengers, 19-inch light-alloy wheels and Burmester surround sound system. There is also a sports package and AMG package. Safety standards are high with optional systems such as Collision Prevention Assist and Distronic Plus, along with multiple airbags for driver and passengers. It also gets traction control, stability control, blind-spot assist and lane-tracking system.

The Borgward BX7 marks the rebirth of the long-defunct German luxury brand as a Chinese-built crossover. It is a compact crossover powered by a 2.0-litre direct-injection turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive. The BX7 comes in S trims with 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as SE and SL trims with 18-inch alloys. There is a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater confingurations, and three levels of leather upholstery, depending on trim. All models get basics such as power windows and mirrors, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, 12.3-inch touchscreen, USB/AUX ports, smart keyless entry and start, LED tail lamps and parking sensors. Higher models get Xenon auto headlights, LED running lights, panoramic glass roof, power folding mirrors, power seats, 360-degree parking camera with sensors, and a 10-speaker stereo with nav. All models get ABS, ESP, electronic diff lock, brake assist, fatigue detection, hill-start assist and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as front-side airbags and options such as curtain airbags, hill-descent control on AWD models and blind-spot monitoring.

The third-generation Kia Cerato hatchback boasts sleeker styling that is 30 mm longer, 15 mm lower and 5 mm wider than the outgoing car, with a 50 mm extended wheelbase. It also featured an all-new bodyshell, upgraded equipment, a host of additional convenience and safety features, a more spacious cabin with better quality, improved suspension and an upgraded powertrain line-up that delivers class-leading performance and fuel economy. In 2017, the Cerato got a facelift. No changes were made in 2018. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors. Safety features include ABS brakes, brake assist, stability control, and two front airbags.

The Prado has become a popular choice among people who want a true off-roader but never go off-road. The Prado also shares a bade with the legendary Land Cruiser which makes it more attractive. The latest Land Cruiser Prado is a refined animal, taking advantage of technical and engineering advances that offer reasonably smooth performance on the road and reasonably capable off-roading ability. One look at it reveals rock-solid build quality so obviously missing from competitors from American manufacturers. The Prado is offered with a 2.7-litre four-cylinder, a 4.0-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre six-cylinder diesel. The petrol engines get Toyota's more modern manual and automatic gearboxes, while the weak diesel gets only a manual. The cabin is spacious and roomy with abundant headroom and legroom. Features of the interior include dual-zone air-conditioning and a CD/cassette audio system with either 4 or 6 speakers, depending on model. The Prado comes with dual front airbags and ABS as standard, with seating for either five or eight people. Side-airbags and stability control are not offered in this aging SUV.

The Chinese Tiggo received a facelift for its 2014 model year. Powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, and comes with a 4-speed automatic transmission. The five-door five-seater Tiggo gets a versatile interior, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling.

An all-new Mazda CX-9 crossover SUV made its debut in 2016. Powered by a new turbocharged 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, it comes with a six-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in four trims, the GS, GT, GTX and GTX Limited are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The higher spec CX-9 gets  20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console. Safety-wise, the CX-9 comes with standard stability control and ABS, and is optionally equipped with Forward Obstruction Warning, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Control.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This latest generation of midsize pickups feature roomier cabins, improved ride quality and increased stability. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with only a manual gearbox, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player.

An all-new Mitsubishi L200 was released as a 2016 model year. It got a significant facelift in 2019. It is sold in the GCC purely as a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Safety features include ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. For 2013, a Roadster version was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its third facelift for the 2016 model-year. It remains the same for 2020. The exterior and interior both get a major overhaul. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Mitsubishi Lancer Fortis arrived to finally replace the 'regular' Lancer, a massive rental favourite in the GCC. However, this time the engine in the offered in the Lancer Fortis will actually move the car, a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features include fabric cloth seats, CD player with AM/FM radio and MP3 support, halogen lamps, power windows, power mirrors, disc brakes front and back, and steel wheels. Optional equipment include alloy wheels and fog lamps. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags.

A 2-door coupe joins the Cadillac CTS range in October 2010 as a 2011 model. Alongside the regular V6 base model is a supercharged 6.2-litre V8-powered CTS-V. The Cadillac CTS-V Coupe can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. All the cars are rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterised by a large chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The Kia Cerato gets a complete makeover, virtually lifting up the Korean compact to within striking distance of the Japanese favourites. However, Kia is once again undermining their own cars in this region with poor marketing and decontented GCC-spec models. It will initially be available with a 1.6-litre with 4-speed automatic. A manual gearbox might also be available on special-order. In 2011, all models got a 6-speed automatic. The interior feature in the Cerato that Kia is proud of seems to be a new "super vision" LCD cluster with reddish lighting with warning-message and trip-computer functionality. at the bottom of the cluster. Also available is a basic four-speaker audio system, with the option of six-speaker system that adds tweeters, plus a choice of three radio/CD players and the option of MP3 and iPod connectivity. Standard are power windows, electric mirrors, 15-inch wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery and central locking. Other available features in higher models include 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, some chrome exterior trim, "super vision" gauge cluster, fog lamps, sunroof, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, aluminium pedals and automatic headlights. Safety is being downplayed again, as the basic Cerato comes with a single driver's airbag. The higher model gets ABS, active headrests and rear disc brakes instead of drums. Side-curtain airbags and stability control, though not initially available, became standard on the top-spec model later.

The Navara is a stylish work truck, and essentially a pickup version of the Pathfinder. Like the Pathfinder, it offers good hauling capability and marginal on-road handling. It offers decent interior space and more convenience features than most competitors. It is offered with a 2.5-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with a five-speed automatic and 2WD, or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine with a six-speed manual transmission and 4WD. The two versions share the same features that include 16-inch alloywheels, bedliner, power door locks, front fog lamps,4-speaker audio system with CD player, power windows, chrome door mirrors, dual power outside mirrors with LED turn signallamps, keyless entry, chrome rear bumper and speed-sensingwipers. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes. Climate control, premium trim and special upholstery are optional equipment. It is apparently only available in double cab five-seater body style with a long rear load bay.

The Hyundai i40 is a midsize station wagon. A basic, mid-range and top model are sold here. All the models get the same 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, steel wheels, AM/FM radio and CD player with MP3 playback capability and six speakers. Available features, standard on higher trim levels, include parking sensors and alloy wheels. The rear seat backrests feature a 60:40 split, so you can still carry the luggage plus a rear seat passenger or two. If more space is required, rear seat backrests fold flat into the floor while the floor rail system helps keep your luggage secured.

The Maybach was originally built for the ultra-rich back before World War II. Mercedes-Benz has revived the brand for the ultra-rich of today, as "a business jet on wheels," according to the company, and quite rightly so. The Maybach is offered in two versions currently. The Maybach 57 is the shorter wheelbase model, which is still very large, and this body style comes in either standard 57 trim with a 5.5-litre turbocharged V12, or in 57 S trim with a 6.0-litre turbocharged V12. Both models utilise a five-speed automatic and rear-wheel-drive. Standard features include massive seats, leather interior and wood all over. The cars can be customised according to fat-cat customer wishes, including real gold interior trim, special paint finishes, TV tuner, DVD player, CD changer, telephone, Dolby surround sound system, panoramic glass roof, and, especially for the 62, reclining rear seats. Safety features include all the requisite equipment, including a multitude of airbags and electronic stability systems.

For 2014, the Renault Safrance received a minor facelift but mechanically remains the same. It comes with three Nissan-sourced engines. The base model comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and comes standard with a CVT automatic, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lights, manual a/c, keyless entry, power windows, alarm, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth phone, Renault key card, cruise control with speed limiter, grey fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. The base model can be optioned up with a package that includes a tyre pressure monitoring system, dual front-side thorax and curtain airbags, auto headlights, auto windscreen wipers, electrically adjustable and folding door mirrors, dual-zone climate control, leather steering wheel, air quality ioniser, fragrance diffuser, dark carbon fabric seat trim, 17-inch alloys and a rear spoiler. The mid-range model comes with a 2.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, and additionally features stability control with traction control. The top model comes with a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, and additionally comes with an athermic windshield, electric mirrors with memory function, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, tri-zone climate control, deadlocking with an anti-intruder device, electric rear windows with anti-pinch, Bose CD/MP3 stereo with 10 speakers, Bluetooth phone, Renault keyless smart card, panoramic sunroof, floor mats, cream leather seats, power front seats with massage, integrated rear sunblind, as well as front and rear parking sensors. Items such as HID headlights, dark leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels and an electronic parking brake are optional in some markets.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i and the M235i. The 220i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M235i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto or a 6-speed manual. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M235i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

This generation of the G37 Coupe was first offered in 2008. The G coupe uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. The G37 coupe originally had a 5-speed automatic transmission in 2008, while from 2009 onwards it received a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The 5th-generation 3-Series convertible was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Ford Flex received a facelift and new engines for the 2013 model. Touted as a crossover, it is more of a boxy-shaped minivan alternative. Offered in various trim levels, the Flex is powered by either a 3.5-litre V6 or a turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated with a 6-speed automatic transmission and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive. Airy and spacious, It offers four forward-opening doors, seating for six or seven depending on chosen options, and can be had with a refrigerator, dual panoramic sunroofs, cruise control, common power accessories, capless fuel-filler, HID headlights and LED tails, two-tone paintjob, programmable interior LED lighting, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, 10-speaker Sony stereo, and Ford's new Sync multimedia system which can connect and control any Bluetooth phone or USB music player. Safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, multiple front and side airbags and ABS brakes.

The Audi S8 was the performance version of their flagship A8 model. It featured a Lamborghini-derived 5.2-litre V10 engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission and their trademark "quattro" all-wheel drive system. The center differential distributes 40 percent of the torque to the front and 60 per cent to the rear. The S8 was not too heavy for its size, thanks to its all-aluminium body panels.  As well as adaptive light technology and 20-inch wheels, other features include new, noise-insulating double glazing for the windows, a DVD navigation system and BOSE Surround audio system with CD changer. The door armrests, the center console, and the seats in the Audi S8 are upholstered in leather. Safety features include traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, front and side airbags.

The BAIC X35 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. It comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor and traction control.

All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 Cabriolet is powered by either a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Toyota Aurion got a complete redesign for the 2012 model year alongside its Camry sibling. The Aurion is essentially a redone version of the Camry, but fitted with a V6 engine and better interior appointments. All models get a carryover 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. In the UAE, the 2012 Toyota Aurion comes in only two grades, namely Sports and Grande. In other markets such as Saudi Arabia, the grades are dubbed as Touring, SE and Grande, with a base model that isn't offered in the UAE. Only the Aurion Grande gets leather trim, 7-inch touchscreen navigation & DVD player, Bi-Xenon headlights with intelligent "AFS" and headlamp cleaner, and 8 way memory seats for the driver, all standard for the UAE. Navigation is optional in the Saudi model. The Aurion Sports model loses those features, but is instead fitted with a sport-tuned suspension, fabric sport seats with enhanced support, a newly-designed three spoke steering, paddle shifters, stereo with 6.1-inch display, 17-inch wheels and an exclusive front grille as well as sporty front and rear bumper skirts, all standard for the UAE. The moonroof and 17-inch alloys is optional on the Saudi Touring model. Other features include covered cup-holders, dual-zone auto a/c, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, keyless start, cruise control, rear parking sensors, front and side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control and more.

The Continental Flying Spur was launched in 2006 as the 4-door version of the Continental GT. It is also their first sedan model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the unloved VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets. Standard equipment on the Spur includes HID headlights, 19-inch alloy wheels, a tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, keyless entry and ignition, rain-sensing wipers, powered trunk lid and a choice of 16 colours. On the inside, one has a choice of 17 colours for the leather-appointed interior with matching carpets and seatbelts. The cabin features steering-column mounted shift paddles, sunroof with electronic sunshade, DVD navigation, six-CD changer and Bluetooth. Almost all seats feature lumbar massage, memory and heat settings. Options include a choice of three 19-inch wheel styles and a 20-inch wheel and tyre package, ceramic brakes, and the sunroof can be had with a solar panel to power ventilation fans to maintain interior temperature when parked, a full-length centre console and numerous trim choices. Convenience options include a cordless privacy handset with keypad in centre console, a rear telephone system, and a rear-view camera. The Continental Flying Spur is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. An unnoticeable facelift came in mid-2008, as well as a new Flying Spur Speed variant, adding more power, while improving performance and handling.

The Gen2 is probably the most competitive model in Proton's line-up. Its chassis is engineered with the help of Proton-owned sports car maker Lotus, with engines derived from Mitsubishi. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this five-door hatchback can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, rear spoiler, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include optional ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Gen2 is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras. It first came to Saudi Arabia in 2007, and UAE in late 2011.

An all-new GLS-63 AMG model came out in 2020. The GLS uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. The GLS 63 AMG comes with a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The performance of the V8 biturbo engine is enhanced by a further 16 kW courtesy of the integrated starter-alternator - resulting in impressive torque. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GLS-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

The sixth-generation Nissan Z shrinks in overall size and gains in engine size to become a more focussed sports car. The all-new 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. Initially launched in late 2009 in coupe form, the drop-top 370Z Roadster came in summer 2010, offering almost the same chassis rigidity as the coupe and a power soft-top. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new model came as a 2014 model year for the Honda City and remained the same for the 2017 model year. It is slightly larger in every dimension, but gains a sizeable amount of wheelbase and is very spacious inside, to the point where its rear legroom is comparable to that of midsize sedans. Aside from the redone platform, the 1.5-litre 4-cylinder is carried over from the previous model, while the CVT automatic has apparently been locally tuned to be more "sporty". It still has front independent and rear torsion-beam suspension and front disc and rear drum brakes. Other available features, depending on which of the three trim levels you choose, include 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery, regular keyless remote or smart keyless entry with starter button, regular CD/MP3 stereo or 7-inch touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB/AUX/HDMI ports, manual or auto a/c with touch controls as well as rear vents, standard cruise control, paddle shifters, parking sensors and more. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS brakes with electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Luxgen7 SUV is a seven-seater crossover, currently only sold in UAE and Oman. It is available as either a front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. The top feature is the Luxgen Think+ system, co-developed with smartphone makers HTC, that comes with built-in HSPDA 3.5G communications, GPS Navigation and a 10.2-inch LCD display screen for a comprehensive tech package. The system also includes the "Eagle View+" 360-degree parking assist which utilises four cameras to provide a real-time visual display of the surrounding environment. The "Side View+" feature automatically displays live video images of the vehicle's rear blind spot to reduce the chance of an accident during lane changes. The "Night Vision+" high-sensitivity night vision camera system helps illuminate the road and traffic conditions at night beyond the range of the headlamps. "LDWS+" constantly reads the road surface for lane markers and dividers and gives audible and visual warnings when the vehicle veers too close to the lane markings. Overall, the SUV is equipped with 23 advanced ECUs and 8 video cameras to provide these features. Also available are power-opening doors, leather upholstery, rear DVD screen, Bluetooth and more. The Luxgen7 SUV is powered by a turbocharged-and-intercooled 2.2-litre DOHC 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. To improve driving feel, the steering system was tuned by Delphi, noise suppression engineering was handled by LMS, the suspension system was developed by Magna, and the overall chassis tuning was done by both Magna and Prodrive.

The all-new Celerio is Suzuki's latest mini-car offering, launching in the middle of 2009 to be sold alongside the existing Alto. In reality, the Celerio is sold as an Alto replacement in other countries, and is built by Suzuki-Maruti in India. The Celerio offers all the styling of a modern hatchback, although its features are on the low side to keep prices down. Fitted with a standard 1.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the tiny motor can be mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Touted as a "full options" hatchback, the Celerio comes with a CD stereo with MP3, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lamps, alloy wheels, keyless entry and power steering. The cabin features a hard plastic dashboard housing a minimalistic gauge cluster and various storage areas. The rear-side windows cannot be rolled down, but can slightly pop out at the edge for ventilation. While it didn't do too well in European crash tests, its lightness puts it among the most fuel-efficient cars in the GCC.

The Honda Accord has been redesigned for the 2013 model. It is available as a sedan or a coupe. The base engine is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The other engine is a 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to a new 6-speed automatic transmission. All models gets active noise cancellation, to reduce engine noise. The interior gets a standard new i-MID system, an 8-inch screen on the dashboard used for displaying information, navigation, for playing music through your iPhone or USB, as well as for storing music in the in-built hard-drive, depending on trim level. Standard features on the base 2.4 DX model include electric power steering, power door mirrors with LED indicators, power windows and mirrors, LED front running lamps and tail lights, 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, cruise control, cloth upholstery, ABS and two front airbags. The 2.4 LX sedan adds floor mats, side and curtain airbags, stability control and hill-start assist, as does all other trim levels. In certain markets, it is additionally offered with a sunroof, 17-inch aluminium wheels, and a touchscreen control panel for multimedia functions. The 2.4 EX sedan further adds front fog lights, power-folding mirrors, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, leather seats, leather steering wheel, power rear sunshade, smart keyless entry and start, auto-dimming mirror, rear parking sensors and a power driver's seat. The 2.4 EX sedan can be upgraded with navigation, rear camera, "i-Dual" a/c, 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, USB/AUX ports, and a power-adjustable passenger seat. The 3.5 EX sedan adds the V6 engine and transmission, dual exhaust tips, wooden steering wheel, rear-side window sunshades, full LED headlights, and a new feature called "LaneWatch" that adds a camera under the right-side mirror to visually monitor your right blindspot. The 3.5 Sport sedan additionally gets 18-inch alloys, little paddle-shifters, and leather steering. There are further options for both the sedan and the coupe, such as a complete body kit with lip spoiler, LED door-sill plates and footwell lights, and external chrome strips.

The 5th-generation 3-Series coupe was introduced in 2007 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2010. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. They all came in 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmissions. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo and optional sunroof. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

An all-new Lincoln Navigator debuted for 2018, still a rebodied version of the new-for-2018 Ford Expedition. The Navigator L is the long-wheelbase version, with more boot space. All new Navigators make extensive use of high-strength aluminium-alloy to lose weight while offering more space inside. Power continues to be provided by an uprated twin-turbo V6 and mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, similar to the Ford F-150 Raptor. The top model is known as the Signature. Inside, both front seats feature heating/cooling/massaging functions and are adjustable in 30 ways. Rear seats have a recline function. Available rear-seat entertainment features include 10-inch adjustable screens. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are part of the standard SYNC 3 touchscreen system, along with navigation, Bluetooth, phone, etc. A total of 20 speakers with the optional Revel II audio system can create distinct listening modes including audience, on-stage, and stereo. A Lincoln “welcome mat” will illuminate on the ground beneath the front doors, and the Lincoln star badge in the grille lights up too. Other available notable features include powered side-steps, heads-up display, customisable LCD gauge cluster and USB ports for the power-adjustable third row. Safety features are extensive, with a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, al-round parking sensors with cameras and all that.

Attempting to cash in on the four-door 'coupe' craze, Volkswagen jumped into the ring with their ill-conceived Passat CC. While 'CC' stands for 'Comfort Coupe,' there isn't much different from the standard Passat, except for a slightly-deformed exterior and a reduction in headroom. Priced to fail between the standard Passat and the large Phaeton, the Passat CC utilises a common platform with the Passat, including the same engines, mechanicals and interior components. The sporty looks are betrayed by its standard engine choices, which include a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, with a manual or DSG automanual. Both TSI engines are turbocharged 4-cylinder units. By 2010, we believe VW dropped the 1.8-litre and introduced the 3.6-litre V6 with all-wheel-drive and a 6-speed automanual. Features include fabric or leather upholstery in various colours, sports seats, common power accessories, 17-inch alloy wheels, adaptive suspension, electrically-adjustable driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, 'Press & Drive' starter with keyless entry, front and curtain airbags for front and rear passengers including side airbags, electric parking brake with hill-hold control, stability control, ABS, rain-sensing wipers, tyre pressure monitor and more. Options include various wood and aluminium cabin trims, automatic a/c, cruise control, reverse camera, Xenon headlights with bending feature, 18-inch wheels, panoramic sunroof, and various stereo options that include CD/MP3, Bluetooth phone, six-disc changer and AUX inputs. Park Assist, Automatic Distance Control and Lane Assist features are also optionally available. Incidentally, local VW dealers now call it the 'Volkswagen CC' because they feel their customers are too dumb to differentiate between this and the regular Passat.

This was one of the most popular versions of the Accord, being the first model to actually offer interior space befitting a midsize family car. Its conservative styling proved to be just right for its target market, and it even became the only Accord generation to become the top-selling car in the competitive American market, even though it was mildly overshadowed by the Camry in the GCC. The American-built two-door coupes are also a common sight. This new-for-1998 model was completely redesigned compared to the previous model, but retained the fancy double-wishbone suspension system that made Honda famous. There are two engines, the standard 2.3-litre 4-cylinder with a manual or automatic, and the hard-to-find optional 3.0-litre V6 with an automatic only. The popular sedans are great everyday cars with comfort and convenience features. Available features include cruise control, power locks, keyless entry, steel or alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with ABS, CD player, leather upholstery, a power glass sunroof, front airbags and more.

The CLS, first launched in 2006, combines the elegance of a coupÃ© with the practicality of a saloon. Facelifted for 2008, Mercedes-Benz marketing folks like to incorrectly call it a coupe. Anyway, the CLS is a very expensive alternative to the car on which it is based, namely the E-Class. The CLS comes with an extensive list of standard features, including a 7-speed automatic transmission, ABS with stability program, CD radio with telephone keypad and 8 loudspeakers, cruise control with variable speed limiter, infrared remote control and visual locking-verification signal, speed-sensitive power steering, automatic climate control and two-stage front airbags and side bags, plus window bags. The new entry for 2008 is the CLS 280 with the 3.0-litre V6. Other models include an upgraded 3.5-litre CLS 350, the 5.5-litre CLS 500 and the 6.2-litre CLS 63 AMG, the latter two being new in 2007. Options include bi-xenon headlamps with Active Light System and cornering light function, COMAND control and display system for radio and navigation, Distronic proximity control, upholstery options, headlamp cleaning system, keyless start, parking sensors, semi-active air suspension, four-zone automatic climate control and a tyre pressure warning system.

The Australian-built Caprice has been redesigned from the ground up, but still remains one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers a choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the V8 engine as an option. The V6 was dropped by 2011, leaving the V8 as standard. The big V8 is standard on the sport-tuned SS and the luxury-tuned Royale. The Caprice continues to use a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Available features include front and rear proximity sensors, optional twin DVD screens, satellite navigation, power features, a cloth or leather interior, and more. ABS brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

Porsche released a facelifted 991.2-generation 911 GT3 sometime in early 2017. Changes made from the earlier 991.1-generation 911 GT3 are the engine and the spoiler, which is 20% taller along with the front bumper and the exhaust system. The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4.0-litre racing engine, upgraded to have the same power as a GT3 RS now. Another change from the 991.1 is the introduction of the spoiler-less touring version that includes a manual transmission, along with the regular version that has a choice between manual and PDK transmissions. It also has rear-axle steering and Porsche Torque Vectoring Plus with fully variable rear axle differential lock. The GT3 RS has been discontinued. The regular GT3 comes with a full interior, including a touchscreen multimedia system, auto a/c, a full set of airbags and other safety features.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. For 2013, a Roadster version was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The Maserati Quattroporte became larger and lighter in 2013, and for 2015, is offered with three engine options, namely two versions of a 3.0-litre V6 in the base Quattroporte and the mid-range Quattroporte S, and a 3.8-litre V8 in the Quattroporte GTS, all twin-turbocharged direction-injection units built by Ferrari, but using some Chrysler-derived parts. Both have an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive for the GCC market. Later on, an all-wheel-drive version for the Quattroporte S was available. The all-new architecture retains its 50:50 weight distribution, double-wishbone front suspension, and a five-link rear suspension. The more-spacious interior can be had with both four-seat and five-seat layouts. Cabin features include a Chrysler-sourced 8.4-inch touchscreen, adjustable pedals, reversing cameras and the optional 15-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system, as well as WLAN-based WiFi and Bluetooth compatibility. The screen includes navigation, reverse camera, DVD player, audio and ventilation functions. Adaptive cruise control, smart key with push-button start, front-side airbags and a dual-zone climate control system with 13 ventilation ports, complete the list of standard features.

The MKT is Lincoln's full-size luxury crossover that is based on the Ford Flex, with three rows of seating and tons of space. It got a facelift in 2013, along with minor improvements to the interior. According to Lincoln, the "T" in MKT, stands for Touring. Larger than the MKX midsize crossover and more efficient than the Navigator, the MKT is offered in the UAE with the turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Offered in either 6-seater or 7-seater configurations, a second-row 60/40 split folding bench seat, optional power "fold and tumble" second-row bucket seats include heating, cooling and power lumbar adjustment, and an available 5-quart refrigerator in the centre console, alongside all the usual features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, CD/MP3 stereo and Bluetooth phone. A fixed-glass panoramic roof with power-assisted front and rear sunshades is standard and an opening panoramic sunroof is optional. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as ABS and stability control.

Equipped with a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, the Renault Megane RS is the brand's top performance model sold in the region. Channeling that power is a 6-speed dual-clutch transmission. It comes with launch control. As for now, the manual transmission version is not available. The suspension sits 5 mm lower than the GT and sits on a stiffer suspension set up. The handling is further improved with the four-wheel steering. The exhaust system also puts out a decent soundtrack which adds to the fun factor. The exterior gets additional 60 mm wings, front splitter, functional rear diffuser, and full LED headlamps.For the interior, optional features include seats upholstered in Alcantara, along with Alcantara steering wheel, exclusive black headliner and red stitching. The centre console feature Renault’s R-Link multimedia system with the big screen. Optionally it gets Bose surround sound system with a sub-woofer. Rear camera, front and rear sensors are standard.Safety features include front and curtain airbags, blind spot monitor, tyre pressure monitoring system, hill start assist, ESP and ABS.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. It received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. They all come with a 5-speed manual gearbox or the optional 4-speed automatic, the latter available only on the 3.0-litre. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, but the top model can be outfitted with two-tone cloth seats, CD stereo, power windows, fog lights and keyless entry. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

The attractive GranTurismo is derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. A Sport version ups the ante with a 4.7-litre V8, which can either mated to a Electro-Actuated MC Shift or an optional MC-Shift automanual transmission. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale is also available, which has some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The attractive GranCabrio is convertible version of the GranTurismo, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is offered with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. The cloth roof drops electrically in 28 seconds and this can be done on the move at speeds of up to 30 kph. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. It is equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

From 2011, the Ford Mustang got two new aluminium engine choices, namely a 3.7-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, with a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. The Mustang is offered in coupe and glass-roof versions. Only the metal-top coupe will be offered with the manual gearbox with either engine, while the glass-roof will only be sold with an automatic. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, 18-inch to 19-inch aluminium wheel choices, power mirrors, 8-speaker "Shaker 500" CD/MP3 stereo with a six-disc changer, standard SYNC multimedia system with Bluetooth, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, variable "MyColor" gauge illumination, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe. A Roush model was made available in 2011, with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8.

Looking to ring bells in the midsize-SUV market is the BYD S6. Entering the GCC market, the S6 fights for space alongside dominant Japanese and Korean rivals. Under the hood, it gets a 2.4-litre engine. However, it is coupled to a dated 4-speed automatic. The interior is pretty plush for its price range though, and on offer is a 4.2-inch TFT speedometer, multi-information display screen, leather steering wheel with mounted controls, dual-zone A/C and Smart key system. Tick a few more boxes and the S6 receives a DVD system with a 7-inch touch screen and 9-speaker audio system. As for safety, the S6 comes standard with ABS and EBD and dual front airbags. Higher models get curtain airbags, rear parking sensors and rear-view camera parking system. The S6 is only on offer in select countries across the GCC including UAE, Oman and Kuwait.

The Jeep Renegade is the smallest SUV offering from the brand. It gets 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under the hood, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The base Renegade Sport model comes in front-wheel-drive format, while the Latitude, Trailhawk and Limited models are all-wheel drive platforms. Standard options include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, manual A/C, FM radio with AUX/USB support and alloy wheels. Higher options include automatic A/C, Infotainment system with screen, navigation, automatic A/C and leather seats. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, traction control and vehicle stability control.

New from the ground up for 2006 and much more better-looking, the M-Class, which actually uses the ML moniker, is a better on-road and off-road 4WD now. The ML 63 AMG is the top performance variant and it uses a 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic. Features include AMG alloy wheels, leather upholstery, tyre pressure loss warning system, crash sensors, front and side airbags, CD radio with pre-installation for mobile phone and more.

This generation of the Subaru Forester debuted in 2015 and carries on unchanged except for a facelift and minor trim updates in 2017. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The R8 is Audi's two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The convertible made its debut in 2011. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. There is also a more powerful 5.2-litre V10 engine. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or a R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK back in 2016. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. First released as a 2016 model year, it remains pretty much the same for 2018 as well. Under the hood, the GLC250 and GLC 300 get a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with two different tunes, both of which can be had in either two-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Featuring a further-retuned engine for 2013, the FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. Also standard are a low-range transfer case, a premium sound system, a washable interior and loads of optional accessories, including a rear-view camera, wi-fi, roof rack, pricey TRD alloy wheels and cheesy stickers. Available features in higher trims include cruise control, parking sensors, door scuff plates and step guards. 17-inch alloy wheels are standard, while some models get lower skid plates and optional rear diff lock. Safety features include standard front and side-curtain airbags as well as ABS, but stability control is available only on the top model.

The fourth generation of the VW Golf was a huge success during its long run. The clean and conservative styling combined with a vague sense of being a status symbol made it a hit among well-to-do yuppies. Available only as a 5-door hatchback here, with a variety of engine options upgraded over the years. Even a 4Motion all-wheel-drive model is available, though it may be hard to find in these parts. After its 1998 makeover, the Golf got considerably more tasteful inside, with nicely contrasting colours and patterns. The cabin offers sufficient room for six-footers, while the rear compartment is as small as any other compact. The cargo area under the hatch is huge for a compact, and the rear seats fold flat.
