Available features included power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, sunroof, alloy wheels and more, depending on trim level. A pair of airbags is standard on all models, with some getting side airbags as well, while ABS is standard. Engines included 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors. Sportier early models included the FWD or AWD GTI with a 2.3-litre V5, and an AWD 4Motion model with a 2.8-litre V6. In the later years, the V5 got more power. For its premium price, equipment levels were limited, with an underlying platform that had independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year. In 2018, it got a facelift and interior upgrades, but no mechanical changes. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG Coupe comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG Coupe gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Lexus RX got a minor facelift for 2013, the main change being the new spindle grill being adopted by all the models. Also joining the RX 350, will be a hybrid model called the RX 450h. The RX 350 gets the 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. However there is also an F Sport model which gets a bodykit as well as an 8-speed transmission which does not improve performance figures at all. The RX 450h gets a similar 3.5-litre V6 engine combined to three electric motors. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 19-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations.

Looking like an exotic sports car, but based on more conservative roots, the striking Mitsubishi Eclipse officially debuted for the 2009 model year in the GCC for the first time, after years of grey imports. This version of the Eclipse has actually been around in American markets for years now, and what the GCC gets is the facelifted version with a new grille. Under the hood, the new-for-2009 Eclipse comes with either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual or automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Both engines MIVEC variable valve timing, while all automatics feature a Sportronic mode to allow manual gearshifts. Safety includes standard advances dual-stage front airbags, seat-mounted side airbags and front seat curtain side airbags. Available cabin features, depending on trim, include a CD/MP3 stereo with changer and subwoofer, power windows, keyless entry, electric mirrors, split-folding rear seatbacks, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power-adjustable seats, sunroof, digital a/c and a two-tone interior. Mitsubishi has made the 650W Rockford Fosgate audio system with 9 speakers a standard fitment on all Eclipse trims. All models are equipped with front-wheel-drive, four-wheel disc brakes, ABS and electronic brake-force distribution. The V6-powered Eclipse GT features larger ventilated rear discs and standard 18-inch alloy wheels.

The Honda CR-V soft-roader has been facelifted for 2010, with minor upgrades and trim changes. The CR-V comes with a carryover 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive, though the lack of low-range gearing prevents off-road excursions. The spacious cabin offers cargo versatility and seating for five. The styling was radically revised for 2007, and the 2010 facelift consists of a new grille, bumpers and wheels. Inside, all the interior trim panels receive new textures and revised colours, as well as improved seat fabric, floor carpets and thicker door grips, as well as wider centre-folding armrests up front. Standard features for 2010 include manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo and optional 6-disc changer, an adjustable steering column, power mirrors, power windows, and power outlets, along with front airbags, keyless entry and alloy wheels. Newly-added standard features in the base RVi trim now include ABS, stability control, USB/AUX jacks, double-deck cargo shelf, and an overhead 'conversation' mirror, as well as a side-airbags option. Additional standard features on the top RVSi model includes auto-dimming rearview mirror, HID with optional turning feature, chrome exhaust tip, sunroof, leather steering wheel and shifter, lights in sun-visor mirrors, standard side airbags, and power-folding door mirrors. Leather is an additional option. Various body kit pieces are also available from the accessories catalogue.

The seventh generation BMW 5-series arrived in 2017. The 2021 BMW 5-Series got a facelift. The 520i and 530i has a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 540i model gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is a big 4WD that dates back to the 1992 version, relaunched with a new skin in 1998. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its reasonable on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder came for 2002, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A 4-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the 5-speed manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features.

The Lexus RC is the Japanese luxury brand's compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC carries on with a 3.5-litre V6 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, it got a facelift. Enhancements have been made to the RC's aerodynamics, tyres and suspension, and there are also improvements to engine response and steering feel. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control.

The new 5-Series reared its rakish head back in 2004. Facelifted for 2006, the extensive models available include the 523i, 525i, 530i, and, newly replacing the 545i are the 540i and the 550i. The 5-Series is available in both saloon and Touring wagon platforms, but the slow-selling wagons are not actively peddled in this region. The exterior design by Chris Bangle is controversial, especially the aptly-named "Bangle-butt" rear end. Its iDrive system has been simplified compared to the first-generation system that debuted in the 7-Series. It can be ordered with options such as Active Cruise Control, head-up display, active steering and a Harman Kardon Logic7 stereo system. Most of the 5-Series models are capable of high speeds but the electronic 250 kph limiter on all cars means that both the 530i and the M5 have the same top speed.

The Chevrolet Blazer made a comeback in 2019, slotting in between the Equinox and Traverse. Both engine options offered on the Blazer are naturally aspirated - with the base model getting the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the higher model gets a 3.6-litre V6 engine, both of which are mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The 2.5-litre is available in front-wheel drive and all-wheel-drive, while the 3.6-litre model only comes as all-wheel-drive. However, the rear axle can be completely cut-off in the AWD models to run only in FWD mode. Standard features in the Blazer include power steering, power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, 4.2-inch driver information display screen, infotainment system with an 8-inch touch screen including Bluetooth, Android Auto, and Apple CarPlay, 6 speakers and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS, stability control, traction control, and front, side and knee airbags. Higher models include options such as adaptive cruise control, leather seats, premium Bose audio system with sub-woofer, panoramic sunroof, surround vision camera, 20-inch and 21-inch alloy wheels, and wireless charging. The higher trims also get more safety features such as forward collision alert, automatic braking, pedestrian braking, lane departure warning, lane keep assist, blind spot monitor and park assist.

Launched in the United States back in 2006, announced in the GCC in early 2008, and finally launched here as a 2009 model, the Fusion is America's answer to the European Mondeo. It is odd that both cars are available here, with similar engines and mechanicals. The Fusion, based on a modified Mazda platform shared with the Mondeo, should attract a more-conservative clientele who may shy away from Ford's European offering. Featuring a three-bar chrome grille, a long body, and well-balanced suspension tuning, the Fusion offers comfortable interior room for both front and rear passengers, while promising an engaging drive. Powered by a 2.3-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a manual or automatic 5-speed gearbox and front-wheel-drive, the Fusion comes in three trim levels and standard features such as power windows, CD stereo, electric mirrors and more. Safety features include six airbags, ABS brakes and a stiff frame. On another note, the Fusion is built alongside the Mercury Milan and the Lincoln MKZ, all based on the same platform.

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports convertible. In 2017, two 4-cylinder engines were available, a naturally aspirated 1.6-litre and a supercharged 1.8-litre engine. Both are available with a 6-speed manual transmission. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. The soft-top is standard on the Elise, with the option of a hard-top as well. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The all-new GLK is the first Mercedes-Benz entry in the competitive compact soft-roader market, although its premium pricing and already-outdated styling are far from competitive. Available in GLK 280 trim with a 3.0-litre V6 and in GLK 350 trim with a 3.5-litre V6, both models come standard with 4Matic all-wheel-drive and a 7-speed automatic gearbox. The GLK apparently has some offroading pretensions, with an optional 'off-road styling package' that adds nothing but matte-black bumper strips and a simulated skidplate. Sizeable 19-inch alloy wheels are standard, with 20-inch ones being optional. Cabin features include two-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable front seats, Bluetooth interface, central 5-inch colour display, power accessories and an available power liftgate. Further extra-cost options include Xenon headlights with adaptive lighting and washers, rain-sensing windshield wipers, memory driver's seat, COMAND multimedia system with hard-drive navigation, rear-view camera, available rear-seat DVD entertainment system featuring two eight-inch screens, leather upholstery, wood trim and panorama sunroof. Safety features include front and side airbags, window airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The McLaren 570S gets the same twin-turbocharged 3.8-litre V8 as the 650S, but has 30% new components. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The 570S weighs just 1,313 kg and is longer than the 650S. It benefits from a newly developed front and rear suspension with adaptive dampers, front and rear anti-rollbars, and double wishbones. It rides on 19-inch front and 20-inch rear alloy wheels, wrapped around in some Pirelli P Zero Corsa tyres. Carbon ceramic brakes are standard. Inside, it gets a new TFT digital instrument cluster and a 7-inch touchscreen system that accomodates all climate controls and provides access to Bluetooth and radio. Alcantara and Nappa leather upholsteries as well as a carbon-fibre trim are optional extras. The 570S gets 4-speakers as standard but McLaren also offers a higher quality 8-speaker sound system or a 12-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system.

The CL-Class, the coupe version of the S-Class on which it is based, received a minor facelift for the 2011 model. This coupe features numerous innovative safety technology, such as up-front sensors which make it possible to assess the impact severity at an early stage during a crash and activate the front passenger airbag in two stages depending on the severity of the accident. Other features include Active Body Control for better handling, Intelligent Light System using bi-xenon headlights with five different lighting functions to match weather conditions. Options include night-view assist with infrared headlamps, reversing camera, voice control for car radio, DVD changer and navigation as well as tyre pressure monitoring system. Some new engines were introduced as well. Models include the CL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The CL 600 has the same 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8 carried over, which is mated to the old 5-speed automatic transmission. The performance model CL 63 AMG gets the new twin-turbocharged 5.5-litre V8, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. The CL 65 AMG still has the same 6.0-litre V12 bi-turbo engine, connected to a 5-speed automatic, but tweaked to give more power.

The Abarth 695 Rivale is a tribute to the Riva brand, a famous luxury boat manufacturer. The bodywork is presented in a two-tone blue and grey colouring, separated by a “Waterline” in Aquamarine colour. The intent is to give the idea of the sky that meets the grey asphalt, separated by a thin line that represents the sea. Door sills, dashboard and some details of the steering wheel, are covered with mahogany wood. It gets the UConnect multimedia system with a 7-inch screen, compatible with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Under the hood, it gets a 1.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to an Abarth 5-speed automatic transmission. The engine note is enhanced with the addition of an Akrapovic exhaust system. Safety standards are high with the Abarth 695 equipped with seven airbags as standard equipment. It also gets ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), electronic stability control (ESC), anti-slip regulation (ASR) system, the Hill Holder devices and hydraulic brake assistance (HBA) to help with emergency stops.

The previous Lancer will continue to be sold alongside this new Lancer. The new model, dubbed the Lancer EX, comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a 1.5-litre and a 2.0-litre. Both models come with a five-speed manual, while optionally, the smaller engine gets a four-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Features in the most basic model includes a driver's airbag, CD player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers. There are various trim levels right up to the top GT model which adds a sporting body kit, sunroof, adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, rear spoiler, leather steering wheel with audio switches, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, rear split seats with centre armrest, dual front airbags, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, paddle-shifters with the CVT, and a full keyless operation system.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that.

The Dodge Dart makes its debut in the region, but in limited numbers. With a standard 1.4-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed "DCCT" dual-clutch automatic, it certainly has a unique drivetrain for the segment. The base SXT model gets keyless entry with speed-sensitive power locks, power windows and mirrors, 17-inch alloys, manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Uconnect 8.4-inch touchscreen with voice command and Bluetooth, rear camera, USB port, remote start, active grille shutters for better aerodynamics, 60/40 split-folding rear seat with boot pass-through, auto-dimming mirror, fog lamps, auto halogen projector headlights and LED 'racetrack' taillamps, among other items. The Rallye version gets the black-out grille, sunroof and a unique alloy-wheel design, aside from an additional knee-airbag for the passenger. The top-spec Limited looks more conservative, but gets mirror-mounted indicators, dual-zone auto a/c, polished alloy wheels, one-touch up/down front power windows instead of for driver only, HID headlights, smart key with starter button and some electronic driving-safety aids. Safety features include standard front and side airbags, side-curtain airbags, driver's knee airbag with optional passenger knee-bag, standard traction and stability control, hill-start assist, rain brake support, active headrests, ready alert braking and tyre-pressure monitoring. The top model gets blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert. The Dart is only available in the UAE for now.

The redesigned-for-2011 Dodge Charger looks a bit like the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but feels like a completely different car compared to its predecessor. Identifiable by its larger snout and 164-LED tail lamps, the new rear-wheel-drive Charger features updated suspension, upgraded engines and a much nicer interior. The new 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to a 5-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in two trim levels. For 2012, an 8-speed automatic also became available for the V6. The base "Express" model gets a manual a/c, cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. The "Lux" trim level additionally comes with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with a 5-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. The base "Full House" trim gets almost all the features of the top V6 model except for leather and fancy cup-holders, but gains sportier suspension and brakes. The "Lux" adds power seats, the fancy cup-holders, premium audio and a few other features. The top "R/T" model gets the "Road and Track" performance package with sportier suspension, steering, exhaust, grille, spoiler, 20-inch alloys and a 3.06 axle ratio instead of the stock 2.65 one. The top model, the Charger SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Superbee SRT8 gained special graphics, but came with standard suspension rather than the full-spec SRT8's adaptive ones, along with fewer other features. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

An all-new Ford F-150 Raptor was made available in the GCC in 2021. It comes with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. The Raptor is available as a SuperCab or as a SuperCrew. Standard features on the 2022 Ford F-150 Raptor include power steering, power windows, cruise control, keyless entry, manual single-zone A/C, bucket seats with manual lumbar support, fabric upholstery, SYNC voice recognition communications and entertainment system, AM/FM stereo with 7 speakers, leather wrapped steering-wheel with mounted audio controls, reverse parking sensors with camera, and 17-inch alloy wheels with all-terrain tyres. Optional features on the 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor include the SYNC 3 system with an 12-inch touch screen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, B & O audio system and sub-woofer, power seats, navigation, moonroof, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, ventilated seats, active park assist, adaptive cruise control and blind spot monitor. All models of the 2021 Ford F-150 Raptor get front driver and passenger airbags, side curtain airbags, rollover sensor and stability control.

The new Audi Q5 is the smallest offering in the German manufacturer's limited SUV range, peddling its entry in the compact luxury 4WD field. The Q5 is available in the GCC with either a 2.0-litre turbocharged FSI 4-cylinder or a 3.2-litre FSI V6, both lifted from other VW products. Both versions come standard with an 'S-tronic' 7-speed dual-clutch automanual transmission. Also standard is Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive system, and will be available with the Audi 'Drive-Select' system to change its settings. Features include LED running lights and taillights, alloy wheels of up to 20 inches in size, seating for five with folding rear bench and a foldable front seat, and the usual power accessories. The Q5 will be available in several different trim options, including an 'S-Line' trim option with aggressive body mouldings and mesh foglight grills, while a faux 'Offroad' exterior package includes front and rear underbody protection panels, along with flared fender and door sill protection. Other available features, whether standard or optional, include a roof load sensor to adjust the stability control for the higher centre of gravity, rearview camera, navigation, high-beam assistant that automatically switches between the high and low beams, blind-spot monitor, adaptive cruise control, triple-zone climate control, intelligent keyless entry, electric parking brake, multiple airbags, MMI multimedia with speech control system, Bluetooth telephone, a DVD drive and TV tuner, an iPod interface and MP3 capability.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The BMW X5 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X5 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

Chinese Chery's range of cars are hilariously named, and looking at them will give you a feeling that you've seen them before, even if you've never heard of Chery. We have no experience with these cars either, so we'll just take stuff out of the brochure. We start off with the A11, also known as the Wind Cloud, and a car that looks remarkably like the Seat Toledo that was discontinued last decade. The company promises an elegant driving experience thanks to a Ford 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, a Siemens ABS braking system, two airbags from a company called American Breed, Webster electric sunroof and French Valeo air-conditioning. In short, it is an ideal model of outsourcing, except that other companies don't exactly brag about it. There is only a manual gearbox, while standard features thankfully include power windows, central locking, radio cassette player and a spare tyre. Options available on the top luxury model include a CD changer, leather upholstery, sunroof, imitation wood trim and a rear armrest. At least they are upfront about the fake wood, unlike Toyota.

The Cadillac XTS debuted in late 2012 as a new flagship, replacing the STS as well as the DTS. Based on a front-wheel-drive Chevrolet platform, the XTS is powered by a 3.6-litre direct-injection V6, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. It comes with a electronically-controlled limited-slip differential, adjustable suspension and Brembo brakes, with standard 20-inch wheels. For 2014, a V-Sport model with a turobcharged 3.6-litre V6 and all-wheel-drive joined the range. Features include leather upholstery, configurable 12.3-inch LCD display, CUE multimedia system, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, HID headlights, smart keyless entry/start and all the usual power accessories, with further available features such as heads-up display, adaptive cruise control. Safety features include multiple airbags, lane departure warning, collision alert, safety alert seat, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert and available automatic emergency braking.

The YRV has been billed as a young and innovative car, posing as a direct rival to models in a niche that no one wants to deal with. It's cheap to own, easy to drive and offers a similar package to the Toyota Yaris hatchback, with which it shares an engine, all for a cheaper price. The car has adequate space for two adults in the front, while the back may accomodate two adults in tight settings, or maybe three kids comfortably. The car is a comfortable cruiser on long journeys, although it will lose this advantage when the roads get slightly bumpy. The 1.3-litre 4-cylinder, with the manual or auto, lacks power for swift overtaking manouevres, but is fine for town traffic driving, as it is exceptionally light and easy to handle, paticularly when parking. Features include a radio cassette player, power windows, central locking, rear foldable seat, 14-inch steel wheels and not much else. It has a 40-litre fuel tank, which should last a while as the car is very frugal indeed. It looks like a little van though, which can put many buyers off.

The Nissan Altima received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year, including a restyled front end, new wheel designs, and new interior options. The Altima will be available with a choice of a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.5-litre V6. All versions get the CVT automatic as standard. However, many dealers started offering only the 2.5-litre automatic models from 2011. All GCC-spec Altima models come with a beige interior, in cloth or optional leather. The entertainment system has been upgraded with a optional new Bose premium stereo with nine speakers, optional 4.3-inch colour display, USB port with iPod connectivity, Bluetooth hands-free Phone System, MP3/WMA CD playback, and rear monitor. Also offered is an optional hard-drive navigation system with 6.5-inch VGA colour display, 9.3GB Music Box for music storage and playback, Bluetooth Streaming Audio, DVD player and an RCA input for auxiliary audio/video connectivity. The base 2.5 model gets 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and manually-adjusted seats. The higher 2.5 models gets 16-inch alloy wheels, Bose stereo, fog lamps, rear camera and cloth upholstery with options such as sunroof and spoiler. And the 3.5 gets 17-inch alloys, power driver's seat, spoiler and optional leather. All Altima models now come with stability control, front and side airbags, and ABS, with options such as side-curtain airbags and a tyre-pressure monitor.

The Fiesta is an entirely new sub-compact car from Ford's European division. Built in Germany, the Fiesta pushes the boundaries of small-car design with futuristic styling and sporty handling. Available only in 5-door form, economical engine choices include a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder with manual gearbox and a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with a manual or automatic. Available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trim levels, basic features include 15-inch steel wheels, electric power steering, capless fuel-filler system, full-size spare tyre, dual front airbags, cloth seats and manual windows. The top model can be outfitted with 15-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, rear 'sport' spoiler, front/rear parking sensors, automatic a/c, power windows, fog lamps, optional stability control, front and optional side-curtain airbags, driver's knee airbag, optional trip computer, keyless entry with push-button start, CD/MP3 with 6 speakers and steering-wheel controls, AUX input jack, Bluetooth, optional cruise control and more. For the first year, a limited-edition of 24 cars were launched in the UAE, each with differing custom-paint schemes.

The Maserati Quattroporte became larger and lighter in 2013, and for 2015, is offered with three engine options, namely two versions of a 3.0-litre V6 in the base Quattroporte and the mid-range Quattroporte S, and a 3.8-litre V8 in the Quattroporte GTS, all twin-turbocharged direction-injection units built by Ferrari, but using some Chrysler-derived parts. Both have an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive for the GCC market. Later on, an all-wheel-drive version for the Quattroporte S was available. The all-new architecture retains its 50:50 weight distribution, double-wishbone front suspension, and a five-link rear suspension. The more-spacious interior can be had with both four-seat and five-seat layouts. Cabin features include a Chrysler-sourced 8.4-inch touchscreen, adjustable pedals, reversing cameras and the optional 15-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system, as well as WLAN-based WiFi and Bluetooth compatibility. The screen includes navigation, reverse camera, DVD player, audio and ventilation functions. Adaptive cruise control, smart key with push-button start, front-side airbags and a dual-zone climate control system with 13 ventilation ports, complete the list of standard features.

The Rexton II is the latest version Ssangyong's attractive original Rexton. It was launched in the Middle East alongside two other now-defunct 4WDs back in 2002, and has survived with a facelift for 2007. The five-door Rexton can seat up to seven people and comes with a host of features. The most significant of these is the 3.2-litre inline-six engine built under license from Mercedes-Benz, based on a ten-year-old design. The engine is mated to a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability, and power reaches the road through a four-wheel-drive system that even includes low-range gearing. Available features include cloth or leather upholstery, fake wood trim, alloy wheels, CD player, keyless entry, power windows, cruise control and more. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side bags. The four-wheel disc brakes are assisted by ABS with Automatic Braking Differential, while traction control is also available.

An all-new Honda Pilot was released as a 2016 model. It got a facelift for the 2019 model year. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-liter Direct Injected V6 engine with Variable Cylinder Management (VCM), mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base EX model can be had in 2WD or AWD form, while the EX-L and Touring trims only come with AWD and no low-range gearing. The Pilot includes a traction management system and is featured on all models except the EX 2WD, with pushbutton mode selection and TFT mode display on the cockpit instrument panel. In addition, EX (AWD) & EXL grades offer 200 mm of ground clearance for better off-road ability. There is also a sand-mode feature. Features include halogen projector headlights in EX and EXL grades whereas LED projector headlights in Touring grade, which also gets a panoramic glass roof. Some of the other features standard in all grades includes front fog lights, LED taillights and LED daytime running lights along with Tailgate Spoiler, power door mirrors and LED turn light indicators. For the interior, an 8-inch touchscreen, standard in all grades, gives you access to audio system controls and other display features. The Touring grade includes second row captain's chairs, which provides easy walk through between the second and third row for a 7 passenger configuration. Other amenities include tri-zone automatic climate control, rear air conditioning duct in the second and third row seats, rear door sunshade, sun glass holder and conversation mirror, cargo area hidden storage for extra luggage, active noise control (ANC) for a quieter cabin, with a rear entertainment system with a 9-inch display screen available in the Touring grade. Safety features include Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD), Hill Start Assist (HSA), Agile Handle Assist (AHA) and Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS).

The T-Series, also known as the Chevy LUV sometimes, is a range of light pickup trucks that are actually rebadged models from Isuzu. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are these nifty stickers along the sides that hint at the T's non-sporting intentions. On a serious note, if these things came with a bigger engine and an automatic gearbox, we'd totally buy one in black, outfit it with big wheels, slap on some black-out tint and build a cheap blingmobile to cruise the streets in style.

The Caprice soldiered on for years on just minor updates, but it is still one of the few affordable large sedans in the market. It offers the choice of two powertrains, namely the 3.6-litre Alloytec V6 and the Corvette-derived 6.0-litre V8. The Alloytec V6 is available on the LS and LTZ models along with the Generation III V8 engine. However, there is a higher-output version of the V8 that is standard on the SS and the Royale. The Caprice uses a basic 4-speed electronic automatic transmission which includes an economy programme to ensure optimum fuel consumption and a power shift program to facilitate quick downshifting when required. The Royale has a chrome grille while the SS has a monochromatic paint job, whilst all models now have LED brake-lamps that increase in intensity depending upon the brake pressure applied. Latest optional features include front and rear proximity sensors, twin DVD screens, satellite navigation and a leather interior. ABS Brakes and traction control are also available throughout the range.

The 7-seater Mahinda XUV500 SUV debuted in the UAE with a 140 hp 2.2-litre turbocharged petrol engine and a 6-speed automatic, with features such as 6 airbags, a 7-inch infotainment system and cruise control. Available in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive variants, options include faux-leather upholstery, sunroof and more.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro Convertible was launched for the 2017 model year. While the exterior may not be that different from the previous generation, under the hood the 3.6-litre V6 and 6.2-litre V8 engines have been upgraded with more power. The Camaro also has a new 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, but it is not sold in the GCC. They can all be had with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 18-inch wheels for the V6 and 4-cylinder, and 20-inch ones for the V8. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The second generation Volkswagen Tiguan came as a 2017 model. It's 60mm longer, while the wheelbase has stretched by 77mm as a result of moving the front and rear axles closer to the extremities of the car. Width, too, is expanded by 30mm, when compared to the previous generation. There are two 4-cyinder turbocharged engines in the 2018 Volkswagen Tiguan, one a 1.4-litre and the other a 2.0-litre but available in two different states of tune. The front-wheel-drive 1.4 engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic 'DSG' gearbox, whereas the all-wheel-drive 2.0 gets the 7-speed 'DSG' gearbox. The 2018 Volkswagen Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parallel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera. Safety features include front and side curtain airbags, parking sensors, traction control, ABS and brake assist.

The Volkswagen Beetle Cabriolet made its debut in the GCC in 2016. It is powered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. It gets either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels.

The Montego is the Mercury version of Ford's Five Hundred fullsizer, offering pretty much the same deal as its twin. Based on a Volvo platform, this American model features slightly different front and rear designs than the Ford, with an identical cabin as well as the standard 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The standard model is front-wheel-drive, but all-wheel-drive is optional. Features include ABS brakes, traction control, keypad autolock, power mirrors, power windows, remote keyless entry, eight cupholders, CD stereo with MP3 audio jack, anti-theft system, and optional tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher models include dual-zone a/c, memory power seats, leather, fake wood trim and more. Available options include heated front seats, 18-inch chrome wheels, adjustable pedals, stability control, sunroof, reverse sensors, in-dash six-disc CD audio system and other items. Standard safety equipment includes dual-stage driver and passenger front air bags, seat-deployed side airbags for driver and front passenger, and side curtain airbags for both rows.

The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG came in 2008. The high-performance eight cylinder engine is partnered by the AMG Speedshift Plus 7G-Tronic transmission. Equipped with AMG steering wheel shift paddles there are three driving modes with the 'M' mode changing gears 50 percent faster than the Comfort setting. Outstanding handling dynamics comes thanks to an all-new three-link front axle design with springs and gas shock absorbers ensuring optimal road contact and low body movement in cornering. The multi-link independent rear suspension has a 12 millimetre wider track and more camber than the standard C-Class giving improved cornering performance. Inside the AMG instrument cluster in a tubular design features newly styled dials, AMG-specific lettering and a new night-time design. The AMG main menu in a central display allows numerous settings including Warm Up, Set Up and Race modes activated via buttons on the steering wheel. Warm Up displays engine oil and coolant temperatures, Set Up the current ESP mode and transmission settings. Race mode makes the Racetimer available with which the driver can measure lap times on a race track.

Creating a fixed-top version of the Azure convertible, the Brooklands coupe is limited to only 550 examples. The design of the four-seat shares its face as well as its 6.8-litre turbo V8 with the Arnage sedan. However, the rare Brooklands gets a higher-tuned version of the standard engine that beats in the Azure and the Arnage. The cabin and rear section of the car are a new design and the interior is crammed with every common luxury cue that defines a Bentley. The Brooklands is highlighted by a new laser-cut matrix grille that evokes the large sporting Bentleys that had won the 24 hours of Le Mans five times between 1924 and 1930. Bentley is now a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG. The spacious handcrafted interior features the highest level of leather and wood trim, individually tailored to the taste of each owner. The complex folding roof on the Azure convertible has been replaced by a traditional roof, shaped to look more sporting than the Arnage sedan, while still offering good space for rear passengers. Safety features in this classic include multiple airbags and the usual electronic nannies found in any modern car. though the platform remains a remnant from the last century.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. In 2017 it got a slight facelift and power upgrade. The SL 65 AMG comes with a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The Tata Xenon is the Indian manufacturer's answer to commercial vehicles which is currently dominated by the Japanese. Featuring a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine, the Xenon comes standard with power steering, power windows and air-conditioning. Unlike the name, it does not come with xenon headlamps. The Xenon can be had in either single cab or double cab, with the option of two-wheel drive or four-wheel-drive.

The Brilliance FSV, also known as the BS2 elsewhere, is a Chinese compact sedan that's built on technology partnerships from companies such as BMW and Toyota, with a Mitsubishi-design powertrain. Even the simplistic platform with independent-front torsion beam-rear suspension is said to be Lotus-tuned, while Italdesign Giugiaro had a hand in the styling. Available with a single 1.5-litre 4-cylinder "MIVEC" engine mated to a 4-speed automatic, the front-wheel-drive 5-seater is fairly class-competitive. Features in the base "Comfortable" trim level include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, front disc and rear drum brakes, power windows, tilt-adjustable power steering, speed-sensitive central locking, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, fabric upholstery, split-folding rear seats and a single rear foglamp. The "Deluxe" model adds 15-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, front and rear ventilated disc brakes, rear parking sensors, digital a/c, power mirrors, sunroof and front foglamps. All trim levels get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, alarm and collision beams in the doors.

The Mercedes-Benz AMG GT, or Mercedes-AMG GT as the marketeers like to call it now, is the first car entirely developed in-house by AMG. Four variants of the AMG GT will be available as of 2017, all with the same V8 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered in both variants through a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The standard AMG GT gets a mechanical rear-axle locking rear differential while the AMG GT C gets an electronic locking rear differential. The GT C also has an AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with electronically controlled dampers with three different modes - Comfort, Sport and Sport Plus. The AMG GT R is the top performance model, with more power, modified suspension and more aerodynamic thanks to exterior mods. The GT R also gets all-wheel steering for better handling performance. The AMG GT doesn't weigh so much for its size, thanks to the body structure being built through a mixture of steel, aluminium and magnesium. Safety standards are high in the AMG GT with front and side airbags, traction control, ABS brakes and stability control.

An all-new model of the BMW X4 came out for the 2019 model. The X4 20i and X4 xDrive30i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, with two different tunes. Both are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic. The X4 M40i is available with a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder motor, mated to an 8-speed auto transmission as well. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Maxima was a hot car when it was first unveiled in this iteration. However, Nissan's GCC division chose to let this model stagnate to the point where it was easily overshadowed by the newer Altima, even when the Maxima was redesigned in other markets and transformed into a luxury cruiser. The GCC-spec Maxima also still uses Nissan's older version of the corporate V6, with a displacement of 3.0-litre, combined with front-wheel-drive, and with a choice of five-speed manual and four-speed auto gearboxes. Performance is very respectable even after all these years. It comes with automatic air-conditioning, CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, ABS-assisted disc brakes, cloth seats, front airbags and many wheel choices, depending on model. The basic model gets 15-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include an in-dash CD changer with subwoofer, cruise control, sunroof, rear electric sunshade and leather cabin trim. Changes from year to year largely involve a new grille style every few years.

An all-new GLS-63 AMG model came out in 2020. The GLS uses 4MATIC, the permanent Mercedes-Benz four-wheel drive system, with special off-road features such as Downhill Speed Regulation (DSR), hill-start assist and off-road ABS assist. The package includes a two-speed transfer case with a low range ratio and 100 percent differential locks for the transfer case and the rear axle. The GLS 63 AMG comes with a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The performance of the V8 biturbo engine is enhanced by a further 16 kW courtesy of the integrated starter-alternator - resulting in impressive torque. Equipped with the third-row individual seats, the GLS-Class is a full-size seven-seater. Either one or both seats can be electrically folded to create a continuously level load floor. All the usual Mercedes-Benz safety and luxury power features are included in this one too.

An all-new Mazda CX-5 was launched as a 2018 model year. The standard engine is a direct-injection 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There is one front-wheel-drive and two all-wheel-drive versions available. All models get a dual-zone auto a/c, keyless entry, fabric upholstery, 40:20:40 split-folding rear seat, USB port, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys and a 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo. The top version additionally comes with smart keyless start, HID headlights, leather upholstery, sunroof, 9-speaker Bose stereo, lane-change monitor, rear camera, 19-inch alloys and a few other knick-knacks. The CX-5 comes equipped with optional safety tech such as ABS, stability control and front as well as side airbags as standard. Lane-change warning and rear monitoring with camera are available only on the top model.

An all-new Lincoln Navigator debuted for 2018, still a rebodied version of the new-for-2018 Ford Expedition. The new Navigator makes extensive use of high-strength aluminium-alloy to lose weight while offering more space inside. Power continues to be provided by an uprated twin-turbo V6 and mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, similar to the Ford F-150 Raptor. The top model is known as the Signature. Inside, both front seats feature heating/cooling/massaging functions and are adjustable in 30 ways. Rear seats have a recline function. Available rear-seat entertainment features include 10-inch adjustable screens. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are part of the standard SYNC 3 touchscreen system, along with navigation, Bluetooth, phone, etc. A total of 20 speakers with the optional Revel II audio system can create distinct listening modes including audience, on-stage, and stereo. A Lincoln “welcome mat” will illuminate on the ground beneath the front doors, and the Lincoln star badge in the grille lights up too. Other available notable features include powered side-steps, heads-up display, customisable LCD gauge cluster and USB ports for the power-adjustable third row. Safety features are extensive, with a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, al-round parking sensors with cameras and all that.

The Jaguar XE is the smallest car offering from the British brand. It got a slight facelift and some interior updates in 2020. The XE is offered with two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. The turbocharged engine is offered in two different tunes. All models get the 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options in the XE include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, dual-zone AC, smart key system with keyless start, 8-inch display screen, 6 speakers, cloth seasts, paddle shifters and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher option models get leather seats, sunroof, ventilated seats, xenon headlights, adaptive cruise control, head-up display, bodykit, and 18 to 19-inch rims. Safety features include All Surface Progress Control (ASPC), Torque Vectoring by Braking (TVbB), ABS, dynamic stability control (DSC), lane departure warning, closing vehicle sensing, autonomous emergency braking, driver and passenger front and side airbags.

An all-new Chevrolet Tahoe was released as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can now fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

BAIC is a Chinese car company which made its debut in the UAE in late 2014, followed by other GCC countries in the next few years. The BAIC A1 hatchback comes is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They are come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

From 2011, the Ford Mustang Convertible got two new aluminium engine choices, namely a 3.7-litre V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, with a new 6-speed automatic transmission. The interior comes in cloth or leather, a soft-touch dashboard and aluminium trim, though some hard plastics remain. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, stability control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, 18-inch to 19-inch aluminium wheel choices, power mirrors, 8-speaker "Shaker 500" CD/MP3 stereo with a six-disc changer, standard SYNC multimedia system with Bluetooth, front and side-curtain air bags, power locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, cruise control, optional reverse camera, variable "MyColor" gauge illumination, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, power driver's seat and optional panoramic roof on the coupe.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 cabriolet is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

Offered from 2011 to 2014 alongside a regular V6 base CTS coupe is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8-powered Cadillac CTS-V Coupe. It can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. All the cars are rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterised by a large chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The redesigned-for-2011 Chrysler 300 looks similar to the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but in reality has many major changes, including a sharper-sloping windshield and a lower belt-line for better visibility. The new 300 thankfully remains rear-wheel-drive and features updated suspension, upgraded engine and a much nicer interior. The top model, the 300 SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Getz, new in 2003 and facelifted in 2006, is known for offering "European" levels of refinement. We feel it is let down only by its weak range of engines, namely a tiny 1.1-litre, followed by a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all four-cylinder units, some with a manual gearbox and others with an automatic. This front-wheel-drive hatchback comes standard with very little, but includes air-conditioning, a rear wiper with washer, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, and wind-up windows. Options in the higher trim levels include power steering, ABS brakes, a single airbag, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, sunroof, rear spoiler, fog lamps, keyless entry system, a radio and cassette player and fake carbon-fibre trim. The interior is well-made, with good materials. It is not too cramped inside either, with seating for five and decent legroom both front and back. All trim levels come with a cloth cabin and a useful rear luggage area with a lift-up tailgate. Small 14-inch steel wheels with plastic hubcaps.

The Mountaineer is supposed to be a more upscale version of the Ford Explorer, and it certainly looks like it from the outside. It shares its structure and most major components with the Explorer, but apparently it shares a lot of the interior as well, thus diminishing brand differences. The Mountaineer is also powered by the Explorer's 4.0-litre V6, mated to a five-speed automatic, but it loses low-range gearing for its four-wheel-drive system The interior theoretically offers seating for up to eight people with three rows of seats, with a third-row seat that can fold flat. Standard interior features include a CD stereo, power windows and mirrors, available CD changer and sunroof, cruise control, available leather upholstery, and standard alloy wheels. The Mountaineer also builds on Ford's strong safety offerings, offering standard AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, ABS brakes, dual front airbags and a tyre-pressure monitoring system, while the Safety Canopy side-curtain airbag system is optional.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2015 model year and will now be available only as a 4-door sedan. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

The Chrysler 300 got a facelift in 2015. The new 300 is rear-wheel-drive and gets a 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual capability. The base model gets cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. Higher trim levels additionally come with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with an 8-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. Standard features include cruise control, 18-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inch wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry with starter button. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more.

The 407 remains the odd-one-out in the overly-competitive midsize car segment, with styling that still looks good today as it did when the model was launched in 2005. For 2009, the 407 has received a minor facelift comprising on exterior trim add-ons, new tail-lights and mild changes in engine output. Now available in four-door sedan and two-door coupe body styles only, the wagon version has been dropped. There are three engine choices available for the sedan. The entry level engine is a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine combined with a 4-speed automatic with a tiptronic function. Then there is a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with the same 4-speed automatic gearbox. The top model is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with a 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 407 comes with 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, depneding on trim level. All models get eight or more airbags, as well as stability control and ABS.

The Lexus RC is the Japanese luxury brand's compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control.

The VW Touareg is a luxurious and comfortable 4WD that is surprisingly capable both on the road and off it too. It is a practical vehicle, and on the highway, the Touareg offers a firm but smooth ride, and its handling is responsive for its mass, while in the desert, a full set of off-roading equipment comes in handy, including locking diffs and low-range gearing. The range includes a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a very limited 6.0-litre W12. All models come with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Also standard is Volkswagen's 4Motion permanent all-wheel-drive system. The Touareg seats five, and there is no third row of seats available. The Touareg comes standard with leatherette upholstery, dual-zone climate control with rear seat controls, wood trim, power windows, mirrors and sunroof, electrically adjustable front seating, alloy wheels of various sizes, ABS and many more items. Higher models get leather, auto-dimming outside mirrors with memory; and other luxuries. All models include front, side-impact and curtain airbags.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The limited-production twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 G65 AMG has been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. It comes over here as only a 5-door wagon. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet made its debut back in 2007. In 2010 it received power upgrades and a new automatic gearbox. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets an updated all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Another option in the Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

The Toyota Camry is a favourite among individuals and fleet buyers. The Camry sedan was completely redesigned and greatly improved for 2003, becoming a much larger car than its predecessor. For 2005, the Toyota Camry received a minor facelift, although most buyers will not be able to spot the changes. By the end of production, the Camry was being offered as four models, namely the XLi, GLi, Touring V6 and Grande V6. All 4-cylinder models come standard with a five-speed manual transmission, while a four-speed automatic transmission is standard on the V6 and optional on the 4-cylinder models. The base four-cylinder Camry XLi and GLi sedans come with air conditioning, power windows, central locking, AM/FM/cassette stereo, a 60/40 split rear seat and 15-inch steel wheels. The Touring and Grande Mid-Range grades add a V6 engine ABS with Electronic Brake force Distribution (EBD), an engine immobilizer, and aluminium wheels, front fog lamps and rear spoiler, while the top-of-the-range Grande adds cruise control, moonroof, keyless entry, leatherette and CD changer. Front airbags were standard on all models. These cars are very spacious, and used to sell when new midsize cars were actually affordable.

The Volvo XC40 debuted as a new subcompact crossover model for 2018, slotting in under the XC60. Initially, the only version on offer is the XC40 T5 with a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. The two trim levels at launch are R-Design and Momentum. The interior features Volvo's latest design ideas such as the vertical a/c vents, aside from the portrait-mode touchscreen. The mid-range Momentum model is generously equipped with a 12.3-inch digital instrument display, a 9-inch touchscreen infotainment system, dual-zone climate control, rear parking assist, and leather seats as standard. Stepping up to the R-Design trim will add leather and aluminum trim, twin exhaust tips, and sport suspension. Safety features include a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking, City Safety for pedestrian detection, and the Pilot Assist system for semi-autonomous steering, acceleration, and braking on “well-marked” roads, a feature that will work up to 128 kph.

The Wrangler has been redesigned for 2007, with a stiffer frame, revised suspension, a new engine, and fresh styling. The all-new real jeep is longer and wider, more refined, and for the first time, offered with four doors. Now powered by a 3.8-litre V6, with a manual or automatic, it still offers low-range gearing and off-road capability. In 2011, the interior was redesigned completely, with a new dashboard and door panels, while body-coloured exterior plastic trim and roof were offered. The lengthened four-door wheelbase also provides room for a three-wide rear seat in the new Unlimited, making for five-passenger capability. It also offers more ground clearance, more wheel articulation and some new suspension hardware. For the first time, the Wrangler offers an optional electronic-disconnecting front stabiliser bar. This Active Sway Bar System allows more front-wheel travel over obstacles. Also available is the Command-Trac part-time four-wheel-drive system. A Trak-Lok limited slip differential and Rock-Trac with special off-road tyres also are available. Comfort features include power windows, CD/MP3 stereo, and even a voice-controlled 'UConnect' Bluetooth telecom system. Safety includes stability control, ABS brakes, front airbags and seat-mounted side-airbags. It can be equipped with a new three-piece hardtop with removable panels. Also available is a Sunrider soft top with a sunroof feature. The dealer also offers a huge catalogue of original offroad accessories, such as lift kits, metal bumpers, monster tyres and the like, which can get quite expensive if every add-on is chosen.

The S2000 is a small two-seat roadster that can easily chase the likes of the snobby Porsche Boxster. It is a technological innovation from Honda, whose aim with this car was to pump as much horsepower out of a small 2.0-litre engine as possible, without any turbo or supercharging trickery. The S2000 is said to drive like a superbike, because big horsepower from small displacement with a narrow powerband and extremely high rpm produces a very frantic experience. Driving it slowly, shifting the manual at low rpm apparently results in very weak performance in traffic. The latest model has refinements to the engine and suspension put in place back in 2005. Changes to the S2000 in 2006 include more shoulder and elbow room, and some tweaks, most notably 17-inch wheels, drive-by-wire throttle, stability control and new headlights with a triple-beam design. Early models had a plastic rear window, while 2002-plus models get a glass one. The last external facelift was in 2004. Interior features are basic, but include leather upholstery, electric power steering, starter button, power windows, power mirrors, remote central locking, air-conditioning and a pathetic radio cassette stereo with 2 speakers.

The sister-model to the hotly-anticipated Toyota 86, the Subaru BRZ finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. The BRZ is a collaborative effort with Toyota, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates, with only a front bumper different between the two.
