Optional features include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Andriod Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist.

The Tata Indica is an outdated hatchback first launched in India back in 1998, and on sale in the GCC for the first time from 2008 onwards, but only in select countries such as Saudi Arabia. The Indica is considered India's first indigenously-developed passenger car. In reality, the engine and engineering came from within India, but the exterior styling was largely handled by an Italian design firm. Italian styling would've been cool if it wasn't out-of-date by a decade. The five-seater is powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine that is consumes less fuel than larger cars in general, but nowhere near as efficient as modern Japanese subcompacts. Standard features include a 5-speed manual and not much else. However, it can be outfitted with power steering, basic a/c, alloy wheels, power windows, keyless entry, disc brakes, four-spoke steering wheel, tinted windows, fog lamps, rear spoiler with integrated LED stop lamp, two-tone interior colours, chrome exterior trimmings, tachometer, child lock on rear doors, ABS and front airbags.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

The Nissan Patrol Pickup is the commercial version of the more popular Nissan Patrol Safari model. It gets the 4.8-litre inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission.  It comes with a Straight-line drive transfer which allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol Pickup has a baisc interior featuring cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, and16-inch steel wheels. Front airbags, EBD, VDC and ABS are standard.

An Hyundai Elantra received a significant facelift in 2019. Under the hood, the 2019 Hyundai Elantra gets two 4-cylinder engines, a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models of the 2019 Hyundai Elantra get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features on the 2019 Hyundai Elantra include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Kia Picanto, one of the few superminis available in the GCC, underwent a complete redesign for 2012, increasing slightly in size to improve interior space. The Picanto remains a 5-seater hatchback, powered by a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with "dual CVVT" variable valve timing. Only the base model can be had with a 5-speed manual, while the three higher trims get a 4-speed automatic. Features, most of which are optional, includes LED front markers, LED rear lamps, cloth or leatherette upholstery, 13-inch or 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, 14-inch or 15-inch alloy wheels, UV-reducing solar windscreen glass, manual or automatic a/c, electric folding door mirrors, automatic light control with "˜welcome and escort' modes, passenger seat storage tray, under-floor trunk storage box, retractable dual cup holders with mood lighting, sun visors with illuminated vanity mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and iPod/USB ports, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, fog lamps, power windows and sunroof. Safety features, available only on the top model, includes ABS and one airbag.

The Kia Carens compact MPV is all-new for the 2007 model year, and is available with a seven-seat cabin. The new Carens is completely different from the old one, sharing only the name of the previous model. Longer, wider and taller than its goofy predecessor, the latest Carens offers more interior space than most 4WDs thanks to better packaging. Inside the cabin, the middle and rear row seats fold down to create a flat-floored luggage area. With five seats occupied, luggage space is more than 400 litres and with just the driver and front passenger on board, up to 2,106 litres of cargo can be carried. It is offered with a relatively weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic transmission that offers sequential manual selection. The model has a hydraulic power-assisted rack and pinion steering system with relatively high gearing, requiring just 2.86 turns of the wheel from lock-to-lock with the standard 16-inch wheels. Features include front and rear disc brakes backed up by ABS with EBD, CD stereo, four forward-opening doors, and an undetermined number of airbags.

The Kia Soul is part of the Korean manufacturer's new product offensive. Being touted as a crossover, it is really a tall compact hatchback, designed to be appealing for our misguided urban youth. Featuring tons of cabin space, the updated-for-2012 front-wheel-drive Kia Soul is powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, both mated to a 4-speed automatic. Available in two trim levels, the basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, a single driver's airbag, roof rack, fog lamps, CD stereo with iPod input, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seat, black cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better CD stereo with a sub-woofer and illuminated speakers, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, underfloor tray and power outlet in the boot, luggage net, some extra trim. dual front airbags and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of black, beige and red two-tone interiors. Optional features are extensive, largely limited to appearance kits, such as funkier alloy wheels, stickers, chrome trim, front and rear skirts, and shiny fuel caps. In addition to front airbags, ABS is available on all except the base model, but stability control and side airbags are not available on GCC-spec models.

The Lexus LC is the Japanese luxury brand's first attempt at a grand tourer model. The 2-door coupe gets two engine choices - the LC500 gets naturally aspirated 5.0-V8 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, the other a 3.5-litre V6 coupled with an electric motor, with power transmitted via a hybrid transmission, which is a combined 4-speed automatic and CVT. Standard features on the LC 500 include power steering, power windows, electric foldable mirrors, cruise control, LED headlamps, smart entry and start system, front and rear corner sensors, panoramic roof, leather seats, 10-way power front seats, Mark Levinson surround sound system, DVD player, 2 USB ports, Bluetooth, 13 speakers, navigation, head up display, LED interior lighting package, seat ventilation and 21-inch alloy wheels. There is a "Carbon" edition available for the V8, with carbon moon roof, carbon scuff plates, sports seats and Lexus Dynamic Handling, which is the luxury brand's 4-wheel steering wheel system. Safery features include pre-crash safety systems, lane keeping assist, automatic high beams system, blind spot monitor, rear cross traffic alert, ABS, traction control, vehicle stability control and front, side & knee, curtain airbags.

The second-generation Peugeot 308 went on sale in the GCC in 2015. The same  is turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. In 2019, it got a slight facelift and interior upgrades. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. In 2017, the convertible joined the lineup. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

JAC M5 is the Chinese brand's large minivan offering. It features a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, trip computer, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 7-inch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system, rearview camera, folding mirrors. leather seats and xenon headlamps. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes, brake assist (BA) and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Toyota Prado SWB debuted as an all-new model in 2010. The engine on offer for the SWB from 2013 onwards is only the 2.7-litre 4-cylinder, mated to an automatic transmission. All models have four-wheel ventilated disc brakes as well as independent front and live-axle rear suspension. The 2.7L 3-door model, available in one trim in the UAE and gets 17-inch alloy wheels, common power accessories, keyless entry, single-CD stereo with 6 speakers, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, manual front and rear a/c, fog lamps, rear spoiler, side steps, rear parking sensors, fabric upholstery, chrome door handles, tilt-telescoping steering column, dual front airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The redesigned-for-2008 CTS 4-door sedan gave birth to the Cadillac CTS-V sedan in 2009. Powering the rear-wheel-drive CTS-V is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 that can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. The exterior is characterized by a larger chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V also gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

An all-new Ford Edge made its way to the GCC in 2016. It comes with three engine options. One is the same 3.5-litre V6 engine seen in the previous generation. The other two are turbocharged "Ecoboost" engines, of which one is the base 2.0-litre and the top variant with 2.7-litre. They all get a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. Moving up the trim levels, a number of options become available, including a panoramic Vista Roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats, Ford MyTouch touchscreen with SYNC voice-controlled multimedia computer and Sony stereo, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Optional features include HID headlights, adaptive cruise control and bigger alloy wheel options. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, with options such as blind-spot monitor, rear camera and cross-traffic detection.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur debuted as a 2020 model year. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i and the M235i. The 220i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M235i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto or a 6-speed manual. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M235i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

An all-new Chevrolet Silverado was released as a 2014 model year. It received a facelift and new transmission for the 2017 model year. A Z71 package is available which includes stronger shocks, front tow hooks and extra under-body protection. The interior gets a 4.2-inch display on the dashboard. The Silverado pickups has 12-volt outlets, five USB ports and a SD-card slot. There is a 4.3-litre V6, 5.3-litre and 6.2-litre V8 motors. The V6 model gets a 6-speed auto, but the V8 models get a new 8-speed automatic transmission. For improving fuel economy, all engines have cylinder deactivation and direct injection.

The Ford Ecosport is a new addition to the American brand's increasingly international line-up. Built in several countries around the world, this little crossover comes from India for the GCC market. In 2018, it got a facelift. The standard engine is a simple 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic gearbox, and it only comes in front-wheel-drive form with SUV-like ground clearance. Measuring only a little more than a sub-compact hatchback in length, the Ecosport seats five, with a small boot behind the sideways-opening tailgate. Standard features on the base Ambiente trim include a 2-way manual-adjustable driver's seat, 60:40-split folding rear seat, electric power steering, front-disc rear-drum brakes, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, power windows, front floor mats, adjustable steering column, rear wiper, rear fog lamp, cooled glovebox, basic keyless entry, and 15-inch steel wheels with covers or optional 16-inch alloys. The mid-range Trend trim adds a 4-way manual-adjustable driver's seat, additional storage spaces, 6-speaker stereo, voice-activated SYNC multimedia system, USB port, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, one-touch function on power windows, standard 16-inch alloys, body-colour trim, light-coloured grille, front fog lamps, roof rack, and cruise control with the optional automatic transmission. The top Titanium model additionally gets a lumbar-adjustable driver's seat with armrest, standard automatic gearbox, unique 16-inch alloys, Bluetooth, extra map lights, climate control, rain-sensing front wipers, auto headlights, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra power-point in the boot, rear floor mats, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, silver roof rack, trip computer, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and a seatbelt warning for front passengers, with optional features such as leather upholstery and soft-touch door armrests. All versions get dual front airbags, ABS, stability control and engine immobiliser, with the Trend and Titanium further getting side and curtain airbags as well as a perimeter alarm. Optional accessories include roof-rack crossbars, spare wheel cover, metal pedal covers, carpeted floor mats, rear spoiler, mud guards and more.

The Renault Laguna Coupe is a French-built 2-door that comes with a Nissan-developed 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. Featuring a unique design, one of the best features of the Laguna Coupe is its four-wheel steering, or 4-control as they like to call it, which turns the rear wheels slightly along with the front for better cornering ability. Basic features include leather seats, Bose stereo system, alloy wheels, hands-free key card, auto headlamps and auto wipers. Safety features include six airbags, ABS and electronic stability control.
An all-new GMC Yukon came out in 2021.

A new-generation Kia Sorento made its debut in 2015. The Sorento is a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension. The available engines for the GCC are a 3.3-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive as well as a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available with cloth or leather upholstery. The Sorento can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, xenon headlamps, LED indicators on the mirrors, seat cooler and warmer in the front, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch or 19-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

Launched in 2005 and facelifted for 2008, the compact S40 sedan is based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the S40 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The S40 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre, a higher-tuned 2.4-litre and a turbocharged 2.5-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The 2015 Dodge Charger SRT received a significant facelift. From 2019, only the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 powered SRT Hellcat was available. For 2021, it got a host of upgrades to the interior, exterior and mechanical bits. Also a Charger SRT Hellcat Redeye was added to the lineup. Both get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard SRT features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Charger SRT Hellcat receives a large, power-bulge aluminium hood, which features a dedicated air intake. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.A new widebody kit version was added to the lineup in 2020.

Replacing the awkward-looking 1-Series Coupe, the BMW 2-Series made its debut as a 2014 model year. In 2018 it got a slight facelift and updated interior, and the M235i changed to M240i with more power. Variants sold in the GCC include the 220i, 230i and the M240i. The 220i and 230i coupe comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic. The M240i coupe comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder, again with an 8-speed auto. The 2-Series will be offered in basic, Sport Line, Modern Line and the M Sport trim. The M240i only comes in M Sport trim. The cabin also features a few upholstery and trim choices unique to the Sport Line. The M Sport gets retuned suspension and sits 10 mm lower, riding on unique lightweight 18-inch alloy wheels. An aero kit and a unique grille are included, as are sport seats, unique dash trims and options such as variable sport steering, an M Sport braking system and adaptive M suspension. A Driving Experience Control feature is available, utilising a rocker switch near the shifter that allows drivers to change between a number of modes for the car's suspension, throttle, transmission, steering and engine settings. Safety standards are always high in BMWs, with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

An all-new model of the Audi A7 came out in 2019. Almost 5 metres long with a low roofline, the Audi A7 Sportback is a full-sizer and as with all Audi sedans,  really rides a front-wheel-drive platform, with optional 'Quattro' all-wheel-drive tacked onto the higher trim levels. Currently only the 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 is the only engine option available in the GCC. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system. Optional equipment include interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound.

JAC J5 is the Chinese brand's 7-seater minivan offering. It features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, fabric seats, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with MP3/USB/AUX support, 6 speakers, roof rails, parking sensors and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better stereo system with 8 speakers, fog lamps, automatic headlamps and leather seats. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Chevrolet Corvette C6 is the most capable Corvette ever. The LS2 V8 powerplant has grown to 6.2 litres for 2008, with power and torque that is killer at the track and useable in regular driving. The standard tranny is an updated 6-speed manual gearbox, while a new 6-speed automatic with paddles is optional since 2007. The steering is improved for 2008. Large 18-inch wheels at the front and 19-inch at the rear and exposed headlamps with fixed Xenon HID lights continue to define the Corvette. Available as a hatchback coupe with a lift-off roof panel or as a convertible with a fabric soft-top and heated glass rear window, while a power top is also available, as are optional magnetic shocks and a two-mode exhaust. The new race-bred Corvette Z06 packs a massive 7.0-litre V8 engine, and comes in manual coupe form only, offering performance that rivals Ferrari. In 2009, the Corvette ZR1 was launched, with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 and 6-speed manual, along with various upgrades such as some carbon-fibre body panels, stiffer suspension, bigger brakes and more. The Corvette's only letdown is the less-than-stellar interior, although GM makes up for it with gadgets such as keyless start, button-actuated door opening and a heads-up display. Other available features include touchscreen navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, power seats, front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, leather and more. Previously, a Z51 package was available for the base Corvette with upgraded suspension, close-ratio manual gearbox and other mods, but from 2010, a Grand Sport version based on the regular model replaced that package with similar mods derived from the Z06.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The coupe and powered soft top models almost have the same rigidity. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Envoy is powerful and capable midsize off-road vehicle, which is just the right size to not be a pain on the roads. It has a rigid chassis, good off-road suspension, powerful brakes and a spacious enough interior to compete in this class. It is stable at high speeds, wobbly around curves, and comfortable over rough surfaces, while being quite capable off-road, thanks to a proper four-wheel-drive system with low-range gearing. The Envoy also comes in an XL trim with an extended wheelbase that adds a third row seat. The Envoy comes with an upgraded-for-2006 Vortec 4.2-litre inline 6-cylinder engine that generates very respectable numbers, similar to the V8 motors of some competitors. And then there is 5.3-litre V8 engine that can be had as an option only on the EXT. The V8 is equipped with GM's Displacement on Demand technology as standard which deactivates four cylinders under certain driving conditions to aid fuel efficiency, returning the full complement of power once the controller senses vehicle speed or load requires additional power. Both engines use a Hydra-Matic four-speed auto transmission. The Denali version adds chrome trim and some luxury interior features.

The 5-seater Jeep Grand Cherokee, redesigned for 2011, firmly moves up one level in this iteration, with a new-found emphasis on quality. Offered with a choice of a new 3.6-litre "Pentastar" V6 or an upgraded 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8, both come with a 5-speed automatic, four-wheel-drive with low-range and three trim levels. By 2012, the 5.7-litre models got a 6-speed automatic. The base Laredo is V6 only, the Limited can be V6 or V8, and the Overland is V8 only. An SRT8 version debuted for 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8, 5-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. For non-SRT versions, depending on trim level, there is a choice of two 4x4 systems, new Quadra-Lift air suspension on the Overland, and a new Selec-Terrain system with crawl control. The all-new Mercedes-Benz-derived platform has independent front and rear suspension, stiffer new body structure and more space. Even the Laredo is well-equipped, with body-colour bumpers, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, power driver's seat, dual-zone manual a/c, keyless start, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, HID automatic headlights, fog lamps, and the usual power accessories. The Limited adds leather, Alpine premium audio, automatic a/c, panoramic roof, 18-inch wheels, rain-sensing wipers, navigation, 30GB hard drive and UConnect Bluetooth phone. The Overland adds real leather, real wood trim, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The new 5-Series reared its rakish head back in 2004. Facelifted for 2006, the extensive models sold in GCC include the 523i, 525i, 530i and the 545i. The 5-Series is available in both saloon and Touring wagon platforms, but the slow-selling wagons are not actively peddled in this region. The exterior design by Chris Bangle is controversial, especially the aptly-named "Bangle-butt" rear end. Its iDrive system has been simplified compared to the first-generation system that debuted in the 7-Series. It can be ordered with options such as Active Cruise Control, head-up display, active steering and a Harman Kardon Logic7 stereo system. Most of the 5-Series models are capable of high speeds but the electronic 250 kph limiter on all cars means that both the 530i and the 545i have the same top speed.

This is the second generation of Toyota RAV-4. Often credited with creating the soft-roader genre, th e RAV-4 is one of the most fuel-efficient crossover SUVs on the market. It has to be, given that it is powered by a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, it comes standard with all-wheel drive for the GCC. The RAV-4 has a unibody construction with all-wheel independent suspension, making it more of a car than any sort of offroader. It seats five, and is available with power windows, dual front airbags, cassette or CD player, keyless entry, 16-inch wheels, rear spoiler, optional ABS and sunroof, depending on model. The rear cargo door opens sideways, and has a spare tyre mounted on it, so the rear window does not open. Higher-trim models had body-coloured plastic body trim, which come in standard black on base models. In 2005, it became available with a cheesy locally-installed body kit that gave it a sporty low-rider look, although there were no mechanical changes.

The Carnival, now known as Grand Carnival, is undoubtedly Kia's largest offering, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. It comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The Subaru WRX is in its fifth generation, debuting in 2015 and getting a facelift for 2018. Redesigned 18-inch wheels, revised electric power steering and optional turning LED headlights are also new for 2018. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler. It will be coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission. There's a new Sport Lineartronic CVT as an option, which also comes with 6-speed and 8-speed paddle-shifter mode. The new lighter engine ensures that this WRX with the manual gearbox is 30 kg heavier than the previous 2014 model. Of the two alternatives, torque will be equally (50:50) distributed to all four wheels in the 6-speed manual variant and the CVT will receive a torque distribution split of 45:55 with Subarua's Variable Torque Distribution system. The new WRX is 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Audi S8 was the performance version of their flagship A8 model. It featured a Lamborghini-derived 5.2-litre V10 engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission and their trademark "quattro" all-wheel drive system. The center differential distributes 40 percent of the torque to the front and 60 per cent to the rear. The S8 was not too heavy for its size, thanks to its all-aluminium body panels.  As well as adaptive light technology and 20-inch wheels, other features include new, noise-insulating double glazing for the windows, a DVD navigation system and BOSE Surround audio system with CD changer. The door armrests, the center console, and the seats in the Audi S8 are upholstered in leather. Safety features include traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist, front and side airbags.

Opel Astra returned to the UAE and GCC as a 2013 model. Three models will be sold here - Astra Enjoy sedan, the Astra Cosmo hatchback and Astra GTC hatchback. The first two models get the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, whereas the GTC gets a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder motor. They all get a 6-speed automatic transmission. Basic options include a single-zone manual A/C, central locking with remote, power windows, cruise control, daytime running lamps, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, speed sensitive power steering, driver seat manual adjustable, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/Aux in support and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get dual zone automatic A/C, sunroof, leather steering wheel, outside mirror power foldable, 18-inch alloy wheels, flex-ride with continuous damping control and driver selectable sport/tour modes. The GTC gets 20-inch alloy wheels and a rear spoiler. Safety features include driver and passenger front, side and curtain airbags, electronic stability program (ESP) and ABS as standard on all models.

An all-new BMW M5 came out in 2018. It gets the same 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, upgraded to produce more power. It is mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Also new in this generation is it comes in all-wheel drive. When the engine is first started, the new BMW M5 will be in all-wheel-drive mode with Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) switched on. The driver is then able to vary the handling characteristics of the M5 by activating various driving dynamics modes, including a rear-wheel-drive mode with no DSC. Some of the wide range of driving and comfort features offered in the BMW M5 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. The BMW M5 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Volvo V70 is a midsize station wagon available in a few GCC countries. Currently only the V70 Comfort is sold here with the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment in the car include power mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with CD player, foldable three-split rear seats and alloy wheels. Volvo, never to compromise on safety, has driver, passenger, side and curtain airbags as standard, along with WHIPS whiplash protection. Luggage space is quite big thanks to its upright shape. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

The Mitsubishi Attrage is the Japanese brand's sub-compact sedan offering, introduced in 2014 GCC market. The Thai-built Attrage gets a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual in fleet-spec trim or a CVT in all other versions. The small engine, combined with the lightweight body makes it very fuel-efficient. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry with central locking, fabric seats, manual a/c, AM/FM radio with CD player and 4 speakers, tachometer and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional equipment include a full-auto a/c, better entertainment system, leather-strapped steering wheel and gear knob, 15-inch alloy wheels and USB port. For safety, only the top model gets 2 airbags for the driver and passenger, whereas as the rest get only one for the driver. All models get ABS with EBD.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. In 2017, an Aventador S model was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

As evolutionary developments of the America's most popular minivan, the 2005 facelift model features larger headlights than the older pre-2004 model, optional power operation of the sliding side doors, a power rear liftgate and revised interiors that are quieter, nicer and more comfortable. The new Grand Voyager also features Stow "˜n Go rear seats, giving the ability to easily fold the second and third-row seats into the floor in as little as 30 seconds with a simple one-hand operation. Featuring 256 possible seating positions and an additional 340 litres of available storage, Stow "˜n Go provides for immense flexibility and convenience. More options include a rear-seat audio system, a tyre-pressure warning system, electronically adjustable pedals and a rear-seat DVD entertainment. Chrysler minivans, in various shapes and names, are best sellers in the United States, but failed to make any headway in this region, firstly because minivans are not popular here, and secondly, engine options are limited to just one aging V6 here.

The Toyota Corolla is all-new for 2014, with completely-redone styling and an extended wheelbase for more cabin space. It has remained the same for the 2018 model year. Engine offerings include a 1.6-litre and a new 2.0-litre, both 4-cylinder "VVT-i" units mated to 4-speed automatics, although a base model with a 6-speed manual is available in some GCC markets. The front-wheel-drive platform still rides on independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension. The five-seater is available in various trim levels. In Saudi Arabia, there is a 1.6 XLi model with a manual or automatic gearbox, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, black front grille, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and a 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo. Moving up to the 1.6 GLi adds fog lamps, 16-inch alloys, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, trunk liner, better upholstery with leather steering wheel, split-folding rear seats, 6-speaker touchscreen stereo with Bluetooth, smart keyless entry with starter button and several other smaller convenience features. The 2.0 GLi adds LED headlights with LED running lamps, sunroof, rear manual curtains, auto a/c and cruise control. In the UAE, there are 5 trim levels, starting with an uber-basic 1.6 S model that includes a standard automatic gearbox, 15-inch steelies, 4-speaker CD/MP3/USB/AUX stereo, power mirrors and a black grille. The next-level 1.6 SE version adds power windows, keyless entry and body-colour door handles. The 1.6 SE+ adds better upholstery with leather steering wheel, chrome grille, split-folding rear seats, LED running lamps, smart keyless entry and start, LCD info display, a better 6-speaker stereo and a few other extra bits. Moving on to the larger engine, the 2.0 SE has all the features of the 1.6 SE, but additionally gets 15-inch alloys and 6 speakers for the basic stereo. The 2.0 SE+ model gets all the features of the 1.6 SE+ model. And the 2.0 Limited gets a sunroof, auto-levelling projector headlights and cruise control. Other markets may get slightly different trim levels. All models get standard dual front airbags, ABS with brake assist and EBD, and an alarm immobiliser.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. A 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine comes standard while a 3.0-litre V6 is optional. The 2.3-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the 3.0-litre only gets an automatic. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 15-inch steel wheels and AM/FM/6CD stereo. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. Available safety features include front-and-side airbags along with ABS. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The BMW X3 compact crossover grows in size for the 2011 redesign. The five-seater 5-door is now larger in size and gains a couple of new corporate engine. One is the naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the xDrive28i, and the other is the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline 6-cylinder for the xDrive35i, both with 8-speed automatic gearboxes and all-wheel-drive. The new interior integrates either a 6.5-inch or an 8.8-inch screen, and new features, standard or optional depending on trim, include a heads-up display with night vision, active and passive systems such as the lane change and lane departure warnings, optional parking assistant, adaptive cruise control, surround-view cameras, Variable Damper Control to pick between Normal, Sport and Sport+, Bluetooth phone with audio connectivity, navigation, multiple front and side airbags, leather or cloth upholstery, HID headlights, keyless start, sunroof, BlackBerry smartphone connectivity to gain access to e-mails and other distractions which can be shown on the control display and read out via the optional voice output. An M package is available that adds a body kit and more.

The Passat CC, better known as just the CC in the GCC, received a facelift for the 2013 model. The CC utilises a common platform with the Passat, including the same engines, mechanicals and interior components. Standard engine choices include a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, with a 7-speed and 6-speed DSG automanual respectively. Both TSI engines are turbocharged 4-cylinder units. A naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine is offered as well with a 6-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel drive. Features include fabric or leather upholstery in various colours, sports seats, common power accessories, 17-inch alloy wheels, adaptive suspension, electrically-adjustable driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, 'Press & Drive' starter with keyless entry, front and curtain airbags for front and rear passengers including side airbags, electric parking brake with hill-hold control, stability control, ABS, rain-sensing wipers, tyre pressure monitor and more. Options include various wood and aluminium cabin trims, automatic a/c, cruise control, reverse camera, Xenon headlights with bending feature, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic sunroof, and various stereo options that include CD/MP3, Bluetooth phone, six-disc changer and AUX inputs. Park Assist, Automatic Distance Control and Lane Assist features are also optionally available.

The Brilliance V5 is the Chinese company's compact SUV offering. It features a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design has similarities to the BMW X1, since BMW produces the X1 in China in partnership with Brilliance. The front-wheel drive V5 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with AUX, manual A/C, rear sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets, keyless start and keyless entry system, pretinted windows, sunroof, driver side glasses box and luggage carrier. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

The Renault Captur is a small SUV offering from the French brand. Under the hood, the Spanish-made Captur gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. A lot of customisation can be done on the car's bodywork, interior trim and upholstery. Standard features on the front-wheel drive Captur include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, fabric seats, radio with MP3/AUX/CD player support, USB, Blutetooth, manual A/C, alloy rims, LED daytime lights, tire pressure monitoring system, push button start, central locking & keyless entry. Top model features include navigation, rear view camera, 17-inch 2-tone alloy wheels, parking sensors, automatic A/C, power folding mirrors, 2-tone body color and removable seat covers. Standard safety features include front and passenger airbags, ABS and ESP.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013 and more power in 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The limited-production twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 G65 AMG has been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. It comes over here as only a 5-door wagon. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Sierra range is GMC's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Sierra 1500 pickup is the identical twin of the second-best selling truck in the United States, namely the Chevy Silverado. The Sierra 1500 light pickup version is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending everyone around you with your show of excess, while the Sierra 1500 HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The Sierra is available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a 4.3-litre V6, a 4.8-litre V8 and a 5.3-litre V8, all with 4-speed automatics. A luxury Sierra Denali version was introduced in 2009, with a 6.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic. All versions come in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. Along with leather and special exterior trim, the Denali gets standard features such as Bluetooth, power-adjustable pedals, auto-dimming inside mirror, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, remote starting system, rear parking sensors, MP3-capable stereo with a six-disc in-dash CD changer, Bose premium speakers, rear-seat audio, power-sliding rear window, navigation, sunroof and an optional DVD rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include at least front airbags and ABS brakes, while higher trim levels get side-curtain airbags and stability control, among other options.

The tenth-generation Honda Civic looks to have gone more upmarket, with LED daytime running lights and taillights given as standard, and LED headlights offered as an option. The new body is also said to be more rigid, thanks to the use of ultra-high strength steel. The new Civic is not only bigger, but 31 kg lighter than the previous generation as well. The interior also has been upgraded with better fit and finish, while the increase in overall size has helped improve legroom and trunk capacity. Two engines are on offer in the GCC, the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and the more powerful turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder unit. Standard features in the compact sedan include automatic climate control, electronic parking brake with brake hold, auto up/down front power windows and walk-away auto door locks. Higher models get dual-zone climate control. All models also get a new centre console which includes a new infotainment system featuring a 7-inch touchscreen display and supports both Android Auto and Apple CarPlayUnder the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor mated to a CVT transmission in base trim. The top model gets a 1.5-litre turbo 4-cylinder. Safety features include airbags, ABS and traction control.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets a major interior and exterior facelift for 2008. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models an upgraded 3.6-litre V6 engine. Engine choices also include the carryover 4.6-litre Northstar V8 and the 4.4-litre supercharged V8, the latter of which is reserved for the sporting STS-V. All engines hook up to a new six-speed automatic transmission, and all-wheel-drive is optional in the non-V models. The V8 models were cancelled after 2010. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, 17-inch or 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, automatic climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, rear parking assist, and a starter button. New technological features in the 2008 STS, available in some markets, include active steering technology in the StabiliTrak electronic stability control system, a Lane Department Warning System and Size Blind Zone Alert System. A Chinese-built long-wheelbase version of the rear-wheel-drive car, dubbed the SLS, is also available in Middle East markets.

The Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year and replaces the CL65 AMG. It is still motivated by a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, but produces more power than its predecessor. The engine can be coupled with rear-wheel-drive, as well as an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 7-speed automatic transmission. There's also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

A new generation Nissan X-Trail debuted in the GCC in 2015. Featuring a completely revised exterior and interior, it gets a 2.5-litre 4 cylinder engine, mated to a CVT gearbox. The base model is front-wheel-drive, but all other trim levels are all-wheel-drive with an electronic 4x4 lock feature. There's also a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater layouts. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, keyless entry with central locking, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, and steel or 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include better entertainment system with screen and more speakers, bigger alloy wheels, parking sensors, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power front seats, navigation, 18-inch alloys and automatic a/c, among other things. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags with optional side airbags, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist (BA).

A classic if there ever was one in this modern world, the Arnage stands as a symbol of what Bentley once was, before the VW-based Continental came along. Bentley claims an unrivalled heritage thanks to a skill-set handed down through three generations working on the same site, and an ability to tailor cars to precise customer wishes. Every Arnage is built to order, and over half are further modified by Bentley's coachbuilding arm, Bentley Mulliner. Bentley also claims that the Arnage is the culmination of over 80 years continual experience of building Grand Touring Limousines. It is odd though that at least in the last decade, the Arnage, in R, T and RL trims, has remained largely untouched, except for a minor facelift. Bentley also likes to brag about one regular customer, who said that determining the specification of an Arnage is like having your own private car company. An exclusive club for sure, but we have to wonder what they pay for. The impressive 6.8-litre turbo V8 engines, mated to a 4-speed automatic, are massive and yet they are easily surpassed in power and economy by, of all people, the Americans. This facelift came in 2005, and the higher-output motor was reserved for the sporting T model.

The Forester, after many years being Subaru's compact crossover wagon-like 4WD, has been completely redesigned for 2009 with a more SUV-like appearance. The new Forester is larger in every way than its predecessor, improving cargo capacity and rear-seat legroom. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester also comes standard with a 4-speed automatic features SportShift manual shifting. The basic 2.5X model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The Ford Explorer got a facelift in 2016, as well as slight trim changes. It is a crossover with a unibody structure and road-biased demeanour. The Explorer is available with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 model, in addition to the 3.5-litre V6, both engines mated to a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with the base model getting front-wheel-drive and the rest getting full-time all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. There are four trim levels. The base model features include cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic Ford SYNC with 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, 18-inch wheels, three-row seating, keyless entry, cruise control, capless fuel filler, power driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, common power options and more. Available features higher up the trim levels include intelligent access with push button start, three-zone auto a/c, remote engine start, power liftgate, power-adjustable seats and pedals with memory, leather, heated and cooled front seats, MyFord Touch for the Ford SYNC touchscreen, 8-speaker stereo or 12-speaker Sony audio system, Bluetooth, 20-inch polished aluminium wheels, dual moonroof and power-folding third-row seats. The top Limited can be outfitted with further options such as HID headlights, rain-sensing wipers, adaptive cruise control with auto braking and the automatic parallel-parking system. The front-biased all-wheel-drive Explorer has an electronic center coupling that controls the torque split between the front and rear wheels, and acts as a center differential. Standard off-road electronics on AWD models include hill-descent control, hill-ascent assist, four-wheel electronic traction control and a standard "Terrain Management" system that varies drivetrain and ESP characteristics for different conditions. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, Roll Stability Control, stability control and Curve Control. Other optional safety features include inflatable rear-seatbelt airbags, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, and collision warning with pre-crash brake support.

The Ford Escape gets a completely new design for the 2013 model. Slightly longer than the previous model and ditching the V6 motor, the new shape will arrive in the GCC with just the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and only front-wheel-drive for now. The interior will also receive a major upgrade as it will have the Microsoft SYNC entertainment system we have all come to expect in all Fords. The  Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering.  Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It might get all-wheel-drive in the future, and has decent ground clearance, but it will not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

The Hyundai Grand Santa Fe is basically a larger version of the regular Santa Fe, with a bigger boot. In 2017, it got a facelift with restyled headlights and taillights, along with some minor interior upgrades. Powered by a standard 3.3-litre V6, it comes with a 6-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive on the base model or all-wheel-drive in the rest of the trim levels. The Grand Santa Fe crossover comes well-equipped in even base trim, including three-row seating, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, rear spoiler, power mirrors with indicators, rear parking sensors, cruise control, keyless entry, adjustable power steering and 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB/AUX ports. The higher-level versions add all-wheel-drive, 19-inch alloys and, depending on trim, chrome door handles, auto a/c, auto headlights with optional HIDs, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power-adjustable memory front seats, power tailgate, electric parking brake, 4.3-inch multimedia screen, navigation, smart keyless start, compass and rain sensor. All six trim levels get ABS, while 2 airbags are standard on all but the highest two trim levels, which get 6 airbags; and the top two trim levels get stability control.

The Kia Soul is part of the Korean manufacturer's new product offensive. Being touted as a crossover, it is really a tall compact hatchback, designed to be appealing for our misguided urban youth. Featuring tons of cabin space, the updated-for-2012 front-wheel-drive Kia Soul is powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, both mated to a 4-speed automatic. Available in two trim levels, the basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, a single driver's airbag, roof rack, fog lamps, CD stereo with iPod input, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seat, black cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better CD stereo with a sub-woofer and illuminated speakers, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, underfloor tray and power outlet in the boot, luggage net, some extra trim. dual front airbags and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of black, beige and red two-tone interiors. Optional features are extensive, largely limited to appearance kits, such as funkier alloy wheels, stickers, chrome trim, front and rear skirts, and shiny fuel caps. In addition to front airbags, ABS is available on all except the base model, but stability control and side airbags are not available on GCC-spec models.

The new Civic is a breath of fresh air in the crowded compact class. Honda once led the class with quality and style. It lost its way for a while, but now it is back in form. The redesigned Honda Civic is the most futuristic compact car on the market. There is more power from just one 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine choice, with either a manual or an automatic. Improvements include better ride and handling, and better interior packaging. The Civic offers important safety features such ABS brakes and airbags, though not all might be standard in some markets. Standard equipment include power windows, tilt-and-telescope steering wheel, height-adjustable driver's seat, rear window-integrated radio antenna, air conditioning, power mirrors, central locking, a centre console with sliding armrest, a four-speaker AM/FM/CD stereo with MP3 and WMA playback, and the funky digital dashboard. Options include a power moonroof; a 60/40 split folding rear seatback, cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls and 16-inch alloy wheels.

An all-new BMW X5 launched as a 2014 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X5 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X5 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

Continuing to be based on a joint platform with Mazda, the Focus remains one of the best handling cars in its class, getting a  makeover for the 2008 model year. It comes in two different body styles, namely a sedan and a five-door hatchback. The Focus is a popular car in Europe where it is built, and is fairly well-built at that. Both the versions cost the same, but all are available in various trim levels. The standard motor is an anaemic 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the top engine is a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. Features include electro-hydraulic power steering, and choice of a 5-speed manual transmission and a 4-speed automatic. Standard conveniences include power windows, basic stereo, cloth seating and not much else. Options include LED tail-lights, CD changer, USB audio connector, keyless starter button, Xenon adaptive headlights, tyre pressure monitor, sunroof, fog lights and a 230-volt inverter. Safety features include optional side thorax airbags and inflatable side curtains alongside the standard dual front airbags.

The Pathfinder can be considered a proper off-roading 4WD. It is built on a fullsize pickup platform, thereby offering good off-road capability but marginal on-road handling. The current Pathfinder is significantly larger than previous models. It offers more interior space and more convenience features. It also offers third-row seating to carry up to seven people. The 4.0-litre V6 that powers the Pathfinder is a larger, retuned version of the engine that powers the 350Z. Its five-speed automatic transmission is geared to use the engine's torque characteristics. The 4WD features optional Hill Descent Control, which limits downhill speed without driver intervention, and Hill Start Assist, which briefly holds the Pathfinder on a slope while the driver releases the brake pedal and applies the accelerator. Standard features include fabric upholstery, cruise control, power mirrors, windows and door locks with keyless remote, CD stereo with six speakers, reclining backs on the middle row seats, front and side airbags, ABS and alloy wheels. Options include power seats, halogen foglights, running boards, roof rack cross bars and leather seating. For 2008, the Pathfinder received a very minor facelift, while gaining new available features such as Bluetooth, navigation, rear-seat DVD entertainment and intelligent keyless entry.

The Chevrolet Trax is the American brand's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 4-cylinder 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The South Korean-made Trax comes in two trims - LT and LTZ. The base-model LT comes in only front-wheel drive, while the LTZ gets all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/AUX support and alloy wheels. Optional features include bigger alloy wheels, better sound system and chrome door handles. Safety-wise, the Trax gets traction control, stability control and 4-wheel ABS with panic brake assist.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. In 2021, the all-new Isuzu D-Max made its debut. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The Fortuner is Toyota's cheapest SUV offering. The 2016 model year is built in Thailand. Although this 4WD is based on a pickup, its styling is very softly finished, with none of its truck-like toughness showing. It has true off-road ability, thanks to four-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. It also has space for five, or optionally seven, and its value-packed price has attracted families rather than desert junkies. The Fortuner is available here with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as a 4.0-litre V6 engine. Most markets offer four-wheel-drive as standard, but a two-wheel-drive version is also offered in Saudi markets. It has space for five adults and two kids. Features include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, and fabric upholstery, although the basic model is only offered in Saudi Arabia and few other GCC countries. Higher trim levels, which is standard now in the UAE, get fake wood, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear diff lock, ABS, multi-information display, 6-speaker CD stereo and optional leather. Top-spec Saudi models get HID headlights, power driver's seat and wi-fi features as well.

The Carnival, also known as Grand Carnival or Sedona in some markets, is undoubtedly Kia's largest non-commercial vehicle, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. Powered by a 3.8-litre V6, it comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The redesigned Boxster roadster was introduced in 2005, with mildly-updated carryover engines until the 2007 model year. Considered the entry-level Porsche offerings, the cars are powered by a 2.7-litre version of the traditional Porsche flat-six engine in their base trim, while the higher-performance S versions are powered by a 3.2-litre version of the sixer. The Boxster are considered a benchmark for sports-car handling, with rear-wheel-drive and a choice of either a manual or a manually-shiftable automatic. It is generally accepted that it is more engaging to drive than a 911. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, among other luxury options involving leather upholstery colours and cabin trim materials. The Boxster offers head airbags in combination with thorax airbags, concealed on the outer side of the backrest, alongside the usual front airbags, while stability control and ABS are standard. Luggage space is very limited, with two trunks, one in the front and one behind the mid-mounted engine in the back. The Boxster can be ordered with a removable hard top to further stiffen the body. Wheel sizes range from 17-inch to 19-inch. PASM active suspension was optional.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In 2017, it got a slight facelift. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The Lexus IS debuted as an all-new sedan in 2007, and has received a very minor facelift as well as new versions to choose from in 2011. The facelift includes the addition of LED running lights and redone tail lamps. The carryover GCC-specific with the 3.0-litre V6 and 6-speed automatic continues in the IS 300 sedan. An IS 250 sedan with a 2.5-litre V6 and 6-speed automatic newly joined the range as a base model, but was dropped by the end of 2012. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof, ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system.
