Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

The Maserati Spyder is a high-performance two-door two-seater based on the 4200 GT Coupe, except with a shorter wheelbase and a convertible top. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations was the GranSport Spyder, which featured sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport version, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

Receiving a minor frontal facelift for 2013, the sixth-generation Nissan Z continues to be a focussed sports car that is now affordable. The 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. The coupe and powered soft top models almost have the same rigidity. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The American-built Honda Odyssey minivan has been redesigned for 2011. The upmarket minivan is aimed at big families, and is longer, wider and lower than the previous version. It comes in LX, EXL and Touring trim levels. Mechanical specs include a 3.5-litre V6 with cylinder-shutoff technology, a 5-speed automatic in the LX and EXL as well as a 6-speed automatic reserved for the Touring, MacPherson strut front and double-wishbone rear suspension, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and an 80-litre fuel tank. Depending on trim, features include three rows of seating for up to eight people, adjustable 2nd-row seats that can space outwards to fit three baby seats, 3rd-row "magic" seats that can flip forwards or backwards, power-adjustable driver's seat with optional powered passenger seat, optional HID headlights, optional rear DVD screen that is ultra-wide to play a movie and a video game at the same time, ports for USB and even HDMI, optional navigation with Bluetooth phone, optional 15GB hard drive or 2GB flash drive to store CDs instead of needing a CD changer, front and side airbags with three-row side-curtain airbags, stability control, power windows front and rear, cruise control, sunroof, cooler box, remote-controllable power tailgate and rear sliding doors, variable power steering, ABS and 15 bottle and cup holders.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur made its debut as a 2014 model year, and ditches the "Continental" from its name. The exterior shape now has a lower and wider appearance, new wing vents in the front fenders, slightly flared rear fenders and a more sloping roofline. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. It gets an 8-channel, 8-speaker audio system. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split. The suspension has been made softer for the new Flying Spur for a more comfortable ride. A Mulliner Driving Specification is available which adds diamond-quilted seats, drilled alloy foot pedals, a sports shift lever, jeweled filler cap and unique 21-inch two-piece alloy rims.

The Maserati Coupe, sometimes known as the 4200 GT, is a high-performance two-door four-seater that relaunched Ferrari-owned Maserati as a contender in the sport-luxury class. It complements the two-seater Spyder, which is a shorter-wheelbase convertible version of the Coupe. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations were the GranSport Coupe and the GranSport Spyder, which feature sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport versions, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars got a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 250 and GLC 300 get a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with two different tunes, which can be had in either two-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Thai-built Honda City received a facelift in 2012. The front bumper gets a sportier look and the front grille is now chrome plated. The rear bumper and tail-lights also received changes. Coupled with the good looks, the City also has enough cabin space to rival some midsize cars. Based on the platform shared with the Jazz, and powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 5-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive sedan has grown in size, with a full list of interesting options. Standard features on the basic City LX include 15-inch steel wheels, power mirrors, body-colour bumpers, electric power steering, power windows, power door locks, manual a/c, CD/MP3 player with USB/AUX connector and 2 speakers, stereo volume-compensation depending on speed, trip computer, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, and an immobiliser. The City EX adds paddle shifters, 16-inch alloy wheels, chrome exhaust tip, front and rear armrests, split-folding rear seat, stereo controls on the steering wheel and 4 speakers, and keyless entry.

The Logan has been around in Europe since 2004 under the Dacia brand name, with the distinction of being the cheapest car in Europe, but has recently spread its wings and is now built in at least five developing countries. For the GCC, there is only one trim level for now that comes with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine and a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Also standard are front power windows, rear wind-up windows, power steering, cloth seats, 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, a Blaupunkt CD stereo, a manual a/c and one airbag. The Logan aims for the lowest end of the new car market without actually being too small, offering a reasonably spacious 5-seater cabin and a hard-plastic interior that goes for durability and simplicity rather than outright cushiness and aesthetics. Being a front-wheel-drive European car, it also comes with a well-tuned suspension setup that favours handling while also retaining a fair degree of ride comfort. Models with more optional features are expected later.

The Audi A8 is the German manufacturer's flagship full-size luxury sedan. Of course, that means the list of options will be long for this car. Only the long-wheel base makes its way to the UAE. There are three engine variants - the 3.0-litre supercharged V6, 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 and the 6.3-litre W12. They are all equipped with all-wheel drive systems. Some basic options include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon-head lamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, rear-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and sunroof. Customers can add different equipment packages which can add rear-entertainment systems, individual rear power seats, seat ventilation and massage function for both front and rear, alcantara trim, 20-inch alloy wheels, panoramic sunroof and electronically opening and closing bootlid. However, adding options to the A8 L creeps up the price further.

Lexus has an all-new flagship luxury sedan that is as good as the best in the business. This fourth-generation LS, dubbed the LS 460, is powered by a new 4.6-litre V8 engine without direct injection, but mated to the new 8-speed automatic. Available features include navigation, Bluetooth, ventilated seats, sunroof, cruise control and an updated Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system. The cabin has all the customary Lexus luxury touches, including seats covered in one of four leathers to coordinate with three woodgrain trims. A power reclining seat equipped with power leg rests and massage is available for the right rear, along with a folding table. The LS 460 also offers a nine-inch rear monitor mounted in the headliner along with a new 19-speaker Mark Levinson audio system with an onboard hard drive that holds 4000 songs. It is available in regular-length and stretched-wheelbase versions.

The fifth generation Honda Odyssey came out in 2018, featuring a new design and improvements in technology and safety. The Odyssey is still the same size, but improvements have been made to the structure to improve efficiency and safety. Under the hood, the 3.5-litre V6 engine is carried over, connected to a new 10-speed automatic transmission, for better performance and fuel efficiency. Standard features on the 2020 Honda Odyssey include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric sliding doors, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED tail lights, 8-inch touchscreen display audio, Apple CarPlay, USB, AUX, Bluetooth, 6 speakers and subwoofer, cruise control, push start button, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get 10.2-inch screen rear entertainment system, navigation, 11 speakers, leather seats, wireless phone charging, automatic AC,  and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control, hill-start assist, electronic brake distribution and tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher trims get additional blind spot monitor and Honda Sensing.

Though the new-for-2011 Volkswagen Touareg looks a lot like a simple facelift, this is apparently an all-new model compared to the last one. The only petrol engine on offer in this 5-seater at launch is a carryover 3.6-litre V6, and later also with a 4.2-litre V8, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive, but now without low-range gearing. This VW is a proper crossover now, with independent four-wheel-suspension and a simple terrain-select system. Largely optional features include cloth or leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, navigation, Bluetooth phone, intelligent keyless entry, starter button, panoramic sunroof, real wood trim, power-folding rear seat, adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go function, lane departure warning system, blind-spot monitor, pre-crash system with full automatic emergency braking, ABS, a full set of front and side airbags, parking assist with four cameras, adaptive air suspension with continuous damping control and adaptive roll compensation, LED tail lamps, HID headlights, power-adjustable front seats with memory, seat heaters and a choice of 18-inch, 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels.

The SL has undergone numerous design and interior improvements in its facelifted-for-2007 iteration. Models include the new 3.5-litre SL 350, the new 5.5-litre SL 500 and the twin-turbo 5.5-litre SL 600 rocketship. Upping the ante are two sport-tuned models, namely the upgraded supercharged 5.5-litre SL 55 AMG and the twin-turbo 6.0-litre SL 65 AMG. Second-generation Active Body Control and the more direct steering improve handling without compromising the comfort aspects of the SL. The redesigned front, new rear light units and new light-alloy wheels of the revised SL are hardly noticeable compared to the previous version. New interior appointments include new materials and colour schemes. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, Electronic Stability Program, Xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

The all-new GLK is the first Mercedes-Benz entry in the competitive compact soft-roader market, although its premium pricing and already-outdated styling are far from competitive. Available in GLK 280 trim with a 3.0-litre V6 and in GLK 350 trim with a 3.5-litre V6, both models come standard with 4Matic all-wheel-drive and a 7-speed automatic gearbox. The GLK apparently has some offroading pretensions, with an optional 'off-road styling package' that adds nothing but matte-black bumper strips and a simulated skidplate. Sizeable 19-inch alloy wheels are standard, with 20-inch ones being optional. Cabin features include two-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable front seats, Bluetooth interface, central 5-inch colour display, power accessories and an available power liftgate. Further extra-cost options include Xenon headlights with adaptive lighting and washers, rain-sensing windshield wipers, memory driver's seat, COMAND multimedia system with hard-drive navigation, rear-view camera, available rear-seat DVD entertainment system featuring two eight-inch screens, leather upholstery, wood trim and panorama sunroof. Safety features include front and side airbags, window airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The Brilliance FRV is the Chinese company's sub-compact hatchback offering.  The FRV Cross has been around since 2009, but only made its debut in the UAE in 2013. It comes with 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the FRV include power steering, power windows, fabric seats, radio with single CD player and MP3/USB support, and steel wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019. The 8-Series comes with a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 8-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Nissan Micra made its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. It remains the same for the 2014 and 2015 model year. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are fewer trim levels from 2014 onwards, with higher trims having features such as power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

The Nissan Micra made its entry into the GCC market for the first time in 2012. A facelifted version became available for 2018. Based on a shortened Sunny sub-compact platform, the Micra hatchback comes only in 5-door form, with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 4-speed automatic. The base model gets 14-inch steel wheels, folding rear bench seat, rear fog lamp, intermittent front and rear wipers, basic CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, trip computer, manual a/c, power steering with tilt adjustment, alarm and fabric upholstery. There are fewer trim levels from 2014 onwards, with higher trims having features such as power windows, split-folding rear seat with three headrests, 15-inch alloy wheels, chrome exterior trim, auto headlights, remote locks or smart keyless entry with starter button, auto wipers, front fog lamps, tachometer, height-adjustable driver's seat with centre armrest, rear window defroster, 12V power outlet, and sunvisors with vanity mirrors. Optional accessories include a chrome grille, body kit, chrome exhaust tip, rear spoiler, mirror-mounted indicators, mud guards and floor mats. Standard safety features include ABS with EBD, brake assist, dual front airbags, and 3-point seatbelts for all five seats.

The FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. In UAE, the base EXR model comes with a manual gearbox, power steering, power windows, manual side mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX/Bluetooth support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, rear parking sensors, full-time 4x4, rear-diff lock and 17-inch alloy wheels; the GXR gets additionally an automatic gearbox, power mirrors, crawl control, dashboard display, navigation, rear-view camera, rear window wiper and part-time 4x4; the GXR gets 10 JBL speakers & subwoofer, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, leather-stitched steering wheel, front skid plate protector, spare wheel hard cover, and lot of chrome pieces such as the exhaust tip, grille, door mirrors and door handles. In Saudi Arabia, the base FJ gets a manual gearbox, power steering, power windows, manual side mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, radio & CD player/USB/AUX support, water-resistant fabric seats, front fog lamps, full-time 4x4, rear diff-lock and 17-inch alloy wheels; the base automatic gets part-time 4x4, side-step, rear-window wiper, smaller fuel tank, no traction control and no rear diff-lock; the FJ 1 gets power mirrors, Bluetooth, steering wheel with audio and telephone controls, rear parking sensors, iPod support, driver arm rest, 10 JBL speakers & subwoofer, rear-view camera, spare wheel cover and no diff lock; the FJ 2 gets rear diff-lock, front skid plate, traction control, wi-fi and two-hitch. Safety features include standard front airbags as well as ABS and vehicle stability control. In Saudi Arabia, the top model gets side airbags as well. A new TRD version was launched in the UAE in 2015 as well, which gets a new skid plate, TRD coil springs and shock absorbers, and black side sill protectors, 17-inch black rims among other TRD add-ons.

The Hyundai Grand Santa Fe is basically a larger version of the regular Santa Fe, with a bigger boot. Powered by a standard 3.3-litre V6, it comes with a 6-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive on the base model or all-wheel-drive in the rest of the trim levels. The Grand Santa Fe crossover comes well-equipped in even base trim, including three-row seating, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, rear spoiler, power mirrors with indicators, rear parking sensors, cruise control, keyless entry, adjustable power steering and 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB/AUX ports. The higher-level versions add all-wheel-drive, 19-inch alloys and, depending on trim, chrome door handles, auto a/c, auto headlights with optional HIDs, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power-adjustable memory front seats, power tailgate, electric parking brake, 4.3-inch multimedia screen, navigation, smart keyless start, compass and rain sensor. All six trim levels get ABS, while 2 airbags are standard on all but the highest two trim levels, which get 6 airbags; and the top two trim levels get stability control.

The Infiniti G35 is company's first serious rear-wheel-drive honest-to-goodness sports sedan. It uses a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. Its platform is the corporate front-midship, which it shares with the Nissan 350Z. Features include 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlamps, fog lamps, heated mirrors, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, cloth or leather seats with power adjustment, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo and wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a rear spoiler, power sunroof, rosewood interior trim, dual HVAC controls and a DVD-based navigation system. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Gen2 is probably the most competitive model in Proton's line-up. Its chassis is engineered with the help of Proton-owned sports car maker Lotus, with engines derived from Mitsubishi. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this five-door hatchback can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, rear spoiler, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include optional ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Gen2 is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras. It first came to Saudi Arabia in 2007, and UAE in late 2011.

The Mercedes-Benz GLE-Class is essentially the new facelifted M-Class following the German brand's new nomenclature. Mercedes-AMG GLE 63 is the top performance model and got more power and torque in 2016. There are two variants, which includes the standard GLE 63 and then the GLE 63 S. Under the hood, both come with the 5.5-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Available features include adjustable air suspension, adaptive cruise control and active parking assist. The exterior features HID headlights, LED running maps and 21-inch cross-spoke AMG alloy wheels. The 5-seater interior offers leather upholstery, mood lighting, HDD navigation, panoramic sunroof, rear entertainment system, keyless start, ventilated power front seats and a split-folding rear seat. Safety features include nine airbags, stability control, ABS and drowsiness monitor, with options such as a rear view camera with parking sensors, active lane assist, blind-spot monitor and automatic pre-crash braking.

The 2016 Mazda 2 is a new generation model. It is a hatchback and now uses its own "Skyactiv" chassis and engine. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a new 6-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. LED headlights, fog lamps, leather seats, heads-up display, rear spoiler and 16-inch alloys are some of the optional features. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The top-spec model gets 6 airbags.

The Ford Focus ST got a facelift for its 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder EcoBoost engine, mated to a 6-speed manual. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, cruise control with speed limiter, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights and LED tail lamps. The Focus ST hatchback also gets a body kit, Recaro seats, sports suspension and an overboost feature for extra torque when needed. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The 2015 Mazda 3 is slightly longer in height and length than the previous generation. The exterior of the Mazda 3 got the new Mazda "KODO" treatment, their new trademark design at the time. The compact sedan came with two engine choices in the GCC, a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor with a 4-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Mechanical features include independent suspension, disc brakes, electric power steering and an all-new platform unrelated to the Ford Focus, unlike before. The basic S-grade 1.6L model comes with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, power windows, manual a/c, Bluetooth, central locking, starter button, 16-inch steel wheels, cruise control, tilt/telescoping steering column and a single-piece folding rear seat. The V-grade 1.6L model adds some chrome trim, running lamps, 16-inch alloys, fog lamps, split-folding rear seat, leather steering wheel and mirror-mounted indicators. An optional package adds a 6-speaker stereo, sunroof, auto-dimming mirror, adaptive headlights, MZD Connect multimedia system with LCD screen and rotary controller, headlamp washers, rear camera with sensors, LED tail lamps, auto-levelling HID headlights, single-zone auto a/c and, as a further option, navigation. The R-grade 2.0L model gets the larger engine as well as additional features such as a basic heads-up display, standard navigation, smart keyless entry, piano-black front grille, leather seats, auto headlights and wipers, adaptive cruise, 18-inch alloys, power-folding mirrors, rear spoiler and better safety features. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, while top-spec R-grade models get side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The F430 is heavily influenced by F1 Racing technology, and makes it known to everyone openly. The F430's compact 4.3-litre V8 engine offers blistering high-revving performance, and the experience is enhanced by an optional F1-style paddle-shifting gearbox which has made its way to every other Ferrari model too. The F430's aerodynamics are honed to generate special flows to increase downforce and improve cooling. One technical feature is the electronic differential, transferring massive torque levels to the track under high cornering g-forces, and guarantees maximum grip out of bends, eliminating wheel spin. The larger interior can be personalized with carbon-fibre or aluminium inserts, with space behind the seats accessed using an electrically operated compartment. The standard electric seats can be substituted by more sporting items with four-point harnesses to order. Even with all this the interior is noticeably barebones in keeping with its sporting nature.

The C3 is a curvaceous hatchback that competes in the hot compact segment dominated by Toyota. The standard C3 is available in five-door form only, while the funky C3 Pluriel is only available as a two-door. Designed to be roomy and versatile, it is utterly more futuristic than the usual offerings in this segment, and fairly well-equipped. The C3 cabin has plenty of cubbyholes and storage spaces, a big windshield and the 'Moduboard' foldable false floor for the luggage trunk. There are more unexpected features such as speed-sensitive windshield wipers, follow-me-home headlights and one-touch electric windows. Current engine choices are the 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre four-cylinder motors. An upgraded 1.4-litre option came later. A manual is standard, with an optional auto on the 1.4-litre. The SensoDrive auto gearbox is offered on the upgraded 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre with a fuel-saving feature called the Stop-Start system, which automatically turns the engine off when idling in traffic and turns it on again when you lift off the brake. The Pluriel comes with a different front end and a 1.6-litre auto only, and this unique car can be converted into a hatchback, a pick-up and a convertible by playing with roof configurations. The Pluriel was discontinued here by 2007. Standard front and side airbags, as are ABS brakes.

The Hyundai Accent is all-new for 2012, being longer, wider and lower than the outgoing model. It now features Hyundai's swoopy new corporate styling and superb build quality. The spacious sub-compact 4-door sedan comes with a choice of 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines, both with 5-speed manual and 4-speed automatic geabox options. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features, all optional, includes stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Gelaendewagen first debuted in 1979 as a utilitarian offroader and as military transport. In 1990, it got its first major revamp, upgrading it to luxury specs, but retaining its classic looks. Its boxy styling was again left alone during the 1997 update, which introduced a new range of engines, updated again and again over the years until its next major update in 2007. The trademark clean-cut, sharp lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a limited-edition soft-top version of the three-door.  The only petrol engine debuting in 1997 was the 3.2-litre V6 in the G 320, alongside various diesel motors. The 5.0-litre V8-powered G 500 debuted in 1998. In 2003 came the first AMG model, namely the 5.5-litre G 55 AMG. This was replaced in 2004 by the upgraded supercharged 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Along the way came turbodiesel models, such as the G 320 CDI in 1997 and the G 400 CDI in 2000. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. Stability control was added in 2001, and while dual front airbags are available, there are no side airbags. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

Lexus has an all-new flagship luxury sedan that is as good as the best in the business. This fourth-generation LS, dubbed the LS 460, is powered by a new 4.6-litre V8 engine without direct injection, but mated to the new 8-speed automatic. Available features include navigation, Bluetooth, ventilated seats, sunroof, cruise control and an updated Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system. The cabin has all the customary Lexus luxury touches, including seats covered in one of four leathers to coordinate with three woodgrain trims. A power reclining seat equipped with power leg rests and massage is available for the right rear, along with a folding table. The LS 460 also offers a nine-inch rear monitor mounted in the headliner along with a new 19-speaker Mark Levinson audio system with an onboard hard drive that holds 4000 songs. It is available in regular-length and stretched-wheelbase versions.

The Coupe is probably the only sports car in its price range among the hordes of boring sedans sold in the Middle East. It may be front-wheel-drive, not so powerful and hardly the best handler of them all, but darn does it look good from most angles. Powered by either a weak 2.0-litre four-cylinder or a decent 2.7-litre V6, only the smaller motor comes with a manual with optional available automatic, while the larger motor gets only an automatic. Standard basic features include a single airbag, power steering, central door locks, power windows, fog lamps, a rear spoiler with high-mounted brake lamp, outside electric mirrors, semi-cloth seats, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, rear wiper with washer, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The full options list includes dual airbags, ABS brakes, cruise control, keyless entry with burglar alarm, power sunroof, leather interior, CD player and 17-inch alloy wheels. Bumping up the horsepower would've made it a real contender in the sports car market.

An all-new BMW X5 launched as a 2014 model year. It is slightly wider, longer and lower than the previous model but the wheelbase remains the same. Under the bonnet, the same turbocharged engines are carried over from the previous generation, which is a 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder unit and a 4.4-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. However performance tweaks and use of lighter weight materials for the body makes this X5 faster and more fuel efficient than the previous model. Features for the X5 include roof rails and panoramic moonroof, optional iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, rear seat entertainment system, side-view cameras, top-view camera, Nappa leather seats, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration.

The Kia Sorento has been completely redesigned from the ground up for 2010. Originally a proper 4x4 with low-range gearing, the Sorento is now a road-going crossover SUV with seating for five or optionally seven, four-wheel independent suspension, and featuring the new Kia corporate grille. The available engine for the GCC is a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder joined later, with a 6-speed automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior is available in four colours, with cloth or leather upholstery. The new Sorento CUV can be equipped with a 6-speaker or 8-speaker audio system with MP3, USB and iPod connectivity, plus a built-in or external amplifier. Depending on model, available tech features on higher models include hands-free keyless entry and engine start button, in-mirror reversing camera, navigation, automatic a/c, LED indicators on the mirrors, fold-flat 3rd-row seat and a panoramic glass sunroof. Lower models get 17-inch alloy wheels while higher trims get 18-inch ones, and all get standard four-wheel disc brakes. The Sorento is also available with features such as standard ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, and optional stability control, while passive safety is limited to a stiffened structure and two front airbags, with side and curtain airbags only on the top model.

The Volvo V60 Polestar is the top performance trim of the model. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 3.0-llitre inline-6 cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. Very few were sold in the GCC.

The fifth-generation BMW 7-Series was launched for the 2009 model year, returning to form as an attractive full-size luxury sedan, after years of looking like a troll in its previous generation. The first models to be launched include the standard-wheelbase 740i and 750i as well as the long-wheelbase 740Li and 750Li. The long-wheelbase 760Li came in 2010. Most GCC dealers import only the long-wheelbase version of all the models. In a misleading move dreamt up by retarded marketeers, the 740i and 740Li are now powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-6 engine, instead of the V8 that the badge implies. The 750i and 750Li are now powered by a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, although the 760Li moniker is accurate, with its 6.0-litre twin-turbo V12. The 730i and 730Li models debuted later in 2010, with naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline-6. Badge deception notwithstanding, all engines are capable performers, featuring Double-VANOS variable valve technology, direct injection, and a 6-speed automatic for all except the V12, which comes with an 8-speed automatic. The range now comes equipped with EfficientDynamics technologies as standard, all aimed at improving fuel economy. All 7-Series can now be specified with a side-view camera system, Park Distance Control, two forward-facing cameras, night-vision system, a pedestrian recognition system, blind-spot warning, a heads-up display, speed-related active steering, variable air-suspension damping control, stability control, hill-start assistant, ABS, brake drying, brake-fade compensation, iDrive with larger 10.2-inch screen, instrument cluster with a high-resolution colour display, navigation, 8 GB hard drive, rear-seat DVD entertainment with integrated screens, four-zone automatic air-conditioning, multiple front and side-curtain airbags, optional rear-seat ventilation system with massage function, and other electronic gimmicks. All the usual luxury basics are obviously also included, such as leather, power accessories, sunroof and 18-inch alloys.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 is a facelifted model which came out in 2013. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Lexus NX 200t is the Japanese brand's first entry in the compact crossover field. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. All models come with 18-inch alloys, LED headlights, synthetic or real leather, power front seats, premium multimedia system with navigation, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, power tilt/telescoping steering wheel with buttons, Bluetooth, USB and more. The higher-spec models gain adaptive cruise, Mark Levinson stereo, wood trim, illuminated scuff plates, ventilated seats, remote starter, power-folding rear seats, wireless phone charger, power tailgate, panoramic parking cameras, heads-up display, adaptive suspension and more. The F-Sport models additionally get a mesh grille for the different front bumper, firmer suspension tuning and different wheel designs, optionally with wider tyres. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags as well as stability control and ABS with brake assist, with options including a pre-crash safety system, lane-change assist with blind-spot monitoring and cross-traffic alert, and lane-keeping assist with lane-departure alert and steering assist.

The Legacy is Subaru's midsize model, available in all-wheel-drive form as standard. For 2005, Subaru introduced the fourth-generation Legacy with fresh styling and better handling. The same model, available in sedan and wagon body styles, has been facelifted for the 2007 model year. The Legacy is available in the Middle East with either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder, known as the 2.0R, and the 3.0-litre six-cylinder, known as the 3,0R. Both are flat "boxer" engines, mated to automatic gearboxes. Standard equipment in the base 2.0R model includes MP3/WMA CD stereo, a 6-disc CD changer, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, alloy Wheels, fog lamps, climate control, cruise control and cloth upholstery. Leather and sunroof are optional. The top 3.0R trim level adds the advanced Vehicle Dynamics Control stability and traction control system, eight airbags, sunroof, leather upholstery with power-adjustable seats and more. The wagon is only available in 2.0R form.

The Mitsubishi Outlander got a facelift in 2016 and carries on unchanged. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

The Outlander crossover was redesigned for 2008, based on the Lancer platform, but only two years later, it got a new Evo-inspired nose for 2010. Engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, and a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a 6-speedautomatic. The all-wheel-drive system distributes power as needed under various conditions and also with a 4WD Lock mode, but it does not have the equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with a six-CD changer and 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and Brake Assist, power steering, power windows, cloth upholstery, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 18-inch alloys, Rockford Fosgate stereo with 6-CD changer and 9 speakers, full keyless system, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, paddle shifters and faux leather seats. Only the five-seater version is sold in the GCC.

The Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year and replaces the CL65 AMG. In 2018, it got a facelift, a new engine and major interior upgrades. It is now equipped with a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8. From 2018, it was available only as an all-wheel drive. The engine is coupled to an AMG SPEEDSHIFT MCT 9-speed automatic transmission. There's also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The Audi RS 7 is the top performance variant of the A7, the German brand's "4-door coupe" offering. In 2020, an all-new model of the RS 7 came out. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The Renault Dokker Van is a light commercial vehicle made in Morocco. It comes with one engine option in the GCC, which is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. The panel van version has a luggage capacity of 3,300 litres and a maximum load length of 1.90 metres, thanks to the foldable front passenger seat, that can also be tipped forward against the glove box to free up space for a load length of up to 2.42 metres. If the front seat is removed altogether it provides a carrying capacity of 3,900 litres and a maximum load length of up to 3.11 metres. The payload capacity is 750 kg. It can be equipped with the Media Nav system, that combines navigation and audio functions, featuring Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and auxiliary USB and jack sockets. phone wirelessly and directly onto the Dokker Van's music system. 8 mobile phone devices can be connected to the Bluetooth enabled Media Nav with phonebook and call history.Wooden flooring and interior panelling in the cargo area are amongst the various accessories available. The wood protection kits are designed to protect the Dokker Van's rear loading space and are made from marine-quality plywood with non-slip treatment. Storage bin kit is another wooden accessory to arrange and store tools and is the perfect complement to a full wooden protection kit.Accessorized high-strength grilles for the rear window protect goods against theft and deter vehicle break-ins. Accessories in the range also include transverse roof bars, textile carpet mats, volume and perimeter alarm with or without remote control, and 15-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features in the Dokker include ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), and one driver side front airbag.

The Continental GT is the first new model to come out of the Bentley since it separated from Rolls-Royce under VW ownership. The Continental is smaller and less expensive than any past Bentley, but it still remains out of reach for pretty much anyone who doesn't have a seven-figure bank account. It is also their first model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the ill-received VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental coupe is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GT Speed coupe for 2008 adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling. Also introduced in 2009 is the Continental GT Supersports with even more power and capable of running on both petrol and biofuel. The Supersports had a more aggressive exterior, while mechanically it had revised suspension settings to make it more sporty, bigger ceramic brakes and an automatic retractable spoiler.

The XLR roadster is the flagship sports car of the Cadillac range. The latest variant was the new-for-2006 supercharged XLR-V. The most expensive offering in the Cadillac lineup is based on the Chevrolet Corvette C6 platform, only shorter, narrower, and taller in height. Standard XLR models use a 4.6-litre Northstar V8 engine with a 5-speed automatic in older models, and a 6-speed in newer models since 2007. The XLR-V uses a 4.4-litre Northstar engine with a positive displacement intercooled supercharger, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Chassis modifications include larger brakes, recalibrated Magnetic Ride Control, larger front stabilizer bar and an additional rear one, stiffer rear lower control arm bushings, larger wheels and tyres, a power steering fluid cooler, and a higher-capacity fuel pump. The lightweight roof, made of composite panels, retracts in less than thirty seconds at the push of a button. Features include adaptive Xenon headlights with washers, LED taillights, rear parking assist, rain-sensing wipers, automatic dual-zone climate control, adaptive cruise control, head-up display (HUD), tyre pressure monitoring system, DVD-based navigation system,  Bose six-CD stereo, Magnasteer speed-sensitive variable-assist steering, Magnetic Ride Control, and a keyless access system. The XLR received a minor facelift inside and out for 2009, just before being killed off during the General Motors bankruptcy.

The Subaru Legacy is in its sixth-generation, and has received a facelift for 2018, along with minor updates such as better sound insulation. The Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and got an entirely new design back in 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. The 2018 Subaru Legacy is also available with a 3.6-litre flat 6-cylinder engine, coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

In 2013, the Audi R8 Spyder got a facelift. The R8 is Audi's two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The convertible made its debut in 2011. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. There is also a more powerful 5.2-litre V10 engine. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or a R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 got a power increase for 2009. It features cylinder deactivation technology, dubbed MDS, that seamlessly turning off the fuel consumption in four cylinders of the 5.7-liter HEMI engine when V8 power is not needed, improving fuel economy by up to 20%, though one would be hardpressed to notice a difference. The ride is smooth, but corners should be handled with care. A 6.1-litre V8-powered SRT-8 models is also available in many GCC markets, with a more sporting demeanour and does not have MDS. For 2010, the 300 Limited model was introduced, with a 3.5-litre V6 and 4-speed automatic, as well as being fully-loaded with options such as UConnect computer, navigation, leather and remote start. Available features across the model range include cloth or leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, power accessories, optional sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, navigation and a hard drive. The SRT8 gets larger 20-inch alloy wheels, sports leather seats, a mild body kit and sports suspension. All models feature front and side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The midsize Toyota Camry sedan has been redesigned heavily for 2012, with a new engine, new interior, new suspension and an overall repackage to make it more appealing. A 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic is standard, and it makes a little less horsepower on the base model than in the rest of the range, as it is the only one to receive a single exhaust tip, while the other trims receive dual exhaust tips. The base model can be had with a manual gearbox in Saudi Arabia, but not in the UAE. Now available in four new trim levels, the base model also looks visibly different than the rest of the range, with its basic bumpers, 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps and more hard plastics in the interior. Known as S or GL, depending on market, it comes with a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags. The mid-range model, known as SE or GLX, also gets fake wood trim, dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, 16-inch alloys, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, and a "sport" front bumper, "sport" grille, rear boot spoiler and dual exhaust tips. Also available are stability control, sunroof, DVD, keyless start and navigation, although the mid-range specs vary between GCC countries. The top-spec "Sport" model, known as GLX S in some markets, gets a unique rear bumper, paddle-shifters, stability control, leather seats, 17-inch alloys and fake metal cabin trim, with some markets like Oman getting intelligent keyless entry with starter button and DVD player. In terms of safety, all models get dual front airbags and ABS, but only some of the top trim levels get side airbags and stability control, though again specs vary, as the most-expensive Sport model in the UAE does not get those latter features. In late 2012, a "Royale" model was offered in the UAE, essentially a base model with a few extra features tacked on, identified by dealer-installed LEDs on the front bumper.

An all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz CLA 45 AMG came out in 2020. It gets an upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, available in two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. All models are all-wheel-drive. The standard features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Isuzu MU-X is the brand's only SUV offering. It is basically a rebadged Chevrolet Trailblazer, but with a diesel engine. It gets the 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.Features on the higher trim levels include 16-inch alloys, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more.

The Tahoe has been Chevy's bread and butter for ages now, and so GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Tahoe gets many upgrades throughout the vehicle, including a new platform and a better quality interior. A beefy new Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Tahoe, with better fuel economy to boot. However it still had the ageing Hydra-Matic 4L60-E 4-speed automatic transmission. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Tahoe is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The Liana is pitched into the ultra-competitive compact segment. It was introduced as a 2002 model, and mildly facelifted for 2005. The only model offered here is the 1.6-litre four-cylinder version with either a manual or an automatic. It can be fully equipped with air-conditioning, ABS brakes, dual airbags, CD stereo, full electrics, keyless entry and an engine immobiliser. The interior has undergone a respectable makeover, with a new quality look, new materials and better bolstered front seats. Front seat occupants will enjoy the airy cabin. The seats are supportive and well contoured, and even rear passengers are not lacking for headroom or legroom. The high seating position contributes to good visibility. The luggae trunk is not particularly roomy, but split-fold rear seats allow more load space. There are faux aluminium and chrome highlights all over, while optional accesories include a rear spoiler and alloy wheels. The Liana used to come in sedan and hatchback body styles in other markets, but in its final years, only the sedan survived in most markets. European and American markets get larger engine choices.

In 2007, the all-new Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet made its debut. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets a new all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 2007 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. A new option in the 2007 Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. The V60 straddles the line between compact and midsize, with more cabin room to boot. Available in the GCC with two engine choices, the entry-level V60 T4 model comes with a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The higher-spec V60 2.0T model comes with 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 6-speed automatic as well. Later on the more powerful V60 T5 2.0-litre turbocharged engine came was offered. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. Very few were sold in the GCC.

The Daihatsu Gran Max Pickup is the Japanese brand's compact commercial pickup offering. The two-seater is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, it is mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features include power steering, A/C, audio system with AM/FM radio and MP3/CD player. It has a loading capacity of up to 1075 kg.

The Renault Twizy is designed as an "ultramobile" and is just 2.34 metres long, 1.24 metres wide and 1.45 metres tall. It is available in only four colours blue, white, red and black -- from which customers can choose many styling combinations. Different stickers can also be added to the doors and rims. We're classifying it as a mini-hatchback, but the truth is this four-wheeled 2-seater is hard to categorise. The passenger sits behind the driver, crammed in somehow. The Twizy's electric motor can run up to 85 km on a single charge. The lithium-ion batteries takes about 3.5 hours to charge completely using a 220-240v powerpoint. For safety, the Twizy comes with a 4-point seatbelt and a steering-wheel airbag. It is equipped with disc brakes as well and an optional rear-parking aid.

An all-new Chevrolet Tahoe was released as a 2015 model year. It is pretty much the same for the 2018 model. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

PGO proclaims itself to be a 'French automobile craftsman' to highlight their hand-crafted aspect and small-scale production. The range expands from the Speedster II with the addition of the CÃ©vennes. Both share the same technical foundation and differ only in style, with the CÃ©vennes looking more modern with restyled bumpers and trim. Indeed, the overall styling is still based on the 1950s Porsche 356. However, it is powered by a recent 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Peugeot engine, with no additional tuning. The rear-mounted motor is mated to a rear-wheel-drive platform and a choice of 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. While the car is very basic and very expensive, customisation options offer 15 paintjobs, 8 soft-top colours, 14 types of leather and 10 types of carpet. Standard features include a basic a/c, power windows, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with 2 speakers, keyless entry, electric mirrors, black manual soft top and a set of eight instrumentation gauges. Options include chrome wheels, two-tone leather, CD changer, alarm and more.

The Patriot is an all-new compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine with either a standard 5-speed manual transmission or an optional second-generation CVT automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. The optional off-road package has simulated low-range gearing using the CVT gearbox. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

The Jaguar XK received a face-lift for 2012. The XK Coupe and Convertible are powered by a 5.0-litre V8 direct-injection engine, while a supercharged version of the same V8 powers the high-performance XKR. That too can be had in either coupe or convertible format. Both engines are mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox with paddle shifters. An even more powerful XKR-S was released in 2012 with the same supercharged 5.0-litre engine but producing even more horsepower. Changes include a new wider front grille, enlarged vents in the lower grille with chrome accents, LED daytime running lights and slightly thinner headlamps. Its rigid chassis and CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a CD stereo system. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz CLS-Class came out in 2019. The exterior and interior have been completely changed to incorporate their new design language, first seen on the Mercedes-Benz A-Class. New engines now power the CLS-Class which includes a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo for the CLS 350, the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 motor for the CLS-450 and the 3.0-litre turbo inline-6 engine coupled with an electric motor for the CLS-53 AMG. All of them get the 9-speed automatic transmission. The CLS 450 and CLS 53 AMG are available only in all-wheel-drive. Standard features are aplenty which include leather seats, keyless entry, central locking, engine stop-start button, digital instrument cluster, infotainment system with Bluetooth/USB support, cruise control, LED headlights and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment includes air suspension and a widescreen cockpit consisting of two 12.3-inch displays on the dashboard. An AMG line is also available and includes AMG body styling, a diamond pattern radiator grille, 19-inch alloy wheels, and a flat-bottomed sports steering wheel.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 is a facelifted model which came out in 2013. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Altea was one of the first Seat models to adopt the sensationalistic new styling direction of the VW-owned Spanish company. It is supposed to be a so-called Multi Sports Vehicle, but in reality is just a tall hatchback. The Altea has enough space inside for five occupants, and has a two-tiered luggage compartment. The vast engine range includes a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre, and a turbocharged 2.0-litre, all four-cylinders mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. All are available with a manual or an automatic, and the turbo motor is exclusively available with a DSG automanual dual-clutch gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and keyless entry. Active safety features include ABS-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, traction control, stability control system and the built-in emergency braking system. The Altea is also equipped as standard with driver and passenger airbag, side airbag and head airbag.

The 2016 Mazda 2 is a new generation model. It is a hatchback and now uses its own "Skyactiv" chassis and engine. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a new 6-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. LED headlights, fog lamps, leather seats, heads-up display, rear spoiler and 16-inch alloys are some of the optional features. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The top-spec model gets 6 airbags.

The Toyota Prado got a minor facelift for 2014, with a redesigned front-end and other trim changes. The only engine available with the short-wheelbase 3-door variant is a carryover 2.7-litre 4-cylinder. In 2016, it got a 6-speed automatic gearbox. It is only available in some markets, such as the UAE in GXR trim; and Bahrain in TX and TXL trim. It gets standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing and a locking centre-differential. In the UAE, the Prado 2.7L GXR comes with 17-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, rear spoiler, mud guards, fabric seating for five, keyless entry, front and rear manual a/c, CD/MP3 6-speaker stereo, ABS with EBD and brake-assist, dual front airbags, cool box, steering audio controls, USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, smart keyless entry and start, leather steering wheel and shift lever, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, front fog lamps and some other basic features.

The Lexus RC F is the Japanese luxury brand's performance compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC F gets a 5.0-litre V8 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control. A carbon package replaces the bonnet, roof and boot with carbon-fibre body panels.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The CX-9 crossover SUV has received a minor facelift for the 2010 model year that adds a new front end with a grinning corporate grille, new rear light clusters, and some small interior changes. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it comes with a six-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in two trims, both the base CX-9 and the CX-9 GT are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The CX-9 GT has 20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console.

The Citroen DS4 is the compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission.
