Standard features on the DS4 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, automatic a/c with dual-zone temperature control, radio stereo with CD/AUX support, Bluetooth, USB port, steering mounted controls, navigation system, cruise control, interior mood lighting, aluminium drilled pedals, automatic headlamps, automatic wipers, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, daytime running LEDs, fabric seats with lumbar support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA), Electronic Stability Program (ESP) with traction control, driver's, front passengers and front lateral airbags, and front and rear curtain airbags.

The Mitsubishi Mirage hopes to take on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. The hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

Hyundai has upped its game considerably, and sister-company Kia benefits too. The new-for-2011 Kia Optima is based on the latest Sonata and therefore a larger car than its predecessor. Styled like a European sedan, the midsize Optima will receive two economy-biased engines in the GCC, mainly a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, with some countries receiving a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder. Both are available with 6-speed manual and 6-speed automatic transmissions, though some countries will only get a standard automatic with paddle-shifters. The base model comes with power steering, power windows, manual a/c with rear cooling ducts, automatic headlights, paddle shifters, power mirrors with indicators, fog lamps, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, USB and AUX ports with iPod cable, steering wheel buttons, 16-inch steel wheels and a single airbag. The mid-range model gains a panoramic glass roof, with automatic rolling cloth roof-shades, as well as 17-inch alloy wheels and ABS. The fully-optioned model is loaded with intelligent keyless entry with start button, power-folding mirrors, HID headlights, chrome door handles, automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, overhead 'map' lights up front, excellent leather upholstery, driver's power-adjusted seat, trip computer, slightly-tinted glass, 6-CD changer, ventilated seats, 18-inch alloys, navigation, Bluetooth, six airbags, and stability control with hill-start assist and brake assist. Kia is offering proper safety features only in the top model.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2016, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The 5-door wagon is sold here, with the 3-door and soft top versions available only on special order. The Mercedes-Benz G 500 is fitted with 4.0-litre V8 twin-turbocharged engine coupled with a 7-speed automatic transmission. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The limited-production twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 G65 AMG has been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. It comes over here as only a 5-door wagon. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Picanto is one of the smallest cars plying the Middle East's aggressive roads. Powered by a tiny 1.1-litre four-cylinder, it is smaller than a family-size Coke bottle, mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The tall styling makes sure there is fair headroom, though legroom is conservative at best. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, radio cassette player with roof antenna and 4 speakers, manual air-conditioning, combination vinyl-cloth cabin, variable intermittent front wipers, front cup holder, seat belts and, thankfully, a tachometer. Available features in higher trim levels include a rear wiper and washer, rear shelf cover over the luggage area, body-coloured exterior trim pieces and bumpers, a luggage net, and not much else. We believe most markets do not get anything more than seat belts as safety features, although a few markets do get the front-wheel-drive Picanto with all sorts of optional airbags. Anyone who chooses to pilot a Picanto in public is a brave man indeed.

An all new Mitsubishi L200 was released as a 2016 model year. It is sold in the GCC purely as a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.
Coming soon..

The long-running Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van has been facelifted for the 2014 model year. It can be classified as one of the largest "light" commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value. Optional safety features include lane-keeping assist, blind-spot assist, collision-prevention assist and high-beam assist.

The Maserati Quattroporte became larger and lighter in 2013, and for 2015, is offered with three engine options, namely two versions of a 3.0-litre V6 in the base Quattroporte and the mid-range Quattroporte S, and a 3.8-litre V8 in the Quattroporte GTS, all twin-turbocharged direction-injection units built by Ferrari, but using some Chrysler-derived parts. Both have an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive for the GCC market. Later on, an all-wheel-drive version for the Quattroporte S was available. The all-new architecture retains its 50:50 weight distribution, double-wishbone front suspension, and a five-link rear suspension. The more-spacious interior can be had with both four-seat and five-seat layouts. Cabin features include a Chrysler-sourced 8.4-inch touchscreen, adjustable pedals, reversing cameras and the optional 15-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system, as well as WLAN-based WiFi and Bluetooth compatibility. The screen includes navigation, reverse camera, DVD player, audio and ventilation functions. Adaptive cruise control, smart key with push-button start, front-side airbags and a dual-zone climate control system with 13 ventilation ports, complete the list of standard features.

Toyota tacks on the Land Cruiser badge on up to three of their 4WD models, including a pickup, but there is only one true Land Cruiser that everyone knows and loves for reasons unknown. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon remains at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. It is still one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. Few vehicles offer the off-road capability of the Land Cruiser, and fewer still combine this with its level of luxury. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.5-litre six-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto, and a new 4.7-litre V8 and a five-speed auto. There is also a 4.2-litre diesel with a manual. It can transport anywhere from eight to ten passengers depending on model. It is an expensive vehicle, but everything is still optional, including ABS, airbags and cruise control. Other options include leather sunroof and navigation. We'd love to love this outdated 4WD, but we hate the people who buy these, as any other road user will know why.

Toyota had been selling a slightly-altered version of the Prado in the United States since 2002, calling it the Lexus GX 470. That model has now been replaced by a new-for-2010 GX 460 model, based on the latest-generation Prado. The most obvious difference between the GCC-spec Prado and the US-spec GX460 is the front-end styling, with small changes to the rear light clusters and a completely unique dashboard. The cabin trim quality is also a notch better, while even a few control buttons have been changed for a more premium feel. The real news is under the bonnet, as the Lexus version comes exclusively with a 4.6-litre V8, slighty detuned compared to the U.S. version. The V8 is mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. In terms of standard equipment, this 7-seater comes with three-zone auto a/c, 9-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, front and side-curtain airbags, front knee airbags, hands-free keyless entry with starter button, wood and leather trim, Bluetooth and USB jack, as well as a centre-diff lock, KDSS air suspension, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID turning headlights, sunroof, parking assist, common power accessories, cruise control, ABS and stability control. Adding to the base 'Premium' model, the 'Premium Plus' trim adds a 17-speaker stereo with DVD changer, 8-inch navigation screen, rear DVD entertainment system, roof rails, 4-camera 360-degree system and crawl control. The top 'Luxury' trim adds semi-aniline leather, active cruise control and a remote engine starter.

An all new Mercedes-Benz SL Class was released for 2012. The new design features a complete new aluminium body, so it is lighter than its predecessor. Also the new generation SL Class is wider and longer. Engine choices include SL 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and SL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8. Both are mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include front airbags and head-thorax sidebags, ABS brakes, automatic climate control with dust filter and air recirculation, automatic steering wheel with adjustment on entry and exit, brake assist, central locking, cruise control with variable speed limiter, stability control, xenon headlights, leather upholstery, light-alloy wheels, CD radio with 8 speakers and more.

European motorcycle-maker KTM, introduced their first ever car with the X-Bow. KTM basically transferred its principles from two wheels to four, with a track-biased car that can be driven on the street. But KTM developers have kept the weight of the vehicle extremely light by removing everything that is not needed, including body panels, doors and a windshield. Parts of the suspension are intentionally visible. Built on a carbon-fibre chassis, a 'crash box' in the front nose absorbs collision energy, while roll bars are integrated into the structure, which is all good considering there are no airbags. An options kit is available on request which includes having additional struts mounted at designated points. The Audi-sourced 4-cylinder FSI turbo engine is made of aluminium and mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 6-speed DSG automanual transmission. Brembo brakes, a limited-slip differential, and four-point seat-belts round out the standard package. There are no electronic driving aids, no power steering and no roof, although a cloth tarpaulin is available to cover the interior when not in use.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 3.0-litre diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

This generation of the Lexus RX debuted back in 2016. In 2020, it got a facelift. Under the hood, the RX 350 gets the 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. However there is also an F Sport model which gets a bodykit. The RX 450h gets a similar 3.5-litre V6 engine combined to three electric motors. In 2020, a long wheel base version RX 450hL was added to the lineup. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 20-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations.

The Continental Flying Spur was launched in 2006 as the 4-door version of the Continental GT. It is also their first sedan model ever to feature all-wheel drive, which is no surprise, since it uses the same platform as the unloved VW Phaeton. However, this Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets. Standard equipment on the Spur includes HID headlights, 19-inch alloy wheels, a tyre pressure monitoring system, cruise control, keyless entry and ignition, rain-sensing wipers, powered trunk lid and a choice of 16 colours. On the inside, one has a choice of 17 colours for the leather-appointed interior with matching carpets and seatbelts. The cabin features steering-column mounted shift paddles, sunroof with electronic sunshade, DVD navigation, six-CD changer and Bluetooth. Almost all seats feature lumbar massage, memory and heat settings. Options include a choice of three 19-inch wheel styles and a 20-inch wheel and tyre package, ceramic brakes, and the sunroof can be had with a solar panel to power ventilation fans to maintain interior temperature when parked, a full-length centre console and numerous trim choices. Convenience options include a cordless privacy handset with keypad in centre console, a rear telephone system, and a rear-view camera. The Continental Flying Spur is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. An unnoticeable facelift came in mid-2008, as well as a new Flying Spur Speed variant, adding more power, while improving performance and handling.

The Daihatsu Gran Max Van is a compact commercial van offering from the Japanese brand. The Indonesian-built Gran Max can be had as panel van or glass van. Under the hood is a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Gran Max Van include power steering, AC, AM/FM radio with MP3/CD player and steel wheels. It has a loading capacity of upto 870 kg.

The Tata Xenon is the Indian manufacturer's answer to commercial vehicles which is currently dominated by the Japanese. Featuring a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine, the Xenon comes standard with power steering, power windows and air-conditioning. Unlike the name, it does not come with xenon headlamps. The Xenon can be had in either single cab or double cab, with the option of two-wheel drive or four-wheel-drive.
An all-new GMC Sierra will be available in 2019.

The Nissan Tiida is all-new for 2014, and is essentially a hatchback version of the Sentra sedan. Two 4-cylinder engine options are available, namely a 1.6-litre and a 1.8-litre, both mated to a CVT automatic. The brakes are front discs with rear drums. The suspension is independent up front, with a torsion-beam rear. The basic 1.6-litre Tiida S features power steering, power windows, central door locking, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with CD player and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. For the 1.6-litre Tiida SV, there's audio controls on the steering wheel, 4 speakers and 16-inch alloy wheels. The 1.8-litre Tiida SV gets additional smoked halogen lamps, smoked-chrome front grille and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 1.8-litre Tiida SL also gets power folding mirrors with integrated side lamp, cruise control, intelligent key, starter button, steering wheel-mounted bluetooth buttons, rear armrest, leather shift knob, 6 speakers and automatic A/C. The Tiida SL Plus optionally adds leather seats and sunroof, although these are standard on the SL in some markets such as the UAE. For the UAE market specifically, the SV and SL models get a 5.8-inch display screen with Bluetooth, CD player, MP3, AUX, USB, Ipod connectivity, navigation and rear-view camera as standard, although these may be optional in other GCC markets. A fully body kit is also optionally available in some markets. Standard safety features for the Nissan Tiida include dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and brake assist (BA). The 1.8-litre models also get stability control, and only the top 1.8 SL Plus gets side and curtain airbags.

The fifth generation Honda Odyssey came out in 2018, featuring a new design and improvements in technology and safety. The Odyssey is still the same size, but improvements have been made to the structure to improve efficiency and safety. Under the hood, the 3.5-litre V6 engine is carried over, connected to a new 10-speed automatic transmission, for better performance and fuel efficiency. Standard features on the 2019 Honda Odyssey include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric sliding doors, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED tail lights, 8-inch touchscreen display audio, Apple CarPlay, USB, AUX, Bluetooth, 6 speakers and subwoofer, cruise control, push start button, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get 10.2-inch screen rear entertainment system, navigation, 11 speakers, leather seats, wireless phone charging, automatic AC,  and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control, hill-start assist, electronic brake distribution and tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher trims get additional blind spot monitor and Honda Sensing.

The XLR roadster is the flagship sports car of the Cadillac range. The latest variant was the new-for-2006 supercharged XLR-V. The most expensive offering in the Cadillac lineup is based on the Chevrolet Corvette C6 platform, only shorter, narrower, and taller in height. Standard XLR models use a 4.6-litre Northstar V8 engine with a 5-speed automatic in older models, and a 6-speed in newer models since 2007. The XLR-V uses a 4.4-litre Northstar engine with a positive displacement intercooled supercharger, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Chassis modifications include larger brakes, recalibrated Magnetic Ride Control, larger front stabilizer bar and an additional rear one, stiffer rear lower control arm bushings, larger wheels and tyres, a power steering fluid cooler, and a higher-capacity fuel pump. The lightweight roof, made of composite panels, retracts in less than thirty seconds at the push of a button. Features include adaptive Xenon headlights with washers, LED taillights, rear parking assist, rain-sensing wipers, automatic dual-zone climate control, adaptive cruise control, head-up display (HUD), tyre pressure monitoring system, DVD-based navigation system,  Bose six-CD stereo, Magnasteer speed-sensitive variable-assist steering, Magnetic Ride Control, and a keyless access system. The XLR received a minor facelift inside and out for 2009, just before being killed off during the General Motors bankruptcy.

The 2014 Mitsubishi Outlander got a complete new redesign which ditches the Lancer-inspired front fascia. The exterior body is now composed of high-tensile steel which reduces the weight of the new Outlander by as much as 90 kgs. The interior also had a major overhaul, featuring soft-touch materials and wooden accents all around. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/USB support, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

This was one of the most popular versions of the Accord, being the first model to actually offer interior space befitting a midsize family car. Its conservative styling proved to be just right for its target market, and it even became the only Accord generation to become the top-selling car in the competitive American market, even though it was mildly overshadowed by the Camry in the GCC. The American-built two-door coupes are also a common sight. This new-for-1998 model was completely redesigned compared to the previous model, but retained the fancy double-wishbone suspension system that made Honda famous. There are two engines, the standard 2.3-litre 4-cylinder with a manual or automatic, and the hard-to-find optional 3.0-litre V6 with an automatic only. The popular sedans are great everyday cars with comfort and convenience features. Available features include cruise control, power locks, keyless entry, steel or alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with ABS, CD player, leather upholstery, a power glass sunroof, front airbags and more.

The Jeep Renegade is the smallest SUV offering from the brand. It gets 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under the hood, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The base 2020 Jeep Renegade Sport model comes in front-wheel-drive format, while the Latitude, Trailhawk and Limited models are all-wheel drive platforms. Standard options in the 2020 Jeep Renegade include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, manual A/C, FM radio with AUX/USB support and alloy wheels. Higher options include automatic A/C, Infotainment system with screen, navigation, automatic A/C and leather seats. Safety features in the 2020 Jeep Renegade include driver and passenger airbags, traction control and vehicle stability control.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK and also added a Coupe model in 2017. It got a slight facelift in 2020. Under the hood, the GLC 63 S AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S got a minor facelift in 2017, as well as a slight power upgrade, thanks to modified inlet ports in the cylinder head, new injection nozzles and higher fuel pressure. Fuel economy improves slightly as well due to further advanced electronic engine and transmission management with revised gear change mappings. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

An all-new Kia Sportage came out for the 2016 model year. The base model of the Sportage is a naturally aspirated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, available only in front-wheel-drive format. Other engines include a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, or a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder will all-wheel drive. The naturally-aspirated engines get a 6-speed automatic transmission, while the turbo engine is mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre AWD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, navigation and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. The top "GT Line" option comes with a different front bumper with four-cube fog lamps, different front grille, front and back skid plates, dual exhaust tips, D-shaped steering wheel and 20-inch alloy wheels

Available from early 2013, the "Mark 7" VW Golf may look the same, but is really completely new, the big news being several weight-saving enhancements that form the car. It got a facelift and new engine for 2018. Only the 1.0-litre 3-cylinder TSI engine unit was available mated to 7-speed "DSG" automanual transmissions. All Golf models now have touchscreen systems as standard, starting with a 5.8-inch colour display and rising to the range-topping satellite navigation system with 8-inch colour display that operates with finger gestures. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, power windows, keyless entry and such, with optional features such as sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, 5.8-inch touchscreen, fog lamps and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. Standard on all new Golf models is a multi-collision brake system which automatically brakes the vehicle after a collision, to reduce kinetic energy significantly and thus minimise the chance of a second impact. Other available electronic aids include adaptive cruise control and city emergency braking, both capable of applying full braking to a stop. Further options include a Driver Alert System that monitors the driver's inputs to detect any signs of tiredness, while a camera-operated Lane Assist system can help keep the car in a specific lane, providing countersteering assistance where necessary, while the Dynamic Light Assist system optionally masks the vehicle's high beam lighting to avoid dazzling oncoming traffic.

An all-new Ford Expedition model came out as in 2018. Engine specs for the 2021 Ford Expedition include a second generation 3.5-litre twin-turbocharged "Ecoboost" engine, available in two different tunes, and connected to a 10-speed automatic transmission. The Expedition’s terrain-management system allows the driver to select from seven modes in 4WD models, so whatever terrain you’re tackling (be it sand, mud/ruts, gravel, grass or snow), there’s a mode that optimises the drivetrain for it. Needless to say that when driving in the Sport mode, you get an improved throttle response and gearbox mapping. The big Ford offers the best towing capability of any full-size SUV, and it comes with features such as Pro Trailer Backup Assist, which negates the need for repeated back- and forth when reversing with a trailer. There’s also an available hands-free, foot-activated liftgate to make loading bulky cargo into the load bay less of a back-breaking exercise. Aside from offering best-in-class second-row and third-row legroom as well as hip-room, the Expedition is also the first in this segment to feature a sliding second-row seat with tip-and-slide functionality, providing easy access to the third row without the need to first remove a child safety seat. The Expedition’s second-row and third-row seats not only provide best-in-class roominess but can be quickly folded flat with the push of a button to provide access to a cargo area wide and flat enough to handle 4×8-foot sheets of plywood and other gear. There’s no shortage of luxury kit in the Expedition, and among the goodies on offer is plush leather trim, multicontour driver seat with massage feature, a power reclining 3rd row seat, capacitive touchscreen with SYNC 3 (which also offers Arabic voice capability) and Apple CarPlay / Android Auto compatibility, adaptive cruise control with Stop-and-Go (keeps a set distance to the vehicle in front, and will automatically bring the car to a complete stop, and accelerate away again when required), dual-headrest rear entertainment system and a premium 12-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system with enough bass to make the windows reverberate. Add to that, a class-leading Panoramic VistaRoof that covers not only the 1st row but also the 2nd. Your devices are also well catered to, as there’s wireless charging, four 12-volt power points, up to six USB ports positioned across all three rows and a 230-volt outlet. The Platinum gets collision-avoidance detection (for both pedestrians and vehicles), lane-keeping system, blind-spot warning with cross-traffic alert and enhanced active park assist (for both parallel and perpendicular parking needs). There’s also a 360-degree camera to give you a bird’s eye view of the car’s immediate surrounds.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019. The 8-Series comes two engines - a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 engine and a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, both motors coming with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 8-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is a big 4WD that dates back to the 1992 version, relaunched with a new skin in 1998. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its reasonable on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder came for 2002, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A 4-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the 5-speed manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features.

The Citroen C5 is the midsize offering from the French brand. Only one engine is offered in the GCC, which is a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. Standard features on the C5 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, steering wheel with multi-functional controls, automatic A/C, stereo radio/MP3 compatible CD player, cruise control, Bluetooth system with USB, automatic rain-sensitive windscreen wipers and automatic illumination of headlamps, front fog lamps, cornering lights, daytime runnings LEDs, rear parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher model gets Hydractive 3+ suspension, hill-start assist, automatic electric parking brake, electric front seats, chrome linings, part leather seats, interior mood lighting, sunroof, xenon headlamps and different 17-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features are good with front and passenger airbags, knee airbags and curtain airbags, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) with traction control and Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA).

Originally introduced in Malaysia back in 1993, the Wira was based on the early-90s Mitsubishi Lancer, and continued in its early form all the way to the new century, and ending up being the most outdated car on the market. Available as a sedan or a liftback, the engine and gearbox were sourced from Mitsubishi, namely a 1.5-litre and a 1.6-litre, both 4-cylinder. The smaller engine came with a 5-speed manual or a 3-speed automatic, while the larger one came standard with a 4-speed auto. Features included cloth interior, manual or power windows, radio-cassette player, optional sunroof, optional spoiler, and not much else. Safety features were limited to seat-belts in early models, with later ones receiving a driver-side airbag, ABS brakes and safety-bars in the doors. As unrefined as the car is, proven Mitsubishi mechanicals under the skin means on-road reliability is as good as most Japanese cars, although the car itself will be falling apart from the inside out, starting with the cheap cabin trim. The car flopped in the GCC region, except in places like Kuwait, where it was marketed as a commercial vehicle.

The Ferrari F8 Tributo replaced the 488 GTB in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016. The wagon is available with a "SkyActiv" 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection engine. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. There is no top-spec model offered in the GCC. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, there is only one petrol engine on offer, which is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The other engines options are the diesel units which include a 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre, which will most likely not make it to the GCC just yet. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with AUX/USB/iPOD/MP3/CD player, and 4 speakers. Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, 5-inch touchscreen, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

The Audi E-Tron is the German luxury brand's first all-electric vehicle offering. The E-Tron Sportback variant came a year later. Built on Audi’s new battery-electric vehicle or BEV platform, the E-tron packs a 95 kWhr battery and two motors to power the front and rear wheels. Audi intentionally kept the design similar to their petrol-powered cars, to make potential customers switching to electric feel more comfortable with the initial transition. The interior features the new “virtual cockpit”, which includes the infotainment system with dual haptic touchscreens. The shifter is new and unique — it looks like a hand rest but has a tab at the end, which can be moved to change gears. Another unique feature is the side-view “mirrors” which are actually screens on the upper door panels, and on the outside were just sticks with cameras. While it takes a moment to get used to, rest assured it is just as option for people who still want the traditional side mirrors. The regenerative braking technology on the E-tron is one of the highlights of the car. What Audi managed to do is keep the drive similar to a combustion-engined Audi. During normal driving, most of the braking is done by the electric motors, which then send the captured energy to the battery. The best feature of this system is the brake pedal feel, which is not like the “switch” feel of other electric cars, but gives that linear braking smoothness of non-electric cars. At speeds below 11 kph, it switches to normal hydraulic brakes so you don’t get that jerky feeling when parking or moving slowly through traffic.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class sedan. Under the hood, they gets twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The new Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its truck-like construction as well as low-range gearing on all but the most basic model. This second-generation model is much more sophisticated than its previous iteration, and is a solid alternative to regular soft-roaders. Suzuki offers 3-door and 5-door body styles, with either a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or a 2.7-litre V6, and a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and amazingly enough, a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain bags for those in the back.

The Laguna is supposed to be an alternative to the average car in the boring midsize segment. The Laguna looks somewhat like a sedan, but is actually a liftback, with a rear hatch that opens upwards for easier access to the luggage trunk. There are two new engines. The base model comes with a simple 2.0-litre four-cylinder, mated to an automatic gearbox in this region. The top model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder setup with unique suspension that is lowered by 10 mm and comes with stiffened springs and dampers. The Laguna became the first car in Europe to achieve the top rating in European governmental crash tests, and is one of the safest cars in its class. Standard safety features include ABS brakes with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Brake Assist, anti-whiplash head restraints, front, front-lateral and front/rear curtain airbags, with de-activation for the front passenger seat. Other standard features include remote central locking, immobiliser and alarm, power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and more.

The Nativa is an off-road capable 4WD that fits in an odd spot between the Pajero and the Outlander. Powered by a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a four-speed automatic, the Nativa is a dated design, but still a decent wagon. Standard features for the low base price include AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, driver's and front passenger's front airbags, part time 4WD with synchronized front free-wheel differential, transfer protector, power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, alloy wheels, keyless entry system and seating for five. Features available on higher models include gauges for a thermometer, compass, oil pressure and voltage meter, faux wood trim, front fog lights, CD player with 6 speakers, leather seats, sunroof, limited slip differential, ABS with EBD, cruise control and more. The Nativa rides on the older L200 pickup platform, and was discontinued in a number of markets since 2004. Shipments have continued from Thailand since 2008, alongside the Pajero Sport. However, few 4WDs are offered at this price that are properly equipped to go off-road. Some dealers only offered one fully-loaded trim in the later years.

The Jeep Cherokee got a facelift for the 2019 model year. It offers both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive. From 2020, only the 3.2-litre "Pentastar" V6 engine was available. A 9-speed automatic transmission is standard on all models. It features four-wheel-independent suspension. There will be four different versions Sport, Longitude, Limited and Trailhawk. The last one is the most offroad-capable version and has Jeep's "Trail Rated" badges, and comes with a Selec-Terrain system, 1-inch lift and a locking rear differential. Other available features include a park-assist system that gives you directions on how to park into a particular space, an 8.4-inch touchscreen with optional navigation and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with auto-braking, and more.

The Fiesta is a pint-sized runabout, and looks funny next to the Crown Victoria, but it is a product of Ford's European effort. Released for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, the Fiesta is built in Germany and few in this region know about this. Even fewer have even heard of this car. The Fiesta is a bestseller in Europe but failed to make an impact here, mostly because of impossibly snobby dealership prices for servicing this cheap car. Otherwise it is a very good sub-compact. Handling and ride  is even better than the highly acclaimed late-90's version thanks to the ultra-stiff bodyshell. Power comes from a Duratec 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine that offers fuel economy expected from cars of this size. There is also a choice of manual and automatic gearboxes for this front-wheel-drive hatchback. Safety equipment includes ABS brakes, airbags and other items. Small on the outside, decent packaging allows the Fiesta to offer decent space for people and cargo in its small body. It doesn't look too bad either.

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports coupe with a supercharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. The Performance Pack Performance Pack increases power, a revised engine specification and engine management calibration, 308 mm front discs with AP Racing four-piston calipers, upgraded brake pads and hoses, full length Lotus Sport roof scoop, variable slip traction control, launch control, uprated clutch plate and cover. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

After a two-year hiatus to clear old stocks, the Renault Megane came back to the GCC market with an all-new design, more conservative than before. Engine choices, all 4-cylinder, include a 1.6-litre with a 5-speed manual, a 1.6-litre with an ancient 4-speed automatic, and a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The front-wheel-drive Megane is available as a hatchback only now, aside from a CC convertible version, with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features in the hatchback include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

The all-new Chevrolet Sonic is a sub-compact replacement for the Aveo. Available in sedan and hatchback body-styles, the Sonic was sold in the GCC with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic function, while a 5-speed manual available in some markets. The base model comes with 5-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, fold-down rear seat, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, optional keyless entry and only one airbag. The mid-range LS model additionally gets steel wheels or optional 15-inch alloy wheels, optional sunroof, power windows, 4-way manually-adjustable driver's seat, better stereo with Bluetooth and more optional speakers, split-folding rear seat, optional parking sensors, optional ABS and two airbags. The top LT model additionally gets 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, standard ABS, 6-speaker stereo, and front as well as side airbags.

The 206 is one of Peugeot's more popular models, with a wide range of body styles, trim levels and engine choices. Its design has changed little since its launch in 1999, although new derivatives such as the 206 CC Cabriolet joined the line-up in 2001. There are various petrol engines in the range, although after 2006, the local offerings had decreased. The standard five-door hatchback can be had with a 1.4-litre or a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine with either a manual or an automatic. The 206 CC coupe-cabriolet can only be had as a 1.6-litre automatic in the later years, although the manual 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre CC models were available here for a few years in between. There is a more powerful 2.0-litre engine with a manual offered in three-door RC hatchback form, which is a true sporting contender. The tuned RC debuted in 2003, replacing the competent GTi 2.0-litre model. All models come with front power windows, a cloth interior, driver's airbag and other basics as standard. Comprehensive safety equipment such as ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution, Emergency Brake Assist, ESP and traction control, along with passenger front airbag, were all optional. Available features included a CD player, alloy wheels and more.

The MG 350 is the Chinese-owned brand's attempt to enter into the competitive compact sedan segment. Under  the hood, it gets a 1.5 litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a five speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Standard features in the 350 include power windows, power mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support, fabric seats with manual adjustment, folding rear seats, fog lamps, front and rear disc brakes, and steel wheels. As we go higher up the range, features include climate control, leather seats, electric seats, DVD entertainment system, sunroof, rear parking sensor,bluetooth connectivity and 16-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The IS 300 C comes with a GCC-specific 3.0-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The rear-wheel-drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. Safety features that come standard include numerous airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, and electronic brake-force distribution. Along with the folding hard-top, the IS C features LED rear lights, parking sensors, revised instrument gauges, climate control designed for top-down motoring, 12-speaker Mark Levinson sound system and an in-dash CD changer. Lexus's Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management system, which includes traction control, vehicle stability control and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, is standard. Options include a "Pre-Crash" safety system and two-tone leather seats.

The Honda CR-V is roomy little 4WD that is convenient and easy to drive on the streets, but no hero on the rough stuff. There lots of stuff in it and the back seats are quite comfortable. It rides as smoothly as a car, especially since it is based on the Civic. It offers the cargo versatility of a sport utility, an upright seating position, and all-wheel drive. Besides being less expensive, the CR-V is smaller and more maneuverable than a full-sized 4WD. The styling was revised for 2005. The CR-V comes with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine lifted from the Accord, now with only a five-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning with micron filtration, AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with 6-CD changer, an adjustable steering column, power mirrors, power windows, front and rear power outlets and a removable folding picnic table, along with front airbags, integrated keyless entry and 16-inch steel wheels. Aluminium alloy wheels are available, as is a moonroof, leather and cruise control.

The Suzuki Carry is the Japanese brand's commercial pick-up offering. It is designed in Japan but assembled in Indonesia to keep costs low. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Basic options include power steering, radio with CD player, fabric seats, air-conditioning and steel wheels.

The Chinese Tiggo beautifully illustrates the Koreans' fight for dominance in the small-4WD segment over the Japanese. The Tiggo has a bit of the Kia Sorento front end slapped onto the body of a previous-generation Toyota RAV-4. It kind of reminds us of a fake Rolex watch that has a Swatch lookalike face--a bit of the best and a bit of the average, but still ultimately neither. The five-door five-seater Tiggo does benefit from a versatile interior though, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Powered by a 2.4-litre Mitsubishi-sourced 4-cylinder engine, it comes with either a four-speed auto with two-wheel-drive, or a five-speed manual gearbox with all-wheel-drive. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling. Don't put too much faith in the incredibly low manufacturer-quoted fuel consumption numbers though.

An all-new Hyundai Tucson debuted in 2016. It remained the same for the 2018 model year. Standard features include standard projector headlights, LED tail lamps, shark-fin antenna and wheels upto 19-inch in size. The Tucson is powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, USB port, Bluetooth, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, ABS and more. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre 4WD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, front and rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags and side airbags. Other optional safety features include Smart Parking Assist, Autonomous Emergency Braking, Lane Keeping Assist System, Rear Traffic Cross Alert, Blind Spot Detection, Speed Limit Information Function and Active Bonnet System which will automatically raise the hood to cushion the impact shock in case of a frontal collision.

The Nativa is an off-road capable 4WD that fits in an odd spot between the Pajero and the Outlander. Powered by a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a four-speed automatic, the Nativa is a dated design, but still a decent wagon. Standard features for the low base price include AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, driver's and front passenger's front airbags, part time 4WD with synchronized front free-wheel differential, transfer protector, power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, alloy wheels, keyless entry system and seating for five. Features available on higher models include gauges for a thermometer, compass, oil pressure and voltage meter, faux wood trim, front fog lights, CD player with 6 speakers, leather seats, sunroof, limited slip differential, ABS with EBD, cruise control and more. The Nativa rides on the older L200 pickup platform, and was discontinued in a number of markets since 2004. Shipments have continued from Thailand since 2008, alongside the Pajero Sport. However, few 4WDs are offered at this price that are properly equipped to go off-road. Some dealers only offered one fully-loaded trim in the later years.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ertiga is a seven-seater minivan offering from the Japanese brand. In 2019, an all-new model of the Ertiga came out, weighing 50 kg lighter than its predecessor.The front-wheel drive people carrier features a 1.5-litre engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ertiga include power steering, AM/FM radio, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C with rear vents, halogen headlamps and steel wheels. Higher options get alloy wheels, fog lamps, chrome grille and side body moulding. Depending on trim level, the Ertiga gets dual airbags and ABS.

The Tesla Model S is a fully electric sedan, which combines high performance and zero emission. Dropping rear-wheel-drive models altogther, all versions are now all-wheel-drive with air suspension as standard for 2018 -- 75D, 100D and P100D, with the numbers indicating the size of the battery. Standard features include power steering, power-folding heated side mirrors, LED headlamps, LED fog lamps, automatic keyless entry, 17-inch touch screen, AM/FM radio with Bluetooth, and USB, leather seats, reverse camera, Wifi and internet connectivity, power liftgate and 19-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include, self-driving capability, enhanced autopilot, higher quality leather interior, Alcantara, higher quality exterior paint, better sound system and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include six airbags, collision avoidance, automatic emergency braking, blind spot detection and lane departure warning. Optional safety features feature traffic-aware cruise control, autosteer and autopark.

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. The redesigned 2008 Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track. An optional performance kit was offered in 2009 to boost power by 37 hp.

The American-built Sequoia is Toyota's largest ever passenger vehicle. Its claim to fame is space, with three rows of adult seating and impressive cargo volume. In the GCC, this big SUV will be promoted as a family hauler rather than an offroader, considering the initial availability of a rear-wheel-drive variant. The four-wheel-drive model with low-range gearing came in 2010. The second row can either seat two or three, depending on the setup chosen. It is powered by a 5.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed automatic gearbox. It may be based on the Tundra pickup-truck platform, but it comes standard with four-wheel independent suspension, stability control, CD/MP3 stereo, automatic three-zone a/c, stability control, front airbags, and side-curtain airbags. The three trim levels are named SR5, Limited and Platinum. Depending on trim level, this 'city SUV' comes with options such two rear-seat DVD screens, 20-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera and parking sensors, CD changer, powered tailgate, power-folding third-row seats, power tailgate, cloth or leather upholstery, navigation, rear air suspension and more.

The 407 Coupe has always been a niche product, with styling that still looks good today as it did when the model was launched. For 2009, the 407 Coupe has received a minor facelift comprising on exterior trim add-ons and new tail-lights. The coupe got a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with a 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 407 comes with 16-inch, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, depneding on trim level. All models get eight or more airbags, as well as stability control and ABS.

The Jaguar XF luxury-sports sedan got an all-new model for 2016. Engines include a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 unit with two different tunes. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The Lamborghini HuracÃ¡n, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the HuracÃ¡n LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. The Dzire is the sedan version of the Swift hatchback, boasting a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, it is mated to an automated-manual "AGS" gearbox. Features include a CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, tilt-adjustable steering wheel with audio controls, Bluetooth, 14-inch steel wheels and front/rear fog lamps on the base GL trim. The GLX trim additionally gets 15-inch alloy wheels, driver-seat height adjuster, smart key with starter button, and rear parking sensors. Safety features includes front airbags, ESP, ABS with EBD and tyre-pressure monitor..

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Mildly facelifted for 2009, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. Versions for the latest incarnation include the upgraded 5.5-litre G 500 and the 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Standard specification includes permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The MG GS is the Chinese company's compact SUV offering. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It comes standard in front-wheel-drive format, with optional four-wheel-drive. Standard features on the 2019 MG GS include power steering, power windows, central locking, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, fog lamps, LED daytime running lamps, manual-adjustable seats, manual A/C, stereo with USB/AUX support, 4 speakers and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the 2019 MG GS include automatic headlamps, xenon headlamps, keyless entry, engine start-stop button, 18-inch alloy wheels, leather seats with lumbar support, sunroof, automatic A/C, infotainment system with 6.1-inch touch screen and 6 or 8 speakers, Bluetooth, electric folding side mirrors,  glovebox cooling and rear camera. Safety features on the 2019 MG GS include stability control, ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist, auto hold and front airbags. The higher models get additional airbags, hill descent control and anti-roll program.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2015 model year and will now be available only as a 4-door sedan. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

The ZNA Rich is a midsize pickup available in single and double-cab body styles, with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine. Features include a 5-speed manual, 15-inch steel wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes, power steering, adjustable steering column, central locking, power windows, power mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and SD card, manual antenna, manual a/c and front seat belts.

The Kia Soul is part of the Korean manufacturer's new product offensive. Being touted as a crossover, it is really a tall compact hatchback, designed to be appealing for our misguided urban youth. Featuring tons of cabin space, the front-wheel-drive Kia Soul is powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic and, if you ask the dealer nicely, a 5-speed manual too. Available in two trim levels, the basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, a single driver's airbag, roof rack, fog lamps, CD stereo with iPod input, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seat, black cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets a better CD stereo with a sub-woofer and illuminated speakers, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, underfloor tray and power outlet in the boot, luggage net, some extra trim. dual front airbags and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of black, beige and red two-tone interiors. Optional features are extensive, largely limited to appearance kits, such as funkier alloy wheels, stickers, chrome trim, front and rear skirts, and shiny fuel caps. In addition to front airbags, ABS is available only on the top-spec model, but stability control and side airbags are not available on GCC-spec models.

The Audi A3 Sedan is the German brand's sub-compact sedan offering. A new model of the A3 came out in 2021. It is available with one engine which is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get matrix LED headlamps, leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, Bang & Olufsen audio system with 15-speakers, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The Audi Q5 is the compact class offering in the VW-owned German manufacturer's SUV range. The Q5 is available in the GCC, the engines on offer from 2013 involving an upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder for the 2.0TFSI and a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 for the 3.0T. It remains the same for the 2017 model year, however with some GCC countries not offering the 2.0-litre engine anymore. Both versions come standard with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Also standard is Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive system, and will be available with the Audi 'Drive-Select' system to change its settings. Other changes include retuned suspension and other minor mechanical updates. Features include LED running lights and taillights, alloy wheels of up to 20 inches in size, seating for five with folding rear bench and a foldable front seat, and the usual power accessories. The Q5 will be available in several different trim options, including an 'S-Line' trim option with aggressive body mouldings and mesh foglight grills. Other available features, whether standard or optional, include a roof load sensor to adjust the stability control for the higher centre of gravity, rearview camera, navigation, high-beam assistant that automatically switches between the high and low beams, blind-spot monitor, adaptive cruise control, triple-zone climate control, intelligent keyless entry, electric parking brake, multiple airbags, MMI multimedia with speech control system, Bluetooth telephone, a DVD drive and TV tuner, an iPod interface and MP3 capability.

The Hyundai Genesis sedan got a minor facelift for 2012, the most obvious change being the LED running lights in the headlights. For 2013, the Hyundai Genesis added the direct injection 3.8-litre "GDI" V6 engine in their line-up, adding to the regular 3.8-litre "MPI" V6 option. The engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. A limited-to-1200-worldwide Genesis Prada model was also made available, with a 4.6-litre "MPI" V8 and unique leather upholstery. The interior gets a new 8-inch display with a user-interface, integrated with a joystick-type function. The Genesis sedan offers a host of upscale luxury features including Smart Cruise Control, adaptive HID headlights, air suspension and a Lexicon CD audio system with iPod input and 17 speakers. Further features include a power rear sunshade, automatic electronic parking brake, proximity key and push button starter, leather upholstery, eight parking sensors with optional reverse camera, soft-touch instrument panel with woodgrain accents, Bluetooth hands-free mobile phone interface, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, and a choice of 17-inch and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety aspects include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as active head restraints, stability control and big ABS-assisted disc brakes. The Genesis is a full-size luxury sedan competing in price with small and medium-sized models from established luxury marques, but Hyundai not having its own premium brand may be a downer for upscale buyers.

The Asian-market Ford Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a work truck which provides versatile usage, but are slightly concerned about basic comforts. The Ranger is designed to meet the needs of this customer group while offering exceptional value for money. It is a midsize pickup based on the Asian Mazda-based truck platform and built in Thailand. It can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The extensive engine range includes a 2.2-litre petrol engine, a 2.6-litre petrol engine and a 3.0-litre turbodiesel engine, all with a five-speed manual gearbox. Features include air-conditioning, basic radio cassette player, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, 15-inch or 16-inch wheels, available power locks and windows, and decent off-road capability due to low-range gearing in 4WD models. The Ranger can be had in either two-door single cab or four-door double cab body styles.

The McLaren 650S is based on the 12C but with 25% new parts. The 650S comes with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

The Kia Rio is all-new for the 2012 model year. Attractively designed, it is available in 4-door sedan and 5-door hatchback form. The only engine for the GCC is a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with variable-valve timing, mated to a 4-speed automatic. While mechanically basic, the Rio can be had with a host of features unseen in the sub-compact segment. Standard features include 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, CD/MP3 stereo, adjustable steering wheel, central locking, power windows, electric mirrors and only one airbag. The mid-range model gets 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, centre-console armrest, fog lamps, keyless entry, USB port, Bluetooth, steering-wheel audio controls, sun-visor lights, folding mirrors with indicators and a split-folding rear seat. The top model gets rear parking sensors, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, padded leatherette door trim, LED front running lights and tail lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, more speakers for the stereo, cruise control, cooled glovebox, auto headlights, sunroof, and finally, ABS and a passenger-side airbag in addition to the driver's one. The Rio is offered in Europe and the States with full front-side-curtain airbags and stability control, and has a 5-star crash-test rating in Europe, but that model is not sold in the GCC.

The BMW 3-Series received a minor facelift for the 2016 model year, along with new engines. It is available in three trim variants the Sport Line, Luxury Line and Modern Line.
