Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

With Honda going for premium prices nowadays, the City is about as low as you can go in the Honda range. Introduced for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, it is touted as the perfect `urban` vehicle, with its small exterior and tall interior. There is now a choice of two engines, namely a 1.3-litre four-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a gearless CVT automatic, or a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with a gearless CVT that can imitate a seven-speed gearbox using wheel-mounted buttons. Standard features on the base 1.3-litre model include multi-reflector headlamps, 14-inch steel wheel, air-conditioning with heater, power windows, electric power steering, radio CD player with 2 speakers, cup and card holders, dual airbags and side door beams. Upgrading to the 1.5-litre adds 15-inch alloy wheels, hidden radio antenna, rear 60/40 split seat, rear tip-up seat function, driver seat height adjuster, power locks, electric mirrors, 2 more speakers for the CD stereo, fake wood-finish consoles, keyless entry and ABS brakes.

Mini released all-new Cooper and Cooper S hardtop model as a 2015 model. It is larger than its predecessor and features new engines as well. In 2016, a 5-door version was introduced as well. The new Mini looks quite similar to the old one. It is the same height but it is bigger overall, offering more interior space for its occupants. It is 114 mm longer and 43 mm wider than the previous model. The Mini Cooper will be getting a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They can both be had in either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The Canadian-built MKX is the Lincoln-badged version of the Ford Edge, an all-new soft-roader that debuted for the 2007 model year. The Edge features a car-derived platform, a raked windshield, a fast-sloping back window, a high-mounted rear spoiler, a high beltline and standard 18-inch alloy wheels. The interior features seating for five and cargo space can be maximized when the rear seats are folded. The Edge is powered by a new 3.5-liter V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available with an intelligent all-wheel-drive system in the GCC, the MKX is not equipped with low-range gearing. The interior features a center console that can fit a laptop computer and a number of standard features including leather upholstery, a panoramic Vista Roof, rear DVD screen, an MP3 audio jack and six-way power-adjustable front seats. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, seat-mounted side airbags and Safety Canopy air curtain system with rollover detection and side-curtain airbags.

The Tiguan is VW's new "crossover" 4WD model. Small in size and conservative in design, the Tiguan is being embarrassingly marketed as the "GTI of SUVs" in some places. Three different trim levels include the Trend&Fun, the Sport&Style and the Track&Field, the latter of which is supposedly tuned for offroading, given its underbody plates and higher front bumper, though there is no low-range gearing for the 4Motion all-wheel-drive vehicle. There are two turbocharged engines, both 2.0-litre and in different states of tune. The engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic that can hold gears in offroad conditions, later replaced by a 7-speed DSG automanual in 2011. The Tiguan has seating for five, with a split-folding 60:40 rear bench, and has multiple position settings for the seatback. For additional cargo area, there is also an optional double-floor trunk-floor setup, including a cargo management system. The cabin can be had in cloth or leather, and features include power windows, electric mirrors, multiple airbags, stability control, ABS brakes, cruise control and CD stereo with a dash-mounted touchscreen. An automatic parellel parking system is also available, as are parking sensors and a rear camera.

The French-built Saxo was launched in 1996 to replace the CitroÃ«n AX. The car's platform, engines and major components were a development of the AX and were shared with the Peugeot 106, CitroÃ«n's unofficial sister company. The different trim levels and engine options in the Saxo range changed many times during the model's lifetime. Engines amd trims included a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre VTR and a tuned 1.6-litre VTS. The sporting VTR and VTS came with 14-inch alloy wheels, firmer suspension, sports seats and a body kit. The 2000 model year saw the introduction of this heavily-facelifted version and upgraded engines, even though the basic platform was already dated. The Saxo came as 3-door and 5-door hatchback models, and only the basic 1.4i model had an optional automatic available. Basics included a stereo, cloth cabin, front airbags and not much else.

The Porsche Macan is a second SUV for the German premium brand and hopes to replicate the success of the Cayenne, albeit in the compact crossover segment. Taking the front fascia from its elder brother, the Macan doesn't disappoint in terms of looks. The rear of the vehicle however, is unique and could be termed as a love-or-hate affair. But the wide tyres which range from 18-inch to 21-inches do complement the somewhat muscular stance of the Macan. But it must be noted that it stands shorter and is marginally longer than its Q5 counterpart. As for the variants, Porsche has four. The Macan S is equipped with a 3.0-litre twin-turbo V6 engine. It also features an active all-wheel-drive and a 7-speed double-clutch transmission. Height-adjustable air suspension is optional on the S. As with any Porsche, the interior is carefully setup. It follows the generic Porsche cockpit, but there happens to be a new steering wheel which is a welcome change from the one on the Cayenne. The Macan's interior comes in a variety of colours, but there also happens to be a Piano Black interior package with Alcantara inserts for the seats on the S variant. Available features include a multimedia touchscreen, navigation, rear camera, power seats, panoramic glass roof and much more from a long list of options. Safety features include Porsche Stability Management (PSM), as well as airbags for driver and passenger all around the vehicle.

Volvo continues to move up the premium-luxury ladder with the new-for-2018 Volvo XC60, featuring an updated corporate look and a stunning interior. Engines for the GCC include a 2.0-litre turbo in the T5 and a 2.0-litre twin-charged 4-cylinder in the T6 model. All-wheel-drive and an 8-speed automatic gearbox are standard. Various cabin trim options are available, including burled aluminium and driftwood. The new CleanZone four-zone climate system removes harmful pollutants and particles from outside the cabin to deliver “Scandinavian-fresh” air on the inside. Volvo's driver infotainment touchscreen offers smartphone integration with CarPlay and Android Auto where available. The 5-seater XC60 expectedly offers loads of safety technology. Steer Assist has been added to the ground-breaking City Safety system. A new safety system called Oncoming Lane Mitigation uses steer assist to help mitigate head-on collisions, while Volvo’s Blind Spot Indication System (BLIS) now uses Steer Assist functionality to reduce the risk of lane-changing collisions. Pilot Assist, Volvo’s advanced semi-autonomous driver assistance system, which takes care of steering, acceleration and braking on well-marked roads up to 130 kph, is available as an option.

The Lexus ES is pretty much the luxury carmaker's bread-and-butter sedan, with its comfort-biased approach and focus on convenience features. The new ES has a longer wheelbase than before, and features corporate styling similar to the pricier GS. It also comes in two trim levels now, the ES 250 with the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, and the ES 350 with the 3.5-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The ES 250 comes in one "Premier" trim and features HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, front-rear parking sensors, 17-inch alloys, moonroof, headlamp cleaner, leather interior, powered front seats, 8-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, power-adjustable steering, and dual-zone auto a/c. The ES 350 "Prestige" adds the V6 engine, nicer leather, navigation, power rear sunshade and a blind-spot monitor. The "Platinum" adds a front DVD player, rear camera and a remote-touch computer. The "Titanium" further adds adaptive headlights, different wheels, panoramic glass roof, even semi-aniline leather, front ventilated seats, 3-zone a/c, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist and a pre-crash safety system. All models come with front, knee, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

The Maserati Coupe, sometimes known as the 4200 GT, is a high-performance two-door four-seater that relaunched Ferrari-owned Maserati as a contender in the sport-luxury class. It complements the two-seater Spyder, which is a shorter-wheelbase convertible version of the Coupe. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations were the GranSport Coupe and the GranSport Spyder, which feature sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport versions, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars got a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The redesigned Jaguar XK was the long-awaited successor to Jaguar's sports car franchise back in 2007. For 2010, the Jaguar XK Coupe is powered by a new 5.0-litre V8 direct-injection engine, while a new supercharged version of the same V8 powers the high-performance XKR. Both engines are mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox with paddle shifters. Other changes include a new front bumper, new side mirrors with integrated LED side repeater, rear bumper spoiler, rear LED lights and colour-coded side vents. Its rigid chassis and the latest CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a CD stereo system. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

The Ford F-150 is new from the ground up for 2015. Starting from its redesigned steel ladder-frame chassis, every aspect of the truck is new, including a shift to aluminium body construction and a general push towards "EcoBoost" turbocharged engines. In 2018, it got a facelift, engine upgrades and new transmission. Available in single cab, "SuperCab" quad-cab and "SuperCrew" double-cab body styles, engines on offer in the 2020 Ford F-150 include a 3.5-litre turbo V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, both with 10-speed automatics and power upgrades. Further configurations include a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive with low-range, while an "FX4" package can add offroad suspension, rear locking diff and skidplates to any model except the base one. Aside from the usual basic features such as power windows, keyless entry and electric mirrors, other features, depending on trim level, include remote tailgate locking and release, unique "BoxLink" tailgate attachment points that accept standard attachments used in moving trucks and trailers, stowable loading ramps that attach to the BoxLink points, optional LED headlights, optional all-around LED lighting including side-mirror "flashlights" and in-bed lighting, 170-degree opening half-doors on SuperCab models, flat rear load floor in SuperCab and SuperCrew cabins, 360-degree camera view, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot warning and even a panoramic sunroof. And it still has that built-in step in its tailgate to climb onto the bed, aside from new pop-out steps on the sides of the bed. Standard safety features in the 2020 Ford F-150 include ABS, ESP, front and side-airbags, and optional rear inflatable belts.

An all-new Audi A4 came out in 2016. It is a more spacious car, while at the same time is lighter than its predecessor. Under the hood, there are 2 available engines. There is the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and is available only as front-wheel-drive. Then there is the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and comes with all-wheel drive. Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A4 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

This 4th generation of the long-running 3-Series remained BMW's best-selling car, and with good reason. Ignoring the 3-Series Compact that was based on an older platform, this iteration of the 3-Series came in sedan, coupe and convertible forms, as well as in wagon trim that never came to the GCC. These variations were enough to solidify this model as the arguably the top-selling entry-luxury car in the market. While lower models managed with cloth upholstery, steel wheels and basic power accessories, the higher trim levels enjoyed leather, premium CD stereo, navigation, alloy wheels, sunroof and other amenities. While all models were rear-wheel-drive, some markets may have gotten a few all-wheel-drive versions of the various models. Manual and automatic transmissions were standard, but some markets may also have automanual gearboxes on some higher models. The sedan debuted in 1999, followed by the coupe in 2000, with 2.0-litre, 2.2-litre, 2.5-litre and 2.8-litre engines, along with 318i, 320i, 323i and 328i designations respectively, and 2-door models getting "Ci" badging instead of "i" at the end. The year 2001 brought about the hot 3.2-litre M3 version, available in 2-door form only, while all other models got new engines and names, such as upgraded 2.5-litre 325i and new 3.0-litre 330i alongside the existing 318i and 320i. A minor front-end facelift came in 2002 for all models except the M3. A lightweight M3 CSL with an upgraded engine was briefly available unofficially. While the sedan was replaced by an all-new model by 2006, the coupe and convertible continued well into 2006 before their new versions came out.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's midsize sedan offering. It got minor exterior and interior changes for the 2015 model year. Only sold in some GCC countries, the Insignia gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with front-wheel-drive. Some features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, heated leather seats with memory, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, daytime running lights, fog lamps and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, lane-departure warning, ESP and ABS.

The M6 Cabriolet uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Fuel economy is apparently better by 30% compared to the old V10-powered model. Other mechanical features include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option. The M6 features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

The GAC GS5 is the Chinese brand's compact crossover SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engine choices, which is the naturally aspirated 2.0-litre motor and the turbocharged 1.8-litre unit. They both can be had in either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 5-speed automatic transmission. While the 2.0-litre version is front-wheel drive, the 1.8-litre turbocharged version can be had in four-wheel-drive as well. Standard feature for the GS5 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fog lamps, parking sensors, AM/FM radio with CD/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, fabric seats, automatic A/C with dual-zone, rear A/C vents and manual seats. The higher models get leather seats, power seats, sunroof and audio controls on steering wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and EBD.

The Volkswagen Amarok is a mid-size pickup for the commercial sector. In 2017, it got a slight facelift. In the GCC, only the rear-wheel drive model will be sold, which comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, mated to a six-speed manual transmission. The double-cab model is only available in this region. Standard and optional equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3 player with 4-speakers, manual A/C, fog lamps, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels and  cruise control. Safety features include two airbags, ABS and traction control.

The Hyundai Azera fills the gap between the mid-size Sonata and the luxury Genesis sedan. It has been completely overhauled for the 2018 model year. The new Azera, known as Grandeur in Korea, comes with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Features in the 2020 Hyundai Azera include smart keyless entry with starter button, mood lighting, available panoramic sunroof, fake wood trim, rear sunshade, Apple Carplay system with Smartphone mirroring, premium analogue clock, auto-dimming mirror, electric parking brake with auto hold, leather powered seats, fog lamps, and parking sensors. Optional features in higher trims include xenon lights, memory and seat massage for driver, heating & cooling for front seats, electric tilt & telescopic steering wheel, Bluetooth, tyre pressure monitoring system, electric folding mirrors, adaptive cruise control, rain sensor, dual-zone a/c, and a DVD Navigation system with rear camera. Safety features include up to 8 airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control.

An all-new model of the BMW Z4 came out in 2019. The platform and drivetrain are shared with the revived Toyota Supra. It is available with two different engines. There is a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine available in two different tunes, and there is the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder motor. All engines get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Like the older models, the Z4 will get separate convertible and coupe models. Standard features in the Z4 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, engine push start button, iDrive, cruise control, automatic A/C, leather seats and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control and tyre pressure monitor. Optional safety features include Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go function, traffic sign recognition, distance information, Lane Change Warning system, Rear Collision Prevention and Cross-Traffic Alert, Active Park Distance Control and a rear-view camera.

An all-new Ford Escape made its debut in 2017 in the GCC. This generation Escape is the first Ford vehicle in the world with available SYNC Connect, allowing users to unlock doors, check fuel level and even locate where a vehicle is parked. For the 2019 Ford Escape, two engines are available. The first is carried over from the previous generation, a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, while the other is a new 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base 2019 Ford Escape model is two-wheel drive, which optional 4-wheel drive is available. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering. The Sync 3 infotainment system gets Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as well. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. The 2019 Ford Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes, AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control, blind spot monitor,  and adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support. Active Park Assist is also available to park the car itself, whether parallel or perpendicular. Higher models gets adaptive front lighting system which automatically adjust the bi-xenon headlamps according to the environment.

The Mazda 6, or Mazda6 as the marketeers call it, has been completely redesigned for 2013. It got a minor facelift in 2016, and then another minor facelift in 2019. It is available with "SkyActiv" engines, a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder,direct-injection with high compression ratios. In 2020, a 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine joined the lineup. Both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The lower models include features such as 17-inch or 18-inch wheels, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, manual a/c, halogen headlights, cloth upholstery and a CD/MP3 stereo. The top model includes 19-inch alloy wheels, reverse camera, bi-xenon headlights, daytime running lights, 11-speaker Bose sound system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents and a sunroof. Navigation and adaptive cruise control can be further added to the top-spec version, but they're not offered in all GCC markets. Standard safety features include dual front airbags with optional side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with EBD.

An all-new Jeep Wrangler Unlimited came out in 2018. It is slightly bigger, faster and lighter than the previous generation. The engine has been carried over from the older model, the 3.6-litre V6 “Pentastar” motor. Acceleration and fuel economy numbers have been improved, thanks to the new 8-speed automatic transmission replacing the ancient 5-speed. Manual gear lovers will be left disappointed though, as it is not offered anymore in this region. The electronically assisted steering has replaced the hydraulic steering. The interior has more quality materials than the older model, with the Sahara and Rubicon models getting more of the leather treatment. Even the standard equipment has improved, with the Wrangler Unlimited Sport getting a touchscreen for the infotainment system. Safety features include four airbags, ABS, stability control, and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monitor, and rear cross path detection.

The 2014 Hyundai Tucson has received an unnoticeably-minor facelift, with real external changes limited to standard projector headlights, LED tail lamps, shark-fin antenna, and new 17-inch or 18-inch wheel designs. Inside, available new features include a 4.2-inch display within the gauge cluster, a new multimedia/navigation system, optional brown leather and standard Bluetooth. The Tucson is powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre 4WD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. For 2015, side-curtain airbags were introduced in top trims.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

This is the second generation of Toyota RAV-4. Often credited with creating the soft-roader genre, th e RAV-4 is one of the most fuel-efficient crossover SUVs on the market. It has to be, given that it is powered by a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, it comes standard with all-wheel drive for the GCC. The RAV-4 has a unibody construction with all-wheel independent suspension, making it more of a car than any sort of offroader. It seats five, and is available with power windows, dual front airbags, cassette or CD player, keyless entry, 16-inch wheels, rear spoiler, optional ABS and sunroof, depending on model. The rear cargo door opens sideways, and has a spare tyre mounted on it, so the rear window does not open. Higher-trim models had body-coloured plastic body trim, which come in standard black on base models. In 2005, it became available with a cheesy locally-installed body kit that gave it a sporty low-rider look, although there were no mechanical changes.

Spyker is largely an unknown name to the general public, but this Dutch name was apparently around as far back as 1898. The company was resurrected in 2000 with the C8 Spyder, a unique and expensive hand-built supercar with an open-top roof. The Spyker C8 Laviolette coupe soon joined the Spyder. In 2002, the street version of their LeMans racer was unveiled as the C8 Double12 S coupe, with an extended rear end. The C8 was finally launched in this region in 2007. The Spyker C8 range has a 4.2-litre Audi V8, manual or automatic six-speed gearbox, limited slip differential and ABS brakes. Optional features for all cars include a turned-aluminium dashboard fascia, 19-inch Aeroblade magnesium wheels, several leather options, Chronoswiss dashboard instruments, supercharger or even a custom-fitted Louis Vuitton luggage set. The body is built in Germany and the car is assembled in Holland.

The unique Infiniti FX "crossover" 4WD was given a complete makeover in 2009, with an unnoticeable facelift coming in 2012. The most prominent change for 2013 came in the form of a larger 3.7-litre V6 in a new FX37 model alongside the carryover 5.0-litre V8 in the FX50, both with 7-speed automatics with paddle shifters. Built on the all-wheel-drive front-midship platform, the new FX features an extensive list of available equipment. Available features include Continuous Damping Control, Rear Active Steer, and 21-inch lightweight aluminium-alloy wheels designed by Enkei. Inside, the new FX interior  has available "sport" seating and advanced audio, optional navigation and technology ranging from an 11-speaker Bose-developed audio system to the intelligent key, available active cruise control and available around-view monitor system. The new FX offers numerous safety and convenience technologies such as intelligent brake assist, distance control assist, adaptive front lighting system, standard HID headlights, integrated fog lights, rear LED taillights, functional side air vents, aluminium roof rails, leather and wood trim, sunroof, "self-healing" clearcoat paint finish, stability control, and the usual power accessories and multiple airbags. Available new safety features for 2013 include object-detection for the around-view parking camera system as well as voice instructions on how to parallel-park into a specific space.

The new-for-2008 LX 570 now offers total comfort and luxury, while still offering outstanding off-road capability. Heavily based on the Toyota Land Cruiser, this new one at least gets a unique front end and a different interior. The Lexus version is powered by a new 5.7-litre V8 mated with a new 6-speed automatic transmission. The full-time all-wheel drive features a new 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a new crawl-control feature when in low range. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes and traction control, as well as multiple airbags. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. A minor facelift in 2010 offered up a new front bumper, an upgrade from 18-inch to 20-inch wheels, and an optional new body kit. For 2011, a new tan leather interior was optionally offered, besides the usual beige and black.

The Porsche 911 Cabriolet is all-new after spending more than a decade in its current form, with continuous updates of course. For 2012, the design incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than before. It is still a 2+2 seater convertible. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.4-litre direct-injection flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The 911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet, which was introduced in 2013, adds all-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S Cabriolet upgrades the motor to a 3.8-litre, while the, new for 2013, 911 Carrera 4S Cabriolet adds all-wheel-drive. The 911 Turbo Cabriolet and Turbo S Cabriolet was released in 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre turbocharged engine, and comes only with the PDK transmission. The 911 GTS was revealed in the GCC in late 2014 and is available as rear-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. It is powered by a 3.8-litre motor, coupled with either a 7-speed manual or PDK transmission. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

The Audi Q7 is based on the same platform as the Volkswagen Touareg and Porsche Cayenne, though it shares mostly drivetrain components. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 has two 3.0-litre supercharged V6 "TFSI" engines at different states of tune, although the marketeers like to give only the more powerful one the "supercharged" label. There is a 4.2-litre turbodiesel V8 and a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V12 "TDI" engine available for order as well, for whatever reason. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. The new engines came in 2011, but visual changes to the Audi Q7 came in 2010, including new LED headlights and indicators, LED taillights, a chromed front grille, new bumpers, new instrument cluster, ambient lighting and new cabin trim choices, along with new paint colours. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. Available items include 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels, three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. The Q7 is a proper luxurious 4WD  that can also go off-road, in the vein of the Range Rover models, though it looks a lot like a minivan.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

After years of selling an outdated decade-old version of the car in the UAE, the all-new 2010 Nissan Maxima has finally gone on sale in the GCC. The America-built front-wheel-drive midsizer has moved upscale and aims to be a budget 'sports' sedan, although betrayed by its drivetrain layout. It is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. The entry-level Maxima S model comes with an auto-dimming mirror, cloth upholstery, cruise control, CD stereo, Bluetooth, power windows, intelligent key with starter button, power front seats, fake wood trim, sunroof, 19-inch rims, and dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents. The Maxima SV adds power outside mirrors with LED turn signals, digital compass, HID headlights, fog lights, power-adjustable steering column with memory, power-adjustable pedals, front and rear parking sensors. The top Maxima SR gets additional features such as auto-dimming driver-side mirror, leather seats, driver's seat thigh support extension and ventilation fans, rear bucket seats, rear-window power sunshade, navigation system touchscreen with rearview camera, and a rear spoiler. All come standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control. Equipment packages between trim levels changed slightly later during 2010. In 2011, the top model got chrome exhaust tips, a unique sport grille, smoked headlights, a new navigation-multimedia system and a price increase.

The all-new 6-Series was introduced in 2003, filling the hole in the line-up left since the end of the 8-Series. The last actual 6-Series was around back in the 1980s. Based on the underpinnings of the 5-Series, the new 6-Series was introduced with a 4.4 L V8 engine for the 645Ci, but this has since been replaced by the 650Ci with a 4.8-litre V8 in 2006. In 2004, a more affordable inline 6-cylinder engine was introduced in the 630i, upgraded in power for 2006. This was soon followed by a convertible model. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a six-speed manual or a six-speed automatic, with an available six-speed SMG automanual in the V8. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. The Dzire is the sedan version of the Swift hatchback, boasting a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, it is mated to an automated-manual "AGS" gearbox. Features include a CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, tilt-adjustable steering wheel with audio controls, Bluetooth, 14-inch steel wheels and front/rear fog lamps on the base GL trim. The GLX trim additionally gets 15-inch alloy wheels, driver-seat height adjuster, smart key with starter button, and rear parking sensors. Safety features includes front airbags, ESP, ABS with EBD and tyre-pressure monitor..

VW-owned Czech carmaker Skoda diverged from simply building rebadged versions of dull VW products, and created something totally original. Dubbed the Roomster, it is billed as a "leisure activity vehicle" that pushes the boundaries of the non-SUV crossover genre. Sharing components with the last-generation Octavia and the current Fabia, the Roomster is supposed to be a combination of "room" and "roadster," although we are pretty sure it is more of a hostel bed-space than a sports car. Å koda conceived the Roomster's cabin to have different configurations. The rear seats, which are taller than the front seats, can be folded in a 40-20-40 split configuration, instead of the more usual 40-60, and can also be moved longitudinally and transversally by removing the middle seat. The rear seats also have variable inclination up to 7Â° to the back, or completely to the front. The luggage compartment can have a completely flat surface with the rear seats completely removed, and the surface's height can also be modified. The only available engine is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, shared with the Fabia. The main transmission choice is a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability, although a manual might be available on request. Available safety features include as many airbags as you'd like, as well as ABS brakes and optional stability control.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received 2 major makeovers for 2008 and 2019, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

An all-new Ford F-150 was made available in the GCC in 2021. It comes with a 5.0-litre V8, a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine and 3.5 turbo hybrid, all mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 2022 Ford F-150 Raptor include power steering, power windows, cruise control, keyless entry, manual single-zone A/C, bucket seats with manual lumbar support, fabric upholstery, SYNC voice recognition communications and entertainment system, AM/FM stereo with 7 speakers, leather wrapped steering-wheel with mounted audio controls, reverse parking sensors with camera, and 17-inch alloy wheels with all-terrain tyres. Optional features on the 2022 Ford F-150 include the SYNC 3 system with an 12-inch touch screen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, B & O audio system and sub-woofer, power seats, navigation, moonroof, dual-zone automatic A/C, leather seats, ventilated seats, active park assist, adaptive cruise control and blind spot monitor. All models of the 2021 Ford F-150 get front driver and passenger airbags, side curtain airbags, rollover sensor and stability control.

The MG 6 comes in two body shapes, either as a sedan or as a liftback version. There are two 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engines to choose from, one being naturally aspirated and the other a turbocharged unit. They can be had in either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission with optional paddle shifters. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with CD/MP3 support and 8 speakers, trip computer and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, power mirrors, cruise control, parking rear camera, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C, radio with DVD/MP3 support and 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The SX4 is an all-new compact car from Suzuki. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model that is not actually offered in most GCC markets. The crossover-style hatchback came first, then a tall sedan came in mid-2008. Originally fitted with a standard 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the SX4 can be equipped with a five-speed manual transmission, while also coming with an optional four-speed automatic. A 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine debuted with the sedan. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

The Santa Fe is Hyundai's best 4WD to date, and is destined to become the brand's bread and butter model. Hyundai went all out on the redesign of this compact 4WD that borders on becoming a midsize. Standard features include a 2.7-litre V6 with automatic, dual mufflers, underbody skid plate, single airbag, power steering, two-tone exterior paint job, roof rack with crossbar, fake wood trim, power windows, central door locking, keyless entry with burglar alarm, electric outside mirrors, front fog lamps, radio cassette player with CD and MP3 capability and 4 speakers, ABS with EBD, 18-inch wheels and finally, front and rear manual a/c with vents in all seating rows. The top model gets Electronic Stability Program, dual airbags, leather steering wheel, leather seats, cruise control, power front seats, rear spoiler  with brake light, power sunroof, trip computer, centre console with cool box, auto-dimming centre rearview mirror with compass, in-dash 6-CD changer with amplifier and subwoofer, and steering wheel controls for the stereo.

The new-for-2011 Mazda 2 is a facelifted version of the Mazda2 that has been on sale in Europe since 2008. Offered for the first time in the GCC, it comes in sedan and hatchback versions, and competitively priced when compared to its platform-mate, the Ford Fiesta. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloys are optional. The interior can be had in either black or two-tone, with ten exterior colours available. The glove-box lid is a unique two-compartment design, with one compartment exposed on top to keep files and papers in. The seats are cloth-upholstered, and every other piece of cabin trim is hard plastic, with no padded armrests. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The Mazda2 is highly rated in European crash tests, but those safety ratings are based on Euro-spec models with side airbags, not available here.

The Escalade is all-new for 2007, but still based on the latest version of the Chevrolet Tahoe. The King of Bling is back, bigger, gaudier, more powerful and more fuel efficient than before. Available in either standard five-door 4WD body, ESV long-wheelbase 4WD body or a retarded EXT long-wheelbase 4WD pick-up body, the Escalade ups the ante when it comes to showing off on the streets. The Escalade boasts a massive grille, tighter panel gaps, and a more streamlined exterior, which enables it to get better fuel mileage despite having a more powerful, 6.2-litre V8 engine that makes 403 hp and a whopping 565 Nm of torque. The Escalade models come with standard 18-inch wheels and tyres, but buyers can opt for 22-inchers. Stability control is standard and now incorporates a program to help avoid rollovers, while front side air bags are standard and a full-length head curtain system is available. Other features include automatic dual-zone climate control, tyre pressure monitoring system, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power-adjustable pedals, leather and wood steering wheel with audio controls, leather interior, 14-way power seats, six-CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers and rear-seat audio controls, four ventilated brake discs, speed-sensitive steering, automatic rear level control system, and rear parking assist. All off-roading equipment from the Chevy version has been stripped out in this one.

The fresh Mazda CX-7 five-seater crossover comes in two trim levels for the GCC market, namely a base model with front-wheel-drive and the top version with all-wheel-drive, both mated to a standard 2.3-litre turbocharged "DISI" 4-cylinder engine. The base 2WD GT model gets black fabric upholstery, CD player, manual a/c, cruise control, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, basic trip computer, dual exhaust tips, rear spoiler, folding 60/40 split rear seats, power windows, electric mirrors and four-wheel independent suspension with disc brakes on all corners. The fully-optioned AWD GTX model additionally gets beige leather upholstery, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, Bose 9-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with changer, colour-screen trip computer, powered driver's seat, automatic a/c, xenon headlights, fog lamps, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof and rear-view camera. All models thankfully get ABS, stability control, front and side-curtain airbags and alarm, Mazda choosing not to skimp on safety features.

The Lexus RX got a minor facelift for 2013, the main change being the new spindle grill being adopted by all the models. Also joining the RX 350, will be a hybrid model called the RX 450h. The RX 350 gets the 3.5-litre V6 with VVT-i variable valve timing, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive platform. However there is also an F Sport model which gets a bodykit as well as an 8-speed transmission which does not improve performance figures at all. The RX 450h gets a similar 3.5-litre V6 engine combined to three electric motors. The basic model includes front-side airbags, curtain and knee airbags, rear-side airbags, cruise control, CD changer with 9 speakers, powered front seats, wood trim, fabric seats, smart entry and start system, ABS, stability control, 18-inch alloy wheels, front and rear parking sensors, and HID headlights. The mid-range model adds Mark Levinson audio with 15 speakers, DVD changer, Bluetooth, heads-up display, rear entertainment system, navigation system, rear camera, leather seats, Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management, 19-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, adaptive headlights and hill-start assist. The top model adds better leather, panoramic sunroof and a pre-crash safety system. The optional Vehicle Dynamics Integrated Management is a system that coordinates the stability control system with Active Torque Control to offer better handling in emergency situations.

An all-new Subaru Forester came out in 2015. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

The C3 is a curvaceous hatchback that competes in the hot compact segment dominated by Toyota. The standard C3 is available in five-door form only, while the funky C3 Pluriel is only available as a two-door. Designed to be roomy and versatile, it is utterly more futuristic than the usual offerings in this segment, and fairly well-equipped. The C3 cabin has plenty of cubbyholes and storage spaces, a big windshield and the 'Moduboard' foldable false floor for the luggage trunk. There are more unexpected features such as speed-sensitive windshield wipers, follow-me-home headlights and one-touch electric windows. Current engine choices are the 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre four-cylinder motors. An upgraded 1.4-litre option came later. A manual is standard, with an optional auto on the 1.4-litre. The SensoDrive auto gearbox is offered on the upgraded 1.4-litre and the 1.6-litre with a fuel-saving feature called the Stop-Start system, which automatically turns the engine off when idling in traffic and turns it on again when you lift off the brake. The Pluriel comes with a different front end and a 1.6-litre auto only, and this unique car can be converted into a hatchback, a pick-up and a convertible by playing with roof configurations. The Pluriel was discontinued here by 2007. Standard front and side airbags, as are ABS brakes.

The Cadillac ATS-V is the American luxury brand's compact sports sedan offering. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS-V gets a twin-turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. A 6-speed manual is available but will most likely not be offered in the GCC. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps, automatic headlamps, automatic dual-zone A/C, Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Asian-market Ford Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a work truck which provides versatile usage, but are slightly concerned about basic comforts. The Ranger is designed to meet the needs of this customer group while offering exceptional value for money. It is a midsize pickup based on the Asian Mazda-based truck platform and built in Thailand. It can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. The extensive engine range includes a 2.2-litre petrol engine, a 2.6-litre petrol engine and a 3.0-litre turbodiesel engine, all with a five-speed manual gearbox. Features include air-conditioning, basic radio cassette player, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, 15-inch or 16-inch wheels, available power locks and windows, and decent off-road capability due to low-range gearing in 4WD models. The Ranger can be had in either two-door single cab or four-door double cab body styles.

The 3-Series is the king of compact entry-level luxury sedans, while also available in coupe and convertible body styles. Also available is the Touring wagon model, but it is not exactly made available here since no one wants one. Now in its fifth generation, models currently available in the Middle East include the 320i with 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, and the amazing 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder as well as the all-wheel-drive versions of some the models, namely the 325xi, the 330xi and the 330xd. A new engine was introduced into the series with the new coupe and later the sedan, dubbed the 335i with a 3.0-litre twin turbo 6-cylinder motor. The new V8-powered M3 debuted for 2008, also in coupe, sedan and convertible styles, with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer option is available, and it is a pain to use, since BMW chooses to use a little joystick in the centre console instead of a simple touch screen. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, alloy wheels, ABS brakes and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The BMW X6 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X6 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Chevrolet Impala is a large sedan designed to slot in just above the Malibu. The front-wheel drive Impala comes to the GCC with a 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. Along with the usual power steering, power windows and power mirrors, other features include 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, LED daytime running lights, optional multimedia-navigation system with pop-up screen, Bluetooth and a six-speaker audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/AUX support. Safety features include 10 standard airbags, and options include adaptive cruise control, collision mitigation braking, forward collision alert, lane departure warning, side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, rear camera and rear-park assist.

A new generation Nissan X-Trail debuted in the GCC in 2015. It got a facelfit for the 2018 model year. Featuring a completely revised exterior and interior, it gets a 2.5-litre 4 cylinder engine, mated to a CVT gearbox. The base model is front-wheel-drive, but all other trim levels are all-wheel-drive with an electronic 4x4 lock feature. There's also a choice of 5-seater and 7-seater layouts. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, keyless entry with central locking, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX, cruise control, smart keyless entry with starter button, and steel or 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include better entertainment system with screen and more speakers, bigger alloy wheels, parking sensors, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power front seats, navigation, 18-inch alloys and automatic a/c, among other things. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags with optional side airbags, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist (BA).

The Spanish-built Seat Ibiza is based on the VW Polo and even shares engines and gearboxes, but with a completely unique exterior and interior. In the Middle East, this front-wheel-drive is offered in 3-door or five-door hatchback as well as "Ibiza ST" station-wagon body styles. As the VW-owned company is nearly inactive in promoting the brand in the GCC, drivetrain availability is vague, although numerous VW-derived powerplants can be optioned up, including a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, all 4-cylinder engines, the former with a 5-speed manual and the latter with either a 5-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch DSG automanual. The sporty FR and Cupra models both get 1.4-litre "twin" supercharged-turbocharged 4-cylinder engines with 7-speed DSG automanual gearboxes. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, driver and passenger airbag, power steering, power front windows, electric mirrors, remote central locking, 15-inch to 17-inch wheels, CD stereo, height adjustable front seats, split rear seat, cloth upholstery, traction control and even an optional stability control system. These cars are quite well-packed with features for their size. Sport and FR models get larger alloy wheels, stiffer suspension, body-colour rear spoiler, sports seats and unique exhausts as standard. The limited-availability 3-door Cupra gets the top turbo engine and further sports tuning.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets a major interior and exterior facelift for 2008. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models an upgraded 3.6-litre V6 engine. Engine choices also include the carryover 4.6-litre Northstar V8 and the 4.4-litre supercharged V8, the latter of which is reserved for the sporting STS-V. All engines hook up to a new six-speed automatic transmission, and all-wheel-drive is optional in the non-V models. The V8 models were cancelled after 2010. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, 17-inch or 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, automatic climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, rear parking assist, and a starter button. New technological features in the 2008 STS, available in some markets, include active steering technology in the StabiliTrak electronic stability control system, a Lane Department Warning System and Size Blind Zone Alert System. A Chinese-built long-wheelbase version of the rear-wheel-drive car, dubbed the SLS, is also available in Middle East markets.

Spyker is largely an unknown name to the general public, but this Dutch name was apparently around as far back as 1898. The company was resurrected in 2000 with the C8 Spyder, a unique and expensive hand-built supercar with an open-top roof. The Spyker C8 Laviolette coupe soon joined the Spyder. In 2002, the street version of their LeMans racer was unveiled as the C8 Double12 S coupe, with an extended rear end. The C8 was finally launched in this region in 2007. The Spyker C8 range has a 4.2-litre Audi V8, manual or automatic six-speed gearbox, limited slip differential and ABS brakes. Optional features for all cars include a turned-aluminium dashboard fascia, 19-inch Aeroblade magnesium wheels, several leather options, Chronoswiss dashboard instruments, supercharger or even a custom-fitted Louis Vuitton luggage set. The body is built in Germany and the car is assembled in Holland.

An all-new Ford Taurus came out in 2020. Sold only in a few countries in the GCC as crossovers take over the market, the Taurus features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder "Ecoboost" engine. The engine is mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the standard Taurus Ambiente include power steering, power windows, LED auto headlamps, auto start stop, cruise control, sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system, Bluetooth, dual-zone automatic AC, parking sensors and 18-inch alloy wheels. The Taurus Trend gets additional rearview camera and dual panel sunroof. The Taurus Titanium gets additional leather seats, 19-inch alloy wheels, front LED fog lamps, ambient lighting, wireless charging and adaptive cruise control. The Taurus Titanium Plus gets additional power rear seat recliner, rear seat climate control and automated parking system. Standard safety features on the Ambiente include front and side aribags, knee airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS, and traction control. The higher Titanium models get lane departure warning, lane discipline aid, blind sport monitor and collision mitigation.

The Toledo used to be a handsome compact sedan in a previous life. Now it is one of those weird cars which cannot be categorised with any certainty. We saw one in person and believe it could be competition for compact sedans, but with an upward-opening tailgate instead. In reality, it is an extended version of the Altea, but aiming for a more conservative crowd, but unfortunately with an unconservative design. Sold here with a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with manual or automatic, it does pack a lot of features. Equipment includes power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, standard six airbags, split-folding rear seat, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers, folding electric mirrors, front fog lamps and ESP stability control with EBA brake assist and DSR traction control. Options include turning front lighting system  with bi-xenon headlights, special upholsteries, stereo controls on the steering wheel,  better speakers, rain-sensing wipers, anti-dazzle rear-view mirror, rear parking sensor, cruise control, 17-inch alloy wheels, lowered suspension and sports seats.

The Nissan X-Terra nameplate made a comeback to the region, with an all-new model coming out in 2021. Under the hood, it now gets 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The base SE is a two-wheel drive model with hydraulic power steering, power mirrors, power windows, push start engine, fabric seats, auto headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, roof rails, manual A/C, rear A/C, offroad monitor and 17-inch alloy wheels. The Titanium model can be had in two-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive. Additional features include LED fog lamps, headlamps leveler, automatic dual-zone A/C, wireless charging and rear USB ports. The top Platinum model gets leather seats, infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Navigation, power adjusted leather seats and 18-inch machine cut alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, hill assist, stability and traction control and brake assist. The top Xterra Platinum model gets added safety features such forward collision alert, auto emergency braking, lane departure warning, blind spot monitor and rear cross traffic alert.

A new generation of the Mazda 3 came out in 2020. Mechanically, the engines have carried over from the previous model. One engine is offered in the GCC, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The Volvo S60 got a facelift for the 2014 model year and minor updates in 2017. The S60 straddles the line between compact and midsize. Originally available in the GCC with three engine choices, the S60 range has been whittled down to a single T5 2.0T model which gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, also in front-wheel drive. It gets an 8-speed automatic transmission. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The 'Prestige' model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. A simple silver body kit is optional. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. A software-based Polestar power upgrade is also offered, adding 20-30 hp, depending on the model.

The Peugeot 308 received a facelift in 2012. The same 1.6-litre 4-cylinder and turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape. However, the turbocharged version gets a power boost. From 2012, they get a new 6-speed automatic transmission. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

The X-Trail is Nissan's entry for the small road-going 4WD market, though for a long time we thought it was really a midsize comparable to the old Pathfinder in size. Developed to attract young adventurous buyers, we find the X-Trail particularly unattractive, but it has proved to be a runaway success with older people just looking for a conservative vehicle that looks like a 4WD. The X-Trail has undergone only slight exterior redesigns and interior upgrades ever since it was launched years ago and is beginning to look dated. Powered by a 2.5-litre four-cylinder engine coupled with a 4-speed automatic or a 5-speed manual transmission, it isn't particularly fast, but a reasonable long-distance cruiser. Full-time four-wheel drive is available when the computer system senses the need for all wheels to be driven to suit demand, but it will get stuck if you take it beyond the beach. The interior is full of storage spaces, including cup-holders, centre console box and other nooks and crannies. ABS brakes and 2 airbags are standard.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. An all-new model came out in 2016. It remains the same for the 2018 model. Under the hood, it gets a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Few GCC countries offer the manual transmission. Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, push start button, chrome grille, parking sensors, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port. Safety features include front airbags for both driver and passenger, and stability control.

The radical C4 offers a hip and modern hatchback with out-of-this-world styling and innovative new ideas, with items such as a multi-functional fixed-centred steering wheel and an built-in air freshener. Available as either a three-door or a five-door, it is already popular on the Internet for its dancing-robot TV ads. Besides eye-catching styling, it comes with a long list of standard equipment. Firstly, the base engine is a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with either a manual or an automatic. The top model is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic. The C4 comes standard with alloy wheels, cruise control and the power features features. Options include a panoramic sunroof and xenon dual-function directional headlamps. On the inside, where the C4 pays attention to detail with touches like the damped push-open drawers on the dashboard and an abundance of soft-touch trim. There are six airbags as standard, as well as ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Emergency Braking Assistance. Electronic Stability Programme with Traction Control is optional.

BMW's American-built 4WD comes in three models in this region, namely the 3.0i with a 6-cylinder engine, the 4.4i with a V8, and the 4.8is with a bigger V8. Debuting in 2000 and receiving a facelift in 2004, the X5 has all-wheel drive without low-range gearing, but does come with ABS and traction control. The 3.0i offers manual and automatic transmissions, but the V8 models only come with an automatic. The automatics do have a manual shift gate, but they are still essentially automatics. Standard on V8s and optional on the 3.0i are load-leveling suspension, leather upholstery, front and rear obstacle detection, and steering-linked xenon headlights. Other available features include adjustable ride-height suspension, heated rear seats, navigation system and sunroof. The X5 is far from an off-roader, but it has built up a reputation for excellent on-road driving dynamics for a 4WD, and has become popular with rich people who like to terrorise other road users with some deft moves. The V8 models drive more like sport wagons rather than any 4WD, though it seems a little pointless when BMW itself has much more capable V8-powered 5-Series wagons in its European stable.

Common hard-working people desire to own a car with a decent amount of interior space, fuel economy, reliability and adequate performance, all for a reasonable price. The all-new Tiida arrives as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. The fact that it's partly based on the Renault Megane, a European stalwart, means you get some Euro driving dynamics alongside traditional Japanese reliability. It is pleasantly surprising how big the Tiida feels inside. There is good head room and even tall passengers will find rear seat legroom as good as that in many much larger cars. Available as a five-door hatchback or a four-door sedan, the Tiida is available with either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine, with manual or automatic transmissions. Standard features include electric power steering, tilt steering column, 60/40 split folding rear seats, air conditioning with micro filter and a CD stereo system. Safety features include front airbags and ABS brakes. Power accessories are optional. The Tiida received a minor facelift for the 2009 model year, as Nissan made available a "sport" body kit option. Other new available features include cruise control, 6-CD changer, MP3 capability, IPod-ready AUX input, a 6-speaker audio system, fully automated air-conditioning and a trip computer.

The Eos is a resurrection of the Golf convertible, only with a different name. Sharing design cues, platforms and engines with the Golf, it is touted to be the first car in the world to feature a five-piece retractable hardtop. The car can somewhat seat four people, with good luggage room when the top is up. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Eos is available in the Middle East with three engine options, namely two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.2-litre V6, with choices of manual, automatic or DSG automanual, depending on model.  All models are well equipped, with a CD stereo, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front airbags, side airbags, lateral airbags, a roll-bar safety system, stability control, power mirrors and windows, among others.

The Toyota Land Cruiser Prado SWB got a second facelift in 2018. with a redesigned front-end and other trim changes. The only engine available with the short-wheelbase 3-door variant is a carryover 2.7-litre 4-cylinder. It is available only with a 6-speed automatic . It is only available in some markets, such as the UAE in GXR trim; and Bahrain in TX and TXL trim. It gets standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing and a locking centre-differential. In the UAE, the Prado 2.7L GXR comes with 18-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, rear spoiler, mud guards, fabric seating for five, keyless entry, front and rear manual a/c, CD/MP3 6-speaker stereo, cool box, steering audio controls, 9-inch screen with navigation, USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, smart keyless entry and start, leather steering wheel and shift lever, sunroof, front fog lamps, and front & rear parking sensors. Safety features include front, curtain, side and knee airbags, ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is a popular rear-wheel-drive roadster from Mazda. Completely overhauled for the 2016 model year, this purebred sports car is now powered by an all-new SkyActiv-G 2.0-litre four-cylinder motor, and mated to a 6-speed SkyActiv-Drive automatic transmission with paddle-shifters. There is a 6-speed manual variant available elsewhere, which is not offered in the GCC at the moment. Featuring the usual soft-top passed down from its predecessors, there is also a retractable hard-top variant known as the MX-5 RF (Retractable Fastback) available from 2017 model year. Besides a few kilos of weight, there are no significant differences between the soft and hard top variants, even in terms of performance. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 9 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, auto a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-key for keyless entry and ignition, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, navigation, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, LED headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind-spot monitoring, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats.
