Safety features, all optional, includes stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The BMW X5 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X5 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Magna was an all-new model back in 1997, replacing Mitsubishi's Sigma as their top-of-the-line sedan. Competing in the near-luxury segment against upscale brands, it never stood a chance, but soldiered on anyway unchanged right up to 2003, at which point it got a facelift. The Magna features a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine, a 4-speed automatic gearbox, a modern-at-the-time dashboard, decent suspension tuning and improvements in body structure that promise fair handling. Offered only as a sedan, the fairly-large Magna rode on a front-wheel-drive platform, and didn't overlap with the more-popular Galant, which was originally in between a compact and a midsize at that time. The Magna was available in essentially two flavours, namely a standard model and a sportier VR-X version. The Magna VR-X upgrades include a mesh grille, colour-keyed rear spoiler, aerodynamic side skirts, wheel lip moldings, sport-style bucket seats, unique seat fabric, and possibly sportier suspension tuning with slightly-increased engine power. Standard features on this redesigned sedan include dual airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, tinted glass, a power driver seat, an AM/FM stereo with cassette and CD player, remote keyless entry, optional leather, optional ABS and a security system. A minor facelift came for 2000, before the major one in 2004.

The SQ 5 is the top performance version of the Q5 compact SUV. Under the hood, it comes with a 3.0-litre supercharged engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. The four-wheel-drive model gets standard features like power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, Nappa leather interior, cruise control, keyless entry and start, auto headlamps, auto headlight range adjustment, fog lamps, xenon headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillights, navigation, panoramic glass roof, 3-zone automatic A/C, Bluetooth, Bang & Olufsen sound system, front and rear parking sensors and 21-inch ally wheels. Optional equipment include electric front seats with memory function, electric folding mirrors with heated and memory, side steps, adaptive cruise control, adaptive lights, red brake callipers, dynamic steering, more leather padding and sports seats. Safety features include front, side and head airbags, traction control, brake assist and stability control.

The 3 is a fairly roomy and affordable compact car, with the sportiest handling and the poorest engine in this class of cars. The Mazda 3, or Mazda3 as company likes to call it, is available as a four-door sedan in this region, while a five-door has been released from 2006 onwards, all with only the base engine available. The 3 has an interesting rounded shape that hides the height which is necessary for a roomier cabin. The Mazda 3 features a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with five trim levels, of which only the base version has a standard manual gearbox, with the rest having a five-speed automatic with manual shift capability. Available features, depending on trim level, includes leather, sunroof, and a premium sound system with a CD changer. As with the engine choices, safety options are limited in the Middle East too. Available airbags only include a standard driver side and an optional passenger-side bag. And ABS brakes are standard only on the higher models. Available on all but the base model are power windows, mirrors, central locking and keyless entry. A sporty appearance kit is optional.

The CK is Geely's first offering in a few GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia and the UAE, although it first went on sale in China a couple of years prior. The name "CK" somehow stands for "Freedom Ship" or "Free Cruiser" in Chinese. The CK holds the distinction of being the first Chinese automobile ever displayed at an American auto show, although it has never been allowed to be on sale there. The reasons are that it failed crash tests and emissions regulations. The small car was developed in China, but is supposedly based on a South Korean design by Daewoo. Its 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine is licenced from Toyota. The front-wheel-drive sedan comes with either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. Features include manual air-conditioning, remote locking, fog lamps, CD stereo, power steering, painted bumpers, power windows, intermittent wipers, 14-inch alloy wheels, cloth upholstery and more. Options include leather upholstery, ABS with electronic brake-force distribution, dual front airbags,

The Mercedes-Benz Vito is a midsize commercial van that can be outfitted as a cargo carrier or as a passenger transport. The cargo vans can be had with three turbocharged 2.1-litre 4-cylinder diesel engines with different states of tune, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The UK-built luxury passenger carrier version gets a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. All models are rear-wheel-drive. Basic options include power steering, front power windows and central locking with remote control. Safety features include ESP, driver-side airbag, third brake light and three-point seatbelts for all seats.

The Mercedes-Maybach, which was introduced back in 2015, got an all-new model in 2021. The S650 Maybach is being sold in the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include a full panoramic sunroof, powered privacy shades for the rear windows, acres of leather trim, night-vision display in the LCD gauge-cluster, chrome-plated speaker grilles, fibre-optic ambient lighting, Burmester 3D surround sound, and back-lit tweeters on all the doors that spiral out on start-up, although these things can even be had in a standard S-Class, if you tick everything on the options list. The lounge-worthy rear seats both offer a full range of power adjustability, and includes extending calf-supports, a massaging function, heated/cooled cup-holders and a seat heating/cooling feature, while the right-side rear seat gets an additional footrest that can be motored out of the front passenger seatback for sleeping. It's so intricate that the dual LCD screens on the front seat-backs automatically adjust their angles as the front seats are adjusted, so the rear passengers always get the best view. The massage and multimedia features are controlled with a remote, with animated settings showing on the screens. Its "Magic Body Control" system that scans the road ahead for bumps and adjusts the suspension to drive over them as smoothly as possible. Further options include flip-out tray-tables and a fridge that comes with a pair of silver-plated champagne flute-glasses as well as space for three chilled bottles. Along with the front and side airbags, ABS, traction control, the Mercedes-Maybach can be added with PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, Brake Assist BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Night View Assist Plus. In the shape of the seat belt buckle extender, Beltbag (both part of the PRE-SAFE rear package) and seat cushion airbag.

The Subaru Impreza got a complete redesign for 2012, and is only offered in sedan form in the GCC. Interestingly, the WRX versions have spun off into a separate model line and continue unchanged from their pre-2012 forms, at least until 2014. The Impreza is now offered with either a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine, both mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. Standard features in the 1.6i model include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, power windows and mirrors, multi-function display, automatic a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port, 60/40 folding rear seats and cloth upholstery. The 2.0i model adds the larger engine, 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, fog lamps, faux paddle-shifters and a rear-seat centre armrest with cup-holders. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, along with the all-weather traction of asymmetrical all-wheel-drive.

The BMW X1 is the smallest crossover SUV in the German brand. An all-new model came out in 2016. Based on the 1-Series platform, complete with four-wheel-independent suspension and disc brakes, the X1 is available in rear-wheel-drive form with the sDrive20i base model, sporting a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. The other model in the range is the all-wheel-drive xDrive25i, also fitted with same engine but producing more power. The interior features an optional integrated iDrive that includes either the 6.5-inch Business or the 8.8-inch Professional navigation systems. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes various alloy wheels, Bluetooth phone, dual-zone a/c, sunroof, cloth or leather upholstery, HID headlights, run-flat tyres, rear parking sensors, keyless entry, cruise control, immobiliser and the usual power accessories. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution as well as cornering brake control.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The twin-turbochared 5.5-litre V8 G63 AMG is fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Citroen C5 is the midsize offering from the French brand. Only one engine is offered in the GCC, which is a turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. Standard features on the C5 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, steering wheel with multi-functional controls, automatic A/C, stereo radio/MP3 compatible CD player, cruise control, Bluetooth system with USB, automatic rain-sensitive windscreen wipers and automatic illumination of headlamps, front fog lamps, cornering lights, daytime runnings LEDs, rear parking sensors and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher model gets Hydractive 3+ suspension, hill-start assist, automatic electric parking brake, electric front seats, chrome linings, part leather seats, interior mood lighting, sunroof, xenon headlamps and different 17-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features are good with front and passenger airbags, knee airbags and curtain airbags, ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Electronic Stability Programme (ESP) with traction control and Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA).

The Lotus Elise is a super-light sports convertible with a supercharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. It gets go-kart like handling, thanks to its light weight, as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. The soft-top is standard on the Elise, with the option of a hard-top as well. It can be had with either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. Upgrade packages are offered for the Elise - the Touring Pack offers leather ProBax seats, leather door panels, perforated leather door inserts, leather trimmed centre console, handbrake gaiter, black carpet mats with embroidered Elise logo, noise insulation paneling, auxiliary driving lights, iPod stereo connection, trinket tray divider and cup holder. The Sport Pack offers Bilstein sports dampers, twin oil coolers, 7-twin-spoke ultra light weight forged alloy wheels in Hi-power silver and ProBax sports seats. Safety features include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The 407 is an oddity in the midsize car segment, with bold styling that puts form over function. The exterior features a long hood and a compact trunk, all of which compromises interior space. Available in four-door sedan, two-door coupe or five-door station wagon body styles, there are at least three engines littering the range. The entry level engine is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine combined with a 4-speed automatic with tiptronic sequential control. Then there is a 2.2-litre four-cylinder engine with a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Manual gearbox models have been discontinued here. The top model is a 3.0-litre V6 engine with variable valve timing, combined with an all-new 6-speed automatic gearbox with tiptronic. The sedan gets all engine options, while the SW wagon gets only the 2.0-litre. Even the most basic model gets power windows, keyless entry, cruise control, ABS, stability control, power mirrors, fog lights, rear sunblind and automatic climate control. The 4-cylinder models get six airbags, while the V6 model gets as many as nine airbags.

The Jaguar XF luxury-sports sedan got an all-new model for 2016. In 2021, it got a facelift and newer tech. Only the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engines were now available in the UAE and GCC, with standard rear-wheel-drive and optional all-wheel-drive. All engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. it will get the InControl Touch Pro infotainment system with a 10.2-inch touchscreen display powered by a quad-core processor and equipped with a solid state drive (SSD). Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options.

The Chinese Tiggo beautifully illustrates the Koreans' fight for dominance in the small-4WD segment over the Japanese. The Tiggo has a bit of the Kia Sorento front end slapped onto the body of a previous-generation Toyota RAV-4. It kind of reminds us of a fake Rolex watch that has a Swatch lookalike face--a bit of the best and a bit of the average, but still ultimately neither. The five-door five-seater Tiggo does benefit from a versatile interior though, with fold-flat seats and a spacious cargo area. Features, standard or optional, include front dual airbags, rear three-point seat belts, ABS brakes with electronic brakeforce distribution, disc brakes, keyless entry, alloy wheels and a rear windshield wiper. Powered by a 2.4-litre Mitsubishi-sourced 4-cylinder engine, it comes with either a four-speed auto with two-wheel-drive, or a five-speed manual gearbox with all-wheel-drive. Chery also brags that sports car maker Lotus Engineering had a hand in developing this mishmash, so we expect decent handling. Don't put too much faith in the incredibly low manufacturer-quoted fuel consumption numbers though.

The Ford Fusion is midsize sedan offering from the American brand. It is powered by a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the front-wheel-drive sedan only comes with a 6-speed automatic. A 2.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder Ecoboost engine was available later on. Available in two trim levels, the Fusion S comes with independent front and rear suspension, torque-vectoring control, electric parking brake, trip computer, steering wheel with cruise and audio buttons, power windows with one-touch open/close, capless fuel filler, auto halogen headlights, LED tail lamps, speed-sensitive wipers, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB ports, SYNC with MyFord multimedia system with 4.3-inch screen, Bluetooth, 16-inch steel wheels and blind-spot mirrors. The Fusion SE adds power-adjustable driver's seats, rear armrest, 6-speaker stereo, outside temperature display and compass, rear a/c vents, mirror-mounted indicators, additional body-colour trim, keypad lock and 17-inch alloys. Options include 18-inch alloys, parking sensors, sunroof, fog lamps, rear spoiler, premium floor mats, auto a/c, rear camera, 8-inch touchscreen with additional 4.2-inch gauge-cluster LCD displays, front memory power seats, rain-sensing wipers, leather upholstery and navigation. The 2.0-litre Ecoboost version comes only in SE trim and gets additional paddle shifters. Standard safety features include front and side/curtain airbags, knee airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, hill-start assist, and alarm. Optional safety features include auto high beams, blind-spot monitors, cross-traffic alert and lane-keeping assist.

The Fiat Fiorino is a compact commercial vehicle offering by the Italian brand. The Turkish-built Fiorino comes with a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual. Standard features include power steering, sliding side door, foldable passenger seat, adjustable driver's seat, heat reflecting windows, radio with CD/MP3 player, and ABS. It has 2.8 cubic-metre volume of cargo space with a 600 kg payload capacity.

The Audi Q3 is the German manufacturer's 'baby SUV' offering. There are two engine options available in the GCC which is the 1.4-litre turbocharged engine mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission, and the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The 1.4-litre model comes in front-wheel drive while the all-wheel drive 2.0-litre gets two different engine ratings. The Q3 gets a lot of the standard options in the base model such as automatic xenon headlamps, LED rear lights, 17-inch alloy rims, automatic air-conditioning, 8-speaker audio system, AUX-IN port, front and side airbags, hill-start assist and ESC. The higher spec model gets hill-hold assist, parking sensors, driver information system, Bluetooth and cruise control.

The Audi Q2 made its debut in the GCC in 2017. It is the smallest SUV offering from Audi. It is offered in two engines - the front-wheel-drive 3-cylinder 1.0-litre turbocharged motor and the four-wheel-drive 4-cylinder 1.4-litre turbocharged unit, both of which are connected to a 7-speed DSG transmission.   Standard equipment on the Q2 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, sunroof, automatic A/C, and HID headlamps. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class made its debut as a 2018 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, and followed by the C-Class. The new E 63 AMG gets an all-new turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. A fully variable all-wheel-drive system capable of transferring up to 100 percent power to either axles is standard, and so are a limited-slip differential and adaptive damping in the rear axle. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

The Honda Odyssey J is the Japanese version of the model, which is being sold side by side with the U.S. built Odyssey. This one was introduced to offer the minivan as more affordable option. This one gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlamps, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). The EX-V gets additional blind spot indicators on the side mirrors.

At first glance, this Chinese-built car looks like nothing more than a cheap copy of the Toyota Corolla, with the rear end of a Honda City mixture, but wearing a fake BMW badge. And it is exactly that, but if you look past the lame attempts at plagiarism, you'll find a package that actually might be a decent deal for a new car. The F3 is powered by a 1.6-litre Mitsubishi-sourced engine, mated to a 5-speed manual Mitsubishi gearbox. It includes an interior that is exactly like that of a last-generation Toyota Corolla, but with softer touchable surfaces. Available features, standard or optional, include 15-inch wheels, leather upholstery, dual front airbags, sunroof, manual air-conditioning, CD player, remote keyless entry, fake wood trim, height-adjustable steering wheel, power windows, ABS brakes and the price tag of a car half its size. Build quality seems to be of passing-grade, although some plastic pieces have an unfinished feel to them. If only they'd try a bit harder and be a bit more original. The price may make up for it though, in the eyes of some cost-conscious buyers.

The Sonata is the real highlight of the Hyundai range, showing that this Korean company can actually build a world-class midsize sedan. It can do everything that the Japanese class leaders can do, but at a delightfully lower price. The choice of two competitive engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.3-litre V6, both with manually-shiftable automatics, though the smaller engine can be had with a proper manual too. Standard features include power windows, power outside mirrors, manual a/c, central door lock, front fog lamps, cloth seats, 15-inch steel wheels and a radio cassette player with 4 speakers and a hidden antenna. Options spread over the range includes dual airbags, ABS brakes, dual exhaust, automatic a/c, electric sunroof, cruise control, leather upholstery, electric driver's seat, trip computer, rear parking warning sensor, rear sunblind, fake wood and metal cabin trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel, 6-CD changer with 6 speakers and a subwoofer and an electronic auto-dimming rearview mirror, along with 17-inch alloy wheels.

The Chery Arrizo 3 is the Chinese brand's smallest sedan. It does not aspire to be anything more than an inoffensive 5-seater subcompact sedan, but actually a bit bigger than most of its sub-compact rivals. Powered by a typical 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 4-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, other features include split-folding rear seats, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry and all the usual basics. Touchscreen stereo, leatherette seats and more are also available. Safety features include at least 2 airbags and ABS.

The Peugeot 5008 started life as a minivan, but has been reinvented as a 7-seater crossover SUV for 2018. Basically an extended version of the Peugeot 3008, the 5008 is powered by the same 1.6-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine and 6-speed automatic mated to a front-wheel-drive platform. Standard features in the 2020 Peugeot 5008 include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats and alloy wheels. Further available features on the 2020 Peugeot 5008 include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Android Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features on the 2020 Peugeot 5008 include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist, as well as options such as lane-departure warning, collision alert, hill-descent control and more.

The new Avalon is Toyota's rendition of the traditional big car. The Avalon was designed, engineered and built by the Toyota Technical Center in the United States. Its understated styling is more distinctive than any previous-generation Avalon, presenting a quiet look of grace. There was a very minor facelift in 2008, though no one noticed. Power produced by the powerful 3.5-litre V6 goes to the front wheels, originally via a smooth 5-speed automatic. A 6-speed automatic replaced the previous unit from 2008 onwards. Inside is a comfortable cabin lavished with tasteful materials and ergonomically-designed controls that makes this car a pleasant and cheap alternative to a Lexus. This newest Avalon is significantly larger than previous models. The front seats are roomy and comfortable and special attention was paid to back-seat comfort. The Avalon is smooth and comfortable, quiet and serene, as the suspension was tuned for ride comfort. Trim variations are limited to accessories. Standard features include a premium AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with nine speakers, remote keyless entry, multi-function information display for audio, climate control, temperature and trip computer, among other things.

The new-for-2012 Honda CR-V is an all-new design that is slightly lighter and apparently more aerodynamic. Built in the United States, it comes in LX, EX and EX-Leather flavours. It is still powered by a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a basic 5-speed automatic transmission, but power has been bumped up a fair bit. Honda now tacks on an improved all-wheel-drive system that still drives the front wheels most of the time but can send torque to the rear wheels anytime, instead of like the old system that used to wait for the front wheels to lose traction and spin first. The 5-seater cabin comes with a quick 60:40 fold-flat rear bench. The LX gets 17-inch alloys, a 4-speaker CD stereo with AUX port, mirror-mounted indicators, ABS, stability control and front airbags. Only the EX and EX-L models get 18-inch wheels, a 6-speaker stereo with USB/AUX ports, cruise control, HID headlights, fog lamps, dual-zone auto a/c, sunroof, Bluetooth, rear camera and an 'i-MID' LCD display. The EX-L itself further gets side-curtain airbags, leather and a power driver's seat.

An all-new model of Chevrolet Traverse came out in 2018. Under the hood, the 2020 Chevrolet Traverse gets the same 3.6-litre V6 engine is carried over but tweaked with more power and mated to a new 9-speed automatic transmission. The model can be had in either front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. Standard trim available on the 2020 Chevrolet Traverse is the "LS", which comes with  black body side moldings, LED daytime running lights, HID headlamps, body color door handles, black rocker moldings, 18-inch aluminum wheels, solar-absorbing glass, LED tail lamps, rear view camera, switchable AWD selector, tri-zone automatic air conditioning, Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system with 7-inch diagonal color touch-screen, keyless entry and push button start. The "LT" trim gets additional front fog lamps, driver seat power lumbar support, multi-directional power driver seat adjuster, leather-wrapped steering wheel, rear park assist, optional side blind zone alert and optional rear cross traffic alert. The "LT leather" adds standard side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, surround vision camera, Bose 10-speaker system, 6-way power front passenger seat adjuster, auto-dimming rearview mirror with wide angle camera modeChevrolet MyLink audio system with 8-inch diagonal color touch-screen with navigation, heated driver and front passenger seats, available 20-inch aluminum wheels and power liftgate. The "LT Premier" option adds D-optic LED headlamps, Intellibeam headlamps, panoramic power sunroof, 20-inch aluminium wheels, power tilt and telescopic steering column, ventilated driver and front passenger seats, driver seat memory settings, heated rear seats, low speed front automatic braking, front pedestrian detection, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and following distance indicator. The top "High Country" trim adds full speed front automatic braking, twin-clutch AWD, automatic rear locking differential, inductive wireless charging, power folding third row 60/40 split-bench seat, adaptive cruise control with Stop/Go technology and 20-inch aluminium wheels.

An all-new model came out for the Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S in 2020. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The sister-model to the hotly-anticipated Toyota 86, the Subaru BRZ finally made its showroom debut as a mid-2012 model. The BRZ is a collaborative effort with Toyota, and therefore versions are available under both nameplates, with only a front bumper different between the two. Usually available in only one trim level in most GCC markets, the front-engine rear-wheel-drive car comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection boxer engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or automatic transmission. Depending on the dealer, standard features include cloth or leather sports seats, HID headlights, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, Bluetooth, auto a/c, common power accessories and 17-inch alloy wheels, as well as a stability control system with three modes, ABS and a full set of front, side, curtain and knee airbags. It additionally gets a limited-slip diff, paddle-shifters, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra digital speedo, cruise control and and floor illumination. Specs may vary between different GCC countries, with most offering only the automatic version.

The perfectly-sized CX-9 is an award-winning crossover 4WD that drives like a sporty car and goes off-road like a sporty car too. Built on an all-new architecture, the CX-9 shares the V6 engine sourced from Ford. Powered by a new-for-2008 3.7-litre V6, it also comes with a six-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive, which means no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one hand operation for an extra 26 inches of space between the folded second-row seat and the door opening. The 60-40 split second row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Other available features include 18-inch rims, CD stereo,  and HID headlights. The disc brakes are assisted by ABS, traction control, dynamic stability control, and an advanced roll stability control system. A six airbag system is fitted as standard and includes side-curtain airbags that extend to the third row. The CX-9 now becomes the flagship family vehicle in the Mazda lineup.

New from the ground up, the all-new Chrysler Pacifica builds on the styling cues started by the failed Chrysler 200 sedan, and replacing the aging Chrysler Grand Voyager. It comes with a 3.6-litre V6, a 9-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The Pacifica offers 7-seater capacity (or 8 seats optionally), with a folding/collapsible second-row “Stow ‘n Go” seats, and a 60/40-split folding third-row seat. Available with sizeable 17-inch, 18-inch or 20-inch alloys, it aims to be a bit more premium than the usual minivan offerings. Options include two 10-inch multimedia touchscreens with built-in travel games, an 8.4-inch UConnect touchscreen up front, Blu-Ray player, a built-in vacuum cleaner, power sliding doors, power tailgate with hands-free operation, LED running lights and taillights, standard 3-zone automatic climate control, cooled front seats, two large sunroofs and an automated parallel/perpendicular parking system, aside from all the usual standard luxury trappings such as power windows, Bluetooth, cruise control and smart keyless start, although all features may not be offered in all markets. Stereo options include 6-speaker, 13-speaker and 20-speaker choices, the last one being Harmon Kardon. The models with the rear screens also get tons of USB and HDMI ports for rear passengers. Standard safety equipment includes stability control, ABS, front, front-side and curtain airbags as well as front knee airbags, and a rearview camera (although rear parking sensors are missing in the base model). The ABS can also dry the brake rotors in rainy conditions. Safety options include automatic braking for forward collision mitigation, blind-spot monitoring, rear-cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The CSV CR8 is a high-performance variation of the Lumina SS. It is simply a rebadged version of the Australian-built HSV supersedan, but using a "Chevrolet Special Vehicles" badge for the GCC region. The 2008 model was powered by a Corvette-sourced 6.0-litre LS2 V8, to be replaced by a 6.2-litre LS3 V8 in 2009.The CR8 is one of the quickest sedans available today, but without the overblown German price tag. Standard features include a six-speed manual or automatic, rear-wheel-drive with limited-slip differential, 19-inch alloy wheels, full body kit with spoiler, two-tone leather interior, better brakes and other upgrades. Convenience and safety features include dual front and side-curtain airbags, stability and traction control, ABS brakes, CD/MP3 player with in-dash CD changer, Bluetooth phone, power windows and mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry and a basic a/c. Options include a rear-seat DVD player and a sunroof. It is a large and heavy car, while lacking the last bit of refinement that puts the Germans at the top of this class. But for the price, even if high at first glance, the CR8 is a performance bargain.

The Haval H9 is the Chinese brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed ZF automatic transmission. Standard features on the H9 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop button, xenon headlamps, front and rear fog lamps, leather seats, infotainment system with touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, radio, AUX-in, USB, CD player and GPS. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The CX-9 crossover SUV received a facelift for the 2013 model year that incorporates their new 'Kodo' design theme. Powered by a 3.7-litre V6, it comes with a six-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. It is a seven-seater that offers easy access to the third-row seat with only one-hand operation. The 60/40-split second-row carries three, plus offers fore-and-aft slide travel and a reclining backrest. Available in two trims, both the base CX-9 and the CX-9 GT are equipped with air conditioning, power windows, power door locks with remote keyless entry, a trip computer, cruise control, six airbags, and a choice of a black or beige interior colour scheme. New features for the facelifted model include a redesigned climate-control system for rear seating areas, and an optional audio system with a new 4.3-inch LCD display, MP3-capable CD changer, auxiliary input jack, and iPod connectivity, as well as a back-up monitor system. The base CX-9 is equipped with 18-inch aluminium wheels and halogen headlamps. The top-spec CX-9 GT has 20-inch aluminium wheels, and features chrome exterior door handles, exterior mirrors with turn indicators, a three-position memory driver's seat, wood-finish instrument panel trim and door trim, blue interior lighting and a silver finish on the rear console. Safety-wise, the CX-9 comes with standard stability control and ABS, and is optionally equipped with Forward Obstruction Warning, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Control.

The McLaren 540C is the second release from the Sports Series lineup after the 570S and is set to be the lowest-priced McLaren on offer. It features a revised aerodynamics package when compared to the 570S, and also features new alloy wheels. For the interior it gets leather-wrapped seats, dashboard and door panels. The infotainment system includes a 7-inch screen, Bluetooth and navigation. Under the hood, is the usual turbocharged 3.8-litre V8, while power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic gearbox. McLaren have also retuned the dampers of the 540C to make it more suitable for daily driving.

The Toyota Fortuner shares the same underpinnings as the Toyota Hilux. However, the design is much more pleasing than its commercial cousin and also more comfortable, thanks to tweaks made to the suspension. In 2021, the Toyota Fortuner got a facelift and the 4-cylinder model got a very slight bump in power.  The advantages of sharing a pickup chassis gives it superior off-road ability, as it gets four-wheel drive and low-range gearing. Slight tweaks have been made to the suspension to make it more comfortable than a Hilux. Customers can add two extra seats at the back at the expense of luggage space, if they want a 7-seater, making the Forturner a firm family-favourite here in the GCC.  The 2021 Toyota Fortuner is available with a 2.7-litre 4-cylinder as well as a 4.0-litre V6 engine. Some markets such as in Saudi Arabia, there is a 2.4-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine option as well. Most markets such as the UAE offer four-wheel-drive as standard, but a two-wheel-drive version is available in KSA markets. Standard features for the 2021 Fortuner include power windows, dual front airbags, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo system with USB port, and fabric upholstery, although only few GCC countries get the basic model. Higher trim levels get replica wood panels, cruise control, chrome body trimmings, navigation, 17-inch alloy wheels, rear-diff lock, ABS, multi-information display, 6-speaker CD stereo and optional leather upholstery. Top-spec of the 2021 Toyota Fortuner in Saudi Arabia models get additional features such as HID headlights, power driver's seat and wi-fi features.

The new-for-2010 Hyundai Tucson has been redesigned from the ground up, only slightly longer than the outgoing model, but 27 kg lighter than before. Now powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre 4WD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags.

The Escape is Ford's smallest sport-utility 4WD. It offers comfortable seating for four and plenty of space for stuff. Folding down the rear seats reveals a moderate cargo area with a flat floor. Its smooth ride and car-like handling make for easy driving, helped by its compact dimensions. A 2.3-litre four-cylinder engine comes standard while a 3.0-litre V6 is optional. The 2.3-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the 3.0-litre only gets an automatic. The Escape comes standard with cloth seats, illuminated remote entry, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 15-inch steel wheels and AM/FM/6CD stereo. Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, 16-inch aluminium wheels, various premium audio system choices and parking sensors. Available safety features include front-and-side airbags along with ABS. It has all-wheel-drive and decent ground clearance, but it does not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

An identical replica of the Porsche 356 Speedster from the 1960s, the new-age Speedster II is hand-built by French outfit Pierre GÃ©rard Organisation, also known as PGO. Changes to the basic design include higher-positioned mirrors, modern tail-lights and stylish 16-inch or 17-inch rims. The chassis is made of composite materials, is attached to a steel frame. The engine, a Peugeot-sourced 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, is mounted in the rear, while the small luggage compartment is in the front. Standard setup include rear-wheel-drive, a 5-speed manual gearbox and a cloth soft top. Features of the original include a cloth or leather interior, electric mirrors, basic CD stereo and as many as eight whole gauges, but not much else. The windows are of the removable variety, and the soft top is manual. The car stays true to its roots and therefore has no ABS brakes, no airbags and not even power steering. However, the 2008 model features luxuries such as power windows, a/c, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo and keyless entry, as well as a 4-speed automatic gearbox. Sold only in a few GCC countries, the Speedster offers a pure driving experience few cars offer, but it can only be regarded as an expensive toy.

In 2007, the all-new Porsche 911 Turbo made its debut. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets a new all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 2007 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Further options include an powered steel sliding/lift sunroof and a roof-transport system. A new option in the 2007 Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

Previously speculated to be named the 620 GT, the replacement for the 599 has actually been named the Ferrari F12 Berlinetta, which is their most powerful road-going car at the time of release. The F12 is powered by a 6.3-litre V12. It only comes with an "F1"³ dual-clutch 7-speed automatic gearbox, in keeping with their official promise to eliminate the traditional manual gearbox forever, one model at a time. Other features include carbon-ceramic brakes, updated magnetorheological suspension control system, and numerous jumbled electronic aids, including E-Diff, ESP Premium, F1-Trac, and high-performance ABS.

This 4th generation of the long-running 3-Series remained BMW's best-selling car, and with good reason. Ignoring the 3-Series Compact that was based on an older platform, this iteration of the 3-Series came in sedan, coupe and convertible forms, as well as in wagon trim that never came to the GCC. These variations were enough to solidify this model as the arguably the top-selling entry-luxury car in the market. While lower models managed with cloth upholstery, steel wheels and basic power accessories, the higher trim levels enjoyed leather, premium CD stereo, navigation, alloy wheels, sunroof and other amenities. While all models were rear-wheel-drive, some markets may have gotten a few all-wheel-drive versions of the various models. Manual and automatic transmissions were standard, but some markets may also have automanual gearboxes on some higher models. The sedan debuted in 1999, followed by the coupe in 2000, with 2.0-litre, 2.2-litre, 2.5-litre and 2.8-litre engines, along with 318i, 320i, 323i and 328i designations respectively, and 2-door models getting "Ci" badging instead of "i" at the end. The year 2001 brought about the hot 3.2-litre M3 version, available in 2-door form only, while all other models got new engines and names, such as upgraded 2.5-litre 325i and new 3.0-litre 330i alongside the existing 318i and 320i. A minor front-end facelift came in 2002 for all models except the M3. A lightweight M3 CSL with an upgraded engine was briefly available unofficially. While the sedan was replaced by an all-new model by 2006, the coupe and convertible continued well into 2006 before their new versions came out.

Porsche is offering a "new" Cayman model from 2009, and while the facelift is barely noticeable, the real changes are under the bonnet. Still available in base and S versions, both models feature more horsepower, new gearbox choices and modern multimedia options. A lightweight Cayman R model debuted in early 2011 with slightly more power. The base Cayman now has a 2.9-litre flat-6, while the Cayman S and Cayman R have a 3.4-litre flat-6 with direct fuel injection technology. A Cayman S Black Edition model also gets the R engine. While a 6-speed manual is standard on all, the optional new 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK) dual-clutch automanual gearbox is also available, which actually improves acceleration and fuel economy. The Cayman is priced at a premium over the Boxster, for what amounts to a slight bump in power and a fixed top. Cosmetic changes from 2009 include new headlights and tail lamps, larger front intakes with integrated running lights, and an altered lower rear-end with twin diffusers. Both models can be fitted with a never-ending list of optional features, which can drive up the total price by 30% or more. While the basic models are very bare on features, the car can be optionally outfitted with a hardtop, various types of expensive cloth or leather sports seats, different 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheel designs, a new Porsche Communication Management System (PCM) with a touchscreen, Bluetooth, TV tuner, DVD changer, metallic paint, stickers, wind deflector, roll bars, headlamp cleaners, Xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, and a cabin that can be trimmed with carbon-fibre, aluminium, alcantara or wood.

The Carnival, also known as Grand Carnival or Sedona in some markets, is undoubtedly Kia's largest non-commercial vehicle, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. Powered by a 3.8-litre V6, it comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was released as a 2014 model year. The Thai-built Yaris receives two 4-cylinder engines to choose from. The base gets a 1.3-litre, where as higher models get a 1.5-litre. They both get a 4-speed automatic transmission, while some select markets get the 5-speed manual transmission. The 1.3-litre is available in two packages - the S and SE, whereas the 1.5-litre gets an SE+ and a Sport option in the UAE. New exterior colours have also been introduced. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the Sport, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, steering wheel control for audio, sportier seats, 15-inch alloy wheels, smoker metallic plating, different analogue dashboard meter and a body kit with spoiler. The SE+ get automatic air-conditioning, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels, projector headlights and better quality seats. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD).

The Morris Garages nameplate, an off-shoot of the defunct Rover brand, has been resurrected by the Chinese SAIC group, and their first product is the MG 750, midsize front-wheel-drive sedan based fully on a facelifted Rover 75. The MG 750 comes with an updated 183 hp 2.5-litre V6, 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, independent suspension, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, dual front airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, leather seats, power-adjustable driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, steering-mounted radio controls, automatic climate control a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, CD changer, sunroof, keyless entry, auto headlights, cooled central cubby box, illuminated sunshade mirrors and parking sensors. Options such as GPS and side airbags are apparently not yet available in GCC-spec models, but may be offered later.

The Ford Fusion receives a facelift, interior updates and more power for 2010. Essentially a modified version of the previous version, this Mexican-built midsize sedan is available in the GCC in a limited number of trim levels. The new look includes a sleeker chrome-grilled front end and a redesigned rear slapped onto the carryover three-box body. While introduced in the U.S. boasting four engines and various transmission options, it is sold here only in front-wheel-drive automatic form with one engine choice. The standard engine is a new 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a  6-speed automatic transmission. Features include the Ford SYNC voice-activated entertainment system, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, power windows, electric mirrors, manual A/C, power driver seat, 12-speaker Sony sound system, fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, capless fuel filler, dual chrome-tipped exhausts, four-wheel disc brakes, reverse sensors and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. Available safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, curtain side airbags, and front side airbags.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was all-new in 2014 and facelifted for 2018. The 2018 Toyota Yaris sedan is only available with a 1.5-litre engine and a CVT automatic in the UAE, in SE and SE+ trims. In Saudi Arabia, the 1.3-litre is available as a fleet, standard, Y and YX trims, while the 1.5-litre is available in Y and YX trims. Standard features in the 2018 Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the SE+, the 2018 Toyota Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, auto a/c, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels and more. Standard safety features on the 2018 Toyota Yaris sedan include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD). Tyre-pressure monitor and stability control are now standard in the UAE on all trims.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class sedan. Under the hood, they gets twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The American-built Honda Odyssey minivan received a facelift for the 2014 model year and remains unchanged for the 2016 model year. The upmarket minivan is aimed at big families, and is longer, wider and lower than the previous version. It comes in LX, EXL and Touring trim levels. Mechanical specs include a 3.5-litre V6 with cylinder-shutoff technology, a 6-speed automatic, MacPherson strut front and double-wishbone rear suspension, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and an 80-litre fuel tank. Depending on trim, features include three rows of seating for up to eight people, adjustable 2nd-row seats that can space outwards to fit three baby seats, 3rd-row "magic" seats that can flip forwards or backwards, power-adjustable driver's seat with optional powered passenger seat, optional HID headlights, optional rear DVD screen that is ultra-wide to play a movie and a video game at the same time, ports for USB and even HDMI, optional navigation with Bluetooth phone, optional 15GB hard drive or 2GB flash drive to store CDs instead of needing a CD changer, front and side airbags with three-row side-curtain airbags, stability control, power windows front and rear, cruise control, sunroof, cooler box, remote-controllable power tailgate and rear sliding doors, variable power steering, ABS and 15 bottle and cup holders.

The Cadillac ATS Coupe was released at the end of 2014 for the GCC market. The rear-wheel drive coupe is offered only with the 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, navigation, magnetic ride control, rearview camera, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard, automatic collision preparation motorised safety belts, electronic park brake, front and rear automatic braking, blind zone alert, rear cross-traffic alert, and front & passenger airbags and curtain airbags.

BAIC is a Chinese car company which made its debut in the UAE in late 2014. The BAIC A1 hatchback comes is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They are come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Fabia gets a total redesign for the 2009 model year, losing its conservative skin for a more funky appearance. Inside and out, the level of quality has apparently been upgraded. Skoda seems to be offering only one engine in most GCC markets, namely an unremarkable 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The Fabia RS became available in 2012, with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder that has both a turbocharger and a supercharger. The 1.6-litre front-wheel-drive 5-door hatchback comes with a choice of either a 5-speed manual or a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic transmission, although in all likelihood, dealers will never have a manual version in stock. The 1.4-litre RS version has a 7-speed DSG automanual. Safety features include ABS, dual front airbags and height-adjustable rear headrests. Features available on the Fabia, depending on trim level, include power windows, cloth upholstery, electric mirrors, foglights, keyless entry, alloy wheels, CD stereo, and the option to have a white-painted roof. A special-edition Fabia Monte Carlo model was offered for 2012 with the 1.6-litre engine, 16-inch wheels, black accents, special trim bits and sports suspension. The RS has 17-inch wheels, auto a/c, sports suspension, unique bumpers and optional LEDs up front. The quirky Skoda is an interesting alternative to the usual sub-compact choices, dubious VW origins notwithstanding.

The Uplander is a new attempt by General Motors to conquer the world of minivan by offering something different. It is a minivan that tries to look a little like a 4WD, and hopes that people won't notice that it is indeed just a minivan. This new seven-passenger minivan is a front-driver that is about 90 percent minivan, and the other 10% could become a quasi-4WD with the optional Versatrak all-wheel-drive, but this option is apparently not offered here. GM is calling their new line a crossover sport van. Power came from a 3.5-litre V6 powerplant in the early models, while a 3.9-litre V6 was later offered optionally, only to become the only choice since 2007. Interior features include fold-down second and third row seating, ceiling rail storage system with DVD and other entertainment features, along with a series of in-floor rear storage bins. The van still utilizes a walkthrough between seats and sliding doors for inner access, while the back has a lift-up tailgate. This van is effectively a replacement for the unloved Venture minivan, which few people knew even existed. The only Uplanders visible on the road seems to be airport taxi vehicles.

The Suzuki Baleno is the brand's sub-compact hatchback offering. The Indian-made Baleno comes with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Two trims are available - the GL and GLX. On the inside, the top-spec Baleno GLX, features a 6.2-inch infotainment system. Other standard features in the GLX include cruise control, automatic A/C and rear park distance control. Safetywise, the GLX gains 4 additional airbags over the GL model, with a total of 6 airbags. The GLX also gains rear disc brakes, while the GL derivative has rear drum brakes. Standard fare across the range are USB and Aux ports.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

An all-new Hyundai Elantra was released as a 2016 model year. It remains the same for the 2018 model. It is wider than the previous generation. Under the hood, the Elantra gets two 4-cylinder engines, a 1.6-litre and a 1.8-litre. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

Featuring a further-retuned engine for 2013, the FJ Cruiser is a true off-road vehicle that draws on the styling and heritage of the classic Toyota FJ40 that started life back in the 1960s and kept alive all the way into the 1980s. Aside from new LED tail lamps, almost everything externally has been left unchanged for the refresh, including the white roof, unique grille and wrap-around rear side windows, all signature elements of the original FJ40. The FJ Cruiser has two main forward-hinged doors and two smaller rear-hinged access doors that open to 90 degrees for rear-seat access. First offered in the GCC for 2008, the Japanese-built FJ Cruiser comes equipped with an upgraded 4.0-litre V6. A 5-speed automatic is standard on all trims, but there is also a 6-speed manual base model. Also standard are a low-range transfer case, a premium sound system, a washable interior and loads of optional accessories, including a rear-view camera, wi-fi, roof rack, pricey TRD alloy wheels and cheesy stickers. Available features in higher trims include cruise control, parking sensors, door scuff plates and step guards. 17-inch alloy wheels are standard, while some models get lower skid plates and optional rear diff lock. Safety features include standard front and side-curtain airbags as well as ABS, but stability control is available only on the top model.

The Kia Cerato gets a complete makeover, virtually lifting up the Korean compact to within striking distance of the Japanese favourites. However, Kia is once again undermining their own cars in this region with poor marketing and decontented GCC-spec models. It will initially be available with a 1.6-litre with 4-speed automatic. A manual gearbox might also be available on special-order. In 2011, all models got a 6-speed automatic. The interior feature in the Cerato that Kia is proud of seems to be a new "super vision" LCD cluster with reddish lighting with warning-message and trip-computer functionality. at the bottom of the cluster. Also available is a basic four-speaker audio system, with the option of six-speaker system that adds tweeters, plus a choice of three radio/CD players and the option of MP3 and iPod connectivity. Standard are power windows, electric mirrors, 15-inch wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery and central locking. Other available features in higher models include 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, some chrome exterior trim, "super vision" gauge cluster, fog lamps, sunroof, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, aluminium pedals and automatic headlights. Safety is being downplayed again, as the basic Cerato comes with a single driver's airbag. The higher model gets ABS, active headrests and rear disc brakes instead of drums. Side-curtain airbags and stability control, though not initially available, became standard on the top-spec model later.

The Kia Telluride is the Korean brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, the US-built Telluride gets a 3.8-litre V6 engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the 8-seater midsize SUV include power steering, power windows, cruise control, infotainment system with touchscreen, Apple Carplay, Android Auto, Bluetooth, 5 USB charging ports, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, and alloy wheels. The higher trims get a bigger 10.25-inch touchscreen, better audio system, 6 USB ports, sunroof and leather seats. Standard safety features include traction control, stability control, ABS, BA and EBD. The top model gets seven airbags, lane departure warning, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, forward collision alert, cross traffic alert and blind spot monitor.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class sedan. Under the hood, they gets twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The fourth generation of the VW Golf was a huge success during its long run. The clean and conservative styling combined with a vague sense of being a status symbol made it a hit among well-to-do yuppies. Available only as a 5-door hatchback here, with a variety of engine options upgraded over the years. Even a 4Motion all-wheel-drive model is available, though it may be hard to find in these parts. After its 1998 makeover, the Golf got considerably more tasteful inside, with nicely contrasting colours and patterns. The cabin offers sufficient room for six-footers, while the rear compartment is as small as any other compact. The cargo area under the hatch is huge for a compact, and the rear seats fold flat. Available features included power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, sunroof, alloy wheels and more, depending on trim level. A pair of airbags is standard on all models, with some getting side airbags as well, while ABS is standard. Engines included 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motors. Sportier early models included the FWD or AWD GTI with a 2.3-litre V5, and an AWD 4Motion model with a 2.8-litre V6. In the later years, the V5 got more power. For its premium price, equipment levels were limited, with an underlying platform that had independent front and torsion-beam rear suspension.

The Jaguar F-Type Coupe hit showrooms in mid-2014, joining the range almost a year after the Roadster's launch. It comes with two supercharged 3.0-litre engine choices, in V6 and V6 S form, as well as with a supercharged 5.0-litre V8, in V8 R form, the latter more powerful than the V8 S Roadster. There is no V8 S version for the Coupe. Components include adaptive dampers and adjustable suspension settings, several aluminium body bits, rear-wheel-drive and a unique 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 8 or 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate and a retractable rear wing spoiler. Further available features include optional sports seats, dual-zone a/c, customisable colours for cabin trim, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. The F-Type R Coupe additionally gets a new electronic active differential and a torque vectoring system, as well as larger brakes with optional carbon-ceramic discs.

The XC90 is Volvo's largest 4x4 vehicle. From 2012, the 7-seater is powered by only a 3.2-litre V6 engine option, with an automatic gearbox and all-wheel-drive, as the other engine choices have been dropped. The 2012 facelift also added LEDs front and rear, new bumper bits and new wheel designs. Among the three rows of seats, the second row moves front and back offering adjustable legroom, while the foldable third row seats can be tucked away to increase luggage space. Standard features include keyless entry, 18-inch wheels, CD player, trip computer, rear air-conditioning, power windows, doors, locks and mirrors, and an eight-way power driver's seat with memory. Available features also include leather seats, a power front passenger seat, memory mirrors, a power moonroof, upgraded audio with a six-CD changer, turning HID headlights and self-leveling rear suspension. An R-Design sports package adds 19-inch rims, redesigned upholstery, extra cabin trim and unique 19-inch wheels.stiffer suspension. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, and a rollover protection system.

In 2015, the Audi A7 Sportback got a facelift. It remained the same for the 2016model year. Almost 5 metres long with a low roofline, the Audi A7 Sportback is a full-sizer riding on 18-inch to 20-inch wheels, and as with all Audi sedans,  really rides a front-wheel-drive platform, with optional 'Quattro' all-wheel-drive tacked onto the higher trim levels. Three engines are on offer - a turbocharged 4-cylinder 2.0-litre, a naturally aspirated 2.8-litre V6 and a 3.0-litre supercharged motor, all of which are mated to an 'S-tronic' 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system. Optional equipment include interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound.

The Navigator is the Lincoln-badged luxury version of the Ford Expedition, a full-size 4WD known to be smooth, stable and refined for the most part. Heavily facelifted and revised for 2007, its four-wheel-independent suspension is sophisticated, providing better on-road ride and handling, while low-range gearing is available for off-roading. The standard engine is a 5.4-litre V8 engine mated to an automatic gearbox. The Navigator is loaded with safety features, and offers an available Roll Stability Control system, which is designed to sense an approaching rollover situation then take action to help prevent it. What the Navigator does best is move large quantities of people and gear, with its perfectly flat cargo area and available PowerFold third-row seat that folds perfectly flat with the press of a button, with the ability to carry up to eight passengers. Other features include HID headlights, 18-inch wheels, power-folding running boards, leather seats and wood trim. Options include 20-inch wheels, a rear-seat DVD system and more power features. Also new to the range is the Navigator L, an extended version which has a longer wheelbase and additional cargo space.

Dodge's new entry-level vehicle is a five-passenger hatchback that replaces the Neon sedan and attempts to be a replacement for the common 4WD wagon too. It has a liftgate and split-folding rear seats. All trim levels use a 4-cylinder engine. The base model is a 2.0-litre with CVT automatic. The larger 2.4-litre is available with either manual or CVT. For 2009, the Caliber SRT-4 model was quietly released, with a 2.4-litre turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual. Available features include a fold-flat front passenger seat, refrigerated glovebox, and removable cargo light/flashlight. Unique features include oddities such as flip-down speakers when the liftgate is open, illuminated cup-holders and a central armrest that moves front and back. Also available are leather upholstery, nine-speaker Boston Acoustics stereo and alloy wheels. ABS is optional on the base models, and standard on the top trim, where it comes with rear disc brakes instead of drums. A tyre pressure monitor is optional. All Calibers have available front airbags and side airbags.

The Chevrolet Tahoe got a new 6-speed transmission from 2009 onward. A beefy  Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Tahoe. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include the usual power features and three rows of seats. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, the Tahoe is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Suburban is the long-wheelbase version of the Tahoe, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. New versions added later include the Tahoe Z71 off-road package with lifted suspension.

The all-new Chery Tiggo 7 is the first Chery to have the new corporate face with its wavy grille and boomerang-shaped xenon headlights. It comes standard with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and CVT automatic, with a 1.5-litre turbo 4-cylinder and dual-clutch automatic joining a bit later. All are front-wheel-drive. The new Chery features a dual-tone interior with a patch of stitched leatherette across the dashboard and onto the inner door handles, matching the leather seats. The 9-inch capacitive touchscreen includes multimedia features, a/c settings and vehicle settings, while there’s also a 4.8-inch LCD dashboard screen. Other available features include smart keyless entry and start, dual-zone auto a/c and 360-degree camera as well as a panoramic roof. The Tiggo 7 received a five-star safety rating in the Chinese NCAP crash tests (which in theory is similar to EuroNCAP). Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, hill-start, tyre-pressure monitor and 6 airbags.

The GAC GS4 is the Chinese brand's sub-compact SUV offering. An all-new model was revealed in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and GCC in 2022.
