Under the hood, the front-wheel GS4 gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, leather seats, LED daytime running lamps, infotainment system with touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto and wireless charging, fog lamps, cruise control and automatic A/C. Safety features include airbags for front driver and  passenger, ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist, traction control, hill assist and hill descent control.

The original Continental by Bentley is a large, expensive, luxury coupÃƒÂ© made by Rolls-Royce for a 10-year run. It was the first Bentley in 25 years to not feature a body shared with a Rolls-Royce model. It was also the first Bentley to use a GM  4-speed automatic transmission to work Bentley's long-running twin-turbo 6.8-litre V8. Power output of the earliest models are unknown, as Rolls Royce was too snobby to reveal numbers. But back then, the Continental was still the quickest, most expensive, and most powerful Bentley ever. The convertible version was called the Bentley Azure, launched in 1995. The cabin featured usual Bentley traits such as acres of wood, leather and chrome. The standard model was known as the Continental R, but 1994 saw production of a severely-limited Continental S, and then the shortened Continental T was introduced in 1996 as a performance model. Mulliner editions, which started in 1999, added performance upgrades on both the R and the T. A handful of Continental SC models were built in 1999, with a huge lift-out glass sunroof.

The Genesis G90 is the the first model to be released after its parent company Hyundai decided to make Genesis a separate luxury brand. The G90 is their flagship sedan and it comes in the GCC with three engine options. In 2021, it got a major facelift incorporating their new design language. The base engine is the 3.8-litre V6 which was found in the Centennial, while the other two new additions are the turbocharged 3.3-litre V6 motor and the 5.0-litre V8. Standard options in the G90 include power steering, power windows, electric folding mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop, leather upholstery, memory and ventilated seats, audio system with AUX/USB support, auto A/C, navigation, auto defog system, rain sensors, sunroof, parking assist system, rear electric curtain, xenon headlamps, LED headlights and taillights with LED daytime running lamps, front and rear camera, air suspension and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include 9 airbags, lane keep assist, adaptive cruise control, ABS, traction control, stability control, brake assist, blind spot detection and autonomous emergency braking (AEB).

The Ferrari F8 Spider replaced the 488 Spider in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 3.9-litre V8, and power is delivered via an updated 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Toyota Hiace has been the market leader for years in the UAE and continues to be a popular choice in the commercial sector, whether for transporting the work-force or cargo. There is only one engine choice in the Hiace, a 2.7-litre four cylinder petrol engine mated to a standard 5-speed manual, while some markets such as UAE occasionally get a 4-speed automatic option. The Saudi market additionally gets a 2.5-litre diesel model with a 5-speed manual. It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

The midsize Toyota Camry sedan has been redesigned heavily for 2012, so the 2014 refresh only brings minor trim changes. A 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic is standard, and it makes a little less horsepower on the base model than in the rest of the range, as it is the only one to receive a single exhaust tip, while the other trims receive dual exhaust tips. The base model can be had with a manual gearbox in Saudi Arabia, but not in the UAE. In Qatar, a Camry variant with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic is being sold. Now available in four new trim levels, the base model also looks visibly different than the rest of the range, with its basic bumpers and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Known as S or GL, depending on market, it comes with a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags. The mid-range model, known as SE or GLX, also gets fake wood trim, dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, 17-inch alloys, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, and a "sport" front bumper, "sport" grille, rear boot spoiler and dual exhaust tips. Also available as an optional "Plus" package are stability control, sunroof, DVD, keyless start and navigation, although the mid-range specs vary between GCC countries. The top-spec "Sport" model, known as SE Limited in some markets, gets a unique rear bumper, paddle-shifters, stability control, leather seats, 17-inch alloys and fake metal cabin trim, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and DVD navigation. In terms of safety, all models get dual front airbags and ABS, but only some of the top trim levels get side airbags and stability control. For 2014, there is now a new top-spec trim level in some markets, called the Limited, with basic-style bumpers, chrome grille and trimmings, rear lip spoiler, leather, navigation, rear camera, and all other luxury as well as safety features available in the Sport trim. A limited edition RZ model went on sale in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain as well. It got a glossy black front grille and spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 17-inch glossy black alloy wheels, sporty headlamps and matte black fog lamp cover. It also comes with RZ decals on the doors and rear bumper.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is Mazda's excellent two-seat, rear-wheel-drive convertible sports car that was completely redesigned for the 2006 model year, but is available for the first time in the GCC from 2008. Powered by a high-revving 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, this little runner is mated to a six-speed manual. Only the version with the powered folding hard top is offered here. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 7 Bose speakers, power windows and Mirrors manual a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-card for keyless entry and ignition, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobilizer, and rollover hoops behind the seats. A bit pricey and a favourite among women, but a great alternative to German roadsters for carving up roads.

The Opel Corsa is the smallest offering from the German manufacturer in the Middle East market. It received a significant update to the exterior in 2015. The base model comes with a 4-cylinder 1.4-litre engine, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. There is a 3-door and 5-door hatchback version to choose from. Standard options include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, manual A/C, AM/FM radio, cloth upholstery and steel wheels. The higher models get a better entertainment system with a CD player and MP3/iPod/AUX support, and alloy wheels. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution.

The Dodge Durango was completely redesigned in 2011. Mildly facelifted for 2014 with a whole lot of LED lighting, the three-row crossover SUV is based on a stretched Jeep platform. There are now three trim levels, namely the base SXT V6 and SXT Plus V6, the Limited V6 and Limited V8, the R/T V8 and the Citadel V8. The carryover engines, a 3.6-litre V6 and a 5.7-litre V8, all now get a new 8-speed automatic with tiptronic as standard. The base model can be had in rear-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. All higher trim levels are all-wheel-drive, although only the V8 Hemi models get low-range gearing. The SXT model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, tri-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, built-in rechargeable torch, cargo cover, 6-speaker CD/DVD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with 30GB hard drive and audio jack, fog lamps, automatic headlights, hill-start assist and keyless entry. The Limited adds LED running lamps, leather steering wheel, remote start, front power seats with memory, Bluetooth, navigation, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, 9-speaker stereo with subwoofer, power liftgate, chrome roof rails, chrome mirrors with indicators, chrome exhaust tip, rear parking sensors, tyre pressure display, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, and rear-view camera. The R/T model adds leather seats, 20-inch wheels, power-adjustable steering wheel, heated first and second-row seats, HID headlights, body-colour exterior trim, sports suspension, rain-sensitive wipers and more. The top Citadel model adds 20-inch chrome alloys, bigger brakes, heated steering wheel, Nappa perforated leather, ventilated front seats, HID headlights, sunroof, blindspot monitor & cross-path detection, forward collision warning and adaptive cruise control. Some of the Citadel's features seem to be optionally available on the lower trim levels. Standard safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, rain brake support, anti-theft alarm, active headrests and a tyre-pressure monitor.

Named after Mitsubishi's famed now-dead sports car, the Eclipse Cross is an economical crossover with no sporting pretensions beyond its sharply sloping rear roofline. Powered by a 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and a choice of front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, the Eclipse Cross seats five and is based on the Outlander platform, just like the brand's ASX crossover. The rear seat reclines and slides front-back as needed, to increase legroom or boot space. It has the all modern amenities available, such as power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry and start, multimedia screen, and more. It rides on a choice of 16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include ABS with EBD, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor and dual front with optional side-curtain airbags.

The son of the Orient is the most impressive to look at. The design seems derivative, but is largely original and non-offensive, though what is under the hood is outsourced from Mitsubishi. Boasting the most advanced engine in this raggedy range, it comes with only an automatic transmission in this region. The underpowered 2.4-litre engine is of the same design as the one that did duty in various large Mitsubishi models in the past. There is also a 2.0-litre engine that has almost as much power as the 2.4-litre. With a Delphi ABS system and four airbags, it does not skimp on safety items, and with options such a visual reverse sensor, a 3-screen DVD stereo system, a CD changer, an automatic thermostatic air-conditioner and 8-way adjustable power leather seats, you'd be hard-pressed to find better value anywhere else, even among the Koreans. Other options on this front-wheel-drive compact include an electric sunroof, keyless entry and even GPS navigation. We just hope it is not loaded with a map of mainland China.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S 65 AMG gets a mid-cycle refresh, in line with the rest of the S-Class range, with ever-so-subtle design changes. The most significant changes for the S65 AMG include a new transmission, and ends with a slightly redesigned front-fascia and DRL's. It is still propelled by a 6.0-litre twin-turbocharged V12 engine, and is now mated to an all-new 9-speed automatic transmission. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. Theres also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

The Isuzu MU-X is the brand's only SUV offering. It is basically a rebadged Chevrolet Trailblazer, but with a diesel engine. It gets the 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.Features on the higher trim levels include 16-inch alloys, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more.

The Grand Marquis is the longest running Mercury-badged vehicle ever. The mechanical underpinnings date back to the 70s, but a revision in 2003 involved a new frame, a revised independent front suspension, a new steering rack and rear suspension tuning. More updates in 2005 included a facelifted exterior, interior trim changes and more convenience features.The Grand Marquis is powered by a heavily detuned version of the Mustang's 4.6-litre V8 powerplant, mated to a four-speed automatic. If not obvious yet, the Grand Marquis is just a rebadged version of the Ford Crown Victoria. Features include three-person bench seats front and back, optional leather trim, a new instrument panel, burl woodgrain, a two-tone colour package and standard power windows. It is available in the Middle East in GS, GS Convenience, GS-L, LS Premium, LSE and LS Ultimate trims, at last count. A handling package, optional on GS and LS series, aims to improve the boat-like drive with 16-inch  aluminium wheels, a 3.27 axle, heavy duty rear stabiliser bar and rear air suspension with unique springs. Safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The Infiniti Q30 is Nissan's first entry in the premium compact hatchback category. Sharing a front-wheel-drive platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it shares engines with its joint-venture German cousin as well, including the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor. Standard options in the Q30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, infotainment system with touch screen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year, to replace the CL-Class. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class Coupe features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. It got a facelift for the 2018 model year. The Mercedes-Benz S500 Coupe comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine.. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class Coupe gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

Big and conservative, the Kia Mohave is supposed to strengthen Kia's "family" SUV line-up and brand image in the world market. With a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated with the 5-speed automatic transmission and a 4.6-litre V8 available with a 6-speed auto in some GCC markets such as Qatar, the Kia Mohave is characterized by fully-independent air suspension and its various safety systems, including the ABS brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), brake assist, stability control, traction control, and front and side airbags. Furthermore, the Mohave is equipped with Downhill Assist Control, keeping the vehicle's speed steady while going down straight and strong slopes, while a Hill-Start Assist Control is also available. The Mohave comes with a 600W stereo with six-CD changer, seven-seater capability, cloth or leather trim, DVD player, reverse camera and all the usual power accessories. The Mohave rides on a  truck-like body-on-frame platform and comes with four-wheel-drive and low-range gearing, which allows it to be classified as an off-road vehicle by default.

The Chevrolet Aveo sedan is built in Korea. An all-new model came out in 2017. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Three trim levels are on offer - a base, LS and LT. The standard model gets steering wheel controls, Bluetooth, radio and phone handsfree controls, driver and passenger dual air bags, 15-inch steel wheels and front power windows. The LS trim gets addtiional 4-way driver seat adjuster, rear park assist, rear seat full folding, 40/60 split, front fog lamps and optional 15-inch alloy wheels. The LT trim gets additional 7-inch MyLinkTM screen with phone integration, 6 speakers and 15-inch alloy wheels.

The Mercedes-Benz R-Class got a facelift in 2011. Packed under the hood are rather powerful engines, but that hardly makes it a sporting vehicle. Models from 2011 onwards include the new R 300, the R 350 and the upgraded R 500, most available only in long-wheelbase trim here. Amazingly, it is very hard to tell the difference between long and short models. Originally available only as a luxurious six-seater, the R-Class is now optionally available with five or seven seats too. Sadly, few on the road recognise its eccentricity and price tag, so it gets as much respect in public as a typical cargo hauler. Features include a 7-speed automatic transmission, cruise control with variable speed limiter, automatic climate control and all-wheel-drive. Options include a panoramic sunroof, air suspension and navigation. Standard safety features include the anticipatory occupant protection system PRE-SAFE, a complete restraint system with eight airbags, crash-responsive NECK-PRO front head restraints, a tyre pressure loss warning system and adaptive brake lights.

The McLaren 675LT Spider is a special model, limited to just 500 units. It is based on the 650S but is more powerful, lighter and track-focused.The exterior includes a newly designed front splitter, Formula 1-style nose end-plates and larger 'Longtail' Airbrake. The rear deck is also new. These bodywork changes contribute to a significant increase in downforce levels, up 40 percent over the 650S. Weight has been reduced by 100 kg through the increased usage of carbon-fibre and by lighter components throughout, including newly developed suspension geometry derived from the McLaren P1. The windscreen is 1 mm thinner, saving 3 kg, while the rear bulkhead glass is 0.5 mm thinner, saving a further 500 g. The weight saving measures also include a louvred polycarbonate engine cover. These revisions to the glazing save a combined 4.7 kg. The cabin is upholstered in lightweight Alcantara, and features a four-speaker Meridian hi-fi and a satellite navigation system as standard. Front and rear track are widened over other Super Series models by 20 mm, improving grip levels and agility, while the front ride height has been lowered by 20 mm over the 650S. Gear changes are upto twice as face, thanks to Ignition Cut technology, a technique adopted from Formula 1 which sees a momentary cut of the fuel spark on gearshift.

Hyundai's Genesis G70 is the Korean carmaker's attempt at cracking the entry-level premium sports sedan niche. Starting off with a shortened platform derived from the Kia Stinger, the compact sedan appears to derive a lot from its rivals and brings nothing new to the table, aside from offering a bit more power, based on preliminary reports. The engines on offer include a 2.0-litre turbo four and a 3.3-litre twin-turbo V6, both mated to 8-speed automatics. Features include LED lighting, an 8-inch touch screen, electronic shifter. available 15-speaker Lexicon audio system, Apple CarPlay and a heads-up display. Safety features include the usual set of airbags, ABS, ESP and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as active-driving aids such as adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane-departure warning, etc.

The Passat CC, better known as just the CC in the GCC, received a facelift for the 2013 model. The CC utilises a common platform with the Passat, including the same engines, mechanicals and interior components. Standard engine choices include a 1.8-litre and a 2.0-litre, with a 7-speed and 6-speed DSG automanual respectively. Both TSI engines are turbocharged 4-cylinder units. A naturally aspirated 3.6-litre V6 engine is offered as well with a 6-speed DSG automanual and all-wheel drive. Features include fabric or leather upholstery in various colours, sports seats, common power accessories, 17-inch alloy wheels, adaptive suspension, electrically-adjustable driver's seat, auto-dimming mirror, 'Press & Drive' starter with keyless entry, front and curtain airbags for front and rear passengers including side airbags, electric parking brake with hill-hold control, stability control, ABS, rain-sensing wipers, tyre pressure monitor and more. Options include various wood and aluminium cabin trims, automatic a/c, cruise control, reverse camera, Xenon headlights with bending feature, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, panoramic sunroof, and various stereo options that include CD/MP3, Bluetooth phone, six-disc changer and AUX inputs. Park Assist, Automatic Distance Control and Lane Assist features are also optionally available.

GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Yukon gets many upgrades, including a new platform and a better-designed interior. A beefy Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Yukon, with better fuel economy to boot. It still had the aging 4-speed automatic though. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include power windows, electric mirrors and additional power equipment, along with a folding third-row seat. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, Yukon is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Yukon XL is the long-wheelbase GMC version of the Suburban, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. The Denali version adds a 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto, chrome trim and some luxury interior features, but loses off-road gearing.

An all-new model of Nissan Altima was revealed for 2019. The sixth generation model features an upgraded 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, but the V6 has been replaced with a 2.0-litre turbocharged motor. Both engines are connected to a CVT automatic and front-wheel-drive platform. The platform itself has gained wheelbase length, which translates to more cabin space. The 2019 Altima will be offered in a range of trim levels – S, SV and SL in the 2.5L and SV, SL grades in 2.0L Turbo, although not all trims may be offered in all GCC markets. Available new features include upgraded seats with added bolstering, an updated infotainment system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto as well as an 8-inch multi-touch colour display, blind-spot monitoring with Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Automatic Emergency Braking with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Departure Warning and High Beam Assist, aside from the usual smart keyless entry and start, full set of airbags, ESP, tyre-pressure monitor, the usual power accessories and more.

The Cruze is Chevrolet's latest Korean-built compact model. Designed from the ground up, the Cruze first became available as a sedan, and later as a hatchback as well since 2011. The front-wheel-drive sedan features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a 5-speed manual or a class-leading 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

This 4th generation of the long-running 3-Series remained BMW's best-selling car, and with good reason. Ignoring the 3-Series Compact that was based on an older platform, this iteration of the 3-Series came in sedan, coupe and convertible forms, as well as in wagon trim that never came to the GCC. These variations were enough to solidify this model as the arguably the top-selling entry-luxury car in the market. While lower models managed with cloth upholstery, steel wheels and basic power accessories, the higher trim levels enjoyed leather, premium CD stereo, navigation, alloy wheels, sunroof and other amenities. While all models were rear-wheel-drive, some markets may have gotten a few all-wheel-drive versions of the various models. Manual and automatic transmissions were standard, but some markets may also have automanual gearboxes on some higher models. The sedan debuted in 1999, followed by the coupe in 2000, with 2.0-litre, 2.2-litre, 2.5-litre and 2.8-litre engines, along with 318i, 320i, 323i and 328i designations respectively, and 2-door models getting "Ci" badging instead of "i" at the end. The year 2001 brought about the hot 3.2-litre M3 version, available in 2-door form only, while all other models got new engines and names, such as upgraded 2.5-litre 325i and new 3.0-litre 330i alongside the existing 318i and 320i. A minor front-end facelift came in 2002 for all models except the M3. A lightweight M3 CSL with an upgraded engine was briefly available unofficially. While the sedan was replaced by an all-new model by 2006, the coupe and convertible continued well into 2006 before their new versions came out.

The Audi Q8 is the German luxury brand's answer to the BMW X6 and Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe. Under the hood, it gets a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine, mated to a 8-speed transmission. Standard features in the all-wheel drive Q8 include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. It comes standard in 18-inch alloy wheels, which can go up to 21-inch alloy wheels, while optional equipment panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. The optional "Audi pre sense basic" initiates preventive protective measures for the occupants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts.

The Mercedes-Benz GLA-Class is a compact crossover offering. It is powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Cadenza has been redesigned for the 2014 model year. However, in the GCC it still comes with the same 3.5-litre "MPI" V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox from the previous model. Features, standard or otherwise, include a CD/MP3 stereo with six JBL speakers and iPod/USB support, 6-disc CD changer, cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 17-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes.

The Mercedes-Maybach, which was introduced back in 2015, got a facelift in 2018 and a power upgrade. The S650 Maybach is being sold in the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include a full panoramic sunroof, powered privacy shades for the rear windows, acres of leather trim, night-vision display in the LCD gauge-cluster, chrome-plated speaker grilles, fibre-optic ambient lighting, Burmester 3D surround sound, and back-lit tweeters on all the doors that spiral out on start-up, although these things can even be had in a standard S-Class, if you tick everything on the options list. The lounge-worthy rear seats both offer a full range of power adjustability, and includes extending calf-supports, a massaging function, heated/cooled cup-holders and a seat heating/cooling feature, while the right-side rear seat gets an additional footrest that can be motored out of the front passenger seatback for sleeping. It's so intricate that the dual LCD screens on the front seat-backs automatically adjust their angles as the front seats are adjusted, so the rear passengers always get the best view. The massage and multimedia features are controlled with a remote, with animated settings showing on the screens. Its "Magic Body Control" system that scans the road ahead for bumps and adjusts the suspension to drive over them as smoothly as possible. Further options include flip-out tray-tables and a fridge that comes with a pair of silver-plated champagne flute-glasses as well as space for three chilled bottles. Along with the front and side airbags, ABS, traction control, the Mercedes-Maybach can be added with PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, Brake Assist BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Night View Assist Plus. In the shape of the seat belt buckle extender, Beltbag (both part of the PRE-SAFE rear package) and seat cushion airbag.

The MG RX5 is the Chinese-British brand’s offering of a compact crossover. There will be a choice of two well-equipped trims with two available powertrains, namely a 1.5-litre with a 7-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic, both turbocharged. The front-wheel-drive 2019 MG RX5 is available with LED headlamps, two-tone 18-inch rims, high-quality cabin finish including soft-touch surfaces, opening panoramic sunroof, adjustable fold-flat rear seats with split/fold function, power tailgate, keyless entry, a start button and an auto-hold brake function. A remote smart app allows the driver to operate vehicle functions such as remote start and stop air conditioning, vehicle tracking and aftersales appointments, even reminding owners of the services needed for the car. There is a 10.4-inch high-definition infotainment touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and navigation on the 2.0T version and an 8-inch colour navigation system for 1.5T models. The 2019 MG RX5 comes with standard ESP and traction control, a curving braking control system and more. Passive safety features include a strengthened body structure that uses thermal formed steel, multiple airbags, automatic unlocking in the event of a collision and a collapsible steering column, all of which has helped the MG RX5 earn a 5-star rating in the Chinese C-NCAP crash tests.

The PT Cruiser is Chrysler's unique retro wagon, and it got a makeover inside and out with updated front and rear fascias, a new grille with Chrysler winged badge, new headlights, redesigned taillights, round fog lights and a new discrete spoiler on the tailgate roof. The PT receives an all-new interior to add refinement to the versatility. This new interior includes new seat materials, a new larger three-dial instrument panel colour-coded to the exterior paintwork, and an analogue clock, of all things. The versatile PT has a tall profile that gives it a high seating position and tons of interior space. The interior can be arranged in 32 different seating configurations. This front-driven wagon is powered by either a 2.0-litre or a 2.4-litre engine, with a choice of five-speed manual or an optional four-speed automatic transmission featuring driver-adaptive shift logic along with AutoStick manual gear selection. The PT Cruiser continues to inspire other manufacturers to delve into the retro craze. Too bad the turbo models are not offered here. The standard PT Cruiser sold so slowly here that it was discontinued in the GCC long before it went out of production in America.

The undeniable mascot of the VW range, the car popularly known as the New Beetle isn't that new anymore, but still a weird head-turning cruiser. Launched in 1999, it hass received a few facelifts over the years, but is still essentially the same. Passengers must make some concessions for retro style. Interior ergonomics are not as good as that in a traditional car, and there isn't a lot of trunk space. But the Beetle does come in an assortment of bright colours, including sunflowery yellow and limey green. Its exterior and interior design details are fun and creative, but very much on the feminine side. On the road, the Beetle is smooth and handles fairly okay. The convertible adds to the fun with its ability to drop the top. But the New Beetle hardly offers blistering performance, with a choice of 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre four-cylinder engines, with either a manual or an automatic. All Beetles are well equipped, with an AM/FM/cassette stereo, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual airbags, power exterior mirrors and windows, among others. Options include a CD changer and electronic stability control.

The luxury car of the Kia range, the Opirus is a large front-wheel-drive sedan aiming for the entry-level luxury segment. Its most obvious feature is the mixed-salad styling, though it has been improved for 2007, with a less prominent grille and a redesigned rear end. This front-wheel-drive comes with a new 3.8-litre V6 and a five-speed automatic gearbox with manual shift capability. Features, standard or otherwise, include a radio cassette player with MP3 and 8 speakers, ABS brakes, standard front and side airbags, leather, power driver's seat with electric lumbar support, power passenger's seat, electric power steering, keyless entry system, auto light control system, fake wood grain, front fog lamps, power door locks, power windows, power mirrors, audio controls on the steering wheel, immobilizer, battery saver, active head restraint, cup holders front and back, body-coloured  exterior trim, 17-inch alloy wheels, and automatic air-conditioning with dual independent controls.

The GMC Yukon got a new 6-speed automatic transmission from 2009 onward and also the Yukon Denali got a slight power increase. A beefy Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Yukon, with better fuel economy to boot. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include power windows, electric mirrors and additional power equipment, along with a folding third-row seat. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, Yukon is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Yukon XL is the long-wheelbase GMC version of the Suburban, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. The Denali version adds a 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto, chrome trim and some luxury interior features, but loses off-road gearing.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2015 model year and will now be available only as a 4-door sedan. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

An all-new Cadillac CT5 made its debut in 2020, replacing the CTS. In the GCC, the CT5 gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CT5 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE entertainment system with 10-inch screen and BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The X6 M debuted in late 2009, with a higher-tuned turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 than the regular X6. The M has a 6-speed auto with proper paddle-shifters. Features include iPod / USB adapter interface, Active Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Departure Warning, Active Steering, running boards, Head-Up Display, 4-zone automatic climate control, side-view cameras, top-view camera, leather-covered dashboard, full keyless entry, and smartphone integration. The M gets 20-inch wheels with performance tyres, Adaptive Drive system, M door sill plates, M driver footrest, M steering wheel and M aerodynamic enhancements. It also gets  features such as sports suspension, 'M' driving mode, paddle-shifted quicker-response automatic, launch control and a body kit.

The Renault Talisman replaces the Safrane in the French-brand's lineup. Under the hood, the Talisman gets two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT and a turbocharged 1.6-litre motor connected to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the base Talisman PE model include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors with demisting function, central locking, keyless entry, automatic dual zone A/C with rear vents, automatic wipers, steering wheel with audio/Bluetooth/voice command controls, multi-information display, fabric seats, 4.2-inch screen with AM/FM, USB, AUX, audio streaming via Bluetooth and voice command/recognition for phone, 6 speakers and 16-inch alloy wheels. The SE model gets additional daytime running lamps, fog lamps, Renault Multi-Sense system, central jog-dial, speed limiter and cruise control, height adjustable passenger seat, electric folding side mirrors, Renault R-Link multimedia system with 7-inch touchscreen, navigation, 3D sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, AM/FM, 2 USBs, AUX, audio/photo streaming via Bluetooth, voice command/recognition for phone, navigation, media and text-to-speech, refrigerated storage in front centre console armrest, rear power socket, higher quality upholstery and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 1.6TC SE model gets all of the above, plus engine start-stop, acoustic windscreen, smart engine management and twin chrome exhaust tips. The top 1.6TC LE model gets added goodies such as LED headlights, LED taillights, LED interior lamps, parking assist, 7-inch TFT digital instrument cluster, push engine start-stop button, power seats with memory function and lumbar support, auto sliding seats for easy entry and exit, rear-glass sunblind, Renault R-Link 2 multimedia system with 8.7-inch touchscreen, 3D sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, AM/FM, 2 USBs, 1 SD card, AUX, audio/photo streaming via Bluetooth, voice command/recognition for phone, navigation, media and text-to-speech, leather upholstery, wood accents, panoramic sunroof, front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, stability control, brake assist, hill-start assist and traction control. The higher models get side airbags, while only the top LE model gets blind sport monitor, moving object detection and flank guard protection.

The CCX is the latest mid-engined supercar from Swedish manufacturer Koenigsegg. It is an evolutionary design that replaced the original Koenigsegg CCR. The removable roof can be stored in the front cargo area of the carbon-fibre and kevlar-reinforced body. This new model has been designed to be more practical, so its scissor-doors reveal a cabin with Sparco sports seats and decent headroom. While previous Koenigsegg models were powered by a Ford Modular V8 engine sourced from America, the CCX engine was designed in-house, based on the Ford Modular architecture and assembled by Grainger & Worrall, a British outfit that produces drivetrain components for Formula 1 cars. The engine is a 4.7-litre V8 boosted by two centrifugal superchargers and mated to a 6-speed manual. A vortex-generator behind the seats and a flat underbelly improve downforce, while a rear spoiler is optional. Large 19-inch front and 20-inch rear magnesium-alloy wheels are standard. Also standard are electronically-adjustable ride height, climate control, electric mirrors, leather interior, central locking, power windows, alarm with immobilizer, toolkit, driver-side airbag, power steering, ABS brakes, traction control and a CD stereo. Options include custom-colour leather, custom paint, parking sensors, navigation, rearview camera, carbon-fibre wheels and fitted luggage. CCX is an abbreviation for Competition Coupe X. The X refers to the 10th anniversary of the completion and test drive of the first Koenigsegg vehicle in 1996.

The fourth-gen Audi A8 debuted as a 2018 model, lighter and filled with even more complicated technology than before. The initial powertrain offering for the GCC will be a 3.0-litre "TFSI" turbo V6, but a 4.0-litre TFSI turbo V8 follows later, and there will also be a 6.0-litre W12 for those who want one on special order. The new A8 has a suspension system that uses actuators to individually raise and lower each wheel to keep the car as flat as possibly over bumpy roads, and uses a camera that scans the road ahead to basically pre-set the suspension accordingly. Audi claims the new A8 is the first production car to offer Level 3 automated driving at speeds of up to 60 kph, but only on highways where a physical barrier separates you from cars travelling in the opposite direction. Other features include variations of adaptive cruise control, lane-departure assist and all that. Up front, Audi has more or less done away with buttons and switches via a 10.1-inch touchscreen display which, when off, blends almost invisibly into the high-gloss black surround. The user interface comes to life as soon as the car is opened. There’s also a secondary touchscreen display in the centre console to control air-con functions and make text inputs. Audi is also offering an optional ‘relaxation seat’ in the A8 L that adjusts four ways and has a footrest that incorporates both warming and massaging functions for aching soles. Other rear-seat features include matrix reading lights, in-seat massage function and a smartphone-mimicking remote control.

Zhengzhou Nissan Automobile Company, established in 1993 and located in Zhengzhou in central China, is a 50/50 joint venture between DongFeng Group and Nissan. The ZNA Oting is a product of that affair, dating back to 2007. However, the Oting 5-seater SUV is based on the decade-old first-generation Nissan Xterra, only with a different front end and an underpowered 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Sold only in the UAE for now, only one trim level is available with rear-wheel-drive, although the four-wheel-drive version may make an appearance later. The rear-seat bench folds flat to increase cargo room. Standard features include front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, adjustable steering column, remote locks, power windows, leather seats, power mirrors, roof rack, side-steps, CD/MP3 stereo with SD card, power antenna, 16-inch alloy wheels, body-colour bumpers, manual a/c, rear parking sensors and one airbag.

Introduced in 2004, the Jazz got a minor update and a new engine for 2006. Honda claims that the new Jazz rewrites the small car concept, offering benchmark space, functionality, style, performance, fuel economy and world class safety. It is at least partially true, considering the car was created by two design teams, one from Japan and another from Germany. Their innovations have led to a vehicle which is fun to drive and versatile too, though very dorky to look at. It is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic from 2006, but it is the space that Honda is touting. During the design process, every part of the Jazz was examined for space efficiency. Engineers have even located the fuel tank beneath the front cabin floor to make efficient use of cabin space. Therefore by centrally locating the fuel tank, Honda has boosted body rigidity, increased crash protection in all directions as well as improved protection of the fuel tank. Jazz has a range of standard features that include driver and passenger airbags, anti-lock brakes, CD player and unique "Magic Seats", though it does skimp on interior materials, and power windows are only available for the front.

For 2009, an underwhelming Audi S5 Quattro coupe model debuted, with a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed manual or an automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The new-for-2010 Honda Accord Crosstour is an American-built 5-door, 5-passenger crossover with a liftback profile and only one available trim level in the GCC. The Crosstour comes with a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a 5-speed paddle-shiftable automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. Standard features include a CD/MP3 player with USB and AUX ports, automatic HID headlights, fog lights, automatic dual-zone climate control with rear ducts, cruise control, keyless entry, leather seats, driver's memory seat, electric mirrors, power windows, sunroof, rear wiper and 18-inch alloy wheels. In terms of versatility, the cargo area comes with a carpeted floor that can be turned over to become a rubberised floor for dirty items, under which is a big compartment to hide stuff in. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags as well as stability and traction control, ABS disc brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and child-seat compatibility.

The Maxima was a hot car when it was first unveiled in this iteration. However, Nissan's GCC division chose to let this model stagnate to the point where it was easily overshadowed by the newer Altima, even when the Maxima was redesigned in other markets and transformed into a luxury cruiser. The GCC-spec Maxima also still uses Nissan's older version of the corporate V6, with a displacement of 3.0-litre, combined with front-wheel-drive, and with a choice of five-speed manual and four-speed auto gearboxes. Performance is very respectable even after all these years. It comes with automatic air-conditioning, CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, ABS-assisted disc brakes, cloth seats, front airbags and many wheel choices, depending on model. The basic model gets 15-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include an in-dash CD changer with subwoofer, cruise control, sunroof, rear electric sunshade and leather cabin trim. Changes from year to year largely involve a new grille style every few years.

The Nissan Sunny got a facelift for the 2015 model year. It remained the same for the 2017 model year. The Sunny sedan comes from India, and is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT. The basic 'S' model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, AUX jack, cloth upholstery, trip computer and a black grille surround. The 'SV' model, identified by a chrome grille surround and door handles, adds power mirrors, front power windows, keyless entry, upgraded cloth seats and hubcaps, with an optional comfort package that adds fog lights, rear power windows, rear fan vents, parking sensors, more speakers and a central rear armrest. The top 'SL' model comes only in automatic, with 15-inch alloys, Bluetooth, steering-wheel stereo controls, nicer gauges with more readings, push-start, Display Audio system with Facebook support, cloth trim on the doors, LED side mirrors, rear spoiler and mud guards. All models get dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, brake assist, and seatbelts for all five seating positions.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 is a facelifted model which came out in 2013. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

Hyundai unveiled the completely new Elantra in 2012, and the car continues with minor changes for 2014. The spacious 5-seater is offered with either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre in most markets, both 4-cylinder engines mated to a standard 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. Some GCC markets, such as Saudi Arabia, get a 2.0-litre instead of the 1.8-litre, with an automatic gearbox. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The all-new Maserati Quattroporte is larger and lighter than before, with new engine offerings, namely a 3.0-litre V6 in the Quattroporte S and a 3.8-litre V8 in the Quattroporte GTS, both twin-turbocharged direction-injection units built by Ferrari, but using some Chrysler-derived parts. Both have an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive for the GCC market. The all-new architecture retains its 50:50 weight distribution, double-wishbone front suspension, and a five-link rear suspension. The more-spacious interior can be had with both four-seat and five-seat layouts. Cabin features include a Chrysler-sourced 8.4-inch touchscreen, adjustable pedals, reversing cameras and the optional 15-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system, as well as WLAN-based WiFi and Bluetooth compatibility. The screen includes navigation, reverse camera, DVD player, audio and ventilation functions. Adaptive cruise control, smart key with push-button start, front-side airbags and a dual-zone climate control system with 13 ventilation ports, complete the list of standard features.

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the MDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, roof rack, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power seats with lumbar support, 3 rows for 7 seaters, 3-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 12 speakers, DVD player with Dolby Pro Logic II (PL2)/MP3/WMA/USB/AUX support & 100 GD hard-disk, handsfree telephone with voice recognition, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard. The higher model gets adaptive cruise control, premium MILANO leather and bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the MDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), traction control, hill-start assist and trailer stability assist. The higher model gets additional blind spot information, crash mitigation brake system & forward collision warning system.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The Mercedes-Benz G500 is fitted with 5.5-litre V8 engine and is now been fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's midsize sedan offering. Only sold in some GCC countries, the Insignia gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with front-wheel-drive. Some features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, heated leather seats with memory, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, daytime running lights, fog lamps and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, lane-departure warning, ESP and ABS.

The redesigned-for-2008 CTS 4-door sedan continues externally unchanged for 2010. Not including the CTS-V, the CTS for 2010 has a rearranged set of engine choices. Alongside the mainstay 3.6-litre direct-injection V6 is a new 3.0-lire V6 direct-injection base engine. The V6 engines only come with a 6-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterized by a larger chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 17-inch to 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced.

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Volkswagen is attempting to move upscale and the Phaeton is its new flagship luxury sedan, built alongside its platform-mate, the Bentley Continental GT. The VW Phaeton is available in three models, namely a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a 6.0-litre W12, all mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission and all impressively powerful. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a navigation system, all-wheel drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies. Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

The X6 is what you get when you chop the top off an X5. It is dubbed the world's first "Sport Activity Coupe," which unfortunately abbreviates down to "SAC." While still technically a 4WD, the new-for-2009 X6 comes in two models, namely the XDrive35i and the XDrive50i, both being powerful high-end models, in keeping with its exclusive nature. It is therefore powered by either a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 or a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8, both mated to 6-speed manually-shiftable automatics. The X6 gets a new all-wheel drive system, without low-range gearing, but improving on-road handling. Redesigned to be shorter in height than its practical sibling, the X6 offers seating for only four in its chop-top cabin. A whole host of features include standard bi-xenon headlights, BMW's controversial iDrive computer, 19-inch alloy wheels, run-flat tyres, tyre-pressure monitor, 10-way power front seats, and new leather colour schemes. Other available features include active steering, automatic tailgate, adaptive headlights, rear-mounted DVD system, reverse-view camera, satellite-navigation, four-zone air-conditioning, and bigger rims. Standard safety features include front, side and side head airbags, and crash-activated front-seat headrests, as well as stability control, ABS and a fancy new driving aid called Dynamic Performance Control.

The Chrysler 300 got a facelift in 2015. The new 300 is rear-wheel-drive and gets a 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual capability. The base model gets cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. Higher trim levels additionally come with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with an 8-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. Standard features include cruise control, 18-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inch wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry with starter button. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more.

The front-wheel-drive C5 is available in a 5-door sedan or a 5-door wagon form, both with upward-opening rear liftgates, and it can be credited with a smooth ride with lots of space, thanks to a restyling back in 2005 that also saw equipment levels upgraded and suspension modified to meet earlier criticisms of ride comfort. Sound-proofing and insulation have been improved too. The long front and rear overhangs makes the C5 look bloated, but its details make it stand out in a crowd. The engine line-up in this region consists of a 2.0-litre four-cylinder and a 3.0-litre V6. The 2.0-litre can be had with either a manual or an automatic, while the range-topping 3.0-litre comes with a six-speed tiptronic-style auto gearbox. The C5 features the latest Hydractive 3 version of Citroen's hydro-pneumatic suspension, with automatic height adjustment according to speed and terrain, and continuous alteration of characteristics to suit driving styles. This technically complex car comes with features such as automatic window-closing when it rains, rain-sensing wipers and adaptive headlights which 'bend' around corners and options like a lane-departure warning system, which vibrates the driver's seat if you drift over the white lines without indicating. Seven airbags are standard, along with traction control, ESP and ABS.

The Renault Megane got a facelift for its 2015 model year. Engine choices, all 4-cylinder, include a 1.6-litre with a 5-speed manual, an updated 1.6-litre with a CVT automatic, and a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The front-wheel-drive Megane is available in hatchback form, with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features in the hatchback include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

The 2-door Cerato Koup comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with a 4-speed automatic. In 2011, it got a 6-speed automatic. The interior feature in the Cerato that Kia is proud of seems to be a new "super vision" LCD cluster with reddish lighting with warning-message and trip-computer functionality. at the bottom of the cluster. Also available is a basic four-speaker audio system, with the option of six-speaker system that adds tweeters, plus a choice of three radio/CD players and the option of MP3 and iPod connectivity. Standard are power windows, electric mirrors, 15-inch wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery and central locking. Other available features in higher models include 17-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, automatic a/c, some chrome exterior trim, "super vision" gauge cluster, fog lamps, sunroof, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, aluminium pedals and automatic headlights. Safety is being downplayed again, as the basic Cerato comes with a single driver's airbag. The higher model gets ABS, active headrests and rear disc brakes instead of drums. Side-curtain airbags and stability control, though not initially available, became standard on the top-spec model later.

The Hyundai Sante Fe comes to the UAE and GCC as a seven-seater version. It remains the same for the 2018 model year. While it competes with compact crossover SUVs, it is only slightly smaller than most midsize SUVs. It comes with a choice 2 engines - the 'Theta' 4-cylinder 2.4-litre and the 'Lambda' V6 3.3-litre. Two-wheel drive is standard in the 2.4-litre base model, while all the other trims are in four-wheel drive in the higher 2.4-litre and 3.3-litre models. Some of the optional features include panoramic sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, reverse camera, leather seats, memory seats with cooling & heating for front passengers, memory package for mirrors with auto folding, smart key with engine start, automatic lights and rain sensing wipers. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution(EBD) and traction control.

The Peugeot 508 midsize sedan is an all-new model that debuted in 2012, replacing the 407 as well as the 607 at once. The only engine on offer for this front-wheel-drive sedan is a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic mode. The base model features 16-inch alloy wheels, LED running lights, auto a/c, power windows, electric folding mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth, cruise control with speed limiter, fog lamps, and a cooled glove box. The mid-range model adds 17-inch alloys, power seats, dual-zone a/c, one-touch power windows, AUX port for the stereo, auto-dimming mirror and rear parking sensors. The top "Allure" model gets 18-inch alloys, four-zone a/c, turning HID headlights, navigation, 8-speaker JBL stereo, sunroof, smart keyless entry with starter button, electric parking brake with hill assist, side and rear sun-blinds, heads-up display, leather and front-rear parking sensors with distance display. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and automatic hazard lights on emergency braking. All markets do not get all trim levels.

The Eos is a resurrection of the Golf convertible, only with a different name. Sharing design cues, platforms and engines with the Golf, it is touted to be the first car in the world to feature a five-piece retractable hardtop. The car can somewhat seat four people, with good luggage room when the top is up. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Eos is available in the Middle East with three engine options, namely two 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.2-litre V6, with choices of manual, automatic or DSG automanual, depending on model.  All models are well equipped, with a CD stereo, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front airbags, side airbags, lateral airbags, a roll-bar safety system, stability control, power mirrors and windows, among others.

The Rio is Kia's sub-compact nameplate that started life in 2000. It can always be depended on for the most unique exterior designs in this segment. This generation of the Rio debuted in 2006 and received a minor frontal facelift in 2010, before being replaced in 2012. The interior offers decent space for its size, although the cabin is a hard plastic tomb, like most others in its class. Powered by a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive runabout comes in either sedan or hatchback body styles. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, 14-inch steel wheels with full wheel covers, battery saver, wind-up windows and AM/FM radio cassette player. Higher models add a few items, such as body-coloured outer trimmings and power windows, along with electric mirrors, front fog lamps, driver's seat height adjustability, luggage undertray and central door locks. We could not verify what safety features are available besides seat belts, although we believe many markets get ABS brakes and front airbags, standard or otherwise.

The Patrol is Nissan's most capable 4WD in its lineup. It is a big 4WD that dates back to the 1992 version, relaunched with a new skin in 1998. It has garnered a reputation as an excellent off-road vehicle in the Middle East, even though it has been fighting a losing battle with the overrated Toyota Land Cruiser for decades now. It is also popular for its reasonable on-road ride, though its handling leaves a lot to be desired. The 4.8-litre inline six-cylinder came for 2002, alongside the older 4.5-litre inline-six which eats more fuel, and the frugal diesel 4.2-litre inline-six. A 4-speed automatic with manual sequential shift facility is available on petrol models alongside the 5-speed manual. The latest updates give the Patrol an edgier new front end and freshened rear end. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The latest Patrol has an all-new interior featuring better quality materials and more equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, it has room for seven. Front airbags are standard, among other features.

For 2012, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class received engine upgrades for some models. The models to choose from are the E 200, E 250, E 300, E 350 and E 500. The E 200 and E 250 get a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. The E 300 gets a 3.0-litre V6 whereas the E 350 is fitted with a 3.5-litre V6 engine. The E 500 has a 4.7-litre under the hood. They all have a 7-speed automatic transmission. The E-Class Cabriolet has much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door format.  An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Trooper was Isuzu's first well-known 4WD vehicle, and is a vehicle that was very competitive in terms of looks and features, but never caught on due to poor marketing and even poorer dealer support. It came in 3-door and 5-door body styles, both five-seaters, although both looked very similar to each other, except for the number of doors. While previous Trooper models were basic utilitarian offroaders, this version actually was well-endowed with basic luxury features of the time. This particular model line ended in 2002, at which point Isuzu discontinued its passenger-vehicle line and concentrated on work trucks. The Trooper came with an acceptable 3.5-litre V6, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. All trims had standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. Available features included cloth or leather interior, power windows, electric mirrors, monotone or two-tone paintjob, sunroof, cassette stereo with CD changer, cruise control and alloy wheels. Safety features included four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and front airbags.

The Hyundai Elantra Coupe was launched by the end of 2012 in some GCC markets, and continues unchanged for 2015. It comes with two 4-cylinder engine choices, either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Peugeot 301 is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. While claiming class-leading cabin and boot space, the Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

Big and conservative, the Kia Mohave is supposed to strengthen Kia's "family" SUV line-up and brand image in the world market. With a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated with the 5-speed automatic transmission and a 4.6-litre V8 available with a 6-speed auto in some GCC markets such as Qatar, the Kia Mohave is characterized by fully-independent air suspension and its various safety systems, including the ABS brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), brake assist, stability control, traction control, and front and side airbags. Furthermore, the Mohave is equipped with Downhill Assist Control, keeping the vehicle's speed steady while going down straight and strong slopes, while a Hill-Start Assist Control is also available. The Mohave comes with a 600W stereo with six-CD changer, seven-seater capability, cloth or leather trim, DVD player, reverse camera and all the usual power accessories. The Mohave rides on a truck-like body-on-frame platform and comes with four-wheel-drive and low-range gearing, which allows it to be classified as an off-road vehicle by default.

An all-new BMW X6 launched as a 2020 model year. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission.
