Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Toyota RAV4 got a complete redesign for 2013, with a new styling language, a new drivetrain, and new features. The existing platform has been updated with new suspension tuning, while the standard engine now is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. There is also a choice of front-wheel-drive with limited-slip diff or all-wheel-drive with 50:50 lock mode. New items in this 5-seater crossover include a lift-up tailgate with the spare wheel now stored under the boot floor. In the UAE, the 2WD is available in EX and EXR grades, while the AWD is sold in GX, GXR and VXR grades. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, fold-flat split rear seating and more. The base model gets cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic keyless entry and 17-inch steel wheels. Additional available features, depending on trim level, include smart keyless entry and start, LED running lamps, auto-dimming mirror, roof rails, cargo net, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, cruise control, dual-zone auto a/c, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Only the top 4x4 model gets touchscreen navigation, DVD player, rear camera, power driver's seat, sunroof and leather upholstery. All RAV4 models get two front airbags as well as ABS with EBD. Only the top 4WD model gets additional side and curtain airbags. The top two 4WD trims get stability control, brake assist, downhill assist, and hill-start assist.

The Toyota Hiace has been the market leader for years in the UAE and continues to be a popular choice in the commercial sector, whether for transporting the work-force or cargo. There is only one engine choice in the Hiace, a 2.7-litre four cylinder petrol engine mated to a standard 5-speed manual, while some markets such as UAE occasionally get a 4-speed automatic option. The Saudi market additionally gets a 2.5-litre diesel model with a 5-speed manual. It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

The new-for-2008 Volvo C30, the Swedish firm's entry-level attempt at capturing younger buyers, received a frontal facelift for 2010. This sporting hatchback has room for four average-sized adults and a range of competitive engines. It offers a fair bit of space inside, at least for the front passengers, and features very basic interior styling, save for a few unique touches such as the floating centre console. Available for 2010 are only two engines, both 5-cylinder, one being a 2.4-litre and the other a turbocharged 2.5-litre, both with automatic gearboxes and tiptronic functionality. By 2012, the only version available was the T5 R-Design. All versions are front-wheel-drive. Standard features include cloth upholstery, power windows, trip computer and CD audio. Standard safety features typical of Volvo include ABS brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, and a whiplash protection system. Options include alloy rims between 15-inch and 18-inch sizes, three levels of audio equipment, customisable centre console trim, stability control and a blind-spot warning system for inattentive drivers. A new R-Design package adds sportier suspension and a body kit.

The French-built Saxo was launched in 1996 to replace the CitroÃ«n AX. The car's platform, engines and major components were a development of the AX and were shared with the Peugeot 106, CitroÃ«n's unofficial sister company. The different trim levels and engine options in the Saxo range changed many times during the model's lifetime. Engines amd trims included a 1.4-litre, a 1.6-litre VTR and a tuned 1.6-litre VTS. The sporting VTR and VTS came with 14-inch alloy wheels, firmer suspension, sports seats and a body kit. The 2000 model year saw the introduction of this heavily-facelifted version and upgraded engines, even though the basic platform was already dated. The Saxo came as 3-door and 5-door hatchback models, and only the basic 1.4i model had an optional automatic available. Basics included a stereo, cloth cabin, front airbags and not much else.

Launched in 2005 and facelifted for 2008, the compact S40 sedan is based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the S40 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The S40 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre, a higher-tuned 2.4-litre and a turbocharged 2.5-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The redesigned-for-2011 Dodge Charger looks a bit like the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but feels like a completely different car compared to its predecessor. Identifiable by its larger snout and 164-LED tail lamps, the new rear-wheel-drive Charger features updated suspension, upgraded engines and a much nicer interior.The top model, the Charger SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Superbee SRT8 gained special graphics, but came with standard suspension rather than the full-spec SRT8's adaptive ones, along with fewer other features. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Citroen C3 is the sub-compact hatchback offering from the French brand. Only one engine choice is sold in the GCC, the naturally aspirated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the C3 include power steering, power windows, halogen headlamps, automatic A/C, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, AM/FM stereo with CD player and MP3 compatibility, front fog lamps and 16-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front passenger and driver airbags, curtain airbags, ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and emergency braking assistance (EBA), and automatic activation of hazard warning lights (in case of rapid deceleration, change of direction or impact).

The new Jeep Cherokee will offer both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, with a choice between a 2.4-litre "Tigershark" 4-cylinder and a new 3.2-litre "Pentastar" V6. A new 9-speed automatic transmission is standard on all models. It features four-wheel-independent suspension. There will be four different versions Sport, Longitude, Limited and Trailhawk. The last one is the most offroad-capable version and has Jeep's "Trail Rated" badges, and comes with a Selec-Terrain system, 1-inch lift and a locking rear differential. Other available features include a park-assist system that gives you directions on how to park into a particular space, an 8.4-inch touchscreen with optional navigation and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with auto-braking, and more.

The 2010 Bentley Continental GTC received a facelift and now had an upright front grille, larger lower air intake and chrome headlamp bezels. Mechanical improvements include Servotronic power steering for improved feedback and feel, radar"“based adaptive cruise control and optional carbon ceramic brakes.It gets the same twin turbocharged 6.0-litre W12 engine as the coupe and all-wheel drive is standard. It comes with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental GT convertible is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GTC Speed, introduced in 2010 adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling. Also introduced in 2010 is the Continental GT Supersports Convertible with even more power and capable of running on both petrol and biofuel. The Supersports had a more aggressive exterior, while mechanically it had revised suspension settings to make it more sporty, bigger ceramic brakes and an automatic retractable spoiler.

The Opel Insignia is the German manufacturer's midsize sedan offering. Only sold in some GCC countries, the Insignia Grand Sport gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine with front-wheel-drive. Some features include dual-zone automatic AC, sunroof, electronic parking brake, cruise control, ventilated leather seats with memory, infotainment system with an 8-inch screen and AUX/USB/Bluetooth connectivity, front and rear parking sensors, speed-sensitive power steering, rearview camera, daytime running lights, fog lamps and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, forward collision alert, lane-departure warning, lane keeping assist, ESP and ABS.

The second generation Porsche Panamera came out as a 2017 model year. The trims available in the GCC include the base Panamera, along with the, Panamera 4, Panamera 4 E-Hybrid Turbo S E-Hybrid. In 2019, the Panamera GTS and GTS Sport Turismo joined the range. The base model and the Panamera 4S gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6,  while the Panamera Turbo and Panamera GTS gets a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8. The Turbo S E-Hybrid gets a V8 4.0-litre turbo unit combined with an electric motor. Some updates on the new generation include an improved adaptive air suspension system and optional rear-axle steering. Inside, the interior gets a new instrument cluster with two 7-inch displays. The centre console gets a 12.3-inch touch screen, while the rear passenger get their own set of infotainment and climate controls. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

The Geely Emgrand GT is the Chinese brand's midsize sedan. Under the hood,it gets two engines. One is the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, and the other is the 3.5-litre V6, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features on the front-wheel drive Emgrand GT include hydraulic power steering, leather steering wheel, cruise control, ventilated discs in the front, 17-inch alloy wheels, panoramic sunroof, daytime LED, automatic headlamps, electric folding side mirrors, dual climate control a/c, rear a/c vents, keyless smart entry system, remote switch for opening/closing sunroof, parking sensors in the front and rear, reverse camera, driver memory function for the seat/steering/mirror and 8-speaker audio system, 8-inch infotainment system with GPS navigation, Bluetooth, SD card and AUX/USB ports. Safety features include front airbags with optional side/curtain/knee airbags, brake assist, ABS and EBD, traction control, electronic parking brake and hill-start assist control.

The Lexus ES, the luxury carmaker's bread-and-butter sedan, carries on with its comfort-biased approach and focus on convenience features. A new generation ES sedan came out in 2019. It comes with three engine options, a 4-cylinder 2.5-litre, a 3.5-litre V6, both mated to an 8-speed automatic, and a 2.5-litre coupled with an electric motor, connected to a CVT. All models are front wheel drive. The ES 250 model comes in one "Prlatinum" trim and features HID headlights, smart keyless entry and start, front-rear parking sensors, 18-inch alloys, moonroof, headlamp cleaner, leather interior, powered front seats, 8-speaker navigation, 12.3-inch screen with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, power-adjustable steering, and dual-zone auto a/c. The ES 350 "Prestige" adds the V6 engine, nicer leather, navigation, power rear sunshade and a blind-spot monitor. The "Platinum" adds a front screen, rear camera and a remote-touch computer. The "Titanium" further adds adaptive headlights, different wheels, panoramic glass roof, even semi-aniline leather, front ventilated seats, 3-zone a/c, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist and a pre-crash safety system. All models come with front, knee, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

The first ever GMC-badged compact 4WD isn't even a real GMC. The Terrain is a Korean product sold in Europe as an Opel and in America as a Saturn. However, it does complete the local range, giving GMC dealers their very own small soft-roader. The Terrain is available in SLE and SLT trims, while available engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.2-litre V6, both with a standard 5-speed automatic transmission offering rudimentary manual shifting capability. All-wheel-drive is standard, but there is no low-range gearing. Unlike its longer Chevy cousin, the Captiva-based Terrain seats five and does not offer third-row seating. However, the rear seat folds flat to extend the cargo area. Active and passive safety systems include stability control, hill descent control and active rollover protection, as well as dual-stage front and side-impact airbags, as well as head-curtain airbags. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD player, keyless entry, alloy wheels and more.

An all-new GMC Sierra was released as a 2014 model year. Exterior-wise, the styling carries pretty much the same DNA as the previous model but the new front fascia seems more imposing now. That is because they have added bigger headlights and a huge grille. GM consciously kept the design similar as, unlike the UAE where big pickup trucks are more of a statement, in the U.S. market it is a high volume seller among conservative buyers. A Z71 package is available which includes stronger shocks, front tow hooks and extra under-body protection. The interior is where the main changes will be, with the new 4.2-inch display on the dashboard. More soft-touch material has been added around the cockpit. The new Sierra pickups will have 12-volt outlets, five USB ports and a SD-card slot. A new 4.3-litre V6 engine adds to the family of 5.3-litre and 6.2-litre V8 motors. They will all be mated to a six-speed automatic. For improving fuel economy, the V8 engines have cylinder deactivation and direct injection.

A new generation model of the Kia Soul came in 2020. Engines are carried over from the previous model, being powered by a 1.6-litre mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The 2022 Kia Soul is available only as front-wheel-drive. The basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, roof rack mounting points, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth, split-folding rear seat, cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better infotainment system, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, luggage net, some extra trim and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of different two-tone interiors.

The Cayenne, the black sheep of the Porsche family, is a sporty 4WD that is surprisingly as capable on the road as it is off the road. Developed in conjunction with Volkswagen, it is available in three guises, namely the base Cayenne, the Cayenne S and the  Cayenne Turbo. All the models have been upgraded for the 2008 model year, adding a mid-level GTS model, and later reintroducing the top Turbo S version. The entry-level Cayenne has a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, the S and the lowered GTS versions uses two separate versions of the 4.8-litre V8, while the Turbo and Turbo S uses two turbocharged versions of the 4.8-litre V8. All versions utilise a four-wheel-drive system and a six-speed automatic gearbox, but a rare six-speed manual is available with the non-turbo models. The Cayenne models include traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and an active suspension system. An extensive equipment list includes leather upholstery, alarm system, central locking with remote control, on board computers, tinted glass, electric windows and wing mirrors, as well as a full set of front and side airbags. Options include a panoramic glass roof, reverse camera, various wheels, and different cabin-trim choices.

The Nissan Urvan has been a commercial success in the UAE for a long time, whether for transporting cargo or hauling the labour force. The Nissan Urvan NV350 is a facelifted model which came out in 2013. Consumers get two four-cylinder engine choices, either a 2.5-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbocharged diesel plant, both of which can only be had in a five-speed manual. The exterior can be had in the Panel Van or Window Van format with or without high roof. The panel van can be had in 3-seater or 6-seater format, while the micro-bus model is a 15-seater. Standard features include an AM/FM Cassette player, halogen lamps and 15-inch steel wheels.

The Hyundai Centennial is a full-size high-end luxury sedan that serves as the flagship model for the Korean manufacturer. Also known as the Equus elsewhere, it is the most expensive sedan in the company's lineup ever. This is the first time that it has ever been offered outside Korea. The new-for-2010 model comes with a rear-wheel-drive platform and V8 engine aimed to compete with the Germans. The styling is conservative and the naming is derivative, as the standard model with the 4.6-litre V8 goes by the badge Centennial VS460. Features include a 6-speed automatic, 3.5-inch display screen for the driver information system, parking cameras rear and front, HID headlights, Adaptive Front Lighting, electric parking brake, leather upholstery, sunroof, power seats with reclining rear ones, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry with push-button start, and all the usual power accessories. The Vehicle Stability Management includes the Lane Departure Warning System, Pre-Safety System and Smart Cruise Control. When a collision is detected, the system automatically applies full braking force and reels in the front seat belts. Other safety features include nine airbags, including two front, four side and two side curtain airbags, as well as a knee airbag.

The second-generation SLK, a hard-top convertible, boasts a better-looking design than its limited competition from Germany. Several details take their cue from Formula 1, like its arrow-shaped nose. The range starts with the 1.8-litre supercharged SLK 200 Kompressor, and goes up to V6 models such as the 3.0-litre SLK 280 and the new 3.5-litre SLK 350, while Mercedes-AMG builds the top 5.4-litre SLK 55 AMG. Standard equipment includes light-alloy wheels of various sizes, projection-beam headlamps, LED tail-lights, manual six-speed transmission on non-AMG models, stability control, remote control locking system and cruise control. Options, standard on high-spec models, include 18-inch alloy wheels, AMG bodystyling, Designo upholstery, sports suspension, speed-sensitive power steering, steering wheel gearshift buttons for the optional automatic transmission, bi-xenon headlamps with cornering light, parking sensors, electric seats with memory function, infrared remote control for the vario-roof, COMAND navigation system with DVD player, and a Harman/Kardon LOGIC7 surround-sound system with 11 speakers.

The fifth-generation BMW 7-Series was all-new for the 2009 model year and facelifted for 2013. The first models to be relaunched include the 730Li, the 740Li, the 750Li, and the 760Li, all long-wheelbase variants as most GCC dealers chose to import only the stretched models. The confusing naming convention continues, with the 740i and 740Li powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-6 engine and the 750i and 750Li powered by an updated 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, although the 730i and 730Li models get a naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre inline-6. The limited-availability 760Li gets a 6.0-litre turbo V12. Badge deception notwithstanding, all engines are capable performers, featuring Double-VANOS variable valve technology, direct injection, and a new 8-speed automatic. The range come equipped with EfficientDynamics technologies as standard, all aimed at improving fuel economy. All 7-Series can now be specified with a side-view camera system, Park Distance Control, two forward-facing cameras, night-vision system, a pedestrian recognition system, blind-spot warning, a heads-up display, speed-related active steering, variable air-suspension damping control, stability control, hill-start assistant, ABS, brake drying, brake-fade compensation, iDrive with larger 10.2-inch screen, instrument cluster with a high-resolution colour display, navigation, 8 GB hard drive, rear-seat DVD entertainment with integrated screens, four-zone automatic air-conditioning, multiple front and side-curtain airbags, optional rear-seat ventilation system with massage function, and other electronic gimmicks. All the usual luxury basics are obviously also included, such as leather, power accessories, sunroof and 18-inch or larger alloys.

An all-new model of the Mercedes-Benz A 45 AMG came out in 2020. It gets an upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, available in two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. All models are all-wheel-drive. The 5-seater hatchback's features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

This generation of the Subaru Forester debuted in 2015 and carries on unchanged except for a facelift and minor trim updates in 2017. Subaru continues to offer standard all-wheel-drive, while the only engine choice for the GCC is the 2.5-litre flat-6 engine. Subaru's 'symmetrical' AWD uses an electronically-controlled multi-plate transfer clutch system to actively manage power distribution on all four wheels, working in conjunction with the standard stability control system. While not a true offroader, ground clearance and approach angles have been increased for the new model. Built on the Impreza platform, the Forester comes with a CVT automatic. The basic 2.5i model comes with full power accessories, stability control, dual front airbags, cruise control, automatic a/c, CD player, ABS, fog lamps, roof rails and 16-inch wheels. The mid-range model adds alloy wheels and leather-wrapped controls. The top model gets a CD changer, full leather trim, sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, HID headlights, and a full set of side and curtain airbags.

Hyundai's first ever rear-wheel-drive sports car, the Genesis Coupe is a 2+2 seater was mildly revamped for 2013 with a new front end, new tail lamps and a nicer interior. It continues unchanged for 2015, aside from a sizeable price drop. The Genesis Coupe is based on the same rear-drive platform as found under the full-size Genesis sedan, but with almost five inches chopped out of the wheelbase. The Coupe features a MacPherson strut dual-link front suspension and a five-link rear suspension. The GCC-spec Genesis Coupe will only be available as a fully-optioned V6 automatic model. That means the two-door coupe will come with power windows, electric mirrors, 18-inch wheels, leather seats, cruise control, sunroof, HID headlights, 10-speaker Infinity audio and Brembo brakes. The 3.8-litre V6 engine is mated to a new 8-speed automatic. Safety features include dual front airbags with available side airbags, ABS and stability control. The "GDI" V6 manual and the base turbo 4-cylinder engines, as sold in other overseas markets, will not be offered as of now.

The Nissan Altima, released GCC-wide for 2005, is a roomy and practical midsize sedan, competing with the Honda Accord and Toyota Camry with slightly more sporty handling and a little more extrovert styling. The Altima however sits at the top of the class in terms of available horsepower and interior room. Though the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes, is enough for most people, it is the 3.5-litre V6, also with a choice of manual or automatic, that makes the Altima a cheap alternative to pricey and slow front-wheel-drive sports sedans from Volvo and Audi. The Altima delivers stunning acceleration when optioned with the V6, which is essentially the same engine used in the Nissan 350Z. The Altima also boasts a big interior. Standard features include power windows, tinted windshield, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, power steering, a 60/40 split folding rear seat and an in-glass antenna. Also available are power mirrors, remote keyless entry with remote trunk lock, optional electric seats, cruise control, a six-speaker audio system and optional leather. ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist are standard, as are front airbags and alloy wheels.

The Carnival, also known as Grand Carnival or Sedona in some markets, is undoubtedly Kia's largest non-commercial vehicle, being a full-size minivan. With three rows of seats, there is no shortage of space. Powered by a 3.8-litre V6, it comes with limited standard features, which include 16-inch alloy wheels, AM/FM radio with CD, front and rear a/c with tri-zone control, battery saver, electric mirrors, central door locks, ABS brakes, power windows with driver-side auto down, variable intermittent wipers, hidden radio antenna, power sunroof and an automatic gearbox. Higher trim levels get additional features such as an AM/FM radio with cassette player, CD and MP3, automatic light control system, audio remote controls on the steering wheel, reverse warning system, electric folding mirrors, cruise control, keyless entry system, roof rack, front fog lamps, power sliding doors and tailgate, 8-way power driver's seat and finally, dual front airbags. Safety features are surprisingly limited to only ABS brakes, the optional airbags and an energy-absorbing steering column.

The Thai-built Honda City returns in 2009 with a full redesign. Sporting one of Honda's numerous corporate front-ends, it looks good for the first time ever, and comes with enough cabin space to rival some midsize cars. Based on the new platform shared with the Jazz, and powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a 5-speed automatic, this front-wheel-drive sedan has grown in size, with a full list of interesting options. Standard features on the basic City LX include 15-inch steel wheels, power mirrors, body-colour bumpers, electric power steering, power windows, power door locks, manual a/c, CD/MP3 player with USB/AUX connector and 2 speakers, stereo volume-compensation depending on speed, trip computer, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD, and an immobiliser. The City EX adds paddle shifters, 16-inch alloy wheels, chrome exhaust tip, front and rear armrests, split-folding rear seat, stereo controls on the steering wheel and 4 speakers, and keyless entry.

The Camaro continued with minor changes for 2013. The ZL1 gets a supercharged 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed manual or automatic. StabiliTrak traction control and front-side airbags are standard. There is a new frameless rearview mirror for 2013 as well. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and a new MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The midsize Toyota Camry sedan has been redesigned heavily for 2012, so the 2014 refresh only brings minor trim changes. A 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic is standard, and it makes a little less horsepower on the base model than in the rest of the range, as it is the only one to receive a single exhaust tip, while the other trims receive dual exhaust tips. The base model can be had with a manual gearbox in Saudi Arabia, but not in the UAE. In Qatar, a Camry variant with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic is being sold. Now available in four new trim levels, the base model also looks visibly different than the rest of the range, with its basic bumpers and 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Known as S or GL, depending on market, it comes with a manual a/c, 6-speaker CD/MP3 touchscreen stereo with USB port, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, fabric seats, rear parking sensors, ABS with EBD and two airbags. The mid-range model, known as SE or GLX, also gets fake wood trim, dual-zone auto a/c, auto-dimming mirror, cruise control, Bluetooth, audio jack, scuff plates with illumination, rear camera, powered driver's seat, 17-inch alloys, door mirrors with turn indicators, front fog lamps, and a "sport" front bumper, "sport" grille, rear boot spoiler and dual exhaust tips. Also available as an optional "Plus" package are stability control, sunroof, DVD, keyless start and navigation, although the mid-range specs vary between GCC countries. The top-spec "Sport" model, known as SE Limited in some markets, gets a unique rear bumper, paddle-shifters, stability control, leather seats, 17-inch alloys and fake metal cabin trim, intelligent keyless entry with starter button and DVD navigation. In terms of safety, all models get dual front airbags and ABS, but only some of the top trim levels get side airbags and stability control. For 2014, there is now a new top-spec trim level in some markets, called the Limited, with basic-style bumpers, chrome grille and trimmings, rear lip spoiler, leather, navigation, rear camera, and all other luxury as well as safety features available in the Sport trim. A limited edition RZ model went on sale in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain as well. It got a glossy black front grille and spoiler, sport-tuned suspension, 17-inch glossy black alloy wheels, sporty headlamps and matte black fog lamp cover. It also comes with RZ decals on the doors and rear bumper.

The Hyundai i10 received a facelift for the 2011 model year. It also gets a new 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with VTVT (Variable Timing and Valve Train) technology, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include a CD player with MP3 compatibility and iPod input, dual front airbags, body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. This is about as cheap as it gets for a decent new car in the GCC market. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The seventh generation BMW 5-series arrived in 2017. The 2021 BMW 5-Series got a facelift. The 520i and 530i has a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 540i model gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The second-generation Clio hatchback was launched as a 1999 model, and was heavily facelifted for 2002, coinciding with the release of the Turkish-built sedan version. The all-new Mark-3 Clio was already out in European markets by 2006, but the Middle East soldiered with the older Mark-2 model. Therefore in 2006, the model received a second unnoticeable facelift, and the hatchback was renamed the Clio Campus, while the sedan became the Clio Classic. The Clio is the smallest car in Renault's range, and offers buyers a number of trim options and petrol engines, in either hatchback or sedan form. The basic 1.4-litre engine powers the standard five-door hatchback and four-door sedan, with a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. The hot 2.0-litre engine powers the rare three-door Clio 182 model, with a stock manual transmission. The unique combination of sizeable engines, unique styling, competitive pricing, safety features and equipment levels make other cars in this category look bad. The Clio is available with a host of trim levels, with names like Authentique, Expression, Privilege, Initiale, Dynamique and, for the hot 182 model, Renaultsport. Standard features include electric power steering, some sort of stereo, available power features and more. Class-leading levels of equipment include ABS with brake assist, dual front airbags, remote control central locking, power windows.

The Genesis is Hyundai's new rear-wheel-drive flagship sedan. It is designed to take on all sorts of established luxury-sport sedans at their own game. Hyundai's attempt at moving upscale is a solid effort at a reasonable price. For the GCC, it is offered only with one engine, namely a standard 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic gearbox. The Genesis sedan offers a host of upscale luxury features including Smart Cruise Control, adaptive HID headlights, air suspension and a Lexicon CD audio system with iPod input and 17 speakers. Further features include a power rear sunshade, automatic electronic parking brake, proximity key and push button starter, leather upholstery, eight parking sensors with optional reverse camera, soft-touch instrument panel with woodgrain accents, Bluetooth hands-free mobile phone interface, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, and a choice of 17-inch and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety aspects include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as active head restraints, stability control and big ABS-assisted disc brakes. The Genesis is a full-size luxury sedan competing in price with small and medium-sized models from established luxury marques, but Hyundai not having its own premium brand may be a downer for upscale buyers.

Almost 5 metres long with a low roofline, the Audi A7 Sportback is a full-sizer riding on 18-inch to 20-inch wheels, and as with all Audi sedans,  really rides a front-wheel-drive platform, with optional 'Quattro' all-wheel-drive tacked onto the higher trim levels. Two V6 engines are offered in the UAE - a 2.8-litre and a supercharged 3.0-litre, both of which are mated to an 'S-tronic' automatic transmission. An S7 was introduced as a 2013 model with a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system. Optional equipment include interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound.

The Lotus Evora is the British manufacturer's first offering of combining superb race track handling with everyday practicality. In 2017, it got power upgrades and a slight facelift. There are two models to choose from, the Evora 400 and Evora Sport 410.The Evora comes with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine in two states of tune, both mated to either a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual transmission. The mid-engined Evora has a 2+2 configuration, although the back seats can be used for storage purposes than anything else. Standard options include central door locking, flat bottomed magnesium steering wheel trimmed in leather, leather gear knob, leather handbrake sleeve, bespoke aluminium illuminated control knobs and switches, power windows, remote release glove box, door storage bins and integrated cup holders, Alpine CD/MP3/WMA receiver, and Lotus command centre with auxiliary trip computer and vehicle monitoring displays. It comes with standard 18-inch alloy wheels and optional 19-inch/20-inch alloys with wider tyres. Additional packages can be added. The Tech Pack offers Alpine multi-media in car entertainment system with 7" WVGA touch screen, bluetooth connectivity, satellite navigation, tyre pressure monitoring, cruise control, rear parking sensors. The Sport Pack offers switchable sports mode with sharper throttle response, increased rpm limit and sports traction control setting, sports diffuser, titanium sports exhaust tailpipe, cross drilled brake discs, engine oil cooler and black painted brake callipers. The Premium Pack offers accent lighting, upgraded interior trim, centre arm-rest and further extensive use of premium grade leathers. Further options include electric power-fold door mirrors, xenon headlights, Alpine Imprint dynamic audio EQ system , reversing camera and body colour door handles.

The B-Series is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines include a 2.2-litre and a 2.6-litre petrol engines, while the diesel offering is a 2.9-litre unit, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual, or even an automatic in some markets. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include overfender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

The Lincoln MKX was an all-new model for 2016 and has been rebadged as the Lincoln Nautilus for 2019, receiving a Navigator-inspired facelift as well. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, the base model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged inilne-4 engine, while the higher models get an updated turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, 12.3-inch configurable driver's display, SYNC 3 multimedia touchscreen, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. They also introduced a SUV "coupe" version for the GLC. Under the hood, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe sports a twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. In 2020, the GLC 43 AMG Coupe got a slight facelift and bump in power. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

As evolutionary developments of the America's most popular minivan, the latest model features a more square design, optional power operation of the sliding side doors, dual front airbags, a power rear liftgate and revised interiors that are quieter, nicer and more comfortable. The new Grand Voyager comes with a 3.8-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic. It also features Stow 'n' Go rear seats, giving the ability to easily fold the second and third-row seats into the floor in as little as 30 seconds with a simple one-hand operation. More options include a rear-seat audio system, traction control, parking sensors, side-curtain airbags, a tyre-pressure warning system, electronically adjustable pedals and a rear-seat DVD entertainment. Chrysler minivans, in various shapes and names, are best sellers in the United States, but failed to make any headway in this region because minivans are not popular here.

The Chrysler 300 got a facelift in 2015. The new 300 is rear-wheel-drive and gets a 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 version, mated to an 8-speed automatic with manual capability. The base model gets cruise control, cloth upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with 4.3-inch touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry and other standard features. Higher trim levels additionally come with an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more. The 5.7-litre Hemi V8 model, with an 8-speed automatic with manual capability, comes in three trim levels. Standard features include cruise control, 18-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inch wheels, CD/MP3 stereo with touchscreen and USB port, auto headlights, intelligent keyless entry with starter button. Other available features, depending on trim level, includes an 8.4-inch touchscreen, stereo amplifier, auto a/c with rear vents, power seats, heated/cooled cup-holders, leather, remote start, Bluetooth, HID headlights, sunroof and more.

An all-new Volkswagen Touareg came out in 2019. It is slightly wider and longer than the previous model. It is also lighter because of its mixed material construction of aluminium (48 per cent) and high-tech steels (52 per cent). The new dimensions help it achieve more cargo room at the back. The UAE and GCC market gets two engine options - a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 unit. Notable features include the Digital Cockpit with a 12-inch display and the infotainment system with a 15-inch display. It gets a lot of new safety features as well. Along with the multitude of airbags, blind spot detection, traction control and stability control, it gets technologies such as the 'Night Vision' assistance system (detects people and animals in darkness via a thermal imaging camera), Roadwork Lane Assist (semi-automated steering and lane keeping, accelerating and braking up to 60 km/h), Front Cross Traffic Assist (reacts to cross traffic in front), and 'IQ.Light - LED matrix headlights' (interactive, camera-based dipped and main beam headlight control).

New from the ground up in 2006 and much more better-looking, the American-built M-Class, which actually uses the ML moniker, is a better on-road and off-road 4WD now. Mildly worked over for 2008, and facelifted a few months later, including the addition of a new V8, the M-Class is built for better off-road performance, with permanent all-wheel-drive plus 4ETS, a hill-start aid to help when climbing, and Downhill Speed Regulation to ensure constant speed on downhill tracks. In addition, the optional AIRMATIC package and ADS adaptive damping system so you can increase the ground clearance up to 110 mm at the touch of a button. Various aesthetic options include the off-road styling package, the Chrome package, the Sports package and the Interior equipment package. Models include the 3.5-litre ML 350 and a new 5.5-litre ML 500. All come with a 7-speed automatic. Features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, man-made leather/Aspen fabric or leather upholstery, tyre pressure loss warning system, crash sensors, front and side airbags, CD radio with pre-installation for mobile phone and more. The AMG kit adds 20-inch or 21-inch alloy wheels.

The GAC GA5 is the Chinese brand's midsize sedan offering. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engine choices, which is the naturally aspirated 2.0-litre motor and the turbocharged 1.8-litre unit. They both can be had in either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 5-speed automatic transmission. Standard feature for the GA5 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fog lamps, parking sensors, AM/FM radio with CD/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, fabric seats, automatic A/C with dual-zone, rear A/C vents and manual seats. The higher models get leather seats, power seats, sunroof and audio controls on steering wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and EBD.

Named after Ferrari coachbuilder Sergio Scaglietti, the all-aluminum 612 Scaglietti attempts to blend performance and comfort in the tradition of a true Ferrari berlinetta designed to accommodate four people. This Ferrari is a 12-cylinder model with both the space-frame chassis and body panels in aluminium. The overall layout, with the 5.7-litre engine mounted behind the front axle and the gearbox in line with the differential at the rear, ensures an ideally balanced weight distribution, as well as permitting a lower centre of gravity. The performance-orientated handling is enhanced by active damping and a new stability and traction control system, with components from General Motors subsidiaries no less. The 612 runs with a six-speed mechanical gearbox, in a choice of manual or F1-style paddle shifts. With a relatively long wheelbase, the 612 has been designed to offer ease of entry for rear-seat passengers to a luxurious cabin which will accommodate four adults in comfort, while the luggage trunk hold a five-piece Ferrari luggage set or two full sets of golf clubs. Features include a new radio-CD system, voice recognition system, MP3 player, Bluetooth and more.

The Maserati Quattroporte became larger and lighter in 2013, and for 2015, is offered with three engine options, namely two versions of a 3.0-litre V6 in the base Quattroporte and the mid-range Quattroporte S, and a 3.8-litre V8 in the Quattroporte GTS, all twin-turbocharged direction-injection units built by Ferrari, but using some Chrysler-derived parts. Both have an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive for the GCC market. Later on, an all-wheel-drive version for the Quattroporte S was available. The all-new architecture retains its 50:50 weight distribution, double-wishbone front suspension, and a five-link rear suspension. The more-spacious interior can be had with both four-seat and five-seat layouts. Cabin features include a Chrysler-sourced 8.4-inch touchscreen, adjustable pedals, reversing cameras and the optional 15-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system, as well as WLAN-based WiFi and Bluetooth compatibility. The screen includes navigation, reverse camera, DVD player, audio and ventilation functions. Adaptive cruise control, smart key with push-button start, front-side airbags and a dual-zone climate control system with 13 ventilation ports, complete the list of standard features.

In 2013, the Audi A5 Sportback received a facelift and new engine options. All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The 4-door A5 Sportback comes with three engine options; a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder motor and a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged unit. Power is delivered through a CVT automatic for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic is mated to the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions. Available technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, smart keyless entry and start, and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

For 2018, the Infiniti QX80 got a major facelift which included new LED headlight clusters, new grille, reshaped bumpers, redone rear lights, new tailgate chrome trim, and redesigned 22-inch wheels. It still comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. A 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available. The QX80 also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. The cabin can be trimmed in either leather as standard or semi-aniline leather with optional contrast-colour piping. Standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 8-inch colour monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the QX80's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA colour touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

The Audi RS 3 is the top performance trim for the A3 model. Under the hood, the all-wheel-drive hatchback gets a turbocharged 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the car include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push start-stop engine button, Nappa leather upholstery, Bang & Olufsen sound system with sub-woofer, Bluetooth, USB/AUX support, front sports seats, front electric seats with 4-way lumbar support, rear folding back seats, fog lamps, rear spoiler and alloy wheels. Some optional features include Audi magnetic ride, 19-inch polished alloy wheels with matte titanium finish, 5-spoke rotor arm design, red brake calipers and roof rails with matte titanium look. Standard safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front airbags and knee airbags.

The Lexus IS debuted in its current form back in 2014, and got a facelift in 2017. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, later renamed to IS300 in 2018, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

After a decade, Toyota finally redesigned the Land Cruiser for the 2008 model year. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon is at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. However, it really is one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. The new Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.0-litre V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, and an upgraded 4.7-litre V8 with a 5-speed auto. There is also a 4.5-litre turbodiesel V8 option, with the 6-speed automatic version getting more power than the 5-speed manual version. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. Features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 17-inch alloy or steel wheels, smart key, start/stop button, optional parking sensors, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional leather, ABS brakes, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, and Bluetooth among other items.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The Ford Taurus receives a mid-cycle makeover for 2013 that includes a refreshed design and numerous exterior and interior upgrades for better fuel economy, more technology and sharpened driving dynamics. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive returns. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. The SHO gets a unique grille, larger rear spoiler, additional body trimmings and standard 20-inch alloys. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are available on higher trims.

An all-new model of the Audi A6 came out in 2019. In 2020, more engine options became available. The A6 lineup includes a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder, and a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 engine. Both engines are mild hybrid systems, connected to small batteries to aid performance. A 7-speed dual-clutch transmission sends power to the wheels for all the models.  Standard features include LED running lights, three-zone automatic air conditioning, front seats with lumbar support and ventilation, MMI computer control system, intelligent key that stores the vehicle's service info, and a Bang & Olufsen audio system. Also available are side-assist warning system for safe lane changes, and a parking system with a rear-view camera. The A6 also gets a dynamic system that Audi called Drive Select that manipulates transmission shifts, steering feel and suspension settings. All models get the usual power accessories as well as safety features such as multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The unimaginatively-named Five Hundred full-size sedan is a capable new family performer that does what it's supposed to, and nothing extra. Based on a Volvo platform, this American model features the three-bar Ford grille, a massive well-appointed cabin and a standard 3.5-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The standard model is front-wheel-drive, but all-wheel-drive is optional. Features include ABS brakes, traction control, keypad autolock, power mirrors, power windows, remote keyless entry, eight cupholders, CD stereo with MP3 audio jack, anti-theft system, and optional tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher models include dual-zone a/c, memory power seats, leather, fake wood trim and more. Available options include heated front seats, 18-inch chrome wheels, adjustable pedals, stability control, sunroof, reverse sensors, in-dash six-disc CD audiosystem and other items. Standard safety equipment includes dual-stage driver and passenger front air bags, seat-deployed side airbags for driver and front passenger, and side curtain airbags for both rows.

The Cadiilac CTS-V is the top sports variant which with a supercharged 6.2-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. External changes for 2018 are limited to new colours. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps, fog lamp, Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, navigation, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Gelaendewagen stands out anywhere, even in the heart of the urban jungle. Facelifted slightly for 2013, its classic beefcake looks have remained untouched for over 20 years apart from the interior where the comfort levels have been repeatedly upgraded. The trademark clean-cut, square-jawed lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a two-door soft-top version of the three-door. The twin-turbochared 5.5-litre V8 G63 AMG is fitted with a 7-speed automatic transmission. The AMG models get a unique front bumper with large intakes as well as side-exit exhaust tips. Interior features include various leather trim and wood choices, power-adjustable front seats, redesigned large multimedia screen, navigation, Bluetooth, CD/DVD/MP3 and all that. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel-drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, the Electronic Stability Program and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The Golf intends to be a German-designed, German-engineered and German-built alternative to the Asian-nameplate vehicles that dominate the entry level of the automotive marketplace. Unlike many of its competitors, the Golf is a hatchback and therefore offers the advantage of cargo-carrying utility not provided by the typical four-door sedans. Hatchbacks were never popular, but the VW Golf always had some sort of following here. Though the base models, namely the 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, are no rockets, they are still responsive and fun to drive. Its four-wheel independent suspension and relatively long wheelbase give it a nice ride along with good stability and handling. The Golf comes standard with available safety features such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS brakes and optional ESP, alongside available convenience features like power windows and CD stereo.

The Infiniti QX30 is pretty much the same as the Q30 hatchback, but with a very minor increase in ground clearance, to become a crossover. Sharing a platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it also shares an engine with its joint-venture German cousin as well, namely the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. Standard options in the QX30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, 7-inch infotainment touchscreen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The new-for-2011 Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

The Lincoln MKS is an all-new full-size luxury sedan produced by Ford's upscale division, continuing the brand's confusing new letter-based naming system. And although it can be considered the marque's technological flagship sedan, it still falls behind leaders in the wider market. For starters, it is based on a front-wheel-drive platform shared with the Ford Taurus. But while this can be overlooked thanks to all-wheel-drive being standard on all GCC-spec models, the main engine for this full-sizer is a new 3.7-litre V6, instead of a V8. It rides on fully-independent suspension and 20-inch polished aluminium wheels. Features include a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, keyless entry and start, adaptive cruise control, SYNC voice-activated multimedia system, Bluetooth, rain-sensing windshield wipers, a rearview camera system, front and rear park assist, a THX sound system with full 5.1 surround sound, vented power seats, sunroof, HID headlights, LED taillamps, wood and leather interior trim, and Ford's capless fuel-filler system. Safety features include standard front, side and curtain airbags, stability control and ABS brakes.

The new Elantra gets a sleeker yet bulbous new look. It's also taller and wider than the outgoing Elantra. There's also more interior space than before, and a higher seating position. Most people would probably consider the Elantra a compact sedan, but its new interior volume is now comparable to some midsize cars. Various trim levels are available on this front-wheel-drive sedan, including a top-of-the-line model which comes with leather seats. But all models are well-equipped with plenty of convenience features, including power windows, intermittent windshield wipers, multiple storage areas, a 60/40-split fold-down rear seatback, dual vanity mirrors, tinted windows, two 12-volt outlets and a tilt steering wheel. Engine choices include a carryover 1.6-litre four-cylinder and a revamped 2.0-litre four-cylinder. A five-speed manual comes standard with the smaller motor, while a four-speed automatic is available for both engines. Basic models get only a single airbag and steel 15-inch wheels. The top model gets dual airbags, ABS brakes, stability control, and 16-inch alloys.

The new Civic was a breath of fresh air in the crowded compact class back in 2006, and continues with a 2009 facelift that includes a reshaped front end and more features. Trim levels include the basic LXi, the mid-level EXi and the top VTi, all sharing the same 1.8-litre engine. Standard features on all trims now include 16-inch wheels, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, CD/MP3 player, cruise control, body-coloured exterior trim, power windows and mirrors, and a 5-speed automatic gearbox, with a manual gearbox available only on the LXi. The EXi receives a standard automatic gearbox only, and adds stability control, optional sunroof, turn signals on the mirrors, upgraded stereo with 4 speakers, USB jack and steering wheel controls, and outside temperature gauge. The VTi adds side-curtain airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, standard automatic gearbox with paddle shifters, standard sunroof, optional leather, automatic a/c, chrome exhaust tip, foglights and HID headlights. The Civic only gets more expensive, overlapping with the Accord now in terms of price.

The A8 is the most imposing of the Audi range. Most noticeable is the big single-frame grille on all models. Engines available in front-wheel-drive form include the 2.8-litre V6 and the 3.2-litre V6 in this region, while all-wheel-drive Quattro offerings include the 4.2-litre V8, although some dealers do offer the 6.0-litre V12 too. All these models are sold here only in long wheelbase form, but there is also a sweet short-wheelbase S8 model, again only from some dealers, that is powered by a Lamborghini-sourced 5.2-litre V10. Basic features on A8 models include a parking system with graphic display, adaptive front lighting, new 18-inch wheel designs, optional 19-inch performance tyres with the Sport Package, a revamped Driver Information Centre; a glove box lock and a leather interior. The 4.2-litre, 6.0-litre and 5.2-litre models all use Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive. The A8 uses an all-aluminium frame with a fully pneumatic suspension system. Its aluminium four-link front axle and trapezoidal-link rear axle suspension has air spring struts at each wheel, with sensors that continually monitor and adjust the damping, and automatically level the car. The 3.2-litre uses a CVT automatic transmission, while the rest of the models use a six-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission with manual mode and available wheel-mounted paddles. Audi's Multi Media Interface control system can be used to monitor or control such things as the radio, phone, climate control, stereo or lighting profiles of the LED illumination in the door trim and foot wells. The Quattro models are at least a step in the right direction in combating its German brethren.

Essentially a rebadged version of the Romanian-built Dacia Sandero that has been trundling around Europe since 2007, this hatchback is based on the same platform as the Renault Logan sedan. The Renault Sandero is more modern-looking than the Logan sedan, but still a very simple car aimed at the entry-level sub-compact segment. Originally designed in France for the Brazilian market, its claim to possible fame is that it is more spacious than its price competitors. However, compared to the Logan, it has a slightly shorter wheelbase. Storage options are decent, with the spare wheel underneath the car freeing up boot space, and a folding rear seat-back. The front-wheel-drive Sandero is equipped with a 1.6-litre engine, mated to a simple 4-speed automatic. The Sandero also seems better-equipped than the Logan, with ABS and better sound-deadening materials on offer, alongside an MP3 stereo, front power windows, central locking, cloth seats and one airbag.

The Haval H9 is the Chinese brand's flagship SUV. Under the hood, it gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed ZF automatic transmission. Standard features on the H9 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start-stop button, xenon headlamps, front and rear fog lamps, leather seats, infotainment system with touch screen and 10 speakers, Bluetooth, radio, AUX-in, USB, CD player and GPS. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA) and traction control.

The V5 Crossover is aptly named, although we'd say it is more of a minivan segment player. From what we can gather from vague press materials, it aims to include all the comforts of a luxury car with the space and versatility of a wagon. The interior is beautiful in design, though the build quality is far from perfect. The centrally-mounted gauges and the fake wood trim are expected downsides. Powered by the same 2.4-litre four-cylinder Mitsubishi engine that serves most other Chery models, it comes with a 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power windows, remote central locking, CD player with optional 6-disc changer, 16-inch alloy wheels, manual cloth seats or optional electric leather seats, dual front airbags with optional front-side airbags, ABS-assisted four-wheel-disc brakes with EBD, power mirrors, parking sensors, power steering, optional DVD navigation, sunroof and of course an alarm system should someone try to steal your Chery.

All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions.  It gets a 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 7-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Changan CS95 is a mid-size SUV available as both five and seven-seater variants, and is powered by a 2.0 turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. The only gearbox available is six-speed automatic and equipped with Changan’s NexTrac AWD system.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova attempts to resemble a 4WD in height, with a high waistline and four forward-opening doors, but it ends up looking like a van. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a manual or automatic. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include a cassette/MP3/CD player with 6 speakers, dual-zone a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, probably fake wood trim, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The big van rides on comparatively tiny 15-inch alloy wheels. Ironically, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 Spyder is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The electrohydraulic, lightweight soft top opens via a button positioned on the central tunnel in just 17 seconds up to a driving speed of 50 kph. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

A new generation Audi TT came out as a 2015 model year. Under the hood, it gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit with two different tunes. The standard TT can be had in front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive "quattro" format, while the TTS gets more power and is only available with all-wheel drive. A 6-speed manual gearbox is standard on both models, with an optional 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission optional. Standard features in the TT include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fabric seats, radio with CD/USB/AUX support, parking sensors and manual A/C. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system with a touch-screen, navigation, rear-camera, hard-drive, card readers, Bluetooth, voice control system, leather seats and automatic A/C.
