Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and electronic stability control (ESC) while lane assist is optional. In 2018, the Audi TT RS was sold in the GCC. It came with a 2.5-litre turbocharged

The Audi RS 5 Sportback is being sold, but mostly only on special order. It made its debut in the GCC in 2020. It gets a twin turbocharged 2.9-litre V6 engine with a 8-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5 Sportback.

An all-new Hyundai Accent came out for 2019. The new-generation Accent is slightly longer and wider than the previous model, with increased interior space. Two four-cylinder petrol engine options are being offered for the 2020 Hyundai Accent in the region, including a 1.4-litre and a 1.6-litre, with multi-point fuel injection, matched to a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic transmission. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features in the 2019 Hyundai Accent include stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Alto is a tiny hatchback originally conceived as a "kei" car for the Japanese market, meaning it had to be restricted to this tiny size to qualify for tax breaks in Japan. Built in India since 2004, for foreign markets it is powered by a tiny 1.1-litre engine driving the front wheels through a five-speed manual or a three-speed automatic. The suspension is made up of MacPherson struts and coil springs at the front and Suzuki's isolated trailing link and coil spring system at the rear.Very popular in India, it offers low fuel consumption, low maintenance costs and even safety features such as dual airbags, side impact beams and even seat belts. It offers enough seating for four people as well as their wallets in the rear luggage compartment. Available features, standard or optional, include front power windows, cloth upholstery, power steering, central locking, CD player and steel wheels with plastic hubcaps. Parking one of these things is easy in tight city streets, but it could run out of breath on the highway fast lane. The new version of the Alto was launched during the summer of 2009, and is being sold in the GCC as the Celerio alongside this old Alto.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. Based on a Nissan platform, the Koleos received a minor facelift in 2014, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. The 2016 models were technically 2015 model-year leftovers as an all-new Koleos debuted in the second half of the year. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Navigation is a new option for 2014. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The Nissan Patrol Nismo debuted in the GCC in 2016 and gets a whole host of upgrades. The 5.6-litre V8 engine has been upgraded to produce slightly more power. The exterior gets a bodykit which includes Nismo sports headlights, 22-inch forged-alloy wheels, chrome-plated radiator grille, front and rear sports bumpers. The interior gets a sportier design for the leather upholstery with Nismo logos. The suspension has been upgraded with Nismo-tuned Bilstein shock absorbers. The rest of the features you will find similar to the Patrol Platinum edition which includes Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

Ford decided to build this uber-expensive mid-engine supercar to celebrate the Blue Oval's Centennial. The Ford GT is to be built for two or three years in a limited run. Powered by a massive 5.4-litre V8, it is fitted with a six-speed manual transmission and capable of speeds in excess of 300 kph. It lacks the amenities of a Ferrari V12 cruiser, but it is supposedly comfortable and accommodating for a high-performance sports car. It does however outperform many Ferrari models that cost more than the GT, so the price is considered a bargain by many. There is no trunk to speak of so it can't be your only car, which is a shame. Standard features include air conditioning, AM/FM/CD/MP3 two-speaker stereo, tilt-and-telescope steering wheel, power windows, seats and mirrors, leather trim, keyless remote, and textured rubber floormats. An optional McIntosh stereo adds an eight-inch subwoofer and one-inch A-pillar speakers. Other options include forged aluminium wheels, painted brake calipers, and painted racing logo stripes. Standard safety equipment includes frontal airbags, ABS brakes and a tyre inflation kit.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Hyundai Elantra Coupe was launched by the end of 2012 in some GCC markets, and continues unchanged for 2015. It comes with two 4-cylinder engine choices, either a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. The new front-wheel-drive platform has independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Spark is the smallest offering from the American brand. An all-new model came out in 2016, now with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under its hood, mated to a CVT. Options for the higher-spec models include aluminium-alloy wheels, coloured door handles, fog lamps, cruise control, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, and CD player with MP3 support and USB port.

The Audi S8 is the sports version of the carmaker's flagship A8 model. In 2020 an all-new Audi S8 model came out. Under the hood, the S8 comes with a powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine connected to a small electric motor, and mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It also gets cylinder deactivation so it can run on only 4 cylinders for better fuel economy. Features include four-zone automatic air-conditioning, Bluetooth, xenon headlamps, start-stop engine system, parking-aid, 360-view camera, adaptive air-suspension, leather seats, navigation and panoramic roof. Safety standards are high, with electronic stability control, various collision prevention systems and numerous airbags. Different equipment packages are available as well for further customisation.

An all-new Ford Taurus came out in 2020. Sold only in a few countries in the GCC as crossovers take over the market, the Taurus features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder "Ecoboost" engine. The engine is mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the standard Taurus Ambiente include power steering, power windows, LED auto headlamps, auto start stop, cruise control, sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen for the infotainment system, Bluetooth, dual-zone automatic AC, parking sensors and 18-inch alloy wheels. The Taurus Trend gets additional rearview camera and dual panel sunroof. The Taurus Titanium gets additional leather seats, 19-inch alloy wheels, front LED fog lamps, ambient lighting, wireless charging and adaptive cruise control. The Taurus Titanium Plus gets additional power rear seat recliner, rear seat climate control and automated parking system. Standard safety features on the Ambiente include front and side aribags, knee airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS, and traction control. The higher Titanium models get lane departure warning, lane discipline aid, blind sport monitor and collision mitigation.

The Ford Mustang is an icon of American something-or-the-other since its 1964 introduction, popular for its bold style and affordable price. The Mustang started the "pony car" genre, and now it has gone back to its old styling. The Mustang rides on rear-wheel-drive platform, but it still doesn't have independent rear suspension to the detriment of handling compared to other sports cars. The interior looks good, but is full of cheap plastics. But this car is one of the best performance bargains in town. The Mustang GT boasts a powerful 4.6-litre V8, available with a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic. The new-for-2005 Mustang was sold only in GT form here. Standard equipment includes four-wheel disc brakes with four-channel ABS and all-speed traction control, dual exhausts, front fog lamps, a rear spoiler, tilt steering wheel, 17-inch painted cast aluminium wheels with Z-rated performance tyres, power mirrors, AM/FM stereo with a single-CD player, air bags, power door locks with remote keyless entry, and power windows. Options include the Shaker 500-watt audio system with 6-disc CD player and MP3 capability, among other things.

An all-new Bentley Continental GT was released in 2018. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Continental GT is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

The all-new M4 Convertible came out as a 2015 model year and is the replacement for the M3 Convertible. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

BMW made its leap into the large SUV category with the flagship X7. Under the hood, two engine options are available - the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder engine and the turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 motor, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and electrically adjustable third-row seating. The middle row features three seats with a two-seat "captain's chair" configuration also available. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. The X7 also receives driver assistance systems including autonomous cruise control and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Fiesta is an entirely new sub-compact car from Ford's European division. Built in Germany, the Fiesta pushes the boundaries of small-car design with futuristic styling and sporty handling. Available only in 5-door form, economical engine choices include a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder with manual gearbox and a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder with a manual or automatic. Available in Ambiente, Trend and Titanium trim levels, basic features include 15-inch steel wheels, electric power steering, capless fuel-filler system, full-size spare tyre, dual front airbags, cloth seats and manual windows. The top model can be outfitted with 15-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, rear 'sport' spoiler, front/rear parking sensors, automatic a/c, power windows, fog lamps, optional stability control, front and optional side-curtain airbags, driver's knee airbag, optional trip computer, keyless entry with push-button start, CD/MP3 with 6 speakers and steering-wheel controls, AUX input jack, Bluetooth, optional cruise control and more. For the first year, a limited-edition of 24 cars were launched in the UAE, each with differing custom-paint schemes.

The oddly-named xA offers solid construction, tons of headroom and low maintenance costs. The xA doesn't set the world on fire with its styling, but it comes well-equipped with convenience and safety features. It's comfortable in the front seats, though the rear is a bit cramped, and it offers decent cargo space. The ride is firm and it handles reasonably well. It doesn't have a lot of power, but offers impressive fuel economy. The xA is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder and comes standard with a five-speed manual transmission, while a four-speed automatic is optional. The motor is spritely, but ultimately still underpowered. The list of standard features is surprisingly long for a car in this price class, and includes ABS brakes with Electronic Brake Distribution which boosts braking pressure in emergency situations, power windows, door locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, tilt steering wheel, tachometer and trip meter, 60/40 split folding rear seat and a six-speaker MP3/CD sound system.

The Fiesta is a pint-sized runabout, and looks funny next to the Crown Victoria, but it is a product of Ford's European effort. Released for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, the Fiesta is built in Germany and few in this region know about this. Even fewer have even heard of this car. The Fiesta is a bestseller in Europe but failed to make an impact here, mostly because of impossibly snobby dealership prices for servicing this cheap car. Otherwise it is a very good sub-compact. Handling and ride  is even better than the highly acclaimed late-90's version thanks to the ultra-stiff bodyshell. Power comes from a Duratec 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine that offers fuel economy expected from cars of this size. There is also a choice of manual and automatic gearboxes for this front-wheel-drive hatchback. Safety equipment includes ABS brakes, airbags and other items. Small on the outside, decent packaging allows the Fiesta to offer decent space for people and cargo in its small body. It doesn't look too bad either.

The Infiniti Q30 is Nissan's first entry in the premium compact hatchback category. Sharing a front-wheel-drive platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it shares engines with its joint-venture German cousin as well, including the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The standard engine is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor. Standard options in the Q30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, infotainment system with touch screen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

A new generation of the Kia Soul came out as a 2015 model year. Being touted as a crossover, it is really a tall compact hatchback, designed to be appealing for our misguided urban youth. Featuring tons of cabin space, the Kia Soul is powered by a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Also the Soul gets more soft-touch material inside than the previous generation. Available in two trim levels, the basic model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows, electric power steering, keyless entry, electric mirrors, a single driver's airbag, roof rack, fog lamps, CD stereo with iPod input, rear parking sensors, split-folding rear seat, black cloth upholstery and 16-inch alloy wheels. The top-spec trim gets LED running lamps, a better CD stereo with a sub-woofer and illuminated speakers, as well as a sunroof, leather steering wheel, underfloor tray and power outlet in the boot, luggage net, some extra trim. dual front airbags and 18-inch alloy wheels, with a choice of black, beige and red two-tone interiors. Optional features are extensive, largely limited to appearance kits, such as funkier alloy wheels, stickers, chrome trim, front and rear skirts, and shiny fuel caps. In addition to front airbags, ABS is available on all except the base model, but stability control and side airbags are not available on GCC-spec models.

The Lincoln MKX was an all-new model for 2016 and has been rebadged as the Lincoln Nautilus for 2019, receiving a Navigator-inspired facelift as well. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, the base model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged inilne-4 engine, while the higher models get an updated turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, 12.3-inch configurable driver's display, SYNC 3 multimedia touchscreen, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

An all-new Skoda Octavia came out in 2014 in the GCC. Compared to its predecessor, the Octavia has grown significantly in length and width. The new model is 90 mm longer and 45 mm wider than the second-generation Skoda Octavia. At the same time, the wheelbase has grown by 108 mm, mainly benefiting the interior and space on the rear seats. In 2017, there are two 4-cylinder turbocharged engines to choose from, the 1.4-litre and the 2.0-litre, both mated to a 7-speed DSG gearbox. The base Octavia Ambition model comes with 16-inch steel wheels, fabric interior, rear mud flaps, automatic A/C, electric adjustable, heated & foldable door mirrors, electric windows, parking sensors, radio with CD player and MP3 support,  4 speakers, remote central locking, fog lights and front & side front airbags. The Octavia Style model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, leather interior, chrome package, cruise control, Apply connectivity, mobile device interface (MDI), electric seats, sunroof and xenon headlamps. The Octavia RS gets 19-inch alloy wheels, carbon-fibre inlays for dashboard and door panels, boot spoiler, red brake calipers, sports suspension, Bluetooth and Apple connectivity.

International truck company's MXT is a lowered crew-cab pickup truck in a more consumer-friendly package than the company's larger trucks. The MXT's front end is dominated by a tall waterfall grille, while its profile looks odd with its "lowered" ride height is really much higher than it seems. A sport exterior package adds a chrome bumper with tow hooks and anodized aluminium tubular running boards. The MXT features a long cargo bed and measures large enough to not fit in most conventional garages. The MXT is powered by a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V8, mated to an Allison five-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. Features include an air suspension system, 20-inch wheels, a five-occupant interior with front bucket seats and a three-place rear bench seat, leather seating surfaces, a leather-wrapped tilt steering wheel, keyless entry, and power locks and windows, as well as ABS brakes. The optional "Prestige Interior" includes ivory-coloured gauges, silver interior trim, special floor mats, and front and rear air-ride seats. Options include a navigation system with a 6.5-inch screen and a rearview camera, and a DVD entertainment system with a 10-inch screen. Twice as heavy as any large 4WD, and with space to walk between seats, the MXT is being marketed as an off-road vehicle. Thankfully, it is not available in all GCC markets.

In 2013, the Audi R8 got a facelift. The R8 is German brand's two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. In mid-2009, a 5.2-litre V10 engine was introduced. In 2013, the R8 V10 plus was introduced. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or a new 7-speed S-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. However in most GCC countries, the manual gearbox is only offered on the V8, possibly on special order. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

An all-new Skoda Octavia came out in 2014 in the GCC. It got a facelift for the 2018 model. Compared to its predecessor, the Octavia has grown significantly in length and width. The new model is 90 mm longer and 45 mm wider than the second-generation Skoda Octavia. At the same time, the wheelbase has grown by 108 mm, mainly benefiting the interior and space on the rear seats. In 2017, there are two 4-cylinder turbocharged engines to choose from, the 1.4-litre and the 1.8-litre, both mated to a 7-speed DSG gearbox. The base Octavia Ambition model comes with 16-inch steel wheels, fabric interior, rear mud flaps, automatic A/C, electric adjustable, heated & foldable door mirrors, electric windows, parking sensors, radio with CD player and MP3 support,  4 speakers, remote central locking, fog lights and front & side front airbags. The Octavia Style model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, leather interior, chrome package, cruise control, Apply connectivity, mobile device interface (MDI), electric seats, sunroof and xenon headlamps. The Octavia RS gets 19-inch alloy wheels, carbon-fibre inlays for dashboard and door panels, boot spoiler, red brake calipers, sports suspension, Bluetooth and Apple connectivity.

The awkwardly-named MP4-12C marks McLaren Automotive's return to building their own street cars, having dabbled in Formula 1 for years now. Their "affordable" supercar is still pricey, but it is positioned as a no-compromises piece of engineering, with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a "pre-cog" 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised, and can generally be had with manual sports seats, leather-alcantara upholstery, touchscreen multimedia system, MP3 stereo with USB port, power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry, HID headlights, carbon-fibre interior trim, auto a/c, cruise control, cup-holders and all that, though there is no Bluetooth, rear camera or CD player. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA 45 AMG is a sub-compact sports sedan of the German brand. If features a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to a 7-speed automatic and an all-wheel-drive platform. It gets the AMG-specific bumpers and wheels. Other AMG-specific features include a conservative "twin-blade" grille, black side-sills and trim, and squared-off exhaust tips. Further features include sports seats, stiffer suspension, sports exhaust system, speed-sensitive sports steering, transmission oil cooler, bigger brakes and an AMG-tuned ESP system. The CLA 45 AMG "Edition 1" model includes red highlights on certain trim bits, red brake calipers, 19-inch AMG light-alloy wheels in matte black, and special seat upholstery, AMG Performance steering wheel and other doodads. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, ABS brakes, ESP and traction control.

The weirdly-named Qashqai is built on Nissan's "C" platform, providing high body stiffness with reduced body weight. It received a minor facelift for 2011, with a new front, new tail lamps, fresh wheel designs and new instrument gauges. The Qashqai offers a choice of 2WDand full-time 4WD with a single 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT transmission. The fancy interior seats five, and available features include intelligent key, power windows and mirrors, rear 60/40 split-fold bench seat, cloth upholstery, automatic headlights and wipers, new LED tail lamps, additional sound deadening and xenon headlights. Also available are steering wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, aCD audio system with six speakers and 6-disc CD changer, auto air-conditioning with dual zone temperature control, a Bluetooth hands-free phone system, and a choice of 16-inch or 17-inch wheels. While it looks like a 4WD, the poseur 2WD model should prove popular as a hatchback alternative, considering it does not offer much more cargo space than a standard hatchback anyway. Aside from the strong bodyshell, safety features include stability control and front airbags, while side and curtain airbags are optional.

The Opel Adam is the German brand's mini hatchback offering. Under the hood, the Adam gets a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. An automatic transmission will be available later. It is very fuel-efficient since it also comes with engine start/stop technology. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with USB/AUX support, manual A/C and fabric seats. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control (ESC).

The Ford Flex received a facelift and new engines for the 2013 model. Touted as a crossover, it is more of a boxy-shaped minivan alternative. Offered in various trim levels, the Flex is powered by either a 3.5-litre V6 or a turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated with a 6-speed automatic transmission and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive. Airy and spacious, It offers four forward-opening doors, seating for six or seven depending on chosen options, and can be had with a refrigerator, dual panoramic sunroofs, cruise control, common power accessories, capless fuel-filler, HID headlights and LED tails, two-tone paintjob, programmable interior LED lighting, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, 10-speaker Sony stereo, and Ford's new Sync multimedia system which can connect and control any Bluetooth phone or USB music player. Safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, multiple front and side airbags and ABS brakes.

For 2018, the Mercedes-Benz S 65 AMG gets a mid-cycle refresh, in line with the rest of the S-Class range, with ever-so-subtle design changes. The most significant changes for the S65 AMG include a new transmission, and ends with a slightly redesigned front-fascia and DRL's. It is still propelled by a 6.0-litre twin-turbocharged V12 engine, and is now mated to an all-new 9-speed automatic transmission. Mercedes-Benz has gone forward and cut an impressive 100 kg from the overall weight. Theres also an AMG sports exhaust system with logic-controlled exhaust flaps that produces the desired sound according to the situation. The exterior also has AMG design cues, despite the fact that it looks less aggressive than its predecessor. It still has the angry looking air-intakes, and an upright and distinctive radiator grill. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The new for 2015 Subaru WRX is a new generation model and available only as sedan. Under the hood, it gets a new 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler, replacing the 2.5-litre unit. It will be coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission. There's a new Sport Lineartronic CVT as an option, which also comes with "6-speed" and "8-speed" paddle-shifter mode. The new lighter engine ensures that this WRX with the manual gearbox is just 30 kg heavier than the previous model. It gets 17-inch wheels wrapped within Dunlop SP Sport Maxx RT tires. Of the two alternatives, torque will be equally (50:50) distributed to all four wheels in the 6-speed manual variant and the CVT will receive a torque distribution split of 45:55 with Subaru's Variable Torque Distribution system.  The new WRX will be 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

The Ford Explorer remains unchanged for 2013, with some slight trim changes and the addition of a new engine option. It is a crossover with a unibody structure and road-biased demeanour. The Explorer is now available with a turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 model, in addition to the 3.5-litre V6, both engines mated to a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, with the base model getting front-wheel-drive and the rest getting full-time all-wheel-drive with no low-range gearing. There are four trim levels. The base model features include cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic Ford SYNC with 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, 18-inch wheels, three-row seating, keyless entry, cruise control, capless fuel filler, power driver's seat, adjustable steering wheel, common power options and more. Available features higher up the trim levels include intelligent access with push button start, three-zone auto a/c, remote engine start, power liftgate, power-adjustable seats and pedals with memory, leather, heated and cooled front seats, MyFord Touch for the Ford SYNC touchscreen, 8-speaker stereo or 12-speaker Sony audio system, Bluetooth, 20-inch polished aluminium wheels, dual moonroof and power-folding third-row seats. The top Limited can be outfitted with further options such as HID headlights, rain-sensing wipers, adaptive cruise control with auto braking and the automatic parallel-parking system. The front-biased all-wheel-drive Explorer has an electronic center coupling that controls the torque split between the front and rear wheels, and acts as a center differential. Standard off-road electronics on AWD models include hill-descent control, hill-ascent assist, four-wheel electronic traction control and a standard "Terrain Management" system that varies drivetrain and ESP characteristics for different conditions. Standard safety features include dual front airbags, side and curtain airbags, Roll Stability Control, stability control and Curve Control. Other optional safety features include inflatable rear-seatbelt airbags, blind-spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, and collision warning with pre-crash brake support.

The MKT is Lincoln's full-size luxury crossover that is based on the Ford Flex, with three rows of seating and tons of space. It got a facelift in 2013, along with minor improvements to the interior. According to Lincoln, the "T" in MKT, stands for Touring. Larger than the MKX midsize crossover and more efficient than the Navigator, the MKT is offered in the UAE with the turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. Offered in either 6-seater or 7-seater configurations, a second-row 60/40 split folding bench seat, optional power "fold and tumble" second-row bucket seats include heating, cooling and power lumbar adjustment, and an available 5-quart refrigerator in the centre console, alongside all the usual features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seats, CD/MP3 stereo and Bluetooth phone. A fixed-glass panoramic roof with power-assisted front and rear sunshades is standard and an opening panoramic sunroof is optional. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, as well as ABS and stability control.

The Mazda CX-3 is the Japanese brand's smallest SUV offering. Under the hood, it comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2-wheel drive model includes power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push button start, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/USB, Bluetooth, 4 speakers and alloy wheels. The mid-spec models get all-wheel drive, rear camera, auto A/C, 7-inch touch screen, 6 speakers, steering wheel with Bluetooth controls, daytime running lamps and fog lamps. The top model gets navigation, 6 Bose speakers, adaptive cruise control, leather seats, head up display, digital tachometer and DVD player. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, ABS with EBD and traction control and stability control. The higher models get blind spot monitor, auto-braking system, lane departure warning system and side curtain airbags.

The Volvo V60 is the estate version of the S60. Originally available in the GCC with two engine choices, there is only a V60 2.0T model now, that comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine mated to an 8-speed automatic. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians.

The Mitsubishi Mirage takes on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. In 2017, it got a facelift and few interior upgrades. The hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

The sleek new-for-2008 EX35 is what Infiniti likes to call a coupe-crossover, although it is really a compact five-door wagon. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6, it comes with a standard five-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. It has an excellent leather interior, power front seats, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo, power mirrors, stability control,  and an advanced front-side-curtain airbag system. There is no low-range gearing as the EX35 sits low and the chassis is tuned for on-road dynamics. The EX35 also comes with nifty features such as intelligent keyless entry and start, as well as a seven-inch colour display with Infiniti controller for the trip computer and additional vehicle information, including the Infiniti DVD navigation system. But the most interesting feature by far is the around-view parking system that uses four cameras to simulate a 360-degree image of what is around the vehicle, thereby making parking easier in tight spots.

The Skoda Kodiaq is the VW-owned Czech brand's first proper foray into the crossover market after the van-like Skoda Yeti was cancelled. There is a choice of two engines , one a 1.4-litre turbo in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive forms, and another a 2.0-litre turbo in all-wheel-drive form. The smaller engine comes with a 6-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic while the larger one gets a 7-speed DSG auto. Seating can be 5 or 7, depending on trim level. Features include a touchscreen multimedia system, cruise control, keyless entry, ABS with EBD, a full set of airbags and all the other other usual bits and bobs.

The Opel Corsa is the smallest offering from the German manufacturer in the Middle East market. The base model comes with a 4-cylinder 1.4-litre engine, mated to a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic transmission. There is a 3-door and 5-door hatchback version to choose from. Standard options include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, manual A/C, AM/FM radio, cloth upholstery and steel wheels. The higher models get a better entertainment system with a CD player and MP3/iPod/AUX support, and alloy wheels. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution.

The all-new M4 came out as a 2015 model year and is the replacement for the M3 Coupe. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

The Nissan Tiida is all-new for 2014, and is essentially a hatchback version of the Sentra sedan. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. Two 4-cylinder engine options are available, namely a 1.6-litre and a 1.8-litre, both mated to a CVT automatic. The brakes are front discs with rear drums. The suspension is independent up front, with a torsion-beam rear. The basic 1.6-litre Tiida S features power steering, power windows, central door locking, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with CD player and 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. For the 1.6-litre Tiida SV, there's audio controls on the steering wheel, 4 speakers and 16-inch alloy wheels. The 1.8-litre Tiida SV gets additional smoked halogen lamps, smoked-chrome front grille and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 1.8-litre Tiida SL also gets power folding mirrors with integrated side lamp, cruise control, intelligent key, starter button, steering wheel-mounted bluetooth buttons, rear armrest, leather shift knob, 6 speakers and automatic A/C. The Tiida SL Plus optionally adds leather seats and sunroof, although these are standard on the SL in some markets such as the UAE. For the UAE market specifically, the SV and SL models get a 5.8-inch display screen with Bluetooth, CD player, MP3, AUX, USB, Ipod connectivity, navigation and rear-view camera as standard, although these may be optional in other GCC markets. A fully body kit is also optionally available in some markets. Standard safety features for the Nissan Tiida include dual front airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and brake assist (BA). The 1.8-litre models also get stability control, and only the top 1.8 SL Plus gets side and curtain airbags.

This generation of the G37 Coupe was first offered in 2008. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe and the convertible are proper 2+2 seater cars, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. An all new generation Koleos came out in 2017, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. In 2020, it got a minor facelift. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment in the 2020 Renault Koleos, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Navigation is a new option for 2014. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The C 63 AMG model is the sports model of the C-Class range. The heavily-tuned 6.2-litre V8-powered C 63 AMG comes with a 7-speed automatic. An auto start-stop feature allows for low fuel-consumption ratings. The centre console comes with an electronic rotary switch for selecting the four transmission modes and the race start function. The sports seats are optionally available in single-tone or two-tone designo leather. In 2013, a special "Edition 507" version was offered, with black wheels and an upgraded engine. The C 63 AMG comes with a full set of safety features, including electronic nannies and multiple airbags.

With the Sharan, VW properly wets its feet in the minivan segment, though it is falling behind the modern competition nowadays, considering its 1995 origins. The Sharan is not a true VW, being based on a Ford minivan, and also sold as a rebadged Seat. Revamped in 2000, and facelifted for 2004, it provides ample room for the driver and six adult passengers to sit back, relax and enjoy their individually formed 'business class' seats. The Sharan offers the flexibility of removing the rear seats to open up a massive 2,610 cubic litres of storage space. Powered by two aging VW engines, namely the 1.8-litre turbo four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre VR6 units, they can be had with a manual or an automatic. Built in Portugal, the Sharan comes standard with five removable rear seats, ABS brakes with electronic brake-pressure distribution, electronic climate control both front and rear, alarm with interior protection and remote central locking, front side airbag system, driver's and front passenger's airbags, electric front windows, electrically adjustable door mirrors, radio/CD stereo with 10 speakers, and seat belts for all three rows of seating.

The 2018 Ford Transit is the brand's large commercial van offering. It seats up to 2 people, and comes in 3 roof heights: Low, Medium and High. It comes in 2 wheelbases and 3 lengths:RWB, LWB and LWB EL. Under the hood, the 2021 Ford Transit gets the 3.7-litre V6 petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, vinyl seats, halogen headamps, AM/FM stereo, 4 front speakers, auxiliary audio input jack and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features include AdvanceTrac with RSC (Roll Stability Control), airbags – driver and front-passenger, airbags – Safety Canopy System with side-curtain airbags for front row, passenger-side front airbag with deactivation switch and rear view camera with trailer hitch assist, SOS Post Crash Alert System, and tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS).

For 2018, the Infiniti QX80 got a major facelift which included new LED headlight clusters, new grille, reshaped bumpers, redone rear lights, new tailgate chrome trim, and redesigned 22-inch wheels. It still comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. A 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available. The QX80 also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. The cabin can be trimmed in either leather as standard or semi-aniline leather with optional contrast-colour piping. Standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 8-inch colour monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the QX80's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA colour touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

The Mercedes-Maybach, which was introduced back in 2015, got an all-new model in 2021. The S650 Maybach is being sold in the GCC. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 6.0-litre V12, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include a full panoramic sunroof, powered privacy shades for the rear windows, acres of leather trim, night-vision display in the LCD gauge-cluster, chrome-plated speaker grilles, fibre-optic ambient lighting, Burmester 3D surround sound, and back-lit tweeters on all the doors that spiral out on start-up, although these things can even be had in a standard S-Class, if you tick everything on the options list. The lounge-worthy rear seats both offer a full range of power adjustability, and includes extending calf-supports, a massaging function, heated/cooled cup-holders and a seat heating/cooling feature, while the right-side rear seat gets an additional footrest that can be motored out of the front passenger seatback for sleeping. It's so intricate that the dual LCD screens on the front seat-backs automatically adjust their angles as the front seats are adjusted, so the rear passengers always get the best view. The massage and multimedia features are controlled with a remote, with animated settings showing on the screens. Its "Magic Body Control" system that scans the road ahead for bumps and adjusts the suspension to drive over them as smoothly as possible. Further options include flip-out tray-tables and a fridge that comes with a pair of silver-plated champagne flute-glasses as well as space for three chilled bottles. Along with the front and side airbags, ABS, traction control, the Mercedes-Maybach can be added with PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, Brake Assist BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Night View Assist Plus. In the shape of the seat belt buckle extender, Beltbag (both part of the PRE-SAFE rear package) and seat cushion airbag.

The Lexus ES is all-new for 2007. With a new 3.5-litre engine, mated to a six-speed automatic, the Lexus ES 350 became a more powerful ride. Still, the Lexus ES 350 is a luxury sedan that wows with smoothness and quietness rather than handling and speed. This so-called entry-level luxury car is based on the Toyota Camry chassis, with upgraded body, equipment and interior. The front-wheel drive ES 350 does come with an impressive set of standard features that the Toyota Camry can only dream about. The Lexus ES 350 comes as one model, but the buyer can opt for a huge range of equipment. Available features include park assist, a power rear sunshade, ventilated front seats, a wood and leather trim package, and DVD navigation with backup camera. Optional equipment includes a navigation system, a 14-speaker Mark Levinson stereo system, Bluetooth wireless capability for cellphones, a panoramic glass roof, and radar-adaptive cruise control. Safety features that come standard on the ES 350 include dual front airbags, a knee airbag, side-impact airbags, curtain airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, electronic brake-force distribution, also known as EBD, and a tyre-pressure monitor system.

The Dodge Challenger received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the all-new Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It can also be optioned with a forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection.Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger can be had with a 3.6-litre V6 or a 5.7-litre V8. Standard features in the V6 include sporty suspension, cloth upholstery, alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo, power accessories and not much else. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, lane departure warning, lane discipline system, blind spot monitor, tyre pressure monitor, front collision alert and auto braking, and adaptive cruise control.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations. Features, most of them optional, include air conditioning, a reclining split bench seating in front, power steering, 4-speaker AM/FM radio cassette audio system with CD player, power windows and auto door lock, airbags, dual cup-holders and a sliding rear window. A bunch of bed accessories are also available. The four-wheel-drive models have better ground clearance and a pumped-up look compared to the rear-wheel-drive models. It seems not all models are available in all local markets.

The Fluence is a budget model from Renault, built in Korea and designed for Eastern-European and Middle-Eastern markets. It received a face-lift for the 2013 model. Sized somewhere between a compact and a midsize, it is value-priced and can be loaded with up with respectable features. Powered by a weak 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, this front-wheel-drive sedan can be had with either a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic. A 2.0-litre model comes later with a CVT. Standard features include variable electric power steering, anti-theft alarm, adjustable steering wheel, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 player, manual a/c and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher models can be specced up with a Arkamys or Bose stereo, USB/iPod ports, Bluetooth, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, auto headlights, keyless start button, dual-zone automatic a/c, fog lamps, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof and more. Standard safety features include ABS-assisted front disc and rear drum brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution, two front airbags and seatbelt pre-tensioners, with optional features such as stability control and side-curtain airbags.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The eight-generation Hilux made its debut in the GCC as a 2016 model year. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Mechanically, the 2016 Hilux will offer a new 6-speed automatic transmission, which gives a 15-percent better fuel economy rating than the previous generation model. Engine choices include the 2.0-litre and 2.7-litre petrol engines, and a new more powerful 2.4-litre diesel engine. While the 2.0-litre is available only in rear-wheel-drive, the other two engines can be had in either four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive. Safety features for it includes front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbag for the driver, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) seat-belt equipped on all seats except the centre seat.

The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. In some GCC markets like Saudi Arabia, a 4.5-litre V8 turbodiesel model is sold as well. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. In 2021, a Land Cruiser 70 Overland was introduced. Equipped with front and rear TJM XGS Series 4000 SX Shocks and TJM XGS Coil Springs on the front providing increased ride height. The Overlander edition also comes standard with a heavy-duty on-board air compressor, 12V electric factory winch and STEDI 7-inch LED spotlights. It gets a 9-inch display audio with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, along with navigation.

Introduced in 2004, the Jazz got a minor update and a new engine for 2006. Honda claims that the new Jazz rewrites the small car concept, offering benchmark space, functionality, style, performance, fuel economy and world class safety. It is at least partially true, considering the car was created by two design teams, one from Japan and another from Germany. Their innovations have led to a vehicle which is fun to drive and versatile too, though very dorky to look at. It is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic from 2006, but it is the space that Honda is touting. During the design process, every part of the Jazz was examined for space efficiency. Engineers have even located the fuel tank beneath the front cabin floor to make efficient use of cabin space. Therefore by centrally locating the fuel tank, Honda has boosted body rigidity, increased crash protection in all directions as well as improved protection of the fuel tank. Jazz has a range of standard features that include driver and passenger airbags, anti-lock brakes, CD player and unique "Magic Seats", though it does skimp on interior materials, and power windows are only available for the front.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class sedan. Under the hood, they gets twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

From 2014, the Infiniti G37 Coupe became the Q60 Coupe to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. This generation of the coupe was first offered in 2008. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted 7-speed automatic gearbox. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. The coupe and the convertible are proper 2+2 seater cars, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Some markets, such as UAE, now offer only one trim level. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Lexus NX, the Japanese brand's first entry in the compact crossover field, received a facelift for 2018. The name was also changed from NX 200t to NX 300. It comes with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to an 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. All models come with 18-inch alloys, LED headlights, synthetic or real leather, power front seats, premium multimedia system with navigation, cruise control, smart keyless entry and start, power tilt/telescoping steering wheel with buttons, Bluetooth, USB and more. The higher-spec models gain adaptive cruise, Mark Levinson stereo, wood trim, illuminated scuff plates, ventilated seats, remote starter, power-folding rear seats, wireless phone charger, power tailgate, panoramic parking cameras, heads-up display, adaptive suspension and more. The F-Sport models additionally get a mesh grille for the different front bumper, firmer suspension tuning and different wheel designs, optionally with wider tyres. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags as well as stability control and ABS with brake assist, with options including a pre-crash safety system, lane-change assist with blind-spot monitoring and cross-traffic alert, and lane-keeping assist with lane-departure alert and steering assist.

BMW made its leap into the large SUV category with the flagship X7. Under the hood, two engine options are available - the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 cylinder engine and the turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 motor, both mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and electrically adjustable third-row seating. The middle row features three seats with a two-seat "captain's chair" configuration also available. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. The X7 also receives driver assistance systems including autonomous cruise control and collision detection with braking intervention.

The BMW M2 made its debut in the GCC in 2016. The exterior of the M2 Coupe may look no different than that of the M235i at first glance. But there are visual changes such as aggressively-flared front and rear bumpers, quad-exhausts and sporty alloys. As much as 80% of parts can be different when comparing M cars versus their non-M versions. Underneath the bonnet is a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. The car gets an overboost function that increases the torque for a few seconds. The engine will be mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The car also receives M4-derived aluminium front and rear axles, aluminium suspension components, tuned electronic power-steering and an Active M-Differential. The longer M4-sourced axles are what led the M2 to have wider fenders, so the tyres wouldn't stick out.

The Nissan Altima, released GCC-wide for 2005, is a roomy and practical midsize sedan, competing with the Honda Accord and Toyota Camry with slightly more sporty handling and a little more extrovert styling. The Altima however sits at the top of the class in terms of available horsepower and interior room. Though the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, with a choice of manual or automatic gearboxes, is enough for most people, it is the 3.5-litre V6, also with a choice of manual or automatic, that makes the Altima a cheap alternative to pricey and slow front-wheel-drive sports sedans from Volvo and Audi. The Altima delivers stunning acceleration when optioned with the V6, which is essentially the same engine used in the Nissan 350Z. The Altima also boasts a big interior. Standard features include power windows, tinted windshield, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, power steering, a 60/40 split folding rear seat and an in-glass antenna. Also available are power mirrors, remote keyless entry with remote trunk lock, optional electric seats, cruise control, a six-speaker audio system and optional leather. ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution (EBD) and Brake Assist are standard, as are front airbags and alloy wheels.

The Dodge Ram, Chrysler's full-size pickup, was given a complete makeover for 2009, although technically it became available in most GCC markets only by 2010. Also, "Ram" became its own separate brand in the States,  dropping the "Dodge" name for the pickup line, although it was still referred to as a Dodge Ram in this region until 2011, regardless of what the badges say. The Ram 1500 will only be offered in the GCC with a 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic with available manual-shift feature. Available in regular cab, quad cab and crew cab, with three box lengths depending on model, the two trim levels available in the UAE are the ST and the Laramie. The new model is the first truck in this segment to have a coil-spring multilink rear suspension fitted to a solid rear axle, instead of leaf springs, to improve ride quality. The new design boasts best-in-class aerodynamics and new interiors with premium soft-touch materials, as well as an optional industry-first RamBox lockable storage bins built into the bed rails, and cabin storage bins with removable liners big enough for ten beer cans. Other available features include heated and ventilated front seats, surround-sound Alpine audio system, common power accessories, voice-controlled UConnect multimedia touchscreen system with Bluetooth phone and 30 GB hard drive, rear DVD screen, basic keyless entry with remote start, 17-inch basic or 20-inch chrome wheels, dual-zone auto a/c and a choice of cloth or leather upholstery, all depending on trim level. Standard safety features include standard ABS, stability control with hill-start assist and trailer sway control, front airbags and side airbags, as well as optional  adjustable pedals, rear parking sensors and back-up camera.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received 2 major makeovers for 2008 and 2019, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The Peugeot 308 received a facelift in 2012. The same 1.6-litre 4-cylinder and turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines carried over from the previous shape. However, the turbocharged version gets a power boost. They all get a new 6-speed automatic transmission. Even the most basic model gets driver & passenger airbags, ABS brakes with EBD, trip computer, AM/FM Radio with CD/MP3 player with remote stalk, speed-sensitive power steering, electric windows and mirrors, cooling vent inside the glove compartment, height-adjustable headlights, split-folding rear seats, remote key with central locking, and 15-inch wheels. Moving up to the higher trim levels adds items such as side-curtain airbags, stability control, navigation system, dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents, CD/MP3 player with bluetooth and AUX input, 5-CD changer, panoramic sunroof with automatic curtain, cruise control, automatic headlights, rain-sensing wipers, leather seats with chrome interior trim, auto-dimming mirror, foldable door mirrors, fog lights, parking sensors, front and rear armrests,  16-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and automatic tyre pressure sensors. Inside and out, it is a classy hatchback for its category, making it almost as good as any of the premium-branded compacts.

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. For 2020 it got a facelift and new tech features, along with slight bump up in horsepower and torque. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Later in 2017, a 6.6-litre V12 engine was added to the lineup with all-wheel drive, called the M760Li. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

The new-for-2011 Mitsubishi ASX is a 5-seater sub-compact crossover based on the Outlander platform and actually shares the exact same wheelbase, but is shorter at the front and especially the rear. The standard engine is a 2.0-litre DOHC 4-cylinder with MIVEC variable valve timing, CVT transmission and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The all-wheel-drive has 2WD, 4WD and 4WD Lock modes. The base model comes with 16-inch alloy wheels, keyless entry, cloth seats, soft-touch dash and front door surfaces, CD/MP3 player with AUX and USB ports, ABS-assisted disc brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, up to seven airbags including a knee bag, and an optional panoramic glass roof with mood lighting along the sides. The top model gets 17-inch alloys, a front lip spoiler, intelligent entry with starter button, HID headlights, leather upholstery and a 7-speaker stereo with subwoofer, among other items. Available safety features include the aforementioned airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, hill start assist and emergency braking blinkers.

The Lexus IS received a full redesign for 2014, completely shying away from their usual conservative styling. It comes with a choice of 2.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic transmission in the IS 250 or a 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350, both on a rear-wheel-drive platform, with new steering and rear suspension derived from the Lexus GS. New driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it now gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. A host of new standard items for 2014 include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

The RAV-4 is credited for being the original small 4WD built on a car chassis. It's not that there is anything fundamentally wrong with the vehicle. It's just that the RAV-4 is not a strong off-roader, but insists on looking like one, and people buy it for that reason. It continues with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder in this market even though a V6 model has been introduced elsewhere. Most markets, including UAE and KSA, get the all-wheel-drive model, but KSA additionally gets a two-wheel-drive option as well, the base one with a manual gearbox. The RAV4 range has an array of comfort and convenience features including auto air- conditioning, a MP3 compatible CD player with 6 speakers, power windows and central locking, keyless entry, and cruise control. Its rugged yet stylish exterior appearance is enhanced by a rear spoiler, roof rails, fog lamps and alloy wheels. The high series models also feature a powered driver's seat, leather seats, a moonroof and rear corner sensors. Safety features on all models include dual-stage frontal airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control and traction control. Side airbags are optional. Minor facelifts over the years are too small to notice.

The X6 is what you get when you chop the top off an X5. It is dubbed the world's first "Sport Activity Coupe," which unfortunately abbreviates down to "SAC." While still technically a 4WD, the new-for-2009 X6 comes in two models, namely the XDrive35i and the XDrive50i, both being powerful high-end models, in keeping with its exclusive nature. It is therefore powered by either a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 or a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8, both mated to 6-speed manually-shiftable automatics. The X6 gets a new all-wheel drive system, without low-range gearing, but improving on-road handling. Redesigned to be shorter in height than its practical sibling, the X6 offers seating for only four in its chop-top cabin. A whole host of features include standard bi-xenon headlights, BMW's controversial iDrive computer, 19-inch alloy wheels, run-flat tyres, tyre-pressure monitor, 10-way power front seats, and new leather colour schemes. Other available features include active steering, automatic tailgate, adaptive headlights, rear-mounted DVD system, reverse-view camera, satellite-navigation, four-zone air-conditioning, and bigger rims. Standard safety features include front, side and side head airbags, and crash-activated front-seat headrests, as well as stability control, ABS and a fancy new driving aid called Dynamic Performance Control.

The Ranger pickup range will appeal to customers who are looking for a basic work truck, although it can be optioned up with luxury-car equipment as well. Completely redesigned and enlarged for 2012 and sharing its platform with Mazda, the Ranger is a midsize pickup that can be had in either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive form. It got a facelift for the 2016 model year. The engine range includes a 2.5-litre petrol 4-cylinder with a 5-speed manual, a 2.2-litre turbodiesel 4-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic and a 3.2-litre turbodiesel 5-cylinder with a 6-speed manual or automatic, though not all motors are available in all markets. Offered in single-cab and double-cab body styles, available features include manual or optional auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB, optional Bluetooth, optional rear camera with sensors, numerous storage spaces inside the cabin, and a choice of 16-inch or optional 17-inch wheels. Moving up the trim levels adds ABS, dual front and optional side-curtain airbags, 6-speaker stereo with CD changer, keyless entry, power windows, power mirrors, decals, bedliner, steel-tubing protection bars and 4x4 with low-range gearing with optional diff lock. The top model is the Ranger WildTrak model, which is aimed at offroad enthusiasts.

The five-door Leon is arguably the sportiest model in the Seat line-up, and the best interpretation of the new Seat design language yet.
