Named after a Spanish city, yet based on the VW Golf, the Leon offers an array of engines, including a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre and three turbocharged 2.0-litre units, all from Volkswagen. Depending on model, there are manual, automatic or DSG automanual gearboxes available. Standard features include power front windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, keyless entry, ABS brakes, traction control, electronic stability control and anti-slip regulation. Also available are front airbags, side and curtain airbags, a tyre pressure sensor, electric mirrors and a quality CD audio system. Basic models get 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, while climbing up the model range allows for 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include special upholstery, cruise control, onboard computer, rear power windows and side mirror with electric parking position. The sporty FR gets the first turbo engine, sports seats, lowered suspension and other trim bits. The Cupra carries the FR concept further with an upgraded turbo engine and a body kit, among other changes. The Cupra R replaced the Cupra later on with more power.

The Jaguar XFR-S is the top performance model in the XF lineup. It gets a supercharged 5.0-litre V8 and is mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The most interesting feature of the car is its simplistic interior which consists of toys such as a rotary-dial gear selector and hideway a/c vents. It features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, in-dash 7-inch screen, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options. The audio unit comes with 30GB of storage and a standard 400-watt system, an optional 600-watt system, or a 1200-watt system which features 17-speakers with subwoofer from Bowers & Wilkins. The XFR-S gets unique bumpers, skirts, wheels and interior upholstery, as well as sports suspension and drivetrain components.

The G35 is a fairly luxurious rear-wheel-drive honest-to-goodness sports sedan. It uses an upgraded 3.5-litre V6 with a five-speed automatic transmission. Its platform is the corporate front-midship, which it shares with the Nissan 350Z. Features include  a restyled exterior, luxury suspension tuning, upgraded interior materials, 17-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, heated mirrors, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo with seven speakers and wheel-mounted controls, cruise control, automatic headlamps, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a rear spoiler, power sunroof, rosewood interior trim, dual HVAC controls and a DVD-based navigation system. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The fancy FX35 aims to please city-going rich folks. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6, it comes with a standard five-speed automatic and a sporting chassis. It has a leather interior, power driver's and passenger seats, 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, aluminium roof rails, rearview monitor, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, 300-watt six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo with ten speakers, power mirrors and an advanced airbag system. The FX's on-demand all-wheel-drive system, known as ATTESA E-TS, or Advanced Total Traction Engineering System for All Electronic Torque Split, runs at 99 per cent rear wheel bias under most conditions. When slip is detected, up to 50 per cent power goes to the front wheels, but there is no low-range gearing. The FX35 also comes with automatic rear hatch closure assist system, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, aluminium interior trim, dual-zone climate control, information display monitor, and three-spoke leather-wrapped wheel with audio controls.

The Cadillac SRX aims more for road-going luxury than any sort of off-roading ability. There's a standard power rear liftgate, reduced step-over for easy exiting, stylish 17-inch and 18-inch wheels and an enhanced optional wood package, all of which signify its intentions. Bigger than a wagon but not quite a 4WD, the SRX is one of the rare vehicles that truly deserves the "crossover" designation. It uses GM's Sigma platform serving the Cadillac CTS. Engine choices are a 3.6-litre V6 and a 4.6-litre Northstar V8, both of which use a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. Both engine sizes can be optioned up to all-wheel-drive. Standard features include fog lights, heated mirrors, roof rack side rails, rear wiper/washer, 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather-wrapped wheel with controls for audio and voice recognition systems, express up/down on all windows, leather interior, eight-way power driver's seat, 60/40 folding rear seat, CD player with seven speakers, automatic headlamps, and rear parking assist. The V8 model adds driver's side auto-dimming exterior mirror, 18-inch aluminum wheels, CD changer and more. The SRX handles like a car rather than a lumpy 4WD, and the optional Magnetic Ride Control, which automatically adjusts the shocks to compensate for any road imperfections, makes it even smoother on the roads, where it belongs.

The Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo came out as a 2019 model year. It is the estate or "shooting brake" variant of the regular Panamera. Initially, only two all-wheel drive variants were made available in the GCC - the 4S and Turbo. Later on the base Panamera was available, along with the, Panamera 4, Panamera 4 E-Hybrid Turbo S E-Hybrid. The base model and the Panamera 4S gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6,  while the Panamera Turbo gets a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8. The Turbo S E-Hybrid gets a V8 4.0-litre turbo unit combined with an electric motor. Some updates on the new generation include an improved adaptive air suspension system and optional rear-axle steering. Inside, the interior gets a new instrument cluster with two 7-inch displays. The centre console gets a 12.3-inch touch screen, while the rear passenger get their own set of infotainment and climate controls. Safety features include the usual cocoon of airbags, electronic stability control and ABS.

Mercedes-Benz GLC replaced the GLK. It gets a whole new exterior design. The interior gets a wide centre console and a screen sticking out on top of the A/C vents. It is said to be more spacious than the GLK, thanks to the 11.8 cm longer wheelbase. It is also 80 kg lighter than the GLK, thanks to a mix of different materials used to make the body which includes aluminium and high-strength steels. Under the hood, the GLC 63 AMG gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to the 4Matic all-wheel-drive system. Power is delivered via a 9-speed automatic transmission. Features include AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

Porsche introduced this generation of the 911 model series as a new model, even though it looks almost identical to the older one. The GT3 and GT3 RS get a further upgraded version of the 3.8-litre engine. It is available only with a 6-speed manual transmission. Additional new features include front and rear LED driving lights, bi-xenon headlights, dynamic cornering lights, and a mild overall facelift. Interior features include a CD stereo, leather upholstery, optional multimedia system, common power accessories and more. Safety includes multiple airbags, stability control, ABS and traction control.

The SX4 is an all-new compact car from Suzuki. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model that is not actually offered in most GCC markets. The crossover-style hatchback came first, then a tall sedan came in mid-2008. Originally fitted with a standard 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the SX4 can be equipped with a five-speed manual transmission, while also coming with an optional four-speed automatic. A 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine debuted with the sedan. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class made its debut as a 2018 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, and followed by the C-Class. The new E 63 AMG gets an all-new turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. A fully variable all-wheel-drive system capable of transferring up to 100 percent power to either axles is standard, and so are a limited-slip differential and adaptive damping in the rear axle. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

Mini released an all-new Cooper and Cooper S 5-door hatchback model in 2015 model. In 2018, it received a minor facelift and a new transmission. The Mini Cooper gets a twin-turbocharged 1.5-litre 3-cylinder engine, while the Cooper S gets a twin-turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine. They both get a 7-speed, with the Cooper S getting the dual-clutch transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, fabric seats and alloy rims. Optional features include rain sensor, Park Distance Control, Comfort Access, electrically operated glass roof, roof rails, electrically heated and folding exterior mirrors, interior and exterior mirrors with automatic anti-dazzle function, seat heating, 2-zone automatic air conditioning, rear spoiler in John Cooper Works design, large selection of decorative roof and exterior mirror options, bonnet stripes, seat upholsteries, interior surfaces and Colour Lines, MINI navigation system, MINI Radio Visual Boost and Harman Kardon hi-fi speaker system.Standard safety systems include front and side airbags, ABS brakes and stability control. Driver assistance systems package includes MINI Head-Up-Display, Driving Assistant including camera-based active cruise control, collision and pedestrian warning with initial brake function, high beam assistant and road sign detection, parking assistant; rear view camera.

The sixth-generation Nissan Z shrinks in overall size and gains in engine size to become a more focussed sports car. The all-new 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The redesigned Ssangyong Korando made its debut in the Middle East in 2013, as a sub-compact crossover. Only the petrol engine will be sold here, which is a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It can be had in either two-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, air conditioning, electric windows, electronic stability control, CD/MP3 player, Bluetooth, cruise control, reverse sensors, 16-inch alloy wheels and a leather steering wheel. The higher models get 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels.

The quasi-legendary Mitsubishi Pajero received a facelift in 2015, but it remains largely unchanged since the debut of this version a decade ago. The Pajero is a true off-roader, but has carved a niche as a family wagon. Powertrain options in the 2019 Mitsubishi Pajero is either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 5-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features in the 2019 Mitsubishi Pajero include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a multimedia entertainment system, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard.

The Dodge Challenger received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the all-new Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It can also be optioned with a forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection.Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger can be had with a 3.6-litre V6 or a 5.7-litre V8. Standard features in the V6 include sporty suspension, cloth upholstery, alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo, power accessories and not much else. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. For 2011, the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive, got a massive power upgrade. For 2012, it was upgraded again by 20 hp, along with better fuel economy. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Structural stiffness, suspension and aerodynamics had all been upgraded for 2011. The shocks were upgraded again for 2012. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Prices had gone up by 20% compared to the pre-facelift version, but then came down again for 2012, even while is was upgraded. A 'VVIP' edition debuted in 2011 that costs twice as much while offering a customisable leather interior and gold-plated exterior trimmings. A Black edition debuted in 2012 that added some red cabin trim and Recaro seats.

Originally introduced in Malaysia back in 1993, the Wira was based on the early-90s Mitsubishi Lancer, and continued in its early form all the way to the new century, and ending up being the most outdated car on the market. Available as a sedan or a liftback, the engine and gearbox were sourced from Mitsubishi, namely a 1.5-litre and a 1.6-litre, both 4-cylinder. The smaller engine came with a 5-speed manual or a 3-speed automatic, while the larger one came standard with a 4-speed auto. Features included cloth interior, manual or power windows, radio-cassette player, optional sunroof, optional spoiler, and not much else. Safety features were limited to seat-belts in early models, with later ones receiving a driver-side airbag, ABS brakes and safety-bars in the doors. As unrefined as the car is, proven Mitsubishi mechanicals under the skin means on-road reliability is as good as most Japanese cars, although the car itself will be falling apart from the inside out, starting with the cheap cabin trim. The car flopped in the GCC region, except in places like Kuwait, where it was marketed as a commercial vehicle.

The F-150 delivers all the manly attributes of toughness, strength, and imposing size, although it is largely sold here as a fashion statement for tiny men. Redesigned for 2009 and updated in 2011, the fully-loaded F-150 crew-cab is sold here as more of a lifestyle vehicle, offering interior design and comfort that would rival some luxury cars. Properly equipped, it can haul more than a tonne in its bed. The F-150 is comfortable as well, with a quiet and refined ride. It comes with dual front and side airbags, cloth or leatherette seats, CD/MP3 stereo, and air conditioning as standard. Other available features include an optional 4.2-inch LCD screen, hill descent control, electronic locking differential settings and stability control. A host of power and luxury options are available too. For all these reasons, the F-150 has been America's best-selling full-size pickup for nearly 30 consecutive years. It is the most most profitable vehicle Ford makes. It is available in various trim levels, variations, and specialty models, including quad cab, single cab and dual cab model, with various bed sizes. New engines redefined the line-up for 2011, with a new 3.7-litre V6 and a new 5.0-litre V8, both from the Mustang, and fitted with automatic transmissions and a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive. The top version is called the Platinum, while a special Harley-Davidson trim is also available. The F-150 SVT Raptor also became available on special-order, in 6.2-litre V8 form, and identifiable by its unique body mods and aggressive offroad suspension.

The BMW X6 M got a new model for the 2020 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X6 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

One of the longest-running nameplates in the region, the Sunny has become popular for its reasonable price and traditional reliability, all while competitors drove their own prices up. However, the Sunny soon fell behind in terms of equipment, and the all-new Tiida arrived as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. Nissan Middle East is openly pushing the Sunny as a fleet car now, leaving the Tiida for individual sales. For 2010, and the engine lineup is limited to just one. There are now two versions, one a basic rebadged Samsung SM3 built in Korea and another a "Classic" model with a different front-end built in Japan. There is good head room, but other interior dimensions fall behind its competitors. Available as a four-door sedan, the Sunny is now available only with a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include electric power steering, air conditioning and a cloth interior. Options include a CD stereo system and power accessories. Optional safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the MDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, roof rack, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power seats with lumbar support, 3 rows for 7 seaters, 3-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 12 speakers, DVD player with Dolby Pro Logic II (PL2)/MP3/WMA/USB/AUX support & 100 GD hard-disk, handsfree telephone with voice recognition, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard. The higher model gets adaptive cruise control, premium MILANO leather and bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the MDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), traction control, hill-start assist and trailer stability assist. The higher model gets additional blind spot information, crash mitigation brake system & forward collision warning system.

The Renault Koleos is a compact SUV designed by Renault and developed by Nissan. It is manufactured by Renault Samsung Motors, a subsidiary of Renault, at its plant in South Korea. Based on a Nissan platform, the Koleos received a minor facelift in 2014, but still uses a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic gearbox. Though it may look like an offroader, this mildly-lifted crossover comes standard with front-wheel-drive in the base trim, while basic all-wheel-drive system is standard on the higher trim levels, with 50:50 lock but without low-range gearing. Available equipment, depending on trim level, includes cruise control, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 sound system, automatic air-conditioning, rain-sensing wipers, automatic headlights, rear parking sensors, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and an automatic electronic parking brake. Navigation is a new option for 2014. Stability control, ABS, front airbags and side-curtain airbags helped the Koleos achieve a 5-star crash test rating in Europe.

The Outlander crossover was redesigned for 2008, based on the Lancer platform, but only two years later, it got a new Evo-inspired nose for 2010. Engines include a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic, and a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a 6-speedautomatic. The all-wheel-drive system distributes power as needed under various conditions and also with a 4WD Lock mode, but it does not have the equipment to be a serious off-roader. Basic features include an AM/FM radio cassette player with a six-CD changer and 4 speakers, dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and Brake Assist, power steering, power windows, cloth upholstery, central locking, keyless entry, 16-inch alloy wheels and power mirrors. The higher models can be optioned out with cruise control, 18-inch alloys, Rockford Fosgate stereo with 6-CD changer and 9 speakers, full keyless system, leather steering wheel with audio controls, rear parking sensors, paddle shifters and faux leather seats. Only the five-seater version is sold in the GCC.

Previously speculated to be named the 620 GT, the replacement for the 599 has actually been named the Ferrari F12 Berlinetta, which is their most powerful road-going car at the time of release. The F12 is powered by a 6.3-litre V12. It only comes with an "F1"³ dual-clutch 7-speed automatic gearbox, in keeping with their official promise to eliminate the traditional manual gearbox forever, one model at a time. Other features include carbon-ceramic brakes, updated magnetorheological suspension control system, and numerous jumbled electronic aids, including E-Diff, ESP Premium, F1-Trac, and high-performance ABS.

Dodge's new entry-level vehicle is a five-passenger hatchback that replaces the Neon sedan and attempts to be a replacement for the common 4WD wagon too. It has a liftgate and split-folding rear seats. All trim levels use a 4-cylinder engine. The base model is a 2.0-litre with CVT automatic. The larger 2.4-litre is available with either manual or CVT. For 2009, the Caliber SRT-4 model was quietly released, with a 2.4-litre turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual. Available features include a fold-flat front passenger seat, refrigerated glovebox, and removable cargo light/flashlight. Unique features include oddities such as flip-down speakers when the liftgate is open, illuminated cup-holders and a central armrest that moves front and back. Also available are leather upholstery, nine-speaker Boston Acoustics stereo and alloy wheels. ABS is optional on the base models, and standard on the top trim, where it comes with rear disc brakes instead of drums. A tyre pressure monitor is optional. All Calibers have available front airbags and side airbags.

The Cadillac XT4 is the luxury brand's compact SUV offering. It comes equipped with a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, which is the only engine option, and a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the XT4 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, push start button, AM/FM stereo with 8-inch diagonal color information display, 7 speakers, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, parking sensors with rear camera, sunroof, LED headlamps and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment includes Bose Sound System, "Technology Package" which includes Air Ionizer, 8-inch diagonal color reconfigurable gauge cluster, head-up display, power rake, and telescoping steering column and wireless charging, 20-inch diamond cut alloy wheels, interior ambient lighting, navigation, AM/FM stereo with connected navigation providing real-time traffic, 8” diagonal color information display, one type A and one type C full function USBs, personalized profiles for each driver’s settings, Natural Voice Recognition (English only) and NFC (Near Field Communications) mobile device pairing. Safety features include airbags - dual-stage frontal, knee and seat-mounted side-impact for driver and front passenger; head-curtain for all outboard seating positions with rollover protection, stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor and ABS. Optional safety features include "Driver Awareness Package", which includes Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking, Front Pedestrian Braking, Following Distance Indicator, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and IntelliBeam. Also available is a "Driver Assist Package", which includes Adaptive Cruise Control, and Forward and Reverse Automatic Braking.

In 2015, the Volkswagen Scirocco R got a facelift. Engine for the Scirocco R is a higher tuned 2.0-litre FSI turbocharged 4-cylinder. It first became available in 2012, with more power, a body kit and firmer suspension. This Portugese-built front-wheel-drive hatchback gets the usual power accessories, along with available panoramic sunroof, CD/MP3 stereo, HID headlights, front-side airbags, climate control, keyless entry, stability control, ABS and such. The VW Scirocco also gets an optional three-mode adaptive chassis control, offering the driver a choice of sport and comfort that affects suspension and steering tune.

The first to adopt Infiniti's new naming system, the Q50 replaces the G25 and G37 model. A complete new design, the Q50 does not disappoint in the looks department. It now has the signature Infiniti "double arch" grille, along with the horizontal headlights and taillights. The Q50 is also longer, wider and sits lower than the outgoing G. As for the interior, it now has the Infiniti's new InTouch system a touch screen which displays information and navigation. Owners will also be able to download, update and synch personal apps through their smartphones and USB drives. As per the new naming system, the numbers in model names don't designate the engine capacity any more. The same engine is carried over from the Infiniti G37 in the Q50, the 3.7-litre V6, which is mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. However, there is a new entry-level engine, a Mercedes-sourced 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged unit which made its debut as a 2015 model year. The top model is the Q50 S Hybrid, with a 3.5-litre V6 boosted by an electric motor, and mated to a 7-speed automatic. Lot of new technologies have been added to improve driver safety. One of them, Active Lane Control, uses a camera-based straight-line stability system which is included as part of the Lane Departure Prevention system. The Lane Departure Prevention system makes small steering input angle adjustments if the car undergoes minor direction changes due to road surface changes or crosswinds. It also gets Direct Adaptive Steering system which allows independent control of the Q50's tire angle and steering inputs, transmitting the driver's intentions to the wheels faster than a mechanical system.

The Renault Twizy is designed as an "ultramobile" and is just 2.34 metres long, 1.24 metres wide and 1.45 metres tall. It is available in only four colours blue, white, red and black -- from which customers can choose many styling combinations. Different stickers can also be added to the doors and rims. We're classifying it as a mini-hatchback, but the truth is this four-wheeled 2-seater is hard to categorise. The passenger sits behind the driver, crammed in somehow. The Twizy's electric motor can run up to 85 km on a single charge. The lithium-ion batteries takes about 3.5 hours to charge completely using a 220-240v powerpoint. For safety, the Twizy comes with a 4-point seatbelt and a steering-wheel airbag. It is equipped with disc brakes as well and an optional rear-parking aid.

An all-new 2019 Mercedes-Benz G 63 AMG was revealed. Under the hood, it gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission.  It still retains all its off-road ruggedness, combined with a much a smoother ride, thanks to the addition of air suspension. The new electric power steering now makes turning the front wheels a less tedious task, unlike before. Features are abundant and the standard GCC models come significantly equipped. The cockpit now features the big screens for the instrument cluster and infotainment. Leather is abundant everywhere and the seats are comfortable. It also gets a small sunroof. It includes all the safety nannies such as airbags, stability control, traction control, blind spot monitor etc.

Dongfeng Motors (DFM) released the S30 sedan in the UAE in 2015. The S30 sedan is available in Elegant and Nobel models. Both models get a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, but the Nobel models get the one with VVT-i tech and an all-aluminium body engine, and produces slightly more power. They are all front-wheel drive and get a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the S30 include power steering, power mirrors, automatic A/C, power windows, fabric seats, LED front lights and parking sensors. A power sunroof and multi-functional steering wheel with acoustic control and cruise control are available for the Nobel models. Standard safety features on the S30 include 4 airbags, ABS and EBD.

The Mercedes-AMG C63 and C63 S are the sports variants of the C-Class. In 2017, an all-new C63 Coupe made its debut. It has remained the same for the 2020 model year. Under the hood, they get twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to 7-speed automatic transmission, with the C63 S having the slightly higher power rating. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, automatic A/C, cruise control, xenon headlamps, radio with MP3/iPod/USB/AUX support, navigation system and leather sports seats. The C63 gets AMG RIDE CONTROL sports suspension with electronically controlled shock absorbers and the AMG DYNAMIC SELECT drive programmes. It also gets 3-stage RIDE CONTROL sport suspension, the 3-stage ESP and the optional button for the performance exhaust system with flap control. Standard safety equipment includes front drive and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, drowsiness warning system ATTENTION ASSIST and COLLISION PREVENTION ASSIST PLUS, which helps to avoid rear-end collisions.

The second-generation Punto, codenamed Project 188, was launched in 1999 for the 2000 model year. The styling was all-new while retaining the original Punto's distinctive shape and design, while the chassis and interior were completely overhauled. The new Punto also became the first Fiat in decades to carry the original round Fiat badge, to celebrate Fiat's centenary. The entry-level engine had two forms of the 1.2-litre petrol unit, with either 8 valves or 16 valves, with various manual or CVT transmission choices. A sporty two-door 1.8-litre model with a manual gearbox, called the Punto HGT, was briefly offered before 2003. The Punto had adopted the Dualdrive electric power steering and came with two operation modes, using an electric motor, rather than a hydraulic pump driven by the engine, for reduced fuel consumption. Driver and passenger airbags are fitted to all models, while side and roof airbags came as extras. ABS is also fitted to all but the most basic models. The Punto was facelifted from the 2004 model year, with new headlights and a new grilled front end, but it is unclear if many of them came to the GCC, at a time when the brand was being phased out.

The CL-Class, the coupe version of the S-Class on which it is based, received a minor facelift for the 2011 model. This coupe features numerous innovative safety technology, such as up-front sensors which make it possible to assess the impact severity at an early stage during a crash and activate the front passenger airbag in two stages depending on the severity of the accident. Other features include Active Body Control for better handling, Intelligent Light System using bi-xenon headlights with five different lighting functions to match weather conditions. Options include night-view assist with infrared headlamps, reversing camera, voice control for car radio, DVD changer and navigation as well as tyre pressure monitoring system. Some new engines were introduced as well. Models include the CL 500 with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The CL 600 has the same 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8 carried over, which is mated to the old 5-speed automatic transmission. The performance model CL 63 AMG gets the new twin-turbocharged 5.5-litre V8, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. The CL 65 AMG still has the same 6.0-litre V12 bi-turbo engine, connected to a 5-speed automatic, but tweaked to give more power.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is a popular rear-wheel-drive roadster from Mazda. Completely overhauled for the 2016 model year, this purebred sports car is now powered by an all-new SkyActiv-G 2.0-litre four-cylinder motor, and mated to a 6-speed SkyActiv-Drive automatic transmission with paddle-shifters. There is a 6-speed manual variant available elsewhere, which is not offered in the GCC at the moment. Featuring the usual soft-top passed down from its predecessors, there is also a retractable hard-top variant known as the MX-5 RF (Retractable Fastback) available from 2017 model year. Besides a few kilos of weight, there are no significant differences between the soft and hard top variants, even in terms of performance. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 9 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, auto a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-key for keyless entry and ignition, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, navigation, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, LED headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind-spot monitoring, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats.

The Mitsubishi Attrage is the Japanese brand's sub-compact sedan offering, introduced in 2014 GCC market. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. The Thai-built Attrage gets a 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual in fleet-spec trim or a CVT in all other versions. The small engine, combined with the lightweight body makes it very fuel-efficient. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry with central locking, fabric seats, manual a/c, AM/FM radio with CD player and 4 speakers, tachometer and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional equipment include a full-auto a/c, better entertainment system, leather-strapped steering wheel and gear knob, 15-inch alloy wheels and USB port. For safety, only the top model gets 2 airbags for the driver and passenger, whereas as the rest get only one for the driver. All models get ABS with EBD.

The six-seater R-Class, the so-called Grand Sports Tourer from Mercedes-Benz, is certainly a trendsetter. This unprecedented vehicle concept attempts to mesh the qualities of a sporty saloon, a wagon, a minivan and a 4WD. All we see is a very sleek-looking minivan. Packed under the hood are rather powerful engines, but that hardly makes it a sporting vehicle. Models include the R 350 L and the R 500 L, both available only in long-wheelbase trim here, and then there is the shorter R 63 AMG. Amazingly, it is very hard to tell the difference between long and short models. Boasting ample spaciousness, exemplary standards of safety and impeccable comfort for up to six passengers, the new R-Class enthrals with its beguiling styling. Sadly, few on the road recognise its eccentricity and price tag, so it gets as much respect in public as a typical cargo hauler. Features include a 7-speed automatic transmission, cruise control with variable speed limiter, automatic climate control and all-wheel-drive. Options include a panoramic sunroof and navigation.

The Audi RS 6 is the top performance variant of the A6, the German brand's midsize offering. It is only available as a 5-door station wagon. In 2015, it got a minor facelift. Under the hood is a turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. It is available only in all-wheel drive format, as with all RS models. Standard options include 4-zone automatic air-conditioning, reverse-camera, MMI touch-sensitive navigation system, 10-speaker audio system, interior leather packages for the seats and door trim, sports suspension, air suspension, front and reverse camera, park assist, side assist, night-vision, lane-assist and BOSE surround sound. Safety standards are high as expected with front and side airbags all around, along with traction control and stability control.

The BMW M2 made its debut in the GCC in 2016. The exterior of the M2 Coupe may look no different than that of the M235i at first glance. But there are visual changes such as aggressively-flared front and rear bumpers, quad-exhausts and sporty alloys. As much as 80% of parts can be different when comparing M cars versus their non-M versions. Underneath the bonnet is a 3.0-litre turbocharged 6-cylinder engine. The car gets an overboost function that increases the torque for a few seconds. The engine will be mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. The car also receives M4-derived aluminium front and rear axles, aluminium suspension components, tuned electronic power-steering and an Active M-Differential. The longer M4-sourced axles are what led the M2 to have wider fenders, so the tyres wouldn't stick out.

The Coupe is probably the only sports car in its price range among the hordes of boring sedans sold in the Middle East. It may be front-wheel-drive, not so powerful and hardly the best handler of them all, but darn does it look good from most angles. Powered by either a weak 2.0-litre four-cylinder or a decent 2.7-litre V6, only the smaller motor comes with a manual with optional available automatic, while the larger motor gets only an automatic. Standard basic features include a single airbag, power steering, central door locks, power windows, fog lamps, a rear spoiler with high-mounted brake lamp, outside electric mirrors, semi-cloth seats, a radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, rear wiper with washer, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The full options list includes dual airbags, ABS brakes, cruise control, keyless entry with burglar alarm, power sunroof, leather interior, CD player and 17-inch alloy wheels. Bumping up the horsepower would've made it a real contender in the sports car market.

The Maxima was a hot car when it was first unveiled in this iteration. However, Nissan's GCC division chose to let this model stagnate to the point where it was easily overshadowed by the newer Altima, even when the Maxima was redesigned in other markets and transformed into a luxury cruiser. The GCC-spec Maxima also still uses Nissan's older version of the corporate V6, with a displacement of 3.0-litre, combined with front-wheel-drive, and with a choice of five-speed manual and four-speed auto gearboxes. Performance is very respectable even after all these years. It comes with automatic air-conditioning, CD player, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, ABS-assisted disc brakes, cloth seats, front airbags and many wheel choices, depending on model. The basic model gets 15-inch steel wheels, while higher models get 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include an in-dash CD changer with subwoofer, cruise control, sunroof, rear electric sunshade and leather cabin trim. Changes from year to year largely involve a new grille style every few years.

The Korean-built Chevrolet Cruze gets a minor facelift for the 2013 model. It is available in sedan and hatchback body-styles in the GCC. The front-wheel-drive compact features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a rare 5-speed manual or a common 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

The Tata Xenon is the Indian manufacturer's answer to commercial vehicles which is currently dominated by the Japanese. Featuring a 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine, the Xenon comes standard with power steering, power windows and air-conditioning. Unlike the name, it does not come with xenon headlamps. The Xenon can be had in either single cab or double cab, with the option of two-wheel drive or four-wheel-drive.

The new Toyota Yaris Sedan was all-new in 2014 and facelifted for 2018. It is only available with a 1.5-litre engine and a CVT automatic in the UAE, in SE and SE+ trims. In Saudi Arabia, the 1.3-litre is available as a fleet standard Y trim with a manual transmission, while the 1.5-litre is available in Y and YX trims with CVT. Standard features in the Toyota Yaris Sedan include power steering, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with AM/FM/CD/AUX/USB support with 2 speakers, steel wheels and halogen lamps. The SE gets central locking, power windows and 4 speakers. For the SE+, the Yaris Sedan gets a leather steering wheel, auto a/c, smart entry and push-button start system, 6 speakers for the audio entertainment system, steering wheel control for audio, 15-inch alloy wheels and more. Standard safety features on the Toyota Yaris include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, brake assist and Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD). Tyre-pressure monitor and stability control are now standard in the UAE on all trims.

The Tucson is a player in the rare breed of tiny 4WD vehicles that offer little off-road capability, but drive rather well on the road. It comes with either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or, surprisingly, a 2.7-litre V6, with a range of manual or automatic transmissions depending on model. It also comes in either a blasphemous front-wheel-drive version or a more realistic four-wheel-drive version with full-time 4WD. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power outside mirrors, central door locking, roof rack, cloth seats, front fog lamps, rear wiper with washer, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a range of storage spaces, while riding on 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include dual airbags, sunroof, probably faux leather upholstery, two-tone paint job, body-colour outside mirrors, AM/FM CD and cassette player with 4 speakers and tweeters, dual mufflers and a whole lot of cuteness for an affordable amount of cash.

The VW Golf GTI is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine and having a choice of 6-speed manual or 6-speed "DSG" automanual gearboxes. It features a body kit with a built-in rear diffuser and wider side sills. Compared to the regular Golf, the GTI also rides on 17-inch or 18-inch wheels with lower suspension. Inside it gets sportier seats, steering wheel and pedals than the standard Golf. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, USB/auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, optional sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, common power accessories and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. For 2016, a limited edition 40th anniversary Clubsport variant was released with a more powerful engine and a revised bodykit. Along with the DSG gearbox, a 6-speed manual transmission was offered later on for the Clubsport.

The Volvo S60 got a facelift for the 2014 model year and minor updates in 2017. The S60 straddles the line between compact and midsize. Originally available in the GCC with three engine choices, the S60 range has been whittled down to a single T5 2.0T model which gets a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, also in front-wheel drive. It gets an 8-speed automatic transmission. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's trademark 'floating' console in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, CD/MP3 stereo, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The 'Prestige' model gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. A simple silver body kit is optional. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians. A software-based Polestar power upgrade is also offered, adding 20-30 hp, depending on the model.

The Ford Transit Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying cargo. It can seat up to 3 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2022 Ford Transit Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine, available in two different tunes. All models get the 6-speed manual transmission. The van has a payload capacity up to 1,024 kg, a maximum cargo volume of 8.3 cubic metre square and a wide space between the wheel arches allowing for the storage of 1.2-m x 2.4-m boards vertically or horizontally. The load-through bulkhead lets you carry up to 3-meter-long cargo, such as pipes, ladders or carpet rolls. Fixing points and 8 tie-down loops are positioned on the bodysides, leaving the floor clear for easier loading, unloading and cleaning. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety features on the 2022 Ford Transit Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The first product from the takeover of Chrysler by Daimler-Benz was the Crossfire, a stylish sports coupe that rides on the old Mercedes-Benz SLK platform, while sharing many of its components with other Mercedes models, and built in Germany too. The Crossfire has a long hood with streaks on it, while the fastback roofline ends with a "boat tail." The car also has a centre spine that runs the length of the car, from the grille in front to between the dual, centre-mounted rear exhausts. The Crossfire's stance is enhanced by rear tyres that are larger than those in front, and by its broad shoulders, tall body sides and minimal glass area. The car's central spine reappears as an element in the car's interior design. The car's two bucket seats are trimmed in two-tone leather. Gauges have white-on-black faces with metallic bezels and chrome trim rings, while the centre console has a metallic look too. Other features for the two-seat coupe include a speed-activated rear spoiler and six-speaker audio system with dual subwoofers. By now, it would seem like the Crossfire is more of a design exercise than an attempt to build a true sports car. This is confirmed by the old 3.2-litre V6 that doesn't pull the car with enough verve.

The Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, and has been mildly facelifted for 2014. In 2017, the major change was the new V6 engine and no manual option was available. In 2018, everything was pretty much the same. Engine options include a base 4.0-litre V6 with a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol XE or SE, as well as a 5.6-litre V8 with direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic body motion control system for the suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top Platinum "City" trim gets a slightly-lower unique bumper. For the Desert Edition, it gets bead-lock wheels, skid plates and more, built from the base Patrol LE model. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The Volkswagen Beetle, which has been around since 2012 in other countries, made its debut in the GCC as a 2015 model. It will be powered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. It gets either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed DSG automatic transmission. The latest generation Beetle breaks free of the geometry of the previous model and has an extended bonnet, sharply swept-back windscreen and a longer wheelbase. Modified interior ergonomics have produced an improved feeling of space with its longer roof section. Features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, radio with CD/MP3/USB support, parking sensors, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking with keyless remote, anti-theft system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and 17-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include Xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights and up to 19-inch alloy wheels. In 2016, the Beetle R-Line model was added to lineup.For the exterior, the Beetle R-Line front fascia features bigger air intakes in the bumper, while the rear gets a lower diffuser and large spoiler. It also gets 20-inch "Monterey" alloy wheels to complete the look.Inside, it gets two-tone cloth sport seats, a multi-function leather-wrapped steering wheel with R-Line badging and a set of sport gauges mounted on the top of the centre console, along with R-Line door entry sills. Other standard options on the Beetle R-Line include panoramic sunroof, xenon headlamps with LED daytime running lights, touch screen, Bluetooth and USB connection.

Chinese Chery's range of cars are hilariously named, and looking at them will give you a feeling that you've seen them before, even if you've never heard of Chery. We have no experience with these cars either, so we'll just take stuff out of the brochure. We start off with the A11, also known as the Wind Cloud, and a car that looks remarkably like the Seat Toledo that was discontinued last decade. The company promises an elegant driving experience thanks to a Ford 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, a Siemens ABS braking system, two airbags from a company called American Breed, Webster electric sunroof and French Valeo air-conditioning. In short, it is an ideal model of outsourcing, except that other companies don't exactly brag about it. There is only a manual gearbox, while standard features thankfully include power windows, central locking, radio cassette player and a spare tyre. Options available on the top luxury model include a CD changer, leather upholstery, sunroof, imitation wood trim and a rear armrest. At least they are upfront about the fake wood, unlike Toyota.

The attractive GranTurismo is derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. A Sport version ups the ante with a 4.7-litre V8, which can either mated to a Electro-Actuated MC Shift or an optional MC-Shift automanual transmission. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale is also available, which has some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The Tucson is a player in the rare breed of tiny 4WD vehicles that offer little off-road capability, but drive rather well on the road. It comes with either a weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder or, surprisingly, a 2.7-litre V6, with a range of manual or automatic transmissions depending on model. It also comes in either a blasphemous front-wheel-drive version or a more realistic four-wheel-drive version with full-time 4WD. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power outside mirrors, central door locking, roof rack, cloth seats, front fog lamps, rear wiper with washer, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a range of storage spaces, while riding on 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include dual airbags, sunroof, probably faux leather upholstery, two-tone paint job, body-colour outside mirrors, AM/FM CD and cassette player with 4 speakers and tweeters, dual mufflers and a whole lot of cuteness for an affordable amount of cash.

The Jeep Renegade is the smallest SUV offering from the brand. It gets 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine under the hood, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. The base 2019 Jeep Renegade Sport model comes in front-wheel-drive format, while the Latitude, Trailhawk and Limited models are all-wheel drive platforms. Standard options in the 2019 Jeep Renegade include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, fabric seats, manual A/C, FM radio with AUX/USB support and alloy wheels. Higher options include automatic A/C, Infotainment system with screen, navigation, automatic A/C and leather seats. Safety features in the 2019 Jeep Renegade include driver and passenger airbags, traction control and vehicle stability control.

The Chrysler 200 is a reborn Sebring, but with a major facelift, new engines, retuned suspension and a better interior. Now offered with a choice of 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and 3.6-litre V6 engines, both mated to 6-speed automatics, the front-wheel-drive midsize sedan gets a second chance in the GCC market. The base 200 LX model comes with the 4-cylinder engine, cloth upholstery, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, 17-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, cruise control and manual a/c. The mid-range 200 Touring model adds 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone auto a/c, leather-wrapped steering wheel, trip computer, power driver's seat and 6-speaker stereo, with available options such as remote start, sunroof and voice-controlled UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and hard-drive. The top 200 Limited model adds a V6 engine, exterior chrome trim, 18-inch alloys, auto up/down windows, auto-dimming rearview mirror, leather upholstery, while the same extra-cost options as the Touring are also available, with the addition of an optional Boston Acoustics stereo. All models get standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, alarm and a tyre-pressure monitoring system.

The new-for-2011 BMW 5-Series entered the Middle East market with two inline-6 engines, with more engines on the way later. The base 523i got a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder in 2011, but a new base model, the 520i, was added in 2012 with a lower-tuned turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder and 8-speed auto, replacing the 523i. The 535i has a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, both mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 528i model joined the line-up later with yet another naturally-aspirated 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and 8-speed auto, replaced later by a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder by 2012. The 550i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto came closer to 2011. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The redesigned BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S made its debut in 2014. It pretty much remained the same in 2015 as well. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. There is no more manual transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The all-new Bentley Flying Spur made its debut as a 2014 model year, and ditches the "Continental" from its name. The exterior shape now has a lower and wider appearance, new wing vents in the front fenders, slightly flared rear fenders and a more sloping roofline. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. It gets an 8-channel, 8-speaker audio system. Powering the new Flying Spur is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split. The suspension has been made softer for the new Flying Spur for a more comfortable ride. A Mulliner Driving Specification is available which adds diamond-quilted seats, drilled alloy foot pedals, a sports shift lever, jeweled filler cap and unique 21-inch two-piece alloy rims.

An all-new MG 6 came out as a 2019 model. The MG 6 comes as a liftback version. It gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged engine, mated to a 7-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power steering, fabric seats, sunroof, rear parking sensors, leather steering wheel, radio with Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay support and 6 speakers, trip computer. rear parking camera, push start button and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional features on the MG 6 include leather seats, electric seats, cruise control, auto headlamps, dual-zone climate control A/C and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include only one driver airbag and ABS. The higher models get traction, stability control and emergency brake assist. Only the top model gets passenger side airbags.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. A minor frontal facelift and other trim changes marked the changes for 2012. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The long-wheelbase model holds seven passengers, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard. From early 2012, a few hundred 30th Anniversary edition models were offered, signified by LED lights in the bumpers and a few other trim bits.

The Renault Megane came back to the GCC market with an all-new design in 2011, and got a minor facelift for 2013. Engine choices, all 4-cylinder, include a 1.6-litre with a 5-speed manual, an updated 1.6-litre with a CVT automatic, and a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The front-wheel-drive Megane is available in hatchback form, with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features in the hatchback include cloth upholstery, split-folding rear seat, fog lamps, rear wiper, manual a/c, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, optional HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

An all-new model of the BMW X4 came out for the 2019 model. The X4 20i and X4 xDrive30i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine, with two different tunes. Both are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic. The X4 M40i is available with a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder motor, mated to an 8-speed auto transmission as well. In 2022, the X4 got a slight facelift, as well the engines got mild hybrid technology for better performance and fuel economy. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The VW Multivan is the range-topping minivan based on the T5 Transporter work-van platform. The outdated front-wheel-drive van is powered by an equally-outdated 3.2-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic. Available with 6 or 7 seats, it has a unique rail feature in which seats can slide forward and backward into any configuration. Offered in base Comfortline and upgraded Highline trim, the Multivan can be had with features such as power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, and a CD stereo. It can be optionally outfitted with cloth or leather seats, HID headlights, wood cabin trim, rear DVD entertainment system, sunroof, alloy wheels and automatic doors. A wide range of accessories are available, like tables and refrigerators which fit onto the rails, all movable. The Multivan has safety features as standard such as front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Lincoln MKC is the luxury brand's compact SUV offering. It gets two 4-cylinder turbocharged units to choose from, one 2.0-litre and the other 2.3-litre. Both are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. While the 2.0-litre is available in front-wheel drive, the 2.3-litre gets all-wheel drive. Standard features in the MKC include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, automatic A/C, central locking with keyless entry, pust-start engine, signature push button gear shiftter, leather seats and alloy-wheels. Optional features include panoramic roof and better infotainment system. Lincoln MKC offers advanced technology such as collision warning with brake support, a Lane-Keeping System and driver assist to help drivers avoid common accidents. The collision warning system is designed to alert the driver if it detects a potential front-end crash. The system issues an audible alert in the cabin, a visual alert on the windshield and automatic brake assist sensitivity. MKC has park-out assist technology, a class-exclusive feature that enhances the vehicle's active park assist capabilities. Where active park assist helps guide drivers into tight parallel parking situations, park-out assist steers drivers out of tight parking spots. The vehicle's Lane-Keeping System uses rearview mirror-mounted cameras to identify lane markers and help drivers avoid unintentionally straying from their lane. Dashboard-mounted cameras monitor driver alertness. If the system detects a driver's alertness level dropping below a given threshold, a warning is issued via a chime and a pop-up message appears on the left-hand cluster screen. MKC also offers a Blind Spot Information System, which continuously monitors the vehicle's blind spots with radar sensors, and class-exclusive cross-traffic alert, which detects traffic as the vehicle backs from a parking space. The MKC gets 7 standard airbags, including a class-exclusive driver's knee airbag.

JAC M5 is the Chinese brand's large minivan offering. It features a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed manual or 5-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, trip computer, fabric seats, automatic A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support and 7-inch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof and alloy wheels. Optional equipment include a better entertainment system, rearview camera, folding mirrors. leather seats and xenon headlamps. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes, brake assist (BA) and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Pathfinder is a 4-door, 5-passenger luxury 4WD, and a popular performer. This unit-body shape was introduced in 2000, but got the newer 3.5-litre V6 only in 2002. This model range ran till 2005. A 5-speed manual is standard while a 4-speed automatic transmission with overdrive is optional. The manual-mated V6 is slightly more powerful than the automatic-mated V6. Later models also have an optional package consisting of electronic stability control, ABS brakes, traction control, and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. The top Pathfinder models got six-spoke 17-inch wheels and a leather interior in the later years, while lower models have 16-inch wheels and a cloth cabin. Exterior paint-jobs were two-colour for base models and monotone for upper models. Available features included a cassette or CD player, power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and power front seats, among other accessories.

An all-new model of the BMW X5 came out in 2019. It is longer, wider and higher than the outgoing model. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The BAIC X7 is the brand's midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets the 1.5-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric folding mirrors, LED headlamps and taillamps, LED daytime running lamps, steering wheel with touch controls, leather seats, electric seats with lumbar support, cruise control, dual zone automatic A/C, digital instrument cluster, 12.3-inch touch screen with USB ports, Bluetooth, front and rear fog lamps, panoramic roof, front and rear sensors, rearview camera and alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, side airbags, curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, hill assist control, and tyre pressure monitor.

The Lotus Exige S is a super-light sports coupe with a Toyota-sourced supercharged 3.5-litre V6 engine. It gets go-kart handling, thanks to its light weight as well as its aerodynamics and aluminium chassis. It is only available with a 6-speed manual gearbox . Standard options include  light weight aluminium passenger foot-rest, proBax seats, plain black leather sun-visors, light weight aluminium foot-well divider, black leather steering wheel, black leather gear lever gaiter, polished aluminium gear-knob and hand break sleeve, radio and single CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, immobiliser with remote activated alarm and central door locking. There are two new interior package options available: Premium and Premium Sport. The Premium Pack provides added comfort and style where as the Premium Sport option focuses on creating an internal space optimised for ultimate driver involvement. Built for the adrenalin hungry sportscar aficionado, the Lotus Exige S features high performance bespoke tyre package with Pirelli P-Zero Corsa tyres as standard. A Lotus DPM (Dynamic Performance Management) switch allows the driver to switch between three driving modes: Touring, Sport and DPM off.And if three dynamic settings are not enough, an additional Race Pack option is available which adds a fourth driving mode setting: Race. This setting provides the maximum possible traction out of corners. The Race Pack also features Launch Control and an optimised suspension setting making the car perfect for letting rip on the track. Safety features for the Exige include driver and passenger front airbags, traction control system (TCS) and torque-sensing limited slip differential.

The Ford Tourneo Custom is the commercial van offering for carrying passengers. It can seat up to 8 people, offers 2 roof heights (low and high) and two wheelbases (SWB and LWB). The 2021 Ford Tourneo Custom comes with a 2.2-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder diesel engine. Standard features include power steering, power windows, power windows, keyless entry, AM/FM radio with 4 speakers,  SYNC, 3.5-multifunctional display, Bluetooth and AUX, halogen headlamps, manual A/C, fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels.
