Safety features on the 2021 Ford Tourneo Custom include Electronic Stability Program (ESP) ,ABS, roll movement intervention, emergency brake assist [EBA], hill hold assist [HHA], traction control, tire pressure monitoring system and emergency brake light flashers.

The M is a car very similar to the G35, only slightly larger in size. Ever so lightly facelifted for 2008, it is offered with either a 3.5-litre V6 or a 4.5-litre V8 mated to the usual five-speed automatic transmission with manual-shift mode and a rear-wheel-drive chassis. The M35 and M45 are also a little more luxurious than the G35, by virtue of its extra cabin space. The suspension is independent double-wishbone in front and multi-link independent rear. Rear Active Steer adjusts the geometry of the rear suspension, according to steering input and vehicle speed, to enhance low-speed manoeuvrability and high-speed stability. Standard features on the M35 sedans include heated and cooled leather seats, ten-way power driver's seat, six-way power passenger seat, intelligent key with pushbutton ignition, Bluetooth, 18-inch wheels, six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo, vehicle information system with seven-inch screen, xenon headlamps with adaptive front lighting, and power sunroof. Optional features include surround sound with 14 speakers, DVD-based navigation system with eight-inch colour monitor, DVD entertainment system, and laser-based intelligent cruise control.

An all-new model of the Hyundai Elantra came out in 2021. It is longer, lower and wider than the previous generation Elantra. Under the hood, the 2021 Hyundai Elantra gets two 4-cylinder engines, a 1.6-litre and a 2.0-litre, both engines mated to a CVT. Standard features include 15-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, four-wheel-disc brakes, cloth upholstery, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, power windows, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX/USB input and manual a/c. Higher models of the 2021 Hyundai Elantra get 17-inch alloy wheels, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, better stereo, faux leather upholstery, fog lamps, sunroof, cruise control, power driver's seat, parking sensors and more, but not all features will be offered by all dealers. Safety features on the 2021 Hyundai Elantra include one standard airbag and ABS, mid-range models get two airbags, while the higher models get six airbags and stability control.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

The Sportage is another of Kia's long-running nameplates, though the crossover itself has changed over time. Whereas the original Sportage was unreliable but could do basic off-roading, the new one is much more dependable but is allergic to sand dunes. It is even offered in a front-wheel-drive model alongside the four-wheel-drive, to dilute the nameplate further. Powered by either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic, or a 2.7-litre V6 with a four-speed automatic, it is interesting to note that Kia and parent Hyundai are the first ones to officially offer a V6-powered small 4WD in the region. Standard features include manual air-conditioning, height-adjustable driver seat, power windows, front and rear power outlets, immobiliser, 60/40 split-folding rear seat, front and rear cup holders, 16-inch alloy wheels, radio cassette stereo with 4 speakers and a roof antenna. We could not verify what safety features are available on the Sportage, though ABS brakes and front airbags might possibly be options.

The Haval H2 is the Chinese SUV brand's smallest offering. It comes with a turbocharged 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, steering wheel with audio and cruise control buttons, keyless entry, push-start engine, fabric upholstery, manual seats, bluetooth, audio system with CD player and AUX support, 4 speakers, halogen headlamps with daytime running lamps, fog lamps. manual AC, rear parking sensors and alloy wheels. Higher models get sunroof, audio system with 6 speakers and MP3/USB support, electric foldable mirrors and reverse camera. Safety features include dual airbags in the front, while the higher models get side airbags as well. Other standard safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution, brake assist and traction control.

This VW marks the return of the Jetta nameplate to the Middle East, replacing the Bora lineup. However, it could have been better. Engines choices include a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit and an odd 2.5-litre 5-cylinder unit that is conspicuously underpowered for its size. Both engines are equipped with either a 5-speed manual gearbox or the new 6-speed Tiptronic automatic. The Jetta GLI debuted later in 2008, with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine and 6-speed DSG automanual gearbox. Volkswagens are known for better-than-average handling, and the new Jetta is said to be no exception. The new Jetta is larger than the previous Bora, and it features a more spacious interior stuffed with convenience and lavished with Volkswagen's attention to detail. Even the least-expensive model offers an elegant, high-quality cabin. Standard equipment include power windows, AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power outside mirrors, split/folding rear seats, remote central power locking, front airbags, side-impact airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and available electronic stability control. The GLI exclusively gets black-out body trim, 17-inch wheels, and a slightly-upgraded interior.

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

An all-new Mitsubishi L200 was released as a 2016 model year. It got a significant facelift in 2019. It is sold in the GCC purely as a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Safety features include ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Ferrari 812 Superfast replaced the F12 Berlinetta and is the fastest naturally aspirated model they have ever produced at the time. It is a front mid-engined real-wheel drive grand tourer. The engine is a 6.5-litre V12, mated to 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Electric power steering was introduced in this model. The car also saw the introduction of the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system (PCV) which combines electric front-wheel steering assistance with the mechanical concept built around tyre dimensions and the rear-wheel steering. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Touran 7-seater is a minivan smaller than the Sharan, with four forward-opening doors and a rear tailgate. Engines include the small 1.6-litre and the 2.0-litre, both four-cylinder units with a manual or automatic. Standard equipment includes stability control, ABS with brake assist system, six airbags, active head restraints for driver and front passenger, and three-point automatic seat belts for all seats. Among the most important features of this new Volkswagen are its versatile interior layout and the good amount of space it provides, with a load area that can be as large as 1,989 litres. The three separate seats in the second row each weigh less than 16 kilograms and can be individually slid forward and back, repositioned sideways, folded into a very small space or removed completely. Similarly, the two rear seats can be folded flat into the floor when not in use. There are up to 39 storage spaces and compartments inside the well-planned interior.

The Hyundai Centennial is a full-size high-end luxury sedan that serves as the flagship model for the Korean manufacturer. Also known as the Equus elsewhere, it is the most expensive sedan in the company's lineup ever. This is the first time that it has ever been offered outside Korea. The new-for-2010 model comes with a rear-wheel-drive platform and V8 engine aimed to compete with the Germans. The styling is conservative and the naming is derivative, as the standard model with the 4.6-litre V8 goes by the badge Centennial VS460. Features include a 6-speed automatic, 3.5-inch display screen for the driver information system, parking cameras rear and front, HID headlights, Adaptive Front Lighting, electric parking brake, leather upholstery, sunroof, power seats with reclining rear ones, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry with push-button start, and all the usual power accessories. The Vehicle Stability Management includes the Lane Departure Warning System, Pre-Safety System and Smart Cruise Control. When a collision is detected, the system automatically applies full braking force and reels in the front seat belts. Other safety features include nine airbags, including two front, four side and two side curtain airbags, as well as a knee airbag.

The Renault Duster, a rebadged Dacia, has been designed to suit all types of roads across the world's less-developed countries. This new sub-compact SUV is based on a stretched Nissan Tiida platform, and comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available in either a two-wheel-drive 4-speed automatic form or in an all-wheel-drive 6-speed manual form, the latter capable of locking the diff for a 50:50 front/rear torque split. Interestingly, the 2WD model comes with a torsion-beam rear suspension, while the 4WD model gives up some boot space to make way for an independent rear suspension. The rear seats fold down as standard, and split-folding on all but the base model, while you can transport longer items if the front passenger seat is folded down as well. The basic PE version comes with two-wheel-drive, 4-speed automatic, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth with buttons behind steering wheel, unpainted bumpers, 16-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, folding rear bench seat, power steering and manual a/c. Early models came with one airbag, but by mid-2012, all models had two standard airbags. The higher-spec SE can be had in 2WD automatic or special-order 4WD manual drivetrains, and adds standard fog lamps, trip computer, ABS with Emergency Brake Assist, extra front-passenger airbag, rear power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, painted bumpers, leatherette steering wheel and extra chrome trim. The SE version can be further upgraded with leather seats with additional pyrotechnic pre-tensioners on the front seatbelts as well as side airbags. The exterior package on the SE version also adds standard chrome door mirrors, longitudinal roof rails, front/rear skid plates and side-skirt covers. Extra tinted rear windows, rear quarter glass and rear windscreen round up the list, as is a split-folding rear seat, height adjustable driver's seat and height-adjustable steering wheel. A comprehensive range of accessories,including wind reflectors, side steps, wheel arch mouldings, chrome exhaust trim and mudflaps, is also available.

The Cadiilac CTS-V is the top sports variant which with a supercharged 6.2-litre V8, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. External changes for 2018 are limited to new colours. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps, fog lamp, Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, navigation, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz E-Class made its debut as a 2018 model year. It adopted the new design culture already first seen on the S-Class, and followed by the C-Class. In 2021, it received a facelift, which Mercedes-Benz claims also improved the aerodynamics.The E 63 AMG gets an all-new turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 engine mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. A fully variable all-wheel-drive system capable of transferring up to 100 percent power to either axles is standard, and so are a limited-slip differential and adaptive damping in the rear axle. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert, Drive Pilot and Evasive Steering Assist.

Toyota created the IMV platform to serve its budget-oriented lineup, and one of the products of this venture is the Innova. The IMV platform consists of a body-on-chassis setup, offering more refinement in its larger vehicles. The Innova received its third facelift for the 2016 model-year. It remains the same for 2020. The exterior and interior both get a major overhaul. The only engine is a 2.7-litre four-cylinder straight from the Fortuner, offered with a 4-speed automatic in the UAE, but a 5-speed manual is offered as a base model in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets. All versions are well-equipped, seat eight people and get a rear seat slide mechanism to improve legroom, along with infinitely-configurable seats. Standard features include new CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and USB port, dual-zone manual a/c, power & tilt steering, power windows, keyless entry, central locking, multi-information display, fabric seats, fake wood trim, 15-inch steel wheels, fog lamps, airbags for driver and front passenger, and ABS brakes. The top trim gets rear parking sensors, auto-dimming mirror, 15-inch alloys, 6-speaker stereo, auto a/c, leatherette steering wheel, chrome door handles and faux wood. Incidentally, the Innova is considered a luxury vehicle in third-world markets.

The 2015 Legacy is the sixth-generation model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive sedan. Like all Subaru models for more than a decade, the Legacy is available only with all-wheel-drive, and gets an entirely new design for 2015 with carryover engines. It comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engines mated with a CVT automatic. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 18-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Suzuki Carry is the Japanese brand's commercial pick-up offering. It is designed in Japan but assembled in Indonesia to keep costs low. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Basic options include power steering, radio with CD player, fabric seats, air-conditioning and steel wheels.

The  Milan is Mercury's new midsize five-passenger sedan that is designed to appeal to a younger audience and provides a new entry point to the Mercury brand, as Mercury's first vehicle in this segment in more than a decade. It is based on a modified Mazda 6 platform, but features signature Mercury design cues including waterfall grille and satin aluminium trim. It is powered by a Mazda-derived 2.3-litre four-cylinder, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The premium interior features upgraded materials such as leather seats and either Satin Metallic or Wales Mahogany wood trim, and available two-tone leather seating surfaces with contrast stitching. Standard equipment includes power windows, electric mirrors, an auxiliary audio input jack, fold-down passenger seat, front-seat side airbags, side-impact air curtains, ABS brakes, traction control, and a security package highlighted by side-impact airbags, side-curtain airbags for all rows, and an anti-theft alarm system. Options include some sort of appearance package, rear spoiler, and more.

The Hyundai Santa Fe was redesigned in 2007 and mildly facelift in 2010. The real changes were under the bonnet, with a pair of 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and 3.5-litre V6 engines replacing the old 2.7-litre V6. Both motors are mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. The basic 4-cylinder model comes with third-row seating, power windows, cruise control, roof rack with crossbar, fake wood trim, keyless entry, fog lamps, CD/MP3 stereo with 4 speakers and 2 tweeters, AUX/USB ports with iPod cable, manual a/c with rear vents, 18-inch alloy wheels, four-wheel-disc brakes with ABS, and only one airbag. The mid-range model additionally gets the V6 engine along with intelligent keyless entry with starter button, dual-zone auto a/c, subwoofer, "solar" glass, "supervision" gauges, automatic HID headlights, cruise control, sunroof, power front seats, rear parking sensors and camera, leather upholstery, "conversation" cabin mirror, cool box, rear spoiler and headlamp washers, as well as dual front airbags, stability control and active headrests. The top V6 model also gets navigation, trip computer and a full set of six airbags, including side-curtain airbags.

The Nissan Patrol was redesigned from the ground up for 2010, and has been mildly facelifted for 2014. External changes include a redone grille and front bumper, new headlight clusters with LED running lights, new tail-lamp clusters and new wheel options. Engine options include a base 5.6-litre V8 with 5-speed automatic or 6-speed manual, known as the Patrol SE, as well as a 5.6-litre V8 with more power, direct injection and a 7-speed automatic, known as the Patrol LE. Depending on trim level, the 7-seater Patrol can be had with standard or optional features such as all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing, hydraulic independent air suspension, computerised terrain response system, climate-controlled leather seats, Arabic-supported HDD navigation, wide WVGA 8-inch touchscreen, multi-screen DVD entertainment system, 9.3GB Music Box hard drive, Bluetooth, power rear liftgate, keyless start, adaptive cruise control, 20-inch alloy wheels, power-folding 3rd-row seat, around-view cameras, and a centre console cool-box that can be opened from both 1st & 2nd-row seats. Also available is an Off-road Monitor that provides real-time information such as tyre conditions involving steer angle, slip and pressure, as well as hill start, hill descent, and an electronically-locking rear diff. Most models get a regular offroad-ready front bumper, while the top Platinum "City" trim gets a slightly-lower unique bumper. A VIP Edition of the City model was also launched later, with matte-black paint and red seats. Also offered for 2014 is a limited-edition matte-black Platinum model, dubbed the VVIP Edition, with red leather seats and chrome wheels. Safety features include two front airbags and numerous side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS, as well as optional lane-departure warning, tyre-pressure monitor and auto-braking systems.

The new Civic is a breath of fresh air in the crowded compact class. Honda once led the class with quality and style. It lost its way for a while, but now it is back in form. The redesigned Honda Civic is the most futuristic compact car on the market. There is more power from just one 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine choice, with either a manual or an automatic. Improvements include better ride and handling, and better interior packaging. The Civic offers important safety features such ABS brakes and airbags, though not all might be standard in some markets. Standard equipment include power windows, tilt-and-telescope steering wheel, height-adjustable driver's seat, rear window-integrated radio antenna, air conditioning, power mirrors, central locking, a centre console with sliding armrest, a four-speaker AM/FM/CD stereo with MP3 and WMA playback, and the funky digital dashboard. Options include a power moonroof; a 60/40 split folding rear seatback, cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls and 16-inch alloy wheels.

The Gen2 is probably the most competitive model in Proton's line-up. Its chassis is engineered with the help of Proton-owned sports car maker Lotus, with engines derived from Mitsubishi. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this five-door hatchback can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, rear spoiler, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include optional ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Gen2 is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras. It first came to Saudi Arabia in 2007, and UAE in late 2011.

The futuristic Audi TT Coupe was first launched in late 1998, followed by the Roadster in 1999. It became a trend-setter in terms of style, but mechanical mediocrity meant it was never a true sports car, being based on the same platform that served the VW Golf and the Skoda Octavia. Originally available with two original engine choices, both were turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder units, at different states of tune. The lower model got front-wheel-drive, while the higher-powered model benefitted from standard Quattro all-wheel-drive. First-year models suffered from dangerous high-speed handling due to lift-off oversteer and led to many deaths, so stability control, better stabilisers and a rear lip-spoiler were added from 2000. All versions only had a manual gearbox up till 2003, when an automatic gearbox with manual-shift capability was offered in the lower-powered model. Model-year 2003 also saw a minor unnoticeable facelift as well as the introduction of a 3.2-litre V6 option, available with either a manual or, from 2004, a newly-developed DSG automanual gearbox. The V6 also got standard Quattro all-wheel-drive, stiffer suspension and slightly upgraded body trim. The coupe was a 2+2 seater, while the roadster only had two seats. All versions got a cramped but stylish interior, and could be had with special leather upholstery, the usual power accessories, and more. Variations over the years meant different wheel designs and interior options were available. Final-year 2006 models can be identified by a two-tone paintjob. The original TT was a popular entry into the compact sports-car market due to its looks, but it was always the worst in terms of driving dynamics compared to its more-capable competitors.

The Lincoln MKS is the full-size luxury sedan produced by Ford's upscale division. It got a facelift in 2013. Although the MKS can be considered the marque's technological flagship sedan, it still falls behind leaders in the wider market. For starters, it is based on a front-wheel-drive platform shared with the Ford Taurus. But while this can be overlooked thanks to all-wheel-drive being standard on all GCC-spec models, the main engine for this full-sizer is a new 3.7-litre V6, instead of a V8. It rides on fully-independent suspension and 20-inch polished aluminium wheels. Features include a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic, keyless entry and start, adaptive cruise control, SYNC voice-activated multimedia system, Bluetooth, rain-sensing windshield wipers, a rearview camera system, front and rear park assist, a THX sound system with full 5.1 surround sound, vented power seats, sunroof, HID headlights, LED taillamps, wood and leather interior trim, and Ford's capless fuel-filler system. Safety features include standard front, side and curtain airbags, stability control and ABS brakes.

This mini-car, also known as the Atos Prime occassionally, is in such a rare category that few people heard about it, and even fewer have bought one. It is amazingly cheap, but even more amazingly small, which seems to be to its detriment in this region. Powered by either 1.0-litre or 1.1-litre four-cylinder engines, the smaller engine can be had with a manual or automatic, while the slightly larger engine gets only an automatic as well as better fuel economy, Standard features include air- conditioning, seat under-tray for the front passenger, AM/FM radio and cassette player, a fold-down rear seat and, of course, wind-up windows. Move up to the better trims, and available features include power steering, front fog lamps, central door locking, power windows, rear wiper with washer, seat back pockets, better cloth upholstery, body-coloured door handles and outside mirrors, and the all-important seat under-tray both under the passenger as well as the driver's seat, to store your dirty magazines. Safety features include nothing more than the metal holding up the body panels.

The Volvo V90 debuted as a wagon version of the S90 in 2017, which itself was introduced to compete in the premium midsize luxury segment. The new V90 adopts Volvo's latest corporate look from the XC90, and a clean rear featuring pillar-length taillights and dual exhaust tips. In the GCC, it is offered with a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 with front-wheel-drive (T5) and a 2.0-litre turbocharged and supercharged 4-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive (T6), both mated to 8-speed automatics. Interior features include the usual leather, wood and aluminium trim choices and power accessories as well as a portrait-style multimedia touchscreen. Volvo is incorporating ‘Pilot Assist’ as a standard feature that will track lane-markings on the road, and accelerate, brake and steer at speeds up to 128 kph depending on obstacles. Other safety features include the City Safety pedestrian-braking system, ESP, ABS, blind-spot monitor, tyre-pressure monitor, anti-whiplash headrests and a full set of airbags.

The Renault Dokker Van is a light commercial vehicle made in Morocco. It comes with one engine option in the GCC, which is the 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. The panel van version has a luggage capacity of 3,300 litres and a maximum load length of 1.90 metres, thanks to the foldable front passenger seat, that can also be tipped forward against the glove box to free up space for a load length of up to 2.42 metres. If the front seat is removed altogether it provides a carrying capacity of 3,900 litres and a maximum load length of up to 3.11 metres. The payload capacity is 750 kg. It can be equipped with the Media Nav system, that combines navigation and audio functions, featuring Bluetooth hands-free connectivity and auxiliary USB and jack sockets. phone wirelessly and directly onto the Dokker Van's music system. 8 mobile phone devices can be connected to the Bluetooth enabled Media Nav with phonebook and call history.Wooden flooring and interior panelling in the cargo area are amongst the various accessories available. The wood protection kits are designed to protect the Dokker Van's rear loading space and are made from marine-quality plywood with non-slip treatment. Storage bin kit is another wooden accessory to arrange and store tools and is the perfect complement to a full wooden protection kit.Accessorized high-strength grilles for the rear window protect goods against theft and deter vehicle break-ins. Accessories in the range also include transverse roof bars, textile carpet mats, volume and perimeter alarm with or without remote control, and 15-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features in the Dokker include ABS with electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), and one driver side front airbag.

Ferrari introduced a new chapter in its history with the introduction of its first series production PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), the SF90 Stradale in 2020. Under the hood, it gets a twin-turbocharged 4.0-litre V8, coupled with three electric motors. Power is delivered via an 8-speed dual clutch automatic transmission. The LCD displays in the gauge cluster serve as screens for everything from telematics to navigation. Other available features include front/rear parking sensors, cruise control, power windows and mirrors, ceramic brake discs, and selectable drive modes using the dial on the steering wheel, which loosens up the ESP to various degrees. Optional features include front and rear cameras, and an automated front-lift system to avoid scrapes.

The Cherry E5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. The front-wheel drive E5 gets a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT automatic. The ACTECO engine, jointly developed by Chery and AVL, Austria, has also passed a 3,000,000km road test and 10,000 hours tough bench test following European and American standards. The chassis of E5 is accurately tuned by Lotus on parts, including spring, shock absorber, horizontal stabiliser bar and redirector. Its gets ABS and electronic brake distribution (EBD) as standard. The instrument cluster ahs multifunctional display and the central blue multifunctional window displays the comprehensive driver info including time, odometer, instant fuel consumption, average fuel consumption, etc. The integrated audio control switches on the steering wheel are easy to recognise and operate enhancing driving comfort and pleasure. Fourway adjustable seats with fabric or soft and fine leather with ventholes and contoured sides provide perfect lumbar, back and leg support. Height adjustable neck and head support relieve fatigue and protect head and neck in collision. Foldin rear seats provide large flat space for additional storage. Front ventilated disc and rear solid disc braking systems ensure stable braking performance even in tough conditions. An all metal cage with high strength steel beams in the front and back, anticollision board in the front doors and steel bars in the rear doors are designed to absorb the force of the impact during collision. Front driver and passenger airbags are standard.

The Kia K900 is the flagship model of the Korean brand. Under the hood, it gets 2 engine options. One is a 3.8-litre V6 engine, while the top model gets a 5.0-litre V8 motor. Both engines are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, engine push start, leather seats, memory seats, digital instrument cluster, 12.3-inch screen with rotary dial controller, premium sound system with AUX and USB, wireless charging, triple-zone climate control, rear ac controls, sunroof, ventilated seats and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include rear-seat entertainment,  rear seat ventilation, and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, front knee airbags, and front and rear passenger side airbags, stability control, brake assist, ABS, adaptive cruise control, tyre pressure monitor, blind spot monitor and auto parking.

The Dodge Challenger received a minor facelift and new engine upgrades in 2015. The interior has been significantly improved as well. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. The interior gets upgraded with a bit more gadgetry in the form of an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system and 7-inch customization display between the retro-inspired speedometer and tachometer. With a high-sill center aluminium gauge bezels makes the revamped interior extremely pleasing to the eyes. Through the Uconnect interface, you can now access the all-new Dodge performance pages that allows you to select different driving modes to adjust steering effort, engine and transmission response, electronic stability and traction controls, and standard launch control. It can also be optioned with a forward collision warning, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitoring and rear cross path detection.Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger can be had with a 3.6-litre V6 or a 5.7-litre V8. Standard features in the V6 include sporty suspension, cloth upholstery, alloy wheels, keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo, power accessories and not much else. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front,side and curtain airbags, lane departure warning, lane discipline system, blind spot monitor, tyre pressure monitor, front collision alert and auto braking, and adaptive cruise control.

The 7-seater Mahinda XUV500 SUV debuted in the UAE with a 140 hp 2.2-litre turbocharged petrol engine and a 6-speed automatic, with features such as 6 airbags, a 7-inch infotainment system and cruise control. Available in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive variants, options include faux-leather upholstery, sunroof and more.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. It received a massive revamp for 2007, with an all-new interior, and can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. From 2010, powertrain options were either a 3.5-litre V6 mated to a 4-speed automatic, or a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated to a 5-speed auto. A minor frontal facelift and other trim changes marked the changes for 2012. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and 16-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box, leather seats and 17-inch wheels. Only the top-level 3.8 models get side airbags as standard. From early 2012, a few hundred 30th Anniversary edition models were offered, signified by LED lights in the bumpers and a few other trim bits.

The BMW Z4 was completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, shifting focus and becoming a comfort-cruiser rather than the focused sports car that it was before. Along with all-new styling, the Z4 now sports a folding hard-top convertible roof that folds down in 20 seconds at the touch of a button. While still a two-seater, the Z4 now has more space for two passengers and their luggage, although not much cargo room is left with the roof down. Changes to the cabin now include more premium materials as well as an integrated iDrive multimedia computer. The Z4 comes with a choice between three inline-6 engines. The Z4 sDrive23i with a 2.5-litre, the Z4 sDrive30i with a 3.0-litre, and the Z4 sDrive35i with a turbocharged 3.0-litre, all available with a manual or automatic, with the exception of the turbo motor, which can be mated to a clutchless automanual gearbox. The Z4 comes with Dynamic Drive Control as standard, which allows NORMAL, SPORT and SPORT+ modes, each of which changes throttle response and gearbox characteristics. Other features include the iDrive system with a high-resolution display that integrates entertainment, navigation, Bluetooth phone and climate control functionality. All the usual luxury features are available, either standard or optional, such as cloth or leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, powered seats, keyless entry with starter button, alloy wheels, and HID headlights, among other options. On the safety front, the Z4 Roadster comes with stability control, ABS, front airbags, head and thorax airbags, reinforced A-pillars and roll bars behind the headrests.

An all-new model of the Kia Cadenza came out in 2017. In 2020, the Cadenza got a facelift and a new engine option. It comes with two engine options, one the 3.5-litre "MPI" V6 and a 6-speed automatic gearbox, and the other a 3.3-litre "GDI" V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Features, standard or otherwise, in the 2020 Kia Cadenza include cloth or leather upholstery, power front seats, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, HID headlights, fake wood grain, fog lamps, power windows, electric mirrors, immobilizer, 17-inch, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, electric rear curtains, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers, cruise control, 8-inch screen with navigation, ventilated front seats, rear camera and interior lighting. It gets Kia's UVO system featuring Android Auto and Apple CarPlay as standard, while a 12-speaker Harman/Kardon system is an option. Safety features include stability control, eight airbags, active headrests and ABS for the four-wheel-disc brakes. Higher models get Kia's "Drive Wise" semi-autonomous self-driving tech. The self-driving suite includes emergency braking, radar cruise control that can function in stop-and-go traffic, and lane keep assist tech.

The XLR roadster is the flagship sports car of the Cadillac range. The latest variant was the new-for-2006 supercharged XLR-V. The most expensive offering in the Cadillac lineup is based on the Chevrolet Corvette C6 platform, only shorter, narrower, and taller in height. Standard XLR models use a 4.6-litre Northstar V8 engine with a 5-speed automatic in older models, and a 6-speed in newer models since 2007. The XLR-V uses a 4.4-litre Northstar engine with a positive displacement intercooled supercharger, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Chassis modifications include larger brakes, recalibrated Magnetic Ride Control, larger front stabilizer bar and an additional rear one, stiffer rear lower control arm bushings, larger wheels and tyres, a power steering fluid cooler, and a higher-capacity fuel pump. The lightweight roof, made of composite panels, retracts in less than thirty seconds at the push of a button. Features include adaptive Xenon headlights with washers, LED taillights, rear parking assist, rain-sensing wipers, automatic dual-zone climate control, adaptive cruise control, head-up display (HUD), tyre pressure monitoring system, DVD-based navigation system,  Bose six-CD stereo, Magnasteer speed-sensitive variable-assist steering, Magnetic Ride Control, and a keyless access system. The XLR received a minor facelift inside and out for 2009, just before being killed off during the General Motors bankruptcy.

The Suzuki Baleno is the brand's sub-compact hatchback offering. The Indian-made Baleno comes with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Two trims are available - the GL and GLX. On the inside, the top-spec Baleno GLX, features a 6.2-inch infotainment system. Other standard features in the GLX include cruise control, automatic A/C and rear park distance control. Safetywise, the GLX gains 4 additional airbags over the GL model, with a total of 6 airbags. The GLX also gains rear disc brakes, while the GL derivative has rear drum brakes. Standard fare across the range are USB and Aux ports.

The radical C4 offers a hip and modern hatchback with out-of-this-world styling and innovative new ideas, with items such as a multi-functional fixed-centred steering wheel and an built-in air freshener. Available as either a three-door or a five-door, it is already popular on the Internet for its dancing-robot TV ads. Besides eye-catching styling, it comes with a long list of standard equipment. Firstly, the base engine is a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with either a manual or an automatic. The top model is a 2.0-litre four-cylinder with only an automatic. The C4 comes standard with alloy wheels, cruise control and the power features features. Options include a panoramic sunroof and xenon dual-function directional headlamps. On the inside, where the C4 pays attention to detail with touches like the damped push-open drawers on the dashboard and an abundance of soft-touch trim. There are six airbags as standard, as well as ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution and Emergency Braking Assistance. Electronic Stability Programme with Traction Control is optional.

GM went all out on the redesign of this full-size hauler even though petrol prices are at an all-time high. The Yukon gets many upgrades, including a new platform and a better-designed interior. A beefy Vortec 5.3-litre V8 powers the Yukon, with better fuel economy to boot. It still had the aging 4-speed automatic though. The V8 powers the rear wheels on the road, or through all four wheels when the standard 4WD system is engaged. Features include power windows, electric mirrors and additional power equipment, along with a folding third-row seat. Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals are standard on the higher models and optional on the base versions. New features also include power folding rear seats, among other things. On the road, Yukon is smooth and stable in a straight line, hopeless in the corners and strong off the road. The Yukon XL is the long-wheelbase GMC version of the Suburban, and offers more room in the back. Rear passengers can enjoy an optional package that includes a DVD system with flip-down seven-inch colour monitor, six-disc in-dash audio player and Bose speakers. The Denali version adds a 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed auto, chrome trim and some luxury interior features, but loses off-road gearing.

The Everest will appeal to customers who are ready to consider the purchase of a 4WD product which provides versatile usage, but aren't too concerned about where the vehicle is built or what it is based on. The Everest is positioned under the Explorer in some markets, precisely to meet the needs of this customer group while offering exceptional value for money. The Everest is a midsize 4WD based on the Asian Mazda-based Ford Ranger pickup truck platform and built in Thailand. The 4WD has three-row seating, a 2.6-litre petrol engine and a five-speed manual gearbox. Features include 7-seater capacity, with a slightly higher level for each row of seating, dual climate control a/c system, ABS brakes, seat belts for all seating positions including 3rd row seat, dual airbags, decent off-road capability, a side-hinged tailgate, tailgate-mounted spare tyre, standard audio system with a CD player, MP3, tweeters and additional speakers, power windows, power doorlocks and power plug-in points for TVs, fridges and Playstations. Not very fast though.

Porsche is offering a "new" Boxster model from 2009, and while the facelift is barely noticeable, the real changes are under the bonnet. Still available in base and S versions, both models feature more horsepower, new gearbox choices and modern multimedia options. A new lightweight Boxster Spyder model debuted in 2010. The base Boxster now has a 2.9-litre flat-6, while the Boxster S has a 3.4-litre flat-6 with direct fuel injection technology. The Spyder uses the 3.4-litre engine, with slightly more power. While a 6-speed manual is standard on both, the optional new 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplungsgetriebe (PDK) dual-clutch automanual gearbox is also available, which actually improves acceleration and fuel economy. Cosmetic changes from 2009 include new headlights and tail lamps, larger front intakes with integrated running lights, and an altered lower rear-end with twin diffusers. Both models can be fitted with a never-ending list of optional features, which can drive up the total price by 30% or more. While the basic models are very bare on features, the car can be optionally outfitted with a hardtop, various types of expensive cloth or leather sports seats, different 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheel designs, a new Porsche Communication Management System (PCM) with a touchscreen, Bluetooth, TV tuner, DVD changer, metallic paint, stickers, wind deflector, roll bars, headlamp cleaners, Xenon headlights, rear parking sensors, and a cabin that can be trimmed with carbon-fibre, aluminium, alcantara or wood.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

The Renault Megane came back to the GCC market in 2011 with an all-new design and, aside from the hatchback version, there's this hard-top convertible Megane CC model as well. A nearly-unnoticeable facelift came in 2013. Engine choices are limited to a 2.0-litre with a CVT automatic. The CC comes with independent front and live-axle rear suspension. Standard features include cloth upholstery, fog lamps, power windows and mirrors, keyless entry, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX port and Bluetooth and more. Available features on higher models include optional leather upholstery, cruise control, HID headlights, automatic a/c, intelligent keyless entry and start, rain-sensing wipers, Arkamys stereo with USB port, and 17-inch alloy wheels. Most markets got one loaded trim with two-tone cloth or leather upholstery. Standard safety features include ABS and dual front airbags, with side and curtain airbags available on higher models.

Ford went back to the drawing board to completely redesign the Ford Five Hundred, and with inspiration from their European division, they came up with an all-new Taurus for 2010. The new Taurus, while still based on the Five Hundred platform, actually has reduced interior volume due to its stylised exterior. The full-size sedan is powered by a carryover 3.5-litre V6 with some fuel-economy enhancements, while being mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, with all-wheel-drive optional. The Taurus SHO model, with the 3.5-litre turbocharged "EcoBoost" V6 engine and all-wheel-drive was offered from late 2011. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth upholstery, 18-inch wheels, and more. Features on higher trim levels include 19-inch alloy wheels, leather upholstery, power seats, SYNC voice-controlled stereo with Bluetooth phone, parking sensors, sunroof, capless fuel filler, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone automatic a/c, rain-sensing wipers and more. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, while cross-traffic monitoring, adaptive cruise control and blind-spot monitoring are optional.

The Nativa is an off-road capable 4WD that fits in an odd spot between the Pajero and the Outlander. Powered by a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a four-speed automatic, the Nativa is a dated design, but still a decent wagon. Standard features for the low base price include AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, driver's and front passenger's front airbags, part time 4WD with synchronized front free-wheel differential, transfer protector, power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, alloy wheels, keyless entry system and seating for five. Features available on higher models include gauges for a thermometer, compass, oil pressure and voltage meter, faux wood trim, front fog lights, CD player with 6 speakers, leather seats, sunroof, limited slip differential, ABS with EBD, cruise control and more. The Nativa rides on the older L200 pickup platform, and was discontinued in a number of markets since 2004. Shipments have continued from Thailand since 2008, alongside the Pajero Sport. However, few 4WDs are offered at this price that are properly equipped to go off-road. Some dealers only offered one fully-loaded trim in the later years.

The Partner is a small workvan that is convenient for quick deliveries and useful for small establishments. It comes in four variations, with two different lengths. The smaller-length models are the Partner Origin Combi 5-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater panel van, capable of a 600 kg payload. The longer-length models are the Partner Combi 7-seater people-carrier and the Partner Origin 2-seater long-body panel van, capable of a 1 ton payload. The smaller models are powered by a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder, while the longer models are powered by a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder, both mated to a 5-speed manual and front-wheel-drive. All models offer power steering with tilt adjustment, radio with CD player, manual a/c, single-side sliding door, and a driver's side airbag.

The Lincoln MKX was an all-new model for 2016 and has been rebadged as the Lincoln Nautilus for 2019, receiving a Navigator-inspired facelift as well. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, the base model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged inilne-4 engine, while the higher models get an updated turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, 12.3-inch configurable driver's display, SYNC 3 multimedia touchscreen, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

The Subaru WRX is in its fifth generation, debuting in 2015 and getting a facelift for 2018. Redesigned 18-inch wheels, revised electric power steering and optional turning LED headlights are also new for 2018. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Boxer engine with a twin-scroll turbocharger and intercooler. It will be coupled to a 6-speed manual transmission. There's a new Sport Lineartronic CVT as an option, which also comes with 6-speed and 8-speed paddle-shifter mode. The new lighter engine ensures that this WRX with the manual gearbox is 30 kg heavier than the previous 2014 model. Of the two alternatives, torque will be equally (50:50) distributed to all four wheels in the 6-speed manual variant and the CVT will receive a torque distribution split of 45:55 with Subarua's Variable Torque Distribution system. The new WRX is 25 mm longer wheelbase than the previous generation. So rear seat passengers gain nearly 51 mm of extra legroom. It also has a bigger boot and 60/40-split fold-down rear seats. Inside, the Subaru gets a leather-wrapped steering wheel and sports seats covered in high-grip fabric. Buyers can also opt for leather seats and 8-way adjustable driver seat. Among other features is a power sunroof, a dual gauge instrument layout with a 3.5-inch LCD central screen displaying various functions and a new 4.3-inch multi-information central display providing a multitude of vehicle system functions. Safety features include driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

JAC J5 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, central locking with keyless entry, fabric seats, manual A/C, AM/FM radio with CD/USB/AUX support, 2 speakers and steel wheels. Optional equipment include a better stereo system with 4 speakers, fog lamps, alloy wheels, leather seats, parking sensors and sunroof. Standard safety features include airbags, ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

The Lexus RC is the Japanese luxury brand's compact coupe offering. Introduced for the first time in 2015, the RC carries on with a 3.5-litre V6 engine under the hood, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push-start engine, automatic dual-zone A/C, navigation, infotainment system with display screen, radio with AUX/iPod/USB/Bluetooth audio support, LED Daytime Running Lights, eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and touchpad to access multimedia and climate controls. The RC F-Sport package adds Adaptive Variable Suspension, LFA-inspired digital instrumentation and 19-inch wheels. Safety features include front, side & curtain airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind spot monitor, lane-departure warning and dynamic cruise control.

The Renault Symbol is a sub-compact offering from the French car manufacturer. The Romanian-built Symbol made its way back to the GCC market in 2015. It comes with only one engine, a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre motor, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the basic Symbol PE model include power steering, front electric windows, central locking, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/USB, Bluetooth, steering wheel mounted controls, fabric seats, front fog lamps and steel wheels with 15-inch hubcaps. The SE model gets additional rear electric windows, electric mirrors, trip computer, temperature sensor, body colour door handles with chrome, automatic A/C, cruise control and leather steering wheel. The top SE model gets 15-inch alloy wheels, rear parking sensors, 7-inch touchscreen with GPS and navigation, and optional leather seats. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, and ABS.

The XF luxury-sports sedan is still based on the previous S-Type's mechanicals, but is still a real step forward towards competing in the real world. While Jaguar is owned by India-based Tata now, the XF was the last car developed under Ford ownership. Ditching the carryover V8 motors from the previous generation, the revamped-for-2010 models include the carryover 3.0-litre V6, the new 5.0-litre V8, and the new supercharged 5.0-litre V8 for the XFR. All engines are mated to a ZF six-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The most interesting feature of the car is its simplistic interior which consists of toys such as a rotary-dial gear selector, hideway a/c vents and touchless operation of the glovebox and overhead lights. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options. The XFR gets unique bumpers, skirts, wheels and interior upholstery, as well as sportier suspension and drivetrain components.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 6.1-litre V8-powered SRT-8 models is available in many GCC markets, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. The SRT8 gets larger 20-inch alloy wheels, sports leather seats, a mild body kit and sports suspension. All models feature front and side airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 was launched in 2017. In 2020, it received a slight facelift and small increase in power. It came with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 engine. It comes with an 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry, heads-up display, sunroof and the MyLink entertainment system with touchscreen navigation. Standard rims include 20-inch ones for the ZL1. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The 911 is Porsche's original legendary rear-engined sports car, produced in coupe, cabriolet and glass-roofed targa body styles based on model, and with numerous flat-six engines and drivetrains. The race-tuned GT3 and GT3 RS are the lightest cars in the range, and use a modified high-output version of the 3.6-litre engine, with only a 6-speed manual gearbox. Available features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD stereo and a full set of airbags. Both the GT3 and GT3 RS are fitted with an Active Suspension Management system. Traction Control ties together three electronic control systems: Automatic Brake Differential (ABD), Automatic Slip Control (ASC), and Engine Drag Control (EDC). Masterminded by an electronic "brain", the Traction Control offers two different control maps, can be completely deactivated, and features both wheel-spin and drag-force management for extra smoothness. The limited-slip differential offers an asymmetric limited-slip function of 28 percent under load and 40 percent in overrun. Set to the Sports mode, the suspension system (PASM) allows a more precise driving style by reducing body movements to a minimum. By pressing the Sports button, the driver also activates a special engine control map which increases torque by approximately 15 Nm from 3000 - 4250 rpm, and boosts engine power by almost 14 hp.

An all-new Bentley Continental GT was released in 2018. The exterior shape features 19-inch alloy wheels as standard, with optional 21-inch alloys wrapped in sportier tyres. Inside, the driver and passengers alike interface with the car and the outside world through touch-screen infotainment, mobile connectivity including Wi-Fi, a Rear Seat Entertainment suite and a new hand-held Touch Screen Remote which allows rear-cabin occupants to control an extensive range of features from the comfort of their seat. Powering the new Continental GT is the same 6.0-litre, twin turbocharged W12 engine as the previous generation but with more power, coupled to a ZF 8-speed transmission. A new twin turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 has been added to the lineup as well later on. Power is delivered to the road via all-wheel drive with a 40:60 rear-biased torque split.

The Jaguar F-Pace is the British luxury brand's first SUV in their lineup. In 2021, it got a mild facelift and new engines. The base model gets the same 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. The higher model gets a 3.0-litre in-line 6 cylinder turbo coupled with an electric . supercharger. There is also a hybrid model Power is delivered via an 8-speed automatic transmission for all motors. A limited production "First Edition" model was released initially. The Pure, Prestige, R-Sport and Portfolio models get the standard 2.0-litre and 3.0-litre engines, while the F-Pace S and the First Edition trims get the more powerful 3.0-litre engine. Standard options on the all-wheel drive F-Pace include power windows, power mirrors, power steering, speed proportional steering, electric parking brake, hill launch assist, LED taillights, 2-zone climate control, paddle shifters,  5-inch screen, Bluetooth connectivity and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include 19-inch rims, luxury sports seats, electric seats with lumbar support, sliding panoramic roof, interior mood lighting, body kit, and Meridian Digital sound system. Safety features include front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera, 360-degree parking view, valet mode, blind spot monitor, traction control, front and curtain airbags.

The Fabia gets a total redesign for the 2009 model year, losing its conservative skin for a more funky appearance. Inside and out, the level of quality has apparently been upgraded. Skoda seems to be offering only one engine in most GCC markets, namely an unremarkable 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The Fabia RS became available in 2012, with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder that has both a turbocharger and a supercharger. The 1.6-litre front-wheel-drive 5-door hatchback comes with a choice of either a 5-speed manual or a 6-speed manually-shiftable automatic transmission, although in all likelihood, dealers will never have a manual version in stock. The 1.4-litre RS version has a 7-speed DSG automanual. Safety features include ABS, dual front airbags and height-adjustable rear headrests. Features available on the Fabia, depending on trim level, include power windows, cloth upholstery, electric mirrors, foglights, keyless entry, alloy wheels, CD stereo, and the option to have a white-painted roof. A special-edition Fabia Monte Carlo model was offered for 2012 with the 1.6-litre engine, 16-inch wheels, black accents, special trim bits and sports suspension. The RS has 17-inch wheels, auto a/c, sports suspension, unique bumpers and optional LEDs up front. The quirky Skoda is an interesting alternative to the usual sub-compact choices, dubious VW origins notwithstanding.

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. This Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street and came out first in 2008, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track.

The Civic grew up in 1984, in terms of size as well as image, spawning a new CRX sports model. The larger new model looked very modern for its time. A new 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine was offered alongside a 1.3-litre 4-cylinder unit on base models. Transmission choices included 4-speed and 5-speed manuals and a 3-speed automatic. The revamped suspension was a temporary step backwards for Honda, since it didn't have an independent rear setup, like in previous and later Civics. But this offered a space-efficient cabin design while retaining reasonable ride and handling characteristics. The  base models were barren, but higher models had sport seats, reclining rear seats, a rear stabilizer bar and more. The new CRX was basically the Civic chassis under a sporty body. All CRXs had a two-tone paint scheme, with a silver lower bodyside and bumper treatment. Introduced in 1985, the hot-rod CRX Si came ready with a fuel-injected version of the 1.6-litre engine. The Si also boasted handling enhancements, such as 14-inch alloy wheels with performance tyres, as well as a power sunroof, sports seats, and a monotone paint scheme. The base CRX HF now had a detuned 1.5-litre. The Shuttle wagon was later available with all-wheel drive and a six-speed manual gearbox. Changes  in 1986 included a 4-speed automatic.

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. It remained the same for the 2018 model year. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Later in 2017, a 6.6-litre V12 engine was added to the lineup with all-wheel drive, called the M760Li. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

The Bentley Continental GT received a facelift for the 2016 model. There are two 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 models in the lineup with different power ratings, and a W12 6.0-litre which got a power upgrade. It now comes with an 8-speed automatic transmission which gives better fuel economy numbers and ever so slight increase in acceleration figures. The Bentley does not skimp on luxury, with a handcrafted wood and leather interior, complete with all the requisite gadgets such as navigation and a killer stereo. Instrumentation is provided by classic dials that live in deep recesses ahead of the steering wheel, while a small screen directly in the driver's line of sight monitors all relevant in-car systems. The two-door Continental coupe is equipped with the full suite of passive safety equipment, including two front airbags, four side airbags and two side curtain bags. And the GT Speed coupe, with the same W12 engine adds more power, reduced weight and an aluminium cabin trim package, while improving performance and handling.

The Chery Arrizo 7 is the Chinese brand's compact sedan offering in a tough market dominated by the Japanese. Under the hood, the Arrizo 7 gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to 5-speed manual gearbox or a CVT automatic. The suspension has been tuned by British sports car company Lotus. Standard features on the Arrizo 7 include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, manual A/C, radio with CD/AUX/USB/Bluetooth support, fabric seats and steal wheels. The higher models get sunroof, cruise control, leather seats, automatic A/C, rear-view camera, 7-inch screen and alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver & passenger airbags, ABS and EBD.

The Cayenne, the black sheep of the Porsche family, is a sporty 4WD that is surprisingly as capable on the road as it is off the road. Developed in conjunction with Volkswagen, it is available in three guises, namely the base Cayenne, the Cayenne S and the  Cayenne Turbo. All the models have been upgraded for the 2008 model year, adding a mid-level GTS model, and later reintroducing the top Turbo S version. The entry-level Cayenne has a new 3.6-litre V6 engine, the S and the lowered GTS versions uses two separate versions of the 4.8-litre V8, while the Turbo and Turbo S uses two turbocharged versions of the 4.8-litre V8. All versions utilise a four-wheel-drive system and a six-speed automatic gearbox, but a rare six-speed manual is available with the non-turbo models. The Cayenne models include traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and an active suspension system. An extensive equipment list includes leather upholstery, alarm system, central locking with remote control, on board computers, tinted glass, electric windows and wing mirrors, as well as a full set of front and side airbags. Options include a panoramic glass roof, reverse camera, various wheels, and different cabin-trim choices.

The Peugeot RCZ received a minor facelift for 2013. The RCZ is a racy sports car built on the 308 hatchback's foundations, but featuring a futuristic coupe body. This front-wheel-drive 2-door can be had with a turbocharged 1.6-litre mated to either a 6-speed manual in the THP200 model or a 6-speed automatic in the THP156. The THP200 makes more power than the THP156, but only the latter is offered in most GCC markets now. Standard features include 19-inch alloy wheels, active rear spoiler, electric leather sports seats with memory, leather dashboard, cruise control with speed limiter, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/iPod connectivity, Bluetooth phone, auto dual-zone a/c, cooled glove box, electric mirrors with automatic-tilting on reverse, power windows, auto-dimming rear-view mirrors, automatic wipers, auto headlights, keyless entry, puncture repair kit, front and rear parking aid with screen display, and aluminium pedals. Also available is a navigation system in the top version. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, front and rear fog lights, and hill-start assist on the manual version. The manual THP200 also has slightly sportier suspension tuning, some shorter gearing and bigger front brakes.

After years of selling an outdated decade-old version of the car in the UAE, the all-new 2010 Nissan Maxima has finally gone on sale in the GCC. The America-built front-wheel-drive midsizer has moved upscale and aims to be a budget 'sports' sedan, although betrayed by its drivetrain layout. It is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT transmission with redundant paddle shifters. The entry-level Maxima S model comes with an auto-dimming mirror, cloth upholstery, cruise control, CD stereo, Bluetooth, power windows, intelligent key with starter button, power front seats, fake wood trim, sunroof, 19-inch rims, and dual-zone automatic a/c with rear vents. The Maxima SV adds power outside mirrors with LED turn signals, digital compass, HID headlights, fog lights, power-adjustable steering column with memory, power-adjustable pedals, front and rear parking sensors. The top Maxima SR gets additional features such as auto-dimming driver-side mirror, leather seats, driver's seat thigh support extension and ventilation fans, rear bucket seats, rear-window power sunshade, navigation system touchscreen with rearview camera, and a rear spoiler. All come standard with ABS, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and stability control. Equipment packages between trim levels changed slightly later during 2010. In 2011, the top model got chrome exhaust tips, a unique sport grille, smoked headlights, a new navigation-multimedia system and a price increase.

The ZNA Yumsun is a 7-seater minivan that turns out to be the unlikely flagship, with its 2.5-litre Nissan 4-cylinder engine. The single trim level includes soft-touch cabin trim, 4-speed automatic, 15-inch alloy wheels, front-disc rear-drum brakes with ABS, power steering, fake wood and leather trim, CD/MP3 stereo with steering controls and 6-CD changer, remote locking, power windows and mirrors, table on the backrest of front seats, 3.9-inch LCD screen with rear audio controls and 6 speakers, automatic antenna, rear parking sensors, auto front and rear a/c, and two airbags.

The Terracan is odd one out in the Hyundai range. It is a capable midsize off-road vehicle based on the old Mitsubishi Pajero, just the right size to not be too big on the roads. The problem is that it became outdated as soon as it was released. This 80s-style 4WD does have a fairly spacious  interior and loaded with features to compete in this class, with a low price to boot. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6 mated to an automatic, it comes with beefy tyres on 16-inch alloy wheels and a full-time 4WD system with active torque transfer. Standard features include power steering, single airbag, a nifty limited slip differential, central door locking system, side steps, roof rack, power windows and electric mirrors, front and rear a/c, front fog lamps, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and hidden antenna, and rear wiper with washer. Options include dual airbags, ABS brakes, keyless entry with anti-theft system, leather interior upholstery, useless rear spoiler, fake wood trim, cruise control, digital multi-metre, electric driver's seat, CD player with 6 speakers, and a few more storage areas.

The Fabia attempts to deliver Skoda's strategy of offering extra features at prices similar to those of its competitors.First launched in 2000, the Fabia underwent a facelift in 2005. It is available in hatchback, sedan and station wagon versions with a choice of two 1.4-litre engines officially, and various trim levels.The weaker engine comes with a manual or an automatic, while the stronger engine comes with a manual. The car looks somewhat sporty with colour-coded front and rear bumpers, and minimal  overhangs, aided by gently flared rear wheel arches. The cabin offers  soft touch materials and a decent amount of space. With a split rear-folding seat, the cabin offers versatility, while power features such as windows and mirrors are all available.. Also standard are power steering, adjustable steering wheel and a height-adjustable driver's seat. Safety standards are high, with standard features on all Fabia models that include driver and front passenger airbags and ABS brakes.

In 2019, a new generation of the Porsche 911 was revealed. The 2+2 seater coupe gets an updated exterior design, along with updates to the engine. The 911 Carrera and Carrera S is offered with a 3.0-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine with two different tunes, mated to a 8-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The Carrera 4 and 4S is all-wheel drive. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, sunroof, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more.
