Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The Carrera S and Carrera T models also have the option of all-wheel-steer.

The 2018 Peugeot 2008 is a five-seater crossover loosely based on the 208 hatchback. In 2017, the 2008 got a facelift and new engine and transmission. It gets a 1.2-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder engine connected to a 6-speed automatic. Features of the 2018 Peugeot 2008 include tiptronic gear-shifting, panoramic glass roof, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, multimedia LCD display, 16-inch alloy wheels, split-folding rear seats, keyless entry, cruise control with speed limiter, power windows, eletric mirrors, front airbags and ABS, among other options.

The Lexus IS is all-new for 2007 in the Middle East, although other markets have been getting 2.5-litre and 3.5-litre versions since 2006. The local market only gets a 3.0-litre V6 engine. The IS 300 offers the most sporting ride of the Lexus range, going head-to-head directly with the Germans in the enthusiast market. The rear-wheel drive IS comes with an impressive set of standard features that includes a premium sound system with CD auto-changer MP3 and WMA compatibility along with 13 speakers, power windows and front seats, keyless entry and start, cruise control, HID headlamps with auto-leveling system, and a fabric interior. The numerous options include a Mark Levinson premium surround sound system with DVD and 14 speakers, moonroof; ventilated front seats, navigation system, power rear window sunshade, auto wiper system, adaptive front-lighting system, rear view monitor system and park assist system. Safety features that come standard include dual front airbags, knee airbags, side-impact airbags, curtain airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, and electronic brake-force distribution.

The compact V50 wagon and its S40 sedan sibling are based on the same front-wheel-drive platform as the Mazda 3 and the Ford Focus, all of which come under the Ford umbrella. Yet Volvo claims that the V50 is a true Volvo, asserting unique premium features only found in the Volvo. The V50 is an obviously small car, but it looks a lot like its larger siblings with its signature new-age-Volvo styling. There are three engine choices, all of them the corporate oddball five-cylinder, except for the base 1.6-litre four-cylinder with manual gearbox. The range includes a basic 2.4-litre and a higher-tuned 2.4-litre, all offered with automatic with tiptronic in this region. Markets outside this region get all-wheel-dive models too. The interior has an ultra-slim centre console that seems to be free-floating, with extra storage space behind it. The safety package includes a patented zonal front structure using differing strengths of high-strength steel to disperse force away from passengers in a crash. Dual front airbags, SIPS side impact protection, curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection are all standard.

The Caterham Seven is the lightweight sports car based on an ancient chassis simple enough to build it yourself if you wanted to. The Seven 270 comes in 1.6-litre Ford-engined ‘R’ pack form with 5-speed manual, as offered in the UAE. The ‘R’ pack is more track-focused and includes a limited-slip differential, sports suspension, a four-point race harness and many other race-orientated upgrades. The Seven 270 is available in the standard narrow-body S3 chassis, although a wide-body and a 6-speed gearbox can be ordered. The Seven 360 model adds a 2.0-litre Ford engine, and is offered in 'R' pack wide-body form in the UAE. The wide-body SV chassis benefits from a wider-track front suspension and a larger fuel tank, with only a 25 kg weight gain over the S3 chassis. Finally, the Seven 420 model adds a higher-tuned 2.0-litre Ford engine. There are no safety features to speak of, aside from a roll hoop and harness belts.

Mercedes-Benz GLE Coupe is a combination of both coupe and crossover, designed to the tackle the BMW X6. Currently only the GLE 43 AMG is being sold, known as the GLE 450 when it was initially launched in 2016, which comes with a 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged V6 motor, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Exterior-wise, it shares a few design cues of the new S-Class Coupe, such as the roofline and rear tail-lights. The interior features sports seats, a sports steering wheel and a new infotainment display. The cabin is covered in silver shadow accents, and aluminum or wood trim.Safety features include Driving Assistance package which includes features such as DISTRONIC PLUS with Steering Assist and Stop&Go Pilot, PRE-SAFE Brake with pedestrian detection, BAS PLUS with Cross-Traffic Assist, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist and PRE-SAFE PLUS. The Parking package includes the 360-degree camera and Active Parking Assist with PARKTRONIC. Night-time vision is improved by the LED Intelligent Light System which is a standard feature on all models; adverse weather conditions with impaired view are defused by MAGIC VISION CONTROL the heated, adaptive windscreen wiper system.

The Patriot is an all-new compact all-wheel-drive 4WD that, like the Compass, is based on the Dodge Caliber and features Jeep styling cues such as a seven-slot grille and round headlights. Unlike the Compass, the Patriot attempts to retain some features of a traditional 4WD, such as decent ground clearance and short overhangs. The all-wheel-drive Patriot is powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine with either a standard 5-speed manual transmission or an optional second-generation CVT automatic transmission. The Patriot is available in very bare Sport trim and loaded Limited trim. The full-time active four-wheel-drive system includes a "Lock" mode for use on low-traction surfaces. The optional off-road package has simulated low-range gearing using the CVT gearbox. Standard equipment includes side-curtain airbags, ESP, traction control and a fabric interior. Other features include a built-in flashlight, flip-down rear speakers in the tailgate, 17-inch alloy wheels and power features.

This seriously outdated version of the Land Cruiser, updated in 2001, is technically a fullsize pickup, staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The pickup, known as Land Cruiser 75 in some markets, is not as big and brawny as the V8 muscle from Ford, Dodge and Chevrolet/GMC, but it is a tough truck. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.5-litre six-cylinder petrol or a 4.2-litre six-cylinder diesel, both lifted from the Land Cruiser wagon and mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, optional a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows and central locking. But no matter how much you pay, you won't get ABS or airbags, but you do get a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, this pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Legacy is Subaru's midsize model, available in all-wheel-drive form as standard. For 2005, Subaru introduced the fourth-generation Legacy with fresh styling and better handling. The same model, available in sedan and wagon body styles, has been facelifted for the 2007 model year. The Legacy is available in the Middle East with either a 2.0-litre four-cylinder, known as the 2.0R, and the 3.0-litre six-cylinder, known as the 3,0R. Both are flat "boxer" engines, mated to automatic gearboxes. Standard equipment in the base 2.0R model includes MP3/WMA CD stereo, a 6-disc CD changer, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, alloy Wheels, fog lamps, climate control, cruise control and cloth upholstery. Leather and sunroof are optional. The top 3.0R trim level adds the advanced Vehicle Dynamics Control stability and traction control system, eight airbags, sunroof, leather upholstery with power-adjustable seats and more. The wagon is only available in 2.0R form.

The Cadillac ATS is the smallest offering from the American luxury brand. Attempting to take on its German rivals, the ATS will be offered with two engine choices. One will be a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine and other a 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

The Mercedes-Benz GLA-Class is a compact crossover offering. It is powered by a direct-injection 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed "DCT" dual-clutch automanual and a front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive platform. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The redesigned Ssangyong Korando made its debut in the Middle East in 2013, as a sub-compact crossover. Only the petrol engine will be sold here, which is a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. It can be had in either two-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, air conditioning, electric windows, electronic stability control, CD/MP3 player, Bluetooth, cruise control, reverse sensors, 16-inch alloy wheels and a leather steering wheel. The higher models get 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels.

The Jaguar XK received a face-lift for 2012. The XK Convertible are powered by a 5.0-litre V8 direct-injection engine, while a supercharged version of the same V8 powers the high-performance XKR. Both engines are mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox with paddle shifters. An even more powerful XKR-S was released in 2012 with the same supercharged 5.0-litre engine but producing even more horsepower. Changes include a new wider front grille, enlarged vents in the lower grille with chrome accents, LED daytime running lights and slightly thinner headlamps. Its rigid chassis and CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a CD stereo system. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

The Bentley line is headed by these land-yachts. Called the Azure in convertible form, the design of the four-seat shares its face as well as its 6.75-litre turbo V8 with the Arnage sedan. The Azure does not get the higher-tuned engine from the limited-edition Brooklands. The cabin and rear section of the car are a new design and the interior is crammed with every common luxury cue that defines a Bentley. The Azure is highlighted by a new laser-cut matrix grille that evokes the large sporting Bentleys that had won the 24 hours of Le Mans five times between 1924 and 1930. Bentley is now a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG. The spacious handcrafted interior features the highest level of leather and wood trim, individually tailored to the taste of each owner. The complex folding roof on the convertible is operated hydraulically at the touch of a switch and the three-layer fabric assembly stows beneath the leather-trimmed tonneau cover in less than 30 seconds. Safety features in this classic include multiple airbags and the usual electronic nannies found in any modern car. though the platform remains a remnant from the last century.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

The Luxgen7 SUV is a seven-seater crossover, currently only sold in UAE and Oman. It is available as either a front-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. The top feature is the Luxgen Think+ system, co-developed with smartphone makers HTC, that comes with built-in HSPDA 3.5G communications, GPS Navigation and a 10.2-inch LCD display screen for a comprehensive tech package. The system also includes the "Eagle View+" 360-degree parking assist which utilises four cameras to provide a real-time visual display of the surrounding environment. The "Side View+" feature automatically displays live video images of the vehicle's rear blind spot to reduce the chance of an accident during lane changes. The "Night Vision+" high-sensitivity night vision camera system helps illuminate the road and traffic conditions at night beyond the range of the headlamps. "LDWS+" constantly reads the road surface for lane markers and dividers and gives audible and visual warnings when the vehicle veers too close to the lane markings. Overall, the SUV is equipped with 23 advanced ECUs and 8 video cameras to provide these features. Also available are power-opening doors, leather upholstery, rear DVD screen, Bluetooth and more. The Luxgen7 SUV is powered by a turbocharged-and-intercooled 2.2-litre DOHC 4-cylinder engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed automatic transmission. To improve driving feel, the steering system was tuned by Delphi, noise suppression engineering was handled by LMS, the suspension system was developed by Magna, and the overall chassis tuning was done by both Magna and Prodrive.

The XF luxury-sports sedan is still based on the previous S-Type's mechanicals, but is still a real step forward towards competing in the real world. While Jaguar is owned by India-based Tata now, the XF was the last car developed under Ford ownership. Facelifted for 2012, the engines remain the same, including the 3.0-litre V6, the 5.0-litre V8, and the supercharged 5.0-litre V8 for the XFR. All engines are mated to a ZF six-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The most interesting feature of the car is its simplistic interior which consists of toys such as a rotary-dial gear selector and hideway a/c vents. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, in-dash 7-inch screen, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options. The audio unit comes with 30GB of storage and a standard 400-watt system, an optional 600-watt system, or a 1200-watt system which features 17-speakers with subwoofer from Bowers & Wilkins, also as an option. The XFR gets unique bumpers, skirts, wheels and interior upholstery, as well as sportier suspension and drivetrain components.

For 2015, the Infiniti QX80 got minor interior and exterior changes which include new LED-laden headlight clusters, new mesh grille, reshaped bumpers and new 22-inch wheels. The exterior gives away its Nissan origins, save for unique front and rear ends, as well as some trim bits. The QX80 comes with a 5.6-litre V8 engine with 'VVEL' variable valve timing and 'DIG' direct injection, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. A 'Hydraulic Body Motion Control' system is available. The QX80 also offers three-row seating, in a 7-seater or 8-seater configuration, with a reclining 3rd row. Inside, standard and optional features include the usual power accessories, a standard Infiniti Hard Drive Navigation System, Bluetooth, Around View Monitor, Bose 2-channel, 13-speaker Premium Audio System, available perforated semi-aniline leather seating, and available DVD entertainment system with dual 7-inch colour monitors which allows different sources to be played at the same time. Included among the QX80's standard entertainment and technology features are an 8-inch WVGA colour touch-screen display, Infiniti Controller for use with the vehicle information systems and comfort and convenience features. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, lane departure warning, lane departure prevention, blind spot warning. Options include intelligent cruise control, distance control assist, intelligent brake assist with forward collision warning and front pre-crash seat-belts.

An all-new Peugeot 3008 came out in 2017. The compact SUV is available in the GCC with only one engine option - the turbocharged 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the 3008 include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats and alloy wheels. Optional features include an 8-inch touch screen, a 12.3-inch head-up digital display, LED headlights, handsfree tailgate open, park assist system with 360-degree view, Apple Carplay/Andriod Auto, premium 10-speaker audio system, automatic dual-zone A/C, panoramic roof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include six airbags, ABS with EBD, stability control and emergency braking assist.

Toyota tacks on the Land Cruiser badge on up to three of their 4WD models, including a pickup, but there is only one true Land Cruiser that everyone knows and loves for reasons unknown. The Land Cruiser five-door wagon remains at the top of the heap in sales when it comes to luxury and off-road capability, but not necessarily because it is best at either. It is still one of only a few truly legendary off-road vehicles. Few vehicles offer the off-road capability of the Land Cruiser, and fewer still combine this with its level of luxury. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a 4.5-litre six-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto, and a new 4.7-litre V8 and a five-speed auto. There is also a 4.2-litre diesel with a manual. It can transport anywhere from eight to ten passengers depending on model. It is an expensive vehicle, but everything is still optional, including ABS, airbags and cruise control. Other options include leather sunroof and navigation. We'd love to love this outdated 4WD, but we hate the people who buy these, as any other road user will know why.

The American-built Honda Odyssey minivan has been redesigned for 2011. The upmarket minivan is aimed at big families, and is longer, wider and lower than the previous version. It comes in LX, EXL and Touring trim levels. Mechanical specs include a 3.5-litre V6 with cylinder-shutoff technology, a 5-speed automatic in the LX and EXL as well as a 6-speed automatic reserved for the Touring, MacPherson strut front and double-wishbone rear suspension, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and an 80-litre fuel tank. Depending on trim, features include three rows of seating for up to eight people, adjustable 2nd-row seats that can space outwards to fit three baby seats, 3rd-row "magic" seats that can flip forwards or backwards, power-adjustable driver's seat with optional powered passenger seat, optional HID headlights, optional rear DVD screen that is ultra-wide to play a movie and a video game at the same time, ports for USB and even HDMI, optional navigation with Bluetooth phone, optional 15GB hard drive or 2GB flash drive to store CDs instead of needing a CD changer, front and side airbags with three-row side-curtain airbags, stability control, power windows front and rear, cruise control, sunroof, cooler box, remote-controllable power tailgate and rear sliding doors, variable power steering, ABS and 15 bottle and cup holders.

The Mercedes-Benz CLA 35 AMG 4Matic joined the lineup for the first time in 2020. It is a new performance variant, sitting below the CLA 45 AMG. It uses the same 2.0-litre turbocharged engine as the standard version, but tuned to produce more horsepower. Power is delivered via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. The sedan features include 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

The Audi A3 Sedan is the German brand's sub-compact sedan offering. It will be available with two engine choices, either a 1.4-litre or a 1.8-litre, both of which are 4-cylinder and turbocharged units. While the 1.4-litre is only available in front-wheel drive format, the 1.8-litre can be had with all-wheel drive. The front-wheel drive versions get a 7-speed DSG automatic transmissions and the all-wheel drive model gets the 6-speed DSG. Standard equipment include power steering, power windows, power mirrors, daytime running headlamps, start-stop system, manual A/C, fabric seats, central locking, cruise control, entertainment system with Bluetooth and 8 speakers, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get leather seats, automatic A/C, sports seats, HID headlamps, headlight washers, sports suspension, fog lights and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include electronic stability control, ABS with EBD as well as front and side airbags with knee airbags.

The Camaro continued with minor changes for 2013. The ZL1 gets a supercharged 6.2-litre V8 with a 6-speed manual or automatic. StabiliTrak traction control and front-side airbags are standard. There is a new frameless rearview mirror for 2013 as well. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows and lock, and keyless entry. Available features include heads-up display, sunroof and a new MyLink entertainment system which includes touchscreen navigation. Safety features include front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The 5th-generation 3-Series was introduced in 2006 in its current iteration, but received a facelift as well as new engines for 2009. Models currently available in some, but not all, GCC countries include the 320i with higher-tuned 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, the sharp 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder and the hyper 335i with a 3.0-litre turbo 6-cylinder engine. A base 316i sedan-only model debuted in 2011, with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic. Manual models are not actively imported by many GCC dealers. All cars come equipped with keyless entry, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or powered front seats, electric mirrors, power windows, CD stereo, optional sunroof, and a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. The optional iDrive computer is available on all models, as are active steering, HID headlights, and alloy wheels in various sizes. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Ram 1500 will only be offered in the GCC with a 5.7-litre "Hemi" V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic with available manual-shift feature. Available in regular cab, quad cab and crew cab, with three box lengths depending on model, the two trim levels available in the UAE are the ST and the Laramie. The new model is the first truck in this segment to have a coil-spring multilink rear suspension fitted to a solid rear axle, instead of leaf springs, to improve ride quality. The new design boasts best-in-class aerodynamics and new interiors with premium soft-touch materials, as well as an optional industry-first RamBox lockable storage bins built into the bed rails, and cabin storage bins with removable liners big enough for ten beer cans. Other available features include heated and ventilated front seats, surround-sound Alpine audio system, common power accessories, voice-controlled UConnect multimedia touchscreen system with Bluetooth phone and 30 GB hard drive, rear DVD screen, basic keyless entry with remote start, 17-inch basic or 20-inch chrome wheels, dual-zone auto a/c and a choice of cloth or leather upholstery, all depending on trim level. Standard safety features include standard ABS, stability control with hill-start assist and trailer sway control, front airbags and side airbags, as well as optional adjustable pedals, rear parking sensors and back-up camera.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz A-Class Sedan came out in 2019. The A-Class now comes in two variants, the A 200 and A 250. Under the hood, is the same turbocharged 2.0-litre engine carried over from the previous generation, mated to an a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, but gains more power. The 5-seater is offered in one loaded "Sport" spec that includes 18-inch AMG alloys, sporty bumpers, power windows, electric mirrors, multimedia screen, navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, USB port, Bluetooth, cruise control, keyless entry and other features. Standard safety features include front airbags, side-curtain airbags, radar-based collision-prevention assist, attention assist, stability control and ABS. Other available features include LED xenon headlights, active parking assist, rear camera, hill-start assist and a interior ambient-lighting pack. Additional safety options include adaptive cruise control, adaptive highbeam assist, speed-limit sign assist, blind-spot assist and lane-keeping assist.

With the Sharan, VW properly wets its feet in the minivan segment, though it is falling behind the modern competition nowadays, considering its 1995 origins. The Sharan is not a true VW, being based on a Ford minivan, and also sold as a rebadged Seat. Revamped in 2000, and facelifted for 2004, it provides ample room for the driver and six adult passengers to sit back, relax and enjoy their individually formed 'business class' seats. The Sharan offers the flexibility of removing the rear seats to open up a massive 2,610 cubic litres of storage space. Powered by two aging VW engines, namely the 1.8-litre turbo four-cylinder and the 2.8-litre VR6 units, they can be had with a manual or an automatic. Built in Portugal, the Sharan comes standard with five removable rear seats, ABS brakes with electronic brake-pressure distribution, electronic climate control both front and rear, alarm with interior protection and remote central locking, front side airbag system, driver's and front passenger's airbags, electric front windows, electrically adjustable door mirrors, radio/CD stereo with 10 speakers, and seat belts for all three rows of seating.

After nearly a decade since leaving the GCC market, Fiat has returned, and the first car to join their new range is the Fiat 500 hatchback, later joined by the 500 convertible. Available only in select countries and dealers, the 500 is offered with only a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 5-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. It comes in three trim levels, namely Pop, Lounge and Sport. All trims come with standard keyless entry, trip computer, leather-trimmed steering wheel with stereo buttons, CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors. In addition, the base Pop trim has 15-inch alloy wheels and cloth upholstery. The mid-range Lounge trim additionally gets a sunroof, chrome exterior door handles, chrome exhaust tip, silver-trimmed side mirrors, Bluetooth, an upgraded stereo, front fog lights and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Sport trim adds automatic climate control and leather upholstery. An expensive Gucci hatchback model was introduced in 2011, with special trimmings. All models get front and side airbags, stability control and ABS. The convertible gets a cloth roof, but does not fully open as the side-window pillars are retained.

A new-generation Honda CR-V made its debut in 2017. No changes have been made for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, the same engine remains, which is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection engine mated to a CVT that can simulate a 7-speed in 'sport' mode. The DX and LX trims come in 2WD form, while the EX and Touring trims come in AWD form. Standard features on the base two-wheel-drive CR-V model include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, remote key, halogen headlights, daytime running lamps, single-zone A/C, rear camera, fabric seats, 5-inch audio screen, 1 USB, 4 speakers, cruise control and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models gets all-wheel-drive, LED headlights, fog lamps, paddle shifters, engine push start, 7-inch screen, 8 speakers, 4 USB ports, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, dual-zone A/C, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include ABS, vehicle stability assist, traction control system, tyre pressure monitor, hill start assist, electric brake force distribution, and driver attention monitor. The AWD models get Honda's LaneWatch side camera. The top model gets side and curtain airbags as well.

The Luxgen U7 Turbo is the Chinese brand's 7-seater compact SUV offering. It comes with a turbocharged 2.2-litre engine under the hood, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric folding door mirrors, leather seats, stereo system with radio/CD/VCD/DVD/MP3 support and 9-inch touchscreen, USB port, AUX in, 9 JBL speakers, automatic A/C, independent rear climate control, rear A/C vents, cruise control, central locking, keyless entry, push engine start/stop button, sunroof, power tailgate, rearview camera, parking sensors, LED headlamps, taillamps, LED daytime running lamps, rear spoiler and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, brake assist, traction control and stability control, lane departure warning system, front collision warning system and night vision.

The 2018 Megane GT is a higher version of the compact offering from the French brand. It only comes as a hatchback. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push-button engine start, dual-zone A/C, rear air vents, cruise control, auto headlamps, 7-inch touchscreen, navigation, 3D Sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, 2 USBs, AUX, streaming via Bluetooth, cruise control and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include panoramic roof, techno Pack( full LED headlights, electric parking brake) or Premium Pack (Alcantara trim, heated driver & passenger seats, 8.7-inch touchscreen navigation, Bose sound system, 8 speakers, 2 USBs, AUX, Streaming via Bluetooth. Safety features include front and side airbags,  front & rear curtain airbags, ABS, emergency brake assist, blind spot warning, tyre pressure monitoring system and ESP with Hill Start Assist.

The Nativa is an off-road capable 4WD that fits in an odd spot between the Pajero and the Outlander. Powered by a 3.0-litre V6 mated to a four-speed automatic, the Nativa is a dated design, but still a decent wagon. Standard features for the low base price include AM/FM radio cassette player with 4 speakers, driver's and front passenger's front airbags, part time 4WD with synchronized front free-wheel differential, transfer protector, power steering, power windows, central locking, power mirrors, alloy wheels, keyless entry system and seating for five. Features available on higher models include gauges for a thermometer, compass, oil pressure and voltage meter, faux wood trim, front fog lights, CD player with 6 speakers, leather seats, sunroof, limited slip differential, ABS with EBD, cruise control and more. The Nativa rides on the older L200 pickup platform, and was discontinued in a number of markets since 2004. Shipments have continued from Thailand since 2008, alongside the Pajero Sport. However, few 4WDs are offered at this price that are properly equipped to go off-road. Some dealers only offered one fully-loaded trim in the later years.

The Volvo XC40 debuted as a new subcompact crossover model for 2018, slotting in under the XC60. Initially, the only version on offer is the XC40 T5 with a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder and 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive. The two trim levels at launch are R-Design and Momentum. The interior features Volvo's latest design ideas such as the vertical a/c vents, aside from the portrait-mode touchscreen. The mid-range Momentum model is generously equipped with a 12.3-inch digital instrument display, a 9-inch touchscreen infotainment system, dual-zone climate control, rear parking assist, and leather seats as standard. Stepping up to the R-Design trim will add leather and aluminum trim, twin exhaust tips, and sport suspension. Safety features include a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, Cross Traffic Alert with automatic braking, City Safety for pedestrian detection, and the Pilot Assist system for semi-autonomous steering, acceleration, and braking on “well-marked” roads, a feature that will work up to 128 kph.

The 9-3 midsize sports sedan has been around for a while now, spawning variants such as the Sport Combi station wagon and the evergreen convertible. Trim levels include the confusing Linear, Arc, Vector and Aero trims. The base model features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine known as the 1.8t, a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic, 16-inch alloy wheels, power windows and mirrors, a power driver's seat, and an infotainment audio system with 150 watts and seven speakers. Mid-level engines are both also 2.0-litre turbo, known as the 2.0t and the 2.0T, with either manual or automatic. The top Aero models feature the new 2.8-litre V6 turbo engine, known as the 2.8T, and a choice of 6-speed manual or automatic transmissions, along with 17-inch alloy wheels, the sophisticated ReAxs four-wheel steering system, lowered sports suspension and stability control. Not all engines come in all body styles, though all are available in Aero form. Optional features, some of which are standard on higher models, include a glass sunroof,  wooden trim, integrated telephone system with SIM card reader & Bluetooth phone connection, headlamp washers, Xenon headlamps, 6-disc in-dash changer, keyless entry and more. Safety features include available front, side and curtain airbags, along with ABS brakes and available ESP system.

The G37 sedan debuted in 2009 to replace the G35. The sedan then received a frontal facelift for 2011. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. In late 2011, an entry-level G25 model debuted with a 2.5-litre V6 engine. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The GMC Terrain made its debut in the GCC as a 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engines choices, either a 1.5-litre or a 2.0-litre, both of which has been turbocharged. Both engines get a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base SLE model are power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry with engine push start, HID headlamps with LED daytime running lamps, fog lamps, single-zone AC, rear AC vents, infotainment system with 7-inch screen, rear park assist and 17-inch alloy wheels. The SLT model gets additional remote start, rear view camera, front & rear park assist, optional panoramic sunroof, 6-way power driver seat, automatic A/C, optional 18-inch alloy wheels, infotainment system with 8-inch touchscreen display with navigation, 6-speaker audio system and leather seats. The Denali model, which is only available with the 2.0-litre engine, additionally gets all active safety features, engine START/STOP system, heated and cooled front seats, active noise cancellation, wireless charging, automatic rear liftgate with hands-free technology, Bose premium 7-speaker system, semi-automatic parking, 19-inch wheels and panoramic sunroof. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, tire pressure monitoring system, traction control, stability control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Changan CS 75 Plus is a compact SUV and is a sportier version of the CS 75, featuring a more sloped roofline and more power. Under the hood, it gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the CS75  Plus include power windows, central locking, cruise control, dual-zone auto A/C, 8 speakers, multifunctional steering wheel, USB+AUX ports, 12-inch screen, Bluetooth, 360 camera, leather ventilated seats, sunroof, fog lamps, parking sensors LED headlamps, panoramic roof, keyless entry and start, and 19-inch wheels. Safety features includes dual front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), brake assist (BA), traction control and hill assist.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. While shorter than the outgoing model by 10mm, the new Swift boasts a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a new 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, the new motor is actually smaller than before, but more efficient. There is also a turbocharged 1.0-litre 3-cylinder motor offered elsewhere, which may make a debut in the GCC later on. This front-wheel-drive hatchback still comes with a choice of a 5-speed manual or a CVT automatic, although some GCC dealers may choose to only import the auto version. Features include 4 or 6 speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB port, automatic a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, leather steering wheel with audio controls, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, Bluetooth and fog lamps. Available safety features, depending on trim level, includes front airbags, side-curtain airbags and ABS with EBD.

This generation of the S-Class is among the top-selling luxury cars in the Middle East thanks to its mix of luxury and road presence. The S 63 AMG came by 2008. It gets the 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. Also features such as a reversing camera, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels are included.

One of the longest-running nameplates in the region, the Sunny has become popular for its reasonable price and traditional reliability, all while competitors drove their own prices up. However, the Sunny soon fell behind in terms of equipment, and the all-new Tiida arrived as an unofficial replacement to the Sunny in Nissan's lineup. Nissan Middle East is openly pushing the Sunny as a fleet car now, leaving the Tiida for individual sales. That fact has led to the Sunny receiving only a facelift in its latest iteration, while having its engine lineup reduced to just one. The new car is in fact a rebadged Samsung SM3, sold only in Korea. There is good head room, but other interior dimensions fall behind its competitors. Available as a four-door sedan, the Sunny is now available only with a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with a manual or automatic transmissions. Standard features include electric power steering, air conditioning and a cloth interior. Options include a CD stereo system and power accessories. Optional safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes.

The seventh generation BMW 5-series arrived in 2017. The 530i has a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 540i model gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The Lexus GX 460 received a facelift for 2014. Sporting a new front-end, actual changes are minimal, but the midsize luxury SUV in now available in three trim levels. On the outside, the most obvious changes include the redesigned front-end with the corporate "spindle" grille, adaptive LED-HID combination headlights, LED running lamps, new tail lamp clusters, redone 18-inch wheels and other minor bits. The engine is a carryover 4.6-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. The base Premier model is well-equipped, with standard features such as a multi-terrain select system, smart keyless entry and start, sunroof, rear camera and side camera with park assist, synthetic leather trim for the 7-seater cabin, 9-speaker stereo with new 8-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, USB/AUX ports, DVD navigation, tri-zone a/c, crawl control, ESP, basic cruise control and a full set of airbags that includes knee bags. The mid-range Prestige model adds semi-aniline leather, heated/ventilated seats, cool box and lane-change assist with blind-spot monitor. The top Platinum model adds a 17-speaker Mark Levinson stereo, pre-crash safety system, radar cruise control and a rear-seat entertainment system.

BAIC is a Chinese car company which made its debut in the UAE in late 2014. The BAIC A1 sedan is a mini compact which comes with a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, radio with USB/AUX, 4 speakers, fabric seats, 14-inch steal wheels and driver airbag. The higher models get a remote key, CD player with touch screen, 6 speakers, sunroof, leather seats, parking sensors, rearview camera, cruise control, auto headlights, passenger side airbag and curtain airbags.They are come with standard ABS brakes and electronic brake distribution (EBD).

In 2011, the Mercedes-Benz S 63 AMG got a new turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 engine. The new model features new steps in road safety with the second generation of the PRE-SAFE occupant protection system that predicts accidents and prepares the car's occupants for the crash by initiating safety measures such as pre-tensioning seatbelts, raising seat backs to the optimum position and even closing the sunroof. In addition, it also has optional Night View Assist which is an advanced after-dark vision system. Other features include enhanced COMAND system with 8-inch display and a controller on the centre console, Airmatic adaptive suspension and adaptive brake lights. It also includes a reversing camera, AMG bodykit and AMG light-alloy wheels.

The latest Durango has been redesigned, mostly with a minor facelift, and it appears to be a well-built light duty 4WD capable of transporting seven people almost anywhere in very comfortable surroundings, even though it is ultimately one of the ugliest vehicles on the road. The only engine option available here is the 5.7-litre, Hemi V8, which helps the two-and-a-half ton Durango move off with reasonable verve. It's interior design conserves space, which permits a 3rd row of relatively accessible seating. It is obvious that parent company Mercedes-Benz has had an influence on the lowly Dodge. The seams are tight and the materials are of a high quality. The ergonomics work well too, with all the minor luxuries, including a good sound system and a rear seat DVD-entertainment system. Excellent sound insulation means passengers aren't too distracted by road or wind noise, while the third row folds flat into the floor and the 2nd row folds up and out of way very easily. Standard features include air conditioning, power mirrors, illuminated entry lighting, front and rear power outlets, bucket seats, 40/20/40 folding second-row seat, AM/FM stereo radio with in-dash single-disc CD player, cruise control, tilting steering column, and remote keyless entry. Also available are rear climate controls, a power sunroof, AM/FM/6CD/MP3 player and a two-speed transfer case for off-roading.

The Veyron 16.4 was a long-running pet project by Volkswagen to create the fastest production car in the world at the time, reintroducing the Bugatti badge in style. Goofy looks notwithstanding, the styling is an essential part of the design to ensure total stability at top speed. The car is powered by an 8.0-litre quad-turbo W16 engine derived from Volkswagen designs, mated to all-wheel-drive and a seven-speed direct-shift automanual gearbox. The fully customisable interior is covered in leather and metal, with numerous features such as CD stereo, navigation and more. The single-piece carbon-fibre monocoque does well in crash tests, while airbags give the driver and passenger additional protection. The high-speed tyres designed specially for the Veyron 16.4 incorporate the PAX System that ensures safe handling even after sudden pressure loss. Another safety element is the rear spoiler that acts as a "˜parachute brake' during emergency braking. A second key must be engaged when stopped to initiate "top speed" mode, when the rear spoiler sets itself to a lower position, the front air diffusers close and the vehicle lowers to further improve aerodynamic downforce. A limited-to-150-pieces Grand Sport model was released in mid-2008 with a removable targa-roof panel.

The Kia Quoris is a new nameplate for the Korean brand, becoming the flagship of the range by a long shot, in terms of pricing. The full-size sedan comes with a 3.8-litre "MPI" V6 as standard. The rear-wheel-drive platform is fed power via an 8-speed automatic and held up by electronically-adjustable air suspension riding on 18-inch alloy wheels. Available features include a full LCD gauge cluster, electronic gear-shift knob, 17-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB and Bluetooth support, haptic-feedback steering wheel controls, 9.2-inch dual rear screens, heads-up display, power ventilated front seats, surround-view cameras, power rear sunblinds and more. Safety features include nine airbags including a knee airbag, as well as stability control and ABS, while adaptive cruise control, turning HID headlights and blind-spot monitoring are also available.

The new L200 offers versatility combined with a tough new look that makes it seem more like a lifestyle vehicle than a commercial pickup. It obviously is tough enough to be a commercial pickup. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is offered here. The spacious interior places the L200 firmly in the midsize class, unlike the previous compact model. The L200 is an ideal choice for small to medium type of business application. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab along with a variety of work and handling packages. Mitsubishi's new L200 delivers good everyday performance, thanks to willing, if somewhat weak, engines, ventilated disc brakes at the front and drum rear brakes, and available ABS and Electronic Brakeforce Distribution. The brakes, the rear axle, the steering gear and the chassis have all been substantially beefed up for the new L200, while interior features include vinyl seats and a radio cassette player.

The Kia Seltos is a generically handsome sub-compact crossover that debuted for 2020. The LED headlamps, DRLs and fog lamps adorn the front and rear, at least in top-trim models. The UAE and GCC markets will get a non-turbo 1.6-litre and a turbo 1.4-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive, although other markets get better engines and options. Inside, the GCC-spec 2022 Kia Seltos is offered with an 8-inch infotainment screen, basic cruise control, sunroof, rear camera, manual or automatic a/c, 3.5-inch or 7-inch gauge cluster screen, and up to 6 airbags.

An all-new BMW X6 launched as a 2020 model year. The same engines are carried over but have been updated for more power. This includes the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder unit and 4.4-litre V8 turbo motor. Both are mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment includes power steering, power windows, keyless entry, push engine start stop button, leather seats, four-zone climate control, iDrive, LED headlights, wireless charging, and 19-inch alloy rims. Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, up to 21-inch alloy rims, and laser headlights. An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and traction control system. Safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, traction control, stability control, brake assist, tyre pressure monitor, and ABS. Optional packages include driver assistance systems which have autonomous cruise control, lane departure warning, lane assist and collision detection with braking intervention.

The BMW 8-Series, also known by its chassis code E31, is a Grand Tourer developed as a flagship for the German carmaker in its time. While it replaced the original E24 6-Series in 1991, the 8-Series was not a successor, but rather an entirely new class with a substantially higher price. Initially, the only engine on offer was a 5.0-litre V12, for the 850i, which was later renamed 850Ci by 1993. The 1993 model-year also saw the introduction of the 4.0-litre V8 with an 840Ci model, which was later replaced by a 4.4-litre V8 for 1995. Also for 1995, a new 5.4-litre V12 replaced the old engine for the 850Ci. All models were offered with a choice of manual and automatic transmissions. From 1992 to 1996, an M-tuned 850CSi model was also offered, identified by its frontal chin spoiler, unique wheels and manual-only gearbox, and powered by a 5.6-litre V12. The cars at the time were loaded with features such as leather upholstery, power windows and mirrors, power-adjustable seats, premium stereo, LCD info displays, airbags, ABS and more.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is a contender to be the van of choice for families, assuming you are looking just for a whole lot of space and not much luxury features. Its tough looks are misleading, as it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning, some even with rear a/c. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps.

The new-for-2013 Subaru XV, known also as Crosstrek elsewhere, is a completely new nameplate on the Impreza platform, but with hatchback styling, raised suspension, and roof rails. While appearing tough, this compact crossover is powered by a small 2.0-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. The standard XV 2.0i comes with the usual power options, cloth upholstery, auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys, cruise control and halogen headlights. The 2.0i-S Premium adds smart keyless entry and start, rear camera, aluminium pedals, dual-zone auto a/c, HID headlights with washers, power-folding mirrors with LED indicators, and a sunroof. Front and side-curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control are standard on all models.

The Ford Flex received a facelift and new engines for the 2013 model. Touted as a crossover, it is more of a boxy-shaped minivan alternative. Offered in various trim levels, the Flex is powered by either a 3.5-litre V6 or a turbocharged 3.5-litre "EcoBoost" V6 engine, mated with a 6-speed automatic transmission and a choice of front-wheel-drive or all-wheel drive. Airy and spacious, It offers four forward-opening doors, seating for six or seven depending on chosen options, and can be had with a refrigerator, dual panoramic sunroofs, cruise control, common power accessories, capless fuel-filler, HID headlights and LED tails, two-tone paintjob, programmable interior LED lighting, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels, 10-speaker Sony stereo, and Ford's new Sync multimedia system which can connect and control any Bluetooth phone or USB music player. Safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, multiple front and side airbags and ABS brakes.

The new-for-2007 Aurion serves as a direct replacement to the previous V6-powered Camry Grande model. It uses the same front-wheel-drive platform as the all-new Camry. The Aurion features more aggressive front and rear styling, but is largely the same size as the Camry. The new Camry is thoroughly revamped, reworked and upgraded from the ground up, and the Aurion benefits directly. Inside is a huge airy interior that features some slight changes when compared to the Camry. The engine choice is the singular 3.5-litre V6 mated to a six-speed automatic gearbox. The Aurion can be had with cruise control, electrically-adjustable seats, the usual array of power accessories, a multi-function driver information display, a decent AM/FM/CD/MP3 stereo, power tilt/slide moonroof, cloth or leather, a fancy keyless entry system, front and side airbags, and alloy wheels. Dynamic safety features also include electronic stability control and ABS brakes. Toyota has been smart in differentiating the common Camry from the fast V6 model, for the benefit of those who pay more for the extra power. A 'Touring' model appeared in 2011 with a body kit.

The Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT gets a name-change to only "SRT" for 2014, as well as a 6.4-litre V8, 8-speed automatic and all-wheel-drive with no low-range. Other features include an 8.4-inch touchscreen display and 7-inch customer configurable multiview cluster display. Other features include real leather upholstery, stitched-leather dash trim, ventilated power-adjustable front seats, 9-speaker audio with subwoofer and 20-inch wheels, with various options and accessories available. The SRT8 version gets a unique body kit, sports suspension, sports seats and other trim bits. Safety features available include standard active head restraints, front airbags, full-length side-curtain and seat-mounted side airbags, stability control, electronic roll mitigation, hill-start assist and optional trailer-sway control. An optional blind-spot/rear cross-path detection system and adaptive cruise control with forward collision warning are also available.

The Chevrolet Aveo sedan is the American brand's sub-compact offering, which is built in Korea. An all-new model came out in 2017. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Three trim levels are on offer - a base, LS and LT. The standard model gets steering wheel controls, Bluetooth, radio and phone handsfree controls, driver and passenger dual air bags, 15-inch steel wheels and front power windows. The LS trim gets addtiional 4-way driver seat adjuster, rear park assist, rear seat full folding, 40/60 split, front fog lamps and optional 15-inch alloy wheels. The LT trim gets additional 7-inch MyLinkTM screen with phone integration, 6 speakers and 15-inch alloy wheels.

The redesigned-for-2011 Dodge Charger looks a bit like the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but feels like a completely different car compared to its predecessor. Identifiable by its larger snout and 164-LED tail lamps, the new rear-wheel-drive Charger features updated suspension, upgraded engines and a much nicer interior.The top model, the Charger SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Superbee SRT8 gained special graphics, but came with standard suspension rather than the full-spec SRT8's adaptive ones, along with fewer other features. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Audi A1 is the smallest car offered by the German manufacturer. In 2015 it received a minor facelift. There are two versions - the 'Attraction' and the 'Ambition'. They all have a 1.4-litre engine, with the base and mid-option "122" models getting a turbocharger and the higher spec "185" models having a turbo-supercharger combo. The cramped platform offers a cheap independent-front and solid torsion-beam rear suspension. Standard options include electric mirrors, power windows, AM/FM radio with 8 speakers, start-stop engine system and  daytime running headlamps. Optional equipment include xenon headlamps, fog lamps, automatic air-conditioning,  leather seats, cruise control, headlight washers, LED rear lights, sports seats with lumbar support and parking sensors. Safety-wise, front and side-curtain airbags, ESC with electronic limited slip differential and hill-start assist come standard in all models.

For 2017, the Mercedes-Benz SLK-Class was renamed to SLC-Class. It received a significant facelift, along with engine and interior upgrades. Under the hood, it gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre engine with two different tunes, mated to a 9-speed automatic transmission. Standard equipment include automatic engine start/stop function, driver and passenger front airbags, ABS, acceleration skid control(ASR), electronic stability control (ESP), cruise control and radio with AUX/USB support. Optional extras include steering wheel with shift paddles, parking sensors, LED daytime running lights, rain sensor, headlamp cleaning system, Harmon Kardon surround sound system, navigation, memory seats and AMG bodykits.

The Freestar is a capable full-size minivan that is a solid performer, but is outclassed by newer entries. However, it is well-equipped, easily hauling seven passengers, and has a deep well behind the third row that is perfect for groceries. Fold the third-row seat into the floor, and the Freestar holds four passengers and offers a big, flat cargo area behind the seats. The third row can flip around to function as a tailgate seat, while options include a power rear liftgate and dual power sliding doors. On the highway, the Freestar is smooth and quiet, moved along by either a 4.2-litre V6. It doesn't feel as refined as the best and newest of the minivans, but it's strongest suit is safety, with dual-stage driver and front-passenger air bags standard, while the optional Safety Canopy airbags can help protect against head injuries in a rollover or side impact. The Freestar comes standard with ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, a tyre-pressure monitor is standard and optional AdvanceTrac electronic stability control.

The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter can be classified as one of the largest commercial vehicles on offer in the GCC market. It comes with a range of petrol and diesel engines, with three roof heights, various wheelbase lengths, and several body trims, including panel-van, pickup and crew-bus styles. Apparently, this German-built van holds three times as much cargo as its Japanese rivals, with standard safety features to boot, such as airbags, ESP and three-point seatbelts for all passengers, and with 40,000 km service intervals for the diesel models, it ends up offering reasonable overall value.

Toyota revealed an all-new model of the RAV-4 in 2019. New engines have been introduced to the line-up, along with an hybrid model. Under the hood, the 2.5-litre engine carried over into the Toyota RAV-4, but connected with a new 8-speed automatic transmission. In KSA, the base model gets a 2.0-litre engine, mated to a CVT. The hybrid model comes with an electric motor coupled with a 2.5-litre engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features on the RAV-4 include power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, 9-inch infotainment screen with 4 speakers, rear view camera and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher trims get 18-inch alloy wheels, moonroof and LED fog lamps. Safety features include front, side and knee airbags, vehicle stability control, traction control, and ABS.

The redesigned-for-2011 Chrysler 300 looks similar to the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but in reality has many major changes, including a sharper-sloping windshield and a lower belt-line for better visibility. The new 300 thankfully remains rear-wheel-drive and features updated suspension, upgraded engine and a much nicer interior. The top model, the 300 SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Standard safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

The Citroen DS5 is the French brand's compact wagon offering. Under the hood, it gets a 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. There are two variants available in the GCC, the 'So Chic' and 'Sport Chic'. Standard features on the DS5 include power steering, power windows, power-foldable mirrors, central locking, automatic a/c with dual-zone temperature control, radio stereo with CD/AUX support, Bluetooth, USB port, steering mounted controls, navigation system, cruise control, interior mood lighting, aluminium drilled pedals, automatic xenon headlamps, automatic wipers, fog lamps, rear parking sensors, daytime running LEDs, leather seats with lumbar support and 18-inch alloy wheels. The higher models get front parking sensors, electric heated sports seats, and driver's seat with electric lumbar adjustment, massage function and memory settings. Standard safety features include ABS with Electronic Brakeforce Distribution (EBD), Emergency Braking Assistance (EBA), Electronic Stability Program (ESP) with traction control, driver's, front passengers and front lateral airbags, and front and rear curtain airbags.

The Brilliance H530 is the Chinese company's compact sedan offering. It features a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder Mitsubishi engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The design was styled by Italy's Pininfarina. The front-wheel drive H530 is available in two variants, called Comfort and Deluxe. The Comfort model gets standard features such as power steering, power mirrors, power windows, central locking with remote key, fabric seats, single CD player with MP3/USB/AUX support, manual A/C, rear sensors and 15-inch alloy wheels. The Deluxe model gets leather seats, keyless start and keyless entry system, digital A/C, sunroof and 16-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include driver and passenger front-airbags, ABS and electronic brake distribution, and traction control. The Deluxe model gets side airbags as well.

Equipped with a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, the Renault Megane RS is the brand's top performance model sold in the region. Channeling that power is a 6-speed dual-clutch transmission. It comes with launch control. As for now, the manual transmission version is not available. The suspension sits 5 mm lower than the GT and sits on a stiffer suspension set up. The handling is further improved with the four-wheel steering. The exhaust system also puts out a decent soundtrack which adds to the fun factor. The exterior gets additional 60 mm wings, front splitter, functional rear diffuser, and full LED headlamps.For the interior, optional features include seats upholstered in Alcantara, along with Alcantara steering wheel, exclusive black headliner and red stitching. The centre console feature Renault’s R-Link multimedia system with the big screen. Optionally it gets Bose surround sound system with a sub-woofer. Rear camera, front and rear sensors are standard.Safety features include front and curtain airbags, blind spot monitor, tyre pressure monitoring system, hill start assist, ESP and ABS.

The Mazda CX-3 is the Japanese brand's smallest SUV offering. Under the hood, it comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the base 2-wheel drive model includes power steering, power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, push button start, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, AM/FM radio with CD/MP3/AUX/USB, Bluetooth, 4 speakers and alloy wheels. The mid-spec models get all-wheel drive, rear camera, auto A/C, 7-inch touch screen, 6 speakers, steering wheel with Bluetooth controls, daytime running lamps and fog lamps. The top model gets navigation, 6 Bose speakers, adaptive cruise control, leather seats, head up display, digital tachometer and DVD player. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, ABS with EBD and traction control and stability control. The higher models get blind spot monitor, auto-braking system, lane departure warning system and side curtain airbags.

An all-new Mini Countryman was released in 2017. No changes were made in 2018. The Countryman is 8-inches longer than the previous generation. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and powered by the same engines. The standard model gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder motor, while the Cooper S gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, both of which can be had in front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive formats. It can be had with a 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The Golf R debuted in 2011 with a higher-tuned turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, DSG automanual and all-wheel-drive. The interior is very similar to the previous Golf, but some new bits include the steering wheel, 'climatronic' a/c and better noise reduction.It features sports seats, standard XDS electronic differential lock, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist, 19-inch alloys, optional navigation, rear camera, sunroof, adaptive cruise control, usual power accessories and optional DCC adjustable suspension. Safety features include seven airbags including a knee airbag, stability control, traction control and ABS brakes,

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the MDX include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, LED headlights, daytime running lights, roof rack, sunroof, engine start-stop button, cruise control, front power seats with lumbar support, 3 rows for 7 seaters, 3-zone automatic A/C, leather interior, premium audio system with 12 speakers, DVD player with Dolby Pro Logic II (PL2)/MP3/WMA/USB/AUX support & 100 GD hard-disk, handsfree telephone with voice recognition, front & rear smart keyless entry, front heated & ventilated seats, front & rear parking sensors and real wood dashboard. The higher model gets adaptive cruise control, premium MILANO leather and bird's eye view camera. Standard safety features on the MDX include front, side curtain and knee airbags, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), vehicle stability assist (VSA), traction control, hill-start assist and trailer stability assist. The higher model gets additional blind spot information, crash mitigation brake system & forward collision warning system.

The goofy B-Class is touted as a Compact Sports Tourer, when it really is a tall hatchback. Though the A-Class is still in production, its sale seems to have been cancelled here, with this one taking its place. Mercedes-Benz is also touting their the sandwich concept, to which it credits the space-saving arrangement of the engine and transmission partly in front of and partly beneath the passenger cell, which in turn offers the interior spaciousness of larger saloons and estate cars despite its compact external dimensions. There is a height-adjustable load compartment floor, an asymmetrically divided, folding and removable rear seat unit plus an optionally removable front passenger seat, all of which allows conversion from a comfortable touring car to a practical van. Models include the B 150, the B 170, the B 200 and the B 200 Turbo, all four-cylinder, rear-wheel-drive, and available with a choice of manual or CVT automatic, plus all the creature comforts and safety features of a Mercedes-Benz.

The Jimny is a longstanding Suzuki 4WD dating back to the 1980s Samurai. With its rounded 1999 facelift, it entered the modern age in with a lot of enthusiasm. Powered by a 1.3-litre four-cylinder engine, it can be had with either a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic. For what it's worth, the manual version is much quicker than the automatic one, though both are still painfully slow. Off-road, the Jimny holds its own against bigger 4WD vehicles. A separate chassis means that the Jimny has been constructed with serious off-road use in mind. Four adults can be carried on short journeys as long as they don't bring any luggage, but even then, front seat occupants will probably be called upon to sacrifice some legroom. When carrying rear passengers, the luggage area behind them is tiny. It is better to think of this vehicle as a two-seater with a fold-down rear bench. Driver and passenger airbags are available, as are ABS brakes. The Jimny is outdated, but finding another off-roader at this price is an unrealistic idea.

The Jeep Cherokee got a facelift for the 2019 model year. It offers both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive, with a choice between a 2.4-litre "Tigershark" 4-cylinder and a new 3.2-litre "Pentastar" V6. A 9-speed automatic transmission is standard on all models. It features four-wheel-independent suspension. There will be four different versions Sport, Longitude, Limited and Trailhawk. The last one is the most offroad-capable version and has Jeep's "Trail Rated" badges, and comes with a Selec-Terrain system, 1-inch lift and a locking rear differential. Other available features include a park-assist system that gives you directions on how to park into a particular space, an 8.4-inch touchscreen with optional navigation and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with auto-braking, and more.

The Opel Corsa is the smallest offering from the German manufacturer in the Middle East market. The Corsa is a 5-door hatchback, getting a 1.2-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, central locking, digital instrument cluster, fabric seats, adaptive cruise control, infotainment with 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, LED matrix headlights and 16-inch alloy wheels. Optional equipment include navigation, wireless charging and 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include airbags, front collision warning, automatic emergency braking in city traffic, lane departure warning and lane keep assist, brake assist and stability control.

The MK6 Golf GTI debuted in the summer of 2009, with a mildly-upgraded 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and a choice of 6-speed manual or DSG automanual, though the manual version isn't imported by most GCC dealers. The interior is very similar to the previous Golf, but some new bits include the steering wheel, 'climatronic' a/c and better noise reduction. It comes with seven airbags including a knee airbag, stability control, adaptive cruise control, adaptive chassis control with adjustable suspension, Park Assist, alloy wheels, sunroof, and the usual power accessories. The Golf GTI has features such as sports seats, GTI alloy wheels, and a standard XDS electronic differential lock, and optional features such as adaptive suspension, turning HID headlights, automatic parking assist and more.

All A5 versions feature a loudmouth grille framed by rectangular headlights, a very thick C-pillar, frameless windows, and a waistline that flows upwards around the wheel arches. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by either a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder turbo engine, 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder or a 3.0-litre V6 supercharged engine. Power is delivered through a CVT transmission for the front-wheel-drive 1.8-litre version, and a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission for the Quattro all-wheel-drive versions.  It gets a 4.2-litre V8 engine with a 7-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new Subaru Impreza made its debut in 2017 in the GCC. The engines carryover from the previous model, which is either a 1.6-litre or a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine, both mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. Standard features in the 1.6i model include 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, power windows and mirrors, multi-function display, automatic a/c, audio system with 6.5 inch screen, 4 speakers, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, 60/40 folding rear seats and cloth upholstery. The 2.0i model adds the larger engine, 17-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, fog lamps, 6 speakers, faux paddle-shifters and a rear-seat centre armrest with cup-holders. Standard safety features include front dual airbags, knee airbags, stability control and ABS with EBD, along with the all-weather traction of asymmetrical all-wheel-drive.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

Acura made its debut in the Middle East market in 2015. It got a facelift in 2017. Currently it is only being sold in Kuwait. The Acura MDX is their luxury midsize SUV offering. Under the hood, the all-wheel drive model has a 3.5-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission.
