It comes in two variants, the Hiace Panel Van version for carrying cargo and the Hiace Commuter which gets back seats to act as a people carrier. Standard features include dual front/rear a/c, an AM/FM cassette player with 2 speakers, power steering, power door locks, toolbox, halogen headlamps and 15-inch steel wheels. Some markets get optional features such as remote locking. Depending on market, consumers have the choice of a normal roof, mid-roof or high-roof with a standard, long or super long wheel base-wide body.

An all-new Hyundai Grand i10 was offered in the UAE & GCC in 2021. It gets a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine with VTVT (Variable Timing and Valve Train) technology, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. The no-frills base model comes with 14-inch steel wheels, air-conditioning, body-coloured bumpers, central locking, chrome radiator grille, electric power steering, front electric windows, and a stereo with six speakers. More available features include body-coloured door handles, body-coloured mirrors, driver's seat height adjustment, electric door mirrors, all-electric windows, front fog lights, remote locking, seatbelt reminder, 15-inch alloy wheels and anunderfloor rear luggage compartment. Although it is possible to go even cheaper, the i10 represents a good balance of modernity without the appearance of being a product for basic motoring.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. Two engines have carried over to the new model, the 3.7-litre V6 and 5.0-litre V8, while there is a new turbocharged 2.3-litre 4-cylinder motor in the line-up. All engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The interior has been significantly improved as well with higher quality materials and upgraded MyFord infotainment system. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

The Mini Coupe is the latest edition for 2012 to the ever-expanding Mini line-up. Based on the standard Mini, the only real difference is in the upper half. While the regular hatchback had tight back seats, the Coupe still features a rear hatch, albeit more sloping, and ditching the rear seats completely in the process. Models include the Cooper, the turbocharged Cooper S, and the upgraded turbocharged John Cooper Works. The Cooper uses a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with the S adding a turbocharger, and the JCW featuring an upgraded turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic for all except the JCW, which only comes with a manual. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. The John Cooper Works package bumps up the horsepower and handling. Further options on all Minis include bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The redesigned-for-2011 Dodge Charger looks a bit like the old model, and still uses a lot of the same underpinnings, but feels like a completely different car compared to its predecessor. Identifiable by its larger snout and 164-LED tail lamps, the new rear-wheel-drive Charger features updated suspension, upgraded engines and a much nicer interior.The top model, the Charger SRT8, was released in 2012 with a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. The Superbee SRT8 gained special graphics, but came with standard suspension rather than the full-spec SRT8's adaptive ones, along with fewer other features. Standard safety features on all models include front, side and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor and optional adaptive cruise control with auto braking.

An all new Porsche Cayenne came out for 2018. The variants initially available were the Cayenne, Cayenne S and Cayenne Turbo. The entry-level Cayenne gets a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine. The Cayenne S gets a new 2.9-litre turbo V6. The Cayenne Turbo gets a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine. Later on, an E-Hybrid model joined the lineup which got a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine combined to an electric motor. All engines get an 8-speed automatic transmission. Porsche updated the interior of the Cayenne by doing away with many buttons and by replacing them with a 12.3-inch touchscreen and a few touch-capacitive controls. The interior retains the analog tachometer which now comes with two 7-inch color displays on either sides that read out driver information. The new Cayenne comes with a list of goodies that are offered in other Porsche products. Rear wheel steering, a Porsche Active Suspension Management system for “finer degree of specific calibration” of the air suspension, a new Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control that uses a 48-volt electrical system and a new semi-autonomous driving tech called Innodrive are a few of them. Features available on the Cayenne optional two-tone or body-colour leather upholstery, 40:20:40 split rear seat with front-back movement, power front-seat adjustment with optional memory feature, optional adaptive sports seats, cruise control, navigation, Bluetooth, cruise control with optional distance-control function, optional lane-change monitor, parking sensors with optional back-up camera, wheel sizes from 18-inch to 21-inch and higher quality audio systems. Safety features are thankfully standard, including front and side airbags, tyre pressure monitor, ABS and stability control, with various other optional electronic aids.

An all-new Honda Pilot was released as a 2016 model. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-liter Direct Injected V6 engine with Variable Cylinder Management (VCM), mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base EX model can be had in 2WD or AWD form, while the EX-L and Touring trims only come with AWD and no low-range gearing. The Pilot includes a traction management system and is featured on all models except the EX 2WD, with pushbutton mode selection and TFT mode display on the cockpit instrument panel. In addition, EX (AWD) & EXL grades offer 200 mm of ground clearance for better off-road ability. There is also a sand-mode feature. Features include halogen projector headlights in EX and EXL grades whereas LED projector headlights in Touring grade, which also gets a panoramic glass roof. Some of the other features standard in all grades includes front fog lights, LED taillights and LED daytime running lights along with Tailgate Spoiler, power door mirrors and LED turn light indicators. For the interior, an 8-inch touchscreen, standard in all grades, gives you access to audio system controls and other display features. The Touring grade includes second row captain's chairs, which provides easy walk through between the second and third row for a 7 passenger configuration. Other amenities include tri-zone automatic climate control, rear air conditioning duct in the second and third row seats, rear door sunshade, sun glass holder and conversation mirror, cargo area hidden storage for extra luggage, active noise control (ANC) for a quieter cabin, with a rear entertainment system with a 9-inch display screen available in the Touring grade. Safety features include Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD), Hill Start Assist (HSA), Agile Handle Assist (AHA) and Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS).

The Mitsubishi Lancer EX, first introduced in 2008, got some minor trim changes for 2010. From 2013 onwards, it comes with a choice of two four-cylinder engines, namely a new 1.6-litre and a carryover 2.0-litre. The smaller engine gets a 4-speed automatic and the larger one gets a CVT auto transmission. Offering a choice of either engine, features in the most basic GLX model includes power steering, locally-installed CD/MP3 player with 4 speakers, manual a/c, keyless entry, 16-inch steel wheels with covers, power windows and even colour-coded bumpers, but only a driver's airbag. The mid-range GLS model can only be had with the larger engine, and includes a sporting body kit, rear spoiler, leather-wrapped steering wheel, cruise control, rain-sensing wipers, smart key with starter button, sunroof, 6-speaker stereo with USB port, rear camera and faux-wood panelling. The top GT model adds adaptive headlights which turn with the steering wheel, fog lamps, Rockford Fosgate premium CD audio system with six-CD changer and 9 speakers, "sport-type" front seats, rear split seats with centre armrest, colour-keyed power mirrors, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, 18-inch alloy wheels and just two front airbags.

An all-new Honda Pilot was released as a 2016 model. It has remained the same for the 2018 model year. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-liter Direct Injected V6 engine with Variable Cylinder Management (VCM), mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base EX model can be had in 2WD or AWD form, while the EX-L and Touring trims only come with AWD and no low-range gearing. The Pilot includes a traction management system and is featured on all models except the EX 2WD, with pushbutton mode selection and TFT mode display on the cockpit instrument panel. In addition, EX (AWD) & EXL grades offer 200 mm of ground clearance for better off-road ability. There is also a sand-mode feature. Features include halogen projector headlights in EX and EXL grades whereas LED projector headlights in Touring grade, which also gets a panoramic glass roof. Some of the other features standard in all grades includes front fog lights, LED taillights and LED daytime running lights along with Tailgate Spoiler, power door mirrors and LED turn light indicators. For the interior, an 8-inch touchscreen, standard in all grades, gives you access to audio system controls and other display features. The Touring grade includes second row captain's chairs, which provides easy walk through between the second and third row for a 7 passenger configuration. Other amenities include tri-zone automatic climate control, rear air conditioning duct in the second and third row seats, rear door sunshade, sun glass holder and conversation mirror, cargo area hidden storage for extra luggage, active noise control (ANC) for a quieter cabin, with a rear entertainment system with a 9-inch display screen available in the Touring grade. Safety features include Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD), Hill Start Assist (HSA), Agile Handle Assist (AHA) and Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS).

A new-generation Honda CR-V made its debut in 2017. In 2020, it got slight facelift, along with upgraded tech inside. Under the hood, the same engine remains, which is a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder direct-injection engine mated to a CVT that can simulate a 7-speed in 'sport' mode. The DX and LX trims come in 2WD form, while the EX and Touring trims come in AWD form. Standard features on the base two-wheel-drive CR-V model include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking, remote key, halogen headlights, daytime running lamps, single-zone A/C, rear camera, fabric seats, 5-inch audio screen, 1 USB, 4 speakers, cruise control and 17-inch alloy wheels. Higher models gets all-wheel-drive, LED headlights, fog lamps, paddle shifters, engine push start, 7-inch screen, 8 speakers, 4 USB ports, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, dual-zone A/C, and 18-inch alloy wheels. The 2020 Honda CR-Vs gets a redesigned center console that is easier to use, with more flexible storage options, while CR-V Touring grade now come standard with Wireless Cell phone charger. The 7-inch touch screen Display Audio is compatible with Apple CarPlay and AndroidAuto platforms. The 2020 CR-V gets the Hands-Free Access Power Tailgate with adjustable height feature standard in the EX and the Touring grade. Safety features include ABS, vehicle stability assist, traction control system, tyre pressure monitor, hill start assist, electric brake force distribution, and driver attention monitor. The AWD models get Honda's LaneWatch side camera. The top model gets side and curtain airbags as well.

This generation of the Audi A6 was first launched in 2005, and continues for 2009 with a minor facelift. It is available as a sedan and a wagon in this region, along with the RS6, although the wagons seem popular only for fleet duty. The engine range continues to get exceedingly confusing. Available in the front-wheel-drive platform are the 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 for the 2.0T as well as the 2.8-litre V6 for the 2.8 model. The Quattro all-wheel-drive platform came the new 3.0-litre supercharged V6 for the 3.0T, while the 4.2-litre V8 and the 5.2-litre S6 are not available in the GCC. The RS6 sedan also joined the range in 2009, with a twin-turbo 5.0-litre V10. The standard transmission on Frontrak front-wheel-drive models is either a CVT with simulated 7-speed functionality, while the all-wheel-drive Quattro models will get a 6-speed automatic, but a manual gearbox will not be offered in the GCC. The S-Line sports package is available on the higher-end sedan models. Other features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well as 17-inch or 18-inch rims. The A6 attempts to offer a blend of comfort and performance, and the Quattro models certainly do well here. The front-wheel-drive models are purely for cosmetic non-sporting purposes, considering the wrong wheels put the power down, unlike rear-wheel-drive offerings from BMW and Mercedes-Benz.

From 2012, the design all-new Porsche 911 incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than the previous generation. It is still a 2+2 seater coupe. The Porsche 911 GT3 was revealed in mid 2014. In 2016, a GT3 RS was made with slightly more power and less weight. The GT3 and GT3 RS gets a 3.8-litre motor and for the first time, will not have a manual gearbox option. It is available only with the 7-speed dual-clutch "PDK" transmission. The new active rear-wheel steering and the Porsche Torque Vectoring (PTV) Plus, are used in the 911 GT3 for the first time as standard, expanding the range of driving options considerably, completed by active engine mounts, the Porsche Stability Management (PSM) and the active damper system (PASM). Available features include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

This 4th generation of the long-running 3-Series remained BMW's best-selling car, and with good reason. Ignoring the 3-Series Compact that was based on an older platform, this iteration of the 3-Series came in sedan, coupe and convertible forms, as well as in wagon trim that never came to the GCC. These variations were enough to solidify this model as the arguably the top-selling entry-luxury car in the market. While lower models managed with cloth upholstery, steel wheels and basic power accessories, the higher trim levels enjoyed leather, premium CD stereo, navigation, alloy wheels, sunroof and other amenities. While all models were rear-wheel-drive, some markets may have gotten a few all-wheel-drive versions of the various models. Manual and automatic transmissions were standard, but some markets may also have automanual gearboxes on some higher models. The sedan debuted in 1999, followed by the coupe in 2000, with 2.0-litre, 2.2-litre, 2.5-litre and 2.8-litre engines, along with 318i, 320i, 323i and 328i designations respectively, and 2-door models getting "Ci" badging instead of "i" at the end. The year 2001 brought about the hot 3.2-litre M3 version, available in 2-door form only, while all other models got new engines and names, such as upgraded 2.5-litre 325i and new 3.0-litre 330i alongside the existing 318i and 320i. A minor front-end facelift came in 2002 for all models except the M3. A lightweight M3 CSL with an upgraded engine was briefly available unofficially. While the sedan was replaced by an all-new model by 2006, the coupe and convertible continued well into 2006 before their new versions came out.

The Audi RS 5 Sportback is being sold, but mostly only on special order. It made its debut in the GCC in 2020. It gets a twin turbocharged 2.9-litre V6 engine with a 8-speed automatic. Technology includes partial LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control. The exterior gets more aggressive bumpers to differentiate from the standard A5 Sportback.

The Ford Focus ST was made available by 2013 in the GCC market with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder EcoBoost engine, mated to a 6-speed manual. Standard features include four-wheel-independent suspension, power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, CD stereo with USB/AUX port, capless fuel filler, 18-inch alloy wheels, keyless start, dual-zone auto a/c, rain-sensing wipers, auto headlights, cruise control with speed limiter, Bluetooth, "premium" centre-console storage, fog lights and LED tail lamps. The Focus ST hatchback also gets a body kit, Recaro seats, sports suspension and an overboost feature for extra torque when needed. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, as well as ABS, stability control with hill-start assist, and a torque-vectoring system for better handling.

The Skoda Yeti got a facelift which came to the GCC in 2015. The Yeti is a sub-compact crossover SUV, and it comes with two engine options. One is the turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine with a 7-speed DSG automatic transmission, the other is a 1.8-litre turbo 4-cylinder engine coupled to a 6-speed DSG automatic gearbox and an all-wheel-drive system. The standard models gets power steering, power windows, 16-inch steel wheels, fabric seating, black roof rails, manual a/c, electric mirrors, folding table on rear-seat centre armrest and on the rear of front seats, cooled storage compartment, rear parking sensors and CD/MP3 stereo. The higher models get different 17-inch wheels, silver roof rails, 6-CD changer with SD card reader, and a panoramic glass roof. Safety features include standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, hill-descent assist, and a whole host of electronics.

While all models were rear-wheel-drive, some markets may have gotten a few all-wheel-drive versions of the various models. Manual and automatic transmissions were standard, but some markets may also have automanual gearboxes on some higher models. The sedan debuted in 1999, followed by the coupe in 2000, with 2.0-litre, 2.2-litre, 2.5-litre and 2.8-litre engines, along with 318i, 320i, 323i and 328i designations respectively, and 2-door models getting "Ci" badging instead of "i" at the end. The year 2001 brought about the hot 3.2-litre M3 version, available in 2-door form only, while all other models got new engines and names, such as upgraded 2.5-litre 325i and new 3.0-litre 330i alongside the existing 318i and 320i. A minor front-end facelift came in 2002 for all models except the M3. A lightweight M3 CSL with an upgraded engine was briefly available unofficially. While the sedan was replaced by an all-new model by 2006, the coupe and convertible continued well into 2006 before their new versions came out.

The S-Type sporting sedan is a great example of a polarising retro design, and though we love its looks, many out there don't. It was originally launched for 2000, then upgraded for 2003, and received a facelift in 2005. The 2003 update apparently had improved the car dramatically, while adding a set of new V8 motors. For 2005, Jaguar updated the styling, revised the interior, and retuned the suspension. Engines include the adequate base 3.0-litre V6, the decent 4.2-litre V8 and the over-the-top supercharged 4.2-litre V8, all mated to a ZF six-speed automatic with basic manual shift capability. Jaguar's quality has been dramatically improved over the past few years. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, power adjustable steering column with tilt-away entry and exit action, twin-function trip computer, and cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Options include satellite navigation, power adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, and rain-sensing wipers. Front and rear parking sensors, adaptive cruise control, upgraded upholstery, sports suspension and other options are also available.

The SX4 is an all-new compact car from Suzuki. Suzuki says SX4 stands for Sport X-over for 4 seasons, in reference to an all-wheel-drive model that is not actually offered in most GCC markets. The crossover-style hatchback came first, then a tall sedan came in mid-2008. Originally fitted with a standard 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, the SX4 can be equipped with a five-speed manual transmission, while also coming with an optional four-speed automatic. A 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine debuted with the sedan. The hatchback offers versatility and even looks like a stylish mini-4WD with its black plastic body-cladding. Standard features include air conditioning, power windows, locks and mirrors, remote keyless entry, AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with four speakers, tilt steering wheel, 16-inch alloy wheels and black roof rails on the hatchback. The higher trim level adds electronic stability control and traction control, auto temperature control, cruise control, leather-wrapped steering wheel with steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, premium audio with six-disc CD changer and nine speakers including subwoofer, silver-colour roof rails and more. Basic safety features include dual front airbags and ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, although non-GCC markets get better safety equipment.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Boxster have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Boxster gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Boxster S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Porsche Boxster has been completely revamped for 2012 in almost all aspects, with a new exterior design that doesn't rely on leftover 911 parts like before. Rebadged in early 2016, the '718' Boxster have engines that have been downsized to 4-cylinder turbocharged motors, with a choice of 6-speed manual or 7-speed "PDK" automanual. The standard Boxster gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre motor, while the Boxster S gets the turbocharged 2.5-litre unit. Also, the front fascia has been updated with a new headlight design and longer cooling intakes. The 2-seater Boxster comes standard with an insulated power soft-top, 18-inch wheels, HID headlights, power windows, keyless entry and not a whole lot else. Everything else costs extra, with a choice of  options such as 19-inch and 20-inch wheel designs, special paint colours, various leather seat styles and upholstery options, cabin trim materials, Bose stereo, CD/DVD changer, multimedia system with navigation and Bluetooth, keyless start, power-folding mirrors, parking sensors, wind deflector and even coloured wheel-caps. Further optional features include speed-sensitive power steering, ceramic brakes, Porsche Torque Vectoring system with mechanically-locking rear differential, Sport Chrono package with launch control, and a variable sports exhaust system. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, fixed roll hoops, ABS, stability control and optional tyre-pressure monitor.

The Skoda Kodiaq is the VW-owned Czech brand's first proper foray into the crossover market after the van-like Skoda Yeti was cancelled. There is a choice of two engines , one a 1.4-litre turbo in front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive forms, and another a 2.0-litre turbo in all-wheel-drive form. The smaller engine comes with a 6-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic while the larger one gets a 7-speed DSG auto. Seating can be 5 or 7, depending on trim level. Features include a touchscreen multimedia system, cruise control, keyless entry, ABS with EBD, a full set of airbags and all the other other usual bits and bobs.

Not only does the 2014 Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG get a boost in power from the twin turbocharged 5.5-litre V8 engine, but also it has gone all-wheel drive. That's not it, as there is also an S-model which produces even more power. The engine is mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Like all AMG models, there is Comfort, Sport, Sport+ and Manual modes to tweak suspension and transmission settings. The S-model gets a limited-slip differential as well. AMG carbon ceramic brakes are optional.  The front fascia incorporates the new AMG design philosophy, which is the silver-chrome AMG "twin blade" radiator grille and the so-called "A-wing". Black flics on the side air inlets ensure optimal airflow to the cooling modules, and on the bottom a front splitter contributes to increasing downforce. It also gets widened fenders. There's both a sedan and a wagon version, although expect the sedan only to come to the Middle East, incidentally one of AMG's largest markets.  All the usual luxury and safety features are available, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. It also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Porsche 911 Turbo and Turbo S got a minor facelift in 2017, as well as a slight power upgrade, thanks to modified inlet ports in the cylinder head, new injection nozzles and higher fuel pressure. Fuel economy improves slightly as well due to further advanced electronic engine and transmission management with revised gear change mappings. The engine is a 3.8-litre turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission. Standard features on the 911 Turbo include power steering, power mirrors, keyless entry, electric sports seats, leather seats, Alcantara roof lining, multifunction steering wheel, 2-zone automatic A/C, cruise control, front and rear parking sensors with rearview camera, Porsche Communication Management (PCM) infotainment system with radio and Bluetooth, Connect Plus with Apple CarPlay, Bose sound system with 12 speakers and subwoofer, and 20-inch alloy wheels. In the Turbo S, sports bucket seats and Porsche Ceramic Composite Brake (PCCB) are standard. Optional features list is long where customers can opt for different interior packages, higher end music system, special exterior paint, different alloy rim designs, etc. Standard safety features include airbags for driver and front passenger, Porsche Side Impact Protection (POSIP), comprising side impact protection elements in the doors, thorax airbag integrated into the side bolsters of the front seats and head airbag for driver and front passenger in each door panel, traction control, stability control and lane keeping assist.

The Avalon, in this rendition since 2005, has been facelifted for 2011, with new front and rear designs as well as a mildly updated interior. Engineered and built by Toyota's U.S. division, it remains unchanged mechanically. Power comes from a carryover 3.5-litre V6, mated to front-wheel-drive and a 6-speed automatic. Inside is a comfortable cabin lavished with tasteful materials and ergonomically-designed controls that makes this car a pleasant and cheaper alternative to a Lexus. Now available in only one trim level in the UAE, standard features include a sunroof, 17-inch alloy wheels, fog lamps, HID headlights, power windows and mirrors, intelligent keyless entry with starter button, CD/MP3 stereo with AUX and USB port as well as 9 speakers, Bluetooth, navigation, rear-view monitor, leather seats, wood trim, cruise control, dual-zone auto a/c, power sunshade, powered front seats with driver-side memory, and most importantly, front seat heaters. However, Saudi Arabia gets two lower-trim models more, with fabric seats and fewer features. Safety features include front airbags, side and curtain airbags, a front knee airbag, stability control and ABS with EBD.

The Cadillac CTS got a redesign for the 2014 model year. External changes for 2018 are limited to new paint colours. The base engine is now a 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, coupled with 6-speed automatic transmission. The 3.6-litre V6 is still there, with a new 8-speed automatic. A new CTS VSport variant joins the lineup later, with a twin turbocharged 3.6-litre V6, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CTS include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE 3 entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.

When the new Nissan Patrol was launched in 2010, the carmaker elected to keep producing the older-generation Patrol Safari alongside the new one. It remains the same for the 2020 model year. The long-running Safari continues to be Nissan's best four-wheel-drive model. It gets the 4.8-litre inline 6-cylinder engine as standard, with the choice of a 5-speed automatic with tiptronic or a proper 5-speed manual. It is available as a 3-door and a 5-door model. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol also has a decent interior featuring quality materials, wood trim, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, fog lamps, 16-inch wheels and other equipment. In 2017, the Patrol Super Safari trim was introduced which comes with new tan leather seats and door trim with 8-way power seats for the driver and 4-way for the front passenger. New features include a navigation system as well as front and rear parking sensors with rear view camera, Bluetooth, USB, CD, AUX input and FM/AM radio. The vehicle comes equipped with automatic climate control and a built-in refrigerated cool box. The Super Safari can be distinguished from other Patrol models by its unique machine-cut 17-inch black alloy wheels, dual-tone body colour, a rear spoiler and a Super Safari body stripe. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, the wagon model has room for seven. A sunroof and an electric front winch are optional. In late 2018, a trio of locally-modified versions were introduced -- the Falcon with chrome trim and leather; the Gazelle with a 2-inch lift kit, remote-reservoir shocks, fender flares and snorkel; and the Gazelle X with a 4-inch lift kit, off-road wheels, regeared diffs, metal bumpers, boot drawer set, louder exhaust and more. These versions will be built based on demand.Stability control and a tyre-pressure monitor are standard now, as per current regulations. Dual front airbags, ABS, an immobiliser and cruise control are also included, as are the classic rear locking differential, as well as front and rear-pintle tow hooks.

Built by Noble Automotive, the M600 is a handbuilt British supercar that debuted in 2009. Utilising materials such as stainless steel, aluminium and carbon-fibre, the M600 is powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 from the Volvo XC90 that was originally developed by Yamaha. There are driver-selectable settings that vary the power, fed through an Italian-sourced 6-speed manual to the rear wheels. The 2-seater cabin is tight and impractical, while using premium leather upholstery and offering a basic stereo. Wheels are 19-inch up front and 20-inch in the back. Safety features are lacking, with traction control and nothing else, not even airbags or ABS for the mildly-assisted steel brakes.

The Pajero is a true off-roader, and a legend in its own right. Powered by either a 3.0-litre V6 or a 3.8-litre V6 engine, it can only be had with an automatic transmission nowadays. It can be had in either three-door or five-door body styles. The standard package includes ActiveTrac four-wheel-drive with rear-wheel, full-time all-wheel and 4WD high and low range with locked centre differential. The short-wheelbase three-door Pajero holds five passengers, while the long-wheelbase model holds seven, with a third-row seat that can be folded into a well in the cargo area floor, or removed entirely. Standard features include an RV meter showing external temperature, time, date, compass, pressure, altitude and maintenance intervals. Also standard are a radio cassette player with 6 speakers, automatic a/c, front dual airbags, keyless entry, power windows and mirrors, and alloy wheels. Higher models get a 6-disc CD changer, fake wood interior trim, sunroof, front and rear automatic a/c, traction control, ABS with EBD, cruise control, cool box and leather seats.

The Audi A6 is available as a sedan and a wagon in this region, along with the sporting S6, although the wagons seem popular only for fleet duty. The engines available in the front-wheel-drive platform are the 2.0-litre inline-4 turbo, as well as the 2.4-litre and the 3.2-litre V6 powerplants, and in the Quattro all-wheel-drive platform, the 3.2-litre V6, the 4.2-litre V8, and for the S6, a 5.2-litre V10. The transmission of choice in these cars is either the CVT or the traditional six-speed automatic, depending on model. The S-Line sports package is available on 3.2 and 4.2 sedans. Other features include a Bose surround sound standard on the 4.2, adaptive cruise control and adaptive air suspension are available, and 17-inch wheels are standard on the 3.2, while the 4.2 gets 18-inch rims. The A6 attempts to offer a blend of comfort and performance, and the Quattro models certainly do well here. The 3.2 does a good job of lugging passengers around, while the 4.2 and S6 are pure muscle. The front-wheel-drive models are purely for cosmetic purposes, considering the wrong wheels put the power down, unlike rear-wheel-drive offerings from BMW and Mercedes-Benz.

From 2014, the Infiniti G37 Convertible became the Q60 Convertible to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted 7-speed automatic gearbox. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. It is a proper 2+2 seater car, with decent space in the back too. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

A new generation Ford Mustang was introduced in 2015. In 2018 it received a facelift and some power upgrades. There is no more V6 engine offered, with only 2.3-litre turbo and the V8 engines carrying over. All engines can be had with either a 6-speed manual transmission or a new 10-speed automatic transmission. The interior gets the MyFord infotainment system with SYNC 3. For the first time, Ford has introduced independent rear suspension for this generation Mustang, which helps improve handling. Standard features include power windows, power steering, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, paddle shifters and alloy rims. The higher models get navigation, rear-view camera, leather seats, more speakers, engine push-start and automatic A/C. Safety standards include driver and passenger airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes and traction control.

An all-new Chevrolet Suburban came as a 2015 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements, which includes a stronger frame. Under the hood of the 2019 Chevrolet Suburban is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine, but has been slightly updated for more horsepower and torque. Power is delivered through a 6-speed automatic transmission. Features in the 2019 Chevrolet Suburban include a new electric power steering system, power windows, electric mirrors, 12 device-charging locations, AM/FM radio with MP3/AUX/USB support, 4.2-inch display between the instrument panel, an optional 8-inch screen with MyLink infotainment system and alloy rims. The rear seats can fold down flat, allowing for more luggage space. Safety features include a front-seat center air bag, forward collision alert, front park assist, lane departure warning, lane change assist, rear cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control. An advanced anti-theft system can be added which shuts down key systems to make the it almost impossible to move or start.

For 2016, the 300 SRT got a facelift, giving it a more aggressive look. It got some new safety features, updated entertainment system and a new automatic transmission. Under the hood is a 6.4-litre V8 mated to a 8-speed automatic. Standard SRT8 features include leather upholstery, ventilated seats, UConnect multimedia system with touchscreen, 19 Harmon Kardon speakers, dual-pane panoramic sunroof, 20-inch wheels, rear spoiler and more, along with a unique exterior kit. Getting the "Black Vapor" option adds black chrome surround grille, black headlamp bezels, and black LED taillamps. Standard safety features include front, side, knee and curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane departure warning, blind spot monitor, cross path detection and forward collision warning.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The Volvo XC70 got minor exterior and interior upgrades, as well as new added safety features in 2014. Although it is still not really that good off-road as we know it, the XC70 gets by on gravel and flat sand, given its fairly impressive ground clearance. Available only in T6 trim now, it is powered by a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder engine, with an automatic offering tiptronic manual shifting. The second-row has a three-section bench seat with removable centre position for various setups. Standard features include keyless entry, CD player, trip computer, air-conditioning, xenon headlights, power windows, doors, locks, sunroof and mirrors. Available features also include leather or vinyl seats, ventilated front seats with perforated leather, 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels, an in-dash computer system with USB and Bluetooth support, and an optional rear-seat entertainment system. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags, WHIPS whiplash protection, collision Warning with brake support and emergency brake lamps, adaptive cruise control helps keeping a safe distance to vehicles ahead, hydraulic brake assist, optimised hydraulic brakes and fading brake support. An optional Polestar ECU upgrade is available to bump up the power by 25 hp.

An all-new Nissan Pathfinder was introduced in 2013, when it ditched its body-on-frame chassis and gained some length to compete in the hotly-contested midsize crossover segment. In 2018 it got a facelift, along with engine and interior upgrades. The 7-seater Pathfinder is powered by a 3.5-litre V6, mated to a CVT and a choice of either front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive in all trim levels. The hybrid model is powered by a 4-cylinder 2.5-litre supercharged engine combined with an electric motor. The all-wheel-drive model gets a selector for choosing 2WD, 4WD or Auto. The base Pathfinder S comes standard with a second-row 60/40-split fold-flat bench seat, a third-row 50/50-split fold-flat reclining bench seat, LED running lights, 18-inch alloys, tri-zone automatic a/c, keyless entry with push-button ignition, power windows, CD/MP3/DVD/HDD audio system with 8-inch screen and 6 speakers, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth phone, auto headlights, 6 airbags, stability control, tyre-pressure monitor and apparently a standard power liftgate in some markets. The Pathfinder SV adds power-adjustable front seats, rear camera, 20-inch alloy wheels, remote starter, auxiliary audio/video input jack, power windows with front one-touch auto-up/down, front fog lamps, chrome body side trim, welcome lighting, stainless-steel kick plates, speed-sensitive intermittent wipers, illuminated sun-visor mirrors, sunroof, wood-tone trim, leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, leather seats, and a tow hitch receiver with 7-pin trailer tow wiring harness on the rear bumper. The top-spec Pathfinder SL further adds a key-linked memory seat and other settings for individual drivers, side-curtain airbags front and rear, digital compass, 9GB hard drive, 8-inch VGA colour monitor with navigation, Bose audio system with 13 speakers, climate-controlled front seats, and a power-tilt/telescoping steering column. An around-view four-camera parking aid is optional, as is a rear DVD entertainment system with 2 screens. Available accessories include roof rail bars, rear-installing tent and more.

Volkwagen's Phaeton is a luxury car for people who refuse to flaunt their wealth. If you can afford a hand-built luxury car but don't need to go around with a hood ornament to proclaim your arrival, then you may find that this expensive new VW more than meets your needs. Volkswagen is attempting to move upscale and the Phaeton is its new flagship luxury sedan, built alongside its platform-mate, the Bentley Continental GT. The VW Phaeton is available in three models, namely a 3.2-litre V6, a 4.2-litre V8 and a 6.0-litre W12, all mated to an automatic tiptronic transmission and all impressively powerful. Only the long wheelbase body style is sold in this region. The Phaeton includes as standard equipment such things as a navigation system, all-wheel drive, air suspension, draft-free four-zone automatic climate controls with vents hidden behind wood doors, 12-way front power seats and a long list of safety and driver-assist technologies. Standard safety features includes ABS brakes, anti-slip regulation, electronic differential lock, engine braking control, electronic brake force distribution and electronic stabilization technology, along with front, side and curtain airbags, and a tyre pressure monitor.

The new-for-2011 Safrane is the second iteration of Renault's Korean-built midsize sedan offering in the GCC. It has been completely redesigned compared to the previous Nissan-derived model, and now comes with three Nissan-sourced engines. The base model comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and comes standard with a CVT automatic, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lights, manual a/c, keyless entry, power windows, alarm, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth phone, Renault key card, cruise control with speed limiter, grey fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. The base model can be optioned up with a package that includes a tyre pressure monitoring system, dual front-side thorax and curtain airbags, auto headlights, auto windscreen wipers, electrically adjustable and folding door mirrors, dual-zone climate control, leather steering wheel, air quality ioniser, fragrance diffuser, dark carbon fabric seat trim, 17-inch alloys and a rear spoiler. The mid-range model comes with a 2.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, and additionally features stability control with traction control. The top model comes with a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, and additionally comes with an athermic windshield, electric mirrors with memory function, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, tri-zone climate control, deadlocking with an anti-intruder device, electric rear windows with anti-pinch, Bose CD/MP3 stereo with 10 speakers, Bluetooth phone, Renault keyless smart card, panoramic sunroof, floor mats, cream leather seats, power front seats with massage, integrated rear sunblind, as well as front and rear parking sensors. Items such as HID headlights, dark leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels and an electronic parking brake are optional in some markets.

The Chevrolet Trax is the American brand's compact SUV offering. For the 2017 model year, it got a facelift, some interior updates and upgraded safety features. The 2019 Chevrolet Trax comes with a 4-cylinder 1.8-litre engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The South Korean-made Trax comes in two trims - LT and LTZ. The base-model LT comes in only front-wheel drive, while the LTZ gets all-wheel drive. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, electric windows, fabric seats, manual A/C, radio with CD/MP3/AUX support and alloy wheels. The infotainment system gets a 7-inch touch screen, which also supports Apple and Android phones. Optional features include bigger alloy wheels, better sound system and chrome door handles. Safety-wise, the 2019 Chevrolet Trax gets traction control, stability control and 4-wheel ABS with panic brake assist.

The redesigned Boxster roadster was introduced in 2005, and it spawned the fixed-top Cayman for the 2006 model year. Considered the entry-level Porsche offering, the cars are powered by a 2.7-litre version of the traditional Porsche flat-six engine in their base trim, while the higher-performance S versions are powered by a 3.4-litre version of the sixer. The model is considered a benchmark for sports-car handling, with rear-wheel-drive and a choice of either a manual or a manually-shiftable automatic. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels, among other luxury options. The Cayman offers head airbags in combination with thorax airbags, concealed on the outer side of the backrest, alongside the usual front airbags. Luggage is space is very limited, with two trunks, one in the front and one behind the mid-mounted engine in the back.

Maxus G10 is a the Chinese brand's MPV offering. Under the hood, there are two engines. The cargo vans get a naturally aspirated 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox, while the people carrier gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the G10 people carrier include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric mirrrors, keyless entry, manual dual-zone A/C, radio with MP3/AUX support and 6 speakers, halogen headlights, front & rear foglights, sliding doors, lift tailgate and 16-inch wheels. The higher models gets LED headlamps, LED taillamps, dual-sliding doors, rear panorama sunroof, leather seats,  7-inch touch screen with DVD system, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control and traction control.

The X-Trail is Nissan's entry for the small road-going 4WD market, though for a long time we thought it was really a midsize comparable to the old Pathfinder in size. Developed to attract young adventurous buyers, we find the X-Trail particularly unattractive, but it has proved to be a runaway success with older people just looking for a conservative vehicle that looks like a 4WD. The X-Trail has undergone only slight exterior redesigns and interior upgrades ever since it was launched years ago and is beginning to look dated. Powered by a 2.5-litre four-cylinder engine coupled with a 4-speed automatic or a 5-speed manual transmission, it isn't particularly fast, but a reasonable long-distance cruiser. Full-time four-wheel drive is available when the computer system senses the need for all wheels to be driven to suit demand, but it will get stuck if you take it beyond the beach. The interior is full of storage spaces, including cup-holders, centre console box and other nooks and crannies. ABS brakes and 2 airbags are standard.

The CMC Z7, new in the GCC, is actually an iteration of a Taiwanese model called the Mitsubishi Zinger, and sharing a chassis with the Mitsubishi Nativa. The Z7 people-carrier is powered by a Mitsubishi-sourced 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Features include four forward-opening doors with a rear tailgate, eight seats, cloth upholstery, parking sensors, keyless entry, power windows, power locks, power steering, rear spoiler and 18-inch alloy wheels. Higher trim levels get climate control, HID headlights and leather upholstery. Safety features include ABS and one standard airbag, with a second one optional. Local dealers are offering long warranties.

The Hyundai Grand Santa Fe is basically a larger version of the regular Santa Fe, with a bigger boot. In 2017, it got a facelift with restyled headlights and taillights, along with some minor interior upgrades. Powered by a standard 3.3-litre V6, it comes with a 6-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive on the base model or all-wheel-drive in the rest of the trim levels. In 2019, the Grand Santa Fe  started getting the GDI 3.3-litre V6 engine, bumping up power and slightly improving fuel efficiency. The Grand Santa Fe crossover comes well-equipped in even base trim, including three-row seating, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, rear spoiler, power mirrors with indicators, rear parking sensors, cruise control, keyless entry, adjustable power steering and 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB/AUX ports. The higher-level versions add all-wheel-drive, 19-inch alloys and, depending on trim, chrome door handles, auto a/c, auto headlights with optional HIDs, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power-adjustable memory front seats, power tailgate, electric parking brake, 4.3-inch multimedia screen, navigation, smart keyless start, compass and rain sensor. All six trim levels get ABS, while 2 airbags are standard on all but the highest two trim levels, which get 6 airbags; and the top two trim levels get stability control.

An all-new Chevrolet Silverado was released as a 2014 model year. Exterior-wise, the styling carries pretty much the same DNA as the previous model but the new front fascia seems more imposing now. That is because they have added bigger headlights and a huge grille. GM consciously kept the design similar as, unlike the UAE where big pickup trucks are more of a statement, in the U.S. market it is a high volume seller among conservative buyers. A Z71 package is available which includes stronger shocks, front tow hooks and extra under-body protection. The interior is where the main changes will be, with the new 4.2-inch display on the dashboard. More soft-touch material has been added around the cockpit. The new Silverado pickups will have 12-volt outlets, five USB ports and a SD-card slot. A new 4.3-litre V6 engine adds to the family of 5.3-litre and 6.2-litre V8 motors. They will all be mated to a six-speed automatic. For improving fuel economy, the V8 engines have cylinder deactivation and direct injection.

The new-for-2011 Safrane is the second iteration of Renault's Korean-built midsize sedan offering in the GCC. It has been completely redesigned compared to the previous Nissan-derived model, and now comes with three Nissan-sourced engines. The base model comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine and comes standard with a CVT automatic, dual front airbags, ABS, fog lights, manual a/c, keyless entry, power windows, alarm, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, Bluetooth phone, Renault key card, cruise control with speed limiter, grey fabric seats and 16-inch steel wheels. The base model can be optioned up with a package that includes a tyre pressure monitoring system, dual front-side thorax and curtain airbags, auto headlights, auto windscreen wipers, electrically adjustable and folding door mirrors, dual-zone climate control, leather steering wheel, air quality ioniser, fragrance diffuser, dark carbon fabric seat trim, 17-inch alloys and a rear spoiler. The mid-range model comes with a 2.5-litre V6 mated to a 6-speed automatic, and additionally features stability control with traction control. The top model comes with a 3.5-litre V6 with a 6-speed automatic, and additionally comes with an athermic windshield, electric mirrors with memory function, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, tri-zone climate control, deadlocking with an anti-intruder device, electric rear windows with anti-pinch, Bose CD/MP3 stereo with 10 speakers, Bluetooth phone, Renault keyless smart card, panoramic sunroof, floor mats, cream leather seats, power front seats with massage, integrated rear sunblind, as well as front and rear parking sensors. Items such as HID headlights, dark leather upholstery, 18-inch alloy wheels and an electronic parking brake are optional in some markets.

In 2021, the all-new Genesis G80 made its debut in the GCC. The Genesis can be had with a choice of either a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged engine, or a 3.5-litre turbocharged V6 motor. Both engines are mated to a Hyundai-designed 8-speed automatic transmission. Rear-wheel-drive is standard in both models.

The Octavia is based on the Volkswagen Golf platform, and has received a facelift for 2009. The range of engines and options has seemingly been paired down for the GCC, considering its low sales volumes. The base engine on offer is the outdated 1.6-litre 4-cylinder with a 6-speed auto, while a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder with a 7-speed automanual was offered in some GCC countries. By late 2010, only the base engine and a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder were offered. The Octavia is one of the more unique cars in its segment, with the look of a proper sedan, but with a lift-up rear hatch for loading luggage. It was initially available in most markets here in basic Classic and upmarket Ambiente trims. The Classic version offers steel wheels with hubcaps, manually operated rear windows, halogen headlights and black rubbing strips. Later, most local markets got only Ambiente, Ambiente Plus, Elegance and sporty RS trims. Available features, depending on trim, include power windows with anti-pinch feature, height adjustable steering wheel dual-tone fabric seats, remote central locking, dual-zone climate control a/c, cruise control, a multi-function display, a CD/MP3 stereo with AUX input, electric mirrors with integrated turn signals, Xenon headlights with washer system, 17-inch alloy wheels and colour-coded exterior trim. The RS gets the VW GTI engine, Bluetooth, 18-inch wheels, parking sensors, sunroof, rear spoiler and directional Xenon headlights. Among the available safety features are stability control, ABS, dual front and side airbags and optional rear park sensors.

The Volvo XC60 was launched with high hopes for the Swedish company, capitalising on the small crossover vehicle market. The XC60 is a new 5-seater crossover SUV that is aimed at attracting luxury-brand buyers. The XC60 T6 is powered by a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shifting capability, and an all-wheel-drive system without low-range gearing. For 2010, an XC60 T5 model was introduced, with a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder with a 6-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The smallest XC model includes new safety technology, debuting Volvo's new City Safety system, designed to help a driver avoid a collision at under 30 kph, or reduce the speed of impact at higher speeds by hitting the brakes if the vehicle in front suddenly stops and City Safety determines that a collision is likely. Another new safety featured being introduced on the XC60 is Pre-Prepared Restraints that uses a laser sensor that interacts with other technology to control the airbags and adaptive seatbelt load limiters. Other features, depending on trim level, include cloth or leather upholstery, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, reverse camera, keyless entry, sunroof, alloy wheels, common power accessories and a CD/MP3 stereo. An R-Design body kit is optional. Standard safety features include front and side-surtain airbags, stability control, ABS with EBD, and whiplash-protection headrests.

The redesigned-for-2008 Mondeo is an attractive midsize car built in Europe that shares a Mazda platform. It looks excellent inside and out, but loses out to the Japanese with a weak combination of carryover engines, along with the stigma of expensive dealer maintenance charges. It was facelifted a bit for 2011, with a new front bumper and grille. The Mondeo is largely avaliable as a family sedan, but it is also available in sporty liftback and practical wagon form in some markets. The Mondeo is a tremendous success in Europe though, simply because its handling is outstanding, rivalling more expensive cars like Alfa Romeo, all for an affordable price. The interior is especially attractive and put together well. The base Mondeo is powered by the 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available with a 5-speed manual. A 2.3-litre 4-cylinder engine is coupled with a 6-speed automatic transmission in the higher model. Various trim levels are available, all with power windows, trip computer, ABS brakes, front airbags, CD stereo with MP3 connector and more. Options include stability control, CD changer, keyless starter button, Xenon adaptive headlights, tyre pressure monitor, sunroof, fog lights, variable suspension settings, hill launch assist and adaptive cruise control.

The Toyota Land Cruiser 70 continues to stay alive in certain parts of the GCC simply because people keep buying them. There is a three-door short-wheelbase version and a 5-door version. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by a 4.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine mated to only five-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American luxury trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, power windows, fog lamps and central locking. There is an optional audio system with CD/MP3/AUX/USB support, but not much else. Safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability.

The Mini Roadster is just a soft-top version of the Mini Coupe, which itself is the latest edition for 2012 to the ever-expanding Mini line-up. Based on the standard Mini, the only real difference is in the upper half. While the regular Cabrio had tight back seats, the Roadster ditches the rear seats completely. Models include the Cooper, the turbocharged Cooper S, and the upgraded turbocharged John Cooper Works. The Cooper uses a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, with the S adding a turbocharger, and the JCW featuring an upgraded turbocharger. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic for all except the JCW, which only comes with a manual. Standard features include CD stereo, power windows and electric mirrors, along with a number of airbags, with options such as navigation, sports seats, panoramic glass roof and alloy-wheel choices. The John Cooper Works package bumps up the horsepower and handling. Further options on all Minis include bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

The Audi RS 4 is the sports version of the A4, developed by Audi AG's performance tuning division quattro GmbH. It comes with a high-revving naturally aspirated V8 engine under the hood, featuring FSI direct injection technology. It comes only with a 6-speed manual transmission. The RS 4 has a full-time all-wheel-drive system, of which 40 percent of the power is sent to the front wheels and 60 percent is sent to the rear. Audi's Dynamic Ride Control system has been added to aid body roll. It has a more sportier suspension and damper settings as compared to the regular A4, as well as sit 30 mm lower. Other features included in the electronic stability program are the electronic differential lock (EDL), traction control (ASR), electronic brake force distribution, and ABS. It also is possible to disable the stability program in two stages: in the first stage only the traction control function is disabled; in the second stage the program is completely deactivated, including the traction control. As a result, there is no control intervention in any driving situation. For the interior, Recaro seats are standard and is covered in full silk nappa leather. Leather, aluminum and carbon fiber are the predominant materials in the interior. The RS steering wheel is covered in perforated leather. Carbon fiber trim inside the car serves to accentuate the sporting qualities of the Audi RS 4, while milled aluminum door openers are echoed on the gear knob and the steering wheel. The gear knob, handbrake lever and steering wheel are covered in perforated leather. The standard color LCD driver information system incorporated into the typical RS design cockpit features an oil temperature gauge as well as a stopwatch with lap timer function. An additional boost to safety is provided by the electronic stability program, with its integrated dry braking function. When the road is wet, the system lightly applies the brake pads to the discs at regular intervals, unnoticed by the driver, to sweep water from them and so improve braking response. Front and side airbags are standard in all RS 4 models.

The 3-Series is the king of compact entry-level luxury sedans, while also available in coupe and convertible body styles. Also available is the Touring wagon model, but it is not exactly made available here since no one wants one. Now in its fifth generation, models currently available in the Middle East include the 320i with 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, the 325i with a 2.5-litre 6-cylinder, and the amazing 330i with a 3.0-litre 6-cylinder as well as the all-wheel-drive versions of some the models, namely the 325xi, the 330xi and the 330xd. A new engine was introduced into the series with the new coupe and later the sedan, dubbed the 335i with a 3.0-litre twin turbo 6-cylinder motor. The new V8-powered M3 debuted for 2008, also in coupe, sedan and convertible styles, with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer option is available, and it is a pain to use, since BMW chooses to use a little joystick in the centre console instead of a simple touch screen. All cars get multiple front and side airbags, stability control, alloy wheels, ABS brakes and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Jaguar F-Type SVR Coupe is the top performance model trim. Under the hood, it gets the supercharged 5.0-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Standard options include engine start/stop function, bi-xenon headlamps, power windows, LED daytime running lights, 10-speaker entertainment system, USB port, Bluetooth phone and streaming, several airbags, power tailgate, retractable rear wing spoiler, sports seats, dual-zone a/c, power-adjustable seats and steering, cruise control and more. Performance upgrades include a high-performance braking system, an electronic rear-differential, and a sport-tuned suspension with adaptive dampers.

The Chevrolet Impala is a large sedan designed to slot in just above the Malibu. The front-wheel drive Impala comes to the GCC with a 3.6-litre V6 engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. Along with the usual power steering, power windows and power mirrors, other features include 19-inch or 20-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights, LED daytime running lights, optional multimedia-navigation system with pop-up screen, Bluetooth and a six-speaker audio entertainment system with CD/MP3/AUX support. Safety features include 10 standard airbags, and options include adaptive cruise control, collision mitigation braking, forward collision alert, lane departure warning, side blind zone alert, rear cross traffic alert, rear camera and rear-park assist.

The third generation Mercedes-Benz SLK Roadster received a redesign for the 2012 model, with the front end looking more like their SLS model. The range starts with the SLK 200 and SLK 250, both with two 4-cylinder 1.8-litre turbocharged units. Then comes the SLK 350 with a 3.5-litre V6 and finally a high-powered SLK 55 AMG model fitted with a naturally aspirated 5.5-litre V8 engine. Only the SLK 200 gets the six-speed manual, while the rest of the models is mated to a seven-speed automatic. The traditional mechanically folding hardtop continues in the SLK, with this time having the option of combining it with a panoramic glass roof. Standard equipment include automatic engine start/stop function, driver and passenger front airbags, ABS, acceleration skid control(ASR), electronic stability control (ESP), cruise control and radio with AUX/USB support. Optional extras include steering wheel with shift paddles, parking sensors, LED daytime running lights, rain sensor, headlamp cleaning system, Harmon Kardon surround sound system, navigation, memory seats and AMG bodykits. The SLK 55 AMG has a cylinder deactivation system, which switches off four cylinders to achieve impressive fuel economy numbers.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

It is trying to be Chevrolet's volume seller in the Middle East, but we have trouble spotting an Optra on the streets even though the car has been on the market for some time now. On paper at least, this car seems to have what it takes to go head-on with the opposition. Positioned in the lower compact segment, the Optra offers good value for money, selling in 4-door sedan, 5-door hatchback and 5-door station wagon trims. Styled by Italians but barely showing it, the styling can best be described as interesting without being ambitious. The cabin is basic, but there are lots of storage spaces and space for five adults. Engine options include a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder unit. These are combined with a five-speed manual or four-speed auto transmission transmitting juice to the front wheels. While both engines have enough grunt for the segment, they fall short of leaders like the top Civic and Corolla models. Ride and handling are quite good, and bodes well for the Optra. All we ask for are better engines.

The CL-Class is a rare breed, always in the shadow of its S-Class sibling, on which is is based. Receiving a complete overhaul like the sedan, this coupe features numerous innovative safety technology, such as up-front sensors which make it possible to assess the impact severity at an early stage during a crash and activate the front passenger airbag in two stages depending on the severity of the accident. Other features include Active Body Control for better handling, Intelligent Light System using bi-xenon headlights with five different lighting functions to match weather conditions. Options include night-view assist with infrared headlamps, reversing camera, voice control for car radio, DVD changer and navigation as well as tyre pressure monitoring system. Models include the CL 500 with a 5.5-litre V8 and a CL 600 with a 5.5-litre twin-turbocharged V8, both with automatic transmissions. The standard automatic has the new DIRECT SELECT gearshift, which allows selection of the gear by nudging a lever on the steering column. Operating commands are transmitted electronically by wire.

Named after Ferrari coachbuilder Sergio Scaglietti, the all-aluminum 612 Scaglietti attempts to blend performance and comfort in the tradition of a true Ferrari berlinetta designed to accommodate four people. This Ferrari is a 12-cylinder model with both the space-frame chassis and body panels in aluminium. The overall layout, with the 5.7-litre engine mounted behind the front axle and the gearbox in line with the differential at the rear, ensures an ideally balanced weight distribution, as well as permitting a lower centre of gravity. The performance-orientated handling is enhanced by active damping and a new stability and traction control system, with components from General Motors subsidiaries no less. The 612 runs with a six-speed mechanical gearbox, in a choice of manual or F1-style paddle shifts. With a relatively long wheelbase, the 612 has been designed to offer ease of entry for rear-seat passengers to a luxurious cabin which will accommodate four adults in comfort, while the luggage trunk hold a five-piece Ferrari luggage set or two full sets of golf clubs. Features include a new radio-CD system, voice recognition system, MP3 player, Bluetooth and more.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

Citroen is such a low-volume player in the Middle East that most people here think the brand is not available here any more. The C2 is the replacement for the Saxo at the lower end of the Citroen range. Based on the same platform as the larger C3, the C2 is only available as a three-door model, while the C3 is the five-door version. The C2 has distinctive styling. It offers a lot of interior room in the front and a decent driving position, as well as rear seats which optionally fold, recline, slide and come out altogether. Its dashboard is shared with the C3 with trim of decent enough material. There are coloured plastic inserts on the door trim and gearknob to dress up the cabin. The driving position is good, with good visibility to the front and somewhat limited to the rear thanks to a small rear window. The C2 only with one engine in this region. The 1.6-litre four-cylinder isn't very powerful, but it is quite a revelation given the size of the car. It is mated to a 5-speed automatic SensoDrive transmission. It has four airbags as standard, but ABS brakes, with electronic brakeforce distribution and brake assist, are only an option.

The Foton Tunland is the Chinese manufacturer's midsize pickup offering. Two engines are on offer - a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine and a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor. Both engines are mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Standard features on the Tunland include power steering, power windows, remote locking, central locking, fabric seats, rear fog lamp, manual A/C, radio with AUX/USB support, 2 speakers and 15-inch steel wheels. It gets ABS but no airbags. There is a higher model with leather seats, 16-inch alloy rims, and driver and passenger side front airbags.

The BMW Z4 was completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, shifting focus and becoming a comfort-cruiser rather than the focused sports car that it was before. Along with all-new styling, the Z4 now sports a folding hard-top convertible roof that folds down in 20 seconds at the touch of a button. While still a two-seater, the Z4 now has more space for two passengers and their luggage, although not much cargo room is left with the roof down. Changes to the cabin now include more premium materials as well as an integrated iDrive multimedia computer. The Z4 comes with a choice between three inline-6 engines. The Z4 sDrive23i with a 2.5-litre, the Z4 sDrive30i with a 3.0-litre, and the Z4 sDrive35i with a turbocharged 3.0-litre, all available with a manual or automatic, with the exception of the turbo motor, which can be mated to a clutchless automanual gearbox. The Z4 comes with Dynamic Drive Control as standard, which allows NORMAL, SPORT and SPORT+ modes, each of which changes throttle response and gearbox characteristics. Other features include the iDrive system with a high-resolution display that integrates entertainment, navigation, Bluetooth phone and climate control functionality. All the usual luxury features are available, either standard or optional, such as cloth or leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, powered seats, keyless entry with starter button, alloy wheels, and HID headlights, among other options. On the safety front, the Z4 Roadster comes with stability control, ABS, front airbags, head and thorax airbags, reinforced A-pillars and roll bars behind the headrests.

The Lexus LX 570 got a makeover for the 2016 model year. Heavily based on the Toyota Land Cruiser, new model gets a new front-end, LED headlights, new alloy wheels, new LED tail-lamps and new interior colours. The Lexus is powered by a 5.7-litre V8 mated with an 8-speed automatic transmission. The full-time all-wheel drive features a 2-speed transfer case, Torsen centre differential and a crawl-control feature when in low range. The "overturn" assist feature can lock one inside rear tyre to help make slow turns tighter in offroad conditions. The LX has a vehicle "posture control" system with four-wheel active height control and adaptive variable suspension that reacts more quickly and allows for a greater range of adjustment than the system it replaces. The leather interior can be had in tan, beige or black. The plush interior is covered in leather and wood, with seating for at least seven, and features such as ventilated front seats, power-folding third-row seating, sunroof, navigation, Mark Levinson CD/DVD stereo, front-rear-side-view cameras and all the usual power accessories. Active safety features include stability control, ABS brakes, and traction control, as well as multiple airbags, with available tech such as the Pre-Crash Safety System that can detect and prepare for a crash, Lane Departure Alert, Automatic High Beam System, Dynamic Radar Cruise Control with auto  braking, and Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert.

The all-new C-Class Coupe made its debut in 2016. The exterior and interior has been completely revamped.
