There are three variants on offer which is the C 180 which gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged motor, the C 200 and the C 250, both of which get a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine but with different tunes. Power is delivered via a 7-speed automatic transmission. Three different suspension setups are offered, including a first-in-class air suspension option. Inside, most dashboard buttons have been replaced by a screen which can be accessed via a rotary controller or an optional touchpad. Standard safety features include multiple airbags, stability control and traction control. Various optional safety systems include Active Parking Assist, Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus and Traffic Sign Assist with Wrong-Way Alert.

The Toyota RAV4 got a complete redesign for 2013, with a new styling language, a new drivetrain, and new features. In 2016, it got a facelift. The existing platform has been updated with new suspension tuning, while the standard engine now is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a 6-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. There is also a choice of front-wheel-drive with limited-slip diff or all-wheel-drive with 50:50 lock mode. New items in this 5-seater crossover include a lift-up tailgate with the spare wheel now stored under the boot floor. In the UAE, there was a reshuffle of trims for 2016, with the 2WD available in EX  and VX grade, while the AWD is sold in GXR and VXR grades. Standard features include power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, fold-flat split rear seating and more. The base model gets cloth upholstery, manual a/c, basic keyless entry and 17-inch alloy wheels. Additional available features, depending on trim level, include smart keyless entry and start, LED headlights and running lamps, LED tail lamps, auto-dimming mirror, roof rails, cargo net, rear parking sensors, fog lamps, cruise control and dual-zone auto a/c. Also offered on higher-spec models are touchscreen navigation, DVD player, rear camera, power driver's seat, sunroof, leather upholstery and 18-inch alloy wheels. All RAV4 models get two front airbags as well as ABS with EBD, while higher-spec models get additional side and curtain airbags, stability control, brake assist, downhill assist, and hill-start assist.

The all-new Jaguar XK is the long-awaited successor to Jaguar's sports car franchise, and though its new face is decidedly controversial, it is still a very desirable car. The new-for-2007 XK comes as both a coupe and a convertible. Riding on a much longer wheelbase, the new aluminium-built XK offers substantially more interior space than the old model. The XK 4.2 model is powered by the corporate 4.2-litre V8, while the XKR gets a supercharged version of that engine. Both engines are mated to a six-speed manual gearbox with paddle shifters. Its rigid chassis and the latest CATS adaptive suspension aim for a smooth ride and sporty cornering. Standard equipment includes DVD navigation, keyless entry and keyless start, a seven-inch video display, Bluetooth capability, cruise control, a 6-CD/MP3 player, rear park assist, cruise control, and electronic parking brake. Options include adaptive cruise control with a forward-alert system that sounds an audible warning, full soft leather upholstery, and a 520-watt Alpine sound system with eight speakers. Safety feature include front and side airbags, ABS with EBD, traction control, dynamic stability control with a track feature, and electronic rollover mitigation.

An all-new model of the Kia Cerato came out as a 2019 model year. Two 4-cylinder engines are offered here -- a 1.6-litre and 2.0-litre, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Available options include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, Intelligent Key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors. Safety features include ABS brakes, brake assist, stability control, and two front airbags.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. For 2011, the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive, got a massive power upgrade. For 2012, it was upgraded again by 20 hp, along with better fuel economy. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Structural stiffness, suspension and aerodynamics had all been upgraded for 2011. The shocks were upgraded again for 2012. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Prices had gone up by 20% compared to the pre-facelift version, but then came down again for 2012, even while is was upgraded. A 'VVIP' edition debuted in 2011 that costs twice as much while offering a customisable leather interior and gold-plated exterior trimmings. A Black edition debuted in 2012 that added some red cabin trim and Recaro seats.

The Nissan GT-R is a class-leading sports car built on Nissan's Premium Midship platform, and utilising carbon-fibre, aluminium and steel components. For 2011, the 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6 "VR38" engine, mated with a dual-clutch automanual and all-wheel-drive, got a massive power upgrade. For 2012, it was upgraded again by 20 hp, along with better fuel economy. A special Bilstein DampTronic system uses all pertinent vehicle information to provide appropriate damping forces for all situations and helps maintain a high level of control for straight-line driving, cornering, and braking. Structural stiffness, suspension and aerodynamics had all been upgraded for 2011. The shocks were upgraded again for 2012. Other standard features include HID headlights, LED front markers, LED tails, Brembo brakes, front and side airbags, run-flat tyres, launch control, and a CD stereo with Bluetooth and hard drive. The driver can adjust transmission shifts, shock absorbers and the Vehicle Dynamic Control (VDC-R) system with three button-operated settings for Normal, Comfort or Racing. Also interesting is a computer system that shows a variety of useful and useless information, such as cornering g-forces and acceleration percentage, alongside various temperature readings. Nissan admits the car being high-maintenance, and says the highly-tuned car cannot support additional mods. Each hand-built engine can vary  in output compared to the official specs. Prices had gone up by 20% compared to the pre-facelift version, but then came down again for 2012, even while is was upgraded. A 'VVIP' edition debuted in 2011 that costs twice as much while offering a customisable leather interior and gold-plated exterior trimmings. A Black edition debuted in 2012 that added some red cabin trim and Recaro seats.

The Hyundai Accent is all-new for 2012, being longer, wider and lower than the outgoing model. It now features Hyundai's swoopy new corporate styling and superb build quality. The spacious sub-compact 4-door sedan comes with a choice of 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engines, both with 5-speed manual and 4-speed automatic geabox options. The basic front-wheel-drive Accent comes with 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, cloth upholstery, six cup-holders, power windows and mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power steering, four-wheel-disc brakes, and a single airbag. Features on higher models include 14-inch or 16-inch alloy wheels, leather steering wheel with stereo controls, fog lamps, centre-console storage cubby, rear parking sensors with camera, auto-dimming mirror, split-folding rear seat, Bluetooth and sunroof. Safety features, all optional, includes stability control, ABS and a full set of front and side airbags, though it depends on the local dealer if they want to offer these options.

The Cerato is Kia's entry in the popular compact field. Updated for 2007, the front-wheel-drive Cerato can be had as a four-door sedan only. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder or optionally a 2.0-litre four-cylinder, both with either a manual or an automatic, this barebones commuter car has basic standard features like 15-inch steel wheels, radio cassette player with power antenna and 6 speakers, manual cloth seats, halogen headlamps, air-conditioning, front cup holders, intermittent wipers and not much else. Available features include front and rear power windows, central door locking, full wheel covers, impact sensor auto door unlocking, body colour trim, battery saver, and a rear spoiler. We are not quite sure what safety features are available, other than the usual door beams and seat belts. It seems ABS brakes and front airbags might be optional in some markets, standard in others, and not available at all in some places.

The Volvo V40 is the Swedish company's 5-door hatchback offering, facelifted for 2017 with new headlights and other minor trim changes. The V40 T5 is fitted with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder for the Middle East. It is connected to a 8-speed automatic. In 2019, the V40 T3 was offered which gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged unit mated to a 6-speed automatic. Variants beyond the regular V40 include the V40 R-Design model with a sporty body kit and unique wheels and a Polestar version with more power. All versions are front-wheel-drive. Features include fuel-saving auto start-stop tech, power windows, electric mirrors, CD/MP3 stereo, cloth or leather upholstery, 17-inch or 18-inch alloy wheels and other basics, with options such as HID headlights, sunroof, navigation and all that. Safety standards are always high in Volvos, and the V40 is no exception. Safety features, aside from the standard front and side-curtain airbags, include a world-first pedestrian airbag, blind spot monitoring, lane-keeping aid with haptic auto steering, pedestrian detection with auto braking, and a Park Assist Pilot system that makes parallel parking easy.

The BMW X5 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X5 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Porsche 911 Cabriolet is all-new after spending more than a decade in its current form, with continuous updates of course. For 2012, the design incorporates a completely new platform, so now the 911 is longer and lower than before. It is still a 2+2 seater convertible. The base 911 Carrera is offered with a 3.4-litre direct-injection flat-6 engine, mated to either a world-first 7-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" dual-clutch automatic and rear-wheel-drive. The 911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet, which was introduced in 2013, adds all-wheel-drive. The rear-wheel-drive 911 Carrera S Cabriolet upgrades the motor to a 3.8-litre, while the, new for 2013, 911 Carrera 4S Cabriolet adds all-wheel-drive. The 911 Turbo Cabriolet and Turbo S Cabriolet was released in 2014. It gets a 3.8-litre turbocharged engine, and comes only with the PDK transmission. The 911 GTS was revealed in the GCC in late 2014 and is available as rear-wheel drive or all-wheel drive. It is powered by a 3.8-litre motor, coupled with either a 7-speed manual or PDK transmission. As usual, everything is optional beyond the basic power accessories, touchscreen multimedia system, Bluetooth, basic keyless entry, HID headlights, electric parking brake and 19-inch wheels. Available options include different colours and materials for every interior surface, different 20-inch wheel designs, metallic paint choices, power-adjustable or sports seats, Bose or Burmester audio systems with optional voice control and TV tuner, CD changer, parking sensors, smart keyless entry and start, adaptive headlights, electric folding mirrors, rear wiper, body kit and more. Standard safety features include front and side airbags, stability control and ABS.

Soon after the launch of the all-new nearly-midsize Japanese-built Mazda 6, GCC dealers chose to launch the new American-built Mazda 6 as well. The American 6 is a good bit larger than the Japanese 6, with a longer wheelbase offering more legroom and cargo space. Dubbed the Mazda 6 Ultra, the larger car is offered in two versions, namely the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder with a 5-speed automatic and the 3.7-litre V6 engine with a 6-speed automatic. The Ultra only comes in the sedan body-style. Available features include intelligent keyless entry with starter button, rain-sensing wipers, sunroof, power accessories, alloy wheels, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, Bose stereo with six-disc CD changer and ten speakers, manual-shifting functionality with all automatics, Xenon headlights, fog lamps, and automatic a/c with rear vents. Available safety features include dual front airbags, side airbags, ABS and stability control. Specifically for the GCC version, there are special chrome side-mirror housings, chrome on the upper grille, and a gold-plated ULTRA badge at the rear. With this larger model, Mazda can finally compete with the oversized Japanese midsize sedans that dominate the current market.

The British Morris Garages brand, a spin-off of Rover, is back in a new guise under Chinese ownership. The new-for-2011 MG 550 1.8T compact sedan is designed by MG's British team and comes with a newly-developed 1.8-litre light-pressure turbo 4-cylinder engine and a 5-speed automatic, on a front-wheel-drive platform vaguely derived from the old Rover 75, with independent suspension and disc brakes on all four wheels. The base model gets 16-inch alloys wheels, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, stability control, two front airbags, ABS with EBD, fabric seats, one-press engine start with the key still requiring insertion, steering-mounted radio controls, power windows and mirrors, automatic climate control a/c, faux wood trim, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, keyless entry, illuminated sunshade mirrors, digital gauges and fog lights. The top "Deluxe" model gets 17-inch alloys, side-curtain airbags, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, tinted windows, electric driver's seat, parking sensors, sunroof and a basic GPS system. There are many more options available, such as Bluetooth, rear camera and cooler box, but the dealer will not offer those for now.

The sixth-generation Nissan Z shrinks in overall size and gains in engine size to become a more focussed sports car. The all-new 370Z includes a 3.7-litre V6 engine with VVEL variable-valve timing, lightweight 4-wheel independent suspension with extensive use of aluminum components, 19-inch staggered lightweight alloy wheels, and a choice of a 6-speed manual with the innovative SynchroRev Match system or a 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters. Features include power windows and mirrors, 'intelligent' keyless entry and starter button, 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with two subwoofers, Bluetooth, optional navigation touchscreen system, various dashboard-top gauges and available leather upholstery in various colours. Optional NISMO factory accessories include an exhaust system, body kit, rear spoiler, suspension sway bars, S-tune shocks and springs, and NISMO alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, ABS and stability control.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. The Audi A5 sportback is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 8-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Spark is a typical urban runabout based wholly on the Korean Daewoo Matiz, and is built in Korea too. It is a best seller in the supermini market, which is a market with few buyers in this region. The Spark is a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering just enough interior space for four inside a compact body. Its big windows and tight turning circle make it easy to park and cut through traffic, if you have the guts to cut in front of big 4WDs. The design tries to be cute, but unlike the Mini or the Beetle, this thing still looks like half a car. Inside, centre-mounted instruments greet you, as does cheap plastics. Depending on which of the upholstery fabrics and body colours is chosen, the displays have a blue, green or orange background. All interior mouldings and seating fabrics are robust but still cheap. It is powered by either a 0.8-litre three-cylinder or a 1.0-litre four-cylinder unit, and comes with a standard five-speed manual gearbox which features an all-new gearchange mechanism with damping for improved shift quality. A four-speed auto is optional. GM claims increased percentage of 'super steel' in the structure, but we'd still feel uncomfortable travelling in one of these.

The Lamborghini Huracan, named after yet another Spanish fighting bull, officially replaced the Gallardo. With styling inspired from the Aventador, the Huracan LP610-4 is powered by a 5.2-litre direct-injected V10, with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and all-wheel-drive. The Huracan LP580-2 which came out in 2016, is also powered by the same engine, but slightly detuned and has rear-wheel drive. For 2018, the Huracan Performante was released with higher performance numbers. It features three driving modes as well as a stop-start system, while fuel consumption is now much lower than the Gallardo. Safety standards are high, as it should be, with driver and passenger airbags, ABS, traction control and stability control.

An all-new BMW M5 came out in 2018. It gets the same 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, upgraded to produce more power. It is mated to a 8-speed automatic transmission. Also new in this generation is it comes in all-wheel drive. In 2021, an M5 Competition was introduced with more power and better handling characteristics, at the expense of some comfort. When the engine is first started, the new BMW M5 will be in all-wheel-drive mode with Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) switched on. The driver is then able to vary the handling characteristics of the M5 by activating various driving dynamics modes, including a rear-wheel-drive mode with no DSC. Some of the wide range of driving and comfort features offered in the BMW M5 include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. The BMW M5 comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The A8 is the most imposing of the Audi range. Most noticeable is the big single-frame grille on all models. Engines available in front-wheel-drive form include the 2.8-litre V6 and the 3.2-litre V6 in this region, while all-wheel-drive Quattro offerings include the 4.2-litre V8, although some dealers do offer the 6.0-litre V12 too. All these models are sold here only in long wheelbase form, but there is also a sweet short-wheelbase S8 model, again only from some dealers, that is powered by a Lamborghini-sourced 5.2-litre V10. Basic features on A8 models include a parking system with graphic display, adaptive front lighting, new 18-inch wheel designs, optional 19-inch performance tyres with the Sport Package, a revamped Driver Information Centre; a glove box lock and a leather interior. The 4.2-litre, 6.0-litre and 5.2-litre models all use Audi's Quattro all-wheel-drive. The A8 uses an all-aluminium frame with a fully pneumatic suspension system. Its aluminium four-link front axle and trapezoidal-link rear axle suspension has air spring struts at each wheel, with sensors that continually monitor and adjust the damping, and automatically level the car. The 3.2-litre uses a CVT automatic transmission, while the rest of the models use a six-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission with manual mode and available wheel-mounted paddles. Audi's Multi Media Interface control system can be used to monitor or control such things as the radio, phone, climate control, stereo or lighting profiles of the LED illumination in the door trim and foot wells. The Quattro models are at least a step in the right direction in combating its German brethren.

The Corsa is the smallest car among Opel models offered in the Middle East. Its extensive safety package and rigid galvanized body have been tested to excel in passenger protection. Body styles available in the Middle East are three-door and five-door hatchbacks, as well as a 4-door sedan. Opel went the extra step and added colour-keyed bumpers and high-level safety features, which is rare in this class of cars. Two engine options are available here, namely a 1.4-litre unit and a 1.8-litre unit, both four-cylinder. Both powerplants power the front wheels using the available standard manual transmission, but the smaller motor has an optional automatic five-speed transmission with manual shifting mode. All cars can seat five. A fold-down rear backrest can be fixed at two different angles and a rear bench can be fully folded down. Available features include power windows, cloth upholstery and CD stereo. All Corsa variants are also equipped with ABS brakes, featuring brake assist and electronic brakeforce distribution. Stability control is optional.

The Hyundai Sante Fe comes to the UAE and GCC as a seven-seater version. It remains the same for the 2017 model year. While it competes with compact crossover SUVs, it is only slightly smaller than most midsize SUVs. It comes with a choice 2 engines - the 'Theta' 4-cylinder 2.4-litre and the 'Lambda' V6 3.3-litre. Two-wheel drive is standard in the 2.4-litre base model, while all the other trims are in four-wheel drive in the higher 2.4-litre and 3.3-litre models. Some of the optional features include panoramic sunroof, 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, reverse camera, leather seats, memory seats with cooling & heating for front passengers, memory package for mirrors with auto folding, smart key with engine start, automatic lights and rain sensing wipers. Safety features include ABS, electronic brake distribution(EBD) and traction control.

The BMW X6 received a minor facelift for the 2013 model. The X6 comes in two models, namely the XDrive35i and the XDrive50i, both being powerful high-end models. It is powered by either a 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 or a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8, both mated to 6-speed manually-shiftable automatics. The X6 gets an all-wheel drive system without low-range gearing. The X6 offers seating for only four in its chop-top cabin. A whole host of features include standard bi-xenon headlights, BMW's controversial iDrive computer, 19-inch alloy wheels, run-flat tyres, tyre-pressure monitor, 10-way power front seats, and new leather colour schemes. Other available features include active steering, automatic tailgate, adaptive headlights, rear-mounted DVD system, reverse-view camera, satellite-navigation, four-zone air-conditioning, and bigger rims. Standard safety features include front, side and side head airbags, and crash-activated front-seat headrests, as well as stability control, ABS and a driving aid called Dynamic Performance Control.

An all-new model of the Mitsubishi Outlander came out in 2021. There are two engines to choose from, the standard motor is a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT and the other unit is a 3.0-litre V6, connected to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come in all-wheel drive format. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, fabric seats, dual-zone A/C, audio entertainment system with Apply CarPlay/Android Auto, 6 speakers, central locking and 16-inch steel wheels. Optional features include leather seats, sunroof, centre console multi-information display screen with rear-view camera, full automatic A/C, 18-inch alloy rims and HID headlamps. Safety features include ABS brakes, electronic brake distribution (EBD), front driver and passenger side airbags.

The Ferrari Portofino is the entry-level model for the Italian supercar maker. It replaces the Ferrari California T.  Under the hood is a 3.9-litre turbocharged V8 motor, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the car include power windows, keyless entry, power mirrors, central locking, engine push start, leather seats, leather dashboard with stitching, automatic AC, navigation system, xenon headlamps and 20-inch alloy wheels. Options are endless from different leather, Alcantara and carbon-fibre options for the interior, carbon-fibre accessories for the exterior, better stereo system, sports seats, and different wheel options. Safety features include airbags, stability control, traction control, ABS brakes and brake assist.

The Suzuki Baleno is the brand's sub-compact hatchback offering. The Indian-made Baleno comes with a 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic. Two trims are available - the GL and GLX. On the inside, the top-spec Baleno GLX, features a 6.2-inch infotainment system. Other standard features in the GLX include cruise control, automatic A/C and rear park distance control. Safetywise, the GLX gains 4 additional airbags over the GL model, with a total of 6 airbags. The GLX also gains rear disc brakes, while the GL derivative has rear drum brakes. Standard fare across the range are USB and Aux ports.

An all-new Volkswagen Touareg came out in 2019. It is slightly wider and longer than the previous model. It is also lighter because of its mixed material construction of aluminium (48 per cent) and high-tech steels (52 per cent). The new dimensions help it achieve more cargo room at the back. The UAE and GCC market gets two engine options - a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor and a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 unit. Notable features include the Digital Cockpit with a 12-inch display and the infotainment system with a 15-inch display. It gets a lot of new safety features as well. Along with the multitude of airbags, blind spot detection, traction control and stability control, it gets technologies such as the 'Night Vision' assistance system (detects people and animals in darkness via a thermal imaging camera), Roadwork Lane Assist (semi-automated steering and lane keeping, accelerating and braking up to 60 km/h), Front Cross Traffic Assist (reacts to cross traffic in front), and 'IQ.Light - LED matrix headlights' (interactive, camera-based dipped and main beam headlight control).

The BLS offers all the looks of a Cadillac CTS, with all the driving dynamics of a Saab 9-3, on which is is based. Built on GM's corporate front-wheel-drive platform, the BLS is an entry-level model with three turbo engines taken straight from Saab. There are two 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engines that can be mated to  a five-speed automatic transmission. The top engine is a 2.8-litre V6 turbo. Built in Europe to somehow compete with German sports sedans, the usual power features are all there, as are six airbags and stability control features. The base model is fitted with 16-inch alloy wheels, climate control, cruise control, electric windows and door mirrors, a seven speaker CD system with MP3 inlet, and wheel-mounted controls for the cruise controls and stereo. Additional features include 17-inch or 18-inch alloys, fog lights and rain sensing wipers, leather trim, dual zone climate control, electric adjustment for driver and front passenger seats, a Bose stereo system with nine speakers and a six-CD changer, auto dimming rearview mirrors inside and out and rear parking sensors.

The fifth generation Honda Odyssey came out in 2018, featuring a new design and improvements in technology and safety. The Odyssey is still the same size, but improvements have been made to the structure to improve efficiency and safety. In 2021, it received a facelift and updated interior and safety features. Under the hood, the 3.5-litre V6 engine is carried over, connected to a new 10-speed automatic transmission, for better performance and fuel efficiency. Standard features on the 2021 Honda Odyssey include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric sliding doors, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED tail lights, 8-inch touchscreen display audio, Apple CarPlay, USB, AUX, Bluetooth, 6 speakers and subwoofer, cruise control, push start button, and 18-inch alloy wheels. Higher models get 10.2-inch screen rear entertainment system, navigation, 11 speakers, leather seats, wireless phone charging, automatic AC,  and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control, hill-start assist, electronic brake distribution and tyre pressure monitoring system. Higher trims get additional blind spot monitor and Honda Sensing.

It is trying to be Chevrolet's volume seller in the Middle East, but we have trouble spotting an Optra on the streets even though the car has been on the market for some time now. On paper at least, this car seems to have what it takes to go head-on with the opposition. Positioned in the lower compact segment, the Optra offers good value for money, selling in 4-door sedan, 5-door hatchback and 5-door station wagon trims. Styled by Italians but barely showing it, the styling can best be described as interesting without being ambitious. The cabin is basic, but there are lots of storage spaces and space for five adults. Engine options include a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder unit. These are combined with a five-speed manual or four-speed auto transmission transmitting juice to the front wheels. While both engines have enough grunt for the segment, they fall short of leaders like the top Civic and Corolla models. Ride and handling are quite good, and bodes well for the Optra. All we ask for are better engines.

The Swift offers eye-catching looks, quality and good driving dynamics all in an affordable sub-compact package. Built and sold in many countries, this "world car" is a break from previously dull Suzuki iterations and adopts a muscular body with bold sides, spread-out wheels, and a broad-shouldered beltline that continues all the way to the tail lights, while the roof's rear edge is shaped as a spoiler to improve aerodynamics. The Swift has one of the widest bodies in its class, and together with a long wheelbase, permits a spacious enough cabin. The functional interior uses aluminium-look trim highlights, tight fit and finish, and high-grade hard plastics. The little Suzuki is powered by a 1.5-litre four-cylinder powerplant, while power is sent to the front-wheels using either the standard five-speed manual transmission or a four-speed automatic with a gated shift lever option. Standard features include power windows, CD/MP3 player, power steering and more, positioning the Swift as a semi-upscale runabout in the GCC. An expensive body kit is optional. All models have standard driver and passenger front and side airbags, as well as available full-length curtain airbags.

The budget APV multi-purpose people carrier has a name that stands for All-Purpose Vehicle and offers up to eight seats or a panel-van body. That makes the APV one of the few passenger vehicles sold here that have more than seven seats. Built on a ladder frame chassis, the APV is supposed to be tough and affordable. It is designed in Japan and assembled in Indonesia. Although production costs were kept low, Suzuki engineers tried not to cut corners when it came to safety. The APV has Suzuki's proprietary TECT body, which is a structural design that's supposed to redirect collision energy away from occupants. The doors are reinforced with side impact beams and there are two front airbags that come as standard. Externally, the APV looks clean and distinctive in an oddball kind of way. It's dimensions translate into a roomy interior, but having eight adults in the APV is possible for average-sized people who just manage to fit. Luggage space is limited with the third-row seats up, but can be expanded by folding the rear seats forward, which then liberates enough space to allow you to transport something as big as a washing machine. Available features include rear air-conditioning, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking with remote control, 15-inch alloy wheels and a 1.6-litre engine with either a manual or an automatic.

After a decade, Toyota launched a redesigned Land Cruiser for the 2008 model year. The Land Cruiser comes with the choice of a carryover 4.0-litre V6 with either a 5-speed manual or a 5-speed auto, a carryover 4.7-litre V8 with a 5-speed auto, a rare 4.5-litre turbodiesel V8 with the 6-speed automatic version getting more power than the 5-speed manual version, and the new 5.7-litre version with a 6-speed automatic, launched in the GCC as part of a 2011 special-edition 60th anniversary model line that can optionally be had with the smaller V8 and V6 engines too, depending on market. The Land Cruiser can transport as many as eight or nine passengers with its variable seating configurations. Features include power windows and mirrors, cruise control, sunroof, 17-inch alloy or steel wheels, smart key, start/stop button, optional parking sensors, multi-information display, optional cooler box, three rows of seats, optional four-zone climate control, optional leather, ABS brakes, standard CD/MP3 stereo with CD changer, and Bluetooth among other items. A limited-edition Land Cruiser "Xtreme" model, modified locally with fender flares, 17-inch wheels with beefy tyres and lifted suspension, became available for 2010, with any of the engine choices. Depending on market, the 2011 60th Anniversary special-edition features coloured roof rails, colour-matched rear mud guards, LED bumper lights and an optional bespoke spare tyre cover.

Korean carmaker Hyundai have added the 2013 i30 hatchback to their range of cars available in the Middle East. Banking on the i30's success in Europe and the favoritism it has won in many car awards, Hyundai hopes to mimic the same success in the GCC. The i30 was designed and engineered at the Hyundai Motor Europe Technical Centre in Germany. Essentially an Elantra hatchback, the new model resonates Hyundai's 'fluidic sculpture' design ethos as seen in other cars in the family. It features Hyundai's signature frontal feature - the hexagonal-shaped grille and LED daytime running lights making it tastefully distinctive compared other cars in it's class. Customers are offered a choice of two petrol engines - 1.6-litre unit or a 1.8-litre motor. All engines can be had with a six-speed automatic transmission. The i30 comes to the Middle East in two models, the GL and GLS. Both models get power windows, front fog lamps, steering wheel audio controls and a roof rack. Sadly, GCC-spec cars are underequipped, especially in terms safety, as there is only one standard airbag and no ABS brakes.

When the new Nissan Patrol was launched in 2010, the carmaker elected to keep producing the older-generation Patrol Safari alongside the new one. The long-running Safari continues to be Nissan's best four-wheel-drive model. For 2010, it only became available as a 5-door model with the 4.8-litre inline 6-cylinder engine as standard, with the choice of a 5-speed automatic with tiptronic or a proper 5-speed manual. By the middle of 2011, a 3-door short-wheelbase model became available with the same drivetrain, as a 2012 model. Straight-line drive transfer allows on-the-fly shifting from 2WD to 4WD with one touch of a lever. The Patrol also has a decent interior featuring quality materials, wood trim, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo, manual a/c, fog lamps, 16-inch wheels and other equipment. Along with two foldout cargo-area seats, the wagon model has room for seven. Front airbags and ABS are standard, among other features.

The Fiat Ducato is the Italian company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

Available from early 2013, the "Mark 7" VW Golf may look the same, but is really completely new, the big news being several weight-saving enhancements that form the car. The two "TSI" engine choices are a 1.2-litre and a 1.4-litre, both turbocharged 4-cylinder units mated to 7-speed "DSG" automanual transmissions. All Golf models now have touchscreen systems as standard, starting with a 5.8-inch colour display and rising to the range-topping satellite navigation system with 8-inch colour display that operates with finger gestures. Features include CD/MP3 stereo, auxiliary inputs, Bluetooth telephone, multiple airbags, power windows, keyless entry and such, with optional features such as sunroof, smart keyless entry and start, 5.8-inch touchscreen, fog lamps and more. Between the front seats, space is increased by virtue of the new electronic parking brake with auto-hold feature. The Golf's steering now uses a variable-ratio electric system, and with optional Park Assist can parallel-park the car automatically. It is also available with driver-profile selection, which allows the driver to choose from several modes that alter the throttle mapping and engine management to the chosen style, such as Eco and Sport. Standard on all new Golf models is a multi-collision brake system which automatically brakes the vehicle after a collision, to reduce kinetic energy significantly and thus minimise the chance of a second impact. Other available electronic aids include adaptive cruise control and city emergency braking, both capable of applying full braking to a stop. Further options include a Driver Alert System that monitors the driver's inputs to detect any signs of tiredness, while a camera-operated Lane Assist system can help keep the car in a specific lane, providing countersteering assistance where necessary, while the Dynamic Light Assist system optionally masks the vehicle's high beam lighting to avoid dazzling oncoming traffic.

The Chevrolet Corvette C6 is the most capable Corvette ever. The LS2 V8 powerplant has grown to 6.2 litres for 2008, with power and torque that is killer at the track and useable in regular driving. The standard tranny is an updated 6-speed manual gearbox, while a new 6-speed automatic with paddles is optional since 2007. The steering is improved for 2008. Large 18-inch wheels at the front and 19-inch at the rear and exposed headlamps with fixed Xenon HID lights continue to define the Corvette. Available as a hatchback coupe with a lift-off roof panel or as a convertible with a fabric soft-top and heated glass rear window, while a power top is also available, as are optional magnetic shocks and a two-mode exhaust. The new race-bred Corvette Z06 packs a massive 7.0-litre V8 engine, and comes in manual coupe form only, offering performance that rivals Ferrari. In 2009, the Corvette ZR1 was launched, with a 6.2-litre supercharged V8 and 6-speed manual, along with various upgrades such as some carbon-fibre body panels, stiffer suspension, bigger brakes and more. The Corvette's only letdown is the less-than-stellar interior, although GM makes up for it with gadgets such as keyless start, button-actuated door opening and a heads-up display. Other available features include touchscreen navigation, CD/MP3 stereo, power seats, front and side airbags, ABS, stability control, leather and more. Previously, a Z51 package was available for the base Corvette with upgraded suspension, close-ratio manual gearbox and other mods, but from 2010, a Grand Sport version based on the regular model replaced that package with similar mods derived from the Z06.

Hyundai's Genesis G70 is the Korean carmaker's attempt at cracking the entry-level premium sports sedan niche. Starting off with a shortened platform derived from the Kia Stinger, the compact sedan appears to derive a lot from its rivals and brings nothing new to the table, aside from offering a bit more power, based on preliminary reports. The engines on offer include a 2.0-litre turbo four and a 3.3-litre twin-turbo V6, both mated to 8-speed automatics. Features include LED lighting, an 8-inch touch screen, electronic shifter. available 15-speaker Lexicon audio system, Apple CarPlay and a heads-up display. Safety features include the usual set of airbags, ABS, ESP and tyre-pressure monitor, as well as active-driving aids such as adaptive cruise control with auto braking, lane-departure warning, etc.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The latest Hilux has been recently redesigned, sitting on an all-new platform and not built in Japan any more. Nearly every pickup in this class has grown from a compact to a midsize, so it is no surprise that Toyota did the same. This latest generation of midsize pickups feature roomier cabins, improved ride quality and increased stability. They also boast increased refinement. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. The newest crew cab models are practical alternatives to a sedan, if someone were to drive one of these every day. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Engines include a 2.0-litre and a 2.7-litre petrol, and a 2.5-litre diesel unit, all with only a manual gearbox, either rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive, and basics such as a radio cassette player.

In 2014, the BMW 4 Series Convertible replaced the 3-series convertible model. In 2018 it got some minor exterior and interior upgrades. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i  and 430i features a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine and the 440i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The BMW 4 Series Convertible gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and stability control.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

The B-Series is the forgotten small pickup truck range of the Mazda line-up. No one in their right mind is going to buy one of these for personal use, but for those who want to be different, in a flamboyant American sort of way, they can pick up one of these and modify them for purposes other than hauling cargo. Engines include a 2.2-litre and a 2.6-litre petrol engines, while the diesel offering is a 2.9-litre unit, all four-cylinder motors and all with a standard five-speed manual, or even an automatic in some markets. Body styles include a single cab and a double cab shape. Key features include an AM/FM radio with cassette deck and 2 speakers, monotone or two-tone paintjob, and manually operated windows. Available accessories include overfender and side-step cladding panels, and front and rear skirt kits. Cargo-box equipment includes a single-action tailgate lock, a rear step bumper, outer and inner rope hooks, and load rests. Options, available in some markets, include front airbags, ABS brakes with electronic brake-force distribution, and even power windows.

An all-new Honda Pilot was released as a 2016 model. It got a facelift for the 2019 model year. Under the hood, it gets a 3.5-liter Direct Injected V6 engine with Variable Cylinder Management (VCM), mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. The base EX model can be had in 2WD or AWD form, while the EX-L and Touring trims only come with AWD and no low-range gearing. The Pilot includes a traction management system and is featured on all models except the EX 2WD, with pushbutton mode selection and TFT mode display on the cockpit instrument panel. In addition, EX (AWD) & EXL grades offer 200 mm of ground clearance for better off-road ability. There is also a sand-mode feature. Features include halogen projector headlights in EX and EXL grades whereas LED projector headlights in Touring grade, which also gets a panoramic glass roof. Some of the other features standard in all grades includes front fog lights, LED taillights and LED daytime running lights along with Tailgate Spoiler, power door mirrors and LED turn light indicators. For the interior, an 8-inch touchscreen, standard in all grades, gives you access to audio system controls and other display features. The Touring grade includes second row captain's chairs, which provides easy walk through between the second and third row for a 7 passenger configuration. Other amenities include tri-zone automatic climate control, rear air conditioning duct in the second and third row seats, rear door sunshade, sun glass holder and conversation mirror, cargo area hidden storage for extra luggage, active noise control (ANC) for a quieter cabin, with a rear entertainment system with a 9-inch display screen available in the Touring grade. Safety features include Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) with Traction Control Systems (TCS), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD), Hill Start Assist (HSA), Agile Handle Assist (AHA) and Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS).

An all-new BMW 7-Series debuted as a 2016 model year. For 2020 it got a facelift and new tech features, along with slight bump up in horsepower and torque. As usual, BMW offers a standard version and a long-wheel base version. The LWB version is about 14 cm longer. The car is said be upto 130 kg lighter than the outgoing generation, thanks to the use of carbon-fibre reinforced plastic (CFRP) mixed with aluminium and steel, a tech first used in the BMW i8. This makes the body more stronger and rigid, while at the same time reduces weight. The interior is, as expected, loaded with luxury and features. It consists of different high quality leather options, as well as wood trim and aluminium accents. There is a new iDrive infotainment system, which gets a touchscreen and gesture control technology. There is the Executive Lounge package on the LWB variants. It features a four-zone automatic climate control system, ventilated seats, and power rear seats with a massage function. Additionally the rear console adds a fold out table, cup holders and a 7-inch Touch Command tablet. The engine specs pretty much remain the same, with the petrol engines on offer the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, the turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder unit and the turbocharged 4.0-litre V8 motor. Later in 2017, a 6.6-litre V12 engine was added to the lineup with all-wheel drive, called the M760Li. Safety standards are high as well, with multiple airbags and electronic aids. The Driving Assistant Plus equipment offers partially autonomous driving thanks to Active cruise control with Stop&Go function and Steering and lane control assistant. In addition to the Driving Assistant functions, active safety is improved by Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping assistant with active side collision protection, Approach control warning and Person warning with full city braking function and Crossing traffic warning.

The Grand Vitara got an unnoticeable facelift for 2009, but the real change is under the bonnet, with a new 2.4-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a manual or automatic, and a new 3.2-litre V6 with an automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction, with the V6 now offering hill-hold and hill-descent functions. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. The V6 is only available with the 5-door model. For 2009, all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

The all-new oddly named GTC4Lusso is Ferrari’s latest luxury sports hatchback that replaces the popular FF. Referred to as a shooting-brake, the GTC4Lusso carries on the same basic body styling as that of the FF, albeit with a more streamlined contour that resembles a fastback. From 2017, a derivation of the GTC4Lusso, namely the GTC4Lusso T was offered. The GTC4Lusso T differentiates itself from the GTC4Lusso with a rear-wheel-drive layout, and being powered by Ferrari’s 3.9-litre V8 engine mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch F1 transmission, whilst retaining the electronic rear differential and all-wheel-steering system. Other features include an all-new 10.3-inch touchscreen system, Alcantara, Bluetooth with audio streaming, and navigation. Optional features include up to 128gb in-built hard-disk storage, separate passenger displays, and support for I-Pad installation.

The Jaguar F-Pace is the British luxury brand's first SUV in their lineup. In 2021, it got a mild facelift and new engines. The base model gets the same 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. The higher model gets a 3.0-litre in-line 6 cylinder turbo coupled with an electric . supercharger. There is also a hybrid model Power is delivered via an 8-speed automatic transmission for all motors. A limited production "First Edition" model was released initially. The Pure, Prestige, R-Sport and Portfolio models get the standard 2.0-litre and 3.0-litre engines, while the F-Pace S and the First Edition trims get the more powerful 3.0-litre engine. Standard options on the all-wheel drive F-Pace include power windows, power mirrors, power steering, speed proportional steering, electric parking brake, hill launch assist, LED taillights, 2-zone climate control, paddle shifters,  5-inch screen, Bluetooth connectivity and 18-inch alloy wheels. Optional features include 19-inch rims, luxury sports seats, electric seats with lumbar support, sliding panoramic roof, interior mood lighting, body kit, and Meridian Digital sound system. Safety features include front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera, 360-degree parking view, valet mode, blind spot monitor, traction control, front and curtain airbags.

The Lancer Evolution is Mitsubishi's rally-inspired high-performance all-wheel-drive sedan based on the Lancer compact sedan. This Lancer Evolution is the tenth generation of the rally car for the street and came out first in 2008, and hence it is called the Evolution X. The all-new Evo X is offered in one trim level in the GCC, known as GSR, with different levels of equipment. Standard is the turbocharged and intercooled 2.0-litre 4-cylinder that now gets either a 5-speed manual gearbox or a new 6-speed paddle-shifted Twin-Clutch Sportronic Shift Transmission (TC-SST) with Normal, Sport and S-Sport modes. Both versions include the Super All-Wheel Control (S-AWC) all-wheel-drive system with Active Center Differential (ACD), Active Yaw Control (AYC), Active Stability Control (ASC), and Sport ABS brakes. Features include automatic climate control, Recaro bucket seats, 18-inch Enkei alloy wheels, various aluminium body panels, cruise control, adaptive HID headlights, foglamps, tyre pressure gauge, power windows and electric mirrors. Safety includes ABS-assisted Brembo brakes, front airbags, side-curtain airbags and a knee airbag for the driver. Leather, keyless entry and a Rockford Fosgate stereo are optional. These latest models come with a GCC warranty, which become void if the car even touches the track.

The Odyssey is a best-seller in America, but has yet to make an impact in this region, where 4WDs rule. The Odyssey has a car-like ride and handling quality since it is based on the Accord. It is powered by the same fuel-efficient 3.5-litre V6 engine as the MR-V, mated to an automatic. The interior features a clever seating system that can accommodate up to eight passengers. The Odyssey comes standard with side curtain airbags, electronic stability control and ABS brakes, as well as power door locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, 60/40 split fold-down rear seats, power sliding doors, tri-zone climate control, a stowable second-row PlusOne seat, in-dash CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, cruise control, power driver seat controls, alloy wheels and other features. Leather upholstery is available, as is a power moonroof and heated front seats. The Odyssey aims to be more of a luxury cruiser than a basic family or labour hauler.

The Indian-made Suzuki Ertiga is a seven-seater minivan offering from the Japanese brand. The front-wheel drive people carrier features a 1.4-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual or 4-speed automatic transmission. Standard features on the Ertiga include power steering, AM/FM radio, manual windows, fabric seats, manual A/C with rear vents, halogen headlamps and steel wheels. Higher options get alloy wheels, fog lamps, chrome grille and side body moulding. Depending on trim level, the Ertiga gets dual airbags and ABS.

The seventh generation BMW 5-series arrived in 2017. The 530i has a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. A 540i model gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 5-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The regular 5-Series can also be had with an M package that adds sports suspension and a body kit. The BMW 5-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The SLR McLaren is an impressive celebration of Mercedes-Benz and its Formula 1 partner McLaren in the development and production of high-performance sports cars. The two-seater, with its striking swing-wing doors and styling elements borrowed from the Formula 1 Silver Arrows, builds on the legacy of the famous SLR racecars of the 1950s. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, it is designed to ensure a high standard of safety, comfort and class-leading speed. The specially-developed supercharged 5.4-litre V8 engine, with an automatic, delivers an impressive output rivaling traditional super cars, powering up to as much as 334 kph. The body of the new SLR, like F1 racecars, is made from lightweight carbon-fibre composites. However, the body itself is hardly the most attractive of supercars, with an overlong snout and a short rear. Many might confuse it for a 'bargain' SL or SLK, though it should still attract a lot of attention. The SLR has a spoiler mounted on the rear which pops up when braking from high speeds. A special lighter 722 edition has black alloy rims and more power. A convertible Roadster joined the range for 2008.

The new Civic was a breath of fresh air in the crowded compact class back in 2006, and continues with a 2009 facelift that includes a reshaped front end and more features. Trim levels include the basic LXi, the mid-level EXi and the top VTi, all sharing the same 1.8-litre engine. Standard features on all trims now include 16-inch wheels, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, CD/MP3 player, cruise control, body-coloured exterior trim, power windows and mirrors, and a 5-speed automatic gearbox, with a manual gearbox available only on the LXi. The EXi receives a standard automatic gearbox only, and adds stability control, optional sunroof, turn signals on the mirrors, upgraded stereo with 4 speakers, USB jack and steering wheel controls, and outside temperature gauge. The VTi adds side-curtain airbags, 16-inch alloy wheels, standard automatic gearbox with paddle shifters, standard sunroof, optional leather, automatic a/c, chrome exhaust tip, foglights and HID headlights. The Civic only gets more expensive, overlapping with the Accord now in terms of price.

The Previa is roomy, comfortable and does everything well. It is easy to live with if you learn how to park it, and it comes loaded with features that make life easier and more convenient. Everything operates exactly as expected, so equipment struggles are rare. Its smoothness and convenience allows the vehicle to fade into the background while you go about your life, even though it looks like a space ship. On the road, the Previa delivers a smooth ride and decent handling. Its 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine and four-speed automatic transmission offer adequate throttle response and fuel economy, though given its weight, it is far from quick. The 3.5-litre V6 with six-speed automatic, new for 2007, improves straight-line power. Standard features include seating for either seven or eight, a radio cassette player, power windows, cloth seats, keyless entry and central locking, along with ABS and two airbags. Optional features include HID headlamps with adaptive light system and auto leveling, front fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, CD player with 6 speakers, cruise control and automatic rear doors.

The BMW M3 debuted in 2008 as a sedan, coupe and convertible in the Middle East. It is powered by high revving 4.0-litre V8 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed automanual dual-clutch transmission. The M3 is the only 3-Series model with features such as electronically-variable suspension and chassis adjustments. The iDrive computer is standard, as are active steering, HID headlights, and 18-inch alloy wheels, or an optional 19-inches. The M3 gets multiple front and side airbags, stability control, ABS and great rear-wheel-drive handling characteristics.

The Renault Twizy is designed as an "ultramobile" and is just 2.34 metres long, 1.24 metres wide and 1.45 metres tall. It is available in only four colours blue, white, red and black -- from which customers can choose many styling combinations. Different stickers can also be added to the doors and rims. We're classifying it as a mini-hatchback, but the truth is this four-wheeled 2-seater is hard to categorise. The passenger sits behind the driver, crammed in somehow. The Twizy's electric motor can run up to 85 km on a single charge. The lithium-ion batteries takes about 3.5 hours to charge completely using a 220-240v powerpoint. For safety, the Twizy comes with a 4-point seatbelt and a steering-wheel airbag. It is equipped with disc brakes as well and an optional rear-parking aid.

The Outback is the redesigned model of Subaru's midsize all-wheel-drive crossover wagon. Like all previous Outback models for more than a decade, the new-for-2010 version continues to be based on the Legacy wagon, only with slightly better ground clearance. Compared to the previous version, it now features a larger body and carryover engines. The base Outback 2.5i comes with a 2.5-litre 4-cylinder boxer engine mated with a CVT automatic. The top model is the 3.6R, with a turbocharged 3.6-litre 6-cylinder boxer engine mated to a paddle-shifted 5-speed automatic. Base models get power windows, electric mirrors, ABS, front and side-curtain airbags, cloth upholstery, 16-inch wheels and a CD stereo. The top-spec trim gets stability control, SI-Drive driving mode selection system, keyless entry with starter button, cruise control, dual-zone a/c, leather interior, 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat, aluminium pedals, 6-speaker stereo with 6-CD changer, 17-inch alloy wheels, HID headlights with pop-up washers, and a sunroof.

The Audi S6 received a facelift for the 2015 model year. The all-wheel drive S6 has a 4.0-litre turbocharged V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Features include a Bose surround sound, adaptive cruise control, MMI multimedia interface, reverse camera, and adaptive air suspension, as well 19-inch and 20-inch rims. Optional Valcona leather can be had for the seats, as well as ventilated seats with both cooling and heating and massage feature. Optional features for the S6 include heads-up display, sports differential, dynamic steering and ceramic brakes. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and electronic stability control. Optional safety features include rear side airbags, park assist, lane assist, adaptive cruise control, night vision and pre-sense assist.

Proton claimed that the Waja was their first in-house car designed by Malaysians. However, its petrol engine is bought directly from Mitsubishi, and the suspension work was done by their independent Lotus division. The Waja is sold as the Impian in some markets, or referred to as the Waja Campro sometimes to advertise its latest engine. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this four-door sedan can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, sunroof, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Waja is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras.

The Gelaendewagen first debuted in 1979 as a utilitarian offroader and as military transport. In 1990, it got its first major revamp, upgrading it to luxury specs, but retaining its classic looks. Its boxy styling was again left alone during the 1997 update, which introduced a new range of engines, updated again and again over the years until its next major update in 2007. The trademark clean-cut, sharp lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a limited-edition soft-top version of the three-door.  The only petrol engine debuting in 1997 was the 3.2-litre V6 in the G 320, alongside various diesel motors. The 5.0-litre V8-powered G 500 debuted in 1998. In 2003 came the first AMG model, namely the 5.5-litre G 55 AMG. This was replaced in 2004 by the upgraded supercharged 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Along the way came turbodiesel models, such as the G 320 CDI in 1997 and the G 400 CDI in 2000. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. Stability control was added in 2001, and while dual front airbags are available, there are no side airbags. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The British Morris Garages brand, a spin-off of Rover, is back in a new guise under Chinese ownership. The new-for-2011 MG 550 1.8T compact sedan is designed by MG's British team and comes with a newly-developed 1.8-litre light-pressure turbo 4-cylinder engine and a 5-speed automatic, on a front-wheel-drive platform vaguely derived from the old Rover 75, with independent suspension and disc brakes on all four wheels. The base model gets 16-inch alloys wheels, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, cruise control, stability control, two front airbags, ABS with EBD, fabric seats, one-press engine start with the key still requiring insertion, steering-mounted radio controls, power windows and mirrors, automatic climate control a/c, faux wood trim, CD/MP3 stereo with 8 speakers, keyless entry, illuminated sunshade mirrors, digital gauges and fog lights. The top "Deluxe" model gets 17-inch alloys, side-curtain airbags, dual-zone a/c, leather upholstery, tinted windows, electric driver's seat, parking sensors, sunroof and a basic GPS system. There are many more options available, such as Bluetooth, rear camera and cooler box, but the dealer will not offer those for now.

An all-new Skoda Octavia came out in 2014 in the GCC. It got a facelift for the 2018 model. Compared to its predecessor, the Octavia has grown significantly in length and width. The new model is 90 mm longer and 45 mm wider than the second-generation Skoda Octavia. At the same time, the wheelbase has grown by 108 mm, mainly benefiting the interior and space on the rear seats. In 2017, there are two 4-cylinder turbocharged engines to choose from, the 1.4-litre and the 1.8-litre, both mated to a 7-speed DSG gearbox. The base Octavia Ambition model comes with 16-inch steel wheels, fabric interior, rear mud flaps, automatic A/C, electric adjustable, heated & foldable door mirrors, electric windows, parking sensors, radio with CD player and MP3 support,  4 speakers, remote central locking, fog lights and front & side front airbags. The Octavia Style model gets 18-inch alloy wheels, leather interior, chrome package, cruise control, Apply connectivity, mobile device interface (MDI), electric seats, sunroof and xenon headlamps. The Octavia RS gets 19-inch alloy wheels, carbon-fibre inlays for dashboard and door panels, boot spoiler, red brake calipers, sports suspension, Bluetooth and Apple connectivity.

The 1-Series is the smallest range in BMW's line-up. Completely redesigned for 2012, it remains the only vehicle in its class featuring rear-wheel-drive and is offered in the GCC as a 5-door hatchback alongside the older-generation 1-Series coupe and convertible that carried on into the 2012 model year. Petrol versions now include the 1.6-litre 116i, the 2.0-litre 118i and the turbocharged 2.0-litre 125i, although all models are not offered in all GCC markets. All models come with a choice of 6-speed transmissions, both manual or automatic, although only the automatic version is offered here. An M 135i model was offered from 2013, in 5-door form, with a 3.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder and a choice of 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic. While the hatchback was completely redesigned for 2012, the coupe and convertible continued unchanged for one more year. To differentiate the sub-models, BMW offers Sport Line and Urban Line models which differ by alloy wheels, kidney grille and other appearance-related features. All trims come standard with common power accesories, cloth or leather upholstery, front and side airbags, stability control and ABS, alongside various optional features such as HID headlights, "active" steering, stereo choices and various wheel sizes. BMW claims to have improved cabin materials from the last 1 series. All models are equipped with start-stop and a/c as standard. Higher trims will include a 8.8-inch LCD monitor and Bluetooth hands-free with USB connectivity. BMW's Drive Performance Control is standard on all models. Drive Performance Control allows the driver to select one of four modes. These include Comfort, Sport, Sport+, and ECO PRO. ECO PRO aims to save fuel by adjusting throttle response to encourage slower acceleration and by limiting the use of accessories like air-conditioning, heated mirrors and seats.

All an new model of the BMW X5 M came out in 2020. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X5 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

The Dodge Ram had been extensively re-engineered for 2006, with a minor restyling and an upgraded interior, having been originally redesigned in 2002. It has a new hydroformed frame that's boxed its full length to provide more strength than in any previous model. New suspension and body mounts also improve ride and handling, though it is still no luxury sports sedan. Inside the Ram, the instrument panel, centre console and seats have been redesigned for more car-like comfort, while new entertainment features have been introduced. The standard motor for the Middle East is the 5.7-litre Hemi V8 engine, which featured the new Multi-Displacement System from 2006, a setup that shuts down four of the Hemi's eight cylinders when they are not needed. Dodge claims the switchover is seamless, and that fuel economy is improved by as much as 20 percent. Adding to the Hemi's responsive nature is a five-speed automatic transmission. The Ram comes standard with air conditioning, AM/FM/CD stereo, rear-wheel ABS, 17-inch wheels and a full-size spare tyre. Also available are power windows and door locks, keyless entry, an overhead console with mini-trip computer and compass, cruise control and larger aluminium wheels.

The 2018 Suzuki Swift is a complete overhaul from the previous model, built on an upgraded platform which is based on the likes of Ignis and Baleno. The Dzire is the sedan version of the Swift hatchback, boasting a 20mm increase in its wheelbase, thus offering more roomy interior and increased boot space. Powered by a 1.2-litre 4-cylinder engine, it is mated to an automated-manual "AGS" gearbox. Features include a CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, manual a/c, power windows, power mirrors, keyless entry, cloth upholstery, tilt-adjustable steering wheel with audio controls, Bluetooth, 14-inch steel wheels and front/rear fog lamps on the base GL trim. The GLX trim additionally gets 15-inch alloy wheels, driver-seat height adjuster, smart key with starter button, and rear parking sensors. Safety features includes front airbags, ESP, ABS with EBD and tyre-pressure monitor..

The M6 Coupe uses a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8, mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox. Fuel economy is apparently better by 30% compared to the old V10-powered model. Other mechanical features include BMW's electronically-controlled Active M Differential, massive 16.1-inch carbon-ceramic rotors in front with blue 6-piston calipers, 15.6-inch rotors in the back with a single-piston caliper, M-specific 19-inch alloys with 265/40 ultra-high performance tyres in front and 295/35 tyres in the rear, with 20-inch available as an option, and a carbon-fibre roof. The M6 features both Brake Energy Regeneration and the Auto Start-Stop function. It comes equipped with Cornering Brake Control, Dynamic Brake Control, Brake Assistant, Brake Fade Compensation function, a Brake Drying function and Start-off Assistant.

It is trying to be Chevrolet's volume seller in the Middle East, but we have trouble spotting an Optra on the streets even though the car has been on the market for some time now. On paper at least, this car seems to have what it takes to go head-on with the opposition. Positioned in the lower compact segment, the Optra offers good value for money, selling in 4-door sedan, 5-door hatchback and 5-door station wagon trims. Styled by Italians but barely showing it, the styling can best be described as interesting without being ambitious. The cabin is basic, but there are lots of storage spaces and space for five adults. Engine options include a 1.6-litre or a 1.8-litre four-cylinder unit. These are combined with a five-speed manual or four-speed auto transmission transmitting juice to the front wheels. While both engines have enough grunt for the segment, they fall short of leaders like the top Civic and Corolla models. Ride and handling are quite good, and bodes well for the Optra. All we ask for are better engines.

The Everest will appeal to customers who are ready to consider the purchase of a 4WD product which provides versatile usage, but aren't too concerned about where the vehicle is built or what it is based on. The Everest is positioned under the Explorer in some markets, precisely to meet the needs of this customer group while offering exceptional value for money. The Everest is a midsize 4WD based on the Asian Mazda-based Ford Ranger pickup truck platform and built in Thailand. The 4WD has three-row seating, a 2.6-litre petrol engine and a five-speed manual gearbox. Features include 7-seater capacity, with a slightly higher level for each row of seating, dual climate control a/c system, ABS brakes, seat belts for all seating positions including 3rd row seat, dual airbags, decent off-road capability, a side-hinged tailgate, tailgate-mounted spare tyre, standard audio system with a CD player, MP3, tweeters and additional speakers, power windows, power doorlocks and power plug-in points for TVs, fridges and Playstations. Not very fast though.

The Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG Coupe debuted in 2010 on a completely new and unique platform, paying homage to the original 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300SL Gullwing. Renamed the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT for 2013 with almost no changes, it is supposed to be an everyday-use supercar, a product of in-house development by AMG. The car's trademark feature is the set of 'gullwing' doors that open upwards, requiring less room to open than conventional coupe doors. Underneath the long bonnet is the usual AMG-built 6.2-litre V8 engine, now upgraded by 20 hp in the GT, and mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automanual gearbox in this application. By the end of 2013, the GT was replaced by a GT Final Edition, identified by its big wing, carbon-fibre bonnet, lip spoiler and wheels. A lightweight structure molded largely from carbon-fibre and aluminium double-wishbone suspension form the basics of the SLS. Among other things, the centre console incorporates the AMG DRIVE UNIT, which enables SLS owners to customise their vehicle set-up, while the AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission is operated by means of the E-SELECT lever. Beyond the usual power accessories and comfort features such as automatic a/c and cruise control, the simplistic interior can be customised in various colours, and can be fitted with options such as sports seats, metal trim, various leather choices, nicer paint and carbon-fibre appliquÃ©s. Further options include different 19-inch and 20-inch alloy wheels, carbon-ceramic brakes, pricey Bang & Olufsen stereo and a sports steering wheel.

The unimaginatively-named Pickup is a midsize pickup that is designed to be a workhorse rather than a lifestyle vehicle, but we are listing it here anyway as it is practical enough to serve as personal transport for someone who absolutely needs to drive a pickup. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder petrol engine mated to a five-speed manual or four-speed automatic, or a 2.5-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel mated to a five-speed manual, it recently received a facelift that gives the truck a corporate front end. It is available in single cab and quad cab configurations.
