The Infiniti QX30 is pretty much the same as the Q30 hatchback, but with a very minor increase in ground clearance, to become a crossover. Sharing a platform with the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, it also shares an engine with its joint-venture German cousin as well, namely the 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and all-wheel-drive. Standard options in the QX30 include power steering, power windows, central locking, leather interior, power front seats, alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, Bose stereo, 7-inch infotainment touchscreen, power mirrors, stability control, intelligent keyless entry and start and an advanced front-side-curtain 7-airbag system. Other safety features include lane departure warning, front collision warning and stop, ABS and brake assist.

The redesigned-for-2008 CTS 4-door sedan spawned the Cadillac CTS-V sedan in 2009. Powering the rear-wheel-drive CTS-V is the supercharged 6.2-litre V8 that can be had with a 6-speed manual or automatic. The exterior is characterized by a larger chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced. The CTS-V also gets extra bodywork, better brakes, stiffer suspension and Recaro sports seats alongside the Corvette-derived supercharged V8.

The new-for-2011 Mazda 2 is a facelifted version of the Mazda2 that has been on sale in Europe since 2008. Offered for the first time in the GCC, it comes in sedan and hatchback versions, and competitively priced when compared to its platform-mate, the Ford Fiesta. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a 4-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. Fog lamps, rear spoiler and 15-inch alloys are optional. The interior can be had in either black or two-tone, with ten exterior colours available. The glove-box lid is a unique two-compartment design, with one compartment exposed on top to keep files and papers in. The seats are cloth-upholstered, and every other piece of cabin trim is hard plastic, with no padded armrests. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The Mazda2 is highly rated in European crash tests, but those safety ratings are based on Euro-spec models with side airbags, not available here.

The Spark is a typical urban runabout based wholly on the Korean Daewoo Matiz, and is built in Korea too. It is a best seller in the supermini market, which is a market with few buyers in this region. The Spark is a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering just enough interior space for four inside a compact body. Its big windows and tight turning circle make it easy to park and cut through traffic, if you have the guts to cut in front of big 4WDs. The design tries to be cute, but unlike the Mini or the Beetle, this thing still looks like half a car. Inside, centre-mounted instruments greet you, as does cheap plastics. Depending on which of the upholstery fabrics and body colours is chosen, the displays have a blue, green or orange background. All interior mouldings and seating fabrics are robust but still cheap. It is powered by either a 0.8-litre three-cylinder or a 1.0-litre four-cylinder unit, and comes with a standard five-speed manual gearbox which features an all-new gearchange mechanism with damping for improved shift quality. A four-speed auto is optional. GM claims increased percentage of 'super steel' in the structure, but we'd still feel uncomfortable travelling in one of these.

The  Milan is Mercury's new midsize five-passenger sedan that is designed to appeal to a younger audience and provides a new entry point to the Mercury brand, as Mercury's first vehicle in this segment in more than a decade. It is based on a modified Mazda 6 platform, but features signature Mercury design cues including waterfall grille and satin aluminium trim. It is powered by a Mazda-derived 2.3-litre four-cylinder, mated to a 5-speed automatic. The premium interior features upgraded materials such as leather seats and either Satin Metallic or Wales Mahogany wood trim, and available two-tone leather seating surfaces with contrast stitching. Standard equipment includes power windows, electric mirrors, an auxiliary audio input jack, fold-down passenger seat, front-seat side airbags, side-impact air curtains, ABS brakes, traction control, and a security package highlighted by side-impact airbags, side-curtain airbags for all rows, and an anti-theft alarm system. Options include some sort of appearance package, rear spoiler, and more.

Looking to ring bells in the midsize-SUV market is the BYD S6. Entering the GCC market, the S6 fights for space alongside dominant Japanese and Korean rivals. Under the hood, it gets a 2.4-litre engine. However, it is coupled to a dated 4-speed automatic. The interior is pretty plush for its price range though, and on offer is a 4.2-inch TFT speedometer, multi-information display screen, leather steering wheel with mounted controls, dual-zone A/C and Smart key system. Tick a few more boxes and the S6 receives a DVD system with a 7-inch touch screen and 9-speaker audio system. As for safety, the S6 comes standard with ABS and EBD and dual front airbags. Higher models get curtain airbags, rear parking sensors and rear-view camera parking system. The S6 is only on offer in select countries across the GCC including UAE, Oman and Kuwait.

The G37 sedan debuted in 2009 to replace the G35. The sedan then received a frontal facelift for 2011. It uses a 3.7-litre V6, mated to a paddle-shifted automatic gearbox. In late 2011, an entry-level G25 model debuted with a 2.5-litre V6 engine. All post-2011 G37 models use a 7-speed automatic. The platform is the corporate front-midship, offering about 54:46 front-rear balance. Features include alloy wheels, fog lamps, Xenon headlamps, 18-inch or 19-inch wheels, LED taillights, folding rear seat with trunk pass-through, heated leather seats with eight-way driver and four-way passenger power adjustment, leather-wrapped wheel, automatic climate control, six-CD stereo, cruise control, automatic headlamps, intelligent key, auto-dimming rearview mirror, power windows and variable intermittent wipers. Available options include a DVD-based navigation system and rear-view camera. Safety features include the usual multitude of airbags, ABS brakes and other electronic nannies.

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

The Renault Talisman replaces the Safrane in the French-brand's lineup. Under the hood, the Talisman gets two engines - a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a CVT and a turbocharged 1.6-litre motor connected to a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission. Standard features on the base Talisman PE model include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors with demisting function, central locking, keyless entry, automatic dual zone A/C with rear vents, automatic wipers, steering wheel with audio/Bluetooth/voice command controls, multi-information display, fabric seats, 4.2-inch screen with AM/FM, USB, AUX, audio streaming via Bluetooth and voice command/recognition for phone, 6 speakers and 16-inch alloy wheels. The SE model gets additional daytime running lamps, fog lamps, Renault Multi-Sense system, central jog-dial, speed limiter and cruise control, height adjustable passenger seat, electric folding side mirrors, Renault R-Link multimedia system with 7-inch touchscreen, navigation, 3D sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, AM/FM, 2 USBs, AUX, audio/photo streaming via Bluetooth, voice command/recognition for phone, navigation, media and text-to-speech, refrigerated storage in front centre console armrest, rear power socket, higher quality upholstery and 17-inch alloy wheels. The 1.6TC SE model gets all of the above, plus engine start-stop, acoustic windscreen, smart engine management and twin chrome exhaust tips. The top 1.6TC LE model gets added goodies such as LED headlights, LED taillights, LED interior lamps, parking assist, 7-inch TFT digital instrument cluster, push engine start-stop button, power seats with memory function and lumbar support, auto sliding seats for easy entry and exit, rear-glass sunblind, Renault R-Link 2 multimedia system with 8.7-inch touchscreen, 3D sound by Arkamys, 8 speakers, AM/FM, 2 USBs, 1 SD card, AUX, audio/photo streaming via Bluetooth, voice command/recognition for phone, navigation, media and text-to-speech, leather upholstery, wood accents, panoramic sunroof, front and rear parking sensors, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, stability control, brake assist, hill-start assist and traction control. The higher models get side airbags, while only the top LE model gets blind sport monitor, moving object detection and flank guard protection.

The range-topping M6 arrived for 2006, in coupe and convertible form, using the same V10 engine as the M5. Unlike that of the new 5-Series and 7-Series models, the styling of the new 6 Series has generally received a warm welcome from the public, for unknown reasons. The new 6-Series was designed to look like a shark, and really does remind you of one, but it is far from good-looking. The controversial "Bangle-butt" rear styling works somewhat better on the shapely 6-Series than on other BMW models though. The 6-Series has become the vehicle of choice for rich town-cruising yuppies, but it is actually an excellent performance car, available with a 7-speed SMG automanual in the M6. A mild facelift came for the 2008 model, adding minor gadgetry updates.

An all-new Chevrolet Silverado was released as a 2014 model year. Exterior-wise, the styling carries pretty much the same DNA as the previous model but the new front fascia seems more imposing now. That is because they have added bigger headlights and a huge grille. GM consciously kept the design similar as, unlike the UAE where big pickup trucks are more of a statement, in the U.S. market it is a high volume seller among conservative buyers. A Z71 package is available which includes stronger shocks, front tow hooks and extra under-body protection. The interior is where the main changes will be, with the new 4.2-inch display on the dashboard. More soft-touch material has been added around the cockpit. The new Silverado pickups will have 12-volt outlets, five USB ports and a SD-card slot. A new 4.3-litre V6 engine adds to the family of 5.3-litre and 6.2-litre V8 motors. They will all be mated to a six-speed automatic. For improving fuel economy, the V8 engines have cylinder deactivation and direct injection.

The Spark is a typical urban runabout based wholly on the Korean Daewoo Matiz, and is built in Korea too. It is a best seller in the supermini market, which is a market with few buyers in this region. The Spark is a great driver in town traffic with practicality and tight proportions offering just enough interior space for four inside a compact body. Its big windows and tight turning circle make it easy to park and cut through traffic, if you have the guts to cut in front of big 4WDs. The design tries to be cute, but unlike the Mini or the Beetle, this thing still looks like half a car. Inside, centre-mounted instruments greet you, as does cheap plastics. Depending on which of the upholstery fabrics and body colours is chosen, the displays have a blue, green or orange background. All interior mouldings and seating fabrics are robust but still cheap. It is powered by either a 0.8-litre three-cylinder or a 1.0-litre four-cylinder unit, and comes with a standard five-speed manual gearbox which features an all-new gearchange mechanism with damping for improved shift quality. A four-speed auto is optional. GM claims increased percentage of 'super steel' in the structure, but we'd still feel uncomfortable travelling in one of these.

Facelifted for 2007, the Touran 7-seater is a minivan smaller than the Sharan, with four forward-opening doors and a rear tailgate. The engine lineup has been cut down to a weak 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit with a manual. The high feature set for the Touran includes, as standard equipment, stability control, ABS with brake-assist system, six airbags, active head restraints for driver and front passenger, and three-point automatic seat belts for all seats. Among the most important features of this new Volkswagen are its versatile interior layout and the good amount of space it provides, with a load area that can be as large as 1,989 litres. The three separate seats in the second row each weigh less than 16 kilograms and can be individually slid forward and back, repositioned sideways, folded into a very small space or removed completely. Similarly, the two rear seats can be folded flat into the floor when not in use. There are up to 39 storage spaces and compartments inside the well-planned interior.

Dodge's new entry-level vehicle is a five-passenger hatchback that replaces the Neon sedan and attempts to be a replacement for the common 4WD wagon too. It has a liftgate and split-folding rear seats. All trim levels use a 4-cylinder engine. The base model is a 2.0-litre with CVT automatic. The larger 2.4-litre is available with either manual or CVT. For 2009, the Caliber SRT-4 model was quietly released, with a 2.4-litre turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual. Available features include a fold-flat front passenger seat, refrigerated glovebox, and removable cargo light/flashlight. Unique features include oddities such as flip-down speakers when the liftgate is open, illuminated cup-holders and a central armrest that moves front and back. Also available are leather upholstery, nine-speaker Boston Acoustics stereo and alloy wheels. ABS is optional on the base models, and standard on the top trim, where it comes with rear disc brakes instead of drums. A tyre pressure monitor is optional. All Calibers have available front airbags and side airbags.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP-700 4 is the Italian supercar maker's latest flagship model, replacing the 10-year old Murcielago. In 2017, an Aventador S model was introduced. The all-wheel drive Aventador gets a 6.5-litre V12 engine, Lamborghini's only second 12-cylinder plant. The transmission is a 7-speed, single clutch semi-automatic, capable of doing gear shifts in 50 milliseconds. The interior gets a LCD screen, through which you can control audio controls and the navigation system. Driving aids include ABS, electronic brake distribution, anti-slip control, speed-dependent servo-tronic steering, hill start assist and ESP stability control. The rear spoiler and the side air intakes are electronically controlled. The Drive Select System enables vehicle characteristics (engine, transmission, differential, stability control, steering) to be set in three modes Strada (road), Sport and Corsa (track).

While the Impreza sedan's interior and exterior styling are pretty much mainstream, it is the only car in its class with standard full-time all-wheel drive. Subaru likes to tout their rally heritage, but none of the Middle East models are anywhere near rally cars. The Impreza was given a minor facelift for the 2006 model year, including an all-new corporate front-end that reflects Subaru's history as an aircraft builder. The models offered here are the 1.6-litre, known as the 1.6i, and the 2.0-litre, known as the 2.0R. Both have flat four-cylinder "boxer" engines, and both mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. Base models have a standard AM/FM stereo system, cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, central locking and steel wheels, along with dual front airbags. The full-spec 2.0R model features the same full power options, alloy wheels, rear spoiler, ABS brakes, dual front airbags, fog lamps, sunroof and not much else. Only the four-door sedan is officially offered locally.

The Mini is a thrill ride that offers extremely excellent handling, enough to kill exotic cars at twisty tracks. It is also one of the smallest cars on the road and can be parked virtually anywhere. Yet it seats four, though with painfully tight back seats, and it can carry a amount of cargo. Its cute looks still generates smiles years after its introduction. Engineered by BMW, the Mini is a high-quality piece of equipment, boasting a multitude of passive and active safety systems. Convertibles were added to the lineup for 2005 and lasted till 2007. All models were enhanced then with new interior lighting, storage space and trim options, plus revised styling. Models include the Cooper and the supercharged Cooper S, but the base Mini One has been cancelled. The Cooper also comes in Seven, Checkmate and Park Lane trims. All use a 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine, but the S uses a supercharger. Gearbox choices include a manual, CVT and automatic. Standard features include power windows and mirrors, along with a number of airbags. Options for the Cooper S include a John Cooper Works package that bumps up horsepower, and a Sport package that offers DSC, bonnet stripes, 17-inch alloys and xenon headlamps.

General Motors expands their line-up of crossovers with the GMC Terrain, a soft-roader featuring squared-off edges and flared fenders. Technically a compact, it is almost as big as a midsize SUV. There is a choice of two engines, namely a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder and a 3.0-litre V6, both featuring "SIDI" direct injection, a 6-speed automatic, and either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive. The interior features ambient lighting, clever storage spaces, a closed compartment under the center armrest for a notebook binder, four power outlets, optional power liftgate, basic keyless entry with optional remote start, single-zone a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB support, optional 8-speaker premium audio with available 10GB hard drive with DVD and navigation, optioal DVD rear-seat entertainment with two screens, optional power driver's seat, standard rear camera, optional sunroof, common power accessories, cloth or leather upholstery, and a choice of 17-inch, 18-inch and 19-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include stability control, traction control, six standard airbags and ABS disc brakes.

The BMW X6 M got a new model for the 2015 model year. Under the hood, it comes with a twin-turbocharged 4.4-litre V8 engine, mated to a 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. Standard features in the X6 M include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, keyless entry, central locking, Merino leather sports seats,  leather wrapped M-steering wheel with aluminium paddle shifters, leather-wrapped dashboard, Alcantara roof liner, M-branded door sill plates, aluminium trim, contrast stitching, a 4-zone automatic climate control system, Harman Kardon audio system, xenon headlamps and 21-inch alloy wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, curtain airbags, dynamic stability control (DSC), rollover sensors and tyre defect sensors.

For 2009, the previous C-Class Sports Coupe breaks away from the C-Class range and gets its own name. Now dubbed the CLC-Class, the  model gets a new front and rear end, and an upgraded interior. And yes, it is a hatchback, even if the marketing people insist it's a coupe. However, it is still heavily based on the previous C-Class version, and is now being built in Brazil. Starting off the new line-up are two supercharged 1.8-litre engines, in the CLC 180 Kompressor and the CLC 200 Kompressor, at different states of tune. The 2.5-litre V6-powered CLC 230 comes next. The 3.5-litre V6-powered CLC 350 rounds off the range. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers might be hesitant to order one for you. Features include power windows, electric mirrors, cloth or leather upholstery, optional panoramic sunroof, alloy wheels, automatic a/c, keyless entry, CD stereo, sports seats and more.

The Lincoln MKX was an all-new model for 2016 and has been rebadged as the Lincoln Nautilus for 2019, receiving a Navigator-inspired facelift as well. Based on the Ford Edge, but looking nothing like it from the inside or outside, the base model gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged inilne-4 engine, while the higher models get an updated turbocharged 2.7-litre V6 engine, both mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive without low-range gearing. Available features include full-adaptive LED headlights, leather upholstery, rain-sensing wipers, 18-inch or optional 20-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone automatic a/c, power accessories, panoramic glass roof, six-way power-adjustable front seats with heating and cooling, 12.3-inch configurable driver's display, SYNC 3 multimedia touchscreen, optional Revel Ultima audio system with up to 19 speakers, USB and SD card ports, Bluetooth, dual-zone a/c, remote starter, keyless entry with starter button, power-operated tailgate and more. Standard safety features include Advance Trac with Roll Stability Control, front and side airbags, Safety Canopy side-curtain airbags with rollover detection, hill start assist, tyre pressure monitor and ABS, as well as blind-spot monitor, 360 degree and rear camera, adaptive cruise control with collision warning and brake support, and cross-traffic detection.

The Isuzu MU-X is the brand's only SUV offering. It is basically a rebadged Chevrolet Trailblazer, but with a diesel engine. It gets the 2.5-litre turbodiesel engine, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.Features on the higher trim levels include 16-inch alloys, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more.

Toyota revealed an all-new model of the RAV-4 in 2019. New engines have been introduced to the line-up, along with an hybrid model. Under the hood, the 2.5-litre engine carried over into the Toyota RAV-4, but connected with a new 8-speed automatic transmission. In KSA, the base model gets a 2.0-litre engine, mated to a CVT. The hybrid model comes with an electric motor coupled with a 2.5-litre engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features on the RAV-4 include power windows, central locking, keyless entry, fabric seats, halogen headlamps, 9-inch infotainment screen with 4 speakers, rear view camera and 17-inch alloy wheels. The higher trims get 18-inch alloy wheels, moonroof and LED fog lamps. Safety features include front, side and knee airbags, vehicle stability control, traction control, and ABS.

All new Kia Rio came out for the 2018 model year. It is a slightly larger car from its predecessor so interior room has marginally gone up as well. Two 4-cylinder engines are available on the front-wheel drive 2021 Kia Rio sedan - one a 1.4-litre and the other a 1.6-litre. Standard features on the Rio include power steering, power windows, central locking, halogen lamps, manual A/C, fabric seats, USB port and 15-inch steel wheels. Higher models get a 5.0-inch touchscreen audio system, 3.5-inch LCD screen on the instrument cluster, automatic A/C, leather seats, fog lamps and 15 inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Safety features on the 2021 Kia Rio include ABS, front driver and passenger airbags, stability control, electronic brake distribution and brake assist.

The attractive GranTurismo is derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is a pure Italian, given its Ferrari-developed engine and mechanicals, powered by a 4.2-litre V8 mated to a 6-speed automatic that adjusts to individual driving styles. A Sport version ups the ante with a 4.7-litre V8, which can either mated to a Electro-Actuated MC Shift or an optional MC-Shift automanual transmission. A lighter GranTurismo MC Stradale is also available, which has some exterior modifications to improve aerodynamics. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. This two-door 2+2 coupe is a grand tourer rather than an all-out sports car, but still offers a balanced drive thanks to an optimal 49:51 weight distribution and sporting suspension. It is fitted with an automatic gearbox and equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The 2016 Mazda 2 is a new generation model. It is a hatchback and now uses its own "Skyactiv" chassis and engine. The Mazda 2 gets a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine. Mated to a new 6-speed automatic transmission, the front-wheel-drive Mazda 2 comes with standard features such as electric power steering, front discs and rear drum brakes, CD stereo, keyless entry, single-zone a/c and 14-inch steel wheels with hubcaps. LED headlights, fog lamps, leather seats, heads-up display, rear spoiler and 16-inch alloys are some of the optional features. Standard safety features include ABS with electronic brake-force distribution and dual front airbags. The top-spec model gets 6 airbags.

Hyundai's first ever rear-wheel-drive sports car, the Genesis Coupe is a 2+2 seater that has quickly earned some respect in the affordable performance category. The Genesis Coupe is based on the same rear-drive platform as found under the full-size Genesis sedan, but with almost five inches chopped out of the wheelbase. The Coupe features a MacPherson strut dual-link front suspension and a five-link rear suspension. The GCC-spec Genesis Coupe will only be available as a fully-optioned V6 automatic model. That means the two-door coupe will come with power windows, electric mirrors, 18-inch wheels, leather seats, cruise control, sunroof, HID headlights, 10-speaker Infinity audio and Brembo brakes. The 3.8-litre V6 engine is mated to a 6-speed automatic. The V6 manual and the base turbo 4-cylinder engine, as sold in other overseas markets, will not be offered as of now. While details on this limited-import model are vague, safety features should at least include dual front airbags, ABS and stability control.

For 2015, the Mercedes-Benz E-Class received a massive facelift. From heavily-revised exterior styling to a redesigned interior, the refreshed E-Class looked more like an overhauled model. While the E 200, E 250, E 350, and E 500 continued life in its newer form, the older E 300 was replaced by the E 400. The E 200 and E 250 get a turbocharged 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine. The E 350 is fitted with a 3.5-litre V6 engine, while the new E400 came with a turbocharged 3.0-litre V6 engine. The E 500 has a 4.7-litre under the hood. They all have a 7-speed automatic transmission. The E-Class Coupe has much of the same features as the sedan, but in a 2-door format.  An AMG sports package is also available to dress up the standard coupe models. Of course, that doesn't help the interior, which harks backs to Mercedes-Benz models of the early 80s, with squared-off dash panels and boring trim detailing. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, depending on model, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, cloth or leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. The E-Class also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

The Honda CR-V is roomy little 4WD that is convenient and easy to drive on the streets, but no hero on the rough stuff. There lots of stuff in it and the back seats are quite comfortable. It rides as smoothly as a car, especially since it is based on the Civic. It offers the cargo versatility of a sport utility, an upright seating position, and all-wheel drive. Besides being less expensive, the CR-V is smaller and more maneuverable than a full-sized 4WD. The styling was revised for 2005. The CR-V comes with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder engine lifted from the Accord, now with only a five-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include air conditioning with micron filtration, AM/FM/CD/cassette stereo with 6-CD changer, an adjustable steering column, power mirrors, power windows, front and rear power outlets and a removable folding picnic table, along with front airbags, integrated keyless entry and 16-inch steel wheels. Aluminium alloy wheels are available, as is a moonroof, leather and cruise control.

Launched back in 2001, redone mechanically in 2004, and facelifted in 2007, the S60 is tuned to be a sports sedan, but though it is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis in all but the R model, it looks like a sleek sports coupe from afar. The interior is fairly spacious even with the swooping roofline, and it offers more of a midsize package than a compact one, even though it is occassionally pitted against smaller German rivals in comparisons. For the Middle East market, there are five powerplants. These include a basic 2.0-litre turbo and a 2.5-litre turbo for the run-of-the-mill S60 sedan models, a 2.4-litre turbo for the sporty front-wheel-drive T5 and a highly-tuned 2.5-litre turbo for the all-wheel-drive S60 R. All engines are five-cylinder, and have an automatic with tiptronic, although some can be had with a manual too. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection.

The Dakota is a mid-size pickup with a full-size attitude, as Dodge likes to brag, and they are not far from the truth. The Dakota is the largest pickup in its class and the only mid-size truck available with a V8. The Dakota looks big, thanks to a complete redesign recently, making it larger than before and making it look almost as big and tough as the full-size Dodge Ram. The standard engine is a 3.7-litre V6. It comes with a six-speed manual transmission. An optional four-speed automatic is available on the higher trim levels. A 4.7-litre V8 engine is available for all models. A "high-output" version of the 4.7-litre V8 is also available on the higher models. With either V8, a six-speed manual transmission is standard, while a five-speed automatic is optional. Two available transfer cases, either full-time or part-time, are available on the 4WD models. Available steering wheel mounted audio controls allow easy control of the standard AM/FM/Cassette radio or the optional AM/FM/CD radio with eight speakers.

Porsche released a facelifted 991.2-generation 911 GT3 sometime in early 2017. Changes made from the earlier 991.1-generation 911 GT3 are the engine and the spoiler, which is 20% taller along with the front bumper and the exhaust system. The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4.0-litre racing engine, upgraded to have the same power as a GT3 RS now. Another change from the 991.1 is the introduction of the spoiler-less touring version that includes a manual transmission, along with the regular version that has a choice between manual and PDK transmissions. The slightly-lighter 991-gen 911 GT3 RS remains unchanged since its debut in 2016, and continues with only a PDK automatic, but it also comes with functions such as declutching by "paddle neutral", and a Pit Speed limiter button. As with the 911 GT3, there is rear-axle steering and Porsche Torque Vectoring Plus with fully variable rear axle differential lock. The GT3 RS was discontinued after 6500 units were built sometime in 2017. The regular GT3 comes with a full interior, including a touchscreen multimedia system, auto a/c, a full set of airbags and other safety features.

An all-new Chrysler 200 model debuted for 2015. It gets a new Alfa-Romeo based chassis and the new 9-speed automatic transmission. Under the hood, the new Chrysler 200 will have two engines to choose from. One will be a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and the other will be the 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 unit. The base 200 LX model comes with the cloth upholstery, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, cruise control and manual a/c. The mid-range 200 Touring model adds 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone auto a/c, leather-wrapped steering wheel, trip computer, power driver's seat and 6-speaker stereo, with available options such as remote start, sunroof and voice-controlled UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and hard-drive. The top 200 Limited model adds a V6 engine, exterior chrome trim, 18-inch alloys, auto up/down windows, auto-dimming rearview mirror and leather upholstery. All models get standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, alarm and a tyre-pressure monitoring system.

The SC 430 switches from luxury hardtop coupe to open roadster at the touch of a button. Dropping the power hardtop turns it into a true convertible, but the SC is far from a sporting vehicle. Its exterior and interior were freshened for 2006. This rear-wheel drive car is powered by a 4.3-litre V8 engine mated to a new six-speed automatic transmission and soft comfort-biased suspension. It comes as one model that features a power retractable hardtop, soft leather with wood and chrome accents, a navigation system and a Mark Levinson audio with nine speakers, 6-CD changer, a/c system that auto-adjusts temperature for top-up and top-down, eight-way power adjustable front seats with memory function, power door mirrors, Bluetooth mobile phone, HID headlamps with adaptive front-lighting system and auto-leveling system, LED tail lamps, rear spoiler, front and rear corner sensors, and 18-inch aluminium wheels. Safety features include dual front & side airbags, whiplash injury lessening concept seats, ABS brakes with EBD and Brake Assist, Vehicle Stability Control, traction control, and a tyre pressure warning system.

The Suzuki Vitara is a completely new model, making its debut in the GCC in 2016. Smaller, lighter and losing its offroad capabilities, the new Vitara is designed to compete in the road-going crossover segment and is a separate vehicle line from the existing Grand Vitara. It is only available as a 5-door wagon, and gets a 1.6-litre engine, mated to either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 6-speed automatic transmission. It is available in both two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive. In the UAE, two trims are available, the GLX and GLX+, all of which come with automatic transmission as standard. Standard features include power steering, power mirrors, central locking, keyless push start system, sunroof, LED daytime running lamps, leather seats, cruise control,  automatic A/C, roof rails, front & rear parking sensors, front skid plate, chrome front grille and alloy wheels. The higher GLX+ model gets panoramic roof and polished aluminium wheels. Standard safety features include 6 airbags, electronic brake distribution (EBD), ABS and brake assist.

The Foton View C1 minibus is the Chinese manufacturer's light commercial van offering. It is sold in select GCC countries. Only the 2.2-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine is sold in this region. Standard features include power steering, manual mirrors, manual windows, central locking, fabric seats, manual front and rear A/C, radio with USB and 15-inch steel rims with hubcaps.

The Grandis is a slick minivan that offers buyers a genuine three-row seating configuration to take the kids to school and pick up their buddies at picnics on the weekend, but without the higher running costs associated with a 4WD alternative thanks to their small 4-cylinder engines and car-like demeanour. It is also interesting to note that this people mover forego sliding rear doors in favour of a car-like 4-door configuration. The MPV is kitted out with a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine, andÂ  gets a standard 4-speed automatic with manual shift capability, transferring its engine power to the ground via the front wheels. With seating for seven, standard safety features include front airbags, though front side and curtain airbags are optional. Also standard are ABS-assisted disc brakes, rear a/c and power windows and mirrors. Options include such niceties as dual sunroofs, leather, CD changer and more. Just be ready to be mistaken for a professional van driver on the streets, even though the Grandis is far too good to be a commercial vehicle.

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The T-Series, also known as the Chevy LUV sometimes, is a range of light pickup trucks that are actually rebadged models from Isuzu. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, and for entertainment, there is a solid radio cassette player to play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are these nifty stickers along the sides that hint at the T's non-sporting intentions. On a serious note, if these things came with a bigger engine and an automatic gearbox, we'd totally buy one in black, outfit it with big wheels, slap on some black-out tint and build a cheap blingmobile to cruise the streets in style.

Based on the E-Class platform, the Mercedes-Benz CLS continues the trend of offering a repackaged midsize luxury sedan in a prettier suit. Facelifted for 2015, the CLS 63 AMG comes with a 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 and a 7-speed automatic mated to a rear-wheel-drive base. For 2018, there are no changes. Standard features include leather upholstery, active parking assist, memory electric front seats, COMAND multimedia system, electric rear-window blinds, automatic a/c and LED exterior running lamps, sunroof, active shape-shifting front seats with fans, rear camera, intelligent keyless entry, DVD changer, Harman Kardon stereo, TV tuner and more. The CLS 63 AMG can be had with a limited-slip rear diff, adjustable suspension, carbon-fibre trim inside and out, ceramic brakes and other optional items at extra cost, including an AMG performance package that adds additional horsepower.

The Gelaendewagen first debuted in 1979 as a utilitarian offroader and as military transport. In 1990, it got its first major revamp, upgrading it to luxury specs, but retaining its classic looks. Its boxy styling was again left alone during the 1997 update, which introduced a new range of engines, updated again and again over the years until its next major update in 2007. The trademark clean-cut, sharp lines have already made the G-Wagen a cult classic. The G-Class represents pure off-road driving pleasure. It is among the elite few off-roaders that combine comfortable surroundings with a complete suite of off-road equipment. The model range includes a five-door wagon, a three-door wagon and a limited-edition soft-top version of the three-door.  The only petrol engine debuting in 1997 was the 3.2-litre V6 in the G 320, alongside various diesel motors. The 5.0-litre V8-powered G 500 debuted in 1998. In 2003 came the first AMG model, namely the 5.5-litre G 55 AMG. This was replaced in 2004 by the upgraded supercharged 5.4-litre G 55 AMG Kompressor. Along the way came turbodiesel models, such as the G 320 CDI in 1997 and the G 400 CDI in 2000. Standard specifications include permanent four-wheel drive with an off-road reduction gear plus the electronically controlled traction system 4ETS, and three differential locks which can be operated at the push of a button. Stability control was added in 2001, and while dual front airbags are available, there are no side airbags. The G-Class is built for Mercedes-Benz by Magna Steyr in Austria, and has been since 1979.

The C8 is an interesting new addition to the midsize people mover market. It drives like a car and has the utility of a 4WD. The regional market gets a 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine, mated to an automatic. Available features include twin sliding anti-trap rear side doors than can be electronically controlled individually from the key fob, a panoramic interior mirror for viewing the interior, seatback tables, up to three individually controllable climate zones, power outlets for running TVs and Playstations, and numerous other storage holes. It has a walk-through cabin that allows front passengers to snake their way between the front seats to the back. The seats are versatile, and you can fold them, remove them or move them around. The dashboard is a funky design, with main dials are in the centre and the tripmeter on the steering column. There are numerous airbags, seven three-point belts and enough safety features to make the C8 a safe bet.

European motorcycle-maker KTM, introduced their first ever car with the X-Bow. KTM basically transferred its principles from two wheels to four, with a track-biased car that can be driven on the street. But KTM developers have kept the weight of the vehicle extremely light by removing everything that is not needed, including body panels, doors and a windshield. Parts of the suspension are intentionally visible. Built on a carbon-fibre chassis, a 'crash box' in the front nose absorbs collision energy, while roll bars are integrated into the structure, which is all good considering there are no airbags. An options kit is available on request which includes having additional struts mounted at designated points. The Audi-sourced 4-cylinder FSI turbo engine is made of aluminium and mated to a 6-speed manual or an optional 6-speed DSG automanual transmission. Brembo brakes, a limited-slip differential, and four-point seat-belts round out the standard package. There are no electronic driving aids, no power steering and no roof, although a cloth tarpaulin is available to cover the interior when not in use.

The Mitsubishi Mirage hopes to take on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. The hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

The Mitsubishi Lancer Fortis arrived to finally replace the 'regular' Lancer, a massive rental favourite in the GCC. However, this time the engine in the offered in the Lancer Fortis will actually move the car, a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features include fabric cloth seats, CD player with AM/FM radio and MP3 support, halogen lamps, power windows, power mirrors, disc brakes front and back, and steel wheels. Optional equipment include alloy wheels and fog lamps. Standard safety features include driver and passenger airbags.

The Yaris is Toyota's replacement for the goofy Echo. But the Yaris is a much better basic transportation option than the Echo ever was. The Yaris actually looks somewhat stylish even though it is still a pudgy little car, but it offers perky performance and an interior that looks great, but is devoid of soft-touch materials. The hatchback comes with a very weak 1.3-litre mated to either a five-speed manual or a four-speed auto. Standard items include power steering, a tilt-adjustable steering wheel, front and rear cupholders, two airbags, radio cassette player, 14-inch steel wheels, and ABS brakes. The suspension is independent in front and torsion beam in the rear. Options include a CD player with MP3 capability, a 60/40 split fold-down rear seat, 15-inch alloy wheels and a rear spoiler.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It got a second major facelift in 2020, along with additional new tech inside. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in three trim levels, namely Comfortline, Trendline and Highline, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level Comfortline features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, 60/40 folding rear seat, infotainment system with touch screen, Apply CarPlay, Android Auto, MirrorLink, electronic vehicle immobilisation and 16-inch alloy wheels. The Comfortline model includes a leather steering wheel, 2 USB ports, automatic climate control with dual zone, rearview camera and 17-inch alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the CL and TL models, the Highline has leatherette sports seats, high-end sound system with a subwoofer in the boot, LED headlights with light assist, electric driver seat adjustment, sunroof and 18-inch alloy wheels .  Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise.

The attractive GranCabrio is convertible version of the GranTurismo, derived from a shortened Quattroporte platform. The sizeable GranTurismo is offered with a 4.7-litre V8, mated to a 6-speed MC-Shift automanual. The cloth roof drops electrically in 28 seconds and this can be done on the move at speeds of up to 30 kph. Everything can be customised, including the interior, which can be had in a choice of 10 colours, accented by either wood or body-colour trim. It is equipped with an adaptive control system which adjusts the gear-shifting mode to the driving style and conditions. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats, alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes, stability control and more.

The Honda Odyssey J is a smaller Japanese version of the larger US-built Odyssey. It gets the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. It has been facelifted for 2018 with a new grille, new front bumper with available LED running lights and fog lights, and new 17-inch wheels. Two trims are available - the EX and EX-V. The EX offers three rows of seats for 8 people, while the EX-V provides seating for 7 people, as it has 2 separate middle-row seats for easy access to the third-row. Base EX grade gets fabric seats, halogen lamps, touch-screen infotainment system, cruise control, 6 speakers, auto AC and 16-inch rims. The higher EX-V model get LED headlights, daytime running lamps, leather seats, independent front and rear A/C, engine start/stop button, sunroof, bodykit and 17-inch rims. Other new features include a touch-panel for a/c controls, rear camera and more. Safety features include 6 airbag, Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA), Anti-Lock Brake Systems (ABS), Electronic Brake Distributor (EBD) and Hill Start Assist (HSA). For 2018, the EX-V additionally gets the Honda Sensing suite of active safety features that include Adaptive Cruise Control, Collision Mitigation Braking System, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Road Departure Mitigation System (RDM), Blind Spot Information System, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Pedestrian Detection System and Lane Keeping Assist System.

The Fiat Fiorino is a compact commercial vehicle offering by the Italian brand. The Turkish-built Fiorino comes with a turbocharged 1.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual. Standard features include power steering, sliding side door, foldable passenger seat, adjustable driver's seat, heat reflecting windows, radio with CD/MP3 player, and ABS. It has 2.8 cubic-metre volume of cargo space with a 600 kg payload capacity.

MG 3 is a 5-door hatchback to compete in the sub-compact category. It comes with two 4-cylinder engine choices, either a 1.3-litre or a 1.5-litre, both mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power steering, power windows, light-on warning, high mounted stop lamp, fabric seats, radio with SD/USB/AUX support with 4 speakers and 14-inch steel wheels. Optional features include rear parking sensors, exhaust tips, radio with CD/MP3/USB/AUX support and 6 speakers, multi-function steering wheel and 15-inch alloy rims. Standard safety features include both driver and passenger airbag, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD) and cornering brake control (CBC).

The rear-wheel-drive H1 is marketed as a contender in the minivan market for families, assuming you are looking just for obscene lot of space. It received a major makeover for 2008, and while its cabin has improved considerably, it appeals more to corporate groups as staff transportation rather than the jalopy of choice for large families who would like to travel in style and comfort. Still, Hyundai is promoting it as such. Powered by a 2.4-litre four-cylinder, it is available in various configurations, ranging from a 3-seater all the way to a 12-seater. The top spec is actually a 9-seater with power front windows, electric mirrors, an automatic gearbox and a two-tone paint job. The other models don't get any of those features, and manage with a manual gearbox. All trims get power steering, radio cassette player and air-conditioning with rear vents. Boasting uniquely configurable seats and extensive luggage space, other standard features include cloth seat coverings, while options include central door locks and front fog lamps. A driver's airbag is optional, and only the top 9-seater trim gets dual airbags.

The five-door Leon is arguably the sportiest model in the Seat line-up, and the best interpretation of the new Seat design language yet. Named after a Spanish city, yet based on the VW Golf, the Leon offers an array of engines, including a 1.6-litre, a 2.0-litre and three turbocharged 2.0-litre units, all from Volkswagen. Depending on model, there are manual, automatic or DSG automanual gearboxes available. Standard features include power front windows, electric mirrors, cloth upholstery, keyless entry, ABS brakes, traction control, electronic stability control and anti-slip regulation. Also available are front airbags, side and curtain airbags, a tyre pressure sensor, electric mirrors and a quality CD audio system. Basic models get 16-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, while climbing up the model range allows for 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. Options include special upholstery, cruise control, onboard computer, rear power windows and side mirror with electric parking position. The sporty FR gets the first turbo engine, sports seats, lowered suspension and other trim bits. The Cupra carries the FR concept further with an upgraded turbo engine and a body kit, among other changes. The Cupra R replaced the Cupra later on with more power.

An all-new Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG made its debut as a 2014 model year. Slightly taller and wider, the new S65 features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S65 AMG comes with a twin-turbocharged 6.0-litre V12 engine. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S65 AMG gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S65 AMG gets "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The 2016 Audi Q7 got some changes to the exterior, as well as weighing up to 325 kg lighter than the previous generation. The Q7 is larger in all dimensions than its relatives, and is named after its Quattro all-wheel drive system. The Q7 has a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 "TFSI" engines. There is a 4.2-litre turbodiesel V8 and a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V12 "TDI" engine available for order as well, for whatever reason. Features include seven-passenger seating which can be optioned to six-passenger by changing the second-row bench to two individual seats. Standard features include bi-Xenon headlamps, leather seating surfaces, MMI computer with colour screen, in-dash six-CD changer and Bose premium sound system. It comes standard in 18-inch alloy wheels, which can go up to 21-inch alloy wheels, while optional equipment include three-panel panorama sunroof, advanced parking system with rearview camera, keyless lock and ignition system, and parking sensors. Standard safety features include adjustable speed limiter, rest recommendation and the safety system "Audi pre sense city". At city speeds it warns the driver of impending collisions with other vehicles or pedestrians and will initiate heavy braking in an emergency. If the collision is inevitable, the multicollision brake assist system uses controlled braking maneuvers during the accident to aid the driver. This can help to prevent the car from skidding and thus additional collisions. The optional "Audi pre sense basic" initiates preventive protective measures for the occupants in instable driving states, such as tightening of the front seat belts. Optional solutions are bundled in the packages "Parking", "City" and "Tour". The "Parking" package includes the surround view camera and the park assist system, which autonomously steers the car backwards into parallel and perpendicular parking spots. The driver only has to apply the brakes and the gas. The "City" package comprises new systems. The cross-traffic assist warns the driver of other vehicles when driving slowly in reverse, such as when pulling out from a perpendicular parking spot. The exit warning system indicates vehicles or cyclists approaching from the rear before the door is opened.  "Audi side assist" uses radar measurements behind the car to ensure safe lane changes. "Audi pre sense rear" tensions the seat belts in the event of an impending collision from behind. The parking system plus and the reversing cameras round out the "City" package.

The Japanese-built Tiida has been replaced by a Mexican-built version for the 2011 model year, the benefits of which include a lower price and more available features. Available as a 5-door hatchback or a 4-door sedan, the new-for-2011 Tiida is available with a standard 1.8-litre four-cylinder engine, with a 6-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. There is good head room and even tall passengers will find rear seat legroom as good as that in many much larger cars. Two trim levels are available, namely the 1.8S and the 1.8SL. Standard features on the 1.8S include electric power steering, tilt steering column, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch steel wheels, a/c with micro filter, trip computer and a CD/MP3 stereo with AUX input. Moving up the range to a 1.8SL adds cruise control, front fog lamps, power door mirrors and windows, leather-wrapped steering wheel and a wood-grain interior finish and optional 16-inch alloy wheels, among other items. On the safety front, only a driver-side airbag is standard, while ABS, EBD, Brake-Assist, passenger-side front airbag and side-curtain airbags are all extra-cost options.

The Mitsubishi Mirage hopes to take on the sub-compact category currently being dominated by its Japanese rivals. The hatchback has a tiny 1.2-litre 3-cylinder engine under the hood. The base model has a 5-speed manual, with the option of a CVT in the higher models. Standard features will include cloth seats, AM/FM Radio with a CD-player, painted bumpers and 14-inch steel wheels. Available options on higher-level versions include 15-inch alloy wheels, body-colour exterior trim, electric power steering, trip computer, split-folding rear bench, power windows, keyless entry, rear wiper, fog lamps and two types of CD/MP3 stereo with optional USB port. Standard safety features include ABS and a driver-side front airbag, with a passenger-side one available in higher trims.

The Mercedes-Benz E 63 AMG was changed in 2010, with an all new design. However the engine carried on from the previous generation but with slightly more power from the monster 6.2-litre V8 engine, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. A multimedia computer is now awkwardly integrated into the dashboard, with a controller on the centre console. All the usual luxury and safety features are available, such as power windows, electric seats, sunroof, HID headlights, front airbags, side-curtain airbags, LED running lights, leather upholstery, Bluetooth phone, adaptive cruise control, and more. It also features over 70 sensors whose sole purpose is to ensure the driver's physical well-being, such as drowsiness monitors, night-vision, automatic braking and other electronic gimmickry.

An all-new Volvo S60 came out as a 2020 model in the GCC. It is the first ever Volvo to be built in the United States. The S60 straddles the line between compact and midsize. In 2021, the petrol engine available was 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder mild hybrid engine. The cabin features extensive soft-touch materials and Volvo's tablet-style infotainment system in a choice of wood, metal and graphite colours. Base features include cloth upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, alloy wheels, front and side-curtain airbags, keyless entry with starter motor and more. The higher models gets larger wheels, leather, navigation, adaptive cruise control, blind-spot monitor, adaptive HID headlights, sunroof and more. Volvo's unique 'City Safety' feature is standard, whereby the system brakes by itself to avoid hitting cars and pedestrians.

The Accent is Hyundai's long-running sub-compact nameplate, though it could be more successful than it is. The new model is a decent upgrade over the old Accent, though still using lightly-modifed carryover engines. Now available in 5-door sedan and 3-door hatchback form in this region, the most basic Accent thankfully comes with power steering, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio and cassette player with 4 speakers and a 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine with a manual or automatic gearbox at a dirt-cheap price. Step up to the higher models, and buyers are treated to a 1.6-litre four-cylinder with a manual or an automatic, power windows, central door locks, electric mirrors, fog lamps, better cloth seats, a 60/40 split-folding rear seat with centre armrest and cup holders, and not much else. An agreeably spacious interior and steel 14-inch wheels with plastic covers are standard on all trim levels, but there is no mention of airbags or ABS brakes in the spec sheet on cars bound for the Middle East market.

The Ford Escape gets a completely new design for the 2013 model. Slightly longer than the previous model and ditching the V6 motor, the new shape will arrive in the GCC with just the 2.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission and only front-wheel-drive for now. The interior will also receive a major upgrade as it will have the Microsoft SYNC entertainment system we have all come to expect in all Fords. The  Escape comes standard with cloth seats, power door locks, windows and mirrors, tilt steering column, speed controls on the steering wheel, 17-inch alloy wheels and electric power steering.  Upgrades include premium cloth upholstery or leather, power front seats, a power moonroof, cruise control, fog lamps, 18-inch alloy wheels and parking sensors. Escape comes standard with front, side and curtain airbags, ABS brakes and AdvanceTrac with Roll Stability Control. It might get all-wheel-drive in the future, and has decent ground clearance, but it will not have the low range gearing to tackle serious turf.

New from the ground up, the all-new Chrysler Pacifica builds on the styling cues started by the failed Chrysler 200 sedan, and replacing the aging Chrysler Grand Voyager. In 2022, it got a facelit and more modern tech inside. It comes with a 3.6-litre V6, a 9-speed automatic and front-wheel-drive. The Pacifica offers 7-seater capacity (or 8 seats optionally), with a folding/collapsible second-row “Stow ‘n Go” seats, and a 60/40-split folding third-row seat. Available with sizeable 17-inch, 18-inch or 20-inch alloys, it aims to be a bit more premium than the usual minivan offerings. Options include two 10-inch multimedia touchscreens with built-in travel games, an 8.4-inch UConnect touchscreen up front, Blu-Ray player, a built-in vacuum cleaner, power sliding doors, power tailgate with hands-free operation, LED running lights and taillights, standard 3-zone automatic climate control, cooled front seats, two large sunroofs and an automated parallel/perpendicular parking system, aside from all the usual standard luxury trappings such as power windows, Bluetooth, cruise control and smart keyless start, although all features may not be offered in all markets. Stereo options include 6-speaker, 13-speaker and 20-speaker choices, the last one being Harmon Kardon. The models with the rear screens also get tons of USB and HDMI ports for rear passengers. Standard safety equipment includes stability control, ABS, front, front-side and curtain airbags as well as front knee airbags, and a rearview camera (although rear parking sensors are missing in the base model). The ABS can also dry the brake rotors in rainy conditions. Safety options include automatic braking for forward collision mitigation, blind-spot monitoring, rear-cross traffic alert and adaptive cruise control.

The MG RX5 is the Chinese-British brand’s offering of a compact crossover. There will be a choice of two well-equipped trims with two available powertrains, namely a 1.5-litre with a 7-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic, both turbocharged. The front-wheel-drive 2019 MG RX5 is available with LED headlamps, two-tone 18-inch rims, high-quality cabin finish including soft-touch surfaces, opening panoramic sunroof, adjustable fold-flat rear seats with split/fold function, power tailgate, keyless entry, a start button and an auto-hold brake function. A remote smart app allows the driver to operate vehicle functions such as remote start and stop air conditioning, vehicle tracking and aftersales appointments, even reminding owners of the services needed for the car. There is a 10.4-inch high-definition infotainment touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and navigation on the 2.0T version and an 8-inch colour navigation system for 1.5T models. The 2019 MG RX5 comes with standard ESP and traction control, a curving braking control system and more. Passive safety features include a strengthened body structure that uses thermal formed steel, multiple airbags, automatic unlocking in the event of a collision and a collapsible steering column, all of which has helped the MG RX5 earn a 5-star rating in the Chinese C-NCAP crash tests.

The XF luxury-sports sedan is still based on the previous S-Type's mechanicals, but is still a real step forward towards competing in the real world. While Jaguar is owned by India-based Tata now, the XF was the last car developed under Ford ownership. For 2013, the engines include a new turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder, a new supercharged 3.0-litre V6, and the carryover supercharged 5.0-litre V8 for the XFR. All engines are mated to a 8-speed automatic with manual-shift capability. The most interesting feature of the car is its simplistic interior which consists of toys such as a rotary-dial gear selector and hideway a/c vents. Depending on model, features include power seats with memory, a split-folding rear seat, automatic dual-zone climate control, trip computer, sunroof and adaptive cruise control. Safety features include stability and traction control, ABS brakes and numerous airbags. Other available features include satellite navigation, in-dash 7-inch screen, power-adjustable foot pedals, self-leveling xenon headlights, rain-sensing wipers, front and rear parking sensors, leather upholstery, keyless entry and start, and other options. The audio unit comes with 30GB of storage and a standard 400-watt system, an optional 600-watt system, or a 1200-watt system which features 17-speakers with subwoofer from Bowers & Wilkins, also as an option. The XFR gets unique bumpers, skirts, wheels and interior upholstery, as well as sportier suspension and drivetrain components.

The 300C's unique styling and engineering combines pieces from the Mercedes-Benz parts bin with doodles from Chrysler's American design studios. Marking the Chrysler brand's return to a rear-wheel-drive, V8 powered automobiles for the first time in decades, the 300C pays homage to the first letter-series Chrysler 300s, which where popular in the 60s for their performance and prestige. With a unique shape to stand out with, the interior continues the theme of the exterior, with distinctive materials and textures. The 300C also marked the return of the Hemi V8 engine to the Chrysler brand since the 1960s. The 6.1-litre V8-powered SRT-8 models is available in many GCC markets, mated to a 5-speed automatic transmission. The SRT8 gets larger 20-inch alloy wheels, sports leather seats, a mild body kit and sports suspension. All models feature front and side airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Ford Ecosport is a new addition to the American brand's increasingly international line-up. Built in several countries around the world, this little crossover comes from India for the GCC market. In 2018, it got a facelift. The standard engine in the 2019 Ford Ecosport is a simple 1.5-litre 4-cylinder mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 6-speed automatic gearbox, and it only comes in front-wheel-drive form with SUV-like ground clearance. Measuring only a little more than a sub-compact hatchback in length, the Ecosport seats five, with a small boot behind the sideways-opening tailgate. Standard features on the base 2019 Ford Ecosport Ambiente trim include a 2-way manual-adjustable driver's seat, 60:40-split folding rear seat, electric power steering, front-disc rear-drum brakes, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, power windows, front floor mats, adjustable steering column, rear wiper, rear fog lamp, cooled glovebox, basic keyless entry, and 15-inch steel wheels with covers or optional 16-inch alloys. The mid-range 2019 Ford Ecosport Trend trim adds a 4-way manual-adjustable driver's seat, additional storage spaces, 6-speaker stereo, voice-activated SYNC multimedia system, USB port, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, one-touch function on power windows, standard 16-inch alloys, body-colour trim, light-coloured grille, front fog lamps, roof rack, and cruise control with the optional automatic transmission. The top 2019 Ford Ecosport Titanium model additionally gets a lumbar-adjustable driver's seat with armrest, standard automatic gearbox, unique 16-inch alloys, Bluetooth, extra map lights, climate control, rain-sensing front wipers, auto headlights, smart keyless entry with starter button, extra power-point in the boot, rear floor mats, rear parking sensors, chrome grille, silver roof rack, trip computer, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and a seatbelt warning for front passengers, with optional features such as leather upholstery and soft-touch door armrests. All versions get dual front airbags, ABS, stability control and engine immobiliser, with the Trend and Titanium further getting side and curtain airbags as well as a perimeter alarm. Optional accessories include roof-rack crossbars, spare wheel cover, metal pedal covers, carpeted floor mats, rear spoiler, mud guards and more.

The Hyundai Grand Santa Fe is basically a larger version of the regular Santa Fe, with a bigger boot. In 2017, it got a facelift with restyled headlights and taillights, along with some minor interior upgrades. Powered by a standard 3.3-litre V6, it comes with a 6-speed automatic and either front-wheel-drive on the base model or all-wheel-drive in the rest of the trim levels. In 2019, the Grand Santa Fe  started getting the GDI 3.3-litre V6 engine, bumping up power and slightly improving fuel efficiency. The Grand Santa Fe crossover comes well-equipped in even base trim, including three-row seating, 18-inch alloy wheels, manual a/c, rear spoiler, power mirrors with indicators, rear parking sensors, cruise control, keyless entry, adjustable power steering and 6-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with Bluetooth and USB/AUX ports. The higher-level versions add all-wheel-drive, 19-inch alloys and, depending on trim, chrome door handles, auto a/c, auto headlights with optional HIDs, rear camera, panoramic glass roof, leather, power-adjustable memory front seats, power tailgate, electric parking brake, 4.3-inch multimedia screen, navigation, smart keyless start, compass and rain sensor. All six trim levels get ABS, while 2 airbags are standard on all but the highest two trim levels, which get 6 airbags; and the top two trim levels get stability control.

The new-for-2012 BMW 6-Series Gran Coupe is essentially a 6-Series with four doors on a 5-Series platform. The 640i gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The 650i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto came at the end of 2012. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 6-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport +, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. BMW claims the Gran Coupe is a 4+1 seater, but the rear middle seat offers zero legroom. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inchers, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

Chery Arrizo 5 is the Chinese brand's compact car offering. Under the hood, it features a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a CVT. Standard features in the Arrizo 5 include power steering, power windows, central locking, manual A/C, fabric seats, alloy wheels, LED daytime running lights and LED taillights and turn signals. Optional features include push button engine start-stop and an infotainment system with 7-inch touch screen and SD/USB/Bluetooth device support. Looking at the safety features, it includes ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control, traction control, tyre pressure monitor, hill hold control (HHC), speed-sensitive door-locking, emergency brake alarm and dual airbags in the front.

The Ford F-150 is new from the ground up for 2015. Starting from its redesigned steel ladder-frame chassis, every aspect of the truck is new, including a shift to aluminium body construction and a general push towards "EcoBoost" turbocharged engines. In 2018, it got a facelift, engine upgrades and new transmission. Available in single cab, "SuperCab" quad-cab and "SuperCrew" double-cab body styles, engines on offer in the 2019 Ford F-150 include a 3.5-litre turbo V6 and a 5.0-litre V8, both with 10-speed automatics and power upgrades. Further configurations include a choice of rear-wheel-drive or four-wheel-drive with low-range, while an "FX4" package can add offroad suspension, rear locking diff and skidplates to any model except the base one. Aside from the usual basic features such as power windows, keyless entry and electric mirrors, other features, depending on trim level, include remote tailgate locking and release, unique "BoxLink" tailgate attachment points that accept standard attachments used in moving trucks and trailers, stowable loading ramps that attach to the BoxLink points, optional LED headlights, optional all-around LED lighting including side-mirror "flashlights" and in-bed lighting, 170-degree opening half-doors on SuperCab models, flat rear load floor in SuperCab and SuperCrew cabins, 360-degree camera view, adaptive cruise control, lane-keeping assist, blind-spot warning and even a panoramic sunroof. And it still has that built-in step in its tailgate to climb onto the bed, aside from new pop-out steps on the sides of the bed. Standard safety features in the 2019 Ford F-150 include ABS, ESP, front and side-airbags, and optional rear inflatable belts.

The Lexus LS has been completely redesigned for 2013. However, mechanically it remains the same. There are two models, the LS 460 and the hybrid LS 600h. The LS 460 are all rear-wheel drive and LS 600h is all-wheel drive. The LS 460 has  five models - Premier, F Sport, Prestige, Platinum and Titanium. The Premier and F Sport are the short-wheel base versions, whereas the Prestige, Platinum and Titanium are the long-wheel base models. The all-wheel drive LS 600h has Platinum and Titanium model options. The LS 460 gets a 4.6-litre V8 mated to an eight-speed transmission and the LS 600h has 5.0-litre V8 engine connected to an electric motor and mated to a CVT transmission. Base options include Bi-Xenon HID+halogen headlamps with AFS and daytime running lamps, Smart Entry & Start system, 19-inch alloy wheels, moonroof, blind spot monitor, leather seats, cruise control, HDD navigation system with 12.3-inch screen and DVD player with 10 Speakers. The F-Sport gets bodykit, air suspension, paddle shifters, 19-speaker Mark Levinson audio/DVD system, rear-seat entertainment system with Blue Ray player, lane discipline system and night vision. The higher models get the options of massage seats and a pre-crash safety system.

An all-new Jeep Wrangler came out in 2018.  It is slightly bigger, faster and lighter than the previous generation. The engine has been carried over from the older model, the 3.6-litre V6 “Pentastar” motor. Acceleration and fuel economy numbers have been improved, thanks to the new 8-speed automatic transmission replacing the ancient 5-speed. Manual gear lovers will be left disappointed though, as it is not offered anymore in this region. The electronically assisted steering has replaced the hydraulic steering. The interior has more quality materials than the older model, with the Sahara and Rubicon models getting more of the leather treatment. Even the standard equipment has improved, with the Wrangler Sport getting a touchscreen for the infotainment system. Safety features include four airbags, ABS, stability control, and brake assist. Optional safety features include blind spot monitor, and rear cross path detection.

The Hyundai Kona is a sub-compact crossover with no offroad abilities whatsoever, although it sports black plastic cladding and half-baked roof rails to imitate it. In 2021, a facelift model debuted in the UAE & GCC.
