Powered by either a 2.0-litre with a 6-speed automatic or a turbocharged 1.6-litre with a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic, both 4-cylinder and with either front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, the Kona seems to rival the company's own Creta crossover. Available features include LED running lights and tail lights, alloy wheels, cruise control, and an LCD multimedia touchscreen with Bluetooth, USB, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay and all that. Safety features include at least 2 airbags, ABS with EBD, ESP and a tyre-pressure monitor. It has a 5-star EuroNCAP crash-test rating, but only when equipped with side airbags in full-option trim.

The Dodge Ram 1200 is a commercial pickup offering from the American brand, which is basically a rebadged Mitsubishi L200. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is currently offered here, with an automatic option set to come later. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab.

Big and conservative, the Kia Mohave is supposed to strengthen Kia's "family" SUV line-up and brand image in the world market. With a 3.8-litre V6 engine mated with the 6-speed automatic transmission, the Kia Mohave is characterized by fully-independent air suspension and its various safety systems, including the ABS brakes, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD), brake assist, stability control, traction control, and front and side airbags. Furthermore, the Mohave is equipped with Downhill Assist Control, keeping the vehicle's speed steady while going down straight and strong slopes, while a Hill-Start Assist Control is also available. The Mohave comes with a 600W stereo with six-CD changer, seven-seater capability, cloth or leather trim, DVD player, reverse camera and all the usual power accessories. The Mohave rides on a  truck-like body-on-frame platform and comes with four-wheel-drive and low-range gearing, which allows it to be classified as an off-road vehicle by default.

Named after Ferrari coachbuilder Sergio Scaglietti, the all-aluminum 612 Scaglietti attempts to blend performance and comfort in the tradition of a true Ferrari berlinetta designed to accommodate four people. This Ferrari is a 12-cylinder model with both the space-frame chassis and body panels in aluminium. The overall layout, with the 5.7-litre engine mounted behind the front axle and the gearbox in line with the differential at the rear, ensures an ideally balanced weight distribution, as well as permitting a lower centre of gravity. The performance-orientated handling is enhanced by active damping and a new stability and traction control system, with components from General Motors subsidiaries no less. The 612 runs with a six-speed mechanical gearbox, in a choice of manual or F1-style paddle shifts. With a relatively long wheelbase, the 612 has been designed to offer ease of entry for rear-seat passengers to a luxurious cabin which will accommodate four adults in comfort, while the luggage trunk hold a five-piece Ferrari luggage set or two full sets of golf clubs. Features include a new radio-CD system, voice recognition system, MP3 player, Bluetooth and more.

The CTS builds on Cadillac's push for technology and design innovation, and is a modern interpretation of the striking cars that made Cadillac famous. Built on GM's Sigma rear-wheel-drive architecture, CTS was rigourously tested at the famed Nurburgring racetrack in Germany. The CTS has an entry-level model with a 2.8-litre engine with decent power. The new-for-2005 2.8-litre V6 VVT is a modified version of the better new-for 2004 3.6-litre VVT CTS engine. Braking and suspension capabilities remain the same for both. Both engines can be mated to a six-speed manual transmission, though both are available with the five-speed automatic transmission. The automatic has an engine braking feature in all five gears. The CTS offers a unique exterior and interior, with 16-inch wheels on the base model, going up to 17-inch on this higher models. Standard features include the usual power options and multiple airbags, while available features include navigation, leather and sunroof. Wooden surfaces are used sparingly in the cabin, limited to trimmings on the steering wheel, shifter knob and door pulls. It is a convincing alternative to the Germans, but lacks the overall refinement to fully compete in anything other than in price.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It got a facelift for the 2016 model. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in four trim levels, namely S, SE, SEL and SPORT, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level S is designed specifically for fleet customers, and features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo, 60/40 folding rear seat, and electronic vehicle immobilisation. The SE model includes a six-CD changer, leather steering wheel, rear a/c vents and 16-inch "Carolina" alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the S and SE models, the SEL has 17-inch "Knoxville" alloy wheels, leatherette seats and a high-end Fender sound system with a subwoofer in the boot. A media input with iPod cable is also standard on the SEL, as is a powered driver's seat, front fog and cornering lamps, keyless entry, pushbutton start, a sunroof and dual-zone climatronic air conditioning with air quality sensors. The SPORT model adds part-leather seats, 18-inch "Chattanooga" alloy wheels, touch-screen navigation system, 30GB hard disc, SD card reader and DVD drive, memory function for the driver's seat and a powered front passenger seat. Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise. The R-Line model adds an exterior package which includes side skirts, front bumper and rear diffuser, and "Salvador" 19-inch alloy wheels.

An all-new Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet made its debut back in 2007. In 2010 it received power upgrades and a new automatic gearbox. Under the hood, is the same 3.6-turbocharged flat-6 engine, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed "PDK" automatic transmission. The power unit of the Porsche 911 Turbo features an exhaust gas turbocharger with variable turbine geometry (VTG), which helps increase power. It also gets an updated all-wheel drive management system. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, electric seats, leather upholstery, automatic AC and 19-inch alloy wheels. the Porsche 911 Turbo comes standard with Porsche Communication Management (PCM), including DVD-based navigation. The standard BOSE Surround Sound System comprises 13 speakers and a seven-channel digital amplifier. As an option, PCM may be upgraded through the addition of a telephone module. The PCM also gets a 5.8-inch display. An MP3-compatible CD player is fitted just above the display. Additional standard features on the 911 Turbo include rear-view mirrors with an automatic anti-dazzle function, and a theft warning system monitoring the car with radar sensors for the interior and contact sensors for all the door and lid latches. The Porsche 911 Turbo can be further personalized by additional features including the Park Assistant. Another option in the Porsche 911 Turbo is the Sports Chrono Package Turbo, which includes an Overboost function for even quicker acceleration. By depressing the dash-mounted button to activate the Sport mode, the driver is able to temporarily boost turbocharger pressure in the medium speed range for up to 10 seconds by approximately 2.9 psi (0.2 bar). Safety features include front and side curtain airbags for driver and passenger, traction control, ABS and stability control.

The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe was launched as a 2015 model year. It received a slight facelift in 2018. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 430i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the 440i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic or a six-speed manual transmission. Only real-wheel drive versions will be offered here. The BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe gets "Air Breathers", which are positioned rearwards of the front wheel arches to reduce drag. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Peugeot 301 is the French manufacturer's answer for the budget sub-compact segment. It got a facelift in 2018. It's offered with a 4-cylinder 1.6-litre petrol engine, mated to a 4-speed automatic gearbox. While claiming class-leading cabin and boot space, the Spanish-built saloon offers several convenience and safety features, depending on trim level, including a CD/MP3 stereo, USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cloth upholstery, manual or electric mirrors, power windows, manual or single-zone automatic a/c, rear parking sensors, one or two airbags, ABS with emergency brake-assist system, fog lamps and either 15-inch steel or 16-inch alloy wheels.

The Cadillac ATS Coupe was released at the end of 2014 for the GCC market. The rear-wheel drive coupe is offered only with the 3.6-litre V6. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps.Optional equipment include Cadillac's CUE entertainment system with 10 BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, rearview camera, 18-inch alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard, automatic collision preparationmotorized safety belts, electronic park brake, front and rear automatic braking, blind zone alert, rear cross-traffic alert, and front & passenger airbags and curtain airbags.

The all-new Mercedes-Benz S-Class Coupe made its debut as a 2015 model year, to replace the CL-Class. Slightly taller and wider, the new S-Class Coupe features a front fascia with a bigger front radiator grille and a slanting rear end. The Mercedes-Benz S500 Coupe comes with a turbocharged 4.7-litre V8 engine.. Inside, the traditional instrument cluster from the previous generation is gone and is replaced by two high-resolution 8:3 format colour displays, 12.3-inch in size, for controlling comfort settings and infotainment purposes. Seats are fitted with 14 actuated air bladders in the backrest with six different massage programs. For safety the S-Class Coupe gets "beltbags", which are airbags in the seatbelt webbing, and "cushionbags", which prevent occupants from sliding under the belt. A new climate control, called "thermotronic" features improved filtering of outside air and also an "active perfuming system" for customising the smell of the interior. The new S-Class Coupe gets optional "Magic Body Control" which uses cameras to scan the road in advance and adjust the suspension accordingly. Safety features include Active Parking Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist, Night View Assist Plus, Distronic Plus with Steering Assist, Brake Assist Plus with Cross-Traffic Assist and Pre-Safe Brake with pedestrian recognition.

The all-new M4 Convertible came out as a 2015 model year and is the replacement for the M3 Convertible. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

The Malibu nameplate returns to the GCC for 2010, after almost a decade, although it wasn't missed at all. Unlike its predecessor however, the new Malibu is a highly-competitive entry in the midsize sedan segment, with a clean-sheet design and good features. The new Malibu is a mainstream front-wheel-drive sedan, but aims slightly higher with its chrome trimmings and colourful interior options. Powered by either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.6-litre V6, both are available with a 6-speed automatic offering manual-shift capabilities. Unique features for this segment include standard 18-inch wheels, optional two-tone interior colour schemes, and lots of extra noise-reducing features that make the Malibu's cabin quieter than most. Other features include a CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or digital a/c, and options such as sunroof and cruise control, among others. The V6 is identified by its front foglights and dual exhaust tips. Safety is prioritised with six standard airbags, traction control, tyre pressure monitoring system, four-wheel-disc brakes, ABS and stability control.

The Suzuki Carry is the Japanese brand's commercial pick-up offering. It is designed in Japan but assembled in Indonesia to keep costs low. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Basic options include power steering, radio with CD player, fabric seats, air-conditioning and steel wheels.

An all-new model of the BMW X3 came out for the 2018 model. The X3 xDrive20i and xDrive30i gets a 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder unit, while the X3 M40i gets the 3.0-litre turbocharged inline-6 cylinder engine. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic. Standard features include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support. Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This "compact" pickup has grown substantially for 2013, larger in every dimension, with more cabin and cargo room. The D-Max can only be had in 4-door crew cab form now in the GCC, with a range of 4-cylinder diesel engines, namely a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, a 2.5-litre intercooled turbodiesel, and a 3.0-litre intercooled turbodiesel. The folks who will drive these at work have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional new 5-speed automatic. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms, depending on the engine. Features on the basic 2WD model comes with unpainted bumpers, 15-inch or 16-inch steel wheels, cloth or vinyl seats and manual windows. Features on higher trim levels include 15-inch or 16-inch alloys, painted bumper, chrome rear bumper, higher-grade cloth seats, leatherette-wrapped steering wheel, CD/MP3 stereo, power windows and mirrors, central locking, fog lamps, LED rear lights, optional rear defogger, optional dual front airbags, optional ABS brakes and more. A D-Max GT model was launched in 2014, with the 3.0-litre engine, bumper-skirts, racing stripes, optional 17-inch grey alloys, red-black seats, bedliner and stereo choices.

The VW Passat offered in the GCC is unique in that it's designed and built in the United States specifically for that market, and is larger as well as cheaper than the European version. It got a facelift for the 2016 model. It is currently offered with one 2.5-litre 5-cylinder engine option mated to a 6-speed automatic. Offered in four trim levels, namely S, SE, SEL and SPORT, the 4-door sedan boasts class-leading space and respectable cabin trim. The entry-level S is designed specifically for fleet customers, and features ABS, ESP, dual front airbags, curtain and side thorax airbags, Bluetooth with voice command, multifunction steering wheel with audio and phone controls, cruise control, CD/MP3 stereo, 60/40 folding rear seat, and electronic vehicle immobilisation. The SE model includes a six-CD changer, leather steering wheel, rear a/c vents and 16-inch "Carolina" alloy wheels. In addition to the features seen on the S and SE models, the SEL has 17-inch "Knoxville" alloy wheels, leatherette seats and a high-end Fender sound system with a subwoofer in the boot. A media input with iPod cable is also standard on the SEL, as is a powered driver's seat, front fog and cornering lamps, keyless entry, pushbutton start, a sunroof and dual-zone climatronic air conditioning with air quality sensors. The SPORT model adds part-leather seats, 18-inch "Chattanooga" alloy wheels, touch-screen navigation system, 30GB hard disc, SD card reader and DVD drive, memory function for the driver's seat and a powered front passenger seat. Other features include tyre-pressure sensors, insulating glass and a special acoustic film integrated into the windscreen to help keep out external noise. The R-Line model adds an exterior package which includes side skirts, front bumper and rear diffuser, and "Salvador" 19-inch alloy wheels.

The Fiesta is a pint-sized runabout, and looks funny next to the Crown Victoria, but it is a product of Ford's European effort. Released for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, the Fiesta is built in Germany and few in this region know about this. Even fewer have even heard of this car. The Fiesta is a bestseller in Europe but failed to make an impact here, mostly because of impossibly snobby dealership prices for servicing this cheap car. Otherwise it is a very good sub-compact. Handling and ride  is even better than the highly acclaimed late-90's version thanks to the ultra-stiff bodyshell. Power comes from a Duratec 1.4-litre four-cylinder engine that offers fuel economy expected from cars of this size. There is also a choice of manual and automatic gearboxes for this front-wheel-drive hatchback. Safety equipment includes ABS brakes, airbags and other items. Small on the outside, decent packaging allows the Fiesta to offer decent space for people and cargo in its small body. It doesn't look too bad either.

From 2014, the Infinti FX model became the QX70 to follow the Japanese brand's new naming structure. The QX70 will be available in two variants and two different engines. The basic model gets a 3.7-litre V6 engine, while the QX70 S variant gets the 5.0-litre V8, with both engines mated to 7-speed automatic transmissions. Built on the all-wheel-drive front-midship platform, the the QX70 features an extensive list of available equipment. Available features include Continuous Damping Control, Rear Active Steer, and 21-inch lightweight aluminium-alloy wheels designed by Enkei. Inside, the interior has available "sport" seating and advanced audio, optional navigation and technology ranging from an 11-speaker Bose-developed audio system to the intelligent key, available active cruise control and available around-view monitor system. The QX70 offers numerous safety and convenience technologies such as intelligent brake assist, distance control assist, adaptive front lighting system, standard HID headlights, integrated fog lights, rear LED taillights, functional side air vents, aluminium roof rails, leather and wood trim, sunroof, "self-healing" clearcoat paint finish, stability control, and the usual power accessories and multiple airbags. Available safety features include object-detection for the around-view parking camera system as well as voice instructions on how to parallel-park into a specific space.

The GAC GS5 is the Chinese brand's compact crossover SUV offering. Under the hood, it gets two 4-cylinder engine choices, which is the naturally aspirated 2.0-litre motor and the turbocharged 1.8-litre unit. They both can be had in either a 5-speed manual transmission or a 5-speed automatic transmission. While the 2.0-litre version is front-wheel drive, the 1.8-litre turbocharged version can be had in four-wheel-drive as well. Standard feature for the GS5 include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, fog lamps, parking sensors, AM/FM radio with CD/AUX/USB support, 6 speakers, fabric seats, automatic A/C with dual-zone, rear A/C vents and manual seats. The higher models get leather seats, power seats, sunroof and audio controls on steering wheels. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS brakes and EBD.

The Hilux may be considered the best pickup in its class simply for being from Toyota. The eight-generation Hilux made its debut in the GCC as a 2016 model year. They are available in the single cab and crew cab configurations. Midsize pickups offer better manoeuvrability than the fullsize pickup trucks that the Americans sell as 'lifestyle' vehicles, while providing serious hauling and towing utility. Mechanically, the 2016 Hilux will offer a new 6-speed automatic transmission, which gives a 15-percent better fuel economy rating than the previous generation model. Engine choices include the 2.0-litre and 2.7-litre petrol engines, and a new more powerful 2.4-litre diesel engine. While the 2.0-litre is available only in rear-wheel-drive, the other two engines can be had in either four-wheel-drive or two-wheel-drive. Safety features for it includes front driver and passenger airbags, knee airbag for the driver, ABS, electronic brakeforce distribution (EBD) and Emergency Locking Retractor (ELR) seat-belt equipped on all seats except the centre seat.

Updated mildly for 2005 with a facelift and some new engines. Available as a saloon, wagon or sports coupÃ©, the C-Class range has something to suit every individual. Featuring a wide range of engines that just confuses the average consumer, the C-Class can be optioned out as a bare commuter car or a beefy sports car. The optional Sports Edition package offers attractive suspension and cosmetic add-ons to any model. Starting off the line-up is the 1.8-litre. Next are three supercharged 1.8-litre engines, at different states of tune, and available as either a sports coupe, sedan or wagon, also depending on model year. The 2.6-litre is also available, as is a 3.2-litre, both V6. The V6 models can also be had with all-wheel-drive, but only in sedan and wagon form. The supercharged 3.2-litre C 32 AMG comes in sedan form only, as the wagon wasn't offered here. Many of the lower models are offered with a manual gearbox in addition to the automatic, though dealers were hesitant to bring any over. There are also diesel models that are not really promoted in this region. All cars come with a full set of safety features, though many luxury features are optional on the base models.

The Grand Vitara got a facelift for 2013. Only the 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine is now offered, which is mated to an ancient 4-speed automatic. The Grand Vitara is among the handful of small 4WD vehicles that offers true all-round 4x4 capability thanks to its low-range gearing and truck-like construction. Suzuki offers the trucklet in 3-door and 5-door body styles. all models get four-wheel disc brakes. All Grand Vitara models come well-equipped with useful features. Some of the available features include new cabin trimmings, drive-by-wire throttle control, power windows, electric mirrors, power-adjustable front seating, CD stereo, and a keyless entry system that does not require the key to leave the pocket to unlock the doors and start the engine. Though standard equipment differs from country to country, the Grand Vitara will be offered in most markets with stability control, steel or alloy wheels, glass sunroof, in-dash 6-disc changer with MP3 compatibility, and leather seats. Safety features are also class-leading, with a full array of airbags with front, side and curtain bags for front seat passengers, plus curtain airbags for those in the back.

The Trooper was Isuzu's first well-known 4WD vehicle, and is a vehicle that was very competitive in terms of looks and features, but never caught on due to poor marketing and even poorer dealer support. It came in 3-door and 5-door body styles, both five-seaters, although both looked very similar to each other, except for the number of doors. While previous Trooper models were basic utilitarian offroaders, this version actually was well-endowed with basic luxury features of the time. This particular model line ended in 2002, at which point Isuzu discontinued its passenger-vehicle line and concentrated on work trucks. The Trooper came with an acceptable 3.5-litre V6, mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 4-speed automatic. All trims had standard all-wheel-drive with low-range gearing. Available features included cloth or leather interior, power windows, electric mirrors, monotone or two-tone paintjob, sunroof, cassette stereo with CD changer, cruise control and alloy wheels. Safety features included four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and front airbags.

An all-new Cadillac Escalade was revealed for 2015. The front fascia gets the new corporate design with the LED headlights. The engine under the hood will be the same 6.2-litre V8 engine, but tweaked to produce slightly more power than the previous model. Power is delivered through a new 10-speed automatic transmission. All-wheel-drive is standard, and low-range gearing is finally available. There will also be an extended version, based on the Chevrolet Suburban. Standard features include new electric power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic dual-zone A/C, power-adjustable pedals, Bluetooth, heated and ventilated seats, and cylinder deactivation. Standard alloy-wheel size is 20-inch, with 22-inch alloys as optional. The interior features a new centre console, which includes their CUE touchscreen interface. The six or seven seats configuration is still available on the new Escalade, with the rear seats having the ability to fold completely flat. Magnetic Ride Control has been added as well to improve ride quality. Safety features include front and side airbags, ABS and stability control. A Driver Awareness package includes Forward Collision Alert, Lane Departure Warning System, and the patented Safety Alert Seat, which offers directional vibrations to alert the driver about potential crash threats. A Driver Assist package adds Full Speed Range Adaptive Cruise Control, Front and Rear Automatic Braking and Automatic Safety Belt Tightening. Additionally, Side Blind Zone Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Lane Change Alert are standard on higher models.

The S80 is the flagship of Volvo range, and though it looks big in size, it is actually more of a large midsize sedan than a true fullsize barge. The front-wheel-drive models get either a 2.5-litre 5-cylinder turbo or a 3.2-litre 6-cylinder, both with a six-speed automatic with manual shift capability. The top model is an all-wheel-drive sedan with a 4.4-litre V8 and a six-speed automatic, again with tiptronic. New and improved for the 2007 model year, it adds new Volvo innovations such as the wafer-thin center console that houses the digital climate controls and the Dolby Pro-Logic II surround sound system. The car is filled to the brim with the usual luxury features such as power windows, mirrors and seats, leather trim, large alloy rims and what not, but the big news is the all-new engine range. Safety features include ABS brakes, stability control, dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection.

The V70, based on the S60, is tuned to be a sports wagon, but is betrayed by a front-wheel-drive chassis and weak regional engine choices. The interior is fairly spacious and the luggage area is huge thanks to its upright boxy shape. For the Middle East market, there is a basic 2.4-litre 5-cylinder only for the V70 wagon, although European markets get as many engines as the S60 sedan. Gearbox choices include a manual and an automatic. Maintaining Volvo tradition, safety features include dual front airbags, side impact airbags for SIPS, inflatable curtain airbags and WHIPS whiplash protection. In this region, the V70 is sadly relegated largely to taxi duties.

An all-new Lincoln Navigator debuted for 2018, still a rebodied version of the new-for-2018 Ford Expedition. The Navigator L is the long-wheelbase version, with more boot space. All new Navigators make extensive use of high-strength aluminium-alloy to lose weight while offering more space inside. Power continues to be provided by an uprated twin-turbo V6 and mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission, similar to the Ford F-150 Raptor. The top model is known as the Signature. Inside, both front seats feature heating/cooling/massaging functions and are adjustable in 30 ways. Rear seats have a recline function. Available rear-seat entertainment features include 10-inch adjustable screens. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are part of the standard SYNC 3 touchscreen system, along with navigation, Bluetooth, phone, etc. A total of 20 speakers with the optional Revel II audio system can create distinct listening modes including audience, on-stage, and stereo. A Lincoln “welcome mat” will illuminate on the ground beneath the front doors, and the Lincoln star badge in the grille lights up too. Other available notable features include powered side-steps, heads-up display, customisable LCD gauge cluster and USB ports for the power-adjustable third row. Safety features are extensive, with a full set of airbags, ESP, ABS, lane-departure warning, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, al-round parking sensors with cameras and all that.

International truck company's MXT is a lowered crew-cab pickup truck in a more consumer-friendly package than the company's larger trucks. The MXT's front end is dominated by a tall waterfall grille, while its profile looks odd with its "lowered" ride height is really much higher than it seems. A sport exterior package adds a chrome bumper with tow hooks and anodized aluminium tubular running boards. The MXT features a long cargo bed and measures large enough to not fit in most conventional garages. The MXT is powered by a 6.0-litre turbodiesel V8, mated to an Allison five-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel-drive. Features include an air suspension system, 20-inch wheels, a five-occupant interior with front bucket seats and a three-place rear bench seat, leather seating surfaces, a leather-wrapped tilt steering wheel, keyless entry, and power locks and windows, as well as ABS brakes. The optional "Prestige Interior" includes ivory-coloured gauges, silver interior trim, special floor mats, and front and rear air-ride seats. Options include a navigation system with a 6.5-inch screen and a rearview camera, and a DVD entertainment system with a 10-inch screen. Twice as heavy as any large 4WD, and with space to walk between seats, the MXT is being marketed as an off-road vehicle. Thankfully, it is not available in all GCC markets.

The Malibu nameplate returns to the GCC for 2010, after almost a decade, although it wasn't missed at all. Unlike its predecessor however, the new Malibu is a highly-competitive entry in the midsize sedan segment, with a clean-sheet design and good features. The new Malibu is a mainstream front-wheel-drive sedan, but aims slightly higher with its chrome trimmings and colourful interior options. Powered by either a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder or a 3.6-litre V6, both are available with a 6-speed automatic offering manual-shift capabilities. Unique features for this segment include standard 18-inch wheels, optional two-tone interior colour schemes, and lots of extra noise-reducing features that make the Malibu's cabin quieter than most. Other features include a CD stereo, power windows, electric mirrors, cloth or leather upholstery, manual or digital a/c, and options such as sunroof and cruise control, among others. The V6 is identified by its front foglights and dual exhaust tips. Safety is prioritised with six standard airbags, traction control, tyre pressure monitoring system, four-wheel-disc brakes, ABS and stability control.

The Cruze is Chevrolet's latest Korean-built compact model. Designed from the ground up, the Cruze first became available as a sedan, and later as a hatchback as well since 2011. The front-wheel-drive sedan features a 1.8-litre 4-cylinder engine, with either a 5-speed manual or a class-leading 6-speed automatic, with an independent front and solid-axle rear suspension setup. There are three trim levels. The interior has an attractive "dual-cockpit" design, with seam-stitching colour-matched to the instrument panel, MP3/CD radio with USB port and MP3 jack, optional CD changer, manual or automatic a/c, optional cruise control, optional split-folding rear seat, power windows, keyless entry and optional keyless start. Depending on trim, the Cruze can be had with optional fog lamps, optional sunroof, optional parking sensors and electric mirrors. The basic LS model gets rear drum brakes and 15-inch steel wheels. The higher LT models get four-wheel-disc brakes and either 16-inch or 17-inch alloy wheels. ABS and dual front airbags are standard, while side airbags are available.

The Lexus IS debuted in its current form back in 2014, and got a facelift in 2017. In 2016, the IS250 was replaced by the IS200t, which comes with a 4-cylinder 2.0-litre turbocharged engine, connected to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The other engine remains the same, which is the 3.5-litre V6 with an 8-speed automatic transmission in the IS 350. The new generation is more driver-focused, ergonomic interior features lower driver position and it gets 60/40 split folding rear seats for cargo-carrying versatility. Standard features include LED Daytime Running Lights, fabric or premium NuLuxe seat surfaces with eight-way power-adjustable front sport seats, user-selectable drive modes, HID headlamps with headlamp washers, Lexus Display Audio and more. There is the F SPORT package which has the optional "G-AI control", that actively matches gear changes to g-forces generated during cornering. F SPORT models also feature special interior and exterior styling, including unique seats. The F SPORT package also adds specially-tuned suspension plus many special F SPORT details, including a unique front fascia with mesh spindle grille, distinctive LFA-inspired 18-inch aluminium alloy wheels, sport front seats with lightweight NuLuxe seat surfaces, perforated leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, interior trim, aluminium door-sill trim, and more.

Available only in a few GCC markets, this outdated version of the Land Cruiser got a big facelift for 2008, but the mechanicals underneath remain the same. Staying alive simply because people keep buying them. The popular pickup version became known as the LC79 from 2010, by virtue of a new petrol engine. It is built to Toyota's high standard of quality so you get unsurpassed durability and reliability. Powered by either a 4.0-litre V6 petrol, or in some markets, an old 4.2-litre inline-6 diesel, mated to only 5-speed manuals, these trucks are very rudimentary, unlike the American "luxury" trucks. Standard features include a radio with cassette player and 2 speakers, manual a/c, power steering and fabric seats. Options on higher models include power door mirrors, electric winch, 16-inch steel wheels, power windows and central locking.  If you are lucky, you might get an optional CD player, but not much else. Standard safety features include nothing more than a fire extinguisher, although some markets now get optional dual front airbags. Conversely, the Saudi market gets several variations, with available features such as a 10-seater covered bed, keyless entry, cooled glove-box, heavy-duty suspension and sand tyres. Incidentally, the pickup is regionally popular for modifying into drag racers due to their durability, although the loss of the old 4.5-litre petrol engine may put a dent in that.

The redesigned-for-2008 Cadillac CTS 4-door sedan got a rearranged set of engine choices in 2010 and remained the same till its final year in 2013. Alongside the mainstay 3.6-litre direct-injection V6 is a new 3.0-lire V6 direct-injection base engine. The V6 engines only come with a 6-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel-drive. The exterior is characterized by a larger chrome-trimmed grille, vertical-shaped headlights and vertical taillights with LED lighting. Inside, the interior is luxurious enough and has standard or optional technological features including DVD-based navigation with telescoping touch-screen, Bose 5.1 Cabin Surround audio system, front and side-curtain airbags, leather trim, adaptive HID headlights, an Easy Key system with Smart Remote Start, 17-inch to 19-inch alloy wheels, Bluetooth, optional limited-slip diff and an optional panoramic sunroof. For maximum comfort, heated and ventilated seats is fitted with new "thin-seat" technology and rear-seat leg, knee and foot room has been enhanced.

Yet another entry into Daihatsu's sub-compact range, this one is a unique little number. Daihatsu advertising is so poor in this region that we only came across this specialty machine by mistake. Some prefer to call it a mini MPV, but it is really a hatchback. The little boxy car offers oodles of space thanks to the tall shape and long wheelbase. It is powered by a 1.5-litre 4-cylinder engine, with a choice of a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The rear doors open wide to allow easy entry and exit, and the rear seat can be optioned to slide front and back. Luggage capacity is hihgly flexible, with folding front seats and split-folding rear seats, while pockets are all over the place. This Toyota-derived vehicle has its annoying gauge cluster in the centre, and the interior treatment is all hard plastic, except for interesting touches such as illuminated speakers and handles. Other available features include with a CD/AM/FM radio, power windows, remote central locking, ABS brakes and at least dual front airbags if not more.

The Peugeot Boxer is the French company's large commercial van offering. Only the turbocharged 2.2-litre 4-cylinder diesel engine is offered in the GCC. They all come with a 6-speed manual transmission. There are three different versions, each with a different height and length. Standard options include power windows, power steering, central locking, air-conditioning, AM/FM radio with CD player and 16-inch steel wheels. Safety options include ventilated front and rear brake discs, and ABS with electronic brake force distribution (EBFD).

The Viano is a very large and versatile minivan that can be optioned up to become a true luxury transportation. It has a variable seating rail system that lets you remove or reposition seats in a short time, and a variety of storage options. The Viano can accommodate up to eight people and luggage of all shapes and sizes. And with innovative equipment, including a folding table and a cool box for long journeys, it is a great long-distance cruiser. This is because, in addition to the independent suspension all round, the optional air suspension for the rear axles uses automatic level control to maintain optimum weight distribution for the best possible traction and steering in all situations. The air suspension also lets you raise or lower the Viano's rear floor by up to 50 mm at the touch of a button. Various trim choices include a short body, long body and very long body. Engine choices include two 2.2-litre turbodiesel engines with different tuning, and a 3.5-litre petrol motor. All come with automatics, though the diesel models can be had with a manual.

Created by Ford's SVT team, the updated-for-2010 Shelby GT500 is the most powerful car you can buy at its price. Powered by a supercharged and intercooled 5.4-litre DOHC V8 engine, it comes with a 6-speed manual,and a new final drive ratio changed from 3.31 to 3.55 for better acceleration. For 2011, Ford switched to an aluminium engine block, making it 55 kg lighter while adding 10 hp. Features include a twin-disc clutch to improve driveability, a resonator to reduce the supercharger whine, a domed aluminium bonnet to help in cooling, and a conical air filter for better breathing. The suspension system remains independent at the front and live-axle at the rear. Brakes, suspension and steering have also been improved. The GT500 gets Goodyear F1 Supercar tyres and aluminium wheels. The coupe gets forged 19-inch rims while the convertible gets cast 18-inch ones. A redesigned front splitter, a revised duck-tail spoiler, and a fake rear diffuser housing large dual exhaust tips complete the exterior package for the beefed-up facelifted Mustang. The interior uses genuine leather, real aluminium trim and upscale Alcantara inserts. Convenience features include Ford's SYNC voice-activated hands-free in-car communication and entertainment system, Bluetooth, power windows and mirrors, customisable ambient lighting and cruise control. The GT500 also features safety devices such as stability control with sport mode, ABS, dual front airbags, side-impact airbags and more. It might be available through special order in GCC markets.

With Honda going for premium prices nowadays, the City is about as low as you can go in the Honda range. Introduced for 2003 and facelifted for 2006, it is touted as the perfect `urban` vehicle, with its small exterior and tall interior. There is now a choice of two engines, namely a 1.3-litre four-cylinder with either a five-speed manual or a gearless CVT automatic, or a 1.5-litre four-cylinder with a gearless CVT that can imitate a seven-speed gearbox using wheel-mounted buttons. Standard features on the base 1.3-litre model include multi-reflector headlamps, 14-inch steel wheel, air-conditioning with heater, power windows, electric power steering, radio CD player with 2 speakers, cup and card holders, dual airbags and side door beams. Upgrading to the 1.5-litre adds 15-inch alloy wheels, hidden radio antenna, rear 60/40 split seat, rear tip-up seat function, driver seat height adjuster, power locks, electric mirrors, 2 more speakers for the CD stereo, fake wood-finish consoles, keyless entry and ABS brakes.

The Dodge Ram 1200 is a commercial pickup offering from the American brand, which is basically a rebadged Mitsubishi L200. Available in two-wheel-drive form with a 2.4-litre petrol engine or a 2.5-litre turbodiesel, or in four-wheel-drive form with the diesel engine only, it is an interesting proposition on-road, and even off-road, if equipped. Only the five-speed manual is currently offered here, with an automatic option set to come later. Choices in body styles include double cab or single cab.

The awkwardly-named MP4-12C marks McLaren Automotive's return to building their own street cars, having dabbled in Formula 1 for years now. Their "affordable" supercar is still pricey, but it is positioned as a no-compromises piece of engineering, with a carbon-fibre tub chassis, bespoke 3.8-litre twin-turbo V8, a "pre-cog" 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, an adaptive hydraulic suspension system, an air-brake spoiler, various driving modes and even an F1-developed brake-steer system. Using absolutely no parts from other manufacturers, the McLaren can be fully customised, and can generally be had with manual sports seats, leather-alcantara upholstery, touchscreen multimedia system, MP3 stereo with USB port, power windows and mirrors, smart keyless entry, HID headlights, carbon-fibre interior trim, auto a/c, cruise control, cup-holders and all that, though there is no Bluetooth, rear camera or CD player. Standard safety features include front, side-curtain and knee airbags, ABS and defeatable stability control. Interestingly, McLaren offers future power and feature upgrades for free to all owners. Also, the body is customisable to any unique shapes, up to a point, because they are just moulded "SMC" composite panels attached to the chassis.

The Dodge Challenger debuted in 2008, went on sale in the GCC by 2010, and has already been upgraded for the 2011 model year. The Challenger utilises retro styling that is largely a rethinking of the original 1970s Challenger's 2-door design. From this version, the Challenger became available in top-spec V8-powered SRT-8 trim in the GCC. Sharing its platform, engine and mechanicals with other fullsize rear-wheel-drive Chrysler cars, the Challenger packs a 6.4-litre Hemi V8 mated to a 5-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual. The SRT-8 gets bi-xenon headlights, leather-alcantara sport seats, CD stereo, and 20-inch aluminium-alloy wheels, along with the usual accessories such as automatic a/c, cruise control and fog lamps. Also available are a sunroof, racing stripes, rear sensors with camera, and the UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with voice controls as well as navigation, hard drive and Bluetooth phone. Safety features include ABS, stability control, front and side airbags, and SRT-exclusive Brembo brakes.

The Renault Clio RS got a new model in 2014 and started making its way to the GCC as a 2015 model year. It gets 1.6-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed EDC automatic gearbox with paddle shifters. The standard RS model gets remote central locking, auto A/C, LED daytime running lamps, power windows, power-foldable door mirrors, rain sensing wipers, cruise control, leather steering wheel and gear knob, sports front seats, automatic headlamps, rear sensors, radio and entertainment system with Bluetooth, USB & iPod connectivity and jack plug, navigation system,  handsfree entry and start system, 18-inch alloy wheels, rear bumper air diffuser with twin exhausts and rear spoiler. The RS+ model gets additional leather front bucket seats with red-stitching and rear-view camera. Standard safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS with electronic brake distribution (EBD) and electronic stability program (ESP) with anti-skid regulation (ASR).

The Subaru XV debuted in its current form in 2013. Known also as Crosstrek elsewhere, it is a based on the Impreza platform, but with hatchback styling, raised suspension, and roof rails. While appearing tough, this compact crossover is powered by a small 2.0-litre 4-cylinder mated to a CVT automatic and all-wheel-drive. The standard XV 2.0i comes with the usual power options, cloth upholstery, auto a/c, CD/MP3 stereo with USB and AUX ports, Bluetooth, 17-inch alloys, cruise control and halogen headlights. The 2.0i-S Premium adds smart keyless entry and start, rear camera, aluminium pedals, dual-zone auto a/c, HID headlights with washers, power-folding mirrors with LED indicators, and a sunroof. Front and side-curtain airbags, ABS with EBD, and stability control are standard on all models.

Maxus G10 is a the Chinese brand's MPV offering. Under the hood, there are two engines. The cargo vans get a naturally aspirated 2.4-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox, while the people carrier gets a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission. Standard features in the G10 people carrier include power steering, power windows, central locking, electric mirrrors, keyless entry, manual dual-zone A/C, radio with MP3/AUX support and 6 speakers, halogen headlights, front & rear foglights, sliding doors, lift tailgate and 16-inch wheels. The higher models gets LED headlamps, LED taillamps, dual-sliding doors, rear panorama sunroof, leather seats,  7-inch touch screen with DVD system, rearview camera and 18-inch alloy wheels. Safety features include front driver and passenger airbags, ABS, electronic brake distribution (EBD), stability control and traction control.

The Mercedes-Benz V-Class replaces the Viano and Vito in the lineup. In  2017, the V-Class was released in the GCC with a petrol engine. In 2020 it got a facelift, getting a new front bumper and grille. Under the hood, it gets the turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder motor, mated to a 7-speed automatic transmission. Standard features include power windows, power mirrors, central locking, keyless entry, cruise control, leather seats, Bluetooth and alloy wheels. The higher models get added options such as 17-inch alloy wheels, their "AGILITY CONTROL" suspension with selective damping system and more premium Lugano leather trim on the seats. The Exclusive edition gets interior trim in brushed aluminium look, air vents in silver chrome, a roof liner in DINAMICA, panoramic sliding sunroof, the new large centre console with integral refrigerated compartment and thermo-cupholders, climatised single seats in Nappa leather for the driver, front and rear passengers, 19-inch light-alloy wheels and Burmester surround sound system. There is also a sports package and AMG package. Safety standards are high with optional systems such as Collision Prevention Assist and Distronic Plus, along with multiple airbags for driver and passengers. It also gets traction control, stability control, blind-spot assist and lane-tracking system.

Proton claimed that the Waja was their first in-house car designed by Malaysians. However, its petrol engine is bought directly from Mitsubishi, and the suspension work was done by their independent Lotus division. The Waja is sold as the Impian in some markets, or referred to as the Waja Campro sometimes to advertise its latest engine. Powered by a 1.6-litre four-cylinder, this four-door sedan can be had with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic. The car is available with cloth upholstery, front power windows, trip computer, 60/40 split folding rear seats, keyless entry, 15-inch alloy wheels, central locking and CD stereo with four speakers and steering wheel-mounted controls. Options include a 10-disc CD changer, rear power windows, sunroof, cruise control, leather seating, fog lamps and metallic paint. Safety features include ABS brakes, dual front airbags and seat-belts for all seating positions. The Waja is not available in all Middle East markets. As far as we know, it is only available in a handful of GCC countries, and might not offer all the optional extras.

The Changan CS95 is a mid-size SUV available as both five and seven-seater variants, and is powered by a 2.0 turbocharged 4-cylinder engine. The only gearbox available is six-speed automatic and equipped with Changan’s NexTrac AWD system.

The Lexus GS received a facelift back in 2016 and gained a new entry-level model, the 200t, which replaced the GS 250. Later on, they renamed it to GS 300 which is currently sold only in some markets. Other models include the GS 350 and the GS 450h hybrid. The GS 300 comes with a turbocharged 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission. The GS The GS 350 comes with a 3.5-litre direct-injection V6, also with a 8-speed paddle-shiftable automatic. The GS 450h comes with a 3.5-litre engine mated to a compact, water-cooled electric motor powered by a nickel-metal hydride battery pack, and a CVT automatic. Identifiable by its Lexus trademark 'spindle' grille and LED running lamps, the GS comes in various trim levels. The base model comes with 18-inch alloys, smart keyless entry and start, moonroof, fabric upholstery, powered front seats and steering wheel adjustment, rear camera, 12-speaker CD/MP3/DVD stereo with USB/AUX ports, Bluetooth, cruise control, bi-xenon headlights, parking sensors, dual-zone auto a/c, and a "dynamics management" system. Higher trim levels add ventilated front seats, leather seats, and an 8-inch screen with hard-drive navigation. The GS 350 also comes in various trim levels, the basic version getting all the features of the top GS 200t, as well as a card-type key. Higher trim levels include turning headlights, nicer leather, further-adjustable front seats, 17-speaker stereo with a 12.3-inch screen, radar cruise control, adaptive variable suspension, heads-up display, pre-crash safety system, and lane-change assist. The top GS 350 comes with an F-Sport package that includes 19-inch wheels, special upholstery, four-wheel-steering and a body kit. The GS 450h, available in only a few GCC markets such as the UAE, comes only in fully-optioned F-Sport trim. Standard safety features include front, side, curtain and knee airbags, as well as stability control, and ABS with EBD and brake-assist.

The R8 is Audi's all-new two-seat, mid-engine sports car that incorporates technology from Audi's Le Mans-winning R8 prototype to build on its racing success for the street. The production version of the Audi R8 sports car debuted at the Mondial de l'Automobile in Paris in the fall of 2006, with the dramatic design remaining very true to the Le Mans quattro concept car first seen in 2003. The Audi R8 goes for the supercar look with its wide lowered stance, mid-engined setup and air-intake overkill. Based on the Lamborghini Gallardo platform, Audi added their own weird ideas of design, such as out-of-place "blade" of carbon fibre on each side, the gaping front end and LED headlight elements. The standard Audi R8 is powered by a 4.2-litre aluminium V8 with FSI direct fuel injection and quattro all-wheel drive. In mid-2009, a 5.2-litre V10 engine was introduced. The V8 Coupe came first, followed by the V10 Coupe, and then the V10 Spyder in 2010. The power is delivered through either a 6-speed manual or an R-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The Kia Carens compact MPV is all-new for the 2007 model year, and is available with a seven-seat cabin. The new Carens is completely different from the old one, sharing only the name of the previous model. Longer, wider and taller than its goofy predecessor, the latest Carens offers more interior space than most 4WDs thanks to better packaging. Inside the cabin, the middle and rear row seats fold down to create a flat-floored luggage area. With five seats occupied, luggage space is more than 400 litres and with just the driver and front passenger on board, up to 2,106 litres of cargo can be carried. It is offered with a relatively weak 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine mated with either a five-speed manual or a four-speed automatic transmission that offers sequential manual selection. The model has a hydraulic power-assisted rack and pinion steering system with relatively high gearing, requiring just 2.86 turns of the wheel from lock-to-lock with the standard 16-inch wheels. Features include front and rear disc brakes backed up by ABS with EBD, CD stereo, four forward-opening doors, and an undetermined number of airbags.

The Odyssey is a best-seller in America, but has yet to make an impact in this region, where 4WDs rule. The Odyssey has a car-like ride and handling quality since it is based on the Accord. It is powered by the same fuel-efficient 3.5-litre V6 engine as the MR-V, mated to an automatic. The interior features a clever seating system that can accommodate up to eight passengers. The Odyssey comes standard with side curtain airbags, electronic stability control and ABS brakes, as well as power door locks with remote keyless entry, power windows, 60/40 split fold-down rear seats, power sliding doors, tri-zone climate control, a stowable second-row PlusOne seat, in-dash CD changer, steering wheel audio controls, cruise control, power driver seat controls, alloy wheels and other features. Leather upholstery is available, as is a power moonroof and heated front seats. The Odyssey aims to be more of a luxury cruiser than a basic family or labour hauler.

The Kia Cerato Koup is a 2-door coupe version of the well-received Cerato sedan. Mildly sporty in its demeanour, the Koup is available with a 2.0-litre "MPI" 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic. Interior comfort is enhanced by lowering the cabin floor and the seats, and by fitting wider front seat cushions with an increased cushion angle for greater thigh support. Available features, depending on market, include a colour 4.2-inch LCD information screen, intelligent key system with push-start, memory seats, rear-camera, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone airconditioning, hill-assist and parking sensors.

An all-new Audi A5 came out in 2017. It got a facelift and infotainment updates in 2020. The Audi A5 coupe is powered by a 2.0-litre turbo 4-cylinder, available in 2 different tunes. Power is delivered through a 7-speed tiptronic auto transmission. Technology includes LED lighting, an electromechanical parking brake, an all-plastic key and three-zone climate control, along with all the usual luxury features, such as power windows, electric mirrors, sunroof and leather upholstery. buyers can specify the optional virtual cockpit function, which includes a 12.3-inch high-definition digital instrument panel as well as the latest evolution of Audi's MMI (Multi Media Interface) Plus infotainment system, which uses an 8.3-inch monitor and a touch-sensitive rotary controller. Safety features include multiple airbags, ABS and stability control.

The Ford Fusion receives a facelift, interior updates and more power for 2010. Essentially a modified version of the previous version, this Mexican-built midsize sedan is available in the GCC in a limited number of trim levels. The new look includes a sleeker chrome-grilled front end and a redesigned rear slapped onto the carryover three-box body. While introduced in the U.S. boasting four engines and various transmission options, it is sold here only in front-wheel-drive automatic form with one engine choice. The standard engine is a new 2.5-litre 4-cylinder, mated to a  6-speed automatic transmission. Features include the Ford SYNC voice-activated entertainment system, Bluetooth phone, keyless entry, power windows, electric mirrors, manual A/C, power driver seat, 12-speaker Sony sound system, fog lamps, 17-inch alloy wheels, capless fuel filler, dual chrome-tipped exhausts, four-wheel disc brakes, reverse sensors and a tyre-pressure monitoring system. Available safety features include ABS, traction control, stability control, curtain side airbags, and front side airbags.

The new-for-2011 Kia Sportage has been redesigned from the ground up, barely larger than the outgoing model, and based on Hyundai underpinnings. Now powered by a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder with front-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive, and a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder with all-wheel-drive, both engines are mated to a 6-speed automatic. The base 2.0-litre FWD model comes with power windows, electric mirrors with indicators, keyless entry, cloth seats, fog lamps, manual a/c, rear spoiler, roof rails, CD/MP3 stereo with 6 speakers and USB/AUX inputs, 17-inch steel wheels, ABS and only a single driver-side airbag. Things get better in the higher trim levels, with the top 2.4-litre AWD model additionally outfitted with dual-zone automatic a/c, panoramic glass roof, cruise control, smart key with starter button, leather upholstery, power driver-side seat, stereo with subwoofer and iPod cable, rear sensors and camera, chrome door handles, electric folding mirrors, 18-inch alloy wheels, and improved safety features such as ABS with stability control, active headrests and two front airbags, though still no side airbags. The Sportage received high ratings in European crash tests, but keep in mind that they apply to a model with six airbags.

An all-new Chevrolet Tahoe was released as a 2021 model year. The exterior gets a complete redesign and also technical improvements. Under the hood is the same 5.3-litre V8 engine. Power is delivered through a 10-speed automatic transmission.

The BMW 8-Series nameplate came back to the line-up in 2019. The 8-Series Convertible came to the GCC in 2020. Under the hood, it comes with a 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 engine, coupled with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 8-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport+, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. The BMW 8-Series comes with a Parking Assistant, an optional feature that facilitates the process of parking, as well as Active Cruise Control, Surround View and Rear View Camera, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Change Warning and BMW Night Vision with pedestrian recognition.

The fancy FX35 aims to please city-going rich folks. Powered by a 3.5-litre V6, it comes with a standard five-speed automatic and a sporting chassis. It has a leather interior, power driver's and passenger seats, 18-inch alloy wheels, sunroof, automatic headlamps, aluminium roof rails, rearview monitor, Bluetooth hands-free phone system, power tilt and telescopic wheel, 300-watt six-CD/MP3 Bose stereo with ten speakers, power mirrors and an advanced airbag system. The FX's on-demand all-wheel-drive system, known as ATTESA E-TS, or Advanced Total Traction Engineering System for All Electronic Torque Split, runs at 99 per cent rear wheel bias under most conditions. When slip is detected, up to 50 per cent power goes to the front wheels, but there is no low-range gearing. The FX35 also comes with automatic rear hatch closure assist system, four-wheel ventilated disc brakes, aluminium interior trim, dual-zone climate control, information display monitor, and three-spoke leather-wrapped wheel with audio controls.

BMW's American-built 4WD comes in three models in this region, namely the 3.0i with a 6-cylinder engine, the 4.4i with a V8, and the 4.8is with a bigger V8. Debuting in 2000 and receiving a facelift in 2004, the X5 has all-wheel drive without low-range gearing, but does come with ABS and traction control. The 3.0i offers manual and automatic transmissions, but the V8 models only come with an automatic. The automatics do have a manual shift gate, but they are still essentially automatics. Standard on V8s and optional on the 3.0i are load-leveling suspension, leather upholstery, front and rear obstacle detection, and steering-linked xenon headlights. Other available features include adjustable ride-height suspension, heated rear seats, navigation system and sunroof. The X5 is far from an off-roader, but it has built up a reputation for excellent on-road driving dynamics for a 4WD, and has become popular with rich people who like to terrorise other road users with some deft moves. The V8 models drive more like sport wagons rather than any 4WD, though it seems a little pointless when BMW itself has much more capable V8-powered 5-Series wagons in its European stable.

The all-new Chevrolet Corvette debuted as a 2014 model year. It features a new LT1 V8 engine, but still has the same 6.2-litre displacement. Power has gone up however, with the new Corvette Stingray producing more horsepower and torque. More interesting is the 7-speed manual transmission it has, with rev-matching technology. For customers who don't like the third pedal, there is a 6-speed automatic transmission, the same gearbox as the previous generation, but tweaked with different internals for better performance. A new electric power steering system and cylinder deactivation help to improve fuel economy, said to be now less than the previous generation. There is a Drive Mode Selector which has 5 settings Weather, Eco, Tour, Sport and Track. Looking at the exterior, we see some similar design elements from other brands such as the new 2013 SRT Viper from the front, the vents and windows of a Nissan GT-R on the side, and rear fender-top vents like that of a Ferrari 458 Italia. The rear still incorporates the trademark four-lamp design, however it looks more like a modified design from the Chevrolet Camaro. The four exhaust tips lined up together is one of those things you either love or hate. The interior is where they have made some much-needed improvements. The designers made sure they cover as much of the interior as possible with soft-touch materials. It features a more driver-focused cockpit and a smaller steering wheel. New seats with more bolstering have been added. A Z51 package adds more sporting suspension as well as extra trim such as a rear spoiler. Safety features include front and side airbags, ESP, ABS and seat-belt pretensioners.

The Maserati Spyder is a high-performance two-door two-seater based on the 4200 GT Coupe, except with a shorter wheelbase and a convertible top. While these cars are based on the original 3200 GT which debuted in 1998, they have been receiving updates regularly. The latest variations was the GranSport Spyder, which featured sport-tuned suspension, aerodynamic and performance upgrades, and racier trimmings. All versions are powered by a Ferrari-tuned 4.2-litre V8, with a choice of a six-speed manual or a six-speed Cambiocorsa paddle-shifted automanual. The Gransport version, which debuted in 2005, have slightly more power. All cars get a full suite of luxury features, such as power windows, premium CD stereo, electric mirrors, power-adjustable leather seats and more. Additional features 18-inch alloy wheels, multiple airbags, ABS brakes and stability control.

The second-generation Audi R8 came out in 2016. In 2019, the Audi R8 got a facelift. Under the hood, there is no more a V8 engine option, but V10 is still available, which has been reworked for better performance. In 2020, a rear-wheel drive version was released. It has also managed to reduce 200 kg by using more carbon-fibre and aluminium for the body.The power is delivered through a 7-speed S-tronic sequential manual gearbox that uses the same transmission and clutch but operates the clutch and changes gears automatically. The cabin is outfitted to luxury standards, with leather upholstery, power features and decent space. Luggage compartments are in the front and in the back. Safety features include the usual airbags and electronic nannies.

The all-new M3 came out as a 2015 model year and will now be available only as a 4-door sedan. Gone is the V8 under the hood, and has been replaced by a highly-tuned twin-turbocharged inline-6, mated to either a 6-speed manual or a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic. Features include head-up display, a backup camera, parking sensors, ventilated seats, keyless entry, and headlamp washers. The Driver Assistance package adds blind-spot monitoring, lane-departure warning, autonomous braking, and side-view camera.

The Nissan Armada is the largest passenger vehicle in Nissan's lineup besides its commercial buses and vans. Facelifted inside and out for 2008, it is capable of towing heavy trailers, hauling eight passengers, and traversing some off-road terrain. Based on a fullsize pickup platform, the Armada accommodates seven or eight passengers depending on configuration, in a roomy cabin that is comfortable, convenient and nicely accessorised. Both rear seating rows fold flat, giving the Armada enormous cargo capacity. The Armada is built at Nissan's American factory, as the Japanese wouldn't touch something so oversized. It comes equipped with a powerful 5.6-litre V8 that would've offered impressive acceleration had it not been for the Armada's titanic weight, even with the power upgrade for 2008. It comes with dual-zone air conditioning, adjustable lumbar support for the front seats, in-dash six CD changer, cruise control, power windows, power mirrors, power locks with remote keyless entry, running boards, a roof rack, ABS brakes, airbags and alloy wheels.

The second-generation Clio hatchback was launched as a 1999 model, and was heavily facelifted for 2002, coinciding with the release of the Turkish-built sedan version. The all-new Mark-3 Clio was already out in European markets by 2006, but the Middle East soldiered with the older Mark-2 model. Therefore in 2006, the model received a second unnoticeable facelift, and the hatchback was renamed the Clio Campus, while the sedan became the Clio Classic. The Clio is the smallest car in Renault's range, and offers buyers a number of trim options and petrol engines, in either hatchback or sedan form. The basic 1.4-litre engine powers the standard five-door hatchback and four-door sedan, with a choice of manual or automatic transmissions. The hot 2.0-litre engine powers the rare three-door Clio 182 model, with a stock manual transmission. The unique combination of sizeable engines, unique styling, competitive pricing, safety features and equipment levels make other cars in this category look bad. The Clio is available with a host of trim levels, with names like Authentique, Expression, Privilege, Initiale, Dynamique and, for the hot 182 model, Renaultsport. Standard features include electric power steering, some sort of stereo, available power features and more. Class-leading levels of equipment include ABS with brake assist, dual front airbags, remote control central locking, power windows.

Launched in the United States back in 2006, announced in the GCC in early 2008, and finally launched here as a 2009 model, the Fusion is America's answer to the European Mondeo. It is odd that both cars are available here, with similar engines and mechanicals. The Fusion, based on a modified Mazda platform shared with the Mondeo, should attract a more-conservative clientele who may shy away from Ford's European offering. Featuring a three-bar chrome grille, a long body, and well-balanced suspension tuning, the Fusion offers comfortable interior room for both front and rear passengers, while promising an engaging drive. Powered by a 2.3-litre 4-cylinder engine mated to a manual or automatic 5-speed gearbox and front-wheel-drive, the Fusion comes in three trim levels and standard features such as power windows, CD stereo, electric mirrors and more. Safety features include six airbags, ABS brakes and a stiff frame. On another note, the Fusion is built alongside the Mercury Milan and the Lincoln MKZ, all based on the same platform.

The second generation Acura NSX made a comeback to the world after years of teasing in 2016. The NSX brings supercar looks and performance, with the advantage of being a daily driver. While the previous generation, which had ended back in 2007, had poor fuel economy, that department has massively improved thanks to its hybrid setup. Mechanically, the NSX gets a twin-turbocharged 3.5-litre V6 engine connected to 3 electric motors, and mated to a 9-speed dual clutch automatic transmission with an all-wheel-drive system. Standard features in the 2-seater NSX include electric power steering, power windows, central locking, remote key access, engine start-stop button, cruise control with steering wheel buttons, leather and Alcantara upholstery, a mix of digital and analog instrument cluster, manual sports seats, dual-zone front A/C, adaptive suspension, backup camera, premium audio system which includes 8 speakers with subwoofer, 7-inch touchscreen, Bluetooth, MP3/auxiliary input jack, USB audio interface, SMS text message function, Android Auto and Apple CarPlay. It gets 19-inch alloy wheels in the front while gets 20-inch. Safety features include knee, side, curtain and front airbags, ABS, tyre pressure monitoring system, traction control, and vehicle stability control.

The all-new Chevrolet Sonic is a sub-compact replacement for the Aveo. Available in sedan and hatchback body-styles, the Sonic is available in the GCC with a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic with tiptronic function, with a 5-speed manual available in some markets. The base model comes with 5-inch steel wheels with hubcaps, manual a/c, fold-down rear seat, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, optional keyless entry and only one airbag. The mid-range LS model additionally gets steel wheels or optional 15-inch alloy wheels, optional sunroof, power windows, 4-way manually-adjustable driver's seat, better stereo with Bluetooth and more optional speakers, split-folding rear seat, optional parking sensors, optional ABS and two airbags. The top LT model additionally gets 16-inch alloy wheels, cruise control, standard ABS, 6-speaker stereo, and front as well as side airbags.

The SLR McLaren is an impressive celebration of Mercedes-Benz and its Formula 1 partner McLaren in the development and production of high-performance sports cars. The two-seater, with its striking swing-wing doors and styling elements borrowed from the Formula 1 Silver Arrows, builds on the legacy of the famous SLR racecars of the 1950s. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, it is designed to ensure a high standard of safety, comfort and class-leading speed. The specially-developed supercharged 5.4-litre V8 engine, with an automatic, delivers an impressive output rivaling traditional super cars, powering up to as much as 334 kph. The body of the new SLR, like F1 racecars, is made from lightweight carbon-fibre composites. However, the body itself is hardly the most attractive of supercars, with an overlong snout and a short rear. Many might confuse it for a 'bargain' SL or SLK, though it should still attract a lot of attention. The SLR has a spoiler mounted on the rear which pops up when braking from high speeds. A special lighter 722 edition has black alloy rims and more power. A convertible Roadster joined the range for 2008.

The Renault Duster, a rebadged Dacia, has been designed to suit all types of roads across the world's less-developed countries. It got a minor facelift in 2015 and updated interior materials. This sub-compact SUV is based on a stretched Nissan Tiida platform, and comes with a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder engine, available in either a two-wheel-drive 4-speed automatic form or in an all-wheel-drive 6-speed manual form, the latter capable of locking the diff for a 50:50 front/rear torque split. Interestingly, the 2WD model comes with a torsion-beam rear suspension, while the 4WD model gives up some boot space to make way for an independent rear suspension. The rear seats fold down as standard, and split-folding on all but the base model, while you can transport longer items if the front passenger seat is folded down as well. The basic PE version comes with two-wheel-drive, 4-speed automatic, cloth upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo with USB port and Bluetooth with buttons behind steering wheel, unpainted bumpers, 16-inch steel wheels, front power windows, keyless entry, folding rear bench seat, power steering and manual a/c. Early models came with one airbag, but by mid-2012, all models had two standard airbags. The higher-spec SE can be had in 2WD automatic or special-order 4WD manual drivetrains, and adds standard fog lamps, trip computer, ABS with Emergency Brake Assist, extra front-passenger airbag, rear power windows, electric mirrors, 16-inch alloy wheels, painted bumpers, leatherette steering wheel and extra chrome trim. The SE version can be further upgraded with leather seats with additional pyrotechnic pre-tensioners on the front seatbelts as well as side airbags. The exterior package on the SE version also adds standard chrome door mirrors, longitudinal roof rails, front/rear skid plates and side-skirt covers. Extra tinted rear windows, rear quarter glass and rear windscreen round up the list, as is a split-folding rear seat, height adjustable driver's seat and height-adjustable steering wheel. A comprehensive range of accessories,including wind reflectors, side steps, wheel arch mouldings, chrome exhaust trim and mudflaps, is also available.

The Silverado range is Chevrolet's line of full-size pickup trucks, and covers everything from passenger pickups to big honking diesel monsters with six wheels and more. The Silverado pickup is the second-best selling vehicle in the United States, behind the Ford F-150 pickup truck, and it sells more trucks there than Toyota sells Camry cars. The Silverado 1500 light pickup truck is about the only vehicle that you can drive from this range without offending anyone around you, while the Silverado HD trucks should best be used if you work at a place that requires regular hauling. The light-duty trucks generally use the 1500 name, can tow up to 4700 kg and can carry 930 kg in their beds. They are available in three cab lengths, 2-door short cab, 3 or 4-door extended cab, and front-hinged 4-door crew cab. Three cargo beds are available, including a short box, a standard box, and a long box. The short box is only available with the extended or crew cab, and is the only option on the 4-door. Engines include a Vortec 4800 V8 and a Vortec 5300 V8. The Vortec 6000 V8 is available in the Heavy Duty models but not in the 1500 models, while the Z71 signifies an off-road package.

The D-Max, also known by other names, is a range of light pickup trucks that are also rebadged as Chevrolet models in many markets. This compact pickup can be had with various bed options, and a range of engines, such as the 2.5-litre turbodiesel, the 3.0-litre turbodiesel and the 2.4-litre petrol motor. The poor folks who get stuck with these at work will have to manage with a 5-speed manual gearbox, or if they are lucky, the optional 4-speed automatic. For entertainment, there is an optional radio cassette player to listen to AM stations or play your classic tapes that you saved up since 1985. Also, available as a two-door single-cab or a double-cab four-door, the air-conditioner is also optional, but as a bonus, the heater is standard in all models for those pesky two weeks of winter that we get in this region. Power steering is also optional, as are many other comfort and utility features. It is available in economical rear-wheel-drive and capable four-wheel-drive forms.

In 2022, an all-new model of the BMW 4-Series Gran Coupe came out. It is offered as three variants in the GCC. The 420i and 430i feature a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine with different power ratings, and the M440i comes with the turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 motor. All are available with a standard 8-speed sport automatic transmission. The 4-cylinder models are rear-wheel drive while the M440i is all-wheel-drive. Standard features on the 2022 BMW 4-Series Gran Coupe include power steering, power windows, electric mirrors, leather seats, automatic A/C and FM radio and entertainment system with USB/iPod/Bluetooth support.
