Optional features include a new generation of BMW Navigation System, full-color BMW Head-Up Display, Driving Assistant Plus which warns the driver of a potential collision with a pedestrian and BMW Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Safety features on the 2022 BMW 4-Series Gran Coupe are always good with BMW and standard equipment include driver and passenger airbags, ABS and dynamic stability control (DSC).

The Cadillac CT5-V is the performance version of the CT5 midsize sedan. Under the hood, gone are the big V8 engines of the old CTS-V and now comes with a 3.0-litre turbocharged V6 engine, mated to a 10-speed automatic transmission. Standard features for the real-wheel-drive CT5 include power windows, power mirrors, LED headlights and tail lamps and fog lamps. Available equipment include Cadillac's updated CUE entertainment system with 10-inch screen and BOSE speakers, magnetic ride control, alloy wheels and adaptive forward lighting. Safety features include ABS and traction control, sensors to warn driver of potential dangers, safety seat alert which sends immediate impulse through the seat cushion from the direction of the potential hazard.
An all-new new model of the Kia Carnival came out in 2021.

The Trajet is Hyundai's latest attempt at conquering the world of minivans, but it is a completely typical minivan, with nothing over the competition except a lower price and an underpowered 2.7-litre V6. Standard features include power steering, front and rear a/c, roof rack, front and rear power windows, radio and cassette player with 4 speakers, central door locks, funky tail lights and an automatic transmission. Options include a sunroof, fog lamps, All models come with 15-inch wheels, though the lower model gets steel rims with plastic covers, while the top model gets alloys. Unique features include four forward-opening doors, which is a rarity in the large minivan set. The basic model actually comes with 8-seater capacity, thanks to a bunch of bench seats, but the top model is more of a 7-seater, with more comfortable accommodations. The cabin is of course versatile, with movable and foldable seats to increase or decrease luggage space as needed. Safety features are conspicuously absent in the Middle East model, though overseas versions get all sorts of airbags, traction control and ABS, some of which you could probably special-order.

The all-new GLK is the first Mercedes-Benz entry in the competitive compact soft-roader market, although its premium pricing and already-outdated styling are far from competitive. Available in GLK 280 trim with a 3.0-litre V6 and in GLK 350 trim with a 3.5-litre V6, both models come standard with 4Matic all-wheel-drive and a 7-speed automatic gearbox. The GLK apparently has some offroading pretensions, with an optional 'off-road styling package' that adds nothing but matte-black bumper strips and a simulated skidplate. Sizeable 19-inch alloy wheels are standard, with 20-inch ones being optional. Cabin features include two-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable front seats, Bluetooth interface, central 5-inch colour display, power accessories and an available power liftgate. Further extra-cost options include Xenon headlights with adaptive lighting and washers, rain-sensing windshield wipers, memory driver's seat, COMAND multimedia system with hard-drive navigation, rear-view camera, available rear-seat DVD entertainment system featuring two eight-inch screens, leather upholstery, wood trim and panorama sunroof. Safety features include front and side airbags, window airbags, stability control, ABS and brake assist.

This generation Mazda 3, which came out in 2015, was slightly longer in height and length than the previous generation. The exterior of the Mazda3 got the new Mazda "KODO" treatment, their new trademark design at the time. In 2017, it got a slight facelift. The 5-door hatchback had two engines in the GCC, a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder motor with a 4-speed automatic and a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder unit with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Mechanical features include independent suspension, disc brakes, electric power steering and an all-new platform unrelated to the Ford Focus, unlike before. The basic S-grade 1.6L model came with a 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo with USB/AUX ports and Bluetooth, power windows, manual a/c, Bluetooth, central locking, starter button, 16-inch steel wheels, cruise control, tilt/telescoping steering column and a single-piece folding rear seat. The V-grade 1.6L model added some chrome trim, running lamps, 16-inch alloys, fog lamps, split-folding rear seat, leather steering wheel and mirror-mounted indicators. An optional package added a 6-speaker stereo, sunroof, auto-dimming mirror, adaptive headlights, MZD Connect multimedia system with LCD screen and rotary controller, headlamp washers, rear camera with sensors, LED tail lamps, auto-levelling HID headlights, single-zone auto a/c and, as a further option, navigation. The R-grade 2.0L model got the larger engine as well as additional features such as a basic heads-up display, standard navigation, smart keyless entry, piano-black front grille, leather seats, auto headlights and wipers, adaptive cruise, 18-inch alloys, power-folding mirrors, rear spoiler and better safety features. Standard safety features included dual front airbags, ABS with EBD and an immobiliser, while top-spec R-grade models got side airbags, "smart" brake support and blind-spot monitoring.

The Renault Trafic is the French manufacturer's commercial van offering. There is a only one engine option here, the 4-cylinder 2.0 litre petrol engine, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. Only the panel van long-wheel base version is sold in this region, either with a low roof or high roof. Standard options include manual A/C, power assisted and depth adjustable steering column, AM/FM radio with 2 speakers, steel wheels and driver side airbag. Optional equipment includes CD player, fog lamps, hubcaps, spare wheel cover, wooden floor cover, ABS and passenger side airbag.

The RAV-4 is credited for being the original small 4WD built on a car chassis. It's not that there is anything fundamentally wrong with the vehicle. It's just that the RAV-4 is not a strong off-roader, but insists on looking like one, and people buy it for that reason. It continues with a 2.4-litre four-cylinder in this market even though a V6 model has been introduced elsewhere. Most markets, including UAE and KSA, get the all-wheel-drive model, but KSA additionally gets a two-wheel-drive option as well, the base one with a manual gearbox. The RAV4 range has an array of comfort and convenience features including auto air- conditioning, a MP3 compatible CD player with 6 speakers, power windows and central locking, keyless entry, and cruise control. Its rugged yet stylish exterior appearance is enhanced by a rear spoiler, roof rails, fog lamps and alloy wheels. The high series models also feature a powered driver's seat, leather seats, a moonroof and rear corner sensors. Safety features on all models include dual-stage frontal airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control and traction control. Side airbags are optional. Minor facelifts over the years are too small to notice.

Hyundai Creta is the Korean brand's sub-compact SUV offering. Under the hood, there is only one petrol engine on offer, which is a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder unit. The other engines options are the diesel units which include a 1.4-litre and 1.6-litre, which will most likely not make it to the GCC just yet. Standard features on the Creta include central locking, 16-inch alloy heels, keyless entry, manual AC, rear AC vents, power steering, front & rear power windows, audio system with AUX/USB/iPOD/MP3/CD player, and 4 speakers. Higher-spec models will get smart-key with a push start-stop button, 17-inch alloy wheels, projector headlamps, leather seats, navigation system, 5-inch touchscreen, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and phone control buttons, reverse parking camera, ABS, stability control and hill-start assist control.

The 2014 model BMW Z4 got some new engine choices in some of the GCC countries. The Z4 was completely redesigned for the 2009 model year, shifting focus and becoming a comfort-cruiser rather than the focused sports car that it was before. Along with all-new styling, the Z4 now sports a folding hard-top convertible roof that folds down in 20 seconds at the touch of a button. While still a two-seater, the Z4 now has more space for two passengers and their luggage, although not much cargo room is left with the roof down. Changes to the cabin now include more premium materials as well as an integrated iDrive multimedia computer. The Z4 comes in 5 variants with two engine choices, a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder turbocharged unit and a 3.0-litre inline-6 turbocharged motor, all with different levels of horsepower ratings. The 4-cylinder sDrive18i, sDrive20i and sDrive28i get 8-speed automatic transmissions, while the sDrive35i and sDrive35is get 7-speed double clutch automatic transmission. The Z4 comes with Dynamic Drive Control as standard, which allows NORMAL, SPORT and SPORT+ modes, each of which changes throttle response and gearbox characteristics. Other features include the iDrive system with a high-resolution display that integrates entertainment, navigation, Bluetooth phone and climate control functionality. All the usual luxury features are available, either standard or optional, such as cloth or leather upholstery, power windows, electric mirrors, cruise control, powered seats, keyless entry with starter button, alloy wheels, and HID headlights, among other options. On the safety front, the Z4 Roadster comes with stability control, ABS, front airbags, head and thorax airbags, reinforced A-pillars and roll bars behind the headrests.

The Ferrari 458 Italia is the successor to the F430. Going on sale in 2010, the 458 has a new mid-mounted 4.5-litre V8 engine, incorporating direct injection and mated only to a 7-speed dual-clutch automated manual gearbox that shifts in 0.05 seconds. Technology includes an E-Diff differential and an F1-Trac skid control system. The brakes feature a new system called "˜prefill' so when the driver's foot lifts off the throttle, the pistons in the calipers move the pads towards the discs to reduce the stopping distance. The 458 Italia's body and chassis are all aluminium, with a Pininfarina-designed exterior. The Vehicle Dynamic Assistance monitors the operating parameters of the most important areas of the car engine/gearbox, tyres and brakes. The VDA offers various settings that enables the driver to tune the car for the ideal operating conditions. The 458 is also available with modern conveniences like Bluetooth, CD stereo, rear camera, navigation, stability control and ABS, as well as a full set of front and side airbags.

The MX-5, also known as the Miata, is a popular rear-wheel-drive roadster from Mazda. Completely overhauled for the 2016 model year this purebred sports car is now powered by an all-new SkyActiv-G 2.0-litre four-cylinder motor, and mated to a 6-speed SkyActiv-Drive automatic transmission with paddle-shifters. There is a 6-speed manual variant available elsewhere, which is not on offer in the GCC at the moment. Featuring the usual soft-top passed down from its predecessors, there is also a retractable hard-top variant known as the MX-5 RF (Retractable Fastback) available from 2017 model year. Besides a few kilograms of weight, there are no significant differences between the soft and hard top variants, even in terms of performance. Interior features include CD/MP3 stereo with six-disc changer and 9 Bose speakers, power windows and mirrors, auto a/c, power steering, leather seats, smart-key for keyless entry and ignition, auto-dimming rear-view mirror, navigation, and cruise control. Additional features include chrome outer door handles, LED headlights, fog lamps, dual exhaust tips, and 17-inch alloy wheels with run-flat tyres. Safety features include dual front airbags and side airbags, ABS brakes, traction control, blind-spot monitoring, stability control, tyre pressure monitor, burglar alarm with immobiliser, and rollover hoops behind the seats.

An all-new Chrysler 200 model debuted for 2015. It gets a new Alfa-Romeo based chassis and the new 9-speed automatic transmission. Under the hood, the new Chrysler 200 will have two engines to choose from. One will be a 2.4-litre 4-cylinder motor and the other will be the 3.6-litre Pentastar V6 unit. The base 200 LX model comes with the cloth upholstery, 4-speaker CD/MP3 stereo, keyless entry, power windows, electric mirrors, halogen headlights, cruise control and manual a/c. The mid-range 200 Touring model adds 17-inch alloy wheels, dual-zone auto a/c, leather-wrapped steering wheel, trip computer, power driver's seat and 6-speaker stereo, with available options such as remote start, sunroof and voice-controlled UConnect touchscreen multimedia system with Bluetooth and hard-drive. The top 200 Limited model adds a V6 engine, exterior chrome trim, 18-inch alloys, auto up/down windows, auto-dimming rearview mirror and leather upholstery. All models get standard front airbags, side-curtain airbags, ABS, stability control, alarm and a tyre-pressure monitoring system.

An all-new Mini Countryman was released in 2017. No changes were made in 2018. The Countryman is 8-inches longer than the previous generation. It is a sub-compact crossover SUV with four doors and a tailgate, larger in size than the Mini cars, and powered by the same engines. The standard model gets a 1.5-litre turbocharged 3-cylinder motor, while the Cooper S gets the 2.0-litre turbocharged unit, both of which can be had in front-wheel drive or all-wheel drive formats. It can be had with a 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic gearboxes. The interior comes with seating for either four or five, with a choice of cabin colours, trim strips and upholstery, as well as a centre rail that allows a variety of things to be fixed on it, including cup holders, sunglasses case, armrests and more. Options include various CD/MP3 audio and navigation systems, a panoramic glass roof, adaptive HID headlights, towbar, and alloy wheels from 16-inch to 19-inch in size, as well as a range of John Cooper Works performance accessories. Safety features include front and side-curtain airbags, stability control, and ABS with electronic brake-force distribution.

The new-for-2012 BMW 6-Series Gran Coupe is essentially a 6-Series with four doors on a 5-Series platform. The 640i gets a turbocharged 3.0-litre 6-cylinder, mated to an 8-speed automatic with paddle-shifters. The 650i with the 4.4-litre turbocharged V8 and 8-speed auto came at the end of 2012. Some of the wide range of sophisticated driving and comfort features offered in the new BMW 6-Series include Dynamic Drive Control with four modes, namely comfort, normal, sport and sport +, as well as Comfort Start, Head-Up Display, Multi-Channel Audio System, Rear Seat Entertainment, Four-Zone Automatic Air Conditioning and BMW iDrive control. BMW ConnectedDrive also offers a unique range of driver-assist technology functions for enhanced comfort and safety. BMW claims the Gran Coupe is a 4+1 seater, but the rear middle seat offers zero legroom. Aside from the usual power accessories, leather upholstery, CD/MP3 stereo and other common items, available features include Surround View cameras, night vision with pedestrian recognition, Park Assistant, heads-up display, BlackBerry smart phone access via iDrive, Bluetooth interface for phone and e-mails, navigation, turning HID headlights, adaptive cruise control, run-flat tyres, 18-inch or 19-inch alloy wheels with optional 20-inchers, electronic parking brake, power-adjustable seats with optional ventilation, active steering, standard Drive Dynamic Control to choose from a range of pre-programmed suspension settings, Adaptive Drive for stability, multiple airbags, ABS, traction control, tyre-pressure monitor and more.

An all-new model released back in 2005, the Cadillac STS gets even better with the addition of the 469 hp STS-V. Changes for the latest model on regular STS models include all-wheel-drive as an available option on V6 models. A Bose 5.1 Studio Surround Sound system with Navigation is standard on the highest V8 model, while 18-inch wheels are available on the V6 and V8 rear-wheel-drive models. Engine choices on the STS are a 3.6-litre V6 and a longitudinally-mounted 4.6-litre Northstar V8. Both hook up to their own versions of a five-speed Hydra-Matic automatic transmission. The STS also comes with Magnetic Ride Control and StabiliTrak stability program. The STS-V features a 4.4-litre supercharged Northstar V8 engine with variable valve timing, also found in the XLR-V, mated to an all-new Hydra-Matic 6L80 six-speed automatic transmission. The STS-V is supposedly capable of zero to 100 kph in five seconds. All STS models contain all the expected luxuries, such as dual projector beam headlights, standard 17-inch painted aluminium wheels, automatic dual-zone climate control, cruise control, leather power seats, CD/MP3 player, and rear parking assist. A starter button is standard on the STS. Cornering and handling are superb, while the Magnetic Ride Control soaks up road imperfections for a firm ride. In price, it competes with smaller midsize Germans.

The PT Cruiser is Chrysler's unique retro wagon, and it got a makeover inside and out with updated front and rear fascias, a new grille with Chrysler winged badge, new headlights, redesigned taillights, round fog lights and a new discrete spoiler on the tailgate roof. The PT receives an all-new interior to add refinement to the versatility. This new interior includes new seat materials, a new larger three-dial instrument panel colour-coded to the exterior paintwork, and an analogue clock, of all things. The versatile PT has a tall profile that gives it a high seating position and tons of interior space. The interior can be arranged in 32 different seating configurations. This front-driven wagon is powered by either a 2.0-litre or a 2.4-litre engine, with a choice of five-speed manual or an optional four-speed automatic transmission featuring driver-adaptive shift logic along with AutoStick manual gear selection. The PT Cruiser continues to inspire other manufacturers to delve into the retro craze. Too bad the turbo models are not offered here. The standard PT Cruiser sold so slowly here that it was discontinued in the GCC long before it went out of production in America.

The Jaguar XJ is generally available in four trim levels in SWB and LWB versions. The UAE and some other GCC markets will only see the Premium Luxury, Portfolio and SuperSport versions, all in LWB form. The XJ Premium Luxury and the Portfolio will be available with a 5.0-litre naturally-aspirated V8. The XJ Portfolio can also be optioned up with a 5.0-litre supercharged V8. The SuperSport comes exclusively with a higher-tuned 5.0-litre supercharged V8. Finally a supercharged 3.0-litre V6 engine completes the line-up. All models are rear-wheel-drive mated with 8-speed automatic gearboxes. Features include an aluminium body, air suspension, "Adaptive Dynamics" continuously-variable damping, adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, "Active Differential Control" and quick-ratio power steering. Customers can have their choice in colours, veneers and leathers. Inside the car, there is a 12.3-inch LCD with virtual Instruments, Dual-View 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, optional 1200W Bowers & Wilkins system, hard drive and connectivity for portable audio and video devices via a "Media Hub." Other available features include a panoramic glass roof, power accessories, automatic climate control, electric seats with ventilation, turning headlights and more. Safety features include front, side and curtain airbags, stability control, ABS, pre-charged braking technology, blind-spot monitoring, tyre pressure monitor and more. The V6 is available in regular or long-wheelbase form, while the V8 is only available in long-wheelbase form, with regular-wheelbase models available upon request.

The Suzuki Carry is the Japanese brand's commercial pick-up offering. It is designed in Japan but assembled in Indonesia to keep costs low. It gets a 1.6-litre 4-cylinder engine, mated to a 5-speed manual transmission. Basic options include power steering, radio with CD player, fabric seats, air-conditioning and steel wheels.
